e.en: The {CAA} regulates civil aviation safety across the country.
e.zh: 民航局负责监管全国的民用航空安全。

e.en: Pilots must follow {CAA} guidelines before every flight.
e.zh: 飞行员每次飞行前都必须遵守民航局的规定。

e.en: I caught a {cab} from the airport to the hotel.
e.zh: 我从机场打了辆出租车去酒店。

e.en: The truck driver climbed into the {cab} and started the engine.
e.zh: 卡车司机爬进驾驶室发动了引擎。

e.en: A small {cabal} of executives secretly controlled the company.
e.zh: 一小撮高管暗中操控着这家公司。

e.en: Reporters uncovered a political {cabal} plotting against the mayor.
e.zh: 记者揭露了一个密谋反对市长的政治小集团。

e.en: The diary was filled with {cabalistic} symbols nobody could decode.
e.zh: 那本日记里满是无人能解的神秘符号。

e.en: He muttered {cabalistic} phrases as he stirred the potion.
e.zh: 他一边搅拌药水一边念着神秘的咒语。

e.en: The Spanish {caballero} rode proudly through the dusty plaza.
e.zh: 那位西班牙绅士骑马威风地穿过尘土飞扬的广场。

e.en: She danced with a charming {caballero} at the fiesta.
e.zh: 她在节庆上和一位迷人的西班牙骑士共舞。

e.en: We rented a beach {cabana} for shade by the pool.
e.zh: 我们在泳池边租了一间海滩小屋遮阳。

e.en: The hotel's private {cabana} included drinks and snacks.
e.zh: 酒店的私人海滩小屋还附送饮料和小吃。

e.en: They watched a lively {cabaret} show in downtown Berlin.
e.zh: 他们在柏林市中心看了一场热闹的歌舞表演。

e.en: The singer started her career in a smoky Paris {cabaret}.
e.zh: 这位歌手的事业起步于巴黎一家烟雾缭绕的歌舞夜总会。

e.en: She chopped the {cabbage} finely for the salad.
e.zh: 她把卷心菜切碎做沙拉。

e.en: Pickled {cabbage} is a staple in many Korean meals.
e.zh: 腌制的卷心菜是许多韩餐的主食。

e.en: The farmer harvested rows of fresh {cabbages} this morning.
e.zh: 农夫今早收获了一排排新鲜的卷心菜。

e.en: Rabbits keep eating the {cabbages} in our garden.
e.zh: 兔子总在啃我们花园里的卷心菜。

e.en: The friendly {cabbie} gave us a tour of the city.
e.zh: 那位友善的出租车司机带我们游览了这座城市。

e.en: A New York {cabbie} knows every shortcut in Manhattan.
e.zh: 纽约的出租车司机熟悉曼哈顿的每条捷径。

e.en: The {cabby} honked impatiently at the slow pedestrian.
e.zh: 那位出租车司机不耐烦地朝慢吞吞的行人按喇叭。

e.en: An old London {cabby} shared stories from decades on the road.
e.zh: 一位伦敦老出租车司机分享了他几十年开车的故事。

e.en: The {cabdriver} dropped me off right at my doorstep.
e.zh: 出租车司机把我直接送到了家门口。

e.en: She tipped the {cabdriver} generously for the smooth ride.
e.zh: 她因为乘车顺利,给出租车司机付了不少小费。

caber.t: n. 苏格兰掷木杆比赛用的长木

e.en: He tossed the {caber} cleanly at the Highland Games.
e.zh: 他在高地运动会上干净利落地抛出了木杆。

e.en: Tossing the {caber} requires both strength and balance.
e.zh: 抛掷木杆既需要力量也需要平衡。

cabernet.t: n. 赤霞珠（葡萄酒品种）

e.en: She poured a glass of {cabernet} with dinner.
e.zh: 她在晚餐时倒了一杯赤霞珠红酒。

e.en: This vineyard produces an award-winning {cabernet} every year.
e.zh: 这家酒庄每年都酿出获奖的赤霞珠葡萄酒。

e.en: We rented a cozy {cabin} in the woods for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们周末在林中租了一间温馨的小木屋。

e.en: Please return to your seat when the {cabin} crew signals.
e.zh: 请在客舱乘务员示意时回到座位。

e.en: She stored the spices in the kitchen {cabinet}.
e.zh: 她把香料放在厨房橱柜里。

e.en: The prime minister announced a new {cabinet} this morning.
e.zh: 首相今早宣布了新的内阁名单。

e.en: A skilled {cabinetmaker} built the bookshelves by hand.
e.zh: 一位熟练的家具木匠手工打造了这些书架。

e.en: Her grandfather was a {cabinetmaker} known for fine joinery.
e.zh: 她的祖父是一位以精湛榫卯工艺闻名的家具木匠。

cabinetry.t: n. 橱柜制品；细木工艺

e.en: The kitchen features custom {cabinetry} made of solid oak.
e.zh: 这间厨房配有橡木实木定制橱柜。

e.en: Beautiful {cabinetry} can dramatically raise a home's value.
e.zh: 精美的橱柜能显著提升房屋的价值。

e.en: They installed white {cabinets} throughout the new kitchen.
e.zh: 他们在新厨房里全部安装了白色橱柜。

e.en: The lab keeps chemicals locked in steel {cabinets}.
e.zh: 实验室把化学品锁在钢制柜子里。

e.en: The resort offers lakefront {cabins} for summer guests.
e.zh: 度假村为夏季客人提供湖畔小木屋。

e.en: All the {cabins} on the cruise ship have ocean views.
e.zh: 邮轮上所有的客舱都有海景。

cable.t:
n. 电缆；缆绳
n. 有线电视

e.en: Plug the USB {cable} into the back of the monitor.
e.zh: 把USB线插到显示器的背面。

e.en: Many viewers have dropped {cable} TV for streaming services.
e.zh: 许多观众已经放弃有线电视,改用流媒体服务。

e.en: He sent a brief {cablegram} announcing his safe arrival.
e.zh: 他发了一封简短的电报,宣布他平安抵达。

e.en: Before email, businesses relied on the {cablegram} for urgent news.
e.zh: 在电子邮件出现前,企业靠电报传递紧急消息。

e.en: Tangled {cables} behind the desk are driving me crazy.
e.zh: 桌子后面缠成一团的线快把我逼疯了。

e.en: Suspension bridge {cables} support enormous loads every day.
e.zh: 悬索桥的钢缆每天承受着巨大的载荷。

e.en: The IT team finished the network {cabling} over the weekend.
e.zh: IT团队在周末完成了网络布线。

e.en: Hidden {cabling} keeps the office looking clean and modern.
e.zh: 隐蔽布线让办公室看起来整洁现代。

e.en: The ring features a polished {cabochon} of deep blue sapphire.
e.zh: 这枚戒指镶有一颗抛光的深蓝色蓝宝石凸面。

e.en: Jewelers cut opaque stones as a {cabochon} rather than faceted.
e.zh: 珠宝匠把不透明宝石切成弧面而不是刻面。

e.en: She packed her clothes, books, and the whole {caboodle}.
e.zh: 她把衣服、书,还有所有家当统统打包带走。

e.en: He bought the kit and {caboodle} at the estate sale.
e.zh: 他在遗产拍卖会上把整套东西全买下来了。

caboose.t: n. 货车车尾的守车；船上厨房

e.en: The red {caboose} trailed at the end of the freight train.
e.zh: 红色的守车挂在货运列车的末尾。

e.en: Old photos show a {caboose} on every American freight train.
e.zh: 老照片显示当年每列美国货运列车都挂着守车。

e.en: John {Cabot} explored the coast of Newfoundland in 1497.
e.zh: 约翰·卡伯特于1497年探索了纽芬兰海岸。

e.en: The town of {Cabot}, Vermont is famous for its cheese.
e.zh: 佛蒙特州的卡伯特镇以奶酪闻名。

e.en: The Spanish word {cabra} simply means goat.
e.zh: 西班牙语单词cabra就是山羊的意思。

e.en: Locals raise the {cabra} for milk and cheese in the hills.
e.zh: 当地人在山间饲养山羊以获取牛奶和奶酪。

cabriolet.t: n. 敞篷汽车；单马小篷车

e.en: He drove a vintage {cabriolet} along the coastal road.
e.zh: 他开着一辆老式敞篷车沿着海岸公路行驶。

e.en: The new {cabriolet} model features a retractable hardtop.
e.zh: 这款新敞篷车配备了可收缩的硬顶。

e.en: Yellow {cabs} are a classic symbol of New York City.
e.zh: 黄色出租车是纽约市的经典象征。

e.en: Few {cabs} were available during the rainstorm last night.
e.zh: 昨晚暴雨期间几乎打不到出租车。

e.en: Dark chocolate is made from roasted {cacao} beans.
e.zh: 黑巧克力是用烘焙过的可可豆制成的。

e.en: Ghana exports large quantities of {cacao} every year.
e.zh: 加纳每年出口大量的可可豆。

e.en: The abbreviation {cach} sometimes appears in old shorthand notes.
e.zh: 缩写cach有时出现在旧式速记笔记中。

e.en: Researchers debated whether {cach} was a typo for cache.
e.zh: 研究人员争论cach是否是cache的笔误。

cache.t:
n. 缓存；隐藏处
v. 缓存；储藏

e.en: Clear your browser {cache} if the page won't load correctly.
e.zh: 如果页面无法正常加载,请清除浏览器缓存。

e.en: Hikers discovered a hidden {cache} of supplies in the cave.
e.zh: 徒步者在洞中发现了一处隐藏的物资储藏点。

e.en: Studying at Oxford carries enormous academic {cachet}.
e.zh: 在牛津求学具有极高的学术声望。

e.en: The boutique label has real {cachet} among young designers.
e.zh: 这个精品品牌在年轻设计师中颇有声望。

cacique.t: n. 印第安酋长；地方首领

e.en: The local {cacique} mediated disputes between neighboring villages.
e.zh: 当地酋长调解相邻村庄之间的纠纷。

e.en: A powerful political {cacique} controlled the region for decades.
e.zh: 一位强大的政治首领统治了这个地区几十年。

cackle.t:
v. 咯咯地笑；（母鸡）咯咯叫
n. 咯咯声

e.en: The witch let out a wicked {cackle} in the cartoon.
e.zh: 动画片里那女巫发出邪恶的咯咯笑声。

e.en: I could hear my aunts {cackle} from across the room.
e.zh: 我能听见姑姑们在房间另一头咯咯大笑。

cackling.t: v. 咯咯地笑（现在分词）

e.en: The hens were {cackling} loudly outside the henhouse.
e.zh: 母鸡在鸡舍外大声咯咯叫个不停。

e.en: She kept {cackling} at her own joke during dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时她一直为自己的笑话咯咯地笑。

e.en: Rush hour traffic produced a {cacophonous} blast of horns.
e.zh: 高峰时段的车流发出刺耳嘈杂的喇叭声。

e.en: The orchestra warming up sounded delightfully {cacophonous}.
e.zh: 乐团调音时听起来又乱又可爱。

cacophony.t: n. 刺耳的杂音；不协调

e.en: A {cacophony} of voices erupted when the verdict was announced.
e.zh: 宣布判决时,场内爆发出一片嘈杂的声音。

e.en: The market was a {cacophony} of vendors shouting prices.
e.zh: 市场里小贩们的叫价声乱作一团。

cacti.t: n. 仙人掌（cactus 的复数）

e.en: Tall {cacti} dotted the desert landscape under the sun.
e.zh: 阳光下沙漠中点缀着高大的仙人掌。

e.en: Many {cacti} can survive months without any water.
e.zh: 许多仙人掌可以数月不浇水也能存活。

e.en: Don't touch that {cactus} — its spines are very sharp.
e.zh: 别碰那株仙人掌,它的刺非常锋利。

e.en: She keeps a small {cactus} on her office desk.
e.zh: 她在办公桌上养了一盆小仙人掌。

cad.t:
n. 计算机辅助设计 (computer-aided design)
n. 无赖

e.en: Everyone agreed her ex-boyfriend was a complete {cad}.
e.zh: 大家都觉得她的前男友是个十足的混蛋。

e.en: The novel's villain is a charming but heartless {cad}.
e.zh: 小说中的反派是个迷人却冷酷的无赖。

e.en: Medical students studied a preserved {cadaver} during anatomy class.
e.zh: 医学生在解剖课上研究一具保存好的尸体。

e.en: The forensic team examined the {cadaver} for clues.
e.zh: 法医团队检查尸体寻找线索。

e.en: Doctors noted {cadaveric} rigidity setting in within hours.
e.zh: 医生注意到尸僵在数小时内开始出现。

e.en: The transplant used a {cadaveric} kidney from a donor.
e.zh: 这次移植使用的是来自捐献者的尸体肾脏。

cadaverous.t: adj. 面色死灰的；瘦削苍白的

e.en: His {cadaverous} face shocked the doctors during the examination.
e.zh: 他那张苍白如尸的脸让医生们大为震惊。

e.en: The actor lost weight to achieve a {cadaverous} look.
e.zh: 演员为塑造形似死尸的形象减了不少体重。

cadbury.t: n. 吉百利（英国巧克力品牌）

e.en: She bought a {Cadbury} chocolate bar at the airport.
e.zh: 她在机场买了一块吉百利巧克力。

e.en: {Cadbury} eggs appear in stores every Easter season.
e.zh: 每到复活节,吉百利彩蛋就会摆上货架。

caddie.t:
n. 高尔夫球童
v. 为高尔夫球手背球包

e.en: The golfer tipped his {caddie} after the tournament.
e.zh: 高尔夫选手在比赛结束后给球童小费。

e.en: A good {caddie} knows every yard of the course.
e.zh: 一个好的球童对球场每一码都了如指掌。

e.en: Trout often feed on {caddis} larvae in the stream.
e.zh: 鳟鱼常以溪流中的石蛾幼虫为食。

e.en: The fly fisherman tied a {caddis} imitation last night.
e.zh: 飞钓爱好者昨晚绑了一只仿石蛾鱼饵。

caddy.t:
n. 茶叶罐；收纳盒
n. 球童

e.en: She stores loose tea leaves in a metal {caddy}.
e.zh: 她把散装茶叶存放在一个金属茶叶罐里。

e.en: The shower {caddy} keeps all our toiletries organized.
e.zh: 淋浴置物架把我们的洗漱用品收纳得井井有条。

e.en: The shepherd raised the orphaned lamb as a {cade}.
e.zh: 牧羊人把那只孤儿羊当成宠物羊养大。

e.en: {Cade} oil comes from a Mediterranean juniper tree.
e.zh: 刺柏油提取自一种地中海地区的桧树。

cadence.t:
n. 节奏；韵律
n. 语调抑扬

e.en: The drill sergeant called {cadence} as the soldiers marched.
e.zh: 教官在士兵行进时喊着口令节奏。

e.en: Her speech had a soothing, melodic {cadence}.
e.zh: 她说话的语调抑扬顿挫,听来让人放松。

cadenced.t: adj. 有节奏的；抑扬顿挫的

e.en: The poet read his lines in a slow, {cadenced} voice.
e.zh: 诗人以缓慢而有韵律的声音朗读诗句。

e.en: Their {cadenced} footsteps echoed through the empty hall.
e.zh: 他们富有节奏的脚步声在空荡的大厅里回响。

cadenza.t: n. 华彩乐段（独奏炫技段落）

e.en: The pianist improvised a brilliant {cadenza} near the finale.
e.zh: 钢琴家在终曲前即兴演奏了一段精彩的华彩段。

e.en: Mozart wrote a famous {cadenza} for this concerto.
e.zh: 莫扎特为这首协奏曲写了一段著名的华彩乐段。

cadet.t: n. 军校学员；警校学员

e.en: The {cadet} saluted his commanding officer sharply.
e.zh: 那名军校学员向长官敬了个利落的礼。

e.en: My brother enrolled as a {cadet} at West Point.
e.zh: 我哥哥进入西点军校成为一名学员。

e.en: He tried to {cadge} a cigarette from a stranger.
e.zh: 他想向一个陌生人讨根香烟。

e.en: She always manages to {cadge} a free meal somewhere.
e.zh: 她总能想办法在哪儿蹭到一顿免费的饭。

cadillac.t: n. 凯迪拉克（汽车品牌）

e.en: He drives a vintage {Cadillac} from the 1950s.
e.zh: 他开着一辆1950年代的老款凯迪拉克。

e.en: This software is the {Cadillac} of design tools.
e.zh: 这款软件堪称设计工具中的顶级之选。

cadiz.t: n. 加的斯（西班牙港市）

e.en: We spent a week exploring the old town of {Cadiz}.
e.zh: 我们在加的斯老城区游玩了一个星期。

e.en: {Cadiz} is one of the oldest cities in Western Europe.
e.zh: 加的斯是西欧最古老的城市之一。

cadmium.t: n. 镉（金属元素，符号 Cd）

e.en: The factory was fined for releasing {cadmium} into the river.
e.zh: 那家工厂因向河中排放镉而被罚款。

e.en: Old paints often contain toxic {cadmium} pigments.
e.zh: 旧颜料中常含有有毒的镉颜料。

cadmus.t: n. 卡德摩斯（希腊神话底比斯城创建者）

e.en: In Greek myth, {Cadmus} founded the city of Thebes.
e.zh: 希腊神话中,卡德摩斯建立了底比斯城。

e.en: {Cadmus} is said to have introduced the alphabet to Greece.
e.zh: 据说卡德摩斯将字母表引入了希腊。

cadogan.t: n. 卡多根（英国姓氏/地名）

e.en: She lives near {Cadogan} Square in central London.
e.zh: 她住在伦敦市中心卡多根广场附近。

e.en: The {Cadogan} estate owns much of Chelsea.
e.zh: 卡多根家族拥有切尔西区的大片地产。

cadre.t:
n. 骨干；核心成员
n. 干部

e.en: A small {cadre} of engineers built the original prototype.
e.zh: 一小批核心工程师打造了最初的原型机。

e.en: The party trained a new {cadre} of young leaders.
e.zh: 该党培养了一批新的年轻干部。

cae.t: n. 计算机辅助工程 (computer-aided engineering)

e.en: Many universities accept the {CAE} as proof of English ability.
e.zh: 许多大学接受CAE考试作为英语能力的证明。

e.en: She is studying hard to pass the {CAE} next month.
e.zh: 她正在努力学习,准备下个月通过CAE考试。

e.en: The appendix branches off from the {caecum} in humans.
e.zh: 人类的阑尾是从盲肠分出的一段结构。

e.en: Rabbits have a large {caecum} for digesting plant fiber.
e.zh: 兔子有一个较大的盲肠用于消化植物纤维。

e.en: We visited the war memorial in {Caen} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们参观了卡昂的战争纪念馆。

e.en: {Caen} suffered heavy damage during World War Two.
e.zh: 卡昂在二战期间遭受了严重的破坏。

caernarfon.t: n. 卡那封（威尔士城市）

e.en: Tourists flock to {Caernarfon} Castle every summer.
e.zh: 每年夏天游客都涌向卡那封城堡。

e.en: The Prince of Wales was invested at {Caernarfon} in 1969.
e.zh: 威尔士亲王于1969年在卡那封举行册封仪式。

caernarvon.t: n. 卡那封（Caernarfon 的旧拼写）

e.en: {Caernarvon} is the older English spelling of the Welsh town.
e.zh: Caernarvon是这座威尔士小镇较旧的英文拼写。

e.en: My grandmother grew up near {Caernarvon} in north Wales.
e.zh: 我祖母在北威尔士的卡那封附近长大。

caerphilly.t: n. 卡尔菲利（威尔士地名；同名奶酪）

e.en: I bought some {Caerphilly} cheese at the farmers' market.
e.zh: 我在农夫市集买了一些卡尔菲利奶酪。

e.en: {Caerphilly} Castle is one of the largest in Britain.
e.zh: 卡尔菲利城堡是英国最大的城堡之一。

caerulein.t: n. 雨蛙素（一种多肽激素）

e.en: Researchers used {caerulein} to stimulate digestive secretions in rats.
e.zh: 研究人员用蛙皮缩胆囊肽刺激大鼠的消化液分泌。

e.en: {Caerulein} can induce experimental pancreatitis in animal studies.
e.zh: 在动物实验中,蛙皮缩胆囊肽可诱发胰腺炎。

caesar.t:
n. 凯撒（罗马统治者头衔）
n. 凯撒沙拉

e.en: Julius {Caesar} crossed the Rubicon in 49 BC.
e.zh: 尤利乌斯·凯撒于公元前49年渡过卢比孔河。

e.en: I'd like a {Caesar} salad with grilled chicken, please.
e.zh: 请给我来一份配烤鸡的凯撒沙拉。

caesarean.t:
n. 剖腹产
adj. 凯撒的

e.en: The doctor performed an emergency {Caesarean} to save the baby.
e.zh: 医生紧急实施了剖腹产以挽救婴儿。

e.en: She delivered her twins by {Caesarean} section last week.
e.zh: 她上周通过剖腹产生下了双胞胎。

caesarian.t: n. 剖腹产（Caesarean 的变体）

e.en: Her first child was born by {Caesarian} section.
e.zh: 她的第一个孩子是通过剖腹产出生的。

e.en: Recovery from a {Caesarian} usually takes several weeks.
e.zh: 剖腹产后的恢复通常需要数周时间。

caesars.t: n. 凯撒（Caesar 的复数/所有格）

e.en: We stayed at {Caesars} Palace during our trip to Vegas.
e.zh: 我们去拉斯维加斯时住在凯撒皇宫酒店。

e.en: The Roman {Caesars} ruled an empire spanning three continents.
e.zh: 罗马的凯撒们统治着横跨三大洲的帝国。

caesium.t: n. 铯（金属元素，符号 Cs）

e.en: Atomic clocks measure time using {caesium} atoms.
e.zh: 原子钟利用铯原子来测量时间。

e.en: {Caesium} reacts violently when it touches water.
e.zh: 铯遇水会发生剧烈反应。

caesura.t: n. 诗行中的停顿；间断

e.en: The poem features a strong {caesura} in the middle line.
e.zh: 这首诗在诗行中间有一处明显的停顿。

e.en: A well-placed {caesura} can add drama to a verse.
e.zh: 恰到好处的停顿可以为诗句增添戏剧张力。

e.en: We met at a small {cafe} near the train station.
e.zh: 我们约在火车站附近的一家小咖啡馆见面。

e.en: The {cafe} serves the best croissants in town.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆做的牛角包是全城最好的。

e.en: Students grabbed lunch at the school {cafeteria} between classes.
e.zh: 学生们课间在学校食堂吃午饭。

e.en: The hospital {cafeteria} stays open until midnight.
e.zh: 医院的自助餐厅一直营业到午夜。

e.en: Most office {cafeterias} now offer vegan options daily.
e.zh: 如今大多数办公楼餐厅每天都提供纯素菜品。

e.en: University {cafeterias} were packed during the lunch rush.
e.zh: 午餐高峰期,大学的食堂里挤满了人。

e.en: I need to {caffeinate} before joining the morning meeting.
e.zh: 我得先来杯咖啡提提神,再去参加早会。

e.en: Some teas {caffeinate} you just as much as coffee.
e.zh: 有些茶提神效果丝毫不逊于咖啡。

e.en: He prefers heavily {caffeinated} drinks during long study sessions.
e.zh: 他在长时间学习时喜欢喝高咖啡因的饮料。

e.en: She switched from {caffeinated} coffee to herbal tea.
e.zh: 她从含咖啡因的咖啡改喝草本茶了。

caffeinates.t: v. 使含咖啡因（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {caffeinates} himself every morning before work.
e.zh: 他每天上班前都要先喝咖啡提神。

e.en: Green tea {caffeinates} you more gently than espresso.
e.zh: 绿茶比浓缩咖啡的提神效果要温和得多。

caffeinating.t: v. 使含咖啡因（现在分词）

e.en: She spent the morning {caffeinating} and answering emails.
e.zh: 她整个上午都在喝咖啡提神并回复邮件。

e.en: {Caffeinating} too late at night ruins my sleep.
e.zh: 晚上喝咖啡太晚会让我睡不好觉。

e.en: Too much {caffeine} can give you a headache.
e.zh: 摄入过多咖啡因会让你头痛。

e.en: This decaf coffee contains almost no {caffeine}.
e.zh: 这种低因咖啡几乎不含咖啡因。

caftan.t: n. 卡夫坦长袍（中东宽松长袍）

e.en: She wore a flowing silk {caftan} to the beach party.
e.zh: 她穿着一件飘逸的丝绸长袍去参加海滩派对。

e.en: The boutique sells handmade {caftan} dresses from Morocco.
e.zh: 这家精品店售卖来自摩洛哥的手工长袍。

cage.t:
n. 笼子
v. 关进笼中

e.en: The parrot escaped from its {cage} again this morning.
e.zh: 那只鹦鹉今天早上又从笼子里逃出来了。

e.en: Zoos are moving away from small {cage} enclosures.
e.zh: 动物园正在逐步淘汰小型笼舍。

caged.t:
adj. 被关在笼中的
v. 关入笼中（过去式）

e.en: She felt {caged} in her dead-end office job.
e.zh: 在那份毫无前景的办公室工作里,她觉得自己像被困住了一样。

e.en: The activists protested against {caged} egg farming practices.
e.zh: 活动人士抗议笼养鸡蛋的养殖方式。

cages.t:
n. 笼子（复数）
v. 关进笼中（第三人称单数）

e.en: The shelter has dozens of {cages} for rescued animals.
e.zh: 这家收容所有几十个笼子用来安置救助的动物。

e.en: Batting {cages} are open until ten on weekends.
e.zh: 打击练习场周末营业至晚上十点。

cagey.t: adj. 守口如瓶的；谨慎的

e.en: The senator was {cagey} about his future plans.
e.zh: 那位参议员对未来的计划讳莫如深。

e.en: He gave a {cagey} answer to avoid revealing details.
e.zh: 他给了个含糊其辞的回答,以免透露细节。

cagily.t: adv. 谨慎地；含糊其辞地

e.en: She {cagily} avoided naming the company in question.
e.zh: 她小心翼翼地避开了点名涉事的那家公司。

e.en: The witness {cagily} sidestepped every direct question.
e.zh: 那位证人对每个直接的问题都谨慎地绕开了。

cagliari.t: n. 卡利亚里（意大利撒丁岛城市）

e.en: We flew into {Cagliari} for our Sardinian holiday.
e.zh: 我们坐飞机到卡利亚里开始撒丁岛的假期。

e.en: {Cagliari} is the largest city on the island of Sardinia.
e.zh: 卡利亚里是撒丁岛上最大的城市。

cagoule.t: n. 轻便连帽防风雨衣

e.en: Pack a lightweight {cagoule} in case it rains on the hike.
e.zh: 徒步时记得带件轻便的防风雨衣以防下雨。

e.en: He pulled the {cagoule} hood over his head.
e.zh: 他把防风雨衣的帽子拉上盖住了头。

e.en: The artist sketched ideas in a small leather {cahier}.
e.zh: 那位艺术家在一本小巧的皮面笔记本里勾画想法。

e.en: Each student received a blank {cahier} on the first day.
e.zh: 每个学生在开学第一天都领到了一本空白笔记本。

cahoot.t: n. 串通，勾结（多用 in cahoots）

e.en: The two thieves were in {cahoot} with a corrupt guard.
e.zh: 那两个小偷与一名腐败的警卫狼狈为奸。

e.en: Investigators believe the suppliers acted in {cahoot} together.
e.zh: 调查人员认为这些供应商之间互相串通。

caiman.t: n. 凯门鳄（中南美鳄类）

e.en: A {caiman} lurked silently along the riverbank.
e.zh: 一只凯门鳄静静地潜伏在河岸边。

e.en: The Amazon is home to several species of {caiman}.
e.zh: 亚马逊地区栖息着多种凯门鳄。

e.en: In the Bible, {Cain} killed his brother Abel out of jealousy.
e.zh: 《圣经》中,该隐出于嫉妒杀害了弟弟亚伯。

e.en: The rowdy kids raised {Cain} all afternoon.
e.zh: 那群淘气的孩子吵吵嚷嚷地闹腾了一下午。

caique.t:
n. 地中海小帆船
n. 凯克鹦鹉

e.en: A bright {caique} parrot perched on her shoulder during the show.
e.zh: 一只色彩鲜艳的凯克鹦鹉在表演时停在她肩上。

e.en: Fishermen rowed a small wooden {caique} across the harbor.
e.zh: 渔民们划着一艘小木船穿过港口。

e.en: Hikers stacked stones to build a {cairn} at the summit.
e.zh: 徒步者在山顶堆起石头筑成一座石冢。

e.en: Follow the trail of {cairn} markers across the foggy ridge.
e.zh: 沿着雾蒙蒙山脊上的石堆路标前进。

e.en: Frances {Cairncross} wrote influential books on environmental economics.
e.zh: 弗朗西丝·凯恩克罗斯撰写了多部有影响力的环境经济学著作。

e.en: The {Cairncross} report shaped policy on local journalism funding.
e.zh: 凯恩克罗斯报告影响了地方新闻业资金的政策。

e.en: She wore a brooch set with a smoky {cairngorm} stone.
e.zh: 她戴着一枚镶有烟晶石的胸针。

e.en: The kilt pin glinted with a polished {cairngorm} crystal.
e.zh: 苏格兰短裙别针上抛光的烟晶水晶闪闪发亮。

cairngorms.t: n. 凯恩戈姆山脉（苏格兰）

e.en: We hiked through the {Cairngorms} National Park last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们徒步穿越了凯恩戈姆国家公园。

e.en: Snow lingers in the {Cairngorms} well into late spring.
e.zh: 凯恩戈姆山脉的积雪一直能持续到晚春。

cairns.t: n. 凯恩斯（澳大利亚城市）

e.en: We flew to {Cairns} to dive the Great Barrier Reef.
e.zh: 我们飞到凯恩斯去潜水探访大堡礁。

e.en: Several {cairns} marked the path along the misty ridge.
e.zh: 几座石堆标示着雾气弥漫山脊上的路径。

e.en: The flight to {Cairo} takes about four hours from Rome.
e.zh: 从罗马飞往开罗大约需要四小时。

e.en: Traffic in downtown {Cairo} can be overwhelming for tourists.
e.zh: 开罗市中心的交通常让游客难以招架。

e.en: Workers sank a steel {caisson} to build the bridge pier.
e.zh: 工人沉下一个钢制沉箱来建造桥墩。

e.en: A military {caisson} carried the flag-draped coffin slowly past.
e.zh: 一辆军用炮车缓缓载着覆盖国旗的灵柩驶过。

caithness.t: n. 凯斯内斯（苏格兰地区）

e.en: We drove north through {Caithness} to reach John o' Groats.
e.zh: 我们一路向北穿过凯思内斯抵达约翰岬。

e.en: The cliffs of {Caithness} are home to thousands of seabirds.
e.zh: 凯思内斯的悬崖上栖息着成千上万只海鸟。

cajole.t: v. 哄骗；甜言蜜语劝诱

e.en: He tried to {cajole} his sister into lending him money.
e.zh: 他想哄骗姐姐借钱给他。

e.en: Teachers often {cajole} reluctant students into joining group work.
e.zh: 老师常常哄着不情愿的学生参与小组活动。

cajolery.t: n. 花言巧语；甜言蜜语

e.en: No amount of {cajolery} could persuade the toddler to nap.
e.zh: 再多的哄劝也无法让那个幼儿乖乖午睡。

e.en: She got the deal through pure charm and clever {cajolery}.
e.zh: 她全靠魅力和巧妙的甜言蜜语谈成了这笔交易。

cajoling.t: v. 哄劝；讨好（cajole 的现在分词）

e.en: After much {cajoling}, he finally agreed to attend the wedding.
e.zh: 经过一番好言相劝,他终于答应出席婚礼。

e.en: She kept {cajoling} the cat out from under the bed.
e.zh: 她不停地哄着猫从床底下出来。

cajun.t:
n. 卡津人（美国路易斯安那法裔）
adj. 卡津风味的

e.en: We ordered spicy {Cajun} shrimp at the Louisiana restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在那家路易斯安那餐厅点了辛辣的卡真虾。

e.en: The band played lively {Cajun} music with fiddles and accordions.
e.zh: 乐队用小提琴和手风琴演奏着欢快的卡真音乐。

cake.t:
n. 蛋糕；饼
v. 结成硬块

e.en: She baked a chocolate {cake} for her son's birthday.
e.zh: 她为儿子的生日烤了一个巧克力蛋糕。

e.en: Setting up the new app was a piece of {cake}.
e.zh: 设置这个新应用简直是小菜一碟。

cakes.t:
n. 蛋糕（复数）
v. 结块（第三人称单数）

e.en: The bakery sells fresh {cakes} every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 那家面包店每周六早上都卖新鲜蛋糕。

e.en: Mom {cakes} the pan with butter before pouring the batter.
e.zh: 妈妈在倒面糊前会把烤盘抹上一层厚厚的黄油。

e.en: The final exam turned out to be a complete {cakewalk}.
e.zh: 期末考试结果简直就是小菜一碟。

e.en: Don't expect this project to be a {cakewalk}.
e.zh: 别指望这个项目会是件轻而易举的事。

cal.t: n. 卡路里（calorie 的缩写）

e.en: This salad has only 200 {cal} per serving.
e.zh: 这份沙拉每份只有200卡路里。

e.en: My friend studies engineering at {Cal} in Berkeley.
e.zh: 我朋友在伯克利的加州大学读工程。

e.en: He drank palm wine from a hollowed {calabash} gourd.
e.zh: 他从一个挖空的葫芦里喝着棕榈酒。

e.en: The market sold dried {calabash} bowls and ladles.
e.zh: 市场上有卖晒干的葫芦碗和水瓢。

calabria.t: n. 卡拉布里亚（意大利大区）

e.en: We spent a week exploring beaches in {Calabria}, southern Italy.
e.zh: 我们花了一周时间游览意大利南部卡拉布里亚的海滩。

e.en: {Calabria} is known for spicy nduja and ancient Greek ruins.
e.zh: 卡拉布里亚以辛辣的恩杜佳香肠和古希腊遗迹闻名。

calabrian.t:
adj. 卡拉布里亚的
n. 卡拉布里亚人

e.en: The pasta was tossed with fiery {Calabrian} chili oil.
e.zh: 这道意面拌上了火辣的卡拉布里亚辣椒油。

e.en: She traces her family roots to a small {Calabrian} village.
e.zh: 她的家族根源可追溯到一个卡拉布里亚的小村庄。

e.en: The shaded patio is filled with colorful {caladium} leaves.
e.zh: 阴凉的露台上摆满了色彩斑斓的彩叶芋。

e.en: She planted a pink {caladium} near the front door.
e.zh: 她在前门附近种了一株粉色的彩叶芋。

calais.t: n. 加莱（法国港口城市）

e.en: The ferry from Dover to {Calais} takes about ninety minutes.
e.zh: 从多佛到加来的渡轮大约需要九十分钟。

e.en: Refugees often gather in camps near {Calais} hoping to cross.
e.zh: 难民常聚集在加来附近的营地,希望能渡海过境。

e.en: We shared a plate of crispy fried {calamari} as appetizer.
e.zh: 我们分着吃了一盘酥脆的炸鱿鱼圈作为开胃菜。

e.en: Grilled {calamari} with lemon is my favorite Greek dish.
e.zh: 配柠檬的烤鱿鱼是我最爱的希腊菜。

calamine.t: n. 炉甘石（皮肤止痒剂）

e.en: Apply some {calamine} lotion to soothe the itchy rash.
e.zh: 涂点炉甘石洗剂可以缓解瘙痒的皮疹。

e.en: Pink {calamine} cream is a classic remedy for sunburn.
e.zh: 粉色的炉甘石乳膏是治晒伤的经典良方。

calamities.t: n. 灾难；灾祸（calamity 的复数）

e.en: The region has suffered repeated natural {calamities} this decade.
e.zh: 这个地区在这十年里接连遭受了多次自然灾害。

e.en: Insurance helps families recover from unexpected {calamities}.
e.zh: 保险帮助家庭从突如其来的灾难中恢复过来。

e.en: The decision had {calamitous} consequences for the entire company.
e.zh: 这个决定给整家公司带来了灾难性的后果。

e.en: A {calamitous} flood wiped out crops across the valley.
e.zh: 一场灾难性的洪水冲毁了整个山谷的庄稼。

e.en: The startup failed {calamitously} within just six months.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在短短六个月内就惨败收场。

e.en: Plans for the merger collapsed {calamitously} after the audit.
e.zh: 审计之后,合并计划灾难性地全面破产。

e.en: Losing the contract would be a real {calamity} for us.
e.zh: 失去这份合同对我们来说将是一场真正的灾难。

e.en: The earthquake was the worst {calamity} in living memory.
e.zh: 那场地震是人们记忆中最严重的灾难。

e.en: The garden thrives in the region's {calcareous} alkaline soil.
e.zh: 花园在当地富含钙质的碱性土壤中长势良好。

e.en: Coral reefs build massive {calcareous} structures over centuries.
e.zh: 珊瑚礁经过数百年形成了巨大的钙质结构。

e.en: The scan revealed early {calcification} in the patient's arteries.
e.zh: 扫描显示该患者动脉已出现早期钙化。

e.en: Excess {calcification} can cause kidney stones over time.
e.zh: 过度钙化会随着时间形成肾结石。

calcified.t:
adj. 钙化的
v. 使钙化（过去式）

e.en: Doctors found a small {calcified} nodule in his lung.
e.zh: 医生在他的肺部发现了一个小的钙化结节。

e.en: The company's culture had {calcified} into rigid bureaucracy.
e.zh: 这家公司的文化已僵化成刻板的官僚作风。

e.en: Old habits can {calcify} if you never challenge them.
e.zh: 旧习惯如果不去挑战,就会变得根深蒂固。

e.en: Soft tissues sometimes {calcify} after repeated injury.
e.zh: 软组织在反复受伤后有时会发生钙化。

e.en: The cave walls glittered with crystals of pure {calcite}.
e.zh: 洞壁上闪烁着纯净的方解石晶体。

e.en: Geologists identified the rock as a coarse-grained {calcite}.
e.zh: 地质学家鉴定这块岩石为粗粒方解石。

e.en: Doctors prescribed {calcitonin} to help slow her bone loss.
e.zh: 医生开了降钙素来帮助减缓她的骨质流失。

e.en: The thyroid gland releases {calcitonin} to regulate blood calcium.
e.zh: 甲状腺会分泌降钙素来调节血钙水平。

e.en: Drinking milk daily helps you get enough {calcium}.
e.zh: 每天喝牛奶有助于摄取足够的钙。

e.en: Older adults often need extra {calcium} for bone health.
e.zh: 年长者通常需要额外补钙以维护骨骼健康。

calculable.t: adj. 可计算的；可估量的

e.en: The risk is small but still easily {calculable}.
e.zh: 这种风险虽小,但仍然很容易计算出来。

e.en: Profit margins must be clearly {calculable} before approving deals.
e.zh: 在批准交易前,利润率必须能够清晰地计算出来。

e.en: Let me {calculate} the total cost including tax and shipping.
e.zh: 让我算一下含税和运费的总价。

e.en: Engineers {calculate} loads carefully when designing tall buildings.
e.zh: 工程师在设计高层建筑时会仔细计算荷载。

calculated.t:
adj. 精心算计的；蓄意的
v. 计算（过去式）

e.en: He took a {calculated} risk and invested in the startup.
e.zh: 他经过深思熟虑后冒险投资了这家初创公司。

e.en: The app {calculated} her commute time based on traffic data.
e.zh: 这个应用根据交通数据算出了她的通勤时间。

calculatedly.t: adv. 蓄意地；精心算计地

e.en: She spoke {calculatedly}, choosing every word with great care.
e.zh: 她说话经过精心算计,每个字都斟酌再三。

e.en: He {calculatedly} delayed the announcement until after the merger.
e.zh: 他有意算计着将公告推迟到合并完成之后。

calculates.t: v. 计算；估计（第三人称单数）

e.en: The app {calculates} your monthly expenses from bank transactions.
e.zh: 这款应用会根据银行交易记录计算你的月度开销。

e.en: She quickly {calculates} the tip in her head after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后她在脑子里飞快地算出小费。

calculating.t:
adj. 工于心计的
v. 计算（现在分词）

e.en: He gave her a cold, {calculating} look across the room.
e.zh: 他隔着房间冷冷地、带着算计地望着她。

e.en: I'm still {calculating} how much paint we'll need.
e.zh: 我还在算我们到底需要多少油漆。

calculatingly.t: adv. 精于算计地；处心积虑地

e.en: She smiled {calculatingly} before making her counter-offer.
e.zh: 她带着算计的笑容,然后提出了还价。

e.en: He glanced {calculatingly} at the rival team's lineup.
e.zh: 他带着盘算的目光扫了一眼对手队伍的阵容。

e.en: A quick {calculation} shows we're over budget this quarter.
e.zh: 简单一算就能看出我们这个季度超出了预算。

e.en: Her decision was based on cold political {calculation}.
e.zh: 她的决定建立在冷酷的政治算计之上。

e.en: My {calculations} suggest the trip will take about six hours.
e.zh: 我估算这趟行程大约需要六小时。

e.en: Engineers double-checked their {calculations} before pouring the concrete.
e.zh: 工程师在浇筑混凝土前再三核对了计算结果。

calculative.t: adj. 精于算计的；计算性的

e.en: His {calculative} approach to friendships made people uneasy.
e.zh: 他在友谊中精于算计的态度让人不安。

e.en: Investors prefer a {calculative} mindset over emotional decision-making.
e.zh: 投资者更欣赏精于盘算的思维,而不是感情用事。

e.en: I used a {calculator} to split the restaurant bill fairly.
e.zh: 我用计算器把餐厅账单公平地分摊好。

e.en: Most phones come with a built-in {calculator} app.
e.zh: 大多数手机都自带计算器应用。

e.en: Students aren't allowed to use {calculators} during this exam.
e.zh: 考生在本场考试中不允许使用计算器。

e.en: Online mortgage {calculators} estimate your monthly payments instantly.
e.zh: 在线房贷计算器能瞬间估算出你的月供金额。

calculus.t:
n. 微积分
n. 结石（医学）

e.en: She's struggling with {calculus} in her first college semester.
e.zh: 她大学第一学期就被微积分搞得焦头烂额。

e.en: The political {calculus} changed dramatically after the scandal broke.
e.zh: 丑闻爆出后,政治考量发生了剧烈变化。

calcutta.t: n. 加尔各答（印度城市）

e.en: My grandfather grew up in {Calcutta} during the 1940s.
e.zh: 我祖父在二十世纪四十年代的加尔各答长大。

e.en: Street food in {Calcutta} is cheap, spicy, and absolutely delicious.
e.zh: 加尔各答的街头小吃便宜、辛辣又非常美味。

e.en: The volcanic {caldera} now holds a deep blue lake.
e.zh: 那座火山口如今盛着一汪深蓝色的湖水。

e.en: Tourists hiked along the rim of the ancient {caldera}.
e.zh: 游客们沿着这座古老火山口的边缘徒步。

e.en: The witches stirred a bubbling {caldron} over the fire.
e.zh: 女巫们搅动着火上沸腾的大锅。

e.en: The city became a {caldron} of political tension.
e.zh: 这座城市成了政治紧张的大熔炉。

caledonia.t: n. 喀里多尼亚（苏格兰古称）

e.en: New {Caledonia} is a French territory in the Pacific.
e.zh: 新喀里多尼亚是法国在太平洋的一块领地。

e.en: Ancient Romans called northern Britain {Caledonia}.
e.zh: 古罗马人把英国北部称为喀里多尼亚。

caledonian.t: adj. 苏格兰的；喀里多尼亚的

e.en: He took the {Caledonian} sleeper train to Edinburgh.
e.zh: 他乘坐喀里多尼亚卧铺列车前往爱丁堡。

e.en: The pub hosted a lively {Caledonian} folk night.
e.zh: 那家酒吧举办了一场热闹的苏格兰民谣之夜。

e.en: Add the meeting to my {calendar} for Friday.
e.zh: 把这次会议加到我周五的日程上。

e.en: She hung a new {calendar} on the kitchen wall.
e.zh: 她在厨房墙上挂了一本新日历。

e.en: Different cultures use different {calendars} to track time.
e.zh: 不同文化使用不同的历法来记录时间。

e.en: Our {calendars} never seem to line up for lunch.
e.zh: 我们的日程总是约不上一起吃午饭。

calender.t:
n. 压光机
v. 用压光机碾压

e.en: The factory uses a {calender} to smooth the paper.
e.zh: 工厂用压光机把纸张压平。

e.en: The fabric passes through a heated {calender} for finishing.
e.zh: 布料经过加热的压光机进行后整理。

e.en: Astronomers solved the {calendrical} problem with leap years.
e.zh: 天文学家用闰年解决了历法上的难题。

e.en: The festival follows a strict {calendrical} cycle.
e.zh: 这个节日遵循严格的历法周期。

e.en: She rubbed {calendula} cream on the small burn.
e.zh: 她在小烫伤上涂了金盏花药膏。

e.en: Bright orange {calendula} flowers filled the garden.
e.zh: 鲜艳的橙色金盏花开满了花园。

calf.t:
n. 小牛；幼崽
n. 小腿肚

e.en: The newborn {calf} struggled to stand on wobbly legs.
e.zh: 刚出生的小牛颤巍巍地想要站起来。

e.en: He pulled a muscle in his left {calf} while running.
e.zh: 他跑步时拉伤了左小腿的肌肉。

e.en: The wallet was made of soft Italian {calfskin}.
e.zh: 这个钱包是用柔软的意大利小牛皮做的。

e.en: She admired the {calfskin} cover of the antique book.
e.zh: 她欣赏着那本古书的小牛皮封面。

calgary.t: n. 卡尔加里（加拿大城市）

e.en: {Calgary} hosts a famous rodeo every July.
e.zh: 卡尔加里每年七月都会举办著名的牛仔竞技节。

e.en: The flight to {Calgary} takes about four hours.
e.zh: 飞往卡尔加里的航班大约要四个小时。

caliban.t: n. 卡利班（《暴风雨》角色）

e.en: {Caliban} is a memorable character in Shakespeare's Tempest.
e.zh: 卡利班是莎士比亚《暴风雨》中令人难忘的角色。

e.en: The actor played {Caliban} with surprising tenderness.
e.zh: 那位演员把卡利班演得出人意料地温柔。

e.en: We need engineers of the highest {caliber} for this project.
e.zh: 这个项目需要最高水平的工程师。

e.en: The rifle uses a small {caliber} bullet.
e.zh: 这把步枪使用小口径子弹。

calibra.t: n. 卡利博（欧宝车型名）

e.en: He restored a vintage Vauxhall {Calibra} in his garage.
e.zh: 他在车库里修复了一辆老款沃克斯豪尔Calibra。

e.en: The {Calibra} was popular with European drivers in the 90s.
e.zh: Calibra在90年代深受欧洲司机喜爱。

e.en: You need to {calibrate} the sensor before each test.
e.zh: 每次测试前都需要校准传感器。

e.en: Managers must {calibrate} their feedback to each employee.
e.zh: 管理者必须根据每位员工调整反馈方式。

calibrated.t:
adj. 已校准的
v. 校准（过去式）

e.en: The thermometer is {calibrated} to medical-grade accuracy.
e.zh: 这支温度计校准到医用级别的精度。

e.en: Her response was carefully {calibrated} to avoid offense.
e.zh: 她的回应经过精心斟酌,以免冒犯他人。

e.en: The lab runs a daily {calibration} on every instrument.
e.zh: 实验室每天都会对每台仪器进行校准。

e.en: The model needs further {calibration} against real data.
e.zh: 该模型需要根据真实数据进一步校准。

e.en: Plug the {calibrator} into the device before measuring.
e.zh: 测量前先把校准器接到设备上。

e.en: Engineers use a digital {calibrator} for precise readings.
e.zh: 工程师使用数字校准器来获得精确读数。

calibre.t: n. 口径；水平（caliber 英式拼法）

e.en: The conference attracted speakers of international {calibre}.
e.zh: 这次大会吸引了国际水准的演讲者。

e.en: She uses {Calibre} to manage her ebook library.
e.zh: 她用Calibre来管理自己的电子书库。

caliche.t: n. 钙积层；硝酸盐矿土

e.en: The {caliche} layer made digging the foundation difficult.
e.zh: 钙质硬层让地基的挖掘工作变得困难。

e.en: Desert roads are often paved with crushed {caliche}.
e.zh: 沙漠公路常用碎钙结砾铺设。

calico.t:
n. 印花棉布
adj. 杂色的（花猫）

e.en: A {calico} cat curled up on the windowsill.
e.zh: 一只三色猫蜷缩在窗台上。

e.en: She sewed a dress from soft floral {calico}.
e.zh: 她用柔软的印花棉布做了一条裙子。

california.t: n. 加利福尼亚州（美国）

e.en: They moved to {California} for the tech jobs.
e.zh: 他们为了科技行业的工作搬到了加州。

e.en: {California} is famous for its beaches and wildfires.
e.zh: 加州以海滩和山火而闻名。

californian.t:
adj. 加州的
n. 加州人

e.en: He has a relaxed {Californian} accent.
e.zh: 他有一种慵懒的加州口音。

e.en: The wine has a distinctly {Californian} character.
e.zh: 这款葡萄酒带有鲜明的加州风格。

caligula.t: n. 卡利古拉（罗马皇帝）

e.en: {Caligula} is remembered as one of Rome's cruelest emperors.
e.zh: 卡利古拉被认为是罗马最残暴的皇帝之一。

e.en: Historians still debate the madness of {Caligula}.
e.zh: 史学家至今仍在争论卡利古拉是否真的疯了。

e.en: He used a digital {caliper} to measure the screw.
e.zh: 他用数显卡尺来测量螺丝。

e.en: The brake {caliper} needs replacing on the front wheel.
e.zh: 前轮的刹车卡钳需要更换。

e.en: Machinists rely on precision {calipers} every day.
e.zh: 机械师每天都离不开精密卡尺。

e.en: The mechanic inspected the brake {calipers} for wear.
e.zh: 修理工检查了刹车卡钳的磨损情况。

caliph.t: n. 哈里发（伊斯兰领袖）

e.en: The {caliph} ruled from the great city of Baghdad.
e.zh: 这位哈里发在巴格达这座大城市统治。

e.en: A new {caliph} was chosen after lengthy debate.
e.zh: 经过漫长讨论后,新的哈里发被选出。

caliphate.t: n. 哈里发国；哈里发的统治

e.en: The Abbasid {caliphate} was a center of medieval learning.
e.zh: 阿拔斯王朝是中世纪学术的中心。

e.en: The {caliphate} stretched from Spain to Central Asia.
e.zh: 这个哈里发国从西班牙一直延伸到中亚。

e.en: He does {calisthenics} every morning in the park.
e.zh: 他每天早晨都在公园里做徒手健身。

e.en: {Calisthenics} requires no equipment beyond your body weight.
e.zh: 徒手训练只需要靠自身体重,不用任何器械。

call.t:
v. 打电话；称呼；呼喊
n. 通话；呼叫

e.en: Please {call} me when you land at the airport.
e.zh: 你到机场后请打电话给我。

e.en: The team has a stand-up {call} every morning at nine.
e.zh: 团队每天早上九点都有一个站会电话。

e.en: She carried a bouquet of white {calla} lilies.
e.zh: 她捧着一束白色的马蹄莲。

e.en: A single {calla} stood elegantly in the vase.
e.zh: 花瓶里优雅地插着一支马蹄莲。

callable.t: adj. 可调用的（函数）；可赎回的

e.en: In Python, any function is a {callable} object.
e.zh: 在Python中,任何函数都是可调用对象。

e.en: The bonds are {callable} after five years.
e.zh: 这些债券在五年后可被赎回。

callaloo.t: n. 加勒比菜汤；苋菜叶

e.en: Grandma's {callaloo} soup is the highlight of Sunday lunch.
e.zh: 奶奶的卡拉鲁汤是周日午餐的亮点。

e.en: {Callaloo} is a beloved Caribbean leafy green dish.
e.zh: 卡拉鲁是一道备受喜爱的加勒比绿叶菜。

e.en: We stopped for tea in the Scottish town of {Callander}.
e.zh: 我们在苏格兰小镇卡兰德停下来喝茶。

e.en: {Callander} sits at the edge of the Trossachs hills.
e.zh: 卡兰德坐落在特罗萨克斯山脉的边缘。

callback.t:
n. 回调函数
n. 回电

e.en: The actor was thrilled to get a {callback} for the role.
e.zh: 那位演员很高兴收到了这个角色的复试通知。

e.en: Pass a {callback} function to handle the response.
e.zh: 传入一个回调函数来处理响应。

e.en: The narrow {calle} was lined with tapas bars.
e.zh: 那条狭窄的小街两旁全是塔帕斯酒吧。

e.en: Her apartment is on a quiet {calle} in Madrid.
e.zh: 她的公寓在马德里一条安静的小街上。

called.t:
v. call 的过去式
adj. 名为…的

e.en: My grandfather {called} every Sunday without fail.
e.zh: 我爷爷每周日都雷打不动地打电话来。

e.en: The new app is {called} Lumen.
e.zh: 这款新应用叫做Lumen。

e.en: The {caller} hung up before I could answer.
e.zh: 我还没来得及接,来电的人就挂了。

e.en: An anonymous {caller} tipped off the police.
e.zh: 一名匿名来电者向警方提供了线索。

callers.t: n. 来电者们；调用方（复数）

e.en: Most {callers} were redirected to the support team.
e.zh: 大多数来电者被转接到了客服团队。

e.en: The radio show takes questions from {callers} live.
e.zh: 这档广播节目现场接听听众的问题。

e.en: A {calligrapher} hand-lettered each wedding invitation.
e.zh: 一位书法家亲手为每张婚礼请柬题字。

e.en: She studied for years to become a master {calligrapher}.
e.zh: 她苦练多年才成为一名书法大师。

calligraphic.t: adj. 书法的；书法风格的

e.en: The logo features a flowing {calligraphic} script.
e.zh: 这个标志采用了流畅的书法字体。

e.en: He admired the {calligraphic} brushwork of the scroll.
e.zh: 他欣赏卷轴上书法的笔触。

e.en: Chinese {calligraphy} is considered a high art form.
e.zh: 中国书法被视为一门高雅的艺术。

e.en: She takes a {calligraphy} class every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 她每周六上午都去上书法课。

calling.t:
n. 使命；职业
v. 呼叫（-ing 形式）

e.en: Teaching is more than a job — it's a {calling}.
e.zh: 教书不仅是一份工作,更是一种使命。

e.en: Stop {calling} me during my lunch break.
e.zh: 别在我午休时间打电话给我了。

calliope.t:
n. 汽笛风琴
n. 卡利俄佩（缪斯女神）

e.en: A steam {calliope} played as the carousel spun.
e.zh: 旋转木马转动时,蒸汽汽笛风琴奏响了乐曲。

e.en: The circus parade was led by a brightly painted {calliope}.
e.zh: 马戏团游行由一架彩绘鲜艳的汽笛风琴打头阵。

e.en: The engineer measured the part with a vernier {calliper}.
e.zh: 工程师用游标卡尺测量零件。

e.en: A worn brake {calliper} can cause uneven braking.
e.zh: 磨损的刹车卡钳会导致刹车不均。

e.en: His {callous} remarks upset everyone at the table.
e.zh: 他冷漠的话让在座所有人都不舒服。

e.en: It was a {callous} decision to fire her by email.
e.zh: 用邮件解雇她是个冷酷无情的决定。

calloused.t: adj. 长茧的；冷漠无情的

e.en: Years of guitar playing left his fingers {calloused}.
e.zh: 多年弹吉他让他的手指长满了老茧。

e.en: The farmer's {calloused} hands told a story of hard work.
e.zh: 那位农夫长满老茧的双手诉说着辛勤的故事。

e.en: He {callously} ignored the homeless man's plea.
e.zh: 他冷漠地无视那位流浪汉的请求。

e.en: The boss {callously} cut bonuses right before Christmas.
e.zh: 老板在圣诞节前夕冷酷地取消了奖金。

e.en: His {callousness} toward the victims shocked the jury.
e.zh: 他对受害者的冷漠让陪审团震惊。

e.en: The film exposes the {callousness} of corporate greed.
e.zh: 这部电影揭露了企业贪婪的冷酷无情。

callow.t: adj. 稚嫩的；缺乏经验的

e.en: He was a {callow} youth when he joined the army.
e.zh: 他参军时还是个不谙世事的青年。

e.en: Her {callow} optimism faded after the first setback.
e.zh: 她那种天真的乐观在第一次挫折后便消退了。

calls.t:
v. 呼叫；调用
n. 通话；调用

e.en: She {calls} her grandmother every Sunday afternoon.
e.zh: 她每个星期天下午都给奶奶打电话。

e.en: The job {calls} for patience and attention to detail.
e.zh: 这份工作需要耐心和对细节的关注。

e.en: Guitar players often develop a thick {callus} on their fingertips.
e.zh: 吉他手的指尖常常会长出厚厚的老茧。

e.en: The doctor trimmed the {callus} on her heel.
e.zh: 医生修剪了她脚跟上的硬皮。

calm.t:
adj. 平静的
v. 使平静

e.en: Try to stay {calm} during the job interview.
e.zh: 面试时尽量保持镇定。

e.en: The lake was perfectly {calm} at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时湖面十分平静。

calmed.t: v. calm 的过去式；平静下来

e.en: The mother {calmed} her crying baby with a lullaby.
e.zh: 母亲用摇篮曲哄哭闹的宝宝安静下来。

e.en: His voice {calmed} the nervous passengers on the plane.
e.zh: 他的声音让飞机上紧张的乘客平静下来。

calming.t:
adj. 令人平静的
v. 使平静（-ing）

e.en: Lavender has a {calming} effect on most people.
e.zh: 薰衣草对大多数人有舒缓作用。

e.en: She played {calming} music while studying for the exam.
e.zh: 她复习考试时放着舒缓的音乐。

e.en: He spoke {calmly} despite the chaos around him.
e.zh: 尽管周围一片混乱,他仍冷静地说话。

e.en: She {calmly} explained the situation to the police officer.
e.zh: 她冷静地向警官解释了情况。

e.en: His {calmness} under pressure impressed the entire team.
e.zh: 他在压力下的沉着令整个团队印象深刻。

e.en: There was a strange {calmness} before the storm hit.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前有种奇异的宁静。

calmnesses.t: n. calmness 的复数；多种平静状态

e.en: The poem describes the different {calmnesses} of the ocean.
e.zh: 这首诗描绘了海洋的种种平静状态。

e.en: She wrote about the small {calmnesses} found in daily life.
e.zh: 她写下了日常生活中那些细小的平静时刻。

e.en: Researchers study how {calmodulin} regulates calcium signaling in cells.
e.zh: 研究人员研究钙调蛋白如何调控细胞中的钙信号。

e.en: The protein {calmodulin} binds calcium ions inside living cells.
e.zh: 钙调蛋白这种蛋白质会在活细胞内结合钙离子。

calms.t:
v. 使平静
n. 平静（复数）

e.en: A warm cup of tea always {calms} my nerves.
e.zh: 一杯热茶总能让我的神经平静下来。

e.en: Deep breathing {calms} the mind before a presentation.
e.zh: 演讲前做深呼吸可以让心情平静。

e.en: Many rural homes still rely on {Calor} gas for cooking.
e.zh: 许多乡村住宅仍然依靠卡乐瓦斯做饭。

e.en: He bought a new {Calor} cylinder for the heater.
e.zh: 他为取暖器买了一个新的卡乐瓦斯钢瓶。

e.en: This snack has a high {caloric} content per serving.
e.zh: 这种零食每份的卡路里含量很高。

e.en: Athletes carefully track their daily {caloric} intake.
e.zh: 运动员会仔细记录每日的热量摄入。

e.en: Each cookie contains about ninety {calorie} units.
e.zh: 每块饼干大约含有九十卡路里。

e.en: She counts every {calorie} in her meals.
e.zh: 她对每餐摄入的每一卡路里都精打细算。

e.en: This salad has fewer {calories} than the burger.
e.zh: 这份沙拉的热量比汉堡低。

e.en: Running for an hour burns plenty of {calories}.
e.zh: 跑步一小时能消耗大量卡路里。

e.en: Coal has a higher {calorific} value than wood.
e.zh: 煤的热值比木材更高。

e.en: The scientist measured the {calorific} content of each fuel sample.
e.zh: 科学家测量了每个燃料样本的热值。

e.en: Students used a {calorimeter} to measure heat from the reaction.
e.zh: 学生用量热计测量反应释放的热量。

e.en: The lab purchased a new {calorimeter} for chemistry experiments.
e.zh: 实验室为化学实验购买了一台新的量热计。

e.en: {Calorimetry} helps scientists determine the energy in different foods.
e.zh: 量热法帮助科学家测定不同食物中的能量。

e.en: The class learned {calorimetry} techniques in their physics lab.
e.zh: 这个班在物理实验课上学习了量热法。

e.en: Each {calory} of energy adds up over the day.
e.zh: 每一卡路里的能量在一天中都会累积起来。

e.en: The label lists the {calory} count per serving.
e.zh: 标签上列出了每份的卡路里数。

e.en: It is wrong to {calumniate} a colleague behind their back.
e.zh: 在背后诽谤同事是不对的。

e.en: Rivals tried to {calumniate} the senator before the election.
e.zh: 竞争对手在选举前试图诋毁这位参议员。

e.en: The article was pure {calumny} and damaged her reputation.
e.zh: 那篇文章纯属诽谤,损害了她的名誉。

e.en: He sued the newspaper for spreading {calumny} about him.
e.zh: 他起诉那家报社散布对他的诽谤。

calvados.t: n. 卡尔瓦多斯苹果白兰地

e.en: They poured a small glass of {calvados} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后他们倒了一小杯卡尔瓦多斯苹果白兰地。

e.en: This Normandy farm produces excellent {calvados} from local apples.
e.zh: 诺曼底这家农场用当地苹果酿造出色的卡尔瓦多斯酒。

e.en: The painting depicts the scene at {Calvary} in vivid detail.
e.zh: 这幅画生动地描绘了各各他山上的场景。

e.en: Pilgrims walk the path leading up to {Calvary} every Easter.
e.zh: 每年复活节朝圣者都会走上通往各各他山的路。

e.en: Glaciers {calve} large icebergs into the sea each summer.
e.zh: 冰川每年夏天都会崩解出大块冰山落入海中。

e.en: The cow is expected to {calve} sometime next week.
e.zh: 这头母牛预计下周会产犊。

e.en: We stopped for lunch in the village of {Calver}.
e.zh: 我们在卡尔弗村停下来吃午饭。

e.en: The bridge at {Calver} crosses the River Derwent.
e.zh: 卡尔弗的桥跨越了德文特河。

e.en: The farmer raised six healthy {calves} this spring.
e.zh: 这位农夫今年春天养了六头健壮的小牛。

e.en: Her {calves} ached after the long mountain hike.
e.zh: 长途登山后她的小腿肚酸痛。

e.en: {Calvin} taught his cat to give high fives.
e.zh: 卡尔文教他的猫击掌。

e.en: The theologian John {Calvin} reshaped Protestant thought in the sixteenth century.
e.zh: 神学家约翰·加尔文重塑了十六世纪的新教思想。

e.en: The Antarctic ice shelf has been {calving} icebergs at alarming rates.
e.zh: 南极冰架正以惊人的速度崩解出冰山。

e.en: The cow began {calving} early in the morning.
e.zh: 母牛清晨就开始产犊了。

calvinism.t: n. 加尔文主义（基督教派）

e.en: {Calvinism} emphasizes predestination and the sovereignty of God.
e.zh: 加尔文主义强调预定论和上帝的主权。

e.en: The history class examined the spread of {Calvinism} across Europe.
e.zh: 这堂历史课探讨了加尔文主义在欧洲的传播。

calvinist.t:
n. 加尔文派信徒
adj. 加尔文派的

e.en: Her family belonged to a strict {Calvinist} congregation.
e.zh: 她的家人属于一个严格的加尔文派教会。

e.en: The {Calvinist} tradition has shaped Dutch culture for centuries.
e.zh: 加尔文派传统几个世纪以来塑造了荷兰文化。

e.en: His upbringing gave him a {Calvinistic} view of hard work.
e.zh: 他的成长经历让他对努力工作抱有加尔文派式的看法。

e.en: The novel explores a community with strong {Calvinistic} values.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了一个具有浓厚加尔文派价值观的社区。

calvo.t: (罕用) 西语姓氏或"秃头"之意

e.en: The diplomat Carlos {Calvo} influenced international law in Latin America.
e.zh: 外交官卡洛斯·卡尔沃影响了拉丁美洲的国际法。

e.en: Many Latin American treaties cite the {Calvo} doctrine on foreign investment.
e.zh: 许多拉美条约引用了关于外国投资的卡尔沃主义。

calypso.t: n. 卡利普索（加勒比音乐风格）

e.en: The band played upbeat {calypso} music all night long.
e.zh: 乐队整晚都演奏着欢快的卡里普索音乐。

e.en: He learned to dance {calypso} during his trip to Trinidad.
e.zh: 他在特立尼达旅行时学会了跳卡里普索舞。

e.en: The green {calyx} protects the flower bud before it opens.
e.zh: 绿色的花萼在花苞开放前保护着它。

e.en: Botanists examined the {calyx} of each blossom under a microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家用显微镜检查每朵花的花萼。

e.en: I ordered a spinach and ricotta {calzone} for lunch.
e.zh: 我午餐点了一个菠菜里科塔奶酪卷饼比萨。

e.en: This Italian restaurant makes the best {calzone} in town.
e.zh: 这家意大利餐厅做的卷饼比萨是城里最棒的。

cam.t:
n. 凸轮
n. 摄像头（camera 的缩写）

e.en: The security {cam} captured the entire incident clearly.
e.zh: 安全摄像头清晰地拍下了整个事件。

e.en: The engine {cam} controls when the valves open and close.
e.zh: 发动机的凸轮控制气门何时开启和关闭。

camaraderie.t: n. 同伴间的友情、默契

e.en: The team built strong {camaraderie} during the training camp.
e.zh: 团队在训练营中建立了深厚的友情。

e.en: There is wonderful {camaraderie} among the firefighters at this station.
e.zh: 这个消防站的消防员之间有着美好的同袍情谊。

camber.t: n. 路面或车轮的外倾角、拱面

e.en: The road has a slight {camber} to help water drain off.
e.zh: 这条路有轻微的拱形斜面以帮助排水。

e.en: Mechanics adjust the wheel {camber} to improve handling.
e.zh: 机械师调整车轮外倾角以改善操控。

e.en: {Camberley} is a town in Surrey known for its military academy.
e.zh: 坎伯利是萨里郡一个以皇家军事学院闻名的城镇。

e.en: The train from London to {Camberley} takes about an hour.
e.zh: 从伦敦到坎伯利的火车大约需要一小时。

camberwell.t: n. 坎伯韦尔（伦敦地区）

e.en: {Camberwell} is a vibrant neighborhood in south London.
e.zh: 坎伯韦尔是伦敦南部一个充满活力的街区。

e.en: She rented a small flat in {Camberwell} near the green.
e.zh: 她在坎伯韦尔绿地附近租了一间小公寓。

e.en: The {cambium} layer is responsible for a tree's growth in width.
e.zh: 形成层负责树木的横向生长。

e.en: Damage to the {cambium} can quickly kill a young tree.
e.zh: 形成层受损可能会迅速使幼树死亡。

e.en: {Cambodia} is famous for the ancient temples of Angkor Wat.
e.zh: 柬埔寨以吴哥窟的古老寺庙而闻名。

e.en: They spent two weeks traveling through {Cambodia} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天他们在柬埔寨旅行了两个星期。

cambodian.t:
adj. 柬埔寨的
n. 柬埔寨人

e.en: The restaurant serves authentic {Cambodian} curry and noodles.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应正宗的柬埔寨咖喱和面条。

e.en: She is studying the {Cambodian} language at university.
e.zh: 她在大学里学习柬埔寨语。

e.en: {Camborne} was once a major center of Cornish tin mining.
e.zh: 坎伯恩曾是康沃尔锡矿业的主要中心。

e.en: The annual Trevithick Day is celebrated in {Camborne} every April.
e.zh: 一年一度的特里维西克日每年四月在坎伯恩举行。

e.en: Many strange creatures first appeared during the {Cambrian} period.
e.zh: 许多奇异的生物最早出现在寒武纪时期。

e.en: Fossils from the {Cambrian} era reveal an explosion of life.
e.zh: 寒武纪时期的化石揭示了生命的大爆发。

cambric.t: n. 白色细麻布/细棉布

e.en: She made the baby's gown from soft white {cambric}.
e.zh: 她用柔软的白色细薄棉布做了婴儿的小礼服。

e.en: The old folk song mentions a shirt of fine {cambric}.
e.zh: 那首古老的民谣提到了一件精细薄棉布做的衬衫。

cambridge.t: n. 剑桥（英国城市/大学）

e.en: She studied physics at {Cambridge} for four years.
e.zh: 她在剑桥大学学习了四年物理。

e.en: {Cambridge} is famous for its historic colleges and punting on the river.
e.zh: 剑桥以其历史悠久的学院和河上撑篙而闻名。

e.en: {Cambridgeshire} is known for its flat landscape and rich farmland.
e.zh: 剑桥郡以其平坦的地形和肥沃的农田闻名。

e.en: The fens of {Cambridgeshire} attract many migrating birds in winter.
e.zh: 剑桥郡的沼泽冬天吸引许多候鸟。

e.en: He filmed his daughter's birthday party with an old {camcorder}.
e.zh: 他用一台旧摄像机拍下了女儿的生日派对。

e.en: Smartphone cameras have largely replaced the traditional {camcorder}.
e.zh: 智能手机摄像头已基本取代了传统的摄像机。

e.en: {Camden} Market is famous for vintage clothes and street food.
e.zh: 卡姆登市集以复古服装和街头小吃闻名。

e.en: They saw a great band play in {Camden} last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末他们在卡姆登看了一场很棒的乐队演出。

came.t: v. come 的过去式，来、到达

e.en: She {came} home late after the long meeting.
e.zh: 漫长的会议结束后,她很晚才回到家。

e.en: The package finally {came} in the mail this morning.
e.zh: 包裹今早终于通过邮件寄到了。

e.en: A {camel} can survive for days without drinking water.
e.zh: 骆驼能够数日不喝水也能存活。

e.en: Tourists rode a {camel} across the desert dunes at sunset.
e.zh: 游客们在日落时分骑骆驼穿越沙丘。

camelford.t: n. 卡梅尔福德（英国地名）

e.en: We stopped for lunch in {Camelford} on our way to Cornwall.
e.zh: 前往康沃尔的路上,我们在卡姆尔福德停下吃午饭。

e.en: {Camelford} is a small town known for its quiet countryside.
e.zh: 卡姆尔福德是一个以宁静乡村闻名的小镇。

e.en: The {camellia} in our garden blooms beautifully every spring.
e.zh: 我们花园里的山茶花每年春天都开得很美。

e.en: She picked a pink {camellia} and tucked it behind her ear.
e.zh: 她摘下一朵粉色山茶花,别在了耳后。

camelot.t: n. 卡美洛（亚瑟王传奇宫廷）

e.en: Legends about King Arthur's {Camelot} still fascinate readers today.
e.zh: 关于亚瑟王卡梅洛特的传说至今仍令读者着迷。

e.en: The film recreates {Camelot} with stunning medieval set design.
e.zh: 这部电影以惊艳的中世纪布景重现了卡梅洛特。

e.en: A caravan of {camels} crossed the dunes at dawn.
e.zh: 一支骆驼商队在黎明时分穿越沙丘。

e.en: {Camels} store fat in their humps, not water.
e.zh: 骆驼的驼峰里储存的是脂肪,而不是水。

e.en: We served warm {camembert} with crusty bread and grapes.
e.zh: 我们端上了温热的卡门贝奶酪,配脆皮面包和葡萄。

e.en: A wheel of {camembert} pairs nicely with a glass of cider.
e.zh: 一整轮卡门贝奶酪配一杯苹果酒非常美味。

cameo.t:
n. 客串演出
n. 浮雕饰品

e.en: The actor made a surprise {cameo} in the season finale.
e.zh: 这位演员在季终集中惊喜客串了一下。

e.en: She wore an antique {cameo} brooch inherited from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她戴着一枚祖母传下来的古董浮雕胸针。

e.en: My phone {camera} takes sharp photos even in low light.
e.zh: 我的手机摄像头在弱光下也能拍出清晰的照片。

e.en: He smiled directly at the {camera} during the interview.
e.zh: 采访时他直接对着镜头微笑。

e.en: The {cameraman} followed the protest march for several hours.
e.zh: 摄像师跟拍抗议游行队伍长达数小时。

e.en: A skilled {cameraman} can make any scene look cinematic.
e.zh: 一位熟练的摄像师能让任何场景都显得像电影画面。

e.en: Security {cameras} monitor every entrance to the building.
e.zh: 安全摄像头监控着大楼的每一个入口。

e.en: Modern phone {cameras} rival professional gear in many situations.
e.zh: 现代手机摄像头在许多场景下能媲美专业设备。

e.en: Critics praised the film's stunning {camerawork} and lighting.
e.zh: 影评人盛赞这部电影出色的摄影和灯光。

e.en: The documentary's shaky {camerawork} created a sense of urgency.
e.zh: 纪录片晃动的摄影手法营造出一种紧迫感。

e.en: {Cameroon} has both French- and English-speaking regions.
e.zh: 喀麦隆既有法语区也有英语区。

e.en: We watched {Cameroon} play in the World Cup last night.
e.zh: 我们昨晚观看了喀麦隆队的世界杯比赛。

cameroonian.t:
adj. 喀麦隆的
n. 喀麦隆人

e.en: The {Cameroonian} striker scored twice in the second half.
e.zh: 那位喀麦隆前锋在下半场打入两球。

e.en: We tried a delicious {Cameroonian} stew at the food festival.
e.zh: 我们在美食节上品尝了一道美味的喀麦隆炖菜。

cami.t: n. 吊带背心（camisole 的缩写）

e.en: She wore a silk {cami} under her blazer to the meeting.
e.zh: 她在西装外套里穿了一件丝质吊带衫去开会。

e.en: This lace {cami} works as both sleepwear and a layering piece.
e.zh: 这件蕾丝吊带衫既能当睡衣也能内搭。

e.en: She layered a black {camisole} under a sheer blouse.
e.zh: 她在透视衬衫里搭了一件黑色吊带背心。

e.en: The silk {camisole} felt cool against her skin in summer.
e.zh: 丝质吊带背心在夏天贴着皮肤感觉很凉爽。

camo.t: n. 迷彩图案（camouflage 的缩写）

e.en: He wore {camo} pants and a plain green tee to the trail.
e.zh: 他穿着迷彩裤和素色绿T恤去走步道。

e.en: {Camo} prints have become surprisingly popular in streetwear.
e.zh: 迷彩印花在街头服饰中意外地流行起来。

e.en: A cup of {camomile} tea helps me fall asleep at night.
e.zh: 一杯洋甘菊茶能帮我在夜里入睡。

e.en: She grows {camomile} in pots on her sunny balcony.
e.zh: 她在阳光充足的阳台上用花盆种洋甘菊。

camouflage.t:
n. 伪装、迷彩
v. 伪装、掩饰

e.en: Chameleons use {camouflage} to blend into their surroundings.
e.zh: 变色龙利用伪装融入周围环境。

e.en: The soldiers wore {camouflage} to move unseen through the forest.
e.zh: 士兵们身穿迷彩服,以便在森林中悄无声息地行动。

camouflaged.t:
adj. 经过伪装的
v. camouflage 的过去式

e.en: The hunter {camouflaged} his blind with branches and leaves.
e.zh: 猎人用树枝和树叶把伪装掩体藏了起来。

e.en: A {camouflaged} frog sat motionless on the mossy log.
e.zh: 一只伪装好的青蛙一动不动地蹲在长满苔藓的木头上。

camp.t:
n. 营地、阵营
v. 露营

e.en: We set up {camp} near the river before sunset.
e.zh: 我们在日落前在河边搭好了营地。

e.en: The kids will go to summer {camp} for two weeks.
e.zh: 孩子们要去参加为期两周的夏令营。

campaign.t:
n. 运动、战役
v. 发起运动

e.en: The {campaign} raised millions of dollars for cancer research.
e.zh: 这场活动为癌症研究筹集了数百万美元。

e.en: Her election {campaign} focused on affordable housing.
e.zh: 她的竞选活动主要关注经济适用房问题。

campaigned.t: v. campaign 的过去式，开展运动

e.en: Activists {campaigned} for stricter environmental laws all year.
e.zh: 活动人士整年都在为更严格的环保法律而奔走。

e.en: She {campaigned} tirelessly across the state before the election.
e.zh: 选举前她不知疲倦地在全州各地竞选拉票。

campaigner.t: n. 活动家、运动参与者

e.en: She is a lifelong {campaigner} for women's rights.
e.zh: 她毕生都是女性权利的倡导者。

e.en: The veteran {campaigner} gave a passionate speech at the rally.
e.zh: 那位资深活动家在集会上发表了激情澎湃的演讲。

campaigning.t:
v. 开展运动（现在分词）
n. 竞选活动

e.en: He spent the summer {campaigning} for the local mayor.
e.zh: 整个夏天他都在为当地市长竞选拉票。

e.en: The senator is {campaigning} hard in swing states this week.
e.zh: 这位参议员本周正在摇摆州大力开展竞选活动。

e.en: Modern political {campaigns} rely heavily on social media advertising.
e.zh: 现代政治竞选活动严重依赖社交媒体广告。

e.en: The brand runs seasonal {campaigns} to boost holiday sales.
e.zh: 该品牌通过季节性营销活动来提振节日销售。

e.en: The medieval {campanile} towered over the village square.
e.zh: 那座中世纪钟楼高耸于村庄广场之上。

e.en: Bells in the {campanile} rang every hour through the town.
e.zh: 钟楼里的钟每小时在小镇上空响起。

e.en: Blue {campanula} flowers lined the garden path in June.
e.zh: 六月的花园小径两旁开满了蓝色的风铃草。

e.en: She planted {campanula} along the stone wall last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天沿着石墙种了风铃草。

campari.t: n. 金巴利酒（意大利利口酒品牌）

e.en: He ordered a {Campari} and soda before dinner.
e.zh: 他在晚餐前点了一杯金巴利加苏打水。

e.en: A classic Negroni mixes gin, vermouth, and {Campari}.
e.zh: 经典的尼格罗尼鸡尾酒由金酒、味美思和金巴利调制而成。

e.en: Andy Warhol famously painted {Campbell} soup cans.
e.zh: 安迪·沃霍尔以画金宝汤罐头而闻名。

e.en: Mr. {Campbell} has taught history at our school for decades.
e.zh: 坎贝尔先生在我们学校教了几十年的历史。

e.en: Home brewers add {Campden} tablets to sterilize their wine.
e.zh: 自酿者会加入坎普登片来给葡萄酒消毒。

e.en: Chipping {Campden} is a charming village in the Cotswolds.
e.zh: 奇平卡姆登是科茨沃尔德地区一个迷人的村庄。

camped.t: v. 露营（camp 的过去式）

e.en: We {camped} beside the lake for three peaceful nights.
e.zh: 我们在湖边露营了三个宁静的夜晚。

e.en: Reporters {camped} outside the courthouse waiting for the verdict.
e.zh: 记者们守在法院外面,等待判决结果。

camper.t:
n. 露营者
n. 露营车

e.en: They bought a small {camper} to travel across the country.
e.zh: 他们买了一辆小房车,打算开着横穿全国。

e.en: Every {camper} must bring a sleeping bag and flashlight.
e.zh: 每位营员都必须带睡袋和手电筒。

campese.t: n. 坎佩塞（姓氏，常指橄榄球名将）

e.en: David {Campese} remains one of rugby's most legendary wingers.
e.zh: 大卫·坎佩塞至今仍是橄榄球史上最具传奇色彩的边锋之一。

e.en: Old fans still talk about {Campese}'s dazzling sidesteps.
e.zh: 老球迷们至今仍在谈论坎佩塞令人眼花缭乱的侧步过人。

campesino.t: n. 农民（尤指拉美小农）

e.en: The {campesino} worked the coffee fields from dawn till dusk.
e.zh: 那位农民从清晨到黄昏都在咖啡田里劳作。

e.en: A young {campesino} sold mangoes by the roadside.
e.zh: 一位年轻的农人在路边卖芒果。

e.en: We roasted marshmallows around the {campfire} until midnight.
e.zh: 我们围着篝火烤棉花糖,直到午夜。

e.en: He told ghost stories beside the crackling {campfire}.
e.zh: 他在噼啪作响的篝火旁讲鬼故事。

e.en: The {campground} had clean showers and friendly staff.
e.zh: 这个营地有干净的淋浴间和友好的工作人员。

e.en: Every {campground} along the coast was fully booked for July.
e.zh: 沿海岸的每个营地七月都已经订满了。

e.en: The closet smelled faintly of {camphor} from the mothballs.
e.zh: 衣橱里因樟脑丸而散发着淡淡的樟脑味。

e.en: She rubbed {camphor} ointment on her chest to ease congestion.
e.zh: 她在胸口涂上樟脑膏以缓解胸闷。

e.en: We're going {camping} in the mountains this weekend.
e.zh: 我们这个周末要去山里露营。

e.en: {Camping} under the stars is one of my favorite summer activities.
e.zh: 在星空下露营是我最喜欢的夏日活动之一。

campings.t: n. 露营（camping 的复数，罕用）

e.en: Several {campings} along the coast offer beachfront pitches.
e.zh: 沿海有几个露营地提供海滨营位。

e.en: We compared prices at three different {campings} before booking.
e.zh: 我们在预订前比较了三个不同露营地的价格。

e.en: Pink {campion} grew wild along the country lane.
e.zh: 粉色的剪秋罗在乡间小路两旁野生生长。

e.en: Jane {Campion} won an Oscar for Best Director in 2022.
e.zh: 简·坎皮恩在2022年获得了奥斯卡最佳导演奖。

e.en: The Italian {campo} was filled with cafés and pigeons.
e.zh: 那座意大利广场上满是咖啡馆和鸽子。

e.en: Children played football on the dusty {campo} every afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们每天下午都在尘土飞扬的场地上踢足球。

camps.t:
n. 营地（复数）
v. 露营

e.en: Refugee {camps} along the border are running short of supplies.
e.zh: 边境沿线的难民营物资正在短缺。

e.en: The two political {camps} could not reach an agreement.
e.zh: 两个政治阵营未能达成一致。

campsie.t: n. 坎普西（苏格兰地名）

e.en: The {Campsie} Fells offer scenic hikes just north of Glasgow.
e.zh: 坎普西丘陵就在格拉斯哥北面,提供风景优美的徒步路线。

e.en: We drove through {Campsie} on our way to Loch Lomond.
e.zh: 我们在前往洛蒙德湖的路上经过了坎普西。

e.en: Our {campsite} had a fire pit and a stunning view.
e.zh: 我们的营地有一个火坑和绝美的景色。

e.en: Please leave the {campsite} cleaner than you found it.
e.zh: 请把营地打扫得比来时更干净。

e.en: Most national park {campsites} require reservations months in advance.
e.zh: 大多数国家公园的营地需要提前数月预订。

e.en: The lakeside {campsites} fill up quickly during summer weekends.
e.zh: 湖边的营地在夏季周末很快就会订满。

e.en: The university {campus} is famous for its cherry blossoms.
e.zh: 这所大学的校园以樱花而闻名。

e.en: Free shuttles run across {campus} every fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 免费班车每十五分钟在校园里穿行一次。

e.en: The company has tech {campuses} in five different cities.
e.zh: 该公司在五个不同的城市设有科技园区。

e.en: Many university {campuses} closed during the pandemic.
e.zh: 许多大学校园在疫情期间关闭了。

campy.t: adj. 夸张做作的；戏谑俗艳的

e.en: The {campy} horror movie had everyone laughing instead of screaming.
e.zh: 这部夸张搞怪的恐怖片让大家笑声不断而不是尖叫连连。

e.en: Her costume was deliberately {campy} and over-the-top.
e.zh: 她的服装故意做得浮夸又夸张。

e.en: Undercooked chicken is a common source of {campylobacter} infection.
e.zh: 未煮熟的鸡肉是弯曲杆菌感染的常见来源。

e.en: Doctors confirmed the outbreak was caused by {campylobacter} bacteria.
e.zh: 医生证实这次疫情是由弯曲杆菌引起的。

camra.t: n. 英国真麦酒运动组织

e.en: {CAMRA} publishes an annual guide to the best real ale pubs.
e.zh: CAMRA每年都会出版一本最佳传统麦芽酒酒吧指南。

e.en: He joined {CAMRA} to support traditional British brewing.
e.zh: 他加入了CAMRA以支持传统的英国酿酒业。

camshaft.t: n. 凸轮轴（发动机部件）

e.en: The mechanic replaced the worn {camshaft} in the engine.
e.zh: 技工更换了发动机里磨损的凸轮轴。

e.en: A broken {camshaft} can completely disable the motor.
e.zh: 凸轮轴断裂会让整台发动机彻底瘫痪。

e.en: She read {Camus} during her philosophy course last semester.
e.zh: 上学期哲学课时她读了加缪的作品。

e.en: {Camus} explored the absurdity of human existence.
e.zh: 加缪探讨了人类存在的荒诞性。

can.t:
v. 能；可以
n. 罐头；易拉罐

e.en: I {can} help you finish the report tonight.
e.zh: 我今晚可以帮你完成报告。

e.en: She opened a {can} of soup for lunch.
e.zh: 她开了一罐汤当午餐。

e.en: The wedding at {Cana} is described in the Gospel of John.
e.zh: 约翰福音记载了迦拿的婚宴。

e.en: Tourists often visit {Cana} during their trip to Galilee.
e.zh: 游客在加利利之旅中常会造访迦拿。

canaan.t: n. 迦南（圣经应许之地）

e.en: The Bible describes {Canaan} as a land of milk and honey.
e.zh: 圣经把迦南描述为流奶与蜜之地。

e.en: Ancient {Canaan} covered parts of modern Israel and Lebanon.
e.zh: 古代迦南包括今天以色列和黎巴嫩的部分地区。

canaanite.t:
n. 迦南人
adj. 迦南的

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered a {Canaanite} city beneath the modern town.
e.zh: 考古学家在现代城镇下发掘出一座迦南古城。

e.en: The museum displays pottery from the {Canaanite} period.
e.zh: 博物馆展出迦南时期的陶器。

e.en: My cousin moved to {Canada} for graduate school.
e.zh: 我表哥搬到加拿大读研究生。

e.en: {Canada} is famous for its maple syrup and ice hockey.
e.zh: 加拿大以枫糖浆和冰球闻名。

canadensis.t: adj. 加拿大的（拉丁学名用）

e.en: Botanists classify the eastern hemlock as Tsuga {canadensis}.
e.zh: 植物学家将东部铁杉归类为加拿大铁杉。

e.en: The plant {canadensis} grows widely across northern forests.
e.zh: 加拿大种植物在北方森林中广泛分布。

canadian.t:
adj. 加拿大的
n. 加拿大人

e.en: My new neighbor is a friendly {Canadian} engineer.
e.zh: 我的新邻居是一位友好的加拿大工程师。

e.en: She loves the polite tone of {Canadian} English.
e.zh: 她喜欢加拿大英语礼貌的语气。

e.en: We took a boat ride along the Venice {canal}.
e.zh: 我们沿着威尼斯运河乘船游览。

e.en: The Suez {canal} connects the Mediterranean and the Red Sea.
e.zh: 苏伊士运河连接地中海和红海。

canaletto.t: n. 卡纳莱托（威尼斯画家）

e.en: The gallery features a famous {Canaletto} painting of Venice.
e.zh: 美术馆展出一幅卡纳莱托描绘威尼斯的名画。

e.en: {Canaletto} was renowned for his detailed cityscapes.
e.zh: 卡纳莱托以细致入微的城市风景画闻名。

canalize.t: v. 开凿运河；疏导（情绪、资源）

e.en: Engineers plan to {canalize} the river to prevent flooding.
e.zh: 工程师计划把河流渠化以防洪水。

e.en: Good leaders {canalize} energy toward shared goals.
e.zh: 优秀的领导者会把精力引导到共同目标上。

e.en: Amsterdam is famous for its picturesque {canals}.
e.zh: 阿姆斯特丹以风景如画的运河闻名。

e.en: Workers cleared debris from the city's old {canals}.
e.zh: 工人清理了城里老运河中的杂物。

e.en: We had dinner at a charming {canalside} cafe.
e.zh: 我们在一家迷人的运河边咖啡馆吃了晚餐。

e.en: Their new apartment offers a beautiful {canalside} view.
e.zh: 他们的新公寓有一片美丽的运河景观。

e.en: The waiter offered us a smoked salmon {canape}.
e.zh: 服务员给我们端来一份熏三文鱼小点心。

e.en: Each guest enjoyed a {canape} before the main course.
e.zh: 每位客人在主菜前都尝了一份开胃小点。

e.en: That rumor turned out to be a complete {canard}.
e.zh: 那则传闻原来完全是无稽之谈。

e.en: Reporters quickly debunked the {canard} about the senator.
e.zh: 记者很快戳穿了关于那位参议员的谣言。

canary.t:
n. 金丝雀
adj. 鲜黄色的

e.en: Her grandmother kept a yellow {canary} in a cage.
e.zh: 她奶奶在笼子里养了一只黄色金丝雀。

e.en: The team uses test users as a {canary} for new features.
e.zh: 团队让测试用户作为新功能的预警金丝雀。

canasta.t: n. 卡纳斯塔纸牌游戏

e.en: My grandparents play {canasta} every Sunday afternoon.
e.zh: 我祖父母每个星期天下午都会玩卡纳斯塔牌。

e.en: She learned {canasta} from her aunt during summer vacation.
e.zh: 她暑假时跟姑姑学会了卡纳斯塔纸牌。

canaveral.t: n. 卡纳维拉尔角（美国航天发射地）

e.en: NASA launched the rocket from Cape {Canaveral} this morning.
e.zh: 今早美国航天局在卡纳维拉尔角发射了火箭。

e.en: Tourists flock to Cape {Canaveral} to watch space launches.
e.zh: 游客纷纷涌向卡纳维拉尔角观看火箭发射。

canberra.t: n. 堪培拉（澳大利亚首都）

e.en: {Canberra} is the political capital of Australia.
e.zh: 堪培拉是澳大利亚的政治首都。

e.en: We visited the parliament building in {Canberra} last summer.
e.zh: 我们去年夏天参观了堪培拉的议会大厦。

e.en: The form had a typo where someone wrote {cance} instead of cancel.
e.zh: 表格上有个错字,有人把 cancel 写成了 cance。

e.en: Spell-check flagged {cance} as a misspelling in the document.
e.zh: 拼写检查把文档里的 cance 标为拼写错误。

e.en: I had to {cancel} my flight because of the storm.
e.zh: 因为风暴我不得不取消航班。

e.en: Tap the button to {cancel} your subscription anytime.
e.zh: 随时点击按钮即可取消订阅。

canceled.t: v. 已取消（cancel 过去式）

e.en: They {canceled} the outdoor concert due to heavy rain.
e.zh: 由于大雨,他们取消了户外音乐会。

e.en: My morning meeting got {canceled} at the last minute.
e.zh: 我早上的会议在最后一刻被取消了。

canceling.t: v. 正在取消（cancel 现在分词）

e.en: She is {canceling} her gym membership next week.
e.zh: 她下周要取消健身房会员资格。

e.en: The airline keeps {canceling} flights to that city.
e.zh: 航空公司不断取消飞往那座城市的航班。

e.en: She {cannily} negotiated a higher salary before signing.
e.zh: 她在签约前精明地谈下了更高的薪水。

e.en: The investor {cannily} sold his shares before the crash.
e.zh: 那位投资者精明地在崩盘前抛售了股票。

canning.t:
n. 罐装；装罐
v. canning (can 的现在分词)

e.en: Grandma is {canning} peaches for the winter months.
e.zh: 奶奶正在腌渍桃子准备过冬。

e.en: The {canning} factory employs hundreds of seasonal workers.
e.zh: 这家罐头厂雇用着数百名季节性工人。

cannister.t: n. 罐；容器（canister 的异体）

e.en: Pour the loose tea into a metal {cannister}.
e.zh: 把散装茶叶倒入金属罐中。

e.en: Police threw a smoke {cannister} to disperse the crowd.
e.zh: 警察扔了一个烟雾罐来驱散人群。

e.en: We hiked through {Cannock} Chase last weekend.
e.zh: 我们上周末徒步穿越了坎诺克猎场。

e.en: The town of {Cannock} lies in central England.
e.zh: 坎诺克镇位于英格兰中部。

e.en: The Sicilian bakery is famous for its crispy {cannoli}.
e.zh: 那家西西里面包店以酥脆的奶油卷闻名。

e.en: He filled the {cannoli} shells with sweet ricotta cream.
e.zh: 他把甜乳清干酪奶油填入卷筒酥皮中。

cannon.t:
n. 大炮；火炮
v. 炮击；猛撞

e.en: Tourists watched the old {cannon} fire at noon.
e.zh: 游客们观看那门老式大炮在中午鸣炮。

e.en: The striker hit a powerful {cannon} of a shot.
e.zh: 前锋射出一记炮弹般有力的射门。

cannonade.t:
n. 连续炮击
v. 炮轰

e.en: The fortress endured a heavy {cannonade} for three days.
e.zh: 那座要塞遭受了三天的猛烈炮轰。

e.en: Reporters faced a {cannonade} of questions at the press conference.
e.zh: 记者们在新闻发布会上遭遇了连珠炮般的提问。

e.en: The boy did a huge {cannonball} into the pool.
e.zh: 那男孩以炮弹式的姿势猛地跳进泳池。

e.en: An iron {cannonball} was found buried in the field.
e.zh: 田里挖出一颗埋藏的铁炮弹。

e.en: Pirates stacked {cannonballs} neatly beside the ship's guns.
e.zh: 海盗们把炮弹整齐地堆在船炮旁边。

e.en: The kids took turns doing {cannonballs} off the diving board.
e.zh: 孩子们轮流从跳板上做炮弹式跳水。

e.en: I {cannot} attend the meeting because of a doctor's appointment.
e.zh: 我无法参加会议,因为有医生预约。

e.en: You {cannot} use your phone during the exam.
e.zh: 考试期间不能使用手机。

e.en: The list of {cannots} for new employees seemed endless.
e.zh: 给新员工的禁令清单似乎没完没了。

e.en: Parents need to balance the cans and {cannots} for teenagers.
e.zh: 父母需要为青少年平衡能做和不能做的事。

e.en: The dialect text oddly {cannotted} the standard contraction rules.
e.zh: 那篇方言文本奇怪地违背了标准缩写规则。

e.en: In old letters the writer sometimes {cannotted} polite phrases together.
e.zh: 在旧信件中,作者有时会把礼貌用语生硬地连写在一起。

e.en: Grammar books warn against {cannotting} verbs in formal writing.
e.zh: 语法书告诫不要在正式写作中乱用 cannot 结构。

e.en: He kept {cannotting} every request his manager made.
e.zh: 他对经理提出的每个要求都说不行。

e.en: The nurse gently inserted a {cannula} into his vein.
e.zh: 护士轻轻把套管针插入他的静脉。

e.en: Oxygen flowed through the nasal {cannula} into her lungs.
e.zh: 氧气通过鼻导管流入她的肺部。

e.en: Successful {cannulation} of the artery requires a steady hand.
e.zh: 成功对动脉插管需要稳健的手法。

e.en: The intern practiced vein {cannulation} on a training arm.
e.zh: 实习生在训练用手臂上练习静脉插管。

e.en: She is a {canny} investor who avoided the market crash.
e.zh: 她是个精明的投资者,躲过了那次股灾。

e.en: The {canny} old farmer knew when rain was coming.
e.zh: 那位精明的老农民知道何时会下雨。

canoe.t:
n. 独木舟；皮划艇
v. 划独木舟

e.en: We paddled the {canoe} across the calm mountain lake.
e.zh: 我们划着独木舟横渡平静的山湖。

e.en: He flipped the {canoe} trying to stand up.
e.zh: 他想站起来,结果把独木舟弄翻了。

e.en: We went {canoeing} on the river last Sunday morning.
e.zh: 上周日上午我们去河上划独木舟了。

e.en: {Canoeing} through the rapids requires both skill and nerve.
e.zh: 划独木舟穿过急流既需要技巧也需要胆量。

e.en: The Olympic {canoeist} trained on the river every morning.
e.zh: 那位奥运皮划艇选手每天早晨在河上训练。

e.en: An experienced {canoeist} can read the current easily.
e.zh: 经验丰富的独木舟手能轻松看懂水流。

e.en: The lodge rents {canoes} by the hour each summer.
e.zh: 那家旅馆每年夏天按小时出租独木舟。

e.en: Two wooden {canoes} were tied up at the dock.
e.zh: 两艘木独木舟停泊在码头边。

e.en: I usually fry vegetables in {canola} oil.
e.zh: 我通常用菜籽油炒蔬菜。

e.en: Yellow {canola} fields stretched to the horizon in Saskatchewan.
e.zh: 在萨斯喀彻温省,黄色的油菜田延伸到地平线。

canon.t:
n. 准则；经典作品
n. 教规；教士

e.en: That novel is now part of the literary {canon}.
e.zh: 那部小说如今已成为文学经典作品之一。

e.en: Fans argue about which films are {canon} in the franchise.
e.zh: 粉丝们争论该系列中哪些电影属于官方正史。

e.en: Bach often used {canonic} structures in his fugues.
e.zh: 巴赫常在赋格曲中使用卡农式结构。

e.en: The textbook covers the {canonic} forms of the equation.
e.zh: 教科书涵盖了该方程的标准形式。

canonical.t: adj. 规范的；标准的（程序/形式）

e.en: Pride and Prejudice is a {canonical} English novel.
e.zh: 《傲慢与偏见》是一部经典的英文小说。

e.en: Always set the {canonical} URL to avoid duplicate content.
e.zh: 务必设置规范网址以避免重复内容问题。

e.en: The {canonisation} of Mother Teresa drew millions to Rome.
e.zh: 特蕾莎修女的封圣仪式吸引了数百万人前往罗马。

e.en: Critics debated the {canonisation} of pop songs as serious art.
e.zh: 评论家们辩论将流行歌曲奉为严肃艺术经典之事。

canonise.t: v. 封为圣徒；奉为经典

e.en: The Pope decided to {canonise} the martyred bishop.
e.zh: 教皇决定将那位殉道的主教封为圣人。

e.en: Critics often {canonise} authors only after their death.
e.zh: 评论界常常在作家去世后才将其奉为经典。

e.en: The {canonist} explained how church law applied to the dispute.
e.zh: 那位教会法学家解释了教会法如何适用于该争议。

e.en: She studied under a respected {canonist} at the seminary.
e.zh: 她在神学院师从一位备受尊敬的教会法学家。

e.en: The {canonization} of the saint took place in Rome last spring.
e.zh: 那位圣人的封圣仪式去年春天在罗马举行。

e.en: Critics debated the {canonization} of the novel as a modern classic.
e.zh: 评论家们争论这部小说是否应被列入现代经典。

canonize.t: v. 封为圣徒；奉为经典

e.en: The Vatican plans to {canonize} the missionary next year.
e.zh: 梵蒂冈计划明年将这位传教士封为圣徒。

e.en: Fans tend to {canonize} their favorite directors as untouchable geniuses.
e.zh: 粉丝们往往把最喜欢的导演奉为不可触碰的天才。

canonized.t: v. 被封为圣徒（过去式）

e.en: Mother Teresa was {canonized} by Pope Francis in 2016.
e.zh: 特蕾莎修女于2016年被教宗方济各封为圣人。

e.en: His early albums have been {canonized} by music critics worldwide.
e.zh: 他的早期专辑已被全球乐评人奉为经典。

e.en: This book breaks all the {canons} of traditional storytelling.
e.zh: 这本书打破了传统叙事的所有规范。

e.en: Several {canons} attended the cathedral service this morning.
e.zh: 几位教士今早出席了大教堂的礼拜。

canoodle.t: v. 搂抱亲热；卿卿我我

e.en: The couple were spotted {canoodle}-ing on a park bench at sunset.
e.zh: 那对情侣被看到日落时在公园长椅上亲热。

e.en: Teenagers love to {canoodle} in the back row of the cinema.
e.zh: 青少年喜欢在电影院后排卿卿我我。

canopied.t: adj. 有华盖的；有顶篷的

e.en: They slept in a {canopied} bed at the boutique hotel.
e.zh: 他们在精品酒店睡的是带顶篷的大床。

e.en: The path was {canopied} by tall oak trees.
e.zh: 小路被高大的橡树遮成了一条绿廊。

e.en: The forest {canopy} blocks most sunlight from reaching the ground.
e.zh: 森林的树冠层挡住了大部分照向地面的阳光。

e.en: A white {canopy} sheltered the outdoor wedding guests from rain.
e.zh: 白色的篷布为户外婚礼的宾客挡雨。

cans.t:
n. 罐头（复数）
v. 装罐

e.en: Please recycle the empty soda {cans} in the blue bin.
e.zh: 请把空汽水罐扔进蓝色回收桶里。

e.en: The pantry is stocked with {cans} of soup and beans.
e.zh: 储藏室里放着许多罐头汤和豆子。

canst.t: v. 能（古英语 can 的第二人称）

e.en: Thou {canst} not enter the kingdom without faith, the priest declared.
e.zh: 牧师宣称没有信仰你便不能进入天国。

e.en: "What {canst} thou see from yonder window?" asked the old knight.
e.zh: 老骑士问道:"你从那边窗户能看到什么?"

cant.t:
n. 倾斜；伪善之词
v. 使倾斜

e.en: Politicians often hide behind empty {cant} about family values.
e.zh: 政客常常用关于家庭价值的空话来掩饰自己。

e.en: The roof has a slight {cant} toward the east.
e.zh: 屋顶向东微微倾斜。

e.en: I sliced a ripe {cantaloupe} for breakfast this morning.
e.zh: 我今早切了一个熟透的哈密瓜当早餐。

e.en: The {cantaloupe} smelled sweet and juicy at the farmer's market.
e.zh: 农贸市场上的哈密瓜闻起来香甜多汁。

cantankerous.t: adj. 脾气坏的；爱争吵的

e.en: Our {cantankerous} neighbor complains about every little noise.
e.zh: 我们那位脾气暴躁的邻居对一点点声响都要抱怨。

e.en: The old cat grew more {cantankerous} as winter approached.
e.zh: 那只老猫随着冬天临近变得越来越乖戾。

e.en: The choir performed a Bach {cantata} at Sunday's service.
e.zh: 合唱团在周日礼拜上演唱了一首巴赫康塔塔。

e.en: She composed a short {cantata} for her graduation recital.
e.zh: 她为毕业演出创作了一首短小的康塔塔。

canted.t:
adj. 倾斜的
v. 使倾斜（过去式）

e.en: The photographer {canted} the camera for a dramatic angle.
e.zh: 摄影师把相机倾斜以拍出戏剧化的角度。

e.en: The ship {canted} sharply to one side after the wave struck.
e.zh: 船在被海浪击中后猛地向一侧倾斜。

e.en: We grab lunch at the office {canteen} every weekday.
e.zh: 我们工作日都在公司食堂吃午饭。

e.en: The hiker filled his {canteen} from the mountain stream.
e.zh: 徒步者从山间小溪里把水壶灌满。

e.en: School {canteens} are switching to healthier menu options.
e.zh: 学校食堂正在改用更健康的菜单选项。

e.en: The soldiers refilled their {canteens} before the long march.
e.zh: 士兵们在长途行军前把水壶都装满了。

e.en: The horse broke into a gentle {canter} across the meadow.
e.zh: 那匹马在草地上轻快地慢跑起来。

e.en: She let the pony {canter} along the sandy beach.
e.zh: 她让小马在沙滩上慢跑。

canterbury.t: n. 坎特伯雷（英国城市）

e.en: We toured {Canterbury} cathedral during our weekend in Kent.
e.zh: 我们在肯特郡度周末时参观了坎特伯雷大教堂。

e.en: Chaucer's pilgrims set out from London toward {Canterbury}.
e.zh: 乔叟笔下的朝圣者从伦敦出发前往坎特伯雷。

e.en: The monks chanted an ancient {canticle} at dawn each morning.
e.zh: 修士们每天清晨吟唱一首古老的颂歌。

e.en: Her novel weaves a {canticle} of love and loss.
e.zh: 她的小说编织出一曲关于爱与失去的颂歌。

e.en: The balcony uses a steel {cantilever} to extend over the cliff.
e.zh: 那个阳台用钢制悬臂伸出悬崖之上。

e.en: Engineers had to reinforce the {cantilever} supporting the rooftop pool.
e.zh: 工程师们必须加固支撑屋顶泳池的悬臂结构。

e.en: The modern house features a dramatically {cantilevered} second floor.
e.zh: 这栋现代住宅有一个引人注目的悬臂式二楼。

e.en: A glass deck is {cantilevered} out over the canyon.
e.zh: 一个玻璃观景台悬挑在峡谷之上。

e.en: We grabbed tacos at a tiny {cantina} near the beach.
e.zh: 我们在海滩附近的一家小酒馆吃了塔可。

e.en: The {cantina} fills up with locals every Friday night.
e.zh: 每个周五晚上这家小酒馆都挤满了本地人。

e.en: Dante describes hell vividly in the third {canto} of the Inferno.
e.zh: 但丁在《地狱篇》第三章里生动描写了地狱。

e.en: The poet read the opening {canto} of his epic aloud.
e.zh: 诗人朗读了他史诗的开篇章节。

e.en: You will receive a refund after the {cancellation} is processed.
e.zh: 取消手续办理完成后您将收到退款。

e.en: The hotel charges a fee for late {cancellation}.
e.zh: 酒店对临时取消会收取费用。

cancelled.t: v. 取消（cancel 的过去式）

e.en: The concert was {cancelled} after the singer fell ill.
e.zh: 歌手生病后,音乐会被取消了。

e.en: Our train was {cancelled} without any explanation.
e.zh: 我们的火车被取消了,且没有任何解释。

e.en: He always {cancels} our plans at the last minute.
e.zh: 他总是在最后一刻取消我们的计划。

e.en: This noise-canceling headset {cancels} background sounds effectively.
e.zh: 这款降噪耳机能有效消除背景噪音。

cancer.t:
n. 癌症
n. 巨蟹座

e.en: Early detection greatly improves the chance of beating {cancer}.
e.zh: 早期发现能大大提高战胜癌症的机会。

e.en: Doctors are testing a new drug for breast {cancer}.
e.zh: 医生正在测试一种治疗乳腺癌的新药。

e.en: The biopsy showed that the lump was not {cancerous}.
e.zh: 活检结果显示该肿块不是癌性的。

e.en: Surgeons removed the {cancerous} tissue successfully.
e.zh: 外科医生成功切除了癌变组织。

e.en: Some {cancers} respond well to immunotherapy treatment.
e.zh: 有些癌症对免疫疗法反应良好。

e.en: Smoking is linked to several types of {cancers}.
e.zh: 吸烟与多种癌症的发生有关。

e.en: A silver {candelabra} sat in the middle of the dining table.
e.zh: 餐桌中央摆着一座银制烛台。

e.en: The antique {candelabra} held seven flickering candles.
e.zh: 那座古董烛台上插着七支摇曳的蜡烛。

e.en: The synagogue displayed an ancient seven-branched {candelabrum}.
e.zh: 那座犹太会堂展示着一座古老的七枝烛台。

e.en: A bronze {candelabrum} stood beside the altar.
e.zh: 祭坛旁立着一座青铜烛台。

candid.t:
adj. 坦率的；直言的
adj. 抓拍的（照片）

e.en: I appreciate her {candid} feedback on my draft.
e.zh: 我很感激她对我草稿坦率的反馈。

e.en: The photographer caught a {candid} moment between the friends.
e.zh: 摄影师抓拍到朋友之间一个自然的瞬间。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed her rash as a {candida} infection.
e.zh: 医生诊断她的皮疹是念珠菌感染。

e.en: Probiotics may help control overgrowth of {candida} in the gut.
e.zh: 益生菌可能有助于控制肠道内念珠菌过度生长。

candidacy.t: n. 候选资格；候选人身份

e.en: She announced her {candidacy} for mayor this morning.
e.zh: 她今天上午宣布参选市长。

e.en: His {candidacy} surprised many party leaders.
e.zh: 他参选一事让许多党内领导大感意外。

e.en: Each {candidate} gave a five-minute opening statement.
e.zh: 每位候选人都做了五分钟的开场陈述。

e.en: She seems like the strongest {candidate} for the role.
e.zh: 她看起来是这个职位最有力的人选。

e.en: We interviewed five {candidates} for the engineering position.
e.zh: 我们面试了五位工程师职位的应聘者。

e.en: The debate featured four presidential {candidates}.
e.zh: 那场辩论有四位总统候选人参加。

e.en: He withdrew his {candidature} after weeks of speculation.
e.zh: 在数周的猜测之后,他撤回了自己的候选资格。

e.en: Her {candidature} was endorsed by several union leaders.
e.zh: 她的候选资格得到了几位工会领导人的支持。

e.en: The patient was treated for oral {candidiasis} with antifungal medication.
e.zh: 患者接受了抗真菌药物治疗口腔念珠菌病。

e.en: {Candidiasis} often appears in people with weakened immune systems.
e.zh: 念珠菌病常见于免疫力低下的人群。

e.en: She spoke {candidly} about her struggles with anxiety.
e.zh: 她坦率地谈论了自己与焦虑的斗争。

e.en: The CEO answered the tough questions {candidly}.
e.zh: 首席执行官坦率地回答了那些棘手的问题。

e.en: The cake was topped with {candied} orange peel.
e.zh: 蛋糕上面撒着糖渍橙皮。

e.en: She loves snacking on {candied} ginger after meals.
e.zh: 她喜欢饭后吃糖渍生姜当零食。

e.en: The kids stuffed their pockets with {candies} on Halloween.
e.zh: 孩子们万圣节时把口袋里塞满了糖果。

e.en: She handed out small {candies} to her coworkers.
e.zh: 她分发了一些小糖果给同事。

e.en: She lit a vanilla-scented {candle} on the windowsill.
e.zh: 她在窗台上点了一支香草味蜡烛。

e.en: Power went out, so we ate dinner by {candle} light.
e.zh: 停电了,于是我们点着蜡烛吃晚饭。

e.en: She placed a brass {candleholder} on the mantelpiece.
e.zh: 她把一个黄铜烛台放在壁炉架上。

e.en: The vintage {candleholder} added charm to the dinner setting.
e.zh: 那个复古烛台为晚餐布置增添了魅力。

e.en: They shared a romantic dinner by {candlelight}.
e.zh: 他们在烛光下享用了一顿浪漫的晚餐。

e.en: The room glowed softly with warm {candlelight}.
e.zh: 房间在温暖的烛光中柔和地闪着光。

e.en: He surprised her with a {candlelit} dinner on their anniversary.
e.zh: 结婚纪念日他给她准备了一顿烛光晚餐惊喜。

e.en: The cathedral hosted a {candlelit} vigil for the victims.
e.zh: 大教堂为遇难者举行了烛光守夜活动。

e.en: She blew out all the {candles} on her birthday cake.
e.zh: 她吹灭了生日蛋糕上所有的蜡烛。

e.en: Scented {candles} can help create a calming atmosphere.
e.zh: 香薰蜡烛有助于营造宁静的氛围。

candlestick.t:
n. 烛台
n. K线（金融图表）

e.en: An antique silver {candlestick} stood on the mantel.
e.zh: 壁炉架上摆着一个古董银烛台。

e.en: Traders study {candlestick} charts to spot market trends.
e.zh: 交易者通过研究蜡烛图来发现市场趋势。

e.en: Her {candor} during the interview impressed the hiring manager.
e.zh: 她面试中的坦率给招聘经理留下了深刻印象。

e.en: I appreciate the {candor} with which he admitted his mistake.
e.zh: 我很欣赏他坦率承认错误的态度。

e.en: The minister spoke with surprising {candour} about the failed policy.
e.zh: 那位部长出人意料地坦率谈到了失败的政策。

e.en: Her {candour} earned the trust of her colleagues.
e.zh: 她的坦率赢得了同事们的信任。

e.en: The kids traded {candy} after going trick-or-treating.
e.zh: 孩子们去要糖后互相交换糖果。

e.en: She bought a bag of sour {candy} at the cinema.
e.zh: 她在电影院买了一袋酸味糖果。

e.en: The fair sold pink {candyfloss} on paper sticks.
e.zh: 游乐场卖着插在纸棒上的粉色棉花糖。

e.en: Her hair looked like fluffy {candyfloss} in the wind.
e.zh: 她的头发在风中像蓬松的棉花糖。

cane.t:
n. 手杖；藤条
v. 用藤条打

e.en: The old man walked slowly with a wooden {cane}.
e.zh: 老人拄着木拐杖慢慢走。

e.en: Farmers in Brazil grow huge fields of sugar {cane}.
e.zh: 巴西的农民种植大片的甘蔗田。

e.en: A snake slithered through the dense {canebrake} by the river.
e.zh: 一条蛇在河边茂密的竹丛中爬行。

e.en: Hunters lost the trail in the thick {canebrake}.
e.zh: 猎人在浓密的甘蔗丛里失去了踪迹。

caned.t: v. 用藤条抽打（过去式）

e.en: In the old days, students were {caned} for misbehaving.
e.zh: 过去学生顽皮会被用藤条打。

e.en: The chair has a beautifully {caned} seat.
e.zh: 这把椅子有一个编织精美的藤面座椅。

e.en: The shop sells walking {canes} carved from oak.
e.zh: 那家店出售用橡木雕刻的手杖。

e.en: Workers cut sugar {canes} in the hot afternoon sun.
e.zh: 工人在炎热的午后砍甘蔗。

e.en: The fox is a wild {canid} found across Europe.
e.zh: 狐狸是一种遍布欧洲的野生犬科动物。

e.en: Wolves and dogs both belong to the {canid} family.
e.zh: 狼和狗都属于犬科家族。

canine.t:
adj. 犬的
n. 犬齿

e.en: The dentist said my upper {canine} tooth was chipped.
e.zh: 牙医说我上排的犬齿崩了一小块。

e.en: Police use trained {canine} units to detect drugs.
e.zh: 警方使用训练有素的警犬队来侦测毒品。

e.en: The headmaster banned {caning} as a form of punishment.
e.zh: 校长禁止把鞭打作为一种惩罚方式。

e.en: She is learning the craft of {caning} antique chairs.
e.zh: 她正在学习给古董椅编藤面的手艺。

e.en: Store the flour in an airtight {canister} on the counter.
e.zh: 把面粉装在台面上密封的罐子里。

e.en: Police fired a tear gas {canister} into the crowd.
e.zh: 警察向人群中发射了一枚催泪瓦斯罐。

canker.t: n. 口腔溃疡；植物腐烂病

e.en: A painful {canker} sore appeared inside her lower lip.
e.zh: 她的下唇内侧长了一个疼痛的口腔溃疡。

e.en: Corruption is a {canker} eating away at the institution.
e.zh: 腐败是一种正在侵蚀这个机构的毒瘤。

e.en: The dialect word {cann} once meant a drinking cup.
e.zh: 方言词 cann 曾经指饮酒用的杯子。

e.en: Old records spell the surname {Cann} without an e.
e.zh: 古老的记录把这个姓拼作 Cann,没有字母 e。

e.en: Bright red {canna} lilies bloomed along the garden path.
e.zh: 鲜红的美人蕉沿着花园小径盛开。

e.en: She planted a {canna} bulb beside the back fence.
e.zh: 她在后篱笆旁种了一颗美人蕉球茎。

e.en: Several US states have legalized {cannabis} for adult use.
e.zh: 美国有几个州已将大麻合法化供成人使用。

e.en: Doctors prescribed medical {cannabis} for her chronic pain.
e.zh: 医生为她的慢性疼痛开了医用大麻。

canned.t:
adj. 罐装的
adj. 预录的

e.en: I keep {canned} tomatoes in the pantry for quick pasta.
e.zh: 我在橱柜里备着罐头番茄,方便快速做意面。

e.en: The sitcom uses {canned} laughter after every joke.
e.zh: 这部情景喜剧每个笑点后都用罐头笑声。

e.en: She ordered spinach and ricotta {cannelloni} at the Italian restaurant.
e.zh: 她在意大利餐厅点了菠菜乳清干酪馅的卷面。

e.en: The chef stuffed the {cannelloni} tubes with seasoned beef.
e.zh: 厨师把调味牛肉塞进了卷面管中。

e.en: Her grandfather worked at a salmon {cannery} in Alaska.
e.zh: 她的祖父曾在阿拉斯加的一家三文鱼罐头厂工作。

e.en: The old {cannery} has been converted into trendy lofts.
e.zh: 那座旧罐头厂已被改造成时髦的公寓。

e.en: The film won top honors at the {Cannes} Festival.
e.zh: 这部电影在戛纳电影节上获得了最高荣誉。

e.en: Celebrities walked the red carpet in {Cannes} last night.
e.zh: 昨晚明星们走过戛纳的红毯。

cannibal.t: n. 食人者；同类相食的动物

e.en: Early explorers feared meeting {cannibal} tribes in the jungle.
e.zh: 早期探险家害怕在丛林里遇到食人部落。

e.en: The praying mantis is a known {cannibal} of its mate.
e.zh: 螳螂是众所周知会吃配偶的同类相食者。

cannibalise.t: v. 拆用旧机零件（英式）

e.en: Engineers had to {cannibalise} the broken jet for spare parts.
e.zh: 工程师不得不拆解坏掉的飞机以获取零件。

e.en: The new product may {cannibalise} sales of the older model.
e.zh: 新产品可能会蚕食旧型号的销量。

e.en: The shipwreck survivors were accused of {cannibalism} to stay alive.
e.zh: 沉船幸存者被指控为求生而吃人。

e.en: Some spider species practice {cannibalism} after mating.
e.zh: 某些蜘蛛种类在交配后会同类相食。

cannibalistic.t: adj. 食人的；同类相残的

e.en: The horror film featured a {cannibalistic} family in the woods.
e.zh: 那部恐怖片描述了一个住在林中的食人家族。

e.en: Hamsters can show {cannibalistic} behavior toward their pups.
e.zh: 仓鼠可能会对幼崽表现出同类相食的行为。

e.en: Mechanics had to {cannibalize} two old cars to fix mine.
e.zh: 修理工不得不拆两辆旧车的零件来修我的车。

e.en: The new iPhone might {cannibalize} sales of the older one.
e.zh: 新款 iPhone 可能会蚕食旧款的销量。

canton.t: n. 州；行政区（如瑞士的州）

e.en: Zurich is the most populous {canton} in Switzerland.
e.zh: 苏黎世是瑞士人口最多的州。

e.en: Each Swiss {canton} has its own laws and traditions.
e.zh: 瑞士每个州都有自己的法律和传统。

e.en: Swiss {cantonal} elections take place every four years.
e.zh: 瑞士州一级的选举每四年举行一次。

e.en: Tax rates vary widely between {cantonal} jurisdictions.
e.zh: 各州的税率差异很大。

cantonese.t:
n. 粤语；广东人
adj. 广东的

e.en: My grandmother only speaks {Cantonese}, not Mandarin.
e.zh: 我奶奶只会说粤语,不会说普通话。

e.en: This restaurant serves authentic {Cantonese} dim sum every morning.
e.zh: 这家餐厅每天早上供应正宗的粤式点心。

e.en: The British army built a large {cantonment} outside the city.
e.zh: 英军在城外建起了一座大型营地。

e.en: Families lived in bungalows inside the colonial {cantonment}.
e.zh: 许多家庭住在殖民时期军营内的平房里。

cantor.t: n. (犹太教会堂) 领唱者；唱诗班领唱
