e.en: The {cantor} led the congregation in singing the morning prayers.
e.zh: 领唱者带领会众一起吟唱晨祷。

e.en: She trained for years to become a synagogue {cantor}.
e.zh: 她经过多年训练才成为犹太会堂的领唱。

canute.t: n. 卡努特（人名，古英格兰国王）

e.en: King {Canute} famously commanded the tide to stop rising.
e.zh: 克努特国王曾下令潮水不许上涨,这一典故广为流传。

e.en: Trying to ban smartphones in schools feels like a {Canute} moment.
e.zh: 想在学校禁用智能手机就像克努特挡潮一样徒劳。

canvas.t:
n. 画布；帆布
n. (网页) 画布元素

e.en: The artist stretched a fresh {canvas} for her next painting.
e.zh: 画家为下一幅画绷好了一块新的画布。

e.en: Tokyo became the perfect {canvas} for the director's vision.
e.zh: 东京成了那位导演施展构想的绝佳画布。

canvasback.t: n. 帆背潜鸭（一种野鸭）

e.en: A {canvasback} duck floated quietly on the still pond.
e.zh: 一只帆背潜鸭静静地浮在平静的池塘上。

e.en: Hunters value the {canvasback} for its rich, distinctive flavor.
e.zh: 猎人因其浓郁独特的风味而珍视帆背潜鸭。

canvass.t: v. 拉票；游说；征求意见

e.en: Volunteers will {canvass} the neighborhood before the election.
e.zh: 志愿者将在选举前挨家挨户地走访这一带。

e.en: We need to {canvass} customers about the new feature design.
e.zh: 我们需要就新功能的设计征求客户意见。

e.en: A friendly {canvasser} knocked on our door asking about voting plans.
e.zh: 一位友善的拉票员敲门询问我们的投票计划。

e.en: Each {canvasser} carried a tablet to log voter responses.
e.zh: 每位拉票员都带着平板电脑记录选民的回答。

canvassing.t: n. 拉票活动；挨家征求意见

e.en: The campaign is {canvassing} swing districts every weekend.
e.zh: 竞选团队每个周末都在摇摆选区拉票。

e.en: She spent Saturday {canvassing} opinions on the proposed park.
e.zh: 她周六花了一整天征求大家对拟建公园的看法。

e.en: We hiked down into the {canyon} just before sunrise.
e.zh: 我们在日出前不久徒步下到峡谷里。

e.en: The river carved this stunning {canyon} over millions of years.
e.zh: 这条河经过几百万年才切出这壮观的峡谷。

e.en: The historical drama features {Cao} Cao as its central warlord.
e.zh: 这部历史剧以曹操为核心军阀人物。

e.en: Professor {Cao} will give the keynote at next week's conference.
e.zh: 曹教授将在下周的会议上做主题演讲。

cap.t:
n. 帽子；上限
v. 限制；封顶

e.en: He pulled his baseball {cap} low to block the sun.
e.zh: 他把棒球帽压得很低来挡太阳。

e.en: The government plans to {cap} rent increases at five percent.
e.zh: 政府计划把房租涨幅上限定在百分之五。

capabilities.t: n. 能力；功能（capability 的复数）

e.en: The new phone's camera {capabilities} rival those of professional gear.
e.zh: 这款新手机的相机性能可与专业设备相媲美。

e.en: We're hiring engineers to expand our AI {capabilities}.
e.zh: 我们正在招聘工程师以扩展人工智能方面的能力。

e.en: This laptop has the {capability} to run heavy 3D software.
e.zh: 这台笔记本电脑有能力运行大型三维软件。

e.en: Rapid learning is the most valuable {capability} on any team.
e.zh: 快速学习是任何团队最宝贵的能力。

capable.t: adj. 有能力的；能够胜任的

e.en: She is more than {capable} of leading the entire project.
e.zh: 她完全有能力领导整个项目。

e.en: This engine is {capable} of reaching highway speeds in seconds.
e.zh: 这台发动机能在几秒钟内达到高速公路的速度。

e.en: The intern handled the customer complaints surprisingly {capably}.
e.zh: 那位实习生处理客户投诉的能力出乎意料地强。

e.en: She {capably} managed three projects at once during the merger.
e.zh: 在合并期间她干练地同时管理着三个项目。

e.en: The new SUV has a remarkably {capacious} trunk for road trips.
e.zh: 这款新SUV的后备箱大得惊人,很适合长途旅行。

e.en: Her {capacious} memory holds thousands of song lyrics.
e.zh: 她过人的记忆力能记住成千上万首歌词。

e.en: Engineers measure {capacitance} in farads using a specialized meter.
e.zh: 工程师用专用仪表以法拉为单位测量电容量。

e.en: Touchscreens detect your finger by sensing tiny changes in {capacitance}.
e.zh: 触屏通过感知电容的微小变化来识别你的手指。

capacities.t: n. 容量；能力（capacity 的复数）

e.en: Our cloud servers come in several different storage {capacities}.
e.zh: 我们的云服务器提供多种不同的存储容量。

e.en: He has served the company in many {capacities} over twenty years.
e.zh: 二十年来他在公司担任过多种不同的职务。

e.en: Most modern phones use a {capacitive} touchscreen for input.
e.zh: 大多数现代手机使用电容式触摸屏进行输入。

e.en: The stylus only works with {capacitive} screens, not resistive ones.
e.zh: 这支触控笔只能在电容屏上使用,不支持电阻屏。

e.en: A blown {capacitor} caused the motherboard to stop working.
e.zh: 一个烧坏的电容器导致主板无法工作。

e.en: The technician soldered a new {capacitor} onto the circuit board.
e.zh: 技师把一个新电容焊到了电路板上。

capacity.t:
n. 容量；容纳量
n. 能力；产能

e.en: The stadium has a seating {capacity} of sixty thousand fans.
e.zh: 这座体育场可容纳六万名观众。

e.en: Children have an amazing {capacity} for learning new languages.
e.zh: 儿童学习新语言的能力令人惊叹。

caparison.t: n. 马的披挂；华丽装饰

e.en: The knight's horse wore a richly embroidered {caparison} into battle.
e.zh: 那位骑士的战马披着绣工华丽的鞍披上阵。

e.en: Museum visitors admired the medieval {caparison} on display.
e.zh: 博物馆参观者欣赏着展出的中世纪马披。

cape.t:
n. 披风；斗篷
n. 海角

e.en: The little boy ran around wearing a red superhero {cape}.
e.zh: 那个小男孩披着红色超级英雄披风到处跑。

e.en: We sailed around the {cape} just before the storm hit.
e.zh: 我们在风暴来临前刚好绕过了那个海角。

caped.t: adj. 穿披风的；带斗篷的

e.en: A {caped} figure stood silhouetted against the moonlit sky.
e.zh: 一个披风加身的身影映在月光下的天空中。

e.en: Children love stories about {caped} crusaders fighting injustice.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢看披风英雄对抗不公的故事。

e.en: The village of {Capel} sits quietly in the Surrey countryside.
e.zh: 凯佩尔村安静地坐落在萨里郡的乡间。

e.en: He traced his family roots back to a small {Capel} parish.
e.zh: 他把家族根源追溯到一个小小的凯佩尔教区。

capelin.t: n. 毛鳞鱼（一种小型海鱼）

e.en: Whales feed heavily on {capelin} during the summer months.
e.zh: 夏季鲸鱼以毛鳞鱼为主要食物。

e.en: Fishermen in Newfoundland still harvest {capelin} from the shore.
e.zh: 纽芬兰的渔民仍会在岸边捕捞毛鳞鱼。

capellini.t: n. 天使细面（极细意面）

e.en: She tossed the {capellini} with garlic, olive oil, and chili.
e.zh: 她用蒜、橄榄油和辣椒拌了天使细面。

e.en: {Capellini} cooks in just two minutes, so watch the pot.
e.zh: 天使细面只需两分钟就熟,要看着锅。

caper.t:
v. 蹦跳；雀跃
n. 刺山柑（调味用花蕾）

e.en: The kids {caper} around the yard whenever it snows.
e.zh: 每次下雪,孩子们就在院子里蹦跳玩闹。

e.en: Add a spoonful of {capers} to brighten the pasta sauce.
e.zh: 加一勺刺山柑能让意面酱更鲜亮。

capetian.t:
adj. 卡佩王朝的
n. 卡佩王朝成员

e.en: The {Capetian} dynasty ruled France for over three centuries.
e.zh: 卡佩王朝统治法国长达三百多年。

e.en: Medieval historians often study {Capetian} marriage politics in detail.
e.zh: 中世纪史学家常详细研究卡佩王朝的联姻政治。

e.en: Add one {capful} of detergent to the washing machine.
e.zh: 在洗衣机里加一瓶盖洗衣液即可。

e.en: Pour a {capful} of fabric softener into the rinse cycle.
e.zh: 在漂洗时倒一瓶盖柔顺剂进去。

capillary.t:
n. 毛细血管
adj. 毛细的

e.en: Tiny {capillary} blood vessels deliver oxygen to every cell.
e.zh: 细小的毛细血管把氧气输送到每个细胞。

e.en: Water rises through the soil by {capillary} action.
e.zh: 水通过毛细作用在土壤中上升。

capital.t:
n. 首都；资本
adj. 大写的；主要的

e.en: Tokyo is the {capital} and largest city of Japan.
e.zh: 东京是日本的首都,也是最大的城市。

e.en: The startup raised enough {capital} to expand into Europe.
e.zh: 这家初创公司筹到了足够进军欧洲的资金。

capitalisation.t: n. 资本化；市值（英式拼写）

e.en: The company's market {capitalisation} crossed one billion pounds yesterday.
e.zh: 该公司的市值昨天突破了十亿英镑。

e.en: Check the {capitalisation} of proper nouns before publishing the article.
e.zh: 发布文章前请检查专有名词的大小写。

capitalise.t: v. 利用；大写（英式拼写）

e.en: Always {capitalise} the first letter of a person's name.
e.zh: 人名的首字母永远要大写。

e.en: Smart investors {capitalise} on market dips to buy cheap.
e.zh: 聪明的投资者会利用市场回调低价买入。

e.en: Modern {capitalism} relies heavily on global supply chains.
e.zh: 现代资本主义高度依赖全球供应链。

e.en: Critics argue that {capitalism} widens inequality between rich and poor.
e.zh: 批评者认为资本主义扩大了贫富差距。

capitalisms.t: n. 各种资本主义形态

e.en: Scholars compare different {capitalisms} across Europe, Asia, and America.
e.zh: 学者们比较欧亚美各地不同形式的资本主义。

e.en: The book contrasts liberal and state {capitalisms} in detail.
e.zh: 这本书详细对比了自由资本主义与国家资本主义。

capitalist.t:
n. 资本家
adj. 资本主义的

e.en: He became a successful {capitalist} after launching three tech startups.
e.zh: 他创办三家科技公司后成了成功的资本家。

e.en: The country shifted toward a {capitalist} economy in the nineties.
e.zh: 该国在九十年代转向了资本主义经济。

e.en: The film offers a sharp critique of {capitalistic} greed.
e.zh: 这部电影尖锐地批判了资本主义式的贪婪。

e.en: Her values feel too {capitalistic} for the nonprofit world.
e.zh: 她的价值观对非营利圈子来说太资本主义了。

capitalization.t:
n. 资本化；市值
n. 首字母大写

e.en: The market {capitalization} of Apple exceeds three trillion dollars.
e.zh: 苹果公司的市值超过三万亿美元。

e.en: Pay attention to {capitalization} when writing email subject lines.
e.zh: 写邮件主题时要注意大小写。

capitalize.t:
v. 利用；使…资本化
v. 首字母大写

e.en: Don't forget to {capitalize} the first word of each sentence.
e.zh: 别忘了把每句话的首词大写。

e.en: The team hopes to {capitalize} on their opponent's mistake.
e.zh: 球队希望能利用对手的失误得分。

capitalized.t: adj. 大写的；已资本化的

e.en: All proper nouns in the document are properly {capitalized}.
e.zh: 文档里所有专有名词都正确地大写了。

e.en: She {capitalized} on the viral moment and gained millions of followers.
e.zh: 她抓住了病毒式的爆红时刻,涨了数百万粉丝。

capitals.t: n. 首都；大写字母（复数）

e.en: He can name all fifty state {capitals} from memory.
e.zh: 他能凭记忆说出全部五十个州的首府。

e.en: The headline was printed entirely in {capitals} for emphasis.
e.zh: 为了强调,标题全部用大写字母印刷。

capitated.t: adj. 按人头计费的（医保）

e.en: Many clinics use a {capitated} payment model for routine care.
e.zh: 许多诊所对常规医疗采用按人头付费模式。

e.en: Under {capitated} contracts, doctors receive a fixed fee per patient.
e.zh: 按人头付费的合同下,医生每位病人收取固定费用。

capitation.t: n. 按人头付费；人头税

e.en: The insurer pays the clinic on a {capitation} basis monthly.
e.zh: 保险公司每月按人头付费给诊所。

e.en: {Capitation} fees reward doctors for keeping patients healthy.
e.zh: 按人头付费的方式鼓励医生让病人保持健康。

capitol.t: n. 国会大厦；州议会大厦

e.en: Tourists lined up to enter the United States {Capitol} building.
e.zh: 游客排队等候进入美国国会大厦。

e.en: Protesters gathered on the steps of the state {capitol}.
e.zh: 抗议者聚集在州议会大厦的台阶上。

e.en: After hours of pressure, the CEO refused to {capitulate}.
e.zh: 经过几小时的施压,首席执行官仍拒绝屈服。

e.en: The rebels were forced to {capitulate} when supplies ran out.
e.zh: 补给耗尽后,叛军被迫投降。

e.en: His sudden {capitulation} surprised everyone at the negotiation table.
e.zh: 他突然让步令谈判桌上的所有人都吃惊。

e.en: The treaty marked the formal {capitulation} of the defeated army.
e.zh: 该条约标志着战败军队的正式投降。

capm.t: n. 资本资产定价模型（金融学）

e.en: Finance students learn the {CAPM} formula in their first semester.
e.zh: 金融系学生第一学期就学资本资产定价模型公式。

e.en: The analyst used {CAPM} to estimate the stock's expected return.
e.zh: 分析师用资本资产定价模型估算股票的预期回报。

capo.t:
n. (吉他) 变调夹
n. 黑手党头目

e.en: She clipped a {capo} on the second fret to change keys.
e.zh: 她把变调夹夹在第二品上来转调。

e.en: The young guitarist always travels with a spare {capo} backstage.
e.zh: 那位年轻吉他手总在后台备一个变调夹。

capon.t: n. 阉割后育肥的公鸡

e.en: Roast {capon} was the centerpiece of the holiday dinner.
e.zh: 烤阉鸡是节日晚餐的主菜。

e.en: A {capon} grows larger and more tender than a regular rooster.
e.zh: 阉鸡比普通公鸡长得更大、肉更嫩。

e.en: She served warm {caponata} on toasted bread as an appetizer.
e.zh: 她把热腾腾的西西里茄子酱抹在烤面包上作开胃菜。

e.en: Sicilian {caponata} balances sweet and sour flavors beautifully.
e.zh: 西西里茄子酱把酸甜风味调和得恰到好处。

capone.t: n. 卡彭（姓氏，如 Al Capone）

e.en: Al {Capone} ran organized crime in Chicago during the 1920s.
e.zh: 艾尔·卡彭在二十年代掌控芝加哥的有组织犯罪。

e.en: The museum displays photos and weapons linked to {Capone}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了与卡彭有关的照片和武器。

capped.t: v. 封顶；限制（数量、金额）

e.en: Annual bonuses are {capped} at twenty percent of base salary.
e.zh: 年度奖金的上限是基本工资的百分之二十。

e.en: Snow {capped} the mountain peaks all the way to spring.
e.zh: 白雪覆盖着山顶,一直持续到春天。

capper.t:
n. 压盖机
n. 收尾之作

e.en: The fireworks were the perfect {capper} to a great night.
e.zh: 那场烟花是这个美好夜晚最完美的收尾。

e.en: His winning goal was a real {capper} on the championship game.
e.zh: 他的制胜进球为冠军赛画上了精彩的一笔。

capping.t:
v. 加盖；设上限
n. 封顶层

e.en: The government is {capping} energy prices to protect consumers.
e.zh: 政府正在限制能源价格以保护消费者。

e.en: A late goal was the {capping} moment of an amazing season.
e.zh: 最后时刻的进球为这精彩赛季画上完美句号。

e.en: I ordered a {cappuccino} with extra foam this morning.
e.zh: 我今天早上点了一杯多奶泡的卡布奇诺。

e.en: The cafe makes the best {cappuccino} in the neighborhood.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆做的卡布奇诺是附近最好的。

e.en: Frank {Capra} directed many beloved classic Hollywood films.
e.zh: 弗兰克·卡普拉执导了许多受人喜爱的好莱坞经典电影。

e.en: Film students still study {Capra}'s masterful storytelling techniques.
e.zh: 电影系学生至今仍在研究卡普拉精湛的叙事技巧。

e.en: They spent a sunny week on the island of {Capri}.
e.zh: 他们在卡普里岛上度过了阳光明媚的一周。

e.en: She wore white {Capri} pants and a striped shirt.
e.zh: 她穿着白色的七分裤和条纹衬衫。

e.en: The pianist played a lively {capriccio} as an encore.
e.zh: 钢琴家用一首活泼的随想曲作为返场曲。

e.en: His latest {capriccio} blends folk melodies with jazz harmonies.
e.zh: 他最新的随想曲融合了民谣旋律与爵士和声。

e.en: The king ruled by {caprice} rather than by reason.
e.zh: 国王凭一时兴致而非理智来治理国家。

e.en: Fashion trends often change at the {caprice} of celebrities.
e.zh: 时尚潮流常常随名人的心血来潮而改变。

capricious.t: adj. 反复无常的；任性的

e.en: The weather here is {capricious}, sunny one minute, raining the next.
e.zh: 这里的天气反复无常,前一分钟晴朗,下一分钟就下雨。

e.en: Her {capricious} boss changes his mind several times a day.
e.zh: 她那位反复无常的老板一天能改主意好几次。

e.en: The market moved {capriciously} after the surprise rate decision.
e.zh: 在意外的利率决定后,市场反复无常地波动。

e.en: He hires and fires staff {capriciously}, with no clear reasoning.
e.zh: 他随心所欲地招人解雇,毫无章法。

e.en: Investors hate the {capriciousness} of new regulatory announcements.
e.zh: 投资者讨厌新监管公告反复无常的特性。

e.en: The {capriciousness} of fame can ruin careers in months.
e.zh: 名声的反复无常能在几个月内毁掉事业。

e.en: My sister is a {Capricorn}, born in early January.
e.zh: 我妹妹是摩羯座,出生在一月初。

e.en: Astrologers describe {Capricorn} as ambitious and disciplined.
e.zh: 占星师把摩羯座描述为有抱负且自律。

caps.t:
n. 帽子（复数）
n. 上限；大写字母

e.en: All the players wore matching team {caps} during practice.
e.zh: 训练时所有球员都戴着统一的球队帽子。

e.en: The new policy {caps} overtime hours at ten per week.
e.zh: 新政策把加班时间限制在每周十小时以内。

e.en: {Capsaicin} is the compound that makes chili peppers feel hot.
e.zh: 辣椒素是让辣椒尝起来辣的化合物。

e.en: Doctors prescribe {capsaicin} cream to ease nerve pain.
e.zh: 医生开辣椒素药膏来缓解神经疼痛。

e.en: Slice the red {capsicum} thinly for the salad.
e.zh: 把红甜椒切成薄片放进沙拉里。

e.en: Australians often call bell peppers {capsicum} at the supermarket.
e.zh: 澳大利亚人在超市里常把柿子椒叫做capsicum。

e.en: The viral {capsid} protects the genetic material inside.
e.zh: 病毒的衣壳保护着内部的遗传物质。

e.en: Researchers redesigned the {capsid} to deliver gene therapy safely.
e.zh: 研究人员重新设计衣壳,以安全递送基因治疗药物。

e.en: The small boat could {capsize} if everyone moves to one side.
e.zh: 如果大家都挤到一边,这艘小船可能会翻。

e.en: Strong waves threatened to {capsize} the kayak near the rocks.
e.zh: 巨浪几乎要把皮划艇掀翻在礁石旁。

capsized.t: v. 已倾覆；翻船（过去式）

e.en: The fishing boat {capsized} in the storm last night.
e.zh: 那艘渔船昨晚在风暴中翻了。

e.en: Two kayakers were rescued after their canoe {capsized}.
e.zh: 两名皮划艇手在独木舟翻了之后获救。

e.en: Sailors turned the {capstan} to slowly raise the heavy anchor.
e.zh: 水手们转动绞盘,慢慢拉起沉重的锚。

e.en: The old ship's {capstan} still works after a hundred years.
e.zh: 那艘旧船的绞盘历经百年仍能使用。

e.en: Her thesis was the {capstone} of four years of research.
e.zh: 她的论文是四年研究的压轴之作。

e.en: The new bridge is the {capstone} project of his career.
e.zh: 这座新桥是他职业生涯的巅峰之作。

e.en: The surgeon repaired a torn {capsular} ligament in the knee.
e.zh: 外科医生修复了膝盖里撕裂的关节囊韧带。

e.en: {Capsular} contracture is a common complication after breast implants.
e.zh: 包膜挛缩是隆胸手术后常见的并发症。

capsule.t:
n. 胶囊
n. 太空舱

e.en: Take one {capsule} with water after each meal.
e.zh: 每餐饭后用水送服一粒胶囊。

e.en: They buried a time {capsule} in the schoolyard for 2050.
e.zh: 他们在校园里埋了一个时间胶囊,留给2050年。

e.en: The pharmacy sold {capsules} that dissolve quickly in the stomach.
e.zh: 药房出售一种在胃里能快速溶解的胶囊。

e.en: Astronauts returned to Earth in tiny reentry {capsules}.
e.zh: 宇航员乘坐小型返回舱回到地球。

capt.t: n. 上尉；船长（Captain 缩写）

e.en: The roster listed her as {capt} of the women's team.
e.zh: 花名册上把她列为女队的队长。

e.en: On the door it just said {capt} Reynolds in faded paint.
e.zh: 门上只用褪色的漆写着雷诺兹上尉。

e.en: The {captain} steered the ship through a heavy storm.
e.zh: 船长驾驶轮船穿过了猛烈的风暴。

e.en: She was elected {captain} of the basketball team.
e.zh: 她被选为篮球队的队长。

e.en: He took over the {captaincy} after the previous leader retired.
e.zh: 前任队长退役后,他接任了队长一职。

e.en: Her {captaincy} brought the squad three consecutive titles.
e.zh: 她担任队长期间球队连续三次夺冠。

e.en: The two {captains} shook hands before the match began.
e.zh: 比赛开始前两位队长互相握手。

e.en: Industry {captains} gathered in Davos to discuss the economy.
e.zh: 商界领袖齐聚达沃斯讨论经济问题。

caption.t:
n. 字幕；标题
v. 加字幕

e.en: She added a witty {caption} to her Instagram photo.
e.zh: 她给自己的 Instagram 照片配了一句俏皮的文字。

e.en: Turn on the {caption} feature if you can't hear the video.
e.zh: 听不清视频的话就打开字幕功能。

captions.t: n. 字幕；说明文字（复数）

e.en: YouTube auto-generates {captions} for most uploaded videos.
e.zh: YouTube 会为大多数上传的视频自动生成字幕。

e.en: The museum's bilingual {captions} helped foreign visitors a lot.
e.zh: 博物馆的双语说明文字对外国游客帮助很大。

e.en: My {captious} editor flagged every misplaced comma in the draft.
e.zh: 那位爱挑刺的编辑把草稿里每一个错位的逗号都标了出来。

e.en: Don't be so {captious} about minor flaws in his presentation.
e.zh: 别对他演讲里的小瑕疵这么吹毛求疵。

e.en: Good storytellers can {captivate} an audience within seconds.
e.zh: 优秀的讲故事者能在几秒内抓住观众的心。

e.en: The northern lights never fail to {captivate} first-time viewers.
e.zh: 北极光总能让初次见到的人着迷。

captivated.t: v. 被深深吸引（过去式）

e.en: The children were {captivated} by the magician's clever tricks.
e.zh: 孩子们被魔术师巧妙的戏法深深吸引。

e.en: She sat {captivated} as the pianist played the final movement.
e.zh: 钢琴家弹奏最后一个乐章时,她着迷地坐着聆听。

e.en: The novel's opening chapter is absolutely {captivating}.
e.zh: 这部小说的开头章节非常引人入胜。

e.en: She gave a {captivating} talk on artificial intelligence.
e.zh: 她做了一场关于人工智能的精彩演讲。

captive.t:
n. 俘虏
adj. 被囚禁的

e.en: The soldiers were held {captive} for nearly two years.
e.zh: 那些士兵被囚禁了将近两年。

e.en: Streaming services rely on a {captive} home audience.
e.zh: 流媒体服务依赖于守在家里的固定观众群。

e.en: The rescue team freed all the {captives} before dawn.
e.zh: 救援队在天亮前救出了所有被俘人员。

e.en: The {captives} were released after lengthy negotiations.
e.zh: 经过长时间谈判,人质们终于获释。

e.en: Pandas rarely breed successfully in {captivity}.
e.zh: 大熊猫在圈养环境下很难成功繁殖。

e.en: The journalist spent six months in {captivity} abroad.
e.zh: 那位记者在国外被囚禁了六个月。

e.en: The hostage eventually escaped from her {captor} at night.
e.zh: 那名人质最终在夜里从绑架者手中逃脱。

e.en: He spoke calmly to his {captor}, hoping to gain trust.
e.zh: 他平静地与抓他的人交谈,希望获得对方的信任。

capture.t:
v. 捕获；抓取（数据、画面）
n. 捕获

e.en: Drones can {capture} stunning footage from above the clouds.
e.zh: 无人机能从云层上方拍下惊艳的画面。

e.en: The startup hopes to {capture} half the local market.
e.zh: 这家初创公司希望拿下本地一半的市场份额。

captured.t: v. 已捕获；已抓取（过去式）

e.en: The photographer {captured} the moment perfectly at sunset.
e.zh: 摄影师在日落时分完美地捕捉到了那一刻。

e.en: Police {captured} the suspect after a brief chase.
e.zh: 警方经过短暂的追逐抓获了嫌疑人。

captures.t:
v. 捕获（第三人称单数）
n. 截图；抓取

e.en: This documentary really {captures} the spirit of the era.
e.zh: 这部纪录片真正抓住了那个时代的精神。

e.en: The new sensor {captures} sharper images in low light.
e.zh: 新传感器在弱光下能拍出更清晰的图像。

capturing.t: v. 正在捕获；正在记录

e.en: She is {capturing} street life through her phone camera.
e.zh: 她正用手机镜头记录街头生活。

e.en: The app focuses on {capturing} user feedback in real time.
e.zh: 该应用专注于实时收集用户反馈。

capuchin.t:
n. 卷尾猴
n. 方济各会修士

e.en: A small {capuchin} monkey swung between branches at the zoo.
e.zh: 动物园里一只小卷尾猴在树枝间来回荡着。

e.en: The {capuchin} friar greeted visitors at the monastery gate.
e.zh: 那位嘉布遣会修士在修道院门口迎接来客。

capybara.t: n. 水豚（世界最大啮齿动物）

e.en: A {capybara} calmly waded into the pond beside the ducks.
e.zh: 一只水豚不慌不忙地走进鸭子旁边的池塘。

e.en: The {capybara} is the world's largest living rodent.
e.zh: 水豚是世界上现存最大的啮齿动物。

car.t:
n. 汽车
n. 车厢（火车、电梯）

e.en: My {car} won't start in this freezing weather.
e.zh: 我的车在这么冷的天气里发动不起来。

e.en: She rented a {car} for the weekend road trip.
e.zh: 她为周末的公路旅行租了一辆车。

e.en: Always lock the {carabiner} before trusting your weight to it.
e.zh: 在把全身重量交给它之前,一定要先锁好登山扣。

e.en: He clipped his keys onto a small {carabiner} on his belt.
e.zh: 他把钥匙挂在腰带上的小登山扣上。

carabinero.t:
n. 西班牙宪兵
n. 红虾

e.en: A Chilean {carabinero} directed traffic at the busy intersection.
e.zh: 一名智利警察在繁忙的路口指挥交通。

e.en: The {carabinero} checked our passports at the border post.
e.zh: 那名警员在边境哨所检查了我们的护照。

e.en: Italian {carabinieri} patrolled the square in their dark uniforms.
e.zh: 意大利宪兵身着深色制服在广场上巡逻。

e.en: The {carabinieri} arrested two suspects near the cathedral.
e.zh: 宪兵在大教堂附近逮捕了两名嫌疑人。

caracalla.t: n. 卡拉卡拉（罗马皇帝）

e.en: The Baths of {Caracalla} once held thousands of Roman bathers.
e.zh: 卡拉卡拉浴场曾经能容纳数千名罗马浴客。

e.en: Emperor {Caracalla} extended citizenship to free inhabitants of Rome.
e.zh: 卡拉卡拉皇帝把公民权扩大到罗马所有的自由居民。

caracas.t: n. 加拉加斯（委内瑞拉首都）

e.en: My cousin moved to {Caracas} to work for an oil company.
e.zh: 我表哥搬去加拉加斯,在一家石油公司工作。

e.en: {Caracas} sits in a long valley surrounded by green mountains.
e.zh: 加拉加斯坐落在一条被青山环绕的长山谷里。

caradoc.t: n. 卡拉多克（人名/地名）

e.en: In Welsh legend, {Caradoc} bravely resisted the Roman invasion.
e.zh: 在威尔士传说中,卡拉多克勇敢地抵抗了罗马人的入侵。

e.en: The pub on the corner is called the {Caradoc} Arms.
e.zh: 街角那家酒吧叫卡拉多克之家。

carafe.t: n. 玻璃水瓶、餐桌酒壶

e.en: The waiter brought a {carafe} of cold water to our table.
e.zh: 服务员给我们这桌端来一壶冰水。

e.en: She poured red wine from the glass {carafe} into each cup.
e.zh: 她从玻璃酒壶里把红酒倒进每个杯子。

caramel.t:
n. 焦糖
n. 焦糖色

e.en: I ordered a {caramel} latte with extra foam this morning.
e.zh: 今早我点了一杯多加奶泡的焦糖拿铁。

e.en: The pudding was topped with a thin layer of {caramel}.
e.zh: 布丁上覆盖着一层薄薄的焦糖。

caramelised.t: adj. 焦糖化的（英式拼写）

e.en: The chef served steak with {caramelised} onions on top.
e.zh: 主厨上的牛排上面盖着焦糖洋葱。

e.en: Slowly cooked carrots become beautifully {caramelised} and sweet.
e.zh: 慢炖的胡萝卜会焦糖化,变得又香又甜。

e.en: Heat the sugar gently until it begins to {caramelize}.
e.zh: 用小火加热糖,直到它开始焦糖化。

e.en: Onions {caramelize} best when cooked low and slow.
e.zh: 洋葱用小火慢炒最容易焦糖化。

e.en: The burger came with bacon and {caramelized} onions.
e.zh: 这款汉堡配有培根和焦糖洋葱。

e.en: She drizzled {caramelized} sugar over the vanilla ice cream.
e.zh: 她把焦糖糖浆淋在香草冰淇淋上。

e.en: The turtle pulled its head safely under its hard {carapace}.
e.zh: 乌龟把头缩进坚硬的背甲里以保护自己。

e.en: Years of city life had given him a tough emotional {carapace}.
e.zh: 多年的都市生活让他形成了一层坚硬的情感外壳。

carat.t:
n. 克拉（宝石重量）
n. 开（黄金纯度）

e.en: The diamond on her ring is just over one {carat}.
e.zh: 她戒指上的钻石刚刚超过一克拉。

e.en: This necklace is made of pure 24 {carat} gold.
e.zh: 这条项链是用纯 24 K 黄金制成的。

caravaggio.t: n. 卡拉瓦乔（意大利画家）

e.en: {Caravaggio} used dramatic light to make his paintings feel alive.
e.zh: 卡拉瓦乔运用戏剧性的光影让画作充满生命力。

e.en: We saw a famous {Caravaggio} hanging in the Roman church.
e.zh: 我们在罗马的那座教堂里看到一幅著名的卡拉瓦乔画作。

caravan.t:
n. 大篷车、旅居车
n. 商队

e.en: They spent the summer touring Europe in a small {caravan}.
e.zh: 他们整个夏天开着一辆小拖挂房车游遍欧洲。

e.en: A long camel {caravan} crossed the desert at dawn.
e.zh: 一支长长的骆驼商队在黎明时分穿越沙漠。

e.en: Several {caravans} were parked near the lake for the holiday.
e.zh: 假期里好几辆露营车停在湖边。

e.en: Trade {caravans} once linked China with the Mediterranean coast.
e.zh: 商队曾经把中国与地中海沿岸连接起来。

caravel.t: n. 卡拉维尔帆船（15–16 世纪）

e.en: Columbus sailed across the Atlantic in a small wooden {caravel}.
e.zh: 哥伦布乘坐一艘小型木制卡拉维尔帆船横渡大西洋。

e.en: The museum displayed a model of a 15th-century {caravel}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一艘十五世纪卡拉维尔帆船的模型。

e.en: German rye bread often contains a generous sprinkle of {caraway}.
e.zh: 德国黑麦面包里常常撒有大量的葛缕子。

e.en: She added crushed {caraway} seeds to the cabbage stew.
e.zh: 她在卷心菜炖菜里加了碾碎的葛缕子。

carb.t:
n. 碳水化合物（carbohydrate 缩写）
n. 化油器

e.en: I'm trying to cut down on my {carb} intake this month.
e.zh: 这个月我正在尽量减少碳水化合物的摄入。

e.en: Pasta is a comforting {carb} after a long workout.
e.zh: 长时间锻炼后,意面是一种很治愈的碳水。

carbamazepine.t: n. 卡马西平（抗癫痫药）

e.en: The neurologist prescribed {carbamazepine} to control her seizures.
e.zh: 神经科医生开了卡马西平来控制她的癫痫发作。

e.en: {Carbamazepine} can interact dangerously with several other medications.
e.zh: 卡马西平与多种其他药物合用时可能产生危险的相互作用。

e.en: The drill bit is tipped with tungsten {carbide} for durability.
e.zh: 为了耐用,这枚钻头的刃部镶有碳化钨。

e.en: Old miners' lamps once burned calcium {carbide} to make light.
e.zh: 老式矿工灯曾经靠燃烧碳化钙来发光。

e.en: The soldier slung his light {carbine} over his shoulder.
e.zh: 士兵把那支轻便的卡宾枪挎在肩上。

e.en: Cavalry units once carried a short {carbine} instead of a rifle.
e.zh: 骑兵部队过去携带的是短卡宾枪,而不是步枪。

e.en: Rice is a staple {carbohydrate} in much of Asia.
e.zh: 米饭是亚洲大部分地区的主要碳水化合物。

e.en: Athletes load up on {carbohydrate} the night before a race.
e.zh: 运动员在比赛前一晚会大量补充碳水化合物。

e.en: The hospital corridor smelled faintly of {carbolic} soap.
e.zh: 医院走廊里隐约飘着石炭酸肥皂的味道。

e.en: Victorian surgeons sprayed {carbolic} acid to kill germs in wounds.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的外科医生喷洒石炭酸来杀灭伤口里的细菌。

carbon.t:
n. 碳（元素）
n. 碳排放

e.en: The company pledged to reach net-zero {carbon} emissions by 2040.
e.zh: 该公司承诺在 2040 年前实现净零碳排放。

e.en: Diamond and graphite are both pure forms of {carbon}.
e.zh: 钻石和石墨都是碳的纯净形态。

e.en: Scientists found {carbonaceous} material inside the ancient meteorite.
e.zh: 科学家在那颗古老的陨石内部发现了含碳物质。

e.en: {Carbonaceous} shales often hint at buried oil deposits below.
e.zh: 含碳页岩往往暗示下方埋藏着石油储层。

carbonara.t: n. 卡邦尼意面、培根蛋黄面

e.en: His favorite Roman dish is a creamy plate of {carbonara}.
e.zh: 他最喜欢的罗马菜是一盘奶香浓郁的卡邦尼意面。

e.en: Real {carbonara} uses egg and pecorino instead of cream.
e.zh: 正宗的卡邦尼意面用的是鸡蛋和佩克利诺奶酪,而不是奶油。

carbonate.t:
n. 碳酸盐
v. 使充碳酸气

e.en: Calcium {carbonate} is the main ingredient of common chalk.
e.zh: 碳酸钙是普通粉笔的主要成分。

e.en: Modern machines can {carbonate} water at home in seconds.
e.zh: 现代机器在家几秒钟就能把水充上气。

carbonated.t: adj. 含二氧化碳的、带气的

e.en: She prefers {carbonated} water with a slice of lemon.
e.zh: 她喜欢加一片柠檬的气泡水。

e.en: The drink loses its fizz once the {carbonated} bubbles escape.
e.zh: 汽水里的气泡跑掉后就没气了。

e.en: Cold storage helps preserve the {carbonation} in soft drinks.
e.zh: 低温储存有助于保留软饮料中的气泡。

e.en: Too much {carbonation} can make the soda taste sharp.
e.zh: 二氧化碳过多会让汽水口感太刺激。

carbonic.t: adj. 碳的（carbonic acid 碳酸）

e.en: Rainwater absorbs CO2 to form weak {carbonic} acid.
e.zh: 雨水吸收二氧化碳形成弱碳酸。

e.en: The cave was shaped by {carbonic} acid dissolving limestone.
e.zh: 这个洞穴是碳酸溶解石灰岩形成的。

e.en: Giant ferns dominated forests during the {carboniferous} period.
e.zh: 石炭纪时期巨型蕨类植物统治着森林。

e.en: Most of Britain's coal comes from {carboniferous} rock layers.
e.zh: 英国的煤炭大多来自石炭纪的岩层。

e.en: High heat will {carbonise} the wood into black charcoal.
e.zh: 高温会把木头碳化成黑色木炭。

e.en: Engineers {carbonise} bamboo to make it stronger and waterproof.
e.zh: 工程师将竹子碳化以增强其强度并防水。

e.en: Archaeologists found {carbonised} grain inside the ancient pottery.
e.zh: 考古学家在古陶器中发现了碳化的谷物。

e.en: The fire left {carbonised} beams in what remained of the roof.
e.zh: 大火把残存屋顶的横梁烧成了焦炭。

carbonises.t: v. 碳化（第三人称单数，英式）

e.en: Sugar {carbonises} quickly when left on a hot pan.
e.zh: 糖留在热锅上很快就会碳化。

e.en: This kiln {carbonises} wood without exposing it to oxygen.
e.zh: 这个窑在隔绝氧气的条件下使木头碳化。

e.en: The factory is {carbonising} bamboo to produce activated charcoal.
e.zh: 工厂正在碳化竹子以生产活性炭。

e.en: Slowly {carbonising} the wood preserves its natural grain.
e.zh: 缓慢碳化木材可以保留其天然纹理。

e.en: They {carbonize} coconut shells to make filter material.
e.zh: 他们将椰壳碳化用来制作过滤材料。

e.en: Intense heat will {carbonize} any organic matter on the surface.
e.zh: 高温会把表面所有有机物都碳化。

e.en: Scientists studied the {carbonized} scrolls buried by the volcano.
e.zh: 科学家研究了被火山掩埋的碳化卷轴。

e.en: The toast was completely {carbonized} and stuck to the pan.
e.zh: 面包片彻底烧焦,黏在了锅上。

carbonizes.t: v. 碳化（第三人称单数）

e.en: This process {carbonizes} sawdust into a usable fuel briquette.
e.zh: 这个工艺把锯末碳化成可用的燃料块。

e.en: The flame {carbonizes} the surface and seals in the flavor.
e.zh: 火焰让表面碳化,把风味锁在里面。

e.en: They are {carbonizing} agricultural waste to reduce landfill use.
e.zh: 他们正在将农业废料碳化,以减少填埋量。

e.en: {Carbonizing} steel adds carbon to harden its outer layer.
e.zh: 渗碳处理通过加碳使钢的外层变硬。

e.en: The molecule contains a reactive {carbonyl} group.
e.zh: 该分子含有一个活性羰基。

e.en: Aldehydes and ketones share the same {carbonyl} structure.
e.zh: 醛和酮拥有相同的羰基结构。

carboxylic.t: adj. 羧基的（carboxylic acid 羧酸）

e.en: Vinegar's sour taste comes from a {carboxylic} acid.
e.zh: 醋的酸味来自一种羧酸。

e.en: Many drugs contain a {carboxylic} group that affects solubility.
e.zh: 许多药物含有羧基,会影响溶解度。

carbuncle.t:
n. 痈、毒疮
n. 红榴石

e.en: The doctor drained a painful {carbuncle} on his neck.
e.zh: 医生为他脖子上一处疼痛的痈引流了脓。

e.en: Critics called the new tower a {carbuncle} on the skyline.
e.zh: 评论家把这座新塔楼称为天际线上的毒瘤。

e.en: He restored a classic {carbureted} engine in his garage.
e.zh: 他在车库里修复了一台老式化油器引擎。

e.en: Older motorcycles use {carbureted} fuel systems instead of injection.
e.zh: 老式摩托车使用化油器供油,而不是喷射系统。

e.en: The mechanic cleaned the clogged {carburetor} on my old car.
e.zh: 机修工清理了我那辆老车堵塞的化油器。

e.en: A faulty {carburetor} can make the engine stall at idle.
e.zh: 化油器故障会让发动机怠速时熄火。

e.en: He adjusted the {carburettor} to fix the rough idle.
e.zh: 他调整了化油器,解决了怠速不稳的问题。

e.en: Modern cars replaced the {carburettor} with fuel injection systems.
e.zh: 现代汽车已用燃油喷射系统取代了化油器。

carcase.t: n. 动物尸体（carcass 的异体）

e.en: The butcher hung the beef {carcase} in the cold room.
e.zh: 屠夫把整条牛胴体挂在了冷库里。

e.en: Wolves stripped the {carcase} clean within a few hours.
e.zh: 狼群几个小时内就把动物尸骸啃得干干净净。

e.en: Vultures circled above the deer {carcass} in the field.
e.zh: 秃鹫在田野上空围着鹿的尸体盘旋。

e.en: Workers hauled the rusted {carcass} of the car away.
e.zh: 工人们把那辆生锈的汽车残骸拖走了。

e.en: Tobacco smoke is a well-known {carcinogen}.
e.zh: 烟草烟雾是众所周知的致癌物。

e.en: Researchers identified the chemical as a likely {carcinogen}.
e.zh: 研究人员认定这种化学品很可能是致癌物。

e.en: The lab studies how chronic inflammation drives {carcinogenesis}.
e.zh: 该实验室研究慢性炎症如何引发癌症。

e.en: Genetic mutations play a key role in {carcinogenesis}.
e.zh: 基因突变在癌变过程中起着关键作用。

e.en: The factory released several {carcinogenic} chemicals into the river.
e.zh: 工厂向河中排放了多种致癌化学物质。

e.en: Processed meats are classified as {carcinogenic} by the WHO.
e.zh: 世卫组织将加工肉类列为致癌物。

e.en: Tests confirmed the pesticide's {carcinogenicity} in laboratory animals.
e.zh: 测试证实该农药对实验动物有致癌性。

e.en: Regulators evaluate the {carcinogenicity} of each new additive.
e.zh: 监管机构会评估每种新添加剂的致癌性。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with a slow-growing {carcinoid} tumor.
e.zh: 患者被诊断出患有生长缓慢的类癌瘤。

e.en: {Carcinoid} syndrome can cause flushing and chronic diarrhea.
e.zh: 类癌综合征会引起潮红和慢性腹泻。

e.en: Early screening can detect basal cell {carcinoma} on the skin.
e.zh: 早期筛查可以发现皮肤的基底细胞癌。

e.en: The biopsy confirmed an aggressive lung {carcinoma}.
e.zh: 活检确认是一种侵袭性肺癌。

card.t:
n. 卡片；银行卡
v. 查验证件

e.en: Please tap your {card} on the reader to pay.
e.zh: 请把你的卡在读卡器上一刷支付。

e.en: She sent a birthday {card} to her grandmother.
e.zh: 她给奶奶寄了一张生日贺卡。

e.en: Add a pinch of {cardamom} to the coffee for extra flavor.
e.zh: 在咖啡里加一点豆蔻粉,味道更香。

e.en: This curry uses fresh ginger and crushed {cardamom} pods.
e.zh: 这道咖喱使用了鲜姜和压碎的豆蔻荚。

cardboard.t:
n. 硬纸板
adj. 刻板的

e.en: He flattened the {cardboard} boxes for recycling.
e.zh: 他把纸箱压扁后拿去回收。

e.en: The kids built a fort out of old {cardboard}.
e.zh: 孩子们用旧纸板搭了一个堡垒。

e.en: Please enter the {cardholder} name exactly as printed.
e.zh: 请按卡上印刷的名字准确输入持卡人姓名。

e.en: Every {cardholder} earns points on every purchase.
e.zh: 每位持卡人每笔消费都能积分。

e.en: The {cardia} is the upper opening where the esophagus meets the stomach.
e.zh: 贲门是食道与胃相接的上部开口。

e.en: Surgeons examined the {cardia} for signs of reflux damage.
e.zh: 外科医生检查贲门以寻找反流损伤的迹象。

e.en: The patient was rushed to the {cardiac} unit overnight.
e.zh: 患者连夜被送进了心脏科病房。

e.en: Regular exercise reduces the risk of {cardiac} disease.
e.zh: 经常运动可以降低患心脏病的风险。

cardiff.t: n. 卡迪夫（英国威尔士首府）

e.en: We took a weekend trip to {Cardiff} to watch a rugby match.
e.zh: 我们周末去卡迪夫看了一场橄榄球比赛。

e.en: {Cardiff} is the capital and largest city of Wales.
e.zh: 卡迪夫是威尔士的首都和最大城市。

e.en: She threw on a wool {cardigan} before heading outside.
e.zh: 她披上一件羊毛开衫就出门了。

e.en: His grandfather always wore a brown {cardigan} at home.
e.zh: 他爷爷在家总穿着一件棕色开衫。

e.en: The shop sells handmade {cardigans} in soft pastel colors.
e.zh: 这家店出售柔和粉彩色的手工开衫。

e.en: She knits {cardigans} for her grandchildren every winter.
e.zh: 她每年冬天都给孙辈织开衫。

cardiganshire.t: n. 卡迪根郡（威尔士旧郡）

e.en: They spent their holiday on the coast of {Cardiganshire}.
e.zh: 他们在卡迪根郡的海岸度假。

e.en: {Cardiganshire} is a historic county in west Wales.
e.zh: 卡迪根郡是威尔士西部的一个古老郡。

cardinal.t:
adj. 主要的；基本的
n. 红衣主教

e.en: Honesty is a {cardinal} virtue in their family.
e.zh: 诚实是他们家最重要的美德之一。

e.en: The {cardinal} addressed the crowd from the balcony.
e.zh: 那位红衣主教从阳台上向人群讲话。

e.en: My {cardiologist} recommended cutting back on salt.
e.zh: 我的心脏病医生建议我少吃盐。

e.en: She made an appointment with a {cardiologist} after the chest pain.
e.zh: 胸痛过后她预约了心脏科医生。

e.en: He completed his fellowship in {cardiology} last year.
e.zh: 他去年完成了心脏病学的专科培训。

e.en: The hospital's {cardiology} department is among the country's best.
e.zh: 该医院的心脏科是全国一流的。

e.en: The athlete was diagnosed with hypertrophic {cardiomyopathy}.
e.zh: 那位运动员被诊断患有肥厚型心肌病。

e.en: {Cardiomyopathy} weakens the heart muscle over time.
e.zh: 心肌病会随时间逐渐削弱心肌。

e.en: Bystanders performed {cardiopulmonary} resuscitation until paramedics arrived.
e.zh: 旁观者一直做心肺复苏,直到急救人员到达。

e.en: The test measures your {cardiopulmonary} fitness during exercise.
e.zh: 这项测试测量你运动时的心肺功能。

e.en: Running improves your {cardiorespiratory} endurance over time.
e.zh: 长期跑步可以提高心肺耐力。

e.en: The clinic offers {cardiorespiratory} screening for older patients.
e.zh: 该诊所为老年患者提供心肺功能筛查。

e.en: She trained as a {cardiothoracic} surgeon for nearly a decade.
e.zh: 她接受了近十年的心胸外科医生培训。

e.en: The {cardiothoracic} team performed a delicate bypass operation.
e.zh: 心胸外科团队做了一台精细的搭桥手术。

e.en: Walking daily is great for your {cardiovascular} health.
e.zh: 每天散步对心血管健康很有好处。

e.en: The drug reduces the risk of {cardiovascular} events significantly.
e.zh: 该药物能显著降低心血管事件的风险。

e.en: Doctors performed {cardioversion} to restore his normal heart rhythm.
e.zh: 医生为他做了电复律以恢复正常心律。

e.en: Electrical {cardioversion} is often used to treat atrial fibrillation.
e.zh: 电复律常用于治疗房颤。

e.en: They played {cards} all evening at the kitchen table.
e.zh: 他们整晚都在厨房桌子上打牌。

e.en: Most stores accept credit {cards} and mobile payments now.
e.zh: 现在大多数商店都接受信用卡和移动支付。

cardwell.t: n. 卡德韦尔（人名/地名）

e.en: We stopped in {Cardwell} on our drive up the coast.
e.zh: 我们沿海北上时在卡德韦尔停了一下。

e.en: {Cardwell} is a small town in tropical north Queensland.
e.zh: 卡德韦尔是昆士兰州北部热带地区的一个小镇。

cardy.t: n. 开襟毛衣（cardigan 的俗称）

e.en: Grab a {cardy} — it gets chilly in the evenings.
e.zh: 带件开衫吧——晚上会有点冷。

e.en: She pulled an oversized {cardy} on over her pajamas.
e.zh: 她在睡衣外套上一件宽松的开衫。

care.t:
v. 在乎；关心
n. 照顾；小心

e.en: I really {care} about how this project turns out.
e.zh: 我真的很在意这个项目的结果。

e.en: Elderly patients need long-term {care} and attention.
e.zh: 老年患者需要长期的照护和关注。

e.en: She {cared} for her sick mother for many years.
e.zh: 她照顾生病的母亲许多年。

e.en: He never really {cared} what other people thought.
e.zh: 他从不在乎别人怎么想。

careen.t: v. (车辆) 摇晃疾驰；倾侧

e.en: The truck began to {careen} wildly down the icy hill.
e.zh: 卡车开始在结冰的山坡上疯狂打滑下冲。

e.en: Stock prices {careen} between highs and lows every week.
e.zh: 股价每周都在高低之间剧烈摇摆。

e.en: The taxi came {careening} around the corner at full speed.
e.zh: 出租车全速冲过转角，摇摇晃晃。

e.en: I watched the shopping cart go {careening} into the parked cars.
e.zh: 我看着购物车失控地撞向停着的车。

e.en: She built a successful {career} in software engineering.
e.zh: 她在软件工程领域建立了成功的职业生涯。

e.en: This decision could damage your entire {career}.
e.zh: 这个决定可能会毁掉你整个职业生涯。

careerism.t: n. 个人野心至上主义

e.en: Critics accused the politician of pure {careerism}.
e.zh: 批评者指责这位政客只顾追求个人事业。

e.en: The company's culture rewards {careerism} over teamwork.
e.zh: 公司文化更看重往上爬，而不是团队合作。

careerist.t: n. 一心谋求升迁的人

e.en: He's a ruthless {careerist} who'll step on anyone.
e.zh: 他是个冷酷的事业野心家，会踩着任何人往上爬。

e.en: The office is full of {careerist} types chasing promotions.
e.zh: 办公室里满是追求升职的野心家。

careers.t: n. 职业（复数）；职业生涯

e.en: Many {careers} have been transformed by remote work.
e.zh: 许多职业都因远程办公而改变了面貌。

e.en: She {careers} down the slope without slowing down.
e.zh: 她不减速地飞速冲下斜坡。

e.en: I miss my {carefree} college days.
e.zh: 我怀念无忧无虑的大学时光。

e.en: The kids spent a {carefree} summer at the beach.
e.zh: 孩子们在海边度过了一个无忧无虑的夏天。

e.en: Be {careful} when crossing the busy street.
e.zh: 过繁忙的马路时要小心。

e.en: She gave the contract a {careful} reading before signing.
e.zh: 她在签字前仔细阅读了合同。

e.en: He {carefully} placed the vase on the top shelf.
e.zh: 他小心翼翼地把花瓶放在最上层。

e.en: Read the instructions {carefully} before starting.
e.zh: 开始之前请仔细阅读说明。

e.en: Her {carefulness} with details makes her a great editor.
e.zh: 她对细节的细致使她成为一名出色的编辑。

e.en: The job demands a high level of {carefulness}.
e.zh: 这份工作要求极高的细心程度。

e.en: My mother is the primary {caregiver} for my grandfather.
e.zh: 我母亲是我外公的主要照顾者。

e.en: The app helps {caregiver} families track medication schedules.
e.zh: 这款应用帮助护理家庭跟踪用药时间。

careless.t: adj. 粗心的；漫不经心的

e.en: One {careless} mistake cost the team the championship.
e.zh: 一个粗心的失误让球队丢了冠军。

e.en: He's {careless} with passwords and gets hacked often.
e.zh: 他对密码很随便，经常被黑。

e.en: She {carelessly} left her laptop on the train.
e.zh: 她粗心地把笔记本电脑落在了火车上。

e.en: He spoke {carelessly} and offended several guests.
e.zh: 他说话不经大脑，得罪了几位客人。

e.en: The accident was caused by sheer {carelessness}.
e.zh: 这场事故完全是由粗心大意造成的。

e.en: His {carelessness} with money worries his parents.
e.zh: 他对钱的随便态度让父母很担心。

e.en: The report listed several {carelessnesses} in the lab procedures.
e.zh: 报告列出了实验流程中的几处疏忽。

e.en: Small {carelessnesses} added up to a major safety failure.
e.zh: 小疏忽累积成了重大安全事故。

e.en: She works as a full-time {carer} for elderly patients.
e.zh: 她全职照顾年迈的病人。

e.en: The government offers benefits to every registered {carer}.
e.zh: 政府为每位注册护理者提供补贴。

cares.t:
v. 在乎（第三人称单数）
n. 忧虑

e.en: Nobody really {cares} about the old logo anymore.
e.zh: 没人再真正在意那个旧标志了。

e.en: She has too many {cares} weighing on her mind.
e.zh: 她心头压着太多烦心事。

caress.t:
v. 爱抚，轻抚
n. 抚摸

e.en: He gave her cheek a gentle {caress}.
e.zh: 他温柔地抚摸了一下她的脸颊。

e.en: The warm breeze seemed to {caress} my face.
e.zh: 温暖的微风仿佛在轻抚我的脸。

caressing.t:
adj. 爱抚的，温柔的
v. 爱抚 (caress 的现在分词)

e.en: She was {caressing} the cat as she watched TV.
e.zh: 她一边看电视一边轻抚着那只猫。

e.en: His voice had a soft, {caressing} tone.
e.zh: 他的声音柔和而温存。

e.en: He spoke {caressingly} to the frightened puppy.
e.zh: 他温柔地对受惊的小狗说话。

e.en: She ran her fingers {caressingly} through his hair.
e.zh: 她温柔地用手指梳过他的头发。

caretaker.t:
n. 看管人，管理员
adj. 临时代理的

e.en: The {caretaker} locks the building every night at ten.
e.zh: 看管员每晚十点锁好大楼。

e.en: A {caretaker} government will run the country until elections.
e.zh: 看守政府将管理国家直到选举举行。

caretaking.t:
n. 看管，照料
adj. 看管的

e.en: She handled the {caretaking} of the estate for years.
e.zh: 她多年来负责打理那处庄园。

e.en: His {caretaking} duties include feeding the animals daily.
e.zh: 他的看管职责包括每天给动物喂食。

careworn.t: adj. 饱经忧患的，憔悴的

e.en: Her {careworn} face showed years of hardship.
e.zh: 她饱经忧患的脸上写满了多年的艰辛。

e.en: The old farmer had {careworn} hands and tired eyes.
e.zh: 那位老农双手粗糙，眼神疲惫。

e.en: Mom gave me {carfare} so I could get home.
e.zh: 妈妈给了我车费让我能回家。

e.en: He didn't even have enough {carfare} for the bus.
e.zh: 他连坐公交车的车钱都不够。

carfax.t: n. 卡法克斯（地名；汽车历史查询品牌）

e.en: I checked the {carfax} report before buying the used SUV.
e.zh: 买这辆二手SUV前我查了车辆历史报告。

e.en: The {carfax} showed the car had been in two accidents.
e.zh: 车辆历史报告显示这辆车出过两次事故。

e.en: {Cargill} is one of the world's largest agricultural companies.
e.zh: 嘉吉是世界上最大的农业公司之一。

e.en: She got an internship at {Cargill} last summer.
e.zh: 她去年夏天在嘉吉公司实习。

cargo.t: n. 货物，(船、飞机装载的) 运货

e.en: The ship was loaded with {cargo} bound for Shanghai.
e.zh: 这艘船装满了运往上海的货物。

e.en: He wore baggy {cargo} pants with deep pockets.
e.zh: 他穿着口袋很深的宽松工装裤。

e.en: The port handles thousands of {cargoes} every month.
e.zh: 这个港口每月处理数千批货物。

e.en: Several {cargoes} of grain were delayed by the storm.
e.zh: 几批粮食货物因暴风雨而延误。

e.en: A {carhop} brought our burgers right to the window.
e.zh: 一名汽车餐厅服务员把汉堡直接送到车窗前。

e.en: She worked as a {carhop} at the drive-in diner.
e.zh: 她在汽车餐厅当过服务员。

caribbean.t:
adj. 加勒比海的
n. 加勒比地区

e.en: We took a {Caribbean} cruise for our honeymoon.
e.zh: 我们蜜月去了加勒比海邮轮旅行。

e.en: The food has strong {Caribbean} influences and lots of spice.
e.zh: 这些菜深受加勒比风味影响，香料丰富。

e.en: A herd of {caribou} crossed the highway in Alaska.
e.zh: 一群驯鹿在阿拉斯加横穿了公路。

e.en: The indigenous people have hunted {caribou} for centuries.
e.zh: 当地原住民几个世纪以来一直猎捕驯鹿。

caricatural.t: adj. 漫画式的，夸张讽刺的

e.en: The villain was almost {caricatural} in his evilness.
e.zh: 那个反派的邪恶几乎到了漫画化的程度。

e.en: His acting style felt {caricatural} rather than realistic.
e.zh: 他的表演风格像漫画夸张，而不是写实。

caricature.t:
n. 讽刺漫画
v. 把…画成漫画

e.en: The artist drew a funny {caricature} of the mayor.
e.zh: 画家画了一幅市长的搞笑漫画肖像。

e.en: The film is a {caricature} of small-town life.
e.zh: 这部电影把小镇生活刻画得很夸张。

caricatured.t: v. 画成漫画 (caricature 的过去式)

e.en: The cartoon {caricatured} every politician in the cabinet.
e.zh: 那幅漫画讽刺地描绘了内阁里的每位政客。

e.en: Her accent was {caricatured} on the comedy show.
e.zh: 她的口音在那档喜剧节目里被夸张模仿。

e.en: A street {caricaturist} drew my portrait in five minutes.
e.zh: 街头漫画师五分钟就画好了我的肖像。

e.en: The {caricaturist} exaggerated the senator's huge ears.
e.zh: 漫画师夸张地画出了那位参议员的大耳朵。

caricom.t: n. 加勒比共同体 (Caribbean Community)

e.en: {Caricom} leaders met to discuss regional climate policy.
e.zh: 加勒比共同体领导人开会讨论区域气候政策。

e.en: Trade between {Caricom} member states grew last year.
e.zh: 加共体成员国之间的贸易去年有所增长。

e.en: Regular brushing helps prevent dental {caries}.
e.zh: 经常刷牙有助于预防蛀牙。

e.en: The dentist found early-stage {caries} on two molars.
e.zh: 牙医在两颗臼齿上发现了早期蛀牙。

e.en: The church {carillon} plays a melody every hour.
e.zh: 教堂的排钟每小时奏响一段旋律。

e.en: We could hear the {carillon} ringing across the campus.
e.zh: 我们能听到排钟声在校园里回荡。

e.en: The constellation {Carina} is visible in the southern sky.
e.zh: 船底座在南半球的天空中可见。

e.en: The doctor examined the {carina} during the bronchoscopy.
e.zh: 医生在支气管镜检查时检查了气管隆突。

caring.t:
adj. 关怀的，体贴的
n. 关心，照顾

e.en: She's a deeply {caring} person who helps everyone.
e.zh: 她是个非常有爱心的人，乐于助人。

e.en: Thank you for {caring} about my mother during her illness.
e.zh: 谢谢你在我母亲生病期间关心她。

e.en: We hiked through the lakes of {Carinthia} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们徒步穿越了卡林西亚的湖区。

e.en: {Carinthia} is the southernmost state in Austria.
e.zh: 卡林西亚是奥地利最南端的州。

carioca.t: n. 里约热内卢人；卡里欧卡舞

e.en: As a true {carioca}, he loves Rio's beaches.
e.zh: 作为地道的里约人，他热爱里约的海滩。

e.en: The band played a lively {carioca} at the festival.
e.zh: 乐队在节日上演奏了欢快的卡里奥卡舞曲。

e.en: Two men tried to {carjack} her at the gas station.
e.zh: 两名男子在加油站试图劫走她的车。

e.en: It's risky to {carjack} someone in broad daylight downtown.
e.zh: 在市中心光天化日之下劫车风险极大。

e.en: Police arrested the {carjacker} after a short chase.
e.zh: 警方在短暂追逐后逮捕了那名劫车犯。

e.en: The {carjacker} threatened the driver with a knife.
e.zh: 劫车犯用刀威胁司机。

e.en: There's been a rise in {carjacking} cases this year.
e.zh: 今年劫车案件有所增加。

e.en: He survived a violent {carjacking} downtown last week.
e.zh: 上周他在市中心遭遇暴力劫车后幸存。

e.en: Living {carless} in the city is actually cheaper.
e.zh: 在城里不开车其实更便宜。

e.en: Many young adults are choosing a {carless} lifestyle.
e.zh: 许多年轻人选择不买车的生活方式。

e.en: She got into {Carleton} College on a full scholarship.
e.zh: 她获得全额奖学金被卡尔顿学院录取。

e.en: My cousin teaches economics at {Carleton} University.
e.zh: 我堂兄在卡尔顿大学教经济学。

carling.t: n. 卡林（啤酒品牌）；纵梁

e.en: He ordered a pint of {Carling} at the pub.
e.zh: 他在酒吧点了一品脱嘉令啤酒。

e.en: {Carling} sponsors several Premier League football matches.
e.zh: 嘉令赞助了多场英超联赛。

carlisle.t: n. 卡莱尔（英格兰城市）

e.en: We stopped in {Carlisle} on our way to Scotland.
e.zh: 我们在去苏格兰的路上经过卡莱尔。

e.en: {Carlisle} has a beautiful medieval castle and cathedral.
e.zh: 卡莱尔有一座美丽的中世纪城堡和大教堂。

e.en: We brought a {carload} of groceries home from Costco.
e.zh: 我们从好市多带了满满一车的食品回家。

e.en: A {carload} of teenagers showed up to the party.
e.zh: 一车青少年来到了派对。

e.en: He ordered a cold {Carlsberg} after the long hike.
e.zh: 长途徒步后他点了一杯冰镇嘉士伯啤酒。

e.en: {Carlsberg} sponsors several major football tournaments worldwide.
e.zh: 嘉士伯赞助了多项全球大型足球赛事。

e.en: They booked a suite at the Ritz-{Carlton} in Tokyo.
e.zh: 他们在东京丽思卡尔顿酒店订了套房。

e.en: {Carlton} is a popular surname in Commonwealth countries.
e.zh: 卡尔顿在英联邦国家是常见的姓氏。

e.en: Thomas {Carlyle} influenced Victorian thinking on heroes and history.
e.zh: 托马斯·卡莱尔影响了维多利亚时代关于英雄与历史的思想。

e.en: The {Carlyle} Group manages billions in private equity assets.
e.zh: 凯雷集团管理着数十亿美元的私募股权资产。

e.en: The Japanese {carmaker} unveiled its first electric SUV.
e.zh: 这家日本汽车制造商发布了其首款电动SUV。

e.en: Every major {carmaker} is investing heavily in self-driving tech.
e.zh: 各大汽车制造商都在自动驾驶技术上重金投入。

carmarthen.t: n. 卡马森（威尔士城镇）

e.en: We visited {Carmarthen}, one of the oldest towns in Wales.
e.zh: 我们参观了卡马森,威尔士最古老的城镇之一。

e.en: The market in {Carmarthen} has run for over eight centuries.
e.zh: 卡马森的集市已经延续了八百多年。

carmarthenshire.t: n. 卡马森郡（威尔士郡名）

e.en: {Carmarthenshire} offers stunning coastal walks and rolling green hills.
e.zh: 卡马森郡有迷人的海岸步道和连绵的绿色丘陵。

e.en: She grew up on a dairy farm in rural {Carmarthenshire}.
e.zh: 她在卡马森郡乡下的一个奶牛场长大。

e.en: They spent the weekend in {Carmel}-by-the-Sea, California.
e.zh: 他们在加州海滨小镇卡梅尔度过了周末。

e.en: Mount {Carmel} holds religious significance for several traditions.
e.zh: 迦密山对多个宗教传统都具有重要意义。

carmelite.t: n. 加尔默罗会修士；天主教修会成员

e.en: The {Carmelite} nuns lived a quiet life of prayer.
e.zh: 加尔默罗会的修女们过着安静的祈祷生活。

e.en: He studied the writings of a famous {Carmelite} mystic.
e.zh: 他研究了一位著名加尔默罗会神秘主义者的著作。

e.en: We watched a stunning production of Bizet's {Carmen} last night.
e.zh: 我们昨晚观看了一场精彩的比才《卡门》演出。

e.en: {Carmen} is one of the most performed operas worldwide.
e.zh: 《卡门》是全球上演次数最多的歌剧之一。

e.en: Hoagy {Carmichael} composed many beloved American jazz standards.
e.zh: 霍奇·卡迈克尔创作了许多深受喜爱的美国爵士经典曲目。

e.en: Stokely {Carmichael} popularized the phrase 'Black Power' in 1966.
e.zh: 斯托克利·卡迈克尔在1966年让“黑人力量”一词广为流传。

carmina.t: n. 卡尔米娜（女名）；拉丁语"歌"

e.en: The choir performed Orff's {Carmina} Burana with thunderous percussion.
e.zh: 合唱团表演了奥尔夫的《布兰诗歌》,打击乐震撼人心。

e.en: {Carmina} is Latin for songs or poems set to music.
e.zh: Carmina在拉丁语中意为配乐的歌曲或诗歌。

carmine.t:
n. 胭脂红
adj. 深红色的

e.en: Her lips were painted a deep, glossy {carmine}.
e.zh: 她的嘴唇涂着深沉而有光泽的胭脂红。

e.en: The artist mixed {carmine} into the sunset on her canvas.
e.zh: 画家在画布上的落日里调入了胭脂红。

e.en: We climbed to the {carn} marking the mountain's summit.
e.zh: 我们爬到了标记山顶的石冢处。

e.en: An ancient {carn} of stones stood beside the path.
e.zh: 小路旁矗立着一座古老的石堆。

e.en: {Carnaby} Street became iconic during the swinging sixties in London.
e.zh: 卡纳比街在伦敦摇摆的六十年代成为标志性街道。

e.en: We shopped for vintage clothes along {Carnaby} Street yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天沿着卡纳比街淘了不少复古服装。

e.en: The freeway pileup left scenes of horrific {carnage}.
e.zh: 高速公路连环追尾造成了惨烈的场面。

e.en: Critics called the budget cuts an act of political {carnage}.
e.zh: 评论人士称预算削减是一场政治大屠杀。

e.en: The novel explores {carnal} desire and its emotional consequences.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了肉体欲望及其情感后果。

e.en: He warned against indulging purely {carnal} pleasures.
e.zh: 他告诫人们不要纵情于纯粹的肉体享乐。

e.en: The sermon condemned {carnality} as a distraction from spiritual growth.
e.zh: 布道谴责肉欲会让人偏离灵性成长。

e.en: His poems blur the line between love and {carnality}.
e.zh: 他的诗模糊了爱情与肉欲之间的界限。

e.en: The two characters became {carnally} involved before truly knowing each other.
e.zh: 这两个角色在真正了解彼此之前就有了肉体关系。

e.en: He spoke {carnally} about the relationship, ignoring its emotional depth.
e.zh: 他用情欲化的方式谈论这段关系,忽视了其中的情感深度。

e.en: Lord {Carnarvon} funded the discovery of Tutankhamun's tomb in 1922.
e.zh: 卡纳冯勋爵资助了1922年图坦卡蒙陵墓的发现。

e.en: {Carnarvon} is also a coastal town in Western Australia.
e.zh: 卡纳冯也是西澳大利亚的一座沿海城镇。

e.en: He pinned a white {carnation} to his lapel for the wedding.
e.zh: 他在西装翻领上别了一朵白色康乃馨参加婚礼。

e.en: On Mother's Day, red {carnations} sell out at every florist.
e.zh: 母亲节那天,各家花店的红色康乃馨都会售罄。

e.en: Rio's {Carnaval} draws millions of dancers and tourists each February.
e.zh: 里约的狂欢节每年二月吸引数百万舞者和游客。

e.en: The streets exploded into color during {Carnaval} weekend.
e.zh: 狂欢节周末,街道上色彩缤纷,热闹非凡。

e.en: I ordered {carne} asada tacos with extra lime and cilantro.
e.zh: 我点了烤牛肉玉米卷,加多了青柠和香菜。

e.en: The chef slow-cooked the {carne} for over six hours.
e.zh: 厨师把这块肉慢炖了六个多小时。

e.en: Andrew {Carnegie} funded thousands of public libraries across America.
e.zh: 安德鲁·卡内基资助了全美数千座公共图书馆。

e.en: She dreamed of performing at {Carnegie} Hall someday.
e.zh: 她梦想有朝一日能在卡内基音乐厅演出。

e.en: She wore a {carnelian} pendant carved with ancient symbols.
e.zh: 她戴着一枚刻有古老符号的红玉髓吊坐。

e.en: Ancient Egyptians prized {carnelian} for protective amulets.
e.zh: 古埃及人将红玉髓视为珍贵的护身符宝石。

e.en: Art {Carney} won an Oscar for his role in Harry and Tonto.
e.zh: 阿特·卡尼凭借《老人与猫》一片荣获奥斯卡奖。

e.en: The old {carney} could spot a mark from across the fairground.
e.zh: 那个老江湖艺人能从游乐场的另一端看出谁是冤大头。

e.en: Some athletes take {carnitine} supplements to support fat metabolism.
e.zh: 一些运动员会服用左旋肉碱补剂来辅助脂肪代谢。

e.en: Red meat is naturally rich in {carnitine}.
e.zh: 红肉本身就富含左旋肉碱。

e.en: The kids spent all evening at the traveling {carnival}.
e.zh: 孩子们整晚都在巡回嘉年华里玩个不停。

e.en: Venice's {carnival} is famous for its elaborate masks and costumes.
e.zh: 威尼斯狂欢节以精致的面具和服装而闻名。

carnivalesque.t: adj. 嘉年华式的；狂欢喧闹的

e.en: The film has a wild, {carnivalesque} energy from start to finish.
e.zh: 这部电影从头到尾都充满了狂欢般的疯狂能量。

e.en: Her novels are known for their {carnivalesque} blend of humor and chaos.
e.zh: 她的小说以狂欢式的幽默与混乱融合而著称。

e.en: Summer {carnivals} fill small towns with rides, games, and cotton candy.
e.zh: 夏天的嘉年华让小镇充满了游乐设施、游戏和棉花糖。

e.en: Brazil hosts some of the world's most spectacular {carnivals}.
e.zh: 巴西举办着全球最壮观的几场狂欢节。

e.en: The lion is an apex {carnivore} on the African savanna.
e.zh: 狮子是非洲草原上的顶级食肉动物。

e.en: As a committed {carnivore}, he ordered the steak rare.
e.zh: 作为坚定的肉食爱好者,他点了五分熟的牛排。

e.en: Venus flytraps are {carnivorous} plants that catch insects.
e.zh: 捕蝇草是会捕捉昆虫的食肉植物。

e.en: Wolves are highly social and strictly {carnivorous} animals.
e.zh: 狼是高度群居且严格食肉的动物。

carny.t: n. 游乐场/马戏团工作人员

e.en: He worked as a {carny} running the Ferris wheel one summer.
e.zh: 有一年夏天他在游乐场打工,负责操作摩天轮。

e.en: The film follows a young {carny} chasing his dreams across America.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述一名年轻嘉年华工人横跨美国追梦的故事。

caro.t: adj. 亲爱的（意/西语）；姓氏

e.en: She signed her letter, '{Caro} mio, I miss you.'
e.zh: 她在信末写道:“我亲爱的,我想你。”

e.en: Robert {Caro} is famous for his exhaustive political biographies.
e.zh: 罗伯特·卡罗以详尽的政治人物传记而闻名。

carob.t: n. 角豆树；角豆（巧克力替代品）

e.en: She uses {carob} powder instead of cocoa for caffeine-free brownies.
e.zh: 她用角豆粉代替可可粉来做无咖啡因的布朗尼。

e.en: The {carob} tree thrives in dry Mediterranean climates.
e.zh: 角豆树在干燥的地中海气候中生长茂盛。

carol.t:
n. 颂歌；圣诞颂歌
v. 唱颂歌

e.en: The children sang a Christmas {carol} on the doorstep.
e.zh: 孩子们在门口唱起了圣诞颂歌。

e.en: Carolers will {carol} through the neighborhood on Christmas Eve.
e.zh: 颂歌队将在平安夜走遍整个街区报佳音。

e.en: A cheerful {caroler} handed us a candle and a songbook.
e.zh: 一位欢快的颂歌歌手递给我们一支蜡烛和一本歌本。

e.en: Each {caroler} wore a red scarf and Santa hat.
e.zh: 每位颂歌歌手都戴着红围巾和圣诞帽。

carolina.t: n. 卡罗来纳（美国地名）

e.en: They drove down to {Carolina} for a beach weekend.
e.zh: 他们开车去卡罗来纳州度了一个海滨周末。

e.en: North {Carolina} is known for its barbecue and basketball culture.
e.zh: 北卡罗来纳州以烧烤和篮球文化闻名。

e.en: {Caroline} just got promoted to senior product manager.
e.zh: 卡罗琳刚刚晋升为高级产品经理。

e.en: Princess {Caroline} of Monaco often appears in European tabloids.
e.zh: 摩纳哥的卡罗琳公主经常登上欧洲八卦小报。

carolingian.t:
adj. 加洛林王朝的
n. 加洛林王朝成员

e.en: The {Carolingian} empire reached its peak under Charlemagne.
e.zh: 加洛林帝国在查理曼大帝时期达到鼎盛。

e.en: Scholars revived classical learning during the {Carolingian} Renaissance.
e.zh: 学者们在加洛林文艺复兴时期重振了古典学问。

carolinian.t:
n. 卡罗来纳人
adj. 卡罗来纳的

e.en: He spoke with a slow, friendly {Carolinian} drawl.
e.zh: 他说话带着缓慢而友好的卡罗来纳口音。

e.en: The recipe captures the heart of classic {Carolinian} cooking.
e.zh: 这道食谱抓住了经典卡罗来纳烹饪的精髓。

e.en: The cue ball will {carom} off two cushions before sinking.
e.zh: 母球会先撞两次台边才落袋。

e.en: His shot caused a perfect {carom} into the corner pocket.
e.zh: 他的击球完美撞库后落入角袋。

e.en: Carrots get their orange color from beta-{carotene}.
e.zh: 胡萝卜的橙色来自β-胡萝卜素。

e.en: The body converts {carotene} into vitamin A as needed.
e.zh: 人体会按需把胡萝卜素转化为维生素A。

e.en: Tomatoes contain a {carotenoid} called lycopene linked to heart health.
e.zh: 番茄含有一种叫番茄红素的类胡萝卜素,有益心脏健康。

e.en: Flamingos turn pink from {carotenoid} pigments in their diet.
e.zh: 火烈鸟变粉是因为食物中的类胡萝卜素色素。

carotid.t:
n. 颈动脉
adj. 颈动脉的

e.en: The doctor checked his {carotid} pulse during the exam.
e.zh: 医生在检查时摸了他的颈动脉脉搏。

e.en: A blocked {carotid} artery can dramatically increase stroke risk.
e.zh: 颈动脉堵塞会大幅增加中风风险。

e.en: The sailors would {carouse} in port until dawn.
e.zh: 水手们会在港口纵情狂欢直到天亮。

e.en: They went out to {carouse} after winning the championship.
e.zh: 夺冠之后他们出去尽情狂欢了一番。

carousel.t: n. 轮播图；旋转木马；行李传送带

e.en: My luggage was the last off the airport {carousel}.
e.zh: 我的行李是机场行李转盘上最后一件下来的。

e.en: The kids begged for one more ride on the {carousel}.
e.zh: 孩子们求着再坐一次旋转木马。

carousing.t: n. 狂饮作乐；豪饮喧闹

e.en: They spent the night {carousing} with old college friends.
e.zh: 他们整晚都在和大学老友们尽情狂欢。

e.en: Loud {carousing} from the bar kept the neighbors awake.
e.zh: 酒吧里大声的狂欢闹得邻居整夜睡不着。

carp.t:
n. 鲤鱼
v. 唠叨抱怨

e.en: He caught a huge {carp} in the village pond.
e.zh: 他在村里的池塘钓到了一条很大的鲤鱼。

e.en: Stop {carping} about every little detail of the plan.
e.zh: 别再对计划的每个小细节挑三拣四了。

carpaccio.t: n. 生肉/生鱼薄片（意式前菜）

e.en: We started with beef {carpaccio} drizzled in olive oil.
e.zh: 我们以淋了橄榄油的生牛肉薄片作为开胃菜。

e.en: The chef serves a delicate tuna {carpaccio} with capers.
e.zh: 主厨上了一道配酸豆的精致金枪鱼薄片。

carpal.t:
adj. 腕骨的
n. 腕骨

e.en: Years of typing gave him {carpal} tunnel syndrome.
e.zh: 多年的打字让他患上了腕管综合症。

e.en: The wrist contains eight small {carpal} bones.
e.zh: 手腕由八块小小的腕骨组成。

e.en: The {carpark} was full by 9 a.m. on Saturday.
e.zh: 周六上午九点停车场就停满了。

e.en: She left her keys in the multi-storey {carpark}.
e.zh: 她把钥匙落在多层停车场里了。

e.en: We hiked through the {Carpathian} mountains last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们徒步穿越了喀尔巴阡山脉。

e.en: The legend originates from a remote {Carpathian} village.
e.zh: 这个传说源自一个偏远的喀尔巴阡村庄。

e.en: Each {carpel} contains the seeds of the flower.
e.zh: 每个心皮里都包含着花的种子。

e.en: The biology teacher pointed to the {carpel} during class.
e.zh: 生物老师在课上指着心皮讲解。

e.en: My grandfather was a skilled {carpenter} for forty years.
e.zh: 我爷爷做了四十年的熟练木匠。

e.en: We hired a {carpenter} to build custom kitchen cabinets.
e.zh: 我们雇了个木匠来定制厨房橱柜。

e.en: The {carpenters} finished the deck in just three days.
e.zh: 木匠们只用了三天就完成了露台。

e.en: Local {carpenters} are in high demand this season.
e.zh: 本季当地的木匠非常抢手。

e.en: The town has several family-run {carpentries} dating back generations.
e.zh: 镇上有几家世代相传的木工作坊。

e.en: Traditional {carpentries} still use hand tools for fine work.
e.zh: 传统木工坊精细活计仍用手工工具。

e.en: He's taking a {carpentry} class on weekends.
e.zh: 他周末在上木工课。

e.en: The {carpentry} on this old house is remarkable.
e.zh: 这栋老房子的木工活做得非常出色。

carpet.t:
n. 地毯
v. 铺地毯

e.en: They installed a thick wool {carpet} in the bedroom.
e.zh: 他们在卧室铺了一块厚实的羊毛地毯。

e.en: Please don't spill coffee on the new {carpet}.
e.zh: 请别把咖啡洒在新地毯上。

e.en: She traveled west carrying only an old {carpetbag}.
e.zh: 她只带着一个旧花毯包就西行了。

e.en: The antique {carpetbag} sold for hundreds at auction.
e.zh: 那只古董花毯包在拍卖会上卖了几百块。

carpetbagger.t: n. 投机政客，外来投机者

e.en: Locals dismissed the new candidate as a {carpetbagger}.
e.zh: 当地人把这位新候选人视为外来投机客。

e.en: The newspaper called him a political {carpetbagger}.
e.zh: 报纸称他是个政治投机者。

carpeted.t:
adj. 铺了地毯的
v. carpet 的过去式

e.en: The hallway is {carpeted} in a soft beige.
e.zh: 走廊铺着柔和的米色地毯。

e.en: Fallen leaves {carpeted} the forest floor in October.
e.zh: 十月里落叶铺满了林间地面。

e.en: New {carpeting} throughout the office cost a fortune.
e.zh: 整个办公室换新地毯花了一大笔钱。

e.en: Wildflowers were {carpeting} the entire hillside.
e.zh: 野花覆盖了整个山坡。

e.en: Persian {carpets} can take years to weave by hand.
e.zh: 波斯地毯手工编织起来要花好几年。

e.en: She vacuums the {carpets} every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 她每周六早上都用吸尘器清理地毯。

carping.t:
adj. 爱挑剔的
n. 吹毛求疵

e.en: I'm tired of his constant {carping} about the food.
e.zh: 我受够了他不停地挑剔食物。

e.en: Stop {carping} and help with the dishes.
e.zh: 别再唠叨抱怨了,过来帮忙洗碗。

e.en: We {carpool} to work to save on gas.
e.zh: 我们拼车上下班来省油钱。

e.en: Joining a {carpool} cuts my commute costs in half.
e.zh: 加入拼车小组让我的通勤成本省了一半。

carpools.t: n./v. 拼车（复数/第三人称）

e.en: Several parents organize school {carpools} every morning.
e.zh: 几位家长每天早上组织拼车送孩子上学。

e.en: She {carpools} with three colleagues from her neighborhood.
e.zh: 她和小区里三位同事一起拼车。

e.en: They built a wooden {carport} beside the garage.
e.zh: 他们在车库旁搭了一个木制车棚。

e.en: The {carport} barely shelters the car from the rain.
e.zh: 那个车棚几乎遮不住车不被雨淋。

carrara.t: n. 卡拉拉（意大利地名，产白大理石）

e.en: The kitchen counters are made of polished {Carrara} marble.
e.zh: 厨房台面是用抛光的卡拉拉大理石做的。

e.en: Michelangelo sourced his stone from {Carrara} quarries.
e.zh: 米开朗琪罗从卡拉拉的采石场取石材。

carrel.t: n. 图书馆单人阅读间

e.en: I booked a quiet {carrel} on the library's third floor.
e.zh: 我在图书馆三楼订了一间安静的小阅览间。

e.en: Each study {carrel} has its own desk lamp.
e.zh: 每个学习卡座都配有独立的台灯。

carrera.t: n. 卡雷拉（保时捷车型/姓氏）

e.en: He drives a vintage Porsche {Carrera} on weekends.
e.zh: 他周末开一辆复古的保时捷卡雷拉。

e.en: The {Carrera} accelerated smoothly onto the highway.
e.zh: 那辆卡雷拉平稳地加速驶上了高速公路。

carriage.t:
n. 马车；（火车）车厢
n. 运输，运费

e.en: A horse-drawn {carriage} took us through Central Park.
e.zh: 一辆马车带我们穿过了中央公园。

e.en: The first-class {carriage} was nearly empty.
e.zh: 头等车厢几乎空无一人。

e.en: The train has twelve {carriages} including a dining car.
e.zh: 这列火车有十二节车厢,包括一节餐车。

e.en: Antique {carriages} are displayed in the royal museum.
e.zh: 古董马车陈列在皇家博物馆里。

e.en: Both lanes of the {carriageway} were closed for repairs.
e.zh: 行车道的两条车道都因维修被封闭了。

e.en: An accident blocked the southbound {carriageway} all morning.
e.zh: 一起事故整个上午都堵住了南向车道。

e.en: We sailed past {Carrick} castle at sunset.
e.zh: 我们在日落时分驶过卡里克城堡。

e.en: The {Carrick} bend is a useful sailing knot.
e.zh: 卡里克结是一种实用的航海绳结。

carrickfergus.t: n. 卡里克弗格斯（北爱尔兰地名）

e.en: {Carrickfergus} is famous for its medieval Norman castle.
e.zh: 卡里克弗格斯以中世纪诺曼城堡而闻名。

e.en: The folk song about {Carrickfergus} brings me to tears.
e.zh: 那首关于卡里克弗格斯的民谣总让我落泪。

carried.t: v. carry 的过去式；携带、搬运

e.en: She {carried} the heavy box up four flights of stairs.
e.zh: 她把那个重箱子搬上了四层楼。

e.en: The proposal was {carried} by a narrow majority.
e.zh: 该提案以微弱多数获得通过。

carrier.t:
n. 运营商（电信）；承运人
n. 带原者；航母

e.en: Choose a wireless {carrier} with good rural coverage.
e.zh: 选个农村信号好的无线运营商。

e.en: The aircraft {carrier} returned to port after six months.
e.zh: 那艘航空母舰在六个月后返港。

carriers.t: n. 运营商；承运人（复数）

e.en: Major {carriers} are competing on 5G network speeds.
e.zh: 各大运营商正在比拼5G网速。

e.en: Mosquitoes are common {carriers} of tropical diseases.
e.zh: 蚊子是热带疾病的常见传播媒介。

carries.t: v. carry 的第三人称单数；携带

e.en: This bag {carries} my laptop and a change of clothes.
e.zh: 这个包能装下我的笔记本和一套换洗衣物。

e.en: The store {carries} every brand of running shoe.
e.zh: 这家店各种品牌的跑鞋都有卖。

e.en: A {Carrington}-level solar storm could knock out power grids.
e.zh: 卡灵顿级别的太阳风暴可能瘫痪电网。

e.en: Leonora {Carrington} painted dreamlike surrealist scenes.
e.zh: 莱奥诺拉·卡灵顿画过梦幻般的超现实主义场景。

e.en: Vultures circled overhead, searching for {carrion}.
e.zh: 秃鹫在头顶盘旋,搜寻着腐肉。

e.en: Hyenas often feed on {carrion} left by lions.
e.zh: 鬣狗常吃狮子留下的腐肉。

e.en: Lewis {Carroll} wrote Alice in Wonderland in 1865.
e.zh: 刘易斯·卡罗尔在1865年写下了《爱丽丝梦游仙境》。

e.en: {Carroll} loved riddles, photography, and mathematical puzzles.
e.zh: 卡罗尔喜爱谜语、摄影和数学难题。

carron.t: n. 卡伦（苏格兰地名/姓氏）

e.en: The old {Carron} ironworks once supplied cannons to Britain.
e.zh: 古老的卡伦铁厂曾为英国供应过火炮。

e.en: A heavy {Carron} stove warmed the cottage all winter.
e.zh: 一台沉重的卡伦炉子让小屋整个冬天都很温暖。

e.en: The rabbit nibbled happily on a fresh {carrot}.
e.zh: 兔子开心地啃着一根新鲜胡萝卜。

e.en: Management dangled a bonus as a {carrot} for overtime.
e.zh: 管理层用奖金作诱饵来鼓励加班。

e.en: She chopped {carrots} and onions for the stew.
e.zh: 她切了胡萝卜和洋葱准备炖菜。

e.en: Eating {carrots} is supposed to be good for your eyes.
e.zh: 据说吃胡萝卜对眼睛有好处。

e.en: Norwich City plays its home games at {Carrow} Road.
e.zh: 诺维奇城队的主场比赛在卡罗路球场进行。

e.en: Fans packed {Carrow} Road for the cup final.
e.zh: 球迷把卡罗路球场挤得水泄不通观看杯赛决赛。

carry.t:
v. 携带，搬运
v. 传递；承载

e.en: Can you help me {carry} the groceries inside?
e.zh: 你能帮我把杂货拎进屋里吗?

e.en: Most airlines {carry} insurance for lost luggage.
e.zh: 大多数航空公司都为丢失的行李投保。

e.en: She tossed her laptop into a leather {carryall}.
e.zh: 她把笔记本电脑塞进一个皮质大手提包里。

e.en: This canvas {carryall} fits everything for a weekend trip.
e.zh: 这个帆布大包能装下周末旅行的全部行李。

e.en: The baby slept soundly in the {carrycot} all afternoon.
e.zh: 宝宝整个下午都在便携婴儿提篮里睡得很香。

e.en: Most modern strollers come with a detachable {carrycot}.
e.zh: 大多数现代婴儿车都配有可拆卸的提篮。

carrying.t: v. carry 的现在分词；携带，搬运

e.en: She was {carrying} two bags of groceries up the stairs.
e.zh: 她正提着两袋杂货上楼。

e.en: The truck was {carrying} steel beams across the bridge.
e.zh: 卡车正载着钢梁过桥。

e.en: Last quarter's losses were a {carryover} from the recession.
e.zh: 上季度的亏损是经济衰退留下的后遗症。

e.en: My unused vacation days are a {carryover} into next year.
e.zh: 我没用完的假期可以结转到明年。

e.en: Electric {cars} are becoming more affordable each year.
e.zh: 电动汽车每年都变得更加亲民。

e.en: Several {cars} were stuck in the snowstorm overnight.
e.zh: 暴风雪中好几辆车被困了一整夜。

carshalton.t: n. 卡舍尔顿（伦敦地名）

e.en: {Carshalton} is a leafy suburb in south London.
e.zh: 卡尔沙尔顿是伦敦南部一个绿树成荫的郊区。

e.en: We took the train to {Carshalton} to visit relatives.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去卡尔沙尔顿探亲。

e.en: My daughter always gets {carsick} on winding mountain roads.
e.zh: 我女儿在蜿蜒的山路上总会晕车。

e.en: Reading in the back seat makes me {carsick}.
e.zh: 坐在后座看书会让我晕车。

e.en: Rachel {Carson} warned the world about pesticide dangers.
e.zh: 蕾切尔·卡森向世界警示了杀虫剂的危害。

e.en: {Carson} City is the capital of Nevada.
e.zh: 卡森城是内华达州的首府。

carstairs.t: n. 卡斯泰尔斯（姓氏/地名）

e.en: The patient was transferred to {Carstairs} secure hospital.
e.zh: 那位病人被转送到卡斯泰尔斯戒备医院。

e.en: {Carstairs} village lies in the Scottish lowlands.
e.zh: 卡斯泰尔斯村位于苏格兰低地。

cart.t:
n. 购物车（电商）
n. 手推车；v. 搬运

e.en: I added three items to my shopping {cart}.
e.zh: 我往购物车里加了三件商品。

e.en: The farmer pulled a wooden {cart} loaded with hay.
e.zh: 农民拉着一辆装满干草的木板车。

e.en: {Cartagena} has stunning colonial architecture and Caribbean beaches.
e.zh: 卡塔赫纳有迷人的殖民地建筑和加勒比海滩。

e.en: We spent four days exploring old {Cartagena} on foot.
e.zh: 我们花了四天徒步游览卡塔赫纳老城。

e.en: The chef gave me {carte} blanche over the menu.
e.zh: 主厨让我对菜单全权做主。

e.en: You can order à la {carte} or pick the set meal.
e.zh: 你可以单点,也可以选择套餐。

e.en: The oil {cartel} agreed to cut production next month.
e.zh: 该石油卡特尔同意下月减产。

e.en: Authorities dismantled a major drug {cartel} after years of investigation.
e.zh: 当局经过多年调查捣毁了一个大毒品集团。

carter.t:
n. 运货马车夫
n. 卡特（姓氏）

e.en: The {carter} delivered hay to the village every morning.
e.zh: 那位车夫每天早上给村里送干草。

e.en: President {Carter} negotiated the historic peace agreement.
e.zh: 卡特总统促成了那项历史性的和平协议。

cartesian.t: adj. 笛卡尔的；笛卡尔坐标的

e.en: Plot the points on a {Cartesian} coordinate system.
e.zh: 把这些点画在笛卡尔坐标系上。

e.en: The robot uses {Cartesian} geometry to navigate the warehouse.
e.zh: 该机器人利用笛卡尔几何在仓库中导航。

e.en: The professor lectured on the legacy of {Cartesianism} in modern philosophy.
e.zh: 教授讲述了笛卡尔主义对现代哲学的影响。

e.en: {Cartesianism} separates the mind from the physical body.
e.zh: 笛卡尔主义将心灵与身体分离开来。

e.en: Ancient {Carthage} was destroyed by Rome in 146 BC.
e.zh: 古迦太基于公元前146年被罗马摧毁。

e.en: Tourists explore the ruins of {Carthage} near modern Tunis.
e.zh: 游客在突尼斯附近游览迦太基遗址。

carthaginian.t:
adj. 迦太基的
n. 迦太基人

e.en: Hannibal led the {Carthaginian} army across the Alps.
e.zh: 汉尼拔率领迦太基军队翻越阿尔卑斯山。

e.en: Archaeologists found a {Carthaginian} coin near the harbor.
e.zh: 考古学家在港口附近发现了一枚迦太基钱币。

e.en: The heavy {carthorse} pulled the wagon up the hill.
e.zh: 那匹壮硕的役马拉着货车上了山。

e.en: He moves like a {carthorse} when he's tired.
e.zh: 他累的时候走起路来像头老马一样笨重。

carthusian.t:
adj. 加尔都西会的
n. 加尔都西会修士

e.en: The {Carthusian} monks live in silence and solitude.
e.zh: 加尔都西会的修士过着沉默而独居的生活。

e.en: She visited a {Carthusian} monastery high in the French Alps.
e.zh: 她参观了法国阿尔卑斯山深处的一座加尔都西会修道院。

e.en: He bought her a {Cartier} watch for their anniversary.
e.zh: 他在结婚纪念日给她买了一只卡地亚手表。

e.en: The {Cartier} boutique on Fifth Avenue is always crowded.
e.zh: 第五大道上的卡地亚精品店总是人来人往。

e.en: She tore the {cartilage} in her knee playing soccer.
e.zh: 她踢足球时撕裂了膝盖的软骨。

e.en: Sharks have skeletons made entirely of {cartilage}.
e.zh: 鲨鱼的骨架完全由软骨构成。

e.en: Sharks and rays are {cartilaginous} fish without true bones.
e.zh: 鲨鱼和鳐鱼是没有真正骨头的软骨鱼。

e.en: The doctor examined a {cartilaginous} growth on his ear.
e.zh: 医生检查了他耳朵上的一处软骨增生。

carting.t: v. 用车运送（cart 的现在分词）

e.en: The movers spent hours {carting} boxes up the stairs.
e.zh: 搬家工人花了好几个小时把箱子搬上楼。

e.en: Volunteers were {carting} supplies to the flood victims.
e.zh: 志愿者们正在把物资运往灾区受灾群众那里。

e.en: He delivered a {cartload} of firewood to the cabin.
e.zh: 他给小屋送来了满满一车柴火。

e.en: The farmer sold a whole {cartload} of pumpkins at the market.
e.zh: 那位农夫在集市上卖掉了满满一车南瓜。

e.en: The {cartographer} spent years drawing maps of the coastline.
e.zh: 那位制图师花了多年时间绘制海岸线地图。

e.en: A modern {cartographer} relies heavily on satellite data.
e.zh: 现代制图师在工作中大量依赖卫星数据。

e.en: The museum displays rare {cartographic} works from the 16th century.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了十六世纪的珍贵地图作品。

e.en: New software has revolutionized {cartographic} accuracy.
e.zh: 新软件极大地提升了地图绘制的精确度。

e.en: Digital {cartography} has transformed how we make maps today.
e.zh: 数字制图学彻底改变了今天的地图绘制方式。

e.en: She studied {cartography} at university before joining Google Maps.
e.zh: 她在大学学过制图学,后来加入了谷歌地图团队。

e.en: Please grab a {carton} of milk on your way home.
e.zh: 回家路上麻烦买一盒牛奶。

e.en: The fragile vase arrived in a sturdy {carton}.
e.zh: 那只易碎花瓶装在一个结实的纸箱里送到了。

e.en: Stack the empty {cartons} behind the warehouse for recycling.
e.zh: 把空纸箱堆在仓库后面等着回收。

e.en: She bought three {cartons} of eggs for the bakery.
e.zh: 她为面包店买了三盒鸡蛋。

e.en: My kids watch the same {cartoon} every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 我家孩子每周六早上都看同一部动画片。

e.en: The newspaper printed a political {cartoon} on its front page.
e.zh: 那家报纸在头版刊登了一幅政治漫画。

cartoonish.t: adj. 卡通式的；夸张滑稽的

e.en: The villain's {cartoonish} laugh made the audience giggle.
e.zh: 反派那夸张漫画式的笑声把观众逗乐了。

e.en: His acting was so {cartoonish} that no one took it seriously.
e.zh: 他的表演太像卡通人物了,没人当回事。

e.en: The {cartoonist} draws a new comic strip every week.
e.zh: 那位漫画家每周都画一组新连环画。

e.en: She works as a freelance {cartoonist} for several magazines.
e.zh: 她为多家杂志做自由漫画家。

e.en: Modern {cartoons} often appeal to adults as much as kids.
e.zh: 现代动画片往往同时吸引成人和孩子。

e.en: He grew up watching Saturday morning {cartoons} on TV.
e.zh: 他是看着周六早上电视里的动画片长大的。

cartouche.t: n. 涡形装饰；椭圆形纹章

e.en: The pharaoh's name was carved inside an oval {cartouche}.
e.zh: 法老的名字被刻在椭圆形的王名圈里。

e.en: Egyptologists translated the symbols within the ancient {cartouche}.
e.zh: 埃及学家解读了那个古老王名圈内的符号。

cartridge.t:
n. 弹药筒
n. 墨盒；打印耗材

e.en: My printer needs a new ink {cartridge} again.
e.zh: 我的打印机又得换新墨盒了。

e.en: He loaded a fresh {cartridge} into the rifle.
e.zh: 他往步枪里装了一发新子弹。

cartwheel.t:
n. 侧手翻
n. 大车轮

e.en: She did a perfect {cartwheel} across the gym floor.
e.zh: 她在体操馆地板上漂亮地翻了个侧手翻。

e.en: The kids took turns doing a {cartwheel} on the lawn.
e.zh: 孩子们轮流在草坪上翻侧手翻。

cartwright.t:
n. 造车匠
n. 卡特赖特（姓氏）

e.en: The village {cartwright} repaired wagon wheels for a living.
e.zh: 村里的造车匠靠修理车轮谋生。

e.en: My neighbor Mr. {Cartwright} restores antique carriages.
e.zh: 我的邻居卡特赖特先生专门修复古董马车。

e.en: Enrico {Caruso} remains one of the most celebrated tenors in history.
e.zh: 恩里科·卡鲁索至今仍是史上最负盛名的男高音之一。

e.en: My grandfather collected old {Caruso} recordings on vinyl.
e.zh: 我祖父收藏了不少卡鲁索的老黑胶唱片。

e.en: He likes to {carve} pumpkins every Halloween.
e.zh: 他每年万圣节都喜欢雕南瓜。

e.en: Dad will {carve} the turkey at the dinner table.
e.zh: 爸爸会在餐桌上切火鸡。

carved.t:
adj. 雕刻的
v. 雕刻（过去式）

e.en: The artist {carved} a beautiful eagle from a single log.
e.zh: 艺术家用整根原木雕出了一只精美的雄鹰。

e.en: Her initials were {carved} into the old wooden bench.
e.zh: 她的名字缩写被刻在了那张旧木长椅上。

e.en: The wood {carver} sells handmade figurines at the market.
e.zh: 那位木雕师在集市上卖手工小雕像。

e.en: My uncle is a skilled ice {carver} for hotel events.
e.zh: 我叔叔是一位为酒店活动雕冰的能手。

e.en: The hotel {carvery} serves roast beef every Sunday afternoon.
e.zh: 酒店的烤肉自助餐厅每周日下午供应烤牛肉。

e.en: We had a huge lunch at the {carvery} downtown.
e.zh: 我们在市中心的烤肉餐厅吃了一顿丰盛的午餐。

carves.t: v. 雕刻（第三人称单数）

e.en: He carefully {carves} the roast chicken for the family.
e.zh: 他小心翼翼地为家人切开烤鸡。

e.en: The river {carves} a deep canyon through the desert.
e.zh: 那条河在沙漠中切割出一道深邃的峡谷。

carving.t:
n. 雕刻品
v. 雕刻（现在分词）

e.en: The wooden {carving} on the door is over a century old.
e.zh: 门上的木雕已有一百多年历史。

e.en: Grandpa is {carving} a small boat for his grandson.
e.zh: 爷爷正在给孙子雕一艘小船。

e.en: I took my muddy SUV through the {carwash} after the trip.
e.zh: 旅行回来后我把沾满泥的越野车开去了洗车场。

e.en: The high school team is hosting a {carwash} fundraiser.
e.zh: 高中校队正举办洗车筹款活动。

e.en: Each {caryatid} on the temple supports the marble roof gracefully.
e.zh: 神庙上的每尊女像柱都优雅地支撑着大理石屋顶。

e.en: The Acropolis museum displays a famous ancient {caryatid}.
e.zh: 卫城博物馆陈列着一尊著名的古代女像柱。

cas.t: n. CAS（常见缩写，如化学文摘服务）

e.en: The chemical's {CAS} number helps identify it across databases.
e.zh: 该化学品的CAS编号有助于在各数据库中识别它。

e.en: Single sign-on uses {CAS} to authenticate users across services.
e.zh: 单点登录使用CAS协议在多个服务之间验证用户身份。

e.en: Welcome to my humble {casa} — please come in.
e.zh: 欢迎来到我的小家,请进吧。

e.en: We rented a beachside {casa} in Mexico for the holidays.
e.zh: 我们在墨西哥租了一栋海边小屋过假期。

e.en: {Casablanca} is the largest city in Morocco.
e.zh: 卡萨布兰卡是摩洛哥最大的城市。

e.en: We watched the classic film {Casablanca} together last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我们一起看了经典电影《卡萨布兰卡》。

casanova.t: n. 卡萨诺瓦；风流男子

e.en: He fancies himself a {Casanova}, but few are impressed.
e.zh: 他自以为是个情圣,但没几个人吃这套。

e.en: The novel portrays a charming {Casanova} of eighteenth-century Venice.
e.zh: 小说描绘了一位十八世纪威尼斯的风流情圣。

e.en: We got lost wandering the narrow alleys of the {Casbah}.
e.zh: 我们在卡斯巴老城的狭窄小巷里迷路了。

e.en: The old {Casbah} of Algiers is a UNESCO heritage site.
e.zh: 阿尔及尔的卡斯巴老城是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。

cascade.t:
n. 小瀑布；级联
v. 层叠流下

e.en: A small failure can {cascade} into a system-wide outage.
e.zh: 一个小故障可能连锁反应成整个系统的瘫痪。

e.en: Her hair fell in a beautiful {cascade} down her back.
e.zh: 她的头发像瀑布般优美地垂在背后。

e.en: The error {cascaded} through every microservice in production.
e.zh: 那个错误层层蔓延到了生产环境中的每个微服务。

e.en: Water {cascaded} down the rocks into the clear pool below.
e.zh: 水从岩石上倾泻而下,流入下方清澈的水潭。

e.en: The waterfall {cascades} dramatically over the edge of the cliff.
e.zh: 瀑布从悬崖边壮观地倾泻而下。

e.en: We hiked through the {Cascades} mountain range last summer.
e.zh: 我们去年夏天徒步穿越了喀斯喀特山脉。

e.en: A single bug caused {cascading} failures across the network.
e.zh: 一个小bug在整个网络中引发了连锁式故障。

e.en: {Cascading} style sheets control how web pages look.
e.zh: 层叠样式表控制着网页的外观。

case.t:
n. 情况；案件
n. 箱；盒

e.en: In that {case}, let's reschedule the meeting for tomorrow.
e.zh: 既然这样,我们把会议改到明天吧。

e.en: The detective solved the murder {case} in just three days.
e.zh: 那位侦探只用三天就破了那起谋杀案。

e.en: Law students study real disputes from a constitutional {casebook}.
e.zh: 法学院学生通过一本宪法案例集研究真实的争议案件。

e.en: The professor added a recent ruling to her {casebook}.
e.zh: 那位教授把最近的一项判决加进了她的案例集中。

cased.t: adj. 装入套中的；有外壳的

e.en: The thieves had {cased} the bank for weeks before the heist.
e.zh: 那伙窃贼在抢劫前已经踩点观察银行好几周了。

e.en: Each rare violin is {cased} in velvet-lined wood.
e.zh: 每把珍贵的小提琴都装在内衬天鹅绒的木盒里。

e.en: {Casein} is the main protein found in cow's milk.
e.zh: 酪蛋白是牛奶中含量最多的蛋白质。

e.en: Bodybuilders often drink {casein} shakes before going to bed.
e.zh: 健美爱好者常常在睡前喝酪蛋白奶昔。

caseload.t: n. (医生、律师等的) 工作量；案件数

e.en: The social worker's {caseload} grew heavier every month.
e.zh: 那位社工手上的案件量每个月都在加重。

e.en: Hospitals reported a rising {caseload} during flu season.
e.zh: 医院报告流感季的病例数正在上升。

e.en: She opened the {casement} to let in the spring breeze.
e.zh: 她推开窗扇,让春风吹进屋里。

e.en: The old cottage had charming wooden {casement} windows.
e.zh: 那间老式小屋装着漂亮的木制平开窗。

cases.t: n. case 的复数；案例；箱子

e.en: In most {cases}, the warranty covers manufacturing defects.
e.zh: 在大多数情况下,保修都涵盖制造缺陷。

e.en: COVID {cases} dropped sharply after the new vaccine rollout.
e.zh: 新疫苗推广后,新冠病例数大幅下降。

e.en: Her {casework} with refugees changed her view of immigration.
e.zh: 她为难民做的个案工作改变了她对移民的看法。

e.en: Social workers handle hundreds of {casework} files each year.
e.zh: 社工每年要处理数百份个案档案。

e.en: The {caseworker} visited the family every Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 个案社工每周二上午都来探访这家人。

e.en: Each {caseworker} is assigned about thirty active clients.
e.zh: 每位个案社工大约负责三十名在案客户。

cash.t:
n. 现金
v. 兑现

e.en: Most small shops still prefer {cash} over credit cards.
e.zh: 大多数小店还是更喜欢收现金而不是刷卡。

e.en: I need to {cash} this check before the bank closes.
e.zh: 我得在银行关门前把这张支票兑现。

e.en: The volunteer locked the {cashbox} after the bake sale ended.
e.zh: 义卖结束后,志愿者把钱箱锁了起来。

e.en: She kept tips in a small metal {cashbox} under the counter.
e.zh: 她把小费放在柜台下的一个小铁钱箱里。

e.en: He's allergic to every nut except the {cashew}.
e.zh: 除了腰果,他对所有坚果都过敏。

e.en: This stir-fry uses chicken and roasted {cashew} nuts.
e.zh: 这道炒菜用了鸡肉和烤腰果。

e.en: Poor {cashflow} forced the startup to delay payroll.
e.zh: 现金流不佳迫使这家初创公司延迟发工资。

e.en: Subscription revenue gives the business steady monthly {cashflow}.
e.zh: 订阅收入为公司带来了稳定的月度现金流。

e.en: The {cashier} scanned my groceries and asked for a bag fee.
e.zh: 收银员扫了我的食品,还问要不要付袋子费。

e.en: Please pay the {cashier} at the front of the store.
e.zh: 请到店门口的收银员处付款。

cashless.t: adj. 无现金的 (支付方式)

e.en: Sweden is moving toward a fully {cashless} society.
e.zh: 瑞典正逐步迈向完全无现金的社会。

e.en: The festival was {cashless}, so everyone paid by phone.
e.zh: 这个节庆活动不收现金,大家都用手机支付。

e.en: She wore a soft {cashmere} sweater to the dinner.
e.zh: 她穿了一件柔软的羊绒衫去赴晚宴。

e.en: Real {cashmere} feels warmer and lighter than wool.
e.zh: 真正的羊绒比羊毛更轻更保暖。

e.en: There's a {cashpoint} right outside the supermarket entrance.
e.zh: 超市门口外面就有一台自动取款机。

e.en: The {cashpoint} swallowed my card and wouldn't return it.
e.zh: 那台取款机吞了我的卡,怎么也不肯退出来。

cashpoints.t: n. cashpoint 的复数；自动取款机

e.en: Most {cashpoints} in town charge a small withdrawal fee.
e.zh: 镇上大多数取款机取款都要收一点手续费。

e.en: The bank installed new {cashpoints} along the high street.
e.zh: 银行在大街上安装了几台新的取款机。

e.en: The phone's plastic {casing} cracked when I dropped it.
e.zh: 手机摔下去后塑料外壳裂开了。

e.en: Engineers replaced the engine's outer {casing} after the leak.
e.zh: 漏油之后工程师换掉了发动机的外壳。

e.en: They lost most of their savings at a Las Vegas {casino}.
e.zh: 他们在拉斯维加斯的赌场输掉了大部分积蓄。

e.en: The {casino} offers free drinks to keep players at the tables.
e.zh: 赌场提供免费饮料,好让玩家留在赌桌上。

casinoes.t: n. casino 的复数 (误拼，正确为 casinos)

e.en: Several Macau {casinoes} reported record earnings last quarter.
e.zh: 澳门几家赌场上季度报告了创纪录的收益。

e.en: Online {casinoes} are banned in many countries.
e.zh: 网上赌场在许多国家是被禁止的。

casio.t: n. 卡西欧 (日本电子品牌)

e.en: He still wears the same plastic {casio} watch from college.
e.zh: 他还戴着大学时那块塑料卡西欧手表。

e.en: My first keyboard was a small black {casio} from the eighties.
e.zh: 我的第一台电子琴是八十年代的一台黑色卡西欧。

e.en: The whisky aged for twelve years in an oak {cask}.
e.zh: 这种威士忌在橡木桶里陈酿了十二年。

e.en: Workers rolled the heavy wine {cask} into the cellar.
e.zh: 工人们把那只沉重的酒桶滚进了地窖。

casket.t:
n. 棺材
n. 首饰盒

e.en: The wooden {casket} was carried slowly into the church.
e.zh: 那口木棺材被缓缓抬进教堂。

e.en: She kept her grandmother's jewelry in a velvet {casket}.
e.zh: 她把奶奶的首饰放在一个丝绒小匣子里。

e.en: The {Caspian} Sea is actually the world's largest lake.
e.zh: 里海其实是世界上最大的湖泊。

e.en: Iran exports caviar harvested from the {Caspian} coast.
e.zh: 伊朗出口产自里海沿岸的鱼子酱。

cassandra.t: n. 卡桑德拉 (人名，希腊神话中的女预言家)

e.en: Critics called the economist a modern {Cassandra} ignored by markets.
e.zh: 评论家称这位经济学家是被市场忽视的现代卡桑德拉。

e.en: Our backend stores user events in a {Cassandra} cluster.
e.zh: 我们的后端把用户事件存在一个 Cassandra 集群里。

e.en: In West Africa, {cassava} is a staple food for millions.
e.zh: 在西非,木薯是数百万人的主食。

e.en: Tapioca pearls are made from the starch of {cassava} root.
e.zh: 木薯粉珍珠是用木薯根的淀粉做的。

e.en: She baked a chicken {casserole} for the potluck dinner.
e.zh: 她为聚餐做了一份鸡肉炖菜。

e.en: Leave the {casserole} in the oven for another twenty minutes.
e.zh: 把那锅炖菜再在烤箱里放二十分钟。

e.en: He found a mixtape {cassette} from high school in a drawer.
e.zh: 他在抽屉里找到了一盘高中时代的磁带混音带。

e.en: Few cars today still have a {cassette} player installed.
e.zh: 如今很少有汽车还装着磁带播放机。

cassettes.t: n. cassette 的复数；盒式磁带

e.en: A box of old {cassettes} sat unused in the garage.
e.zh: 一箱旧磁带闲置在车库里。

e.en: Some indie bands are releasing albums on {cassettes} again.
e.zh: 一些独立乐队又开始用磁带发行专辑了。

e.en: Most supermarket cinnamon is actually ground {cassia} bark.
e.zh: 超市卖的肉桂大多其实是磨碎的桂皮。

e.en: The garden was lined with yellow-flowered {cassia} trees.
e.zh: 花园两旁种着开黄花的决明树。

cassino.t: n. 卡西诺 (纸牌游戏/地名)

e.en: Grandpa taught me to play {cassino} with a regular deck.
e.zh: 爷爷教我用一副普通扑克玩卡西诺纸牌。

e.en: They spent rainy afternoons playing {cassino} at the kitchen table.
e.zh: 雨天下午他们就在厨房桌旁打卡西诺牌。

e.en: She ordered a kir made with white wine and {cassis}.
e.zh: 她点了一杯用白葡萄酒和黑醋栗利口酒调的基尔酒。

e.en: The dessert was topped with a tart {cassis} sauce.
e.zh: 甜点上浇着一层酸酸的黑醋栗酱。

cassock.t: n. (教士穿的) 黑色长袍

e.en: The young priest adjusted his black {cassock} before the service.
e.zh: 年轻的神父在礼拜前整理了一下黑色长袍。

e.en: A {cassock} hung on a hook beside the vestry door.
e.zh: 祭衣室门旁的挂钩上挂着一件教士长袍。

cassoulet.t: n. 法式砂锅炖豆 (肉与豆的炖菜)

e.en: The bistro is famous for its slow-cooked duck {cassoulet}.
e.zh: 这家小酒馆以慢炖鸭肉砂锅菜闻名。

e.en: A good {cassoulet} needs white beans, sausage, and patience.
e.zh: 一锅好的卡苏莱炖菜需要白豆、香肠和耐心。

cast.t:
v. 投；扔；投射
n. 演员阵容

e.en: The director finally {cast} her in the leading role.
e.zh: 导演最终选她出演了主角。

e.en: Tall trees {cast} long shadows across the lawn at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时高大的树木在草坪上投下长长的影子。

e.en: She fries eggs in an old {cast-iron} skillet every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都用一口旧的铸铁锅煎鸡蛋。

e.en: He gave a {cast-iron} guarantee that the project would ship.
e.zh: 他给出了铁定的保证,说项目一定会上线。

e.en: She tapped a single {castanet} in time with the guitar.
e.zh: 她用一只响板随着吉他打着节拍。

e.en: The dancer held a wooden {castanet} in each hand.
e.zh: 舞者每只手里都拿着一只木制响板。

castaway.t: n. 被遗弃者；漂流荒岛者

e.en: The {castaway} survived three weeks on a deserted island.
e.zh: 那位漂流者在一座荒岛上熬过了三个星期。

e.en: He felt like a {castaway} after moving to the new city.
e.zh: 搬到新城市后,他觉得自己像个被遗弃的漂泊者。

e.en: India's {caste} system still influences marriage and politics today.
e.zh: 印度的种姓制度至今仍影响着婚姻和政治。

e.en: Reformers worked for decades to weaken rigid {caste} barriers.
e.zh: 改革者几十年来都在努力削弱森严的种姓壁垒。

castell.t: n. 叠人塔 (加泰罗尼亚传统)

e.en: In Catalonia, teams compete to build the tallest human {castell}.
e.zh: 在加泰罗尼亚,各队比赛搭建最高的人塔。

e.en: Hundreds gathered in the square to watch the {castell} rise.
e.zh: 数百人聚集在广场观看人塔一层层垒起。

castellated.t: adj. 有城垛的；城堡式的

e.en: The mansion had a {castellated} roofline that mimicked a fortress.
e.zh: 那座宅邸的屋顶像城堡一样有锯齿状的雉堞。

e.en: Engineers used a {castellated} nut to lock the axle in place.
e.zh: 工程师用一个开槽螺母把车轴锁定到位。

e.en: We stayed at a tiny {castello} in the Tuscan hills.
e.zh: 我们住在托斯卡纳山间一座小小的城堡酒店里。

e.en: The {castello} on the hill dates back to the twelfth century.
e.zh: 山上的那座城堡可以追溯到十二世纪。

e.en: They bought a flat near {Castelnau} on the edge of Barnes.
e.zh: 他们在巴恩斯边上靠近卡斯特尔诺路的地方买了套公寓。

e.en: The bus stops on {Castelnau} just before the bridge.
e.zh: 公交车就在过桥前的卡斯特尔诺路上停靠。

caster.t:
n. 脚轮；撒粉瓶
n. 施法者（游戏）

e.en: One {caster} on the office chair keeps getting stuck.
e.zh: 办公椅上有一个滚轮老是卡住。

e.en: British recipes often call for fine {caster} sugar.
e.zh: 英国食谱常常要用细砂糖。

e.en: Editorials continue to {castigate} the mayor for his silence.
e.zh: 社论持续抨击市长一直保持沉默。

e.en: Coaches shouldn't {castigate} young players for honest mistakes.
e.zh: 教练不该因为无心之失就严厉批评小球员。

e.en: The report's harsh {castigation} of regulators sparked public debate.
e.zh: 报告对监管机构的严厉抨击引发了公众讨论。

e.en: He accepted the public {castigation} without offering any defense.
e.zh: 他接受了公开的严厉指责,没有为自己辩解。

e.en: Medieval {Castile} eventually became the heart of modern Spain.
e.zh: 中世纪的卡斯蒂利亚后来成了现代西班牙的核心。

e.en: She washes her face with pure {castile} soap every night.
e.zh: 她每晚都用纯正的卡斯蒂利亚橄榄皂洗脸。

castilian.t:
adj. 卡斯蒂利亚的
n. 卡斯蒂利亚语/人

e.en: In Madrid, people speak a clear {Castilian} Spanish.
e.zh: 在马德里,人们说的是清晰的卡斯蒂利亚西班牙语。

e.en: Her grandmother taught her traditional {Castilian} recipes.
e.zh: 她的奶奶教她做传统的卡斯蒂利亚菜。

e.en: Tourists climbed up to the old {castillo} above the harbor.
e.zh: 游客们爬上港口上方那座古老的城堡。

e.en: The {castillo} once guarded the entrance to the bay.
e.zh: 那座城堡曾经守卫着海湾的入口。

casting.t:
n. 选角；铸造
v. 投掷；施法

e.en: {Casting} for the new series begins in early September.
e.zh: 这部新剧的选角将于九月初开始。

e.en: The bronze sculpture required a single careful {casting} in the foundry.
e.zh: 这件青铜雕塑需要在铸造厂一次性小心浇铸成型。

castle.t:
n. 城堡
n. 国际象棋中的车

e.en: We toured a medieval {castle} on the cliffs of Wales.
e.zh: 我们参观了威尔士悬崖上的一座中世纪城堡。
