e.en: The kids built a sand {castle} that the tide soon destroyed.
e.zh: 孩子们堆了一座沙堡,很快就被涨潮冲垮了。

e.en: Lord {Castlereagh} represented Britain at the Congress of Vienna.
e.zh: 卡斯尔雷勋爵代表英国出席了维也纳会议。

e.en: Historians still debate {Castlereagh}'s role in postwar Europe.
e.zh: 史学家至今仍在争论卡斯尔雷在战后欧洲的角色。

e.en: Scotland is dotted with ruined stone {castles} on remote hills.
e.zh: 苏格兰偏远的山头上散布着许多石头城堡的遗迹。

e.en: He's always building {castles} in the air instead of saving money.
e.zh: 他总是空中楼阁地幻想,却从不存钱。

e.en: We hiked from {Castleton} up to the old lead mines.
e.zh: 我们从卡斯尔顿村徒步上山,去看古老的铅矿。

e.en: {Castleton} is famous for its caves and Blue John stone.
e.zh: 卡斯尔顿以洞穴和蓝约翰石而闻名。

castor.t:
n. 蓖麻（castor oil 蓖麻油）
n. 脚轮

e.en: Grandma swore that {castor} oil could cure almost anything.
e.zh: 奶奶坚信蓖麻油几乎能治百病。

e.en: One {castor} on the couch keeps popping out of its socket.
e.zh: 沙发上有一个脚轮老是从底座里掉出来。

e.en: Vets often {castrate} male puppies to reduce aggression.
e.zh: 兽医常会给雄性小狗做绝育以减少攻击行为。

e.en: Heavy edits can {castrate} an otherwise powerful piece of writing.
e.zh: 过度删改会让一篇本来很有力的文章变得软弱无力。

e.en: The vet {castrated} the young bull last week.
e.zh: 兽医上周给那头小公牛做了阉割手术。

e.en: Critics say the new law has {castrated} the agency's powers.
e.zh: 批评人士说新法律削弱了该机构的权力。

e.en: Chemical {castration} is used in some countries for sex offenders.
e.zh: 一些国家对性犯罪者实施化学阉割。

e.en: The farmer scheduled the {castration} of several piglets today.
e.zh: 农场主安排今天给几头小猪做阉割。

castrato.t: n. 阉伶歌手（男声高音）

e.en: The opera was originally written for a {castrato} singer.
e.zh: 这部歌剧最初是为阉伶歌手创作的。

e.en: A {castrato} had a remarkably high and powerful voice.
e.zh: 阉伶歌手拥有极为高亢而有力的嗓音。

e.en: Fidel {Castro} ruled Cuba for nearly five decades.
e.zh: 菲德尔·卡斯特罗统治古巴近五十年。

e.en: The {Castro} district in San Francisco is famous for its history.
e.zh: 旧金山的卡斯特罗区因其历史而闻名。

e.en: He always uses {Castrol} oil in his motorcycle.
e.zh: 他总是给摩托车用嘉实多机油。

e.en: The mechanic recommended {Castrol} for high-mileage engines.
e.zh: 修理工推荐高里程发动机使用嘉实多。

casts.t:
v. 投掷；选角（第三人称）
n. 铸件；演员阵容

e.en: The streetlight {casts} long shadows across the road.
e.zh: 路灯在马路上投下长长的影子。

e.en: The director {casts} unknown actors in major roles.
e.zh: 导演让不知名的演员出演重要角色。

casual.t:
adj. 休闲的；随意的
adj. 临时的；偶然的

e.en: The office has a {casual} dress code on Fridays.
e.zh: 办公室周五着装比较随意。

e.en: They're just {casual} friends from the gym.
e.zh: 他们只是健身房里的普通朋友。

e.en: She mentioned the promotion {casually} over coffee.
e.zh: 她喝咖啡时随口提了一下升职的事。

e.en: He dressed {casually} for the weekend brunch.
e.zh: 他穿着随意去吃周末早午餐。

e.en: Her {casualness} about the deadline annoyed the team.
e.zh: 她对截止日期的漫不经心让团队很恼火。

e.en: There's a studied {casualness} to his writing style.
e.zh: 他的写作风格有一种刻意营造的随意感。

e.en: The hurricane caused hundreds of {casualties} along the coast.
e.zh: 飓风在沿海地区造成数百人伤亡。

e.en: Small businesses were the main {casualties} of the new policy.
e.zh: 小企业是这项新政策的主要受害者。

e.en: Privacy is often the first {casualty} of new technology.
e.zh: 隐私往往是新技术的第一个牺牲品。

e.en: The soldier was the only {casualty} of the brief skirmish.
e.zh: 那名士兵是这场小冲突中唯一的伤亡者。

e.en: His argument is clever {casuistry} but lacks moral weight.
e.zh: 他的论点是巧妙的诡辩,却没有道德分量。

e.en: The lawyer dismissed the defense as mere {casuistry}.
e.zh: 律师将那番辩护斥为纯粹的诡辩。

e.en: {Caswell} County is located in northern North Carolina.
e.zh: 卡斯韦尔县位于北卡罗来纳州北部。

e.en: Dr. {Caswell} published a new study on marine biology.
e.zh: 卡斯韦尔博士发表了一项海洋生物学的新研究。

e.en: My {cat} sleeps on the keyboard while I work.
e.zh: 我工作时,我的猫就睡在键盘上。

e.en: A stray {cat} keeps showing up on the porch.
e.zh: 一只流浪猫总是出现在门廊上。

e.en: The financial {cataclysm} of 2008 reshaped global banking.
e.zh: 2008年的金融大灾难重塑了全球银行业。

e.en: Scientists warn of an environmental {cataclysm} if we ignore warnings.
e.zh: 科学家警告若忽视警告将面临环境大灾变。

e.en: The asteroid impact had {cataclysmic} effects on the dinosaurs.
e.zh: 小行星撞击对恐龙造成了灾难性的影响。

e.en: Losing the championship felt {cataclysmic} to the young team.
e.zh: 输掉冠军赛对这支年轻队伍来说如同天崩地裂。

e.en: Tourists explored the ancient {catacomb} beneath the church.
e.zh: 游客们探索了教堂下方古老的地下墓穴。

e.en: Each {catacomb} held the remains of early Christian martyrs.
e.zh: 每个地下墓穴都安放着早期基督教殉道者的遗骸。

e.en: The president's coffin rested on a draped {catafalque}.
e.zh: 总统的灵柩停放在覆盖着帷幕的灵台上。

e.en: A wooden {catafalque} stood in the center of the cathedral.
e.zh: 一座木制灵台立于大教堂的中央。

catalan.t:
adj. 加泰罗尼亚的
n. 加泰罗尼亚语/人

e.en: Many people in Barcelona speak both Spanish and {Catalan}.
e.zh: 巴塞罗那很多人同时讲西班牙语和加泰罗尼亚语。

e.en: She's proud of her {Catalan} heritage and traditions.
e.zh: 她为自己的加泰罗尼亚血统和传统感到自豪。

e.en: We took a ferry to {Catalina} Island for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们坐渡轮去卡塔利娜岛过周末。

e.en: macOS {Catalina} introduced several major system changes.
e.zh: macOS Catalina 引入了几项重大的系统改动。

catalog.t:
n. 目录；产品图册
v. 编入目录

e.en: Browse the new spring {catalog} on our website.
e.zh: 在我们网站上浏览最新的春季商品目录。

e.en: Librarians {catalog} every book that arrives.
e.zh: 图书管理员会为每一本到馆的书编目。

e.en: The library hired a new {cataloger} for its rare books.
e.zh: 图书馆为其珍本藏书聘请了一位新的编目员。

e.en: As a {cataloger}, she organizes thousands of museum artifacts.
e.zh: 作为编目员,她整理着博物馆数以千计的文物。

e.en: She spent the afternoon {cataloging} her grandmother's record collection.
e.zh: 她花了一下午为外婆的唱片收藏编目。

e.en: The museum is {cataloging} every artifact found at the site.
e.zh: 博物馆正在为遗址出土的每件文物编目。

catalogs.t:
n. 目录（复数）
v. 编目（三单）

e.en: Old seed {catalogs} pile up in the gardener's shed.
e.zh: 旧的种子目录在园丁的小棚里堆得高高的。

e.en: The website {catalogs} thousands of vintage posters.
e.zh: 该网站收录了数千张复古海报。

catalogue.t:
n. 目录；产品册
v. 编目

e.en: The gallery published a {catalogue} of the artist's work.
e.zh: 画廊出版了一本该艺术家的作品图录。

e.en: He keeps a careful {catalogue} of his stamp collection.
e.zh: 他对自己的邮票收藏做了仔细的目录记录。

e.en: The {cataloguer} spent years organizing the manuscript collection.
e.zh: 那位编目员花了多年时间整理手稿藏品。

e.en: As lead {cataloguer}, she trains new library staff.
e.zh: 作为首席编目员,她负责培训新的图书馆员工。

catalogues.t:
n. 目录（复数）
v. 编目

e.en: The shop sends out seasonal {catalogues} to its customers.
e.zh: 这家店会向顾客寄送季节性商品目录。

e.en: The book {catalogues} every battle of the civil war.
e.zh: 这本书记录了内战中的每一场战役。

e.en: The archivist is {cataloguing} letters from the 19th century.
e.zh: 档案管理员正在为19世纪的信件编目。

e.en: {Cataloguing} the new arrivals took the whole weekend.
e.zh: 为新到藏品编目花了整整一个周末。

catalonia.t: n. 加泰罗尼亚（西班牙地区）

e.en: {Catalonia} held a controversial independence referendum in 2017.
e.zh: 加泰罗尼亚于2017年举行了备受争议的独立公投。

e.en: Barcelona is the capital of {Catalonia}.
e.zh: 巴塞罗那是加泰罗尼亚的首府。

e.en: She enjoys traditional {Catalonian} dishes like pa amb tomàquet.
e.zh: 她喜欢番茄面包等传统的加泰罗尼亚菜肴。

e.en: The festival celebrates {Catalonian} culture and music.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝加泰罗尼亚的文化与音乐。

e.en: A massive {catalpa} tree shades the entire backyard.
e.zh: 一棵巨大的梓树为整个后院遮阴。

e.en: The {catalpa} blooms with white, trumpet-shaped flowers.
e.zh: 梓树开出白色的喇叭状花朵。

e.en: Enzymes {catalyse} chemical reactions inside living cells.
e.zh: 酶在活细胞内催化化学反应。

e.en: The new funding may {catalyse} change in rural schools.
e.zh: 这笔新资金可能会推动农村学校的变革。

e.en: The professor specializes in {catalysis} and green chemistry.
e.zh: 这位教授专攻催化作用与绿色化学。

e.en: Industrial {catalysis} makes fuel production far more efficient.
e.zh: 工业催化使燃料生产效率大大提高。

e.en: Different fields use different {categorizations} for the same phenomena.
e.zh: 不同领域对同一现象采用不同的分类方式。

e.en: The model tested several {categorizations} before selecting the best.
e.zh: 该模型测试了几种分类方案才选出最佳的。

e.en: You can {categorize} your photos by date or location easily.
e.zh: 你可以轻松按日期或地点给照片分类。

e.en: Critics struggle to {categorize} her unique writing style.
e.zh: 评论家很难给她独特的写作风格归类。

categorized.t:
v. 已分类（categorize 过去式）
adj. 经过分类的

e.en: The reports were {categorized} by department and quarter.
e.zh: 这些报告按部门和季度进行了分类。

e.en: Her novels are often {categorized} as literary fiction.
e.zh: 她的小说常被归类为严肃文学。

categorizes.t: v. 分类（第三人称单数）

e.en: The system automatically {categorizes} incoming support tickets.
e.zh: 系统会自动给收到的客服工单分类。

e.en: The journal {categorizes} articles by subject and methodology.
e.zh: 该期刊按主题和研究方法对文章进行分类。

categorizing.t: v. 正在分类（categorize 现在分词）

e.en: I'm {categorizing} my browser bookmarks into folders by topic.
e.zh: 我正在按主题把浏览器书签整理到文件夹里。

e.en: {categorizing} customers helps marketers target ads more effectively.
e.zh: 客户分类帮助营销人员更精准地投放广告。

e.en: Which {category} should I file this expense under?
e.zh: 这笔开销应该归入哪个类别?

e.en: The film won best picture in the drama {category}.
e.zh: 这部电影在剧情片类别中获得了最佳影片奖。

catenary.t: n. 悬链线（数学/铁路接触网）

e.en: The hanging cable formed a perfect {catenary} curve between the poles.
e.zh: 悬挂的电缆在两根杆子之间形成完美的悬链曲线。

e.en: Engineers calculated the {catenary} for the new suspension bridge.
e.zh: 工程师为新的悬索桥计算了悬链线方程。

cater.t:
v. 迎合；满足需求
v. 提供餐饮服务

e.en: This restaurant can {cater} weddings for up to 200 guests.
e.zh: 这家餐厅可承办最多200人的婚宴酒席。

e.en: The website is designed to {cater} to mobile users specifically.
e.zh: 该网站专门为手机用户设计。

catered.t: v. 已迎合；已承办酒席（cater 过去式）

e.en: The company {catered} lunch for everyone at the conference.
e.zh: 公司为会议所有人提供了餐饮服务。

e.en: The tour {catered} mainly to retirees with flexible schedules.
e.zh: 这次旅行主要针对时间灵活的退休人士。

e.en: We hired a local {caterer} for our daughter's wedding reception.
e.zh: 我们为女儿的婚宴请了一家本地的承办商。

e.en: The {caterer} arrived early to set up the buffet table.
e.zh: 餐饮服务商提前到达布置自助餐台。

caterham.t: n. 卡特汉姆（英国地名/跑车品牌）

e.en: He drives a {caterham} on weekends for the open-road thrill.
e.zh: 他周末开一辆Caterham跑车体验开阔公路的刺激。

e.en: The {caterham} Seven remains an icon of lightweight British sports cars.
e.zh: Caterham Seven至今仍是英国轻量化跑车的标志。

catering.t:
n. 餐饮承办服务
v. 迎合（现在分词）

e.en: The {catering} service brought enough food for fifty guests.
e.zh: 餐饮服务商为五十位宾客准备了充足的食物。

e.en: They started a small {catering} business out of their home.
e.zh: 他们从家里起步,开了一家小型餐饮公司。

caterings.t: n. 餐饮服务（复数，罕用）

e.en: The hotel offers different {caterings} for weddings and corporate events.
e.zh: 酒店为婚礼和企业活动提供不同的餐饮方案。

e.en: Several {caterings} were sampled before the couple chose one.
e.zh: 那对新人尝试了几家餐饮服务才选定一家。

e.en: A green {caterpillar} crawled slowly along the leaf's edge.
e.zh: 一只绿色的毛毛虫沿着叶子边缘缓慢爬行。

e.en: The {caterpillar} will eventually transform into a beautiful butterfly.
e.zh: 这只毛毛虫最终会变成美丽的蝴蝶。

caters.t: v. 迎合；承办酒席（第三人称单数）

e.en: This shop {caters} mostly to tourists looking for souvenirs.
e.zh: 这家店主要面向寻找纪念品的游客。

e.en: The bakery {caters} corporate breakfasts every weekday morning.
e.zh: 这家面包店每个工作日早上为公司提供早餐配送。

caterwaul.t:
v. 发出刺耳嚎叫
n. 猫般的嚎叫声

e.en: Stray cats {caterwaul} loudly outside my window every night.
e.zh: 流浪猫每晚在我窗外大声嚎叫。

e.en: Critics began to {caterwaul} about the new tax proposal.
e.zh: 评论人士开始对新税收提案大声抱怨。

e.en: Robert {catesby} led the failed Gunpowder Plot in 1605.
e.zh: 罗伯特·凯茨比是1605年失败的火药阴谋的首领。

e.en: Historians still debate {catesby}'s true motives for the plot.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在争论凯茨比策划阴谋的真实动机。

catfight.t: n. 女人之间的争吵或打斗

e.en: The two celebrities had a public {catfight} on social media.
e.zh: 那两位名人在社交媒体上公开互撕。

e.en: A loud {catfight} broke out in the alley last night.
e.zh: 昨晚巷子里爆发了一场激烈的猫打架。

catfish.t:
n. 鲶鱼
v. 网恋中冒充他人

e.en: He turned out to be a {catfish} using fake photos online.
e.zh: 他原来是用假照片在网上骗人的网络骗子。

e.en: We caught a huge {catfish} in the river yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天在河里钓到一条很大的鲶鱼。

catford.t: n. 卡特福德（伦敦地名）

e.en: She rents a small flat in {Catford}, south London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦南部的卡特福德租了一间小公寓。

e.en: The train to {Catford} leaves every fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 开往卡特福德的列车每十五分钟一班。

e.en: Writing in her journal provides a daily {catharsis}.
e.zh: 写日记让她每天得到情感的宣泄。

e.en: The film offers an emotional {catharsis} for grieving viewers.
e.zh: 这部电影为悲伤的观众带来情感上的释放。

cathartic.t:
adj. 使情绪得到宣泄的
n. 泻药

e.en: Crying after the breakup felt strangely {cathartic}.
e.zh: 分手后的痛哭莫名地让人感到释放。

e.en: She found the long run deeply {cathartic} after work.
e.zh: 下班后的长跑让她感到内心彻底的舒缓。

e.en: Marco Polo wrote about the riches of {Cathay}.
e.zh: 马可·波罗描写了契丹的繁荣富庶。

e.en: We flew to Hong Kong on {Cathay} Pacific.
e.zh: 我们搭乘国泰航空飞往香港。

cathcart.t: n. 卡斯卡特（姓氏/地名）

e.en: The bus stops near {Cathcart} station every morning.
e.zh: 公交车每天早上在卡斯卡特站附近停靠。

e.en: She grew up in {Cathcart}, a quiet Glasgow suburb.
e.zh: 她在格拉斯哥安静的郊区卡斯卡特长大。

e.en: Tourists lined up to enter the medieval {cathedral}.
e.zh: 游客们排队进入这座中世纪的大教堂。

e.en: The {cathedral} bells rang loudly across the old town.
e.zh: 大教堂的钟声响彻整个老城。

e.en: Europe is famous for its Gothic {cathedrals}.
e.zh: 欧洲以其哥特式大教堂而闻名。

e.en: Several historic {cathedrals} were damaged during the war.
e.zh: 几座历史悠久的大教堂在战争中受损。

e.en: The nurse carefully inserted a {catheter} into the patient.
e.zh: 护士小心地为病人插入导尿管。

e.en: He needed a {catheter} after the surgery for several days.
e.zh: 手术后他需要使用导管好几天。

cathexis.t: n. 心理能量投注（心理学）

e.en: Freud described emotional {cathexis} as energy attached to ideas.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德把情感投注描述为依附于观念的能量。

e.en: Her {cathexis} on the project bordered on obsession.
e.zh: 她对这项目的情感投入近乎执念。

e.en: The battery's {cathode} attracts positive ions during discharge.
e.zh: 电池放电时,阴极吸引正离子。

e.en: Old TVs used a {cathode} ray tube to display images.
e.zh: 老式电视机用阴极射线管来显示图像。

e.en: Engineers use {cathodic} protection to prevent pipeline corrosion.
e.zh: 工程师使用阴极保护来防止管道腐蚀。

e.en: The {cathodic} reaction generates hydrogen at the electrode surface.
e.zh: 阴极反应在电极表面产生氢气。

catholic.t:
adj. 天主教的；普遍的
n. 天主教徒

e.en: She was raised in a strict {Catholic} family.
e.zh: 她在一个严格的天主教家庭中长大。

e.en: He has remarkably {catholic} taste in music and books.
e.zh: 他在音乐和书籍上的品味十分广泛。

catholicism.t: n. 天主教；天主教教义

e.en: He converted to {Catholicism} in his late twenties.
e.zh: 他在二十多岁后期皈依了天主教。

e.en: {Catholicism} remains the dominant religion across much of Latin America.
e.zh: 天主教仍是拉丁美洲大部分地区的主要宗教。

catholicity.t: n. 普遍性；天主教信仰

e.en: The festival's {catholicity} attracted artists from every continent.
e.zh: 这个节日的包容性吸引了来自各大洲的艺术家。

e.en: His reading list shows a remarkable {catholicity} of interests.
e.zh: 他的书单显示出他兴趣的广博。

e.en: The old {cathouse} on the edge of town was finally demolished.
e.zh: 镇边那座老妓院终于被拆除了。

e.en: Sheriffs raided the {cathouse} during the prohibition era.
e.zh: 禁酒令时期警长突袭了那家妓院。

e.en: Sodium is a common {cation} found in seawater.
e.zh: 钠是海水中常见的一种阳离子。

e.en: Each {cation} carries a positive electrical charge.
e.zh: 每个阳离子都带有正电荷。

e.en: Hair conditioners often contain {cationic} surfactants for smoothness.
e.zh: 护发素常含有阳离子表面活性剂以增加顺滑度。

e.en: The membrane allows only {cationic} species to pass through.
e.zh: 这种膜只允许阳离子物质通过。

e.en: A fuzzy {catkin} dangled from every willow branch in spring.
e.zh: 春天每根柳枝上都垂着毛茸茸的柔荑花序。

e.en: The hazel tree dropped pollen from each yellow {catkin}.
e.zh: 榛树从每条黄色的柔荑花序中散出花粉。

catlike.t: adj. 像猫一样的；轻巧敏捷的

e.en: She moved with {catlike} grace across the dance floor.
e.zh: 她以猫一般的优雅穿过舞池。

e.en: The burglar made a {catlike} leap onto the balcony.
e.zh: 那个窃贼像猫一样轻盈地跃上阳台。

e.en: Bees love the purple flowers of the {catmint} in our garden.
e.zh: 蜜蜂很喜欢我们花园里荆芥的紫色花朵。

e.en: She planted {catmint} along the sunny garden border.
e.zh: 她沿着阳光充足的花园边缘种了荆芥。

catnap.t:
n. 打盹；小睡
v. 打盹

e.en: I usually take a quick {catnap} after lunch.
e.zh: 我通常午饭后会小睡一会儿。

e.en: A short {catnap} on the train left him refreshed.
e.zh: 在火车上小憩片刻让他精神焕发。

e.en: My cat goes wild whenever I open the {catnip} jar.
e.zh: 我一打开猫薄荷罐子,我家猫就疯了一样。

e.en: The toy mouse is stuffed with dried {catnip}.
e.zh: 那只玩具老鼠里塞满了干猫薄荷。

cato.t: n. 加图（古罗马政治家）

e.en: {Cato} the Elder famously demanded the destruction of Carthage.
e.zh: 老加图以坚持摧毁迦太基而闻名。

e.en: Students still read speeches by {Cato} in Latin class.
e.zh: 学生们在拉丁语课上仍会读加图的演讲。

catalyst.t:
n. 催化剂
n. 促成因素

e.en: Her speech was the {catalyst} for major policy reform.
e.zh: 她的演讲成为重大政策改革的催化剂。

e.en: Platinum acts as a {catalyst} in the car's exhaust system.
e.zh: 铂在汽车排气系统中起催化剂作用。

e.en: Social media posts can be powerful {catalysts} for change.
e.zh: 社交媒体帖子可以成为强大的变革催化剂。

e.en: Researchers are developing cheaper {catalysts} for hydrogen production.
e.zh: 研究人员正在开发更廉价的制氢催化剂。

catalytic.t: adj. 催化的；起催化作用的

e.en: Thieves often target the {catalytic} converter under the car.
e.zh: 小偷常常盯上汽车下方的催化转化器。

e.en: The mentor played a {catalytic} role in her career.
e.zh: 那位导师在她的职业生涯中起到了催化作用。

e.en: The grant will {catalyze} new research in clean energy.
e.zh: 这项拨款将推动清洁能源领域的新研究。

e.en: Her book helped {catalyze} the modern feminist movement.
e.zh: 她的书推动了现代女性主义运动的兴起。

e.en: They sailed a {catamaran} across the bay at sunset.
e.zh: 他们日落时驾着双体船穿过海湾。

e.en: The {catamaran} is faster and more stable than a monohull.
e.zh: 双体船比单体船更快、更稳。

e.en: A {catamount} was spotted prowling near the campground.
e.zh: 有人发现一头美洲狮在营地附近游荡。

e.en: Local legend says a {catamount} once roamed these woods.
e.zh: 当地传说中曾有一只山猫出没于这片树林。

catania.t: n. 卡塔尼亚（意大利城市）

e.en: {Catania} sits at the foot of Mount Etna in Sicily.
e.zh: 卡塔尼亚位于西西里岛埃特纳火山脚下。

e.en: We had amazing pasta at a small trattoria in {Catania}.
e.zh: 我们在卡塔尼亚一家小餐馆吃到了美味的意面。

catapult.t:
n. 弹射器；弹弓
v. 弹射；猛推

e.en: The viral video could {catapult} her to instant fame.
e.zh: 这段爆红视频可能让她瞬间声名大噪。

e.en: Soldiers used a {catapult} to hurl stones at the castle wall.
e.zh: 士兵们用投石机向城墙投掷石块。

cataract.t:
n. 白内障
n. 大瀑布

e.en: My grandmother had {cataract} surgery on both eyes.
e.zh: 我外婆做了双眼白内障手术。

e.en: The river plunged over a thundering {cataract}.
e.zh: 河水从轰鸣的大瀑布上倾泻而下。

e.en: The cold left him with a persistent {catarrh} for weeks.
e.zh: 那场感冒让他鼻粘膜炎持续了好几周。

e.en: Doctors recommended steam inhalation to relieve the {catarrh}.
e.zh: 医生建议通过蒸汽吸入来缓解粘膜炎症。

e.en: The oil spill turned into an environmental {catastrophe}.
e.zh: 那次漏油事件演变成了一场环境灾难。

e.en: Forgetting the passport at the airport felt like a {catastrophe}.
e.zh: 在机场忘带护照感觉就像一场大灾难。

e.en: Climate change is making natural {catastrophes} more frequent.
e.zh: 气候变化正使自然灾害愈发频繁。

e.en: Insurance companies prepare for major {catastrophes} every year.
e.zh: 保险公司每年都为重大灾难做准备。

catastrophic.t: adj. 灾难性的；毁灭性的

e.en: A single mistake led to {catastrophic} losses for the firm.
e.zh: 一个失误就给公司带来了灾难性的损失。

e.en: The dam's failure caused {catastrophic} flooding downstream.
e.zh: 水坝溃决在下游造成了灾难性的洪灾。

e.en: The startup failed {catastrophically} after losing its key client.
e.zh: 那家初创公司在失去关键客户后惨败收场。

e.en: Sales dropped {catastrophically} during the pandemic lockdown.
e.zh: 在疫情封锁期间,销售额灾难性地暴跌。

e.en: Nineteenth-century {catastrophism} explained geology through sudden disasters.
e.zh: 十九世纪的灾变论用突发灾难来解释地质变化。

e.en: Modern science largely replaced {catastrophism} with gradualist theories.
e.zh: 现代科学基本以渐变论取代了灾变论。

e.en: The patient slipped into {catatonia} after the traumatic event.
e.zh: 病人在创伤事件后陷入紧张性木僵。

e.en: Doctors treated her {catatonia} with a combination of medications.
e.zh: 医生用多种药物联合治疗她的紧张症。

catatonic.t: adj. 紧张性精神症的；呆滞的

e.en: He sat {catatonic} in front of the TV for hours.
e.zh: 他僵坐在电视机前好几个小时一动不动。

e.en: The shocking news left her almost {catatonic} with grief.
e.zh: 那令人震惊的消息让她悲痛得几乎呆若木鸡。

e.en: A {catbird} mimicked songs from the bushes near the porch.
e.zh: 一只猫鹊在门廊旁的灌木丛中模仿鸟鸣。

e.en: He sat in the {catbird} seat after his promotion last week.
e.zh: 上周升职后他处于绝对有利的位置。

catcall.t:
n. 嘘声；倒彩
v. 喝倒彩

e.en: The speaker ignored the rude {catcall} from the back row.
e.zh: 演讲者无视后排传来的粗鲁嘘声。

e.en: Fans began to {catcall} when the referee made the bad call.
e.zh: 裁判误判时球迷们开始起哄。

catch.t:
v. 接住；抓住；赶上
n. 捕获物；陷阱

e.en: Can you {catch} the ball if I throw it?
e.zh: 如果我扔过去你能接住球吗?

e.en: The deal sounds great, but what's the {catch}?
e.zh: 这笔交易听起来不错,但有什么猫腻?

catchable.t: adj. 可接住的；可捕获的

e.en: The fly ball was easily {catchable} for the outfielder.
e.zh: 那个高飞球外野手轻松就能接到。

e.en: He threw a {catchable} pass to his open teammate.
e.zh: 他给空位的队友传了一个能接住的球。

catchall.t:
n. 大杂烩；通用类
adj. 包罗万象的

e.en: The drawer became a {catchall} for keys, receipts, and old batteries.
e.zh: 那个抽屉成了钥匙、收据和旧电池的杂物堆。

e.en: "Miscellaneous" is a {catchall} category for anything else.
e.zh: “其他”是一个包罗万象的分类。

e.en: The {catcher} signaled for a fastball down the middle.
e.zh: 捕手示意要一个中路快速球。

e.en: She read "The {catcher} in the Rye" in high school.
e.zh: 她高中时读了《麦田里的守望者》。

catches.t:
v. 接住（第三人称单数）
n. 捕获物（复数）

e.en: The goalkeeper {catches} every shot during practice today.
e.zh: 今天训练中守门员每球都接住了。

e.en: The contract has hidden {catches} buried in the fine print.
e.zh: 合同在小字部分藏着一些陷阱。

catching.t: adj. 有传染性的；吸引人的

e.en: Her laughter is {catching} and lifts everyone's mood.
e.zh: 她的笑声有感染力,让大家心情都好起来。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {catching} fish at the lake.
e.zh: 他下午都在湖边钓鱼。

e.en: The school's {catchment} area covers three nearby neighborhoods.
e.zh: 这所学校的招生区涵盖附近三个社区。

e.en: Heavy rain flooded the river's upper {catchment} basin.
e.zh: 暴雨淹没了河流上游的集水盆地。

e.en: "Just do it" became Nike's iconic {catchphrase}.
e.zh: “Just do it”成了耐克的标志性口号。

e.en: Every comedian dreams of inventing a memorable {catchphrase}.
e.zh: 每个喜剧演员都梦想创造一句令人难忘的金句。

e.en: "Sustainability" has become a corporate {catchword} this decade.
e.zh: “可持续性”成了这十年企业界的流行语。

e.en: Politicians often repeat the same {catchword} in every speech.
e.zh: 政客们常在每次演讲中重复同一个口号。

catchy.t: adj. 易记的；朗朗上口的

e.en: The song has a really {catchy} chorus you can't forget.
e.zh: 这首歌的副歌特别洗脑,根本忘不掉。

e.en: They needed a {catchy} slogan for the ad campaign.
e.zh: 他们需要一句朗朗上口的广告语。

e.en: The medieval feast featured many a sweet {cate} for guests.
e.zh: 中世纪宴会上为宾客准备了许多甜美佳肴。

e.en: Old recipes describe each {cate} as a delicate treat.
e.zh: 古老食谱把每道珍馐都形容为精致美味。

e.en: The parish offers {catechesis} classes for children every Sunday.
e.zh: 教区每周日为孩子们开设教理课程。

e.en: Early Christian {catechesis} prepared converts for baptism.
e.zh: 早期基督教的教理讲授让皈依者准备受洗。

catechetical.t: adj. 问答式的；教理讲授的

e.en: The teacher used a {catechetical} method of question and answer.
e.zh: 老师采用问答式的教理教学方法。

e.en: She wrote a {catechetical} guide for new church members.
e.zh: 她为新教友写了一本教理指南。

e.en: Green tea contains {catechin}, a powerful antioxidant compound.
e.zh: 绿茶含有儿茶素,一种强效抗氧化物质。

e.en: Researchers study {catechin} for its potential health benefits.
e.zh: 研究人员正研究儿茶素的潜在健康益处。

catechism.t: n. 教理问答；一连串提问

e.en: Children memorized the {catechism} before their first communion.
e.zh: 孩子们在初领圣体前要背诵教理问答。

e.en: The book reads like a political {catechism} for new recruits.
e.zh: 这本书读起来像给新成员的政治问答手册。

e.en: The {catechist} prepared the youth group for confirmation.
e.zh: 教理讲师为青年组准备坚振礼。

e.en: She volunteered as a {catechist} at her local parish.
e.zh: 她在当地教区义务担任教理讲师。

e.en: The priest will {catechize} the new converts each week.
e.zh: 神父每周会向新皈依者讲授教理。

e.en: Old schools used to {catechize} students through strict drills.
e.zh: 旧时学校通过严格反复问答来教导学生。

e.en: Adrenaline is a {catecholamine} released during stressful situations.
e.zh: 肾上腺素是一种压力下释放的儿茶酚胺。

e.en: Doctors measured her {catecholamine} levels to diagnose the tumor.
e.zh: 医生检测了她的儿茶酚胺水平以诊断肿瘤。

e.en: Each {catechumen} attends classes before joining the church.
e.zh: 每位慕道者入教前都要参加学习班。

e.en: The bishop welcomed every {catechumen} at the Easter vigil.
e.zh: 主教在复活节守夜礼上欢迎每位慕道者。

e.en: Linguists study {categorial} grammar to understand sentence structure.
e.zh: 语言学家研究范畴语法以理解句子结构。

e.en: The philosopher made a {categorial} distinction between mind and body.
e.zh: 那位哲学家对心灵与身体作出范畴上的区分。

e.en: He gave a {categoric} denial of all the accusations.
e.zh: 他对所有指控予以断然否认。

e.en: The minister's {categoric} statement left no room for doubt.
e.zh: 部长斩钉截铁的声明不容置疑。

e.en: The CEO issued a {categorical} denial of the rumors.
e.zh: 首席执行官对谣言予以断然否认。

e.en: Survey results were stored as {categorical} data, not numerical.
e.zh: 调查结果存为分类数据,而不是数值数据。

e.en: She {categorically} denied any involvement in the scandal.
e.zh: 她断然否认与这桩丑闻有任何牵连。

e.en: The spokesperson {categorically} rejected the journalist's claim.
e.zh: 发言人明确驳回了记者的说法。

e.en: The store sorts products into clear {categories} for easy browsing.
e.zh: 这家店把商品分成清晰的类别方便浏览。

e.en: The film won awards in three different {categories} this year.
e.zh: 这部电影今年在三个不同类别获奖。

e.en: The {categorisation} of species took botanists many years.
e.zh: 物种的分类工作耗费了植物学家多年时间。

e.en: His {categorisation} of the data made the report much clearer.
e.zh: 他对数据的分类让报告清晰了许多。

e.en: Different {categorisations} of mental disorders exist across cultures.
e.zh: 不同文化对精神障碍的分类方式各有不同。

e.en: The team compared various {categorisations} before choosing one.
e.zh: 团队比较了多种分类方法后才选定一种。

e.en: Please {categorise} these emails by priority before lunch.
e.zh: 请在午餐前按优先级将这些邮件分类。

e.en: It's hard to {categorise} a film that mixes so many genres.
e.zh: 很难给这部融合多种类型的电影分类。

e.en: The library {categorised} books by subject and author name.
e.zh: 图书馆按主题和作者姓名对书籍进行了分类。

e.en: All complaints are {categorised} according to severity level.
e.zh: 所有投诉均按严重程度进行分类。

categorises.t: v. 分类（第三人称单数，英式）

e.en: The app {categorises} expenses automatically using machine learning.
e.zh: 这款应用利用机器学习自动给支出分类。

e.en: The committee {categorises} each proposal before final review.
e.zh: 委员会在最终审查前对每份提案进行分类。

categorising.t: v. 分类（现在分词，英式）

e.en: She spent hours {categorising} old photos by year and event.
e.zh: 她花了数小时按年份和事件给旧照片分类。

e.en: The intern is {categorising} customer feedback into common themes.
e.zh: 实习生正把客户反馈归入常见主题。

e.en: Proper {categorization} of files saves hours when searching later.
e.zh: 妥善的文件分类能在以后搜索时节省大量时间。

e.en: His {categorization} of the species sparked debate among biologists.
e.zh: 他对该物种的分类在生物学家中引发了争论。

e.en: Stray {cats} gather behind the restaurant every evening.
e.zh: 每天傍晚都有流浪猫聚在餐馆后面。

e.en: Many people keep {cats} as low-maintenance pets.
e.zh: 很多人把猫当作省心的宠物来养。

e.en: She wore a sleek black {catsuit} to the after-party.
e.zh: 她穿着一件贴身的黑色连体紧身衣去庆功派对。

e.en: The dancer's silver {catsuit} sparkled under the stage lights.
e.zh: 舞者的银色连体紧身衣在舞台灯光下闪闪发光。

catsup.t: n. 番茄酱（ketchup 的异体拼写）

e.en: He poured {catsup} all over his fries without thinking.
e.zh: 他想都没想就把番茄酱倒满了薯条。

e.en: The diner serves {catsup} in little glass bottles on every table.
e.zh: 那家餐馆在每张桌上都摆着小玻璃瓶装的番茄酱。

e.en: A red-winged blackbird perched on a tall {cattail}.
e.zh: 一只红翅黑鹂停在一根高高的香蒲上。

e.en: Children pulled fluff from the brown {cattail} by the pond.
e.zh: 孩子们从池塘边棕色的香蒲上拽下绒毛。

cattle.t: n. 牛（总称，尤指家畜牛群）

e.en: The rancher drove his {cattle} across the open prairie.
e.zh: 牧场主把他的牛群赶过开阔的草原。

e.en: Beef {cattle} prices have risen sharply this year.
e.zh: 今年肉牛的价格大幅上涨。

e.en: The veteran {cattleman} knew every cow in his herd by name.
e.zh: 那位资深牧牛人能叫出牛群中每头牛的名字。

e.en: A wealthy {cattleman} bought the ranch at auction.
e.zh: 一位富有的养牛人在拍卖会上买下了那座牧场。

cattles.t: n. 牛群（cattle 的非标准复数）

e.en: In some dialects people loosely say {cattles} for several herds.
e.zh: 在某些方言里,人们会含糊地用 cattles 指几群牛。

e.en: Farmers across the valley raise different breeds of {cattles}.
e.zh: 山谷里的农户饲养着不同品种的牛群。

catty.t: adj. 刻薄的；爱说人坏话的

e.en: Her {catty} remarks about her coworker spread quickly through the office.
e.zh: 她对同事尖酸刻薄的评论很快传遍了办公室。

e.en: Don't be so {catty} about her new haircut.
e.zh: 别对她的新发型那么刻薄。

catwalk.t: n. T 台；（狭窄的）通道

e.en: The model strutted confidently down the {catwalk}.
e.zh: 模特自信地走过T台。

e.en: Workers crossed the narrow {catwalk} above the factory floor.
e.zh: 工人们走过工厂车间上方狭窄的天桥。

caucasian.t:
adj. 白种人的
n. 高加索人种

e.en: The witness described the suspect as a tall {Caucasian} man.
e.zh: 目击者把嫌疑人描述为一名高个白人男子。

e.en: The form asked whether the applicant identified as {Caucasian}.
e.zh: 表格询问申请人是否认同自己为白人。

e.en: The {Caucasus} mountains stretch between the Black and Caspian seas.
e.zh: 高加索山脉绵延于黑海和里海之间。

e.en: Many languages are spoken throughout the {Caucasus} region.
e.zh: 高加索地区使用着许多种语言。

caucus.t: n. 党团会议；核心小组

e.en: The Iowa {caucus} kicks off the presidential primary season.
e.zh: 爱荷华州党团会议拉开了总统初选季的序幕。

e.en: Senators held a closed-door {caucus} to discuss the bill.
e.zh: 参议员们召开闭门党团会议讨论这项法案。

e.en: Sharks propel themselves forward using a powerful {caudal} fin.
e.zh: 鲨鱼依靠强壮的尾鳍向前推进。

e.en: The injury affected the {caudal} region of the spine.
e.zh: 伤势影响到脊柱的尾端区域。

e.en: The country was ruled for decades by a brutal {caudillo}.
e.zh: 这个国家被一位残暴的军事独裁者统治了数十年。

e.en: Each region had its own {caudillo} commanding loyal troops.
e.zh: 每个地区都有自己的军事强人指挥着忠诚的部队。

caught.t: v. 抓住；接住（catch 的过去式）

e.en: She {caught} the ball with one hand and grinned.
e.zh: 她单手接住了球,咧嘴一笑。

e.en: He got {caught} cheating on the math exam.
e.zh: 他在数学考试中作弊被抓了个正着。

caul.t: n. 胎膜（婴儿出生时覆于头部）

e.en: The baby was born with a {caul} covering his face.
e.zh: 婴儿出生时脸上覆盖着一层胎膜。

e.en: Old sailors believed a {caul} would protect them from drowning.
e.zh: 老水手们相信胎膜能保佑他们不被淹死。

cauldron.t: n. 大锅；炼狱般的场面

e.en: The witch stirred a bubbling {cauldron} of green potion.
e.zh: 女巫搅动着一锅冒泡的绿色魔药。

e.en: The stadium became a {cauldron} of noise during the final.
e.zh: 决赛时体育场成了喧嚣沸腾的大熔炉。

e.en: I roasted a whole {cauliflower} with garlic and olive oil.
e.zh: 我用大蒜和橄榄油烤了一整颗花椰菜。

e.en: {Cauliflower} rice is a popular low-carb substitute.
e.zh: 花椰菜米是一种流行的低碳水替代品。

caulk.t:
v. 填缝；用填缝剂密封
n. 填缝剂

e.en: You should {caulk} the gap around the bathtub to prevent leaks.
e.zh: 你应该把浴缸周围的缝隙打上玻璃胶以防漏水。

e.en: Apply a thin bead of {caulk} along the window frame.
e.zh: 沿着窗框涂上一条细细的密封胶。

e.en: The old {caulking} around the tub had cracked and turned black.
e.zh: 浴缸周围的旧密封胶已经开裂发黑了。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {caulking} every gap in the bathroom.
e.zh: 他花了一下午把浴室里每条缝都打上了胶。

e.en: The university awarded him an honorary degree, doctor honoris {causa}.
e.zh: 大学授予他名誉博士学位。

e.en: In Latin, {causa} means cause or reason.
e.zh: 在拉丁语中,causa 意为原因或理由。

e.en: Researchers found a clear {causal} link between smoking and cancer.
e.zh: 研究人员发现吸烟与癌症之间有明确的因果联系。

e.en: Correlation alone doesn't prove a {causal} relationship.
e.zh: 仅有相关性并不能证明因果关系。

e.en: Establishing {causality} in social science is notoriously difficult.
e.zh: 在社会科学中确立因果关系是出了名的困难。

e.en: The experiment was designed to test {causality}, not just correlation.
e.zh: 这个实验旨在检验因果关系,而不仅仅是相关性。

e.en: The two events are {causally} linked, not merely coincidental.
e.zh: 这两个事件存在因果联系,并非仅仅是巧合。

e.en: Stress is {causally} related to many chronic illnesses.
e.zh: 压力与许多慢性疾病在因果上相关联。

e.en: Lawyers must prove {causation} between the defendant's act and the harm.
e.zh: 律师必须证明被告的行为与损害之间存在因果关系。

e.en: Statistics show correlation, but not necessarily {causation}.
e.zh: 统计数据显示相关性,但不一定是因果关系。

causative.t: adj. 致使的；成为原因的

e.en: Smoking is a {causative} factor in many lung diseases.
e.zh: 吸烟是许多肺部疾病的致病因素。

e.en: In English, "make" often functions as a {causative} verb.
e.zh: 在英语中，"make"常常用作使役动词。

cause.t:
n. 原因；事业
v. 导致；引起

e.en: Engineers are still investigating the {cause} of the outage.
e.zh: 工程师们仍在调查这次停电的原因。

e.en: She donated generously to a {cause} she believed in.
e.zh: 她慷慨地为自己支持的事业捐款。

caused.t: v. 导致；引起（cause 的过去式）

e.en: The heavy rain {caused} flooding across the city.
e.zh: 这场大雨在全城范围内引发了洪水。

e.en: His rude comment {caused} an awkward silence at dinner.
e.zh: 他无礼的话让晚餐席间一阵尴尬的沉默。

causes.t:
n. 原因
v. 导致（三单）

e.en: Stress often {causes} headaches and trouble sleeping.
e.zh: 压力常常会导致头痛和失眠。

e.en: The charity supports several environmental {causes} worldwide.
e.zh: 该慈善机构在全球资助多项环保事业。

e.en: A long stone {causeway} connects the island to the mainland.
e.zh: 一条长长的石砌堤道将该岛与大陆相连。

e.en: At high tide, the {causeway} disappears under the water.
e.zh: 涨潮时，这条堤道就被水淹没了。

causing.t: v. 导致；引起（cause 的现在分词）

e.en: The new policy is {causing} confusion among employees.
e.zh: 新政策正在员工中引起困惑。

e.en: Heavy traffic is {causing} delays on the highway tonight.
e.zh: 今晚高速公路上交通拥堵造成延误。

e.en: Be careful—this {caustic} cleaner can burn your skin.
e.zh: 小心——这种腐蚀性清洁剂会灼伤皮肤。

e.en: The critic is famous for her {caustic} reviews of bad films.
e.zh: 这位评论家以对烂片的尖刻评论而闻名。

e.en: He {caustically} dismissed the proposal as a waste of time.
e.zh: 他尖刻地把这个提议贬为浪费时间。

e.en: She replied {caustically} when asked about her ex-boss.
e.zh: 被问及前老板时，她刻薄地回了一句。

cauterise.t: v. 烧灼（伤口）（英式拼写）

e.en: Doctors {cauterise} small wounds to stop the bleeding.
e.zh: 医生会烧灼小伤口来止血。

e.en: The vet had to {cauterise} the cut on the dog's ear.
e.zh: 兽医不得不烧灼狗耳朵上的伤口。

cauterize.t: v. 烧灼止血；腐蚀（伤口）

e.en: Surgeons sometimes {cauterize} blood vessels during an operation.
e.zh: 外科医生有时会在手术中烧灼血管。

e.en: They used a laser to {cauterize} the wound quickly.
e.zh: 他们用激光迅速烧灼了伤口。

e.en: The dentist used electric {cautery} to seal the bleeding gum.
e.zh: 牙医使用电烙术封住流血的牙龈。

e.en: Modern {cautery} tools make minor surgery much safer.
e.zh: 现代烧灼器械让小手术安全得多。

caution.t:
n. 谨慎；警告
v. 告诫

e.en: Drivers should proceed with {caution} on icy roads.
e.zh: 司机在结冰路面上应谨慎驾驶。

e.en: The doctor {caution}ed her against eating too much sugar.
e.zh: 医生告诫她不要摄入太多糖分。

e.en: His failed startup became a {cautionary} tale for founders.
e.zh: 他失败的创业成了创业者们的警示故事。

e.en: The label includes a {cautionary} note about side effects.
e.zh: 标签上附有关于副作用的警示说明。

cautions.t:
n. 警告
v. 告诫（三单）

e.en: The teacher always {cautions} students about online scams.
e.zh: 老师总是提醒学生注意网络诈骗。

e.en: The manual lists several {cautions} before first use.
e.zh: 说明书在首次使用前列出了多项注意事项。

e.en: Investors are {cautious} about the volatile crypto market.
e.zh: 投资者对波动剧烈的加密市场持谨慎态度。

e.en: She gave a {cautious} smile before answering the question.
e.zh: 她回答问题前露出谨慎的微笑。

e.en: He {cautiously} opened the door to see who was knocking.
e.zh: 他小心翼翼地打开门，看是谁在敲。

e.en: Analysts are {cautiously} optimistic about next quarter's earnings.
e.zh: 分析师对下季度的盈利持谨慎乐观态度。

e.en: Her {cautiousness} with money helped her retire early.
e.zh: 她对金钱的谨慎让她得以提早退休。

e.en: The team's {cautiousness} cost them the chance to win.
e.zh: 球队的谨慎让他们失去了取胜的机会。

cava.t: n. 卡瓦（西班牙起泡酒）

e.en: We toasted the new year with a glass of Spanish {cava}.
e.zh: 我们用一杯西班牙卡瓦起泡酒为新年干杯。

e.en: This {cava} pairs surprisingly well with seafood tapas.
e.zh: 这款卡瓦酒搭配海鲜小食出奇地合适。

cavalcade.t: n. 车队；（马队）游行队伍

e.en: A {cavalcade} of black SUVs escorted the president downtown.
e.zh: 一队黑色SUV车队护送总统进入市中心。

e.en: The festival opened with a colorful {cavalcade} of floats.
e.zh: 节日以一支色彩缤纷的花车队伍拉开帷幕。

cavalier.t:
adj. 傲慢的；漫不经心的
n. 骑士

e.en: Her {cavalier} attitude toward deadlines frustrated the whole team.
e.zh: 她对截止日期满不在乎的态度让全组人很无奈。

e.en: You shouldn't be so {cavalier} about other people's feelings.
e.zh: 你不该对别人的感受这么漫不经心。

cavalierly.t: adv. 傲慢地；漫不经心地

e.en: He {cavalierly} dismissed the safety concerns raised by engineers.
e.zh: 他对工程师提出的安全担忧不屑一顾。

e.en: The CEO {cavalierly} brushed aside questions about layoffs.
e.zh: 首席执行官对裁员问题轻率地一带而过。

cavalry.t: n. 骑兵部队；装甲部队

e.en: In old films, the {cavalry} always arrives just in time.
e.zh: 在老电影里，骑兵总是关键时刻赶到。

e.en: Modern {cavalry} units now use armored vehicles instead of horses.
e.zh: 现代骑兵部队如今用装甲车代替了马匹。

e.en: The young {cavalryman} polished his saddle before the parade.
e.zh: 年轻的骑兵在阅兵前擦亮了马鞍。

e.en: Each {cavalryman} was responsible for feeding his own horse.
e.zh: 每个骑兵都要负责喂养自己的战马。

e.en: We spent the weekend fishing on a quiet lake in {Cavan}.
e.zh: 我们周末在卡文一个安静的湖边钓鱼。

e.en: {Cavan} is known for its rolling hills and small villages.
e.zh: 卡文以连绵的丘陵和小村庄而闻名。

cave.t:
n. 洞穴
v. 塌陷；屈服

e.en: Tourists explored the dark {cave} with helmet lamps.
e.zh: 游客们戴着头灯探索那个漆黑的洞穴。

e.en: The boss refused to {cave} to the union's demands.
e.zh: 老板拒绝向工会的要求让步。

e.en: The deal sounds great, but there's one important {caveat}.
e.zh: 这笔交易听起来不错，但有一个重要的附加说明。

e.en: With one {caveat}, I agree with everything you said.
e.zh: 除了一点附带说明，你说的我都同意。

e.en: He eats like a {caveman}—just meat and raw vegetables.
e.zh: 他吃得像个穴居人——只吃肉和生蔬菜。

e.en: The cartoon shows a {caveman} inventing the wheel.
e.zh: 动画片展示了一个穴居人发明轮子的故事。

cavendish.t: n. 卡文迪许（姓氏/地名）

e.en: Most bananas sold in supermarkets are the {Cavendish} variety.
e.zh: 超市里出售的香蕉大多是卡文迪什品种。

e.en: A fungal disease threatens {Cavendish} banana plantations worldwide.
e.zh: 一种真菌病害威胁着全球的卡文迪什香蕉种植园。

e.en: An experienced {caver} knows never to explore alone.
e.zh: 经验丰富的洞穴探险者绝不会独自进洞。

e.en: The {caver} squeezed through a narrow gap in the rock.
e.zh: 洞穴探险者从岩石间狭窄的缝隙挤过。

e.en: The river had carved a huge {cavern} beneath the mountain.
e.zh: 河水在山下冲蚀出一个巨大的洞穴。

e.en: Bats hung from the ceiling of the dimly lit {cavern}.
e.zh: 蝙蝠倒挂在昏暗洞穴的顶部。

cavernous.t: adj. 洞穴般的；空洞深邃的

e.en: The hotel lobby was {cavernous} and oddly empty.
e.zh: 酒店大堂空旷得像山洞，显得格外冷清。

e.en: His {cavernous} eyes made him look exhausted and pale.
e.zh: 他深陷的双眼让他看上去疲惫又苍白。

caversham.t: n. 卡弗舍姆（英国地名）

e.en: They moved into a small house in {Caversham} last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天他们搬进了卡弗舍姆的一栋小房子。

e.en: The bus to {Caversham} runs every fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 开往卡弗舍姆的公交车每十五分钟一班。

e.en: Ancient paintings cover the walls of these limestone {caves}.
e.zh: 古代绘画布满了这些石灰岩洞穴的洞壁。

e.en: Several {caves} in the area are open to the public.
e.zh: 该地区有几个洞穴对公众开放。

e.en: They served {caviar} on tiny toasts at the gala.
e.zh: 晚会上他们把鱼子酱放在小块吐司上端上来。

e.en: Real beluga {caviar} can cost thousands of dollars per pound.
e.zh: 真正的白鲸鱼子酱每磅可能要价数千美元。

caviare.t: n. 鱼子酱（caviar 的异体）

e.en: The British menu spelled it {caviare} in old-fashioned style.
e.zh: 那份英式菜单用老式拼法写作"caviare"。

e.en: A small jar of {caviare} sat chilling on ice.
e.zh: 一小罐鱼子酱被放在冰上冷藏。

cavil.t:
v. 吹毛求疵
n. 无理挑剔

e.en: Don't {cavil} over tiny details when the big picture matters.
e.zh: 重要的是大局，别在细枝末节上吹毛求疵。

e.en: Critics continue to {cavil} at the film's minor inaccuracies.
e.zh: 评论家们仍在挑剔这部电影的小错误。

e.en: He took up {caving} as a weekend hobby last year.
e.zh: 他去年开始把洞穴探险作为周末爱好。

e.en: The CEO is finally {caving} to pressure from shareholders.
e.zh: 首席执行官终于在股东压力下让步了。

e.en: Engineers redesigned the propeller to reduce {cavitation} noise.
e.zh: 工程师重新设计了螺旋桨以减少空化噪声。

e.en: {Cavitation} can slowly damage pump blades over time.
e.zh: 空化作用会随着时间慢慢损坏泵叶片。

e.en: Brushing twice a day helps prevent {cavities} in your teeth.
e.zh: 每天刷两次牙有助于预防蛀牙。

e.en: The scan revealed several small {cavities} inside the rock.
e.zh: 扫描显示岩石内部有几个小空腔。

e.en: The dentist found a {cavity} in my back molar.
e.zh: 牙医在我的后磨牙上发现了一个蛀洞。

e.en: Surgeons inserted a tiny camera into the chest {cavity}.
e.zh: 外科医生将一个微型摄像机伸入胸腔。

e.en: The puppies {cavort} happily in the freshly fallen snow.
e.zh: 小狗们在新雪中欢快地嬉戏跳跃。

e.en: Tabloids love to show celebrities {cavort}ing on yachts.
e.zh: 小报喜欢登载名人在游艇上嬉闹的画面。

caw.t:
v. (乌鸦) 呱呱叫
n. 乌鸦叫声

e.en: A black crow let out a sharp {caw} from the rooftop.
e.zh: 一只黑乌鸦在屋顶发出尖锐的叫声。

e.en: You could hear ravens {caw} across the empty field.
e.zh: 你能听见渡鸦的叫声响彻空旷的田野。

e.en: The {cawing} of crows woke me up before sunrise.
e.zh: 乌鸦的叫声在日出前把我吵醒了。

e.en: Several crows were {cawing} loudly in the bare tree.
e.zh: 几只乌鸦在光秃秃的树上大声鸣叫。

caxton.t: n. 卡克斯顿（英国印刷先驱）

e.en: {Caxton} printed the first book in English in 1473.
e.zh: 卡克斯顿于1473年印刷了第一本英文书籍。

e.en: The library owns a rare page from a {Caxton} edition.
e.zh: 图书馆藏有一张稀有的卡克斯顿版书页。

e.en: We anchored the boat off a tiny tropical {cay}.
e.zh: 我们把船停泊在一个热带小珊瑚岛旁。

e.en: The {cay} was so small you could walk around it quickly.
e.zh: 这个小岛小到很快就能绕一圈。

e.en: Add a pinch of {cayenne} to give the soup some heat.
e.zh: 加一小撮辣椒粉，让汤更有辣味。

e.en: The chili rub uses {cayenne}, paprika, and brown sugar.
e.zh: 这款腌料用了辣椒粉、甜椒粉和红糖。

e.en: A small {cayman} sunned itself on the muddy riverbank.
e.zh: 一只小凯门鳄在泥泞的河岸上晒太阳。

e.en: Many funds are registered in the {Cayman} Islands for tax reasons.
e.zh: 许多基金出于税务原因在开曼群岛注册。

e.en: Sailors love exploring the small {cays} around the Bahamas.
e.zh: 水手们喜欢探索巴哈马周围的小珊瑚岛。

e.en: Several {cays} disappear completely during high tide.
e.zh: 有几个小岛在涨潮时会完全没入水中。

cbc.t: n. 加拿大广播公司；全血细胞计数

e.en: I watched the election results on {CBC} last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我在加拿大广播公司看了选举结果。

e.en: The doctor ordered a {CBC} to check my blood counts.
e.zh: 医生开了全血细胞计数检查来查我的血象。

cbe.t: n. 大英帝国司令勋章

e.en: The actress was awarded a {CBE} for her charity work.
e.zh: 这位女演员因慈善工作获颁大英帝国司令勋章。

e.en: He proudly added "{CBE}" after his name on the program.
e.zh: 他自豪地在节目单上的名字后加了"CBE"勋衔。

e.en: The {CBI} represents thousands of British businesses in policy talks.
e.zh: 英国工业联合会在政策谈判中代表数千家英国企业。

e.en: A {CBI} survey showed manufacturing output rising this quarter.
e.zh: 英国工业联合会的一项调查显示本季度制造业产出上升。

cbs.t: n. 哥伦比亚广播公司

e.en: The drama airs on {CBS} every Thursday night.
e.zh: 这部剧每周四晚在哥伦比亚广播公司播出。

e.en: {CBS} News broke the story before any other network.
e.zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司新闻抢在其他电视网之前报道了这条消息。

cca.t: n. CCA（多种缩写，如彩色校正分析、加州艺术学院等）

e.en: The {CCA} accredits art and design programs nationwide.
e.zh: 该认证委员会为全国的艺术与设计专业进行认证。

e.en: She studied illustration at {CCA} for four years.
e.zh: 她在加州艺术学院学了四年插画。

ccc.t: n. CCC（多种缩写，如中国强制认证）

e.en: The {CCC} planted millions of trees during the Depression.
e.zh: 民间资源保护队在大萧条期间种植了数百万棵树。

e.en: He earned a {CCC} grade in his maths exam.
e.zh: 他的数学考试得了三个C的成绩。

ccd.t: n. 电荷耦合器件（图像传感器）

e.en: The camera uses a {CCD} sensor for sharper low-light images.
e.zh: 这款相机采用电荷耦合器件传感器,在弱光下成像更清晰。

e.en: Astronomers rely on {CCD} chips to capture faint starlight.
e.zh: 天文学家依靠电荷耦合器件芯片捕捉微弱的星光。

ccg.t: n. CCG（缩写，如集换式卡牌游戏）

e.en: The local {CCG} decides which treatments the NHS will fund.
e.zh: 当地的临床委员会小组决定国民保健署资助哪些治疗。

e.en: Each {CCG} manages healthcare budgets for its region.
e.zh: 每个临床委员会小组负责管理本地区的医疗预算。

e.en: {CCK} is a hormone that signals fullness after eating.
e.zh: 胆囊收缩素是一种在进食后传递饱腹感的激素。

e.en: Researchers studied how {CCK} affects appetite control.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了胆囊收缩素如何影响食欲调节。

e.en: The {CCP} held its national congress in Beijing.
e.zh: 中国共产党在北京召开全国代表大会。

e.en: Foreign media closely follow statements from the {CCP}.
e.zh: 外国媒体密切关注中国共产党的声明。

cctv.t: n. 闭路电视；中国中央电视台

e.en: {CCTV} cameras caught the thief leaving the building.
e.zh: 监控摄像头拍到小偷离开大楼。

e.en: The shop installed {CCTV} to deter shoplifters.
e.zh: 那家店安装了监控以吓阻偷窃者。

e.en: Turn the screw {CCW} until it loosens completely.
e.zh: 逆时针转动螺丝,直到完全松开。

e.en: He has a {CCW} permit and carries a small handgun.
e.zh: 他持有隐蔽携枪许可证,带着一把小手枪。

e.en: The old game came on a single {CD-ROM} disc.
e.zh: 那款老游戏装在一张光盘上。

e.en: My laptop no longer has a {CD-ROM} drive.
e.zh: 我的笔记本电脑已经没有光驱了。

e.en: He found a box of dusty {CD-ROMs} in the attic.
e.zh: 他在阁楼里找到一箱布满灰尘的光盘。

e.en: Encyclopedias used to ship on multiple {CD-ROMs}.
e.zh: 百科全书过去常常分装在好几张光盘上发行。

e.en: The {CDC} issued new guidelines on flu vaccinations.
e.zh: 美国疾控中心发布了关于流感疫苗的新指南。

e.en: {CDC} researchers are tracking the outbreak closely.
e.zh: 美国疾控中心的研究人员正在密切追踪疫情。

cdi.t: n. CDI（电容放电点火；商品描述接口等）

e.en: The motorcycle uses a {CDI} ignition for reliable starts.
e.zh: 这辆摩托车采用电容放电点火,启动可靠。

e.en: A faulty {CDI} module can cause sudden engine cutouts.
e.zh: 电容放电点火模块故障可能导致发动机突然熄火。

cdna.t: n. 互补脱氧核糖核酸

e.en: Scientists synthesized {cDNA} from the virus's RNA template.
e.zh: 科学家以病毒RNA为模板合成了互补DNA。

e.en: The lab built a {cDNA} library to study gene expression.
e.zh: 实验室建立了一个互补DNA文库以研究基因表达。

cdp.t: n. 客户数据平台；碳披露项目

e.en: Companies report emissions data to {CDP} every year.
e.zh: 各公司每年都向碳信息披露项目报告排放数据。

e.en: A high {CDP} score signals strong climate transparency.
e.zh: 较高的碳披露评分表明气候透明度良好。

cdr.t: n. 通话详单；可刻录光盘

e.en: The phone company stores a {CDR} for every call made.
e.zh: 电话公司为每一通电话保存一份通话详单。

e.en: Investigators subpoenaed the {CDR} to trace the suspect.
e.zh: 调查人员调取了通话详单以追查嫌疑人。

cds.t: n. 信用违约掉期；光盘（复数）

e.en: She still keeps a shelf of old jazz {CDs} at home.
e.zh: 她家里还留着一架子老爵士唱片。

e.en: Banks bought {CDS} contracts to hedge against defaults.
e.zh: 银行购买信用违约互换合约以对冲违约风险。

cdt.t: n. 中部夏令时间（Central Daylight Time）

e.en: The webinar starts at 3 p.m. {CDT} this Friday.
e.zh: 网络研讨会将于本周五中部夏令时间下午三点开始。

e.en: He studied {CDT} in school and built a wooden chair.
e.zh: 他在学校学了设计与技术课,做了一把木椅子。

cdu.t: n. 德国基督教民主联盟（缩写）

e.en: The {CDU} won the most seats in the German election.
e.zh: 基民盟在德国大选中赢得了最多席位。

e.en: Merkel led the {CDU} for sixteen years.
e.zh: 默克尔领导基民盟长达十六年。

ceanothus.t: n. 美洲茶（一种观赏灌木）

e.en: The {ceanothus} bush burst into vivid blue flowers in spring.
e.zh: 美洲茶灌木在春天盛开出鲜艳的蓝色花朵。

e.en: Bees swarm around our {ceanothus} every May.
e.zh: 每年五月蜜蜂都会围着我们家的美洲茶飞舞。

e.en: The factory will {cease} operations at the end of June.
e.zh: 这家工厂将于六月底停止运营。

e.en: Please {cease} all unnecessary chatter during the test.
e.zh: 考试期间请停止一切不必要的交谈。

ceased.t: v. 停止（cease 的过去式）

e.en: The rain finally {ceased} just before the wedding began.
e.zh: 就在婚礼开始前,雨终于停了。

e.en: The newspaper {ceased} publication after eighty years.
e.zh: 那份报纸在创刊八十年后停刊了。

e.en: Both sides agreed to a temporary {ceasefire} for negotiations.
e.zh: 双方同意暂时停火以进行谈判。

e.en: The {ceasefire} broke down after only three days.
e.zh: 停火协议仅维持三天就破裂了。

ceaseless.t: adj. 不停的；持续不断的

e.en: Her {ceaseless} questions wore the babysitter out.
e.zh: 她没完没了的问题把保姆累坏了。

e.en: The {ceaseless} hum of traffic kept him awake all night.
e.zh: 车流不断的嗡嗡声让他整夜难眠。

e.en: The river flows {ceaselessly} toward the distant sea.
e.zh: 河水不停地向远方的大海流去。

e.en: He worked {ceaselessly} to finish the report by Monday.
e.zh: 他不停地工作,以便在周一前完成报告。

ceases.t: v. 停止（cease 第三人称单数）

e.en: Her energy never {ceases} to amaze the whole team.
e.zh: 她的活力总是让整个团队赞叹不已。

e.en: When the music {ceases}, everyone must find a seat.
e.zh: 音乐一停,每个人都必须找到一个座位。

ceasing.t: v. 停止（cease 的现在分词）

e.en: The wind blew all night without {ceasing}.
e.zh: 风整夜不停地吹着。

e.en: They prayed without {ceasing} for the lost climbers.
e.zh: 他们不停地为失踪的登山者祈祷。

e.en: The {CEC} certified the election results last Friday.
e.zh: 中央选举委员会上周五对选举结果进行了认证。

e.en: Soil with high {CEC} retains nutrients much better.
e.zh: 阳离子交换量高的土壤能更好地保持养分。

e.en: We built the closet from fragrant {cedar} planks.
e.zh: 我们用芬芳的雪松木板做了这个衣橱。

e.en: A huge {cedar} tree shaded the entire backyard.
e.zh: 一棵巨大的雪松为整个后院遮阴。

e.en: The chest gave off a warm {cedarwood} aroma.
e.zh: 那只箱子散发出温暖的雪松木香气。

e.en: She added a drop of {cedarwood} oil to her diffuser.
e.zh: 她往香薰机里滴了一滴雪松木精油。

e.en: The treaty forced the country to {cede} two coastal islands.
e.zh: 该条约迫使该国割让两座沿海岛屿。

e.en: He refused to {cede} control of the family business.
e.zh: 他拒绝交出家族企业的控制权。

ceded.t: v. 割让（cede 的过去式）

e.en: Spain {ceded} the territory to France in 1763.
e.zh: 西班牙于1763年将该领土割让给了法国。

e.en: She finally {ceded} the argument and went to bed.
e.zh: 她最终让步,结束争论上床睡觉了。

ceefax.t: n. BBC 图文电视服务（已停用）

e.en: We used to check football scores on {Ceefax} as kids.
e.zh: 我们小时候常在Ceefax图文电视上查足球比分。

e.en: {Ceefax} closed down when analog TV was switched off.
e.zh: Ceefax图文电视服务在模拟电视停播时关闭了。

ceftriaxone.t: n. 头孢曲松（一种抗生素）

e.en: The doctor prescribed {ceftriaxone} for the severe infection.
e.zh: 医生为这次严重感染开了头孢曲松。

e.en: {Ceftriaxone} is given by injection in most hospitals.
e.zh: 大多数医院都通过注射的方式给予头孢曲松。

cegb.t: n. 英国中央电力局（缩写）

e.en: The {CEGB} once ran most of Britain's power stations.
e.zh: 中央电力局曾经经营英国大部分发电厂。

e.en: Privatization broke up the {CEGB} in the early nineties.
e.zh: 九十年代初的私有化使中央电力局解体。

e.en: A massive {ceiba} tree towered above the rainforest canopy.
e.zh: 一棵巨大的木棉树高耸于雨林冠层之上。

e.en: The Maya considered the {ceiba} a sacred tree of life.
e.zh: 玛雅人将木棉树视为神圣的生命之树。

ceilidh.t: n. 苏格兰/爱尔兰传统音乐舞会

e.en: We danced all night at a Scottish {ceilidh} in Edinburgh.
e.zh: 我们在爱丁堡的一场苏格兰民间舞会上跳了整夜的舞。

e.en: The wedding ended with a lively {ceilidh} and live fiddles.
e.zh: 婚礼以一场热闹的盖尔民间舞会和现场小提琴演奏结束。

ceiling.t:
n. 天花板
n. 上限；最高限额

e.en: A spider was crawling slowly across the bedroom {ceiling}.
e.zh: 一只蜘蛛正缓慢地爬过卧室的天花板。

e.en: Congress voted to raise the federal debt {ceiling} again.
e.zh: 国会再次投票决定提高联邦债务上限。

ceilings.t:
n. 天花板（复数）
n. 上限

e.en: The old church had high vaulted {ceilings} and stained glass.
e.zh: 那座老教堂有高高的拱顶和彩色玻璃。

e.en: Many women still face glass {ceilings} in tech leadership roles.
e.zh: 许多女性在科技领导岗位上仍面临玻璃天花板。

e.en: The animator hand-painted each {cel} for the classic cartoon.
e.zh: 动画师为这部经典卡通手绘了每一张赛璐珞片。

e.en: Original Disney {cel} artwork can sell for thousands of dollars.
e.zh: 迪士尼的原版赛璐珞画作可以卖到数千美元。

e.en: She collects antique {celadon} bowls from the Song dynasty.
e.zh: 她收藏宋代的青瓷古碗。

e.en: The walls were painted a soft {celadon} green.
e.zh: 墙壁被刷成了柔和的青瓷绿色。

e.en: A famous {celeb} sat at the table next to ours.
e.zh: 一位著名明星就坐在我们隔壁桌。

e.en: The magazine ran a glossy {celeb} interview on the cover.
e.zh: 那本杂志在封面刊登了一篇光鲜的名人专访。

celebrant.t: n. 主持仪式者；庆祝者

e.en: The {celebrant} led the couple through their wedding vows.
e.zh: 婚礼主持人引导这对新人完成了结婚誓言。

e.en: A licensed {celebrant} can legally officiate the ceremony.
e.zh: 有执照的主礼人可以合法主持这场仪式。

e.en: We {celebrate} my mother's birthday with a big family dinner.
e.zh: 我们用一顿丰盛的家庭晚餐来庆祝妈妈的生日。

e.en: The whole town gathered to {celebrate} the championship win.
e.zh: 全镇的人聚在一起庆祝冠军的胜利。

celebrated.t:
adj. 著名的
v. 庆祝（过去式）

e.en: She is a {celebrated} pianist who tours all over Europe.
e.zh: 她是一位著名的钢琴家,在欧洲各地巡演。

e.en: They {celebrated} their tenth anniversary in Kyoto last week.
e.zh: 他们上周在京都庆祝了结婚十周年。

celebrates.t: v. 庆祝（第三人称单数）

e.en: The festival {celebrates} the beginning of the harvest season.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝丰收季节的开始。

e.en: Our office {celebrates} every product launch with cake.
e.zh: 我们办公室每次产品发布都会用蛋糕来庆祝。

e.en: We are {celebrating} her promotion at the rooftop bar tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我们在屋顶酒吧庆祝她升职。

e.en: The kids are {celebrating} the end of school with ice cream.
e.zh: 孩子们正用冰淇淋庆祝学期结束。

e.en: The wedding turned into an all-night {celebration} of music and dance.
e.zh: 婚礼变成了一场通宵达旦的音乐舞蹈庆典。

e.en: Fireworks lit up the sky in {celebration} of the new year.
e.zh: 烟花点亮夜空,庆祝新年的到来。

celebrations.t: n. 庆典；庆祝活动（复数）

e.en: Lunar New Year {celebrations} fill the streets with red lanterns.
e.zh: 农历新年的庆祝活动让街道挂满了红灯笼。

e.en: The graduation {celebrations} continued late into the night.
e.zh: 毕业庆祝活动一直持续到深夜。

e.en: They raised a {celebratory} toast after closing the deal.
e.zh: 他们在交易达成后举杯庆祝。

e.en: The team posted a {celebratory} video on social media.
e.zh: 球队在社交媒体上发布了一段庆祝视频。

e.en: Several {celebrities} attended the charity gala last night.
e.zh: 昨晚有几位名人出席了慈善晚宴。

e.en: Many {celebrities} now promote products through Instagram posts.
e.zh: 如今许多名人通过Instagram帖子推广产品。

e.en: She became a {celebrity} after her cooking show went viral.
e.zh: 她的烹饪节目走红后她成了名人。

e.en: The young actor isn't comfortable with sudden {celebrity}.
e.zh: 这位年轻演员对突如其来的名气感到不适。

e.en: He roasted some {celeriac} alongside the carrots and parsnips.
e.zh: 他把根芹和胡萝卜、欧防风一起烤了。

e.en: This soup uses {celeriac} instead of potato for a nuttier flavor.
e.zh: 这道汤用根芹代替土豆,味道更带坚果香。

e.en: The team responded with surprising {celerity} to the outage.
e.zh: 团队以惊人的速度应对了这次故障。

e.en: She answered the email with her usual {celerity}.
e.zh: 她以一贯的迅捷回复了那封邮件。

e.en: I added some chopped {celery} to the chicken soup.
e.zh: 我在鸡汤里加了一些切碎的芹菜。

e.en: She dipped a stick of {celery} into the peanut butter.
e.zh: 她拿一根芹菜蘸了花生酱。

celeste.t:
n. 钢片琴
n. 天蓝色

e.en: The composer added a {celeste} for a dreamy texture.
e.zh: 作曲家加入了一架钢片琴营造梦幻氛围。

e.en: You can hear a {celeste} in the Nutcracker's Sugar Plum Fairy.
e.zh: 在《胡桃夹子》的糖梅仙子段落能听到钢片琴。

celestial.t: adj. 天上的；天空的；神圣的

e.en: Astronomers tracked the {celestial} body across the night sky.
e.zh: 天文学家在夜空中追踪那颗天体。

e.en: The choir's voices had an almost {celestial} quality.
e.zh: 合唱团的嗓音几乎带着天籁般的质感。

e.en: People with {celiac} disease must avoid gluten entirely.
e.zh: 乳糜泻患者必须完全避免麸质。

e.en: The bakery offers bread suitable for {celiac} customers.
e.zh: 这家面包店提供适合乳糜泻顾客的面包。

e.en: The monks take a vow of {celibacy} when they join the order.
e.zh: 修士加入修会时要立下独身誓言。

e.en: She chose {celibacy} to focus on her studies.
e.zh: 她选择独身以便专心学业。

e.en: He remained {celibate} throughout his time at the monastery.
e.zh: 他在修道院期间始终保持独身。

e.en: Many priests in the tradition are required to be {celibate}.
e.zh: 该传统中的许多神父被要求保持独身。

celica.t: n. 丰田 Celica 跑车

e.en: He restored an old Toyota {Celica} in his garage.
e.zh: 他在车库里翻修了一辆老款丰田Celica。

e.en: The 1990s {Celica} still has a strong fan following.
e.zh: 九十年代的Celica至今仍有大批粉丝。

centigrade.t:
adj. 摄氏的
n. 摄氏温度

e.en: Water boils at 100 degrees {centigrade} at sea level.
e.zh: 水在海平面下100摄氏度沸腾。

e.en: The forecast says temperatures will drop below zero {centigrade}.
e.zh: 天气预报说气温将降到零摄氏度以下。

centigrades.t: n. 摄氏度（centigrade 的复数）

e.en: The old thermometer was marked in {centigrades} only.
e.zh: 那支老式温度计只标有摄氏度刻度。

e.en: Convert these {centigrades} into Fahrenheit for the recipe.
e.zh: 把这些摄氏度数换算成华氏度以便照菜谱做。

e.en: The screen is just one {centimeter} thick.
e.zh: 这块屏幕仅一厘米厚。

e.en: Move the picture a {centimeter} to the left.
e.zh: 把这幅画往左挪一厘米。

e.en: The baby grew five {centimeters} in three months.
e.zh: 宝宝三个月里长高了五厘米。

e.en: Cut the fabric into strips ten {centimeters} wide.
e.zh: 把布料剪成十厘米宽的长条。

e.en: The ruler measures down to a single {centimetre}.
e.zh: 这把尺子可以精确到一厘米。

e.en: Snow piled up another {centimetre} overnight.
e.zh: 一夜之间又积了一厘米的雪。

e.en: The shelf is thirty {centimetres} deep.
e.zh: 这块架子深三十厘米。

e.en: Her hair grew several {centimetres} over the summer.
e.zh: 她的头发在夏天里长了好几厘米。

e.en: A {centipede} skittered across the bathroom tiles.
e.zh: 一条蜈蚣从浴室瓷砖上飞快爬过。

e.en: Some species of {centipede} can deliver a painful bite.
e.zh: 某些种类的蜈蚣咬人会非常疼。

e.en: The hotel has a very {central} location downtown.
e.zh: 这家酒店位于市中心,位置非常便利。

e.en: Trust is {central} to any healthy relationship.
e.zh: 信任是任何健康关系的核心。

e.en: The Gare {Centrale} is the city's main train station.
e.zh: 中央车站是这座城市的主要火车站。

e.en: He studied engineering at École {Centrale} in Paris.
e.zh: 他在巴黎中央理工学院攻读工程专业。

centralisation.t: n. 集中化；中央集权（英式拼写）

e.en: The reforms led to greater {centralisation} of government power.
e.zh: 这些改革使政府权力更加集中。

e.en: Critics argue that {centralisation} slows down local decisions.
e.zh: 批评者认为集中化会拖慢地方决策。

centralise.t: v. 使集中；集权化（英式拼写）

e.en: The company plans to {centralise} all customer support in Dublin.
e.zh: 公司打算把所有客户支持业务集中到都柏林。

e.en: They want to {centralise} data across every regional office.
e.zh: 他们希望把各地区办公室的数据统一集中起来。

centralised.t:
adj. 集中化的
v. centralise 的过去式

e.en: The firm has a {centralised} purchasing department for all branches.
e.zh: 该公司设有为各分支统一采购的中心化部门。

e.en: All payroll records are now {centralised} on one server.
e.zh: 所有工资记录现在都集中存放在一台服务器上。

centralising.t: v. 使集中（现在分词，英式）

e.en: The minister is accused of {centralising} too much authority.
e.zh: 这位部长被指责过度集中权力。

e.en: They are {centralising} their warehouses to cut costs.
e.zh: 他们正在集中仓库以削减成本。

e.en: Democratic {centralism} guided decision-making within the party.
e.zh: 民主集中制指导着该党的决策过程。

e.en: Critics say {centralism} ignores the needs of rural regions.
e.zh: 批评者认为中央集权制忽视了农村地区的需求。

centralist.t:
n. 集权主义者
adj. 中央集权的

e.en: The new president has strongly {centralist} tendencies.
e.zh: 新总统具有强烈的中央集权倾向。

e.en: A {centralist} approach left local councils with little power.
e.zh: 中央集权的做法让地方议会几乎没有权力。

e.en: The author stresses the {centrality} of family in the novel.
e.zh: 作者强调家庭在这部小说中的核心地位。

e.en: Data shows the {centrality} of mobile devices in daily life.
e.zh: 数据显示移动设备在日常生活中的核心地位。

e.en: Cloud computing enabled the {centralization} of company files.
e.zh: 云计算使公司文件得以集中存储。

e.en: Too much {centralization} can frustrate frontline employees.
e.zh: 过度集中化会让一线员工感到沮丧。

e.en: We plan to {centralize} all bookings on one platform.
e.zh: 我们计划把所有预订集中到一个平台上。

e.en: Hospitals want to {centralize} patient records for easier access.
e.zh: 医院希望集中管理病历以便随时调阅。

centralized.t: adj. 集中式的；中心化的

e.en: Banks rely on {centralized} systems to process transactions.
e.zh: 银行依靠集中式系统处理交易。

e.en: The startup {centralized} its servers in a single data center.
e.zh: 这家初创公司把服务器都集中到一个数据中心。

e.en: The CEO is {centralizing} marketing across all product lines.
e.zh: 首席执行官正在把各产品线的市场营销集中起来。

e.en: {Centralizing} decisions can speed things up but reduce flexibility.
e.zh: 集中决策可以加快速度,但会降低灵活性。

e.en: The apartment is {centrally} located near the subway.
e.zh: 这套公寓地处市中心,靠近地铁。

e.en: All servers are {centrally} managed by the IT team.
e.zh: 所有服务器都由IT团队集中管理。

centre.t:
n. 中心；中央（英式拼写）
v. 使居中

e.en: They opened a new shopping {centre} near the river.
e.zh: 他们在河边新开了一家购物中心。

e.en: Please {centre} the title on the page.
e.zh: 请把标题在页面上居中。

centred.t: adj. 居中的；以…为中心的

e.en: The discussion {centred} on rising housing costs.
e.zh: 讨论的焦点是不断上涨的住房成本。

e.en: Make sure the photo is properly {centred} in the frame.
e.zh: 确保照片在画框里摆放居中。

centrefold.t: n. 杂志中间跨页插图

e.en: The magazine's {centrefold} showed a stunning mountain landscape.
e.zh: 杂志的跨页大图展示了壮丽的山景。

e.en: He carefully unfolded the poster {centrefold} from the issue.
e.zh: 他小心地把那期杂志的跨页海报展开。

e.en: The plane touched down right on the runway {centreline}.
e.zh: 飞机正好沿跑道中线着陆。

e.en: Faded paint made the road's {centreline} hard to see.
e.zh: 褪色的油漆使道路中线很难看清。

centrepiece.t: n. 核心部分；餐桌中央摆饰

e.en: A floral {centrepiece} brightened the wedding table.
e.zh: 一束花艺中心摆件让婚宴餐桌生辉。

e.en: The new tax cut is the {centrepiece} of the budget.
e.zh: 新的减税措施是这份预算的核心内容。

centres.t:
n. 中心（复数）
v. 使居中（第三人称）

e.en: The charity runs childcare {centres} across the country.
e.zh: 该慈善机构在全国各地经营托儿中心。

e.en: The debate {centres} on whether the law should change.
e.zh: 辩论的焦点在于法律是否应该修改。

centric.t: adj. 中心的；以…为中心的

e.en: The startup builds customer-{centric} software for small businesses.
e.zh: 这家初创公司为小企业开发以客户为中心的软件。

e.en: Their design is too desktop-{centric} and ignores mobile users.
e.zh: 他们的设计过于偏向桌面端,忽视了移动用户。

e.en: The spinning bucket demonstrated {centrifugal} force in class.
e.zh: 旋转的水桶在课堂上演示了离心力。

e.en: A washing machine uses {centrifugal} action to wring out clothes.
e.zh: 洗衣机利用离心作用把衣服甩干。

e.en: Blood samples are separated by {centrifugation} in the lab.
e.zh: 实验室通过离心法分离血液样本。

e.en: {Centrifugation} removes cells from the liquid plasma.
e.zh: 离心可以将细胞从液态血浆中分离出来。

centrifuge.t:
n. 离心机
v. 用离心机分离

e.en: The lab tech loaded the {centrifuge} with blood samples.
e.zh: 实验员把血液样本放入离心机。

e.en: Engineers use a {centrifuge} to test pilots' tolerance to G-forces.
e.zh: 工程师用离心机测试飞行员对重力加速度的承受力。

centring.t:
n. 定心；对中
v. 使居中（现在分词）

e.en: She spent the morning {centring} headings in the report.
e.zh: 她整个上午都在把报告里的标题居中。

e.en: Builders removed the {centring} once the arch had set.
e.zh: 拱顶定型之后,工人撤掉了拱架。

e.en: {Centripetal} force keeps a satellite in orbit around Earth.
e.zh: 向心力使卫星绕地球持续运行。

e.en: A car needs {centripetal} force from friction to turn safely.
e.zh: 汽车需要摩擦提供的向心力才能安全转弯。

e.en: The new party preaches {centrism} and pragmatic compromise.
e.zh: 这个新政党倡导中间路线和务实的妥协。

e.en: Voters seem tired of {centrism} that pleases no one.
e.zh: 选民似乎厌倦了那种谁都不讨好的中间路线。

centrist.t:
n. 中间派人士
adj. 中间立场的

e.en: The {centrist} candidate won over undecided suburban voters.
e.zh: 这位中间派候选人赢得了郊区摇摆选民的支持。

e.en: He holds {centrist} views on most economic issues.
e.zh: 他在大多数经济问题上持中间立场。

e.en: We met for coffee in El {Centro}, the city's old core.
e.zh: 我们约在市中心老城区喝咖啡。

e.en: The mall is named Plaza {Centro} after its central location.
e.zh: 这家商场因地处市中心而取名中央广场。

e.en: The algorithm computes the {centroid} of each cluster of points.
e.zh: 该算法会计算每个点簇的质心。

e.en: Engineers calculated the {centroid} of the irregular shape.
e.zh: 工程师计算了这个不规则形状的形心。

e.en: The {centrum} is the main body of a vertebra.
e.zh: 椎体是椎骨的主要部分。

e.en: Fossil hunters found a well-preserved {centrum} in the cliff.
e.zh: 化石爱好者在悬崖里发现了一块保存完好的椎体。

e.en: The candy costs only fifty {cents} at the corner store.
e.zh: 那块糖在街角小店只卖五十美分。

e.en: He didn't have two {cents} left after paying rent.
e.zh: 付完房租后他身上一分钱也不剩了。

e.en: This temple has stood here for many {centuries}.
e.zh: 这座寺庙已经在这里矗立了好几个世纪。

e.en: Scientists studied climate patterns over the past two {centuries}.
e.zh: 科学家研究了过去两个世纪的气候模式。

e.en: A Roman {centurion} commanded one hundred soldiers in battle.
e.zh: 罗马百夫长在战斗中指挥一百名士兵。

e.en: The museum displays armor worn by an ancient {centurion}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一位古代百夫长穿过的盔甲。

e.en: The internet transformed daily life in the twenty-first {century}.
e.zh: 互联网改变了二十一世纪的日常生活。

e.en: This oak tree is over a {century} old.
e.zh: 这棵橡树已有一个多世纪的历史。

e.en: The {ceo} announced record profits at the annual meeting.
e.zh: 首席执行官在年会上宣布了创纪录的利润。

e.en: She became the youngest {ceo} in the company's history.
e.zh: 她成为公司史上最年轻的首席执行官。

e.en: The nurse located the {cephalic} vein to draw blood.
e.zh: 护士找到头静脉来抽血。

e.en: Doctors monitored the baby's {cephalic} development during pregnancy.
e.zh: 医生在孕期监测胎儿头部的发育情况。

cephalopod.t: n. 头足类动物（如章鱼、乌贼）

e.en: The octopus is a remarkably intelligent {cephalopod}.
e.zh: 章鱼是一种极其聪明的头足类动物。

e.en: Squid and cuttlefish are common {cephalopod} species.
e.zh: 鱿鱼和墨鱼是常见的头足类动物。

cephalosporin.t: n. 头孢菌素类抗生素

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {cephalosporin} antibiotic for the infection.
e.zh: 医生开了头孢类抗生素来治疗感染。

e.en: Some patients are allergic to {cephalosporin} medications.
e.zh: 有些病人对头孢类药物过敏。

e.en: The chemistry textbook listed {cer} as the symbol prefix for cerium.
e.zh: 化学教科书把 cer 列为铈元素的符号前缀。

e.en: Old Latin abbreviations sometimes used {cer} in scholarly notes.
e.zh: 古拉丁文缩写在学术注释中有时使用 cer。

ceramic.t:
adj. 陶瓷的
n. 陶瓷制品

e.en: She drank coffee from a beautiful handmade {ceramic} mug.
e.zh: 她用一只漂亮的手工陶瓷杯喝咖啡。

e.en: The kitchen floor has glossy white {ceramic} tiles.
e.zh: 厨房地面铺着光亮的白色瓷砖。

e.en: She studied {ceramics} at art school for four years.
e.zh: 她在艺术学校学了四年陶艺。

e.en: The gallery sells handmade {ceramics} by local artists.
e.zh: 画廊出售本地艺术家手工制作的陶瓷品。

e.en: The {ceramist} shaped the clay into a delicate vase.
e.zh: 陶艺家把黏土塑成了一只精致的花瓶。

e.en: A famous Japanese {ceramist} demonstrated techniques at the workshop.
e.zh: 一位著名的日本陶艺家在工作坊演示了技法。

cell.t:
n. 细胞；单元格
n. 牢房；手机

e.en: Each {cell} in the spreadsheet contains a sales figure.
e.zh: 电子表格里的每个单元格都填着一个销售数字。

e.en: The biology class examined a plant {cell} under the microscope.
e.zh: 生物课上同学们用显微镜观察了一个植物细胞。

e.en: He keeps his best wines down in the {cellar}.
e.zh: 他把最好的葡萄酒都存放在地窖里。

e.en: The flooded {cellar} took days to dry out completely.
e.zh: 被水淹的地下室花了好几天才彻底干透。

e.en: The château's {cellars} hold thousands of aging bottles.
e.zh: 这座庄园的酒窖里存放着数千瓶陈年酒。

e.en: Old houses around here often have damp stone {cellars}.
e.zh: 这一带的老房子常常有潮湿的石砌地窖。

e.en: Guards locked down the entire {cellblock} after the fight.
e.zh: 打斗发生后狱警封锁了整个牢区。

e.en: The new {cellblock} houses about two hundred inmates.
e.zh: 新牢区关押着大约两百名囚犯。

e.en: The {cellist} performed a Bach suite from memory.
e.zh: 那位大提琴手凭记忆演奏了一首巴赫组曲。

e.en: Yo-Yo Ma is probably the world's most famous {cellist}.
e.zh: 马友友大概是全世界最有名的大提琴家。

cellists.t: n. 大提琴演奏者（复数）

e.en: Two {cellists} auditioned for the orchestra's open chair.
e.zh: 两位大提琴手参加了乐团空缺席位的甄选。

e.en: Young {cellists} often struggle with intonation at first.
e.zh: 年轻的大提琴手起初常常在音准上挣扎。

e.en: His {cellmate} taught him how to read in prison.
e.zh: 他的牢友在狱中教会了他识字。

e.en: She rarely spoke to her new {cellmate} the first week.
e.zh: 头一周她几乎没和新牢友说过话。

e.en: She has been learning the {cello} since age six.
e.zh: 她从六岁起就在学大提琴。

e.en: The warm tone of the {cello} filled the small hall.
e.zh: 大提琴温暖的音色充满了这间小厅。

cellophane.t: n. 玻璃纸；透明包装纸

e.en: The gift basket was wrapped in clear {cellophane}.
e.zh: 礼品篮用透明玻璃纸包了起来。

e.en: She tore open the {cellophane} and bit into the candy.
e.zh: 她撕开玻璃纸,咬了一口糖果。

e.en: Four {cellos} opened the symphony with a low chord.
e.zh: 四把大提琴以一个低沉的和弦拉开了交响乐序幕。

e.en: The shop had several antique {cellos} on display.
e.zh: 店里陈列着几把古董大提琴。

e.en: Please silence your {cellphone} before the movie starts.
e.zh: 电影开始前请把手机调成静音。

e.en: He left his {cellphone} charging on the kitchen counter.
e.zh: 他把手机放在厨房台面上充电。

e.en: Solar {cells} on the roof power most of the house.
e.zh: 屋顶上的太阳能电池为这栋房子大部分供电。

e.en: White blood {cells} help fight off infection.
e.zh: 白细胞帮助身体抵抗感染。

cellular.t: adj. 蜂窝网络的；细胞的

e.en: There's no {cellular} signal once you enter the tunnel.
e.zh: 一进隧道就没有手机信号了。

e.en: The drug works at the {cellular} level to slow aging.
e.zh: 这种药物在细胞层面起作用以延缓衰老。

cellularity.t: n. 细胞密度；细胞构成度

e.en: The biopsy showed increased {cellularity} in the marrow.
e.zh: 活检显示骨髓的细胞密度增加了。

e.en: Pathologists assess tumor {cellularity} under a microscope.
e.zh: 病理学家会在显微镜下评估肿瘤的细胞密度。

e.en: Most of the cream's claims about removing {cellulite} are exaggerated.
e.zh: 那款乳霜关于去除橘皮组织的宣传大多被夸大了。

e.en: She stopped worrying about a little {cellulite} on her thighs.
e.zh: 她不再为大腿上的一点橘皮组织而烦恼。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed {cellulitis} and prescribed antibiotics.
e.zh: 医生诊断为蜂窝组织炎并开了抗生素。

e.en: Untreated {cellulitis} can spread quickly through the skin.
e.zh: 未及时治疗的蜂窝组织炎会迅速在皮肤上蔓延。

e.en: Old films were shot on flammable {celluloid} stock.
e.zh: 老电影是用易燃的赛璐珞胶片拍摄的。

e.en: His face is familiar from decades of {celluloid} fame.
e.zh: 他的面孔因数十年的银幕知名度而广为人知。

e.en: Plant cell walls are made mostly of {cellulose}.
e.zh: 植物细胞壁主要由纤维素构成。

e.en: The insulation contains recycled {cellulose} from old paper.
e.zh: 这种保温材料含有从废纸回收的纤维素。

e.en: Water boils at one hundred degrees {Celsius} at sea level.
e.zh: 在海平面水在一百摄氏度时沸腾。

e.en: It's barely five degrees {Celsius} outside this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上外面才不到五摄氏度。

e.en: An ancient {Celt} would have spoken a language unlike Latin.
e.zh: 古代凯尔特人说的语言与拉丁语完全不同。

e.en: The museum displays jewelry crafted by an early {Celt}.
e.zh: 博物馆陈列着早期凯尔特人打造的首饰。

e.en: She has a small {Celtic} knot tattooed on her wrist.
e.zh: 她手腕上纹了一个小小的凯尔特结。

e.en: The band blends rock with traditional {Celtic} melodies.
e.zh: 这支乐队把摇滚和传统凯尔特旋律融合在一起。

cement.t:
n. 水泥
v. 巩固；黏合

e.en: The workers mixed {cement} for the new sidewalk.
e.zh: 工人们为新人行道搅拌水泥。

e.en: That dinner helped {cement} our friendship for years.
e.zh: 那顿晚餐让我们的友谊在之后多年里更加牢固。

e.en: Sandstone forms through the {cementation} of tiny grains.
e.zh: 砂岩是通过细小颗粒的胶结作用形成的。

e.en: The dentist explained the {cementation} step of the crown.
e.zh: 牙医解释了牙冠粘接固定这一步。

e.en: That goal {cemented} her reputation as the league's best striker.
e.zh: 那粒进球奠定了她联赛最佳前锋的地位。

e.en: Workers {cemented} the loose bricks back into the wall.
e.zh: 工人们把松动的砖块用水泥重新砌回墙里。

e.en: Many old {cemeteries} in the city are now overgrown.
e.zh: 市里许多老墓地如今已经杂草丛生。

e.en: Tourists often visit historic {cemeteries} in New Orleans.
e.zh: 游客经常参观新奥尔良那些有历史的墓园。

e.en: Her grandmother is buried in the small village {cemetery}.
e.zh: 她外婆葬在那座小村庄的墓园里。

e.en: They walked quietly through the {cemetery} at dusk.
e.zh: 他们在黄昏时安静地穿过墓园。

cenotaph.t: n. 衣冠冢；战争纪念碑

e.en: Veterans laid wreaths at the {cenotaph} on Remembrance Day.
e.zh: 老兵们在纪念日把花圈放在纪念碑前。

e.en: The town's {cenotaph} honors soldiers who never came home.
e.zh: 镇上的纪念碑纪念那些再没归来的士兵。

cenote.t: n. 天然溶洞井（墨西哥地貌）

e.en: We swam in a hidden {cenote} deep in the Yucatan jungle.
e.zh: 我们在尤卡坦丛林深处一处隐秘的天然井里游泳。

e.en: The Maya considered each {cenote} a sacred entrance to the underworld.
e.zh: 玛雅人把每一口天然井都视为通往冥界的圣门。

e.en: A priest swung the {censer}, filling the church with incense.
e.zh: 一位神父挥动香炉,教堂里充满了香烟。

e.en: The brass {censer} hung from delicate silver chains.
e.zh: 那只黄铜香炉用纤细的银链悬挂着。

censor.t:
v. 审查并删改
n. 审查员

e.en: The platform will {censor} posts that incite violence.
e.zh: 该平台会审查并删除煽动暴力的帖子。

e.en: A government {censor} reviewed every line of the script.
e.zh: 一名政府审查员审阅了剧本的每一行。

e.en: Several scenes were {censored} before the film aired on TV.
e.zh: 该片在电视播出前有几个场景被删剪了。

e.en: Her social media post was {censored} for political content.
e.zh: 她的社交媒体帖子因政治内容而被审查删除。

e.en: Critics accused the network of {censoring} dissenting voices.
e.zh: 批评者指责电视台审查删除异见声音。

e.en: The app stopped {censoring} mild profanity in user comments.
e.zh: 该应用不再审查用户评论中较轻微的脏话。

e.en: Her {censorious} tone made everyone at dinner uncomfortable.
e.zh: 她那种挑剔指责的语气让晚餐桌上的人都很不自在。

e.en: He gave the rough draft a {censorious} read-through.
e.zh: 他用挑剔批判的眼光通读了草稿。

censorship.t: n. 审查制度；言论审查

e.en: Journalists protested the new wave of internet {censorship}.
e.zh: 记者们抗议新一轮的网络审查。

e.en: Strict {censorship} kept the documentary off local screens.
e.zh: 严格的审查让这部纪录片无法在本地上映。

censure.t: v./n. 严厉批评；官方谴责

e.en: The senator faced public {censure} for his comments.
e.zh: 那位参议员因其言论受到公开谴责。

e.en: The board voted to {censure} the executive for misconduct.
e.zh: 董事会投票决定就不当行为谴责那位高管。

census.t: n. 人口普查；统计调查

e.en: The national {census} happens once every ten years.
e.zh: 全国人口普查每十年进行一次。

e.en: Researchers analyzed the latest {census} data on housing.
e.zh: 研究人员分析了最新的人口普查住房数据。

e.en: This app didn't cost me a single {cent} to install.
e.zh: 这个应用安装时一分钱都没花我。

e.en: He picked up a shiny {cent} from the sidewalk.
e.zh: 他从人行道上捡起一枚闪亮的一分硬币。

e.en: In the myth, a {centaur} taught the young hero archery.
e.zh: 在神话里,一个半人马教那位少年英雄射箭。

e.en: The fantasy game lets you play as a {centaur} ranger.
e.zh: 这款奇幻游戏允许你扮演一名半人马游侠。

e.en: The {centenarian} celebrated her birthday with the whole village.
e.zh: 这位百岁老人和全村人一起庆祝了生日。

e.en: Doctors studied the {centenarian} to learn about healthy aging.
e.zh: 医生研究这位百岁老人以了解健康长寿的秘诀。

e.en: The school marked its {centenary} with a grand reunion.
e.zh: 学校以一场盛大的校友聚会庆祝百年校庆。

e.en: A special stamp was issued for the company's {centenary}.
e.zh: 为庆祝公司成立一百周年发行了一枚特别邮票。

e.en: The city hosted a {centennial} parade down Main Street.
e.zh: 市里在主街举办了百年庆典游行。

e.en: This park was built for the nation's {centennial} in 1876.
e.zh: 这座公园是为1876年国家百年庆典而建的。

center.t:
n. 中心；中央
v. 居中对齐

e.en: The cafe sits right in the {center} of town.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆就位于市中心。

e.en: Please {center} the logo on the homepage.
e.zh: 请把标志在首页上居中对齐。

e.en: Lower the {centerboard} before sailing into deeper water.
e.zh: 驶入深水前先把中插板放下。

e.en: The small dinghy uses a {centerboard} for stability.
e.zh: 这艘小帆船靠中插板保持稳定。

centered.t: adj. 居中的；以…为核心的

e.en: The headline is {centered} above the article.
e.zh: 标题居中显示在文章上方。

e.en: She felt calm and {centered} after meditating.
e.zh: 冥想之后她感到平静而专注。

e.en: He hit a long fly ball to {centerfield}.
e.zh: 他把球击成一记飞向中外野的高飞球。

e.en: The rookie plays {centerfield} for the home team.
e.zh: 那位新秀为主队担任中外野手。

centerfold.t: n. 杂志中央跨页插图

e.en: The magazine's {centerfold} featured the new sports car.
e.zh: 杂志的跨页大图展示了那款新跑车。

e.en: She kept the band's poster {centerfold} on her wall.
e.zh: 她把乐队的跨页海报贴在墙上。

e.en: He spent ages {centering} the title on the slide.
e.zh: 他花了好久把幻灯片上的标题居中。

e.en: The yoga teacher recommends {centering} breaths before class.
e.zh: 瑜伽老师建议课前做几次定心呼吸。

e.en: Do not cross the {centerline} on a blind curve.
e.zh: 在盲弯处不要越过道路中线。

e.en: The referee dropped the puck on the {centerline}.
e.zh: 裁判在中线处把冰球扔下开赛。

centerpiece.t: n. 核心；餐桌中央摆件

e.en: A vase of roses served as the dinner {centerpiece}.
e.zh: 一瓶玫瑰作为晚宴桌上的中心摆件。

e.en: This feature is the {centerpiece} of our new app.
e.zh: 这个功能是我们新应用的核心亮点。

centers.t:
n. 中心（复数）
v. 居中

e.en: The city has three new community {centers} this year.
e.zh: 今年市里新增了三个社区中心。

e.en: Her research {centers} on climate change in coastal towns.
e.zh: 她的研究聚焦于沿海城镇的气候变化。

e.en: He poured milk over his {cereal} for breakfast.
e.zh: 他把牛奶倒在麦片上当早餐。

e.en: Wheat is the most widely grown {cereal} crop.
e.zh: 小麦是种植最广泛的谷物作物。

e.en: The supermarket aisle stocked dozens of breakfast {cereals}.
e.zh: 超市货架上摆着几十种早餐麦片。

e.en: Farmers in this region grow various {cereals} like rye and barley.
e.zh: 这个地区的农民种植黑麦和大麦等多种谷物。

e.en: The patient showed signs of {cerebellar} damage after the stroke.
e.zh: 中风后这位病人出现了小脑损伤的迹象。

e.en: {Cerebellar} function affects balance and coordination.
e.zh: 小脑功能影响平衡和协调能力。

e.en: The MRI revealed a tumor in the {cerebellopontine} angle.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示小脑桥脑角处有一个肿瘤。

e.en: Surgery in the {cerebellopontine} region requires extreme precision.
e.zh: 小脑桥脑区域的手术需要极高的精度。

e.en: The {cerebellum} is responsible for coordinating voluntary movements.
e.zh: 小脑负责协调随意运动。

e.en: Damage to the {cerebellum} can impair walking and balance.
e.zh: 小脑受损会影响行走和平衡能力。

e.en: His novels are highly {cerebral} and demand careful reading.
e.zh: 他的小说非常理性,需要仔细阅读。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed a mild {cerebral} hemorrhage.
e.zh: 医生诊断为轻度脑出血。

e.en: Doctors tested the {cerebrospinal} fluid for signs of infection.
e.zh: 医生检查脑脊液以查找感染迹象。

e.en: A lumbar puncture extracts {cerebrospinal} fluid for analysis.
e.zh: 腰椎穿刺可抽取脑脊液进行分析。

e.en: High blood pressure increases the risk of {cerebrovascular} disease.
e.zh: 高血压会增加患脑血管疾病的风险。

e.en: The hospital opened a new {cerebrovascular} treatment center.
e.zh: 医院开设了一个新的脑血管治疗中心。

e.en: The {cerebrum} controls thinking, memory, and voluntary actions.
e.zh: 大脑控制思维、记忆和随意活动。

e.en: Folds in the {cerebrum} increase its surface area.
e.zh: 大脑的褶皱增加了它的表面积。

ceremonial.t:
adj. 仪式的；礼仪的
n. 礼仪

e.en: The general wore his full {ceremonial} uniform to the parade.
e.zh: 将军穿着全套礼服参加阅兵。

e.en: Tea drinking has deep {ceremonial} significance in Japan.
e.zh: 在日本,饮茶有深厚的仪式意义。

ceremonially.t: adv. 礼仪上地；仪式上地

e.en: The mayor {ceremonially} cut the ribbon to open the bridge.
e.zh: 市长按照仪式剪彩,宣布大桥通车。

e.en: The flag was {ceremonially} lowered at sunset.
e.zh: 国旗在日落时按仪式徐徐降下。

e.en: The Olympic opening {ceremonies} drew millions of viewers.
e.zh: 奥运会开幕式吸引了数百万观众。

e.en: Graduation {ceremonies} were postponed due to bad weather.
e.zh: 毕业典礼因天气恶劣而推迟。

ceremonious.t: adj. 隆重的；讲究礼节的

e.en: He gave a {ceremonious} bow before leaving the room.
e.zh: 他离开房间前郑重地鞠了一躬。

e.en: The reception was a {ceremonious} affair with formal speeches.
e.zh: 招待会是一场隆重的活动,有正式的致辞。

ceremoniously.t: adv. 隆重地；郑重其事地

e.en: The trophy was {ceremoniously} handed to the winning captain.
e.zh: 奖杯被隆重地颁给了获胜队的队长。

e.en: She {ceremoniously} placed the cake at the table's center.
e.zh: 她郑重其事地把蛋糕摆在桌子正中央。

e.en: The wedding {ceremony} took place in a small chapel.
e.zh: 婚礼在一座小教堂举行。

e.en: He greeted the guests without much {ceremony}.
e.zh: 他没有太多客套就迎接了客人。

ceres.t: n. 谷神星；（罗马神话）谷物女神

e.en: The dwarf planet {Ceres} lies in the asteroid belt.
e.zh: 矮行星谷神星位于小行星带中。

e.en: Roman farmers prayed to {Ceres} for a good harvest.
e.zh: 罗马农民向谷物女神刻瑞斯祈求丰收。

cereus.t: n. 仙人柱；大戟柱（植物）

e.en: The night-blooming {cereus} opens its flowers only after dark.
e.zh: 夜昙仅在天黑后才会开花。

e.en: A tall {cereus} cactus stood beside the desert path.
e.zh: 一棵高大的仙人柱伫立在沙漠小径旁。

cerise.t:
n. 樱桃红色
adj. 樱桃红的

e.en: She wore a stunning {cerise} dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一条惊艳的樱桃红连衣裙出席晚会。

e.en: The designer paired {cerise} accents with neutral grey tones.
e.zh: 设计师把樱桃红点缀色与中性灰色调搭配在一起。

cern.t: n. 欧洲核子研究组织（缩写）

e.en: Physicists at {CERN} discovered the Higgs boson in 2012.
e.zh: 欧洲核子研究中心的物理学家于 2012 年发现了希格斯玻色子。

e.en: She landed an internship at {CERN} after graduation.
e.zh: 毕业后她在欧洲核子研究中心获得了一份实习。

e.en: The server requires a valid SSL {cert} to accept connections.
e.zh: 服务器需要有效的 SSL 证书才能接受连接。

e.en: He just earned his AWS {cert} after months of study.
e.zh: 他经过几个月的学习刚拿到 AWS 认证。

e.en: I'm {certain} I locked the door before leaving.
e.zh: 我确定离开前锁了门。

e.en: {Certain} foods can trigger allergic reactions in children.
e.zh: 某些食物可能引发儿童的过敏反应。

e.en: I will {certainly} attend your birthday party next week.
e.zh: 我下周一定会参加你的生日派对。

e.en: That movie was {certainly} better than I expected.
e.zh: 那部电影确实比我预期的要好。

certainties.t: n. 确定的事；必然之事（复数）

e.en: Death and taxes are the only true {certainties} in life.
e.zh: 死亡和税收是人生中仅有的两件确定的事。

e.en: Modern science offers fewer absolute {certainties} than people assume.
e.zh: 现代科学提供的绝对确定性比人们以为的要少。

e.en: No one can predict the future with complete {certainty}.
e.zh: 没有人能完全确定地预测未来。

e.en: She spoke with the {certainty} of an experienced lawyer.
e.zh: 她说话带着资深律师般的笃定。

certifiable.t: adj. 可认证的；可证明的

e.en: His behavior at the meeting was honestly {certifiable}.
e.zh: 他在会议上的举动说实话简直是疯了。

e.en: Only a {certifiable} expert can sign these inspection reports.
e.zh: 只有具备资质的专家才能签署这些检验报告。

e.en: The diamond is {certifiably} conflict-free, with documentation included.
e.zh: 这颗钻石经过认证,确实无冲突,并附有相关证明。

e.en: Driving in that storm would be {certifiably} insane.
e.zh: 在那种暴风雨里开车简直是疯了。

certificate.t:
n. 证书；凭证
v. 颁发证书

e.en: She framed her teaching {certificate} and hung it proudly.
e.zh: 她把教师证书裱起来,自豪地挂在墙上。

e.en: You'll need a birth {certificate} to apply for a passport.
e.zh: 申请护照需要出生证明。

e.en: All instructors must be fully {certificated} before teaching students.
e.zh: 所有教练必须取得完整资质后才能授课。

e.en: The school hires only {certificated} teachers for core subjects.
e.zh: 学校只聘用持证教师担任主科教学。

e.en: Browsers warn users when SSL {certificates} have expired.
e.zh: 当 SSL 证书过期时,浏览器会向用户发出警告。

e.en: She framed all her diving {certificates} on the office wall.
e.zh: 她把所有潜水证书都裱起来挂在办公室墙上。

e.en: He earned his project management {certification} after intensive study.
e.zh: 他经过密集学习取得了项目管理认证。

e.en: The factory received {certification} for its safety standards.
e.zh: 这家工厂的安全标准获得了认证。

e.en: Her resume lists several cloud computing {certifications}.
e.zh: 她的简历上列出了几项云计算认证。

e.en: Many tech jobs now require multiple industry {certifications}.
e.zh: 现在许多科技岗位都要求持有多项行业认证。

e.en: She is a {certified} financial planner with twenty years' experience.
e.zh: 她是一位有二十年经验的注册理财规划师。

e.en: The mechanic is {certified} to work on electric vehicles.
e.zh: 这位技师有资质维修电动汽车。

certifies.t: v. 证明；认证（第三人称单数）

e.en: This document {certifies} that the building meets all safety codes.
e.zh: 本文件证明该建筑符合所有安全规范。

e.en: The board {certifies} only schools that pass rigorous review.
e.zh: 委员会只认证通过严格审查的学校。

e.en: Inspectors must {certify} the elevator before public use.
e.zh: 电梯须经检验员认证后方可对外使用。

e.en: Only a doctor can {certify} that you're fit to dive.
e.zh: 只有医生才能证明你身体状况适合潜水。

e.en: The agency is {certifying} new electric car models this month.
e.zh: 该机构本月正在对新款电动汽车进行认证。

e.en: He signed a letter {certifying} the document's authenticity.
e.zh: 他签署了一封证明该文件真实性的信函。

e.en: The Supreme Court granted a writ of {certiorari} in the case.
e.zh: 最高法院在该案中签发了调卷令。

e.en: His petition for {certiorari} was denied without comment.
e.zh: 他的调卷复审请愿被无评论地驳回。

e.en: He spoke about the future with surprising {certitude}.
e.zh: 他谈论未来时表现出惊人的笃定。

e.en: Scientific progress often dissolves old {certitude} about the world.
e.zh: 科学的进步常常消解人们对世界旧有的确信。

cerulean.t:
adj. 天蓝色的
n. 天蓝色

e.en: The {cerulean} sky stretched endlessly over the ocean.
e.zh: 蔚蓝的天空在海面上无尽延展。

e.en: She painted the bedroom walls a calming {cerulean} blue.
e.zh: 她把卧室的墙刷成令人平静的蔚蓝色。

e.en: The doctor removed the {cerumen} blocking my ear canal.
e.zh: 医生清除了堵塞我耳道的耳垢。

e.en: Excessive {cerumen} can cause temporary hearing loss.
e.zh: 耳垢过多可能导致暂时性听力下降。

cervantes.t: n. 塞万提斯（西班牙作家）

e.en: {Cervantes} wrote Don Quixote in the early 1600s.
e.zh: 塞万提斯在十七世纪初写下了《堂吉诃德》。

e.en: Spanish literature class always begins with {Cervantes}.
e.zh: 西班牙文学课总是从塞万提斯讲起。

e.en: She had a {cervical} cancer screening last week.
e.zh: 她上周做了宫颈癌筛查。

e.en: He wore a {cervical} collar after the car accident.
e.zh: 车祸后他戴上了颈托。

e.en: The doctor examined her {cervix} during the routine checkup.
e.zh: 医生在例行检查时检查了她的子宫颈。

e.en: During labor, the {cervix} gradually dilates.
e.zh: 分娩时,子宫颈会逐渐扩张。

cesarean.t:
n. 剖腹产
adj. 剖腹产的

e.en: She delivered the twins by {cesarean} section.
e.zh: 她通过剖腹产生下了双胞胎。

e.en: The doctor recommended a {cesarean} due to complications.
e.zh: 由于并发症,医生建议剖腹产。

e.en: Atomic clocks rely on the vibrations of {cesium} atoms.
e.zh: 原子钟依靠铯原子的振动来计时。

e.en: {Cesium} reacts violently when it touches water.
e.zh: 铯接触到水时会发生剧烈反应。

cess.t: n. 税；运气（多用于爱尔兰）

e.en: The colonial government imposed a {cess} on every farmer.
e.zh: 殖民政府对每个农民征收附加税。

e.en: A small education {cess} is added to the income tax.
e.zh: 所得税中会附加一笔小额教育税。

e.en: Both sides agreed to a {cessation} of hostilities.
e.zh: 双方同意停止敌对行动。

e.en: Doctors advise immediate {cessation} of smoking.
e.zh: 医生建议立即停止吸烟。

e.en: The treaty included multiple {cessations} of military operations.
e.zh: 该条约包含多次军事行动的停止。

e.en: Brief {cessations} in the rain allowed us to keep working.
e.zh: 雨势的几次短暂停歇让我们得以继续工作。

e.en: The treaty required the {cession} of territory to the victor.
e.zh: 条约要求将领土割让给战胜方。

e.en: The {cession} of those islands ended the long dispute.
e.zh: 那些岛屿的割让结束了长期的争端。

cessna.t: n. 塞斯纳（小型飞机品牌）

e.en: He learned to fly in a small {Cessna} 172.
e.zh: 他在一架小型塞斯纳172上学会了飞行。

e.en: A {Cessna} circled above the lake before landing.
e.zh: 一架塞斯纳飞机在湖面上盘旋后降落。

e.en: The old farmhouse still drains into a {cesspit}.
e.zh: 那栋老农舍的污水仍排入一个化粪池。

e.en: Critics called the comment section a {cesspit} of hate.
e.zh: 评论家称评论区是充满仇恨的污水池。

cesspool.t: n. 污水池；藏污纳垢之所

e.en: The neglected pond had become a {cesspool} of algae.
e.zh: 那口被遗弃的池塘已变成一潭藻类污水。

e.en: He described the website as a {cesspool} of misinformation.
e.zh: 他把那个网站形容为虚假信息的污秽之地。

cetacean.t:
n. 鲸类动物
adj. 鲸类的

e.en: Whales and dolphins belong to the {cetacean} family.
e.zh: 鲸和海豚都属于鲸类家族。

e.en: Researchers tracked the {cetacean} migration across the Pacific.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了鲸类穿越太平洋的迁徙。

ceviche.t: n. 酸橘汁腌鱼（拉美料理）

e.en: We ordered fresh shrimp {ceviche} at the Peruvian restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在那家秘鲁餐厅点了新鲜的鲜虾酸橘汁腌鱼。

e.en: The lime juice slowly cooks the fish in {ceviche}.
e.zh: 酸橘汁腌鱼中,青柠汁会慢慢把鱼肉腌熟。

ceylon.t: n. 锡兰（斯里兰卡旧称）

e.en: She poured a strong cup of {Ceylon} tea.
e.zh: 她倒了一杯浓郁的锡兰红茶。

e.en: {Ceylon} was renamed Sri Lanka in 1972.
e.zh: 锡兰于1972年改名为斯里兰卡。

e.en: She passed all three levels of the {CFA} exam.
e.zh: 她通过了特许金融分析师考试的全部三级。
