e.en: Most equity analysts at the firm hold a {CFA} charter.
e.zh: 该公司大多数股票分析师都持有CFA特许证书。

cfc.t: abbr. 氟氯化碳（破坏臭氧层气体）

e.en: {CFC} emissions damaged the ozone layer for decades.
e.zh: 氟氯化碳的排放破坏了臭氧层数十年。

e.en: The Montreal Protocol banned most {CFC} compounds.
e.zh: 《蒙特利尔议定书》禁止了大多数氟氯化碳化合物。

e.en: He earned his {CFE} credential after years of fraud auditing.
e.zh: 经过多年反舞弊审计后,他获得了注册舞弊审查师资格。

e.en: The bank requires every investigator to be a {CFE}.
e.zh: 该银行要求每位调查员都必须是注册舞弊审查师。

cga.t: abbr. 彩色图形适配器（早期显卡标准）

e.en: Old DOS games still ran in chunky {CGA} graphics.
e.zh: 老旧的DOS游戏仍以粗糙的CGA图形运行。

e.en: The museum displayed a monitor showing classic {CGA} colors.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台显示经典CGA色彩的显示器。

cgi.t: abbr. 电脑生成影像；通用网关接口

e.en: The dragon was created entirely with {CGI}.
e.zh: 那条龙完全是用电脑特效制作的。

e.en: Modern blockbusters rely heavily on {CGI} effects.
e.zh: 现代大片严重依赖电脑特效。

cgmp.t: abbr. 现行药品生产质量管理规范

e.en: The factory must follow strict {cGMP} guidelines for drug production.
e.zh: 该工厂必须遵守严格的现行良好生产规范来生产药品。

e.en: Auditors verified that the plant met {cGMP} standards.
e.zh: 审计员核实该工厂符合现行良好生产规范。

e.en: Investors must pay {CGT} on profits from selling shares.
e.zh: 投资者卖出股票获利后必须缴纳资本利得税。

e.en: The budget proposed raising the {CGT} rate next year.
e.zh: 该预算案提议明年提高资本利得税税率。

e.en: She poured a hot cup of {cha} for the guests.
e.zh: 她为客人倒了一杯热茶。

e.en: In Hong Kong, locals often invite friends out for {cha}.
e.zh: 在香港,本地人常邀请朋友出去喝茶。

e.en: He paired the oysters with a crisp {Chablis}.
e.zh: 他用一瓶清爽的夏布利白葡萄酒搭配生蚝。

e.en: A bottle of {Chablis} chilled in the ice bucket.
e.zh: 一瓶夏布利酒在冰桶里冰镇着。

e.en: He flew to {Chad} to report on the refugee crisis.
e.zh: 他飞往乍得报道难民危机。

e.en: A hanging {chad} caused chaos in the 2000 election.
e.zh: 一个悬挂的选票碎屑在2000年大选中引发混乱。

chadian.t:
adj. 乍得的
n. 乍得人

e.en: The {Chadian} delegation arrived for the climate summit.
e.zh: 乍得代表团抵达参加气候峰会。

e.en: She studies {Chadian} folk music for her dissertation.
e.zh: 她为博士论文研究乍得民间音乐。

chador.t: n. 恰多尔（穆斯林妇女黑袍）

e.en: She wore a black {chador} as she entered the mosque.
e.zh: 她身着黑色长袍走进清真寺。

e.en: Many Iranian women still cover with a {chador} in public.
e.zh: 许多伊朗女性在公共场合仍披着黑袍。

chaebol.t: n. 财阀（韩国家族企业集团）

e.en: Samsung is the largest {chaebol} in South Korea.
e.zh: 三星是韩国最大的财阀。

e.en: The government tried to curb {chaebol} influence on politics.
e.zh: 政府试图抑制财阀对政治的影响力。

e.en: Tight collars often {chafe} the back of his neck.
e.zh: 紧领子常常会磨他的后颈。

e.en: Younger employees {chafe} under the strict dress code.
e.zh: 年轻员工对严格的着装规定感到不满。

chafed.t:
adj. 擦伤的
v. chafe 的过去式

e.en: Her wrists {chafed} from carrying the heavy bags.
e.zh: 她的手腕因为提重袋子而被磨破了。

e.en: He {chafed} at the constant micromanagement from his boss.
e.zh: 他对老板不断的微观管理感到烦躁。

chaff.t:
n. 谷壳；打趣
v. 开玩笑

e.en: Farmers separate the wheat from the {chaff} after harvest.
e.zh: 农民在收获后将麦粒与谷壳分开。

e.en: The interview helps us sort talent from {chaff}.
e.zh: 面试帮助我们从平庸者中筛出真正的人才。

e.en: A bright {chaffinch} landed on the garden feeder.
e.zh: 一只鲜艳的苍头燕雀落在花园喂食器上。

e.en: The {chaffinch} sang loudly from the top of the hedge.
e.zh: 那只苍头燕雀在树篱顶端大声歌唱。

chafing.t:
n. 摩擦、擦伤
v. chafe 的现在分词

e.en: Long runs left her thighs raw and {chafing}.
e.zh: 长跑让她的大腿磨得通红又火辣。

e.en: He was {chafing} at the slow pace of negotiations.
e.zh: 他对谈判的缓慢进度感到不耐烦。

e.en: To his {chagrin}, the audience laughed at his serious speech.
e.zh: 令他懊恼的是,观众对他严肃的演讲哈哈大笑。

e.en: She felt deep {chagrin} after forgetting her lines on stage.
e.zh: 在台上忘词后,她感到深深的懊恼。

e.en: He was {chagrined} to learn his proposal had been rejected.
e.zh: 得知提案被拒后,他感到非常懊恼。

e.en: She looked {chagrined} when the boss caught her napping.
e.zh: 老板抓到她打瞌睡时,她神情十分尴尬。

chain.t:
n. 链条；连锁
v. 用链锁住

e.en: He locked his bike to the rail with a heavy {chain}.
e.zh: 他用一条粗链子把自行车锁在栏杆上。

e.en: The coffee {chain} opened fifty new stores last year.
e.zh: 那家咖啡连锁店去年新开了五十家分店。

chained.t:
adj. 被锁住的
v. chain 的过去式

e.en: The dog was {chained} to a post in the yard.
e.zh: 那只狗被拴在院子里的一根柱子上。

e.en: She felt {chained} to her desk during exam season.
e.zh: 考试季她感觉自己被困在书桌前动弹不得。

chaining.t:
n. 链式调用；锁链
v. chain 的现在分词

e.en: JavaScript developers love {chaining} array methods together.
e.zh: JavaScript 开发者喜欢把数组方法链式调用在一起。

e.en: The protesters were {chaining} themselves to the gates.
e.zh: 抗议者正用链子把自己锁在大门上。

e.en: The prisoner's {chains} clanked as he walked down the hall.
e.zh: 囚犯走过走廊时,身上的镣铐叮当作响。

e.en: Major fast-food {chains} are expanding into smaller towns.
e.zh: 大型快餐连锁店正向小城镇扩张。

e.en: He used a {chainsaw} to cut down the dead oak.
e.zh: 他用电锯把那棵枯橡树砍倒。

e.en: The roar of a {chainsaw} echoed through the forest.
e.zh: 电锯的轰鸣声在森林里回荡。

chair.t:
n. 椅子；主席
v. 主持（会议）

e.en: Please pull up a {chair} and join the discussion.
e.zh: 请拉把椅子过来,加入讨论吧。

e.en: She will {chair} tomorrow's board meeting.
e.zh: 她将主持明天的董事会会议。

e.en: He {chaired} the committee for three consecutive years.
e.zh: 他连续三年担任该委员会的主席。

e.en: The senator {chaired} the hearing on internet privacy.
e.zh: 那位参议员主持了关于互联网隐私的听证会。

chairing.t: v. 主持（会议，现在分词）

e.en: She is {chairing} the panel on artificial intelligence ethics.
e.zh: 她正主持关于人工智能伦理的小组讨论。

e.en: He has experience {chairing} large international conferences.
e.zh: 他有主持大型国际会议的经验。

chairlift.t: n. 高山缆椅、吊椅索道

e.en: We rode the {chairlift} to the top of the ski slope.
e.zh: 我们乘坐缆椅来到滑雪坡的顶端。

e.en: The {chairlift} stopped briefly halfway up the mountain.
e.zh: 缆椅在半山腰处短暂停了一下。

e.en: The {chairman} opened the meeting with a brief speech.
e.zh: 董事长以简短的讲话宣布会议开始。

e.en: He served as {chairman} of the charity for ten years.
e.zh: 他担任该慈善机构主席长达十年。

e.en: Under her {chairmanship}, the company tripled its revenue.
e.zh: 在她担任主席期间,公司收入增长了两倍。

e.en: He resigned the {chairmanship} after the scandal broke.
e.zh: 丑闻爆出后,他辞去了主席职务。

e.en: The two {chairmen} signed the merger agreement on Friday.
e.zh: 两位董事长于周五签署了合并协议。

e.en: Past {chairmen} gathered for the company's centennial celebration.
e.zh: 历任董事长齐聚公司百年庆典。

e.en: The {chairperson} called the meeting to order at nine.
e.zh: 主席在九点宣布会议开始。

e.en: She was elected {chairperson} of the student council.
e.zh: 她当选为学生会主席。

chairs.t:
n. 椅子（复数）
v. 主持（三单）

e.en: We need ten more {chairs} for the workshop tomorrow.
e.zh: 明天的研讨会还需要再添十把椅子。

e.en: Professor Kim {chairs} the linguistics department this semester.
e.zh: 金教授本学期担任语言学系主任。

e.en: The {chairwoman} opened the meeting with a brief welcome speech.
e.zh: 女主席以简短的欢迎致辞开始了会议。

e.en: She was elected {chairwoman} of the school board last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天当选为校董事会的女主席。

chaise.t: n. 轻便马车；躺椅（chaise longue）

e.en: He napped on the {chaise} by the pool all afternoon.
e.zh: 他整个下午都在泳池边的躺椅上打盹。

e.en: A velvet {chaise} sat in the corner of the bedroom.
e.zh: 卧室角落里摆着一张丝绒躺椅。

chances.t:
n. 机会（复数）
n. 可能性

e.en: The {chances} of rain tomorrow are pretty high.
e.zh: 明天下雨的可能性相当大。

e.en: She took her {chances} and applied for the job.
e.zh: 她抓住机会申请了那份工作。

e.en: Investing in startups can be a {chancy} business.
e.zh: 投资初创公司是一项颇具风险的事。

e.en: Driving in this fog feels a bit {chancy}.
e.zh: 在这种雾里开车感觉有点冒险。

e.en: A crystal {chandelier} hung above the dining table.
e.zh: 一盏水晶吊灯悬挂在餐桌上方。

e.en: The hotel lobby features a massive gold {chandelier}.
e.zh: 酒店大堂里有一盏巨大的金色吊灯。

chandler.t: n. 蜡烛商；船舶杂货商

e.en: The ship's {chandler} supplied rope, sails, and food.
e.zh: 船舶用品商供应绳索、船帆和食物。

e.en: My grandfather was a {chandler} who made tallow candles.
e.zh: 我祖父是个制作牛脂蜡烛的工匠。

chandon.t: n. 香东（酩悦香槟品牌）

e.en: They toasted the wedding with a bottle of {Chandon}.
e.zh: 他们用一瓶香桐起泡酒为婚礼干杯。

e.en: Moët & {Chandon} is a famous French champagne house.
e.zh: 酩悦香桐是著名的法国香槟酒庄。

e.en: The Duke of {Chandos} commissioned music from Handel.
e.zh: 钱多斯公爵曾委托亨德尔创作音乐。

e.en: Handel composed the {Chandos} Anthems in the early 1700s.
e.zh: 亨德尔在十八世纪初创作了钱多斯赞美诗。

e.en: She bought a classic {Chanel} handbag in Paris.
e.zh: 她在巴黎买了一只经典的香奈儿手袋。

e.en: Coco {Chanel} revolutionized women's fashion in the 1920s.
e.zh: 可可·香奈儿在二十年代彻底改变了女装。

e.en: Mr. {Chang} runs the noodle shop on the corner.
e.zh: 张先生经营着街角那家面馆。

e.en: Jackie {Chang} performed all his own stunts in the film.
e.zh: 成龙在那部电影里亲自完成所有特技。

change.t:
v. 改变；更换
n. 变化；零钱

e.en: You need to {change} your password every three months.
e.zh: 你每三个月需要更换一次密码。

e.en: The cashier handed me my {change} and a receipt.
e.zh: 收银员把找零和收据递给了我。

e.en: The {changeability} of the weather makes packing difficult.
e.zh: 天气的多变让收拾行李变得困难。

e.en: Teenagers are often known for their emotional {changeability}.
e.zh: 青少年常以情绪多变而著称。

e.en: Spring weather in London is famously {changeable}.
e.zh: 伦敦的春季天气以多变闻名。

e.en: Her moods are {changeable}, so be patient with her.
e.zh: 她情绪起伏不定,请对她耐心一些。

changed.t:
adj. 改变了的
v. change 的过去式

e.en: The internet has completely {changed} how we shop.
e.zh: 互联网彻底改变了我们购物的方式。

e.en: She {changed} into pajamas right after dinner.
e.zh: 她吃完晚饭就换上了睡衣。

e.en: The mountains seem {changeless} against the shifting seasons.
e.zh: 群山在四季变换中显得亘古不变。

e.en: His devotion to his family remained {changeless} throughout life.
e.zh: 他对家人的深情一生从未改变。

changeling.t: n. 被偷换的孩子（传说中仙灵留下的替身）

e.en: Folklore says fairies left a {changeling} in the cradle.
e.zh: 民间传说仙灵在摇篮里留下了一个调包儿。

e.en: The novel features a {changeling} raised by humans.
e.zh: 小说讲述了一个被人类抚养长大的换生灵。

changeover.t: n. 转换；改变（制度、系统）

e.en: The factory's {changeover} to electric vehicles took two years.
e.zh: 工厂转型生产电动汽车花了两年时间。

e.en: There was a smooth {changeover} between the two managers.
e.zh: 两位经理之间的交接非常顺利。

e.en: This new app is a real game {changer} for freelancers.
e.zh: 这款新应用对自由职业者来说真是颠覆性的。

e.en: The CD {changer} could hold six discs at once.
e.zh: 那台CD换碟机可以同时装入六张碟。

changes.t:
n. 变化（复数）
v. change 的第三人称单数

e.en: The team {changes} its strategy after every loss.
e.zh: 球队每次失利后都会调整战术。

e.en: Several {changes} were made to the original draft.
e.zh: 原稿做了几处修改。

changing.t:
v. 正在改变
adj. 变化中的

e.en: The world is {changing} faster than ever before.
e.zh: 世界正以前所未有的速度变化着。

e.en: She is {changing} clothes in the fitting room.
e.zh: 她正在试衣间换衣服。

channel.t:
n. 频道；渠道
v. 引导；传送

e.en: Please subscribe to my YouTube {channel} for weekly videos.
e.zh: 请订阅我的YouTube频道,每周更新视频。

e.en: Ships cross the English {channel} every few minutes.
e.zh: 船只每隔几分钟就会穿越英吉利海峡。

channeled.t: v. channel 的过去式（引导、传送）

e.en: She {channeled} her grief into writing a memoir.
e.zh: 她将悲伤化作动力,写成了一部回忆录。

e.en: Funds were {channeled} directly to local charities.
e.zh: 资金被直接拨付给了当地慈善机构。

e.en: The TV {channeler} stopped working after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后电视的换台器就坏了。

e.en: She claimed to be a spiritual {channeler} for ancient souls.
e.zh: 她自称是为古老灵魂传话的通灵者。

channeling.t:
v. 引导；传送
n. 通灵

e.en: He's {channeling} his frustration into a productive workout.
e.zh: 他把挫败感转化为高效的锻炼。

e.en: The actress is clearly {channeling} Audrey Hepburn's style.
e.zh: 那位女演员显然在演绎奥黛丽·赫本的风格。

e.en: River {channelization} often damages local fish habitats.
e.zh: 河道渠化常常破坏当地鱼类的栖息地。

e.en: The city approved {channelization} of the flood-prone creek.
e.zh: 市政府批准对易涝小溪进行渠化整治。

channelled.t: v. channel 过去式（英式拼法）

e.en: She {channelled} all her energy into the new project.
e.zh: 她把全部精力都投入到了新项目上。

e.en: Donations were {channelled} through a registered nonprofit.
e.zh: 捐款是通过一家注册的非营利机构发放的。

channelling.t: v. 引导；传送（英式拼法）

e.en: He's {channelling} his inner rockstar on stage tonight.
e.zh: 他今晚在台上释放着内心的摇滚巨星气质。

e.en: The aid agency is {channelling} supplies to the disaster zone.
e.zh: 救援机构正在向灾区调配物资。

e.en: My TV gets over five hundred {channels} now.
e.zh: 我家电视现在能收到五百多个频道。

e.en: Please use official {channels} to file your complaint.
e.zh: 请通过官方渠道提交投诉。

e.en: Edith Piaf made the French {chanson} famous worldwide.
e.zh: 伊迪丝·琵雅芙让法国香颂闻名世界。

e.en: He sang an old {chanson} at the café.
e.zh: 他在咖啡馆里唱了一首古老的法语歌。

chant.t:
v. 吟唱；反复高呼
n. 赞美诗

e.en: Fans began to {chant} the player's name in unison.
e.zh: 球迷们齐声高呼那位球员的名字。

e.en: The monks' morning {chant} echoed through the temple.
e.zh: 僧侣晨间的诵经声在寺庙中回荡。

e.en: The lead {chanter} guided the choir through the hymn.
e.zh: 领唱者带领合唱团完成了那首赞美诗。

e.en: The bagpipe's {chanter} produces the main melody.
e.zh: 风笛的旋律管负责发出主旋律。

e.en: We found a basket of {chanterelle} mushrooms in the woods.
e.zh: 我们在树林里采到了一篮鸡油菌。

e.en: The risotto was topped with sautéed {chanterelle} mushrooms.
e.zh: 那道意式烩饭上面铺着炒过的鸡油菌。

chanteuse.t: n. 女歌手（尤指夜总会）

e.en: The {chanteuse} captivated the audience with her smoky voice.
e.zh: 那位女歌手用低沉嗓音迷住了观众。

e.en: She became a famous jazz {chanteuse} in 1950s Paris.
e.zh: 她成了五十年代巴黎著名的爵士女伶。

e.en: Sailors sang a {chantey} while hauling the heavy ropes.
e.zh: 水手们一边拉着粗绳一边唱起劳动号子。

e.en: That old sea {chantey} dates back to the 1800s.
e.zh: 那首古老的海上号子可以追溯到十九世纪。

chantilly.t: n. 尚蒂伊（法国地名；蕾丝/奶油）

e.en: The cake was topped with sweet {chantilly} cream.
e.zh: 蛋糕上铺着香甜的香缇奶油。

e.en: Her wedding dress featured delicate {chantilly} lace.
e.zh: 她的婚纱采用了精致的尚蒂伊蕾丝。

chanting.t:
v. 吟唱；齐声高呼
n. 颂唱

e.en: The crowd was {chanting} slogans outside the parliament.
e.zh: 人群在议会外高呼口号。

e.en: Buddhist {chanting} filled the temple at dawn.
e.zh: 清晨的寺院里回荡着诵经声。

chantry.t: n. 附属小教堂；诵经堂

e.en: The medieval {chantry} chapel still stands beside the cathedral.
e.zh: 那座中世纪的祈祷堂至今仍立在大教堂旁。

e.en: He left money to fund a {chantry} for his soul.
e.zh: 他留下钱财,为自己的灵魂设立祈祷堂。

e.en: My friend {Chao} just moved to Shanghai for work.
e.zh: 我朋友小超刚因工作搬到了上海。

e.en: In Italian, people say '{chao}' to mean goodbye.
e.zh: 在意大利语里,人们用'chao'来道别。

e.en: The kitchen was in complete {chaos} after the party.
e.zh: 派对结束后厨房一片狼藉。

e.en: Heavy snow caused {chaos} on the highways yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天的大雪让高速公路陷入混乱。

e.en: My morning routine is usually pretty {chaotic} with three kids.
e.zh: 带着三个孩子,我早上通常都手忙脚乱。

e.en: The startup's first year was exciting but {chaotic}.
e.zh: 那家初创公司的第一年既刺激又混乱。

e.en: Papers were scattered {chaotically} across the office floor.
e.zh: 文件杂乱无章地散落在办公室地板上。

e.en: Traffic moved {chaotically} during the evening rush hour.
e.zh: 晚高峰时车流毫无秩序地涌动着。

chap.t:
n. 家伙；小伙子
v. (皮肤) 皲裂

e.en: He's a friendly {chap} who always helps the neighbors.
e.zh: 他是个友善的家伙,总是乐于帮助邻居。

e.en: Cold wind can really {chap} your lips in winter.
e.zh: 冬天的冷风真的会让嘴唇皲裂。

chaparral.t: n. 矮灌木丛林（美国西部）

e.en: Coyotes often hide in the dense California {chaparral}.
e.zh: 郊狼常常藏身于加州茂密的灌木丛中。

e.en: Wildfires spread quickly through the dry {chaparral}.
e.zh: 野火在干燥的灌木丛中迅速蔓延。

e.en: She served curry with warm, freshly-made {chapati}.
e.zh: 她端上咖喱,配着刚做好的热薄饼。

e.en: Indian families often eat {chapati} with every meal.
e.zh: 印度家庭几乎每顿饭都会吃薄饼。

chapbook.t: n. 廉价小册子；短篇文集

e.en: The poet self-published a small {chapbook} of love poems.
e.zh: 那位诗人自费出版了一本爱情诗小册子。

e.en: Eighteenth-century street vendors sold cheap {chapbook} editions.
e.zh: 十八世纪的街头小贩兜售廉价的小册子读物。

e.en: She wore a stylish {chapeau} to the garden party.
e.zh: 她戴着一顶时髦的帽子去参加花园派对。

e.en: {Chapeau} to the chef for that incredible dessert!
e.zh: 为那位厨师的精彩甜点脱帽致敬!

e.en: The couple got married in a tiny country {chapel}.
e.zh: 那对新人在一座乡村小教堂里举行了婚礼。

e.en: The college {chapel} holds services every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 学院礼拜堂每周日早上都举行礼拜。

e.en: Sainte-{Chapelle} in Paris is famous for its stained glass.
e.zh: 巴黎的圣礼拜堂以彩色玻璃窗闻名。

e.en: Dave {Chapelle} is one of America's best-known comedians.
e.zh: 戴夫·查普尔是美国最知名的喜剧演员之一。

e.en: {Chapeltown} is a diverse neighborhood in north Leeds.
e.zh: 查普尔敦是利兹北部一个多元文化的社区。

e.en: She grew up in {Chapeltown} during the 1980s.
e.zh: 她于八十年代在查普尔敦长大。

chaperon.t:
n. 陪护人
v. 陪同照顾

e.en: A teacher will {chaperon} the students on the trip.
e.zh: 一位老师将陪同学生们参加这次旅行。

e.en: Her aunt acted as {chaperon} at the dance.
e.zh: 她姨妈在舞会上担任陪护。

chaperone.t:
n. (女性) 陪护人
v. 陪同照看

e.en: My mom volunteered to {chaperone} the school dance.
e.zh: 我妈妈主动报名当学校舞会的陪护。

e.en: Each tour group has an adult {chaperone} for safety.
e.zh: 为安全起见,每个旅行团都配有一名成人陪同。

chaplain.t: n. (学校、军队等的) 牧师

e.en: The army {chaplain} comforted soldiers before the long mission.
e.zh: 随军牧师在长途任务前安慰士兵。

e.en: She serves as the hospital {chaplain} on weekends.
e.zh: 她周末在医院担任牧师。

chaplaincy.t: n. 牧师的职位或任期

e.en: He accepted a {chaplaincy} role at the local university.
e.zh: 他接受了本地大学的牧师职位。

e.en: The {chaplaincy} offers counseling to students of all faiths.
e.zh: 牧师办公室为各种信仰的学生提供咨询。

e.en: Charlie {Chaplin} remains an icon of silent film comedy.
e.zh: 查理·卓别林至今仍是默片喜剧的标志人物。

e.en: The museum exhibits original costumes worn by {Chaplin}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了卓别林穿过的原版戏服。

e.en: His clumsy walk had a {Chaplinesque} charm to it.
e.zh: 他笨拙的步伐有一种卓别林式的魅力。

e.en: The film uses {Chaplinesque} humor to soften its sad theme.
e.zh: 这部电影用卓别林式的幽默来缓和悲伤的主题。

e.en: In old England, a {chapman} traveled village to village selling goods.
e.zh: 在旧时英格兰,小贩走村串户兜售商品。

e.en: Mr. {Chapman} runs the bakery on the corner.
e.zh: 查普曼先生经营着街角那家面包店。

chapped.t: adj. (皮肤) 皲裂的、干裂的

e.en: My lips get {chapped} every winter without lip balm.
e.zh: 冬天不涂润唇膏我的嘴唇就会干裂。

e.en: The cold wind left her hands red and {chapped}.
e.zh: 寒风让她的手又红又裂。

chappie.t: n. 家伙、小伙 (英式口语)

e.en: That young {chappie} at the counter was very polite.
e.zh: 柜台那个小伙子很有礼貌。

e.en: Some {chappie} from accounting called about the invoice.
e.zh: 会计部的一个家伙打来问发票的事。

e.en: He's a friendly {chappy} who always greets the neighbors.
e.zh: 他是个友善的家伙,总跟邻居打招呼。

e.en: The old {chappy} next door tells great war stories.
e.zh: 隔壁那位老先生很会讲战争故事。

e.en: I always keep a {chapstick} in my coat pocket.
e.zh: 我外套口袋里总放着一支润唇膏。

e.en: She borrowed my {chapstick} because her lips were dry.
e.zh: 她嘴唇干,就借了我的润唇膏。

chapter.t:
n. 章、章节
n. (组织的) 分会

e.en: I finished the last {chapter} of the novel last night.
e.zh: 我昨晚读完了小说的最后一章。

e.en: Moving abroad opened a new {chapter} in her life.
e.zh: 出国生活为她的人生开启了新篇章。

e.en: The book has twelve {chapters} and a short epilogue.
e.zh: 这本书有十二章和一个简短的尾声。

e.en: Local {chapters} of the club meet every Thursday.
e.zh: 该俱乐部的各地分会每周四聚会。

char.t:
n. 字符 (character 的缩写)
v. 烧焦

e.en: Don't {char} the steak; just sear it lightly.
e.zh: 别把牛排烤焦,只要稍微煎一下。

e.en: The fire left a deep {char} on the wooden beam.
e.zh: 火灾在木梁上留下了厚厚一层焦痕。

charabanc.t: n. 旧式长途观光大巴

e.en: Grandma remembers riding a {charabanc} to the seaside as a child.
e.zh: 奶奶记得小时候坐大客车去海边玩。

e.en: An old {charabanc} carried tourists through the country lanes.
e.zh: 一辆老式观光大巴载着游客穿过乡间小路。

character.t:
n. 角色；性格
n. 字符

e.en: My favorite {character} in the show is the grumpy chef.
e.zh: 我最喜欢剧里那个坏脾气的厨师角色。

e.en: Her honesty shows real strength of {character}.
e.zh: 她的诚实体现了真正的人格力量。

e.en: The old pub has a {characterful} wooden interior.
e.zh: 那家老酒馆的木质内饰很有特色。

e.en: She gave a {characterful} performance as the eccentric aunt.
e.zh: 她把那个古怪的姑妈演得非常有个性。

characterisation.t: n. 人物刻画；特征描述 (英式)

e.en: The novel's {characterisation} is vivid and emotionally complex.
e.zh: 这部小说的人物刻画生动且情感复杂。

e.en: Critics praised the {characterisation} of the lonely detective.
e.zh: 评论家称赞了那位孤独侦探的人物塑造。

characterisations.t: n. 人物刻画 (复数，英式)

e.en: Her {characterisations} of historical figures feel remarkably real.
e.zh: 她对历史人物的刻画显得格外真实。

e.en: The film's {characterisations} avoid lazy stereotypes.
e.zh: 这部电影的人物塑造避免了懒惰的刻板印象。

characterise.t: v. 描述…的特征；成为…的特点 (英式)

e.en: How would you {characterise} the team's performance this season?
e.zh: 你会如何评价球队本赛季的表现?

e.en: Long silences {characterise} the early scenes of the film.
e.zh: 长时间的沉默是影片开场的特点。

characterised.t: v. characterise 的过去式/过去分词

e.en: His leadership is {characterised} by patience and clear thinking.
e.zh: 他的领导风格以耐心和清晰思维著称。

e.en: The era was {characterised} by rapid technological change.
e.zh: 那个时代以技术的快速变革为特征。

characterises.t: v. characterise 的第三人称单数

e.en: Bold experimentation {characterises} her latest album.
e.zh: 大胆的实验是她最新专辑的特色。

e.en: What {characterises} a good leader in a crisis?
e.zh: 在危机中,优秀领导者有哪些特质?

e.en: The article spends pages {characterising} the small town's residents.
e.zh: 这篇文章用了好几页来刻画这个小镇居民。

e.en: She's good at {characterising} complex feelings in simple words.
e.zh: 她擅长用简单的语言描述复杂的情感。

characteristic.t:
n. 特征、特点
adj. 典型的、特有的

e.en: Sharp wit is a {characteristic} of her writing.
e.zh: 机智犀利是她写作的一大特点。

e.en: He answered with his {characteristic} calm smile.
e.zh: 他露出一贯特有的平静微笑回答。

characteristically.t: adv. 一如既往地；典型地

e.en: She {characteristically} arrived ten minutes early to the meeting.
e.zh: 她一如既往地提前十分钟到达会议。

e.en: The chef {characteristically} adds a pinch of cinnamon.
e.zh: 这位厨师习惯性地加一小撮肉桂。

e.en: This breed has several distinctive physical {characteristics}.
e.zh: 这个品种有几个独特的外形特征。

e.en: The app analyzes the {characteristics} of each user's voice.
e.zh: 该应用会分析每位用户声音的特征。

characterization.t: n. 人物刻画；特征描述

e.en: The movie's weak {characterization} made it hard to care.
e.zh: 这部电影人物塑造薄弱,让人难以投入。

e.en: His {characterization} of the proposal as reckless seems unfair.
e.zh: 他把这个提案说成轻率,似乎不太公平。

e.en: Her {characterizations} of villains are surprisingly sympathetic.
e.zh: 她对反派的塑造意外地令人同情。

e.en: Reviewers loved the nuanced {characterizations} in the show.
e.zh: 影评人喜欢剧中细腻的人物刻画。

characterize.t: v. 描述…的特征；成为…的特点

e.en: I'd {characterize} the meeting as productive but tense.
e.zh: 我会把这场会议形容为高效但紧张。

e.en: Three traits {characterize} most successful startups.
e.zh: 三个特质是大多数成功初创企业的共同点。

characterized.t: v. characterize 的过去式/过去分词

e.en: The debate was {characterized} by sharp personal attacks.
e.zh: 这场辩论以激烈的人身攻击为特点。

e.en: He's often {characterized} as stubborn, but he listens carefully.
e.zh: 人们常把他形容为固执,但他其实很会倾听。

characterizes.t: v. characterize 的第三人称单数

e.en: Quiet confidence {characterizes} her teaching style.
e.zh: 沉静的自信是她教学风格的特点。

e.en: What {characterizes} truly great customer service?
e.zh: 真正优秀的客户服务有哪些特征?

e.en: The journalist spent weeks {characterizing} the local protest movement.
e.zh: 这位记者花了数周来刻画当地的抗议运动。

e.en: Stop {characterizing} my idea as unrealistic without hearing it.
e.zh: 别没听完就把我的想法说成不切实际。

characterless.t: adj. 缺乏个性的、平淡的

e.en: The hotel room was clean but completely {characterless}.
e.zh: 酒店房间很干净,但毫无特色。

e.en: New suburban streets often feel bland and {characterless}.
e.zh: 新建的郊区街道常常显得平淡无奇。

characterological.t: adj. 性格学的、性格分析的

e.en: The therapist studies {characterological} patterns across her patients.
e.zh: 治疗师研究她病人身上的人格特征模式。

e.en: His failures stem from {characterological} flaws, not bad luck.
e.zh: 他的失败源于性格缺陷,而非运气不好。

e.en: This password must contain at least eight {characters}.
e.zh: 密码必须至少包含八个字符。

e.en: The novel introduces dozens of memorable {characters}.
e.zh: 这部小说引入了许多令人难忘的角色。

charade.t: n. 装模作样；明显的假象

e.en: Their friendly smiles were just a {charade} for the cameras.
e.zh: 他们友好的笑容只是在镜头前装样子。

e.en: I'm tired of pretending; this whole {charade} must end.
e.zh: 我厌倦了假装,这场闹剧必须结束。

e.en: We played {charades} at the party until midnight.
e.zh: 我们在派对上玩你画我猜玩到半夜。

e.en: Stop the {charades} and tell me what really happened.
e.zh: 别再演戏了,告诉我到底发生了什么。

e.en: He sketched her portrait quickly in {charcoal}.
e.zh: 他用炭笔很快画出了她的肖像。

e.en: Light the {charcoal} before placing the steaks on the grill.
e.zh: 在把牛排放上烤架前先把木炭点燃。

e.en: We ordered a {charcuterie} board with cheese and olives.
e.zh: 我们点了一份配芝士和橄榄的熟食拼盘。

e.en: The deli sells handmade {charcuterie} from local farms.
e.zh: 这家熟食店出售本地农场手工制作的腌肉。

e.en: Sauté the {chard} with garlic and a pinch of salt.
e.zh: 用大蒜和一小撮盐快炒甜菜叶。

e.en: Rainbow {chard} adds bright color to the salad.
e.zh: 彩虹甜菜为沙拉增添了鲜艳的色彩。

e.en: {Chardin} is famous for his quiet still-life paintings.
e.zh: 夏尔丹以其宁静的静物画闻名。

e.en: The museum displays a small {Chardin} near the entrance.
e.zh: 博物馆在入口附近展出了一幅夏尔丹的小画。

chardonnay.t: n. 霞多丽 (葡萄品种/白葡萄酒)

e.en: She poured a chilled glass of {chardonnay} before dinner.
e.zh: 她在晚餐前倒了一杯冰镇霞多丽。

e.en: This {chardonnay} pairs nicely with grilled chicken.
e.zh: 这款霞多丽很配烤鸡。

charge.t:
v./n. 收费；充电
n. 指控；冲锋

e.en: Don't forget to {charge} your phone before the trip.
e.zh: 出门前别忘了给手机充电。

e.en: The store will {charge} your card when the item ships.
e.zh: 商品发货时商店会从你卡上扣款。

chargeable.t: adj. 应收费的；可起诉的

e.en: All extra luggage is {chargeable} at the airport counter.
e.zh: 所有超重行李在机场柜台都需要另外收费。

e.en: Lawyers track every {chargeable} hour they spend on cases.
e.zh: 律师会记录每一个可计费的工作小时。

charged.t: adj. 已充电的；紧张激烈的

e.en: The atmosphere in the courtroom was emotionally {charged}.
e.zh: 法庭里的气氛充满了情绪张力。

e.en: I {charged} my laptop overnight before the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行前我给笔记本充了一整夜电。

chargee.t: n. 抵押权受让人 (法律)

e.en: The bank acts as {chargee} over the company's main assets.
e.zh: 该银行是公司主要资产的抵押权人。

e.en: Each {chargee} must register their interest with the registry.
e.zh: 每位抵押权人都必须向登记处登记其权益。

e.en: The {chargehand} assigned tasks to each worker on the line.
e.zh: 工长给生产线上的每位工人分配了任务。

e.en: As {chargehand}, she reports directly to the foreman.
e.zh: 作为工长,她直接向领班汇报。

chargepayer.t: n. 地方税缴纳人 (英式)

e.en: Every {chargepayer} in the district receives an annual statement.
e.zh: 该区每位纳费人每年都会收到一份账单。

e.en: The council reduced fees for low-income {chargepayer} households.
e.zh: 市议会为低收入纳费家庭减免了费用。

charger.t:
n. 充电器
n. 战马

e.en: I left my phone {charger} at the hotel by mistake.
e.zh: 我不小心把手机充电器落在酒店了。

e.en: This laptop {charger} works with most USB-C devices.
e.zh: 这个笔记本充电器适用于大多数 USB-C 设备。

chakra.t: n. 脉轮（瑜伽、能量中心）

e.en: The yoga teacher said this pose opens the heart {chakra}.
e.zh: 瑜伽老师说这个体式能打开心轮。

e.en: She believes meditation helps balance every {chakra} in the body.
e.zh: 她相信冥想有助于平衡身体的每个脉轮。

chalcedonian.t: adj. 迦克墩的（基督教会议相关）

e.en: The {Chalcedonian} creed defined Christ's two natures in 451 AD.
e.zh: 迦克墩信经于公元451年界定了基督的二性。

e.en: Most Western churches accept the {Chalcedonian} definition of faith.
e.zh: 大多数西方教会接受迦克墩信仰定义。

e.en: She wore a pendant carved from pale blue {chalcedony}.
e.zh: 她戴着一枚用淡蓝色玉髓雕刻的吊坠。

e.en: The jeweler showed me a smooth piece of polished {chalcedony}.
e.zh: 珠宝商给我看了一块光滑抛光的玉髓。

chaldean.t:
n. 迦勒底人
adj. 迦勒底的

e.en: Ancient {Chaldean} astronomers carefully tracked the movements of planets.
e.zh: 古代迦勒底天文学家仔细追踪行星的运行。

e.en: The museum displayed clay tablets from a {Chaldean} city.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了来自一座迦勒底城市的泥板。

chalet.t: n. 瑞士式木屋、度假小屋

e.en: We rented a cozy ski {chalet} in the Swiss Alps.
e.zh: 我们在瑞士阿尔卑斯山租了一间舒适的滑雪木屋。

e.en: Smoke rose from the wooden {chalet} tucked among pine trees.
e.zh: 炊烟从松林间那座木屋中升起。

e.en: They moved to {Chalfont} for its quiet village atmosphere.
e.zh: 他们搬到了查尔方特,因为那里村庄氛围宁静。

e.en: The train from London to {Chalfont} takes about an hour.
e.zh: 从伦敦到查尔方特的火车大约需要一小时。

e.en: The priest carefully lifted the silver {chalice} during the ceremony.
e.zh: 仪式中神父小心地举起那只银圣杯。

e.en: Legends speak of a sacred {chalice} hidden in an old castle.
e.zh: 传说有一只神圣的圣杯藏在一座古堡中。

chalk.t:
n. 粉笔、白垩
v. 用粉笔写

e.en: The teacher wrote the formula on the board with white {chalk}.
e.zh: 老师用白粉笔在黑板上写下公式。

e.en: Climbers rub {chalk} on their hands for a better grip.
e.zh: 攀岩者把镁粉抹在手上以增加抓握力。

e.en: The cafe lists daily specials on a small {chalkboard} outside.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆把每日特餐写在门外的小黑板上。

e.en: He erased the equations from the {chalkboard} before class ended.
e.zh: 下课前他把黑板上的方程式擦掉了。

chalker.t: n. 姓氏；划粉笔记号者

e.en: The carpenter handed the {chalker} a fresh line of string.
e.zh: 木匠把一根新的弹线绳递给了划线工。

e.en: As a {chalker}, he marked cutting lines on every plank.
e.zh: 作为划线工,他在每块木板上标出切割线。

e.en: The medicine left a {chalky} taste in my mouth.
e.zh: 那药在我嘴里留下一股粉末般的味道。

e.en: Her face looked pale and {chalky} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后她的脸色苍白如粉。

challah.t: n. 哈拉面包（犹太辫子面包）

e.en: My grandmother bakes a beautiful braided {challah} every Friday.
e.zh: 我奶奶每周五都会烤一个漂亮的辫子哈拉面包。

e.en: We tore pieces of warm {challah} and passed them around.
e.zh: 我们撕下温热的哈拉面包,一块块传着吃。

challenge.t:
n. 挑战、难题
v. 挑战、质疑

e.en: Learning a new language is a real {challenge} for adults.
e.zh: 对成年人来说,学一门新语言是个真正的挑战。

e.en: I {challenge} you to finish the puzzle in ten minutes.
e.zh: 我跟你打赌,你能在十分钟内完成这个拼图。

challenged.t:
adj. 受挑战的、有障碍的
v. challenge 的过去式

e.en: She {challenged} her boss's decision during the team meeting.
e.zh: 她在团队会议上对老板的决定提出了质疑。

e.en: The hike {challenged} even the most experienced climbers in our group.
e.zh: 这次徒步让我们队里最有经验的登山者也倍感吃力。

e.en: The young {challenger} knocked out the champion in round three.
e.zh: 年轻的挑战者在第三回合将冠军击倒。

e.en: A new {challenger} entered the market with cheaper electric cars.
e.zh: 一家新的挑战者带着更便宜的电动车进入了市场。

challenges.t:
n. 挑战（复数）
v. challenge 第三人称单数

e.en: Remote work brings unique {challenges} for new team members.
e.zh: 远程办公给新团队成员带来了独特的挑战。

e.en: She {challenges} every assumption her engineers make in design reviews.
e.zh: 在设计评审中,她质疑工程师们的每一个假设。

challenging.t: adj. 有挑战性的、棘手的

e.en: The exam was unexpectedly {challenging}, even for top students.
e.zh: 这次考试出乎意料地难,连尖子生也觉得吃力。

e.en: She enjoys {challenging} herself with longer runs every weekend.
e.zh: 她喜欢每个周末用更长距离的跑步挑战自己。

e.en: He stared {challengingly} at the referee after the controversial call.
e.zh: 那次争议判罚后,他挑衅地盯着裁判。

e.en: She raised an eyebrow {challengingly} and asked him to explain.
e.zh: 她挑衅地扬起眉毛,要求他解释清楚。

challis.t: n. 薄软毛料（一种面料）

e.en: She sewed a summer dress from soft floral {challis} fabric.
e.zh: 她用柔软的印花薄毛料缝了一条夏季连衣裙。

e.en: The old skirt was made of lightweight wool {challis}.
e.zh: 那条旧裙子是用轻薄的羊毛印花料做的。

e.en: The royal {chamber} was decorated with gold and red velvet.
e.zh: 皇室寝宫用金色与红色丝绒装饰着。

e.en: The senate {chamber} fell silent before the vote began.
e.zh: 投票开始前,参议院议事厅一片寂静。

chambered.t: adj. 有腔室的、分隔成室的

e.en: The rifle is {chambered} for a standard hunting cartridge.
e.zh: 这支步枪可装填标准的狩猎弹药。

e.en: A nautilus has a beautifully {chambered} spiral shell.
e.zh: 鹦鹉螺有一个分隔成多腔室的美丽螺旋壳。

e.en: The {chamberlain} announced each guest as they entered the hall.
e.zh: 内侍在每位宾客进入大厅时通报姓名。

e.en: He served as {chamberlain} to the king for thirty years.
e.zh: 他担任国王的内侍长达三十年。

e.en: The {chambermaid} knocked softly before entering the hotel room.
e.zh: 客房女服务员在进入酒店房间前轻轻敲了门。

e.en: A friendly {chambermaid} brought us extra towels and pillows.
e.zh: 一位友善的客房女服务员给我们送来了多余的毛巾和枕头。

chambers.t: n. 法官私室；房间（复数）

e.en: The judge called both lawyers into her {chambers} for a discussion.
e.zh: 法官把两位律师叫进她的内室商谈。

e.en: The heart has four {chambers} that pump blood through the body.
e.zh: 心脏有四个腔室,把血液泵送至全身。

chambray.t: n. 钱布雷布（一种棉布）

e.en: He wore a soft blue {chambray} shirt with rolled sleeves.
e.zh: 他穿着一件柔软的蓝色青年布衬衫,袖子卷了起来。

e.en: This {chambray} fabric looks like denim but feels much lighter.
e.zh: 这种青年布看起来像牛仔布,但手感轻得多。

e.en: A {chameleon} can change color to match its surroundings.
e.zh: 变色龙可以改变颜色以融入周围环境。

e.en: He's a real {chameleon}, adapting to every new social group.
e.zh: 他真是个变色龙,能适应每一个新的社交圈子。

chamfer.t:
n. 倒角、斜面
v. 做倒角

e.en: The carpenter cut a small {chamfer} along the edge of the table.
e.zh: 木匠在桌沿切了一个小小的倒角。

e.en: Designers often {chamfer} sharp corners to make products safer.
e.zh: 设计师常将尖角倒角处理,使产品更安全。

e.en: He polished the car with a soft {chamois} cloth.
e.zh: 他用一块柔软的麂皮布擦亮汽车。

e.en: A wild {chamois} leapt across the rocky alpine slope.
e.zh: 一只野生岩羚羊跃过陡峭的高山岩坡。

e.en: I drink {chamomile} tea every night to help me sleep.
e.zh: 我每晚都喝洋甘菊茶来帮助入睡。

e.en: Tiny white {chamomile} flowers grew along the garden path.
e.zh: 小小的白色洋甘菊花沿着花园小径开放。

chamonix.t: n. 霞慕尼（法国滑雪胜地）

e.en: We spent a week skiing in {Chamonix} at the foot of Mont Blanc.
e.zh: 我们在勃朗峰脚下的霞慕尼滑了一周的雪。

e.en: {Chamonix} hosted the very first Winter Olympics in 1924.
e.zh: 霞慕尼于1924年举办了首届冬季奥运会。

chamorro.t: n. 查莫罗人（关岛原住民）

e.en: Many people in Guam still speak the {Chamorro} language at home.
e.zh: 关岛许多人在家中仍然讲查莫罗语。

e.en: The festival celebrated traditional {Chamorro} food, music, and dance.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝传统的查莫罗饮食、音乐和舞蹈。

champ.t:
n. 冠军（champion 的缩写）
v. 咀嚼

e.en: The reigning {champ} defended his title for the third time.
e.zh: 卫冕冠军第三次成功捍卫了头衔。

e.en: The horses {champ} at their bits, eager to start the race.
e.zh: 马匹咬着嚼子,急切地想开始比赛。

e.en: They opened a bottle of {champagne} to celebrate the engagement.
e.zh: 他们开了一瓶香槟庆祝订婚。

e.en: Real {champagne} only comes from the Champagne region of France.
e.zh: 真正的香槟只产自法国的香槟产区。

e.en: The sommelier recommended several vintage {champagnes} for the wedding.
e.zh: 侍酒师为婚礼推荐了几款年份香槟。

e.en: This shop stocks dozens of French {champagnes} from small producers.
e.zh: 这家店备有数十款来自小酒庄的法国香槟。

e.en: She studied engineering at the University of Illinois at {Champaign}.
e.zh: 她在伊利诺伊大学香槟分校学习工程学。

e.en: The bus to {Champaign} leaves every two hours from downtown.
e.zh: 开往香槟市的巴士每两小时从市中心发一班。

champion.t:
n. 冠军、拥护者
v. 捍卫、支持

e.en: She became world {champion} after years of intense training.
e.zh: 经过多年刻苦训练,她成为了世界冠军。

e.en: He continues to {champion} affordable housing in his community.
e.zh: 他持续为社区里的可负担住房问题发声。

champions.t:
n. 冠军（复数）
v. champion 第三人称单数

e.en: The team are reigning {champions} for the third year running.
e.zh: 这支球队已经连续三年蝉联冠军。

e.en: She {champions} mental health awareness through her podcast.
e.zh: 她通过自己的播客倡导心理健康意识。

e.en: Our school won the state {championship} for the first time.
e.zh: 我们学校第一次赢得了州冠军。

e.en: He's been training hard all year for the world {championship}.
e.zh: 他整年都在为世界锦标赛刻苦训练。

e.en: The swimmer has won three national {championships} in a row.
e.zh: 这位游泳选手已连续赢得三届全国锦标赛冠军。

e.en: Tickets for the world {championships} sold out within an hour.
e.zh: 世界锦标赛的门票在一小时内就售罄了。

champs.t: n. 冠军（champs 常指 champions）

e.en: The defending {champs} celebrated wildly after the final whistle.
e.zh: 卫冕冠军在终场哨响后疯狂庆祝。

e.en: We strolled along the {Champs}-Élysées on a sunny afternoon.
e.zh: 一个阳光明媚的下午,我们沿着香榭丽舍大街散步。

e.en: Mr. {Chan} runs the small bakery on the corner of our street.
e.zh: 陈先生在我们街角经营那家小面包店。

e.en: Jackie {Chan} is famous for performing his own dangerous stunts.
e.zh: 成龙以亲自完成危险特技动作而闻名。

chance.t:
n. 机会、可能性
v. 碰巧

e.en: There's a good {chance} of rain later this afternoon.
e.zh: 今天下午晚些时候很有可能会下雨。

e.en: Give me one more {chance} to prove that I can do it.
e.zh: 再给我一次机会,证明我能做到。

e.en: The choir gathered in the {chancel} before the morning service.
e.zh: 唱诗班在晨祷前聚集在圣坛区。

e.en: Sunlight streamed through the windows above the church {chancel}.
e.zh: 阳光从教堂圣坛上方的窗户洒下。

chancellery.t: n. 总理府、大使馆办公处

e.en: The German {chancellery} announced new measures to support small businesses.
e.zh: 德国总理府宣布了一系列扶持小企业的新措施。

e.en: Reporters waited outside the {chancellery} for an official statement.
e.zh: 记者们在总理府外等候官方声明。

chancellor.t: n. 总理、大臣、大学校长

e.en: The {chancellor} announced major tax cuts in this morning's budget.
e.zh: 财政大臣在今早的预算中宣布了大幅减税。

e.en: The university {chancellor} addressed graduates at the ceremony.
e.zh: 大学校长在毕业典礼上向毕业生致辞。

e.en: Several former {chancellors} attended the historic anniversary celebration.
e.zh: 几位前总理出席了这场具有历史意义的周年庆典。

e.en: European {chancellors} met in Brussels to discuss economic policy.
e.zh: 欧洲各国总理在布鲁塞尔开会讨论经济政策。

e.en: Her {chancellorship} was marked by bold economic reforms.
e.zh: 她的总理任期以大胆的经济改革著称。

e.en: He resigned from the {chancellorship} after only two years.
e.zh: 他在担任总理仅两年后就辞职了。

chancer.t: n. 投机取巧的人（英式俚语）

e.en: Don't trust him — he's a real {chancer} looking for easy money.
e.zh: 别信他,他就是个想赚快钱的投机分子。

e.en: That {chancer} tried to sell me a fake designer watch.
e.zh: 那个投机骗子想卖给我一块假名牌手表。

chancery.t: n. 大法官法庭；档案室

e.en: The documents were filed at the {chancery} court last week.
e.zh: 这些文件上周已提交至大法官法庭。

e.en: He works as a clerk in the diocesan {chancery}.
e.zh: 他在教区档案处担任文员。

charges.t:
n. 费用；指控
v. 充电；收费

e.en: The bank {charges} a small fee for international transfers.
e.zh: 银行对国际转账收取少量手续费。

e.en: Police dropped the {charges} due to insufficient evidence.
e.zh: 由于证据不足,警方撤销了指控。

charging.t:
v. 充电中
adj. 充电的

e.en: My phone has been {charging} for over an hour now.
e.zh: 我的手机已经充了一个多小时电了。

e.en: The bull came {charging} straight at the photographer.
e.zh: 那头公牛直冲着摄影师猛扑过来。

charing.t: n. 查令（英国地名，如 Charing Cross）

e.en: We changed trains at {Charing} Cross station in London.
e.zh: 我们在伦敦的查令十字车站换乘了火车。

e.en: The bookshop near {Charing} Cross Road sells rare editions.
e.zh: 查令十字路附近那家书店出售珍本图书。

e.en: The Roman general rode a golden {chariot} into the city.
e.zh: 那位罗马将军驾着金色战车进入城里。

e.en: Children watched the {chariot} race scene in the old film.
e.zh: 孩子们看着老电影里的战车比赛场面。

e.en: The skilled {charioteer} guided four horses around the arena.
e.zh: 那位熟练的战车手驾着四匹马绕场奔驰。

e.en: Ancient legends praised the {charioteer} who won the king's race.
e.zh: 古老传说赞颂那位赢得国王比赛的战车手。

e.en: Dozens of {chariots} thundered across the dusty battlefield.
e.zh: 数十辆战车在尘土飞扬的战场上隆隆驶过。

e.en: The museum displays bronze {chariots} from the Han dynasty.
e.zh: 博物馆展出汉代的青铜战车。

charisma.t: n. 个人魅力；领袖气质

e.en: The young senator has real {charisma} on stage.
e.zh: 那位年轻参议员在台上很有个人魅力。

e.en: Great teachers often combine knowledge with quiet {charisma}.
e.zh: 优秀的老师常把学识与含蓄的魅力结合在一起。

charismatic.t: adj. 有魅力的；有感召力的

e.en: She is a {charismatic} speaker who fills every auditorium.
e.zh: 她是一位极具魅力的演讲者,场场爆满。

e.en: The startup hired a {charismatic} CEO to lead expansion.
e.zh: 那家创业公司聘请了一位有魅力的首席执行官领导扩张。

e.en: The foundation is a registered {charitable} organization.
e.zh: 该基金会是注册的慈善机构。

e.en: Try to be more {charitable} when judging strangers online.
e.zh: 在网上评价陌生人时不妨宽容一些。

e.en: She {charitably} assumed he had simply forgotten the meeting.
e.zh: 她宽厚地认为他只是忘了开会。

e.en: The critic spoke {charitably} about the director's first film.
e.zh: 那位影评人对导演的处女作给予了善意的评价。

e.en: Several {charities} sent volunteers to help after the flood.
e.zh: 几家慈善机构派志愿者前来协助灾后救援。

e.en: He donates monthly to children's {charities} around the world.
e.zh: 他每月向世界各地的儿童慈善机构捐款。

e.en: The runners raised money for a local {charity}.
e.zh: 跑步者们为当地一家慈善机构筹款。

e.en: He showed great {charity} toward his struggling neighbors.
e.zh: 他对生活艰难的邻居们表现出极大的善心。

charlatan.t: n. 江湖骗子；冒牌专家

e.en: That so-called doctor turned out to be a complete {charlatan}.
e.zh: 那位所谓的医生原来是个彻头彻尾的骗子。

e.en: Investors lost millions trusting a financial {charlatan} online.
e.zh: 投资者轻信网上的金融骗子,损失了数百万。

e.en: {Charlemagne} united much of Western Europe in the ninth century.
e.zh: 查理曼大帝在九世纪统一了西欧大部分地区。

e.en: Students study {Charlemagne} when learning about medieval kingdoms.
e.zh: 学生在学习中世纪王国时会研究查理曼大帝。

e.en: {Charles} took the throne after his mother's long reign.
e.zh: 查尔斯在母亲长期统治之后继承了王位。

e.en: My uncle {Charles} drove all night to reach the wedding.
e.zh: 我叔叔查尔斯开了一整夜车赶去参加婚礼。

charleston.t: n. 查尔斯顿（美国地名、舞蹈）

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring historic {Charleston}, South Carolina.
e.zh: 我们周末游览了南卡罗来纳州历史悠久的查尔斯顿。

e.en: Her grandmother taught her how to dance the {Charleston}.
e.zh: 她祖母教她怎么跳查尔斯顿舞。

e.en: {Charlie} brought homemade cookies to the office today.
e.zh: 查理今天带了自制饼干到办公室。

e.en: Our golden retriever {Charlie} loves chasing tennis balls.
e.zh: 我们家的金毛查理特别喜欢追网球。

charlotte.t: n. 夏洛特（女子名、地名）

e.en: {Charlotte} just landed a software job in Berlin.
e.zh: 夏洛特刚在柏林找到一份软件工程师的工作。

e.en: We flew through {Charlotte} on our way to Miami.
e.zh: 我们去迈阿密的途中在夏洛特转机。

e.en: My grandfather still talks about Bobby {Charlton}'s famous goals.
e.zh: 我祖父至今仍在谈论博比·查尔顿那些著名的进球。

e.en: {Charlton} Heston starred in many classic Hollywood epics.
e.zh: 查尔顿·赫斯顿出演过许多经典的好莱坞史诗片。

charm.t:
n. 魅力；护身符
v. 迷住

e.en: The little café has a quiet old-world {charm}.
e.zh: 这家小咖啡馆有一种安静的旧时代魅力。

e.en: She wore a silver bracelet with a tiny heart {charm}.
e.zh: 她戴着一只镶有小心形吊饰的银手链。

e.en: The audience was completely {charmed} by her opening joke.
e.zh: 观众被她开场的玩笑彻底迷住了。

e.en: He {charmed} his way into the exclusive club downtown.
e.zh: 他靠魅力混进了市中心那家高端俱乐部。

e.en: Watch out — that salesman is a real {charmer}.
e.zh: 小心——那个销售员是个十足的魅力高手。

e.en: Their new puppy is an absolute {charmer} with kids.
e.zh: 他们家的新小狗在孩子面前简直萌得不行。

e.en: We stayed in a {charming} cottage by the lake.
e.zh: 我们住在湖边一间迷人的小屋里。

e.en: Her new boyfriend is funny, smart, and {charming}.
e.zh: 她的新男友幽默、聪明、又有魅力。

e.en: The host welcomed each guest {charmingly} at the door.
e.zh: 主人在门口亲切迷人地迎接每一位客人。

e.en: She writes {charmingly} about her childhood in the countryside.
e.zh: 她以迷人的笔触写她在乡下的童年。

e.en: The hotel lobby was clean but completely {charmless}.
e.zh: 酒店大堂虽然干净,却毫无格调可言。

e.en: Critics called the new comedy flat and {charmless}.
e.zh: 影评人称这部新喜剧平淡无味、毫无魅力。

e.en: The little town has its own quiet {charms}.
e.zh: 这座小镇自有它那份宁静的魅力。

e.en: She collects silver {charms} for her bracelet.
e.zh: 她为自己的手链收集各种银饰小挂件。

charnel.t: adj. 停尸的（charnel house 停尸房）

e.en: The novel's hero stumbled into a forgotten {charnel} house.
e.zh: 小说主角误入一座被遗忘的藏骨堂。

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered a medieval {charnel} chapel beneath the church.
e.zh: 考古学家在教堂下方发现了一座中世纪藏骨小礼拜堂。

charnwood.t: n. 查恩伍德（英国地名）

e.en: We hiked across {Charnwood} Forest on a misty Sunday.
e.zh: 我们在雾蒙蒙的周日徒步穿过查恩伍德森林。

e.en: {Charnwood} is famous for its ancient volcanic rocks.
e.zh: 查恩伍德以其古老的火山岩闻名。

charolais.t: n. 夏洛莱牛（法国肉牛品种）

e.en: The farmer raises {Charolais} cattle on rolling pastures.
e.zh: 那位农民在起伏的牧场上饲养夏洛莱牛。

e.en: {Charolais} bulls are prized for their lean, tender meat.
e.zh: 夏洛莱公牛因瘦嫩的肉质而备受推崇。

charon.t: n. 卡戎（冥河船夫；冥王星卫星）

e.en: In Greek myth, {Charon} ferries souls across the river Styx.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,卡戎渡亡魂越过冥河。

e.en: The novel reimagines {Charon} as a tired modern boatman.
e.zh: 小说把卡戎重新塑造成一个疲惫的现代船夫。

charred.t:
adj. 烧焦的
v. 烧焦（过去式）

e.en: We pulled the {charred} pizza out of the oven too late.
e.zh: 我们把烤焦的披萨从烤箱里拿出来时已经太晚了。

e.en: Firefighters searched through the {charred} remains of the warehouse.
e.zh: 消防员在烧焦的仓库废墟中搜寻。

chart.t:
n. 图表；排行榜
v. 绘制图表

e.en: The {chart} shows website traffic doubling since January.
e.zh: 这张图表显示自一月以来网站流量翻了一番。

e.en: Her new single topped the pop {chart} for six weeks.
e.zh: 她的新单曲在流行榜上蝉联冠军六周。

charted.t: v. 已绘制图表；已记录

e.en: The team {charted} every step of the customer journey.
e.zh: 团队把客户旅程的每一步都绘制了出来。

e.en: Her debut album {charted} in twelve countries that summer.
e.zh: 那年夏天她的首张专辑在十二个国家进入排行榜。

charter.t:
n. 宪章；包租
v. 包租

e.en: They signed a {charter} to protect local rivers and forests.
e.zh: 他们签署了一项保护当地河流与森林的章程。

e.en: We booked a {charter} flight to a tiny Greek island.
e.zh: 我们订了一架包机飞往一个希腊小岛。

e.en: The company {chartered} a yacht for the executive retreat.
e.zh: 公司为高管团建租了一艘游艇。

e.en: She is a {chartered} accountant working in central London.
e.zh: 她是一名在伦敦市中心工作的特许会计师。

e.en: The ship's {charterer} demanded compensation for the late delivery.
e.zh: 船舶承租人因延迟交货要求赔偿。

e.en: Our company acts as {charterer} for several oil tankers.
e.zh: 我们公司是几艘油轮的承租人。

e.en: He attended {Charterhouse} before going up to Cambridge.
e.zh: 他在进入剑桥之前就读于查特豪斯公学。

e.en: The old {charterhouse} on the hill once housed silent monks.
e.zh: 山上那座古老的卡尔特修道院曾住着沉默的修士。

e.en: They are {chartering} a small plane to reach the island.
e.zh: 他们正在包租一架小飞机飞往那个岛。

e.en: {Chartering} a yacht for a week costs more than expected.
e.zh: 包租游艇一周的费用比预想的还要高。

e.en: The city {charters} new bus routes every spring.
e.zh: 市政府每年春天会授权开通新的公交线路。

e.en: Several {charters} guarantee basic rights for university students.
e.zh: 几项章程保障了大学生的基本权利。

e.en: The dashboard is great for {charting} daily sales trends.
e.zh: 这款仪表盘很适合用来绘制每日销售趋势。

e.en: Her latest single is {charting} higher than anyone expected.
e.zh: 她的新单曲在排行榜上的名次比所有人预想的都高。

chartism.t: n. 宪章运动（19世纪英国）

e.en: Victorian workers organized around {Chartism} to demand voting rights.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的工人围绕宪章运动组织起来,要求投票权。

e.en: Historians still debate the long-term impact of {Chartism}.
e.zh: 历史学家至今仍在争论宪章运动的长远影响。

chartist.t: n. 图表分析师；宪章派成员

e.en: A {chartist} trader studies price patterns before each move.
e.zh: 图表派交易员在每次操作前都会研究价格走势。

e.en: The {Chartist} leader spoke passionately about workers' rights.
e.zh: 那位宪章派领袖慷慨激昂地谈论工人权利。

e.en: Tourists travel from Paris to {Chartres} to see the cathedral.
e.zh: 游客从巴黎专程前往沙特尔参观那座大教堂。

e.en: The stained glass at {Chartres} glowed in the afternoon sun.
e.zh: 沙特尔大教堂的彩色玻璃在午后阳光下熠熠生辉。

e.en: She painted the kitchen walls a bright {chartreuse}.
e.zh: 她把厨房墙壁刷成了亮亮的黄绿色。

e.en: The bartender poured a small glass of green {Chartreuse}.
e.zh: 调酒师倒了一小杯绿色的查特酒。

e.en: The dashboard updates the sales {charts} every five minutes.
e.zh: 仪表盘每五分钟更新一次销售图表。

e.en: His new song shot to the top of the {charts}.
e.zh: 他的新歌迅速冲上了排行榜榜首。

e.en: The old {charwoman} cleaned offices long after everyone left.
e.zh: 那位年长的清洁女工总在所有人下班后才打扫办公室。

e.en: In the novel, the {charwoman} secretly knew every family secret.
e.zh: 在小说里,那位清洁女工暗中知晓每一个家庭秘密。

e.en: Investors are {chary} of startups with no clear revenue.
e.zh: 投资者对没有明确营收的初创公司很谨慎。

e.en: She is {chary} about sharing personal details on social media.
e.zh: 她对在社交媒体上分享个人信息相当警惕。

charybdis.t: n. 卡律布狄斯（希腊神话中的大漩涡）

e.en: Sailors in the myth feared Scylla and {Charybdis} equally.
e.zh: 神话中的水手对斯库拉和卡律布狄斯同样畏惧。

e.en: He felt caught between Scylla and {Charybdis} at work.
e.zh: 他在工作中感觉自己进退两难、左右为难。

chase.t:
v. 追赶；追逐
n. 追捕

e.en: The dog loves to {chase} squirrels in the backyard.
e.zh: 那只狗特别喜欢在后院追松鼠。

e.en: The movie ends with a wild car {chase} downtown.
e.zh: 电影以市中心一场疯狂的汽车追逐戏作结。

chased.t: v. chase 的过去式；追赶过

e.en: The cat {chased} a red dot across the living room.
e.zh: 那只猫追着红点跑遍了整个客厅。

e.en: Reporters {chased} the senator down the courthouse steps.
e.zh: 记者们追着参议员一路跑下法院的台阶。

e.en: He ordered a whiskey with a cold beer {chaser}.
e.zh: 他点了一杯威士忌,再配一杯冰啤酒压口。

e.en: That storm {chaser} drives toward tornadoes for a living.
e.zh: 那位追风者以追逐龙卷风为职业。

chases.t:
v. chase 的第三人称单数
n. 追逐（复数）

e.en: The puppy happily {chases} its tail every morning.
e.zh: 小狗每天早上都开心地追着自己的尾巴跑。

e.en: This action film features three spectacular car {chases}.
e.zh: 这部动作片里有三场精彩的汽车追逐戏。

chasing.t:
v. chase 的现在分词
n. 追赶

e.en: Stop {chasing} likes and focus on real friendships.
e.zh: 别再追着点赞跑了,把心思放在真正的友谊上。

e.en: The detective spent years {chasing} a single suspect.
e.zh: 那位侦探花了多年时间追查一个嫌疑人。

chasm.t: n. 裂缝；鸿沟；巨大差异

e.en: A deep {chasm} split the mountain trail in two.
e.zh: 一道深深的裂谷把山间小路一分为二。

e.en: There's a growing {chasm} between the rich and poor.
e.zh: 贫富之间的鸿沟正在不断扩大。

chasse.t:
n. 滑步舞步
v. 跳滑步舞

e.en: The dancer performed a graceful {chasse} across the floor.
e.zh: 舞者在地板上优雅地做了一个滑步。

e.en: Beginners learn to {chasse} in their first ballet class.
e.zh: 初学者在第一节芭蕾课上学习滑步。

e.en: The car's aluminum {chassis} makes it lighter and faster.
e.zh: 这辆车的铝制底盘让它更轻更快。

e.en: Mechanics inspected the {chassis} for signs of rust.
e.zh: 技师检查了底盘是否有生锈的迹象。

e.en: She wore a {chaste} white dress to the ceremony.
e.zh: 她穿着一件素雅的白色礼服出席仪式。

e.en: The novel celebrates a {chaste} and devoted love.
e.zh: 这部小说颂扬了一段纯洁而忠贞的爱情。

e.en: He kissed her {chastely} on the forehead and left.
e.zh: 他在她额头上纯洁地一吻便离开了。

e.en: The room was {chastely} decorated in soft white tones.
e.zh: 房间以柔和的白色调装饰得简朴雅致。

e.en: Failure can {chasten} even the most arrogant leader.
e.zh: 失败能让最傲慢的领导者也变得谦卑。

e.en: The harsh review served to {chasten} the young writer.
e.zh: 那篇严厉的评论让这位年轻作家反躬自省。

chastened.t: adj. 受惩戒的；变得谦逊的

e.en: He returned home {chastened} after losing the election.
e.zh: 竞选失利后,他心怀谦卑地回到了家中。

e.en: The team looked {chastened} after their unexpected defeat.
e.zh: 球队在意外失利后显得垂头丧气。

e.en: Parents shouldn't {chastise} children in front of their friends.
e.zh: 父母不该当着孩子朋友的面责备他们。

e.en: The coach will {chastise} any player who skips practice.
e.zh: 教练会严厉批评任何缺席训练的队员。

chastised.t: v. chastise 的过去式；被斥责

e.en: The manager {chastised} the team for missing the deadline.
e.zh: 经理因团队错过截止日期而严厉训斥了他们。

e.en: She felt {chastised} after reading the critical feedback.
e.zh: 读完那些批评意见后,她感到受到了责备。

e.en: The public {chastisement} of the CEO shocked the company.
e.zh: 对首席执行官的公开斥责令全公司震惊。

e.en: He accepted the {chastisement} without making excuses.
e.zh: 他接受了责备,没有为自己找借口。

e.en: Some religious orders require a vow of {chastity}.
e.zh: 一些宗教教派要求宣誓守贞。

e.en: The novel explores ideas about {chastity} and desire.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了贞洁与欲望之间的关系。

e.en: The priest wore a green {chasuble} during the service.
e.zh: 神父在仪式中穿着一件绿色的祭披。

e.en: An embroidered {chasuble} hung in the cathedral's vestry.
e.zh: 大教堂的更衣室里挂着一件绣花祭披。

chat.t:
v. 聊天；闲谈
n. 聊天；对话

e.en: Let's grab coffee and {chat} about your new job.
e.zh: 咱们去喝杯咖啡,聊聊你的新工作吧。

e.en: The customer service {chat} answered my question instantly.
e.zh: 客服聊天窗口立刻回答了我的问题。

e.en: They spent the weekend at a French wine {chateau}.
e.zh: 他们在一座法国酒庄度过了周末。

e.en: The {chateau} sits on a hill overlooking the vineyards.
e.zh: 这座城堡坐落在俯瞰葡萄园的山丘上。

chateaux.t: n. chateau 的复数；法国庄园

e.en: The Loire Valley is famous for its elegant {chateaux}.
e.zh: 卢瓦尔河谷以其优雅的城堡群而闻名。

e.en: Many old {chateaux} have been converted into luxury hotels.
e.zh: 许多古老的城堡已被改建为豪华酒店。

e.en: The {chatelaine} of the manor greeted every visitor warmly.
e.zh: 庄园的女主人热情地迎接每一位来客。

e.en: She wore a silver {chatelaine} with keys and scissors.
e.zh: 她佩戴着一条挂着钥匙和剪刀的银色腰链。

e.en: We took a ferry to {Chatham} for the seafood festival.
e.zh: 我们乘渡轮去查塔姆参加海鲜节。

e.en: The town of {Chatham} has a beautiful old harbor.
e.zh: 查塔姆镇有一座美丽的老港口。

chats.t:
v. chat 的第三人称单数
n. 聊天（复数）

e.en: She {chats} with her grandmother every Sunday evening.
e.zh: 她每个周日晚上都和奶奶聊天。

e.en: My phone is full of group {chats} I never read.
e.zh: 我手机里全是我从不看的群聊。

chatsworth.t: n. 查茨沃思（英国庄园地名）

e.en: {Chatsworth} House is one of England's grandest stately homes.
e.zh: 查茨沃斯庄园是英格兰最宏伟的庄园之一。

e.en: Tourists flock to {Chatsworth} to see its art collection.
e.zh: 游客蜂拥而至查茨沃斯,只为一睹其艺术藏品。

chatted.t: v. chat 的过去式；聊过天

e.en: We {chatted} for hours over a bottle of wine.
e.zh: 我们就着一瓶酒聊了好几个小时。

e.en: She {chatted} with the cashier while bagging her groceries.
e.zh: 她一边装杂货一边和收银员闲聊。

e.en: In ancient times, slaves were treated as mere {chattel}.
e.zh: 在古代,奴隶仅被视为可买卖的财产。

e.en: The law no longer regards a wife as her husband's {chattel}.
e.zh: 法律不再将妻子视为丈夫的私有财产。

chatter.t:
v. 喋喋不休；（牙齿）打颤
n. 闲聊

e.en: The constant {chatter} in the café made concentration impossible.
e.zh: 咖啡馆里不停的喧闹声让人无法集中注意力。

e.en: My teeth began to {chatter} from the freezing wind.
e.zh: 刺骨的寒风冻得我牙齿直打颤。

e.en: My little sister is such a {chatterbox} at dinner.
e.zh: 我的小妹妹在饭桌上简直是个话匣子。

e.en: The teacher moved the {chatterbox} to the front row.
e.zh: 老师把那个话痨学生调到了第一排。

e.en: He's a famous {chatterer} who dominates every conversation.
e.zh: 他是个出了名的话痨,总能主导每一次谈话。

e.en: The squirrel is a noisy {chatterer} in our backyard.
e.zh: 那只松鼠是我们后院里聒噪的小家伙。

chattering.t:
v. chatter 的现在分词
n. 闲谈

e.en: The students were {chattering} excitedly about the field trip.
e.zh: 学生们兴奋地谈论着即将到来的郊游。

e.en: His teeth were {chattering} after the icy swim.
e.zh: 在冰冷的水里游完后,他的牙齿冷得直打颤。

chatterley.t: n. 查泰莱（《查泰莱夫人的情人》人物）

e.en: Lady {Chatterley}'s Lover caused a famous obscenity trial.
e.zh: 《查泰莱夫人的情人》引发了一场著名的淫秽审判。

e.en: Lawrence's novel about Lady {Chatterley} was banned for decades.
e.zh: 劳伦斯关于查泰莱夫人的小说被禁了数十年。

chatterton.t: n. 查特顿（英国诗人姓氏）

e.en: The poet Thomas {Chatterton} died tragically young.
e.zh: 诗人托马斯·查特顿英年早逝,令人扼腕。

e.en: A famous painting depicts the death of {Chatterton}.
e.zh: 一幅著名画作描绘了查特顿之死。

e.en: She {chattily} described every detail of her vacation.
e.zh: 她唠唠叨叨地讲述了假期的每一个细节。

e.en: The host greeted us {chattily} at the front door.
e.zh: 主人在门口热情健谈地迎接我们。

chatting.t: v. chat 的现在分词；聊天中

e.en: They were {chatting} in the kitchen while making dinner.
e.zh: 他们一边做晚饭一边在厨房里闲聊。

e.en: I spent the afternoon {chatting} with old classmates online.
e.zh: 我整个下午都在网上和老同学聊天。

chatto.t: n. 查托（姓氏/出版社名）

e.en: {Chatto} & Windus published many classic British novels.
e.zh: 查托和温达斯出版了许多英国经典小说。

e.en: She signed her contract with {Chatto} last month.
e.zh: 她上个月与查托出版社签了合同。

e.en: Our taxi driver was unusually {chatty} this morning.
e.zh: 我们今早的出租车司机格外健谈。

e.en: She wrote a {chatty} email full of weekend plans.
e.zh: 她写了一封轻松随意的邮件,满是周末计划。

e.en: {Chaucer} wrote The Canterbury Tales in Middle English.
e.zh: 乔叟用中古英语写下了《坎特伯雷故事集》。

e.en: Students often struggle with the language in {Chaucer}.
e.zh: 学生们常常觉得乔叟作品的语言难以理解。

e.en: The portable {chauffer} kept the room warm all night.
e.zh: 那台便携式取暖炉让房间整夜都很暖和。

e.en: Workshops once used a coal {chauffer} for heating metal.
e.zh: 作坊里曾用煤炭加热炉来烧热金属。

chauffered.t: v. 由司机驾驶接送（chauffeur 的变体）

e.en: The diplomat was {chauffered} from the airport to the embassy.
e.zh: 那位外交官被专车从机场送到了大使馆。

e.en: She was {chauffered} around town in a black sedan.
e.zh: 她乘坐一辆黑色轿车被司机载着在城里转悠。

chauffering.t: v. 当司机接送（chauffeur 的变体）

e.en: He spent the weekend {chauffering} his kids to soccer practice.
e.zh: 他整个周末都在开车送孩子去踢足球训练。

e.en: {Chauffering} guests is part of the hotel concierge's job.
e.zh: 接送客人是酒店礼宾员工作的一部分。

chauffers.t: n. chauffer 的复数；小型火炉

e.en: He {chauffers} his elderly parents to every doctor's appointment.
e.zh: 他每次都开车送年迈的父母去看医生。

e.en: The company {chauffers} executives in fully electric cars.
e.zh: 公司用全电动车接送高管出行。

chauffeur.t:
n. 私人司机
v. 为……开车接送

e.en: A uniformed {chauffeur} opened the limousine door for them.
e.zh: 一位身着制服的司机为他们打开了豪华轿车的车门。

e.en: I'll {chauffeur} you to the airport tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 明早我开车送你去机场。

chauffeured.t: v. chauffeur 的过去式；由司机接送

e.en: The celebrity was {chauffeured} to the awards ceremony.
e.zh: 这位明星被专车送往颁奖典礼。

e.en: She {chauffeured} her grandmother around town all afternoon.
e.zh: 她整个下午都开车带着祖母在城里转。

chauvinism.t: n. 沙文主义；盲目爱国

e.en: Workplace {chauvinism} still holds many talented women back.
e.zh: 职场上的大男子主义仍在阻碍许多有才华的女性。

e.en: He criticized the blind {chauvinism} of the political rally.
e.zh: 他批评那场政治集会上盲目的沙文主义情绪。

e.en: Her boss is a {chauvinist} who interrupts every female colleague.
e.zh: 她的老板是个大男子主义者,总打断每一位女同事。

e.en: He's a flag-waving {chauvinist} about his home country.
e.zh: 他是个挥舞国旗的极端爱国主义者,只夸自己的祖国。

e.en: His {chauvinistic} comments offended several people at dinner.
e.zh: 他大男子主义的言论冒犯了晚餐桌上的几位客人。

e.en: The film was criticized for its {chauvinistic} portrayal of women.
e.zh: 这部电影因带有沙文主义色彩地刻画女性而受到批评。

chaw.t:
v. 咀嚼（尤指嚼烟草）
n. 一口嚼烟

e.en: The old farmer liked to {chaw} tobacco on the porch.
e.zh: 那位老农喜欢坐在门廊上嚼烟草。

e.en: He took a {chaw} of tobacco and spat into the grass.
e.zh: 他嚼了一口烟草,然后吐到草地上。

e.en: Let's grab a {chay} at the corner stand before work.
e.zh: 上班前我们去街角小摊喝杯茶吧。

e.en: The vendor poured hot {chay} from a tall metal pot.
e.zh: 小贩从一只高高的金属壶里倒出热茶。

e.en: She added sliced {chayote} to the chicken soup.
e.zh: 她在鸡汤里加了几片佛手瓜。

e.en: {Chayote} has a mild flavor similar to a cucumber.
e.zh: 佛手瓜味道清淡,有点像黄瓜。

chd.t: n. 冠心病（coronary heart disease 缩写）

e.en: Doctors warned him about his risk of {CHD} after the checkup.
e.zh: 体检后,医生警告他患冠心病的风险。

e.en: Regular exercise helps reduce the chance of {CHD}.
e.zh: 规律的锻炼有助于降低患冠心病的几率。

che.t: n. 切（人名，如切·格瓦拉）

e.en: {Che} Guevara remains a controversial revolutionary icon.
e.zh: 切·格瓦拉至今仍是一位备受争议的革命偶像。

e.en: The poster of {Che} hung above his college desk.
e.zh: 切·格瓦拉的海报挂在他大学时书桌的上方。

cheadle.t: n. 奇德尔（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: Don {Cheadle} delivered a powerful performance in Hotel Rwanda.
e.zh: 唐·钱德尔在《卢旺达饭店》中奉献了震撼人心的表演。

e.en: We took the train from Manchester out to {Cheadle}.
e.zh: 我们从曼彻斯特坐火车去了奇德尔。

e.en: The family moved to {Cheam} for better schools.
e.zh: 这家人为了更好的学校搬到了奇姆。

e.en: {Cheam} is a quiet suburb on the edge of London.
e.zh: 奇姆是位于伦敦边缘的一个安静郊区。

cheap.t:
adj. 便宜的
adj. 廉价的、低劣的

e.en: This restaurant has surprisingly {cheap} but delicious noodles.
e.zh: 这家餐厅的面条便宜得出奇,却很好吃。

e.en: Don't buy {cheap} headphones — they break within a month.
e.zh: 别买廉价耳机,用不到一个月就坏。

e.en: Constant discounts can {cheapen} a luxury brand's image.
e.zh: 频繁打折会让奢侈品牌的形象大打折扣。

e.en: Don't let cynicism {cheapen} the achievement you worked for.
e.zh: 别让愤世嫉俗贬低你辛苦换来的成就。

cheapening.t: v. 使变廉价（cheapen 的现在分词）

e.en: Mass production is {cheapening} the brand's image.
e.zh: 大规模生产正在贬低这个品牌的形象。

e.en: Discount sales are {cheapening} the price of luxury bags.
e.zh: 打折促销正在降低奢侈品包的价格。

cheaper.t: adj. 更便宜的（cheap 的比较级）

e.en: Online shopping is often {cheaper} than buying in stores.
e.zh: 网购通常比实体店购买便宜。

e.en: This phone is {cheaper} but has fewer features.
e.zh: 这款手机更便宜,但功能较少。

e.en: You can travel {cheaply} by booking flights early.
e.zh: 提前订机票可以省钱出行。

e.en: The furniture was made {cheaply} and broke quickly.
e.zh: 这家具做工粗糙,很快就坏了。

e.en: The {cheapness} of the materials was obvious at first glance.
e.zh: 材料的廉价感一眼就能看出来。

e.en: Tourists love the {cheapness} of street food in Bangkok.
e.zh: 游客喜欢曼谷街头小吃的便宜。

cheapo.t:
adj. 廉价劣质的
n. 廉价货

e.en: He bought a {cheapo} charger that broke in a week.
e.zh: 他买了个便宜货充电器,一周就坏了。

e.en: Don't waste money on {cheapo} headphones.
e.zh: 别在劣质耳机上浪费钱。

cheapside.t: n. 齐普赛街（伦敦地名）

e.en: {Cheapside} is a famous historic street in London.
e.zh: 齐普赛街是伦敦一条著名的历史街道。

e.en: The bank's headquarters stand on {Cheapside}.
e.zh: 这家银行的总部坐落在齐普赛街。

e.en: Don't be such a {cheapskate} and tip the waiter.
e.zh: 别这么小气,给服务员小费吧。

e.en: He's a total {cheapskate} who never buys rounds.
e.zh: 他是个十足的吝啬鬼,从不请客。

cheat.t:
v. 作弊、欺骗
n. 骗子；游戏秘籍

e.en: Students who {cheat} on exams face serious consequences.
e.zh: 考试作弊的学生会面临严重后果。

e.en: He used a {cheat} code to beat the game.
e.zh: 他用作弊码通关了这个游戏。

cheated.t:
v. 欺骗（过去式）
adj. 被骗的

e.en: She felt {cheated} when the refund never arrived.
e.zh: 退款迟迟不到,她觉得自己被骗了。

e.en: He {cheated} on the test and got expelled.
e.zh: 他考试作弊被开除了。

e.en: The online game banned every {cheater} it detected.
e.zh: 这款网络游戏封禁了所有被检测到的作弊者。

e.en: Nobody wants to play cards with a known {cheater}.
e.zh: 没人愿意和一个出名的老千玩牌。

cheating.t:
n. 作弊、出轨
v. 欺骗（现在分词）

e.en: AI tools have made {cheating} on essays much easier.
e.zh: AI工具让论文作弊变得容易多了。

e.en: She caught him {cheating} during the chess match.
e.zh: 她抓到他在象棋比赛中作弊。

cheats.t: n. 游戏秘籍；骗子（复数）

e.en: He {cheats} every time we play Monopoly.
e.zh: 我们每次玩大富翁他都作弊。

e.en: This forum shares {cheats} for popular video games.
e.zh: 这个论坛分享热门电子游戏的作弊技巧。

chechen.t:
n. 车臣人
adj. 车臣的

e.en: He grew up speaking {Chechen} at home.
e.zh: 他从小在家说车臣语。

e.en: The documentary explores {Chechen} culture and traditions.
e.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了车臣的文化与传统。

check.t:
v. 检查、核对
n. 支票；勾选标记

e.en: Please {check} your email for the confirmation link.
e.zh: 请查收邮件中的确认链接。

e.en: The waiter brought the {check} after dessert.
e.zh: 服务员在甜点后送上了账单。

checkable.t: adj. 可检查的、可核实的

e.en: Make sure all claims in the report are {checkable}.
e.zh: 确保报告中的所有说法都可核实。

e.en: The bank offers a {checkable} savings account.
e.zh: 这家银行提供可开支票的储蓄账户。

e.en: Few people carry a {checkbook} in their wallet anymore.
e.zh: 现在很少有人钱包里还带支票簿了。

e.en: She pulled out her {checkbook} to pay the rent.
e.zh: 她拿出支票簿来付房租。

checked.t:
v. 已检查（过去式）
adj. 格子图案的

e.en: I {checked} my phone every five minutes for updates.
e.zh: 我每隔五分钟就看一次手机更新。

e.en: He wore a {checked} shirt to the interview.
e.zh: 他穿了一件格子衬衫去面试。

e.en: The grammar {checker} caught several typos in my draft.
e.zh: 语法检查器在我草稿里挑出了好几个错别字。

e.en: The supermarket {checker} scanned my groceries quickly.
e.zh: 超市收银员很快地扫了我的商品。

e.en: The kitchen had a black-and-white {checkerboard} floor.
e.zh: 厨房铺着黑白棋盘格地板。

e.en: She set up the {checkerboard} for a quick game.
e.zh: 她摆好棋盘准备下一盘快棋。

checkered.t: adj. 方格图案的；起伏不定的

e.en: He has a {checkered} past but seems reformed now.
e.zh: 他过去经历坎坷,但现在似乎已经改过自新。

e.en: The picnic table had a red {checkered} tablecloth.
e.zh: 野餐桌上铺着红色格子桌布。

checking.t:
v. 检查（现在分词）
n. 活期账户

e.en: I'm {checking} the weather before we head out.
e.zh: 我们出门前我正在查看天气。

e.en: She opened a {checking} account at the local bank.
e.zh: 她在当地银行开了一个活期账户。

e.en: Pilots run through a {checklist} before every takeoff.
e.zh: 飞行员每次起飞前都要过一遍检查清单。

e.en: I made a packing {checklist} for the trip.
e.zh: 我为这次旅行做了一份打包清单。

e.en: Put a {checkmark} next to each completed task.
e.zh: 在每个已完成的任务旁打个勾。

e.en: Twitter's blue {checkmark} now requires a paid subscription.
e.zh: 推特的蓝色对勾现在需要付费订阅。

checkmate.t:
n. 将死（棋局）
v. 击败、使无法脱身

e.en: She announced {checkmate} after just twelve moves.
e.zh: 她仅走了十二步就宣布将死。

e.en: The grandmaster forced {checkmate} with a brilliant queen sacrifice.
e.zh: 特级大师以精彩的弃后将死了对手。

checkoff.t: n. 工资代扣（工会会费等）

e.en: Union dues come through automatic payroll {checkoff}.
e.zh: 工会会费通过工资自动扣缴。

e.en: The form has a {checkoff} box for charitable donations.
e.zh: 表格上有一个慈善捐款的勾选框。

e.en: Hotel {checkout} is at eleven in the morning.
e.zh: 酒店退房时间是上午十一点。

e.en: There was a long line at the supermarket {checkout}.
e.zh: 超市收银台前排着长队。

e.en: Self-service {checkouts} have replaced many cashiers.
e.zh: 自助结账台已经取代了许多收银员。

e.en: The store added more {checkouts} during the holiday rush.
e.zh: 商店在假日高峰期增设了更多结账通道。

e.en: Soldiers stopped every car at the {checkpoint}.
e.zh: 士兵在检查站拦下了每一辆车。

e.en: Save your progress at the next game {checkpoint}.
e.zh: 在下一个游戏存档点保存进度。

e.en: The marathon route had water stations at several {checkpoints}.
e.zh: 马拉松路线在几个检查点设有补水站。

e.en: Border {checkpoints} were tightened after the incident.
e.zh: 事件发生后,边境检查站加强了管控。

checks.t:
v. 检查（三单）
n. 支票（复数）

e.en: The system runs security {checks} every hour.
e.zh: 系统每小时运行一次安全检查。

e.en: He still pays his bills with paper {checks}.
e.zh: 他仍然用纸质支票付账单。

e.en: I scheduled a dental {checkup} for next Tuesday.
e.zh: 我预约了下周二的牙科检查。

e.en: Annual {checkup} can catch health issues early.
e.zh: 每年体检可以及早发现健康问题。

e.en: She added sharp {cheddar} to the macaroni.
e.zh: 她在通心粉里加了浓味切达奶酪。

e.en: Aged {cheddar} pairs perfectly with apple slices.
e.zh: 陈年切达奶酪和苹果片是绝配。

e.en: {Chee} is a casual exclamation used in some dialects.
e.zh: "Chee"在某些方言里是随意的感叹词。

e.en: "{Chee}, that was close!" he muttered after the near miss.
e.zh: "哎呀,好险!"他在险些出事后嘟囔道。

cheek.t:
n. 脸颊
n. 厚脸皮、放肆

e.en: She kissed him on the {cheek} before leaving.
e.zh: 她离开前在他脸颊上吻了一下。

e.en: The cold wind made her {cheek} turn red.
e.zh: 寒风把她的脸颊吹得通红。

e.en: The model's high {cheekbone} caught the studio light.
e.zh: 模特高耸的颧骨在影棚灯光下熠熠生辉。

e.en: He fractured his {cheekbone} during the boxing match.
e.zh: 他在拳击比赛中颧骨骨折了。

cheekily.t: adv. 厚脸皮地、嬉皮笑脸地

e.en: She {cheekily} stole a fry off his plate.
e.zh: 她调皮地从他盘子里偷了一根薯条。

e.en: The kid {cheekily} answered back to his teacher.
e.zh: 那孩子厚着脸皮顶撞了老师。

e.en: Her {cheeks} flushed when he complimented her.
e.zh: 他夸她时,她双颊泛红。

e.en: The baby's chubby {cheeks} are adorable.
e.zh: 宝宝胖嘟嘟的小脸蛋真可爱。

cheeky.t: adj. 厚脸皮的、嬉皮笑脸的

e.en: He gave a {cheeky} grin and walked away.
e.zh: 他厚脸皮地咧嘴一笑就走开了。

e.en: Let's grab a {cheeky} pint after work.
e.zh: 下班后我们偷偷去喝一杯吧。

cheep.t:
v. (小鸟) 啾啾叫
n. 唧唧声

e.en: The chicks {cheep} loudly when they're hungry.
e.zh: 小鸡饿的时候会大声叽叽叫。

e.en: I heard a faint {cheep} from the nest above.
e.zh: 我听到上方的鸟巢传来微弱的啾啾声。

cheer.t:
v. 欢呼、加油
n. 欢呼声；振奋

e.en: The crowd began to {cheer} as the team scored.
e.zh: 球队进球时,人群开始欢呼。

e.en: A warm cup of cocoa brought her some {cheer}.
e.zh: 一杯热可可让她心情好了一些。

cheered.t:
v. 欢呼（过去式）
adj. 振奋的

e.en: Fans {cheered} loudly when the band took the stage.
e.zh: 乐队登台时粉丝们大声欢呼。

e.en: The good news {cheered} her up immediately.
e.zh: 这个好消息立刻让她振作起来。

chequerboard.t: n. 棋盘图案；方格图案

e.en: The fields below looked like a green {chequerboard} from above.
e.zh: 从上面看,下面的田野像绿色的棋盘。

e.en: He laid the tiles in a classic {chequerboard} pattern.
e.zh: 他按照经典的棋盘格图案铺设瓷砖。

chequered.t:
adj. 方格图案的
adj. 波折不断的

e.en: The driver waved a {chequered} flag at the finish line.
e.zh: 赛车手在终点线挥舞着方格旗。

e.en: The politician has a rather {chequered} past.
e.zh: 这位政客的过去相当复杂多变。

chequers.t: n. 跳棋；英国首相乡间别墅

e.en: The Prime Minister hosted talks at {Chequers} last weekend.
e.zh: 首相上周末在契克斯庄园主持了会谈。

e.en: Children played {chequers} on the porch all afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在门廊玩跳棋。

e.en: Few shops still accept personal {cheques} these days.
e.zh: 如今很少有商店还接受个人支票。

e.en: She signed three {cheques} before leaving the office.
e.zh: 她离开办公室前签了三张支票。

e.en: {Cher} performed her greatest hits at the Las Vegas residency.
e.zh: 雪儿在拉斯维加斯的驻场演出中演唱了她的经典金曲。

e.en: My mother grew up listening to {Cher} on the radio.
e.zh: 我母亲是听着收音机里的雪儿长大的。

cherbourg.t: n. 瑟堡（法国港口城市）

e.en: The ferry from Portsmouth arrives in {Cherbourg} by morning.
e.zh: 从朴茨茅斯出发的渡轮清晨抵达瑟堡。

e.en: {Cherbourg} is a major port on the French coast.
e.zh: 瑟堡是法国沿海的一个主要港口。

e.en: She sliced a ripe {cherimoya} for breakfast.
e.zh: 她切了一个熟透的释迦果当早餐。

e.en: The {cherimoya} tastes like a blend of banana and pineapple.
e.zh: 释迦果尝起来像香蕉和菠萝的混合味道。

cherish.t:
v. 珍惜；珍爱
v. 怀抱（希望、记忆）

e.en: I will always {cherish} the memories from that summer.
e.zh: 我会永远珍惜那个夏天的回忆。

e.en: Parents {cherish} every milestone their children reach.
e.zh: 父母珍视孩子达成的每一个里程碑。

e.en: This necklace is one of my most {cherished} possessions.
e.zh: 这条项链是我最珍爱的物品之一。

e.en: She {cherished} the letters her grandmother had written.
e.zh: 她珍藏着祖母写给她的信。

cherishes.t: v. 珍惜（cherish 的三单形式）

e.en: He {cherishes} the time spent with his grandchildren.
e.zh: 他珍惜与孙辈共度的时光。

e.en: Our company {cherishes} long-term relationships with clients.
e.zh: 我们公司珍视与客户的长期关系。

cherishing.t: v. 珍惜（cherish 的现在分词）

e.en: She spent the afternoon {cherishing} old family photos.
e.zh: 她花了一下午细细回味老家庭照片。

e.en: He believes in {cherishing} every small moment of joy.
e.zh: 他相信要珍惜每一个细小的快乐瞬间。

chernobyl.t: n. 切尔诺贝利（核事故地）

e.en: The {Chernobyl} disaster reshaped global nuclear safety policy.
e.zh: 切尔诺贝利灾难重塑了全球核安全政策。

e.en: Tourists now visit the abandoned town near {Chernobyl}.
e.zh: 游客现在会参观切尔诺贝利附近被遗弃的小镇。

cherokee.t: n. 切罗基人；切罗基语

e.en: The {Cherokee} Nation has its capital in Tahlequah, Oklahoma.
e.zh: 切罗基民族的首府位于俄克拉荷马州的塔勒阔。

e.en: She is learning to speak the {Cherokee} language.
e.zh: 她正在学习说切罗基语。

e.en: He lit a {cheroot} after dinner on the veranda.
e.zh: 晚饭后他在阳台上点了一支方头雪茄。

e.en: The old captain offered me a Burmese {cheroot}.
e.zh: 老船长递给我一支缅甸方头雪茄。

e.en: She topped the cake with fresh {cherries}.
e.zh: 她在蛋糕上放了新鲜的樱桃。

e.en: We picked {cherries} from the backyard tree.
e.zh: 我们从后院的树上摘了樱桃。

cherry.t:
n. 樱桃
adj. 樱桃红的

e.en: He bought a {cherry} red sports car last week.
e.zh: 他上周买了一辆樱桃红的跑车。

e.en: I love {cherry} flavored ice cream in summer.
e.zh: 夏天我最爱吃樱桃味的冰淇淋。

e.en: The desk is made of polished {cherrywood}.
e.zh: 这张书桌是用抛光樱桃木做的。

e.en: She chose a {cherrywood} guitar for its warm tone.
e.zh: 她选了把樱桃木吉他,因为音色温暖。

e.en: Geologists found {chert} fragments along the riverbed.
e.zh: 地质学家在河床边发现了燧石碎片。

e.en: Ancient tools were often shaped from hard {chert}.
e.zh: 古代工具常用坚硬的燧石打造。

cherub.t: n. 小天使；可爱的孩子

e.en: A stone {cherub} stood at the fountain's center.
e.zh: 一尊石雕小天使立在喷泉中央。

e.en: The baby smiled like a tiny {cherub}.
e.zh: 那婴儿笑得像个小天使。

cherubic.t: adj. 天使般的；天真可爱的

e.en: The toddler had a {cherubic} face with rosy cheeks.
e.zh: 那幼童有着红润脸颊,长得像小天使。

e.en: Her {cherubic} smile charmed everyone in the room.
e.zh: 她天真可爱的笑容迷住了在场每个人。

e.en: Add fresh {chervil} to the soup just before serving.
e.zh: 上桌前在汤里加点新鲜细叶芹。

e.en: French chefs often use {chervil} in delicate sauces.
e.zh: 法国厨师常在精致酱汁中使用细叶芹。

e.en: We punted along the {Cherwell} on a sunny afternoon.
e.zh: 一个晴朗的下午,我们在彻韦尔河上撑船。

e.en: The {Cherwell} flows through the city of Oxford.
e.zh: 彻韦尔河流经牛津市。

e.en: The train to {Chesham} leaves from platform two.
e.zh: 开往切舍姆的火车在二号站台发车。

e.en: {Chesham} is a quiet market town in Buckinghamshire.
e.zh: 切舍姆是白金汉郡一座安静的集镇。

e.en: He grinned like a {Cheshire} cat all evening.
e.zh: 他整晚都像柴郡猫一样咧嘴笑。

e.en: {Cheshire} is famous for its salt mines and cheese.
e.zh: 柴郡以盐矿和奶酪闻名。

e.en: She grew up in {Cheshunt}, just north of London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦以北的切森特长大。

e.en: The bus stops at {Cheshunt} station every ten minutes.
e.zh: 公交车每十分钟在切森特站停一次。

e.en: He plays {chess} online every night.
e.zh: 他每晚都在网上下国际象棋。

e.en: My grandfather taught me how to play {chess}.
e.zh: 我祖父教我怎么下国际象棋。

e.en: She set up the {chessboard} for the next match.
e.zh: 她摆好棋盘准备下一局。

e.en: The marble {chessboard} sat in the middle of the study.
e.zh: 大理石棋盘摆在书房正中央。

e.en: We took the kids to {Chessington} World of Adventures.
e.zh: 我们带孩子去了切辛顿冒险世界乐园。

e.en: {Chessington} has some of the best rides near London.
e.zh: 切辛顿拥有伦敦附近最棒的几个游乐项目。

chest.t:
n. 胸部；胸腔
n. 箱子；柜子

e.en: He felt a sharp pain in his {chest}.
e.zh: 他感到胸口一阵剧痛。

e.en: She found old letters inside the wooden {chest}.
e.zh: 她在木箱里发现了一些旧信件。

e.en: {Chester} is known for its Roman walls and timbered buildings.
e.zh: 切斯特以罗马城墙和木构建筑闻名。

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring {Chester}'s old town.
e.zh: 我们整个周末都在切斯特老城区游览。

chesterfield.t: n. 切斯特菲尔德沙发；长大衣

e.en: A leather {chesterfield} dominated the hotel lobby.
e.zh: 一张皮质切斯特菲尔德沙发占据着酒店大堂。

e.en: She curled up on the velvet {chesterfield} with a book.
e.zh: 她蜷在天鹅绒切斯特菲尔德沙发上读书。

chesters.t: n. 切斯特斯（地名、姓氏）

e.en: The Roman fort at {Chesters} attracts many history buffs.
e.zh: 切斯特斯的罗马要塞吸引了许多历史爱好者。

e.en: We visited {Chesters} along Hadrian's Wall last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们沿哈德良长城参观了切斯特斯。

chesterton.t: n. 切斯特顿（英国作家）

e.en: G.K. {Chesterton} wrote the Father Brown detective stories.
e.zh: G·K·切斯特顿写了布朗神父侦探系列小说。

e.en: I'm reading a biography of {Chesterton} this month.
e.zh: 这个月我在读切斯特顿的传记。

chestnut.t:
n. 栗子；栗树
adj. 栗色的

e.en: We roasted {chestnut} over the open fire.
e.zh: 我们在篝火上烤栗子。

e.en: Her hair was a glossy {chestnut} brown.
e.zh: 她的头发呈光亮的栗棕色。

chests.t: n. 胸部；箱子（chest 的复数）

e.en: Pirates were said to bury {chests} of gold here.
e.zh: 据说海盗曾在这里埋下成箱的黄金。

e.en: The runners' {chests} heaved as they crossed the line.
e.zh: 跑者们冲过终点时胸口剧烈起伏。

chesty.t: adj. 胸闷的；咳得厉害的

e.en: He has a {chesty} cough that won't go away.
e.zh: 他有种久咳不愈的痰咳。

e.en: The doctor said her cold had turned {chesty}.
e.zh: 医生说她的感冒已经转成胸部痰咳了。

e.en: A tall {cheval} mirror stood in the corner of the bedroom.
e.zh: 卧室角落立着一面高大的穿衣镜。

e.en: She admired her gown in the antique {cheval} glass.
e.zh: 她在那面古董穿衣镜前端详自己的礼服。

e.en: He was honored as a {chevalier} of the Legion of Honour.
e.zh: 他被授予法国荣誉军团骑士勋位。

e.en: The {chevalier} bowed deeply before the queen.
e.zh: 那位骑士在王后面前深深鞠躬。

cheviot.t: n. 切维厄特羊；粗花呢

e.en: The farmer raised {Cheviot} sheep on the hillside.
e.zh: 农夫在山坡上养切维厄特羊。

e.en: His suit was made of fine {cheviot} wool.
e.zh: 他的西装是用上等切维厄特羊毛做的。

e.en: He drives an old red {Chevrolet} pickup truck.
e.zh: 他开着一辆红色的老式雪佛兰皮卡。

e.en: The {Chevrolet} dealership is having a summer sale.
e.zh: 那家雪佛兰经销店正在搞夏季促销。

chevron.t:
n. V形条纹；人字形
n. 雪佛龙（公司）

e.en: The sergeant wore three {chevron} stripes on his sleeve.
e.zh: 中士袖子上佩有三道V形军衔条。

e.en: She loved the bold {chevron} pattern on the rug.
e.zh: 她很喜欢地毯上醒目的人字纹图案。

chevy.t: n. 雪佛兰（Chevrolet 的简称）

e.en: He restored a 1967 {Chevy} Camaro in his garage.
e.zh: 他在车库里修复了一辆1967年的雪佛兰卡玛洛。

e.en: My uncle still drives his old blue {Chevy}.
e.zh: 我叔叔还在开他那辆旧的蓝色雪佛兰。

chew.t:
v. 咀嚼；嚼
v. 琢磨；思量

e.en: You should {chew} your food slowly.
e.zh: 你应该慢慢嚼食物。

e.en: The puppy loves to {chew} on old shoes.
e.zh: 小狗特别喜欢啃旧鞋子。

e.en: The vitamins come in {chewable} orange tablets.
e.zh: 这种维生素是橙味的咀嚼片。

e.en: Kids usually prefer {chewable} medicine to syrups.
e.zh: 孩子们通常更愿意吃咀嚼药片而不是糖浆。

chewed.t: v. 咀嚼（chew 的过去式）

e.en: The dog {chewed} my favorite slipper to pieces.
e.zh: 狗把我最爱的拖鞋咬得稀烂。

e.en: She {chewed} her gum nervously during the interview.
e.zh: 面试时她紧张地嚼着口香糖。

chewer.t: n. 咀嚼者；嚼食物的人

e.en: My beagle is a notorious shoe {chewer}.
e.zh: 我那只比格犬是出了名的咬鞋专家。

e.en: He's a slow {chewer} and always finishes meals last.
e.zh: 他吃饭嚼得慢,总是最后一个吃完。

chewing.t: v. 咀嚼（chew 的现在分词）

e.en: Stop {chewing} with your mouth open.
e.zh: 别张着嘴嚼东西。

e.en: The cow stood quietly {chewing} grass in the field.
e.zh: 奶牛静静站在田里嚼草。

e.en: She has a {cheerful} personality that lifts everyone's mood.
e.zh: 她性格开朗,能让大家心情变好。

e.en: The room was painted in {cheerful} yellow tones.
e.zh: 房间漆成了明快的黄色调。

e.en: He {cheerfully} agreed to help with the move.
e.zh: 他爽快地答应帮忙搬家。

e.en: She greeted customers {cheerfully} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都热情愉快地招呼顾客。

e.en: Her {cheerfulness} is contagious in any meeting.
e.zh: 她的开朗在任何会议上都具有感染力。

e.en: The nurse's {cheerfulness} comforted the worried patients.
e.zh: 护士的乐观让焦虑的病人感到安慰。

e.en: The poet contrasted the {cheerfulnesses} of different seasons.
e.zh: 诗人对比了不同季节的种种欢愉。

e.en: Various {cheerfulnesses} marked each chapter of her memoir.
e.zh: 她回忆录的每一章都洋溢着不同的欢快情绪。

cheerily.t: adv. 欢快地；兴高采烈地

e.en: She waved {cheerily} from across the street.
e.zh: 她从街对面愉快地挥手致意。

e.en: The barista greeted me {cheerily} despite the early hour.
e.zh: 尽管时间还早,咖啡师还是欢快地跟我打招呼。

e.en: His morning {cheeriness} annoys his sleepy coworkers.
e.zh: 他早晨的活力让睡眼惺忪的同事们很烦。

e.en: The cafe's {cheeriness} comes from its bright decor.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆的欢快氛围来自明亮的装饰。

cheering.t:
n. 欢呼
adj. 令人振奋的

e.en: The {cheering} crowd filled the entire stadium.
e.zh: 欢呼的人群挤满了整个体育场。

e.en: Her message was {cheering} after a difficult day.
e.zh: 度过艰难的一天后,她的信息令人振奋。

e.en: "{Cheerio}!" she called as she boarded the train.
e.zh: "再见!"她登上火车时喊道。

e.en: He waved and said {cheerio} before driving off.
e.zh: 他挥手道别后开车走了。

e.en: She was a {cheerleader} throughout high school.
e.zh: 她整个高中时期都是啦啦队员。

e.en: Every startup needs a {cheerleader} to motivate the team.
e.zh: 每家创业公司都需要一个为团队加油打气的人。

cheerleading.t: n. 啦啦队表演；加油助威

e.en: She joined the {cheerleading} squad in her first year.
e.zh: 她大一就加入了啦啦队。

e.en: The CEO's speech felt like empty {cheerleading} to investors.
e.zh: 首席执行官的讲话在投资者听来像是空洞的鼓吹。

e.en: The waiting room was cold and {cheerless}.
e.zh: 候诊室又冷又压抑。

e.en: Rain made the morning feel particularly {cheerless}.
e.zh: 雨让这个早晨显得格外阴沉。

e.en: {Cheers} to a successful project launch!
e.zh: 为项目成功发布干杯!

e.en: The crowd {cheers} loudly when the goal is scored.
e.zh: 进球时人群大声欢呼。

cheery.t: adj. 愉快的；兴高采烈的

e.en: She gave me a {cheery} wave from across the street.
e.zh: 她从街对面愉快地向我挥手。

e.en: The cafe has a {cheery} yellow interior.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆的内饰是明快的黄色。

e.en: I'd like extra {cheese} on my pizza, please.
e.zh: 麻烦在我的披萨上多加点奶酪。

e.en: This shop sells artisan {cheese} from France.
e.zh: 这家店出售来自法国的手工奶酪。

e.en: She arranged grapes and crackers on the {cheeseboard}.
e.zh: 她把葡萄和饼干摆在奶酪拼盘上。

e.en: We ordered a {cheeseboard} to share before dessert.
e.zh: 我们点了一份奶酪拼盘在甜点前分享。

e.en: I'll have a double {cheeseburger} and fries.
e.zh: 我要一个双层芝士汉堡和薯条。

e.en: This diner makes the best {cheeseburger} in town.
e.zh: 这家小餐馆做的是全城最棒的芝士汉堡。

e.en: She baked a New York-style {cheesecake} for the party.
e.zh: 她为派对烤了一个纽约风味的芝士蛋糕。

e.en: This {cheesecake} has a lovely strawberry topping.
e.zh: 这块芝士蛋糕上面有美味的草莓酱。

e.en: Strain the broth through a piece of {cheesecloth}.
e.zh: 用一块纱布过滤汤汁。

e.en: Wrap the herbs in {cheesecloth} before adding them.
e.zh: 加入前先用纱布把香草包起来。

e.en: The local {cheesemaker} won an award at the fair.
e.zh: 当地的奶酪师在集市上获得了奖项。

e.en: She trained as a {cheesemaker} in the Swiss Alps.
e.zh: 她在瑞士阿尔卑斯山接受了奶酪师培训。

cheesy.t:
adj. 俗气的；廉价的
adj. 奶酪味的

e.en: That pickup line was incredibly {cheesy}.
e.zh: 那句搭讪台词俗气得不行。

e.en: I love a {cheesy} pasta on a cold night.
e.zh: 寒冷的夜晚我喜欢吃浓郁芝士的意面。

e.en: A {cheetah} can sprint faster than any other land animal.
e.zh: 猎豹的冲刺速度超过任何其他陆地动物。

e.en: We spotted a {cheetah} resting under a tree.
e.zh: 我们发现一只猎豹在树下休息。

e.en: The {chef} recommended the seasonal tasting menu.
e.zh: 主厨推荐了时令品鉴菜单。

e.en: He trained as a {chef} in Paris for five years.
e.zh: 他在巴黎做了五年厨师学徒。

e.en: We're reading {Chekhov} in literature class this week.
e.zh: 我们这周在文学课上读契诃夫。

e.en: {Chekhov} mastered the art of the short story.
e.zh: 契诃夫精通短篇小说的艺术。

chekhovian.t: adj. 契诃夫式的；契诃夫风格的

e.en: The play has a quiet, {Chekhovian} sadness about it.
e.zh: 这部剧带着一种契诃夫式的静谧忧伤。

e.en: Critics praised the film's {Chekhovian} character studies.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这部电影具有契诃夫式的人物刻画。

e.en: Doctors used {chelation} therapy to treat the lead poisoning.
e.zh: 医生用螯合疗法治疗铅中毒。

e.en: {Chelation} binds metal ions and removes them from solution.
e.zh: 螯合作用结合金属离子并将其从溶液中除去。

chelmsford.t: n. 切姆斯福德（英国城市）

e.en: She commutes to London from {Chelmsford} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上从切姆斯福德通勤到伦敦。

e.en: {Chelmsford} is the county town of Essex.
e.zh: 切姆斯福德是埃塞克斯郡的郡治。

chelsea.t: n. 切尔西（伦敦地区/足球俱乐部）

e.en: {Chelsea} won the match three to one last night.
e.zh: 切尔西昨晚以三比一赢得了比赛。

e.en: We walked along the river through {Chelsea}.
e.zh: 我们沿着河边走过切尔西区。

cheltenham.t: n. 切尔滕纳姆（英国城市）

e.en: The {Cheltenham} festival attracts thousands of racing fans.
e.zh: 切尔滕纳姆赛马节吸引数千名赛马爱好者。

e.en: She studied at a girls' school in {Cheltenham}.
e.zh: 她在切尔滕纳姆的一所女子学校上学。

e.en: I have {chem} lab right after lunch today.
e.zh: 我今天午饭后就有化学实验课。

e.en: He failed his {chem} midterm and had to retake it.
e.zh: 他化学期中考不及格,只能重考。

chemical.t:
adj. 化学的
n. 化学品

e.en: Always wear gloves when handling this {chemical}.
e.zh: 处理这种化学品时一定要戴手套。

e.en: The factory released a harmful {chemical} into the river.
e.zh: 工厂向河里排放了一种有害化学物质。

chemically.t: adv. 化学上；在化学方面

e.en: The two compounds are {chemically} identical.
e.zh: 这两种化合物在化学上是完全相同的。

e.en: This fabric has been {chemically} treated for stain resistance.
e.zh: 这种面料经过化学处理以防污。

chemicals.t: n. 化学品；化学制品（复数）

e.en: Store the cleaning {chemicals} away from children.
e.zh: 把清洁化学品放在儿童接触不到的地方。

e.en: Many household products contain harsh {chemicals}.
e.zh: 许多家用产品含有刺激性化学物质。

e.en: Fireflies produce light through {chemiluminescence}.
e.zh: 萤火虫通过化学发光产生光芒。

e.en: The glow stick works on the principle of {chemiluminescence}.
e.zh: 荧光棒的工作原理是化学发光。

chemise.t: n. 宽松衬衣；女式内衣

e.en: She wore a silk {chemise} under the linen dress.
e.zh: 她在亚麻连衣裙里面穿了一件丝质衬裙。

e.en: The boutique sells vintage {chemise} styles from the 1920s.
e.zh: 这家精品店出售上世纪二十年代风格的复古内衣。

chemist.t:
n. 化学家
n. 药剂师（英式）

e.en: She works as a {chemist} at a pharmaceutical company.
e.zh: 她在一家制药公司当化学家。

e.en: I'll pick up the prescription from the {chemist} later.
e.zh: 我待会儿去药店取处方药。

e.en: Different battery {chemistries} offer different performance trade-offs.
e.zh: 不同的电池化学体系在性能上各有取舍。

e.en: The two co-stars had completely different on-screen {chemistries}.
e.zh: 两位联合主演在荧幕上的化学反应截然不同。

chemistry.t:
n. 化学
n. 默契；化学反应

e.en: She's majoring in {chemistry} at university.
e.zh: 她在大学主修化学。

e.en: The two leads have great on-screen {chemistry}.
e.zh: 两位主角在荧幕上的默契非常好。

e.en: The {chemists} synthesized a new compound in the lab.
e.zh: 化学家们在实验室合成了一种新化合物。

e.en: Most {chemists} on the high street close at six.
e.zh: 商业街上大多数药店六点关门。

e.en: She starts {chemo} again next Monday morning.
e.zh: 她下周一早上又要开始化疗了。

e.en: His hair fell out after the second round of {chemo}.
e.zh: 第二轮化疗后他的头发掉光了。

chemotherapeutic.t: adj. 化疗的；化学疗法的

e.en: Doctors are testing a new {chemotherapeutic} agent in trials.
e.zh: 医生们正在试验中测试一种新的化疗药物。

e.en: The drug has strong {chemotherapeutic} effects on this tumor.
e.zh: 这种药物对该肿瘤具有很强的化疗效果。

e.en: Modern {chemotherapies} target cancer cells more precisely than before.
e.zh: 现代化疗方法比以往更精准地靶向癌细胞。

e.en: Researchers are comparing several {chemotherapies} in this trial.
e.zh: 研究人员正在这项试验中比较几种化疗方案。

e.en: She finished her last round of {chemotherapy} in March.
e.zh: 她在三月份完成了最后一轮化疗。

e.en: {Chemotherapy} can cause fatigue and hair loss.
e.zh: 化疗可能引起疲劳和脱发。

chenille.t: n. 雪尼尔线；绳绒织物

e.en: She bought a soft {chenille} throw for the sofa.
e.zh: 她买了一条柔软的雪尼尔毯子搭在沙发上。

e.en: The sweater is woven from cotton {chenille} yarn.
e.zh: 这件毛衣是用棉质雪尼尔纱织成的。

e.en: He wrote a {cheque} for the full deposit amount.
e.zh: 他开了一张支票支付全部押金。

e.en: The bank can no longer process this old {cheque}.
e.zh: 银行无法再处理这张旧支票了。

e.en: She pulled out her {chequebook} to pay the contractor.
e.zh: 她拿出支票簿付款给承包商。

e.en: Most people no longer carry a {chequebook} around.
e.zh: 现在大多数人不再随身带支票簿了。

chequer.t:
n. 方格图案
v. 使呈方格花纹

e.en: The tile pattern formed a neat black-and-white {chequer}.
e.zh: 瓷砖图案形成了整齐的黑白方格。

e.en: She painted a {chequer} design on the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 她在厨房地板上画了方格图案。

chews.t: v. 咀嚼（chew 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The dog happily {chews} on its rubber bone.
e.zh: 狗开心地啃着橡胶骨头。

e.en: She always {chews} her pen when she's thinking.
e.zh: 她思考时总爱咬笔。

e.en: These cookies are wonderfully soft and {chewy}.
e.zh: 这些饼干又软又有嚼劲,真好吃。

e.en: The steak was a bit too {chewy} for my liking.
e.zh: 这块牛排对我来说有点太老了。

e.en: We had dinner {chez} Marie last Saturday night.
e.zh: 上周六晚我们在玛丽家吃晚饭。

e.en: The party will be {chez} nous this weekend.
e.zh: 这个周末派对就在我们家办。

chi.t:
n. 气（中国哲学中的生命能量）
n. 希腊字母 χ

e.en: Tai {chi} helps her stay calm and balanced.
e.zh: 打太极让她保持平静与平衡。

e.en: Practitioners believe {chi} flows through the body's meridians.
e.zh: 修炼者相信气在人体经络中流动。

chianti.t: n. 基安蒂红葡萄酒（意大利产）

e.en: He poured a glass of {Chianti} with the pasta.
e.zh: 他倒了一杯基安蒂红酒配意面。

e.en: Tuscany is famous for producing excellent {Chianti}.
e.zh: 托斯卡纳以出产上等基安蒂酒而闻名。

chiaroscuro.t: n. 明暗对照法（绘画技法）

e.en: Caravaggio mastered the use of {chiaroscuro} in his paintings.
e.zh: 卡拉瓦乔在画作中熟练运用明暗对照法。

e.en: The film's dramatic {chiaroscuro} lighting felt almost noir.
e.zh: 影片戏剧性的明暗对比布光颇有黑色电影的感觉。

chiasmus.t: n. 交错配列（修辞手法）

e.en: "Ask not what your country can do for you" is famous {chiasmus}.
e.zh: “不要问国家能为你做什么”是著名的交错配列句。

e.en: The poet used {chiasmus} to mirror the two ideas.
e.zh: 诗人用交错配列法来呼应两个观点。

e.en: The sentence has a clean {chiastic} structure.
e.zh: 这个句子有着工整的交叉结构。

e.en: Biblical scholars often analyze {chiastic} patterns in psalms.
e.zh: 圣经学者常分析诗篇中的交叉对称结构。

chic.t:
adj. 时髦的；别致的
n. 时尚雅致

e.en: She wore a very {chic} black dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿了一条非常时髦的黑色礼服去晚宴。

e.en: The new café has a {chic}, minimalist vibe.
e.zh: 那家新咖啡馆有种时尚极简的氛围。

e.en: {Chicago} is known for its deep-dish pizza.
e.zh: 芝加哥以厚底披萨闻名。
