e.en: She moved to {Chicago} for a tech job last year.
e.zh: 她去年为一份科技工作搬到了芝加哥。

chicane.t:
n. 赛道急弯；诡计
v. 欺诈

e.en: The drivers slowed sharply at the tight {chicane}.
e.zh: 赛车手在那段急弯组合处猛地减速。

e.en: Engineers added a {chicane} to slow traffic on the street.
e.zh: 工程师在街上加了S形弯道来减速车流。

e.en: The lawyer was accused of legal {chicanery} in court.
e.zh: 那位律师被指控在法庭上玩弄诡辩手段。

e.en: Voters were tired of political {chicanery} and broken promises.
e.zh: 选民厌倦了政治诡计和违背的承诺。

e.en: He's proud of his {Chicano} heritage and Mexican roots.
e.zh: 他为自己的奇卡诺血统和墨西哥根源感到自豪。

e.en: The mural celebrates {Chicano} art and culture in Los Angeles.
e.zh: 这幅壁画歌颂洛杉矶的奇卡诺艺术与文化。

chicest.t: adj. 最时髦的（chic 的最高级）

e.en: That boutique is the {chicest} place to shop in town.
e.zh: 那家精品店是城里最时髦的购物去处。

e.en: She always wears the {chicest} outfits at every event.
e.zh: 她每次活动总是穿着全场最时尚的装扮。

chicha.t: n. 奇恰酒（南美玉米发酵酒）

e.en: In the Andes, locals brew {chicha} from fermented corn.
e.zh: 在安第斯山区,当地人用发酵玉米酿制吉开酒。

e.en: He tried homemade {chicha} at a Peruvian village festival.
e.zh: 他在秘鲁村庄的节日上尝了自酿的吉开酒。

chichester.t: n. 奇切斯特（英国城市）

e.en: The cathedral in {Chichester} dates back to the 11th century.
e.zh: 奇切斯特的大教堂可追溯到11世纪。

e.en: We caught a play at the {Chichester} Festival Theatre.
e.zh: 我们在奇切斯特节日剧院看了一场戏。

chick.t:
n. 小鸡；雏鸟
n. (俚) 小妞

e.en: A fluffy yellow {chick} hatched from the egg this morning.
e.zh: 今早一只毛茸茸的黄色小鸡从蛋里孵出来了。

e.en: That cafe is run by two {chicks} from my college.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆是我大学认识的两个女生开的。

e.en: A tiny {chickadee} landed on the bird feeder outside.
e.zh: 一只小山雀停在了外面的喂鸟器上。

e.en: The {chickadee} sang cheerfully despite the freezing weather.
e.zh: 尽管天气严寒,那只山雀仍欢快地鸣唱。

chicken.t:
n. 鸡；鸡肉
adj. (口) 胆小的

e.en: I ordered grilled {chicken} with rice for lunch.
e.zh: 我午餐点了烤鸡配米饭。

e.en: Don't be a {chicken}—just ask her out already.
e.zh: 别当胆小鬼了,赶紧约她出来吧。

e.en: My daughter caught {chickenpox} from a classmate last week.
e.zh: 我女儿上周被同学传染了水痘。

e.en: Most kids get vaccinated against {chickenpox} before kindergarten.
e.zh: 大多数孩子在上幼儿园前会接种水痘疫苗。

e.en: We keep six {chickens} in the backyard for fresh eggs.
e.zh: 我们在后院养了六只鸡,可以吃到新鲜鸡蛋。

e.en: Don't count your {chickens} before they hatch.
e.zh: 别高兴得太早,事情还没成呢。

chickenshit.t: n. (粗俗) 胆小鬼；琐碎事

e.en: Stop being so {chickenshit} and speak up in the meeting.
e.zh: 别那么怂了,开会时大胆发言吧。

e.en: The boss yelled over some {chickenshit} formatting issue.
e.zh: 老板为了一点鸡毛蒜皮的格式问题大发雷霆。

e.en: I added roasted {chickpea} snacks to the salad bowl.
e.zh: 我在沙拉碗里加了烤鹰嘴豆零食。

e.en: Hummus is made primarily from blended {chickpea} and tahini.
e.zh: 鹰嘴豆泥主要由打碎的鹰嘴豆和芝麻酱制成。

chicks.t: n. 小鸡（复数）；（俚）姑娘们

e.en: The hen carefully guarded her newborn {chicks}.
e.zh: 母鸡小心翼翼地守护着刚出生的小鸡。

e.en: A bunch of {chicks} hatched in the incubator overnight.
e.zh: 一夜之间孵化器里孵出了一群小鸡。

e.en: {Chickweed} keeps spreading across my vegetable garden every spring.
e.zh: 每年春天繁缕都会在我的菜园里蔓延。

e.en: She picked fresh {chickweed} to add to the salad.
e.zh: 她摘了新鲜的繁缕加进沙拉里。

chicle.t: n. 糖胶树胶（口香糖原料）

e.en: Original chewing gum was made from natural {chicle} sap.
e.zh: 最初的口香糖是用天然糖胶树胶制成的。

e.en: Workers in Mexico still harvest {chicle} from sapodilla trees.
e.zh: 墨西哥工人至今仍从人心果树上采集糖胶。

chico.t: n. 小伙子（西班牙语借词）

e.en: We drove through {Chico} on our way to Sacramento.
e.zh: 我们在去萨克拉门托的路上经过了奇科市。

e.en: Hey {chico}, can you pass me that wrench?
e.zh: 嘿小伙子,能把那把扳手递给我吗?

chicory.t: n. 菊苣（常作咖啡替代品）

e.en: New Orleans coffee often blends {chicory} for a richer flavor.
e.zh: 新奥尔良咖啡常加菊苣以增添浓郁风味。

e.en: Blue {chicory} flowers bloomed along the country roadside.
e.zh: 乡间路边盛开着蓝色的菊苣花。

e.en: The teacher gently {chided} him for forgetting his homework.
e.zh: 老师温和地责备他忘带作业。

e.en: Don't {chide} her in front of the whole team.
e.zh: 别当着整个团队的面斥责她。

chief.t:
n. 首领；首长
adj. 主要的

e.en: She was promoted to {chief} financial officer last month.
e.zh: 她上个月被提升为首席财务官。

e.en: Pollution remains the {chief} concern in this coastal city.
e.zh: 污染仍是这座沿海城市的首要问题。

chiefdom.t: n. 酋长辖地；首领管辖区

e.en: Archaeologists studied the ancient {chiefdom} that ruled this valley.
e.zh: 考古学家研究了曾统治这片山谷的古代酋邦。

e.en: The tribe evolved from a small village into a {chiefdom}.
e.zh: 该部落从一个小村庄发展成了酋邦。

e.en: The dish is {chiefly} made of rice and grilled vegetables.
e.zh: 这道菜主要由米饭和烤蔬菜组成。

e.en: He's known {chiefly} for his work on climate policy.
e.zh: 他主要因其在气候政策方面的工作而闻名。

e.en: The Kansas City {Chiefs} won the championship game last night.
e.zh: 堪萨斯城酋长队昨晚赢得了冠军赛。

e.en: Tribal {chiefs} gathered to discuss the new land treaty.
e.zh: 部落首领们聚在一起讨论新的土地协议。

e.en: The Highland {chieftain} led his clan into battle.
e.zh: 高地族长率领他的氏族投入战斗。

e.en: A respected {chieftain} settled disputes among neighboring villages.
e.zh: 一位德高望重的酋长调解邻村间的纠纷。

chieftaincy.t: n. 酋长之职；酋长管辖区

e.en: He inherited the {chieftaincy} after his father's death.
e.zh: 父亲去世后他继承了酋长之位。

e.en: Disputes over the {chieftaincy} divided the village for years.
e.zh: 酋长继承权之争让村子分裂了多年。

chieftainship.t: n. 酋长身份；首领职位

e.en: The young warrior assumed the {chieftainship} at just twenty-five.
e.zh: 那位年轻战士二十五岁便接任了酋长之职。

e.en: Tradition determined who would inherit the {chieftainship}.
e.zh: 传统决定了谁将继承酋长的位置。

e.en: In French class today we learned that {chien} means dog.
e.zh: 今天法语课上我们学到 chien 是狗的意思。

e.en: The menu listed "hot {chien}" instead of "hot dog."
e.zh: 菜单上写着 "hot chien" 而不是 "hot dog"。

e.en: She wore a flowing {chiffon} dress to the wedding.
e.zh: 她穿着一条飘逸的雪纺连衣裙参加婚礼。

e.en: The bakery's lemon {chiffon} cake melts in your mouth.
e.zh: 这家烘焙店的柠檬戚风蛋糕入口即化。

chiffonade.t: n. 细丝切法（将叶菜切成细丝）

e.en: Stack the basil leaves and slice them into a {chiffonade}.
e.zh: 把罗勒叶叠起来切成细丝。

e.en: Garnish the soup with a {chiffonade} of fresh spinach.
e.zh: 用新鲜菠菜丝装饰这碗汤。

e.en: Grandma kept her jewelry in the antique walnut {chiffonier}.
e.zh: 奶奶把首饰放在那个古董胡桃木高脚柜里。

e.en: We found a vintage {chiffonier} at the estate sale.
e.zh: 我们在遗产拍卖会上淘到一个复古高脚柜。

e.en: I got covered in {chigger} bites after hiking in tall grass.
e.zh: 在高草丛里徒步后我被恙螨咬了一身。

e.en: A single {chigger} can leave you itching for days.
e.zh: 一只恙螨就能让你痒上好几天。

e.en: She twisted her hair into an elegant {chignon} for the ballet.
e.zh: 她把头发绾成优雅的发髻去看芭蕾。

e.en: A low {chignon} works perfectly with that vintage dress.
e.zh: 低发髻和那件复古连衣裙非常搭。

e.en: Her tiny {chihuahua} barks at every passing stranger.
e.zh: 她那只小吉娃娃见到陌生人就汪汪叫。

e.en: The shivering {chihuahua} curled up under a blanket.
e.zh: 那只发抖的吉娃娃蜷缩在毯子下面。

e.en: My fingers developed painful {chilblain} sores after the cold hike.
e.zh: 在寒冷的徒步后我的手指长出了疼痛的冻疮。

e.en: Wear thick socks to prevent {chilblain} on your toes.
e.zh: 穿厚袜子可以防止脚趾长冻疮。

e.en: Every {child} in the class received a small gift.
e.zh: 班上每个孩子都收到了一份小礼物。

e.en: As a {child}, I spent summers at my grandparents' farm.
e.zh: 我小时候常在祖父母的农场过暑假。

e.en: She delayed {childbearing} to focus on her career first.
e.zh: 她推迟了生育,先专注于自己的事业。

e.en: Many women postpone {childbearing} until their thirties now.
e.zh: 如今很多女性把生育推迟到三十多岁。

e.en: In earlier centuries, many women died in {childbed} from infection.
e.zh: 早些世纪许多妇女因感染死于产褥期。

e.en: She spent two weeks in {childbed} recovering from the delivery.
e.zh: 她在产褥期休养了两周以恢复身体。

e.en: She took a class to prepare for {childbirth}.
e.zh: 她上了一门课为分娩做准备。

e.en: Modern medicine has made {childbirth} much safer worldwide.
e.zh: 现代医学让全世界的分娩变得安全得多。

childcare.t: n. 儿童保育；托儿服务

e.en: Affordable {childcare} is a major issue for working parents.
e.zh: 负担得起的托儿服务是上班父母的一大难题。

e.en: The company offers on-site {childcare} for its employees.
e.zh: 公司为员工提供现场托儿服务。

e.en: Byron's poem follows {Childe} Harold across war-torn Europe.
e.zh: 拜伦的诗描绘了恰尔德·哈罗德游历饱受战乱的欧洲。

e.en: In the ballad, the young {childe} sets out on a quest.
e.zh: 在那首民谣里,年轻的少爷踏上了冒险之旅。

e.en: She has fond memories of her {childhood} in the countryside.
e.zh: 她对乡村的童年时光有美好的回忆。

e.en: {Childhood} obesity rates have risen sharply in recent decades.
e.zh: 近几十年儿童肥胖率急剧上升。

e.en: Stop making {childish} excuses and take responsibility.
e.zh: 别再找幼稚的借口了,承担起责任吧。

e.en: His {childish} delight at the snowfall made everyone smile.
e.zh: 他对降雪那种孩子般的喜悦让大家都笑了。

e.en: He {childishly} refused to apologize after the argument.
e.zh: 吵架后他孩子气地拒绝道歉。

e.en: She {childishly} stuck out her tongue at her brother.
e.zh: 她孩子气地朝弟弟吐舌头。

e.en: His constant {childishness} during meetings frustrated the whole team.
e.zh: 他开会时一贯的幼稚行为让整个团队都很恼火。

e.en: There's a charming {childishness} in her excitement for snow.
e.zh: 她对雪的兴奋中带着一种可爱的孩子气。

e.en: The couple chose to remain {childless} and travel the world.
e.zh: 这对夫妇选择不生孩子,环游世界。

e.en: More {childless} couples are adopting pets instead these days.
e.zh: 如今越来越多没有孩子的夫妇选择养宠物。

e.en: They struggled with {childlessness} for nearly a decade.
e.zh: 他们为没有孩子苦恼了将近十年。

e.en: Voluntary {childlessness} is becoming more accepted in many societies.
e.zh: 主动选择不生育在许多社会中越来越被接受。

childlike.t: adj. 像孩子般的；天真纯朴的

e.en: She has a {childlike} wonder when looking at the stars.
e.zh: 她仰望星空时带着孩子般的好奇。

e.en: His {childlike} honesty makes everyone trust him instantly.
e.zh: 他孩童般的真诚让所有人立刻信任他。

e.en: The poster urged kids in trouble to call {Childline}.
e.zh: 海报呼吁遇到困难的孩子拨打儿童热线。

e.en: {Childline} counselors offer free, confidential support to young people.
e.zh: 儿童热线辅导员为青少年提供免费保密的帮助。

e.en: Could you {childmind} my niece while I run errands?
e.zh: 我去办事的时候你能帮我照看一下侄女吗?

e.en: She earns extra money by helping {childmind} on weekends.
e.zh: 她周末通过帮人看孩子赚点外快。

childminder.t: n. (受雇) 照看儿童的人

e.en: Our {childminder} picks up the kids from school each day.
e.zh: 我们的保姆每天去学校接孩子。

e.en: Finding a reliable {childminder} took us several months.
e.zh: 找一个可靠的看护人花了我们好几个月。

e.en: Modern {childrearing} emphasizes emotional intelligence over strict discipline.
e.zh: 现代育儿更重视情商而非严格管教。

e.en: They share {childrearing} duties equally between both parents.
e.zh: 他们夫妻俩平等分担育儿责任。

children.t: n. 孩子们 (child 的复数)

e.en: The {children} ran outside as soon as the rain stopped.
e.zh: 雨一停孩子们就跑到外面去了。

e.en: Most {children} learn to read between ages five and seven.
e.zh: 大多数孩子在五到七岁之间学会阅读。

childs.t: n. child 的所有格/变体

e.en: In yoga, {child's} pose helps relax the lower back.
e.zh: 瑜伽中的婴儿式有助于放松下背部。

e.en: A {child's} curiosity often leads to surprising questions.
e.zh: 孩子的好奇心常常引出令人意想不到的问题。

e.en: We're flying to {Chile} to hike in Patagonia next month.
e.zh: 我们下个月要飞智利去巴塔哥尼亚徒步。

e.en: She added a roasted green {chile} to the breakfast burrito.
e.zh: 她在早餐卷饼里加了一根烤青椒。

chilean.t:
adj. 智利的
n. 智利人

e.en: The {Chilean} wine paired beautifully with our grilled steak.
e.zh: 那款智利红酒和我们的烤牛排搭配得恰到好处。

e.en: My new coworker is a {Chilean} engineer from Santiago.
e.zh: 我的新同事是一位来自圣地亚哥的智利工程师。

e.en: He added extra {chili} flakes to spice up the pasta.
e.zh: 他往意面里多撒了些辣椒片提味。

e.en: Nothing beats a hot bowl of {chili} on a cold night.
e.zh: 寒夜里没什么比一碗热腾腾的辣肉酱更舒服的了。

e.en: The salsa has three types of {chilis} blended together.
e.zh: 这款莎莎酱混合了三种辣椒。

e.en: She dried the {chilis} on a string in the sun.
e.zh: 她把辣椒串起来晒在阳光下。

chill.t:
n. 寒意；寒冷
v. 冷藏；放松

e.en: Let's just {chill} at home and watch a movie.
e.zh: 我们就在家放松看电影吧。

e.en: There's a sudden {chill} in the autumn air.
e.zh: 秋天的空气里突然有了一丝寒意。

e.en: She served the white wine nicely {chilled}.
e.zh: 她把白葡萄酒冰镇好后端上来。

e.en: He felt {chilled} after walking home in the rain.
e.zh: 他冒雨走回家后觉得浑身发冷。

e.en: That horror movie is a real {chiller}.
e.zh: 那部恐怖片真是让人毛骨悚然。

e.en: The drinks are kept in the {chiller} behind the counter.
e.zh: 饮料存放在柜台后面的冷藏柜里。

chilli.t: n. 辣椒 (chili 的英式拼写)

e.en: Add a pinch of {chilli} powder to the soup.
e.zh: 在汤里加一小撮辣椒粉。

e.en: This curry has way too much {chilli} for me.
e.zh: 这道咖喱对我来说太辣了。

chilling.t: adj. 令人恐惧的；寒冷的

e.en: The documentary tells a {chilling} story of survival.
e.zh: 这部纪录片讲述了一个令人不寒而栗的求生故事。

e.en: We spent the afternoon {chilling} by the pool.
e.zh: 我们整个下午都在泳池边放松。

e.en: The witness described the scene {chillingly} calmly.
e.zh: 目击者出奇冷静地描述了现场,令人不寒而栗。

e.en: His prediction sounds {chillingly} accurate today.
e.zh: 他的预言在今天听来准确得令人胆寒。

e.en: Fresh {chillis} from the market add real flavor.
e.zh: 市场上买的新鲜辣椒能带出真正的香味。

e.en: She grows red and green {chillis} on the balcony.
e.zh: 她在阳台上种了红辣椒和青辣椒。

e.en: The fever gave him {chills} all night.
e.zh: 发烧让他整夜发冷打颤。

e.en: That ghost story still sends {chills} down my spine.
e.zh: 那个鬼故事至今仍让我背脊发凉。

e.en: It's a bit {chilly} this morning—bring a jacket.
e.zh: 今早有点冷,带件外套吧。

e.en: The boss gave us a {chilly} reception in the meeting.
e.zh: 老板在会议上对我们态度冷淡。

chiltern.t: n. 奇尔特恩 (英国地名)

e.en: We hiked through the {Chiltern} hills last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们徒步穿越了奇尔特恩丘陵。

e.en: The MP applied for the {Chiltern} Hundreds to resign.
e.zh: 那位议员申请奇尔特恩百户邑职位以辞职。

e.en: I picked up a {Chilton} repair manual for my old car.
e.zh: 我为我的旧车买了一本奇尔顿修理手册。

e.en: The village of {Chilton} sits quietly in the countryside.
e.zh: 奇尔顿村静静地坐落在乡间。

chime.t:
n. 钟声；和谐音
v. 鸣响

e.en: The doorbell {chime} woke the baby up.
e.zh: 门铃声把宝宝吵醒了。

e.en: Feel free to {chime} in if you have ideas.
e.zh: 如果你有想法欢迎随时插话。

chimera.t: n. 妄想；希腊神话中的怪兽

e.en: Lasting peace in the region remains a {chimera}.
e.zh: 该地区的持久和平仍是一个空想。

e.en: The ancient Greek {chimera} breathed fire from its mouth.
e.zh: 古希腊的奇美拉怪兽口中喷火。

e.en: Scientists created a {chimeric} antibody for the new therapy.
e.zh: 科学家为新疗法制造了一种嵌合抗体。

e.en: His plan sounded ambitious but was largely {chimeric}.
e.zh: 他的计划听起来雄心勃勃,但基本是空想。

chimerical.t: adj. 妄想的；不切实际的

e.en: Hopes for instant wealth turned out to be {chimerical}.
e.zh: 一夜暴富的希望最终被证明是虚幻的。

e.en: He chases {chimerical} dreams instead of real goals.
e.zh: 他追逐虚幻的梦想,而不是实际的目标。

chiming.t: v. 鸣响 (chime 的现在分词)

e.en: The clock was {chiming} midnight as we arrived.
e.zh: 我们到达时,时钟正敲响午夜的钟声。

e.en: I love the sound of bells {chiming} in the distance.
e.zh: 我喜欢远处钟声鸣响的声音。

e.en: Smoke curled gently from the {chimney} of the cottage.
e.zh: 袅袅炊烟从小屋的烟囱里飘出。

e.en: He smokes like a {chimney} when he's stressed.
e.zh: 他压力大时抽烟像烟囱一样凶。

e.en: A vintage clock sat on the carved {chimneypiece}.
e.zh: 一个老式时钟摆在雕花的壁炉架上。

e.en: She hung family photos above the marble {chimneypiece}.
e.zh: 她在大理石壁炉架上方挂了家庭照片。

e.en: Old factory {chimneys} still tower over the town.
e.zh: 老厂房的烟囱仍然高耸在小镇上空。

e.en: Birds sometimes nest inside unused {chimneys}.
e.zh: 鸟有时会在废弃的烟囱里筑巢。

chimp.t: n. 黑猩猩 (chimpanzee 的缩写)

e.en: The young {chimp} swung playfully from branch to branch.
e.zh: 那只小黑猩猩在树枝间欢快地荡来荡去。

e.en: Researchers taught the {chimp} basic sign language.
e.zh: 研究人员教会了那只黑猩猩基本的手语。

e.en: A {chimpanzee} shares about 98% of human DNA.
e.zh: 黑猩猩与人类的DNA相似度约为百分之九十八。

e.en: The {chimpanzee} cracked open the nut with a stone.
e.zh: 那只黑猩猩用石头敲开了坚果。

e.en: Wild {chimpanzees} live in tight social groups.
e.zh: 野生黑猩猩生活在紧密的社群中。

e.en: The sanctuary cares for over forty rescued {chimpanzees}.
e.zh: 该保护区照顾着四十多只获救的黑猩猩。

e.en: He rested his {chin} on his hand while thinking.
e.zh: 他思考时把下巴托在手上。

e.en: Keep your {chin} up—things will get better soon.
e.zh: 打起精神来,情况很快会好转。

china.t:
n. 中国
n. 瓷器

e.en: Grandma only uses the good {china} on holidays.
e.zh: 奶奶只在节日才用那套好瓷器。

e.en: The vase is made of delicate hand-painted {china}.
e.zh: 这个花瓶是手工彩绘的精致瓷器。

e.en: A tall {chinaberry} tree shaded the front porch.
e.zh: 一棵高大的楝树为前廊遮阴。

e.en: The {chinaberry} produces small yellow fruits in autumn.
e.zh: 楝树在秋天会结出小小的黄色果实。

chinaman.t: n. (旧, 含贬义) 中国人

e.en: The novel's outdated use of {chinaman} feels offensive today.
e.zh: 小说中过时的“中国佬”一词如今显得带有冒犯性。

e.en: The bowler delivered a tricky {chinaman} to the batter.
e.zh: 投球手向击球手投出了一个刁钻的左手腕旋球。

e.en: We grabbed dim sum in {Chinatown} on Sunday morning.
e.zh: 周日早上我们在唐人街吃了点心。

e.en: The lanterns in {Chinatown} glow brightly during the festival.
e.zh: 节日期间唐人街的灯笼亮得璀璨。

e.en: Her pet {chinchilla} loves to take dust baths.
e.zh: 她养的龙猫很喜欢洗沙浴。

e.en: The coat was once made from soft {chinchilla} fur.
e.zh: 这件大衣过去是用柔软的栗鼠皮制成的。

e.en: The butcher trimmed fat from the pork {chine}.
e.zh: 屠夫修去了猪脊肉上的肥肉。

e.en: A narrow {chine} ran down to the pebbled beach.
e.zh: 一条狭窄的山涧通向满是鹅卵石的海滩。

chinese.t:
adj. 中国的
n. 中文；中国人

e.en: She's been studying {Chinese} for over five years.
e.zh: 她学中文已经超过五年了。

e.en: Let's order {Chinese} food for dinner tonight.
e.zh: 我们今晚点中餐吃吧。

e.en: Coins fell with a bright {ching} into the jar.
e.zh: 硬币叮当一声清脆地落进罐子里。

e.en: The {Ching} dynasty ruled China for nearly three centuries.
e.zh: 清朝统治中国近三个世纪。

chink.t:
n. 裂缝、缝隙
n. (蔑称) 中国人

e.en: Sunlight streamed through a {chink} in the curtains.
e.zh: 阳光从窗帘的一道缝隙中透了进来。

e.en: His confidence finally showed a small {chink}.
e.zh: 他的自信终于露出了一丝破绽。

chinless.t: adj. 下巴后缩的；懦弱无能的

e.en: The cartoon villain had a comically {chinless} face.
e.zh: 这个卡通反派长着一张滑稽的没下巴的脸。

e.en: Critics called the manager a {chinless} pushover.
e.zh: 评论家称那位经理是个软弱无能的人。

chino.t: n. 斜纹棉布裤；卡其布

e.en: He paired a navy {chino} with a white shirt.
e.zh: 他把藏青色斜纹棉布裤搭配了一件白衬衫。

e.en: This {chino} fabric is breathable and easy to wash.
e.zh: 这种斜纹棉布料透气又好洗。

chinoiserie.t: n. 中国风艺术（装饰风格）

e.en: The hotel lobby is decorated in elegant {chinoiserie}.
e.zh: 酒店大堂装饰着典雅的中国风艺术。

e.en: Her wallpaper features colorful {chinoiserie} birds and flowers.
e.zh: 她的壁纸上有色彩缤纷的中国风花鸟图案。

chinook.t:
n. 奇努克焚风
n. 奇努克族

e.en: A warm {chinook} wind melted the snow overnight.
e.zh: 一阵温暖的钦诺克风一夜之间融化了积雪。

e.en: The river was full of leaping {chinook} salmon.
e.zh: 河里满是跃出水面的奇努克鲑鱼。

chins.t:
n. 下巴 (复数)
v. 引体向上

e.en: Both brothers have strong square {chins}.
e.zh: 兄弟俩都有着坚毅的方下巴。

e.en: The boys did pull-ups until their {chins} cleared the bar.
e.zh: 男孩们做引体向上,直到下巴超过单杠。

chinstrap.t: n. (头盔、帽子的) 下巴系带

e.en: Tighten the {chinstrap} before riding your bike.
e.zh: 骑车前先把下巴带系紧。

e.en: He grew a neat {chinstrap} beard along his jawline.
e.zh: 他沿着下颌线留了一圈整齐的络腮胡。

e.en: Grandma's sofa was covered in floral {chintz}.
e.zh: 奶奶的沙发上罩着花卉印花棉布。

e.en: The cottage curtains were old-fashioned pink {chintz}.
e.zh: 小屋的窗帘是老式的粉色印花棉布。

chintzy.t: adj. 廉价俗气的；小气的

e.en: The hotel's decor felt cheap and {chintzy}.
e.zh: 那家酒店的装潢显得廉价又俗气。

e.en: Don't be {chintzy} with the tip if service was good.
e.zh: 如果服务不错,别在小费上太小气。

chinwag.t:
n. 闲聊、唠嗑
v. 闲谈

e.en: We had a long {chinwag} over coffee yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天我们边喝咖啡边长聊了一番。

e.en: Mum loves a good {chinwag} with the neighbours.
e.zh: 妈妈很喜欢和邻居们闲聊。

chip.t:
n. 芯片；薯片
n. 碎片、缺口

e.en: The new phone uses a faster {chip} than last year's model.
e.zh: 这款新手机用的芯片比去年的快。

e.en: There's a small {chip} on the rim of this mug.
e.zh: 这个马克杯的边缘有一个小缺口。

e.en: The cheap shelf is just laminated {chipboard}.
e.zh: 那个便宜的架子只是覆膜的刨花板。

e.en: Water damage made the {chipboard} swell and crumble.
e.zh: 水渍让刨花板膨胀变形,逐渐碎裂。

e.en: The {chipmaker} announced record profits this quarter.
e.zh: 这家芯片制造商宣布本季度利润创纪录。

e.en: Taiwan is home to the world's largest {chipmaker}.
e.zh: 台湾是全球最大芯片制造商的所在地。

e.en: A tiny {chipmunk} darted across the hiking trail.
e.zh: 一只小花栗鼠飞快地窜过登山小径。

e.en: The {chipmunk} stuffed its cheeks with sunflower seeds.
e.zh: 花栗鼠把腮帮子塞满了葵花籽。

e.en: The sauce gets its smoky flavor from {chipotle} peppers.
e.zh: 这款酱料的烟熏味来自烟熏墨西哥辣椒。

e.en: I added a spoonful of {chipotle} to the marinade.
e.zh: 我在腌料里加了一勺烟熏辣椒酱。

chipped.t:
adj. 有缺口的、崩口的
v. chip 的过去式

e.en: She accidentally {chipped} her front tooth on the spoon.
e.zh: 她不小心用勺子把门牙磕掉了一小块。

e.en: Everyone {chipped} in to buy a leaving gift.
e.zh: 大家凑钱买了一份告别礼物。

chippendale.t: n. 齐本德尔式家具（风格）

e.en: The auction featured a rare {Chippendale} mahogany chair.
e.zh: 拍卖会上有一把稀有的齐彭代尔式红木椅。

e.en: Her dining set is genuine eighteenth-century {Chippendale}.
e.zh: 她的餐桌椅是十八世纪正宗的齐彭代尔式家具。

chippenham.t: n. 奇彭纳姆（英国地名）

e.en: The train to {Chippenham} leaves in ten minutes.
e.zh: 开往奇彭纳姆的火车十分钟后发车。

e.en: She grew up in a small village near {Chippenham}.
e.zh: 她在奇彭纳姆附近的一个小村庄长大。

chipper.t:
adj. 活泼开朗的
n. 碎木机

e.en: She sounded {chipper} on the phone this morning.
e.zh: 她今早在电话里听起来很开朗。

e.en: The gardener fed branches into the wood {chipper}.
e.zh: 园丁把树枝送进木材碎木机里。

chippie.t: n. (英俚) 炸鱼薯条店；木匠

e.en: We grabbed dinner from the {chippie} on the corner.
e.zh: 我们在街角的炸鱼薯条店买了晚餐。

e.en: The local {chippie} closes early on Sundays.
e.zh: 本地那家炸鱼薯条店周日很早就关门。

chipping.t:
n. 碎片、石屑
v. 削、凿

e.en: The old paint is {chipping} off the window frame.
e.zh: 窗框上的旧漆正在剥落。

e.en: He kept {chipping} away at the marble block.
e.zh: 他不停地一点点凿着那块大理石。

chippy.t:
n. (英俚) 炸鱼薯条店
adj. 易怒的

e.en: He gets a bit {chippy} whenever someone questions his work.
e.zh: 每当有人质疑他的工作,他就会有点不耐烦。

e.en: Let's stop by the {chippy} for fish and chips.
e.zh: 我们去炸鱼薯条店买点炸鱼薯条吧。

chips.t:
n. 薯片；(英) 薯条
n. 芯片 (复数)

e.en: She opened a bag of {chips} during the movie.
e.zh: 她看电影时打开了一袋薯片。

e.en: He bet all his {chips} on the final hand.
e.zh: 他在最后一局押上了所有筹码。

e.en: The new laptop uses an energy-efficient {chipset}.
e.zh: 这款新笔记本采用了节能的芯片组。

e.en: Driver updates can boost {chipset} performance noticeably.
e.zh: 驱动更新能明显提升芯片组的性能。

chirac.t: n. 希拉克（法国前总统）

e.en: Jacques {Chirac} served as president of France for twelve years.
e.zh: 雅克·希拉克担任法国总统长达十二年。

e.en: The documentary revisits {Chirac}'s diplomatic legacy.
e.zh: 这部纪录片回顾了希拉克的外交遗产。

e.en: Many drugs contain {chiral} molecules with mirror-image forms.
e.zh: 许多药物含有具有镜像结构的手性分子。

e.en: Our hands are a classic example of {chiral} objects.
e.zh: 我们的双手是手性物体的经典例子。

e.en: The drug's {chirality} affects how it binds to receptors.
e.zh: 该药物的手性影响它与受体的结合方式。

e.en: Researchers measured the {chirality} of the new molecule.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了这种新分子的手性。

chirk.t: adj. 愉快的；使振作 (罕用)

e.en: A hot meal will {chirk} you up after the long hike.
e.zh: 长途徒步后吃顿热饭会让你振作起来。

e.en: Her visit always seems to {chirk} the patients.
e.zh: 她的探访总能让病人们打起精神。

e.en: A swarm of {chironomid} midges hovered above the lake.
e.zh: 一群摇蚊在湖面上空盘旋。

e.en: Biologists study {chironomid} larvae as water quality indicators.
e.zh: 生物学家把摇蚊幼虫作为水质指标来研究。

e.en: The {chiropodist} treated my ingrown toenail in minutes.
e.zh: 足病医生几分钟就处理好了我的嵌甲。

e.en: My grandmother sees a {chiropodist} every two months.
e.zh: 我奶奶每两个月看一次足病医生。

e.en: She studied {chiropody} for three years before opening a clinic.
e.zh: 她学了三年足病学才开了诊所。

e.en: Diabetics often need regular {chiropody} care.
e.zh: 糖尿病患者通常需要定期的足部护理。

e.en: He tried {chiropractic} treatment for his chronic back pain.
e.zh: 他尝试了脊椎按摩疗法来治慢性背痛。

e.en: Insurance now covers some {chiropractic} sessions.
e.zh: 保险现在能报销部分脊椎按摩治疗费用。

e.en: My {chiropractor} adjusted my neck and the headache eased.
e.zh: 我的脊椎按摩师给我调整了颈椎,头痛就缓解了。

e.en: She booked an appointment with a new {chiropractor}.
e.zh: 她预约了一位新的脊椎按摩师。

chirp.t:
v. (鸟、虫) 鸣叫
n. 啁啾声

e.en: I heard a sparrow {chirp} outside my window.
e.zh: 我听见一只麻雀在窗外啁啾。

e.en: My phone gave a cheerful {chirp} when the message arrived.
e.zh: 消息到达时,我的手机欢快地响了一声。

chirping.t:
v. 鸣叫中
n. 鸟鸣声

e.en: The crickets were {chirping} all through the warm night.
e.zh: 整个温暖的夜晚蟋蟀都在鸣叫。

e.en: Birds started {chirping} just before sunrise.
e.zh: 鸟儿在日出前就开始啾啾叫了。

chirps.t:
v. 鸣叫 (第三人称)
n. 啁啾声

e.en: The smoke alarm {chirps} when its battery runs low.
e.zh: 烟雾报警器电量低时会发出短促的提示音。

e.en: A robin {chirps} happily on the fence each morning.
e.zh: 每天早上一只知更鸟都在篱笆上欢快地鸣叫。

chirpy.t: adj. 欢快的、兴高采烈的

e.en: She was unusually {chirpy} after her morning coffee.
e.zh: 喝完早晨的咖啡后,她格外活泼开朗。

e.en: His {chirpy} tone lifted everyone's mood.
e.zh: 他欢快的语气让大家心情都好起来了。

chisel.t:
n. 凿子
v. 雕凿、欺骗

e.en: He used a {chisel} to carve the wooden figurine.
e.zh: 他用凿子雕刻那个木雕小像。

e.en: The sculptor began to {chisel} away at the stone.
e.zh: 雕塑家开始一下下凿那块石头。

chiseled.t: adj. 轮廓分明的；雕凿过的

e.en: The actor has a famously {chiseled} jawline.
e.zh: 这位演员以轮廓分明的下颌线而闻名。

e.en: She {chiseled} her initials into the soft sandstone.
e.zh: 她在松软的砂岩上刻下了自己的姓名缩写。

chiseling.t: v. 雕凿中；(俚) 欺诈

e.en: He spent hours {chiseling} the marble into shape.
e.zh: 他花了好几个小时把大理石凿出形状。

e.en: The contractor was caught {chiseling} customers on materials.
e.zh: 那个承包商被发现在材料上欺骗顾客。

chiselled.t: adj. 轮廓分明的（英式拼写）

e.en: The statue's {chiselled} features looked remarkably lifelike.
e.zh: 雕像那雕琢精细的五官看上去栩栩如生。

e.en: He {chiselled} a small groove along the wooden plank.
e.zh: 他沿着木板凿出了一道小凹槽。

chisels.t:
n. 凿子 (复数)
v. 雕凿

e.en: The carpenter keeps his {chisels} razor sharp.
e.zh: 木匠把他的凿子磨得像剃刀一样锋利。

e.en: She {chisels} delicate patterns into each silver pendant.
e.zh: 她在每个银吊坠上雕刻精致的花纹。

e.en: Shirley {Chisholm} was the first Black woman elected to Congress.
e.zh: 雪莉·奇泽姆是首位当选美国国会议员的黑人女性。

e.en: The biography traces {Chisholm}'s groundbreaking political career.
e.zh: 这本传记记录了奇泽姆开创性的政治生涯。

e.en: They moved to {Chiswick} for the quieter riverside streets.
e.zh: 他们搬到了奇斯威克,图的是河边那些安静的街道。

e.en: The cafe in {Chiswick} serves the best brunch in west London.
e.zh: 奇斯威克那家咖啡馆的早午餐是西伦敦最棒的。

chit.t:
n. 便条、字据
n. 小丫头

e.en: Sign this {chit} so we can charge it to your room.
e.zh: 签一下这张单据,我们就可以记到你房费上。

e.en: The waiter handed me a small {chit} for the drinks.
e.zh: 服务员递给我一张写着饮料的小单子。

chitchat.t:
n. 闲聊、闲谈
v. 闲聊

e.en: We made polite {chitchat} while waiting for the meeting to start.
e.zh: 等会议开始时我们客气地闲聊了几句。

e.en: Let's skip the {chitchat} and get to the point.
e.zh: 我们别闲聊了,直接说重点吧。

e.en: Insect shells are made largely of {chitin}.
e.zh: 昆虫的外壳主要由几丁质构成。

e.en: Researchers extract {chitin} from shrimp shells for medical use.
e.zh: 研究人员从虾壳中提取几丁质用于医疗用途。

e.en: The beetle's {chitinous} armor protects it from predators.
e.zh: 甲虫的几丁质外壳能保护它免受捕食者侵害。

e.en: Crabs have a tough {chitinous} exoskeleton.
e.zh: 螃蟹有一层坚硬的几丁质外骨骼。

e.en: Grandma served {chitlins} with hot sauce every New Year's Day.
e.zh: 奶奶每年元旦都会做猪肠配辣酱。

e.en: Many Southern families still cook {chitlins} for the holidays.
e.zh: 许多美国南方家庭过节时仍会做猪肠这道菜。

chitter.t:
v. (鸟) 啁啾鸣叫
v. 牙齿打颤

e.en: Squirrels {chitter} angrily when you approach their tree.
e.zh: 靠近松鼠的树时,它们会愤怒地吱吱叫。

e.en: Her teeth began to {chitter} in the freezing wind.
e.zh: 在刺骨的寒风中,她的牙齿开始打颤。

e.en: You'll need a {chitty} from reception to enter the lounge.
e.zh: 你需要前台开的一张凭条才能进入贵宾室。

e.en: The clerk stamped a {chitty} for my parcel pickup.
e.zh: 职员盖章后给了我一张取包裹的凭条。

e.en: The novel romanticizes the {chivalric} ideals of medieval knights.
e.zh: 这部小说将中世纪骑士的骑士精神理想化了。

e.en: He still follows an old-fashioned {chivalric} code.
e.zh: 他仍然遵循一套老派的骑士行为准则。

chivalrous.t: adj. 有骑士风度的；殷勤的

e.en: It was {chivalrous} of him to give up his seat.
e.zh: 他让出座位的举动很有绅士风度。

e.en: Her grandfather had impeccably {chivalrous} manners.
e.zh: 她祖父举止彬彬有礼,堪称骑士风范。

e.en: Some say {chivalry} is dead in the dating world.
e.zh: 有人说在如今的约会圈里,绅士风度已经不复存在了。

e.en: Medieval knights swore to uphold the code of {chivalry}.
e.zh: 中世纪骑士发誓要恪守骑士守则。

e.en: Sprinkle a little {chive} over the baked potato.
e.zh: 在烤土豆上撒一点细香葱。

e.en: She grows a small {chive} plant on her windowsill.
e.zh: 她在窗台上种了一小盆细香葱。

chives.t: n. 细香葱（chive 的复数）

e.en: Fresh {chives} add a mild onion flavor to omelets.
e.zh: 新鲜细香葱能给煎蛋卷增添淡淡的洋葱香味。

e.en: He chopped some {chives} to garnish the soup.
e.zh: 他切了一些细香葱用来点缀汤。

e.en: I had to {chivvy} the kids out the door for school.
e.zh: 我得催着孩子们出门去上学。

e.en: Don't {chivvy} him; he'll finish the report on time.
e.zh: 别催他了,他会按时完成报告的。

e.en: Doctors recommend yearly screening for {chlamydia} in young adults.
e.zh: 医生建议年轻人每年做一次衣原体筛查。

e.en: {Chlamydia} can be treated effectively with antibiotics.
e.zh: 衣原体感染可以用抗生素有效治疗。

e.en: Old prescriptions sometimes included {chloral} hydrate as a sedative.
e.zh: 过去的处方有时会把水合氯醛用作镇静剂。

e.en: The lab carefully stored its supply of {chloral}.
e.zh: 实验室小心地存放着其库存的三氯乙醛。

e.en: Many cities now use {chloramine} instead of chlorine to disinfect water.
e.zh: 许多城市现在用氯胺代替氯来消毒自来水。

e.en: {Chloramine} can damage rubber seals in old plumbing.
e.zh: 氯胺会损坏旧管道里的橡胶密封圈。

e.en: Doctors prescribed {chloramphenicol} for the stubborn eye infection.
e.zh: 医生给这顽固的眼部感染开了氯霉素。

e.en: {Chloramphenicol} is rarely used today due to side effects.
e.zh: 氯霉素因副作用较大,如今已很少使用。

e.en: {Chlordane} was banned after researchers linked it to cancer.
e.zh: 在研究人员把氯丹与癌症联系起来后,它就被禁用了。

e.en: Old homes may still contain {chlordane} in the soil.
e.zh: 老房子周围的土壤里可能仍残留有氯丹。

e.en: Sodium {chloride} is just the chemical name for table salt.
e.zh: 氯化钠其实就是食盐的化学名称。

e.en: High {chloride} levels can corrode metal pipes.
e.zh: 较高的氯化物含量会腐蚀金属管道。

chlorinate.t: v. 用氯消毒；氯化处理

e.en: City workers {chlorinate} the pool every Monday morning.
e.zh: 市政工人每周一早上给泳池加氯消毒。

e.en: They {chlorinate} the drinking water to kill bacteria.
e.zh: 他们给饮用水加氯以杀灭细菌。

chlorinated.t: adj. 含氯的；经氯消毒的

e.en: The {chlorinated} pool stung my eyes a little.
e.zh: 加了氯的泳池水有点刺眼。

e.en: Most tap water in the city is heavily {chlorinated}.
e.zh: 这座城市的大部分自来水都加了较多的氯。

chlorination.t: n. 加氯消毒；氯化处理

e.en: {Chlorination} dramatically reduced waterborne diseases in the last century.
e.zh: 上世纪的氯化消毒大幅减少了水传播疾病。

e.en: The plant uses {chlorination} as its main disinfection step.
e.zh: 该工厂以氯化处理作为主要的消毒步骤。

e.en: My hair smells like {chlorine} after swimming.
e.zh: 游完泳后我的头发有股氯水味。

e.en: They added more {chlorine} to keep the pool clean.
e.zh: 他们加了更多的氯来保持泳池清洁。

e.en: The green flecks in the rock are {chlorite} crystals.
e.zh: 岩石中的绿色斑点是绿泥石晶体。

e.en: Geologists identified {chlorite} in the metamorphic samples.
e.zh: 地质学家在变质岩样本中鉴定出了绿泥石。

e.en: Each {chlorofluorocarbon} molecule can destroy thousands of ozone molecules.
e.zh: 每个氟氯化碳分子能破坏数千个臭氧分子。

e.en: Old fridges often leaked {chlorofluorocarbon} gases into the atmosphere.
e.zh: 旧冰箱常会向大气泄漏氟氯化碳气体。

e.en: The villain soaked a rag in {chloroform} in old movies.
e.zh: 老电影里反派常把破布浸满氯仿。

e.en: Chemists once used {chloroform} as a common laboratory solvent.
e.zh: 化学家曾把氯仿当作常用的实验室溶剂。

e.en: Plants use {chlorophyll} to absorb sunlight for photosynthesis.
e.zh: 植物利用叶绿素吸收阳光进行光合作用。

e.en: Leaves turn yellow when {chlorophyll} breaks down in autumn.
e.zh: 秋天叶绿素分解时,树叶就会变黄。

e.en: Each {chloroplast} contains stacks of green pigment-filled membranes.
e.zh: 每个叶绿体内含有一摞摞充满绿色色素的膜。

e.en: The {chloroplast} is where plant cells produce sugar from light.
e.zh: 叶绿体是植物细胞利用光合成糖分的地方。

e.en: Travelers took {chloroquine} to prevent malaria in tropical regions.
e.zh: 旅行者服用氯喹以预防热带地区的疟疾。

e.en: Many parasites have grown resistant to {chloroquine} over the decades.
e.zh: 几十年来许多寄生虫已对氯喹产生抗药性。

e.en: Several states banned {chlorpyrifos} due to risks to children.
e.zh: 由于对儿童的风险,数个州禁用了毒死蜱。

e.en: Farmers once sprayed {chlorpyrifos} widely on corn and soybeans.
e.zh: 农民曾在玉米和大豆上大量喷洒毒死蜱。

cho.t: (罕用) 姓氏「曺/赵」的罗马字

e.en: Professor {Cho} teaches East Asian history at the university.
e.zh: 赵教授在这所大学讲授东亚历史。

e.en: Margaret {Cho} is known for her sharp stand-up comedy.
e.zh: 玛格丽特·赵以犀利的脱口秀闻名。

choc.t: n. 巧克力（chocolate 的口语简写）

e.en: Fancy a {choc} biscuit with your afternoon tea?
e.zh: 下午茶要来块巧克力饼干吗?

e.en: He grabbed a {choc} ice from the freezer after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他从冰箱里拿了一支巧克力雪糕。

chock.t:
n. 垫木；楔块
v. 用楔子塞住

e.en: The mechanic placed a {chock} behind the truck's rear wheel.
e.zh: 机修工在卡车后轮后面垫了一块楔子。

e.en: Her schedule is {chock} full of meetings this week.
e.zh: 她这周的日程被会议塞得满满当当。

e.en: My sister is a total {chocoholic} who hides truffles everywhere.
e.zh: 我妹妹是个超级巧克力狂,到处藏松露巧克力。

e.en: As a self-proclaimed {chocoholic}, he collects rare cocoa bars.
e.zh: 作为自封的巧克力痴,他专门收藏稀有可可棒。

chocolate.t:
n. 巧克力
adj. 巧克力色的

e.en: She gave me a box of dark {chocolate} for my birthday.
e.zh: 她送了我一盒黑巧克力作为生日礼物。

e.en: Pour the warm {chocolate} sauce over the vanilla ice cream.
e.zh: 把温热的巧克力酱浇在香草冰淇淋上。

e.en: He brought a heart-shaped box of {chocolates} on Valentine's Day.
e.zh: 情人节他带来一盒心形包装的巧克力。

e.en: The hotel left two complimentary {chocolates} on each pillow.
e.zh: 酒店在每个枕头上放了两颗赠送的巧克力。

chocolatier.t: n. 巧克力制造商；巧克力师

e.en: A Belgian {chocolatier} hand-crafts every truffle in this shop.
e.zh: 这家店每颗松露巧克力都由比利时巧克力师手工制作。

e.en: She trained as a {chocolatier} in Paris for three years.
e.zh: 她在巴黎学习巧克力工艺整整三年。

chocolaty.t: adj. 巧克力味的；像巧克力的

e.en: This stout has a rich, {chocolaty} finish on the palate.
e.zh: 这款世涛口感浓郁,余味带着巧克力香。

e.en: The cake was dense, fudgy, and intensely {chocolaty}.
e.zh: 这款蛋糕扎实软糯,巧克力味十分浓郁。

choi.t: n. 菜（粤语音译，如 bok choi 白菜）

e.en: Stir-fry the bok {choi} with garlic and a little soy sauce.
e.zh: 用蒜和少许酱油爆炒小白菜。

e.en: Director {Choi} won best film at the Busan festival.
e.zh: 崔导演在釜山电影节上拿下了最佳影片奖。

choice.t:
n. 选择；选项
adj. 精选的

e.en: Picking a college is a really tough {choice} for teenagers.
e.zh: 选大学对青少年来说是个非常艰难的选择。

e.en: You have no {choice} but to restart the router.
e.zh: 除了重启路由器,你别无选择。

e.en: The menu offers plenty of vegetarian {choices} for diners.
e.zh: 菜单为食客提供了许多素食选项。

e.en: Small daily {choices} shape who you become over time.
e.zh: 日常的小选择会逐渐塑造你成为怎样的人。

e.en: The chef hand-picks the {choicest} cuts of beef each morning.
e.zh: 主厨每天清晨亲自挑选最上等的牛肉。

e.en: Only the {choicest} grapes go into their reserve wines.
e.zh: 只有最优质的葡萄才会用来酿造他们的珍藏酒。

e.en: The school {choir} performs at the town hall every Christmas.
e.zh: 学校合唱团每年圣诞都在市政厅演出。

e.en: He has sung in the church {choir} since he was eight.
e.zh: 他从八岁起就在教堂唱诗班唱歌。

e.en: As a {choirboy}, he wore a white robe every Sunday.
e.zh: 当唱诗班男童时,他每个星期天都穿白色长袍。

e.en: The senator is no {choirboy} despite his polished image.
e.zh: 那位参议员形象虽光鲜,实则并非什么乖宝宝。

e.en: The {choirmaster} tapped his baton to start the rehearsal.
e.zh: 合唱指挥敲了敲指挥棒,开始排练。

e.en: A strict {choirmaster} drilled the boys in Latin hymns.
e.zh: 严厉的合唱指挥逼着男孩们苦练拉丁圣歌。

e.en: Several local {choirs} joined together for the holiday concert.
e.zh: 几个当地合唱团联合举办了节日音乐会。

e.en: Gospel {choirs} can fill a small church with sound.
e.zh: 福音合唱团能让小教堂充满洪亮的歌声。

choke.t:
v. 使窒息；哽住
n. 阻风门

e.en: Cut grapes in half so toddlers don't {choke} on them.
e.zh: 把葡萄切半,免得幼儿被噎到。

e.en: Many players {choke} under pressure in the final minutes.
e.zh: 许多球员在最后几分钟的压力下表现失常。

e.en: The {chokecherry} tree by the fence is heavy with fruit.
e.zh: 篱笆旁那棵稠李树挂满了果实。

e.en: Grandma made tart jelly from wild {chokecherry} berries.
e.zh: 奶奶用野生稠李果做了酸甜的果冻。

choked.t:
adj. 哽咽的；堵塞的
v. 窒息（过去式）

e.en: She nearly {choked} on her coffee when he told the joke.
e.zh: 他讲那个笑话时,她差点被咖啡呛到。

e.en: Weeds have {choked} the garden path since last summer.
e.zh: 自去年夏天起,杂草已堵塞了花园小径。

e.en: The referee disqualified him for using an illegal {chokehold}.
e.zh: 裁判因他使用违规锁喉而取消了他的资格。

e.en: A few corporations have a {chokehold} on the entire industry.
e.zh: 少数几家公司扼住了整个行业的咽喉。

e.en: She wore a black velvet {choker} with her evening dress.
e.zh: 她搭配晚礼服戴了一条黑色天鹅绒颈链。

e.en: Critics labeled the quarterback a {choker} after the playoffs.
e.zh: 季后赛后评论员把那位四分卫贬为关键时刻软脚虾。

e.en: Heavy traffic {chokes} the city center during rush hour.
e.zh: 高峰时段繁忙的车流堵塞了市中心。

e.en: He always {chokes} when he has to speak in public.
e.zh: 每次需要当众发言,他都会紧张得说不出话。

choking.t:
adj. 令人窒息的
v. 窒息（现在分词）

e.en: Quickly perform the Heimlich if someone is {choking} on food.
e.zh: 如果有人被食物噎住,要立刻施行海姆立克急救法。

e.en: The {choking} smoke from the wildfire reached neighboring states.
e.zh: 山火带来的呛人浓烟蔓延到了邻近几个州。

chola.t: n. 乔拉人（墨西哥裔女性）

e.en: She styled her hair in classic East L.A. {chola} fashion.
e.zh: 她把头发梳成了东洛杉矶经典的奇卡纳风。

e.en: The {chola} dynasty once ruled much of southern India.
e.zh: 朱罗王朝曾统治印度南部的大片地区。

e.en: Doctors ordered a {cholangiopancreatography} to find the bile duct stone.
e.zh: 医生安排了胆胰管造影以查找胆管结石。

e.en: Magnetic resonance {cholangiopancreatography} avoids the risks of an endoscope.
e.zh: 磁共振胆胰管造影可避免内镜检查的风险。

e.en: Acute {cholangitis} typically causes fever, jaundice, and abdominal pain.
e.zh: 急性胆管炎通常引起发烧、黄疸和腹痛。

e.en: Antibiotics and bile drainage are essential for treating {cholangitis}.
e.zh: 抗生素和胆汁引流是治疗胆管炎的关键。

e.en: He recovered quickly after his laparoscopic {cholecystectomy} last week.
e.zh: 上周做完腹腔镜胆囊切除术后,他恢复得很快。

e.en: A {cholecystectomy} removes the gallbladder to stop recurring stone attacks.
e.zh: 胆囊切除术摘除胆囊,以防结石反复发作。

e.en: Contaminated water spread {cholera} rapidly through the refugee camp.
e.zh: 受污染的水让霍乱在难民营中迅速蔓延。

e.en: Vaccines have dramatically reduced {cholera} deaths in endemic regions.
e.zh: 疫苗已大幅降低了流行地区的霍乱死亡人数。

e.en: Her {choleric} boss explodes whenever a deadline slips by an hour.
e.zh: 她那位暴躁的老板,只要工期晚一小时就会暴跳如雷。

e.en: He's known for his {choleric} outbursts during board meetings.
e.zh: 他以在董事会上动辄暴怒而出名。

e.en: Surgery is usually required to remove a {cholesteatoma} from the ear.
e.zh: 耳内的胆脂瘤通常需要手术摘除。

e.en: Untreated {cholesteatoma} can damage hearing and nearby facial nerves.
e.zh: 胆脂瘤若不治疗,会损伤听力和附近的面神经。

e.en: My doctor said my {cholesterol} levels finally dropped this year.
e.zh: 医生说我今年的胆固醇水平终于降下来了。

e.en: Eggs contain {cholesterol}, but most people can eat them safely.
e.zh: 鸡蛋含有胆固醇,但大多数人吃着没问题。

e.en: Researchers measured {cholesteryl} ester transfer in the patients' plasma.
e.zh: 研究者测量了患者血浆中的胆固醇酯转运情况。

e.en: The drug blocks a {cholesteryl} ester transfer protein in the blood.
e.zh: 该药物阻断血液中的胆固醇酯转运蛋白。

e.en: Eggs are an excellent source of {choline} for brain health.
e.zh: 鸡蛋是有益大脑健康的优质胆碱来源。

e.en: Pregnant women often need extra {choline} for fetal development.
e.zh: 孕妇常需要额外的胆碱来支持胎儿发育。

e.en: Alzheimer's drugs often boost {cholinergic} signaling in the brain.
e.zh: 阿尔茨海默症药物常用于增强脑内胆碱能信号。

e.en: Certain pesticides overstimulate the body's {cholinergic} nervous system.
e.zh: 某些农药会过度刺激人体的胆碱能神经系统。

e.en: Don't brush against the {cholla} cactus on the desert trail.
e.zh: 走沙漠小径时别碰到仙人掌跳跃丛。

e.en: Spines from the {cholla} stuck to her hiking boots.
e.zh: 跳跃仙人掌的刺粘在了她的徒步靴上。

e.en: Lord {Cholmondeley} hosted the garden party at his country estate.
e.zh: 乔姆利勋爵在乡间庄园举办了花园派对。

e.en: Surprisingly, the surname {Cholmondeley} is pronounced simply as 'Chumley'.
e.zh: 令人意外的是,姓氏 Cholmondeley 其实读作 'Chumley'。

e.en: Watch the puppy {chomp} happily on his new rubber bone.
e.zh: 看小狗开心地啃着他的新橡胶骨头。

e.en: Investors are starting to {chomp} at the bit for the IPO.
e.zh: 投资者已经开始迫不及待地等着这次上市。

chomsky.t: n. 乔姆斯基（语言学家）

e.en: Noam {Chomsky} revolutionized linguistics with his theory of universal grammar.
e.zh: 诺姆·乔姆斯基以普遍语法理论彻底改变了语言学。

e.en: Students often debate {Chomsky}'s political essays in seminar classes.
e.zh: 学生们常在研讨课上讨论乔姆斯基的政治论文。

e.en: The professor takes a strictly {Chomskyan} approach to syntax.
e.zh: 这位教授对句法采取严格的乔姆斯基派方法。

e.en: Critics argue {Chomskyan} linguistics underestimates the role of usage.
e.zh: 批评者认为乔姆斯基派语言学低估了语言使用的作用。

e.en: This {chondrite} meteorite contains tiny grains older than the sun.
e.zh: 这块球粒陨石含有比太阳还古老的微小颗粒。

e.en: Scientists study {chondrite} samples to understand the early solar system.
e.zh: 科学家研究球粒陨石以了解早期太阳系。

e.en: The asteroid has a typical {chondritic} composition rich in silicates.
e.zh: 这颗小行星具有典型的富含硅酸盐的球粒陨石成分。

e.en: Researchers compared the meteorite to known {chondritic} reference samples.
e.zh: 研究人员把该陨石与已知的球粒陨石参考样品进行比对。

e.en: Surgeons removed the {chondrosarcoma} from her pelvis last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天医生切除了她骨盆上的软骨肉瘤。

e.en: {Chondrosarcoma} usually responds poorly to standard chemotherapy regimens.
e.zh: 软骨肉瘤通常对常规化疗反应不佳。

e.en: Each {chondrule} formed as a molten droplet in the early solar nebula.
e.zh: 每颗球粒都是早期太阳星云中的熔融小液滴形成的。

e.en: Under the microscope, the {chondrule} showed clear concentric layers.
e.zh: 在显微镜下,这颗球粒显示出清晰的同心层结构。

e.en: You can {choose} any topping you like for your pizza.
e.zh: 你可以随意挑选任何喜欢的披萨配料。

e.en: Many graduates {choose} to take a gap year before working.
e.zh: 许多毕业生选择在工作前来一次间隔年。

e.en: The app's color {chooser} lets you preview themes instantly.
e.zh: 这款应用的颜色选择器能让你即时预览主题。

e.en: She's a picky {chooser} when it comes to restaurants.
e.zh: 在选餐厅这件事上她可挑剔了。

chooses.t: v. 选择（choose 的三单形式）

e.en: He always {chooses} the window seat on long flights.
e.zh: 长途飞行时他总是选靠窗的座位。

e.en: The algorithm {chooses} the cheapest route automatically.
e.zh: 算法会自动选择最便宜的路线。

choosing.t: v. 选择（choose 的现在分词）

e.en: I'm still {choosing} a name for the puppy.
e.zh: 我还在给小狗挑名字。

e.en: {Choosing} the right university takes a lot of research.
e.zh: 挑选合适的大学需要做很多功课。

e.en: My cat is incredibly {choosy} about her food brand.
e.zh: 我家猫对猫粮品牌特别挑剔。

e.en: Don't be too {choosy} or you'll miss good opportunities.
e.zh: 别太挑剔,不然会错过好机会。

chop.t:
v. 砍；切碎
n. 排骨

e.en: Please {chop} the onions finely for the soup.
e.zh: 请把洋葱切碎,用来煮汤。

e.en: He ordered a juicy pork {chop} with mashed potatoes.
e.zh: 他点了一份多汁的猪排配土豆泥。

chope.t: v. (新加坡俚语) 占座位

e.en: Singaporeans use tissue packets to {chope} seats at hawker centres.
e.zh: 新加坡人会用纸巾包在小贩中心占座。

e.en: Could you {chope} a table for us at lunchtime?
e.zh: 你能在午饭时间帮我们占张桌子吗?

e.en: They celebrated their anniversary at an old-school {chophouse}.
e.zh: 他们在一家老派牛排馆庆祝结婚纪念日。

e.en: This {chophouse} is famous for its dry-aged steaks.
e.zh: 这家牛排馆以干式熟成牛排闻名。

e.en: She practiced a {Chopin} nocturne every evening.
e.zh: 她每晚都练习一首肖邦的夜曲。

e.en: The pianist closed the recital with {Chopin}'s famous waltz.
e.zh: 钢琴家以肖邦著名的圆舞曲结束了独奏会。

chopped.t:
adj. 切碎的
v. 砍（chop 的过去式）

e.en: She {chopped} the carrots into thin sticks for the salad.
e.zh: 她把胡萝卜切成细条做沙拉。

e.en: The salsa contains finely {chopped} tomatoes and cilantro.
e.zh: 这款莎莎酱含有切碎的番茄和香菜。

e.en: A rescue {chopper} airlifted the injured hiker to safety.
e.zh: 一架救援直升机把受伤的徒步者空运到安全地带。

e.en: This vegetable {chopper} saves me time in the kitchen.
e.zh: 这台切菜器帮我在厨房省了不少时间。

chopping.t: v. 砍；切（chop 的现在分词）

e.en: He's {chopping} firewood for the camping trip tomorrow.
e.zh: 他在为明天的露营劈柴。

e.en: Use a wooden {chopping} board for raw meat preparation.
e.zh: 处理生肉时请使用木质砧板。

choppy.t: adj. 波涛起伏的；断断续续的

e.en: The ferry ride was rough because the sea was {choppy}.
e.zh: 海面波涛汹涌,渡轮颠簸得厉害。

e.en: Her writing felt {choppy} due to too many short sentences.
e.zh: 由于短句太多,她的文字读起来很生硬。

chops.t:
n. 排骨；嘴边肉
v. 砍（三单）

e.en: The grill master {chops} herbs with impressive speed.
e.zh: 那位烧烤大师切香草的速度令人惊叹。

e.en: This guitarist has serious {chops} on stage.
e.zh: 这位吉他手在台上有着真功夫。

e.en: He dropped a single {chopstick} under the dinner table.
e.zh: 他把一根筷子掉在了餐桌底下。

e.en: The toddler tried to grab noodles with one tiny {chopstick}.
e.zh: 那个小孩试图用一根小筷子夹面条。

e.en: Foreign tourists often struggle to use {chopsticks} at first.
e.zh: 外国游客一开始常常用不惯筷子。

e.en: She bought a beautiful pair of lacquered {chopsticks} as a souvenir.
e.zh: 她买了一双漂亮的漆筷作纪念品。

e.en: The church hosted a {choral} concert on Christmas Eve.
e.zh: 教堂在平安夜举办了一场合唱音乐会。

e.en: He composed a {choral} arrangement for the school choir.
e.zh: 他为学校合唱团编写了一首合唱曲。

e.en: Bach's {chorale} brought tears to the audience's eyes.
e.zh: 巴赫的赞美诗合唱让观众感动落泪。

e.en: The community {chorale} performs every Sunday afternoon.
e.zh: 社区合唱团每周日下午演出。

chord.t:
n. 和弦；和音
n. 弦（几何）

e.en: He strummed a soft G {chord} on the guitar.
e.zh: 他在吉他上轻轻拨了一个G和弦。

e.en: Her speech struck a {chord} with younger voters.
e.zh: 她的演讲引起了年轻选民的共鸣。

e.en: Jazz pianists often explore rich {chordal} voicings.
e.zh: 爵士钢琴家常探索丰富的和弦排列。

e.en: The song's {chordal} structure is surprisingly simple.
e.zh: 这首歌的和弦结构其实非常简单。

e.en: Every {chordate} has a notochord at some life stage.
e.zh: 每一种脊索动物在生命的某个阶段都有脊索。

e.en: Biologists classify humans as a type of {chordate}.
e.zh: 生物学家把人类归类为脊索动物的一种。

e.en: Doing laundry feels like a never-ending {chore}.
e.zh: 洗衣服感觉像是没完没了的家务。

e.en: My kids each have one weekly {chore} around the house.
e.zh: 我家孩子每人每周都有一项家务活。

e.en: Huntington's {chorea} causes involuntary jerky movements.
e.zh: 亨廷顿舞蹈症会引起不自主的抽搐动作。

e.en: The neurologist diagnosed her symptoms as Sydenham's {chorea}.
e.zh: 神经科医生将她的症状诊断为西德纳姆舞蹈症。

e.en: She was hired to {choreograph} the opening dance number.
e.zh: 她受聘为开场舞蹈编排动作。

e.en: Directors {choreograph} fight scenes weeks before filming.
e.zh: 导演会在拍摄前数周编排打斗场面。

choreographed.t: v. 已编舞（choreograph 过去式）

e.en: The wedding party {choreographed} a surprise dance for the bride.
e.zh: 伴郎伴娘为新娘编排了一支惊喜舞蹈。

e.en: Every camera angle was carefully {choreographed} in advance.
e.zh: 每一个镜头角度都事先精心安排过。

e.en: The {choreographer} demanded perfection from every dancer.
e.zh: 那位编舞要求每位舞者都做到完美。

e.en: She became Broadway's most sought-after {choreographer} last year.
e.zh: 她去年成为百老汇最炙手可热的编舞。

e.en: The film features stunning {choreographic} sequences.
e.zh: 这部电影呈现了令人惊艳的编舞段落。

e.en: Her {choreographic} style blends ballet with hip-hop.
e.zh: 她的编舞风格融合了芭蕾和嘻哈。

e.en: The show received praise for its {choreographical} brilliance.
e.zh: 这场演出因其精彩的编舞设计而广受好评。

e.en: Critics analyzed every {choreographical} detail of the performance.
e.zh: 评论家分析了演出中编舞的每一个细节。

e.en: The dance company premiered three new {choreographies} this season.
e.zh: 该舞团本季首演了三部全新编舞作品。

e.en: Her {choreographies} often explore themes of memory and loss.
e.zh: 她的编舞作品常探讨记忆与失去的主题。

choreography.t: n. 舞蹈编排；编舞艺术

e.en: The K-pop group's {choreography} went viral on TikTok.
e.zh: 这个韩团的舞蹈编排在抖音上爆红。

e.en: Backstage rehearsals refined the {choreography} until showtime.
e.zh: 后台排练一直打磨舞蹈,直到演出开始。

chorionic.t: adj. 绒毛膜的（胚胎外层）

e.en: Doctors measured her {chorionic} gonadotropin levels during pregnancy.
e.zh: 医生在她怀孕期间检测了绒毛膜促性腺激素水平。

e.en: A {chorionic} villus sampling test detects genetic disorders early.
e.zh: 绒毛膜取样检查能早期发现遗传疾病。

e.en: Each {chorister} wore a crisp white robe for the service.
e.zh: 每位唱诗班成员都穿着洁白的长袍参加礼拜。

e.en: The young {chorister} sang a flawless solo at evensong.
e.zh: 那位年轻的唱诗班成员在晚祷中独唱得无可挑剔。

e.en: He added spicy {chorizo} to the paella for extra flavor.
e.zh: 他在西班牙海鲜饭里加了辣味西班牙香肠提味。

e.en: The tapas bar serves grilled {chorizo} with crusty bread.
e.zh: 这家小吃酒吧供应烤西班牙香肠配脆皮面包。

chorley.t: n. 乔利（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: My grandma bakes traditional {Chorley} cakes every Sunday.
e.zh: 我奶奶每个周日都会烤传统的乔利蛋糕。

e.en: They drove through {Chorley} on the way to Manchester.
e.zh: 他们开车去曼彻斯特的途中经过了乔利镇。

chorlton.t: n. 乔尔顿（英国曼彻斯特地区）

e.en: {Chorlton} has become a trendy neighborhood in south Manchester.
e.zh: 乔尔顿已经成为曼彻斯特南部的潮流街区。

e.en: We grabbed brunch at a cozy café in {Chorlton}.
e.zh: 我们在乔尔顿一家温馨的咖啡馆吃了早午餐。

chortle.t:
v. 咯咯欢笑
n. 得意的笑声

e.en: Grandpa let out a hearty {chortle} at the joke.
e.zh: 爷爷听了那个笑话发出爽朗的笑声。

e.en: The toddlers {chortle} whenever the puppy chases its tail.
e.zh: 小孩们一看到小狗追自己尾巴就咯咯笑。

chorus.t:
n. 副歌；合唱团
v. 齐声说

e.en: Everyone sang along to the catchy {chorus} of the song.
e.zh: 大家都跟着这首歌朗朗上口的副歌唱。

e.en: A {chorus} of complaints flooded the company's social media.
e.zh: 公司的社交媒体被一片抱怨声淹没。

chose.t: v. 选择（choose 的过去式）

e.en: She {chose} the blue dress over the red one.
e.zh: 她在红色和蓝色的裙子之间选了蓝色那条。

e.en: We {chose} to walk home rather than wait for a taxi.
e.zh: 我们选择步行回家,而不是等出租车。

chosen.t:
adj. 被选中的
v. choose 的过去分词

e.en: The committee has {chosen} a new chairperson for next year.
e.zh: 委员会已经选出了明年的新主席。

e.en: He felt honored to be {chosen} for the team.
e.zh: 他为入选这支队伍感到荣幸。

e.en: The bakery sells delicate cream {chou} pastries every morning.
e.zh: 这家面包店每天早上都卖精致的奶油泡芙。

e.en: She ordered a chocolate {chou} with her afternoon coffee.
e.zh: 她下午配咖啡点了一个巧克力泡芙。

e.en: A red-billed {chough} circled above the Cornish cliffs.
e.zh: 一只红嘴山鸦在康沃尔的悬崖上盘旋。

e.en: Birdwatchers came hoping to spot a rare {chough}.
e.zh: 观鸟者们前来希望能看到稀有的山鸦。

e.en: Let's grab some {chow} before the movie starts.
e.zh: 我们在电影开场前先吃点东西吧。

e.en: The fluffy {chow} chow won best in show.
e.zh: 那只毛茸茸的松狮犬赢得了全场总冠军。

e.en: Boston is famous for its creamy clam {chowder}.
e.zh: 波士顿以奶油蛤蜊浓汤闻名。

e.en: She ordered a bread bowl filled with corn {chowder}.
e.zh: 她点了一个装着玉米浓汤的面包碗。

chp.t: n. 加州公路巡警（California Highway Patrol）

e.en: The {CHP} officer pulled him over for speeding on the freeway.
e.zh: 加州公路巡警因超速将他拦在了高速公路上。

e.en: {CHP} units responded quickly to the highway accident.
e.zh: 加州公路巡警很快赶到高速公路事故现场。

e.en: The bishop blessed the {chrism} during the morning service.
e.zh: 主教在晨礼中祝圣了圣油。

e.en: Anointing with {chrism} is part of the baptism ritual.
e.zh: 用圣油涂抹是洗礼仪式的一部分。

chrissake.t: int. 看在上帝份上（for Christ's sake）

e.en: Oh for {chrissake}, just answer the phone already!
e.zh: 老天啊,你倒是接电话啊!

e.en: For {chrissake}, stop arguing and let's get going.
e.zh: 看在老天的份上,别吵了,我们走吧。

christ.t:
n. 基督（耶稣）
int. 天哪（感叹）

e.en: Millions of believers celebrate the birth of {Christ} at Christmas.
e.zh: 亿万信徒在圣诞节庆祝基督的诞生。

e.en: Oh {Christ}, I left my keys at the office!
e.zh: 我的天,我把钥匙落在办公室了!

christchurch.t: n. 基督城（新西兰城市）

e.en: {Christchurch} is the largest city on New Zealand's South Island.
e.zh: 基督城是新西兰南岛上最大的城市。

e.en: We visited the botanic gardens during our trip to {Christchurch}.
e.zh: 我们在去基督城的旅行中参观了植物园。

e.en: They plan to {christen} their newborn daughter next Sunday.
e.zh: 他们打算下周日为刚出生的女儿举行洗礼。

e.en: Let's {christen} the new apartment with a housewarming party.
e.zh: 我们办个乔迁派对来给新公寓开张吧。

e.en: Medieval {christendom} stretched across most of Europe.
e.zh: 中世纪的基督教世界覆盖了欧洲大部分地区。

e.en: The cathedral was the largest building in all of {christendom}.
e.zh: 那座大教堂是整个基督教世界最大的建筑。

e.en: The baby wore a lace gown for her {christening}.
e.zh: 那个宝宝在洗礼仪式上穿了一件蕾丝长袍。

e.en: The queen attended the {christening} of the new ship.
e.zh: 女王出席了新船的命名仪式。

christian.t:
adj. 基督教的
n. 基督徒

e.en: She grew up in a {Christian} family in rural Texas.
e.zh: 她在德州乡下的一个基督教家庭长大。

e.en: The town hosts a {Christian} music festival every summer.
e.zh: 这座小镇每年夏天都举办基督教音乐节。

christianise.t: v. 使基督教化（英式拼写）

e.en: Missionaries tried to {christianise} the local population centuries ago.
e.zh: 几个世纪前传教士试图使当地人皈依基督教。

e.en: Colonial powers worked hard to {christianise} indigenous communities.
e.zh: 殖民势力极力使原住民社群基督教化。

e.en: {Christianity} is one of the largest religions in the world.
e.zh: 基督教是世界上最大的宗教之一。

e.en: He converted to {Christianity} after years of searching.
e.zh: 经过多年的探索，他皈依了基督教。

e.en: The {Christianization} of Europe took several centuries.
e.zh: 欧洲的基督教化历经数个世纪。

e.en: Historians debate the methods used in the {Christianization} of the Americas.
e.zh: 历史学家对美洲基督教化所用的方式争论不休。

e.en: Many ancient pagan festivals were eventually {christianized}.
e.zh: 许多古代异教节日最终被基督教化。

e.en: The {christianized} tribes adopted new customs and rituals.
e.zh: 皈依基督教的部落采纳了新的习俗和礼仪。

e.en: The painting sold at {Christies} for a record price.
e.zh: 这幅画在佳士得拍出了创纪录的高价。

e.en: She works as an art appraiser at {Christies} in London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦佳士得担任艺术品评估师。

e.en: We always decorate the tree on {Christmas} Eve.
e.zh: 我们总是在平安夜装饰圣诞树。

e.en: My grandparents send gifts every {Christmas} morning.
e.zh: 我的祖父母每年圣诞节早晨都会寄礼物。

e.en: The mall feels really {christmassy} with all the lights.
e.zh: 挂满灯饰的商场充满了浓浓的圣诞气氛。

e.en: She baked cookies to make the kitchen smell {christmassy}.
e.zh: 她烤了饼干，让厨房弥漫着圣诞的味道。

e.en: The village looks magical at {Christmastime} every year.
e.zh: 每年圣诞节期间，村庄看起来像童话一样。

e.en: Family gatherings are a tradition at {Christmastime}.
e.zh: 家人团聚是圣诞节期间的传统。

e.en: The seminar focused on {christological} debates from the early church.
e.zh: 研讨会聚焦于早期教会的基督论辩论。

e.en: His thesis explores {christological} themes in medieval art.
e.zh: 他的论文探讨中世纪艺术中的基督论主题。

e.en: The professor specializes in early church {Christology}.
e.zh: 这位教授专攻早期教会的基督论。

e.en: Her book offers a fresh perspective on modern {Christology}.
e.zh: 她的书为现代基督论提供了全新的视角。

e.en: Adjust the {chroma} setting to make the colors pop.
e.zh: 调整色度设置可以让颜色更鲜艳。

e.en: The video editor used a green screen for {chroma} keying.
e.zh: 视频剪辑师用绿幕做色键合成。

chromatic.t: adj. 彩色的；半音的（音乐）

e.en: The pianist played a fast {chromatic} scale to warm up.
e.zh: 钢琴家弹了一段快速的半音阶来热身。

e.en: This lens reduces {chromatic} aberration in low light.
e.zh: 这款镜头能在弱光下减少色差。

e.en: Scientists study how {chromatin} structure affects gene expression.
e.zh: 科学家研究染色质结构如何影响基因表达。

e.en: The microscope revealed dense {chromatin} inside the nucleus.
e.zh: 显微镜下可见细胞核内致密的染色质。

e.en: The lab uses gas {chromatography} to identify unknown compounds.
e.zh: 实验室使用气相色谱法来鉴定未知化合物。

e.en: She learned paper {chromatography} in her chemistry class.
e.zh: 她在化学课上学了纸层析法。

chrome.t: n. 铬（金属）；Chrome 浏览器

e.en: I always browse the web using {Chrome} on my laptop.
e.zh: 我在笔记本上一直用 Chrome 浏览网页。

e.en: The motorcycle has shiny {chrome} handlebars and exhaust pipes.
e.zh: 这辆摩托车有闪亮的镀铬车把和排气管。

e.en: The vintage car has beautifully {chromed} bumpers.
e.zh: 那辆老爷车有镀铬精美的保险杠。

e.en: He polished the {chromed} wheels until they sparkled.
e.zh: 他把镀铬的轮毂擦得闪闪发亮。

e.en: Stainless steel contains iron, carbon, and {chromium}.
e.zh: 不锈钢含有铁、碳和铬。

e.en: The {Chromium} project powers many open-source browsers.
e.zh: Chromium 项目为许多开源浏览器提供支持。

e.en: Quantum {chromodynamics} describes the strong force between quarks.
e.zh: 量子色动力学描述夸克之间的强相互作用。

e.en: The lecture introduced students to {chromodynamics} and quark theory.
e.zh: 讲座向学生介绍了色动力学和夸克理论。

e.en: The antique shop sold a beautiful Victorian {chromolithograph}.
e.zh: 那家古董店出售一幅精美的维多利亚时代彩色石版画。

e.en: She framed the old {chromolithograph} above her fireplace.
e.zh: 她把那幅旧彩色石版画装裱后挂在壁炉上方。

chromosomal.t: adj. 染色体的，与染色体相关的

e.en: Doctors performed a {chromosomal} test to diagnose the condition.
e.zh: 医生进行了染色体检测以诊断病情。

e.en: Down syndrome is caused by a {chromosomal} abnormality.
e.zh: 唐氏综合征由染色体异常引起。

e.en: Humans normally have 46 {chromosome} pairs in each cell.
e.zh: 人类每个细胞通常有 46 条染色体。

e.en: The Y {chromosome} determines male biological traits.
e.zh: Y 染色体决定男性的生物学特征。

e.en: The sun's {chromosphere} glows red during a total eclipse.
e.zh: 日全食时太阳的色球层会发出红光。

e.en: Astronomers study the {chromosphere} to understand solar activity.
e.zh: 天文学家研究色球层以了解太阳活动。

e.en: She suffers from {chronic} back pain after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后她一直受慢性背痛折磨。

e.en: The city faces a {chronic} shortage of affordable housing.
e.zh: 这座城市长期缺乏经济适用房。

e.en: He has been {chronically} late to meetings for years.
e.zh: 他多年来开会一直习惯性迟到。

e.en: Many workers are {chronically} underpaid in this industry.
e.zh: 这个行业里许多工人长期工资过低。

e.en: The {chronicity} of the disease makes treatment challenging.
e.zh: 这种疾病的慢性特征使治疗颇具挑战。

e.en: Doctors are concerned about the {chronicity} of his symptoms.
e.zh: 医生对他症状的长期性感到担忧。

chronicle.t:
n. 编年史
v. 按时间顺序记载

e.en: Her memoir is a {chronicle} of life during wartime.
e.zh: 她的回忆录记录了战时的生活。

e.en: The blog will {chronicle} their road trip across Europe.
e.zh: 这个博客将记录他们横穿欧洲的公路之旅。

chronicler.t: n. 编年史作者，记录者

e.en: He became the unofficial {chronicler} of the small town.
e.zh: 他成了这个小镇的非官方记录者。

e.en: The medieval {chronicler} described the king's battles in detail.
e.zh: 那位中世纪编年史家详细描述了国王的战役。

e.en: He bought a luxury {chronograph} watch for his anniversary.
e.zh: 他为纪念日买了一只奢华的计时码表。

e.en: The pilot relied on his {chronograph} during long flights.
e.zh: 那位飞行员在长途飞行中依靠他的计时表。

e.en: Please list the events in {chronological} order on the timeline.
e.zh: 请按时间顺序在时间线上列出这些事件。

e.en: The museum arranges its exhibits in {chronological} sequence.
e.zh: 博物馆按时间顺序陈列展品。

e.en: The photos are arranged {chronologically} in the family album.
e.zh: 家庭相册里的照片按时间顺序排列。

e.en: She organized her notes {chronologically} for easier reference.
e.zh: 她按时间顺序整理笔记以便查阅。

e.en: Historians have proposed different {chronologies} for these ancient events.
e.zh: 历史学家对这些古代事件提出了不同的年代记。

e.en: The book compares two competing {chronologies} of dynasty rule.
e.zh: 这本书比较了王朝统治的两种相互对立的年表。

e.en: The article provides a clear {chronology} of the company's growth.
e.zh: 这篇文章清晰地呈现了公司发展的年表。

e.en: Researchers are still debating the {chronology} of human migration.
e.zh: 研究者仍在争论人类迁徙的年代顺序。

e.en: Sailors once used a {chronometer} to determine their longitude at sea.
e.zh: 水手们曾用航海天文钟在海上确定经度。

e.en: This Swiss {chronometer} is certified for exceptional accuracy.
e.zh: 这款瑞士天文台表通过认证，精度极高。

e.en: Archaeologists rely on {chronometric} dating to determine artifact ages.
e.zh: 考古学家依靠测年法来确定文物的年代。

e.en: The lab specializes in {chronometric} analysis of fossil samples.
e.zh: 该实验室专门对化石样本进行测年分析。

chronotope.t: n. 时空体（文学理论术语）

e.en: Bakhtin's concept of the {chronotope} reshaped literary criticism.
e.zh: 巴赫金的时空体概念重塑了文学批评。

e.en: Each novel constructs a unique {chronotope} of time and space.
e.zh: 每部小说都构建出独特的时空体。

e.en: The caterpillar transformed into a butterfly inside its {chrysalis}.
e.zh: 毛毛虫在蛹中变成了蝴蝶。

e.en: We watched the {chrysalis} hanging from the leaf for days.
e.zh: 我们好几天观察那只挂在叶子上的蝶蛹。

e.en: She planted yellow {chrysanthemum} flowers along the garden path.
e.zh: 她在花园小径旁种了黄色的菊花。

e.en: The {chrysanthemum} is a symbol of autumn in many cultures.
e.zh: 在许多文化中，菊花是秋天的象征。

chrysler.t: n. 克莱斯勒（美国汽车品牌）

e.en: The {Chrysler} Building remains an iconic part of New York's skyline.
e.zh: 克莱斯勒大厦依然是纽约天际线的标志性建筑。

e.en: He drives an old {Chrysler} sedan to work every day.
e.zh: 他每天开一辆老款克莱斯勒轿车去上班。

e.en: Greek myths often feature {chthonic} deities ruling the underworld.
e.zh: 希腊神话中常有掌管冥界的地府神祇。

e.en: The novel evokes a dark, {chthonic} atmosphere throughout.
e.zh: 这本小说全篇营造出阴森的地府氛围。

chu.t: n. 楚（中国姓氏或地名音译）

e.en: The ancient state of {Chu} flourished in southern China.
e.zh: 古代楚国曾在中国南方繁荣兴盛。

e.en: Her surname is {Chu}, a common family name in Asia.
e.zh: 她姓朱，这在亚洲是常见的姓氏。

e.en: He caught a large {chub} in the river yesterday.
e.zh: 他昨天在河里钓到一条大鲦鱼。

e.en: The {chub} is a popular target for freshwater anglers.
e.zh: 鲦鱼是淡水钓客喜爱的目标鱼种。

chubb.t: n. 丘伯（英国锁具品牌）

e.en: They installed a {Chubb} lock on the front door for security.
e.zh: 他们在前门装了一把楚布锁以保安全。

e.en: The vault is protected by a heavy {Chubb} safe.
e.zh: 金库由一台坚固的楚布保险柜保护着。

e.en: The {chubby} baby giggled and grabbed his toes.
e.zh: 那个胖乎乎的宝宝咯咯笑着抓自己的脚趾。

e.en: She pinched the puppy's {chubby} cheeks affectionately.
e.zh: 她亲昵地捏了捏小狗胖乎乎的脸颊。

chuck.t:
v. 扔，丢
n. 卡盘；牛肩肉

e.en: Just {chuck} the empty bottle in the recycling bin.
e.zh: 把空瓶子扔进回收桶就行。

e.en: He decided to {chuck} his job and travel the world.
e.zh: 他决定辞掉工作去周游世界。

chuckle.t:
v. 轻声笑
n. 轻笑声

e.en: His joke made the whole audience {chuckle} quietly.
e.zh: 他的笑话让全场观众轻声笑了起来。

e.en: She gave a soft {chuckle} when she read the message.
e.zh: 她看到那条消息时轻声笑了一下。

e.en: The comedian's stories drew warm {chuckles} from the crowd.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员的故事引来观众阵阵轻笑。

e.en: He {chuckles} every time he remembers that embarrassing moment.
e.zh: 每次想起那个尴尬时刻他都会咯咯笑。

e.en: She was {chuckling} to herself while reading the comic.
e.zh: 她看漫画时一个人偷偷笑着。

e.en: The kids kept {chuckling} during the silly puppet show.
e.zh: 孩子们在搞笑的木偶剧里笑个不停。

chuff.t: v. 发出噗噗声（蒸汽机）

e.en: You could hear the steam train {chuff} up the hill.
e.zh: 可以听见蒸汽火车噗噗地爬上山坡。

e.en: The old engine began to {chuff} loudly at the station.
e.zh: 老式机车在车站开始大声地喷气作响。

chuffed.t: adj. 很开心的（英式口语）

e.en: She was absolutely {chuffed} to win the writing competition.
e.zh: 赢得写作比赛让她特别开心。

e.en: He looked really {chuffed} when his team scored.
e.zh: 球队得分时他看上去乐开了花。

chug.t: v. 突突地响；一饮而尽

e.en: He {chug}ged the cold beer in one gulp.
e.zh: 他一口气把那杯冰啤酒喝光了。

e.en: The old train began to {chug} up the hill.
e.zh: 那列旧火车开始突突地爬上山坡。

e.en: The boat kept {chugging} along the river all morning.
e.zh: 那艘船整个上午都沿河突突地行驶。

e.en: He was {chugging} water after the long run.
e.zh: 长跑结束后他在大口大口地灌水。

e.en: A {chukar} darted across the rocky trail at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分一只石鸡从布满岩石的小路上窜过。

e.en: Hunters in Nevada often track the elusive {chukar}.
e.zh: 内华达的猎人常常追踪那种难以捉摸的石鸡。

e.en: He met his old {chum} from college for coffee.
e.zh: 他和大学时的老朋友一起喝咖啡。

e.en: The fishermen tossed {chum} overboard to attract sharks.
e.zh: 渔民把鱼饵碎屑抛入海中以吸引鲨鱼。

e.en: The two coworkers became surprisingly {chummy} after the trip.
e.zh: 那次旅行后两位同事变得出奇地亲密。

e.en: Don't get too {chummy} with the new client yet.
e.zh: 先别和新客户走得太近。

e.en: Only a {chump} would fall for that obvious scam.
e.zh: 只有傻瓜才会上那种明显骗局的当。

e.en: I felt like a real {chump} after losing the bet.
e.zh: 输掉那场赌注后我觉得自己真是个蠢蛋。

e.en: She tore off a {chunk} of warm bread.
e.zh: 她撕下一大块热腾腾的面包。

e.en: A huge {chunk} of my salary goes to rent.
e.zh: 我工资的很大一部分都用来交房租了。

e.en: Cut the potatoes into bite-sized {chunks} before roasting.
e.zh: 烤之前把土豆切成一口大小的块。

e.en: The article is split into easy-to-read {chunks}.
e.zh: 这篇文章被分成了便于阅读的几大块。

e.en: She prefers {chunky} peanut butter on her toast.
e.zh: 她喜欢在吐司上抹颗粒花生酱。

e.en: He wore {chunky} sneakers with baggy jeans.
e.zh: 他穿着厚底运动鞋配宽松牛仔裤。

e.en: We took the {chunnel} from London to Paris.
e.zh: 我们坐英法海底隧道列车从伦敦去巴黎。

e.en: The {chunnel} cuts travel time between England and France dramatically.
e.zh: 海底隧道大大缩短了英法之间的通行时间。

e.en: Grandpa would {chunter} about the weather every morning.
e.zh: 爷爷每天早上都要絮絮叨叨地抱怨天气。

e.en: Stop {chunter}ing and just tell me what's wrong.
e.zh: 别再嘟囔了,直接告诉我哪里不对劲。

e.en: They got married in a small countryside {church}.
e.zh: 他们在乡下的一座小教堂举行了婚礼。

e.en: The whole {church} sang together at the service.
e.zh: 整个教会在礼拜时一同歌唱。

e.en: Many old {churches} in Europe attract millions of tourists.
e.zh: 欧洲许多古老的教堂吸引着数百万游客。

e.en: The town has three {churches} on the main street.
e.zh: 小镇主街上有三座教堂。

e.en: She is a regular {churchgoer} every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 她每周日早上都按时去教堂做礼拜。

e.en: Even as a lifelong {churchgoer}, he had questions about faith.
e.zh: 尽管一辈子都上教堂,他对信仰仍有疑问。

e.en: {Churchill} led Britain through the darkest days of the war.
e.zh: 丘吉尔带领英国度过了战争最黑暗的日子。

e.en: Students still study the famous speeches of {Churchill}.
e.zh: 学生们至今仍在学习丘吉尔著名的演讲。

churchillian.t: adj. 丘吉尔式的（演说、风格）

e.en: His speech had a {churchillian} ring of defiance.
e.zh: 他的演讲带着丘吉尔式的不屈语调。

e.en: The mayor delivered a {churchillian} call to action.
e.zh: 市长发表了一篇丘吉尔式的行动号召演说。

churchly.t: adj. 教会的；适于教会的

e.en: The hall had a quiet, {churchly} atmosphere.
e.zh: 那个大厅有一种宁静而类似教堂的氛围。

e.en: He disliked the {churchly} formality of the ceremony.
e.zh: 他不喜欢那场仪式中教堂式的拘谨。

churchman.t: n. 神职人员；教会成员

e.en: The respected {churchman} spoke out against the new law.
e.zh: 那位备受尊敬的神职人员公开反对这项新法律。

e.en: As a young {churchman}, he served a tiny rural parish.
e.zh: 年轻时身为神职人员,他服务于一个偏远的乡村教区。

churchwarden.t: n. 教堂执事（管理教堂事务的教徒）

e.en: The {churchwarden} unlocked the chapel before morning service.
e.zh: 教区委员在晨间礼拜前打开了小教堂的门。

e.en: She was elected {churchwarden} for a second term.
e.zh: 她再次当选为教区执事。

churchwoman.t: n. 女教徒；女性教会成员

e.en: The devoted {churchwoman} organized the charity drive herself.
e.zh: 那位虔诚的女教徒亲自组织了这次慈善募捐活动。

e.en: As a lifelong {churchwoman}, she knew every hymn by heart.
e.zh: 作为终生的女教徒,她能把每首赞美诗都背下来。

e.en: The cafe had a slightly {churchy} feel with stained glass.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆带彩色玻璃,有点教堂的感觉。

e.en: He found the music too {churchy} for a wedding.
e.zh: 他觉得这音乐用在婚礼上太像教堂圣乐了。

churchyard.t: n. 教堂庭院；教堂墓地

e.en: Old gravestones leaned crookedly in the quiet {churchyard}.
e.zh: 古老的墓碑歪斜地立在静谧的教堂墓地里。

e.en: Children took a shortcut through the {churchyard}.
e.zh: 孩子们抄近路穿过了教堂墓地。

e.en: Only a {churl} would refuse to thank his hosts.
e.zh: 只有粗鄙之人才会不感谢主人的款待。

e.en: He acted like a {churl} at the dinner party.
e.zh: 他在晚宴上表现得像个粗鲁无礼的人。

churlish.t: adj. 粗鲁无礼的；脾气坏的

e.en: It would be {churlish} to refuse such a kind offer.
e.zh: 拒绝这么好意的提议未免太失礼了。

e.en: His {churlish} reply offended the entire team.
e.zh: 他粗鲁的回复冒犯了整个团队。

churn.t:
n. 客户流失（率）
v. 搅拌；翻腾

e.en: The startup is trying hard to reduce customer {churn}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正努力降低客户流失率。

e.en: Heavy waves {churn}ed against the rocky shore.
e.zh: 巨浪猛烈地拍打着岩石海岸。

e.en: My stomach {churned} as the plane hit turbulence.
e.zh: 飞机遇到颠簸时我的胃一阵翻腾。

e.en: The factory {churned} out thousands of units a day.
e.zh: 工厂每天大量生产数千件产品。

churning.t:
v. 翻腾；搅动
n. 剧烈波动

e.en: The {churning} sea made the ferry ride miserable.
e.zh: 翻腾的海面让这趟渡轮之旅十分难受。

e.en: His mind kept {churning} long after the meeting ended.
e.zh: 会议结束后他的思绪仍久久无法平静。

churns.t: v. 搅动；翻腾（第三人称单数）

e.en: The blender {churns} the fruit into a smooth drink.
e.zh: 搅拌机把水果搅打成顺滑的饮品。

e.en: Every release, the team {churns} out new features.
e.zh: 每次发版,团队都会推出大量新功能。

churro.t: n. 吉事果（西班牙油条）

e.en: I dipped the warm {churro} into thick chocolate sauce.
e.zh: 我把热乎乎的吉拿棒蘸进浓巧克力酱里。

e.en: The street vendor sells the best {churro} in town.
e.zh: 那位街头小贩卖的吉拿棒是全城最好吃的。

chute.t: n. 滑道；滑槽；降落伞（略）

e.en: The skydiver pulled the {chute} just in time.
e.zh: 那位跳伞员及时拉开了降落伞。

e.en: Toss the laundry down the {chute} to the basement.
e.zh: 把脏衣服扔进通往地下室的滑槽里。

e.en: This curry tastes amazing with a spoonful of mango {chutney}.
e.zh: 这道咖喱配上一勺芒果酸甜酱味道好极了。

e.en: She makes homemade tomato {chutney} every summer.
e.zh: 她每年夏天都自制番茄甜辣酱。

chutzpa.t: n. 厚颜无耻；胆大妄为（= chutzpah）

e.en: He had the {chutzpa} to ask for a raise immediately.
e.zh: 他竟有胆量一上来就要求加薪。

e.en: It takes serious {chutzpa} to debate experts publicly.
e.zh: 公开和专家辩论需要极大的胆量。

chutzpah.t: n. 厚颜无耻；胆大妄为

e.en: She had the {chutzpah} to email the CEO directly.
e.zh: 她竟有胆量直接给首席执行官发邮件。

e.en: His {chutzpah} on stage won over the skeptical crowd.
e.zh: 他在台上的厚脸皮自信征服了原本怀疑的观众。

e.en: The {CIA} declined to comment on the leaked documents.
e.zh: 中央情报局拒绝就泄露的文件发表评论。

e.en: He spent twenty years working as a {CIA} analyst.
e.zh: 他在中央情报局当了二十年分析员。

e.en: I toasted some {ciabatta} and topped it with avocado.
e.zh: 我烤了几片夏巴塔面包,上面放了牛油果。

e.en: The bakery's fresh {ciabatta} sells out by noon.
e.zh: 这家面包店新鲜出炉的夏巴塔中午前就卖光了。

ciao.t: int. 意语问候：你好；再见

e.en: She waved and said {ciao} as she left the cafe.
e.zh: 她离开咖啡馆时挥手说了声"再见"。

e.en: Italians use {ciao} for both hello and goodbye.
e.zh: 意大利人用"ciao"既可以打招呼也可以道别。

ciba.t: n. 汽巴（瑞士化学公司名）

e.en: My grandmother taught me how to make {ciba} for the festival.
e.zh: 奶奶教我怎样为节日做糍粑。

e.en: Sticky {ciba} rolled in soybean powder is a classic snack.
e.zh: 裹上黄豆粉的糍粑是一道经典小吃。

e.en: The president serves as {CIC} of the armed forces.
e.zh: 总统担任武装部队的最高统帅。

e.en: Orders from the {CIC} reached every base by morning.
e.zh: 最高统帅的命令在早晨前传达到了每个基地。

e.en: A loud {cicada} buzzed in the tree all afternoon.
e.zh: 一只蝉在树上整个下午都叫个不停。

e.en: Billions of {cicada} emerge from the soil every seventeen years.
e.zh: 数十亿只蝉每十七年从土里钻出来一次。

cicely.t: n. 甜茴芹（香草）；女子名

e.en: Sweet {cicely} grew wild along the garden path.
e.zh: 甜没药野生地长在花园小径旁。

e.en: She added fresh {cicely} leaves to the rhubarb compote.
e.zh: 她在大黄炖果中加入了新鲜的甜没药叶。

cicero.t: n. 西塞罗（古罗马演说家）

e.en: Latin students still translate the speeches of {Cicero}.
e.zh: 学拉丁文的学生至今仍在翻译西塞罗的演讲。

e.en: {Cicero} is remembered as Rome's greatest orator.
e.zh: 西塞罗被誉为罗马最伟大的演说家。

ciceronian.t: adj. 西塞罗式的；雄辩流畅的

e.en: The lawyer's {ciceronian} closing argument moved the jury.
e.zh: 那位律师西塞罗式的结案陈词打动了陪审团。

e.en: Her essay had a polished, {ciceronian} elegance.
e.zh: 她的文章有着西塞罗式的精致优雅。

e.en: He keeps a colorful {cichlid} in his living room tank.
e.zh: 他在客厅鱼缸里养了一条色彩鲜艳的慈鲷。

e.en: Lake Malawi is famous for its diverse {cichlid} species.
e.zh: 马拉维湖以其种类繁多的慈鲷而闻名。

cics.t: n. IBM 客户信息控制系统

e.en: The bank still runs core transactions on {CICS} mainframes.
e.zh: 这家银行仍在大型主机上用CICS处理核心交易。

e.en: Legacy {CICS} systems handle billions of operations daily.
e.zh: 老旧的CICS系统每天处理数十亿笔操作。

cid.t: n. 刑事调查局（Criminal Investigation Dept.）

e.en: The {CID} officer questioned witnesses at the scene.
e.zh: 刑事调查处的警官在现场询问了目击者。

e.en: The case was handed over to the {CID} immediately.
e.zh: 案件立即被移交给了刑事调查处。

e.en: We sipped warm spiced {cider} by the fireplace.
e.zh: 我们在壁炉边啜饮着加香料的热苹果酒。

e.en: The orchard sells fresh apple {cider} every fall.
e.zh: 那家果园每年秋天都出售新鲜苹果汁。

cie.t: n. 公司（法语 compagnie 缩写）

e.en: The package was shipped by Dupont et {Cie} from Paris.
e.zh: 包裹由巴黎的杜邦公司寄出。

e.en: The old letterhead reads "Martin et {Cie}, Lyon."
e.zh: 老式信笺抬头上印着"里昂马丁公司"。

e.en: The wall was painted a soft {ciel} blue.
e.zh: 那面墙被刷成了柔和的天蓝色。

e.en: She chose a {ciel} silk scarf for the spring outfit.
e.zh: 她为春装挑了一条天蓝色的丝巾。

e.en: He stepped outside to smoke a quick {cig}.
e.zh: 他走到外面快速抽了一支烟。

e.en: She finally quit and hasn't touched a {cig} in months.
e.zh: 她终于戒了,几个月没碰过香烟了。

e.en: He lit a Cuban {cigar} after the celebratory dinner.
e.zh: 庆祝晚宴后他点燃了一支古巴雪茄。

e.en: The shop sells hand-rolled {cigar}s from the Caribbean.
e.zh: 这家店出售来自加勒比地区的手工卷雪茄。

e.en: He lit a {cigaret} and stared out the window.
e.zh: 他点了一支烟，凝望着窗外。

e.en: The old novel mentioned a half-smoked {cigaret} on the table.
e.zh: 那本旧小说提到桌上有一支抽了一半的香烟。

e.en: She quit smoking and threw away her last {cigarette}.
e.zh: 她戒烟了，把最后一支香烟扔掉。

e.en: The bar bans any {cigarette} use indoors.
e.zh: 这家酒吧室内禁止吸烟。

e.en: A pack of {cigarettes} now costs more than ten dollars.
e.zh: 一包香烟现在要十多美元。

e.en: He left his {cigarettes} on the kitchen counter.
e.zh: 他把香烟落在厨房台面上。

e.en: He lit a thin {cigarillo} after dinner on the porch.
e.zh: 晚饭后他在门廊上点了一支细雪茄。

e.en: The shop sells imported wines and the occasional {cigarillo}.
e.zh: 那家店出售进口葡萄酒，偶尔也卖小雪茄。

e.en: Mind if I step out for a quick {ciggy}?
e.zh: 我出去抽根烟，介意吗？

e.en: He bummed a {ciggy} off his coworker at lunch.
e.zh: 午饭时他向同事讨了一根烟。

e.en: Sprinkle fresh {cilantro} over the tacos before serving.
e.zh: 上桌前在玉米饼上撒些新鲜香菜。

e.en: Some people think {cilantro} tastes like soap.
e.zh: 有些人觉得香菜尝起来像肥皂。

cilia.t: n. 纤毛；睫毛（cilium 的复数）

e.en: Tiny {cilia} in the airways sweep dust out of our lungs.
e.zh: 气道里的微小纤毛能把灰尘扫出肺部。

e.en: Smoking damages the {cilia} that protect the respiratory tract.
e.zh: 吸烟会损伤保护呼吸道的纤毛。

e.en: The {ciliary} muscle changes the lens shape so we can focus.
e.zh: 睫状肌通过改变晶状体形状来帮助聚焦。

e.en: Doctors examined the {ciliary} body during the eye exam.
e.zh: 医生在眼科检查中查看了睫状体。

ciliate.t:
n. 纤毛虫
adj. 有纤毛的

e.en: A pond {ciliate} swam under the microscope, covered in fine hairs.
e.zh: 一只池塘里的纤毛虫在显微镜下游动，全身布满细毛。

e.en: Biology class introduced the {ciliate} as a single-celled organism.
e.zh: 生物课介绍了纤毛虫这种单细胞生物。

cima.t: n. 山顶（意大利语借词，罕用）

e.en: The hikers reached the {cima} just before sunset.
e.zh: 徒步者在日落前抵达了山顶。

e.en: From the {cima} you can see three valleys at once.
e.zh: 从山巅可以同时望见三个山谷。

cimetidine.t: n. 西咪替丁（治胃溃疡药物）

e.en: The doctor prescribed {cimetidine} to reduce stomach acid.
e.zh: 医生开了西咪替丁来降低胃酸。

e.en: Older ulcer treatments often relied on {cimetidine}.
e.zh: 早期的溃疡治疗常依赖西咪替丁。

cinch.t:
n. 轻而易举的事
v. 扎紧、搞定

e.en: With the new app, booking flights is a {cinch}.
e.zh: 有了这款新应用，订机票轻而易举。

e.en: She {cinched} the saddle tight before mounting the horse.
e.zh: 她上马前把马鞍束紧。

cinched.t: v. 扎紧、束紧（cinch 过去式）

e.en: He {cinched} his belt and headed out the door.
e.zh: 他系紧腰带，便走出了门。

e.en: The dress was {cinched} at the waist with a thin ribbon.
e.zh: 那条连衣裙用细丝带在腰间束起。

cincinnati.t: n. 辛辛那提（美国俄亥俄州城市）

e.en: We flew into {Cincinnati} for the weekend conference.
e.zh: 我们飞到辛辛那提参加周末的会议。

e.en: The chili in {Cincinnati} is famously served over spaghetti.
e.zh: 辛辛那提的辣肉酱以浇在意面上而闻名。

e.en: A glowing {cinder} popped from the campfire onto the dirt.
e.zh: 一颗发红的余烬从篝火中蹦到了泥地上。

e.en: The barn burned to a {cinder} overnight.
e.zh: 谷仓一夜之间烧成了灰烬。

cinderella.t: n. 灰姑娘（童话人物或比喻）

e.en: The team became the {Cinderella} story of the tournament.
e.zh: 那支球队成了本届赛事的黑马传奇。

e.en: My daughter watched {Cinderella} three times last weekend.
e.zh: 我女儿上周末把《灰姑娘》看了三遍。

cine.t: adj. 电影的（cinema 的缩写）

e.en: They projected old {cine} film of the family vacation.
e.zh: 他们放映了一家人度假的旧电影胶片。

e.en: The festival celebrates classic European {cine} of the 1960s.
e.zh: 该电影节致敬了上世纪六十年代的欧洲经典影片。

e.en: As a serious {cineaste}, he watches at least four films a week.
e.zh: 作为资深影迷，他每周至少看四部电影。

e.en: The director became a hero to every young {cineaste} in town.
e.zh: 那位导演成了城里每个年轻影迷的偶像。

e.en: They went to the {cinema} to see the new Marvel movie.
e.zh: 他们去电影院看了那部新的漫威电影。

e.en: Korean {cinema} has gained a huge global following.
e.zh: 韩国电影在全球获得了大量影迷。

e.en: Several {cinemas} closed during the streaming boom.
e.zh: 在流媒体兴盛期间，多家电影院相继关门。

e.en: The film opens in {cinemas} nationwide this Friday.
e.zh: 这部影片本周五将在全国院线上映。

cinematic.t: adj. 电影的、富有电影感的

e.en: The video game features stunning {cinematic} cutscenes.
e.zh: 这款游戏拥有令人惊叹的电影化过场动画。

e.en: Drone shots gave the wedding video a {cinematic} feel.
e.zh: 无人机镜头让婚礼视频有了电影般的质感。

e.en: The series is {cinematically} ambitious for a streaming show.
e.zh: 作为一部流媒体剧，这部剧在影像上极具野心。

e.en: That sunset was {cinematically} beautiful, like a movie scene.
e.zh: 那场日落美得像电影画面。

e.en: The {cinematographer} won an Oscar for the film's stunning visuals.
e.zh: 那位摄影指导凭借影片惊艳的视觉效果赢得了奥斯卡。

e.en: A skilled {cinematographer} can transform an ordinary script.
e.zh: 出色的摄影师能让平庸的剧本焕然一新。

e.en: Top {cinematographers} are now in high demand for streaming series.
e.zh: 顶尖摄影师如今在流媒体剧集中炙手可热。

e.en: The festival panel featured three Oscar-nominated {cinematographers}.
e.zh: 该电影节论坛邀请了三位获奥斯卡提名的摄影师。

e.en: The film's {cinematographic} style references 1970s thrillers.
e.zh: 这部电影的摄影风格借鉴了上世纪七十年代的惊悚片。

e.en: She studies {cinematographic} techniques at film school.
e.zh: 她在电影学院学习摄影技法。

cinematographies.t: n. 电影摄影术（复数，罕用）

e.en: The book compares the {cinematographies} of Wong Kar-wai and Deakins.
e.zh: 这本书比较了王家卫与迪金斯的摄影艺术。

e.en: Different national {cinematographies} use light in distinct ways.
e.zh: 不同国家的电影摄影对光线的运用各有特色。

e.en: The {cinematography} in that film is absolutely breathtaking.
e.zh: 那部电影的摄影简直令人叹为观止。

e.en: She studied {cinematography} at a top film school in LA.
e.zh: 她在洛杉矶一所顶尖电影学院学习摄影。

e.en: The mall's {cineplex} has twelve screens and an IMAX theater.
e.zh: 商场的多厅影院有十二个放映厅和一个IMAX影厅。

e.en: We grabbed dinner before heading to the {cineplex}.
e.zh: 我们去多厅影院之前先吃了晚饭。

e.en: Ancient artists ground {cinnabar} to make a brilliant red pigment.
e.zh: 古代画家把朱砂研磨成鲜艳的红色颜料。

e.en: The museum displays a carved {cinnabar} box from the Ming dynasty.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一只明代的雕花朱砂盒。

e.en: She sprinkled {cinnamon} on top of her morning oatmeal.
e.zh: 她在早餐燕麦粥上撒了些肉桂粉。

e.en: The bakery smells of fresh {cinnamon} rolls every Sunday.
e.zh: 每个周日，那家面包店都飘着肉桂卷的香味。

cinque.t: n. 五（骰子或纸牌的五点）

e.en: He rolled a {cinque} and moved his piece five squares.
e.zh: 他掷出五点，把棋子前进了五格。

e.en: The medieval town was one of the original {Cinque} Ports.
e.zh: 这座中世纪小城是最早的五港同盟成员之一。

cinquefoil.t: n. 委陵菜（植物）；五叶形饰

e.en: A small {cinquefoil} bloomed yellow at the edge of the meadow.
e.zh: 草地边缘开着一朵黄色的小委陵菜。

e.en: The cathedral window was decorated with a stone {cinquefoil}.
e.zh: 大教堂的窗户上装饰着一个石雕五叶花纹。

cioppino.t: n. 乔皮诺海鲜汤（美式意式炖海鲜）

e.en: The chef's {cioppino} is loaded with crab, clams, and shrimp.
e.zh: 厨师做的意式海鲜汤里有满满的蟹、蛤蜊和虾。

e.en: San Francisco is famous for its hearty {cioppino}.
e.zh: 旧金山以其浓郁的意式海鲜汤闻名。

cipher.t:
n. 密码、暗号
v. 加密

e.en: Spies used a simple {cipher} to hide their messages.
e.zh: 间谍们用一种简单的密码来隐藏信息。

e.en: At meetings he was a complete {cipher}, saying nothing.
e.zh: 开会时他完全是个隐形人，什么也不说。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {ciprofloxacin} for the urinary infection.
e.zh: 医生开了环丙沙星来治疗尿路感染。

e.en: Travelers sometimes carry {ciprofloxacin} for severe stomach bugs.
e.zh: 旅行者有时会带上环丙沙星以应对严重肠胃感染。

circa.t: prep. 大约（用于年代，约 c. 1900）

e.en: The painting dates from {circa} 1890, according to the curator.
e.zh: 据策展人说，这幅画约创作于1890年。

e.en: He owns a vintage guitar {circa} the early 1960s.
e.zh: 他有一把约1960年代初期的老吉他。

circadian.t: adj. 昼夜节律的、生物钟的

e.en: Jet lag throws off your {circadian} rhythm for several days.
e.zh: 时差会扰乱你的生物节律好几天。

e.en: Bright morning light helps reset your {circadian} clock.
e.zh: 明亮的晨光有助于重设你的生物钟。

circe.t: n. 喀耳刻（希腊神话女巫）

e.en: In the myth, {Circe} turns Odysseus's men into pigs.
e.zh: 神话中，喀耳刻把奥德修斯的同伴变成了猪。

e.en: Madeline Miller's novel retells the story from {Circe}'s viewpoint.
e.zh: 玛德琳·米勒的小说从喀耳刻的视角重述了这个故事。

circle.t:
n. 圆、圈子
v. 环绕、圈出

e.en: Draw a {circle} around the correct answer.
e.zh: 在正确答案外画一个圆圈。

e.en: She has a tight {circle} of close friends from college.
e.zh: 她有一群关系紧密的大学好友。

e.en: The teacher {circled} every spelling mistake in red ink.
e.zh: 老师用红笔把每一处拼写错误都圈了出来。

e.en: A hawk {circled} lazily above the open field.
e.zh: 一只鹰在空旷的田野上方悠然盘旋。

e.en: The kids ran in {circles} around the playground.
e.zh: 孩子们在操场上绕着圈跑。

e.en: Her name is well known in academic {circles}.
e.zh: 她的名字在学术界很有名气。

e.en: The princess wore a delicate silver {circlet} on her forehead.
e.zh: 公主额头上戴着一只精致的银色头环。

e.en: He bought her a tiny {circlet} of pearls as a gift.
e.zh: 他给她买了一只小巧的珍珠头饰作礼物。

e.en: Vultures were {circling} high above the desert highway.
e.zh: 秃鹫在沙漠公路上空高高盘旋。

e.en: Doubts kept {circling} in her mind all night.
e.zh: 疑虑整夜在她脑中盘旋不去。

e.en: A loose wire broke the {circuit} and the lamp went dark.
e.zh: 一根松动的电线断了电路，台灯就灭了。

e.en: The comedian is touring on the college {circuit} this year.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员今年在各大高校巡回演出。

e.en: He took a {circuitous} route home to avoid rush-hour traffic.
e.zh: 他绕了远路回家以避开高峰期车流。

e.en: Her answer was {circuitous} and never quite addressed the question.
e.zh: 她的回答绕来绕去，始终没正面回应问题。

e.en: The river flows {circuitously} through the wide valley.
e.zh: 河流在宽阔的山谷中蜿蜒流淌。

e.en: He explained the issue {circuitously}, frustrating his audience.
e.zh: 他绕着弯子解释问题，让听众很恼火。

e.en: Modern phones contain incredibly compact {circuitries}.
e.zh: 现代手机内部装有极为紧凑的电路系统。

e.en: The lab compares {circuitries} from different chip generations.
e.zh: 实验室比较了不同世代芯片的电路结构。

e.en: A surge damaged the laptop's internal {circuitry}.
e.zh: 一次电压浪涌损坏了笔记本电脑的内部电路。

e.en: Brain {circuitry} for memory is still poorly understood.
e.zh: 大脑中负责记忆的神经回路至今仍未被充分理解。

e.en: The engineer designs low-power {circuits} for wearable devices.
e.zh: 这位工程师为可穿戴设备设计低功耗电路。

e.en: He runs three {circuits} of the park before breakfast.
e.zh: 他早餐前会绕着公园跑三圈。

circular.t:
adj. 圆形的；循环的
n. 传单

e.en: The architect designed a {circular} reading room with a glass dome.
e.zh: 建筑师设计了一间带玻璃穹顶的圆形阅览室。

e.en: Your argument is completely {circular} and proves nothing.
e.zh: 你的论点完全是循环论证，什么也证明不了。

e.en: The argument suffers from obvious {circularity} in its reasoning.
e.zh: 这个论点的推理明显存在循环论证的问题。

e.en: Engineers measured the {circularity} of the bearing surface precisely.
e.zh: 工程师精确测量了轴承表面的圆度。

e.en: The dancers moved {circularly} around the central fire.
e.zh: 舞者们围绕中央的篝火旋转移动。

e.en: The argument was {circularly} structured and proved nothing.
e.zh: 这个论点结构循环,什么也没证明。

e.en: Rumors quickly {circulate} on social media these days.
e.zh: 如今谣言在社交媒体上传播得很快。

e.en: Please {circulate} the memo to all team members.
e.zh: 请将这份备忘录传阅给所有团队成员。

e.en: The petition was {circulated} among local residents last week.
e.zh: 上周这份请愿书在当地居民中传阅。

e.en: Cool air {circulated} through the office vents.
e.zh: 凉爽的空气通过办公室通风口循环流动。

circulates.t: v. 流通、循环（第三人称单数）

e.en: Blood {circulates} through the body roughly every minute.
e.zh: 血液大约每分钟在全身循环一次。

e.en: A strange story {circulates} among the new students.
e.zh: 一个奇怪的故事在新生中流传。

e.en: There are several rumors {circulating} about the merger.
e.zh: 关于这次合并有几个谣言正在流传。

e.en: The fan kept warm air {circulating} around the room.
e.zh: 风扇让暖空气在房间里持续循环。

e.en: Regular exercise improves blood {circulation} significantly.
e.zh: 规律运动能显著改善血液循环。

e.en: The magazine has a {circulation} of two million readers.
e.zh: 这本杂志的发行量达两百万读者。

e.en: Newspaper {circulations} have declined sharply in the digital age.
e.zh: 在数字时代,报纸的发行量大幅下降。

e.en: Ocean {circulations} regulate the planet's climate patterns.
e.zh: 海洋环流调节着地球的气候模式。

e.en: The pump acts as a {circulator} for the heating system.
e.zh: 这个泵在供暖系统中起到循环器的作用。

e.en: She works as a petition {circulator} during election season.
e.zh: 她在选举季担任请愿书征集员。

circulatory.t: adj. 循环的（尤指血液循环）

e.en: Smoking damages the {circulatory} system over time.
e.zh: 吸烟会逐渐损害循环系统。

e.en: The patient suffers from chronic {circulatory} problems.
e.zh: 这位病人患有慢性循环系统疾病。

circumcise.t: v. 施行包皮环切；行割礼

e.en: Some cultures {circumcise} infants for religious reasons.
e.zh: 有些文化出于宗教原因为婴儿行割礼。

e.en: Doctors no longer routinely {circumcise} newborn boys here.
e.zh: 这里的医生不再常规为新生男婴行割礼。

circumcised.t: v. 已行割礼（circumcise 的过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The baby was {circumcised} on the eighth day after birth.
e.zh: 婴儿在出生后第八天接受了割礼。

e.en: Many parents debate whether to have their sons {circumcised}.
e.zh: 许多家长在讨论是否要让儿子接受割礼。

e.en: The {circumciser} performed the ceremony with great care.
e.zh: 行割礼者非常细心地完成了仪式。

e.en: A trained {circumciser} is required for the religious ritual.
e.zh: 这项宗教仪式需要受过训练的行割礼者。

e.en: {Circumcision} is a common practice in several religions.
e.zh: 割礼是几种宗教中的常见习俗。

e.en: The hospital offers safe newborn {circumcision} services.
e.zh: 医院提供安全的新生儿割礼服务。

e.en: The lake has a {circumference} of about ten kilometers.
e.zh: 这个湖的周长约为十公里。

e.en: Measure the {circumference} of the tree trunk first.
e.zh: 先量一下树干的周长。

e.en: The city built a {circumferential} highway around downtown.
e.zh: 这座城市在市中心周围修建了一条环城公路。

e.en: Doctors made a small {circumferential} incision during surgery.
e.zh: 医生在手术中切了一个小的环形切口。

e.en: The French word "hôtel" has a {circumflex} on the o.
e.zh: 法语单词 hôtel 的 o 上有一个长音符。

e.en: Type the {circumflex} accent by holding the option key.
e.zh: 按住 option 键即可输入长音符。

circumlocution.t: n. 迂回的说法；绕圈子说话

e.en: Politicians often use {circumlocution} to avoid direct answers.
e.zh: 政客常用拐弯抹角的说法来回避直接回答。

e.en: Cut the {circumlocution} and tell me what happened.
e.zh: 别拐弯抹角了,告诉我到底发生了什么。

circumlocutory.t: adj. 说话绕弯的；迂回的

e.en: His {circumlocutory} writing style frustrated many readers.
e.zh: 他迂回啰嗦的写作风格让许多读者感到沮丧。

e.en: Avoid {circumlocutory} phrases when writing technical documentation.
e.zh: 撰写技术文档时应避免使用拐弯抹角的表达。

e.en: It takes months to {circumnavigate} the globe by sailboat.
e.zh: 乘帆船环游地球需要数月时间。

e.en: She plans to {circumnavigate} the island in a kayak.
e.zh: 她计划用皮划艇环绕这座岛屿。

circumnavigated.t: v. 已环航（circumnavigate 的过去式）

e.en: Magellan's crew {circumnavigated} the world in the 1500s.
e.zh: 麦哲伦的船员在十六世纪环绕了地球一周。
