e.en: Too much sweetness can {cloy} the palate quickly.
e.zh: 过多的甜味很快就会让人觉得腻。

e.en: Her constant compliments began to {cloy} after a while.
e.zh: 她不停的赞美过了一会儿就让人觉得腻烦。

cloying.t: adj. 甜得发腻的；肉麻的

e.en: The dessert had a {cloying} sweetness I couldn't finish.
e.zh: 那道甜点甜得发腻，我吃不完。

e.en: His {cloying} flattery made everyone uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他那种过分的奉承让大家都觉得不舒服。

e.en: The movie was {cloyingly} sentimental from start to finish.
e.zh: 这部电影从头到尾都煽情得让人发腻。

e.en: She spoke {cloyingly} sweet words to the customers.
e.zh: 她对顾客说着甜得发腻的话。

e.en: The teacher prepared a {cloze} test for vocabulary practice.
e.zh: 老师准备了一份完形填空来练习词汇。

e.en: Students often struggle with {cloze} exercises in English exams.
e.zh: 学生们常常觉得英语考试中的完形填空很难。

e.en: Press {clr} to reset the calculator's display.
e.zh: 按清除键可以重置计算器显示。

e.en: The keyboard has a small {clr} button near the top.
e.zh: 键盘顶部附近有一个小的清除按钮。

club.t:
n. 俱乐部；球棒
v. 用棍棒打

e.en: She joined the chess {club} during her first semester.
e.zh: 她在第一个学期就加入了象棋俱乐部。

e.en: We danced at the {club} until two in the morning.
e.zh: 我们在夜店里跳舞跳到凌晨两点。

clubbable.t: adj. 合群的；适合入会的

e.en: He's a {clubbable} fellow who gets along with everyone.
e.zh: 他是个合群的人，跟谁都处得来。

e.en: Her warm humor makes her instantly {clubbable}.
e.zh: 她热情幽默，让人一接触就觉得好相处。

clubbed.t:
adj. 棒状的
v. 用棍棒打（过去式）

e.en: They {clubbed} together to buy their friend a gift.
e.zh: 他们凑钱一起给朋友买了份礼物。

e.en: We {clubbed} all night in downtown Tokyo.
e.zh: 我们在东京市中心的夜店玩了整晚。

e.en: The startup has a {clubby} atmosphere among early employees.
e.zh: 这家创业公司在早期员工之间有种小圈子氛围。

e.en: Wall Street's {clubby} culture excludes many outsiders.
e.zh: 华尔街那种圈子文化把许多外人排除在外。

clubfoot.t: n. 马蹄内翻足；畸形足

e.en: The baby was born with a {clubfoot} but recovered fully.
e.zh: 这个婴儿天生有马蹄足，但已经完全康复。

e.en: Modern surgery can effectively correct a {clubfoot}.
e.zh: 现代手术可以有效矫正马蹄足。

e.en: The team celebrated their victory in the {clubhouse}.
e.zh: 球队在会所里庆祝他们的胜利。

e.en: Members gathered at the {clubhouse} for the weekly meeting.
e.zh: 会员们聚集在会所参加每周例会。

clubland.t: n. 夜店/俱乐部聚集区

e.en: London's {clubland} comes alive after midnight on weekends.
e.zh: 伦敦的夜店区在周末午夜后才热闹起来。

e.en: Tourists often explore Berlin's famous {clubland} on Saturdays.
e.zh: 游客们经常在周六探访柏林著名的夜店区。

e.en: Members relaxed in the {clubroom} after the tournament.
e.zh: 比赛结束后，会员们在俱乐部室里放松。

e.en: The school's chess {clubroom} is on the second floor.
e.zh: 学校的象棋活动室在二楼。

clubs.t: n. 俱乐部（复数）；梅花（扑克花色）

e.en: Many students join several {clubs} during their freshman year.
e.zh: 许多学生在大一时会加入好几个社团。

e.en: He drew the ace of {clubs} from the deck.
e.zh: 他从牌堆里抽到了梅花A。

cluck.t:
v. (母鸡) 咯咯叫
n. 咯咯声

e.en: The hens {cluck} loudly whenever the farmer approaches.
e.zh: 每当农夫走近，母鸡们就咯咯叫个不停。

e.en: My grandmother would {cluck} disapprovingly at the news.
e.zh: 奶奶看到那则新闻会咂嘴表示不满。

clucking.t: v. 咯咯叫（cluck 的现在分词）

e.en: The hens were {clucking} contentedly in the henhouse.
e.zh: 母鸡们在鸡舍里满足地咯咯叫着。

e.en: She kept {clucking} her tongue at the messy room.
e.zh: 她不停地咂着舌头嫌房间乱。

clue.t:
n. 线索；提示
v. 给…提示

e.en: Detectives found a vital {clue} at the crime scene.
e.zh: 侦探们在犯罪现场找到了一条关键线索。

e.en: I have no {clue} what he's talking about.
e.zh: 我完全不知道他在说什么。

clueless.t: adj. 一无所知的；毫无头绪的

e.en: He's totally {clueless} about how the new app works.
e.zh: 他对这个新应用的用法完全一头雾水。

e.en: Don't be so {clueless} about basic office etiquette.
e.zh: 别对基本的办公礼仪那么一无所知。

e.en: The puzzle game gives you {clues} every five minutes.
e.zh: 这款解谜游戏每五分钟会给你一些提示。

e.en: Investigators pieced together {clues} to solve the case.
e.zh: 调查人员把各种线索拼凑起来破了案。

cluj.t: n. 克卢日（罗马尼亚城市）

e.en: We spent a weekend exploring the old town of {Cluj}.
e.zh: 我们花了一个周末游览克卢日的老城区。

e.en: {Cluj} is a major tech hub in Romania today.
e.zh: 克卢日如今是罗马尼亚的主要科技中心。

e.en: The {clumber} spaniel is a calm and friendly dog breed.
e.zh: 克伦伯猎犬是一种性情温和友善的犬种。

e.en: Her {clumber} loves long walks in the countryside.
e.zh: 她的克伦伯犬喜欢在乡间长时间散步。

clump.t:
n. 一丛；一簇
v. 聚成一团

e.en: A {clump} of mushrooms grew near the old oak tree.
e.zh: 老橡树旁长了一丛蘑菇。

e.en: The data points {clump} together on the right side.
e.zh: 这些数据点都聚集在右侧。

clumped.t: v. 聚成一团（clump 过去式）

e.en: The wet leaves {clumped} together on the sidewalk.
e.zh: 湿叶子在人行道上粘成了一团团。

e.en: Sugar had {clumped} at the bottom of the jar.
e.zh: 糖在罐子底部结成了硬块。

e.en: The mascara is {clumping} on my eyelashes again.
e.zh: 睫毛膏又在我的睫毛上结块了。

e.en: Use a fork to prevent the rice from {clumping}.
e.zh: 用叉子防止米饭粘成一团。

e.en: The yogurt looked a bit {clumpy} after sitting overnight.
e.zh: 酸奶放了一夜后看起来有点结块。

e.en: Her old mascara made her lashes look {clumpy}.
e.zh: 她那支旧睫毛膏让睫毛看起来一团一团的。

e.en: He {clumsily} knocked over the vase while reaching for it.
e.zh: 他笨手笨脚地伸手时把花瓶打翻了。

e.en: She {clumsily} apologized for forgetting his name.
e.zh: 她笨拙地为忘了他的名字道歉。

e.en: His {clumsiness} in the kitchen often led to accidents.
e.zh: 他在厨房里笨手笨脚的，经常出意外。

e.en: The diplomat's {clumsiness} caused a minor international incident.
e.zh: 那位外交官的笨拙引发了一起小型国际事件。

e.en: I'm so {clumsy} I keep dropping my phone.
e.zh: 我笨手笨脚的，老是把手机摔在地上。

e.en: The app's interface feels {clumsy} on small screens.
e.zh: 这款应用的界面在小屏幕上用起来很别扭。

clung.t: v. 紧抓；依附（cling 的过去式）

e.en: The child {clung} tightly to her mother's hand.
e.zh: 那孩子紧紧抓着妈妈的手不放。

e.en: He {clung} to hope even when things looked bleak.
e.zh: 即使前景黯淡，他依然紧握着希望。

clunk.t:
n. 哐当声
v. 发出哐当声

e.en: The old engine made a strange {clunk} before stopping.
e.zh: 那台旧发动机熄火前发出一声奇怪的咔哒声。

e.en: I heard a heavy {clunk} when the box hit the floor.
e.zh: 箱子砸到地上时，我听到一声沉闷的咣当声。

clunker.t: n. 破旧车；失败的作品

e.en: My first car was a real {clunker} from the nineties.
e.zh: 我的第一辆车是九十年代的一辆破烂货。

e.en: That movie was a complete {clunker} at the box office.
e.zh: 那部电影在票房上彻底失败了。

e.en: The website's checkout process is slow and {clunky}.
e.zh: 这个网站的结账流程又慢又难用。

e.en: She wore {clunky} boots with her summer dress.
e.zh: 她穿着笨重的靴子搭配夏季连衣裙。

e.en: The abbey at {Cluny} once dominated medieval Europe.
e.zh: 克吕尼修道院曾在中世纪欧洲举足轻重。

e.en: Tourists visit {Cluny} to see its impressive ruins.
e.zh: 游客们前往克吕尼参观那令人惊叹的遗迹。

cluster.t:
n. 集群；簇
v. 聚集

e.en: A small {cluster} of stars appeared above the mountain.
e.zh: 一小簇星星出现在山顶上方。

e.en: We deployed the app on a Kubernetes {cluster}.
e.zh: 我们把应用部署在了一个 Kubernetes 集群上。

e.en: The villages are {clustered} along the river valley.
e.zh: 这些村庄沿着河谷聚集在一起。

e.en: Reporters {clustered} around the celebrity at the airport.
e.zh: 记者们在机场把那位明星团团围住。

clustering.t:
n. 聚类；集群化
v. 聚集

e.en: We use {clustering} to group similar customer profiles.
e.zh: 我们用聚类方法对相似的客户画像进行分组。

e.en: Bees were {clustering} on the flowering tree.
e.zh: 蜜蜂们成群聚集在那棵开花的树上。

e.en: The galaxy contains many {clusters} of young stars.
e.zh: 这个星系里有许多年轻恒星组成的星团。

e.en: COVID {clusters} appeared again in several cities.
e.zh: 几个城市又出现了新冠聚集性病例。

clutch.t:
n. 离合器；紧握
v. 紧握

e.en: She made a {clutch} three-pointer in the final seconds.
e.zh: 她在最后几秒投进了一个关键的三分球。

e.en: Press the {clutch} before shifting gears in a manual car.
e.zh: 开手动挡车换挡前要先踩离合器。

e.en: She {clutched} her bag tightly on the crowded subway.
e.zh: 在拥挤的地铁里，她紧紧抱着自己的包。

e.en: He {clutched} the letter and read it again.
e.zh: 他紧握着那封信，又读了一遍。

clutches.t:
v. 紧抓
n. 掌控；控制

e.en: The hero escaped from the villain's evil {clutches}.
e.zh: 主人公从反派的魔爪中逃了出来。

e.en: She {clutches} her coffee mug every morning meeting.
e.zh: 她每次早会都紧握着咖啡杯。

clutching.t: v. 紧紧抓住（现在分词）

e.en: The toddler kept {clutching} his favorite stuffed bear.
e.zh: 那个小孩一直紧紧抱着他最喜欢的玩具熊。

e.en: She walked in {clutching} a stack of documents.
e.zh: 她走了进来，怀里紧抱着一叠文件。

clutter.t:
n. 杂乱的东西
v. 使凌乱

e.en: I need to clear the {clutter} on my desk today.
e.zh: 今天我得把桌上的杂物清理一下。

e.en: Too many notifications {clutter} my phone screen.
e.zh: 过多的通知让我的手机屏幕变得很乱。

e.en: His apartment was {cluttered} with old books and papers.
e.zh: 他的公寓里堆满了旧书和纸张，乱七八糟。

e.en: The dashboard feels {cluttered} with too many widgets.
e.zh: 仪表盘上小组件太多，看起来很杂乱。

e.en: Stop {cluttering} the kitchen counter with random items.
e.zh: 别再把杂七杂八的东西堆在厨房台面上了。

e.en: Pop-up ads are {cluttering} the entire homepage.
e.zh: 弹出广告把整个主页搞得乱七八糟。

clutters.t:
n. 杂物
v. 使凌乱

e.en: He always {clutters} the table with empty coffee cups.
e.zh: 他总是把空咖啡杯堆满整张桌子。

e.en: Unnecessary code {clutters} the project repository.
e.zh: 无用的代码把项目仓库弄得很乱。

clwyd.t: n. 克卢伊德（英国威尔士郡名）

e.en: {Clwyd} was once a county in northeastern Wales.
e.zh: 克卢伊德曾是威尔士东北部的一个郡。

e.en: My grandfather grew up in a small village in {Clwyd}.
e.zh: 我祖父在克卢伊德的一个小村庄长大。

clyde.t: n. 克莱德（人名/河流名）

e.en: The river {Clyde} flows through the heart of Glasgow.
e.zh: 克莱德河流经格拉斯哥的市中心。

e.en: Shipbuilding on the {Clyde} once employed thousands of workers.
e.zh: 克莱德河畔的造船业曾雇用数千名工人。

clydesdale.t: n. 克莱兹代尔马（苏格兰重型马）

e.en: The {clydesdale} pulled the heavy cart through the muddy field.
e.zh: 那匹克莱兹代尔马拉着沉重的马车穿过泥泞的田野。

e.en: A massive {clydesdale} stood quietly in the show ring.
e.zh: 一匹高大的克莱兹代尔马安静地站在表演场内。

cmc.t: n. 羧甲基纤维素；指挥官

e.en: The {CMC} regulates communications standards across the region.
e.zh: 该通信管理委员会负责监管该地区的通信标准。

e.en: He chairs the {CMC} meeting every Thursday morning.
e.zh: 他每周四早上主持中央军委会议。

cmea.t: n. 经济互助委员会缩写

e.en: The {CMEA} once coordinated trade among socialist economies.
e.zh: 经互会曾负责协调社会主义国家之间的贸易。

e.en: Many countries left the {CMEA} after 1989.
e.zh: 1989年后许多国家退出了经济互助委员会。

cmos.t: n. CMOS 互补金属氧化物半导体

e.en: Modern cameras use {CMOS} sensors for high-quality images.
e.zh: 现代相机使用CMOS传感器来拍摄高质量图像。

e.en: The chip is built on advanced {CMOS} technology.
e.zh: 该芯片采用先进的CMOS技术制造。

cms.t: n. 内容管理系统（Content Management System）

e.en: We migrated the website to a new {CMS} last month.
e.zh: 我们上个月把网站迁移到了新的内容管理系统。

e.en: WordPress remains the most popular {CMS} on the web.
e.zh: WordPress仍是网络上最流行的内容管理系统。

cnaa.t: n. 英国国家学位授予委员会缩写

e.en: The {CNAA} once awarded degrees for British polytechnics.
e.zh: 全国学术奖励委员会曾为英国理工学院颁发学位。

e.en: Her diploma was validated by the {CNAA} in 1985.
e.zh: 她的文凭于1985年由CNAA认证。

e.en: She joined a {CND} march to protest nuclear weapons.
e.zh: 她参加了核裁军运动的游行抗议核武器。

e.en: The {CND} held a rally outside parliament yesterday.
e.zh: 核裁军运动昨天在议会外举行了集会。

cnn.t: n. 美国有线电视新闻网

e.en: I watched the breaking news on {CNN} this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上我在CNN上看到了突发新闻。

e.en: {CNN} reporters covered the election from multiple cities.
e.zh: CNN记者从多个城市报道了大选情况。

cnrs.t: n. 法国国家科学研究中心

e.en: The researcher received funding from the French {CNRS}.
e.zh: 这位研究员获得了法国国家科学研究中心的资助。

e.en: {CNRS} laboratories collaborate with universities across Europe.
e.zh: 法国国家科研中心的实验室与欧洲各地的大学合作。

e.en: International {co-operation} is essential to fight climate change.
e.zh: 国际合作对于应对气候变化至关重要。

e.en: Thank you for your {co-operation} during the inspection.
e.zh: 感谢您在检查期间的配合。

co-operative.t:
adj. 合作的
n. 合作社

e.en: The local {co-operative} sells produce from nearby farms.
e.zh: 当地的合作社出售附近农场的农产品。

e.en: She was very {co-operative} when answering the police questions.
e.zh: 她在回答警方问题时非常配合。

coach.t:
n. 教练；长途客车
v. 辅导

e.en: The {coach} pushed the team to train harder before finals.
e.zh: 教练在决赛前督促球队加强训练。

e.en: We took a {coach} from London to Edinburgh overnight.
e.zh: 我们坐长途巴士连夜从伦敦去了爱丁堡。

e.en: She {coached} the swim team to three national titles.
e.zh: 她带领游泳队赢得了三个全国冠军。

e.en: The witness was clearly {coached} before the trial.
e.zh: 那名证人显然在庭审前受过指点。

coattails.t: n. 燕尾服下摆；借…之势

e.en: Many junior candidates won on the mayor's {coattails}.
e.zh: 许多初级候选人都是借市长的余威当选的。

e.en: His long {coattails} flapped as he ran.
e.zh: 他奔跑时长长的燕尾服下摆飘动着。

e.en: I had to {coax} the cat down from the tree.
e.zh: 我不得不哄那只猫从树上下来。

e.en: She tried to {coax} a smile from the shy child.
e.zh: 她试着哄那个害羞的孩子笑一笑。

coaxed.t: v. 哄劝（coax 的过去式）

e.en: He {coaxed} the engine back to life after an hour.
e.zh: 他鼓捣了一个小时,终于让引擎重新启动了。

e.en: The teacher {coaxed} him into joining the school play.
e.zh: 老师劝说他参加学校的戏剧表演。

e.en: She gently {coaxes} her toddler to eat vegetables.
e.zh: 她温柔地哄着小宝宝吃蔬菜。

e.en: The trainer {coaxes} the nervous horse into the trailer.
e.zh: 驯马师哄着那匹紧张的马走进拖车。

coaxial.t: adj. 同轴的（如同轴电缆）

e.en: Connect the TV using a {coaxial} cable from the wall.
e.zh: 用同轴电缆把电视和墙上的接口连起来。

e.en: Older internet plans still rely on {coaxial} wiring.
e.zh: 较旧的网络方案仍然依赖同轴线缆。

e.en: After much {coaxing}, the dog finally came inside.
e.zh: 经过一番哄劝,那只狗终于走进了屋。

e.en: He spoke in a {coaxing} voice to calm the baby.
e.zh: 他用哄人的语气说话,让宝宝安静下来。

e.en: She smiled {coaxingly} and offered him a cookie.
e.zh: 她哄人似的笑了笑,递给他一块饼干。

e.en: He spoke {coaxingly} to the frightened puppy.
e.zh: 他用哄哄的口吻对那只受惊的小狗说话。

e.en: We grilled fresh corn on the {cob} for dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐我们烤了带棒的新鲜玉米。

e.en: The horse trotted along, a sturdy little {cob}.
e.zh: 那匹马是一匹结实的小矮种马,小跑着前进。

e.en: Vegans often need a {cobalamin} supplement to stay healthy.
e.zh: 纯素食者通常需要补充维生素 B12 来保持健康。

e.en: Low {cobalamin} levels can cause fatigue and memory issues.
e.zh: 维生素 B12 水平偏低可能导致疲劳和记忆问题。

e.en: The vase was painted a deep {cobalt} blue.
e.zh: 那只花瓶被涂成深钴蓝色。

e.en: Most lithium batteries contain a small amount of {cobalt}.
e.zh: 大多数锂电池都含有少量钴。

cobble.t:
n. 鹅卵石
v. 拼凑修补

e.en: We had to {cobble} together a presentation overnight.
e.zh: 我们不得不一晚上拼凑出一份演示稿。

e.en: Each {cobble} on the old street told a story.
e.zh: 老街上每一块鹅卵石都讲述着一个故事。

cobbled.t:
adj. 鹅卵石铺的
v. 拼凑（过去式）

e.en: The narrow {cobbled} streets were charming but tricky to walk.
e.zh: 那些狭窄的鹅卵石街道很有韵味但不好走。

e.en: He {cobbled} together a script from old code snippets.
e.zh: 他用一些旧代码片段拼凑出一个脚本。

e.en: The local {cobbler} fixed my favorite boots beautifully.
e.zh: 当地的鞋匠把我最爱的靴子修得很漂亮。

e.en: Grandma served warm peach {cobbler} with vanilla ice cream.
e.zh: 奶奶端上了温热的桃子酥皮派配香草冰淇淋。

e.en: Each {cobblestone} in the plaza had been laid by hand.
e.zh: 广场上的每一块鹅卵石都是手工铺的。

e.en: Her heel got stuck between two {cobblestone} cracks.
e.zh: 她的高跟鞋卡在两块鹅卵石的缝隙之间。

e.en: We wandered down a quiet {cobblestoned} alley in Rome.
e.zh: 我们漫步在罗马一条安静的鹅卵石小巷里。

e.en: The {cobblestoned} courtyard glistened after the rain.
e.zh: 那座鹅卵石庭院在雨后闪闪发光。

e.en: Many footballers live in {Cobham}, a wealthy Surrey village.
e.zh: 许多足球运动员住在科巴姆这个富裕的萨里村庄。

e.en: The train to {Cobham} leaves from Waterloo every hour.
e.zh: 开往科巴姆的火车每小时从滑铁卢站发车。

e.en: The chef grilled fresh {cobia} with a lemon butter sauce.
e.zh: 主厨用柠檬黄油酱烤了新鲜的军曹鱼。

e.en: Anglers caught a huge {cobia} off the Florida coast.
e.zh: 垂钓者在佛罗里达海岸钓到一条很大的军曹鱼。

e.en: Many banks still rely on legacy {COBOL} systems for transactions.
e.zh: 许多银行仍依赖老旧的 COBOL 系统处理交易。

e.en: He learned {COBOL} just to maintain the old payroll software.
e.zh: 他学习 COBOL 只是为了维护那套老旧的工资软件。

e.en: A king {cobra} can grow over five meters long.
e.zh: 眼镜王蛇身长可以超过五米。

e.en: The {cobra} raised its hood and hissed loudly.
e.zh: 那条眼镜蛇竖起颈部,大声嘶嘶作响。

e.en: Queen Victoria's husband came from the house of {Coburg}.
e.zh: 维多利亚女王的丈夫出身于科堡王室。

e.en: They visited {Coburg} castle during their tour of Bavaria.
e.zh: 他们在巴伐利亚旅行时参观了科堡城堡。

e.en: A dusty {cobweb} hung in the corner of the attic.
e.zh: 阁楼的角落里挂着一张布满灰尘的蜘蛛网。

e.en: She brushed a {cobweb} off the old picture frame.
e.zh: 她从那个旧相框上拂去一张蜘蛛网。

e.en: The {cobwebbed} basement hadn't been entered in years.
e.zh: 那间布满蛛网的地下室已经多年没人进去过。

e.en: He found a {cobwebbed} box of childhood photos.
e.zh: 他找到一个布满蛛网的童年照片盒。

cobwebby.t: adj. 像蛛网的；布满蛛网的

e.en: The old library had a {cobwebby}, forgotten feel.
e.zh: 那座老图书馆有一种布满蛛网、被人遗忘的感觉。

e.en: She wiped down the {cobwebby} corners of the shed.
e.zh: 她擦拭了棚屋里布满蛛网的角落。

e.en: Farmers in the Andes have grown {coca} for centuries.
e.zh: 安第斯山区的农民已经种植古柯几个世纪了。

e.en: Locals chew {coca} leaves to ease altitude sickness.
e.zh: 当地人嚼古柯叶来缓解高原反应。

e.en: Police seized a large shipment of {cocaine} at the port.
e.zh: 警方在港口缉获了一大批可卡因。

e.en: He spent years in rehab recovering from {cocaine} addiction.
e.zh: 他在戒毒所里花了好几年戒除可卡因毒瘾。

e.en: A {coccus} is any spherical-shaped bacterium under the microscope.
e.zh: 球菌是显微镜下任何呈球形的细菌。

e.en: The lab identified the infection as a gram-positive {coccus}.
e.zh: 实验室确认这次感染是革兰氏阳性球菌引起的。

e.en: She bruised her {coccyx} after slipping on the ice.
e.zh: 她在冰上滑倒后摔伤了尾骨。

e.en: Sitting too long can put pressure on the {coccyx}.
e.zh: 长时间坐着会给尾骨带来压力。

cochabamba.t: n. 科恰班巴（玻利维亚城市）

e.en: {Cochabamba} is known for its mild climate and great food.
e.zh: 科恰班巴以气候温和和美食出名。

e.en: We flew from La Paz to {Cochabamba} in an hour.
e.zh: 我们从拉巴斯飞到科恰班巴只用了一小时。

cochineal.t: n. 胭脂虫；胭脂红染料

e.en: Red food dye is sometimes made from crushed {cochineal} insects.
e.zh: 红色食用色素有时是用碾碎的胭脂虫制成的。

e.en: The fabric was dyed a brilliant red using {cochineal}.
e.zh: 那块布料用胭脂虫染成了鲜艳的红色。

e.en: Sound waves travel through the {cochlea} to reach the brain.
e.zh: 声波经过耳蜗传到大脑。

e.en: Damage to the {cochlea} can cause permanent hearing loss.
e.zh: 耳蜗受损可能导致永久性听力丧失。

cochlear.t: adj. 耳蜗的（如人工耳蜗）

e.en: His daughter received a {cochlear} implant at age two.
e.zh: 他女儿两岁时植入了人工耳蜗。

e.en: {Cochlear} implants help many deaf children learn to speak.
e.zh: 人工耳蜗帮助许多聋哑儿童学会说话。

cock.t:
n. 公鸡；龙头
v. 竖起；扳起扳机

e.en: The {cock} crowed loudly just before sunrise.
e.zh: 日出前那只公鸡大声打鸣。

e.en: He had to {cock} the rifle before firing.
e.zh: 他得先扣上步枪的击锤才能开火。

e.en: Their {cockapoo} puppy is friendly and barely sheds at all.
e.zh: 他们家的可卡贵宾小狗很友好,几乎不掉毛。

e.en: A {cockapoo} mixes a poodle with a cocker spaniel.
e.zh: 可卡贵宾犬是贵宾犬和可卡犬的混血品种。

e.en: Her {cockatiel} whistles whenever the doorbell rings.
e.zh: 她的玄凤鹦鹉每次门铃一响就吹口哨。

e.en: A {cockatiel} can live for over twenty years.
e.zh: 玄凤鹦鹉可以活二十多年。

e.en: The white {cockatoo} screamed loudly from its perch.
e.zh: 那只白色凤头鹦鹉在栖木上大声尖叫。

e.en: A {cockatoo} can mimic human speech surprisingly well.
e.zh: 凤头鹦鹉能惟妙惟肖地模仿人类说话。

cocked.t: adj. 翘起的；扳上扳机的

e.en: The dog {cocked} its head curiously at the sound.
e.zh: 那只狗听到声音好奇地歪了歪头。

e.en: He {cocked} an eyebrow when he heard the news.
e.zh: 他听到这个消息时挑起了一边的眉毛。

e.en: Their golden {cocker} spaniel loves chasing tennis balls.
e.zh: 他们家那只金色可卡犬最爱追网球。

e.en: A {cocker} spaniel needs regular brushing to avoid mats.
e.zh: 可卡犬需要定期梳毛以避免打结。

cockerel.t: n. 未满一岁的小公鸡

e.en: A young {cockerel} was strutting around the farmyard.
e.zh: 一只年轻的小公鸡在农场院子里昂首阔步。

e.en: The {cockerel} began crowing well before dawn.
e.zh: 那只小公鸡天还没亮就开始打鸣了。

cockermouth.t: n. 科克茅斯（英国地名）

e.en: We drove through {Cockermouth} on our way to the Lake District.
e.zh: 我们开车经过科克茅斯前往湖区。

e.en: The poet Wordsworth was born in {Cockermouth} in 1770.
e.zh: 诗人华兹华斯于1770年出生在科克茅斯。

e.en: He came up with another {cockeyed} scheme to get rich quick.
e.zh: 他又想出了一个荒唐的快速致富计划。

e.en: The picture frame hung at a {cockeyed} angle on the wall.
e.zh: 相框在墙上挂得歪歪斜斜的。

coaches.t:
n. 教练（复数）
n. 长途客车

e.en: The {coaches} met to discuss next season's strategy.
e.zh: 教练们开会讨论下赛季的战略。

e.en: Several {coaches} were waiting outside the stadium for fans.
e.zh: 几辆大巴停在体育场外等候球迷。

coaching.t:
n. 辅导；教练工作
v. 训练

e.en: He offers private {coaching} sessions for young tennis players.
e.zh: 他为年轻网球选手提供私人指导课程。

e.en: Executive {coaching} has become popular in tech companies.
e.zh: 高管辅导在科技公司中已变得很流行。

e.en: Her weekly {coachings} helped him land the promotion.
e.zh: 她每周的辅导帮助他获得了晋升。

e.en: The mentor's {coachings} shaped a generation of leaders.
e.zh: 这位导师的指导塑造了一代领导者。

coachload.t: n. 一辆大巴的乘客量

e.en: A {coachload} of tourists arrived at the castle gates.
e.zh: 一大巴车的游客抵达了城堡门口。

e.en: They expected a whole {coachload} of fans for the match.
e.zh: 他们预计会有满满一车球迷来看比赛。

e.en: The {coachman} tipped his hat as the carriage rolled by.
e.zh: 马车经过时,车夫掀了掀帽子致意。

e.en: An old {coachman} drove the wedding carriage through town.
e.zh: 一位年长的车夫驾着婚礼马车穿过小镇。

e.en: The vintage car's {coachwork} was beautifully restored.
e.zh: 这辆老爷车的车身被精美地修复了。

e.en: Italian {coachwork} is famous for its elegant lines.
e.zh: 意大利的车身设计以优雅的线条而闻名。

e.en: Doctors gave him a {coagulant} to stop the bleeding.
e.zh: 医生给他用了凝血剂来止血。

e.en: The factory adds a {coagulant} to purify the wastewater.
e.zh: 工厂加入凝结剂来净化废水。

e.en: Blood will quickly {coagulate} when exposed to air.
e.zh: 血液暴露在空气中会迅速凝结。

e.en: Lemon juice causes the milk to {coagulate} into curds.
e.zh: 柠檬汁会使牛奶凝结成凝乳。

coagulated.t:
adj. 已凝固的
v. 凝固（过去式）

e.en: The spilled paint had {coagulated} into a sticky lump.
e.zh: 洒出的油漆已经凝结成一团黏糊糊的东西。

e.en: Her wound had {coagulated} by the time help arrived.
e.zh: 救援到达时她的伤口已经凝血了。

e.en: Vitamin K plays a key role in blood {coagulation}.
e.zh: 维生素K在血液凝固中起着关键作用。

e.en: The patient suffers from a {coagulation} disorder.
e.zh: 该病人患有凝血功能障碍。

e.en: The old power plant still burns {coal} for electricity.
e.zh: 那座老电厂仍然烧煤来发电。

e.en: He shoveled {coal} into the furnace all morning.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在往炉子里铲煤。

e.en: The protesters began to {coalesce} into a single movement.
e.zh: 抗议者开始汇聚成一场统一的运动。

e.en: Small startups often {coalesce} around shared technology.
e.zh: 小型创业公司常围绕共同技术联合起来。

e.en: The {coalescence} of the two parties surprised analysts.
e.zh: 两党的合并令分析人士感到意外。

e.en: Cloud {coalescence} forms larger droplets and eventually rain.
e.zh: 云中水滴聚合形成更大的水滴,最终成为雨水。

e.en: Public opinion is slowly {coalescing} around the new candidate.
e.zh: 公众舆论正慢慢汇聚到这位新候选人身上。

e.en: The droplets are {coalescing} into a single stream.
e.zh: 水滴正在汇聚成一股水流。

e.en: Workers at the {coalface} know the real challenges firsthand.
e.zh: 一线工人最了解实际面临的挑战。

e.en: He spent twenty years toiling at the {coalface}.
e.zh: 他在采煤工作面辛苦干了二十年。

e.en: The northern {coalfield} once employed thousands of miners.
e.zh: 北部煤田曾雇佣过数千名矿工。

e.en: Production at the {coalfield} declined sharply after 1990.
e.zh: 1990年后煤田的产量急剧下降。

e.en: The ship stopped at the port for {coaling} overnight.
e.zh: 船只在港口停靠一夜以装煤。

e.en: A {coaling} station was built along the trade route.
e.zh: 沿着贸易路线建起了一座加煤站。

e.en: Grandma kept the fire going with {coalite} all winter.
e.zh: 奶奶整个冬天都用焦煤维持炉火。

e.en: The shop sold bags of {coalite} for home heating.
e.zh: 那家店出售用于家用取暖的焦煤。

e.en: The two parties formed a {coalition} after the election.
e.zh: 选举后两党组成了联合政府。

e.en: A broad {coalition} of charities supported the new bill.
e.zh: 一个由众多慈善机构组成的联盟支持这项新法案。

e.en: The country has a long history of {coalitional} politics.
e.zh: 该国有着悠久的联合政治传统。

e.en: {Coalitional} bargaining shaped the final policy outcome.
e.zh: 联盟间的谈判塑造了最终的政策结果。

e.en: Several {coalitions} formed to oppose the controversial law.
e.zh: 几个联盟联合起来反对这项有争议的法律。

e.en: Building {coalitions} takes patience and political skill.
e.zh: 建立联盟需要耐心和政治技巧。

e.en: The {coalman} delivered sacks to every house on the street.
e.zh: 送煤工给街上每家每户都送了煤袋。

e.en: My grandfather worked as a {coalman} for thirty years.
e.zh: 我祖父做了三十年的送煤工。

e.en: The old {coalmine} closed after a century of operation.
e.zh: 那座老煤矿在运营一个世纪后关闭了。

e.en: Safety conditions in the {coalmine} have greatly improved.
e.zh: 煤矿的安全条件已经大大改善。

e.en: His father worked as a {coalminer} in the valley.
e.zh: 他父亲在那条山谷里当煤矿工人。

e.en: The {coalminer} emerged from the shaft covered in dust.
e.zh: 那位煤矿工人从竖井里爬出来,浑身是煤灰。

e.en: The bread is made with {coarse} whole-grain flour.
e.zh: 这种面包是用粗磨全麦面粉做的。

e.en: His {coarse} jokes made everyone uncomfortable at dinner.
e.zh: 他粗俗的笑话让晚餐桌上所有人都感到不自在。

e.en: Chop the onions {coarsely} before adding them to the pan.
e.zh: 把洋葱粗略地切碎,然后加到锅里。

e.en: He spoke {coarsely} to the waiter, embarrassing his date.
e.zh: 他粗鲁地对侍者说话,让约会对象很尴尬。

e.en: Years of farm work began to {coarsen} her hands.
e.zh: 多年的农活开始让她的手变得粗糙。

e.en: Public discourse seems to {coarsen} every election cycle.
e.zh: 公共讨论似乎每个选举周期都变得更加粗俗。

e.en: The {coarseness} of the fabric irritated her sensitive skin.
e.zh: 这布料的粗糙刺激了她敏感的皮肤。

e.en: He apologized for the {coarseness} of his remarks.
e.zh: 他为自己言语的粗鲁表示歉意。

coarsening.t:
n. 变粗糙
v. 使变粗（进行时）

e.en: Critics worry about the {coarsening} of online conversation.
e.zh: 评论人士担心网络对话日益粗俗化。

e.en: The {coarsening} sand indicated a stronger river current.
e.zh: 沙粒变粗表明河水流速加快了。

coast.t:
n. 海岸；沿海地区
v. 滑行

e.en: We rented a small cottage on the {coast} for summer.
e.zh: 我们在海岸边租了一间小屋过暑假。

e.en: He let the bike {coast} down the gentle hill.
e.zh: 他让自行车顺着缓坡滑行而下。

e.en: Many {coastal} towns are threatened by rising sea levels.
e.zh: 许多沿海城镇正受到海平面上升的威胁。

e.en: We drove along the scenic {coastal} highway for hours.
e.zh: 我们沿着风景优美的沿海公路开了好几个小时。

e.en: The car {coasted} silently into the empty driveway.
e.zh: 汽车悄无声息地滑进了空荡荡的车道。

e.en: She {coasted} through the exam without much effort.
e.zh: 她没费多大劲就轻松通过了考试。

coaster.t:
n. 杯垫
n. 沿海贸易船

e.en: Please put your drink on a {coaster} to protect the table.
e.zh: 请把饮料放在杯垫上以保护桌面。

e.en: The new roller {coaster} reaches speeds of 120 kilometers per hour.
e.zh: 这款新过山车的时速可达120公里。

e.en: The {coastguard} rescued three sailors from the sinking boat.
e.zh: 海岸警卫队从下沉的船上救出了三名水手。

e.en: A {coastguard} helicopter circled overhead during the search.
e.zh: 搜寻期间一架海岸警卫队直升机在头顶盘旋。

e.en: He's just {coasting} through his final year of school.
e.zh: 他在学校最后一年只是在混日子。

e.en: The yacht was {coasting} gently along the shoreline.
e.zh: 游艇沿着海岸线缓缓滑行。

e.en: Erosion is rapidly destroying the fragile {coastland}.
e.zh: 侵蚀正在迅速破坏脆弱的沿海地带。

e.en: The reserve protects miles of unspoiled {coastland}.
e.zh: 该保护区保护了数英里未被破坏的海岸地带。

e.en: Australia has one of the longest {coastline}s in the world.
e.zh: 澳大利亚拥有世界上最长的海岸线之一。

e.en: We hiked along the rugged {coastline} for two days.
e.zh: 我们沿着崎岖的海岸线徒步走了两天。

e.en: Australia has some of the most beautiful {coastlines} in the world.
e.zh: 澳大利亚拥有世界上最美丽的海岸线之一。

e.en: Rising seas threaten {coastlines} across the Pacific region.
e.zh: 海平面上升威胁着整个太平洋地区的海岸线。

e.en: Storms regularly batter the {coasts} of southern England.
e.zh: 风暴经常袭击英格兰南部的海岸。

e.en: He {coasts} downhill on his bike without pedaling.
e.zh: 他骑车不踩踏板,顺着下坡滑行。

coat.t:
n. 外套；涂层
v. 覆盖

e.en: Don't forget your {coat} — it's freezing outside.
e.zh: 别忘了你的外套,外面冷死了。

e.en: The walls need a fresh {coat} of paint.
e.zh: 这些墙需要重新刷一层漆。

coatbridge.t: n. 科特布里奇（苏格兰地名）

e.en: She grew up in {Coatbridge}, a town near Glasgow.
e.zh: 她在格拉斯哥附近的科特布里奇镇长大。

e.en: The train from Edinburgh stops at {Coatbridge} station.
e.zh: 从爱丁堡开来的火车在科特布里奇站停靠。

e.en: The pan is {coated} with a non-stick surface.
e.zh: 这只锅表面涂了一层不粘涂层。

e.en: Her shoes were {coated} in mud after the hike.
e.zh: 徒步过后她的鞋子上沾满了泥。

e.en: Hang your jacket on the {coathanger} by the door.
e.zh: 把你的外套挂在门边的衣架上。

e.en: The wire {coathanger} bent under the weight.
e.zh: 那个铁丝衣架被重量压弯了。

e.en: A thin {coating} of dust covered the old books.
e.zh: 那些旧书上覆盖着一层薄薄的灰尘。

e.en: The phone screen has a special anti-glare {coating}.
e.zh: 这部手机屏幕有特殊的防眩光涂层。

e.en: He stood {coatless} in the snow, shivering badly.
e.zh: 他没穿外套站在雪里,冻得直打哆嗦。

e.en: She rushed out {coatless} to grab the mail.
e.zh: 她没披外套就跑出去取邮件。

e.en: Please leave your umbrella on the {coatrack} by the entrance.
e.zh: 请把你的雨伞放在入口处的衣帽架上。

e.en: The wooden {coatrack} was overflowing with winter jackets.
e.zh: 那个木制衣帽架上挂满了冬季外套。

e.en: You can check your bag at the {coatroom} downstairs.
e.zh: 你可以把包寄存在楼下的衣帽间。

e.en: The restaurant's {coatroom} closes at midnight.
e.zh: 餐厅的衣帽间在午夜关闭。

e.en: Hang your {coats} on the hooks by the door.
e.zh: 把你们的外套挂在门边的钩子上。

e.en: She {coats} the chicken in flour before frying.
e.zh: 她在煎之前给鸡肉裹上一层面粉。

e.en: His {coattail} got caught in the closing door.
e.zh: 他的燕尾服下摆被关上的门夹住了。

e.en: The senator rode in on the president's {coattail}.
e.zh: 那位参议员是借总统的声势当选的。

e.en: Police raided an illegal {cockfight} on the outskirts of town.
e.zh: 警方查抄了城郊一场非法斗鸡比赛。

e.en: A {cockfight} is banned in most countries due to animal cruelty.
e.zh: 由于虐待动物,多数国家禁止斗鸡。

e.en: His {cockiness} during the interview cost him the job.
e.zh: 他面试时的自负让他失去了那份工作。

e.en: The young player's {cockiness} faded after a few tough losses.
e.zh: 几场惨败之后,这位年轻球员的傲气消散了。

cocking.t: v. 扳起（枪的）扳机；竖起

e.en: The dog kept {cocking} its head at the strange sound.
e.zh: 那只狗一直歪着头听那奇怪的声音。

e.en: He was {cocking} the rifle when the safety jammed.
e.zh: 他正在给步枪上膛时保险卡住了。

e.en: We collected a bucket of {cockle} shells along the beach.
e.zh: 我们沿海滩捡了一桶鸟蛤的壳。

e.en: Hot soup warms the {cockle} of your heart on a cold day.
e.zh: 寒冷的日子里,热汤暖人心扉。

cockney.t: n. 伦敦东区人；伦敦腔

e.en: He spoke with a thick {Cockney} accent from East London.
e.zh: 他说话带着浓重的伦敦东区考克尼口音。

e.en: The film features traditional {Cockney} rhyming slang throughout.
e.zh: 这部电影从头到尾都用传统的考克尼押韵俚语。

e.en: The pilot ran through checks before leaving the {cockpit}.
e.zh: 飞行员离开驾驶舱前完成了检查。

e.en: Smoke filled the {cockpit} after the warning light came on.
e.zh: 警示灯亮起后,烟雾弥漫了驾驶舱。

e.en: A huge {cockroach} scurried across the kitchen floor last night.
e.zh: 昨晚一只大蟑螂从厨房地板上窜过。

e.en: The apartment had a serious {cockroach} infestation problem.
e.zh: 那间公寓有严重的蟑螂泛滥问题。

e.en: The angry driver shouted "{cocksucker}!" out the window.
e.zh: 愤怒的司机冲着窗外骂了一句脏话。

e.en: Calling someone a {cocksucker} is considered extremely offensive.
e.zh: 骂人那个词被认为是极其冒犯的脏话。

cocksure.t: adj. 过于自信的，自负的

e.en: He was {cocksure} he would win the election easily.
e.zh: 他笃信自己能轻松赢得选举。

e.en: Her {cocksure} attitude annoyed her teammates during practice.
e.zh: 她那副自以为是的态度让队友训练时很反感。

e.en: She ordered a fancy {cocktail} at the rooftop bar.
e.zh: 她在楼顶酒吧点了一杯花式鸡尾酒。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {cocktail} of drugs for the infection.
e.zh: 医生开了多种药物组合来治疗这次感染。

e.en: They serve creative {cocktails} with house-made bitters here.
e.zh: 这里供应用自制苦精调制的创意鸡尾酒。

e.en: We met for {cocktails} before the show started.
e.zh: 演出开始前我们一起小酌了几杯。

cocky.t: adj. 自以为是的，骄傲的

e.en: Don't get too {cocky} just because you won one game.
e.zh: 别因为赢了一场就太得意忘形。

e.en: His {cocky} smile disappeared once the boss walked in.
e.zh: 老板一走进来,他那自负的笑容就消失了。

e.en: The smoothie blends {coco} water with fresh pineapple.
e.zh: 这款奶昔混合了椰子水和新鲜菠萝。

e.en: She named her little poodle {Coco} after the designer.
e.zh: 她以那位设计师的名字给小贵宾犬取名 Coco。

cocoa.t: n. 可可粉；热可可饮品

e.en: Nothing beats a mug of hot {cocoa} on a snowy night.
e.zh: 雪夜里没什么比一杯热可可更让人惬意。

e.en: Ghana exports vast quantities of {cocoa} beans every year.
e.zh: 加纳每年出口大量的可可豆。

e.en: The shop carries several premium {cocoas} from West Africa.
e.zh: 这家店出售好几款来自西非的优质可可粉。

e.en: Different {cocoas} produce noticeably different flavors in baking.
e.zh: 不同的可可粉在烘焙中会产生明显不同的风味。

cocobolo.t: n. 可可波罗木（热带硬木）

e.en: The guitar's back is made from rare {cocobolo} wood.
e.zh: 这把吉他的背板由稀有的可可波罗木制成。

e.en: Craftsmen prize {cocobolo} for its rich reddish-brown color.
e.zh: 工匠们看重可可波罗木浓郁的红棕色泽。

e.en: She cracked open a fresh {coconut} on the beach.
e.zh: 她在沙滩上敲开了一颗新鲜的椰子。

e.en: This curry uses {coconut} milk for a creamy texture.
e.zh: 这道咖喱用椰奶来增添顺滑口感。

e.en: Workers climb tall palms to harvest the ripe {coconuts}.
e.zh: 工人们爬上高大的棕榈树采摘成熟的椰子。

e.en: They sell fresh {coconuts} with a straw at the market.
e.zh: 集市上有人卖插着吸管的新鲜椰子。

cocoon.t:
n. 茧
v. 把…严密包起来

e.en: The caterpillar spun a silken {cocoon} on the leaf.
e.zh: 毛毛虫在叶子上结了一个丝质的茧。

e.en: She wrapped herself in a {cocoon} of blankets on the sofa.
e.zh: 她在沙发上把自己裹在毯子茧里。

cocooned.t: v. 把…包裹起来，隔绝保护

e.en: He {cocooned} himself in headphones and ignored the world.
e.zh: 他戴上耳机把自己封闭起来,对外界不理不睬。

e.en: The baby lay {cocooned} in a soft fleece blanket.
e.zh: 宝宝裹在柔软的绒毯里安静地躺着。

cocooning.t: n. 宅家自保；v. 作茧般包裹

e.en: During the pandemic, people spent months {cocooning} at home.
e.zh: 疫情期间,人们足不出户地宅了好几个月。

e.en: The trend of {cocooning} has boosted streaming service sales.
e.zh: 宅家趋势推动了流媒体服务的销量。

e.en: Silkworms produce {cocoons} that are unraveled into thread.
e.zh: 蚕吐出茧,人们再把它抽成丝线。

e.en: The pods looked like tiny green {cocoons} hanging from branches.
e.zh: 那些豆荚像挂在枝头的小绿茧。

cod.t:
n. 鳕鱼
abbr. 货到付款（cash on delivery）

e.en: We had grilled {cod} with lemon for dinner last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我们晚餐吃的是柠檬烤鳕鱼。

e.en: Atlantic {cod} stocks have collapsed due to overfishing.
e.zh: 由于过度捕捞,大西洋鳕鱼的种群已崩溃。

coda.t: n. 乐曲尾声；结尾部分

e.en: The symphony ends with a triumphant {coda} in C major.
e.zh: 这部交响乐以一段C大调的辉煌尾声收尾。

e.en: Her resignation served as the {coda} to a long career.
e.zh: 她的辞职为漫长的职业生涯画上了尾声。

coddle.t: v. 娇惯，溺爱；小火慢煮

e.en: Parents shouldn't {coddle} kids who refuse to do chores.
e.zh: 父母不该溺爱那些拒绝做家务的孩子。

e.en: The chef will {coddle} the eggs gently in warm water.
e.zh: 厨师会把鸡蛋在温水中慢慢温煮。

e.en: He was {coddled} by his grandparents throughout childhood.
e.zh: 他从小到大都被祖父母娇惯着。

e.en: She served {coddled} eggs with toast for brunch.
e.zh: 她在早午餐时端上了温煮蛋配吐司。

e.en: Critics accuse the league of {coddling} its star players.
e.zh: 批评者指责联盟过分纵容明星球员。

e.en: Stop {coddling} him; he needs to learn responsibility.
e.zh: 别再宠着他了,他得学会承担责任。

code.t:
n. 代码；密码
v. 编程，编码

e.en: She pushed her latest {code} changes to the main branch.
e.zh: 她把最新的代码改动推送到了主分支。

e.en: You'll need a six-digit {code} to access the building.
e.zh: 你需要一个六位数的密码才能进入这栋楼。

e.en: The spy memorized the {codebook} and then burned it.
e.zh: 间谍把密码本背熟后将其烧毁。

e.en: Researchers built a {codebook} to standardize their qualitative coding.
e.zh: 研究人员建立了一份编码手册来规范定性编码。

e.en: This video uses the H.265 {codec} for better compression.
e.zh: 这个视频使用 H.265 编解码器以获得更好的压缩效果。

e.en: You may need to install a new {codec} to play the file.
e.zh: 你可能需要安装一个新的编解码器才能播放该文件。

coded.t:
adj. 编码的
v. 编码；用暗语表达

e.en: He {coded} the entire prototype in a single weekend.
e.zh: 他在一个周末里就把整个原型程序写完了。

e.en: The message was carefully {coded} to avoid detection.
e.zh: 那条信息被精心加密以避免被发现。

e.en: The doctor prescribed cough syrup containing {codeine}.
e.zh: 医生开了一种含可待因的止咳糖浆。

e.en: Many countries restrict the sale of {codeine} without a prescription.
e.zh: 许多国家限制无处方销售可待因。

e.en: The project's internal {codename} was Blue Dragon.
e.zh: 该项目的内部代号是“蓝龙”。

e.en: Apple often uses a big-cat {codename} for new releases.
e.zh: 苹果常用大型猫科动物作为新产品的代号。

codependency.t: n. 病态的相互依赖关系

e.en: Their therapist identified clear signs of {codependency} in the relationship.
e.zh: 他们的治疗师在这段关系中发现了明显的相互依赖症状。

e.en: Recovery groups often address {codependency} alongside addiction issues.
e.zh: 康复团体常在处理成瘾问题的同时关注共依赖关系。

e.en: She's a self-taught {coder} who landed a job at a startup.
e.zh: 她是个自学成才的程序员,后来在一家初创公司找到了工作。

e.en: A good {coder} writes tests before shipping new features.
e.zh: 优秀的程序员会在发布新功能前先写测试。

e.en: The building must comply with current fire safety {codes}.
e.zh: 这栋建筑必须符合现行的消防安全规范。

e.en: He {codes} late into the night to meet the deadline.
e.zh: 他熬夜写代码以赶上截止日期。

e.en: The medieval {codex} contained beautifully illustrated manuscripts.
e.zh: 这本中世纪手抄本里有精美的插图手稿。

e.en: Scholars discovered an ancient {codex} hidden in a monastery.
e.zh: 学者们在一座修道院里发现了一本古老的手抄本。

e.en: Salted {codfish} is a staple ingredient in Portuguese cooking.
e.zh: 咸鳕鱼是葡萄牙烹饪中的主要食材。

e.en: The fishermen returned with crates full of fresh {codfish}.
e.zh: 渔民们带回了一箱箱新鲜的鳕鱼。

e.en: The old {codger} next door yells at kids on his lawn.
e.zh: 隔壁那个老头会冲着草坪上的孩子大吼大叫。

e.en: He's a lovable {codger} who tells the same stories endlessly.
e.zh: 他是个可爱的老头,反复讲着同样的故事。

e.en: She added a {codicil} to her will leaving money to charity.
e.zh: 她在遗嘱上附加了一份附录,将一笔钱捐给慈善机构。

e.en: The lawyer drafted a {codicil} to update the estate plan.
e.zh: 律师起草了一份遗嘱附录来更新遗产规划。

codification.t: n. 编纂成法典；系统化

e.en: The {codification} of common law took several centuries.
e.zh: 普通法的法典化历经了几个世纪。

e.en: Linguists worked on the {codification} of the endangered language.
e.zh: 语言学家致力于将这门濒危语言系统记录下来。

codified.t: v. 将…编成法典；系统化

e.en: The new statute {codified} years of court rulings.
e.zh: 这部新法规将多年来的法院判决系统编纂成法。

e.en: Industry best practices were {codified} into a written manual.
e.zh: 行业最佳实践被整理成了一本书面手册。

e.en: Lawmakers want to {codify} abortion rights into federal law.
e.zh: 立法者希望把堕胎权写入联邦法律。

e.en: The team plans to {codify} their workflow in a public document.
e.zh: 团队计划在公开文档中规范他们的工作流程。

coding.t:
n. 编码；编程
v. 写代码

e.en: She started learning {coding} through free online tutorials.
e.zh: 她通过免费的在线教程开始学习编程。

e.en: Medical {coding} requires precise knowledge of clinical terminology.
e.zh: 医学编码需要对临床术语有精确的掌握。

codling.t: n. 小鳕鱼；长形青苹果

e.en: The {codling} moth ruined half the apples in the orchard.
e.zh: 苹果蠹蛾毁了果园里一半的苹果。

e.en: Farmers spray pheromones to control {codling} moth populations.
e.zh: 农民们喷洒信息素来控制苹果蠹蛾的数量。

e.en: Each {codon} in mRNA specifies a particular amino acid.
e.zh: mRNA 中的每个密码子都对应一种特定的氨基酸。

e.en: A single mutation changed one {codon} and altered the protein.
e.zh: 一个单点突变改变了一个密码子,从而改变了蛋白质。

codpiece.t: n. 中世纪裤裆遮阴布

e.en: Renaissance men wore an ornate {codpiece} as a fashion statement.
e.zh: 文艺复兴时期的男士将华丽的护裆作为时尚象征。

e.en: The museum displays armor with an exaggerated metal {codpiece}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一套带有夸张金属护裆的盔甲。

e.en: The trawler hauled in dozens of {cods} that morning.
e.zh: 那天早上,拖网渔船捕到了几十条鳕鱼。

e.en: Atlantic {cods} have been heavily depleted by industrial fishing.
e.zh: 大西洋鳕鱼因工业化捕捞而数量锐减。

coed.t:
adj. 男女同校的
n. 女大学生

e.en: She attended a small {coed} boarding school in Vermont.
e.zh: 她在佛蒙特州一所男女同校的小寄宿学校就读。

e.en: The dorm became {coed} after the policy change last fall.
e.zh: 去年秋天政策调整后,这栋宿舍变成了男女混住。

e.en: The college embraced {coeducation} in the early 1970s.
e.zh: 这所学院在七十年代初开始实行男女同校。

e.en: Debates about {coeducation} shaped many private schools' identities.
e.zh: 关于男女同校的争论塑造了许多私立学校的特色。

e.en: The academy became fully {coeducational} after merging with a girls' school.
e.zh: 这所学院在与一所女校合并后实现了完全男女同校。

e.en: Most universities today are {coeducational} by default.
e.zh: 如今大多数大学默认都是男女同校。

e.en: The drag {coefficient} of the new car is impressively low.
e.zh: 这款新车的风阻系数低得令人印象深刻。

e.en: Multiply each variable by its {coefficient} before adding the terms.
e.zh: 先把每个变量乘以它的系数,再把各项相加。

e.en: Scientists were stunned when a living {coelacanth} was caught off South Africa.
e.zh: 科学家们对在南非海域捕到活的腔棘鱼感到震惊。

e.en: The {coelacanth} was thought extinct for sixty-five million years.
e.zh: 腔棘鱼曾被认为已灭绝六千五百万年。

e.en: She was diagnosed with {coeliac} disease after years of stomach pain.
e.zh: 在多年胃痛之后,她被诊断出患有乳糜泻。

e.en: The bakery makes bread suitable for {coeliac} customers.
e.zh: 这家面包店制作适合乳糜泻顾客食用的面包。

e.en: Many vitamins act as a {coenzyme} in metabolic reactions.
e.zh: 许多维生素在代谢反应中充当辅酶。

e.en: The drug works by blocking a key {coenzyme} in the pathway.
e.zh: 这种药物通过阻断该通路中的一种关键辅酶而起作用。

e.en: You can't {coerce} someone into loving their job.
e.zh: 你没法强迫别人去热爱自己的工作。

e.en: The manager tried to {coerce} the team into unpaid overtime.
e.zh: 经理试图强迫团队加无薪班。

coerced.t: v. 被迫（coerce 的过去式）

e.en: The witness claimed she was {coerced} into signing the statement.
e.zh: 证人声称自己是被胁迫才签下那份声明的。

e.en: Confessions {coerced} under pressure are inadmissible in court.
e.zh: 在压力下被迫做出的供词在法庭上不可采信。

e.en: The contract is invalid if signed under {coercion}.
e.zh: 如果合同是在胁迫下签署的,则属无效。

e.en: Good leadership relies on persuasion, not {coercion}.
e.zh: 好的领导力靠的是说服,而不是强迫。

e.en: The new law targets {coercive} control in domestic relationships.
e.zh: 新法律针对的是家庭关系中的胁迫性控制。

e.en: Critics called the tactics {coercive} and unethical.
e.zh: 批评者称这些手段具有强制性且不道德。

e.en: We spent the weekend hiking near {Coeur} d'Alene in Idaho.
e.zh: 我们周末在爱达荷州科达伦附近徒步。

e.en: The dessert was a delicate {coeur} à la crème with berries.
e.zh: 那道甜点是配着浆果的精致心形奶油酪。

e.en: The two civilizations were {coeval} but never made contact.
e.zh: 这两个文明同时存在,却从未有过接触。

e.en: These rock layers are {coeval} with the early dinosaurs.
e.zh: 这些岩层与早期恐龙处于同一时代。

e.en: The {coevolution} of flowers and bees is a classic biology example.
e.zh: 花与蜜蜂的协同进化是生物学上的经典例子。

e.en: Predator-prey {coevolution} drives many adaptations in nature.
e.zh: 捕食者与猎物的协同进化推动了自然界的许多适应性变化。

e.en: The orchid and its moth share a remarkable {coevolutionary} history.
e.zh: 这种兰花与它的传粉蛾有着非凡的协同进化史。

e.en: Researchers study {coevolutionary} dynamics between viruses and hosts.
e.zh: 研究人员研究病毒与宿主之间的协同进化动态。

e.en: Cats and dogs can {coexist} peacefully with proper introduction.
e.zh: 只要介绍得当,猫狗也可以和平共处。

e.en: Old traditions and new technology often {coexist} in big cities.
e.zh: 在大城市里,旧传统和新科技常常并存。

e.en: Peaceful {coexistence} between the two communities took decades to build.
e.zh: 两个社区之间的和平共处花了数十年才建立起来。

e.en: The park promotes {coexistence} between humans and wildlife.
e.zh: 该公园倡导人类与野生动物的共存。

e.en: Modern art and classical sculpture are {coexistent} in this museum.
e.zh: 现代艺术与古典雕塑在这家博物馆里并存。

e.en: The two religious traditions have been {coexistent} for centuries.
e.zh: 这两种宗教传统已经共存了好几个世纪。

coexisting.t: adj. 并存的、同时存在的

e.en: Doctors must treat several {coexisting} conditions in elderly patients.
e.zh: 医生必须同时处理老年患者身上并存的多种病症。

e.en: The app supports {coexisting} versions on the same device.
e.zh: 这款应用支持在同一设备上共存的多个版本。

coextensive.t: adj. 范围相同的、同延的

e.en: The rights of citizens are not {coextensive} with those of residents.
e.zh: 公民的权利与居民的权利并不完全等同。

e.en: His authority is {coextensive} with the boundaries of the district.
e.zh: 他的权限与该地区的边界范围一致。

cofactor.t:
n. 辅因子（生化）
n. 余因子（数学）

e.en: Magnesium acts as a {cofactor} for hundreds of enzymes.
e.zh: 镁是数百种酶的辅助因子。

e.en: Smoking is a major {cofactor} in heart disease risk.
e.zh: 吸烟是心脏病风险的一个重要协同因素。

e.en: I need a strong {coffee} before my morning meetings.
e.zh: 开早会之前我得来一杯浓咖啡。

e.en: Let's grab {coffee} and catch up on Saturday.
e.zh: 我们周六约着喝咖啡聊聊近况吧。

coffeecake.t: n. 咖啡蛋糕（佐咖啡的甜点）

e.en: She baked a cinnamon {coffeecake} for the brunch.
e.zh: 她为早午餐烤了一个肉桂咖啡蛋糕。

e.en: A slice of {coffeecake} pairs perfectly with morning espresso.
e.zh: 一块咖啡蛋糕配早晨的浓缩咖啡再合适不过了。

e.en: The neighborhood {coffeehouse} hosts open-mic nights every Friday.
e.zh: 街区的咖啡馆每周五都办开放麦之夜。

e.en: Writers love working from the cozy {coffeehouse} downtown.
e.zh: 作家们喜欢在市中心那家温馨的咖啡馆里工作。

e.en: My {coffeemaker} broke right before a deadline week.
e.zh: 我的咖啡机偏偏在截稿周之前坏了。

e.en: This {coffeemaker} brews a full pot in under five minutes.
e.zh: 这台咖啡机不到五分钟就能煮好一整壶。

e.en: She poured the last of the {coffeepot} into her mug.
e.zh: 她把咖啡壶里最后一点咖啡倒进了自己的杯子。

e.en: The diner keeps a fresh {coffeepot} on the burner all day.
e.zh: 这家小餐馆整天都在炉子上备着一壶新鲜咖啡。

e.en: We ordered two {coffees} and a slice of cake.
e.zh: 我们点了两杯咖啡和一块蛋糕。

e.en: The shop offers single-origin {coffees} from around the world.
e.zh: 这家店供应来自世界各地的单一产区咖啡。

coffer.t:
n. 金库、财库
n. 藏宝箱

e.en: The kingdom's {coffer} was nearly empty after the war.
e.zh: 战争之后,王国的金库几乎空了。

e.en: Tax revenue replenished the city's {coffer} this year.
e.zh: 今年的税收充实了市政府的金库。

e.en: Engineers built a {cofferdam} to keep the construction site dry.
e.zh: 工程师们建了一座围堰,让施工现场保持干燥。

e.en: The bridge piers were poured inside a temporary {cofferdam}.
e.zh: 桥墩是在临时围堰内浇筑完成的。

coffered.t: adj. 方格镶嵌的（天花板）

e.en: The library's {coffered} ceiling was carved from dark walnut.
e.zh: 图书馆的格子天花板是用深色胡桃木雕成的。

e.en: Renaissance palaces often featured ornately {coffered} ceilings.
e.zh: 文艺复兴时期的宫殿常常装有华丽的格子天花板。

e.en: The {coffin} was carried slowly from the church.
e.zh: 棺材被缓缓地从教堂里抬了出来。

e.en: That missed deadline was the final nail in the {coffin}.
e.zh: 那次错过的截止日期成了压垮项目的最后一根稻草。

e.en: The museum displayed several painted Egyptian {coffins}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几具彩绘的埃及棺木。

e.en: Plain wooden {coffins} were lined up at the memorial.
e.zh: 追悼会上摆放着一排朴素的木棺。

cog.t:
n. 齿轮齿
n. 小角色

e.en: He felt like just another {cog} in the corporate machine.
e.zh: 他觉得自己不过是公司这台机器里的一颗螺丝钉。

e.en: A single broken {cog} stopped the entire clock.
e.zh: 一个齿轮坏了,整座钟就停了。

e.en: The lawyer's argument lost {cogency} as the trial wore on.
e.zh: 随着审判进行,律师的论点逐渐失去了说服力。

e.en: Reviewers praised the essay for its clarity and {cogency}.
e.zh: 评审者称赞这篇文章清晰且具有说服力。

e.en: The factory uses {cogeneration} to produce both heat and electricity.
e.zh: 这家工厂使用热电联产同时发电和供热。

e.en: {Cogeneration} systems can dramatically improve energy efficiency.
e.zh: 热电联产系统能够大幅提高能源利用效率。

cogent.t: adj. 有说服力的、令人信服的

e.en: She made a {cogent} case for working from home.
e.zh: 她为在家办公提出了一个有力的理由。

e.en: The report offers a {cogent} analysis of the housing crisis.
e.zh: 这份报告对住房危机做了有说服力的分析。

e.en: He argued {cogently} that the policy needed reform.
e.zh: 他有力地论证了这项政策需要改革。

e.en: The professor explained the theory clearly and {cogently}.
e.zh: 教授清晰而有力地讲解了这一理论。

e.en: Give me a moment to {cogitate} on your proposal.
e.zh: 让我花点时间好好琢磨一下你的提议。

e.en: He likes to {cogitate} over coffee before answering emails.
e.zh: 他喜欢在回邮件前一边喝咖啡一边沉思。

e.en: After much {cogitation}, she finally accepted the offer.
e.zh: 经过反复思量,她终于接受了这个提议。

e.en: The decision required serious {cogitation} from the whole board.
e.zh: 这个决定需要整个董事会认真深思。

e.en: He poured a glass of {cognac} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他倒了一杯干邑白兰地。

e.en: The chef flambéed the dessert with a splash of {cognac}.
e.zh: 厨师淋了点干邑给甜点燃焰增香。

cognate.t:
adj. 同源的（词语、语言）
n. 同源词

e.en: "Night" and the German "Nacht" are {cognate} words.
e.zh: 英语的 night 和德语的 Nacht 是同源词。

e.en: Spanish learners often spot {cognate} terms from Latin roots.
e.zh: 学西班牙语的人常能认出源自拉丁词根的同源词。

e.en: The committee took {cognisance} of the new safety report.
e.zh: 委员会注意到了这份新的安全报告。

e.en: Senior staff must take {cognisance} of customer complaints quickly.
e.zh: 高层员工必须迅速关注客户的投诉。

e.en: The board is fully {cognisant} of the financial risks involved.
e.zh: 董事会完全了解其中涉及的财务风险。

e.en: Drivers should be {cognisant} of cyclists in the bike lane.
e.zh: 司机应当留意自行车道上的骑行者。

e.en: Sleep deprivation impairs {cognition} and memory.
e.zh: 睡眠不足会损害认知能力和记忆力。

e.en: Researchers study how aging affects {cognition} over time.
e.zh: 研究人员研究衰老如何随时间影响认知。

cognitional.t: adj. 认知的、与认知相关的

e.en: The philosopher developed a detailed {cognitional} theory of knowing.
e.zh: 这位哲学家发展出了一套详尽的认知理论。

e.en: His book outlines the {cognitional} structures behind human inquiry.
e.zh: 他的书阐述了人类探究背后的认知结构。

e.en: Puzzles can help maintain {cognitive} function as we age.
e.zh: 随着年龄增长,益智题有助于维持认知功能。

e.en: The therapist used {cognitive} behavioral techniques to treat anxiety.
e.zh: 治疗师使用认知行为疗法来治疗焦虑。

e.en: The task is {cognitively} demanding and requires full focus.
e.zh: 这项任务在认知上要求很高,需要全神贯注。

e.en: Children learn most quickly when {cognitively} engaged.
e.zh: 孩子们在认知上被充分调动时学得最快。

cognizable.t: adj. 可认知的；可受理的

e.en: The court ruled the offense was {cognizable} under federal law.
e.zh: 法院裁定该罪行根据联邦法律可以受理。

e.en: Only {cognizable} claims will be considered at this hearing.
e.zh: 本次听证会只审议法律上可受理的诉求。

e.en: The judge took {cognizance} of the new evidence presented.
e.zh: 法官受理并考虑了新提交的证据。

e.en: Management must take {cognizance} of staff burnout this quarter.
e.zh: 管理层必须重视本季度员工倦怠的问题。

e.en: Designers should be {cognizant} of accessibility from day one.
e.zh: 设计师从一开始就应当注意无障碍设计。

e.en: She was fully {cognizant} of the deadline when she agreed.
e.zh: 她答应时已经完全清楚截止日期。

e.en: His {cognomen} "Iron Mike" stuck with him for life.
e.zh: 他的绰号"铁迈克"伴随了他一生。

e.en: Roman citizens often had a personal name and a {cognomen}.
e.zh: 古罗马公民通常有一个本名和一个家族姓氏。

e.en: The wine is favored by {cognoscenti} around the world.
e.zh: 这款葡萄酒深受全球行家喜爱。

e.en: Only the art {cognoscenti} recognized the painter's early style.
e.zh: 只有艺术圈的内行才认得出这位画家的早期风格。

e.en: They decided to {cohabit} before getting married.
e.zh: 他们决定先同居再结婚。

e.en: Cats and dogs can {cohabit} peacefully if introduced young.
e.zh: 如果从小一起养,猫狗可以和平共处。

e.en: {Cohabitation} before marriage is increasingly common today.
e.zh: 如今婚前同居越来越普遍。

e.en: The law now offers some protections for {cohabitation} couples.
e.zh: 法律现在为同居伴侣提供了一些保护。

e.en: Her {cohabitee} of ten years inherited part of the estate.
e.zh: 与她同居十年的伴侣继承了一部分遗产。

e.en: A {cohabitee} may have fewer legal rights than a spouse.
e.zh: 同居者享有的法律权利可能少于配偶。

cohabiting.t: v. 同居（cohabit 的现在分词）

e.en: The couple has been {cohabiting} for nearly five years.
e.zh: 这对情侣已经同居近五年了。

e.en: More young people are {cohabiting} instead of marrying.
e.zh: 越来越多的年轻人选择同居而不是结婚。

e.en: The chapters don't quite {cohere} into a single argument.
e.zh: 这些章节未能很好地融合成一个统一的论点。

e.en: Wet sand particles {cohere} more easily than dry ones.
e.zh: 湿沙粒比干沙粒更容易粘在一起。

e.en: The essay lacks {coherence} between its main sections.
e.zh: 这篇文章各主要部分之间缺乏连贯性。

e.en: A good speech needs both clarity and {coherence}.
e.zh: 一篇好的演讲既要清晰又要有连贯性。

e.en: The study examines different {coherences} within political ideologies.
e.zh: 该研究考察了政治意识形态内部的不同连贯模式。

e.en: Various {coherences} emerge when the data is reorganized.
e.zh: 重新整理数据后,会浮现出多种内在一致性。

e.en: The report's {coherency} made it easy to follow.
e.zh: 这份报告条理清晰,读起来很顺畅。

e.en: Laser light is prized for its high {coherency}.
e.zh: 激光因其高度的相干性而备受重视。

coherent.t: adj. 连贯的；条理清晰的

e.en: She gave a clear and {coherent} answer to the question.
e.zh: 她对这个问题给出了清晰连贯的回答。

e.en: The team finally formed a {coherent} strategy for launch.
e.zh: 团队终于制定出一套连贯的发布策略。

coherently.t: adv. 连贯地；条理清晰地

e.en: He spoke {coherently} despite being woken in the middle of the night.
e.zh: 尽管半夜被叫醒,他说话依然条理清晰。

e.en: The author argues {coherently} for stricter privacy laws.
e.zh: 作者条理分明地论证了制定更严格隐私法的必要性。

e.en: The coach focused on building team {cohesion} this season.
e.zh: 教练这个赛季着重于建立团队凝聚力。

e.en: Social {cohesion} weakens when inequality grows too large.
e.zh: 贫富差距过大时,社会凝聚力会被削弱。

cohesive.t: adj. 有凝聚力的；紧密团结的

e.en: The new manager helped create a more {cohesive} team.
e.zh: 新经理帮助打造了一个更有凝聚力的团队。

e.en: Her outfit looked {cohesive} from head to toe.
e.zh: 她从头到脚的搭配看起来非常协调统一。

e.en: The brand's {cohesiveness} across platforms impressed investors.
e.zh: 该品牌在各平台上的统一性给投资者留下了深刻印象。

e.en: Group {cohesiveness} often improves after shared challenges.
e.zh: 共同经历挑战后,团队的凝聚力往往会提升。

e.en: Anglers caught several {coho} salmon on the river yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天垂钓者在河里钓到了好几条银鲑。

e.en: The restaurant serves wild {coho} grilled with lemon.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应柠檬烤野生银鲑。

cohort.t: n. 一群人；同伙；同类人群

e.en: The 2024 {cohort} of new hires starts training next week.
e.zh: 2024届新员工下周开始培训。

e.en: Researchers tracked the {cohort} of patients for ten years.
e.zh: 研究人员对这群患者进行了十年追踪。

e.en: Black {cohosh} is sometimes used to relieve menopausal symptoms.
e.zh: 黑升麻有时被用来缓解更年期症状。

e.en: She brewed a tea from dried {cohosh} root.
e.zh: 她用晒干的升麻根泡了一杯茶。

coif.t:
n. 发型；头罩
v. 做发型

e.en: The bride's elegant {coif} took two hours to style.
e.zh: 新娘那个优雅的发型花了两个小时才弄好。

e.en: The medieval nun wore a simple white {coif}.
e.zh: 那位中世纪修女戴着一顶简朴的白色头巾。

coiffed.t: adj. 做过发型的；精心梳理的

e.en: The news anchor was perfectly {coiffed} for the broadcast.
e.zh: 新闻主播为了直播把头发梳理得一丝不苟。

e.en: She arrived elegantly {coiffed} and dressed for the gala.
e.zh: 她头发精心打理、衣着典雅地出席了晚会。

e.en: Her elaborate {coiffure} drew attention at the wedding.
e.zh: 她那精致的发型在婚礼上引人注目。

e.en: The model changed her {coiffure} for every photo shoot.
e.zh: 模特每次拍摄都会更换发型。

coil.t:
n. 线圈；一卷
v. 盘绕

e.en: Please {coil} the garden hose before putting it away.
e.zh: 收起花园水管前请把它盘好。

e.en: A heating {coil} inside the kettle warms the water quickly.
e.zh: 水壶里的加热线圈能快速把水烧热。

e.en: The snake {coiled} tightly around the tree branch.
e.zh: 那条蛇紧紧地缠绕在树枝上。

e.en: He {coiled} the rope neatly and hung it on the wall.
e.zh: 他把绳子整齐地盘好挂在墙上。

coiling.t: v. 盘绕（coil 的现在分词）

e.en: Smoke was {coiling} up from the chimney into the cold air.
e.zh: 烟雾从烟囱里盘旋升入寒冷的空气中。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {coiling} cables after the concert.
e.zh: 音乐会结束后,他花了一下午时间盘绕电缆。

coin.t:
n. 硬币
v. 铸造；创造（新词）

e.en: She flipped a {coin} to decide who would go first.
e.zh: 她抛硬币决定谁先来。

e.en: Tech writers love to {coin} new buzzwords every year.
e.zh: 科技作者每年都喜欢造一些新流行词。

e.en: "Selfie" is a relatively recent {coinage} in English.
e.zh: "selfie"是英语中相对较新的一个造词。

e.en: Roman {coinage} from this period is highly collectible.
e.zh: 这一时期的罗马钱币极具收藏价值。

coincide.t: v. 同时发生；一致；重合

e.en: Our vacations happen to {coincide} this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天我们的假期碰巧重合了。

e.en: The product launch will {coincide} with the holiday season.
e.zh: 产品发布将与节日季同步进行。

e.en: Her arrival {coincided} with the start of the meeting.
e.zh: 她到达的时候正好会议开始。

e.en: The blackout {coincided} with a major storm in the area.
e.zh: 停电时正赶上当地发生了一场大风暴。

e.en: What a {coincidence} to run into you here!
e.zh: 在这儿遇到你真是太巧了!

e.en: It's no {coincidence} that sales rose after the ad campaign.
e.zh: 广告活动后销量上升绝非偶然。

e.en: The novel relies on too many unlikely {coincidences}.
e.zh: 这部小说依赖太多牵强的巧合。

e.en: A series of strange {coincidences} led him to the truth.
e.zh: 一连串奇怪的巧合最终把他引向了真相。

coincident.t: adj. 一致的；同时发生的

e.en: The market crash was {coincident} with the policy change.
e.zh: 市场崩盘恰好与政策变动同时发生。

e.en: Rising temperatures were {coincident} with melting glaciers.
e.zh: 气温上升与冰川融化同时出现。

e.en: Their meeting at the airport was purely {coincidental}.
e.zh: 他们在机场的相遇纯属偶然。

e.en: Any resemblance to real persons is entirely {coincidental}.
e.zh: 如有雷同纯属巧合。

e.en: {Coincidentally}, we both ordered the same dish.
e.zh: 很巧的是,我们俩点了同一道菜。

e.en: He arrived {coincidentally} just as the rain stopped.
e.zh: 他到的时候恰好雨刚停。

e.en: {Coincidently}, my phone died right as the call came in.
e.zh: 巧的是,电话打来的那一刻我手机正好没电了。

e.en: They moved to the same city {coincidently}, without planning it.
e.zh: 他们没有事先约好,却巧合地搬到了同一座城市。

coincides.t: v. 同时发生（第三人称单数）

e.en: Her birthday {coincides} with the company's anniversary.
e.zh: 她的生日恰好与公司周年纪念日同一天。

e.en: The festival {coincides} with the autumn harvest each year.
e.zh: 这个节日每年都与秋收时节重合。

coinciding.t: v. 同时发生（现在分词）

e.en: The exhibition is {coinciding} with the city's art week.
e.zh: 这场展览正好与该市的艺术周同期举办。

e.en: Two {coinciding} schedules made it hard to find a meeting time.
e.zh: 两个时间撞车的日程让人很难找到开会时间。

e.en: Doctors warned of a possible flu and COVID {coinfection} this winter.
e.zh: 医生警告今冬可能出现流感与新冠的合并感染。

e.en: {Coinfection} can complicate diagnosis and treatment.
e.zh: 合并感染可能让诊断和治疗变得更加复杂。

coins.t:
n. 硬币（复数）
v. 铸造

e.en: He emptied a jar of {coins} to pay for the parking.
e.zh: 他倒出一罐硬币来支付停车费。

e.en: The tech industry {coins} new terms almost every week.
e.zh: 科技行业几乎每周都会创造新的术语。

cointreau.t: n. 君度酒（柑橘利口酒）

e.en: A splash of {cointreau} adds depth to the margarita.
e.zh: 加一点君度橙酒能让玛格丽塔更有层次。

e.en: She keeps a bottle of {cointreau} for baking desserts.
e.zh: 她常备一瓶君度橙酒用来烘焙甜点。

e.en: Doormats made of {coire} are durable and eco-friendly.
e.zh: 用椰壳纤维做的门垫既耐用又环保。

e.en: The gardener mixed {coire} into the soil to retain moisture.
e.zh: 园丁把椰糠混入土壤以保持水分。

e.en: The textbook discussed {coital} positions in a clinical context.
e.zh: 教科书在临床语境下讨论了性交体位。

e.en: Some women experience {coital} discomfort that requires medical attention.
e.zh: 有些女性会出现需要就医的性交不适。

e.en: The article used the formal term {coitus} throughout.
e.zh: 这篇文章通篇使用了"性交"这一正式术语。

e.en: Couples are advised to avoid {coitus} during certain treatments.
e.zh: 在某些治疗期间,医生建议夫妻避免性行为。

e.en: It takes serious {cojones} to quit a job without a backup plan.
e.zh: 没有备选方案就辞职,真得有过人的胆量。

e.en: She had the {cojones} to challenge the CEO publicly.
e.zh: 她有胆量公开挑战首席执行官。

coke.t: n. 可口可乐；焦炭；可卡因（俚语）

e.en: I'll have a cheeseburger and a {coke}, please.
e.zh: 请给我一个芝士汉堡和一杯可乐。

e.en: Steel mills burn {coke} to produce extreme heat.
e.zh: 钢铁厂燃烧焦炭来产生高温。

e.en: The refinery installed a new {coker} unit last year.
e.zh: 这家炼油厂去年安装了一台新的焦化装置。

e.en: He worked as a {coker} operator for over twenty years.
e.zh: 他做焦化装置操作员已有二十多年。

cokes.t:
n. 可口可乐（复数）
n. 焦炭

e.en: She ordered two {cokes} and a basket of fries.
e.zh: 她点了两杯可乐和一篮薯条。

e.en: The vending machine was out of {cokes} by noon.
e.zh: 自动售货机中午就把可乐卖光了。

col.t: n. 山坳；两山之间的鞍部

e.en: The hikers crossed a high {col} between the two peaks.
e.zh: 徒步者穿越了两座山峰之间的一处高山垭口。

e.en: Snow blocked the {col} until late spring.
e.zh: 积雪一直堵塞着这处山口,直到春末才融化。

e.en: She prefers diet {cola} over the regular kind.
e.zh: 她更喜欢健怡可乐,而不是普通可乐。

e.en: The recipe uses {cola} to tenderize the beef.
e.zh: 这个菜谱用可乐来让牛肉变嫩。

e.en: Drain the pasta in a {colander} and rinse with cold water.
e.zh: 把意大利面倒进滤盆里沥干,再用冷水冲一下。

e.en: She washed the strawberries in a metal {colander}.
e.zh: 她用金属滤盆清洗草莓。

e.en: The cafe offers several craft {colas} brewed locally.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆供应几款本地酿造的精酿可乐。

e.en: Sales of sugary {colas} have declined in recent years.
e.zh: 近年来含糖可乐的销量有所下降。

e.en: Stephen {Colbert} cracked a joke about the election results.
e.zh: 斯蒂芬·科尔伯特拿选举结果开了个玩笑。

e.en: We watched {Colbert} interview the famous author last night.
e.zh: 我们昨晚看了科尔伯特采访那位著名作家。

colchester.t: n. 科尔切斯特（英国城市）

e.en: She moved to {Colchester} for a teaching job.
e.zh: 她搬到科尔切斯特去做教师工作。

e.en: {Colchester} is one of Britain's oldest recorded towns.
e.zh: 科尔切斯特是英国有记录的最古老的城镇之一。

cold.t:
adj. 冷的；寒冷的
n. 感冒

e.en: The coffee got {cold} while I was on the call.
e.zh: 我打电话的时候咖啡变凉了。

e.en: She caught a bad {cold} after the camping trip.
e.zh: 露营回来后她得了重感冒。

cold-blooded.t: adj. 冷血的；冷酷无情的

e.en: Snakes are {cold-blooded} and need sunlight to warm up.
e.zh: 蛇是冷血动物,需要阳光来取暖。

e.en: The film depicts a {cold-blooded} killer with no remorse.
e.zh: 这部电影描绘了一个毫无悔意的冷血杀手。

e.en: She {coldly} refused to answer the reporter's question.
e.zh: 她冷冷地拒绝回答记者的问题。

e.en: He stared {coldly} at his former business partner.
e.zh: 他冷冷地盯着他从前的生意伙伴。

e.en: The {coldness} in her voice surprised everyone at dinner.
e.zh: 她声音里的冷漠让晚餐上每个人都很吃惊。

e.en: I wasn't ready for the sudden {coldness} of the water.
e.zh: 我没料到水会突然这么冰冷。

e.en: Kids tend to catch more {colds} during the winter months.
e.zh: 孩子们在冬季更容易感冒。

e.en: Vitamin C won't actually prevent most common {colds}.
e.zh: 维生素C其实并不能预防大多数普通感冒。

coldstream.t: n. 科尔德斯特里姆（地名）

e.en: The {Coldstream} Guards marched past Buckingham Palace.
e.zh: 冷溪卫队从白金汉宫前列队走过。

e.en: He served three years in the {Coldstream} regiment.
e.zh: 他在冷溪团服役了三年。

e.en: We rented a cabin near {Coldwater} Lake last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在冷水湖附近租了一间小木屋。

e.en: The {Coldwater} fishing tournament draws anglers from across the state.
e.zh: 冷水钓鱼比赛吸引了全州各地的钓鱼爱好者。

cole.t:
n. 甘蓝；油菜
n. 科尔（人名）

e.en: Nat King {Cole} remains one of the great American singers.
e.zh: 纳特·金·科尔至今仍是美国最伟大的歌手之一。

e.en: My friend {Cole} just started his own design studio.
e.zh: 我朋友科尔刚开了自己的设计工作室。

e.en: The patient is recovering well after the {colectomy} last week.
e.zh: 病人上周做完结肠切除手术后恢复得很好。

e.en: A partial {colectomy} removes only the diseased section of bowel.
e.zh: 部分结肠切除术只切除有病变的那段肠子。

coleraine.t: n. 科尔雷恩（北爱尔兰城市）

e.en: She studied at the university campus in {Coleraine}.
e.zh: 她在科尔雷恩的大学校区读书。

e.en: {Coleraine} sits along the River Bann in Northern Ireland.
e.zh: 科尔雷恩坐落在北爱尔兰班恩河畔。

coleridge.t: n. 柯勒律治（英国诗人）

e.en: We read {Coleridge}'s poem in literature class today.
e.zh: 我们今天在文学课上读了柯勒律治的诗。

e.en: {Coleridge} wrote some of the most haunting lines in English.
e.zh: 柯勒律治写下了英语中最令人难忘的一些诗句。

coles.t: n. 科尔斯（姓氏/澳洲超市）

e.en: I picked up some bread at {Coles} on the way home.
e.zh: 我回家路上在Coles超市买了点面包。

e.en: {Coles} supermarkets are common across most Australian suburbs.
e.zh: Coles超市在澳大利亚大部分郊区都很常见。

coleslaw.t: n. 凉拌卷心菜丝沙拉

e.en: She made a creamy {coleslaw} to go with the barbecue.
e.zh: 她做了奶油凉拌卷心菜来配烧烤。

e.en: The fish tacos came with spicy {coleslaw} on top.
e.zh: 鱼肉玉米饼上面铺了辣味卷心菜沙拉。

e.en: The {coleus} on the porch has bright purple leaves.
e.zh: 门廊上的彩叶草长着鲜艳的紫色叶子。

e.en: I propagated several {coleus} cuttings in a glass of water.
e.zh: 我在一杯水里扦插繁殖了几株彩叶草。

e.en: The fishmonger recommended {coley} as a cheaper alternative to cod.
e.zh: 鱼贩推荐用青鳕鱼作为鳕鱼的便宜替代品。

e.en: She fried the {coley} fillets with lemon and herbs.
e.zh: 她用柠檬和香草煎了青鳕鱼柳。

e.en: I prefer {Colgate} toothpaste for sensitive teeth.
e.zh: 我喜欢用高露洁敏感牙齿专用牙膏。

e.en: She graduated from {Colgate} University with honors.
e.zh: 她以优异成绩从科尔盖特大学毕业。

e.en: The lab confirmed E. {coli} contamination in the lettuce.
e.zh: 实验室确认生菜被大肠杆菌污染。

e.en: Most strains of E. {coli} live harmlessly in our gut.
e.zh: 大多数大肠杆菌菌株无害地存在于我们的肠道中。

e.en: The baby cried for hours, possibly from {colic}.
e.zh: 宝宝哭了好几个小时,可能是肠绞痛。

e.en: Horse {colic} can become serious without quick veterinary care.
e.zh: 马的肠绞痛如果不及时兽医治疗会变得很严重。

e.en: Their newborn was {colicky} every evening for three months.
e.zh: 他们家新生儿连续三个月每天傍晚都肠绞痛。

e.en: A {colicky} baby can leave parents completely exhausted.
e.zh: 肠绞痛的宝宝会让父母筋疲力尽。

coliform.t:
n. 大肠菌类
adj. 大肠菌的

e.en: The water test detected high {coliform} bacteria levels.
e.zh: 水质检测发现大肠菌群细菌含量过高。

e.en: {Coliform} counts are a standard indicator of water safety.
e.zh: 大肠菌群数量是衡量水质安全的标准指标。

coliseum.t: n. 大竞技场；大型体育馆

e.en: The concert sold out the entire downtown {coliseum}.
e.zh: 这场演唱会让市中心整个大体育场都满座了。

e.en: Roman gladiators once fought in the great {coliseum}.
e.zh: 罗马角斗士曾在那座宏伟的大斗兽场里搏斗。

e.en: She was diagnosed with ulcerative {colitis} last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天被诊断患有溃疡性结肠炎。

e.en: Stress can trigger flare-ups of {colitis} symptoms.
e.zh: 压力会引发结肠炎症状的发作。

e.en: He scribbled {coll} as shorthand for college on his notes.
e.zh: 他在笔记上把college简写成coll。

e.en: The Isle of {Coll} lies off the western coast of Scotland.
e.zh: 科尔岛位于苏格兰西海岸外。

e.en: Designers and engineers must {collaborate} closely on this product.
e.zh: 设计师和工程师必须在这款产品上紧密合作。

e.en: We use Figma to {collaborate} on mockups in real time.
e.zh: 我们用Figma实时协作制作设计稿。

e.en: The two artists {collaborated} on a mural downtown.
e.zh: 这两位艺术家合作在市中心创作了一幅壁画。

e.en: Our team {collaborated} with researchers at three universities.
e.zh: 我们团队与三所大学的研究人员展开了合作。

collaborates.t: v. 合作（第三人称单数）

e.en: She regularly {collaborates} with musicians from different countries.
e.zh: 她经常和来自不同国家的音乐家合作。

e.en: The agency {collaborates} closely with local nonprofits.
e.zh: 该机构与当地非营利组织密切合作。

e.en: We're {collaborating} with a startup on the new app.
e.zh: 我们正在和一家初创公司合作开发这款新应用。

e.en: Several authors are {collaborating} on a science fiction anthology.
e.zh: 几位作家正在合作编写一本科幻选集。

e.en: Their {collaboration} produced one of the year's best albums.
e.zh: 他们的合作产出了年度最佳专辑之一。

e.en: Slack makes remote {collaboration} much easier for our team.
e.zh: Slack让我们团队的远程协作容易多了。

collaborationist.t: n. 通敌者；与敌合作者

e.en: The book exposes the {collaborationist} regime during the occupation.
e.zh: 这本书揭露了占领时期的合作主义政权。

e.en: Postwar trials targeted prominent {collaborationist} officials.
e.zh: 战后审判针对了主要的合作主义官员。

e.en: The brand's celebrity {collaborations} sell out within minutes.
e.zh: 该品牌的明星联名款几分钟内就售罄。

e.en: Cross-departmental {collaborations} have boosted innovation at the firm.
e.zh: 跨部门合作提升了公司的创新能力。

e.en: Notion offers a {collaborative} workspace for distributed teams.
e.zh: Notion为分布式团队提供了协作工作空间。

e.en: They built a {collaborative} culture where everyone shares ideas.
e.zh: 他们建立了一种人人分享想法的协作文化。

e.en: The team works {collaboratively} on every product decision.
e.zh: 团队在每个产品决策上都协同合作。

e.en: Students learn better when they solve problems {collaboratively}.
e.zh: 学生协作解决问题时学习效果更好。

e.en: Her longtime {collaborator} composed the score for the film.
e.zh: 她的长期合作者为这部电影谱写了配乐。

e.en: The professor lost his closest research {collaborator} last year.
e.zh: 那位教授去年失去了最亲密的研究合作伙伴。

e.en: The director thanked her {collaborators} during the awards speech.
e.zh: 导演在颁奖致辞中感谢了她的合作者们。

e.en: Open source projects rely on {collaborators} from around the world.
e.zh: 开源项目依靠世界各地的合作者。

e.en: She made a {collage} of family photos for the anniversary.
e.zh: 她为周年纪念日做了一幅家庭照片拼贴画。

e.en: The artist's latest {collage} uses old magazine clippings.
e.zh: 这位艺术家最新的拼贴作品使用了旧杂志剪报。

e.en: She {collaged} ticket stubs and postcards into her travel journal.
e.zh: 她把票根和明信片拼贴进了旅行日记。

e.en: The wall is {collaged} with concert posters from the nineties.
e.zh: 那面墙上拼贴着九十年代的演唱会海报。

e.en: Many skincare products claim to boost {collagen} production.
e.zh: 许多护肤产品声称能促进胶原蛋白生成。

e.en: Bone broth is naturally rich in {collagen} and minerals.
e.zh: 骨头汤天然富含胶原蛋白和矿物质。

collapse.t:
v. 倒塌；崩溃
n. 瓦解；折叠（UI）

e.en: Engineers worried the old bridge might {collapse} under heavy traffic.
e.zh: 工程师担心这座旧桥在重型车辆下可能会坍塌。

e.en: Click the arrow to {collapse} the sidebar menu.
e.zh: 点击箭头收起侧边栏菜单。

collapsed.t: adj. 已折叠的；已坍塌的

e.en: The roof {collapsed} after several days of heavy snow.
e.zh: 连续几天大雪后屋顶塌了。

e.en: He {collapsed} onto the couch after the long shift.
e.zh: 漫长的轮班结束后他瘫倒在沙发上。

collapses.t: v. 折叠；倒塌（第三人称单数）

e.en: The chair {collapses} flat for easy storage in small apartments.
e.zh: 这把椅子可以折叠平放,方便在小公寓里收纳。

e.en: The economy {collapses} whenever oil prices spike too quickly.
e.zh: 每当油价飙升过快,经济就会崩溃。

collapsible.t: adj. 可折叠的；可收起的

e.en: I bought a {collapsible} water bottle for hiking trips.
e.zh: 我买了一个可折叠的水壶用于徒步旅行。

e.en: The kayak is {collapsible} and fits in the trunk.
e.zh: 这艘皮划艇可折叠,能放进后备箱。

collapsing.t: v. 倒塌；崩溃（collapse 的现在分词）

e.en: Rescue workers searched the {collapsing} building for survivors.
e.zh: 救援人员在正在坍塌的建筑里搜寻幸存者。

e.en: The startup is {collapsing} under the weight of its debts.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正在债务重压下崩溃。

collar.t:
n. 衣领；项圈
v. 抓住

e.en: The dog's leather {collar} had a small brass nameplate.
e.zh: 那条狗的皮项圈上有一块小铜名牌。

e.en: He straightened his shirt {collar} before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前他理了理衬衫领子。

e.en: She broke her {collarbone} falling off her bike yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天从自行车上摔下来,锁骨断了。

e.en: The necklace rested gently against her {collarbone}.
e.zh: 项链轻轻贴在她的锁骨上。

e.en: Grandma always served {collard} greens with her Sunday dinner.
e.zh: 奶奶周日晚餐总是会做羽衣甘蓝。

e.en: He sautéed {collard} leaves with garlic and a bit of bacon.
e.zh: 他用大蒜和一点培根炒了羽衣甘蓝。

collards.t: n. 羽衣甘蓝（collard 的复数）

e.en: Southern {collards} are usually slow-cooked with smoked ham hock.
e.zh: 南方羽衣甘蓝通常和烟熏猪蹄一起慢炖。

e.en: I'm growing {collards} and kale in the backyard this fall.
e.zh: 今年秋天我在后院种了羽衣甘蓝和羽衣甘蓝菜。

e.en: Italian menus list dishes like {collare} di maiale for pork collar.
e.zh: 意大利菜单上会写着collare di maiale,意指猪颈肉。

e.en: The chef prepared a slow-roasted {collare} with rosemary and garlic.
e.zh: 厨师用迷迭香和大蒜慢烤了一道猪颈肉。

collared.t:
adj. 有领的；戴项圈的
v. 抓住（collar 过去式）

e.en: He wore a crisp {collared} shirt to the job interview.
e.zh: 他穿着一件笔挺的有领衬衫去面试。

e.en: Police {collared} the suspect just two blocks from the scene.
e.zh: 警方在距案发现场两个街区处抓住了嫌疑犯。

e.en: He prefers a {collarless} shirt for casual summer outings.
e.zh: 他在夏天的休闲场合更喜欢穿无领衬衫。

e.en: The designer launched a {collarless} jacket aimed at younger buyers.
e.zh: 这位设计师推出了一款面向年轻人的无领夹克。

e.en: All the dog {collars} on this shelf are half off today.
e.zh: 这层货架上所有的狗项圈今天半价。

e.en: Stiff white {collars} were standard office wear in the 1950s.
e.zh: 硬挺的白衬衫领是上世纪五十年代办公室的标配。

collate.t: v. 整理、核对（资料、页面）

e.en: Please {collate} the survey responses before tomorrow's meeting.
e.zh: 请在明天会议之前整理好这些调查反馈。

e.en: The printer can {collate} pages automatically into stapled sets.
e.zh: 这台打印机能自动把页面按顺序整理并装订成册。

collateral.t:
n. 抵押品
adj. 附属的；间接的

e.en: He used his car as {collateral} for the small business loan.
e.zh: 他用自己的车作为小企业贷款的抵押品。

e.en: Civilian casualties were dismissed as {collateral} damage by the military.
e.zh: 军方把平民伤亡说成是附带损害。

e.en: The bank issued {collateralized} loans backed by commercial real estate.
e.zh: 银行发放了以商业地产作为抵押的贷款。

e.en: {Collateralized} debt obligations played a key role in the 2008 crisis.
e.zh: 担保债务凭证在2008年金融危机中扮演了关键角色。

collation.t: n. 校对、整理；排序规则

e.en: The intern finished the {collation} of all the research notes.
e.zh: 实习生完成了所有研究笔记的整理汇编。

e.en: Database performance depends heavily on the chosen {collation} settings.
e.zh: 数据库性能在很大程度上取决于所选的排序规则设置。

e.en: My {colleague} from marketing will join us on the call.
e.zh: 我市场部的同事会一起参加这次电话会议。

e.en: She thanked a former {colleague} for recommending her for the role.
e.zh: 她感谢一位前同事推荐她担任这个职位。

e.en: Several {colleagues} stayed late to finish the quarterly report.
e.zh: 几位同事加班到很晚才完成季度报告。

e.en: He still keeps in touch with old {colleagues} from his first job.
e.zh: 他仍然与第一份工作时的老同事保持联系。

e.en: Kids love to {collect} stickers and trade them at school.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢收集贴纸,然后在学校里交换。

e.en: The driver will {collect} your package around three this afternoon.
e.zh: 司机大概今天下午三点来取你的包裹。

collectable.t: adj. 可收集的；值得收藏的

e.en: The vintage poster is highly {collectable} among film fans.
e.zh: 这张复古海报在影迷中很有收藏价值。

e.en: Unpaid invoices over six months old are rarely {collectable}.
e.zh: 超过六个月未付的发票几乎很难再追回了。

collected.t:
adj. 镇定的
v. 收集（过去式）

e.en: She remained {collected} even when the audience started shouting.
e.zh: 即使观众开始起哄,她依然保持镇定。

e.en: We {collected} signatures from over a thousand residents this week.
e.zh: 我们这周收集了一千多位居民的签名。

collectible.t:
n. 收藏品
adj. 值得收藏的

e.en: This limited-edition figure is now a valuable {collectible}.
e.zh: 这款限量版手办如今已成为珍贵的收藏品。

e.en: The first issue of the comic is highly {collectible} today.
e.zh: 这本漫画的第一期如今极具收藏价值。

e.en: He sells rare {collectibles} through an online auction site.
e.zh: 他通过一家在线拍卖网站出售稀有收藏品。

e.en: Sports {collectibles} can be worth thousands if properly preserved.
e.zh: 如果保存得当,体育收藏品可以价值数千美元。

collecting.t:
v. 收集（现在分词）
n. 收藏

e.en: She has been {collecting} stamps since she was eight.
e.zh: 她从八岁起就开始集邮了。

e.en: Volunteers were {collecting} donations outside the train station.
e.zh: 志愿者们在火车站外收集捐款。

e.en: His vinyl {collection} fills an entire wall of the living room.
e.zh: 他的黑胶唱片收藏占满了客厅的整整一面墙。

e.en: The museum unveiled its new spring {collection} last weekend.
e.zh: 博物馆上周末推出了新的春季馆藏系列。

e.en: Several private {collections} were lent to the museum for the exhibit.
e.zh: 几个私人收藏被借给博物馆用于本次展览。

e.en: The agency handles {collections} on overdue credit card accounts.
e.zh: 这家机构负责处理逾期信用卡账户的催收业务。

collective.t:
adj. 集体的；共同的
n. 集体

e.en: The {collective} effort of the team produced amazing results.
e.zh: 团队的集体努力带来了惊人的成果。

e.en: A small artists' {collective} runs the gallery downtown.
e.zh: 一个小型艺术家合作团体经营着市中心那家画廊。

e.en: The siblings {collectively} decided to sell their parents' house.
e.zh: 兄弟姐妹们共同决定卖掉父母的房子。

e.en: Customers {collectively} spent millions during the platform's first year.
e.zh: 在平台上线第一年,顾客们总共花费了数百万美元。

e.en: Soviet {collectivisation} forced peasants onto large state-run farms.
e.zh: 苏联的集体化运动将农民强行编入大型国营农场。

e.en: The {collectivisation} policy caused widespread famine in rural areas.
e.zh: 集体化政策在农村地区造成了大范围的饥荒。

e.en: Her essay contrasts Western individualism with East Asian {collectivism}.
e.zh: 她的文章对比了西方个人主义与东亚的集体主义。

e.en: Critics argue that {collectivism} can suppress personal initiative.
e.zh: 批评者认为集体主义可能会压制个人的主动性。

collectivist.t:
n. 集体主义者
adj. 集体主义的

e.en: Japan is often described as a {collectivist} society.
e.zh: 日本常被描述为一个集体主义社会。

e.en: The party adopted a {collectivist} approach to economic planning.
e.zh: 该党在经济规划上采取了集体主义的方针。

e.en: Researchers compare individualistic and {collectivistic} cultures across many studies.
e.zh: 研究人员在许多研究中比较了个人主义文化与集体主义文化。

e.en: Family loyalty plays a strong role in {collectivistic} societies.
e.zh: 在集体主义社会中,家庭忠诚扮演着重要角色。

e.en: The festival celebrates the {collectivity} of the village every spring.
e.zh: 这个节日每年春天都会庆祝整个村庄的集体生活。

e.en: He emphasized {collectivity} over individual achievement in his speech.
e.zh: 他在演讲中强调集体性高于个人成就。

e.en: Rapid {collectivization} disrupted agricultural output for an entire decade.
e.zh: 急速的集体化使农业产出整整十年都受到了冲击。

e.en: The book details how {collectivization} reshaped rural Chinese life.
e.zh: 这本书详细讲述了集体化如何重塑中国农村的生活。

e.en: The government tried to {collectivize} farms across the entire region.
e.zh: 政府试图将整个地区的农场全部集体化。

e.en: Some economists proposed plans to {collectivize} key industries after the war.
e.zh: 一些经济学家在战后提出了将关键产业集体化的方案。

e.en: A wealthy art {collector} bought the painting at auction yesterday.
e.zh: 一位富有的艺术收藏家昨天在拍卖会上买下了这幅画。

e.en: The tax {collector} sent a final notice last Friday.
e.zh: 税务征收员上周五寄来了最后通知。

e.en: Coin {collectors} gathered in the hotel ballroom for the annual show.
e.zh: 钱币收藏家们聚集在酒店宴会厅参加年度展览。

e.en: Debt {collectors} are required to follow strict legal guidelines.
e.zh: 催收人员必须严格遵守相关的法律规定。

collects.t: v. 收集（第三人称单数）

e.en: My grandfather {collects} antique pocket watches as a hobby.
e.zh: 我爷爷的爱好是收藏古董怀表。

e.en: The app {collects} usage data to improve recommendations.
e.zh: 该应用会收集使用数据,以改进推荐结果。

e.en: The novel's heroine is a young Irish {colleen} from Galway.
e.zh: 小说的女主角是一位来自戈尔韦的爱尔兰年轻姑娘。

e.en: He affectionately called his daughter his little {colleen}.
e.zh: 他亲切地把女儿叫做他的小姑娘。

e.en: She is starting {college} in the fall on a full scholarship.
e.zh: 她将在秋季凭借全额奖学金进入大学。

e.en: My older brother teaches at a community {college} nearby.
e.zh: 我哥哥在附近的一所社区大学任教。

e.en: Many {colleges} now waive application fees for low-income students.
e.zh: 许多大学现在为低收入学生免除申请费。

e.en: She is comparing several {colleges} before submitting her applications.
e.zh: 她在提交申请前正在比较几所大学。

e.en: The lab maintains a friendly, {collegial} atmosphere among researchers.
e.zh: 该实验室在研究人员之间保持着友好融洽的同事氛围。

e.en: Disagreements were handled in a {collegial} and respectful manner.
e.zh: 分歧的处理方式既有同事情谊,又彼此尊重。

e.en: The new dean wants to rebuild a sense of {collegiality} in the department.
e.zh: 新院长希望在系里重建一种同事之间的融洽氛围。

e.en: Strong {collegiality} helped the team survive a difficult year.
e.zh: 良好的同事关系帮助团队挺过了艰难的一年。

e.en: He looks like a typical {collegian} in his hoodie and backpack.
e.zh: 他穿着连帽衫背着双肩包,看起来就是个典型的大学生。

e.en: The young {collegian} won a prize for her short story.
e.zh: 这位年轻的大学生因她的短篇小说获了奖。

e.en: He played four years of {collegiate} basketball before turning pro.
e.zh: 他打了四年大学篮球,之后转入职业联赛。

e.en: The cafe has a cozy, {collegiate} atmosphere students love.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆有一种学生很喜欢的温馨大学校园氛围。

e.en: The papal {collegium} met to discuss the upcoming reforms.
e.zh: 教皇评议团召开会议,讨论即将进行的改革。

e.en: A small {collegium} of senior judges reviews the most sensitive cases.
e.zh: 由资深法官组成的小型评议委员会负责审理最敏感的案件。

collet.t: n. (机械) 夹头；宝石底座

e.en: Tighten the {collet} firmly before starting the milling machine.
e.zh: 在启动铣床之前要把弹簧夹头牢牢拧紧。

e.en: The jeweler reset the diamond into a new {collet}.
e.zh: 珠宝匠把钻石重新镶进了一个新的爪托里。

e.en: Two cars almost {collide} at the intersection every morning.
e.zh: 每天早上都有两辆车在那个路口差点相撞。

e.en: Their personalities tend to {collide} during high-pressure meetings.
e.zh: 他们的性格在高压会议中往往会发生冲突。

e.en: A delivery truck {collided} with a parked van last night.
e.zh: 昨晚一辆送货卡车与一辆停着的面包车相撞了。

e.en: His ambitions {collided} with the company's conservative culture.
e.zh: 他的雄心壮志与公司保守的文化产生了冲突。

e.en: The Large Hadron {Collider} discovered the Higgs boson in 2012.
e.zh: 大型强子对撞机于2012年发现了希格斯玻色子。

e.en: Engineers spent years building the underground particle {collider}.
e.zh: 工程师们花了数年时间建造这台地下粒子对撞机。

e.en: Modern {colliders} require enormous amounts of energy to operate.
e.zh: 现代粒子对撞机的运行需要消耗巨大的能量。

e.en: Two new {colliders} are being planned in Europe and China.
e.zh: 欧洲和中国正在规划建造两台新的对撞机。

e.en: When theory {collides} with reality, the theory usually loses.
e.zh: 当理论与现实发生冲突时,通常输的是理论。

e.en: A meteor occasionally {collides} with the Earth's atmosphere harmlessly.
e.zh: 偶尔会有流星撞入地球大气层,但并不会造成伤害。

e.en: Two galaxies are slowly {colliding} billions of light-years away.
e.zh: 两个星系正在数十亿光年外缓慢地相互碰撞。

e.en: Their {colliding} schedules made it hard to plan dinner.
e.zh: 他们日程上的冲突让安排晚餐变得很困难。

e.en: Their border {collie} can herd sheep with very little training.
e.zh: 他们家的边境牧羊犬几乎不用训练就能赶羊。

e.en: The old {collie} slept by the fire all afternoon.
e.zh: 那只老柯利牧羊犬整个下午都躺在炉火旁睡觉。

collier.t:
n. 煤矿工人
n. 运煤船

e.en: His grandfather worked as a {collier} in the Welsh mines.
e.zh: 他祖父曾在威尔士的煤矿里当矿工。

e.en: The {collier} returned home each night covered in coal dust.
e.zh: 那名煤矿工人每天晚上回家时身上都沾满了煤灰。

e.en: The old {colliery} closed after the coal seam ran dry.
e.zh: 煤层开采殆尽后,这座老煤矿关闭了。

e.en: He worked at the local {colliery} for nearly forty years.
e.zh: 他在当地的那座煤矿工作了将近四十年。

e.en: You need to {collimate} the telescope before serious astrophotography.
e.zh: 在进行正式的天文摄影前,你需要先校准望远镜的光轴。

e.en: Engineers carefully {collimate} the laser beam for precise measurements.
e.zh: 工程师仔细地把激光束校准成平行光,以便进行精确测量。

e.en: The instrument produces a tightly {collimated} beam of light.
e.zh: 该仪器能产生一束高度准直的光线。

e.en: A well {collimated} telescope shows much sharper star images.
e.zh: 光轴校准良好的望远镜能呈现出清晰得多的星点图像。

e.en: Poor {collimation} is the main reason your stars look blurry.
e.zh: 光轴校准不佳是星点看起来模糊的主要原因。

e.en: The technician checked the {collimation} of the X-ray machine.
e.zh: 技师检查了X光机的光束准直情况。

e.en: The {collimator} narrows the X-ray beam onto the target area.
e.zh: 准直器将X射线束聚焦到目标区域上。

e.en: Astronomers use a laser {collimator} to align telescope mirrors.
e.zh: 天文学家使用激光准直器来校准望远镜的反射镜。

e.en: The statistician checked for {collinearity} between the predictor variables.
e.zh: 统计学家检查了各预测变量之间的共线性。

e.en: High {collinearity} can make regression coefficients unreliable.
e.zh: 高度共线性会使回归系数变得不可靠。

collingwood.t: n. 姓氏/地名 科林伍德

e.en: He grew up in {Collingwood}, a quiet suburb of Melbourne.
e.zh: 他在墨尔本一个安静的郊区科林伍德长大。

e.en: The {Collingwood} football club has a passionate fan base.
e.zh: 科林伍德足球俱乐部拥有热情的球迷群体。

collins.t:
n. 姓氏 柯林斯
n. 柯林斯鸡尾酒

e.en: She ordered a Tom {Collins} at the hotel bar.
e.zh: 她在酒店酒吧点了一杯汤姆柯林斯鸡尾酒。

e.en: Mr. {Collins} signed the contract on behalf of the company.
e.zh: 柯林斯先生代表公司签署了合同。

e.en: The {collision} on the highway caused a major traffic jam.
e.zh: 高速公路上的撞车事故造成了严重堵车。

e.en: Hash functions aim to minimize the chance of {collision}.
e.zh: 哈希函数的目标是尽量减少冲突的发生。

e.en: Engineers tested how the car handles side {collisions}.
e.zh: 工程师测试了这款车应对侧面碰撞的表现。

e.en: Database indexes help reduce key {collisions} in lookups.
e.zh: 数据库索引有助于减少查找时的键冲突。

e.en: "Heavy rain" is a common English {collocation}.
e.zh: "heavy rain"是英语中常见的搭配。

e.en: Learning natural {collocation} helps you sound more fluent.
e.zh: 学习自然的词语搭配能让你说得更地道。

e.en: This dictionary highlights useful {collocations} for each entry.
e.zh: 这本词典为每个词条标注了实用搭配。

e.en: Native speakers use {collocations} without thinking about them.
e.zh: 母语者使用词语搭配时根本不用思考。

e.en: The photographer coated the glass plate with {collodion}.
e.zh: 摄影师在玻璃板上涂了一层火棉胶。

e.en: Doctors sometimes apply {collodion} to seal small wounds.
e.zh: 医生有时会用火棉胶封住小伤口。

e.en: Milk is a familiar example of a {colloid}.
e.zh: 牛奶是一种常见的胶体。

e.en: The nurse hung a bag of {colloid} solution for the patient.
e.zh: 护士为病人挂上了一袋胶体溶液。

e.en: She bought a bottle of {colloidal} silver from the pharmacy.
e.zh: 她从药店买了一瓶胶体银。

e.en: Fog forms a {colloidal} suspension of water in air.
e.zh: 雾是水在空气中形成的胶体悬浮物。

e.en: "Gonna" is a {colloquial} form of "going to".
e.zh: "gonna"是"going to"的口语化形式。

e.en: Avoid {colloquial} expressions in your academic essay.
e.zh: 在学术论文中要避免使用口语化表达。

e.en: The textbook explained each {colloquialism} with a simple example.
e.zh: 课本用简单的例句解释了每个口语用语。

e.en: "Bucks" for dollars is a typical American {colloquialism}.
e.zh: 用"bucks"指代美元是典型的美式口语用法。

e.en: The dish is {colloquially} known as "comfort food".
e.zh: 这道菜在口语中被称为"治愈系食物"。

e.en: That neighborhood is {colloquially} called "the village".
e.zh: 那个街区在当地口语中叫做"村子"。

e.en: The physics department hosts a weekly {colloquium} on Fridays.
e.zh: 物理系每周五举办一场学术研讨会。

e.en: She presented her thesis at the graduate {colloquium}.
e.zh: 她在研究生学术研讨会上汇报了她的论文。

e.en: The university organized several {colloquiums} on climate change.
e.zh: 这所大学组织了几场关于气候变化的研讨会。

e.en: Visiting scholars often speak at our {colloquiums}.
e.zh: 访问学者经常在我们的研讨会上发言。

e.en: The judge held a brief {colloquy} with the defendant.
e.zh: 法官与被告进行了简短的对话。

e.en: Their evening {colloquy} stretched on for hours over coffee.
e.zh: 他们晚间的一席长谈在咖啡桌旁延续了数小时。

e.en: The two firms were accused of conspiring to {collude} on prices.
e.zh: 这两家公司被指控合谋串通定价。

e.en: Officials may not {collude} with contractors to rig bids.
e.zh: 官员不得与承包商串通操纵投标。

e.en: Investigators found evidence of {collusion} between the bidders.
e.zh: 调查人员发现了投标方之间串通的证据。

e.en: The leaked emails suggest {collusion} to fix prices.
e.zh: 泄露的邮件表明存在合谋定价的行为。

e.en: Regulators fined the firms for {collusive} bidding practices.
e.zh: 监管机构因串通投标行为处罚了这些公司。

e.en: Their {collusive} arrangement hurt smaller competitors badly.
e.zh: 他们的合谋安排严重损害了小型竞争对手。

colly.t:
n. 煤灰
v. 弄黑

e.en: His boots were {colly} from walking through the coal yard.
e.zh: 他穿过煤场后,靴子上沾满了煤灰。

e.en: The old miner wiped the {colly} dust from his face.
e.zh: 老矿工擦掉了脸上的煤黑灰尘。

colne.t: n. 地名 科恩（英国）

e.en: The town of {Colne} sits in the hills of Lancashire.
e.zh: 科恩镇坐落在兰开夏郡的丘陵中。

e.en: They walked along the River {Colne} on a sunny afternoon.
e.zh: 他们在一个晴朗的下午沿科恩河散步。

e.en: A black-and-white {colobus} leapt between the forest branches.
e.zh: 一只黑白疣猴在林间枝头跳跃。

e.en: The {colobus} monkey is known for its long, silky tail.
e.zh: 疣猴以其长而柔顺的尾巴而闻名。

cologne.t:
n. 古龙水
n. 科隆（德国城市）

e.en: He splashed on a bit of {cologne} before the date.
e.zh: 约会前他喷了一点古龙水。

e.en: We caught an early train to {Cologne} for the festival.
e.zh: 我们坐早班火车去科隆参加节日活动。

e.en: {Colombia} is famous for its high-quality coffee beans.
e.zh: 哥伦比亚以其优质的咖啡豆而闻名。

e.en: She traveled across {Colombia} during her gap year.
e.zh: 她在间隔年期间走遍了哥伦比亚。

colombian.t:
adj. 哥伦比亚的
n. 哥伦比亚人

e.en: He brewed a fresh pot of {Colombian} coffee for breakfast.
e.zh: 他早餐煮了一壶新鲜的哥伦比亚咖啡。

e.en: The {Colombian} delegation arrived at the summit yesterday.
e.zh: 哥伦比亚代表团昨天抵达峰会现场。

colombo.t: n. 科伦坡（斯里兰卡首都）

e.en: Our flight landed in {Colombo} just before sunrise.
e.zh: 我们的航班在日出前降落在科伦坡。

e.en: {Colombo} is the largest city in Sri Lanka.
e.zh: 科伦坡是斯里兰卡最大的城市。

colon.t:
n. 冒号
n. 结肠

e.en: Use a {colon} before introducing a list of items.
e.zh: 在引出一个列表之前要使用冒号。

e.en: The doctor recommended a screening for {colon} cancer.
e.zh: 医生建议做一次结肠癌筛查。

e.en: The {colonel} addressed the troops before the mission.
