e.zh: 工程师测量了这种新型泡沫的可压缩性。

e.en: Gases have much higher {compressibility} than liquids.
e.zh: 气体的可压缩性比液体高得多。

e.en: The sleeping bag is highly {compressible} for backpacking.
e.zh: 这款睡袋压缩性很好,非常适合背包旅行。

e.en: Text files are usually more {compressible} than photos.
e.zh: 文本文件通常比照片更容易压缩。

e.en: Lossless {compression} preserves every detail of the original file.
e.zh: 无损压缩保留原始文件的每一个细节。

e.en: She wore a {compression} sleeve to support her elbow.
e.zh: 她戴了一只压缩护套来保护肘部。

e.en: Give thirty chest {compressions} before each set of breaths.
e.zh: 每组人工呼吸前先做三十次胸外按压。

e.en: Different {compressions} produce different file sizes and quality.
e.zh: 不同的压缩方式会产生不同的文件大小和画质。

e.en: Concrete has excellent {compressive} strength but weak tensile strength.
e.zh: 混凝土的抗压强度很强,但抗拉强度较弱。

e.en: The bridge's pillars handle huge {compressive} loads daily.
e.zh: 桥墩每天承受着巨大的压缩载荷。

e.en: The fridge's {compressor} started making a strange noise.
e.zh: 冰箱的压缩机开始发出奇怪的声音。

e.en: Producers use a {compressor} to even out vocal levels.
e.zh: 制作人用压缩器来平衡人声音量。

e.en: Women {comprise} nearly half of the company's engineers.
e.zh: 女性几乎占了这家公司工程师的一半。

e.en: Six small islands {comprise} the entire archipelago.
e.zh: 六个小岛构成了整个群岛。

comprised.t: v. 包含；由…组成（过去式）

e.en: The team {comprised} five engineers and one designer.
e.zh: 该团队由五名工程师和一名设计师组成。

e.en: Last year's budget {comprised} salaries, rent, and marketing costs.
e.zh: 去年的预算包括工资、租金和营销开支。

comprises.t: v. 包含；由…组成（第三人称单数）

e.en: The course {comprises} ten lectures and two workshops.
e.zh: 这门课程由十次讲座和两次研讨会组成。

e.en: The kit {comprises} everything needed to assemble the desk.
e.zh: 这套工具包含组装书桌所需的一切。

comprising.t: v. 包含；由…组成（现在分词）

e.en: She leads a panel {comprising} doctors and researchers.
e.zh: 她领导一个由医生和研究人员组成的小组。

e.en: The album, {comprising} twelve tracks, drops next Friday.
e.zh: 这张含十二首曲目的专辑将于下周五发行。

compromise.t:
n. 妥协；折衷
v. 妥协；（安全）受损

e.en: Both sides reached a fair {compromise} after long talks.
e.zh: 经过长时间谈判,双方达成了公平的妥协。

e.en: Don't {compromise} on safety just to save money.
e.zh: 不要为了省钱而在安全上让步。

compromised.t:
adj. 受损的；（账号）被盗
v. 妥协（过去式）

e.en: Hackers {compromised} thousands of user accounts overnight.
e.zh: 黑客一夜之间入侵了数千个用户账户。

e.en: His immune system is severely {compromised} after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后他的免疫系统严重受损。

e.en: She's a natural {compromiser} who keeps the team aligned.
e.zh: 她天生善于妥协,能让团队保持一致。

e.en: Critics called the senator a weak {compromiser}.
e.zh: 批评者称这位参议员是个软弱的妥协者。

compromises.t: n./v. 妥协（复数/第三人称单数）

e.en: Every marriage requires small daily {compromises}.
e.zh: 每段婚姻都需要每天作出小小的让步。

e.en: Cheap insulation {compromises} the building's energy efficiency.
e.zh: 廉价的保温材料会损害建筑的能效。

compromising.t:
v. 妥协（现在分词）
adj. 有损名誉的

e.en: She refused to sign without {compromising} her principles.
e.zh: 她拒绝在不违背原则的情况下签字。

e.en: The photo put him in a {compromising} position.
e.zh: 那张照片让他陷入了尴尬的处境。

e.en: The rapper grew up in {Compton}, California.
e.zh: 这位说唱歌手在加州康普顿长大。

e.en: Physicists still teach the {Compton} scattering experiment today.
e.zh: 物理学家至今仍在讲授康普顿散射实验。

e.en: The state {comptroller} audits all public spending.
e.zh: 州审计长负责审计所有公共支出。

e.en: She was promoted to {comptroller} of the hospital network.
e.zh: 她被提升为医院网络的财务总监。

e.en: He felt a strange {compulsion} to check his phone.
e.zh: 他有一种奇怪的冲动想去看手机。

e.en: No one signed the contract under {compulsion}.
e.zh: 没有人是被强迫签下这份合同的。

e.en: Therapy helped her manage her cleaning {compulsions}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助她控制了反复清洁的强迫行为。

e.en: Late-night snacking is one of his worst {compulsions}.
e.zh: 深夜吃零食是他最难戒掉的冲动之一。

compulsive.t: adj. 强迫性的；难以自控的

e.en: He's a {compulsive} liar who can't help himself.
e.zh: 他是个无法自控的强迫性说谎者。

e.en: Online shopping became a {compulsive} habit during lockdown.
e.zh: 封锁期间网购成了一种强迫性习惯。

compulsively.t: adv. 强迫性地；难以自控地

e.en: She refreshes her email {compulsively} every few minutes.
e.zh: 她每隔几分钟就强迫性地刷新一次邮箱。

e.en: He bites his nails {compulsively} when stressed.
e.zh: 他一紧张就忍不住咬指甲。

e.en: His {compulsiveness} about deadlines drives the whole team crazy.
e.zh: 他对截止日期的强迫症让整个团队抓狂。

e.en: Therapy slowly reduced the {compulsiveness} of her routines.
e.zh: 治疗逐渐减轻了她日常行为的强迫性。

e.en: All passengers are {compulsorily} screened before boarding.
e.zh: 所有乘客在登机前都必须接受强制安检。

e.en: The land was {compulsorily} purchased for the new highway.
e.zh: 这片土地为修建新高速公路被强制征收。

e.en: Wearing seatbelts is {compulsory} in every car.
e.zh: 在每辆车里系安全带都是强制性的。

e.en: English is a {compulsory} subject at this school.
e.zh: 英语是这所学校的必修科目。

e.en: He fired the staff without the slightest {compunction}.
e.zh: 他毫无愧疚地解雇了那些员工。

e.en: She felt no {compunction} about cancelling the meeting.
e.zh: 她对取消会议毫无歉意。

e.en: This {computation} took the server nearly an hour.
e.zh: 这个计算让服务器跑了将近一个小时。

e.en: A quick {computation} shows we're over budget.
e.zh: 简单一算就能看出我们已经超预算了。

e.en: Modern AI requires huge {computational} resources.
e.zh: 现代人工智能需要庞大的计算资源。

e.en: She studies {computational} biology at the university.
e.zh: 她在大学研究计算生物学。

e.en: Training the model is {computationally} very expensive.
e.zh: 训练这个模型在算力上非常昂贵。

e.en: This algorithm is {computationally} more efficient than the old one.
e.zh: 这个算法在计算上比旧算法更高效。

compute.t:
v. 计算
n. 算力（云服务资源）

e.en: The script will {compute} the average response time.
e.zh: 该脚本会计算出平均响应时间。

e.en: Cloud providers rent out {compute} by the hour.
e.zh: 云服务商按小时出租算力。

computed.t:
adj. 计算出的
v. 计算（过去式）

e.en: The system {computed} the shipping cost in milliseconds.
e.zh: 系统在几毫秒内就算出了运费。

e.en: Her doctor ordered a {computed} tomography scan of the chest.
e.zh: 医生为她安排了一次胸部CT扫描。

e.en: My new {computer} boots up in under five seconds.
e.zh: 我的新电脑五秒内就能开机。

e.en: Save the file before you shut down the {computer}.
e.zh: 关电脑之前先保存文件。

e.en: {Computerisation} of the library catalogue took two years.
e.zh: 图书馆目录的电脑化用了两年时间。

e.en: {Computerisation} eliminated most of the paperwork at the clinic.
e.zh: 电脑化消除了诊所大部分的纸质工作。

e.en: The hospital plans to {computerise} all patient records soon.
e.zh: 医院计划很快将所有病人记录电脑化。

e.en: Small shops still struggle to {computerise} their inventory.
e.zh: 小店在将库存电脑化方面仍举步维艰。

computerised.t: adj. 电脑化的；用电脑处理的

e.en: The factory uses a {computerised} ordering system.
e.zh: 这家工厂使用电脑化订货系统。

e.en: All flight schedules are now fully {computerised}.
e.zh: 所有航班时刻表现在都已全面电脑化。

computerises.t: v. 使电脑化（第三人称单数）

e.en: The new software {computerises} every step of payroll.
e.zh: 这款新软件将工资发放的每一步都电脑化。

e.en: This tool {computerises} tasks that used to take hours.
e.zh: 这个工具把原本要花几小时的工作电脑化了。

computerising.t: v. 使电脑化（现在分词）

e.en: The team is {computerising} decades of paper records.
e.zh: 团队正在将几十年的纸质记录电脑化。

e.en: {Computerising} the warehouse cut errors by half.
e.zh: 仓库电脑化使差错减少了一半。

competences.t: n. 能力；胜任（competence 的复数）

e.en: The job requires several core {competences} in data analysis.
e.zh: 这份工作需要数据分析方面的几项核心能力。

e.en: She listed her key {competences} on her updated resume.
e.zh: 她在更新的简历上列出了主要技能。

e.en: Language {competency} is required for this international role.
e.zh: 这个国际岗位需要语言能力。

e.en: The training program builds digital {competency} for older workers.
e.zh: 该培训项目帮助年长员工提升数字技能。

e.en: She is a highly {competent} doctor trusted by her patients.
e.zh: 她是一位备受患者信任的优秀医生。

e.en: You need a {competent} lawyer to handle this complex case.
e.zh: 你需要一位称职的律师来处理这个复杂案件。

e.en: The team handled the crisis {competently} and calmly.
e.zh: 团队冷静而出色地处理了这场危机。

e.en: She {competently} managed three projects at the same time.
e.zh: 她有条不紊地同时管理着三个项目。

competes.t: v. 竞争；参赛（第三人称单数）

e.en: Our brand {competes} directly with two larger companies.
e.zh: 我们的品牌直接与两家更大的公司竞争。

e.en: He {competes} in marathons every spring and fall.
e.zh: 他每年春秋两季都会参加马拉松比赛。

competing.t:
v. 竞争；角逐（现在分词）
adj. 相互竞争的

e.en: Several apps are {competing} for users in this crowded market.
e.zh: 在这个拥挤的市场中,多款应用正在争夺用户。

e.en: She is {competing} in her first international chess tournament.
e.zh: 她正在参加自己的首场国际象棋大赛。

e.en: He won first place in the photography {competition} yesterday.
e.zh: 他昨天在摄影比赛中获得了第一名。

e.en: There is fierce {competition} among streaming services right now.
e.zh: 目前流媒体服务之间竞争激烈。

e.en: The school hosts several math {competitions} throughout the year.
e.zh: 学校全年举办多场数学竞赛。

e.en: She has won numerous baking {competitions} on television.
e.zh: 她在电视上赢得了多场烘焙比赛。

competitive.t: adj. 有竞争力的；竞争性的

e.en: Tech salaries are extremely {competitive} in this city.
e.zh: 这座城市的科技行业薪资极具竞争力。

e.en: He has a very {competitive} personality, even in casual games.
e.zh: 他天性好胜,连玩休闲游戏都不例外。

competitively.t: adv. 竞争性地；以竞争方式

e.en: The new phones are {competitively} priced against rival brands.
e.zh: 新款手机的价格与竞争品牌相比颇具优势。

e.en: She has played tennis {competitively} since she was twelve.
e.zh: 她从十二岁起就开始打职业网球比赛。

e.en: The reform aims to boost the {competitiveness} of local industries.
e.zh: 这项改革旨在提升本地产业的竞争力。

e.en: His {competitiveness} pushes everyone on the team to improve.
e.zh: 他的好胜心激励团队中的每个人不断进步。

e.en: Their main {competitor} just launched a similar product.
e.zh: 他们的主要竞争对手刚刚推出了类似产品。

e.en: Every {competitor} in the race finished within two minutes.
e.zh: 比赛中每位选手都在两分钟内完成了赛程。

e.en: Our {competitors} are offering steep discounts this holiday season.
e.zh: 竞争对手在这个假期推出了大幅折扣。

e.en: All {competitors} must register before the event begins.
e.zh: 所有参赛者必须在活动开始前完成注册。

compilation.t:
n. 汇编；合集
n. 编译（代码）

e.en: She released a {compilation} of her best songs last month.
e.zh: 她上个月发行了一张精选合辑。

e.en: The {compilation} of the project failed due to a syntax error.
e.zh: 由于语法错误,项目编译失败了。

compile.t:
v. 编译（代码）
v. 汇编；整理

e.en: Please {compile} a list of attendees for tomorrow's meeting.
e.zh: 请整理一份明天会议的与会者名单。

e.en: It takes ten minutes to {compile} the entire codebase.
e.zh: 编译整个代码库需要十分钟。

e.en: She {compiled} a detailed report from dozens of interviews.
e.zh: 她根据数十次访谈整理出一份详细报告。

e.en: The program {compiled} successfully on the first try.
e.zh: 程序第一次就成功编译了。

compiler.t:
n. 编译器
n. 编纂者

e.en: The {compiler} flagged several errors in the new code.
e.zh: 编译器在新代码中标记了几个错误。

e.en: Modern languages need a fast {compiler} to stay productive.
e.zh: 现代编程语言需要快速的编译器来保持开发效率。

compiles.t: v. 编译；汇编（第三人称单数）

e.en: This script {compiles} user feedback into a weekly summary.
e.zh: 这个脚本会把用户反馈整理成每周总结。

e.en: The code {compiles} without any warnings now.
e.zh: 现在代码编译时没有任何警告。

compiling.t: v. 编译；汇编（现在分词）

e.en: She is {compiling} data for her dissertation this semester.
e.zh: 她这学期正在为论文整理数据。

e.en: The build server has been {compiling} the project for ten minutes.
e.zh: 构建服务器已经编译这个项目十分钟了。

e.en: His {complacence} after the early win cost the team the match.
e.zh: 他在领先后的自满让球队输掉了比赛。

e.en: There is no room for {complacence} in such a competitive industry.
e.zh: 在如此激烈的行业里没有自满的余地。

e.en: Success can breed {complacency} if you stop pushing yourself.
e.zh: 如果不再鞭策自己,成功会滋生自满。

e.en: The coach warned the players against {complacency} before the final.
e.zh: 教练在决赛前提醒队员们切勿自满。

complacent.t: adj. 自满的；安于现状的

e.en: Don't get {complacent} just because sales are growing this quarter.
e.zh: 不要因为本季度销售增长就沾沾自喜。

e.en: The team became {complacent} after winning three games in a row.
e.zh: 球队连胜三场后变得自满起来。

e.en: He smiled {complacently} as the audience applauded his speech.
e.zh: 观众为他的演讲鼓掌时,他得意地笑了。

e.en: She nodded {complacently}, sure her plan would succeed.
e.zh: 她自满地点点头,确信自己的计划会成功。

e.en: Customers often {complain} about slow shipping during the holidays.
e.zh: 顾客常在节日期间抱怨发货太慢。

e.en: Don't {complain} to me—talk to the manager directly.
e.zh: 别向我抱怨,直接去找经理说。

e.en: The {complainant} filed a formal report with the police yesterday.
e.zh: 原告昨天向警方提交了正式报告。

e.en: The court asked the {complainant} to describe the incident.
e.zh: 法庭要求原告描述事件经过。

e.en: She {complained} that the coffee was too cold to drink.
e.zh: 她抱怨咖啡太凉没法喝。

e.en: Several neighbors {complained} about the loud music last night.
e.zh: 几位邻居抱怨昨晚的音乐声太大。

e.en: Nobody likes a constant {complainer} on the team.
e.zh: 团队里没人喜欢老是抱怨的人。

e.en: He's a real {complainer} whenever the WiFi slows down.
e.zh: 每次网速一慢,他就抱怨个不停。

complaining.t:
v. 抱怨（现在分词）
adj. 爱抱怨的

e.en: Stop {complaining} and help me move this couch.
e.zh: 别抱怨了,过来帮我搬这张沙发。

e.en: Users are {complaining} about bugs in the latest app update.
e.zh: 用户正在抱怨最新版应用的漏洞。

complains.t: v. 抱怨；投诉（第三人称单数）

e.en: My dad always {complains} about traffic on his commute.
e.zh: 我爸爸通勤时总是抱怨交通拥堵。

e.en: She rarely {complains}, even when the work is exhausting.
e.zh: 即使工作很累,她也很少抱怨。

complaint.t:
n. 投诉；抱怨
n. 病症

e.en: I'd like to file a {complaint} about the noisy hotel room.
e.zh: 我想就酒店房间太吵投诉一下。

e.en: His main {complaint} was the lack of vegetarian options.
e.zh: 他主要的不满是没有素食选择。

e.en: The store received many {complaints} about the new return policy.
e.zh: 店家收到不少关于新退货政策的投诉。

e.en: She had no {complaints} about her stay at the resort.
e.zh: 她对在度假村的住宿没有任何抱怨。

e.en: His {complaisance} toward customers made him a great salesperson.
e.zh: 他对顾客的殷勤使他成为出色的销售员。

e.en: Her {complaisance} surprised everyone at the difficult meeting.
e.zh: 她在那场艰难会议上的顺从让大家惊讶。

e.en: The waiter was unusually {complaisant} with our long list of requests.
e.zh: 那位服务员对我们一长串要求异常迁就。

e.en: Her {complaisant} smile hid her real opinion of the proposal.
e.zh: 她迎合的微笑掩盖了对提案的真实看法。

compleat.t: adj. 完备的；精通的（complete 古体）

e.en: He's the {compleat} programmer—skilled in both backend and frontend.
e.zh: 他是全能程序员,前后端都精通。

e.en: She owns a {compleat} guide to baking French pastries.
e.zh: 她有一本关于法式糕点的完整指南。

complement.t:
n. 补充物；互补
v. 补充；衬托

e.en: A glass of red wine would {complement} this steak nicely.
e.zh: 一杯红酒能很好地衬托这块牛排。

e.en: The new hire is a great {complement} to our design team.
e.zh: 这位新员工是设计团队的绝佳补充。

complementarily.t: adv. 互补地；相辅相成地

e.en: The two apps work {complementarily} to manage your daily schedule.
e.zh: 这两款应用互为补充,帮你管理日程。

e.en: Their skills function {complementarily}, making the duo unstoppable.
e.zh: 他们的技能互补,使这对搭档势不可挡。

e.en: The {complementarity} between hardware and software drives innovation today.
e.zh: 硬件与软件的互补性正在推动今天的创新。

e.en: There's clear {complementarity} between her research and his fieldwork.
e.zh: 她的研究和他的田野工作有明显的互补性。

complementary.t: adj. 互补的；相辅相成的

e.en: Coffee and chocolate have surprisingly {complementary} flavors.
e.zh: 咖啡和巧克力的味道意外地相得益彰。

e.en: The two engineers have {complementary} skills that strengthen the team.
e.zh: 两位工程师技能互补,增强了团队实力。

e.en: Her bright scarf {complemented} the simple black dress beautifully.
e.zh: 她鲜艳的围巾把简单的黑色连衣裙衬托得很美。

e.en: The dessert {complemented} the spicy main course perfectly.
e.zh: 这道甜点完美地搭配了辛辣的主菜。

complementing.t: v. 补充；衬托（现在分词）

e.en: Soft lighting was {complementing} the cozy atmosphere of the café.
e.zh: 柔和的灯光衬托出咖啡馆温馨的氛围。

e.en: Her experience is {complementing} our team's technical strengths well.
e.zh: 她的经验很好地补充了团队的技术优势。

complements.t: n./v. 补充；互补（复数/第三人称单数）

e.en: This sauce {complements} grilled fish exceptionally well.
e.zh: 这种酱汁与烤鱼搭配得格外好。

e.en: The new feature {complements} the existing user dashboard nicely.
e.zh: 新功能很好地补充了现有的用户仪表板。

complete.t:
v. 完成
adj. 完整的；全部的

e.en: Please {complete} the form before submitting your application.
e.zh: 请在提交申请前填写完整表格。

e.en: The renovation is finally {complete} after six long months.
e.zh: 经过漫长的六个月,装修终于完工了。

completed.t:
v. 完成（过去式）
adj. 已完成的

e.en: She {completed} the marathon in under four hours.
e.zh: 她在四小时内跑完了马拉松。

e.en: The download {completed} successfully despite the unstable connection.
e.zh: 尽管网络不稳定,下载还是成功完成了。

e.en: I {completely} forgot about our meeting this morning.
e.zh: 我完全忘了今早的会议。

e.en: The new design is {completely} different from the old one.
e.zh: 新设计与旧版完全不同。

e.en: Please check the report for accuracy and {completeness}.
e.zh: 请检查报告的准确性和完整性。

e.en: The tutorial earns high marks for its {completeness}.
e.zh: 这份教程因其内容完备而获得好评。

completer.t:
n. 完成者
adj. 更完整的

e.en: Every team needs a {completer} who finishes tasks on time.
e.zh: 每个团队都需要一位能按时完成任务的收尾者。

e.en: The IDE's code {completer} suggests function names as you type.
e.zh: 集成开发环境的代码补全器会在你输入时提示函数名。

completes.t: v. 完成（第三人称单数）

e.en: The app {completes} your sentence as you type a message.
e.zh: 在你输入消息时,这款应用会自动补全句子。

e.en: She {completes} a new painting almost every week.
e.zh: 她几乎每周都能完成一幅新画作。

e.en: He's {completing} his master's degree in computer science.
e.zh: 他正在攻读计算机科学硕士学位。

e.en: After {completing} the survey, you'll receive a small gift card.
e.zh: 完成调查后,你会收到一张小礼品卡。

completion.t:
n. 完成；结束
n. 自动补全（代码）

e.en: The project's {completion} date has been pushed to next March.
e.zh: 项目的完成日期已被推迟到明年三月。

e.en: You'll get a certificate upon {completion} of the course.
e.zh: 完成课程后,你将获得一份证书。

e.en: The AI model offers smart {completions} for your code as you type.
e.zh: 该 AI 模型在你编码时提供智能补全建议。

e.en: Course {completions} jumped after the platform added a mobile app.
e.zh: 平台推出移动应用后,课程完成数大幅上升。

e.en: {Computerization} transformed banking in the 1980s.
e.zh: 电脑化在二十世纪八十年代改变了银行业。

e.en: Full {computerization} of the courts is still years away.
e.zh: 法院的全面电脑化还要等好几年。

computerize.t: v. 使电脑化；用计算机处理

e.en: The school decided to {computerize} all student records.
e.zh: 学校决定将所有学生档案电脑化。

e.en: It took months to {computerize} the entire warehouse.
e.zh: 将整个仓库电脑化花了好几个月。

computerized.t: adj. 计算机化的；电脑操控的

e.en: The bakery uses a {computerized} ordering system.
e.zh: 这家面包店使用电脑化的订货系统。

e.en: Modern cars rely on {computerized} engine controls.
e.zh: 现代汽车依赖电脑化的发动机控制系统。

computerizes.t: v. 使电脑化（第三人称单数）

e.en: This app {computerizes} your entire grocery list.
e.zh: 这款应用把你的整个购物清单电脑化。

e.en: The platform {computerizes} attendance for every classroom.
e.zh: 该平台将每个教室的考勤都电脑化。

computerizing.t: v. 正在电脑化（computerize 的现在分词）

e.en: They are slowly {computerizing} the museum's archives.
e.zh: 他们正在逐步将博物馆的档案电脑化。

e.en: {Computerizing} the workflow saved the team countless hours.
e.zh: 工作流程电脑化为团队节省了无数时间。

e.en: Most offices replace their {computers} every four years.
e.zh: 大多数办公室每四年更换一次电脑。

e.en: Modern {computers} can run dozens of apps simultaneously.
e.zh: 现代电脑可以同时运行几十个应用。

computes.t: v. 计算（第三人称单数）

e.en: The calculator {computes} compound interest instantly.
e.zh: 这台计算器能瞬间算出复利。

e.en: Her explanation just doesn't {computes} for me.
e.zh: 她的解释我怎么也想不通。

computing.t:
n. 计算机运算
v. 正在计算

e.en: Cloud {computing} has changed how startups build products.
e.zh: 云计算改变了初创公司打造产品的方式。

e.en: She majored in {computing} and now works at Google.
e.zh: 她主修计算机,现在在谷歌工作。

e.en: He fought beside his {comrade} for three long years.
e.zh: 他与战友并肩作战了漫长的三年。

e.en: My old college {comrade} just moved back to town.
e.zh: 我大学时的老伙伴刚搬回这座城市。

e.en: They greeted each other with a {comradely} pat on the back.
e.zh: 他们友好地拍着对方的背打招呼。

e.en: The team has a warm, {comradely} atmosphere.
e.zh: 这个团队有种温暖的同志情谊氛围。

comradeship.t: n. 同志情谊；战友之情

e.en: The hike built strong {comradeship} among the new hires.
e.zh: 这次徒步在新员工之间建立了深厚的友情。

e.en: She misses the {comradeship} of her old army unit.
e.zh: 她怀念在原来部队里的战友情谊。

comte.t: n. 孔德（法国哲学家姓氏）

e.en: Auguste {Comte} is widely regarded as the father of sociology.
e.zh: 奥古斯特·孔德被广泛视为社会学之父。

e.en: The young {comte} inherited the family's vineyard estate.
e.zh: 年轻的伯爵继承了家族的葡萄园庄园。

con.t:
v. 欺骗
n. 反对意见；骗局

e.en: He tried to {con} her out of her savings.
e.zh: 他企图骗走她的积蓄。

e.en: List the pros and {con} before deciding.
e.zh: 决定前先列出利与弊。

e.en: {Conan} the Barbarian remains a classic fantasy hero.
e.zh: 野蛮人柯南至今仍是经典的奇幻英雄。

e.en: My nephew can't stop watching {Conan} on late-night TV.
e.zh: 我侄子总是熬夜看柯南的脱口秀。

e.en: Use this function to {concatenate} two strings together.
e.zh: 用这个函数可以把两个字符串连接起来。

e.en: You can {concatenate} the video clips into one file.
e.zh: 你可以把这些视频片段拼接成一个文件。

e.en: String {concatenation} is a basic operation in every language.
e.zh: 字符串拼接是每种语言中最基本的操作。

e.en: The bug came from a sloppy {concatenation} of file paths.
e.zh: 这个错误源于文件路径的草率拼接。

e.en: A {concave} mirror focuses light to a single point.
e.zh: 凹面镜能把光线聚焦到一点。

e.en: The bowl has a deep, smooth {concave} surface.
e.zh: 这只碗有一个又深又光滑的凹面。

e.en: The lens has a slight {concavity} on the inner side.
e.zh: 这块镜片内侧略微凹陷。

e.en: Engineers measured the {concavity} of the satellite dish.
e.zh: 工程师测量了卫星天线的凹度。

e.en: She tried to {conceal} her disappointment with a smile.
e.zh: 她试图用微笑掩饰自己的失望。

e.en: Tall hedges {conceal} the house from the street.
e.zh: 高高的树篱把房子从街上挡住了。

concealed.t:
adj. 隐藏的
v. 已隐藏

e.en: The detective found a {concealed} compartment in the desk.
e.zh: 侦探在书桌里发现了一个暗格。

e.en: He {concealed} the gift behind the curtain.
e.zh: 他把礼物藏在窗帘后面。

e.en: She dabbed a little {concealer} under her tired eyes.
e.zh: 她在疲惫的眼下轻轻点了点遮瑕膏。

e.en: This {concealer} blends seamlessly with most skin tones.
e.zh: 这款遮瑕膏能与大多数肤色无缝融合。

e.en: She was {concealing} her phone under the desk during class.
e.zh: 她上课时把手机藏在桌子下面。

e.en: The makeup is great for {concealing} dark circles under the eyes.
e.zh: 这款化妆品很适合用来遮盖黑眼圈。

e.en: The thick bushes provided perfect {concealment} for the rabbits.
e.zh: 茂密的灌木丛为兔子提供了完美的藏身之处。

e.en: He was charged with the {concealment} of important evidence.
e.zh: 他被指控隐瞒重要证据。

conceals.t: v. 隐藏（第三人称单数）

e.en: This jacket cleverly {conceals} a hidden pocket inside.
e.zh: 这件夹克巧妙地藏了一个内置口袋。

e.en: Her smile {conceals} how exhausted she really feels.
e.zh: 她的微笑掩盖了她真正的疲惫。

e.en: I have to {concede} that your idea is better than mine.
e.zh: 我不得不承认你的想法比我的好。

e.en: The candidate refused to {concede} the election after the recount.
e.zh: 重新计票后,这位候选人拒绝承认败选。

e.en: He {conceded} defeat after losing three matches in a row.
e.zh: 连输三场后,他承认了失败。

e.en: The team {conceded} two goals in the final minutes.
e.zh: 球队在最后几分钟丢了两球。

concedes.t: v. 承认；让步（第三人称单数）

e.en: She rarely {concedes} a point during a debate.
e.zh: 她在辩论中很少让步。

e.en: The report {concedes} that mistakes were made early on.
e.zh: 报告承认早期确实出了一些错误。

conceding.t: v. 正在让步；正在承认

e.en: Without {conceding} anything, the company offered a small refund.
e.zh: 公司没有承认任何责任,只是提供了少量退款。

e.en: They won the series without {conceding} a single set.
e.zh: 他们一盘未失就赢下了整个系列赛。

e.en: His {conceit} makes it hard to work with him on projects.
e.zh: 他的自负让人很难和他合作做项目。

e.en: The novel's central {conceit} is that time runs backward.
e.zh: 这部小说的核心构思是时间倒流。

conceited.t: adj. 自负的；自以为是的

e.en: She's talented but a little {conceited} about her grades.
e.zh: 她很有才华,但对自己的成绩有点自负。

e.en: Don't be {conceited} just because you got promoted first.
e.zh: 别因为你先升职就自以为了不起。

conceits.t: n. 自负（复数）；奇巧的比喻

e.en: The poem is full of clever literary {conceits} and metaphors.
e.zh: 这首诗充满了巧妙的文学构思和隐喻。

e.en: His small {conceits} about his cooking amused his friends.
e.zh: 他对自己厨艺的小小自负把朋友们都逗乐了。

conceivable.t: adj. 可想到的；可想象的

e.en: We tried every {conceivable} solution before calling support.
e.zh: 我们试遍了所有能想到的办法才联系客服。

e.en: It's hardly {conceivable} that he forgot her birthday again.
e.zh: 他居然又忘了她的生日,真是难以想象。

e.en: The delay could {conceivably} push the launch to next year.
e.zh: 这次延误有可能把发布推迟到明年。

e.en: You could {conceivably} finish the book in one weekend.
e.zh: 你或许真的能在一个周末读完这本书。

e.en: I can't {conceive} of living without my smartphone now.
e.zh: 我无法想象现在没有智能手机的生活。

e.en: They tried for years to {conceive} their first child.
e.zh: 他们尝试了多年才怀上第一个孩子。

e.en: The startup was {conceived} during a late-night brainstorming session.
e.zh: 这家创业公司是在一次深夜头脑风暴中构思出来的。

e.en: The project was poorly {conceived} from the very start.
e.zh: 这个项目从一开始构思就不周全。

conceives.t: v. 构想（第三人称单数）

e.en: She constantly {conceives} new ideas for her design business.
e.zh: 她不断为自己的设计公司想出新点子。

e.en: The author {conceives} of memory as a kind of map.
e.zh: 作者把记忆设想成一种地图。

conceiving.t: v. 正在构想；正在怀孕

e.en: He's good at {conceiving} bold concepts but bad at executing them.
e.zh: 他擅长构思大胆的想法,却不善于执行。

e.en: They had trouble {conceiving} and turned to fertility treatments.
e.zh: 他们难以怀孕,于是转向辅助生殖治疗。

concentrate.t:
v. 集中；专注
n. 浓缩物

e.en: It's hard to {concentrate} when your phone keeps buzzing.
e.zh: 手机一直震动时很难集中注意力。

e.en: Just add water to the orange juice {concentrate} and stir.
e.zh: 在浓缩橙汁里加水搅拌一下就行了。

e.en: She {concentrated} hard on the chess board for ten minutes.
e.zh: 她盯着棋盘专注地思考了十分钟。

e.en: This is a highly {concentrated} cleaner, so dilute before use.
e.zh: 这是高浓度清洁剂,使用前请先稀释。

concentrates.t: v. 集中（第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {concentrates} better with instrumental music in the background.
e.zh: 他听着纯音乐时注意力会更集中。

e.en: The factory produces fruit {concentrates} for major beverage brands.
e.zh: 这家工厂为主要饮料品牌生产水果浓缩液。

e.en: I'm {concentrating} on improving my code quality this quarter.
e.zh: 这个季度我专注于提升代码质量。

e.en: Stop talking — I'm {concentrating} on this difficult problem.
e.zh: 别说话了,我正在专心解这道难题。

e.en: Loud notifications constantly break my {concentration} at work.
e.zh: 工作时刺耳的通知声不断打断我的专注。

e.en: The lab measured the {concentration} of salt in the water.
e.zh: 实验室测量了水中盐分的浓度。

e.en: High {concentrations} of caffeine can cause anxiety and insomnia.
e.zh: 高浓度的咖啡因会引发焦虑和失眠。

e.en: Tech {concentrations} have shifted from Silicon Valley to other cities.
e.zh: 科技行业的聚集地已从硅谷转移到其他城市。

e.en: Hospitals use an oxygen {concentrator} to help patients with breathing issues.
e.zh: 医院使用制氧机来帮助有呼吸问题的患者。

e.en: This solar {concentrator} focuses sunlight onto a small panel.
e.zh: 这台太阳能聚光器把阳光聚焦到一块小面板上。

e.en: The target had five {concentric} red and white circles.
e.zh: 靶子上有五个红白相间的同心圆。

e.en: Drop a stone in the pond and watch the {concentric} ripples.
e.zh: 往池塘里扔一块石头,看那些同心涟漪扩散开。

e.en: The {concept} behind the app is simple but brilliant.
e.zh: 这款应用的概念简单却很巧妙。

e.en: Time travel is a fun {concept} for science fiction movies.
e.zh: 时间旅行是科幻电影中很有趣的设定。

e.en: His {conception} of fairness differs from mine in many ways.
e.zh: 他对公平的理解在很多方面和我不同。

e.en: The project has been delayed since its initial {conception}.
e.zh: 这个项目从最初构思以来就一直被推迟。

e.en: Modern {conceptions} of beauty have changed dramatically over decades.
e.zh: 几十年来,现代人对美的理解发生了巨大变化。

e.en: Different cultures have very different {conceptions} of personal space.
e.zh: 不同文化对私人空间有非常不同的理解。

concepts.t: n. 概念；观念（concept 的复数）

e.en: The course covers basic {concepts} of machine learning and statistics.
e.zh: 这门课涵盖了机器学习和统计学的基本概念。

e.en: Children learn abstract {concepts} like fairness through everyday play.
e.zh: 孩子们通过日常游戏学习公平这类抽象概念。

e.en: There's a {conceptual} flaw in the way the database is designed.
e.zh: 这个数据库的设计在概念上存在缺陷。

e.en: The gallery features {conceptual} art from emerging young artists.
e.zh: 这家画廊展出新锐年轻艺术家的概念艺术作品。

conceptualise.t: v. 使概念化；形成概念（英式拼写）

e.en: It helps to {conceptualise} the problem as a flow of data.
e.zh: 把问题理解成数据流动会有帮助。

e.en: Designers must {conceptualise} the user journey before drawing screens.
e.zh: 设计师在绘制界面前必须先构思用户旅程。

conceptualism.t: n. 概念论；概念艺术主义

e.en: The movement of {conceptualism} prioritizes ideas over visual aesthetics.
e.zh: 概念主义运动把理念置于视觉美感之上。

e.en: Her thesis explores {conceptualism} in 1970s American art.
e.zh: 她的论文探讨了1970年代美国艺术中的概念主义。

conceptualist.t: n. 概念论者；概念艺术家

e.en: He's a {conceptualist} who cares more about ideas than execution.
e.zh: 他是一个更重视理念而非执行的概念主义者。

e.en: The exhibition featured a famous {conceptualist} from New York.
e.zh: 展览邀请了一位来自纽约的著名概念艺术家。

conceptualization.t: n. 概念化；形成概念的过程

e.en: Our team's {conceptualization} of the product changed after user testing.
e.zh: 用户测试之后,我们团队对产品的构想发生了变化。

e.en: The {conceptualization} phase usually takes longer than people expect.
e.zh: 概念构思阶段通常比人们预期的要久。

e.en: It's hard to {conceptualize} how big a billion really is.
e.zh: 很难真正想象十亿到底有多大。

e.en: Engineers often {conceptualize} complex systems using simple diagrams.
e.zh: 工程师常用简单的图示来构思复杂系统。

conceptualized.t:
v. 概念化（过去式）
adj. 已概念化的

e.en: The architect {conceptualized} the building as a giant glass cube.
e.zh: 这位建筑师把这栋楼构思成一个巨大的玻璃方块。

e.en: The campaign was {conceptualized} around themes of community and trust.
e.zh: 这个广告活动围绕社区和信任的主题来构思。

conceptually.t: adv. 概念上地；在观念上

e.en: {Conceptually}, the two products are similar, but pricing differs.
e.zh: 从概念上讲,这两款产品很相似,只是定价不同。

e.en: The film is {conceptually} brilliant but quite slow to watch.
e.zh: 这部电影构思精妙,但看起来相当缓慢。

concern.t:
v. 涉及；关心
n. 担忧；关切

e.en: My main {concern} is whether the deadline is realistic.
e.zh: 我主要担心的是这个截止日期是否现实。

e.en: The new policy doesn't {concern} part-time employees at all.
e.zh: 新政策完全不涉及兼职员工。

e.en: Parents are {concerned} about how much screen time their kids get.
e.zh: 家长们担心孩子们的屏幕使用时间过长。

e.en: As far as I'm {concerned}, the meeting can wait until Monday.
e.zh: 就我而言,这个会议可以等到周一再开。

concerning.t:
prep. 关于
adj. 令人担忧的

e.en: The recent test results are honestly quite {concerning}.
e.zh: 最近的检测结果说实话挺让人担心的。

e.en: I have a few questions {concerning} the rental agreement.
e.zh: 我有几个关于租房合同的问题。

concerns.t:
n. 关切；担忧（复数）
v. 涉及（第三人称单数）

e.en: Please raise any {concerns} during tomorrow's team meeting.
e.zh: 如有任何顾虑,请在明天的团队会上提出。

e.en: This issue {concerns} everyone working on the backend.
e.zh: 这个问题关系到所有做后端开发的人。

e.en: We got front-row tickets for the Taylor Swift {concert}.
e.zh: 我们抢到了泰勒・斯威夫特演唱会的前排门票。

e.en: The teams worked in {concert} to launch the new feature.
e.zh: 各团队齐心协力共同推出了这项新功能。

e.en: It will take a {concerted} effort to fix this legacy code.
e.zh: 修复这段遗留代码需要大家齐心协力。

e.en: The government made a {concerted} push to reduce plastic waste.
e.zh: 政府齐心协力推动减少塑料垃圾。

concerti.t: n. 协奏曲（concerto 的复数）

e.en: The pianist recorded all five Beethoven {concerti} in one year.
e.zh: 这位钢琴家在一年内录制了贝多芬全部五首协奏曲。

e.en: Tonight's program features two Mozart {concerti} for violin.
e.zh: 今晚的节目包括两首莫扎特的小提琴协奏曲。

concertina.t:
n. 六角手风琴
v. 压缩成褶皱

e.en: The folder opened up like a {concertina} full of receipts.
e.zh: 那个文件夹像手风琴一样展开,里面塞满了收据。

e.en: He played sea shanties on a small antique {concertina}.
e.zh: 他用一架古旧的小六角手风琴演奏水手歌谣。

concertmaster.t: n. 乐团首席小提琴手

e.en: The {concertmaster} tuned the orchestra before the conductor walked out.
e.zh: 指挥上场前,首席小提琴手先为乐队调音。

e.en: She was promoted to {concertmaster} of the symphony last season.
e.zh: 上个乐季她被提拔为交响乐团的首席小提琴手。

e.en: Her piano {concerto} received a standing ovation last night.
e.zh: 昨晚她的钢琴协奏曲赢得了观众起立鼓掌。

e.en: I'm learning a Vivaldi {concerto} for my upcoming recital.
e.zh: 我正在为即将到来的独奏会练习一首维瓦尔第的协奏曲。

e.en: Outdoor {concerts} in summer are my favorite weekend activity.
e.zh: 夏天的户外音乐会是我最喜欢的周末活动。

e.en: Many artists stream their {concerts} live on social media now.
e.zh: 现在很多艺人会在社交媒体上直播自己的演唱会。

e.en: The union won a major {concession} on overtime pay.
e.zh: 工会在加班费问题上赢得了一项重大让步。

e.en: We bought popcorn at the {concession} stand before the movie.
e.zh: 看电影前我们在小卖部买了爆米花。

concessionaire.t: n. 特许权获得者；特许经营者

e.en: The airport {concessionaire} runs all the coffee shops in Terminal 2.
e.zh: 这家机场特许经营商运营着二号航站楼所有的咖啡店。

e.en: A local {concessionaire} took over the stadium's food services.
e.zh: 一家本地特许经营商接管了体育馆的餐饮服务。

e.en: The bank offered {concessional} loans to first-time home buyers.
e.zh: 银行为首次购房者提供了优惠贷款。

e.en: Students can apply for {concessional} fares on public transport.
e.zh: 学生可以申请公共交通的优惠票价。

e.en: Students can buy {concessionary} tickets at half price.
e.zh: 学生可以以半价购买优惠票。

e.en: The airline offers {concessionary} fares to seniors.
e.zh: 该航空公司为老年人提供优惠票价。

e.en: The park {concessioner} runs the gift shop and café.
e.zh: 公园特许经营商负责礼品店和咖啡馆。

e.en: Each {concessioner} must renew their permit annually.
e.zh: 每个特许经营商必须每年续办许可证。

e.en: Both sides made {concessions} to reach the deal.
e.zh: 双方都做出让步以达成协议。

e.en: We bought popcorn at the {concessions} stand.
e.zh: 我们在小卖部买了爆米花。

e.en: He blew the {conch} shell to signal the start.
e.zh: 他吹响海螺壳作为开始的信号。

e.en: The beach was scattered with pink {conch} shells.
e.zh: 海滩上散落着粉红色的海螺壳。

e.en: The doctor examined the {concha} inside her ear.
e.zh: 医生检查了她耳朵内的耳甲。

e.en: A swollen nasal {concha} can block breathing.
e.zh: 鼻甲肿大会阻碍呼吸。

e.en: The hotel {concierge} booked us a great restaurant.
e.zh: 酒店礼宾员为我们订了一家很棒的餐厅。

e.en: Our app offers {concierge} service to premium users.
e.zh: 我们的应用为高级用户提供专属管家服务。

e.en: The manager tried to {conciliate} the angry customers.
e.zh: 经理试图安抚愤怒的顾客。

e.en: She spoke softly to {conciliate} her rival's supporters.
e.zh: 她语气温和,以争取对手支持者的好感。

e.en: The dispute was settled through {conciliation} rather than court.
e.zh: 这场纠纷通过调解而非诉讼解决。

e.en: His speech was a clear gesture of {conciliation}.
e.zh: 他的演讲明显是和解的姿态。

e.en: Several {conciliations} have failed to end the strike.
e.zh: 几次调解都未能结束罢工。

e.en: The mediator led numerous {conciliations} between the families.
e.zh: 调解员主持了多次家庭间的和解谈判。

e.en: A neutral {conciliator} helped both sides reach agreement.
e.zh: 一位中立的调解人帮助双方达成协议。

e.en: She is known as a skilled {conciliator} in workplace disputes.
e.zh: 她以善于调解职场纠纷而闻名。

e.en: The CEO struck a {conciliatory} tone in her apology.
e.zh: 首席执行官在道歉中采取了和解的语气。

e.en: He sent a {conciliatory} email after the heated meeting.
e.zh: 激烈会议后,他发了一封语气缓和的邮件。

e.en: Please write a {concise} summary of the report.
e.zh: 请写一份简明的报告摘要。

e.en: Her answers were clear and {concise}.
e.zh: 她的回答清晰而简洁。

e.en: He explained the bug {concisely} in two sentences.
e.zh: 他用两句话简洁地解释了这个漏洞。

e.en: Try to write your bio more {concisely}.
e.zh: 试着把你的简介写得更简洁些。

e.en: The editor praised the article's {conciseness} and clarity.
e.zh: 编辑称赞这篇文章简洁明了。

e.en: Good code values {conciseness} without sacrificing readability.
e.zh: 好的代码追求简洁但不牺牲可读性。

e.en: Her writing is admired for its {concision} and wit.
e.zh: 她的文笔以简练和机智而受人称赞。

e.en: Aim for {concision} when drafting product descriptions.
e.zh: 撰写产品描述时要力求简练。

conclave.t: n. 秘密会议；教宗选举会议

e.en: The cardinals gathered in {conclave} to elect a pope.
e.zh: 红衣主教们齐聚秘密会议选举教皇。

e.en: Tech leaders met in a private {conclave} last weekend.
e.zh: 科技领袖上周末举行了一场私密会议。

e.en: Researchers {conclude} that exercise improves sleep quality.
e.zh: 研究人员得出结论,运动可以改善睡眠质量。

e.en: Let's {conclude} the meeting with a quick summary.
e.zh: 让我们用简短总结来结束这次会议。

concluded.t: v. 得出结论；结束（过去式）

e.en: The judge {concluded} that the evidence was insufficient.
e.zh: 法官判定证据不足。

e.en: The festival {concluded} with a spectacular fireworks show.
e.zh: 节日以一场壮观的烟花表演落幕。

concludes.t: v. 得出结论；结束（第三人称单数）

e.en: The article {concludes} with practical tips for beginners.
e.zh: 文章以给初学者的实用建议作为结尾。

e.en: Each episode {concludes} on a dramatic cliffhanger.
e.zh: 每一集都以戏剧性的悬念结尾。

e.en: In her {concluding} remarks, she thanked the team.
e.zh: 在结束语中,她感谢了整个团队。

e.en: The {concluding} chapter ties all the storylines together.
e.zh: 最后一章把所有故事线串联起来。

e.en: We came to the {conclusion} that the design needs work.
e.zh: 我们得出结论,这个设计还需改进。

e.en: The film's {conclusion} surprised everyone in the theater.
e.zh: 电影的结局让影院里所有人都感到意外。

e.en: Don't jump to {conclusions} without reading the full report.
e.zh: 不要在没读完整份报告之前妄下结论。

e.en: The study's {conclusions} match earlier research findings.
e.zh: 该研究的结论与早期研究结果一致。

e.en: There is no {conclusive} evidence linking the two events.
e.zh: 没有确凿证据将这两起事件联系起来。

e.en: The DNA test was {conclusive} proof of his innocence.
e.zh: DNA检测是他清白的确凿证据。

e.en: The data {conclusively} shows that users prefer dark mode.
e.zh: 数据确凿地表明用户更喜欢深色模式。

e.en: Scientists have not yet {conclusively} proven the theory.
e.zh: 科学家尚未确凿地证明这一理论。

conclusory.t: adj. 武断的；仅下结论的

e.en: The judge dismissed his {conclusory} statements as unsupported.
e.zh: 法官认为他那些武断的陈述缺乏依据,予以驳回。

e.en: Avoid {conclusory} claims without citing real data.
e.zh: 避免在没有真实数据支持下作出武断的论断。

concoct.t: v. 调制（饮品）；编造（故事）

e.en: The chef can {concoct} amazing dishes from leftovers.
e.zh: 这位厨师能用剩菜做出惊人的菜肴。

e.en: Did he {concoct} that excuse on the spot?
e.zh: 那个借口是他当场编出来的吗?

e.en: She {concocted} a wild story to avoid trouble.
e.zh: 她编了一个离奇的故事来避免麻烦。

e.en: The bartender {concocted} a refreshing summer cocktail.
e.zh: 调酒师调制了一杯清爽的夏日鸡尾酒。

condescension.t: n. 屈尊俯就；居高临下的态度

e.en: I'm tired of the {condescension} in his emails.
e.zh: 我受够了他邮件里那种屈尊俯就的态度。

e.en: Treat customers with respect, not {condescension}.
e.zh: 对待顾客要尊重,而不是居高临下。

e.en: The corrupt official finally received {condign} punishment for his crimes.
e.zh: 那名贪官终于因其罪行受到应得的惩罚。

e.en: The judge promised {condign} consequences for repeat offenders.
e.zh: 法官承诺对惯犯施以应得的处罚。

e.en: Ketchup is the most popular {condiment} on American tables.
e.zh: 番茄酱是美国餐桌上最受欢迎的调味品。

e.en: He keeps every {condiment} neatly arranged in the fridge.
e.zh: 他把每种调味料都整齐地摆在冰箱里。

condition.t:
n. 条件；状况
v. 使适应；调理

e.en: The car is in excellent {condition} for its age.
e.zh: 这辆车考虑到车龄,状况非常好。

e.en: You can return the item on one {condition}.
e.zh: 你可以退货,但有一个条件。

conditional.t: adj. 有条件的；附带条件的

e.en: Her job offer is {conditional} on passing the background check.
e.zh: 她的工作录用以通过背景调查为前提。

e.en: The code uses a {conditional} statement to check input.
e.zh: 这段代码用一个条件语句来检查输入。

e.en: Loan {conditionality} often requires governments to cut spending.
e.zh: 贷款的附加条件通常要求政府削减开支。

e.en: The treaty's {conditionality} sparked debate among the smaller nations.
e.zh: 该条约的附加条件引发了小国之间的争论。

e.en: The merger was {conditionally} approved by the regulators.
e.zh: 该合并案获得监管机构有条件的批准。

e.en: She was {conditionally} accepted into the graduate program.
e.zh: 她被有条件地录取进入研究生项目。

conditioned.t: adj. 受条件限制的；已调理过的

e.en: Dogs can be {conditioned} to respond to a whistle.
e.zh: 狗可以被训练成对哨声作出反应。

e.en: The room is fully air-{conditioned} for summer comfort.
e.zh: 这个房间装有完整的空调,夏天很舒适。

e.en: Apply {conditioner} after shampooing to keep hair soft.
e.zh: 洗发后涂护发素能让头发保持柔顺。

e.en: The air {conditioner} broke during the heatwave.
e.zh: 空调在热浪期间坏掉了。

e.en: Daily {conditioning} keeps athletes ready for the season.
e.zh: 每天的体能训练让运动员为赛季做好准备。

e.en: The air {conditioning} barely worked in the old office.
e.zh: 那间旧办公室里的空调几乎不制冷。

e.en: Working {conditions} at the factory have improved a lot.
e.zh: 工厂的工作条件已经大大改善。

e.en: The flight was canceled due to bad weather {conditions}.
e.zh: 由于天气状况不佳,航班被取消了。

e.en: They bought a small {condo} near the beach.
e.zh: 他们在海滩附近买了一套小公寓。

e.en: My {condo} association charges a monthly maintenance fee.
e.zh: 我们公寓的业委会每月收取维护费。

e.en: Friends gathered to {condole} with the grieving family.
e.zh: 朋友们聚在一起向悲痛的家人表示慰问。

e.en: She wrote a letter to {condole} her old colleague.
e.zh: 她写了一封信向她的老同事表示哀悼。

e.en: He sent a heartfelt {condolence} card to the family.
e.zh: 他给那家人寄了一张真诚的吊唁卡。

e.en: Please accept my deepest {condolence} for your loss.
e.zh: 请接受我对您失去亲人的最深切慰问。

e.en: Always use a {condom} to prevent sexually transmitted infections.
e.zh: 务必使用避孕套来预防性传播感染。

e.en: The clinic offers a free {condom} to every visitor.
e.zh: 该诊所向每位来访者免费提供一个避孕套。

condominium.t: n. 分户出售的公寓楼

e.en: They are renting a beachfront {condominium} for the summer.
e.zh: 他们这个夏天租了一套海滨公寓。

e.en: The new {condominium} tower has a rooftop swimming pool.
e.zh: 这座新的公寓大楼有一个屋顶游泳池。

condone.t: v. 宽恕；容忍（不当行为）

e.en: The school does not {condone} any form of bullying.
e.zh: 学校绝不容忍任何形式的霸凌行为。

e.en: I cannot {condone} cheating, even on a small quiz.
e.zh: 我不能纵容作弊,哪怕只是一次小测验。

e.en: Management {condoned} the late arrivals for far too long.
e.zh: 管理层对迟到行为纵容得太久了。

e.en: Such rude behavior should never be {condoned} in the workplace.
e.zh: 这种无礼行为绝不应在职场上被纵容。

condones.t: v. 宽恕（第三人称单数）

e.en: No reasonable parent {condones} hitting children as discipline.
e.zh: 没有理智的父母会赞同用打孩子来管教。

e.en: The platform never {condones} hate speech in any form.
e.zh: 该平台绝不容忍任何形式的仇恨言论。

e.en: Staying silent feels like {condoning} the unfair policy.
e.zh: 保持沉默感觉就是在纵容那项不公平的政策。

e.en: He denied {condoning} his friend's reckless driving.
e.zh: 他否认自己纵容朋友的鲁莽驾驶。

e.en: A California {condor} soared high above the canyon.
e.zh: 一只加州秃鹰在峡谷上空高高翱翔。

e.en: The {condor} is one of the world's largest flying birds.
e.zh: 秃鹰是世界上最大的飞鸟之一。

e.en: Regular exercise will {conduce} to better mental health.
e.zh: 经常运动有助于改善心理健康。

e.en: Quiet surroundings {conduce} to deep, focused study.
e.zh: 安静的环境有助于深入而专注的学习。

e.en: A tidy desk is {conducive} to focused work.
e.zh: 整洁的桌面有助于专注工作。

e.en: Loud music is hardly {conducive} to a good night's sleep.
e.zh: 大声的音乐很难让人睡个好觉。

conduct.t:
v. 进行；指挥
n. 行为；举止

e.en: The teacher praised the students for their excellent {conduct} during the trip.
e.zh: 老师表扬了学生们在旅行中的良好表现。

e.en: Researchers will {conduct} a survey on remote work habits next month.
e.zh: 研究人员下个月将开展一项关于远程办公习惯的调查。

e.en: The {conductance} of the wire dropped sharply at low temperatures.
e.zh: 导线的电导率在低温下急剧下降。

e.en: Engineers measured the {conductance} between the two terminals.
e.zh: 工程师测量了两个端子之间的电导。

e.en: The orchestra was {conducted} by a young guest musician.
e.zh: 乐团由一位年轻的客座音乐家指挥。

e.en: Scientists {conducted} hundreds of experiments before publishing the paper.
e.zh: 科学家在发表论文前进行了数百次实验。

conducting.t:
v. 进行中
adj. 传导的

e.en: She is {conducting} interviews with job candidates all afternoon.
e.zh: 她整个下午都在面试求职者。

e.en: Copper is excellent at {conducting} electricity and heat.
e.zh: 铜是导电和导热的绝佳材料。

e.en: Heat {conduction} through the metal pan warms the food evenly.
e.zh: 热量通过金属锅传导,使食物均匀受热。

e.en: Nerve {conduction} tests can help diagnose certain muscle disorders.
e.zh: 神经传导测试有助于诊断某些肌肉疾病。

e.en: Silver is the most {conductive} metal known to scientists.
e.zh: 银是科学家所知导电性最强的金属。

e.en: A quiet library is {conductive} to deep focus and reading.
e.zh: 安静的图书馆有助于深度专注和阅读。

e.en: The new material has higher thermal {conductivity} than aluminum.
e.zh: 这种新材料的导热率比铝还高。

e.en: Saltwater has much greater electrical {conductivity} than fresh water.
e.zh: 盐水的导电性远高于淡水。

e.en: The {conductor} raised his baton and the symphony began.
e.zh: 指挥举起指挥棒,交响乐随即开始。

e.en: Copper is a much better {conductor} of electricity than iron.
e.zh: 铜的导电性比铁好得多。

e.en: Most metals are good {conductors} of both heat and electricity.
e.zh: 大多数金属都是良好的导热和导电体。

e.en: Train {conductors} checked tickets as passengers boarded the platform.
e.zh: 列车员在乘客上车时查验车票。

conducts.t: v. 进行；实施（第三人称单数）

e.en: The professor {conducts} weekly office hours for graduate students.
e.zh: 这位教授每周为研究生举办答疑时间。

e.en: Graphene {conducts} electricity faster than almost any other material.
e.zh: 石墨烯的导电速度几乎超过任何其他材料。

e.en: Social media became a {conduit} for sharing breaking news instantly.
e.zh: 社交媒体成为即时传播突发新闻的渠道。

e.en: Electricians ran the cables through a metal {conduit} in the wall.
e.zh: 电工把电缆穿过墙内的金属导管。

e.en: Influencers serve as {conduits} between brands and younger audiences.
e.zh: 网红是品牌与年轻受众之间的桥梁。

e.en: Underground {conduits} carry fiber optic cables across the city.
e.zh: 地下管道承载着横跨城市的光纤电缆。

e.en: The doctor examined the {condyle} of the jaw for signs of arthritis.
e.zh: 医生检查下颌髁突,寻找关节炎迹象。

e.en: A fracture near the femoral {condyle} requires careful surgical repair.
e.zh: 股骨髁附近的骨折需要谨慎的手术修复。

e.en: She ordered a chocolate ice cream {cone} on the boardwalk.
e.zh: 她在海滨木栈道上点了一支巧克力冰淇淋蛋筒。

e.en: An orange traffic {cone} marked the edge of the construction zone.
e.zh: 一个橙色交通锥标示着施工区的边界。

e.en: The purple {coneflower} attracts bees and butterflies all summer long.
e.zh: 紫松果菊整个夏天都吸引着蜜蜂和蝴蝶。

e.en: She planted {coneflower} seeds along the back fence last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天在后栅栏边种了松果菊的种子。

e.en: Pine {cones} crunched underfoot as we walked through the forest.
e.zh: 我们穿过森林时,松果在脚下嘎吱作响。

e.en: The kids ate ice cream {cones} on the hot summer afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们在炎热的夏日午后吃着冰淇淋蛋筒。

e.en: A wild {coney} darted across the trail and into the bushes.
e.zh: 一只野兔窜过小路,钻进灌木丛。

e.en: He ordered a chili {coney} and fries at the diner.
e.zh: 他在小餐馆点了一份辣肉酱热狗和薯条。

confab.t:
n. 闲谈
v. 聊天（非正式）

e.en: The friends had a quick {confab} before heading into the meeting.
e.zh: 朋友们在进会议室前简短地聊了几句。

e.en: Designers gathered for an annual {confab} in San Francisco.
e.zh: 设计师们齐聚旧金山参加年度交流会。

confabulate.t: v. 闲谈；（心理学）虚构记忆

e.en: Patients with memory loss may unconsciously {confabulate} to fill the gaps.
e.zh: 失忆患者可能会无意识地编造记忆来填补空白。

e.en: The two friends would {confabulate} for hours over coffee.
e.zh: 两个朋友常常一边喝咖啡一边畅聊几个小时。

confabulated.t: v. 闲谈；虚构记忆（过去式）

e.en: The witness apparently {confabulated} details that never actually happened.
e.zh: 那位证人显然编造了一些根本没发生过的细节。

e.en: They {confabulated} late into the night about their travel plans.
e.zh: 他们聊到深夜,谈着旅行计划。

confabulates.t: v. 闲谈（第三人称单数）

e.en: The chatbot sometimes {confabulates} answers when it lacks reliable data.
e.zh: 当缺乏可靠数据时,这个聊天机器人有时会编造答案。

e.en: Grandpa fondly {confabulates} with his old army buddies every Sunday.
e.zh: 爷爷每个星期天都会和老战友们亲切地闲聊。

e.en: The AI was {confabulating} citations that did not exist in any journal.
e.zh: 这个AI在编造一些任何期刊上都不存在的引用。

e.en: They sat on the porch {confabulating} about old times.
e.zh: 他们坐在门廊上闲谈着往日时光。

confabulation.t: n. 闲谈；（心理学）虚构记忆

e.en: AI hallucination is a modern form of machine {confabulation}.
e.zh: AI幻觉是一种现代形式的机器虚构。

e.en: The doctor explained that {confabulation} is common after brain injury.
e.zh: 医生解释说,虚构症在脑损伤后很常见。

confabulations.t: n. 闲谈；虚构记忆（复数）

e.en: The model's {confabulations} sounded confident but were entirely fabricated.
e.zh: 这个模型的虚构内容听起来很自信,但完全是编造的。

e.en: Her childhood {confabulations} entertained the whole family at dinner.
e.zh: 她童年的奇思妙想在晚餐时逗乐了全家人。

e.en: The pastry chef created a stunning chocolate {confection} for the wedding.
e.zh: 糕点师为婚礼制作了一款惊艳的巧克力甜点。

e.en: The new movie is a light {confection} with no real depth.
e.zh: 这部新电影是部轻松的小品,没什么深度。

e.en: The shop sold every {confectionary} treat a child could imagine.
e.zh: 这家店出售孩子们能想象到的各种糖果点心。

e.en: She inherited an old family {confectionary} recipe from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她从祖母那里继承了一份家传的糖果食谱。

concoction.t: n. 混合物；调制的饮料或食物

e.en: This smoothie is a strange {concoction} of fruits and herbs.
e.zh: 这杯思慕雪是水果和香草的奇特混合物。

e.en: The whole story sounds like a {concoction} of lies.
e.zh: 整个故事听起来像是一堆编造的谎言。

concomitant.t:
adj. 伴随的；随之而来的
n. 伴随物

e.en: Rapid growth brought {concomitant} risks to the startup.
e.zh: 快速发展给这家初创公司带来了相伴而生的风险。

e.en: Stress and its {concomitant} health issues are common.
e.zh: 压力以及随之而来的健康问题十分常见。

e.en: Sales rose {concomitantly} with the marketing budget.
e.zh: 销售额随营销预算同步增长。

e.en: Symptoms often develop {concomitantly} with the infection.
e.zh: 症状常常随感染同时出现。

e.en: The neighbors lived in perfect {concord} for years.
e.zh: 邻居们多年来和睦相处。

e.en: After the talks, both nations were in {concord}.
e.zh: 会谈后,两国达成了一致。

e.en: There is strong {concordance} between the two studies' results.
e.zh: 两项研究的结果高度一致。

e.en: She used a {concordance} to find every Bible reference.
e.zh: 她用一本经文索引查找每一处圣经引文。

e.en: His testimony was {concordant} with the security footage.
e.zh: 他的证词与监控录像相符。

e.en: The survey results are {concordant} across all regions.
e.zh: 调查结果在所有地区都一致。

concordat.t: n. 协约；（教廷与政府的）协定

e.en: The {concordat} between the church and state took years to negotiate.
e.zh: 教会与国家之间的协约谈判耗时多年。

e.en: Both governments signed a {concordat} on cultural exchange.
e.zh: 两国政府签署了一份文化交流协约。

concorde.t: n. 协和式超音速客机

e.en: The {Concorde} crossed the Atlantic in under four hours.
e.zh: 协和飞机在不到四小时内飞越大西洋。

e.en: My grandfather once flew on the {Concorde} to New York.
e.zh: 我祖父曾乘坐协和飞机飞往纽约。

e.en: The vintage Ferrari won best in show at the {concours}.
e.zh: 这辆经典法拉利在车展评选中获得了最佳奖。

e.en: Collectors polish their cars before every {concours}.
e.zh: 收藏家们在每次车展评比前都会擦亮爱车。

concourse.t: n. （车站、机场的）中央大厅；汇合

e.en: We met at the airport {concourse} near gate 12.
e.zh: 我们在机场12号登机口附近的大厅碰头。

e.en: The station {concourse} was packed with morning commuters.
e.zh: 车站大厅挤满了清晨的通勤者。

concrete.t:
n. 混凝土
adj. 具体的；实在的

e.en: Can you give me a {concrete} example of the problem?
e.zh: 你能给我一个具体的例子来说明问题吗?

e.en: The new sidewalk is made of reinforced {concrete}.
e.zh: 新人行道是用钢筋混凝土建成的。

e.en: Tell me {concretely} what you need from the team.
e.zh: 具体告诉我你需要团队做什么。

e.en: The plan needs to be defined more {concretely}.
e.zh: 这个计划需要更具体地定义。

e.en: Good feedback values {concreteness} over vague generalities.
e.zh: 好的反馈讲究具体,而非泛泛而谈。

e.en: The proposal lacks the {concreteness} investors want to see.
e.zh: 该提案缺乏投资者希望看到的具体细节。

concretes.t:
n. 混凝土（复数）
v. 使凝固

e.en: The contractor mixes different {concretes} for various foundations.
e.zh: 承包商为不同地基调配多种混凝土。

e.en: High-performance {concretes} resist cracking under heavy loads.
e.zh: 高性能混凝土在重荷载下不易开裂。

e.en: Geologists study how each rocky {concretion} formed underground.
e.zh: 地质学家研究每块结核岩石是如何在地下形成的。

e.en: A small {concretion} appeared in his kidney scan.
e.zh: 他的肾脏扫描中出现了一个小结石。

e.en: The roadmap is the {concretization} of our long-term vision.
e.zh: 这份路线图是我们长期愿景的具体化体现。

e.en: Prototyping helps speed up the {concretization} of ideas.
e.zh: 做原型有助于加快想法的具体化。

e.en: Let's {concretize} this idea with a working prototype.
e.zh: 让我们用一个可运行的原型把这个想法具体化。

e.en: The workshop helps teams {concretize} abstract goals.
e.zh: 工作坊帮助团队把抽象目标具体化。

e.en: Historians study the role of {concubinage} in imperial courts.
e.zh: 历史学家研究纳妾制度在皇宫中的作用。

e.en: The novel critiques the practice of {concubinage} in old societies.
e.zh: 小说批判了旧社会中的纳妾习俗。

e.en: The emperor's favorite {concubine} held great influence at court.
e.zh: 皇帝最宠爱的妃子在宫中拥有很大的影响力。

e.en: The drama follows a {concubine} rising through palace ranks.
e.zh: 这部剧讲述了一位妃子在宫中步步高升的故事。

e.en: The novel explores guilt and {concupiscence} in equal measure.
e.zh: 小说同等地探讨了愧疚与情欲。

e.en: Religious texts often warn against unchecked {concupiscence}.
e.zh: 宗教典籍常警告人们不要放纵情欲。

concur.t: v. 同意；一致；同时发生

e.en: I {concur} with her assessment of the situation.
e.zh: 我同意她对形势的判断。

e.en: Most experts {concur} that early diagnosis saves lives.
e.zh: 大多数专家一致认为,早期诊断能挽救生命。

concurred.t: v. 同意；一致（concur 的过去式）

e.en: The reviewers {concurred} that the paper deserved publication.
e.zh: 审稿人一致认为这篇论文值得发表。

e.en: She {concurred} with the doctor's recommended treatment.
e.zh: 她同意医生推荐的治疗方案。

concurrence.t: n. 同意；一致；同时发生

e.en: The decision required the {concurrence} of all board members.
e.zh: 该决定需要全体董事会成员的一致同意。

e.en: There was a strange {concurrence} of events that morning.
e.zh: 那天早上发生了一连串奇怪的巧合。

e.en: The {concurrences} between the two reports surprised the investigators.
e.zh: 两份报告之间的吻合让调查人员感到惊讶。

e.en: Several {concurrences} of bad weather delayed the entire project.
e.zh: 几次恶劣天气的同时出现拖延了整个项目。

concurrent.t: adj. 并发的；同时发生的

e.en: He is serving two {concurrent} prison sentences.
e.zh: 他正在同时服两项刑期。

e.en: The app supports many {concurrent} users without slowing down.
e.zh: 该应用支持大量用户同时使用而不卡顿。

e.en: The two tests can run {concurrently} to save time.
e.zh: 这两项测试可以同时进行以节省时间。

e.en: She studied music and law {concurrently} at university.
e.zh: 她在大学里同时攻读音乐和法律。

concurring.t:
adj. 一致的
v. 同意（concur 的现在分词）

e.en: The judge wrote a {concurring} opinion supporting the verdict.
e.zh: 法官撰写了一份赞同该裁决的协同意见书。

e.en: Most experts are {concurring} with the new safety guidelines.
e.zh: 大多数专家都赞同新的安全准则。

concurs.t: v. 同意；一致（concur 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The committee {concurs} with the proposed budget cuts.
e.zh: 委员会赞同提议的预算削减。

e.en: My doctor {concurs} that more rest will help.
e.zh: 我的医生也认为多休息会有帮助。

concuss.t: v. 使脑震荡；猛烈摇动

e.en: A hard tackle can easily {concuss} a player.
e.zh: 一次重铲很容易让球员脑震荡。

e.en: The blast was strong enough to {concuss} nearby workers.
e.zh: 爆炸的威力足以震伤附近的工人。

e.en: He suffered a mild {concussion} during the football match.
e.zh: 他在足球比赛中得了轻微的脑震荡。

e.en: Doctors warn against returning to play after a {concussion}.
e.zh: 医生警告脑震荡后不要立即重返赛场。

concussive.t: adj. 震荡的；引发脑震荡的

e.en: The {concussive} blast shattered windows across the street.
e.zh: 震荡性的爆炸震碎了对街的窗户。

e.en: Soldiers train to withstand the {concussive} force of explosions.
e.zh: 士兵们训练以承受爆炸的冲击力。

e.en: The Spanish {conde} owned vast estates in the countryside.
e.zh: 那位西班牙伯爵在乡下拥有大片庄园。

e.en: A {conde} ranks below a marquis in Iberian nobility.
e.zh: 在伊比利亚贵族体系中,伯爵的等级低于侯爵。

condemn.t: v. 谴责；判刑；宣告不适用

e.en: World leaders quickly moved to {condemn} the violent attack.
e.zh: 各国领导人迅速谴责了这次暴力袭击。

e.en: Inspectors plan to {condemn} the unsafe old building.
e.zh: 检查员计划将这栋不安全的老楼列为危房。

e.en: His behavior at the meeting was clearly {condemnable}.
e.zh: 他在会议上的行为显然应受谴责。

e.en: Cheating on exams is a {condemnable} act in any school.
e.zh: 考试作弊在任何学校都是应受谴责的行为。

e.en: The speech drew widespread {condemnation} from the public.
e.zh: 那次演讲招致了公众的广泛谴责。

e.en: Her tweet faced immediate {condemnation} on social media.
e.zh: 她的推文在社交媒体上立刻遭到谴责。

e.en: The newspaper printed a {condemnatory} editorial about the policy.
e.zh: 该报刊登了一篇谴责该政策的社论。

e.en: She gave him a {condemnatory} look across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子向他投去谴责的目光。

condemned.t:
adj. 被判罪的；被谴责的
v. 谴责（过去式）

e.en: The {condemned} building will be demolished next week.
e.zh: 这栋被判定危险的楼房下周将被拆除。

e.en: Critics {condemned} the film for its lazy writing.
e.zh: 评论家批评这部电影剧本写得敷衍。

condemning.t:
adj. 谴责的
v. 谴责（现在分词）

e.en: She issued a statement {condemning} the company's actions.
e.zh: 她发表声明谴责该公司的行为。

e.en: The report is {condemning} of poor working conditions overseas.
e.zh: 该报告对海外恶劣的工作条件提出强烈谴责。

condemns.t: v. 谴责；判刑（第三人称单数）

e.en: The UN {condemns} any use of chemical weapons.
e.zh: 联合国谴责任何使用化学武器的行为。

e.en: Her boss publicly {condemns} office gossip and rumors.
e.zh: 她的老板公开谴责办公室里的闲话和谣言。

e.en: Wipe up the {condensate} that forms on the cold pipes.
e.zh: 擦掉冷水管上凝结的水珠。

e.en: The plant captures gas {condensate} for industrial reuse.
e.zh: 工厂收集天然气凝析液以便工业再利用。

e.en: There's a lot of {condensation} on the bathroom mirror.
e.zh: 浴室镜子上有很多水汽凝结。

e.en: Heavy {condensation} can cause mold to grow on walls.
e.zh: 严重的冷凝水会让墙上长霉。

e.en: The book offers brief {condensations} of each classic novel.
e.zh: 这本书提供了每部经典小说的简明缩写本。

e.en: Morning {condensations} formed beads of water on the leaves.
e.zh: 清晨的凝露在叶子上结成水珠。

e.en: Can you {condense} this report into a single page?
e.zh: 你能把这份报告压缩成一页吗?

e.en: Steam will {condense} into water on the cold glass.
e.zh: 水蒸气会在冷玻璃上凝结成水。

e.en: The recipe calls for a can of {condensed} milk.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要用一罐炼乳。

e.en: He gave a {condensed} version of the long story.
e.zh: 他把那个长故事简短地讲了一遍。

e.en: The air conditioner's {condenser} needs cleaning every spring.
e.zh: 空调的冷凝器每年春天都需要清洗。

e.en: Old microphones often used a {condenser} to capture sound.
e.zh: 老式麦克风常用电容式元件来收音。

condensing.t:
adj. 冷凝的
v. 浓缩（现在分词）

e.en: She is {condensing} her thesis into a short article.
e.zh: 她正在把论文压缩成一篇短文。

e.en: Steam was {condensing} on the cool windowpane.
e.zh: 水蒸气正在凉爽的窗玻璃上凝结。

e.en: The {conder} on the cliff guided fishing boats to shoals.
e.zh: 崖顶上的瞭望员引导渔船驶向鱼群。

e.en: Medieval villages employed a {conder} to spot herring schools.
e.zh: 中世纪村庄会雇用瞭望员来发现鲱鱼群。

condescend.t: v. 屈尊；居高临下地对待

e.en: Please don't {condescend} to me when explaining the problem.
e.zh: 在解释问题时请不要用居高临下的态度对我。

e.en: The CEO refused to {condescend} to answer junior staff.
e.zh: 那位总裁不屑于屈尊回答初级员工的问题。

condescending.t: adj. 居高临下的；摆架子的

e.en: His {condescending} tone made everyone in the room uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他那种居高临下的语气让在场的每个人都不舒服。

e.en: Avoid being {condescending} when teaching beginners new skills.
e.zh: 教初学者新技能时要避免摆出高人一等的姿态。

condescendingly.t: adv. 居高临下地；傲慢地

e.en: He smiled {condescendingly} at the students' simple questions.
e.zh: 他对学生的简单问题露出居高临下的笑容。

e.en: She spoke {condescendingly} to the new intern all morning.
e.zh: 她整个上午都对新来的实习生说话很傲慢。

e.en: The Parisian {confectioner} is famous for handmade chocolate truffles.
e.zh: 这位巴黎糖果师以手工巧克力松露闻名。

e.en: She trained as a {confectioner} in Belgium for three years.
e.zh: 她在比利时接受了三年糖果师培训。

e.en: The {confectionery} on Main Street sells handmade fudge and caramels.
e.zh: 大街上的糖果店出售手工软糖和焦糖。

e.en: Japanese {confectionery} often features delicate seasonal designs.
e.zh: 日式甜点常带有精致的季节性造型。

e.en: The bakery window displayed colorful {confections} that drew in passersby.
e.zh: 面包店橱窗里陈列的彩色甜点吸引着路人驻足。

e.en: Her summer dresses are airy {confections} of silk and lace.
e.zh: 她的夏装是丝绸与蕾丝交织的轻盈作品。

e.en: The southern states formed a {confederacy} during the American Civil War.
e.zh: 南方各州在美国内战期间组成了邦联。

e.en: A loose {confederacy} of indie developers organized the game jam.
e.zh: 一个松散的独立开发者联盟组织了这次游戏开发活动。

e.en: Switzerland operates under a {confederal} system with strong cantonal autonomy.
e.zh: 瑞士实行邦联制,各州享有高度自治。

e.en: The treaty proposed a {confederal} structure for the new union.
e.zh: 该条约为新联盟提出了邦联式的结构。

confederate.t:
n. 同盟者；同伙
adj. 同盟的

e.en: The detective discovered the thief had a {confederate} inside the bank.
e.zh: 侦探发现这名小偷在银行内部有一个同伙。

e.en: Her loyal {confederate} helped pull off the elaborate surprise party.
e.zh: 她忠实的伙伴帮她办成了那场精心策划的惊喜派对。

confederated.t:
adj. 结盟的
v. 结盟（过去式）

e.en: The thirteen colonies {confederated} loosely before adopting the Constitution.
e.zh: 十三州在通过宪法前曾以松散方式联合在一起。

e.en: Several small unions {confederated} to negotiate better wages collectively.
e.zh: 几个小工会联合起来,共同争取更好的薪资。

e.en: The European {confederation} of football clubs announced new rules.
e.zh: 欧洲足球俱乐部联合会宣布了新规则。

e.en: Canada became a {confederation} of provinces in 1867.
e.zh: 加拿大于1867年成为各省联合的联邦。

e.en: The judges paused to {confer} privately before announcing the winner.
e.zh: 评委暂停下来私下商议,然后才宣布获胜者。

e.en: The university will {confer} honorary degrees on three alumni.
e.zh: 该大学将向三位校友授予荣誉学位。

e.en: Each {conferee} received a welcome packet at the registration desk.
e.zh: 每位与会者在登记处都收到了一份欢迎资料包。

e.en: The keynote speaker greeted every {conferee} after her talk.
e.zh: 主讲嘉宾在演讲结束后向每位与会者致意。

e.en: She is presenting her research at a tech {conference} next week.
e.zh: 她下周将在一场科技大会上展示她的研究。

e.en: The team held a video {conference} with clients in Tokyo.
e.zh: 团队与东京的客户进行了视频会议。

e.en: He attends three industry {conferences} every year for networking.
e.zh: 他每年参加三场行业会议来拓展人脉。

e.en: Online {conferences} have made global participation much easier.
e.zh: 线上会议让全球参与变得容易得多。

conferencing.t: n. 会议通讯；远程会议

e.en: Video {conferencing} apps boomed in popularity during the pandemic.
e.zh: 视频会议软件在疫情期间人气暴涨。

e.en: The new {conferencing} platform supports up to a thousand participants.
e.zh: 这个新会议平台最多可支持一千名参与者。

conferencings.t: n. 会议通讯（复数，罕用）

e.en: The report compared various video {conferencings} used by remote teams.
e.zh: 该报告比较了远程团队使用的各种视频会议方式。

e.en: Different styles of {conferencings} suit different team cultures.
e.zh: 不同的会议形式适合不同的团队文化。

e.en: The {conferral} of degrees will take place in the main auditorium.
e.zh: 学位授予仪式将在主礼堂举行。

e.en: Her {conferral} of citizenship was a deeply emotional moment.
e.zh: 她获得公民身份的那一刻令人非常感动。

e.en: The university {conferred} an honorary doctorate on the novelist.
e.zh: 该大学授予这位小说家荣誉博士学位。

e.en: The two doctors {conferred} briefly before deciding on the treatment.
e.zh: 两位医生简短商议后决定了治疗方案。

e.en: The coaches were {conferring} on the sideline about the next play.
e.zh: 教练们在场边商讨下一个战术。

e.en: The ceremony for {conferring} awards lasted nearly two hours.
e.zh: 颁奖仪式持续了近两个小时。

e.en: This membership {confers} access to all premium features instantly.
e.zh: 此会员资格可立即开通所有高级功能。

e.en: The CEO regularly {confers} with department heads about strategy.
e.zh: 首席执行官经常与各部门负责人商讨战略。

e.en: I have to {confess} that I forgot your birthday entirely.
e.zh: 我得承认,我完全忘了你的生日。

e.en: After hours of questioning, the suspect refused to {confess}.
e.zh: 经过数小时的审讯,嫌疑人仍拒不认罪。

e.en: She finally {confessed} that she had been reading his journal.
e.zh: 她终于承认自己一直在偷看他的日记。

e.en: The hacker {confessed} to breaching dozens of corporate networks.
e.zh: 那名黑客承认入侵了数十个企业网络。

e.en: He often {confesses} his love for cheesy 90s pop songs.
e.zh: 他常常坦白自己有多喜欢九十年代的流行口水歌。

e.en: The character {confesses} her secret in the final chapter.
e.zh: 这个角色在最后一章吐露了她的秘密。

e.en: He spent the whole evening {confessing} his feelings to her.
e.zh: 他整晚都在向她吐露自己的心意。

e.en: The defendant avoided {confessing} despite the overwhelming evidence.
e.zh: 尽管证据确凿,被告仍避免认罪。

e.en: The detective recorded the suspect's full {confession} on video.
e.zh: 侦探将嫌疑人的完整供词录成了视频。

e.en: I have a small {confession}: I ate the last cookie.
e.zh: 我要坦白一件小事:最后一块饼干是我吃的。

confessional.t:
n. 忏悔室
adj. 忏悔的

e.en: Her latest album has a raw, {confessional} tone throughout.
e.zh: 她的最新专辑通篇都带着直白的自白式风格。

e.en: The priest waited quietly inside the wooden {confessional}.
e.zh: 神父静静地坐在木制的告解室里等候。

e.en: Her late-night {confessions} surprised even her closest friends.
e.zh: 她深夜的坦白连最亲近的朋友都感到意外。

e.en: The priest listened to {confessions} every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 神父每周六早上都聆听忏悔。

confessor.t: n. 忏悔者；听告解的神父

e.en: She became his trusted {confessor} during the difficult divorce.
e.zh: 在那段艰难的离婚期间,她成了他信赖的倾诉对象。

e.en: The {confessor} sat quietly behind the wooden screen.
e.zh: 那位听告解的神父静静坐在木屏风后。

e.en: Colorful {confetti} rained down as the couple kissed.
e.zh: 新人接吻时彩色纸屑如雨般落下。

e.en: The kids tossed {confetti} into the air at midnight.
e.zh: 孩子们在午夜把彩纸抛向空中。

e.en: He has been my closest {confidant} since college.
e.zh: 他从大学起就是我最亲密的知己。

e.en: Every leader needs a trusted {confidant} to share doubts with.
e.zh: 每位领导者都需要一个能倾诉疑虑的心腹。

e.en: Her sister has always been her closest {confidante}.
e.zh: 她姐姐一直是她最亲密的闺蜜。

e.en: The queen whispered her worries to her loyal {confidante}.
e.zh: 女王把心事悄悄告诉她忠诚的闺中密友。

e.en: You can {confide} in me without worrying about gossip.
e.zh: 你可以放心向我倾诉,不用担心流言。

e.en: Teenagers rarely {confide} their real fears to their parents.
e.zh: 青少年很少向父母吐露真正的恐惧。

e.en: She {confided} her plans to only one coworker.
e.zh: 她只向一位同事透露了自己的计划。

e.en: He {confided} that he was thinking of quitting.
e.zh: 他私下透露自己正在考虑辞职。

e.en: Public speaking helped me build real {confidence} over time.
e.zh: 公开演讲让我逐渐建立起真正的自信。

e.en: I told her the news in strict {confidence}.
e.zh: 我以绝对保密的方式告诉了她这个消息。

e.en: A good friend never betrays your private {confidences}.
e.zh: 真正的朋友绝不会泄露你的私密心事。

e.en: They exchanged {confidences} late into the night.
e.zh: 她们一直聊到深夜,互诉心事。

e.en: She felt {confident} walking into the job interview.
e.zh: 她走进面试时充满自信。

e.en: I am {confident} the package will arrive tomorrow.
e.zh: 我相信包裹明天就会送到。

e.en: Please keep this email strictly {confidential}.
e.zh: 请对这封邮件严格保密。

e.en: The lawyer reviewed several {confidential} client documents.
e.zh: 律师审阅了几份机密的客户文件。

e.en: Doctors must protect patient {confidentiality} at all times.
e.zh: 医生必须始终保护患者的隐私。

e.en: All employees signed a {confidentiality} agreement before starting.
e.zh: 所有员工入职前都签署了保密协议。

e.en: She {confidentially} told me about the upcoming layoffs.
e.zh: 她私下告诉我即将到来的裁员消息。

e.en: Please reply {confidentially} so others cannot see the message.
e.zh: 请以保密方式回复,以免他人看到信息。

e.en: He answered every question {confidently} during the panel.
e.zh: 在小组讨论中,他自信地回答了每个问题。

e.en: She walked {confidently} onto the stage to accept the award.
e.zh: 她自信地走上舞台领奖。

e.en: He only {confides} in his older brother.
e.zh: 他只向自己的哥哥吐露心事。

e.en: She {confides} her worries to her therapist each week.
e.zh: 她每周向心理咨询师倾诉自己的烦恼。

e.en: She spoke in a soft, {confiding} tone.
e.zh: 她用一种轻柔、推心置腹的语气说话。

e.en: He felt better after {confiding} in a close friend.
e.zh: 向密友倾诉之后,他感觉好多了。

confidingly.t: adv. 信任地；推心置腹地

e.en: She leaned in {confidingly} and lowered her voice.
e.zh: 她推心置腹地凑近,压低了声音。

e.en: The child smiled {confidingly} at the new teacher.
e.zh: 孩子信赖地对新老师微笑。

e.en: Face recognition relies heavily on {configural} processing of features.
e.zh: 人脸识别在很大程度上依赖于对各部位的整体构型加工。

e.en: The study compared {configural} and feature-based perception in infants.
e.zh: 该研究比较了婴儿的整体构型知觉与基于特征的知觉。

e.en: Check the network {configuration} before restarting the router.
e.zh: 重启路由器之前请先检查网络配置。

e.en: This laptop {configuration} comes with extra memory.
e.zh: 这款笔记本配置自带额外内存。

e.en: The app supports several keyboard {configurations} for different languages.
e.zh: 该应用支持适用于不同语言的多种键盘配置。

e.en: Engineers tested various engine {configurations} in the wind tunnel.
e.zh: 工程师在风洞中测试了多种发动机配置。

e.en: You can {configure} notifications in the settings menu.
e.zh: 你可以在设置菜单里配置通知。

e.en: It took an hour to {configure} the new server.
e.zh: 配置这台新服务器花了一个小时。

e.en: Please {confine} your comments to the topic at hand.
e.zh: 请把你的发言限定在当前话题上。

e.en: The vet asked us to {confine} the puppy to one room.
e.zh: 兽医让我们把小狗关在一个房间里。

e.en: The cat was {confined} indoors during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间猫被关在屋内。

e.en: The damage was {confined} to the kitchen.
e.zh: 损坏仅限于厨房。

e.en: After weeks of {confinement}, she finally went outside.
e.zh: 被关了几周之后,她终于出门了。

e.en: Solitary {confinement} can seriously affect mental health.
e.zh: 单独监禁会严重影响心理健康。

e.en: The novel explores the {confinements} of small-town life.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了小镇生活的种种束缚。

e.en: Strict pandemic {confinements} reshaped how people work.
e.zh: 严格的疫情封控改变了人们的工作方式。

e.en: She rarely leaves the {confines} of her quiet neighborhood.
e.zh: 她很少离开自家安静街区的范围。

e.en: The discussion stayed within the {confines} of the agenda.
e.zh: 讨论始终未超出议程的范围。

confining.t:
adj. 局促的，狭窄的
v. 限制（confine 的现在分词）

e.en: He found office life too {confining} and quit.
e.zh: 他觉得办公室生活太压抑,于是辞职了。

e.en: The dress was beautiful but {confining} around the waist.
e.zh: 这条裙子很漂亮,但腰部太紧绷。

e.en: Please {confirm} your appointment by replying to this email.
e.zh: 请回复此邮件以确认你的预约。

e.en: Lab results {confirm} the doctor's initial diagnosis.
e.zh: 化验结果证实了医生最初的诊断。

e.en: You'll receive an order {confirmation} by email shortly.
e.zh: 你很快会收到订单确认邮件。

e.en: The job offer is still awaiting final {confirmation}.
e.zh: 这份工作邀约仍在等待最终确认。

e.en: I always save flight {confirmations} in a dedicated folder.
e.zh: 我总是把航班确认单存到专门的文件夹里。

e.en: The bank sent two {confirmations} for the same transfer.
e.zh: 银行为同一笔转账发了两条确认信息。

e.en: The team ran a {confirmatory} test before publishing the results.
e.zh: 团队在发表结果之前进行了一次验证性测试。

e.en: She gave a quick {confirmatory} nod across the room.
e.zh: 她隔着房间快速点头表示确认。

confirmed.t:
adj. 已确认的
v. 确认（过去式）

e.en: The hotel {confirmed} our booking by text message.
e.zh: 酒店通过短信确认了我们的预订。

e.en: He is a {confirmed} fan of indie horror games.
e.zh: 他是个铁杆独立恐怖游戏迷。

e.en: She sent an email {confirming} the meeting time.
e.zh: 她发了一封邮件确认会议时间。

e.en: New data keeps {confirming} the original hypothesis.
e.zh: 新数据不断证实最初的假设。

confirms.t: v. 确认（第三人称单数）

e.en: This receipt {confirms} that the payment went through.
e.zh: 这张收据证明付款已成功。

e.en: The CEO {confirms} the merger in tomorrow's announcement.
e.zh: CEO将在明天的公告中确认这次合并。

e.en: Airport staff may {confiscate} oversized liquid bottles at security.
e.zh: 机场工作人员可能在安检时没收超大液体瓶。

e.en: Teachers used to {confiscate} phones during class.
e.zh: 老师过去常常在课堂上没收手机。

confiscated.t:
v. 没收（过去式）
adj. 被没收的

e.en: Customs officers {confiscated} the undeclared goods at the border.
e.zh: 海关官员在边境没收了未申报的物品。

e.en: The teacher {confiscated} my comic book in third grade.
e.zh: 三年级时老师没收了我的漫画书。

e.en: The new law allows {confiscation} of illegally parked vehicles.
e.zh: 新法律允许扣押违章停放的车辆。

e.en: Police announced the {confiscation} of counterfeit goods worth millions.
e.zh: 警方宣布查扣了价值数百万的假冒商品。

confiscatory.t: adj. 没收性的（常指税收过重）

e.en: Critics called the new tax rates outright {confiscatory}.
e.zh: 批评者直指新税率近乎没收性质。

e.en: The court struck down the law as {confiscatory} and unfair.
e.zh: 法院以具有没收性质且不公平为由废除了该法律。

confit.t: n. 油封（法式慢煮料理）

e.en: The restaurant is famous for its slow-cooked duck {confit}.
e.zh: 这家餐厅以慢炖油封鸭闻名。

e.en: She served garlic {confit} on warm sourdough bread.
e.zh: 她在温热的酸面包上抹上油封蒜泥。

e.en: A small spark turned into a massive {conflagration} overnight.
e.zh: 一点小火花一夜之间演变成了一场大火。

e.en: The political {conflagration} consumed the entire region.
e.zh: 那场政治大动荡席卷了整个地区。

e.en: People often {conflate} correlation with causation in news articles.
e.zh: 人们在新闻文章里常常把相关性和因果关系混为一谈。

e.en: Don't {conflate} disagreement with personal dislike.
e.zh: 不要把意见分歧和个人反感混为一谈。

e.en: The article suffers from a {conflation} of two distinct issues.
e.zh: 这篇文章把两个不同的问题混为一谈,因而存在缺陷。

e.en: Her argument relies on a careless {conflation} of terms.
e.zh: 她的论点建立在对术语的粗心混淆之上。

conflict.t:
n. 冲突，矛盾
v. 冲突，抵触

e.en: There is a scheduling {conflict} with Tuesday's meeting.
e.zh: 周二的会议有时间冲突。

e.en: The two countries have been in armed {conflict} for years.
e.zh: 这两个国家已经武装冲突多年。

e.en: She felt {conflicted} about leaving her hometown for the job.
e.zh: 对于为了这份工作离开家乡,她感到很矛盾。

e.en: The two studies {conflicted} on the drug's safety.
e.zh: 两项研究在该药物安全性上结论相互矛盾。

conflicting.t: adj. 相互冲突的，矛盾的

e.en: Witnesses gave {conflicting} accounts of the accident.
e.zh: 目击者对这起事故给出了相互矛盾的说法。

e.en: I have {conflicting} feelings about moving abroad.
e.zh: 对于出国生活,我心情很复杂。

e.en: The team's {conflictive} dynamics slowed every project down.
e.zh: 团队成员之间的冲突氛围拖慢了每一个项目。

e.en: He grew up in a deeply {conflictive} household.
e.zh: 他在一个充满冲突的家庭中长大。

conflicts.t:
n. 冲突（复数）
v. 冲突（第三人称单数）

e.en: This deadline {conflicts} with my vacation plans.
e.zh: 这个截止日期和我的休假计划有冲突。

e.en: Workplace {conflicts} are best handled face to face.
e.zh: 职场冲突最好当面解决。

e.en: Their relationship became increasingly {conflictual} after the move.
e.zh: 搬家之后,他们的关系变得越来越充满冲突。

e.en: The meeting turned into a {conflictual} debate over budgets.
e.zh: 会议演变成了一场关于预算的激烈争论。

e.en: The town sits at the {confluence} of two rivers.
e.zh: 这个小镇坐落在两条河流的交汇处。

e.en: A {confluence} of factors led to the startup's success.
e.zh: 多种因素的汇聚造就了这家初创公司的成功。

e.en: The cells grew until they formed a {confluent} layer.
e.zh: 这些细胞不断生长,直到形成一层连成一片的细胞层。

e.en: Two {confluent} streams meet just beyond the bridge.
e.zh: 两条汇合的小溪在桥那头交汇。

e.en: The lab uses a {confocal} microscope to image live cells.
e.zh: 实验室用共聚焦显微镜对活细胞进行成像。

e.en: She captured stunning {confocal} images of neuron synapses.
e.zh: 她拍下了神经元突触的精美共聚焦图像。

e.en: All products must {conform} to safety standards.
e.zh: 所有产品必须符合安全标准。

e.en: He refused to {conform} to office dress codes.
e.zh: 他拒绝遵从办公室的着装规定。

e.en: Map projections often use {conformal} transformations to preserve angles.
e.zh: 地图投影常用保角变换来保持角度。

e.en: Engineers applied a {conformal} coating to protect the circuit board.
e.zh: 工程师给电路板涂了一层保形涂层。

e.en: The audit verified {conformance} with industry regulations.
e.zh: 审计确认了对行业法规的合规性。

e.en: Our software was tested for {conformance} to the new API spec.
e.zh: 我们的软件已按新 API 规范进行了符合性测试。

e.en: The protein changes {conformation} when it binds to oxygen.
e.zh: 该蛋白质在结合氧气时会改变构象。

e.en: Judges examined the dog's {conformation} at the show.
e.zh: 评委在比赛上审视了那只狗的体型结构。

e.en: Researchers studied the {conformational} changes in the enzyme.
e.zh: 研究者们研究了该酶的构象变化。

e.en: Drug binding triggers a {conformational} shift in the receptor.
e.zh: 药物结合会引发受体的构象转变。

e.en: The new building {conformed} to all city zoning rules.
e.zh: 新建筑符合所有城市分区规定。

e.en: She quietly {conformed} to her family's expectations.
e.zh: 她默默地顺从了家人的期望。

conforming.t:
adj. 符合的
v. 遵从（现在分词）

e.en: The mattress has a {conforming} foam layer that hugs your body.
e.zh: 床垫有一层贴合身体的记忆海绵。

e.en: Only loans {conforming} to federal limits qualify for this rate.
e.zh: 只有符合联邦上限的贷款才能享受此利率。

conformism.t: n. 因循守旧，从众主义

e.en: The novel criticizes the {conformism} of suburban life.
e.zh: 这部小说批评了郊区生活的从众主义。

e.en: Blind {conformism} can stifle creativity in any team.
e.zh: 盲目的从众会扼杀任何团队的创造力。

conformist.t:
n. 循规蹈矩的人
adj. 从众的

e.en: He was too much of a {conformist} to challenge his boss.
e.zh: 他太循规蹈矩,不敢顶撞老板。

e.en: The school discouraged {conformist} thinking in its students.
e.zh: 这所学校不鼓励学生从众的思维方式。

e.en: Sociologists mapped subtle {conformities} across the two cultures.
e.zh: 社会学家梳理了两种文化间细微的相似之处。

e.en: The report listed several {conformities} between the contracts.
e.zh: 报告列出了两份合同之间的若干一致之处。

e.en: Teenagers often feel pressure for {conformity} with their peers.
e.zh: 青少年常感到要与同龄人保持一致的压力。

e.en: The inspector confirmed {conformity} with building codes.
e.zh: 检查员确认了与建筑规范的一致性。

conforms.t: v. 遵从（第三人称单数）

e.en: This helmet {conforms} to international safety standards.
e.zh: 这款头盔符合国际安全标准。

e.en: Her writing rarely {conforms} to traditional grammar rules.
e.zh: 她的写作很少遵循传统语法规则。

e.en: The election results continued to {confound} pollsters.
e.zh: 选举结果一再让民调专家困惑不解。

e.en: Don't {confound} correlation with causation in your analysis.
e.zh: 在分析中不要把相关性与因果关系混为一谈。

confounded.t:
adj. 困惑的
v. 使困惑（过去式）

e.en: The magician's trick {confounded} even seasoned skeptics.
e.zh: 魔术师的把戏连资深怀疑者都被难住了。

e.en: She stared at the bill, completely {confounded} by the charges.
e.zh: 她盯着账单,对那些费用完全摸不着头脑。

confounding.t: adj. 令人困惑的，混淆的

e.en: The study controlled for several {confounding} variables.
e.zh: 该研究对几个混杂变量进行了控制。

e.en: His sudden resignation was {confounding} to the whole team.
e.zh: 他突然辞职令整个团队都困惑不解。

e.en: The medieval {confraternity} cared for the town's poor and sick.
e.zh: 那个中世纪的兄弟会照顾镇上的穷人和病人。

e.en: Members of the {confraternity} met weekly at the old chapel.
e.zh: 兄弟会成员每周在那座老教堂聚会。

e.en: He greeted his {confrere} from the rival law firm warmly.
e.zh: 他热情地问候了来自对手律所的同行。

e.en: The professor dedicated the book to a beloved {confrere}.
e.zh: 教授把这本书献给了一位敬爱的同行。

e.en: She decided to {confront} her boss about the unpaid overtime.
e.zh: 她决定就拖欠的加班费当面找老板理论。

e.en: Startups must {confront} cash flow problems early on.
e.zh: 初创公司必须尽早正视现金流问题。

e.en: He tried to avoid a public {confrontation} with his neighbor.
e.zh: 他尽量避免与邻居公开发生冲突。

e.en: The meeting turned into a tense {confrontation} over budgets.
e.zh: 会议演变成围绕预算的紧张对峙。

e.en: Her tone in the email felt unnecessarily {confrontational}.
e.zh: 她邮件里的语气显得过于咄咄逼人。

e.en: A less {confrontational} approach usually wins more allies.
e.zh: 少一些对抗性的方式通常能争取到更多盟友。

e.en: He spoke {confrontationally}, putting everyone on edge.
e.zh: 他说话带着挑衅的口气,让大家都很紧张。

e.en: She rarely behaves {confrontationally} in team meetings.
e.zh: 她在团队会议上很少表现得咄咄逼人。

e.en: Verbal {confrontations} between drivers are common in traffic jams.
e.zh: 堵车时司机之间的口角相当常见。

e.en: The diplomat worked to defuse {confrontations} at the border.
e.zh: 那位外交官努力化解边境上的对峙。

e.en: The reporter {confronted} the senator with the leaked emails.
e.zh: 记者拿着泄露的邮件当面质问那位参议员。

e.en: She {confronted} her fear of public speaking head-on.
e.zh: 她正面克服了自己对公开演讲的恐惧。

e.en: {Confronting} climate change requires global cooperation.
e.zh: 应对气候变化需要全球合作。

e.en: He has trouble {confronting} difficult emotions in therapy.
e.zh: 他在治疗中难以面对那些难受的情绪。

confronts.t: v. 面对（第三人称单数）

e.en: The documentary {confronts} viewers with hard truths about poverty.
e.zh: 这部纪录片让观众直面贫困的残酷真相。

e.en: Every founder eventually {confronts} the question of scale.
e.zh: 每位创业者最终都会面对扩大规模这个问题。

confucian.t:
adj. 儒家的，孔子的
n. 儒家信徒

e.en: Many East Asian societies retain strong {Confucian} values.
e.zh: 许多东亚社会仍保留着浓厚的儒家价值观。

e.en: The course explored {Confucian} ideas about family duty.
e.zh: 这门课探讨了儒家关于家庭责任的思想。

e.en: {Confucianism} shaped Chinese government for two thousand years.
e.zh: 儒家思想塑造了中国两千年的政治体制。

e.en: Scholars debate whether {Confucianism} is a religion or philosophy.
e.zh: 学者们争论儒家究竟是宗教还是哲学。

confucius.t: n. 孔子（中国古代思想家）

e.en: {Confucius} taught that learning should never end.
e.zh: 孔子教导说学习应当永无止境。

e.en: Many proverbs are wrongly attributed to {Confucius} online.
e.zh: 网上很多谚语被错误地说成是孔子说的。

e.en: Don't {confuse} kindness with weakness.
e.zh: 别把善良误当成软弱。

e.en: The new icons {confuse} long-time users of the app.
e.zh: 新图标让这款应用的老用户感到困惑。

confused.t: adj. 困惑的，搞不清楚的

e.en: I'm a bit {confused} about which button to click first.
e.zh: 我有点搞不清该先点哪个按钮。

e.en: His {confused} expression told me to repeat the instructions.
e.zh: 他困惑的表情告诉我得把说明再讲一遍。

e.en: She blinked {confusedly} at the unfamiliar dashboard.
e.zh: 她对着陌生的控制面板困惑地眨了眨眼。

e.en: The puppy looked around {confusedly} for its owner.
e.zh: 小狗一脸茫然地四处寻找主人。

confuses.t: v. 使困惑，使混淆（第三人称单数）

e.en: The dense legal jargon {confuses} most ordinary readers.
e.zh: 晦涩的法律术语让大多数普通读者一头雾水。

e.en: He always {confuses} my brother with my cousin.
e.zh: 他总是把我哥哥和我表弟搞混。

confusing.t: adj. 令人困惑的，难以理解的

e.en: The checkout flow is {confusing} on mobile devices.
e.zh: 在手机上,这个结账流程让人摸不着头脑。

e.en: She gave a {confusing} explanation that raised more questions.
e.zh: 她给出的解释含糊不清,反而引出了更多问题。

e.en: {Confusingly}, both products share almost the same name.
e.zh: 令人困惑的是,这两款产品名字几乎一样。

e.en: The streets are {confusingly} numbered in this neighborhood.
e.zh: 这片街区的街道编号让人摸不着头绪。

e.en: There was a lot of {confusion} about the meeting time.
e.zh: 关于开会时间有很多误会。

e.en: Her sudden announcement caused complete {confusion} in the office.
e.zh: 她突然的宣布让办公室一片混乱。

e.en: The FAQ page clears up most common {confusions} about pricing.
e.zh: 常见问题页面解答了关于定价最常见的几种困惑。

e.en: Translation often introduces small {confusions} between languages.
e.zh: 翻译常常会在语言之间带来一些小误解。

e.en: He grew up speaking {Cong}, a regional Vietnamese dialect.
e.zh: 他从小说一种叫贡语的越南方言。

e.en: The museum displayed a jade {cong} from ancient China.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件来自中国古代的玉琮。

e.en: Guests formed a long {conga} line around the dance floor.
e.zh: 宾客们在舞池里排成长长的康茄舞队。

e.en: He tapped out a steady rhythm on the {conga} drum.
e.zh: 他在康茄鼓上敲出稳定的节奏。

e.en: The gravy will {congeal} quickly once it cools down.
e.zh: 肉汁一旦冷却就会很快凝固。

e.en: Vague ideas began to {congeal} into a real business plan.
e.zh: 模糊的想法开始凝聚成一份真正的商业计划。

congealed.t:
adj. 凝固的
v. 凝结（过去式）

e.en: The bacon grease had {congealed} in the pan overnight.
e.zh: 培根油脂在锅里凝固了一夜。

e.en: His scattered notes finally {congealed} into a coherent essay.
e.zh: 他零散的笔记终于汇聚成了一篇连贯的文章。

e.en: For breakfast she ordered {congee} with century egg and pork.
e.zh: 她早餐点了皮蛋瘦肉粥。

e.en: Plain {congee} is comforting when you're feeling sick.
e.zh: 生病时喝一碗白粥会让人很舒服。

e.en: Whisky often contains {congener} compounds that affect its flavor.
e.zh: 威士忌常含有影响其风味的同类化合物。

e.en: The biologist compared the lizard with its closest {congener}.
e.zh: 生物学家把这只蜥蜴与它最近的同属物种作了比较。

congenial.t: adj. 意气相投的，合得来的

e.en: We had a {congenial} dinner with the new neighbors.
e.zh: 我们和新邻居共进了一顿愉快的晚餐。

e.en: The cafe has a {congenial} atmosphere for studying.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆的氛围很适合学习。

e.en: She won an award for her {congeniality} during the contest.
e.zh: 她因比赛中的友善表现获得了一个奖项。

e.en: The team's success owes much to its {congeniality}.
e.zh: 团队的成功很大程度上归功于成员之间的融洽。

e.en: The baby was born with a {congenital} heart defect.
e.zh: 那个婴儿生下来就有先天性心脏缺陷。

e.en: He has a {congenital} dislike of bureaucracy.
e.zh: 他天生就讨厌官僚作风。

e.en: Some breeds of dogs are {congenitally} prone to hip problems.
e.zh: 某些犬种天生就容易出现髋关节问题。

e.en: He seems {congenitally} incapable of arriving on time.
e.zh: 他似乎天生就做不到准时到达。

e.en: Divers spotted a huge {conger} eel hiding in the rocks.
e.zh: 潜水员发现一条巨大的康吉鳗藏在岩石间。

e.en: The fisherman grilled the {conger} with lemon and herbs.
e.zh: 渔夫用柠檬和香草烤了那条康吉鳗。

e.en: The shed held a strange {congeries} of tools and old toys.
e.zh: 棚屋里堆着工具和旧玩具的奇怪混杂物。

e.en: Her essay is a {congeries} of half-formed ideas.
e.zh: 她的文章是一堆未成形想法的杂烩。

e.en: Heavy rain can {congest} the city's drainage system quickly.
e.zh: 大雨会很快让城市的排水系统不堪重负。

e.en: Pollen tends to {congest} my sinuses every spring.
e.zh: 花粉每年春天都会让我鼻塞难受。

e.en: The highway was {congested} during the morning rush hour.
e.zh: 早高峰时段高速公路堵得水泄不通。

e.en: My nose feels {congested} because of this bad cold.
e.zh: 因为重感冒，我的鼻子塞得很厉害。

e.en: Traffic {congestion} in the city is getting worse every year.
e.zh: 城市交通拥堵一年比一年严重。

e.en: The medicine helps relieve nasal {congestion} quickly.
e.zh: 这种药能迅速缓解鼻塞。

e.en: Her grandfather suffers from {congestive} heart failure.
e.zh: 她爷爷患有充血性心力衰竭。

e.en: The doctor explained the symptoms of {congestive} lung disease.
e.zh: 医生解释了充血性肺病的症状。

congleton.t: n. 康格尔顿（英国地名）

e.en: We stopped for lunch in {Congleton} on our way north.
e.zh: 我们北上途中在康格尔顿停下来吃午餐。

e.en: {Congleton} is a small market town in Cheshire, England.
e.zh: 康格尔顿是英格兰柴郡的一个小集镇。

conglomerate.t:
n. 企业集团，联合大企业
v. 聚集

e.en: Sony is a massive media {conglomerate} based in Japan.
e.zh: 索尼是一家总部位于日本的大型媒体集团。

e.en: The rock outcrop is made of {conglomerate} formed over millennia.
e.zh: 这片岩层由经过千年形成的砾岩组成。

e.en: Several Korean {conglomerates} dominate the country's economy.
e.zh: 几家韩国财团主导着该国经济。

e.en: Tech {conglomerates} are buying up smaller AI startups.
e.zh: 科技集团正在大举收购小型人工智能初创公司。

e.en: The festival was a wild {conglomeration} of music and art.
e.zh: 这个节日是音乐与艺术的疯狂混合体。

e.en: His desk holds a strange {conglomeration} of gadgets and books.
e.zh: 他的桌上摆着一堆稀奇古怪的小玩意和书。

e.en: The {Congo} River is the second longest in Africa.
e.zh: 刚果河是非洲第二长的河流。

e.en: She spent two years volunteering in the {Congo}.
e.zh: 她在刚果做了两年志愿者。

congolese.t:
adj. 刚果的
n. 刚果人

e.en: The restaurant serves authentic {Congolese} dishes like fumbwa.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应正宗的刚果菜，例如富姆布瓦。

e.en: Many {Congolese} musicians have influenced African pop music.
e.zh: 许多刚果音乐家影响了非洲流行音乐。

e.en: I want to {congratulate} you on your promotion.
e.zh: 我想恭喜你升职。

e.en: Don't forget to {congratulate} the team after the win.
e.zh: 赢了之后别忘了向团队道贺。

e.en: The coach {congratulated} every player after the final whistle.
e.zh: 终场哨响后，教练向每位队员表示祝贺。

e.en: She {congratulated} him warmly on passing the bar exam.
e.zh: 她热情地祝贺他通过了律师资格考试。

congratulates.t: v. 祝贺（第三人称单数）

e.en: The CEO personally {congratulates} every employee on their work anniversary.
e.zh: CEO会亲自向每位员工的入职周年表示祝贺。

e.en: This card simply {congratulates} the couple on their wedding.
e.zh: 这张卡片只是祝贺这对新人喜结良缘。
