e.en: Machines {corrugate} the cardboard to make it stronger.
e.zh: 机器把硬纸板压成瓦楞状以增强其强度。

e.en: Worry began to {corrugate} his forehead with deep lines.
e.zh: 忧虑开始在他额头上压出深深的皱纹。

e.en: The package arrived in a sturdy {corrugated} cardboard box.
e.zh: 包裹是用结实的瓦楞纸箱寄来的。

e.en: The roof was made of {corrugated} metal sheets.
e.zh: 屋顶是用瓦楞金属板做的。

e.en: The {corrugation} in the iron roof helps rainwater run off.
e.zh: 铁皮屋顶上的波纹有助于雨水排走。

e.en: Deep {corrugation} appeared on his brow as he concentrated.
e.zh: 他专注思考时额头上出现了深深的皱纹。

corrupt.t:
adj. 腐败的；贪污的
v. 腐化；损坏（文件）

e.en: Several {corrupt} officials were arrested last week.
e.zh: 上周有几名腐败官员被逮捕了。

e.en: A power surge can {corrupt} files on your hard drive.
e.zh: 电涌可能会损坏你硬盘上的文件。

corrupted.t: adj. 已损坏的（文件）；被腐化的

e.en: The download failed and the file was {corrupted}.
e.zh: 下载失败,文件已损坏。

e.en: Power had {corrupted} the once-idealistic young leader.
e.zh: 权力腐蚀了那位曾经满怀理想的年轻领导人。

corruptible.t: adj. 易腐化的；可贿赂的

e.en: No system is entirely {corruptible}-proof against insider threats.
e.zh: 没有任何系统能完全防止内部人员的腐败行为。

e.en: Even honest judges can be {corruptible} under enough pressure.
e.zh: 即便是正直的法官,在足够压力下也可能被腐蚀。

corrupting.t: v. 腐蚀；使堕落（现在分词）

e.en: Critics worry about the {corrupting} influence of social media on teens.
e.zh: 批评者担心社交媒体对青少年的腐蚀性影响。

e.en: A virus is {corrupting} files across the company network.
e.zh: 病毒正在破坏公司网络中的文件。

corruption.t:
n. 腐败；贪污
n. (文件) 损坏

e.en: The new government promised to fight {corruption} aggressively.
e.zh: 新政府承诺将大力打击腐败。

e.en: Data {corruption} caused the app to crash repeatedly.
e.zh: 数据损坏导致应用反复崩溃。

e.en: Many parents fear the {corruptive} effects of violent video games.
e.zh: 许多家长担心暴力电子游戏的腐蚀作用。

e.en: The judge warned against the {corruptive} power of unchecked authority.
e.zh: 法官警告说不受约束的权力具有腐蚀性。

e.en: The mayor had been acting {corruptly} for years before being caught.
e.zh: 市长腐败行事多年才被抓。

e.en: Officials who behave {corruptly} face severe penalties under the new law.
e.zh: 根据新法,行为腐败的官员将受到严厉处罚。

corsage.t: n. 胸花；女子礼服上的花饰

e.en: He pinned a small rose {corsage} to her prom dress.
e.zh: 他把一朵小玫瑰胸花别在她的舞会礼服上。

e.en: Each bridesmaid wore a matching white {corsage}.
e.zh: 每位伴娘都戴着配套的白色胸花。

e.en: The novel follows a daring {corsair} sailing the Mediterranean.
e.zh: 小说讲述了一名大胆的海盗在地中海航行的故事。

e.en: Old maps marked routes used by every notorious {corsair}.
e.zh: 旧地图上标注着每个臭名昭著的海盗所用的航线。

e.en: Victorian women often wore a tight {corset} under their dresses.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的女性常在裙子下穿紧身束腰。

e.en: The tradition acted as a {corset} on creative thinking.
e.zh: 那种传统就像紧身衣一样束缚了创造性思维。

corseted.t: adj. 穿紧身胸衣的；受拘束的

e.en: The {corseted} dancers moved stiffly across the ballroom floor.
e.zh: 穿着束腰的舞者在舞池里僵硬地移动着。

e.en: Her writing felt {corseted} by overly strict editorial rules.
e.zh: 她的写作被过于严格的编辑规则束缚住了。

corsica.t: n. 科西嘉岛（法国地名）

e.en: We spent two weeks hiking the mountains of {Corsica}.
e.zh: 我们花了两周时间在科西嘉的山间徒步。

e.en: Napoleon Bonaparte was born on the island of {Corsica}.
e.zh: 拿破仑·波拿巴出生在科西嘉岛。

corsican.t:
adj. 科西嘉的
n. 科西嘉人

e.en: The restaurant serves traditional {Corsican} cheese and cured meats.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应传统的科西嘉奶酪和腌肉。

e.en: Many {Corsican} villages cling to steep mountainsides.
e.zh: 许多科西嘉村庄都建在陡峭的山坡上。

cortege.t: n. 送葬队伍；随行人员

e.en: A long funeral {cortege} followed the hearse through the streets.
e.zh: 长长的送葬队伍跟着灵车穿过街道。

e.en: The president's {cortege} of black cars sped past the crowds.
e.zh: 总统的黑色车队从人群旁飞驰而过。

cortes.t: n. (西班牙、葡萄牙) 议会

e.en: The Spanish {Cortes} passed the new climate law yesterday.
e.zh: 西班牙议会昨天通过了新的气候法。

e.en: Hernán {Cortés} led the conquest of the Aztec Empire.
e.zh: 埃尔南·科尔特斯率军征服了阿兹特克帝国。

e.en: The brain's {cortex} handles complex thought and language.
e.zh: 大脑皮层负责复杂的思维和语言活动。

e.en: Damage to the visual {cortex} can cause partial blindness.
e.zh: 视觉皮层受损可能导致部分失明。

e.en: Researchers studied {cortical} activity during deep sleep.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了深度睡眠期间的大脑皮层活动。

e.en: The drug appears to enhance {cortical} blood flow significantly.
e.zh: 该药物似乎能显著促进大脑皮层的血流量。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {corticosteroid} cream for her rash.
e.zh: 医生开了皮质类固醇药膏治她的皮疹。

e.en: Long-term {corticosteroid} use can weaken the bones.
e.zh: 长期使用皮质类固醇会使骨骼变脆。

cortina.t: n. 科尔蒂纳（意大利地名、车型名）

e.en: My grandfather still drives a vintage Ford {Cortina} from 1972.
e.zh: 我祖父至今还开着一辆1972年的老款福特Cortina。

e.en: They went skiing in {Cortina} d'Ampezzo last winter.
e.zh: 他们去年冬天去科尔蒂纳丹佩佐滑雪了。

e.en: Chronic stress keeps {cortisol} levels elevated all day.
e.zh: 长期压力会让皮质醇水平整天居高不下。

e.en: Exercise can help regulate your body's {cortisol} response.
e.zh: 运动有助于调节身体的皮质醇反应。

cortisone.t: n. 可的松（肾上腺皮质激素）

e.en: The athlete received a {cortisone} injection for his sore knee.
e.zh: 运动员的膝盖痛打了一针可的松。

e.en: Doctors use {cortisone} to reduce severe joint inflammation.
e.zh: 医生用可的松来减轻严重的关节炎症。

e.en: Industrial {corundum} is used as an abrasive in sandpaper.
e.zh: 工业刚玉被用作砂纸中的研磨材料。

e.en: Rubies and sapphires are both gem varieties of {corundum}.
e.zh: 红宝石和蓝宝石都是刚玉的宝石品种。

e.en: Diamonds seemed to {coruscate} under the gallery's bright lights.
e.zh: 钻石在画廊明亮的灯光下闪闪发光。

e.en: Her wit could {coruscate} brilliantly during dinner conversations.
e.zh: 她的机智在晚餐谈话中常常闪耀光芒。

e.en: He spent years restoring his classic 1967 {Corvette}.
e.zh: 他花了好几年时间修复他那辆经典的1967年雪佛兰科尔维特。

e.en: The navy deployed a small {corvette} to patrol the coast.
e.zh: 海军派出一艘小型护卫舰巡逻海岸。

e.en: My aquarium has six {corydora} catfish cleaning the gravel.
e.zh: 我的鱼缸里有六条鼠鱼在清理底砂。

e.en: The {corydora} is a peaceful bottom-dweller perfect for community tanks.
e.zh: 鼠鱼是温和的底栖鱼,非常适合混养鱼缸。

cos.t:
conj. 因为（because 的口语缩写）
n. 长叶生菜

e.en: I'm staying home tonight {cos} I'm exhausted.
e.zh: 我今晚要待在家里,因为我累坏了。

e.en: She added crisp {cos} lettuce to the Caesar salad.
e.zh: 她在凯撒沙拉里加了爽脆的长叶生菜。

e.en: In math class we learned how to {cose} a knit pattern mathematically.
e.zh: 在数学课上我们学到了如何从数学上分析针织图案。

e.en: They like to {cose} up by the fireplace on snowy evenings.
e.zh: 下雪的夜晚他们喜欢依偎在壁炉旁取暖。

cosh.t:
n. 短棍；警棍
v. 用棍打

e.en: The robber threatened to {cosh} him with a metal pipe.
e.zh: 劫匪威胁要用金属管打他的头。

e.en: The hyperbolic function {cosh} appears often in engineering equations.
e.zh: 双曲余弦函数cosh在工程方程中经常出现。

e.en: We saw Mozart's opera {Così} fan tutte at the festival.
e.zh: 我们在音乐节上看了莫扎特的歌剧《女人皆如此》。

e.en: The Italian phrase {cosi} cosi means "so-so" in English.
e.zh: 意大利语 cosi cosi 在英语里就是"马马虎虎"的意思。

e.en: They sat {cosily} together watching old movies on the couch.
e.zh: 他们舒适地依偎在沙发上看老电影。

e.en: The cabin was tucked {cosily} between two snow-covered pines.
e.zh: 小木屋舒适地依偎在两棵积雪的松树之间。

e.en: Use the {cosine} function to calculate the angle of the triangle.
e.zh: 用余弦函数来计算这个三角形的角度。

e.en: The graph of {cosine} oscillates smoothly between one and negative one.
e.zh: 余弦函数的图像在1和-1之间平滑地振荡。

e.en: The cabin's {cosiness} made us forget the storm outside.
e.zh: 小屋的温馨让我们忘记了外面的暴风雨。

e.en: There's a special {cosiness} to reading by candlelight.
e.zh: 在烛光下读书有一种特别的温馨感。

e.en: The various {cosinesses} of each room gave the inn its charm.
e.zh: 每个房间各具特色的温馨感成就了这家旅馆的魅力。

e.en: Travel writers love describing the {cosinesses} of mountain lodges.
e.zh: 旅行作家喜欢描写山间小屋的种种温馨情趣。

cosmetic.t:
n. 化妆品
adj. 美容的；表面的

e.en: The repairs were purely {cosmetic} and didn't fix anything important.
e.zh: 这些修补只是表面功夫,没解决什么实质问题。

e.en: She works for a major {cosmetic} company in Paris.
e.zh: 她在巴黎一家大型化妆品公司工作。

e.en: The car was {cosmetically} restored but still had engine issues.
e.zh: 这辆车外观修复了,但发动机还是有毛病。

e.en: The website was redesigned {cosmetically} without improving usability.
e.zh: 网站只是表面重新设计了一下,可用性并未提升。

e.en: She buys most of her {cosmetics} from Korean online stores.
e.zh: 她大部分化妆品都在韩国网店买。

e.en: Airport duty-free shops sell luxury {cosmetics} at lower prices.
e.zh: 机场免税店以较低价格出售高端化妆品。

e.en: She trained as a {cosmetologist} after finishing high school.
e.zh: 她高中毕业后接受了美容师培训。

e.en: A licensed {cosmetologist} can perform skin and hair treatments.
e.zh: 持证美容师可以进行皮肤和头发护理。

e.en: He enrolled in {cosmetology} school to become a hairstylist.
e.zh: 他报读了美容学校,想成为一名发型师。

e.en: Modern {cosmetology} combines traditional techniques with cutting-edge science.
e.zh: 现代美容学将传统技艺与前沿科学结合在一起。

e.en: The telescope captured stunning images of {cosmic} dust clouds.
e.zh: 望远镜拍到了令人惊叹的宇宙尘埃云图像。

e.en: Missing the train felt like a {cosmic} joke that morning.
e.zh: 那天早上没赶上火车,感觉像是命运开的玩笑。

e.en: On a {cosmically} large scale, our problems seem trivial.
e.zh: 从宇宙尺度来看,我们的问题显得微不足道。

e.en: The two coworkers were {cosmically} mismatched in every way.
e.zh: 那两个同事在各方面都极不相配,简直是天作之孽。

cosmid.t: n. 黏粒（分子生物学载体）

e.en: Scientists used a {cosmid} vector to clone the large DNA fragment.
e.zh: 科学家用粘粒载体克隆了那段大DNA片段。

e.en: The {cosmid} library contained thousands of genomic inserts for screening.
e.zh: 该粘粒文库含有成千上万个用于筛选的基因组插入片段。

cosmo.t: n. 柯梦波丹（Cosmopolitan 杂志昵称）

e.en: She ordered a {cosmo} at the bar before the show started.
e.zh: 演出开始前她在吧台点了一杯大都会鸡尾酒。

e.en: The article appeared in the latest issue of {Cosmo}.
e.zh: 这篇文章登在最新一期《时尚COSMO》杂志上。

e.en: Ancient {cosmogony} explained how the world began through myth.
e.zh: 古代宇宙起源说通过神话来解释世界的诞生。

e.en: Modern physics offers a very different {cosmogony} from religious traditions.
e.zh: 现代物理学提出的宇宙起源论与宗教传统截然不同。

e.en: The James Webb telescope is testing major {cosmological} theories.
e.zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯望远镜正在检验重要的宇宙学理论。

e.en: Einstein introduced a {cosmological} constant to balance his equations.
e.zh: 爱因斯坦引入了宇宙学常数来平衡他的方程。

e.en: The {cosmologist} explained how galaxies formed after the Big Bang.
e.zh: 这位宇宙学家解释了星系如何在大爆炸后形成。

e.en: She became a leading {cosmologist} at the university observatory.
e.zh: 她成为大学天文台的顶尖宇宙学家。

e.en: Modern {cosmology} relies on data from powerful space telescopes.
e.zh: 现代宇宙学依赖强大太空望远镜的数据。

e.en: Ancient {cosmology} placed the Earth at the center of the universe.
e.zh: 古代宇宙观将地球置于宇宙的中心。

cosmonaut.t: n. 宇航员（特指俄罗斯）

e.en: The Russian {cosmonaut} spent six months on the space station.
e.zh: 这位俄罗斯宇航员在空间站上待了六个月。

e.en: Yuri Gagarin was the first {cosmonaut} to orbit Earth.
e.zh: 尤里·加加林是第一位绕地球飞行的宇航员。

cosmopolitan.t:
adj. 国际化的；世界性的
n. 见多识广的人

e.en: Singapore is a {cosmopolitan} city with people from everywhere.
e.zh: 新加坡是一个汇聚各地人群的国际化都市。

e.en: She has a very {cosmopolitan} taste in food and music.
e.zh: 她在饮食和音乐上品味非常国际化。

e.en: The festival celebrates the {cosmopolitanism} of New York City.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝纽约的国际多元文化。

e.en: Her writing reflects a strong sense of {cosmopolitanism}.
e.zh: 她的写作流露出强烈的世界主义情怀。

cosmos.t:
n. 宇宙
n. 波斯菊

e.en: Astronomers study the origins of the {cosmos}.
e.zh: 天文学家研究宇宙的起源。

e.en: He stared at the night sky, lost in the vast {cosmos}.
e.zh: 他凝视夜空,沉醉于浩瀚的宇宙之中。

e.en: The {cossack} rode his horse across the open steppe.
e.zh: 那名哥萨克骑士策马驰骋在辽阔草原上。

e.en: Old paintings often depict the {cossack} in traditional dress.
e.zh: 古画中常描绘身着传统服饰的哥萨克人。

e.en: Some parents {cosset} their children far too much.
e.zh: 有些父母对孩子过分宠溺。

e.en: The hotel staff {cosset} every guest with personal attention.
e.zh: 酒店员工无微不至地呵护每一位客人。

e.en: He grew up {cosseted} by wealthy and protective parents.
e.zh: 他在富有又呵护备至的父母庇护下长大。

e.en: The pampered cat is {cosseted} with daily treats.
e.zh: 这只娇生惯养的猫每天都被宠着喂零食。

cosseting.t: v. 娇惯（cosset 现在分词）

e.en: Too much {cosseting} can leave kids unprepared for real life.
e.zh: 过度溺爱会让孩子无法应对现实生活。

e.en: The spa is famous for {cosseting} its guests.
e.zh: 这家水疗中心以悉心款待客人著称。

cossets.t: v. 娇惯（cosset 第三人称单数）

e.en: She {cossets} her elderly dog with homemade meals.
e.zh: 她用自制餐食悉心宠爱她的老狗。

e.en: The resort {cossets} visitors with luxurious amenities.
e.zh: 这家度假村以奢华设施宠爱每位访客。

cost.t:
n. 成本；费用
v. 花费

e.en: How much does this jacket {cost} on the website?
e.zh: 这件夹克在网站上卖多少钱?

e.en: The total {cost} of the renovation exceeded our budget.
e.zh: 装修的总费用超出了我们的预算。

cost-effective.t: adj. 划算的；性价比高的

e.en: Solar panels are a {cost-effective} solution for many homes.
e.zh: 太阳能板对许多家庭来说是一种性价比高的方案。

e.en: We need a more {cost-effective} way to ship products.
e.zh: 我们需要一种更划算的产品运输方式。

costa.t:
n. 肋；叶脉
n. 科斯塔（姓氏）

e.en: They sipped coffee at a {Costa} café in central London.
e.zh: 他们在伦敦市中心的一家Costa咖啡馆喝咖啡。

e.en: The {Costa} del Sol attracts millions of tourists each year.
e.zh: 太阳海岸每年吸引数百万游客。

e.en: The doctor examined the patient's {costal} cartilage for damage.
e.zh: 医生检查了病人的肋软骨是否受损。

e.en: X-rays revealed a fracture along the {costal} margin.
e.zh: X光显示沿肋骨缘有骨折。

e.en: A Victorian {costermonger} sold fruit from a wooden cart.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的小贩用木车叫卖水果。

e.en: The {costermonger} shouted prices loudly across the market.
e.zh: 那个街头果贩在集市上大声叫喊价格。

costing.t:
n. 成本核算
v. 花费（cost 现在分词）

e.en: Inflation is {costing} families more at the grocery store.
e.zh: 通货膨胀让家庭在超市花费更多。

e.en: The accountant prepared a detailed {costing} for the project.
e.zh: 会计为该项目准备了详细的成本核算。

e.en: The app offers a {costless} version with limited features.
e.zh: 该应用提供功能有限的免费版本。

e.en: Switching providers is essentially {costless} for most customers.
e.zh: 对大多数客户来说,更换服务商基本上不花钱。

e.en: That mistake turned out to be very {costly} for the company.
e.zh: 那个错误对公司来说代价非常高。

e.en: She bought a {costly} handbag for her birthday.
e.zh: 她生日时买了一个昂贵的手提包。

costs.t:
n. 费用（复数）
v. 花费（第三人称单数）

e.en: Rising fuel {costs} are affecting small businesses.
e.zh: 不断上涨的燃料成本正在影响小企业。

e.en: This new printer {costs} less than the old model.
e.zh: 这台新打印机比旧型号便宜。

costume.t:
n. 服装；戏服
v. 为…提供服装

e.en: She wore a vampire {costume} to the Halloween party.
e.zh: 她穿着吸血鬼服装参加万圣节派对。

e.en: The actor's medieval {costume} looked incredibly authentic.
e.zh: 那名演员的中世纪戏服看起来非常逼真。

costumed.t:
adj. 穿着戏装的
v. 给…穿上服装

e.en: {Costumed} performers greeted visitors at the theme park entrance.
e.zh: 身着戏服的表演者在主题公园门口迎接游客。

e.en: The parade featured hundreds of brightly {costumed} dancers.
e.zh: 游行队伍中有数百位身着鲜艳服装的舞者。

costumer.t: n. 戏服设计师；戏服出租商

e.en: The film's {costumer} researched 1920s fashion for months.
e.zh: 电影的服装师花了几个月研究20年代的时装。

e.en: A talented {costumer} can transform any actor's look.
e.zh: 出色的服装师能彻底改变演员的造型。

e.en: The kids picked out their Halloween {costumes} together.
e.zh: 孩子们一起挑选了他们的万圣节服装。

e.en: Stage {costumes} need to look good under bright lights.
e.zh: 舞台服装在强光下也要好看。

e.en: The opera house hired a famous {costumier} from Paris.
e.zh: 歌剧院聘请了一位巴黎著名的服装设计师。

e.en: She trained as a {costumier} for historical dramas.
e.zh: 她接受过为古装剧设计戏服的专业训练。

costuming.t:
n. 服装设计
v. 给…穿戏装

e.en: The {costuming} for the show won an Emmy Award.
e.zh: 该剧的服装设计获得了艾美奖。

e.en: She studied {costuming} at a prestigious theater school.
e.zh: 她在一所知名戏剧学校学习服装设计。

cosworth.t: n. 考斯沃斯（英国赛车引擎厂商）

e.en: The Ford Sierra {Cosworth} is a legendary 1980s sports car.
e.zh: 福特西耶拉Cosworth是80年代传奇的运动车。

e.en: He spent years restoring a classic {Cosworth} engine.
e.zh: 他花了多年时间修复一台经典的Cosworth发动机。

e.en: We curled up by the fireplace in our {cosy} cabin.
e.zh: 我们在温馨的小屋壁炉旁蜷缩着取暖。

e.en: This café has a {cosy} atmosphere perfect for reading.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆气氛温馨,非常适合阅读。

e.en: The baby slept peacefully in her wooden {cot}.
e.zh: 婴儿在她的木制婴儿床里安静地睡着。

e.en: He set up a folding {cot} for the overnight guest.
e.zh: 他为留宿的客人架起一张折叠床。

cote.t: n. 小棚圈（鸽舍、羊圈等）

e.en: The doves returned to their {cote} at sunset.
e.zh: 鸽子在日落时分回到了它们的鸽舍。

e.en: He built a wooden {cote} for the sheep behind the barn.
e.zh: 他在谷仓后面为羊搭建了一个木棚。

e.en: A small {coterie} of writers met every Friday at the café.
e.zh: 一小群作家每周五都在咖啡馆聚会。

e.en: She belongs to an exclusive {coterie} of fashion insiders.
e.zh: 她属于一个时尚圈内人的小圈子。

e.en: The school district is {coterminous} with the city limits.
e.zh: 该学区与市界完全重合。

e.en: Their employment contracts are {coterminous} with the project.
e.zh: 他们的雇佣合同与项目同期结束。

cotillion.t: n. 名媛社交舞会；科蒂永舞

e.en: She wore a white gown to her debutante {cotillion}.
e.zh: 她穿着白色礼服参加成年舞会。

e.en: The Southern {cotillion} included formal dance lessons for teens.
e.zh: 南方传统舞会为青少年安排正式舞蹈课程。

coton.t: n. 科顿犬（马达加斯加犬种）

e.en: A {Coton} de Tulear is a small, fluffy white dog breed.
e.zh: 棉花面纱犬是一种小型蓬松的白色犬种。

e.en: Their {Coton} loves to follow them around the house.
e.zh: 他们的棉花面纱犬喜欢跟着主人在家里到处跑。

e.en: The {cotoneaster} in our garden produces bright red berries.
e.zh: 我们花园里的栒子木结出鲜红的浆果。

e.en: Birds love feeding on the {cotoneaster} during winter.
e.zh: 鸟儿在冬天喜欢以栒子木的果实为食。

cotswold.t: n. 科茨沃尔德（英国地区）

e.en: We rented a stone cottage in a {Cotswold} village.
e.zh: 我们在科茨沃尔德的村庄租了一间石屋。

e.en: The {Cotswold} hills are dotted with charming old pubs.
e.zh: 科茨沃尔德的丘陵间散布着迷人的古老酒馆。

cotta.t: n. 短白衣（神职人员的罩袍）

e.en: The priest wore a white {cotta} over his cassock.
e.zh: 神父在长袍外套着一件白色短白衣。

e.en: Choirboys put on a {cotta} before the morning service.
e.zh: 唱诗班的男孩在早间礼拜前穿上短白衣。

cottage.t: n. 乡村小屋、度假小屋

e.en: They rented a small {cottage} by the lake for the weekend.
e.zh: 他们周末在湖边租了一栋小别墅。

e.en: The {cottage} had a thatched roof and a charming garden.
e.zh: 这栋小屋有茅草屋顶和迷人的花园。

e.en: The old {cottager} grew vegetables in his tiny garden.
e.zh: 那位住在小屋里的老人在小花园里种菜。

e.en: Every {cottager} in the village knew the local baker.
e.zh: 村里每个住小屋的人都认识当地的面包师。

e.en: Tiny stone {cottages} line the road through the village.
e.zh: 村里那条路两旁排列着小石屋。

e.en: The fishing village has dozens of whitewashed {cottages}.
e.zh: 这个渔村有几十栋粉刷白墙的小屋。

cotton.t:
n. 棉花、棉布
v. 喜欢上、领会 (口语)

e.en: This T-shirt is made of soft organic {cotton}.
e.zh: 这件T恤是用柔软的有机棉制成的。

e.en: Farmers harvest {cotton} in the southern United States.
e.zh: 美国南部的农民种植和采摘棉花。

e.en: The {cottonmouth} is a venomous snake found in southern swamps.
e.zh: 棉口蛇是南方沼泽中发现的一种毒蛇。

e.en: Hikers should watch out for {cottonmouth} snakes near rivers.
e.zh: 徒步者在河边要警惕棉口蛇。

e.en: {Cottonseed} oil is commonly used in commercial cooking.
e.zh: 棉籽油常用于商业烹饪。

e.en: Farmers feed {cottonseed} to dairy cattle for extra protein.
e.zh: 农民给奶牛喂棉籽以补充蛋白质。

e.en: A small {cottontail} hopped across the lawn at dusk.
e.zh: 一只小棉尾兔在黄昏时跳过草坪。

e.en: The {cottontail} rabbit froze when it spotted the fox.
e.zh: 那只棉尾兔发现狐狸时立刻僵住不动。

e.en: A massive {cottonwood} tree shaded the riverbank.
e.zh: 一棵巨大的棉白杨为河岸遮阴。

e.en: The {cottonwood} sheds fluffy seeds every spring.
e.zh: 棉白杨每年春天都会飘落毛茸茸的种子。

e.en: The clouds had a soft, {cottony} appearance that morning.
e.zh: 那天早晨的云朵看起来像棉花一样柔软。

e.en: She loved the {cottony} texture of the new blanket.
e.zh: 她喜欢这条新毯子棉绒般的质感。

e.en: The seedling's first {cotyledon} emerged from the soil.
e.zh: 幼苗的第一片子叶从土里冒了出来。

e.en: Each bean seed contains two halves called a {cotyledon}.
e.zh: 每颗豆类种子都含有两片称为子叶的部分。

e.en: The French phrase "{cou} de cygne" means swan neck.
e.zh: 法语短语 "cou de cygne" 意思是天鹅颈。

e.en: She studied the word {cou} in her French vocabulary list.
e.zh: 她在法语词汇表中学习了 cou 这个词。

couch.t:
n. 沙发、长椅
v. 措辞表达

e.en: We spent the whole evening watching movies on the {couch}.
e.zh: 我们整晚都窝在沙发上看电影。

e.en: He tried to {couch} his criticism in polite language.
e.zh: 他试图用礼貌的措辞来表达批评。

e.en: The showroom displays leather {couches} in many colors.
e.zh: 展厅展示着多种颜色的皮沙发。

e.en: She {couches} her advice in gentle, encouraging words.
e.zh: 她用温和鼓励的话语包装自己的建议。

e.en: A {cougar} was spotted near the hiking trail yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天有人在徒步小径附近发现了一只美洲狮。

e.en: The {cougar} silently stalked its prey through the forest.
e.zh: 美洲狮悄无声息地在森林中追踪猎物。

cough.t:
v. 咳嗽
n. 咳嗽声

e.en: I have a bad {cough} that won't go away.
e.zh: 我咳嗽得很厉害，一直不见好。

e.en: Please {cough} into your elbow, not your hand.
e.zh: 请对着手肘咳嗽，不要对着手。

e.en: She {coughed} loudly during the quiet meeting.
e.zh: 在安静的会议上她大声咳嗽了一下。

e.en: The old engine {coughed} and finally started up.
e.zh: 那台旧引擎咳了几声终于启动了。

coughing.t:
v. 咳嗽（进行时）
n. 咳嗽

e.en: He kept {coughing} all night and barely slept.
e.zh: 他咳了一整夜，几乎没怎么睡。

e.en: The {coughing} fit lasted nearly five minutes.
e.zh: 那阵咳嗽持续了将近五分钟。

coughs.t:
v. 咳嗽（第三人称）
n. 咳嗽声（复数）

e.en: This syrup helps relieve dry {coughs} quickly.
e.zh: 这种糖浆能很快缓解干咳。

e.en: He {coughs} whenever he walks into a dusty room.
e.zh: 他一走进有灰尘的房间就咳嗽。

could.t: v. 能够（can 的过去式）；可能会

e.en: {Could} you help me carry these boxes upstairs?
e.zh: 你能帮我把这些箱子搬到楼上吗？

e.en: When I was younger, I {could} run for hours.
e.zh: 我年轻的时候能跑好几个小时。

coulee.t: n. 干涸的深沟；熔岩流

e.en: The dry {coulee} fills with water after heavy rain.
e.zh: 那条干涸的冲沟在大雨后会蓄满水。

e.en: We hiked along a deep {coulee} carved into the prairie.
e.zh: 我们沿着草原上一条深深的冲沟徒步。

coulis.t: n. 果泥酱汁（法式烹饪）

e.en: The dessert came with a sweet raspberry {coulis}.
e.zh: 这道甜点配有香甜的覆盆子果酱。

e.en: She drizzled mango {coulis} over the cheesecake.
e.zh: 她在芝士蛋糕上淋了一层芒果果酱。

couloir.t: n. 山壁陡峭沟槽（登山术语）

e.en: The climbers ascended a steep snow {couloir}.
e.zh: 登山者沿着一条陡峭的雪槽向上攀登。

e.en: Avalanches often roar down this narrow {couloir}.
e.zh: 雪崩常常从这条狭窄的雪槽中倾泻而下。

e.en: One {coulomb} equals the charge of about six quintillion electrons.
e.zh: 一库仑约等于六百京个电子的电荷量。

e.en: The physics exam asked us to calculate charge in {coulomb} units.
e.zh: 物理考试要求我们用库仑为单位计算电荷。

coulter.t: n. 犁刀；(姓) 库尔特

e.en: The plow's sharp {coulter} sliced cleanly through the soil.
e.zh: 犁上锋利的犁刀干净利落地切开了土壤。

e.en: Farmers replaced the worn {coulter} before spring planting.
e.zh: 农民们在春耕前更换了磨损的犁刀。

coumarin.t: n. 香豆素（有机化合物）

e.en: {Coumarin} gives freshly cut hay its sweet smell.
e.zh: 香豆素让刚割下的干草散发出甜香。

e.en: Some perfumes use synthetic {coumarin} for a vanilla note.
e.zh: 一些香水使用合成香豆素来呈现香草调。

e.en: In old texts, {coun} appears as a shortened form of council.
e.zh: 在古文中，coun 是 council 的缩写形式。

e.en: The dictionary lists {coun} as an obsolete English root.
e.zh: 字典将 coun 列为已废弃的英语词根。

council.t: n. 理事会、委员会、议会

e.en: The city {council} approved the new park last night.
e.zh: 市议会昨晚批准了新公园的方案。

e.en: She was elected to the student {council} this year.
e.zh: 她今年被选入了学生会。

e.en: The local {councillor} promised to fix the broken streetlights.
e.zh: 当地的议员承诺修好那些坏掉的路灯。

e.en: Each {councillor} represents a different neighborhood district.
e.zh: 每位议员代表一个不同的社区选区。

e.en: Always check the {counterparty}'s credit before signing the deal.
e.zh: 签合同前一定要核查对方的信用状况。

e.en: The bank failed to assess {counterparty} risk properly.
e.zh: 该银行未能正确评估交易对手风险。

counterpoint.t:
n. 对比；对位法（音乐）
v. 与…形成对照

e.en: Her quiet voice was a perfect {counterpoint} to his shouting.
e.zh: 她安静的嗓音与他的喊叫形成了完美的对比。

e.en: Bach was a master of musical {counterpoint}.
e.zh: 巴赫是音乐对位法的大师。

counterpoise.t:
n. 平衡力；砝码
v. 使平衡

e.en: Free press serves as a {counterpoise} to government power.
e.zh: 自由的新闻媒体是制衡政府权力的力量。

e.en: The crane uses a heavy weight as a {counterpoise}.
e.zh: 起重机使用重物作为平衡配重。

e.en: The article tries to {counterpose} freedom against security.
e.zh: 这篇文章试图将自由与安全对立起来。

e.en: Critics often {counterpose} art and commerce as opposites.
e.zh: 批评家常常将艺术与商业对立起来。

counterproductive.t: adj. 适得其反的；起反作用的

e.en: Yelling at children is usually {counterproductive}.
e.zh: 对孩子大喊大叫通常会适得其反。

e.en: Cutting the marketing budget proved {counterproductive} for sales.
e.zh: 削减营销预算对销售产生了适得其反的效果。

e.en: He acted {counterproductively} by arguing with the customer.
e.zh: 他与顾客争吵的做法适得其反。

e.en: The new rules {counterproductively} slowed down the entire team.
e.zh: 新规定适得其反地拖慢了整个团队的进度。

counterpunch.t:
n. 反击拳
v. 回击

e.en: The boxer landed a sharp {counterpunch} in the second round.
e.zh: 拳击手在第二回合打出了一记凌厉的反击拳。

e.en: Her speech was a {counterpunch} to the senator's attack.
e.zh: 她的演讲是对参议员攻击的有力反击。

counterrevolution.t: n. 反革命；反革命运动

e.en: The new regime feared a {counterrevolution} from exiled leaders.
e.zh: 新政权担心流亡领导人发动反革命。

e.en: Historians debate whether the coup was a true {counterrevolution}.
e.zh: 历史学家争论这场政变是否是真正的反革命。

counters.t:
n. 柜台；计数器（复数）
v. 反击（第三人称单数）

e.en: The store added more checkout {counters} to reduce wait times.
e.zh: 商店增加了更多收银台以缩短等待时间。

e.en: He cleaned all the kitchen {counters} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他擦干净了所有的厨房台面。

countersign.t:
v. 连署；会签
n. 口令；暗号

e.en: Your manager must {countersign} this expense report.
e.zh: 您的经理必须连署签署这份费用报告。

e.en: The guard asked for the secret {countersign} at the gate.
e.zh: 卫兵在大门口要求口令。

countersink.t:
n. 埋头孔
v. 钻埋头孔

e.en: Use a special bit to {countersink} the screws flush.
e.zh: 用特制钻头将螺钉沉头埋入表面。

e.en: The carpenter drilled a {countersink} for each bolt.
e.zh: 木匠为每颗螺栓钻了一个埋头孔。

e.en: All the screws were neatly {countersunk} into the wood.
e.zh: 所有螺钉都整齐地埋入了木头里。

e.en: The hinges are attached with {countersunk} bolts.
e.zh: 铰链用埋头螺栓固定。

e.en: The {countertenor} hit notes higher than the soprano.
e.zh: 假声男高音唱出了比女高音还高的音。

e.en: He trained for years to become a professional {countertenor}.
e.zh: 他训练多年才成为一名专业的假声男高音。

e.en: The agency leads {counterterrorism} efforts across the country.
e.zh: 该机构在全国范围内领导反恐工作。

e.en: She lectures on {counterterrorism} policy at the university.
e.zh: 她在大学讲授反恐政策。

countertop.t: n. 厨房台面；操作台面

e.en: We installed a marble {countertop} in the new kitchen.
e.zh: 我们在新厨房里安装了一块大理石台面。

e.en: Wipe the {countertop} after you finish cooking.
e.zh: 做完饭后请擦一下台面。

e.en: Strong unions can {countervail} corporate power.
e.zh: 强大的工会能够抗衡企业的力量。

e.en: No single force could {countervail} the spreading panic.
e.zh: 没有任何一种力量能够抵消蔓延的恐慌。

e.en: There are {countervailing} arguments on both sides of this issue.
e.zh: 这个问题的双方都存在相互抗衡的论点。

e.en: The court applied a {countervailing} duty on imported steel.
e.zh: 法院对进口钢材征收了反补贴税。

e.en: The elevator uses a heavy {counterweight} to save energy.
e.zh: 电梯使用重型配重来节省能源。

e.en: Independent media act as a {counterweight} to political power.
e.zh: 独立媒体起到了制衡政治权力的作用。

e.en: The {countess} hosted a grand ball at her estate.
e.zh: 伯爵夫人在她的庄园举办了一场盛大的舞会。

e.en: She married a duke and became a {countess}.
e.zh: 她嫁给了一位公爵,成为了伯爵夫人。

e.en: Several rural {counties} reported record snowfall this winter.
e.zh: 几个乡村县今年冬天报告了创纪录的降雪量。

e.en: The new law affects all {counties} in the state.
e.zh: 新法律影响该州所有的县。

counting.t:
v. 计数；数数
n. 计算

e.en: My daughter is {counting} the days until her birthday.
e.zh: 我女儿在数着距离生日还有多少天。

e.en: There are six people here, not {counting} the children.
e.zh: 这里有六个人,孩子还没算在内。

e.en: She received {countless} messages of support after the news.
e.zh: 消息传出后,她收到了无数的支持信息。

e.en: I've watched that movie {countless} times.
e.zh: 那部电影我已经看过无数次了。

e.en: She has visited over thirty {countries} for work.
e.zh: 她因工作走访过三十多个国家。

e.en: Many {countries} signed the climate agreement last year.
e.zh: 许多国家去年签署了气候协议。

countrified.t: adj. 乡土气的；乡村风的

e.en: The cafe has a charming, {countrified} feel inside.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆内部有一种迷人的乡村气息。

e.en: He wore a {countrified} outfit with denim and boots.
e.zh: 他穿着一身带牛仔布和靴子的乡村风装扮。

country.t:
n. 国家
n. 乡村；乡下

e.en: Japan is a fascinating {country} to visit in spring.
e.zh: 日本是个春天值得一游的迷人国家。

e.en: We left the city to live in the {country}.
e.zh: 我们离开城市,搬到乡下居住。

e.en: He met a fellow {countryman} during his trip to Brazil.
e.zh: 他在巴西旅行时遇到了一位同胞。

e.en: The {countryman} sold fresh eggs at the village market.
e.zh: 那位乡下人在村集市上卖新鲜鸡蛋。

e.en: The president addressed his {countrymen} on national television.
e.zh: 总统在国家电视台向他的同胞发表讲话。

e.en: She felt proud cheering on her {countrymen} at the Olympics.
e.zh: 在奥运会上为同胞加油让她感到自豪。

e.en: We rented a small cottage in the English {countryside}.
e.zh: 我们在英国乡下租了一间小屋。

e.en: The {countryside} looks beautiful in autumn.
e.zh: 乡村在秋天显得格外美丽。

e.en: The painter captured the {countrysides} of France and Italy.
e.zh: 这位画家描绘了法国和意大利的乡村景色。

e.en: Different {countrysides} across Asia have unique farming traditions.
e.zh: 亚洲各地的乡村有着独特的耕作传统。

countrywide.t:
adj. 全国性的
adv. 遍及全国

e.en: The bank has {countrywide} branches in every major city.
e.zh: 该银行在每个主要城市都有遍及全国的分行。

e.en: A {countrywide} strike paralyzed public transportation.
e.zh: 一场全国性的罢工使公共交通陷入瘫痪。

e.en: She greeted her {countrywoman} warmly at the airport.
e.zh: 她在机场热情地迎接她的女同胞。

e.en: The {countrywoman} brought homemade jam to the village fair.
e.zh: 那位乡下女子带着自制果酱来到村庄集市。

counts.t:
v. 数数；有价值（第三人称单数）
n. 计数（复数）

e.en: Every vote {counts} in a close election.
e.zh: 在势均力敌的选举中,每一票都至关重要。

e.en: He faces three {counts} of fraud in court.
e.zh: 他在法庭上面临三项欺诈指控。

e.en: Orange {county} has some of California's best beaches.
e.zh: 奥兰治县拥有加州一些最好的海滩。

e.en: The {county} fair attracts thousands of visitors every summer.
e.zh: 县集市每年夏天吸引数千名游客。

e.en: Schools across the {countywide} district will close on Friday.
e.zh: 全县学区的学校将于周五停课。

e.en: A {countywide} ban on plastic bags takes effect next month.
e.zh: 全县范围内的塑料袋禁令将于下月生效。

coup.t:
n. 政变
n. 妙举；成功之作

e.en: The military staged a {coup} and seized power overnight.
e.zh: 军方发动政变,一夜之间夺取了权力。

e.en: Landing that interview was a real {coup} for the journalist.
e.zh: 拿到那次采访对这位记者来说是一次真正的成功。

e.en: He drives a sleek black {coupe} to work daily.
e.zh: 他每天开一辆流线型黑色双门轿跑车上班。

e.en: The new {coupe} model sold out within a week.
e.zh: 这款新双门轿跑车一周内就售罄了。

coupla.t: n. 几个（a couple of 的口语缩写）

e.en: I'll grab a {coupla} beers from the fridge.
e.zh: 我从冰箱里拿几瓶啤酒来。

e.en: Give me a {coupla} minutes to finish this.
e.zh: 给我几分钟把这个做完。

couple.t:
n. 一对；几个
v. 连接；结合

e.en: The young {couple} just bought their first apartment.
e.zh: 这对年轻夫妇刚买下他们的第一套公寓。

e.en: I'll be back in a {couple} of hours.
e.zh: 我过几个小时就回来。

coupled.t:
adj. 成对的；耦合的
v. 连接（过去式）

e.en: Heavy rain {coupled} with strong winds canceled the flight.
e.zh: 大雨加上强风导致航班取消。

e.en: The two carriages are {coupled} together at the station.
e.zh: 两节车厢在车站连接在一起。

e.en: The train {coupler} broke during the long journey.
e.zh: 火车的连接器在长途行驶中坏了。

e.en: Engineers replaced the faulty {coupler} between the cars.
e.zh: 工程师更换了车厢之间故障的连接器。

couples.t:
n. 情侣（复数）
v. 连接（第三人称单数）

e.en: Several {couples} were dancing under the colorful lights.
e.zh: 几对情侣在彩灯下跳舞。

e.en: The resort offers special packages for {couples}.
e.zh: 度假村为情侣提供特别套餐。

e.en: Shakespeare often ends his sonnets with a rhyming {couplet}.
e.zh: 莎士比亚常以押韵对句结束他的十四行诗。

e.en: She wrote a clever {couplet} for the greeting card.
e.zh: 她为贺卡写了一段巧妙的对句。

coupling.t:
n. 联轴器；耦合
v. 连接

e.en: The {coupling} between the engine and gearbox failed.
e.zh: 发动机与变速箱之间的联轴器出现故障。

e.en: Tight {coupling} between modules makes the code hard to maintain.
e.zh: 模块之间的紧耦合让代码难以维护。

e.en: I used a {coupon} to get 20% off groceries.
e.zh: 我用优惠券买杂货省了百分之二十。

e.en: Clip this {coupon} before heading to the store.
e.zh: 去商店前先把这张优惠券剪下来。

e.en: The country has suffered several military {coups} this decade.
e.zh: 这个国家在这十年里经历了几次军事政变。

e.en: Landing that client was one of her biggest {coups}.
e.zh: 拿下那个客户是她最成功的几次壮举之一。

e.en: It takes real {courage} to admit when you're wrong.
e.zh: 承认自己错了需要真正的勇气。

e.en: She showed great {courage} during the rescue operation.
e.zh: 她在救援行动中表现出极大的勇气。

e.en: The {courageous} firefighter rushed into the burning building.
e.zh: 那位勇敢的消防员冲进了着火的大楼。

e.en: Speaking up against the boss was a {courageous} move.
e.zh: 敢于对老板提出异议是一个勇敢的举动。

e.en: She {courageously} shared her story with the audience.
e.zh: 她勇敢地向观众分享了自己的故事。

e.en: The soldiers fought {courageously} to defend the village.
e.zh: 士兵们英勇地战斗以保卫村庄。

e.en: I sliced a {courgette} for the pasta sauce.
e.zh: 我切了一根西葫芦放进意面酱里。

e.en: Grilled {courgette} pairs nicely with lemon and olive oil.
e.zh: 烤西葫芦配柠檬和橄榄油非常搭。

e.en: The garden produced dozens of {courgettes} this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天菜园里收获了几十根西葫芦。

e.en: She stuffed the {courgettes} with rice and herbs.
e.zh: 她在西葫芦里塞满了米饭和香草。

e.en: The {councillors} voted unanimously to raise the budget.
e.zh: 议员们一致投票通过了增加预算的决议。

e.en: Several {councillors} attended the community town hall meeting.
e.zh: 几位议员出席了社区的市民大会。

e.en: The {councilman} held a town hall to hear residents' concerns.
e.zh: 那位市议员召开了市政厅会议听取居民的意见。

e.en: A veteran {councilman} announced his retirement after twenty years.
e.zh: 一位资深市议员在任职二十年后宣布退休。

e.en: The school {councilor} helped students plan their college applications.
e.zh: 学校顾问帮助学生规划大学申请。

e.en: Each {councilor} serves a four-year term in office.
e.zh: 每位议员任期四年。

e.en: Many city {councils} are debating new housing regulations.
e.zh: 许多市议会正在讨论新的住房法规。

e.en: Tribal {councils} have governed these communities for centuries.
e.zh: 部落议会管理这些社区已有几个世纪之久。

e.en: The {councilwoman} pushed hard for better public transit.
e.zh: 那位女议员大力推动改善公共交通。

e.en: A new {councilwoman} was sworn in this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上一位新女议员宣誓就职。

counsel.t:
n. 忠告；法律顾问
v. 提供建议

e.en: The lawyer offered wise {counsel} to her young client.
e.zh: 那位律师给年轻的当事人提供了明智的建议。

e.en: Parents often {counsel} their children about money matters.
e.zh: 父母常常就金钱问题给孩子提供建议。

e.en: She started {counseling} after going through a difficult breakup.
e.zh: 她在经历痛苦的分手后开始接受心理辅导。

e.en: The university offers free {counseling} services to all students.
e.zh: 这所大学为所有学生提供免费的心理咨询服务。

e.en: The clinic logs all individual {counselings} in a secure database.
e.zh: 诊所将所有个别咨询记录在安全的数据库中。

e.en: Multiple {counselings} are sometimes needed before progress shows.
e.zh: 有时需要多次心理辅导才能看到进展。

e.en: Many couples try {counselling} before deciding to separate.
e.zh: 许多夫妇在决定分开前会先尝试咨询辅导。

e.en: Grief {counselling} helped her cope with her loss.
e.zh: 丧亲辅导帮助她度过了失去亲人的痛苦。

e.en: The therapist scheduled weekly {counsellings} for the family.
e.zh: 治疗师为这个家庭安排了每周的咨询辅导。

e.en: Several {counsellings} were needed to address the deeper issues.
e.zh: 需要进行多次咨询辅导才能处理更深层的问题。

e.en: The school {counsellor} listened patiently to her worries.
e.zh: 学校的辅导员耐心地听她诉说烦恼。

e.en: He trained for years to become a licensed {counsellor}.
e.zh: 他经过多年培训才成为持证辅导员。

e.en: Trained {counsellors} are available around the clock at the hotline.
e.zh: 热线服务全天都有受过培训的辅导员值班。

e.en: The summer camp hired ten {counsellors} for the new season.
e.zh: 夏令营为新一季招聘了十名辅导员。

e.en: Her guidance {counselor} helped her choose the right college.
e.zh: 她的升学辅导员帮她选到了合适的大学。

e.en: The camp {counselor} organized games for the kids.
e.zh: 营地辅导员为孩子们组织了游戏。

counsels.t:
n. 建议
v. 劝告（第三人称单数）

e.en: The mentor {counsels} young entrepreneurs every Friday afternoon.
e.zh: 那位导师每周五下午都会为年轻创业者提供建议。

e.en: His grandfather's {counsels} still guide him today.
e.zh: 祖父的教诲至今仍指引着他。

count.t:
v. 数；计算
n. 总数；伯爵

e.en: Please {count} the chairs before the guests arrive.
e.zh: 请在客人到来之前数一下椅子的数量。

e.en: Every vote will {count} in this close election.
e.zh: 在这场势均力敌的选举中每一票都很重要。

e.en: "Apple" is a {countable} noun in English grammar.
e.zh: 在英语语法中，apple 是可数名词。

e.en: The set of natural numbers is infinite but {countable}.
e.zh: 自然数集合是无限的但仍是可数的。

e.en: The {countdown} to the rocket launch began at midnight.
e.zh: 火箭发射的倒计时从午夜开始。

e.en: Everyone cheered as the New Year {countdown} reached zero.
e.zh: 新年倒计时归零时大家欢呼起来。

e.en: She {counted} the cash twice before locking the drawer.
e.zh: 她数了两遍现金才锁上抽屉。

e.en: Every donation, no matter how small, {counted} toward the goal.
e.zh: 每一笔捐款无论多小都为目标贡献了一份力。

countenance.t:
n. 面容；神色
v. 容许

e.en: His calm {countenance} hid the anxiety he was feeling.
e.zh: 他平静的面容掩饰了内心的焦虑。

e.en: The committee refused to {countenance} any further delays.
e.zh: 委员会拒绝容忍任何进一步的拖延。

counter.t:
n. 柜台；计数器
v. 反驳

e.en: Please pay at the {counter} near the entrance.
e.zh: 请在入口附近的柜台付款。

e.en: The new policy runs {counter} to public expectations.
e.zh: 新政策与公众的期望背道而驰。

e.en: Exercise can help {counteract} the effects of a sedentary job.
e.zh: 运动有助于抵消久坐工作带来的影响。

e.en: The medicine is designed to {counteract} severe allergic reactions.
e.zh: 这种药物旨在对抗严重的过敏反应。

e.en: The board took swift {counteraction} against the hostile takeover.
e.zh: 董事会对敌意收购迅速采取了反制行动。

e.en: Every chemical reaction has a corresponding {counteraction}.
e.zh: 每个化学反应都有相应的反作用。

e.en: She prepared a strong {counterargument} for the debate tomorrow.
e.zh: 她为明天的辩论准备了一个有力的反驳论点。

e.en: His {counterargument} convinced most of the skeptical audience.
e.zh: 他的反驳论点说服了大多数持怀疑态度的听众。

e.en: The team launched a swift {counterattack} in the second half.
e.zh: 球队在下半场发起了迅速的反击。

e.en: The general planned a surprise {counterattack} at dawn.
e.zh: 将军计划在黎明时分发动一次出其不意的反击。

counterbalance.t:
v. 抵消
n. 制衡力

e.en: Heavy weights {counterbalance} the elevator as it moves.
e.zh: 重物在电梯运行时起到平衡作用。

e.en: Her optimism is a perfect {counterbalance} to his caution.
e.zh: 她的乐观恰好与他的谨慎形成完美的平衡。

e.en: The risks were {counterbalanced} by enormous potential rewards.
e.zh: 巨大的潜在回报抵消了这些风险。

e.en: His harsh words were {counterbalanced} by genuine kindness.
e.zh: 他刻薄的话语被发自内心的善意所平衡。

e.en: The bridge uses {counterbalancing} weights to stay stable.
e.zh: 这座桥使用配重来保持稳定。

e.en: Strong tea has a {counterbalancing} effect on greasy food.
e.zh: 浓茶对油腻食物有解腻平衡的作用。

e.en: The defendant filed a {counterclaim} against the plaintiff.
e.zh: 被告对原告提出了反诉。

e.en: Her {counterclaim} sought damages for the broken contract.
e.zh: 她的反诉要求为违约赔偿损失。

e.en: Turn the lid {counterclockwise} to open the jar.
e.zh: 逆时针转动盖子就能打开罐子。

e.en: The dancers moved {counterclockwise} around the circle.
e.zh: 舞者们绕着圆圈逆时针移动。

e.en: The 1960s saw many {countercultural} movements rise in America.
e.zh: 上世纪六十年代美国兴起了许多反主流文化运动。

e.en: Their music had a strong {countercultural} message.
e.zh: 他们的音乐传递着强烈的反主流文化信息。

e.en: Hippies were a defining {counterculture} of the late 1960s.
e.zh: 嬉皮士是六十年代末标志性的反主流文化群体。

e.en: The {counterculture} rejected mainstream consumer values.
e.zh: 这种反主流文化拒绝主流的消费观念。

e.en: She {countered} his argument with surprisingly strong evidence.
e.zh: 她用出人意料的有力证据反驳了他的论点。

e.en: The boxer quickly {countered} with a sharp left hook.
e.zh: 拳击手迅速用一记凌厉的左勾拳还击。

counterfactual.t:
adj. 与事实相反的
n. 反事实假设

e.en: Historians often discuss {counterfactual} scenarios about World War II.
e.zh: 历史学家经常讨论关于二战的反事实假设。

e.en: The study used a {counterfactual} model to estimate impact.
e.zh: 该研究使用反事实模型来估算影响。

counterfeit.t:
adj. 伪造的
v. 仿造

e.en: Police seized a large stash of {counterfeit} hundred-dollar bills.
e.zh: 警方查获了大量假冒的百元美钞。

e.en: This handbag is a {counterfeit} of a famous designer brand.
e.zh: 这个手提包是某著名设计师品牌的仿冒品。

e.en: The {counterfeiter} was arrested after years on the run.
e.zh: 那名造假者在逃亡多年后终于被捕。

e.en: A skilled {counterfeiter} can fool even careful inspectors.
e.zh: 技艺高超的造假者甚至能骗过仔细的检查员。

counterfeiting.t:
n. 伪造
v. 仿造（现在分词）

e.en: Police arrested two men for {counterfeiting} hundred-dollar bills.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了两名伪造百元钞票的男子。

e.en: New security features make {counterfeiting} passports much harder.
e.zh: 新的安全特征使得伪造护照变得更加困难。

e.en: Keep the {counterfoil} as proof of your payment.
e.zh: 请保留存根作为付款凭证。

e.en: She tore off the ticket and handed me the {counterfoil}.
e.zh: 她撕下票根,把存根递给了我。

counterforce.t: n. 反作用力；反抗力量

e.en: Friction acts as a {counterforce} against the moving object.
e.zh: 摩擦力对运动的物体起反作用力的作用。

e.en: The protest emerged as a {counterforce} to government policy.
e.zh: 这场抗议作为政府政策的反向力量出现。

countering.t: v. 反驳；抵制（现在分词）

e.en: The lawyer is {countering} every argument with solid evidence.
e.zh: 律师正用确凿的证据反驳每一个论点。

e.en: The team focused on {countering} cyber threats from abroad.
e.zh: 团队专注于应对来自境外的网络威胁。

e.en: The army adopted new {counterinsurgency} tactics in the region.
e.zh: 军队在该地区采取了新的反叛乱战术。

e.en: He wrote a book on modern {counterinsurgency} strategy.
e.zh: 他写了一本关于现代反叛乱战略的书。

e.en: She works in {counterintelligence} for a federal agency.
e.zh: 她在一个联邦机构从事反情报工作。

e.en: The {counterintelligence} unit uncovered a foreign spy ring.
e.zh: 反情报部门破获了一个外国间谍网。

e.en: It seems {counterintuitive}, but eating fat can help you lose weight.
e.zh: 这看似违反直觉,但吃脂肪反而能帮助减肥。

e.en: The app's design is {counterintuitive} for first-time users.
e.zh: 这款应用的设计对新用户来说违反直觉。

e.en: The {counterman} took my order and poured a coffee.
e.zh: 柜台服务员接了我的单,倒了一杯咖啡。

e.en: Ask the {counterman} if they have fresh bagels today.
e.zh: 问问柜台店员今天有没有新鲜的贝果。

e.en: The general had to {countermand} his earlier order to attack.
e.zh: 将军不得不撤销他先前的进攻命令。

e.en: Only the CEO can {countermand} a decision from this committee.
e.zh: 只有首席执行官能撤销这个委员会的决定。

e.en: Two-factor login is a simple {countermeasure} against hackers.
e.zh: 双重验证登录是防范黑客的简单对策。

e.en: The pilot deployed a {countermeasure} to confuse the missile.
e.zh: 飞行员释放了干扰装置以迷惑导弹。

e.en: Her {countermove} on the chessboard surprised everyone.
e.zh: 她在棋盘上的反制一招让所有人都吃惊。

e.en: The company's price cut was a {countermove} to its rival.
e.zh: 该公司降价是对竞争对手的反制行动。

e.en: They rejected my bid and sent a {counteroffer} the next day.
e.zh: 他们拒绝了我的出价,第二天发来一个还价。

e.en: My current employer made a {counteroffer} to keep me.
e.zh: 我现在的雇主提出了一个还价想留住我。

e.en: Grandmother spread a quilted {counterpane} over the bed.
e.zh: 奶奶在床上铺了一条绗缝的床罩。

e.en: The hotel's silk {counterpane} added a touch of luxury.
e.zh: 酒店的丝绸床罩增添了一份奢华感。

e.en: The minister met her French {counterpart} in Paris.
e.zh: 该部长在巴黎会见了她的法国同级官员。

e.en: This software has no real {counterpart} on Windows.
e.zh: 这款软件在Windows上没有真正的对应版本。

e.en: American CEOs earn far more than their European {counterparts}.
e.zh: 美国首席执行官的收入远高于他们的欧洲同行。

e.en: Female athletes often train as hard as their male {counterparts}.
e.zh: 女运动员的训练往往和男性同行一样刻苦。

courier.t:
n. 快递员；信使
n. 快递公司

e.en: A {courier} delivered the package this morning.
e.zh: 今早一名快递员送来了包裹。

e.en: Please send the documents by overnight {courier}.
e.zh: 请用隔日送达的快递寄出这些文件。

course.t:
n. 课程；路线
n. (一道) 菜

e.en: I'm taking an online {course} on machine learning.
e.zh: 我正在上一门机器学习的在线课程。

e.en: The ship changed its {course} to avoid the storm.
e.zh: 船只改变航向以避开风暴。

e.en: Open your {coursebook} to page forty-five, please.
e.zh: 请把课本翻到第四十五页。

e.en: The new {coursebook} includes interactive online exercises.
e.zh: 新教科书附带互动在线练习。

e.en: The university offers free online {courses} for everyone.
e.zh: 这所大学为所有人提供免费在线课程。

e.en: Dinner included three delicious {courses} and dessert.
e.zh: 晚餐包括三道美味的菜和甜点。

e.en: The teacher uploaded new {courseware} to the platform.
e.zh: 老师把新的课件上传到了平台上。

e.en: Modern {courseware} often includes videos and quizzes.
e.zh: 现代课件通常包含视频和测验。

e.en: Half the grade is based on {coursework}, half on exams.
e.zh: 成绩一半来自平时作业,一半来自考试。

e.en: She fell behind on her {coursework} after the illness.
e.zh: 她病后学业作业进度落后了。

coursing.t:
n. 追猎
v. 奔流；追逐

e.en: Adrenaline was {coursing} through her veins before the race.
e.zh: 比赛前肾上腺素在她血管里奔涌。

e.en: Tears were {coursing} down his cheeks at the news.
e.zh: 听到消息后泪水沿着他的脸颊流下。

court.t:
n. 法庭；球场
v. 追求；求爱

e.en: The case will be heard in {court} next Monday.
e.zh: 该案件将于下周一在法庭审理。

e.en: They reserved a tennis {court} for Saturday morning.
e.zh: 他们预订了周六上午的网球场。

courtauld.t: n. 考陶德（人名/学院名）

e.en: We visited the {Courtauld} Gallery to see the Impressionists.
e.zh: 我们参观了考陶尔德美术馆去看印象派画作。

e.en: She studied art history at the {Courtauld} Institute.
e.zh: 她在考陶尔德学院学习艺术史。

e.en: The hotel staff were friendly and {courteous} throughout our stay.
e.zh: 酒店员工在我们入住期间始终友善而有礼。

e.en: Please write a {courteous} reply to the customer.
e.zh: 请给那位客户写一封礼貌的回复。

e.en: He {courteously} held the door open for the elderly woman.
e.zh: 他礼貌地为那位老太太把门拉开。

e.en: The receptionist {courteously} answered every question.
e.zh: 前台礼貌地回答了每一个问题。

e.en: The novel features a famous {courtesan} of the Renaissance.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位著名的文艺复兴时期名妓。

e.en: She played a witty {courtesan} in the period drama.
e.zh: 她在这部古装剧中饰演一位机智的名妓。

e.en: They exchanged the usual {courtesies} before the meeting began.
e.zh: 会议开始前他们寒暄了几句。

e.en: Diplomatic {courtesies} were observed throughout the state visit.
e.zh: 整个国事访问期间都遵守了外交礼节。

courtesy.t:
n. 礼貌；客套
adj. 免费赠送的

e.en: Please have the {courtesy} to reply to the email.
e.zh: 请有礼貌地回复那封邮件。

e.en: The hotel offers a {courtesy} shuttle to the airport.
e.zh: 酒店提供免费往返机场的班车。

e.en: Reporters gathered outside the {courthouse} waiting for the verdict.
e.zh: 记者们聚集在法院外等待判决。

e.en: They got married at the local {courthouse} last week.
e.zh: 他们上周在当地法院登记结婚了。

e.en: The king's favorite {courtier} fell out of favor quickly.
e.zh: 国王最宠爱的廷臣很快失宠了。

e.en: He was a clever {courtier} skilled at palace politics.
e.zh: 他是一位精于宫廷政治的聪明廷臣。

courting.t:
v. 求爱；追求
v. 招致（麻烦）

e.en: The startup is {courting} investors for its next funding round.
e.zh: 这家创业公司正在为下一轮融资争取投资者。

e.en: He spent months {courting} her before proposing.
e.zh: 他追求了她好几个月才求婚。

e.en: His old-fashioned {courtliness} charmed everyone at the dinner.
e.zh: 他那种老派的风度迷倒了晚宴上的所有人。

e.en: She admired the {courtliness} of his manners.
e.zh: 她欣赏他举止中的彬彬有礼。

courtly.t: adj. 优雅的；谦恭有礼的

e.en: He greeted the guests with a {courtly} bow.
e.zh: 他以一种宫廷式的鞠躬迎接客人。

e.en: Her {courtly} manners seemed out of place at the casual party.
e.zh: 她那彬彬有礼的举止在随意的聚会上显得格格不入。

e.en: The {courtroom} fell silent as the judge entered.
e.zh: 法官走进时法庭里一片寂静。

e.en: The lawyer's argument echoed through the packed {courtroom}.
e.zh: 律师的陈词在挤满人的法庭里回荡。

e.en: Federal {courts} ruled in favor of the plaintiff.
e.zh: 联邦法院作出了有利于原告的裁决。

e.en: The park has six tennis {courts} open to the public.
e.zh: 公园里有六个对外开放的网球场。

e.en: Their {courtship} lasted only three months before the wedding.
e.zh: 他们的恋爱期只持续了三个月就结婚了。

e.en: Peacocks display elaborate feathers during {courtship}.
e.zh: 孔雀在求偶时会展开华丽的羽毛。

e.en: The old inn had a small cobblestone {courty} out back.
e.zh: 那家老客栈后面有一个铺着鹅卵石的小庭院。

e.en: Children played football in the {courty} after school.
e.zh: 放学后孩子们在小院子里踢足球。

e.en: We had coffee in the sunny {courtyard} of the cafe.
e.zh: 我们在咖啡馆阳光明媚的庭院里喝咖啡。

e.en: The hotel features a beautiful {courtyard} with a fountain.
e.zh: 酒店有一个带喷泉的美丽庭院。

couscous.t: n. 蒸粗麦粉；北非小米饭

e.en: I made {couscous} with roasted vegetables for dinner.
e.zh: 我做了北非小米配烤蔬菜当晚餐。

e.en: {Couscous} is a staple in many North African dishes.
e.zh: 北非小米是许多北非菜肴的主食。

e.en: My {cousin} is visiting from Australia next month.
e.zh: 我表妹下个月要从澳大利亚来玩。

e.en: He grew up playing with his {cousin} every summer.
e.zh: 他每年夏天都和表哥一起玩长大。

cousins.t: n. 堂（表）兄弟姐妹（复数）

e.en: All my {cousins} gathered for the family reunion.
e.zh: 我所有的表兄弟姐妹都来参加家庭聚会了。

e.en: The {cousins} look almost like twins in old photos.
e.zh: 老照片里这对表兄弟看起来几乎像双胞胎。

coutts.t: n. 顾资（英国银行/人名）

e.en: The royal family has banked with {Coutts} for centuries.
e.zh: 王室几个世纪以来一直在库茨银行存款。

e.en: She opened a private account at {Coutts} in London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦的库茨银行开了一个私人账户。

couture.t: n. 高级定制服装；时装设计

e.en: Paris is the global capital of haute {couture}.
e.zh: 巴黎是全球高级定制时装的中心。

e.en: She wore a stunning {couture} gown to the gala.
e.zh: 她身穿一件惊艳的高级定制礼服出席晚宴。

e.en: The famous {couturier} unveiled his spring collection in Paris.
e.zh: 那位著名的高级时装设计师在巴黎发布了春季系列。

e.en: She apprenticed under a renowned Italian {couturier}.
e.zh: 她曾师从一位著名的意大利高级时装设计师。

e.en: Water molecules are held together by {covalent} bonds.
e.zh: 水分子通过共价键结合在一起。

e.en: The textbook explains how {covalent} bonding works.
e.zh: 教科书解释了共价键的工作原理。

e.en: The two atoms are {covalently} bonded in the molecule.
e.zh: 这两个原子在分子中以共价方式结合。

e.en: Carbon atoms can {covalently} link to form long chains.
e.zh: 碳原子可以通过共价键连接形成长链。

e.en: The analyst calculated the {covariance} between the two stocks.
e.zh: 分析师计算了这两只股票之间的协方差。

e.en: A positive {covariance} suggests the variables move together.
e.zh: 正协方差表明这两个变量同向变化。

e.en: Age was included as a {covariate} in the regression model.
e.zh: 年龄作为协变量被纳入回归模型。

e.en: Researchers controlled for income as a key {covariate}.
e.zh: 研究人员将收入作为关键协变量进行了控制。

e.en: The study examined the {covariation} of stress and sleep quality.
e.zh: 该研究考察了压力与睡眠质量的协同变化。

e.en: Strong {covariation} doesn't necessarily imply causation.
e.zh: 强协同变化并不一定意味着因果关系。

e.en: We anchored the boat in a quiet {cove} overnight.
e.zh: 我们把船停泊在一个安静的小海湾过夜。

e.en: The hidden {cove} became our favorite swimming spot.
e.zh: 那个隐秘的小海湾成了我们最爱的游泳地点。

e.en: The novel features a {coven} of witches in Salem.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述塞勒姆的一个女巫团。

e.en: A secret {coven} gathered in the forest at midnight.
e.zh: 一个秘密女巫团在午夜聚集于森林中。

covenant.t:
n. 契约；盟约
v. 立约

e.en: The two nations signed a {covenant} of mutual defense.
e.zh: 两国签订了一份共同防御的盟约。

e.en: Our neighborhood {covenant} prohibits painting houses bright colors.
e.zh: 我们小区的契约禁止将房屋漆成鲜艳颜色。

e.en: The church emphasizes a {covenantal} relationship with God.
e.zh: 该教会强调与神之间的圣约关系。

e.en: Their marriage was framed in {covenantal} terms.
e.zh: 他们的婚姻是以圣约的方式来定义的。

covent.t: n. 柯芬（如 Covent Garden 伦敦地名）

e.en: We watched a street performer at {Covent} Garden.
e.zh: 我们在科文特花园看了一位街头艺人表演。

e.en: The opera house near {Covent} Garden draws huge crowds.
e.zh: 科文特花园附近的歌剧院吸引大批观众。

e.en: They sent him to {Coventry} after the betrayal.
e.zh: 出卖之后,大家都不再理他了。

e.en: {Coventry} Cathedral was rebuilt after wartime bombing.
e.zh: 考文垂大教堂在战时轰炸后重建。

cover.t:
v. 覆盖；涵盖；报道
n. 封面；掩护

e.en: Please {cover} the pot while the soup simmers.
e.zh: 汤煨着的时候请把锅盖上。

e.en: The magazine {cover} featured a famous athlete.
e.zh: 杂志封面登的是一位著名运动员。

coverage.t: n. 覆盖范围；报道；保险范围

e.en: My phone has no {coverage} in the mountains.
e.zh: 我的手机在山里没有信号。

e.en: The insurance plan offers excellent dental {coverage}.
e.zh: 这份保险计划提供很棒的牙科保障。

coverages.t: n. 覆盖范围；保险项目（复数）

e.en: Compare the {coverages} before choosing a health plan.
e.zh: 在选择健康保险前先比较各项保障范围。

e.en: Different {coverages} apply to flood and fire damage.
e.zh: 洪水和火灾损害适用不同的保险范围。

e.en: The mechanic wore a grease-stained {coverall} all day.
e.zh: 机械师整天穿着一件沾满油污的连体工装。

e.en: Each painter received a clean white {coverall}.
e.zh: 每位油漆工都领到一件干净的白色连体服。

e.en: Farm workers slipped on {coveralls} before spraying pesticide.
e.zh: 农场工人在喷洒农药前穿上连体工装裤。

e.en: His {coveralls} were splattered with paint after the job.
e.zh: 干完活后他的连体工装上溅满了油漆。

covered.t:
adj. 被覆盖的
v. cover 的过去式

e.en: The hills were {covered} in fresh snow this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上山丘被新雪覆盖。

e.en: Don't worry, the warranty has you {covered}.
e.zh: 别担心,这个保修能为你提供保障。

covering.t:
n. 覆盖物
v. 覆盖（进行时）

e.en: A thin {covering} of dust lay on the books.
e.zh: 书上覆着一层薄薄的灰尘。

e.en: Reporters are {covering} the election from every angle.
e.zh: 记者们正从各个角度报道这次选举。

e.en: She smoothed the embroidered {coverlet} on the bed.
e.zh: 她把绣花床罩在床上铺平。

e.en: Grandma's quilted {coverlet} kept us warm all winter.
e.zh: 奶奶的拼布床罩让我们整个冬天都很暖和。

covers.t:
v. 覆盖（第三人称单数）
n. 封面；被褥

e.en: This insurance policy {covers} damage from earthquakes.
e.zh: 这份保险涵盖地震造成的损失。

e.en: The band plays great {covers} of classic rock songs.
e.zh: 这支乐队翻唱的经典摇滚歌曲很棒。

e.en: The agency ran a {covert} operation overseas.
e.zh: 该机构在海外执行了一次秘密行动。

e.en: His {covert} glance at her did not go unnoticed.
e.zh: 他偷偷瞥她的一眼并没有被忽视。

e.en: She {covertly} recorded the meeting on her phone.
e.zh: 她用手机偷偷地录下了会议内容。

e.en: The journalist {covertly} entered the restricted zone.
e.zh: 那名记者秘密地进入了限制区域。

e.en: Many young engineers {covet} a job at that startup.
e.zh: 许多年轻工程师都很向往那家初创公司的工作。

e.en: It's wrong to {covet} what isn't yours.
e.zh: 觊觎不属于自己的东西是不对的。

coveted.t: adj. 令人垂涎的；梦寐以求的

e.en: She finally won the {coveted} promotion last week.
e.zh: 上周她终于拿到了那份梦寐以求的晋升。

e.en: That sneaker is the most {coveted} release this year.
e.zh: 那款球鞋是今年最受追捧的发售款。

e.en: He cast a {covetous} look at his friend's new car.
e.zh: 他用贪婪的眼光打量着朋友的新车。

e.en: Her {covetous} nature strained many friendships over time.
e.zh: 她贪婪的本性久而久之让许多友谊变得紧张。

e.en: Religious texts often warn against {covetousness} and greed.
e.zh: 宗教典籍常常告诫人们不要贪婪和觊觎。

e.en: His {covetousness} for power eventually led to his downfall.
e.zh: 他对权力的贪欲最终导致了他的垮台。

e.en: A {covey} of quail burst from the underbrush.
e.zh: 一群鹌鹑从灌木丛中飞了出来。

e.en: A small {covey} of reporters waited outside the courtroom.
e.zh: 一小群记者在法庭外等候。

cow.t:
n. 母牛；奶牛
v. 恐吓

e.en: The {cow} grazed peacefully in the green pasture.
e.zh: 那头牛在青翠的牧场上悄悄地吃草。

e.en: Don't let the loud critics {cow} you into silence.
e.zh: 别让那些大声批评的人把你吓得不敢出声。

e.en: Only a {coward} would abandon friends in trouble.
e.zh: 只有懦夫才会在朋友有难时弃之不顾。

e.en: He called himself a {coward} for not speaking up.
e.zh: 他说自己是个懦夫,因为没有站出来发声。

e.en: The soldier was discharged for {cowardice} under fire.
e.zh: 那名士兵因临阵怯懦而被开除军籍。

e.en: Staying silent now would be pure {cowardice}.
e.zh: 此时保持沉默就是彻头彻尾的怯懦。

e.en: Running away was a {cowardly} thing to do.
e.zh: 逃跑是一种懦弱的行为。

e.en: The attack was condemned as a {cowardly} act of terror.
e.zh: 这次袭击被谴责为一次懦弱的恐怖行径。

e.en: History rarely remembers the {cowards} who stayed silent.
e.zh: 历史很少铭记那些选择沉默的懦夫们。

e.en: Bullies are often just {cowards} hiding behind threats.
e.zh: 恶霸往往只是躲在威胁背后的懦夫。

e.en: The drummer added a {cowbell} to the chorus.
e.zh: 鼓手在副歌部分加入了一段牛铃声。

e.en: You could hear a distant {cowbell} echoing across the valley.
e.zh: 远处的牛铃声在山谷中回荡。

e.en: A {cowbird} laid eggs in the warbler's nest.
e.zh: 一只牛鹂把蛋下在了莺鸟的巢里。

e.en: The {cowbird} is known for parasitizing other birds' nests.
e.zh: 牛鹂以寄生其他鸟巢而闻名。

e.en: The {cowboy} rounded up the cattle before sunset.
e.zh: 那位牛仔在日落前把牛群赶拢了。

e.en: Don't hire that {cowboy} contractor to fix your roof.
e.zh: 别请那个不靠谱的承包商来修你的屋顶。

cowed.t:
adj. 被吓倒的
v. cow 的过去式

e.en: The harsh manager {cowed} his team into silence.
e.zh: 那位严厉的经理把整个团队吓得不敢吭声。

e.en: She refused to be {cowed} by the threats.
e.zh: 她拒绝被那些威胁吓倒。

e.en: The puppy began to {cower} during the thunderstorm.
e.zh: 小狗在雷雨中开始瑟瑟发抖地畏缩。

e.en: Don't {cower} before bullies—stand your ground.
e.zh: 不要在恶霸面前退缩——要坚守立场。

e.en: The kitten was {cowering} under the parked car.
e.zh: 小猫正在停着的汽车下瑟瑟发抖地躲着。

e.en: The hostages sat {cowering} in the corner.
e.zh: 人质们蜷缩在角落里瑟瑟发抖。

e.en: The yacht race begins in {Cowes} every August.
e.zh: 帆船比赛每年八月在考斯举行。

e.en: {Cowes} Week is famous among sailing enthusiasts worldwide.
e.zh: 考斯帆船周在全球帆船爱好者中享有盛名。

e.en: The young {cowgirl} won first place in barrel racing.
e.zh: 那位年轻的牛仔女郎在绕桶赛中夺得第一。

e.en: She dressed as a {cowgirl} for the rodeo parade.
e.zh: 她打扮成牛仔女郎参加牛仔竞技游行。

e.en: The ranch hired another {cowhand} for the spring roundup.
e.zh: 牧场又雇了一名牧牛工来参与春季围拢。

e.en: Every {cowhand} on the ranch knew how to brand cattle.
e.zh: 牧场上的每个牧牛工都会给牛打烙印。

e.en: The boots were made from genuine {cowhide} leather.
e.zh: 那双靴子是用真正的牛皮制成的。

e.en: A worn {cowhide} rug covered the cabin floor.
e.zh: 小屋的地板上铺着一张磨旧的牛皮毯。

cowl.t:
n. 僧侣兜帽
n. 引擎罩

e.en: The monk pulled the {cowl} over his head.
e.zh: 修道士把头巾兜帽拉到头上。

e.en: The car's engine {cowl} needed a fresh coat of paint.
e.zh: 汽车的发动机罩需要重新喷一层漆。

e.en: A {cowled} figure walked silently down the corridor.
e.zh: 一个戴着兜帽的身影沿走廊静静地走着。

e.en: The {cowled} monks chanted softly in the chapel.
e.zh: 戴着风帽的修士们在小教堂里轻声吟唱。

e.en: Many tech companies have offices on {Cowley} Road.
e.zh: 许多科技公司在考利路上设有办公室。

e.en: The poet {Cowley} was admired in seventeenth-century England.
e.zh: 诗人考利在十七世纪的英格兰备受赞赏。

cowlick.t: n. 翘起的一绺头发；呆毛

e.en: His morning {cowlick} refused to lie flat all day.
e.zh: 他早上翘起的那撮呆毛一整天都压不下去。

e.en: She tried gel to tame her stubborn {cowlick}.
e.zh: 她用发胶来驯服那撮顽固的呆毛。

e.en: The mechanic removed the engine {cowling} for inspection.
e.zh: 机械师拆下发动机整流罩进行检查。

e.en: A bird had nested inside the aircraft's {cowling}.
e.zh: 一只鸟在飞机的整流罩内筑了巢。

e.en: My {coworker} brought donuts to the morning meeting.
e.zh: 我的同事给晨会带来了甜甜圈。

e.en: A friendly {coworker} helped me debug my code.
e.zh: 一位友善的同事帮我调试了代码。

e.en: Farmers plant {cowpea} to enrich the soil with nitrogen.
e.zh: 农民种植豇豆以增加土壤中的氮含量。

e.en: This stew uses {cowpea} as its main protein source.
e.zh: 这道炖菜以豇豆作为主要蛋白质来源。

e.en: {Cowper} wrote pastoral poems beloved in eighteenth-century England.
e.zh: 库柏写下的田园诗在十八世纪英格兰深受喜爱。

e.en: She studied {Cowper}'s hymns in her literature seminar.
e.zh: 她在文学研讨课上研究库柏的圣诗。

e.en: An old {cowpoke} told stories around the campfire.
e.zh: 一位上了年纪的牛仔在营火旁讲着故事。

e.en: Every {cowpoke} on the trail wore a wide-brimmed hat.
e.zh: 路上每个牛仔都戴着一顶宽边帽。

e.en: Jenner used {cowpox} to develop the first smallpox vaccine.
e.zh: 詹纳利用牛痘研制出了第一种天花疫苗。

e.en: Milkmaids who caught {cowpox} rarely contracted smallpox afterward.
e.zh: 得过牛痘的挤奶女工后来很少感染天花。

e.en: Ancient traders used the {cowrie} shell as currency.
e.zh: 古代商人曾用宝贝壳作为货币。

e.en: She wore a necklace strung with tiny {cowrie} shells.
e.zh: 她戴着一条串着小宝贝壳的项链。

e.en: A polished {cowry} sat on the museum display shelf.
e.zh: 一枚打磨光亮的宝贝贝壳摆在博物馆的展示架上。

e.en: The {cowry} once served as money across many cultures.
e.zh: 宝贝贝壳曾在许多文化中被当作货币使用。

cows.t:
n. 母牛（复数）
v. 恐吓

e.en: The {cows} grazed lazily under the afternoon sun.
e.zh: 奶牛们在午后阳光下慵懒地吃着草。

e.en: Dairy {cows} produce milk year-round on this farm.
e.zh: 这个农场的奶牛全年都在产奶。

e.en: The farmer milked the cows inside the old {cowshed}.
e.zh: 农夫在老牛棚里给奶牛挤奶。

e.en: Rain leaked through the roof of the wooden {cowshed}.
e.zh: 雨水从木牛棚的屋顶漏了进来。

cowslip.t: n. 黄花九轮草（一种野花）

e.en: A {cowslip} bloomed beside the garden path.
e.zh: 一朵黄花九轮草在花园小径旁绽放。

e.en: She picked a yellow {cowslip} from the meadow.
e.zh: 她从草地上摘了一朵黄色的报春花。

cox.t:
n. 舵手（赛艇）
v. 当舵手

e.en: The {cox} shouted instructions to the rowing team.
e.zh: 舵手向划艇队员大声喊出指令。

e.en: She trained as a {cox} for the university crew.
e.zh: 她在大学船队接受舵手训练。

e.en: The {coxswain} steered the boat through choppy waves.
e.zh: 舵手操控小船穿过波涛汹涌的水面。

e.en: Their {coxswain} called the stroke rate clearly.
e.zh: 他们的舵手清晰地报出划桨节奏。

coy.t: adj. 故作羞涩的；忸怩的

e.en: She gave a {coy} smile when asked about her date.
e.zh: 被问起约会时,她羞涩地笑了笑。

e.en: The CEO was {coy} about future product plans.
e.zh: 首席执行官对未来产品计划讳莫如深。

e.en: She {coyly} avoided answering the reporter's question.
e.zh: 她含蓄地回避了记者的问题。

e.en: He {coyly} hinted at a surprise gift in his bag.
e.zh: 他羞答答地暗示包里有一份惊喜礼物。

e.en: Her {coyness} about the promotion fooled no one.
e.zh: 她对升职一事的扭捏掩饰不了任何人。

e.en: There was a charming {coyness} in his reply.
e.zh: 他的回答中带着一种迷人的羞涩。

e.en: A {coyote} howled in the desert just after sunset.
e.zh: 日落后不久,一只郊狼在沙漠里嚎叫。

e.en: Hikers spotted a lone {coyote} near the trail.
e.zh: 徒步者在小径附近发现了一只独行的郊狼。

e.en: Scammers try to {cozen} the elderly out of their savings.
e.zh: 骗子企图骗走老年人的积蓄。

e.en: He tried to {cozen} her into signing the contract.
e.zh: 他试图哄骗她签下那份合同。

cozens.t: v. 哄骗（cozen 的第三人称单数）

e.en: That salesman {cozens} customers with empty promises.
e.zh: 那个推销员用空洞的承诺欺骗顾客。

e.en: She {cozens} her little brother into doing her chores.
e.zh: 她哄骗弟弟替她做家务。

e.en: The cat curled up {cozily} on the warm blanket.
e.zh: 猫舒舒服服地蜷缩在温暖的毯子上。

e.en: They sat {cozily} by the fire reading books.
e.zh: 他们惬意地坐在炉火旁看书。

e.en: I love the {coziness} of this little café in winter.
e.zh: 我喜欢冬天这家小咖啡馆的温馨氛围。

e.en: Soft lighting added to the room's {coziness}.
e.zh: 柔和的灯光更增添了房间的温馨感。

e.en: The inn offered different {cozinesses} in each themed room.
e.zh: 这家旅馆每间主题房都营造出不同的温馨感。

e.en: Travel writers compared the {cozinesses} of mountain lodges.
e.zh: 旅行作家比较了各家山间小屋的舒适氛围。

e.en: We found a {cozy} café to escape the rain.
e.zh: 我们找到一家温馨的咖啡馆躲雨。

e.en: Her apartment felt {cozy} with candles and soft music.
e.zh: 她的公寓在烛光和轻音乐中显得很温馨。

cpa.t: abbr. 注册会计师（Certified Public Accountant）

e.en: My {CPA} files my taxes every spring.
e.zh: 我的注册会计师每年春天替我报税。

e.en: She studied for years to become a licensed {CPA}.
e.zh: 她苦学多年才考取了注册会计师执照。

cpc.t: abbr. 每次点击费用（Cost Per Click）

e.en: Our {CPC} on Google Ads dropped after we improved keywords.
e.zh: 优化关键词后,我们谷歌广告的单次点击成本下降了。

e.en: Advertisers track {CPC} to measure campaign efficiency.
e.zh: 广告主通过单次点击成本来衡量投放效率。

cpd.t: abbr. 持续职业发展（Continuing Professional Development）

e.en: Doctors must complete annual {CPD} hours to keep their license.
e.zh: 医生每年必须完成持续职业发展学时才能保留执照。

e.en: The firm pays for staff {CPD} courses every year.
e.zh: 公司每年为员工的持续职业发展课程买单。

cpe.t: abbr. 客户端设备（Customer Premises Equipment）

e.en: Accountants need yearly {CPE} credits to stay certified.
e.zh: 会计师每年需修满继续教育学分才能保持认证。

e.en: The webinar counts toward eight hours of {CPE}.
e.zh: 这场网络研讨会可计入八小时的继续职业教育。

e.en: {Cpl} Martinez led the squad on patrol that night.
e.zh: 那晚由马丁内斯下士带队巡逻。

e.en: He was promoted from private to {Cpl} last month.
e.zh: 上个月他从二等兵晋升为下士。

e.en: Modern game engines are mostly written in {C++}.
e.zh: 现代游戏引擎大多用 C++ 编写。

e.en: She compiled the {C++} code with the latest GCC version.
e.zh: 她用最新版的 GCC 编译了这段 C++ 代码。

e.en: The lifeguard performed {CPR} until paramedics arrived.
e.zh: 救生员一直做心肺复苏,直到急救人员赶到。

e.en: Every teacher should know how to do {CPR}.
e.zh: 每位老师都应该会做心肺复苏。

cprs.t: abbr. 心肺复苏（CPR 的复数）

e.en: The trainees practiced multiple {CPRs} on the dummy.
e.zh: 学员们在假人身上练习了多次心肺复苏。

e.en: Two successful {CPRs} that night saved both patients.
e.zh: 那晚两次成功的心肺复苏救回了两名患者。

cps.t: abbr. 每秒周期数；每秒字符数

e.en: The gaming mouse can register up to twenty {CPS}.
e.zh: 这款游戏鼠标每秒最多可记录二十次点击。

e.en: Speed clickers compete to achieve the highest {CPS}.
e.zh: 快速点击玩家竞相追求最高的每秒点击数。

cpu.t: abbr. 中央处理器（Central Processing Unit）

e.en: The new laptop has a much faster {CPU} than mine.
e.zh: 这台新笔记本电脑的处理器比我的快多了。

e.en: Background processes are using too much {CPU} again.
e.zh: 后台进程又占用了太多 CPU 资源。

cpv.t: abbr. 每次观看成本（Cost Per View）

e.en: YouTube ads are usually billed on a {CPV} basis.
e.zh: YouTube 广告通常按每次观看付费计算。

e.en: Lower {CPV} means more views for the same budget.
e.zh: 每次观看成本越低,同样预算能买到的观看量越多。

crab.t:
n. 螃蟹
v. 抱怨；发牢骚

e.en: We caught a huge {crab} off the pier yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天我们在码头钓到一只大螃蟹。

e.en: She ordered soft-shell {crab} at the seafood restaurant.
e.zh: 她在海鲜餐厅点了软壳蟹。

e.en: The {crabapple} tree blooms with pink flowers each spring.
e.zh: 海棠树每年春天开出粉色的花。

e.en: Grandma made jelly from the tart {crabapple} fruit.
e.zh: 奶奶用酸酸的海棠果做成了果冻。

e.en: His {crabbed} handwriting was almost impossible to read.
e.zh: 他那潦草难辨的字迹几乎无法辨认。

e.en: The {crabbed} old man complained about everything.
e.zh: 那位脾气暴躁的老人对什么都抱怨。

e.en: The toddler gets {crabby} when she misses her nap.
e.zh: 小女孩没睡午觉就会闹脾气。

e.en: Don't talk to him before coffee — he's always {crabby}.
e.zh: 喝咖啡前别跟他说话,他总是脾气暴躁。

e.en: {Crabgrass} keeps invading our perfect green lawn.
e.zh: 马唐草不断入侵我们漂亮的绿色草坪。

e.en: He spent the weekend pulling {crabgrass} from the yard.
e.zh: 他整个周末都在院子里拔马唐草。

e.en: The dancer moved {crablike} sideways across the stage.
e.zh: 舞者像螃蟹一样横着穿过舞台。

e.en: He shuffled {crablike} along the narrow ledge.
e.zh: 他像螃蟹般沿着狭窄的窗台横着挪动。

e.en: The salad was topped with sweet, fresh {crabmeat}.
e.zh: 沙拉上面铺着新鲜香甜的蟹肉。

e.en: She bought a can of {crabmeat} for the pasta sauce.
e.zh: 她买了一罐蟹肉用来做意面酱。

e.en: Tiny {crabs} scuttled across the wet sand.
e.zh: 小螃蟹在湿沙上飞快地横行。

e.en: We boiled a dozen {crabs} for the family dinner.
e.zh: 我们煮了一打螃蟹作为家庭晚餐。

e.en: A blossoming {crabtree} stood at the edge of the orchard.
e.zh: 一棵盛开的海棠树立在果园边上。

e.en: Bees buzzed around the old {crabtree} all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午蜜蜂都在那棵老海棠树旁嗡嗡飞舞。

e.en: He inched {crabwise} along the narrow mountain ledge.
e.zh: 他像螃蟹一样沿着狭窄的山崖横向挪动。

e.en: The negotiations moved {crabwise} toward an agreement.
e.zh: 谈判迂回曲折地朝着达成协议推进。

crack.t:
n. 裂缝；破解
v. 破裂；破解（密码）

e.en: There's a small {crack} running across the phone screen.
e.zh: 手机屏幕上有一道小裂痕。

e.en: Hackers tried to {crack} the password for hours.
e.zh: 黑客花了好几个小时试图破解密码。

e.en: Police announced a {crackdown} on illegal street racing.
e.zh: 警方宣布对非法街头赛车展开严打。

e.en: The government launched a {crackdown} on tax evasion.
e.zh: 政府对偷税漏税行为展开了严厉打击。

e.en: My phone screen {cracked} when it hit the floor.
e.zh: 我的手机屏幕摔到地上就裂了。

e.en: She finally {cracked} the difficult coding problem.
e.zh: 她终于攻克了那道难解的编程题。

e.en: He spread peanut butter on a salty {cracker}.
e.zh: 他在一块咸饼干上抹了花生酱。

e.en: Children pulled the Christmas {cracker} with a loud bang.
e.zh: 孩子们拉响圣诞拉炮,发出一声巨响。

crackerjack.t:
adj. 极出色的
n. 能手

e.en: She's a {crackerjack} programmer at the startup.
e.zh: 她是那家创业公司里一流的程序员。

e.en: The team hired a {crackerjack} lawyer for the case.
e.zh: 团队为这个案子聘请了一位顶尖律师。

crackers.t:
n. 饼干（复数）
adj. 发疯的

e.en: I packed cheese and {crackers} for the picnic.
e.zh: 我为野餐打包了奶酪和饼干。

e.en: You'd be {crackers} to quit such a great job.
e.zh: 辞掉这么好的工作你简直是疯了。

crackhead.t: n. 吸食可卡因的瘾君子

e.en: The film portrayed a {crackhead} struggling to get clean.
e.zh: 这部电影刻画了一名瘾君子努力戒毒的过程。

e.en: He joked that his coworker codes like a caffeinated {crackhead}.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说同事写代码像个嗑了咖啡因的瘾君子。

cracking.t:
adj. 极好的
n. 破裂；裂化

e.en: The ice was {cracking} under our feet on the frozen lake.
e.zh: 我们脚下的冰面在结冰的湖上咔咔作响。

e.en: That was a {cracking} episode of the show last night.
e.zh: 昨晚那一集节目真是精彩极了。

crackle.t:
v. 发出噼啪声
n. 爆裂声

e.en: I love the {crackle} of a fire on a cold night.
e.zh: 我喜欢寒夜里炉火噼啪作响的声音。

e.en: The radio began to {crackle} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨来时收音机开始噼啪作响。

e.en: Logs were {crackling} cheerfully in the fireplace.
e.zh: 壁炉里的木柴欢快地噼啪燃烧着。

e.en: Her speech had a {crackling} energy that thrilled the crowd.
e.zh: 她的演讲充满让全场振奋的活力。

e.en: Grandma fried up some pork {cracklings} for snacks.
e.zh: 奶奶炸了一些猪油渣当零食。

e.en: The chef sprinkled crispy {cracklings} on top of the salad.
e.zh: 厨师在沙拉上撒了一些酥脆的猪油渣。

e.en: The old vinyl record sounded warm and {crackly}.
e.zh: 那张老黑胶唱片听起来温暖而带着杂音。

e.en: Her voice was {crackly} over the bad phone connection.
e.zh: 电话信号不好,她的声音断断续续夹着杂音。

crackpot.t:
n. 怪人；疯子
adj. 古怪的

e.en: He has some {crackpot} theory about flat earth physics.
e.zh: 他有一套关于地平说物理学的怪诞理论。

e.en: Investors dismissed the proposal as a {crackpot} idea.
e.zh: 投资者将这一提案斥为荒唐念头。

cracks.t:
n. 裂缝（复数）
v. 破裂；破解

e.en: Tiny {cracks} appeared in the wall after the earthquake.
e.zh: 地震过后墙上出现了细小的裂缝。

e.en: He always {cracks} jokes during serious meetings.
e.zh: 他总在正经会议上爱开玩笑。

e.en: She wore a black {crape} dress to the funeral.
e.zh: 她穿了一件黑色绉纱连衣裙去参加葬礼。

e.en: The window was draped in heavy {crape} fabric.
e.zh: 窗户上挂着厚厚的绉纱布。

e.en: We caught several {crappie} at the lake this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上我们在湖里钓到了几条莓鲈。

e.en: {Crappie} are a popular freshwater fish in the Midwest.
e.zh: 莓鲈是美国中西部很受欢迎的淡水鱼。

e.en: My phone has been getting really {crappy} battery life lately.
e.zh: 我的手机最近电池续航差得要命。

e.en: It's been a {crappy} week at work.
e.zh: 这周工作糟糕透了。

crapshoot.t: n. 全凭运气的事；冒险

e.en: Picking a winning startup is basically a {crapshoot}.
e.zh: 挑中一家成功的创业公司基本就是碰运气。

e.en: Dating apps can feel like a total {crapshoot}.
e.zh: 约会软件感觉完全就是赌运气。

crash.t:
v. 崩溃；撞毁
n. 崩溃；碰撞

e.en: The app keeps trying to {crash} when I open large files.
e.zh: 我打开大文件时这个应用老是崩溃。

e.en: Heavy rain caused a multi-car {crash} on the highway.
e.zh: 大雨导致高速公路上发生了多车连环相撞。

crashed.t: v. 崩溃（过去式）；撞毁了

e.en: My laptop {crashed} right before I could save the file.
e.zh: 我还没来得及保存文件,笔记本就崩溃了。

e.en: The drunk driver {crashed} into a parked truck.
e.zh: 那个醉酒司机撞上了一辆停着的卡车。

e.en: An uninvited {crasher} showed up at the wedding reception.
e.zh: 婚宴上来了一个不请自来的不速之客。

e.en: The party {crasher} ate all the cake before leaving.
e.zh: 那个混进派对的家伙临走前把蛋糕都吃光了。

e.en: The new update {crashes} every time I open the app.
e.zh: 每次我打开应用,新版本就会闪退。

e.en: Traffic {crashes} spike during the holiday weekend.
e.zh: 假日周末交通事故会激增。

crashing.t:
v. 正在崩溃
adj. 彻底的

e.en: The server keeps {crashing} under heavy weekend traffic.
e.zh: 周末流量大的时候服务器一直崩溃。

e.en: Waves were {crashing} loudly against the rocks.
e.zh: 海浪轰隆隆地拍打着岩石。

e.en: The car earned top marks for {crashworthiness} in safety tests.
e.zh: 这款车在安全测试中获得了最高的抗撞性评级。

e.en: Engineers improved {crashworthiness} by reinforcing the door frames.
e.zh: 工程师通过加固车门框架提升了抗撞性能。

e.en: The new SUV is highly {crashworthy} thanks to its steel cage.
e.zh: 这款新SUV因钢制车身框架而具备出色的抗撞能力。

e.en: Regulators require all minivans to be {crashworthy}.
e.zh: 监管机构要求所有小型货车都必须具备抗撞性。

e.en: His {crass} comments offended everyone at the dinner.
e.zh: 他粗俗的言论冒犯了在场的每一位用餐者。

e.en: The ad was a {crass} attempt to sell more products.
e.zh: 那则广告是一次粗鄙的促销尝试。

e.en: She {crassly} joked about her colleague's recent breakup.
e.zh: 她粗鲁地拿同事最近的分手开玩笑。

e.en: The CEO {crassly} dismissed concerns about layoffs.
e.zh: 那位首席执行官粗暴地驳回了对裁员的担忧。

e.en: The film was criticized for its {crassness} and shock humor.
e.zh: 这部电影因其粗俗和恶趣味而遭到批评。

e.en: Her {crassness} at the funeral shocked the family.
e.zh: 她在葬礼上的粗鲁举止震惊了整个家族。

crate.t:
n. 板条箱；货箱
v. 装箱

e.en: Please pack the books into a wooden {crate} for shipping.
e.zh: 请将书籍装入木箱准备发货。

e.en: The dog sleeps in a small {crate} next to the bed.
e.zh: 那只狗睡在床边的小笼子里。

crated.t: v. 装入板条箱（过去式）

e.en: The artwork was carefully {crated} before the museum tour.
e.zh: 那件艺术品在博物馆巡展前被小心地装入了木箱。

e.en: All the equipment was {crated} and ready for transport.
e.zh: 所有设备都已装箱,准备运输。

e.en: The meteor left a huge {crater} in the desert floor.
e.zh: 那颗陨石在沙漠地面上留下了一个巨大的陨石坑。

e.en: Scientists explored the {crater} of the dormant volcano.
e.zh: 科学家们探查了那座休眠火山的火山口。

cratered.t:
adj. 布满坑的
v. 暴跌；坍塌

e.en: The stock price {cratered} after the disappointing earnings report.
e.zh: 令人失望的财报发布后,股价暴跌。

e.en: The moon's surface is heavily {cratered} from ancient impacts.
e.zh: 月球表面因远古撞击而布满了陨石坑。

craters.t: n. 火山口；陨石坑（复数）

e.en: The old battlefield is dotted with bomb {craters}.
e.zh: 那片古战场上布满了炸弹留下的弹坑。

e.en: Mars has thousands of impact {craters} on its surface.
e.zh: 火星表面有数千个撞击坑。

e.en: The gentleman wore a silk {cravat} with his evening suit.
e.zh: 那位绅士搭配晚礼服戴了一条丝质领巾。

e.en: He tied a colorful {cravat} around his neck for the wedding.
e.zh: 他在脖子上系了一条彩色领巾出席婚礼。

e.en: I {crave} chocolate whenever I'm stressed at work.
e.zh: 每当工作压力大时,我就特别想吃巧克力。

e.en: Many teenagers {crave} validation from their peers online.
e.zh: 许多青少年渴望在网上获得同龄人的认可。

e.en: She {craved} a quiet weekend after the busy week.
e.zh: 忙碌了一周后,她渴望一个安静的周末。

e.en: The athlete {craved} the spotlight after years of training.
e.zh: 经过多年训练后,这位运动员渴望站在聚光灯下。

craven.t:
adj. 怯懦的
n. 懦夫

e.en: His {craven} refusal to defend his friend disappointed everyone.
e.zh: 他怯懦地拒绝为朋友辩护,令所有人失望。

e.en: The general called the soldiers' retreat a {craven} act.
e.zh: 将军称士兵的撤退是怯懦之举。

e.en: The politician {cravenly} backed down from his earlier promises.
e.zh: 那位政客怯懦地放弃了之前的承诺。

e.en: He {cravenly} hid behind his lawyer during the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻爆发时,他怯懦地躲在律师身后。

e.en: My toddler {craves} attention from everyone in the room.
e.zh: 我家小孩渴望得到房间里每个人的关注。

e.en: The plant {craves} sunlight and needs to be near a window.
e.zh: 这种植物需要阳光,得放在窗边。

e.en: I had a sudden {craving} for spicy noodles at midnight.
e.zh: 半夜我突然特别想吃辣面条。

e.en: She's {craving} some quiet time away from her phone.
e.zh: 她渴望有段远离手机的安静时光。

e.en: Pregnancy {cravings} can be really unpredictable and intense.
e.zh: 孕期的食物渴望可能非常难以预料且强烈。

e.en: Drinking water sometimes helps reduce sugar {cravings}.
e.zh: 喝水有时能帮助减少对糖的渴望。

e.en: His rude comment really stuck in my {craw} all evening.
e.zh: 他那句无礼的话整晚都让我耿耿于怀。

e.en: The bird stored seeds in its {craw} before digesting them.
e.zh: 那只鸟把种子先储存在嗉囊里再消化。

e.en: We caught a small {crawdad} in the creek behind the house.
e.zh: 我们在屋后的小溪里抓到了一只小龙虾。

e.en: Boiled {crawdad} is a popular dish in Louisiana.
e.zh: 水煮小龙虾是路易斯安那州一道受欢迎的菜肴。

crawfish.t:
n. 小龙虾
v. 退缩

e.en: The Cajun restaurant serves spicy {crawfish} every Friday night.
e.zh: 那家凯郡餐厅每周五晚都供应香辣小龙虾。

e.en: We caught dozens of {crawfish} in the muddy stream.
e.zh: 我们在浑浊的小溪里抓到了几十只小龙虾。

crawl.t:
v. 爬行；缓慢移动
n. 爬行；自由泳

e.en: Babies usually {crawl} before they learn to walk.
e.zh: 婴儿通常会先学会爬再学会走。

e.en: Traffic began to {crawl} during the morning rush hour.
e.zh: 早高峰时段交通开始变得缓慢。

e.en: The injured hiker {crawled} slowly back to the trail.
e.zh: 那位受伤的徒步者慢慢爬回了小径。

e.en: She {crawled} into bed exhausted after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后,她疲惫地爬上了床。

e.en: The search engine uses a {crawler} to index new web pages.
e.zh: 搜索引擎使用爬虫来索引新的网页。

e.en: Our toddler is now an active {crawler} exploring every room.
e.zh: 我们家宝宝现在是个活跃的爬行小家伙,到处探索每个房间。

e.en: We took a train from London down to {Crawley} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们周末从伦敦坐火车去了克劳利。

e.en: {Crawley} is a town located near London Gatwick Airport.
e.zh: 克劳利是一座位于伦敦盖特威克机场附近的城镇。

crawling.t:
v. 正在爬行
adj. 爬满的

e.en: The kitchen was {crawling} with ants after the picnic.
e.zh: 野餐过后厨房里爬满了蚂蚁。

e.en: My baby just started {crawling} across the living room.
e.zh: 我家宝宝刚开始在客厅里爬来爬去。

e.en: Time {crawls} when you're waiting for important news.
e.zh: 等待重要消息时,时间过得特别慢。

e.en: A spider {crawls} along the windowsill every morning.
e.zh: 每天早晨都有一只蜘蛛沿着窗台爬行。

crawlspace.t: n. 爬行空间（房屋底部矮层）

e.en: Workers found old wiring in the {crawlspace} under the house.
e.zh: 工人在房子下方的爬行空间里发现了旧电线。

e.en: The plumber crawled into the {crawlspace} to fix the leak.
e.zh: 水管工爬进狭小空间去修补漏水处。

crawly.t: adj. 令人发毛的；痒痒的

e.en: That horror movie gave me a {crawly} feeling all night.
e.zh: 那部恐怖片让我整晚都浑身发毛。

e.en: She hates basements full of creepy {crawly} bugs.
e.zh: 她讨厌地下室里那些令人毛骨悚然的爬虫。

e.en: That party last night was totally {cray}!
e.zh: 昨晚那场派对真是太疯狂了!

e.en: My schedule this week is straight up {cray}.
e.zh: 我这周的日程简直疯狂。

e.en: We ordered a plate of grilled {crayfish} at the seafood market.
e.zh: 我们在海鲜市场点了一盘烤小龙虾。

e.en: The stream was full of small {crayfish} hiding under rocks.
e.zh: 小溪里满是躲在石头下的小龙虾。

crayon.t:
n. 蜡笔
v. 用蜡笔画

e.en: The child drew a rainbow with a red {crayon}.
e.zh: 那个孩子用一支红色蜡笔画了一道彩虹。

e.en: My daughter melted a {crayon} on the radiator by accident.
e.zh: 我女儿不小心把一支蜡笔放到暖气片上融化了。

craze.t:
n. 风潮；狂热
v. 使疯狂

e.en: Bubble tea has become a global {craze} among young people.
e.zh: 珍珠奶茶已成为年轻人中的全球流行风潮。

e.en: The fitness {craze} swept through social media last year.
e.zh: 去年这股健身热潮席卷了社交媒体。

e.en: The {crazed} fans rushed the stage during the concert.
e.zh: 狂热的粉丝在演唱会上冲向了舞台。

e.en: He had a {crazed} look in his eyes after staying up all night.
e.zh: 通宵熬夜后,他的眼神里透着一种疯狂。

e.en: The dog barked {crazily} at the mailman every morning.
e.zh: 那只狗每天早晨都对邮递员疯狂地叫个不停。

e.en: Prices have been rising {crazily} over the past year.
e.zh: 过去一年里物价一直在疯狂上涨。

e.en: I need a vacation to escape the {craziness} of city life.
e.zh: 我需要度个假来逃离城市生活的疯狂。

e.en: The holiday season brings its usual {craziness} to the mall.
e.zh: 假日季节又给商场带来了一如往常的疯狂。

e.en: You'd be {crazy} to turn down such a great job offer.
e.zh: 拒绝这么好的工作机会你就太傻了。

e.en: The kids went {crazy} when they saw the puppy.
e.zh: 孩子们看到那只小狗时兴奋得不得了。

e.en: The file failed the {CRC} check during download verification.
e.zh: 该文件在下载校验时未通过CRC检查。

e.en: Network packets include a {CRC} to detect transmission errors.
e.zh: 网络数据包中包含CRC校验码以检测传输错误。

e.en: The {Cre} recombinase enzyme is widely used in genetic research.
e.zh: Cre重组酶在遗传学研究中被广泛使用。

e.en: Scientists used the {Cre}-loxP system to delete the target gene.
e.zh: 科学家利用Cre-loxP系统来敲除目标基因。

creak.t:
v. 发出吱嘎声
n. 吱嘎声

e.en: The old wooden stairs {creak} whenever someone walks up them.
e.zh: 那座老旧的木楼梯只要有人走上去就会嘎吱作响。

e.en: I heard a strange {creak} coming from the attic last night.
e.zh: 昨晚我听到阁楼里传来一阵奇怪的吱嘎声。

cradle.t:
n. 摇篮；发源地
v. 轻抱

e.en: The baby slept peacefully in the wooden {cradle}.
e.zh: 婴儿在木摇篮里安静地睡着。

e.en: She {cradled} the injured kitten in her arms.
e.zh: 她把受伤的小猫轻轻抱在怀里。

craft.t:
n. 手艺；工艺
v. 精心制作

e.en: She learned the {craft} of pottery from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她从奶奶那里学到了制陶手艺。

e.en: Writers {craft} each sentence with care and precision.
e.zh: 作家们精心打磨每一个句子。

crafted.t:
adj. 精心制作的
v. craft 的过去式

e.en: He {crafted} a wooden chair from reclaimed oak.
e.zh: 他用回收的橡木做了一把木椅。

e.en: The CEO {crafted} a careful response to the criticism.
e.zh: 首席执行官精心拟定了回应批评的措辞。

e.en: The {crafter} sells handmade jewelry on Etsy.
e.zh: 那位手工艺人在 Etsy 上卖手工首饰。

e.en: Every {crafter} at the fair brought unique creations.
e.zh: 展会上每位匠人都带来了独特的作品。

e.en: She {craftily} avoided answering the awkward question.
e.zh: 她巧妙地避开了那个尴尬的问题。

e.en: The fox {craftily} slipped past the sleeping guard dog.
e.zh: 狐狸狡猾地从熟睡的看门狗旁溜了过去。

e.en: His {craftiness} helped him win the negotiation.
e.zh: 他的机敏让他在谈判中占了上风。

e.en: The cat's {craftiness} surprised even its owner.
e.zh: 那只猫的狡黠连主人都感到意外。

crafting.t:
n. 制作；打造
v. craft 的现在分词

e.en: She spent the weekend {crafting} holiday decorations.
e.zh: 她周末都在做节日装饰品。

e.en: The team is {crafting} a new marketing strategy.
e.zh: 团队正在制定新的营销策略。

crafts.t: n. 手工艺品（craft 的复数）

e.en: The museum displays traditional {crafts} from rural villages.
e.zh: 博物馆展出来自乡村的传统手工艺品。

e.en: My daughter loves arts and {crafts} after school.
e.zh: 我女儿放学后喜欢做手工。

e.en: The {craftsman} carved intricate patterns into the wooden door.
e.zh: 工匠在木门上雕刻出精美的图案。

e.en: Every {craftsman} signs his work before delivery.
e.zh: 每位工匠在交货前都会签名。

e.en: The watch's {craftsmanship} justifies its high price.
e.zh: 这块手表的工艺值得它的高价。

e.en: Japanese {craftsmanship} is admired around the world.
e.zh: 日本的工匠精神享誉全球。

e.en: Skilled {craftsmen} restored the cathedral's ancient windows.
e.zh: 熟练的工匠修复了大教堂的古老窗户。

e.en: Local {craftsmen} gathered to demonstrate their techniques.
e.zh: 当地工匠齐聚一堂展示他们的技艺。

e.en: The festival celebrates local {craftspeople} and their work.
e.zh: 这个节日是为了表彰当地手工艺人和他们的作品。

e.en: Many {craftspeople} now sell their goods online.
e.zh: 如今许多手工艺人都在网上销售作品。

e.en: Each {craftsperson} brings a unique style to the studio.
e.zh: 每位手工艺人都为工作室带来独特的风格。

e.en: She trained as a {craftsperson} in traditional bookbinding.
e.zh: 她接受过传统装帧手艺的训练。

e.en: The {craftswoman} weaves silk scarves on a wooden loom.
e.zh: 这位女工匠在木织机上织丝巾。

e.en: She is a renowned {craftswoman} in ceramic art.
e.zh: 她是一位著名的陶瓷艺术女匠人。

e.en: The shop sells handmade {craftwork} from local artisans.
e.zh: 这家店出售当地工匠制作的手工艺品。

e.en: Her {craftwork} won first prize at the county fair.
e.zh: 她的手工作品在县博览会上获得了一等奖。

e.en: That {crafty} salesman convinced me to buy the warranty.
e.zh: 那个狡猾的销售员说服我买了保修服务。

e.en: She came up with a {crafty} plan to surprise him.
e.zh: 她想出一个巧妙的计划给他惊喜。

e.en: The eagle built its nest on a high {crag}.
e.zh: 那只鹰在高高的峭壁上筑了巢。

e.en: Climbers rested briefly on the rocky {crag}.
e.zh: 登山者在岩石峭壁上短暂休息。

craggy.t: adj. 多岩石的；轮廓分明的

e.en: The {craggy} coastline made landing nearly impossible.
e.zh: 嶙峋的海岸线让登陆几乎不可能。

e.en: His {craggy} face showed years of outdoor work.
e.zh: 他粗犷的脸庞显出多年户外工作的痕迹。

e.en: We drove through {Craigavon} on our way to Belfast.
e.zh: 我们去贝尔法斯特的路上经过了克雷加文。

e.en: {Craigavon} is a town in Northern Ireland.
e.zh: 克雷加文是北爱尔兰的一个城镇。

cram.t: v. 塞满；临时突击学习

e.en: Students {cram} for exams the night before.
e.zh: 学生们考试前一晚临时抱佛脚。

e.en: Don't try to {cram} too much into your suitcase.
e.zh: 别想往行李箱里塞太多东西。

crammer.t: n. 应试辅导书；填鸭式学校

e.en: He attended a {crammer} to retake his college entrance exam.
e.zh: 他去补习班准备重考大学入学考试。

e.en: The {crammer} promised to boost test scores quickly.
e.zh: 那家补习班承诺能快速提高考试成绩。

cramming.t:
n. 考前突击
v. cram 的现在分词

e.en: {Cramming} all night rarely improves long-term retention.
e.zh: 通宵临时抱佛脚很少能让记忆持久。

e.en: She was {cramming} clothes into an overstuffed bag.
e.zh: 她正把衣服硬塞进已经鼓鼓的包里。

cramp.t:
n. 抽筋；痉挛
v. 束缚

e.en: I got a sudden {cramp} in my calf while swimming.
e.zh: 我游泳时小腿突然抽筋了。

e.en: Tight deadlines {cramp} my creativity at work.
e.zh: 紧迫的截止日期限制了我工作上的创造力。

cramped.t: adj. 狭小拥挤的；局促的

e.en: The apartment felt {cramped} after the new furniture arrived.
e.zh: 新家具搬来后,公寓显得很拥挤。

e.en: Passengers complained about the {cramped} economy seats.
e.zh: 乘客们抱怨经济舱座位太挤。

e.en: My legs kept {cramping} during the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行中我的腿一直在抽筋。

e.en: The strict rules are {cramping} our team's creativity.
e.zh: 严格的规定束缚了我们团队的创造力。

e.en: She strapped a {crampon} onto each boot before climbing.
e.zh: 登山前她在每只靴子上绑了冰爪。

e.en: A broken {crampon} forced him to turn back.
e.zh: 一只冰爪坏了,迫使他原路返回。

e.en: I love {cranberry} sauce with roasted turkey.
e.zh: 我喜欢用蔓越莓酱配烤火鸡。

e.en: She ordered a vodka {cranberry} at the bar.
e.zh: 她在酒吧点了一杯伏特加蔓越莓。

e.en: We stopped for tea in the village of {Cranborne}.
e.zh: 我们在克兰伯恩村停下来喝了茶。

e.en: {Cranborne} sits on the edge of a quiet chase.
e.zh: 克兰伯恩位于一片宁静猎场的边缘。

crane.t:
n. 起重机；鹤
v. 伸长（脖子）

e.en: A massive {crane} lifted the steel beams onto the roof.
e.zh: 一台巨型起重机把钢梁吊上了屋顶。

e.en: Tourists {crane} their necks to see the cathedral ceiling.
e.zh: 游客们伸长脖子仰望大教堂的天花板。

cranfield.t: n. 英国地名（克兰菲尔德大学）

e.en: He earned his MBA at {Cranfield} University.
e.zh: 他在克兰菲尔德大学拿到了 MBA 学位。

e.en: {Cranfield} is known for its aerospace research.
e.zh: 克兰菲尔德以其航空航天研究而闻名。

e.en: The doctor ordered scans to check for {cranial} injuries.
e.zh: 医生要求做扫描检查是否有颅部损伤。

e.en: Her {cranial} nerves seemed to be functioning normally.
e.zh: 她的颅神经看起来功能正常。

e.en: The clinic specializes in {craniofacial} surgery for children.
e.zh: 这家诊所专门为儿童做颅面手术。

e.en: He studied {craniofacial} development in graduate school.
e.zh: 他在研究生阶段研究颅面发育。

e.en: The neurosurgeon performed a {craniotomy} to remove the tumor.
e.zh: 神经外科医生做了开颅手术切除肿瘤。

e.en: Recovery from a {craniotomy} can take several weeks.
e.zh: 开颅手术的恢复可能需要好几个星期。

e.en: The helmet protects the rider's {cranium} during a fall.
e.zh: 摔车时头盔能保护骑手的颅骨。

e.en: Fossils show this dinosaur had an unusually thick {cranium}.
e.zh: 化石显示这只恐龙的颅骨异常厚实。

crank.t:
n. 曲柄；怪人
v. 转动曲柄

e.en: Please {crank} up the volume on the speaker.
e.zh: 请把音箱的音量调大一点。

e.en: He turned the {crank} to start the old engine.
e.zh: 他转动曲柄发动那台老引擎。

e.en: Oil leaked from the engine's {crankcase} onto the driveway.
e.zh: 机油从发动机曲轴箱漏到了车道上。

e.en: Always check the {crankcase} level before a long drive.
e.zh: 长途驾驶前一定要检查曲轴箱油位。

e.en: His {crankiness} faded after a strong cup of coffee.
e.zh: 喝了一杯浓咖啡后,他的暴躁就消失了。

e.en: The toddler's {crankiness} usually means she needs a nap.
e.zh: 小宝宝闹脾气通常说明她该睡午觉了。

e.en: A broken {crankshaft} can total an entire engine.
e.zh: 曲轴断裂可能会让整台发动机报废。

e.en: The mechanic carefully reinstalled the {crankshaft}.
e.zh: 技师小心翼翼地把曲轴装了回去。

e.en: The baby gets {cranky} when she misses her nap.
e.zh: 宝宝没睡午觉就会闹脾气。

e.en: I'm always {cranky} before my morning coffee.
e.zh: 我早上没喝咖啡前总是脾气暴躁。

e.en: We searched every nook and {cranny} for the lost ring.
