e.en: The toddler stacked colorful wooden {cubes} carefully.
e.zh: 幼儿小心地把彩色木方块叠起来。

e.en: The tank holds about ten {cubic} meters of water.
e.zh: 这个水箱大约能装十立方米水。

e.en: Engineers measured the {cubic} volume of the room.
e.zh: 工程师测量了房间的立方体积。

e.en: The artist built a {cubical} sculpture from steel.
e.zh: 那位艺术家用钢材打造了一座立方体雕塑。

e.en: Each storage unit has a perfectly {cubical} shape.
e.zh: 每个储物单元都呈完美的立方体形状。

e.en: He spent eight hours in his office {cubicle}.
e.zh: 他在办公室的小隔间里待了八个小时。

e.en: The bathroom {cubicle} door wouldn't lock properly.
e.zh: 卫生间的隔间门锁不上。

cubism.t: n. 立体主义（绘画流派）

e.en: Picasso pioneered {cubism} in the early twentieth century.
e.zh: 毕加索在二十世纪初开创了立体主义。

e.en: The museum's {cubism} exhibit drew huge crowds.
e.zh: 博物馆的立体主义展览吸引了大量观众。

e.en: The lecture compared various {cubisms} across European art.
e.zh: 讲座比较了欧洲艺术中各种立体主义流派。

e.en: Critics debated the different {cubisms} that emerged.
e.zh: 评论家们争论着相继出现的不同立体主义流派。

cubist.t:
n. 立体派画家
adj. 立体派的

e.en: The gallery showcased a stunning {cubist} portrait.
e.zh: 画廊展出了一幅惊艳的立体派肖像。

e.en: Braque became a leading {cubist} alongside Picasso.
e.zh: 布拉克与毕加索并列成为立体派的领军人物。

cubit.t: n. 腕尺（古代长度单位）

e.en: Ancient builders measured stones in {cubit} lengths.
e.zh: 古代工匠用肘尺为单位测量石头。

e.en: The ark was three hundred {cubit} long.
e.zh: 方舟有三百肘长。

cuckold.t:
n. 妻子出轨的男人
v. 给…戴绿帽

e.en: The play mocks the foolish {cuckold} husband.
e.zh: 这部戏嘲弄了那个被戴绿帽的愚蠢丈夫。

e.en: Shakespeare often wrote about jealous {cuckold} characters.
e.zh: 莎士比亚常常刻画嫉妒的戴绿帽角色。

cuckolded.t: v. 被妻子背叛（过去式）

e.en: He felt humiliated after being {cuckolded} by his friend.
e.zh: 被朋友戴了绿帽后,他感到无比羞辱。

e.en: The novel's hero discovers he has been {cuckolded}.
e.zh: 小说的主角发现自己被戴了绿帽。

cuckoo.t:
n. 杜鹃；布谷鸟
adj. 疯癫的

e.en: A {cuckoo} called from deep within the forest.
e.zh: 森林深处传来布谷鸟的叫声。

e.en: That plan sounds completely {cuckoo} to me.
e.zh: 那个计划在我看来简直疯狂。

e.en: She added sliced {cucumber} to the summer salad.
e.zh: 她在夏日沙拉里加了切片黄瓜。

e.en: He stayed cool as a {cucumber} during the interview.
e.zh: 面试时他镇定得像根黄瓜一样。

e.en: The farmer harvested baskets of fresh {cucumbers}.
e.zh: 农夫收获了一篮篮新鲜的黄瓜。

e.en: Pickled {cucumbers} go great with grilled burgers.
e.zh: 腌黄瓜配烤汉堡非常美味。

e.en: The cows lay in the field chewing their {cud}.
e.zh: 奶牛躺在田里反刍着草料。

e.en: He sat chewing the {cud} over the decision.
e.zh: 他坐着反复琢磨那个决定。

cuddle.t:
v. 搂抱；依偎
n. 拥抱

e.en: The kids love to {cuddle} on rainy mornings.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在雨天的早晨依偎在一起。

e.en: She gave the puppy a gentle {cuddle}.
e.zh: 她轻轻地搂了一下小狗。

e.en: They were {cuddling} on the couch watching movies.
e.zh: 他们依偎在沙发上看电影。

e.en: The kitten kept {cuddling} against her warm sweater.
e.zh: 小猫不停地依偎着她暖和的毛衣。

cuddly.t: adj. 让人想抱的；惹人爱的

e.en: She bought him a {cuddly} teddy bear.
e.zh: 她给他买了一只软绵绵的泰迪熊。

e.en: That golden retriever is so big and {cuddly}.
e.zh: 那只金毛猎犬又大又招人想抱。

e.en: The sailor stored gear in the boat's {cuddy}.
e.zh: 水手把装备存放在船的小船舱里。

e.en: We cooked dinner inside the cramped {cuddy}.
e.zh: 我们在狭小的小船舱里做晚饭。

cudgel.t:
n. 短粗木棒
v. 用棍打

e.en: The guard carried a heavy wooden {cudgel}.
e.zh: 守卫拎着一根沉重的木棍。

e.en: He took up the {cudgel} for free speech online.
e.zh: 他在网上为言论自由挺身而出。

cue.t:
n. 暗示；提示
v. 给…提示

e.en: Take that as your {cue} to start speaking.
e.zh: 把那当作你开始发言的信号。

e.en: He chalked the pool {cue} before his shot.
e.zh: 他在击球前给台球杆抹了粉。

e.en: The director kept {cueing} the actors from offstage.
e.zh: 导演不停地从台下给演员提示。

e.en: She is {cueing} up the next song now.
e.zh: 她正在准备播放下一首歌。

e.en: Good speakers read social {cues} from the audience.
e.zh: 优秀的演讲者会捕捉观众的社交反应。

e.en: The director gave the actors their final {cues}.
e.zh: 导演给演员们发出了最后的提示。

cuff.t:
n. 袖口；裤脚口
v. 给…戴手铐

e.en: He rolled up his shirt {cuff} before working.
e.zh: 他工作前卷起了衬衫袖口。

e.en: I had to answer the question off the {cuff}.
e.zh: 我不得不即兴回答那个问题。

cuffed.t: v. 戴上手铐；翻边（过去式）

e.en: Police {cuffed} the suspect after a brief chase.
e.zh: 警察在短暂追捕后给嫌犯戴上了手铐。

e.en: He {cuffed} his jeans above the ankle stylishly.
e.zh: 他时髦地把牛仔裤卷到了脚踝以上。

e.en: He lost a silver {cufflink} at the wedding.
e.zh: 他在婚礼上弄丢了一枚银袖扣。

e.en: The vintage {cufflink} matched his grandfather's tie clip.
e.zh: 那枚复古袖扣和他爷爷的领带夹很配。

e.en: The road {cufves} sharply near the old bridge.
e.zh: 道路在旧桥附近急剧弯曲。

e.en: This font {cufves} elegantly across the page.
e.zh: 这种字体在页面上优雅地弯曲延展。

e.en: The knight's polished {cuirass} reflected the morning sun.
e.zh: 骑士擦亮的胸甲在晨光中闪闪发亮。

e.en: Museum visitors admired the engraved bronze {cuirass}.
e.zh: 博物馆参观者欣赏着那件雕花青铜胸甲。

e.en: Thai {cuisine} balances sweet, sour, and spicy flavors.
e.zh: 泰国菜在甜、酸、辣之间取得平衡。

e.en: The hotel is famous for its French {cuisine}.
e.zh: 那家酒店以法国菜闻名。

e.en: She enrolled in a top {culinary} school in Paris.
e.zh: 她进入巴黎一所顶尖烹饪学校学习。

e.en: His {culinary} skills impressed everyone at dinner.
e.zh: 他的厨艺让晚宴上的每个人都赞叹。

cull.t:
v. 挑选；剔除
n. 宰杀（病弱动物）

e.en: The library plans to {cull} outdated reference books.
e.zh: 图书馆计划淘汰过时的参考书。

e.en: Editors {cull} the best photos for the magazine.
e.zh: 编辑会从中挑选最好的照片用于杂志。

e.en: The data was {culled} from thousands of survey responses.
e.zh: 这些数据是从数千份调查回复中筛选出来的。

e.en: Officials {culled} infected birds to stop the outbreak.
e.zh: 官员宰杀了感染的禽类以遏制疫情。

e.en: Edward {Cullen} became a household name after Twilight.
e.zh: 《暮光之城》播出后,爱德华·卡伦家喻户晓。

e.en: Mr. {Cullen} teaches advanced math at our school.
e.zh: 卡伦老师在我们学校教高等数学。

e.en: Recyclers melt down {cullet} to make new bottles.
e.zh: 回收商把碎玻璃熔化后制作新瓶子。

e.en: The factory adds {cullet} to reduce energy costs.
e.zh: 工厂掺入碎玻璃来降低能耗。

e.en: Photographers spend hours {culling} shots after a wedding.
e.zh: 摄影师在婚礼后要花几个小时筛选照片。

e.en: The park began {culling} deer to protect plants.
e.zh: 公园开始宰杀部分鹿群以保护植物。

e.en: Medieval cooks served broth as a healing {cullis}.
e.zh: 中世纪厨师用清炖肉汁作为滋补汤品。

e.en: The old recipe calls for a rich {cullis}.
e.zh: 这道古老的食谱要求加入浓郁的肉汁汤。

e.en: The algorithm {culls} duplicate entries from the database.
e.zh: 该算法会从数据库中筛除重复条目。

e.en: Every season the farmer {culls} weaker animals.
e.zh: 每个季节农夫都会淘汰较弱的牲畜。

e.en: Months of training will {culminate} in the championship final.
e.zh: 几个月的训练将以冠军决赛达到顶点。

e.en: The protests {culminate} every year on the anniversary date.
e.zh: 抗议活动每年都在周年纪念日达到高潮。

e.en: The fireworks were the {culminating} moment of the festival.
e.zh: 烟火表演是整个节日的高潮时刻。

e.en: Her speech was the {culminating} event of the conference.
e.zh: 她的演讲是会议的压轴环节。

e.en: This award is the {culmination} of a lifetime of research.
e.zh: 这个奖项是她毕生研究的最高成就。

e.en: The launch marked the {culmination} of years of hard work.
e.zh: 产品发布标志着多年努力的最终成果。

e.en: His novels each end with dramatic emotional {culminations}.
e.zh: 他的每部小说都以戏剧性的情感高潮收尾。

e.en: History books are full of revolutionary {culminations} and turning points.
e.zh: 历史书中充满了革命性的高潮和转折时刻。

e.en: She wore a black {culotte} to the office party.
e.zh: 她穿了一条黑色裙裤去公司聚会。

e.en: This linen {culotte} is perfect for hot summer days.
e.zh: 这条亚麻裙裤非常适合炎热的夏天。

e.en: The court must determine the driver's {culpability} in the crash.
e.zh: 法院必须确定司机在车祸中的过失责任。

e.en: He admitted his {culpability} and apologized publicly.
e.zh: 他承认了自己的过错并公开道歉。

culpable.t: adj. 有过错的；该受罚的

e.en: The manager was found {culpable} for the data leak.
e.zh: 经理被认定对数据泄露事件负有责任。

e.en: Anyone who lied to investigators is {culpable} too.
e.zh: 凡是对调查人员撒谎的人也难辞其咎。

culpably.t: adv. 该受责备地；有过失地

e.en: The company acted {culpably} by ignoring the safety warnings.
e.zh: 公司无视安全警告,行为应受谴责。

e.en: He {culpably} delayed the rescue operation by hours.
e.zh: 他不可原谅地将救援行动推迟了数小时。

culpeper.t: n. 卡尔佩珀（人名/地名）

e.en: We drove through {Culpeper} on our way to Virginia.
e.zh: 我们开车经过卡尔佩珀,前往弗吉尼亚州。

e.en: {Culpeper} County hosts a popular wine festival each fall.
e.zh: 卡尔佩珀县每年秋天举办一场热门的葡萄酒节。

e.en: Police are still searching for the {culprit} behind the theft.
e.zh: 警方仍在追查这起盗窃案的作案者。

e.en: A loose wire was the {culprit} causing the power outage.
e.zh: 一根松动的电线是导致停电的罪魁祸首。

cult.t:
n. 邪教；狂热崇拜
adj. 受小众追捧的

e.en: The film became a {cult} classic among college students.
e.zh: 这部电影成了大学生圈子里的邪典经典。

e.en: Police rescued several members from the dangerous {cult}.
e.zh: 警方从这个危险的邪教组织中解救出几名成员。

cultic.t: adj. 邪教的；崇拜仪式的

e.en: The book examines {cultic} practices in ancient Rome.
e.zh: 这本书研究了古罗马的祭祀崇拜活动。

e.en: The group's {cultic} rituals worried local authorities.
e.zh: 该团体的邪教式仪式引起了当地当局的担忧。

cultish.t: adj. 带邪教色彩的；狂热崇拜的

e.en: The startup has a {cultish} following among young coders.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在年轻程序员中有着狂热的追随者。

e.en: Her fitness program feels almost {cultish} to outsiders.
e.zh: 在外人看来,她的健身项目几乎像邪教一样。

cultist.t: n. 邪教徒；狂热追随者

e.en: The {cultist} refused to speak with reporters outside court.
e.zh: 这名邪教成员拒绝在法庭外与记者交谈。

e.en: He left his life as a {cultist} after years of doubt.
e.zh: 经过多年的怀疑,他终于离开了邪教徒的生活。

e.en: This apple {cultivar} is resistant to most common diseases.
e.zh: 这个苹果品种对大多数常见病害都有抗性。

e.en: Gardeners love this rose {cultivar} for its strong fragrance.
e.zh: 园丁们喜爱这个玫瑰品种,因为它香气浓郁。

e.en: Farmers {cultivate} rice in the flooded paddies every spring.
e.zh: 农民们每年春天都在水田里种植水稻。

e.en: It takes years to {cultivate} trust with new clients.
e.zh: 与新客户建立信任需要多年时间。

cultivated.t:
adj. 有教养的
v. cultivate 的过去式

e.en: She has a {cultivated} taste in classical music.
e.zh: 她对古典音乐有着颇为讲究的品味。

e.en: Most of this land was once {cultivated} by local farmers.
e.zh: 这片土地大部分曾被当地农民耕种过。

cultivates.t: v. cultivate 的第三人称单数

e.en: The school {cultivates} creativity through hands-on projects.
e.zh: 这所学校通过实践项目培养学生的创造力。

e.en: He {cultivates} tomatoes and herbs on his small balcony.
e.zh: 他在小阳台上种植西红柿和香草。

e.en: She is {cultivating} a network of industry contacts.
e.zh: 她正在积极建立行业人脉网络。

e.en: Locals have been {cultivating} this valley for centuries.
e.zh: 当地人在这片山谷耕作已有几个世纪。

e.en: Tea {cultivation} is a major industry in this region.
e.zh: 茶叶种植是这一地区的支柱产业。

e.en: The {cultivation} of good habits takes daily effort.
e.zh: 养成好习惯需要每天的努力。

e.en: He bought a small {cultivator} to till the garden.
e.zh: 他买了一台小型耕作机来翻整菜园。

e.en: She is a passionate {cultivator} of rare orchids.
e.zh: 她是一位热衷于栽培稀有兰花的园艺爱好者。

e.en: Several {cults} in the area target lonely young people.
e.zh: 该地区有几个邪教组织专门针对孤独的年轻人。

e.en: Many ancient {cults} worshipped the sun and moon.
e.zh: 许多古代崇拜团体都信奉日月。

e.en: The festival celebrates the {cultural} diversity of the city.
e.zh: 这个节日庆祝城市的文化多元性。

e.en: There is a deep {cultural} difference between the two regions.
e.zh: 两个地区之间存在深刻的文化差异。

culturally.t: adv. 在文化上；从文化角度

e.en: Singapore is a {culturally} diverse and dynamic city.
e.zh: 新加坡是一个文化多元且充满活力的城市。

e.en: The film resonates {culturally} with audiences across Asia.
e.zh: 这部电影在文化层面引起了亚洲各地观众的共鸣。

culture.t:
n. 文化；培养物
v. 培养（细菌等）

e.en: Japanese {culture} places strong emphasis on respect and harmony.
e.zh: 日本文化非常重视尊重与和谐。

e.en: The startup has a fast-paced engineering {culture}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司有着快节奏的工程师文化。

cultured.t: adj. 有教养的；人工培养的

e.en: He is a well-read and {cultured} gentleman.
e.zh: 他是一位博览群书、有教养的绅士。

e.en: Lab-{cultured} meat may soon appear on grocery shelves.
e.zh: 实验室培养的肉类可能很快会出现在超市货架上。

cultures.t: n. culture 的复数；培养物

e.en: Different {cultures} have very different ideas about politeness.
e.zh: 不同文化对礼貌的理解差别很大。

e.en: Scientists grow bacterial {cultures} in petri dishes.
e.zh: 科学家在培养皿中培养细菌菌群。

e.en: Heavy rain caused water to overflow the {culvert} under the road.
e.zh: 暴雨导致路下涵洞的水溢了出来。

e.en: Workers cleared leaves blocking the {culvert} drain.
e.zh: 工人们清理了堵塞涵洞排水口的树叶。

e.en: She graduated magna {cum} laude from Harvard last spring.
e.zh: 她去年春天以优等成绩从哈佛毕业。

e.en: The room serves as an office-{cum}-guest bedroom.
e.zh: 这个房间既是办公室,又兼作客房。

e.en: Heavy backpacks {cumber} the hikers on steep mountain trails.
e.zh: 沉重的背包让徒步者在陡峭山路上举步维艰。

e.en: Outdated rules continue to {cumber} the legal process.
e.zh: 过时的规定仍在阻碍着法律程序的推进。

e.en: We hiked along the {Cumberland} River last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们沿着坎伯兰河徒步旅行。

e.en: {Cumberland} sausages are a famous British specialty.
e.zh: 坎伯兰香肠是英国著名的特色食品。

cumbersome.t: adj. 笨重的；累赘的；麻烦的

e.en: The old approval process is slow and {cumbersome}.
e.zh: 旧的审批流程既缓慢又繁琐。

e.en: That suitcase is too {cumbersome} to carry up the stairs.
e.zh: 那个行李箱太笨重了,搬不上楼梯。

cumbria.t: n. 坎布里亚（英格兰郡名）

e.en: {Cumbria} is famous for its scenic Lake District.
e.zh: 坎布里亚以风景如画的湖区而闻名。

e.en: They moved to {Cumbria} to enjoy quieter country life.
e.zh: 他们搬到坎布里亚,享受更宁静的乡村生活。

cumbrian.t:
adj. 坎布里亚的
n. 坎布里亚人

e.en: The {Cumbrian} hills are stunning at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时分的坎布里亚丘陵美得令人惊叹。

e.en: She speaks with a soft {Cumbrian} accent.
e.zh: 她说话带着柔和的坎布里亚口音。

cumbrous.t: adj. 笨重的；累赘的（同 cumbersome）

e.en: Knights wore {cumbrous} armor that limited their movement.
e.zh: 骑士们身着笨重的盔甲,行动受到限制。

e.en: The contract uses {cumbrous} legal language no one enjoys.
e.zh: 这份合同使用了无人喜欢的累赘法律措辞。

e.en: Add a teaspoon of {cumin} to deepen the curry's flavor.
e.zh: 加一茶匙孜然可以让咖喱味道更浓郁。

e.en: The smell of toasted {cumin} filled the kitchen.
e.zh: 烘烤孜然的香气弥漫了整个厨房。

cummerbund.t: n. 腰封（礼服用宽腰带）

e.en: He wore a black {cummerbund} with his tuxedo.
e.zh: 他穿燕尾服时系着一条黑色腰封。

e.en: The groom's red {cummerbund} matched his bow tie.
e.zh: 新郎的红色腰封与他的领结相配。

e.en: Some old recipes spell the spice as {cummin} instead of cumin.
e.zh: 一些老食谱将这种香料拼作 cummin 而非 cumin。

e.en: She added a pinch of {cummin} to the lamb stew.
e.zh: 她在炖羊肉里加了一小撮孜然。

e.en: The truck is powered by a reliable {Cummins} diesel engine.
e.zh: 这辆卡车搭载了可靠的康明斯柴油发动机。

e.en: {Cummins} announced new electric powertrains last month.
e.zh: 康明斯上个月发布了新的电动动力系统。

e.en: Small daily savings can {cumulate} into a large fund.
e.zh: 每天的小额储蓄可以累积成一笔可观的资金。

e.en: Errors quickly {cumulate} when no one reviews the code.
e.zh: 如果没人审查代码,错误会迅速累积。

e.en: This award is the {cumulation} of decades of dedication.
e.zh: 这个奖项是她数十年付出的累积成果。

e.en: The {cumulation} of small mistakes ruined the project.
e.zh: 小错误的不断积累毁了整个项目。

e.en: The {cumulative} effect of stress can damage your health.
e.zh: 压力的累积效应会损害你的健康。

e.en: Your {cumulative} GPA appears on the official transcript.
e.zh: 你的累计平均绩点会显示在正式成绩单上。

cumulatively.t: adv. 累计地；逐步累积地

e.en: These features {cumulatively} make the app much faster.
e.zh: 这些功能加在一起让应用速度大大提升。

e.en: The team has {cumulatively} written over a million lines of code.
e.zh: 团队累计编写了超过一百万行代码。

e.en: Fluffy {cumulus} clouds drifted across the summer sky.
e.zh: 蓬松的积云飘过夏日的天空。

e.en: The pilot navigated carefully around the towering {cumulus}.
e.zh: 飞行员小心地绕过高耸的积云。

e.en: They booked a {Cunard} cruise across the Atlantic.
e.zh: 他们预订了一趟跨越大西洋的冠达邮轮之旅。

e.en: {Cunard} has operated luxury ocean liners for over a century.
e.zh: 冠达邮轮公司经营豪华远洋客轮已有一个多世纪。

cuneiform.t:
n. 楔形文字
adj. 楔形的

e.en: Archaeologists deciphered the ancient {cuneiform} tablets last year.
e.zh: 考古学家去年破译了那些古老的楔形文字泥板。

e.en: {Cuneiform} is one of the earliest known writing systems.
e.zh: 楔形文字是已知最早的书写系统之一。

e.en: The textbook uses the clinical term {cunnilingus} in its glossary.
e.zh: 教科书在词汇表中使用了 cunnilingus 这一医学术语。

e.en: Health educators discussed safe practices including {cunnilingus} with the class.
e.zh: 健康教育者向班级讲解了包括口交在内的安全行为。

cunning.t:
adj. 狡猾的；精明的
n. 狡诈

e.en: The fox is famous in fables for its {cunning} ways.
e.zh: 狐狸在寓言中以狡猾著称。

e.en: She came up with a {cunning} plan to solve the puzzle.
e.zh: 她想出了一个巧妙的计划来解开谜题。

e.en: He {cunningly} avoided answering the journalist's pointed question.
e.zh: 他狡猾地避开了记者尖锐的问题。

e.en: The thief {cunningly} disabled the security cameras first.
e.zh: 小偷狡猾地先把监控摄像头都关了。

cunt.t: n. 女性外阴（粗俗）；贱人（骂人）

e.en: The word {cunt} is considered extremely offensive in American English.
e.zh: 在美式英语中,cunt 一词被视为极具冒犯性的脏话。

e.en: The film was rated R partly for using {cunt} in dialogue.
e.zh: 这部电影被评为R级,部分原因是台词中使用了 cunt 这个词。

cup.t:
n. 杯子
n. 奖杯

e.en: She poured a {cup} of hot tea for me.
e.zh: 她为我倒了一杯热茶。

e.en: Our team finally won the championship {cup} this year.
e.zh: 我们队今年终于赢得了冠军奖杯。

e.en: We drove through {Cupar} on our way to St Andrews.
e.zh: 我们去圣安德鲁斯的路上经过了库帕镇。

e.en: {Cupar} is a small town in eastern Scotland.
e.zh: 库帕是苏格兰东部的一个小镇。

e.en: The mugs are in the {cupboard} above the sink.
e.zh: 马克杯放在水槽上方的橱柜里。

e.en: He hid the cookies in a high {cupboard}.
e.zh: 他把饼干藏在高处的柜子里。

e.en: All the kitchen {cupboards} were freshly painted white.
e.zh: 厨房所有的橱柜都被重新漆成了白色。

e.en: She organized the {cupboards} by food category.
e.zh: 她按食物种类整理了橱柜。

e.en: I bought a chocolate {cupcake} for her birthday.
e.zh: 我为她的生日买了一个巧克力小蛋糕。

e.en: The bakery sells gluten-free {cupcake} options.
e.zh: 这家面包店有无麸质的杯子蛋糕可选。

e.en: Add a {cupful} of flour to the mixing bowl.
e.zh: 往搅拌碗里加一杯量的面粉。

e.en: She drank a {cupful} of warm milk before bed.
e.zh: 她睡前喝了一杯温牛奶。

e.en: Valentine cards often feature a tiny {Cupid} with arrows.
e.zh: 情人节卡片上常画着拿弓箭的小丘比特。

e.en: She joked that {Cupid} had finally found her.
e.zh: 她开玩笑说丘比特终于找到她了。

e.en: His {cupidity} drove him to cheat his closest friends.
e.zh: 他的贪婪让他欺骗了最亲近的朋友。

e.en: The novel exposes the {cupidity} of corporate executives.
e.zh: 这部小说揭露了企业高管的贪婪。

e.en: A small gold {cupola} crowns the church roof.
e.zh: 教堂屋顶上有一座小小的金色圆顶。

e.en: Tourists can climb up to the {cupola} for views.
e.zh: 游客可以爬上圆顶观景。

e.en: Fancy a {cuppa} before we head out?
e.zh: 出门前要不要先喝杯茶?

e.en: Nothing beats a hot {cuppa} on a rainy morning.
e.zh: 雨天早上没什么比一杯热茶更棒了。

cupped.t: v. 把(手)弯成杯状；cup 的过去式

e.en: She {cupped} her hands to catch the falling water.
e.zh: 她双手合拢接住落下的水。

e.en: He {cupped} the candle flame against the wind.
e.zh: 他用手掌护住烛火挡风。

e.en: Please bring three {cups} of coffee from downstairs.
e.zh: 请从楼下端三杯咖啡上来。

e.en: The trophy {cups} were displayed in the lobby.
e.zh: 那些奖杯陈列在大堂里。

e.en: A scrappy {cur} barked at us from the alley.
e.zh: 一只瘦小的杂种狗在巷子里冲我们吠叫。

e.en: In old novels, villains are often called a {cur}.
e.zh: 在旧小说里,恶棍常被骂作下贱东西。

e.en: Most early-stage skin cancers are entirely {curable}.
e.zh: 大多数早期皮肤癌是完全可以治愈的。

e.en: Doctors confirmed the infection is easily {curable} with antibiotics.
e.zh: 医生确认这种感染用抗生素就能轻易治好。

e.en: He accepted a {curacy} at a small village church.
e.zh: 他接受了一个小村教堂副牧师的职位。

e.en: Her first {curacy} taught her how to lead services.
e.zh: 她第一份副牧师工作教会了她如何主持礼拜。

curate.t:
v. 策展；精选内容
n. 助理牧师

e.en: Museums {curate} exhibits to tell a coherent story.
e.zh: 博物馆策划展览是为了讲述一个连贯的故事。

e.en: The app lets you {curate} your own playlist.
e.zh: 这款应用让你自己整理播放列表。

curated.t:
adj. 精心挑选的
v. curate 的过去式

e.en: She {curated} a collection of vintage photographs online.
e.zh: 她在网上策划了一个老照片收藏展。

e.en: The newsletter offers {curated} tech news every morning.
e.zh: 这份通讯每天早上提供精选的科技新闻。

curates.t: v. 策展（第三人称单数）

e.en: This editor {curates} the best startup stories weekly.
e.zh: 这位编辑每周精选最佳创业故事。

e.en: The platform {curates} content based on your interests.
e.zh: 该平台根据你的兴趣精选内容。

e.en: She spent months {curating} the gallery's spring exhibition.
e.zh: 她花了几个月策划画廊的春季展览。

e.en: He enjoys {curating} indie music for his podcast.
e.zh: 他喜欢为自己的播客挑选独立音乐。

curation.t: n. 内容策划；精选整理

e.en: Good {curation} makes a streaming service feel personal.
e.zh: 好的内容精选让流媒体服务显得很贴心。

e.en: The museum is famous for its thoughtful {curation}.
e.zh: 这家博物馆以用心的策展闻名。

e.en: Doctors are testing a new {curative} treatment for hepatitis.
e.zh: 医生正在测试一种治疗肝炎的新疗法。

e.en: Herbal teas have long been valued for their {curative} properties.
e.zh: 草药茶长期以来因其疗效而受到重视。

e.en: The museum {curator} explained each painting in detail.
e.zh: 博物馆策展人详细讲解了每幅画作。

e.en: She works as a digital {curator} for an online gallery.
e.zh: 她在一家线上画廊担任数字策展人。

e.en: She has years of {curatorial} experience at major museums.
e.zh: 她在各大博物馆有多年的策展经验。

e.en: The {curatorial} team selected fifty works for the show.
e.zh: 策展团队为本次展览挑选了五十件作品。

e.en: The {curators} debated which artworks to feature first.
e.zh: 策展人们讨论先重点展出哪些艺术品。

e.en: Independent {curators} are reshaping how art is presented.
e.zh: 独立策展人正在改变艺术的呈现方式。

curb.t:
v. 控制；抑制
n. 路缘石

e.en: The government introduced new rules to {curb} inflation.
e.zh: 政府出台新规以抑制通胀。

e.en: He parked too close to the {curb} again.
e.zh: 他又把车停得离路缘太近了。

curbing.t:
v. 控制（进行时）
n. 路缘石材料

e.en: The city is {curbing} short-term rentals in residential areas.
e.zh: 市政府正在限制居民区的短租业务。

e.en: New stone {curbing} lined the entire street.
e.zh: 整条街都铺上了新的石头路缘。

e.en: Many restaurants now offer {curbside} pickup for orders.
e.zh: 许多餐厅现在提供路边取餐服务。

e.en: Place the recycling bin at the {curbside} by Tuesday.
e.zh: 周二之前把回收桶放到路边。

e.en: Fresh cheese {curd} squeaks when you bite it.
e.zh: 新鲜的奶酪凝乳咬起来会吱吱响。

e.en: Lemon {curd} tastes wonderful spread on warm scones.
e.zh: 柠檬凝乳涂在热司康饼上特别好吃。

e.en: Adding lemon juice will {curdle} the warm milk quickly.
e.zh: 加柠檬汁会让温牛奶很快凝结。

e.en: Stories of the haunted house made my blood {curdle}.
e.zh: 鬼屋的故事让我血液都要凝固了。

curdled.t:
adj. 已凝结的
v. curdle 的过去式

e.en: The cream {curdled} after sitting out all afternoon.
e.zh: 奶油在外面放了一下午就结块了。

e.en: Her smile {curdled} when she heard the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息,她的笑容僵住了。

cure.t:
v. 治愈；解决
n. 疗法

e.en: Scientists are searching for a {cure} for Alzheimer's disease.
e.zh: 科学家正在寻找治疗阿尔茨海默病的方法。

e.en: A long walk can {cure} a bad mood.
e.zh: 长时间散步能治愈坏心情。

cured.t: v. 治愈（过去式）；腌制过的

e.en: The medication completely {cured} her chronic headaches.
e.zh: 这种药物彻底治好了她的慢性头痛。

e.en: This ham was {cured} with salt for six months.
e.zh: 这块火腿用盐腌制了六个月。

cures.t:
v. 治愈（第三人称单数）
n. 疗法（复数）

e.en: There are still no {cures} for the common cold.
e.zh: 普通感冒至今仍没有特效治疗方法。

e.en: Grandma swears coffee {cures} her morning grogginess.
e.zh: 奶奶坚信咖啡能治她早上的困倦。

e.en: The doctor recommended {curettage} to remove the abnormal tissue.
e.zh: 医生建议做刮除术去除异常组织。

e.en: Dental {curettage} cleans bacteria from below the gumline.
e.zh: 牙龈刮治术能清除牙龈下方的细菌。

e.en: My parents set a strict 10 p.m. {curfew}.
e.zh: 我父母定下了晚上十点必须回家的严格规定。

e.en: The city imposed a {curfew} after the protests escalated.
e.zh: 抗议升级后,城市实施了宵禁。

curia.t: n. 罗马教廷；古罗马元老院

e.en: The Roman {Curia} advises the Pope on church matters.
e.zh: 罗马教廷在教会事务上为教宗提供建议。

e.en: Reforms within the {Curia} have been slow but steady.
e.zh: 教廷内部的改革缓慢但稳步推进。

e.en: The radioactivity was measured in millicuries, not a full {curie}.
e.zh: 放射性以毫居里为单位测量,不到一个完整居里。

e.en: Marie {Curie} won two Nobel Prizes in different sciences.
e.zh: 玛丽·居里在不同学科领域获得了两次诺贝尔奖。

e.en: Researchers are close to {curing} certain genetic disorders.
e.zh: 研究人员距离治愈某些遗传病已经很近了。

e.en: The bacon needs three weeks of {curing} before smoking.
e.zh: 培根在熏制前需要腌制三周。

e.en: She picked up a strange {curio} at the flea market.
e.zh: 她在跳蚤市场买了一件奇怪的小古玩。

e.en: His shelf is filled with travel {curio} from Asia.
e.zh: 他的架子上摆满了从亚洲带回的小玩意儿。

e.en: The shop sold antique clocks and other Victorian {curiosities}.
e.zh: 这家店出售古董钟和其他维多利亚时代的稀奇物件。

e.en: Children asked endless {curiosities} about the night sky.
e.zh: 孩子们对夜空提出了无数好奇的问题。

curiosity.t:
n. 好奇心
n. 奇物；珍品

e.en: Her natural {curiosity} makes her a great researcher.
e.zh: 她天生的好奇心让她成为出色的研究员。

e.en: Out of {curiosity}, I clicked the mysterious link.
e.zh: 出于好奇,我点开了那个神秘链接。

curious.t:
adj. 好奇的
adj. 奇怪的

e.en: I'm {curious} about how this algorithm actually works.
e.zh: 我很好奇这个算法到底是怎么运作的。

e.en: A {curious} cat poked its head through the fence.
e.zh: 一只好奇的猫从篱笆里探出了头。

e.en: The dog tilted its head and stared {curiously}.
e.zh: 那只狗歪着头好奇地盯着看。

e.en: {Curiously}, the package arrived three days early.
e.zh: 奇怪的是,包裹提前三天就到了。

curl.t:
v. 使卷曲
n. 卷发；卷状物

e.en: My hair tends to {curl} in humid weather.
e.zh: 我的头发在潮湿天气里容易卷起来。

e.en: The cat likes to {curl} up on my laptop.
e.zh: 这只猫喜欢蜷缩在我的笔记本电脑上。

curled.t:
adj. 卷曲的
v. curl 的过去式

e.en: She {curled} up under the blanket with a book.
e.zh: 她蜷缩在毯子下看书。

e.en: The smoke {curled} slowly toward the ceiling.
e.zh: 烟雾缓缓盘旋升向天花板。

curler.t: n. 卷发器；冰壶运动员

e.en: She wrapped her hair around a hot {curler}.
e.zh: 她把头发绕在一个热卷发器上。

e.en: Each {curler} produces a slightly different wave shape.
e.zh: 每种卷发器卷出的波浪形状都略有不同。

e.en: A lone {curlew} called across the misty marsh.
e.zh: 一只孤独的杓鹬在雾蒙蒙的沼泽上鸣叫。

e.en: The {curlew} uses its long beak to probe mud.
e.zh: 杓鹬用它长长的喙在泥里探食。

e.en: She signed her name with an elaborate {curlicue}.
e.zh: 她在签名末尾画了一个精致的花体卷线。

e.en: The wallpaper has tiny {curlicue} patterns throughout.
e.zh: 这种墙纸上到处是小小的螺旋花纹。

curling.t:
v. 卷曲；蜷缩
n. 冰壶（运动）

e.en: Canada has dominated international {curling} competitions for decades.
e.zh: 加拿大几十年来在国际冰壶比赛中占据主导地位。

e.en: Steam was {curling} up from the hot soup.
e.zh: 热腾腾的汤上方升起袅袅蒸汽。

curls.t:
n. 卷发；卷曲物
v. 卷曲（curl 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Her blonde {curls} bounced as she ran downstairs.
e.zh: 她跑下楼时金色卷发一跳一跳的。

e.en: The smoke {curls} gracefully from the chimney.
e.zh: 烟雾从烟囱里优雅地袅袅升起。

e.en: Her {curly} hair bounced as she walked into the room.
e.zh: 她走进房间时，一头卷发随之跳动。

e.en: JSON objects are wrapped in {curly} braces.
e.zh: JSON 对象用花括号包起来。

curmudgeon.t: n. 脾气坏的老人；老顽固

e.en: The old {curmudgeon} next door never waves back.
e.zh: 隔壁那个爱发牢骚的老头从不回应招手。

e.en: Don't be such a {curmudgeon} at the office party.
e.zh: 在公司聚会上别那么爱挑刺嘛。

curmudgeonly.t: adj. 脾气暴躁的；乖戾的

e.en: He gave a {curmudgeonly} grunt and shut the door.
e.zh: 他不耐烦地咕哝一声，把门关上了。

e.en: Her {curmudgeonly} comments hide a kind heart.
e.zh: 她那些刻薄的话其实掩盖着一颗善良的心。

curragh.t: n. 爱尔兰传统兽皮小船

e.en: Fishermen still row a {curragh} along the Irish coast.
e.zh: 渔民们至今仍在爱尔兰海岸划着传统的柳条小船。

e.en: The wooden {curragh} skimmed across the choppy bay.
e.zh: 那只木制柳条艇轻快地掠过波涛起伏的海湾。

currant.t: n. 醋栗；无核小葡萄干

e.en: She added a handful of dried {currant} to the scones.
e.zh: 她在烤饼里加了一把无核小葡萄干。

e.en: The black {currant} jam tastes wonderfully tart.
e.zh: 那瓶黑加仑果酱酸得恰到好处。

e.en: Travelers can exchange dozens of {currencies} at the airport.
e.zh: 旅客可以在机场兑换几十种货币。

e.en: Crypto {currencies} have reshaped global finance.
e.zh: 加密货币已经重塑了全球金融格局。

currency.t:
n. 货币；流通
n. 通用；流行程度

e.en: The euro is the official {currency} of most EU countries.
e.zh: 欧元是大多数欧盟国家的官方货币。

e.en: That slang has lost its {currency} among teenagers.
e.zh: 那种俚语在青少年中已经不流行了。

current.t:
adj. 当前的；现行的
n. 电流；水流

e.en: What is your {current} job title?
e.zh: 你目前的职位是什么？

e.en: A strong {current} pulled the swimmer out to sea.
e.zh: 一股强劲的水流把那名泳者卷向大海。

e.en: The website is {currently} down for maintenance.
e.zh: 网站目前正在维护中。

e.en: She is {currently} working on a new novel.
e.zh: 她目前正在创作一部新小说。

currents.t: n. 水流；电流（current 的复数）

e.en: Ocean {currents} affect weather patterns worldwide.
e.zh: 洋流影响着全球的天气格局。

e.en: Political {currents} are shifting before the election.
e.zh: 选举前夕，政治潮流正在发生变化。

e.en: Universities are updating their {curricula} for the AI era.
e.zh: 各大学正在为人工智能时代更新课程体系。

e.en: Different schools follow very different {curricula}.
e.zh: 不同学校采用的课程设置差别很大。

curricular.t: adj. 课程的；与课程相关的

e.en: The school added coding to its {curricular} requirements.
e.zh: 学校将编程列入了课程要求。

e.en: Sports count as extra-{curricular} activities here.
e.zh: 在这里，体育属于课外活动。

e.en: The new {curriculum} emphasizes critical thinking.
e.zh: 新课程更注重批判性思维的培养。

e.en: Please attach your {curriculum} vitae to the application.
e.zh: 请将简历附在申请表后面。

curried.t:
adj. 加咖喱烹制的
v. 用咖喱烹调（过去式）

e.en: She served {curried} chicken with steamed rice.
e.zh: 她端上了咖喱鸡配米饭。

e.en: He {curried} favor with the boss by working late.
e.zh: 他靠加班来讨好老板。

curries.t: n. 咖喱菜（curry 的复数）

e.en: This restaurant offers a dozen Thai {curries}.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应十几种泰式咖喱。

e.en: He {curries} favor with management at every chance.
e.zh: 他一有机会就向管理层献殷勤。

currish.t: adj. 卑劣的；像杂种狗的

e.en: His {currish} remarks embarrassed everyone at dinner.
e.zh: 他那些卑劣的话让晚餐桌上每个人都感到尴尬。

e.en: I won't tolerate such {currish} behavior from staff.
e.zh: 我不会容忍员工如此下作的行为。

curry.t:
n. 咖喱
v. 用咖喱烹调

e.en: Let's order green {curry} for dinner tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我们点份绿咖喱当晚饭吧。

e.en: Stop trying to {curry} favor with the manager.
e.zh: 别再想方设法讨好经理了。

curse.t:
v. 诅咒；咒骂
n. 诅咒；祸根

e.en: He muttered a {curse} when his laptop crashed.
e.zh: 笔记本电脑死机时，他低声骂了一句。

e.en: Some say the old house lies under a {curse}.
e.zh: 有人说那栋老房子被下了诅咒。

cursed.t:
adj. 被诅咒的；该死的
v. 诅咒（过去式）

e.en: He {cursed} loudly after stubbing his toe.
e.zh: 他踢到脚趾后大声骂了起来。

e.en: The {cursed} printer jammed again before the meeting.
e.zh: 那台该死的打印机在开会前又卡纸了。

curses.t:
n. 诅咒（复数）
v. 诅咒（第三人称单数）

e.en: The driver {curses} every time traffic stops.
e.zh: 每次堵车，司机都会咒骂几句。

e.en: Ancient legends speak of {curses} on the tomb.
e.zh: 古老的传说讲述着加在那座陵墓上的诅咒。

cursing.t:
v. 咒骂；诅咒
n. 咒骂

e.en: He kicked the printer, {cursing} under his breath.
e.zh: 他踢了一脚打印机，嘴里低声咒骂着。

e.en: Stop {cursing} in front of the children.
e.zh: 别在孩子们面前骂脏话。

cursive.t:
adj. 草书的；连笔的
n. 草书字体

e.en: Schools rarely teach {cursive} writing anymore.
e.zh: 现在学校很少再教草体书写了。

e.en: Her wedding invitations were printed in elegant {cursive}.
e.zh: 她的婚礼请柬印着优雅的连体字。

cursor.t: n. 光标（屏幕上的指示符）

e.en: Move the {cursor} to the search bar and click.
e.zh: 把光标移到搜索栏然后点击。

e.en: My mouse {cursor} keeps freezing during video calls.
e.zh: 视频通话时我的鼠标光标老是卡住。

e.en: He glanced {cursorily} at the contract before signing.
e.zh: 他草草地扫了一眼合同就签了字。

e.en: She mentioned the issue {cursorily} in her email.
e.zh: 她在邮件里只是顺带提了一下这个问题。

e.en: Designers can choose from many custom {cursors} online.
e.zh: 设计师可以在网上挑选各种自定义光标。

e.en: Two {cursors} blinked on the shared document.
e.zh: 共享文档上有两个光标在闪烁。

e.en: A {cursory} glance at the data showed obvious errors.
e.zh: 粗略一看数据就能发现明显错误。

e.en: The inspector did only a {cursory} check of the brakes.
e.zh: 检查员只对刹车做了草率的检查。

curt.t: adj. 言辞简短的；唐突无礼的

e.en: His {curt} reply made her feel unwelcome.
e.zh: 他简短生硬的回答让她觉得不受欢迎。

e.en: She gave a {curt} nod and walked away.
e.zh: 她冷冷地点了点头，转身走开了。

e.en: The company had to {curtail} spending this quarter.
e.zh: 公司本季度不得不削减开支。

e.en: New rules will {curtail} smartphone use in classrooms.
e.zh: 新规将限制课堂上使用智能手机。

curtailed.t: v. 缩减（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: Bad weather {curtailed} our weekend plans.
e.zh: 恶劣天气打乱了我们的周末计划。

e.en: The government {curtailed} press freedom overnight.
e.zh: 政府一夜之间就限制了新闻自由。

e.en: The {curtailment} of public services angered residents.
e.zh: 公共服务的削减惹怒了当地居民。

e.en: Drought led to a {curtailment} of water usage.
e.zh: 干旱导致用水量受到限制。

curtain.t:
n. 窗帘；幕布
v. 用帘遮住

e.en: Please draw the {curtain} before turning on the light.
e.zh: 开灯前请先把窗帘拉上。

e.en: The {curtain} rose to reveal a stunning stage.
e.zh: 幕布升起，露出一个惊艳的舞台。

curtained.t: adj. 挂有帘子的；用帘隔开的

e.en: Sunlight barely entered the heavily {curtained} room.
e.zh: 阳光几乎照不进那间窗帘厚重的房间。

e.en: The {curtained} window hid the view of the alley.
e.zh: 挂着窗帘的窗户挡住了小巷的景象。

e.en: The {curtainless} windows let in too much morning light.
e.zh: 那些没挂窗帘的窗户让晨光涌入太多。

e.en: Their loft has stylish {curtainless} floor-to-ceiling glass.
e.zh: 他们的阁楼有时尚的无窗帘落地玻璃。

curtains.t:
n. 窗帘（复数）
n. 完蛋（俚语）

e.en: She bought new {curtains} for the living room.
e.zh: 她为客厅买了新窗帘。

e.en: If the deal falls through, it's {curtains} for the startup.
e.zh: 如果交易告吹，那家初创公司就完蛋了。

curtly.t: adv. 唐突地；简短无礼地

e.en: He answered {curtly} and hung up the phone.
e.zh: 他生硬地答了一句就挂了电话。

e.en: "No comment," she said {curtly} to the reporters.
e.zh: "无可奉告，"她对记者们冷冷地说道。

curtsey.t:
n. 屈膝礼
v. 行屈膝礼

e.en: The young dancer dropped a graceful {curtsey} on stage.
e.zh: 那位年轻舞者在台上优雅地行了个屈膝礼。

e.en: Children traditionally {curtsey} when meeting the queen.
e.zh: 按传统，孩子们见到女王时要行屈膝礼。

curtsy.t:
n. 屈膝礼
v. 行屈膝礼

e.en: She gave a small {curtsy} after the performance.
e.zh: 演出结束后她微微行了个屈膝礼。

e.en: Girls used to learn to {curtsy} at finishing school.
e.zh: 女孩们过去会在淑女学校学习行屈膝礼。

curvaceous.t: adj. (女性身材) 曲线优美的

e.en: The model showcased a {curvaceous} silhouette on the runway.
e.zh: 模特在 T 台上展示出曲线玲珑的身材。

e.en: He admired the {curvaceous} design of the new sports car.
e.zh: 他赞赏那辆新跑车线条优美的设计。

e.en: Astronauts can clearly see the {curvature} of the Earth.
e.zh: 宇航员可以清楚地看到地球的弧度。

e.en: The doctor measured the {curvature} of her spine.
e.zh: 医生测量了她脊柱的弯曲度。

curve.t:
n. 曲线；弯道
v. 弯曲；成曲线

e.en: Slow down before the sharp {curve} ahead.
e.zh: 前方有急转弯，请减速。

e.en: The sales {curve} climbed steadily all year.
e.zh: 销售曲线全年稳步上升。

e.en: The interviewer threw me a {curveball} question.
e.zh: 面试官给我抛出了一个意想不到的问题。

e.en: He struck out swinging at a nasty {curveball}.
e.zh: 他挥棒打了个空，被一个刁钻的曲线球三振出局。

e.en: The new monitor has a slightly {curved} screen.
e.zh: 这款新显示器有一块微微弯曲的屏幕。

e.en: The path {curved} gently around the lake.
e.zh: 小径沿着湖边轻柔地弯曲延伸。

curves.t: n. 曲线（复数）；身材曲线

e.en: The mountain road {curves} through dense pine forest.
e.zh: 那条山路蜿蜒穿过茂密的松林。

e.en: Designers studied the elegant {curves} of the vase.
e.zh: 设计师们研究着那只花瓶优雅的曲线。

curvilinear.t: adj. 由曲线构成的；曲线形的

e.en: The architect favors {curvilinear} forms over sharp angles.
e.zh: 这位建筑师偏爱曲线造型，而非锐利的棱角。

e.en: The data fits a {curvilinear} rather than linear model.
e.zh: 这些数据更符合曲线模型，而不是线性模型。

curving.t:
v. 弯曲；成曲线
adj. 弯曲的

e.en: A {curving} staircase led up to the second floor.
e.zh: 一道弧形楼梯通往二楼。

e.en: The river kept {curving} eastward through the valley.
e.zh: 那条河不断向东蜿蜒穿过山谷。

curvy.t: adj. 有曲线的；凹凸有致的

e.en: The brand designs jeans for {curvy} body types.
e.zh: 这个品牌专为丰满身材设计牛仔裤。

e.en: The {curvy} mountain road made me carsick.
e.zh: 那条弯弯曲曲的山路让我晕车了。

cushier.t: adj. 更轻松的、更舒适的（cushy 的比较级）

e.en: He landed a {cushier} job with shorter hours.
e.zh: 他找到了一份更轻松、工时更短的工作。

e.en: Business class seats are much {cushier} than economy.
e.zh: 商务舱的座椅比经济舱舒适得多。

cushion.t:
n. 垫子；靠垫
v. 缓冲、减轻冲击

e.en: She propped a {cushion} behind her back on the sofa.
e.zh: 她在沙发上把靠垫垫在背后。

e.en: Savings can {cushion} the impact of unexpected expenses.
e.zh: 存款可以缓冲意外开销带来的冲击。

cushioned.t: adj. 有软垫的；有缓冲的

e.en: These running shoes are well {cushioned} for long miles.
e.zh: 这双跑鞋缓震良好，适合长距离跑步。

e.en: Strong sales {cushioned} the company against rising costs.
e.zh: 强劲的销售缓解了公司面临的成本上涨压力。

cushioning.t:
n. 缓冲材料
v. 缓冲（cushion 的进行式）

e.en: The new sneakers offer extra {cushioning} under the heel.
e.zh: 这双新运动鞋的脚跟处提供了额外的缓震。

e.en: Bonus payments are {cushioning} the blow of layoffs.
e.zh: 奖金正在缓解裁员带来的冲击。

cushions.t:
n. 垫子（复数）
v. 缓冲（第三人称单数）

e.en: The sofa {cushions} are stained from last night's party.
e.zh: 沙发的靠垫被昨晚的派对弄脏了。

e.en: Insurance {cushions} the family against unexpected medical bills.
e.zh: 保险能缓冲家庭应对突如其来的医疗账单。

cushiony.t: adj. 像软垫一样柔软的

e.en: These running shoes have a {cushiony} sole that feels great.
e.zh: 这双跑鞋有软垫鞋底,穿起来很舒服。

e.en: She sank into the {cushiony} armchair after a long day.
e.zh: 漫长的一天后,她陷进松软的扶手椅里。

cushy.t: adj. 轻松惬意的（工作、生活）

e.en: He landed a {cushy} job at his uncle's company.
e.zh: 他在叔叔的公司找到了一份轻松的工作。

e.en: Working from home is a pretty {cushy} lifestyle.
e.zh: 在家办公是一种相当舒适的生活方式。

cusp.t: n. 尖端；转折点（on the cusp of）

e.en: AI is on the {cusp} of changing how we work.
e.zh: 人工智能正处于改变我们工作方式的临界点。

e.en: She was born on the {cusp} of two zodiac signs.
e.zh: 她出生在两个星座的交界处。

cuss.t:
v. 咒骂、说脏话
n. 家伙

e.en: Don't {cuss} in front of the children, please.
e.zh: 请不要在孩子面前说脏话。

e.en: He's a stubborn old {cuss} who never listens.
e.zh: 他是个从不听劝的固执老家伙。

cussing.t: v. 骂脏话（cuss 的进行式）

e.en: Stop {cussing} at the referee, you'll get ejected.
e.zh: 别再骂裁判了,你会被罚下场的。

e.en: The mechanic was {cussing} under his breath at the engine.
e.zh: 修车师傅低声咒骂着那台发动机。

e.en: I'd like apple pie with warm {custard} on top.
e.zh: 我想要苹果派,上面浇上温热的蛋奶酱。

e.en: She baked a creamy vanilla {custard} for dessert.
e.zh: 她烤了一份奶香十足的香草蛋奶冻当甜点。

e.en: The mother was awarded {custodial} rights after the divorce.
e.zh: 离婚后母亲获得了孩子的监护权。

e.en: He works in a {custodial} role at the local school.
e.zh: 他在当地学校做清洁工作。

e.en: The {custodian} unlocks the gym at six every morning.
e.zh: 管理员每天早上六点打开体育馆。

e.en: Museums act as {custodian} of priceless cultural treasures.
e.zh: 博物馆是无价文化珍宝的守护者。

custodianship.t: n. 监管权；保管人身份

e.en: The grandmother accepted {custodianship} of her two grandchildren.
e.zh: 祖母接受了对两个孙辈的监护权。

e.en: The temple has been under family {custodianship} for centuries.
e.zh: 这座寺庙数百年来一直由家族世代守护。

custodies.t: n. 监护权；保管（custody 的复数）

e.en: Several suspects are currently in police {custodies} across the country.
e.zh: 多名嫌疑人目前在全国各地被警方羁押。

e.en: The court reviewed both parents' {custodies} arrangements carefully.
e.zh: 法院仔细审查了父母双方的监护安排。

e.en: The suspect remains in police {custody} pending trial.
e.zh: 嫌疑人在审判前仍被警方羁押。

e.en: She won full {custody} of their two children.
e.zh: 她获得了两个孩子的完全监护权。

custom.t:
n. 习俗；惯例
adj. 定制的

e.en: It's a {custom} to remove your shoes before entering.
e.zh: 进门前脱鞋是一种习俗。

e.en: He ordered a {custom} suit for the wedding.
e.zh: 他为婚礼定制了一套西装。

e.en: Tips are {customarily} added to restaurant bills in America.
e.zh: 在美国,小费通常会加在餐厅账单里。

e.en: She {customarily} drinks green tea after dinner.
e.zh: 她习惯在晚餐后喝绿茶。

e.en: It's {customary} to bring a small gift when visiting.
e.zh: 拜访时带份小礼物是惯例。

e.en: He gave his {customary} morning greeting to the doorman.
e.zh: 他像往常一样向门卫问早安。

e.en: The {customer} complained about the slow delivery service.
e.zh: 顾客抱怨配送服务太慢。

e.en: Every {customer} receives a free welcome drink at the bar.
e.zh: 每位顾客都能在吧台领到一杯免费迎宾饮品。

e.en: Loyal {customers} get early access to our new products.
e.zh: 老客户可以优先体验我们的新品。

e.en: The cafe was packed with {customers} on Sunday morning.
e.zh: 咖啡馆在周日早晨挤满了顾客。

customisation.t: n. 定制；自定义（英式拼写）

e.en: The app offers extensive {customisation} of themes and fonts.
e.zh: 这款应用提供丰富的主题和字体自定义选项。

e.en: {Customisation} of the dashboard takes only a few clicks.
e.zh: 自定义仪表板只需几次点击即可完成。

customise.t: v. 定制；自定义（英式拼写）

e.en: You can {customise} the home screen with widgets.
e.zh: 你可以用小组件自定义主屏幕。

e.en: Buyers may {customise} the car's color and interior trim.
e.zh: 买家可以自定义车辆的颜色和内饰。

e.en: She received a {customised} keyboard with her name engraved.
e.zh: 她收到了一把刻有自己名字的定制键盘。

e.en: The trainer built a {customised} workout plan for me.
e.zh: 教练为我量身定制了一份健身计划。

customizable.t: adj. 可定制的；可自定义的

e.en: The dashboard is fully {customizable} to fit your workflow.
e.zh: 仪表板完全可自定义,以适配你的工作流程。

e.en: Players love the {customizable} characters in this game.
e.zh: 玩家很喜欢这款游戏里可自定义的角色。

e.en: You can {customize} notifications in the settings menu.
e.zh: 你可以在设置菜单里自定义通知。

e.en: Let's {customize} the proposal for each client.
e.zh: 我们针对每个客户定制一份提案吧。

e.en: Netflix shows a {customized} list of recommendations for each user.
e.zh: Netflix 会为每位用户显示定制的推荐列表。

e.en: He drives a {customized} Jeep with off-road tires.
e.zh: 他开着一辆改装过的吉普车,装着越野轮胎。

customs.t:
n. 海关；关税
n. 习俗（复数）

e.en: We were stopped at {customs} for over an hour.
e.zh: 我们在海关被拦下了一个多小时。

e.en: Local {customs} vary widely from one village to another.
e.zh: 当地风俗在各村之间差别很大。

cut.t:
v. 切、剪；削减
n. 切口；剪辑

e.en: Please {cut} the onions into small pieces.
e.zh: 请把洋葱切成小块。

e.en: The company plans to {cut} jobs next quarter.
e.zh: 公司计划在下个季度裁员。

e.en: The patient developed a mild {cutaneous} reaction to the antibiotic.
e.zh: 患者对抗生素出现了轻微的皮肤反应。

e.en: Doctors examined the strange {cutaneous} rash on his arm.
e.zh: 医生检查了他手臂上奇怪的皮疹。

cutaway.t:
n. 剖面图
adj. 剪开式的

e.en: The textbook shows a {cutaway} view of a car engine.
e.zh: 教科书展示了汽车发动机的剖面图。

e.en: The director added a {cutaway} shot to the action scene.
e.zh: 导演在动作场景中加入了一个切换镜头。

cutback.t: n. 削减；缩减（开支、人员）

e.en: The school faces a serious {cutback} in government funding.
e.zh: 学校面临政府拨款的大幅削减。

e.en: Staff worry about the upcoming {cutback} in benefits.
e.zh: 员工们担心即将到来的福利削减。

e.en: That puppy in the window is so {cute}.
e.zh: 橱窗里那只小狗太可爱了。

e.en: Don't get {cute} with me, just answer the question.
e.zh: 别跟我耍小聪明,直接回答问题。

e.en: The toddler {cutely} waved goodbye to the cashier.
e.zh: 小宝宝可爱地向收银员挥手再见。

e.en: She {cutely} mispronounced the word and made everyone smile.
e.zh: 她把那个词说得萌萌的,逗笑了所有人。

e.en: The puppy's {cuteness} got hundreds of likes online.
e.zh: 那只小狗的萌样在网上获得了成百上千个赞。

e.en: I can't resist the {cuteness} of baby pandas.
e.zh: 我抵抗不了大熊猫宝宝的可爱。

cutesy.t: adj. 刻意卖萌的；做作可爱的

e.en: The cafe has a {cutesy} pink and floral decor.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆装修得粉嫩花俏,有点可爱过头。

e.en: His {cutesy} nicknames for everyone got annoying fast.
e.zh: 他给每个人取的卖萌小绰号很快就让人厌烦。

e.en: The manicurist gently pushed back my {cuticle}.
e.zh: 美甲师轻轻地把我的指甲表皮往后推。

e.en: Use oil to keep your {cuticle} soft and healthy.
e.zh: 用护甲油保持指甲表皮柔软健康。

e.en: Your baby sister is such a {cutie}.
e.zh: 你的小妹妹真是个小可爱。

e.en: That guy at the coffee shop is a real {cutie}.
e.zh: 咖啡店那个男生真是个小帅哥。

cutlass.t: n. 短弯刀（昔日水手武器）

e.en: The pirate raised his {cutlass} and shouted a warning.
e.zh: 海盗举起短弯刀大声发出警告。

e.en: A rusty {cutlass} hung above the tavern fireplace.
e.zh: 一把生锈的短弯刀挂在酒馆的壁炉上方。

e.en: The {cutler} sharpened the chef's knives to perfection.
e.zh: 刀匠把厨师的刀磨得完美锋利。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a {cutler} in Sheffield.
e.zh: 他祖父在谢菲尔德当过刀具匠。

e.en: Please set the {cutlery} on the dining table.
e.zh: 请把餐具摆到餐桌上。

e.en: The hotel uses silver-plated {cutlery} for fancy dinners.
e.zh: 酒店在正式晚宴上使用镀银餐具。

e.en: She ordered a breaded chicken {cutlet} with mashed potatoes.
e.zh: 她点了一份面包屑炸鸡排配土豆泥。

e.en: The pork {cutlet} was crispy outside and juicy inside.
e.zh: 那块炸猪排外酥里嫩。

cutoff.t:
n. 截止点；切断
adj. 截止的

e.en: The application {cutoff} is midnight on Friday.
e.zh: 申请截止时间是周五午夜。

e.en: He wore faded {cutoff} jeans to the beach.
e.zh: 他穿着褪色的剪短牛仔裤去海滩。

cutout.t:
n. 剪纸；镂空图案
n. 断路器

e.en: A life-sized {cutout} of the actor stood in the lobby.
e.zh: 大堂里立着那位演员的真人大小立牌。

e.en: Her dress had a small {cutout} at the back.
e.zh: 她的裙子背后有一处小镂空。

cuts.t:
n. 切口；削减
v. cut 的第三人称单数

e.en: The chef expertly {cuts} the fish into thin slices.
e.zh: 厨师熟练地把鱼切成薄片。

e.en: The government announced new tax {cuts} for small businesses.
e.zh: 政府宣布对小企业实施新的减税政策。

cutter.t:
n. 切割工具；裁刀
n. 小快艇

e.en: Use a pizza {cutter} to slice it evenly.
e.zh: 用披萨刀把它切得均匀些。

e.en: The coast guard {cutter} patrolled the harbor at night.
e.zh: 海岸警卫队的快艇夜间在港口巡逻。

cutthroat.t:
adj. 激烈的；残酷的
n. 凶手

e.en: The startup world is fiercely {cutthroat} these days.
e.zh: 如今创业界竞争极其残酷。

e.en: She survived years in the {cutthroat} fashion industry.
e.zh: 她在你死我活的时尚界打拼了多年。

cutting.t:
n. 切割；剪报
adj. 锋利的；尖刻的

e.en: He's {cutting} vegetables for tonight's stir-fry.
e.zh: 他正在切菜准备今晚的炒菜。

e.en: The lab uses {cutting}-edge technology in its research.
e.zh: 实验室在研究中使用尖端技术。

e.en: She took {cuttings} from the rose bush to plant elsewhere.
e.zh: 她从玫瑰丛上剪下插枝准备种到别处。

e.en: He keeps newspaper {cuttings} about his favorite team.
e.zh: 他保存着关于自己喜欢球队的报纸剪报。

e.en: Fried {cuttlefish} is a popular dish in Mediterranean restaurants.
e.zh: 炸墨鱼是地中海餐厅里很受欢迎的菜肴。

e.en: The {cuttlefish} changed color to blend with the rocks.
e.zh: 墨鱼变换颜色以融入岩石环境。

cutty.t: adj. 短小的（苏格兰方言）

e.en: The old fisherman smoked a stubby {cutty} pipe on deck.
e.zh: 老渔夫在甲板上抽着一只短柄烟斗。

e.en: He told a Scottish tale about a witch in a {cutty} sark.
e.zh: 他讲了一个关于穿短衬衫的女巫的苏格兰故事。

e.en: The tablecloth featured delicate floral {cutwork} along the edges.
e.zh: 桌布的边缘饰有精致的花卉镂空绣。

e.en: Her grandmother taught her traditional {cutwork} embroidery.
e.zh: 她的祖母教她传统的镂空刺绣。

e.en: A {cutworm} destroyed half the seedlings overnight.
e.zh: 一只夜盗虫一夜之间毁掉了半数幼苗。

e.en: Gardeners use collars to protect plants from {cutworm} damage.
e.zh: 园丁们用护根圈来保护植物免受夜盗虫侵害。

e.en: We spent three days exploring the ancient streets of {Cuzco}.
e.zh: 我们花了三天时间游览库斯科的古老街道。

e.en: {Cuzco} was the historic capital of the Inca Empire.
e.zh: 库斯科曾是印加帝国的历史首都。

e.en: I picked up my prescription at the {CVS} on the corner.
e.zh: 我在街角的CVS药店取了处方药。

e.en: Most developers use Git instead of {CVS} these days.
e.zh: 现在大多数开发者用Git而不是CVS。

e.en: We hiked into a deep {cwm} carved by ancient glaciers.
e.zh: 我们徒步走进一个由古冰川凿出的深谷。

e.en: A small lake glittered at the bottom of the {cwm}.
e.zh: 一个小湖在冰斗谷底闪闪发光。

e.en: The farmer sold ten {cwt} of potatoes at the market.
e.zh: 农民在市场上卖掉了十英担土豆。

e.en: Coal used to be priced by the {cwt} in Britain.
e.zh: 煤炭过去在英国按英担计价。

cyan.t:
n. 青色
adj. 青蓝色的

e.en: She painted the kitchen walls a bright {cyan}.
e.zh: 她把厨房墙壁刷成了亮青色。

e.en: Printers mix {cyan}, magenta, and yellow to make colors.
e.zh: 打印机用青色、品红和黄色调出各种颜色。

e.en: The detective found traces of {cyanide} in the victim's tea.
e.zh: 侦探在受害者的茶里发现了氰化物的痕迹。

e.en: Mining operations sometimes use {cyanide} to extract gold.
e.zh: 采矿业有时用氰化物来提取黄金。

e.en: {Cyanobacteria} bloom turned the lake a sickly green.
e.zh: 蓝藻爆发把湖水染成了病态的绿色。

e.en: Ancient {cyanobacteria} helped fill the early atmosphere with oxygen.
e.zh: 远古蓝藻帮助早期大气充满了氧气。

e.en: Scientists are studying {cyanobacterial} blooms in coastal waters.
e.zh: 科学家正在研究沿海水域的蓝藻爆发。

e.en: The lake's {cyanobacterial} toxins made the water unsafe to drink.
e.zh: 湖中蓝藻毒素让水变得不能饮用。

cybele.t: n. 库柏勒（古代大地女神）

e.en: Ancient Romans built temples to honor the goddess {Cybele}.
e.zh: 古罗马人建造神庙来祭祀女神库柏勒。

e.en: The myth of {Cybele} originated in ancient Anatolia.
e.zh: 库柏勒的神话起源于古代安纳托利亚。

e.en: Her brother became a total {cyberaddict} during the pandemic.
e.zh: 她哥哥在疫情期间彻底成了网瘾者。

e.en: The therapist specializes in helping each {cyberaddict} reduce screen time.
e.zh: 这位治疗师专门帮助网瘾者减少使用屏幕的时间。

e.en: Many young {cyberaddicts} struggle to sleep without their phones.
e.zh: 许多年轻网瘾者没有手机就睡不着。

e.en: The clinic offers group therapy for recovering {cyberaddicts}.
e.zh: 该诊所为康复中的网瘾者提供团体治疗。

e.en: We checked our email at a {cybercafe} in Bangkok.
e.zh: 我们在曼谷的一家网吧查了邮件。

e.en: The old {cybercafe} downtown finally closed last month.
e.zh: 市中心那家老网吧上个月终于关门了。

e.en: Teenagers retreat into digital {cybercaves} to escape reality.
e.zh: 青少年躲进数字洞穴来逃避现实。

e.en: The novel describes hidden {cybercaves} where hackers gather online.
e.zh: 小说描写了黑客在网上聚集的隐秘网络洞穴。

e.en: {Cybercrime} costs the global economy trillions of dollars each year.
e.zh: 网络犯罪每年给全球经济造成数万亿美元损失。

e.en: The FBI has a special unit dedicated to fighting {cybercrime}.
e.zh: 联邦调查局有专门打击网络犯罪的部门。

e.en: Phishing and ransomware are among the most common {cybercrimes} today.
e.zh: 钓鱼和勒索软件是当今最常见的网络犯罪。

e.en: Police investigated several {cybercrimes} targeting elderly residents.
e.zh: 警方调查了多起针对老年居民的网络犯罪。

e.en: The soldier received a {cybernetic} arm after the accident.
e.zh: 那名士兵在事故后装上了一只电子机械手臂。

e.en: Researchers explore {cybernetic} systems that mimic biological feedback loops.
e.zh: 研究人员在探索模仿生物反馈回路的控制论系统。

e.en: Norbert Wiener founded the field of {cybernetics} in the 1940s.
e.zh: 诺伯特·维纳在二十世纪四十年代创立了控制论。

e.en: She studies {cybernetics} to design smarter robotic prosthetics.
e.zh: 她研究控制论以设计更智能的机器人义肢。

e.en: My daughter begged me to buy her a virtual {cyberpet}.
e.zh: 我女儿央求我给她买一只虚拟电子宠物。

e.en: The {cyberpet} died because nobody fed it for days.
e.zh: 那只电子宠物因为好几天没人喂而死了。

e.en: Tamagotchi {cyberpets} were hugely popular in the late nineties.
e.zh: 拓麻歌子电子宠物在九十年代末非常流行。

e.en: Modern apps let kids raise {cyberpets} on their phones.
e.zh: 现代应用让孩子们在手机上养电子宠物。

cyberpunk.t: n. 赛博朋克（科幻风格）

e.en: Blade Runner remains the definitive {cyberpunk} film of all time.
e.zh: 《银翼杀手》依然是史上最经典的赛博朋克电影。

e.en: He decorated his room in a neon {cyberpunk} aesthetic.
e.zh: 他把房间布置成霓虹赛博朋克风格。

e.en: Many families chose {cyberschool} during the lockdown years.
e.zh: 封锁那几年许多家庭选择了网络学校。

e.en: Pennsylvania has several public {cyberschool} programs available statewide.
e.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州有多个全州可选的公立网络学校项目。

e.en: Critics argue that {cyberschools} lack proper social interaction for students.
e.zh: 批评者认为网络学校缺乏让学生进行适当社交互动的环境。

e.en: Several {cyberschools} now offer full high school diplomas online.
e.zh: 现在有几所网络学校在线提供完整的高中文凭。

cyberspace.t: n. 网络空间；赛博空间

e.en: William Gibson coined the term {cyberspace} in his 1984 novel.
e.zh: 威廉·吉布森在1984年的小说中创造了赛博空间一词。

e.en: Hackers move through {cyberspace} like ghosts through walls.
e.zh: 黑客在赛博空间中穿行,如同幽灵穿墙。

e.en: Different online communities create distinct {cyberspaces} with their own rules.
e.zh: 不同的在线社区创造出各有规则的虚拟空间。

e.en: Researchers map how users navigate various {cyberspaces} daily.
e.zh: 研究者绘制用户每天如何在各种虚拟空间中穿行。

e.en: Governments worldwide are increasing defenses against {cyberterrorism}.
e.zh: 世界各国政府正在加强对网络恐怖主义的防御。

e.en: The attack on the power grid was classified as {cyberterrorism}.
e.zh: 对电网的攻击被定性为网络恐怖主义。

e.en: Children today grow up navigating a complex {cyberworld}.
e.zh: 如今的孩子从小就在复杂的网络世界中穿行。

e.en: She lost herself in the {cyberworld} for hours every night.
e.zh: 她每晚都在网络世界里沉迷数小时。

e.en: The movie features a {cyborg} sent back from the future.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述了一名从未来被派回来的半机械人。

e.en: Some argue we are already {cyborg} thanks to our smartphones.
e.zh: 有人认为因为智能手机,我们已经是半机械人了。

e.en: The {cycad} in the garden looks like a small palm tree.
e.zh: 花园里的苏铁看起来像一棵小棕榈树。

e.en: Fossils show {cycad} plants thrived during the dinosaur era.
e.zh: 化石显示苏铁类植物在恐龙时代繁盛一时。

cycladic.t: adj. 基克拉泽斯群岛的

e.en: The museum displays beautiful marble {Cycladic} figurines from ancient Greece.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了来自古希腊的精美基克拉迪大理石小雕像。

e.en: Whitewashed houses give the islands their iconic {Cycladic} look.
e.zh: 刷白的房屋赋予了这些岛屿标志性的基克拉迪风貌。

e.en: She placed a pink {cyclamen} on the windowsill for decoration.
e.zh: 她在窗台上摆了一盆粉色仙客来作装饰。

e.en: The {cyclamen} blooms beautifully throughout the cold winter months.
e.zh: 仙客来在寒冷的冬季里依然开得很美。

e.en: Adenylate {cyclase} converts ATP into a key signaling molecule.
e.zh: 腺苷酸环化酶将ATP转化为一种关键信号分子。

e.en: Researchers study how {cyclase} enzymes regulate cellular communication.
e.zh: 研究人员研究环化酶如何调节细胞间的通讯。

cycle.t:
n. 周期；循环
v. 骑自行车

e.en: The washing machine completes one {cycle} in about an hour.
e.zh: 洗衣机大约一小时完成一个洗涤周期。

e.en: He likes to {cycle} to work every morning.
e.zh: 他喜欢每天早上骑自行车去上班。

cycled.t: v. cycle 的过去式；循环；骑行

e.en: She {cycled} along the river path for two hours yesterday.
e.zh: 她昨天沿着河边小路骑了两个小时自行车。

e.en: The economy has {cycled} through several booms and busts recently.
e.zh: 经济近期经历了几轮繁荣与衰退的循环。

cycles.t:
n. 周期；循环（复数）
v. 骑行

e.en: The moon goes through phases in roughly 29-day {cycles}.
e.zh: 月亮大约以29天为周期经历各个相位。

e.en: He {cycles} to the office whenever the weather permits.
e.zh: 只要天气允许,他就骑车去办公室。

e.en: The new {cycleway} runs along the river all the way downtown.
e.zh: 新的自行车道沿着河边一直通到市中心。

e.en: Drivers must yield to bikes crossing the {cycleway}.
e.zh: 司机必须让横穿自行车道的自行车先行。

e.en: In DNA, {cytosine} always pairs with guanine.
e.zh: 在DNA中，胞嘧啶总是与鸟嘌呤配对。

e.en: The mutation replaced one {cytosine} base with thymine.
e.zh: 这个突变把一个胞嘧啶碱基替换成了胸腺嘧啶。

e.en: Many chemotherapy drugs are {cytotoxic} to fast-growing cells.
e.zh: 许多化疗药物对快速生长的细胞具有细胞毒性。

e.en: The compound proved highly {cytotoxic} in lab tests.
e.zh: 这种化合物在实验室测试中显示出很强的细胞毒性。

czar.t:
n. 沙皇
n. 权威人物

e.en: The president appointed a new drug {czar} last month.
e.zh: 总统上个月任命了一位新的禁毒事务总管。

e.en: In Russia, the {czar} ruled with absolute power for centuries.
e.zh: 在俄国，沙皇曾拥有绝对权力统治数个世纪。

e.en: The young {czarina} was deeply unpopular among the Russian people.
e.zh: 那位年轻的女皇在俄国民众中极不受欢迎。

e.en: Catherine the Great is the most famous {czarina} in history.
e.zh: 叶卡捷琳娜大帝是历史上最著名的女沙皇。

czarist.t:
adj. 沙皇的
n. 沙皇拥护者

e.en: The museum displays uniforms from the {czarist} era.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了沙皇时代的军服。

e.en: Many noble families fled abroad after the {czarist} regime collapsed.
e.zh: 沙皇政权垮台后，许多贵族家族逃往国外。

czech.t:
adj. 捷克的
n. 捷克人；捷克语

e.en: She ordered a {Czech} pilsner with her schnitzel.
e.zh: 她点了一杯捷克皮尔森啤酒配炸肉排。

e.en: Many {Czech} films from the 1960s are now considered classics.
e.zh: 许多上世纪六十年代的捷克电影如今被视为经典。

czechoslovak.t:
adj. 捷克斯洛伐克的
n. 捷克斯洛伐克人

e.en: My grandparents carried {Czechoslovak} passports in the 1970s.
e.zh: 我的祖父母在七十年代持有捷克斯洛伐克护照。

e.en: The {Czechoslovak} hockey team beat the Soviets in 1969.
e.zh: 捷克斯洛伐克冰球队在1969年击败了苏联队。

czechoslovakia.t: n. 捷克斯洛伐克（旧国名）

e.en: {Czechoslovakia} peacefully split into two countries in 1993.
e.zh: 捷克斯洛伐克于1993年和平分裂成两个国家。

e.en: Her grandfather emigrated from {Czechoslovakia} after the war.
e.zh: 她的祖父在战后从捷克斯洛伐克移民出来。

e.en: He inherited an old {Czechoslovakian} crystal vase from his aunt.
e.zh: 他从姑妈那里继承了一只老式捷克斯洛伐克水晶花瓶。

e.en: The film features a {Czechoslovakian} setting during the Cold War.
e.zh: 这部电影背景设定在冷战时期的捷克斯洛伐克。

e.en: The fashion industry follows a {cyclic} pattern of returning trends.
e.zh: 时尚行业遵循着潮流不断回归的循环模式。

e.en: Hormone levels show {cyclic} variation throughout the month.
e.zh: 激素水平在整个月里呈现周期性变化。

e.en: Unemployment tends to be {cyclical}, rising during economic downturns.
e.zh: 失业往往是周期性的,在经济低迷期上升。

e.en: History often feels {cyclical} when you study it long enough.
e.zh: 研究历史够久后,你会觉得它常常是循环的。

e.en: Housing prices tend to rise and fall {cyclically} over decades.
e.zh: 几十年来房价往往呈周期性涨跌。

e.en: The disease symptoms appear {cyclically}, every few months.
e.zh: 这种疾病的症状每隔几个月周期性出现。

e.en: {Cycling} to work has improved both my fitness and mood.
e.zh: 骑车上班既改善了我的体能,也让心情变好了。

e.en: Professional {cycling} requires years of dedicated training.
e.zh: 职业自行车运动需要多年的专注训练。

e.en: The lab tracked several thermal {cyclings} of the battery prototype.
e.zh: 实验室记录了电池原型的多次热循环。

e.en: Different {cyclings} in the wash program suit different fabrics.
e.zh: 洗涤程序中不同的循环模式适合不同的面料。

e.en: A {cyclist} was hit by a car at the intersection yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天一名骑自行车的人在路口被车撞了。

e.en: She trained for years to become a professional {cyclist}.
e.zh: 她训练多年才成为职业自行车运动员。

cyclists.t: n. 骑自行车的人（复数）

e.en: Many {cyclists} gathered at dawn for the charity ride.
e.zh: 许多自行车手在黎明时分聚集参加慈善骑行。

e.en: Drivers should always give {cyclists} plenty of room when passing.
e.zh: 司机超车时应该给自行车手留出足够的空间。

cyclo.t: 前缀. 环状的；循环的

e.en: We toured Hanoi by {cyclo} during our vacation last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天度假时我们坐三轮车游览了河内。

e.en: The old man pedaled his {cyclo} slowly through the market.
e.zh: 老人慢慢蹬着他的人力三轮车穿过市场。

e.en: A powerful {cyclone} struck the coast and flooded several towns.
e.zh: 一场强烈气旋袭击了海岸,淹没了好几个城镇。

e.en: The {cyclone} warning forced thousands of residents to evacuate.
e.zh: 气旋警报迫使数千居民撤离。

e.en: Forecasters detected {cyclonic} activity forming over the warm ocean.
e.zh: 气象预报员探测到温暖洋面上正在形成气旋活动。

e.en: The {cyclonic} winds tore roofs off several homes.
e.zh: 气旋大风掀翻了好几户人家的屋顶。

cyclop.t: n. 独眼巨人（cyclops 的异体）

e.en: Children laughed at the one-eyed {cyclop} drawn on the page.
e.zh: 孩子们看着书页上画的独眼巨人哈哈大笑。

e.en: The story features a friendly {cyclop} who befriends a sailor.
e.zh: 故事里有一个和水手成了朋友的友善独眼巨人。

cyclopean.t: adj. 独眼巨人般的；巨大的

e.en: Ancient builders moved {cyclopean} stones to construct the massive walls.
e.zh: 古代工匠搬动巨石来建造那些宏伟的城墙。

e.en: The cathedral stands as a {cyclopean} achievement of medieval engineering.
e.zh: 这座大教堂是中世纪工程的巨型成就。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {cyclophosphamide} as part of her chemotherapy regimen.
e.zh: 医生开了环磷酰胺作为她化疗方案的一部分。

e.en: {Cyclophosphamide} is used to treat several types of cancer.
e.zh: 环磷酰胺被用来治疗多种类型的癌症。

cyclops.t: n. 独眼巨人（希腊神话）

e.en: Odysseus blinded the {cyclops} with a sharpened wooden stake.
e.zh: 奥德修斯用削尖的木桩刺瞎了独眼巨人。

e.en: The child drew a friendly {cyclops} eating an ice cream cone.
e.zh: 那个孩子画了一个吃冰淇淋筒的友善独眼巨人。

e.en: The theater installed a huge {cyclorama} to project sky backdrops.
e.zh: 剧院安装了一块巨大的环形天幕来投射天空背景。

e.en: Visitors marveled at the painted Civil War {cyclorama} in Atlanta.
e.zh: 游客们赞叹亚特兰大那幅描绘内战的环形画。

cyclosporin.t: n. 环孢素（免疫抑制剂）

e.en: Transplant patients often take {cyclosporin} to prevent organ rejection.
e.zh: 移植患者常服用环孢素以防止器官排斥。

e.en: The doctor adjusted her {cyclosporin} dose after the blood test.
e.zh: 血液检查后医生调整了她的环孢素剂量。

e.en: The lab built a {cyclotron} to accelerate protons for cancer therapy.
e.zh: 实验室建造了一台回旋加速器，用于癌症治疗的质子加速。

e.en: Physicists used the {cyclotron} to smash atoms at incredible speeds.
e.zh: 物理学家用回旋加速器以惊人的速度撞击原子。

e.en: A fluffy gray {cygnet} swam close behind its mother.
e.zh: 一只毛茸茸的灰色小天鹅紧跟在母亲身后游着。

e.en: The pond hosts six swans and one newborn {cygnet} this spring.
e.zh: 今年春天池塘里有六只天鹅和一只刚出生的小天鹅。

e.en: The engine has four pistons, one in each {cylinder}.
e.zh: 这台发动机有四个活塞，每个气缸里一个。

e.en: She rolled the paper into a tight {cylinder} and taped it.
e.zh: 她把纸卷成一个紧实的圆筒并用胶带粘好。

e.en: The bottle has a slim {cylindrical} shape that fits any cup holder.
e.zh: 这个瓶子细长的圆柱形状可以放进任何杯架。

e.en: Engineers tested a {cylindrical} fuel tank for the new rocket.
e.zh: 工程师为新火箭测试了一个圆柱形燃料箱。

e.en: The drummer hit the {cymbal} hard at the end of the song.
e.zh: 鼓手在歌曲结尾用力敲响了铙钹。

e.en: A loud {cymbal} crash startled everyone in the hall.
e.zh: 一声响亮的铙钹声惊动了大厅里的每个人。

e.en: The road sign welcomed drivers to {Cymru} in both Welsh and English.
e.zh: 那块路牌用威尔士语和英语欢迎司机进入威尔士。

e.en: Football fans chanted "{Cymru} am byth" to support their national team.
e.zh: 球迷高呼"威尔士万岁"来支持他们的国家队。

e.en: Even the office {cynic} admitted the new policy was working.
e.zh: 连办公室里最爱唱反调的人也承认新政策有效。

e.en: Don't be such a {cynic}; some people really do mean well.
e.zh: 别这么愤世嫉俗，有些人真的是出于好意。

cynical.t: adj. 愤世嫉俗的；怀疑的

e.en: He gave a {cynical} laugh when she mentioned corporate ethics.
e.zh: 她提到企业道德时，他冷嘲似地笑了一声。

e.en: Years in politics had made her deeply {cynical} about promises.
e.zh: 多年的政治生涯让她对各种承诺深感怀疑。

e.en: He smiled {cynically} when the CEO promised raises for everyone.
e.zh: 当首席执行官承诺给所有人加薪时，他冷笑了一下。

e.en: Critics {cynically} dismissed the announcement as a publicity stunt.
e.zh: 评论家们讥讽地把这则声明斥为炒作。

cynicism.t: n. 愤世嫉俗；犬儒主义

e.en: Her writing is filled with sharp humor and gentle {cynicism}.
e.zh: 她的文字充满了犀利的幽默和温和的讥讽。

e.en: Public {cynicism} about politicians has reached a new high.
e.zh: 公众对政客的不信任已经达到新高。

e.en: The novel is full of small {cynicisms} about modern office life.
e.zh: 这部小说里充满了对现代职场的种种冷嘲。

e.en: His casual {cynicisms} began to wear on his coworkers.
e.zh: 他随口的讥讽渐渐让同事们感到厌烦。

e.en: Even the {cynics} agreed the team played a brilliant game.
e.zh: 连最爱挑刺的人也承认这支球队踢得精彩。

e.en: {Cynics} predicted the startup would fail within a year.
e.zh: 唱衰者预言这家初创公司一年内就会倒闭。

e.en: The young actress was the {cynosure} of every camera at the gala.
e.zh: 那位年轻女演员是晚会上所有镜头的焦点。

e.en: His debut novel quickly became the {cynosure} of literary critics.
e.zh: 他的处女作小说很快成为文学评论家关注的焦点。

e.en: Spies sent messages in a {cypher} only their handler could read.
e.zh: 间谍用只有他们的接头人才能解读的密码发送消息。

e.en: Rappers gathered in a {cypher} and traded freestyle verses.
e.zh: 说唱歌手们围成一圈，互相即兴对唱。

e.en: Tall {cypress} trees lined the road to the old villa.
e.zh: 高大的柏树排列在通往老别墅的路两旁。

e.en: We hiked through a swamp full of moss-draped {cypress}.
e.zh: 我们徒步穿过一片挂满苔藓的柏树沼泽。

cypriot.t:
n. 塞浦路斯人
adj. 塞浦路斯的

e.en: She runs a small {Cypriot} restaurant famous for its grilled halloumi.
e.zh: 她经营着一家以烤哈鲁米奶酪闻名的塞浦路斯小餐馆。

e.en: The {Cypriot} government announced new tourism incentives last week.
e.zh: 塞浦路斯政府上周宣布了新的旅游业激励措施。

e.en: We spent a sunny week in {Cyprus} swimming and exploring ruins.
e.zh: 我们在塞浦路斯度过了阳光明媚的一周，游泳并探访古迹。

e.en: {Cyprus} joined the European Union back in 2004.
e.zh: 塞浦路斯早在2004年就加入了欧盟。

cyrano.t: n. 西哈诺（人名，常指大鼻子情圣）

e.en: He played {Cyrano} on Broadway and won rave reviews.
e.zh: 他在百老汇饰演西哈诺，获得了如潮好评。

e.en: She acted as a {Cyrano}, ghostwriting love texts for her shy friend.
e.zh: 她当起西哈诺，替害羞的朋友代写情话。

cyrillic.t: adj. 西里尔字母的（俄语等）

e.en: Russian and Bulgarian both use the {Cyrillic} alphabet.
e.zh: 俄语和保加利亚语都使用西里尔字母。

e.en: He learned to read {Cyrillic} script during his year in Moscow.
e.zh: 他在莫斯科的那一年学会了读西里尔文。

e.en: The doctor drained a small {cyst} on her wrist.
e.zh: 医生给她手腕上的一个小囊肿做了引流。

e.en: An ultrasound revealed a harmless {cyst} on the ovary.
e.zh: 超声检查发现卵巢上有一个良性囊肿。

e.en: Her brother was born with {cystic} fibrosis and uses inhalers daily.
e.zh: 她哥哥生来就患有囊性纤维化，每天都要使用吸入器。

e.en: The scan showed a {cystic} mass that needed further testing.
e.zh: 扫描显示有一个囊性肿块，需要进一步检查。

e.en: Drinking lots of water helps prevent {cystitis} from coming back.
e.zh: 多喝水有助于防止膀胱炎复发。

e.en: She visited the clinic for painful {cystitis} symptoms.
e.zh: 她因为膀胱炎引起的疼痛症状去了诊所。

e.en: The urologist scheduled a {cystoscopy} to check her bladder.
e.zh: 泌尿科医生安排了一次膀胱镜检查来检查她的膀胱。

e.en: A routine {cystoscopy} revealed a small benign growth.
e.zh: 一次常规膀胱镜检查发现了一个小的良性增生。

e.en: {Cytochrome} proteins play a key role in cellular respiration.
e.zh: 细胞色素蛋白在细胞呼吸中起着关键作用。

e.en: The drug is metabolized by a specific {cytochrome} enzyme.
e.zh: 这种药物由特定的细胞色素酶代谢分解。

e.en: {Cytogenetic} testing helped identify the chromosomal abnormality.
e.zh: 细胞遗传学检测帮助识别出染色体异常。

e.en: The lab specializes in {cytogenetic} analysis of leukemia samples.
e.zh: 该实验室专门对白血病样本进行细胞遗传学分析。

e.en: A massive {cytokine} release can make COVID infections dangerous.
e.zh: 大量细胞因子的释放会使新冠感染变得危险。

e.en: Researchers measured {cytokine} levels to track the immune response.
e.zh: 研究人员测量细胞因子水平来追踪免疫反应。

e.en: The {cytologic} report confirmed the cells were noncancerous.
e.zh: 细胞学报告确认这些细胞为非癌性。

e.en: Doctors ordered a {cytologic} exam of the fluid sample.
e.zh: 医生要求对体液样本进行细胞学检查。

e.en: A pap smear is a common form of {cytology} screening.
e.zh: 宫颈涂片是一种常见的细胞学筛查方法。

e.en: She specializes in {cytology} and reviews dozens of slides daily.
e.zh: 她专攻细胞学，每天要审阅数十张玻片。

e.en: {Cytomegalovirus} can be especially dangerous for newborn babies.
e.zh: 巨细胞病毒对新生儿尤其危险。

e.en: Doctors test transplant patients for {cytomegalovirus} regularly.
e.zh: 医生会定期为器官移植病人检测巨细胞病毒。

e.en: Most chemical reactions in a cell happen inside the {cytoplasm}.
e.zh: 细胞内的大多数化学反应都发生在细胞质中。

e.en: The microscope clearly showed organelles floating in the {cytoplasm}.
e.zh: 显微镜下可以清楚看到细胞器漂浮在细胞质中。

e.en: The protein performs its main function in the {cytoplasmic} space.
e.zh: 该蛋白质在细胞质空间内执行其主要功能。

e.en: Scientists tracked {cytoplasmic} streaming under a high-powered microscope.
e.zh: 科学家在高倍显微镜下追踪细胞质的流动。

chancier.t: a. 不确定的, 偶然发生的

vi. 冷却, 平息
vt. 使冷却, 使平静

costlier.t: a. 昂贵的, 奢华的, 费用大的

craftswomen.t: n. 女工匠,女手艺人,女工艺师

craftier.t: a. 狡诈的, 诡计多端的, 巧妙的

craftiest.t: a. 狡诈的, 诡计多端的, 巧妙的

crappiest.t: a. <俚>蹩脚的, 没价值的, 讨厌的

crassest.t: a. 粗俗的, 愚钝的, 粗糙的, 非常的

crazier.t: a. 发狂的, 狂热的

creamiest.t: a. 含乳脂的, 乳脂状的, 奶油色的\n[建] 含乳油的, 似乳油的

creepier.t: a. 爬行的, 令人毛骨悚然的

crematoria.t: n. 焚尸炉, 火葬场\na. 火葬的

crispest.t: a. 脆的, 新鲜的, 活泼的\nv. (使)烘脆, (使)拳曲, (使)起皱\nn. 松脆物

crispiest.t: a. 卷曲的, 松脆的, 易碎的, 干脆的, 干净利落的, 生气勃勃的

crudest.t: a. 天然的, 未成熟的, 粗糙的, 粗鲁的\nn. 天然的物质

cruellest.t: a. 残酷的, 令人极痛苦的\n[法] 残忍的, 残酷的

crustier.t: a. 有硬皮的, 易怒的\n[建] 硬的, 有壳的, 似外皮的

cuddlier.t: a. 可爱的, 适于搂抱的, 喜欢拥抱的, 可拥抱的

cuddliest.t: a. 可爱的, 适于搂抱的, 喜欢拥抱的, 可拥抱的

curlier.t: a. 拳曲的, 卷毛的, 弯曲的

curliest.t: a. 拳曲的, 卷毛的, 弯曲的

curtsied.t: n. 屈膝礼\nvi. 行屈膝礼

curvier.t: a. 弯曲的；曲线美的（等于curvaceous）

cushiest.t: a. 舒适的, 安逸的

cutest.t: a. 可爱的, 聪明的, 伶俐的\n[医] 品他病

cabriole.t: 弯腿式家具腿；芭蕾跃腿动作

e.en: The antique table stood on graceful {cabriole} legs.
e.zh: 那张古董桌立在优雅的弯腿式桌脚上。

e.en: She executed a perfect {cabriole} during the ballet.
e.zh: 她在芭蕾舞中完成了一个完美的跃腿动作。

cabstand.t: 出租车候客站；计程车招呼站

e.en: We waited at the {cabstand} outside the hotel.
e.zh: 我们在酒店外的出租车候客站等候。

e.en: The {cabstand} near the station is always busy.
e.zh: 车站附近的出租车候客站总是很繁忙。

e.en: She ordered chicken {cacciatore} at the Italian restaurant.
e.zh: 她在意大利餐厅点了猎人式番茄炖鸡。

e.en: The {cacciatore} sauce simmered with herbs and tomatoes.
e.zh: 猎人酱汁与香草和番茄一同慢炖。

e.en: He mixed a caipirinha with fresh lime and {cachaca}.
e.zh: 他用新鲜青柠和巴西甘蔗酒调了一杯卡琵莉亚。

e.en: {Cachaca} is Brazil's most popular distilled spirit.
e.zh: 卡莎萨酒是巴西最受欢迎的蒸馏酒。

e.en: The {cachalot} dove deep in search of giant squid.
e.zh: 那头抹香鲸潜入深海寻找大乌贼。

e.en: Whalers once hunted the {cachalot} for its valuable oil.
e.zh: 捕鲸者过去为获取珍贵鲸油而猎杀抹香鲸。

e.en: The {cachectic} patient had lost considerable muscle mass.
e.zh: 这位恶病质患者已经流失了大量肌肉。

e.en: Late-stage cancer often produces a {cachectic} appearance.
e.zh: 晚期癌症常使人显出极度消瘦的外貌。

cachepot.t: 装饰性花盆套；花盆外饰

e.en: She placed the orchid in a porcelain {cachepot}.
e.zh: 她把那株兰花放进瓷质装饰花盆套里。

e.en: A brass {cachepot} hid the plain plastic pot inside.
e.zh: 一只黄铜花盆套遮住了里面普通的塑料盆。

e.en: Advanced cancer often leads to severe {cachexia}.
e.zh: 晚期癌症常常导致严重的恶病质。

e.en: Doctors monitored him closely for signs of {cachexia}.
e.zh: 医生密切观察他是否出现恶病质的症状。

e.en: The drunken guests began to {cachinnate} loudly.
e.zh: 那些醉醺醺的客人开始放声狂笑。

e.en: It is rude to {cachinnate} during a solemn ceremony.
e.zh: 在庄严的仪式上狂笑是无礼的。

e.en: He {cachinnated} at his own joke for minutes.
e.zh: 他为自己讲的笑话狂笑了好几分钟。

e.en: The audience {cachinnated} when the clown tripped.
e.zh: 小丑摔倒时观众放声大笑。

cachinnates.t: 放声大笑（第三人称单数）

e.en: She always {cachinnates} when watching slapstick comedies.
e.zh: 她看闹剧喜剧时总是放声大笑。

e.en: The villain {cachinnates} after every dastardly deed.
e.zh: 那个反派每做完一件坏事都狂笑不止。

e.en: They sat in the bar {cachinnating} over old memories.
e.zh: 他们坐在酒吧里因往事而放声大笑。

e.en: The {cachinnating} crowd disturbed the neighboring tables.
e.zh: 那群狂笑的人打扰到了邻桌。

e.en: Loud {cachinnation} echoed through the empty hall.
e.zh: 响亮的狂笑声在空荡的大厅里回荡。

e.en: Her sudden {cachinnation} startled everyone at the table.
e.zh: 她突然的放声大笑吓到了桌上所有人。

e.en: She popped a {cachou} to freshen her breath.
e.zh: 她含了一粒清口香丸来清新口气。

e.en: Smokers once used a {cachou} after each cigarette.
e.zh: 过去吸烟者每抽完一支烟就含一粒清口香丸。

e.en: He said the film was utter {cack}.
e.zh: 他说那部电影完全是垃圾。

e.en: Mind you don't step in dog {cack}.
e.zh: 小心别踩到狗屎。

e.en: His {cack-handed} attempt at repairs made things worse.
e.zh: 他笨手笨脚的修理把事情弄得更糟。

e.en: She gave a {cack-handed} apology that offended everyone.
e.zh: 她给出一个拙劣的道歉，反而冒犯了所有人。

e.en: Ancient texts warned of a {cacodaemon} haunting the woods.
e.zh: 古籍警告说有一只恶魔出没在那片森林中。

e.en: He believed a {cacodaemon} was tormenting his dreams.
e.zh: 他相信有邪灵在折磨他的梦境。

e.en: The novel describes a {cacodaemonic} presence in the castle.
e.zh: 小说描写了城堡里的恶魔气息。

e.en: Her {cacodaemonic} laughter chilled the listeners.
e.zh: 她那邪魔般的笑声让听者心寒。

e.en: The shaman claimed to banish the {cacodemon} from the village.
e.zh: 那位萨满声称要把恶魔从村里驱走。

e.en: In folklore, a {cacodemon} brings nightmares and misfortune.
e.zh: 在民间传说中，恶魔会带来噩梦和厄运。

e.en: A {cacodemonic} aura surrounded the abandoned house.
e.zh: 那座废弃的房子被一种邪魔般的气息笼罩。

e.en: He wore a mask with a {cacodemonic} grin.
e.zh: 他戴着一副带有邪魔狞笑的面具。

e.en: The {cacodorous} swamp drove visitors away.
e.zh: 那片散发恶臭的沼泽把游客都赶走了。

e.en: Workers complained about the {cacodorous} chemicals nearby.
e.zh: 工人们抱怨附近散发恶臭的化学品。

e.en: The bishop denounced the sect's {cacodoxy} from the pulpit.
e.zh: 主教在讲道台上谴责该教派的异端邪说。

e.en: Medieval theologians wrote treatises against {cacodoxy}.
e.zh: 中世纪神学家撰写论著反对错误教义。

e.en: Bunsen's research on {cacodyl} nearly killed him.
e.zh: 本生关于卡可基的研究险些要了他的命。

e.en: {Cacodyl} compounds are notorious for their foul odor.
e.zh: 卡可基化合物以其恶臭而臭名昭著。

cacodylate.t: 二甲次胂酸盐；卡可酸盐

e.en: The lab used sodium {cacodylate} as a buffer.
e.zh: 实验室使用二甲次胂酸钠作为缓冲剂。

e.en: {Cacodylate} buffers are common in electron microscopy.
e.zh: 卡可酸盐缓冲液常用于电子显微镜技术。

cacodylic.t: 二甲次胂酸的；卡可酸的

e.en: {Cacodylic} acid was once used as a herbicide.
e.zh: 二甲次胂酸曾被用作除草剂。

e.en: Researchers handled the {cacodylic} compound with care.
e.zh: 研究人员小心处理这种卡可酸化合物。

e.en: The herald carried a {caducean} staff entwined with serpents.
e.zh: 传令官手持缠绕双蛇的商神杖。

e.en: He wore a {caducean} emblem on his lapel.
e.zh: 他在翻领上佩戴着商神杖徽章。

e.en: Two golden {caducei} flanked the temple entrance.
e.zh: 两根金色双蛇杖立在神庙入口两侧。

e.en: The museum displayed several ancient {caducei}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了几根古代的双蛇杖。

e.en: The {caduceus} is often mistaken for a medical symbol.
e.zh: 双蛇杖常被误认作医学标志。

e.en: Hermes is depicted holding a {caduceus}.
e.zh: 赫尔墨斯被描绘成手持双蛇杖。

e.en: The poem laments the {caducity} of youth.
e.zh: 这首诗哀叹青春的短暂。

e.en: He spoke of the {caducity} of all earthly things.
e.zh: 他谈到尘世万物的转瞬即逝。

e.en: The flower has {caducous} sepals that fall when it opens.
e.zh: 这种花的萼片早落，开花时即脱落。

e.en: Botanists noted the {caducous} leaves of the species.
e.zh: 植物学家记录了该物种的早落叶。

e.en: The dissection revealed enlarged {caeca} in the specimen.
e.zh: 解剖显示标本的盲肠肿大。

e.en: Birds have paired {caeca} that aid digestion.
e.zh: 鸟类有成对的盲肠以助消化。

e.en: The surgeon examined the {caecal} wall for inflammation.
e.zh: 外科医生检查盲肠壁是否发炎。

e.en: A {caecal} tumor was discovered during the scan.
e.zh: 扫描中发现了一处盲肠肿瘤。

e.en: The {caecilian} burrows through damp tropical soil.
e.zh: 蚓螈在潮湿的热带土壤中钻洞。

e.en: Researchers studied a rare species of {caecilian}.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了一种稀有的蚓螈。

e.en: Mammals diversified rapidly during the {caenozoic} era.
e.zh: 哺乳动物在新生代时期迅速分化。

e.en: The fossils date from the early {caenozoic} period.
e.zh: 这些化石可追溯到新生代早期。

caesaropapism.t: 政教合一；皇帝教皇主义

e.en: Byzantine rule has often been characterized by {caesaropapism}.
e.zh: 拜占庭统治常被认为是政教合一的体制。

e.en: Critics accused the regime of practicing {caesaropapism}.
e.zh: 批评者指责该政权奉行政教合一。

e.en: The grass grows in dense {caespitose} clumps.
e.zh: 这种草以浓密的丛生方式生长。

e.en: Botanists described the plant as {caespitose}.
e.zh: 植物学家将这种植物描述为丛生型。

e.en: The poem's {caesurae} create a deliberate rhythmic pause.
e.zh: 这首诗的中顿营造出有意的节奏停顿。

e.en: He marked the {caesurae} in the manuscript.
e.zh: 他在手稿上标出了各处中顿。

e.en: The line has a strong {caesural} break in the middle.
e.zh: 这行诗中间有明显的中顿。

e.en: She analyzed the {caesural} pattern of the verse.
e.zh: 她分析了这段诗的中顿格式。

e.en: She brewed coffee in a {cafetiere} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上用法压壶煮咖啡。

e.en: The {cafetiere} is easier to clean than an espresso machine.
e.zh: 法压壶比浓缩咖啡机更容易清洗。

cafetorium.t: 餐厅兼礼堂（学校多功能厅）

e.en: The school assembly was held in the {cafetorium}.
e.zh: 学校集会在餐厅兼礼堂举行。

e.en: They set up chairs in the {cafetorium} for the play.
e.zh: 他们在多功能厅里摆好椅子准备演出。

caff.t: 小餐馆；便宜咖啡馆（英式俚语）

e.en: We grabbed bacon sandwiches at the local {caff}.
e.zh: 我们在当地小餐馆买了培根三明治。

e.en: There's a greasy {caff} on the corner.
e.zh: 街角有家油腻的小咖啡馆。

caffein.t: 咖啡因（caffeine 的变体拼写）

e.en: The drink contains a moderate amount of {caffein}.
e.zh: 这种饮料含有适量的咖啡因。

e.en: He tries to avoid {caffein} after lunch.
e.zh: 他午饭后尽量不摄入咖啡因。

e.en: She prefers {caffeine-free} tea in the evening.
e.zh: 她晚上更喜欢喝无咖啡因的茶。

e.en: The cafe offers several {caffeine-free} options.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆提供几种无咖啡因的选择。

caffeinism.t: 咖啡因中毒；咖啡因依赖症

e.en: Doctors warned him about symptoms of {caffeinism}.
e.zh: 医生警告他注意咖啡因中毒的症状。

e.en: Chronic {caffeinism} can cause anxiety and insomnia.
e.zh: 慢性咖啡因依赖会引发焦虑和失眠。

c'mon.t: 来吧；得了吧（come on的口语缩写）

e.en: {C'mon}, we'll be late for the movie!
e.zh: 快点，我们看电影要迟到了！

e.en: Oh {c'mon}, you can't be serious.
e.zh: 得了吧，你不会是认真的吧。

e.en: He pulled a {c-note} from his wallet.
e.zh: 他从钱包里抽出一张百元美钞。

e.en: She slipped him a {c-note} as a tip.
e.zh: 她偷偷塞给他一张百元钞票作小费。

e.en: Use a {c-spanner} to loosen the locking ring.
e.zh: 用C型扳手拧松锁紧环。

e.en: He fetched a {c-spanner} from the toolbox.
e.zh: 他从工具箱里拿出一把C型扳手。

c-suite.t: 公司高管层；首席高管圈

e.en: She finally made it to the {c-suite}.
e.zh: 她终于跻身公司高管层。

e.en: The {c-suite} approved the merger.
e.zh: 公司高管层批准了合并案。

e.en: Scholars debate the origins of the {cabala}.
e.zh: 学者们对卡巴拉的起源争论不休。

e.en: Mystical doctrines of {cabala} influenced many writers.
e.zh: 卡巴拉的神秘教义影响了许多作家。

cabalism.t: 卡巴拉教义；神秘解经术

e.en: His writings draw on Jewish {cabalism}.
e.zh: 他的著作借鉴了犹太卡巴拉神秘主义。

e.en: {Cabalism} fascinated many Renaissance thinkers.
e.zh: 卡巴拉神秘主义吸引了许多文艺复兴时期的思想家。

cacoepy.t: 发音错误；不正确的发音

e.en: The professor lectured on common {cacoepy} among English learners.
e.zh: 教授讲解了英语学习者常见的发音错误。

e.en: Her {cacoepy} betrayed her unfamiliarity with the language.
e.zh: 她错误的发音暴露了她对这门语言的不熟悉。

e.en: He suffered from a {cacoethes} for gambling.
e.zh: 他染上了赌博的恶癖。

e.en: Writing was her harmless {cacoethes}.
e.zh: 写作是她无害的癖好。

e.en: The study examined factors leading to {cacogenesis} in certain populations.
e.zh: 该研究考察了某些人群劣生的成因。

e.en: Doctors warned against conditions that promote {cacogenesis}.
e.zh: 医生警告人们要避免导致畸形发育的环境。

e.en: They debated the {cacogenic} effects of pollution on offspring.
e.zh: 他们讨论污染对后代的劣生影响。

e.en: The policy was criticized as {cacogenic}.
e.zh: 该政策被批评为助长劣生。

e.en: He wrote a paper criticizing {cacogenics} as pseudoscience.
e.zh: 他撰文批评劣生学是伪科学。

e.en: The textbook briefly mentioned {cacogenics}.
e.zh: 教科书简要提到了劣生学。

cacographer.t: 拼写错误者；字迹拙劣者

e.en: Even a {cacographer} can improve with practice.
e.zh: 即使是拼写糟糕的人也能通过练习进步。

e.en: The teacher gently helped the young {cacographer}.
e.zh: 老师耐心帮助这个写字潦草的孩子。

cacographic.t: 拼写错误的；字迹拙劣的

e.en: His {cacographic} notes were nearly illegible.
e.zh: 他笔迹潦草的笔记几乎无法辨认。

e.en: The manuscript was full of {cacographic} blunders.
e.zh: 手稿中满是拼写错误。

cacographical.t: 拼写错误的；字迹拙劣的

e.en: Editors flagged the {cacographical} sections for rewriting.
e.zh: 编辑标出了拼写错误的部分以便重写。

e.en: His essay had several {cacographical} lapses.
e.zh: 他的文章有几处拼写疏漏。

e.en: The scholar studied medieval {cacography} in old letters.
e.zh: 学者研究中世纪信件中的拼写错误。

e.en: Her {cacography} embarrassed her at school.
e.zh: 她糟糕的字迹让她在学校感到难堪。

e.en: Critics mocked the speaker's persistent {cacology}.
e.zh: 评论家嘲笑演讲者频频用词不当。

e.en: The book lists examples of common {cacology}.
e.zh: 这本书列举了常见的用词错误。

e.en: A {cacomistle} darted across the desert path at dusk.
e.zh: 一只蓬尾浣熊在黄昏时穿过沙漠小径。

e.en: Rangers spotted a {cacomistle} near the canyon.
e.zh: 护林员在峡谷附近发现了一只蓬尾浣熊。

e.en: Biologists rejected the term as a {caconym}.
e.zh: 生物学家把这个名称当作误称予以否定。

e.en: The species name was a recognized {caconym}.
e.zh: 该物种名称被公认为误称。

e.en: The street outside was filled with {cacophonic} noise.
e.zh: 外面的街道充满了刺耳的噪音。

e.en: Their argument turned into a {cacophonic} row.
e.zh: 他们的争吵变成了一阵刺耳的喧闹。

e.en: The garden featured many {cactaceous} plants.
e.zh: 花园里种着许多仙人掌科植物。

e.en: Botanists catalogued the {cactaceous} species of the region.
e.zh: 植物学家整理了该地区的仙人掌科物种。

e.en: Hindi has several {cacuminal} consonants.
e.zh: 印地语有若干卷舌辅音。

e.en: The phonetician described the {cacuminal} sound carefully.
e.zh: 语音学家仔细描述了这个卷舌音。

e.en: Officials updated the {cadaster} after the survey.
e.zh: 勘测之后，官员更新了地籍册。

e.en: The {cadaster} records every parcel in the village.
e.zh: 地籍册记录了村里的每一块土地。

e.en: The engineer prepared a {cadastral} map of the district.
e.zh: 工程师绘制了该区的地籍图。

e.en: They consulted {cadastral} records to settle the dispute.
e.zh: 他们查阅地籍记录来解决争议。

e.en: The land was divided {cadastrally} into numbered plots.
e.zh: 该土地按地籍划分为编号地块。

e.en: Each parcel is recorded {cadastrally}.
e.zh: 每块地都按地籍登记入册。

e.en: The town's {cadastre} dates back to the 1800s.
e.zh: 该镇的地籍册可以追溯到十九世纪。

e.en: He requested a copy of the local {cadastre}.
e.zh: 他申请了一份当地地籍册的副本。

e.en: Decomposing flesh releases {cadaverine} and putrescine.
e.zh: 腐肉会释放尸胺和腐胺。

e.en: The chemist isolated {cadaverine} for analysis.
e.zh: 化学家分离出尸胺以供分析。

e.en: A {caddice-fly} hovered above the trout stream.
e.zh: 一只石蛾在鳟鱼溪上盘旋。

e.en: Anglers imitate the {caddice-fly} with their lures.
e.zh: 垂钓者用拟饵模仿石蛾。

e.en: The {caddis-fly} larva builds a tiny case from pebbles.
e.zh: 石蛾幼虫用小石子搭建巢壳。

e.en: Trout feed eagerly on the {caddis-fly}.
e.zh: 鳟鱼喜欢捕食石蛾。

e.en: Clouds of {caddisflies} rose from the river at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时，成群的石蛾从河面升起。

e.en: The biologist studied larval {caddisflies} in the stream.
e.zh: 生物学家研究溪流中的石蛾幼虫。

e.en: His {caddish} behavior shocked everyone at dinner.
e.zh: 他在晚宴上的下流行为令众人震惊。

e.en: She refused to tolerate his {caddish} remarks.
e.zh: 她不能容忍他卑鄙的言论。

e.en: His {caddishness} cost him many friends.
e.zh: 他的下流行径让他失去了许多朋友。

e.en: The novel exposes the {caddishness} of high society.
e.zh: 这部小说揭露了上流社会的卑劣。

e.en: A {caddisworm} crawled along the riverbed in its case.
e.zh: 一只石蛾幼虫带着巢壳在河床上爬行。

e.en: Children watched a {caddisworm} build its tube.
e.zh: 孩子们观看石蛾幼虫筑造巢管。

e.en: The {cadelle} infested the granary's stored wheat.
e.zh: 谷盗虫害蔓延到粮仓储存的小麦。

e.en: Farmers set traps to control the {cadelle}.
e.zh: 农民设置陷阱来防治谷盗。

e.en: The composer experimented with unusual {cadencies}.
e.zh: 作曲家尝试了不同寻常的终止式。

e.en: Different poems have distinct {cadencies}.
e.zh: 不同的诗歌有各自的节奏。

e.en: The drummer kept a steady {cadency} throughout the march.
e.zh: 鼓手在整段行进中保持稳定的节奏。

e.en: Heraldry uses marks of {cadency} to distinguish sons.
e.zh: 纹章学用幼支记号区分兄弟次序。

e.en: The poem moved with a slow, {cadent} rhythm.
e.zh: 这首诗以缓慢而富有节奏的韵律推进。

e.en: Her {cadent} voice lulled the audience.
e.zh: 她抑扬有致的嗓音让听众陶醉。

e.en: The piece ends with a strong {cadential} chord.
e.zh: 乐曲以一个有力的终止和弦收尾。

e.en: He analyzed the {cadential} patterns of the sonata.
e.zh: 他分析了奏鸣曲的终止式结构。

e.en: He earned his {cadetcy} after rigorous testing.
e.zh: 经过严格考核，他获得了军校学员资格。

e.en: Her {cadetcy} lasted four challenging years.
e.zh: 她的军校学员生涯持续了艰苦的四年。

cadetship.t: 军校学员的身份；学员任期

e.en: He completed his {cadetship} with high honors.
e.zh: 他以优异成绩完成了军校学员训练。

e.en: The {cadetship} prepared her for officer duties.
e.zh: 军校学员训练为她担任军官做了准备。

cadette.t: 女童子军中级团员（六七年级）

e.en: Her daughter joined the local {cadette} troop.
e.zh: 她女儿加入了当地的女童子军中级团。

e.en: The {cadette} earned a badge in community service.
e.zh: 这名女童军中级团员获得了社区服务徽章。

e.en: The old shepherd was {cadgy} after a good harvest.
e.zh: 丰收之后，老牧人显得很欢快。

e.en: She felt {cadgy} on the bright spring morning.
e.zh: 在明媚的春日清晨，她心情活泼愉快。

e.en: The {cadi} settled the dispute according to Islamic law.
e.zh: 卡迪依照伊斯兰教法裁决了纠纷。

e.en: Villagers brought their case before the local {cadi}.
e.zh: 村民把案件呈交给当地的卡迪。

e.en: The essential oil contained traces of {cadinene}.
e.zh: 这种精油含有微量的杜松烯。

e.en: Chemists identified {cadinene} as a key fragrance component.
e.zh: 化学家鉴定出杜松烯是关键的香味成分。

cabalist.t: 卡巴拉教徒；犹太神秘哲学研究者

e.en: The old {cabalist} pored over ancient Hebrew texts.
e.zh: 那位年迈的卡巴拉学者细读古老的希伯来经文。

e.en: He earned a reputation as a learned {cabalist}.
e.zh: 他赢得了博学神秘哲学家的名声。

cabalistical.t: 神秘玄奥的；卡巴拉教的

e.en: She wrote a {cabalistical} treatise on the soul.
e.zh: 她写了一部关于灵魂的神秘主义论著。

e.en: His notebooks were full of {cabalistical} symbols.
e.zh: 他的笔记本里满是卡巴拉式的符号。

cabalistically.t: 以神秘玄奥的方式；卡巴拉式地

e.en: The numbers were arranged {cabalistically} on the page.
e.zh: 那些数字以卡巴拉式的方式排列在页面上。

e.en: He spoke {cabalistically} of hidden meanings.
e.zh: 他神秘玄奥地谈论着隐藏的含义。

e.en: They {caballed} against the king in secret.
e.zh: 他们暗中结党反对国王。

e.en: He was accused of {caballing} with foreign agents.
e.zh: 他被指控与外国特工勾结密谋。

e.en: He wrote a {caballine} treatise on horse anatomy.
e.zh: 他写了一部关于马匹解剖的著作。

e.en: The painting captured a {caballine} grace.
e.zh: 这幅画捕捉到了如马一般的优雅。

e.en: Don't be such a {cabbagehead}, read the instructions.
e.zh: 别这么糊涂，看看说明书。

e.en: He called his brother a {cabbagehead} for losing the keys.
e.zh: 他骂哥哥是个笨蛋，把钥匙弄丢了。

e.en: The {cabbageworm} ravaged the entire garden.
e.zh: 菜青虫毁了整片菜园。

e.en: Farmers spray crops to control {cabbageworm} infestations.
e.zh: 农民喷洒农药以防治菜青虫。

cabbagy.t: 卷心菜似的；带卷心菜味的

e.en: The kitchen had a stale, {cabbagy} smell.
e.zh: 厨房里有一股发馊的卷心菜味。

e.en: She wore a {cabbagy} green dress.
e.zh: 她穿了一件卷心菜绿的连衣裙。

e.en: She studied the {cabbala} for many years.
e.zh: 她研究卡巴拉教义多年。

e.en: The {cabbala} contains intricate mystical teachings.
e.zh: 卡巴拉包含错综复杂的神秘教义。

e.en: His writings reflect a deep interest in {cabbalism}.
e.zh: 他的著作反映出对卡巴拉主义的深厚兴趣。

e.en: Medieval {cabbalism} influenced many later mystics.
e.zh: 中世纪的卡巴拉主义影响了后世许多神秘主义者。

cabbalist.t: 卡巴拉教徒；神秘哲学研究者

e.en: The old {cabbalist} guarded ancient secrets.
e.zh: 那位年迈的卡巴拉教徒守护着古老的秘密。

e.en: He claimed descent from a famous {cabbalist}.
e.zh: 他自称是一位著名卡巴拉学者的后代。

e.en: The book was filled with {cabbalistic} diagrams.
e.zh: 书中满是卡巴拉式的图表。

e.en: He muttered some {cabbalistic} phrase under his breath.
e.zh: 他低声嘟哝着某句神秘的咒语。

cabbalistical.t: 卡巴拉式的；神秘玄奥的

e.en: He wrote in a dense, {cabbalistical} style.
e.zh: 他以晦涩玄奥的风格写作。

e.en: The manuscript bore strange {cabbalistical} markings.
e.zh: 这份手稿上有奇怪的卡巴拉式标记。

e.en: The workers {cabbled} the iron bars before reheating.
e.zh: 工人们在再加热前将铁条切碎。

e.en: Old foundries used to {cabble} blooms by hand.
e.zh: 旧时的铸造厂过去用手工切碎钢坯。

e.en: {Cabbling} prepares the metal for the next forge.
e.zh: 切碎铁块为下一道锻造工序作准备。

e.en: The mill specialized in {cabbling} steel ingots.
e.zh: 这家钢厂专门切碎钢锭。

e.en: The {cabinet-maker} crafted a beautiful walnut desk.
e.zh: 这位细木工打造了一张漂亮的胡桃木书桌。

e.en: She trained for years to become a skilled {cabinet-maker}.
e.zh: 她经过多年训练才成为熟练的家具木工。

cabinetwork.t: 细木工艺；高档家具制作

e.en: The shop is famous for its fine {cabinetwork}.
e.zh: 这家店以精美的细木工艺闻名。

e.en: He learned {cabinetwork} from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他向祖父学习家具制作。

cable-laid.t: 绳缆式编绕的；三股绞合的

e.en: Sailors prefer {cable-laid} rope for heavy moorings.
e.zh: 水手们偏爱用绳缆式编绕的粗绳系泊重物。

e.en: The boat was tied with thick {cable-laid} hemp.
e.zh: 船用粗的三股绞合麻绳系着。

cablecast.t: 通过有线电视播送；有线电视播放

e.en: The concert was {cablecast} to subscribers worldwide.
e.zh: 这场音乐会通过有线电视播送给全球订户。

e.en: Local meetings are {cablecast} on channel five.
e.zh: 本地会议在五频道有线电视上播出。

cablelaid.t: 绳缆式编绕的；三股绞合的

e.en: Use {cablelaid} rope for the anchor line.
e.zh: 锚索请用三股绞合的绳子。

e.en: {Cablelaid} cordage is unusually strong.
e.zh: 绳缆式编绕的索具异常坚固。

cablephoto.t: 电缆传送的照片；早期传真照片

e.en: The newspaper printed a blurry {cablephoto} from Paris.
e.zh: 报纸刊登了一张模糊的来自巴黎的电传照片。

e.en: He saved every {cablephoto} from the war.
e.zh: 他保存了战时每一张电传照片。

e.en: Old reporters wrote dispatches in terse {cablese}.
e.zh: 老记者用简短的电报体撰写报道。

e.en: Hemingway picked up his clipped style from {cablese}.
e.zh: 海明威从电报体中习得了简练的风格。

e.en: The {cableship} laid fiber optics across the Atlantic.
e.zh: 这艘电缆敷设船在大西洋下铺设光纤。

e.en: She works as an engineer aboard a {cableship}.
e.zh: 她在一艘电缆敷设船上当工程师。

e.en: The sailor coiled the {cablet} on the deck.
e.zh: 水手把小缆绳盘在甲板上。

e.en: Tie the boat with a sturdy {cablet}.
e.zh: 用结实的细缆把船系好。

e.en: The {cabman} tipped his hat as he drove off.
e.zh: 马车夫驾车离去时举帽致意。
