e.en: An old {cabman} knows every street in the city.
e.zh: 一个老出租车司机熟悉城里每条街道。

cabmen.t: 出租车司机；马车夫(复数)

e.en: The {cabmen} gathered outside the railway station.
e.zh: 出租车司机们聚集在火车站外。

e.en: Victorian {cabmen} drove hansoms through foggy streets.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的马车夫驾着轻便马车穿过雾蒙蒙的街道。

caboshed.t: (纹章)正面无颈的；正面朝外的

e.en: The shield bore a stag's head {caboshed}.
e.zh: 盾牌上有一只正面无颈的雄鹿头。

e.en: A bull's head {caboshed} appears on the family crest.
e.zh: 家族纹章上有一只正面朝外的公牛头。

cabotage.t: 沿海运输权；国内航线运输权

e.en: Many countries restrict foreign airlines from {cabotage}.
e.zh: 许多国家限制外国航空公司经营国内航线运输。

e.en: {Cabotage} laws protect domestic shipping companies.
e.zh: 沿海运输法保护着国内航运公司。

calash.t: 轻便折篷马车；折叠式女帽

e.en: A small {calash} pulled by a single horse waited at the gate.
e.zh: 一辆由一匹马拉着的小型折篷马车在门口等候。

e.en: She wore a silk {calash} to shield her hair from the wind.
e.zh: 她戴着一顶丝绸折叠帽以遮挡风。

e.en: The {calcaneus} is the largest bone in the foot.
e.zh: 跟骨是脚部最大的骨头。

e.en: He landed badly and shattered his {calcaneus}.
e.zh: 他着地姿势不好，跟骨摔碎了。

calced.t: 穿鞋的（用于天主教修会）

e.en: The {calced} Carmelites wear shoes, unlike their discalced counterparts.
e.zh: 穿鞋加尔默罗会修士与赤足修会的同会修士不同，他们是穿鞋的。

e.en: He joined a {calced} order in his youth.
e.zh: 他年轻时加入了一个穿鞋修会。

e.en: The ring was set with a smooth blue {calcedony}.
e.zh: 那枚戒指镶嵌着一块光滑的蓝色玉髓。

e.en: Ancient seals were often carved from {calcedony}.
e.zh: 古代印章常用玉髓雕刻而成。

e.en: The soil here has a strong {calcic} character.
e.zh: 这里的土壤具有明显的钙质特征。

e.en: They studied the {calcic} layer beneath the topsoil.
e.zh: 他们研究了表土之下的钙积层。

e.en: This orchid is a {calcicole} that thrives on limestone.
e.zh: 这种兰花是喜钙植物，在石灰岩上生长茂盛。

e.en: Gardeners often confuse calcifuges with {calcicole} species.
e.zh: 园艺爱好者常把嫌钙植物与喜钙植物搞混。

calcicolous.t: 喜钙的（生长于石灰质土壤）

e.en: Many alpine flowers are strictly {calcicolous}.
e.zh: 许多高山花卉是严格的喜钙植物。

e.en: The cliff supports a rich {calcicolous} flora.
e.zh: 这片悬崖养育着丰富的喜钙植物群落。

e.en: The supplement contains a small dose of {calciferol}.
e.zh: 这种补充剂含有少量钙化醇。

e.en: {Calciferol} helps the body absorb calcium.
e.zh: 钙化醇有助于人体吸收钙质。

e.en: They drilled through a thick {calciferous} stratum.
e.zh: 他们钻穿了一层厚厚的含钙地层。

e.en: Earthworms have a {calciferous} gland near their gut.
e.zh: 蚯蚓的肠道附近有一个钙腺。

e.en: The scan revealed a small {calcific} deposit on the valve.
e.zh: 扫描显示瓣膜上有一处小钙化沉积。

e.en: Ageing tissue often shows {calcific} changes.
e.zh: 老化组织常出现钙化改变。

e.en: Rhododendrons are a classic {calcifuge}.
e.zh: 杜鹃花是典型的嫌钙植物。

e.en: You cannot grow a {calcifuge} in chalky soil.
e.zh: 你无法在白垩土中种植嫌钙植物。

calcifugous.t: 嫌钙的（不能在石灰质土壤中生长）

e.en: Heather is a famously {calcifugous} shrub.
e.zh: 石南是著名的嫌钙灌木。

e.en: The garden's acid bed suits {calcifugous} plants.
e.zh: 花园的酸性苗床适合嫌钙植物。

calcimine.t: 水性涂料；用水性涂料粉刷

e.en: They will {calcimine} the ceiling next week.
e.zh: 他们下周要给天花板刷水性涂料。

e.en: The old walls were coated with white {calcimine}.
e.zh: 旧墙上涂了一层白色的水性涂料。

e.en: The freshly {calcimined} ceiling brightened the room.
e.zh: 刚刷过水性涂料的天花板让房间亮堂起来。

e.en: Every wall in the schoolhouse was {calcimined} pale blue.
e.zh: 校舍每面墙都被刷成淡蓝色的水性涂料。

e.en: The painter {calcimines} every wall before the festival.
e.zh: 画工在节日前粉刷每一面墙。

e.en: The hardware store sells several {calcimines} in pastel shades.
e.zh: 五金店出售好几种淡彩色调的水性涂料。

e.en: Ancient texts describe how to {calefy} water using sunlight.
e.zh: 古籍记载了如何利用阳光加热水。

e.en: The alchemist tried to {calefy} the metal in the furnace.
e.zh: 炼金术士试图在炉中加热金属。

e.en: The {calefying} rays warmed the stone floor.
e.zh: 温热的阳光使石地板暖了起来。

e.en: He stood by the {calefying} hearth all evening.
e.zh: 他整晚都站在散发热气的壁炉旁。

e.en: The {calendarial} system used by the Maya was extraordinarily precise.
e.zh: 玛雅人使用的历法体系异常精确。

e.en: Scholars debated the {calendarial} reforms of the new era.
e.zh: 学者们讨论着新时代的历法改革。

e.en: The festival follows a strict {calendric} cycle.
e.zh: 这个节日遵循严格的历法周期。

e.en: Ancient {calendric} systems were tied to the moon.
e.zh: 古代的历法体系与月相相关。

calends.t: 古罗马历每月的第一日

e.en: Debts were traditionally settled on the {calends}.
e.zh: 债务传统上在每月朔日结清。

e.en: He promised payment by the next {calends}.
e.zh: 他承诺在下一个朔日前付款。

calenture.t: 热带船员热病；狂热幻觉

e.en: Sailors gripped by {calenture} sometimes leapt overboard imagining green fields.
e.zh: 染上热带狂热病的水手有时幻见绿野而跳海。

e.en: The poet described love as a kind of {calenture}.
e.zh: 诗人把爱情比作一种狂热幻症。

e.en: The {calescence} of the spring afternoon felt soothing.
e.zh: 春日午后渐升的暖意令人舒适。

e.en: Scientists measured the slow {calescence} of the reaction.
e.zh: 科学家测量了反应缓慢升温的过程。

e.en: The {calescent} air signaled the coming summer.
e.zh: 渐渐变暖的空气预示着夏天将至。

e.en: A {calescent} glow filled the eastern sky.
e.zh: 东方天空被渐暖的光辉染亮。

calf-length.t: 及小腿的；到小腿的长度

e.en: She wore a {calf-length} skirt to the ceremony.
e.zh: 她穿着一条及小腿的裙子参加典礼。

e.en: His {calf-length} coat looked elegant in the snow.
e.zh: 他那件及小腿的大衣在雪中显得很雅致。

e.en: He treasured a {calfbound} edition of Shakespeare.
e.zh: 他珍藏一本小牛皮装订的莎士比亚集。

e.en: The library shelves were lined with {calfbound} volumes.
e.zh: 图书馆的书架上摆满了小牛皮装订的书。

e.en: Proper nutrition during {calfhood} affects later milk yield.
e.zh: 幼犊期良好的营养会影响日后产奶量。

e.en: He recalled the cow from its {calfhood} on the farm.
e.zh: 他想起这头牛在农场幼犊时的样子。

calflike.t: 像小牛似的；憨态可掬的

e.en: She gave him a {calflike} look of devotion.
e.zh: 她对他露出小牛般依恋的神情。

e.en: His {calflike} clumsiness made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 他像小牛一样笨拙的样子让大家发笑。

calices.t: 花萼；杯状结构（calix 复数）

e.en: The botanist examined the dried {calices} under a lens.
e.zh: 植物学家在放大镜下检查干燥的花萼。

e.en: Renal {calices} drain urine into the pelvis.
e.zh: 肾盏将尿液汇入肾盂。

e.en: Each coral polyp sits in its own tiny {calicle}.
e.zh: 每只珊瑚虫都栖息在自己的小杯状骨杯中。

e.en: The flower's {calicle} surrounded the true sepals.
e.zh: 那花的副萼围绕着真正的萼片。

e.en: The specimen showed clear {calicular} structures under magnification.
e.zh: 标本在放大下显示出清晰的杯状结构。

e.en: Researchers compared the {calicular} shapes of two coral species.
e.zh: 研究者比较了两种珊瑚的杯状结构。

e.en: Some flowers are described as {caliculate} due to their extra whorl.
e.zh: 有些花因多出一轮被描述为具副萼的。

e.en: The {caliculate} blossom intrigued the botany class.
e.zh: 那朵带副萼的花引起了植物课的兴趣。

e.en: The villa was warmed by an ingenious {caliduct} system.
e.zh: 那座别墅由巧妙的热气导管系统供暖。

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered a {caliduct} beneath the bath floor.
e.zh: 考古学家在浴池地板下发现了一条热气导管。

e.en: The {calif} ruled from a magnificent palace in Baghdad.
e.zh: 那位哈里发在巴格达的宏伟宫殿中统治。

e.en: Stories of the {calif} filled the old manuscripts.
e.zh: 古抄本中充满了关于哈里发的故事。

califate.t: 哈里发国；哈里发的统治

e.en: The {califate} extended from Spain to Persia at its peak.
e.zh: 哈里发国鼎盛时从西班牙延伸至波斯。

e.en: Historians debated the legacy of the early {califate}.
e.zh: 历史学家讨论着早期哈里发国的遗产。

e.en: {Californium} is used in some neutron-detection instruments.
e.zh: 锎被用于某些中子探测仪器中。

e.en: Only minute amounts of {californium} are produced each year.
e.zh: 每年仅能制造极微量的锎。

e.en: The cave's {caliginosity} swallowed the lantern's glow.
e.zh: 洞穴的幽暗吞没了灯笼的光亮。

e.en: He wrote of the soul's {caliginosity} in despair.
e.zh: 他写到绝望中灵魂的昏暗。

e.en: They wandered through {caliginous} corridors deep underground.
e.zh: 他们在地底昏暗的走廊中徘徊。

e.en: A {caliginous} mist hung over the moor.
e.zh: 一层阴沉的薄雾笼罩着荒原。

e.en: The patient complained of {caligo} after the injury.
e.zh: 患者在受伤后抱怨视物模糊。

e.en: A strange {caligo} clouded the horizon.
e.zh: 一抹奇怪的暗影笼罩着地平线。

e.en: Her {caligraphy} on the invitation looked exquisite.
e.zh: 她在请柬上的书法十分精美。

e.en: He studied Chinese {caligraphy} for many years.
e.zh: 他研习中国书法多年。

caliology.t: 鸟巢学；研究鸟巢的学问

e.en: His paper on {caliology} described twenty species' nests.
e.zh: 他关于鸟巢学的论文描述了二十种鸟的巢。

e.en: Few universities still teach {caliology} as a separate subject.
e.zh: 如今很少有大学仍把鸟巢学作为独立科目。

calipash.t: 海龟上甲下的绿色脂肪

e.en: Victorian cookbooks praised the rich {calipash} of sea turtles.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的食谱称赞海龟上甲下的绿色脂肪。

e.en: He had never tasted {calipash} before that dinner.
e.zh: 那次晚宴之前他从未尝过海龟绿脂。

calipee.t: 海龟下甲下的黄色脂肪

e.en: Old recipes for turtle soup called for both calipash and {calipee}.
e.zh: 老式海龟汤食谱同时需要绿脂和黄脂。

e.en: The chef carefully separated the {calipee} from the shell.
e.zh: 厨师小心地将黄脂从龟壳上分离。

calisaya.t: 金鸡纳树皮（用于制奎宁）

e.en: {Calisaya} bark was once vital for treating malaria.
e.zh: 金鸡纳树皮曾是治疗疟疾的重要药材。

e.en: Traders carried {calisaya} from the Andes to Europe.
e.zh: 商人将金鸡纳树皮从安第斯山运往欧洲。

calisthenic.t: 健美体操的；徒手健身的

e.en: He led the class in a brisk {calisthenic} routine.
e.zh: 他带领全班做了一套轻快的健美体操。

e.en: Soldiers performed {calisthenic} drills at dawn.
e.zh: 士兵们在黎明时做徒手体操训练。

e.en: The bishop raised the silver {calix} during the service.
e.zh: 主教在礼拜中举起银制圣杯。

e.en: Each renal {calix} collects urine from the papilla.
e.zh: 每个肾盏从肾乳头收集尿液。

e.en: He had to {calk} the boat before the voyage.
e.zh: 他得在出航前给船填缝防漏。

e.en: Workers {calk} the seams of the wooden hull.
e.zh: 工人们给木船壳的接缝填塞防水。

e.en: The newly {calked} hull no longer leaked.
e.zh: 刚填好缝的船壳不再漏水了。

e.en: Every joint had been carefully {calked} with pitch.
e.zh: 每条接缝都用沥青仔细填塞过。

e.en: The {calker} sealed the wooden hull seams.
e.zh: 填缝工密封了木船船体的接缝。

e.en: An experienced {calker} can prevent costly leaks.
e.zh: 经验丰富的嵌缝工可以避免代价高昂的漏水。

e.en: The blacksmith forged a sharp {calkin} on the shoe.
e.zh: 铁匠在马蹄铁上锻造了锋利的防滑齿。

e.en: A worn {calkin} can make the horse slip on ice.
e.zh: 磨损的防滑齿会让马在冰上打滑。

e.en: They applied fresh {calking} between the planks.
e.zh: 他们在木板之间涂上了新的填缝料。

e.en: The boat needs {calking} before the season starts.
e.zh: 船在季节开始前需要嵌缝。

e.en: The horse's {calks} bit into the muddy track.
e.zh: 马蹄上的防滑齿扎进了泥泞的赛道。

e.en: He {calks} the seams every spring.
e.zh: 他每年春天都会给船缝填料。

e.en: Cast notices were posted on the {call-board}.
e.zh: 演员通知贴在了后台公告板上。

e.en: Check the {call-board} for tomorrow's rehearsal time.
e.zh: 请到公告板上查看明天的排练时间。

call-box.t: 公用电话亭；紧急电话亭

e.en: She rang the police from a roadside {call-box}.
e.zh: 她从路边的电话亭打给了警察。

e.en: The old red {call-box} still stands on the corner.
e.zh: 那座老旧的红色电话亭仍立在街角。

e.en: The novel follows a {call-girl} in 1960s Paris.
e.zh: 小说讲述了1960年代巴黎一位应召女郎的故事。

e.en: He was arrested for managing a {call-girl} ring.
e.zh: 他因经营应召女郎团伙而被捕。

call-in.t: 听众来电节目；电话点播

e.en: She hosts a late-night {call-in} show.
e.zh: 她主持一档深夜听众来电节目。

e.en: The radio {call-in} took listener questions live.
e.zh: 电台来电节目现场接听听众提问。

e.en: Talk-radio {call-ins} dominate the morning slot.
e.zh: 听众来电谈话节目占据了早晨时段。

e.en: Most {call-ins} were about the new tax law.
e.zh: 大多数来电都是关于新税法的。

e.en: The strike {call-off} surprised the workers.
e.zh: 罢工的取消让工人们感到意外。

e.en: We placed a {call-off} order for monthly delivery.
e.zh: 我们下了一份按月提货的订单。

e.en: The teacher began the morning {call-over}.
e.zh: 老师开始了早上的点名。

e.en: A quick {call-over} of the inventory revealed errors.
e.zh: 快速核对库存后发现了错误。

e.en: The pilot's {call-sign} was 'Maverick'.
e.zh: 那位飞行员的呼号是"独行侠"。

e.en: Each station has a unique {call-sign}.
e.zh: 每个电台都有独一无二的呼号。

e.en: The ship transmitted its {call-signal} every hour.
e.zh: 船每小时发送一次呼叫信号。

e.en: Operators recognized the familiar {call-signal}.
e.zh: 操作员认出了熟悉的呼号。

e.en: Fill out a {call-slip} to request the rare book.
e.zh: 填写索书单即可借阅那本珍本图书。

e.en: The librarian collected the {call-slip} at the desk.
e.zh: 图书管理员在柜台收走了索书单。

e.en: He received his {call-up} papers last week.
e.zh: 他上周收到了入伍通知书。

e.en: The young striker earned a national team {call-up}.
e.zh: 这位年轻前锋入选了国家队。

e.en: Wartime {call-ups} emptied the village of young men.
e.zh: 战时的征召使村里的年轻人都走光了。

e.en: Several surprise {call-ups} shook the squad.
e.zh: 几次出人意料的征召名单震动了球队。

e.en: My phone plan includes {call-waiting}.
e.zh: 我的电话套餐包含呼叫等待功能。

e.en: The {call-waiting} beep interrupted our chat.
e.zh: 呼叫等待的提示音打断了我们的聊天。

e.en: She swears by {callanetics} for toning muscles.
e.zh: 她坚信卡兰内提斯健身操能塑形。

e.en: {Callanetics} uses small, precise movements.
e.zh: 卡兰内提斯通过细小而精准的动作进行锻炼。

e.en: The old farmer called him a fine {callant}.
e.zh: 老农夫称他是个好小伙子。

e.en: Every {callant} in the village joined the parade.
e.zh: 村里每个小伙子都参加了游行。

e.en: The director pinned the schedule to the {callboard}.
e.zh: 导演把日程表钉在了后台公告板上。

e.en: Actors check the {callboard} before each show.
e.zh: 演员在每场演出前都会查看公告板。

e.en: She used a highway {callbox} to report the breakdown.
e.zh: 她使用高速公路上的紧急电话亭报告了车辆抛锚。

e.en: The corner {callbox} was vandalized overnight.
e.zh: 街角的电话亭一夜之间被破坏了。

callboy.t: 剧院催场员；旅馆传呼员

e.en: The {callboy} knocked to summon the actors.
e.zh: 催场员敲门通知演员上场。

e.en: He worked as a hotel {callboy} in his youth.
e.zh: 他年轻时在旅馆当传呼员。

e.en: The function passes arguments to the {callee}.
e.zh: 该函数将参数传递给被调用者。

e.en: Bill the caller, not the {callee}.
e.zh: 向主叫方收费，而非被叫方。

e.en: Shakespeare's villain calls her a wretched {callet}.
e.zh: 莎士比亚笔下的恶人骂她是可恶的泼妇。

e.en: The old play features a scolding {callet}.
e.zh: 那出旧戏中有一个泼辣的妇人角色。

e.en: Years of guitar playing left thick {calli} on his fingers.
e.zh: 多年弹吉他在他手指上留下了厚厚的老茧。

e.en: The botanist examined the plant {calli} under the microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下观察植物愈伤组织。

e.en: She likes to {calligraph} wedding invitations by hand.
e.zh: 她喜欢手工书写婚礼请柬。

e.en: He framed the elegant {calligraph} on the wall.
e.zh: 他把那幅优雅的书法作品装裱挂在墙上。

e.en: He {calligraphed} the poem onto rice paper.
e.zh: 他把那首诗用书法写在宣纸上。

e.en: The menu was beautifully {calligraphed}.
e.zh: 菜单是用书法精美书写的。

e.en: The names were rendered {calligraphically} in gold.
e.zh: 那些名字用金色以书法形式书写。

e.en: He signed the scroll {calligraphically}.
e.zh: 他以书法方式在卷轴上署名。

e.en: A renowned {calligraphist} demonstrated brush strokes.
e.zh: 一位著名书法家演示了运笔技法。

e.en: The {calligraphist} sold prints at the fair.
e.zh: 那位书法家在集市上出售作品复制品。

e.en: He runs a sports {callin} on weekends.
e.zh: 他在周末主持一档体育听众来电节目。

e.en: The morning {callin} drew thousands of listeners.
e.zh: 早晨的听众来电节目吸引了数千名听众。

e.en: He left his {calling-card} at the front desk.
e.zh: 他在前台留下了名片。

e.en: Sharp dialogue is the writer's {calling-card}.
e.zh: 犀利的对白是这位作家的招牌特征。

e.en: The chef prized the {callipash} for turtle soup.
e.zh: 厨师视龟壳胶肉为海龟汤的珍品。

e.en: Old cookbooks describe preparing {callipash} carefully.
e.zh: 老烹饪书详细介绍了如何处理龟壳胶肉。

e.en: {Callipee} was once a delicacy in Victorian dining.
e.zh: 龟腹胶肉曾是维多利亚时代餐桌上的珍馐。

e.en: The recipe calls for fresh {callipee} simmered slowly.
e.zh: 这道菜需要慢炖新鲜的龟腹胶肉。

e.en: Ancient sculptors celebrated the {callipygian} form.
e.zh: 古代雕塑家赞美匀称美臀的形态。

e.en: The statue is famously {callipygian}.
e.zh: 这尊雕像以美臀闻名。

e.en: Critics described the dancer as strikingly {callipygous}.
e.zh: 评论家形容那位舞者拥有惊艳的优美臀线。

e.en: The marble figure is unmistakably {callipygous}.
e.zh: 这尊大理石塑像的臀部线条优美无疑。

e.en: She follows a daily {callisthenic} routine.
e.zh: 她每天进行一套徒手健美操训练。

e.en: The school added {callisthenic} drills to PE class.
e.zh: 学校在体育课中加入了徒手操训练。

e.en: Soldiers do {callisthenics} every morning.
e.zh: 士兵每天早上做徒手操。

e.en: {Callisthenics} requires no equipment.
e.zh: 徒手操不需要任何器械。

callithump.t: 喧闹的游行；嘈杂的乐队

e.en: The town held a noisy {callithump} on New Year's Eve.
e.zh: 小镇在除夕举办了热闹喧嚣的游行。

e.en: Children banged pots in a homemade {callithump}.
e.zh: 孩子们敲打锅碗组成了一支自制的喧闹乐队。

e.en: A {callithumpian} band paraded down the street.
e.zh: 一支喧闹的乐队沿街游行。

e.en: Their {callithumpian} celebration woke the whole block.
e.zh: 他们喧闹的庆祝活动吵醒了整个街区。

cageful.t: 一笼的容量；满满一笼之量

e.en: She brought home a {cageful} of crickets for her lizard.
e.zh: 她给蜥蜴带回了满满一笼蟋蟀。

e.en: A {cageful} of canaries sang at dawn.
e.zh: 一笼金丝雀在黎明时齐声鸣叫。

cageier.t: 更谨慎的；更含糊其辞的

e.en: He grew {cageier} as the questions got harder.
e.zh: 问题越尖锐，他回答得越含糊。

e.en: She seemed {cageier} than usual about her plans.
e.zh: 她对自己的计划比平时更守口如瓶。

cageiest.t: 最谨慎的；最含糊其辞的

e.en: He's the {cageiest} witness I've ever interviewed.
e.zh: 他是我见过最闪烁其词的证人。

e.en: She gave the {cageiest} answer of the panel.
e.zh: 她给出了全场最含糊的回答。

e.en: The {cageling} fluttered against the bars.
e.zh: 那只笼中鸟扑打着栏杆。

e.en: He freed the {cageling} into the garden.
e.zh: 他把那只笼中鸟放飞到了花园里。

caginess.t: 谨慎；含糊其辞；守口如瓶

e.en: Her {caginess} about the budget worried investors.
e.zh: 她对预算的含糊其辞令投资者担忧。

e.en: His {caginess} only fueled the rumors.
e.zh: 他的闪烁其词反而助长了流言。

e.en: The butcher refused to sell {cagmag} to his regulars.
e.zh: 那位屠夫不肯把劣质肉卖给老主顾。

e.en: They sat by the fire trading {cagmag} all evening.
e.zh: 他们整晚围坐火炉边闲扯八卦。

cagy.t: 谨慎的；狡猾的；不轻易表态

e.en: He was {cagy} about his sources.
e.zh: 他对消息来源讳莫如深。

e.en: She gave a {cagy} smile and changed the subject.
e.zh: 她狡黠地一笑，转移了话题。

cahow.t: 百慕大圆尾鹱（一种海鸟）

e.en: The {cahow} was once thought to be extinct.
e.zh: 百慕大圆尾鹱一度被认为已经绝种。

e.en: Conservationists protect the rare {cahow} on offshore islets.
e.zh: 保育人士在外海小岛上保护稀有的百慕大圆尾鹱。

cainogenesis.t: 新生发生（个体发育中后天获得的特征）

e.en: The textbook explained {cainogenesis} in larval development.
e.zh: 教材解释了幼体发育中的新生发生现象。

e.en: He published a paper on {cainogenesis} in amphibians.
e.zh: 他发表了一篇关于两栖类新生发生的论文。

caipirinha.t: 卡琵莉亚（巴西甘蔗酒鸡尾酒）

e.en: We ordered a {caipirinha} on the beach in Rio.
e.zh: 我们在里约的沙滩上点了一杯卡琵莉亚。

e.en: She makes the best {caipirinha} I've ever tasted.
e.zh: 她调的卡琵莉亚是我喝过最好喝的。

e.en: The {caitiff} fled rather than face the duel.
e.zh: 那个懦夫不敢应战，落荒而逃。

e.en: Shakespeare often portrays the {caitiff} as a coward.
e.zh: 莎士比亚笔下的卑鄙小人多半是懦夫。

e.en: The oil from the {cajeput} tree is used in folk remedies.
e.zh: 白千层树的精油常用于民间疗法。

e.en: He rubbed a few drops of {cajeput} on his temples.
e.zh: 他在太阳穴上抹了几滴白千层油。

e.en: No amount of {cajolement} would make him change his mind.
e.zh: 再怎么哄劝也无法让他改变主意。

e.en: She finally yielded to his patient {cajolement}.
e.zh: 她最终敌不过他耐心的甜言蜜语。

cake-eater.t: 花花公子；游手好闲的人（俚）

e.en: He dismissed his rivals as a bunch of {cake-eaters}.
e.zh: 他把对手们贬为一群游手好闲的纨绔子弟。

e.en: Don't be such a {cake-eater}—come help with the work.
e.zh: 别再当甩手掌柜了，过来帮忙干活。

e.en: The frosting tasted too {cakey} and dry.
e.zh: 那糖霜口感过于松散干硬。

e.en: Her foundation looked {cakey} under the bright lights.
e.zh: 在强光下她的粉底显得厚重结块。

caky.t: 像蛋糕的；结块的；糊状的

e.en: The mud dried into {caky} chunks on his boots.
e.zh: 泥巴在他靴子上干结成块。

e.en: The makeup went {caky} by the end of the night.
e.zh: 到夜里她的妆已经结块斑驳。

e.en: They threw the drunk into the {calaboose} for the night.
e.zh: 他们把那醉汉关进拘留所过了一夜。

e.en: He spent a week in the local {calaboose}.
e.zh: 他在当地的小牢房里关了一星期。

calabrese.t: 紫花椰菜；卡拉布里亚的

e.en: She added {calabrese} to the pasta sauce.
e.zh: 她在意面酱里加了紫花椰菜。

e.en: The market sells fresh {calabrese} every Saturday.
e.zh: 市场每周六都有新鲜的紫花椰菜。

calamanco.t: 卡拉曼科（一种光面毛织物）

e.en: The waistcoat was made of bright {calamanco}.
e.zh: 那件背心由鲜艳的卡拉曼科呢制成。

e.en: Colonial merchants imported {calamanco} from Flanders.
e.zh: 殖民地商人从佛兰德进口卡拉曼科呢。

e.en: The desk was crafted from polished {calamander}.
e.zh: 那张书桌由打磨过的黑檀木制成。

e.en: He prized the cabinet's {calamander} veneer.
e.zh: 他十分珍视柜子上的黑檀木贴面。

e.en: The fishermen hauled in nets of {calamary}.
e.zh: 渔夫们拉起一网网的鱿鱼。

e.en: Old cookbooks call squid {calamary}.
e.zh: 旧时菜谱把鱿鱼称作 calamary。

calami.t: 芦苇、笔管或菖蒲的复数形式

e.en: Ancient scribes wrote with sharpened {calami}.
e.zh: 古代抄写员用削尖的芦管书写。

e.en: The marsh was thick with rustling {calami}.
e.zh: 沼泽中长满了沙沙作响的芦苇。

e.en: The botanist described the {calamiform} stems.
e.zh: 植物学家描述了那些芦苇状的茎。

e.en: Its {calamiform} leaves rustled in the wind.
e.zh: 它管状的叶片在风中沙沙作响。

calamint.t: 风轮菜；新风轮菜（草本植物）

e.en: She picked {calamint} for her herbal tea.
e.zh: 她采了些风轮菜来泡花草茶。

e.en: The herb garden featured {calamint} and thyme.
e.zh: 香草园里种着风轮菜和百里香。

calamistrum.t: 栉器（蜘蛛后腿上的梳状结构）

e.en: The spider used its {calamistrum} to comb the silk.
e.zh: 那只蜘蛛用栉器梳理蛛丝。

e.en: Researchers studied the {calamistrum} under a microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下观察栉器。

cambist.t: 货币兑换商；外汇经纪人

e.en: The old {cambist} kept a ledger of every exchange rate.
e.zh: 那位老货币兑换商记录着每一个汇率。

e.en: In the port city, every {cambist} spoke several languages.
e.zh: 在这座港口城市，每个外汇商人都会说几种语言。

e.en: He studied {cambistry} before joining the trading firm.
e.zh: 他在加入贸易公司前研究过汇兑业务。

e.en: Medieval merchants relied on {cambistry} to handle foreign coins.
e.zh: 中世纪商人依靠汇兑学来处理外币。

e.en: She wore a soft {camel's-hair} coat to the gallery opening.
e.zh: 她穿着一件柔软的驼绒大衣去画廊开幕式。

e.en: The artist preferred a fine {camel's-hair} brush for delicate work.
e.zh: 这位画家喜欢用细驼毛画笔做精细的工作。

e.en: He bought a tailored {camel-hair} jacket for winter.
e.zh: 他买了一件量身定制的驼绒夹克过冬。

e.en: The {camel-hair} blanket felt luxurious against the skin.
e.zh: 那条驼毛毯子贴在皮肤上感觉很奢华。

e.en: They crossed the desert on {camelback} for three days.
e.zh: 他们骑着骆驼穿越沙漠走了三天。

e.en: The sofa had an elegant {camelback} silhouette.
e.zh: 这张沙发有着优雅的驼背式轮廓。

e.en: The {cameleer} guided travelers across the dunes at dawn.
e.zh: 那位骆驼夫在黎明时分带领旅客穿过沙丘。

e.en: Old photographs show Afghan {cameleers} in the Australian outback.
e.zh: 老照片中可见阿富汗骆驼夫在澳大利亚内陆。

e.en: Llamas and alpacas are {camelids} native to South America.
e.zh: 美洲驼和羊驼是原产南美的骆驼科动物。

e.en: Researchers studied antibodies unique to {camelids}.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了骆驼科动物特有的抗体。

e.en: Medieval bestiaries often depicted the {camelopard} as a curious hybrid.
e.zh: 中世纪动物寓言集常把长颈鹿描绘成奇异的混合生物。

e.en: He used the archaic word {camelopard} to mean giraffe.
e.zh: 他用古词camelopard来指长颈鹿。

e.en: The sultan deployed his {camelry} along the desert frontier.
e.zh: 苏丹把他的骆驼骑兵部署在沙漠边境。

e.en: Colonial forces once maintained a small {camelry} unit.
e.zh: 殖民军队曾维持一支小型骆驼骑兵部队。

camera-phone.t: 拍照手机；带摄像头的手机

e.en: She snapped a quick photo with her {camera-phone}.
e.zh: 她用拍照手机迅速拍了一张照片。

e.en: Early {camera-phones} produced grainy, low-resolution images.
e.zh: 早期的拍照手机拍出的照片颗粒粗糙、分辨率低。

camera-shy.t: 怕上镜的；不喜欢拍照的

e.en: He was always {camera-shy} at family gatherings.
e.zh: 在家庭聚会上他总是怕拍照。

e.en: The {camera-shy} actress avoided red-carpet events.
e.zh: 这位怕镜头的女演员避开红毯活动。

e.en: The fossil shell showed a clear {cameral} structure inside.
e.zh: 这枚化石外壳内部显示出清晰的分室结构。

e.en: He wrote a treatise on {cameral} administration in old Prussia.
e.zh: 他写了一篇关于旧普鲁士财政行政的论文。

e.en: The professor lectured on {cameralistic} theories of state finance.
e.zh: 教授讲授官房学的国家财政理论。

e.en: Eighteenth-century {cameralistic} writers shaped German bureaucracy.
e.zh: 十八世纪官房学作家塑造了德国官僚体制。

cameralistics.t: 官房学；公共财政管理学

e.en: He specialized in {cameralistics} at the old German university.
e.zh: 他在那所古老的德国大学专攻官房学。

e.en: {Cameralistics} influenced early modern European statecraft.
e.zh: 官房学影响了早期近代欧洲的治国之术。

cameraperson.t: 摄影师；摄像师（不分性别）

e.en: The documentary credited an experienced {cameraperson} for its visuals.
e.zh: 这部纪录片把出色的画面归功于一位资深摄像师。

e.en: She trained as a {cameraperson} before becoming a director.
e.zh: 她在当导演之前接受过摄像师训练。

e.en: He recorded the parade with his {cameraphone}.
e.zh: 他用拍照手机录下了游行。

e.en: Modern {cameraphones} rival professional cameras in quality.
e.zh: 现代拍照手机的画质可与专业相机媲美。

e.en: The fossil ammonite has a beautifully {camerated} shell.
e.zh: 这块菊石化石有着精美分室的外壳。

e.en: Engineers built a {camerated} chamber for acoustic tests.
e.zh: 工程师建造了一个分室结构的腔体用于声学测试。

e.en: The {camerawoman} captured stunning footage of the storm.
e.zh: 那位女摄像师拍下了暴风雨的惊人画面。

e.en: She became the first {camerawoman} on the network's news team.
e.zh: 她成为该电视台新闻组的首位女摄像师。

e.en: The {camerlengo} administers Vatican affairs between popes.
e.zh: 枢机总司库在两任教宗之间管理梵蒂冈事务。

e.en: Cardinals waited for the {camerlengo} to confirm the pope's death.
e.zh: 枢机们等待总司库确认教宗去世。

e.en: The {camerlingo} sealed the late pope's apartments.
e.zh: 枢机总司库封存了已故教宗的居所。

e.en: Old chronicles refer to the cardinal as {camerlingo}.
e.zh: 古老的编年史称这位枢机为camerlingo。

cameronian.t: 卡梅伦派教徒（苏格兰盟誓派）

e.en: The {Cameronians} resisted episcopal rule in seventeenth-century Scotland.
e.zh: 卡梅伦派在十七世纪的苏格兰反抗主教制统治。

e.en: He descended from a long line of devout {Cameronians}.
e.zh: 他出身于一个虔诚的卡梅伦派世家。

cami-knickers.t: 连身衬裤；女式连体内衣

e.en: She packed a silk pair of {cami-knickers} for the trip.
e.zh: 她为这趟旅行打包了一套丝质连身衬裤。

e.en: Vintage shops still sell elegant {cami-knickers} from the 1920s.
e.zh: 复古店至今仍售卖二十年代优雅的连身衬裤。

e.en: Defenders scattered {caltrops} across the road to stop cavalry.
e.zh: 守军在路上撒下铁蒺藜以阻挡骑兵。

e.en: Police used {caltrops} to puncture the fleeing car's tires.
e.zh: 警察用铁蒺藜刺破逃跑车辆的轮胎。

calumet.t: 北美印第安人和平烟斗

e.en: The chief offered him the {calumet} as a gesture of peace.
e.zh: 酋长递上和平烟斗以示友好。

e.en: Smoking the {calumet} was a sacred ritual among the tribes.
e.zh: 吸和平烟斗是部落间的神圣仪式。

e.en: He sued the newspaper for the {calumniation} of his character.
e.zh: 他因报纸对他人格的诽谤而提起诉讼。

e.en: Her opponents resorted to {calumniation} during the campaign.
e.zh: 她的对手在竞选中诉诸恶意中伤。

e.en: The {calumniator} was finally exposed in court.
e.zh: 那名诽谤者最终在法庭上被揭穿。

e.en: He dismissed his critics as mere {calumniators}.
e.zh: 他把批评者一概斥为造谣中伤之徒。

e.en: The pamphlet contained {calumniatory} remarks about the mayor.
e.zh: 那本小册子中含有对市长的诽谤言论。

e.en: She refused to dignify the {calumniatory} claims with a response.
e.zh: 她不屑回应那些诽谤性的指控。

e.en: He was outraged by the {calumnious} accusations in the press.
e.zh: 他对报刊上诽谤性的指控感到愤怒。

e.en: Such {calumnious} gossip ruined her reputation overnight.
e.zh: 这种恶意中伤的流言一夜之间毁了她的名声。

e.en: He was {calumniously} accused of embezzlement by his rival.
e.zh: 他被竞争对手诽谤性地指控贪污。

e.en: The article spoke {calumniously} of the late scientist.
e.zh: 那篇文章对已故科学家进行了恶意中伤。

e.en: The anatomist examined the fractured {calvaria} carefully.
e.zh: 解剖学家仔细检查了破裂的颅顶。

e.en: X-rays revealed thinning of the {calvaria}.
e.zh: X 光显示颅顶骨变薄。

e.en: Surgeons performed a {calvarial} reconstruction after the injury.
e.zh: 外科医生在伤后进行了颅顶重建术。

e.en: The scan showed a small {calvarial} fracture.
e.zh: 扫描显示有一处小的颅顶骨折。

e.en: The skeleton's {calvarium} was remarkably well preserved.
e.zh: 这具骨架的头盖骨保存得相当完好。

e.en: They studied the {calvarium} to estimate the individual's age.
e.zh: 他们研究头盖骨以推断死者的年龄。

calvinistical.t: 加尔文教派的；加尔文主义的

e.en: He was raised in a strict {calvinistical} household.
e.zh: 他在一个严格的加尔文教派家庭中长大。

e.en: The sermon had a distinctly {calvinistical} tone.
e.zh: 那篇布道带有明显的加尔文主义色彩。

e.en: The doctor noted early signs of {calvities} on his crown.
e.zh: 医生注意到他头顶有早期秃发的迹象。

e.en: Hereditary {calvities} runs in his family.
e.zh: 遗传性秃顶在他家族中很常见。

e.en: The old monk's {calvous} head shone in the candlelight.
e.zh: 老僧人的秃头在烛光下闪闪发亮。

e.en: He grew increasingly {calvous} as the years passed.
e.zh: 随着岁月流逝，他越来越秃。

e.en: Alchemists studied the {calx} left after roasting the metal.
e.zh: 炼金术士研究金属煅烧后留下的灰。

e.en: The {calx} of lead was once used in pigments.
e.zh: 铅的氧化灰曾被用作颜料。

e.en: The chemist labeled several {calxes} for analysis.
e.zh: 化学家标记了几种金属灰以供分析。

e.en: Different {calxes} produced different colors when heated.
e.zh: 不同的金属灰加热时呈现出不同的颜色。

e.en: The scan revealed {calyceal} dilation in the right kidney.
e.zh: 扫描显示右肾出现肾盏扩张。

e.en: He studied the {calyceal} structure of the flower.
e.zh: 他研究了这朵花的花萼结构。

e.en: The {calyces} of the flowers were tinged with red.
e.zh: 这些花的花萼带有红晕。

e.en: Urine collects in the renal {calyces} before draining.
e.zh: 尿液在排出前先汇集于肾盏中。

e.en: The botanist described the petals as {calyciform}.
e.zh: 植物学家把花瓣描述为花萼状的。

e.en: Tiny {calyciform} structures lined the stem.
e.zh: 茎上排列着微小的杯状结构。

e.en: He examined the {calycinal} hairs under the microscope.
e.zh: 他在显微镜下检查花萼上的绒毛。

e.en: The species has distinctive {calycinal} markings.
e.zh: 该物种具有独特的花萼斑纹。

e.en: A small {calycle} sat beneath the true sepals.
e.zh: 在真萼下方有一个小副萼。

e.en: The {calycle} helps protect the developing bud.
e.zh: 副萼有助于保护发育中的花蕾。

e.en: The plant has {calycoid} bracts surrounding the bloom.
e.zh: 这种植物的花朵周围有花萼状的苞片。

e.en: He noticed a {calycoid} formation near the stem.
e.zh: 他注意到茎附近有一处花萼状结构。

calycoideous.t: 花萼状的；具花萼形态的

e.en: The flowers display {calycoideous} bracts at the base.
e.zh: 这些花朵在基部具有花萼状的苞片。

e.en: Botanists noted the {calycoideous} arrangement of the leaves.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到叶片呈花萼状排列。

e.en: He pointed out the tiny {calycular} leaves at the base.
e.zh: 他指出基部那些细小的副萼叶。

e.en: The species is identified by its {calycular} features.
e.zh: 该物种通过其副萼特征来识别。

e.en: Many {calyculate} species grow in this region.
e.zh: 该地区生长着许多具副萼的物种。

e.en: The flower is clearly {calyculate} on close inspection.
e.zh: 仔细观察可见这朵花明显具有副萼。

e.en: The {calyculus} forms a ring beneath the true calyx.
e.zh: 副萼在真萼下方形成一圈。

e.en: Each bud is enclosed by a delicate {calyculus}.
e.zh: 每个花蕾外面都包着一层精致的副萼。

calypsonian.t: 卡里普索歌手；卡里普索风格的

e.en: The famous {calypsonian} performed at the carnival.
e.zh: 那位著名的卡里普索歌手在狂欢节上演出。

e.en: He grew up listening to {calypsonian} legends from Trinidad.
e.zh: 他从小听着特立尼达的卡里普索传奇歌手长大。

e.en: The moss spore capsule is covered by a thin {calyptra}.
e.zh: 苔藓的孢子蒴外覆盖着一层薄薄的蒴帽。

e.en: The {calyptra} protects the developing capsule.
e.zh: 蒴帽保护着正在发育的孢子蒴。

e.en: This moss species is distinctly {calyptrate}.
e.zh: 这种苔藓明显具有蒴帽。

e.en: The {calyptrate} structure is visible to the naked eye.
e.zh: 这种蒴帽结构肉眼可见。

e.en: The {calyptrogen} produces new cells for the root cap.
e.zh: 根冠原生成新细胞以构成根冠。

e.en: Damage to the {calyptrogen} can stunt root growth.
e.zh: 根冠原受损会阻碍根的生长。

e.en: The knight's {camail} protected his neck and shoulders.
e.zh: 骑士的颈甲护住了脖子和肩膀。

e.en: He polished the rusted {camail} of his armor.
e.zh: 他擦亮了铠甲上生锈的锁子甲披肩。

e.en: A secretive {camarilla} controlled the king's decisions.
e.zh: 一个秘密的小集团操控着国王的决定。

e.en: Critics accused the president of relying on a {camarilla}.
e.zh: 批评者指责总统依赖一个权贵小圈子。

camass.t: 卡马夏百合；可食球茎植物

e.en: Native peoples harvested {camass} bulbs for food.
e.zh: 原住民采收卡马夏的球茎作为食物。

e.en: Fields of blue {camass} bloomed across the meadow.
e.zh: 草地上盛开着一片片蓝色的卡马夏花。

calcimining.t: 涂石灰浆；用石灰水粉刷墙壁

e.en: Workers spent the morning {calcimining} the cellar walls.
e.zh: 工人们一上午都在用石灰浆粉刷地下室的墙壁。

e.en: She remembered her grandmother {calcimining} the kitchen each spring.
e.zh: 她记得祖母每年春天都会用石灰水粉刷厨房。

calcinable.t: 可煅烧的；能经高温焙烧的

e.en: Limestone is readily {calcinable} at high temperatures.
e.zh: 石灰石在高温下很容易煅烧。

e.en: Only certain ores prove {calcinable} in this furnace.
e.zh: 只有某些矿石可以在这种炉中煅烧。

e.en: Engineers {calcinate} the gypsum to drive off water.
e.zh: 工程师们煅烧石膏以去除水分。

e.en: The kiln will {calcinate} the limestone overnight.
e.zh: 这座窑会通宵煅烧石灰石。

calcination.t: 煅烧；煅烧反应；高温焙烧

e.en: Cement production relies on the {calcination} of limestone.
e.zh: 水泥生产依赖于石灰石的煅烧。

e.en: Complete {calcination} requires very high heat.
e.zh: 完全煅烧需要极高的温度。

e.en: They {calcine} the bones to obtain pure ash.
e.zh: 他们煅烧骨头以获得纯净的灰。

e.en: Industrial ovens {calcine} the ore before smelting.
e.zh: 工业炉会在冶炼前先煅烧矿石。

calcined.t: 经煅烧的；高温焙烧过的

e.en: {Calcined} alumina is widely used in advanced ceramics.
e.zh: 煅烧氧化铝广泛用于高级陶瓷。

e.en: The {calcined} powder is then ground very finely.
e.zh: 煅烧后的粉末随后被磨得很细。

e.en: The factory installed a new rotary {calciner}.
e.zh: 这家工厂安装了一台新的回转煅烧炉。

e.en: Each {calciner} runs continuously for several weeks.
e.zh: 每台煅烧炉都连续运行数周。

e.en: The kiln {calcines} the ore at nine hundred degrees.
e.zh: 窑在九百度下煅烧矿石。

e.en: He weighs the {calcines} after each firing.
e.zh: 每次烧制后他都称量煅烧产物。

calcining.t: 煅烧；煅烧过程；正在焙烧

e.en: The {calcining} process emits significant carbon dioxide.
e.zh: 煅烧过程会排放大量二氧化碳。

e.en: Workers monitor the {calcining} furnace very carefully.
e.zh: 工人们非常仔细地监控煅烧炉。

calcinite.t: 方钙石；一种含水钙矿物

e.en: Geologists identified small crystals of {calcinite} in the sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在样本中鉴定出方钙石的小晶体。

e.en: The cave walls were lined with delicate {calcinite}.
e.zh: 洞壁覆盖着精细的方钙石。

calcinosis.t: 钙质沉着症；皮下钙沉积病

e.en: {Calcinosis} can cause painful nodules under the skin.
e.zh: 钙质沉着症可在皮下形成疼痛的结节。

e.en: The dog was diagnosed with cutaneous {calcinosis}.
e.zh: 这只狗被诊断为皮肤钙质沉着症。

calciothermy.t: 钙热还原法；金属钙还原工艺

e.en: {Calciothermy} is used to extract certain rare metals.
e.zh: 钙热还原法用于提取某些稀有金属。

e.en: Engineers prefer {calciothermy} for thorium reduction.
e.zh: 工程师们倾向于用钙热还原法还原钍。

calcipete.t: 嗜钙生物；适应高钙环境的物种

e.en: Some mosses are classified as {calcipete} species.
e.zh: 一些苔藓被归类为嗜钙物种。

e.en: Botanists labelled the herb a true {calcipete}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种草本植物标记为真正的嗜钙生物。

e.en: Many alpine plants are obligate {calciphiles}.
e.zh: 许多高山植物是专性嗜钙生物。

e.en: This rare orchid grows there because it is a {calciphile}.
e.zh: 这种稀有兰花生长在那里是因为它喜钙。

e.en: Rhododendrons are well-known garden {calciphobes}.
e.zh: 杜鹃花是著名的花园厌钙植物。

e.en: Most bog plants behave as strict {calciphobes}.
e.zh: 大多数沼泽植物都是严格的厌钙者。

calciphylaxis.t: 钙化防御症；血管钙化综合征

e.en: {Calciphylaxis} is a rare but serious complication of kidney failure.
e.zh: 钙化防御症是肾衰竭一种罕见但严重的并发症。

e.en: Doctors suspected {calciphylaxis} after the skin lesions appeared.
e.zh: 皮肤病变出现后，医生怀疑是钙化防御症。

calcitic.t: 方解石的；含方解石成分的

e.en: The reef is built from highly {calcitic} sediments.
e.zh: 这片礁石由富含方解石的沉积物构成。

e.en: Fossils embedded in {calcitic} rock are well preserved.
e.zh: 嵌在方解石岩中的化石保存良好。

calcitization.t: 方解石化作用；矿物转化为方解石

e.en: {Calcitization} altered the original aragonite shells.
e.zh: 方解石化作用改变了原本的霰石外壳。

e.en: The fossils underwent gradual {calcitization} over time.
e.zh: 这些化石随时间逐渐发生方解石化。

e.en: Farmers once used {calcium-cyanamide} as a nitrogen fertilizer.
e.zh: 农民曾经使用氰氨化钙作为氮肥。

e.en: The plant produces {calcium-cyanamide} for industrial use.
e.zh: 该工厂生产工业用氰氨化钙。

calclithite.t: 钙屑岩；碳酸盐碎屑沉积岩

e.en: The geologist labelled the sample as {calclithite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把样本标为钙屑岩。

e.en: {Calclithite} forms from eroded carbonate fragments.
e.zh: 钙屑岩由侵蚀的碳酸盐碎片形成。

calcoblast.t: 造钙细胞；分泌钙质的细胞

e.en: Coral polyps contain specialized {calcoblasts}.
e.zh: 珊瑚虫含有特殊的造钙细胞。

e.en: {Calcoblasts} secrete the mineral skeleton of the coral.
e.zh: 造钙细胞分泌珊瑚的矿物骨骼。

calcothar.t: 紫色氧化铁；煅烧后的赭石粉

e.en: {Calcothar} was once used as a polishing powder.
e.zh: 紫色氧化铁曾用作抛光粉。

e.en: Alchemists prized {calcothar} for its deep red colour.
e.zh: 炼金术士因其深红色而珍视紫氧化铁。

calcrete.t: 钙结砾岩；钙质胶结的砾石层

e.en: Hard layers of {calcrete} cover the desert floor.
e.zh: 硬层钙结砾岩覆盖着沙漠地面。

e.en: Roads here are paved with crushed {calcrete}.
e.zh: 这里的道路是用碎钙结砾岩铺成的。

e.en: The veins were filled with translucent {calcspar}.
e.zh: 这些矿脉中充填着半透明的方解石。

e.en: Miners often discarded the {calcspar} as waste rock.
e.zh: 矿工常将方解石作为废石丢弃。

calculability.t: 可计算性；可估算的性质

e.en: The {calculability} of risk varies between markets.
e.zh: 风险的可计算性因市场而异。

e.en: Quantum systems challenge the {calculability} of outcomes.
e.zh: 量子系统对结果的可计算性提出挑战。

calculably.t: 可计算地；按可估量的方式

e.en: The error grew {calculably} with each iteration.
e.zh: 误差每次迭代都按可计算的方式增长。

e.en: Sales should rise {calculably} after the launch.
e.zh: 发售后销售应该会按可估量的幅度上升。

calculagraph.t: 计时计算器；通话时长记录仪

e.en: An old {calculagraph} sat in the corner of the office.
e.zh: 办公室角落放着一台老式计时计算器。

e.en: The {calculagraph} measured call durations very precisely.
e.zh: 这台计时计算器精确地测量通话时长。

e.en: He pointed out a {calculational} error in the proof.
e.zh: 他指出了证明中的一个计算错误。

e.en: The model has serious {calculational} limitations.
e.zh: 这个模型在计算方面有严重局限。

e.en: She used {calculatory} methods to verify the result.
e.zh: 她用计算方法来验证结果。

e.en: The student showed unusual {calculatory} skill.
e.zh: 这个学生表现出非凡的计算能力。

calculi.t: 结石（复数）；体内坚硬沉积物

e.en: The patient passed two kidney {calculi} overnight.
e.zh: 患者一夜之间排出了两颗肾结石。

e.en: Surgeons removed the {calculi} during a brief procedure.
e.zh: 外科医生在简短的手术中取出了结石。

e.en: He was treated for {calculous} disease of the bladder.
e.zh: 他因膀胱结石病接受治疗。

e.en: Recurrent {calculous} infections weakened her kidneys.
e.zh: 反复发作的结石性感染削弱了她的肾功能。

caldarium.t: 古罗马浴场热水室；热浴间

e.en: Visitors lounged in the {caldarium} after the warm bath.
e.zh: 客人们洗完温水浴后在热浴室休憩。

e.en: The Roman ruins still showed traces of the {caldarium}.
e.zh: 罗马遗址仍可见热浴室的痕迹。

calefacient.t: 致温剂；产生温热感的药物

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {calefacient} ointment for her chest.
e.zh: 医生给她开了胸口用的发热软膏。

e.en: Mustard plasters act as a mild {calefacient}.
e.zh: 芥末膏起到温和的发热剂作用。

e.en: The {calefaction} of the soil aids early planting.
e.zh: 土壤的温暖化有助于提前种植。

e.en: He felt the gentle {calefaction} of the spring sun.
e.zh: 他感到春日阳光温柔的温暖。

calefactive.t: 致温的；能使温暖起来的

e.en: The drug has a mildly {calefactive} effect on the skin.
e.zh: 该药对皮肤有温和的发热作用。

e.en: Wool blankets are notably {calefactive} in winter.
e.zh: 羊毛毯子在冬天有显著的保暖作用。

calefactory.t: 修道院取暖室；致温的房间

e.en: Monks gathered in the {calefactory} to warm their hands.
e.zh: 修士们聚在取暖室里暖手。

e.en: The abbey's {calefactory} was the only heated room in winter.
e.zh: 修道院的取暖室是冬天唯一供暖的房间。

e.en: The room had been gently {calefied} by the open hearth.
e.zh: 这间屋子被敞开的炉膛烘得暖暖的。

e.en: {Calefied} water rose through the copper pipes.
e.zh: 加热的水从铜管中升起。

camphoraceous.t: 樟脑似的；带有樟脑气味的

e.en: The ointment had a strong {camphoraceous} smell.
e.zh: 那种药膏有浓烈的樟脑气味。

e.en: She noticed a {camphoraceous} odor in the old chest.
e.zh: 她在那个旧箱子里闻到一股樟脑味。

e.en: The lab synthesized {camphoric} acid for the experiment.
e.zh: 实验室合成了樟脑酸用于实验。

e.en: He detected a {camphoric} note in the perfume.
e.zh: 他在香水中辨出一丝樟脑味。

e.en: She stored her silks in a {camphorwood} chest.
e.zh: 她把丝绸收在一个樟木箱里。

e.en: The carved {camphorwood} box smelled wonderful.
e.zh: 那个雕花樟木盒子味道很香。

campier.t: 更夸张做作的；更娘炮风的

e.en: The sequel was even {campier} than the original.
e.zh: 续集比原作更加夸张做作。

e.en: His outfit looked {campier} under the stage lights.
e.zh: 他的服装在舞台灯光下显得更花哨夸张。

campiest.t: 最夸张做作的；最花哨浮夸的

e.en: It's the {campiest} musical I've ever seen.
e.zh: 这是我看过最浮夸做作的音乐剧。

e.en: She wore the {campiest} dress at the gala.
e.zh: 她在晚会上穿了最夸张浮夸的礼服。

e.en: He performed the song {campily} for laughs.
e.zh: 他夸张做作地演唱那首歌博人一笑。

e.en: The villain was played {campily} on purpose.
e.zh: 那个反派故意被演得夸张滑稽。

campiness.t: 夸张做作的风格；浮夸感

e.en: The film's charm lies in its {campiness}.
e.zh: 这部电影的魅力就在于它的夸张浮夸。

e.en: She embraced the {campiness} of the costume.
e.zh: 她欣然接受了戏服的夸张风格。

e.en: The scouts gathered for a weekend {camporee}.
e.zh: 童子军周末聚在一起举办露营大会。

e.en: Our troop won an award at the {camporee}.
e.zh: 我们小队在童子军露营大会上获奖。

e.en: We organized a family {campout} by the lake.
e.zh: 我们在湖边组织了一次家庭露营。

e.en: The kids loved their first backyard {campout}.
e.zh: 孩子们很喜欢他们第一次在后院的露营。

e.en: He sat on a {campstool} watching the sunset.
e.zh: 他坐在折叠凳上看日落。

e.en: She packed a small {campstool} for the hike.
e.zh: 她为远足带上了一张小折叠凳。

e.en: I {can't} come to the party tonight.
e.zh: 今晚我不能来参加聚会。

e.en: She {can't} swim very well yet.
e.zh: 她还不太会游泳。

can-can.t: 康康舞（一种法国高踢腿舞）

e.en: The dancers performed a lively {can-can} on stage.
e.zh: 舞者们在舞台上跳了一支热闹的康康舞。

e.en: She learned the {can-can} for the cabaret show.
e.zh: 她为夜总会表演学了康康舞。

e.en: She has a real {can-do} attitude at work.
e.zh: 她工作上有股真正的积极进取劲头。

e.en: We need someone with a {can-do} spirit.
e.zh: 我们需要一个有干劲的人。

canadianism.t: 加拿大特有用语；加拿大特色

e.en: The word "toque" is a classic {canadianism}.
e.zh: "toque"一词是典型的加拿大用语。

e.en: The novel is full of charming {canadianism}s.
e.zh: 这部小说充满了有趣的加拿大特色用语。

callose.t: 植物细胞壁中的胼胝质多糖

e.en: Botanists studied how {callose} forms in plant cell walls.
e.zh: 植物学家研究胼胝质如何在植物细胞壁中形成。

e.en: A plug of {callose} sealed the damaged tissue.
e.zh: 一团胼胝质封闭了受损的组织。

callosities.t: 多处皮肤老茧；硬化角质

e.en: Years of manual labor left thick {callosities} on his palms.
e.zh: 多年体力劳动在他手掌上留下厚厚的老茧。

e.en: Right whales develop pale {callosities} on their heads.
e.zh: 露脊鲸的头部会长出浅色的硬皮。

callosity.t: 老茧；皮肤长期摩擦形成的硬皮

e.en: A painful {callosity} formed where the new shoe rubbed.
e.zh: 新鞋摩擦的部位长出了一块疼痛的老茧。

e.en: The doctor examined the {callosity} on her heel.
e.zh: 医生检查了她脚跟上的硬皮。

callout.t: 文字标注框；公开点名批评

e.en: The article uses bold {callout} boxes for key tips.
e.zh: 这篇文章用醒目的标注框来呈现关键提示。

e.en: He received an angry {callout} for his rude remark.
e.zh: 他因粗鲁的言论被人愤怒地公开点名批评。

callouts.t: 多个文字标注；公开点名批评

e.en: The slides featured colorful {callouts} explaining each step.
e.zh: 幻灯片用彩色标注框解释每一个步骤。

e.en: Several public {callouts} embarrassed the entire company.
e.zh: 几次公开点名批评让整家公司都很难堪。

e.en: Each fighter pilot was given a unique {callsign}.
e.zh: 每位战斗机飞行员都获得了一个独特的呼号。

e.en: Her radio {callsign} was simply 'Falcon One'.
e.zh: 她的无线电呼号就是“猎鹰一号”。

e.en: The herbal tea has a gentle {calmative} effect.
e.zh: 这款花草茶具有温和的镇静作用。

e.en: Doctors prescribed a mild {calmative} after the surgery.
e.zh: 医生在手术后开了一种温和的镇静剂。

e.en: She is the {calmest} person I know.
e.zh: 她是我认识的最镇定的人。

e.en: He stayed {calmest} during the entire storm.
e.zh: 在整场暴风雨中他始终最为镇定。

calomel.t: 甘汞；用作药剂的氯化亚汞

e.en: Old medicine cabinets often contained bottles of {calomel}.
e.zh: 老式药柜里常常存放着甘汞瓶。

e.en: In the nineteenth century {calomel} was widely used as a laxative.
e.zh: 十九世纪甘汞曾被广泛用作泻药。

calorically.t: 热量上；从卡路里角度看

e.en: This dessert is {calorically} dense and rich.
e.zh: 这款甜点在热量上非常密集而丰富。

e.en: Athletes need {calorically} balanced meals every day.
e.zh: 运动员每天都需要卡路里均衡的膳食。

e.en: Scientists carefully measured the food's {caloricity}.
e.zh: 科学家仔细测量了这种食物的热值。

e.en: The fuel's {caloricity} largely determines its efficiency.
e.zh: 燃料的产热值在很大程度上决定其效率。

calorifacient.t: 产生热量的；具有生热作用的

e.en: Fatty foods are highly {calorifacient} during cold winters.
e.zh: 高脂食物在寒冬里能强烈地产生热量。

e.en: Some spices have a notable {calorifacient} effect on the body.
e.zh: 某些香料对身体有显著的产热作用。

calorification.t: 加热过程；使物体产生热量

e.en: The complete {calorification} of the room took several hours.
e.zh: 整个房间加热完毕花了好几个小时。

e.en: Engineers studied the {calorification} process inside the boiler.
e.zh: 工程师研究了锅炉内部的产热过程。

calorifier.t: 加热器；热水储存加热装置

e.en: The hotel installed a new {calorifier} for hot water.
e.zh: 酒店安装了一台新的热水加热器。

e.en: A solar {calorifier} now heats the entire water tank.
e.zh: 一台太阳能加热器现在为整个水箱加热。

e.en: These coils quickly {calorify} the circulating water.
e.zh: 这些线圈能迅速给循环水加热。

e.en: Engineers designed a system to {calorify} the cabin air.
e.zh: 工程师设计了一套系统来加热客舱空气。

calorigenic.t: 产热的；引起体内产热的

e.en: Brown fat is highly {calorigenic} in small mammals.
e.zh: 棕色脂肪在小型哺乳动物体内具有很强的产热作用。

e.en: Spicy foods can be quite {calorigenic} after a meal.
e.zh: 辛辣食物饭后可能引起明显的产热反应。

calorimetric.t: 量热法的；用于测热分析的

e.en: They used a {calorimetric} method to measure the reaction.
e.zh: 他们采用量热法测定了这一反应的热效应。

e.en: The lab purchased new {calorimetric} equipment last month.
e.zh: 实验室上个月购置了新的量热设备。

calorimetrically.t: 用量热法地；通过测热方式

e.en: The released energy was measured {calorimetrically}.
e.zh: 释放出的能量是用量热法测得的。

e.en: Researchers analyzed the samples {calorimetrically} for accuracy.
e.zh: 研究人员用量热法分析样品以确保精度。

calorize.t: 渗铝；对金属进行铝化处理

e.en: Engineers {calorize} the steel to prevent oxidation.
e.zh: 工程师对钢材进行渗铝处理以防止氧化。

e.en: They {calorize} the parts before final assembly.
e.zh: 他们在最后装配前对零件进行铝化处理。

calorizer.t: 渗铝工人；铝化处理设备

e.en: The factory uses a large {calorizer} for steel parts.
e.zh: 工厂用一台大型渗铝设备处理钢制零件。

e.en: A skilled {calorizer} carefully operates the coating machine.
e.zh: 一位熟练的渗铝工人仔细操作涂层机器。

calorizing.t: 渗铝处理；金属表面铝化工艺

e.en: The {calorizing} process protects metal from high-temperature corrosion.
e.zh: 渗铝工艺能保护金属免受高温腐蚀。

e.en: Workers were {calorizing} the turbine blades all morning.
e.zh: 工人们整个上午都在对涡轮叶片进行渗铝。

calotte.t: 神职人员的小圆帽；极地冰盖

e.en: The bishop wore a small purple {calotte} on his head.
e.zh: 主教头上戴着一顶紫色的小圆帽。

e.en: Glaciologists carefully studied the polar {calotte} for years.
e.zh: 冰川学家多年来仔细研究极地冰盖。

calotype.t: 卡罗法；早期纸基摄影术

e.en: Talbot patented the {calotype} process in 1841.
e.zh: 塔尔博特于1841年取得了卡罗摄影法的专利。

e.en: Early photographers experimented with the {calotype} technique.
e.zh: 早期摄影师们尝试使用卡罗法摄影技术。

calotypes.t: 卡罗法照片；早期纸基底片

e.en: Museums collect rare nineteenth-century {calotypes} of Edinburgh.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏着稀有的十九世纪爱丁堡卡罗法照片。

e.en: These delicate {calotypes} show Victorian street life.
e.zh: 这些精致的卡罗法照片展现了维多利亚时代的街头生活。

caloyer.t: 希腊东正教修士；东方修道士

e.en: An aging {caloyer} quietly tended the monastery garden.
e.zh: 一位年迈的东正教修士安静地照料修道院花园。

e.en: Each {caloyer} chanted the morning prayers in unison.
e.zh: 每位东正教修士齐声吟诵晨祷。

calpac.t: 高顶毡帽；土耳其式黑毛帽

e.en: He wore a tall black {calpac} during the ceremony.
e.zh: 仪式上他戴着一顶高高的黑色毡帽。

e.en: The traditional {calpac} is made of thick felt.
e.zh: 传统的高顶毡帽由厚实的毛毡制成。

calpack.t: 高顶毡帽；中亚男子传统毡帽

e.en: She bought a colorful {calpack} as a souvenir abroad.
e.zh: 她在国外买了一顶色彩鲜艳的毡帽作为纪念品。

e.en: The dancer's embroidered {calpack} matched her costume.
e.zh: 舞者绣花的毡帽与她的服装相得益彰。

calque.t: 借译词；按字面翻译的外来语

e.en: 'Skyscraper' is a common {calque} in many languages.
e.zh: “摩天大楼”是许多语言中常见的借译词。

e.en: Linguists trace each {calque} back to its source.
e.zh: 语言学家把每个借译词追溯到它的源头。

e.en: The aristocrats sneered at the {canaille} gathered below.
e.zh: 贵族们对下面聚集的乌合之众嗤之以鼻。

e.en: He dismissed the protesters as mere {canaille}.
e.zh: 他把抗议者贬为贱民。

e.en: He raised the tin {canakin} for a toast.
e.zh: 他举起锡制小酒杯祝酒。

e.en: An old {canakin} sat on the windowsill.
e.zh: 窗台上放着一个旧小罐。

e.en: They spent a week on a {canalboat} in England.
e.zh: 他们在英国乘运河船度过了一周。

e.en: The {canalboat} drifted slowly past the locks.
e.zh: 那艘运河船缓缓驶过水闸。

e.en: The bone has a {canalicular} structure under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下这块骨头呈小管状结构。

e.en: Doctors examined the {canalicular} system of the tear duct.
e.zh: 医生检查了泪管的小管系统。

e.en: The leaf stem is finely {canaliculate}.
e.zh: 叶柄上有细密的沟纹。

e.en: Botanists noted the {canaliculate} surface of the petiole.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到叶柄表面有沟纹。

e.en: The shell shows a clearly {canaliculated} margin.
e.zh: 贝壳边缘有明显的小沟。

e.en: This species has {canaliculated} stems.
e.zh: 这个物种的茎上有细沟。

e.en: Each bone cell sits in its own {canaliculus}.
e.zh: 每个骨细胞都位于自己的小管中。

e.en: Tears drain through a tiny {canaliculus}.
e.zh: 眼泪通过一条细小的小管排出。

e.en: The fossil bears {canaliform} markings on its surface.
e.zh: 化石表面有沟状的纹路。

e.en: Botanists describe the leaf as {canaliform}.
e.zh: 植物学家将这片叶子描述为沟状。

e.en: The {canalisation} of the river boosted regional trade.
e.zh: 这条河的运河化推动了区域贸易。

e.en: He spoke about the {canalisation} of public anger into reform.
e.zh: 他谈到将公众愤怒引导为改革动力。

e.en: Engineers plan to {canalise} the lower stretch of the river.
e.zh: 工程师计划把这条河的下游开凿成运河。

e.en: The campaign sought to {canalise} youthful energy into volunteering.
e.zh: 这场运动试图把年轻人的能量引向志愿服务。

e.en: The {canalization} of the river took twenty years.
e.zh: 这条河的运河化工程用了二十年。

e.en: The book studies the {canalization} of dissent in modern politics.
e.zh: 这本书研究现代政治中异见的引导汇集。

e.en: She wore a {canary-yellow} dress to the party.
e.zh: 她穿着一条鲜黄色的连衣裙去派对。

e.en: The kitchen walls were painted {canary-yellow}.
e.zh: 厨房的墙壁刷成了金丝雀黄。

e.en: Her grandmother kept a {canarybird} in the parlour.
e.zh: 她奶奶在客厅里养了一只金丝雀。

e.en: The {canarybird} sang every morning by the window.
e.zh: 那只金丝雀每天清晨在窗边歌唱。

e.en: He filled his pipe with sweet {canaster}.
e.zh: 他往烟斗里填上香甜的粗烟丝。

e.en: The shop sold imported {canaster} in tin boxes.
e.zh: 那家店出售用铁盒装的进口粗烟叶。

e.en: The dancers performed a lively {cancan} on stage.
e.zh: 舞者们在台上表演了一段欢快的康康舞。

e.en: She learned to dance the {cancan} in Paris.
e.zh: 她在巴黎学会了跳康康舞。

e.en: The flight {cancelation} ruined our vacation.
e.zh: 航班取消毁了我们的假期。

e.en: Please confirm the {cancelation} in writing.
e.zh: 请书面确认这次取消。

e.en: A {cancelbot} swept through the newsgroup deleting spam.
e.zh: 一个自动撤帖程序扫过新闻组,删除了垃圾帖。

e.en: Admins deployed a {cancelbot} to fight forum abuse.
e.zh: 管理员部署了自动撤帖程序来对抗论坛滥用。

e.en: The shell has a finely {cancellate} surface.
e.zh: 贝壳表面呈细密的网格状。

e.en: Anatomists studied the {cancellate} bone tissue.
e.zh: 解剖学家研究了网状骨组织。

e.en: The interior of the bone is largely {cancellous}.
e.zh: 骨头内部主要是海绵状的。

e.en: Surgeons grafted {cancellous} bone into the fracture.
e.zh: 外科医生把松质骨移植到骨折处。

e.en: Each {cancellus} forms part of the spongy bone matrix.
e.zh: 每根骨小梁都构成海绵骨基质的一部分。

e.en: The microscope revealed a single {cancellus} clearly.
e.zh: 显微镜清楚地显示出一根骨小梁。

e.en: Untreated lesions can {cancerate} over time.
e.zh: 未经治疗的病变可能随时间癌变。

e.en: The mole began to {cancerate} after years of sun exposure.
e.zh: 那颗痣在多年日晒后开始癌变。

e.en: The biopsy showed {cancerated} tissue throughout.
e.zh: 活检显示组织已全部癌变。

e.en: Doctors removed the {cancerated} growth in surgery.
e.zh: 医生在手术中切除了已癌变的肿块。

e.en: As a {cancerian}, she was famously sentimental.
e.zh: 作为巨蟹座的人,她出了名的多愁善感。

e.en: He matched every {cancerian} stereotype perfectly.
e.zh: 他完美符合每一项巨蟹座的刻板印象。

e.en: Studies confirmed the substance is {cancerogenic}.
e.zh: 研究证实该物质具有致癌性。

e.en: Workers were exposed to {cancerogenic} fumes for years.
e.zh: 工人多年来一直接触致癌烟雾。

e.en: She specializes in {cancerology} at the research institute.
e.zh: 她在该研究所专攻肿瘤学。

e.en: Modern {cancerology} relies heavily on genetics.
e.zh: 现代肿瘤学高度依赖遗传学。

e.en: His {cancerophobia} drove him to monthly checkups.
e.zh: 他的癌症恐惧症让他每月都要做体检。

e.en: Therapy helped her manage her crippling {cancerophobia}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助她控制了严重的癌症恐惧症。

e.en: The composer wrote a {cancrine} canon that reads the same backwards.
e.zh: 这位作曲家写了一首倒读相同的蟹行卡农。

e.en: Linguists noted the {cancrine} structure of the verse.
e.zh: 语言学家注意到这首诗的回文结构。

e.en: The {cancrivorous} otter hunts along rocky shores.
e.zh: 这种食蟹水獭在多岩石的海岸觅食。

e.en: Many seabirds are largely {cancrivorous}.
e.zh: 许多海鸟主要以蟹为食。

e.en: Bach included a {cancrizans} canon in the Musical Offering.
e.zh: 巴赫在《音乐的奉献》中加入了一段蟹行卡农。

e.en: The melody returns in {cancrizans} form near the end.
e.zh: 旋律在结尾处以逆行形式再现。

e.en: The creature has a vaguely {cancroid} body shape.
e.zh: 这种生物长着一副略似蟹的身体。

e.en: Pathologists identified a {cancroid} skin lesion.
e.zh: 病理学家发现了一处类癌皮肤病变。

e.en: {Cancrum} oris devastates malnourished children.
e.zh: 走马疳严重摧残营养不良的儿童。

e.en: The clinic treats cases of {cancrum} in remote villages.
e.zh: 这家诊所在偏远村庄治疗走马疳病例。

candareen.t: 分(中国旧重量与货币单位)

e.en: The merchant weighed the gold to the last {candareen}.
e.zh: 商人把金子精确称到最后一分。

e.en: Old ledgers list prices in taels and {candareen}.
e.zh: 旧账本上的价格以两和分为单位。

e.en: The lamp emits about 1000 {candela} of light.
e.zh: 这盏灯发出约1000坎德拉的光。

e.en: Engineers measured the beam in {candela}.
e.zh: 工程师用坎德拉测量光束。

e.en: The blacksmith pulled a {candent} bar from the forge.
e.zh: 铁匠从炉中抽出一根白热的铁条。

e.en: Stars burn with a {candent} brilliance.
e.zh: 恒星以白热的光辉燃烧。

e.en: The iron glowed with a fierce {candescence}.
e.zh: 铁块发出炽烈的白热光。

e.en: He stared into the {candescence} of the furnace.
e.zh: 他凝视着炉膛的白热光芒。

e.en: The {candescent} filament lit the room.
e.zh: 白热的灯丝照亮了房间。

e.en: Sparks flew from the {candescent} metal.
e.zh: 火花从灼热的金属上飞溅出来。

e.en: He used a {candid-camera} to film passersby.
e.zh: 他用偷拍相机拍下路人。

e.en: The show relied on {candid-camera} pranks.
e.zh: 这档节目靠隐藏摄像机的恶作剧吸引观众。

candidateship.t: 候选人资格；候选人身份

e.en: She withdrew her {candidateship} last week.
e.zh: 她上周撤回了候选人资格。

e.en: His {candidateship} drew little media attention.
e.zh: 他的候选人身份没有引起多少媒体关注。

e.en: He gave a {candidous} reply.
e.zh: 他给出了坦率的回答。

e.en: Her {candidous} manner won their trust.
e.zh: 她坦率的态度赢得了他们的信任。

e.en: She lit a {candle-end} to read by.
e.zh: 她点燃一截残烛就着光读书。

e.en: Only a {candle-end} remained on the table.
e.zh: 桌上只剩下一截蜡烛头。

e.en: They dined by {candle-light}.
e.zh: 他们在烛光下用餐。

e.en: The room glowed with soft {candle-light}.
e.zh: 房间里映着柔和的烛光。

e.en: He used a {candle-snuffer} to extinguish the flame.
e.zh: 他用灭烛器熄灭了火苗。

e.en: A silver {candle-snuffer} sat beside the holder.
e.zh: 烛台旁放着一只银制灭烛器。

e.en: They harvested {candleberry} for wax.
e.zh: 他们采摘杨梅用来制蜡。

e.en: The {candleberry} bushes grew along the coast.
e.zh: 蜡烛果灌木沿海岸生长。

e.en: Native peoples dried {candlefish} for fuel.
e.zh: 原住民把蜡烛鱼晒干当燃料。

e.en: The {candlefish} is rich in oil.
e.zh: 蜡烛鱼富含油脂。

e.en: They roasted {candlenut} for the sauce.
e.zh: 他们烘烤石栗来做酱料。

e.en: The {candlenut} tree thrives in the tropics.
e.zh: 石栗树在热带地区生长茂盛。

e.en: He knocked down every {candlepin}.
e.zh: 他把每一根细瓶都击倒了。

e.en: A {candlepin} is thinner than a tenpin.
e.zh: 细瓶比十瓶保龄球的瓶子要细。

candlepins.t: 细瓶保龄球（一种保龄球运动）

e.en: They played {candlepins} every Friday.
e.zh: 他们每个周五都打细瓶保龄球。

e.en: {Candlepins} is popular in New England.
e.zh: 细瓶保龄球在新英格兰地区很流行。

e.en: The lamp has high {candlepower}.
e.zh: 这盏灯的烛光很高。

e.en: Engineers measured the bulb's {candlepower}.
e.zh: 工程师测量了灯泡的烛光值。

e.en: She reached for the {candlesnuffer}.
e.zh: 她伸手去拿灭烛器。

e.en: An antique {candlesnuffer} hung on the wall.
e.zh: 墙上挂着一只古董烛花剪。

e.en: The {candlewick} burned steadily.
e.zh: 烛芯稳稳地燃烧着。

e.en: She admired the {candlewick} bedspread.
e.zh: 她欣赏那条烛芯线绣的床罩。

e.en: They burned {candlewood} for light.
e.zh: 他们烧烛木来照明。

e.en: {Candlewood} produces a bright flame.
e.zh: 烛木燃烧时火焰明亮。

candock.t: 萍蓬草；睡莲科水生植物

e.en: Yellow {candock} floated on the pond.
e.zh: 黄色的萍蓬草漂浮在池塘上。

e.en: They identified the plant as {candock}.
e.zh: 他们鉴定这种植物是萍蓬草。

candoluminescence.t: 灼热发光；炽热发光现象

e.en: The mantle glows by {candoluminescence}.
e.zh: 这种网罩借灼热发光发出光亮。

e.en: Scientists studied the {candoluminescence} of the oxide.
e.zh: 科学家研究了这种氧化物的炽热发光现象。

candy-striped.t: 红白条纹的；糖果条纹的

e.en: She wore a {candy-striped} dress.
e.zh: 她穿着一条红白条纹的连衣裙。

e.en: The shop had a {candy-striped} awning.
e.zh: 店铺挂着糖果条纹的雨棚。

e.en: The {candyman} handed out free samples.
e.zh: 糖果贩子免费派发样品。

e.en: Police arrested the neighborhood {candyman}.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了那一带的毒贩。

e.en: White {candytuft} bordered the path.
e.zh: 白色屈曲花镶嵌在小路两旁。

e.en: She planted {candytuft} along the wall.
e.zh: 她沿着墙栽种了蜂室花。

e.en: Deer hid in the {canebreak}.
e.zh: 鹿群藏在甘蔗丛里。

e.en: They cut a path through the {canebreak}.
e.zh: 他们在竹丛地里开出一条路。

e.en: The {canecutter} worked under the hot sun.
e.zh: 砍蔗工在烈日下劳作。

e.en: A {canecutter} darted through the swamp.
e.zh: 一只沼泽兔穿过沼泽。

canephoros.t: 持篮少女像（古希腊雕塑）

e.en: The temple displayed a marble {canephoros}.
e.zh: 神庙里陈列着一尊大理石持篮少女像。

e.en: Each {canephoros} carried offerings on her head.
e.zh: 每尊持篮少女像头上都顶着祭品。

e.en: A {canephorus} stood by the altar.
e.zh: 祭坛旁立着一尊持篮人像。

e.en: The frieze featured a row of {canephorus} figures.
e.zh: 檐壁上雕刻着一排持篮人像。

e.en: The leaves had a soft {canescence}.
e.zh: 叶面上覆着柔软的灰白绒毛。

e.en: Age brought a {canescence} to his hair.
e.zh: 岁月让他的头发渐渐变白。

canescent.t: 渐变灰白的；覆盖灰白绒毛的

e.en: The plant's {canescent} leaves shimmered.
e.zh: 这种植物覆着灰白绒毛的叶子闪闪发亮。

e.en: His {canescent} beard reached his chest.
e.zh: 他渐变灰白的胡须垂到了胸前。

e.en: The museum displayed Wedgwood {caneware}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了韦奇伍德的米黄色精陶器。

e.en: She collected antique {caneware}.
e.zh: 她收藏古董米黄色精陶器。

canfield.t: 坎菲尔德纸牌（一种单人扑克游戏）

e.en: Grandma played {canfield} every evening.
e.zh: 奶奶每晚都玩坎菲尔德纸牌。

e.en: He learned {canfield} from an old book.
e.zh: 他从一本旧书里学会了坎菲尔德纸牌。

e.en: He poured a {canful} of paint.
e.zh: 他倒出一罐油漆。

e.en: She drank a whole {canful} in seconds.
e.zh: 她几秒钟就喝掉了一整罐。

e.en: The prisoner wore a heavy {cang}.
e.zh: 囚犯戴着沉重的木枷。

e.en: A {cang} once humiliated petty offenders.
e.zh: 木枷曾用来羞辱轻罪犯人。

e.en: He was sentenced to wear the {cangue}.
e.zh: 他被判戴上木枷。

e.en: The {cangue} weighed down his shoulders.
e.zh: 木枷沉沉地压在他的肩上。

e.en: They endured the {canicular} heat.
e.zh: 他们忍受着三伏天的酷热。

e.en: Ancient texts noted the {canicular} days.
e.zh: 古籍中记载了三伏天。

e.en: Paris suffered through a brutal {canicule}.
e.zh: 巴黎经历了一段酷烈的三伏天。

e.en: The {canicule} drove people to the coast.
e.zh: 酷暑期把人们赶往海边。

e.en: He spoke {cankeredly} to the clerk.
e.zh: 他对店员说话尖刻。

e.en: She replied {cankeredly} to every question.
e.zh: 她对每个问题都乖戾地作答。

cankerous.t: 溃疡的；腐蚀性的；恶毒的

e.en: The tree had a {cankerous} wound.
e.zh: 那棵树上有一处溃疡的伤口。

e.en: His {cankerous} remarks poisoned the meeting.
e.zh: 他恶毒的话语毁了整个会议。

e.en: A {cankerworm} stripped the leaves.
e.zh: 一只尺蠖把叶子啃光了。

e.en: Farmers sprayed to control the {cankerworm}.
e.zh: 农民喷药控制尺蠖。

e.en: The fruit had a {cankery} patch.
e.zh: 那只水果上有一块溃烂的斑点。

e.en: He grew {cankery} with old age.
e.zh: 他随着年纪渐长变得乖戾起来。

e.en: Many users take {cannabidiol} oil to ease anxiety.
e.zh: 许多人服用大麻二酚油来缓解焦虑。

e.en: The shop sells {cannabidiol} gummies and creams.
e.zh: 这家店出售大麻二酚软糖和乳膏。

e.en: Researchers study how {cannabinoids} affect the brain.
e.zh: 研究人员研究大麻素如何影响大脑。

e.en: The plant produces dozens of different {cannabinoid} compounds.
e.zh: 这种植物会产生数十种不同的大麻素化合物。

e.en: {Cannabinol} is mildly psychoactive compared with THC.
e.zh: 与THC相比，大麻酚的精神活性较弱。

e.en: Aged cannabis tends to contain more {cannabinol}.
e.zh: 陈化的大麻往往含有更多的大麻酚。

cannel.t: 烛煤；一种富含油质的煤

e.en: Old lamps once burned oil distilled from {cannel} coal.
e.zh: 旧式油灯曾燃烧从烛煤中提炼的油。

e.en: The miners struck a thick seam of {cannel}.
e.zh: 矿工们挖到了一层厚厚的烛煤。

e.en: The novel describes a {cannibalic} ritual in vivid detail.
e.zh: 小说生动地描写了一场食人仪式。

e.en: Some fish display {cannibalic} behavior when overcrowded.
e.zh: 某些鱼在过度拥挤时会表现出同类相食的行为。

e.en: He poured the rum into a tin {cannikin}.
e.zh: 他把朗姆酒倒进一个小锡杯里。

e.en: The sailors raised their {cannikins} in a toast.
e.zh: 水手们举起小酒杯祝酒。

e.en: Her business {canniness} earned her a fortune.
e.zh: 她在生意上的精明为她赚得了财富。

e.en: The deal showed his usual political {canniness}.
e.zh: 这笔交易展现了他一贯的政治精明。

e.en: A {cannon-ball} crashed through the ship's hull.
e.zh: 一枚炮弹穿透了船体。

e.en: He dove into the pool like a {cannon-ball}.
e.zh: 他像炮弹一样跳进泳池。

e.en: They anchored just out of {cannon-shot} of the fort.
e.zh: 他们把船停在堡垒炮弹射程之外。

e.en: A single {cannon-shot} signaled the attack.
e.zh: 一声炮响发出了进攻的信号。

e.en: The {cannoneer} loaded the gun in seconds.
e.zh: 炮手几秒钟内就装好了炮弹。

e.en: Veteran {cannoneers} aimed for the enemy's flagship.
e.zh: 老练的炮兵瞄准了敌方旗舰。

cannonproof.t: 防炮弹的；炮弹打不穿的

e.en: The fortress walls were said to be {cannonproof}.
e.zh: 据说这座堡垒的城墙是防炮弹的。

e.en: No medieval armor was truly {cannonproof}.
e.zh: 没有任何中世纪盔甲真正能防炮弹。

e.en: Distant {cannonry} rumbled through the night.
e.zh: 远处的炮火声整夜隆隆作响。

e.en: The general commanded a powerful line of {cannonry}.
e.zh: 将军指挥着一支强大的炮兵阵列。

e.en: The engineer designed a {cannular} combustion chamber.
e.zh: 工程师设计了一个管状燃烧室。

e.en: The bone has a {cannular} structure inside.
e.zh: 这块骨头内部呈管状结构。

e.en: The doctor moved to {cannulate} the patient's vein.
e.zh: 医生开始给病人的静脉插管。

e.en: It is hard to {cannulate} small children.
e.zh: 给小孩子插管很困难。

e.en: Surgeons use {cannulated} screws to guide bone fixation.
e.zh: 外科医生使用空心螺钉来引导骨骼固定。

e.en: The patient was {cannulated} before the infusion began.
e.zh: 输液开始前病人已插好了管。

e.en: The skilled {canoeman} navigated the rapids easily.
e.zh: 这位熟练的独木舟手轻松地驶过急流。

e.en: Each {canoeman} took turns steering the boat.
e.zh: 每位划手轮流掌舵。

e.en: She entered the convent and became a {canoness}.
e.zh: 她进入修道院，成为一名女修士。

e.en: The {canoness} taught the village children to read.
e.zh: 这位女修士教村里的孩子识字。

e.en: He was appointed to a {canonicate} at the cathedral.
e.zh: 他被任命担任大教堂的教士职位。

e.en: The {canonicate} carried both honor and duty.
e.zh: 这一教士职位既有荣誉也有职责。

e.en: Scholars debated the {canonicity} of the disputed text.
e.zh: 学者们争论这部有争议文本的正典性。

e.en: Fans question the {canonicity} of the spin-off novel.
e.zh: 粉丝们质疑这部外传小说的正史地位。

e.en: He took a {canonistic} approach to the question.
e.zh: 他用教会法的方式来处理这个问题。

e.en: The ruling rested on {canonistic} principles.
e.zh: 该裁决基于教会法原则。

e.en: Her thesis explores {canonistical} writings of the Middle Ages.
e.zh: 她的论文探讨中世纪的教会法著作。

e.en: The bishop sought a {canonistical} interpretation.
e.zh: 主教寻求一种教会法的解释。

canonry.t: 教士职位；教士团的圣俸

e.en: He was awarded a {canonry} at York Minster.
e.zh: 他被授予约克大教堂的教士职位。

e.en: The {canonry} provided him a steady income.
e.zh: 这一教士圣俸为他提供了稳定的收入。

e.en: He held a {canonship} in the diocese for years.
e.zh: 他多年来在教区担任教士职位。

e.en: Her {canonship} brought her into the chapter.
e.zh: 她的教士身份让她得以加入议会。

e.en: The choir filled the hall with {canorous} song.
e.zh: 合唱团用悦耳的歌声充满了大厅。

e.en: He spoke in a deep, {canorous} voice.
e.zh: 他用低沉而洪亮的嗓音说话。

e.en: The tenor sang {canorously} above the orchestra.
e.zh: 男高音在乐队之上悦耳地歌唱。

e.en: Bells rang {canorously} across the valley.
e.zh: 钟声悦耳地回荡在山谷之间。

e.en: Critics praised the {canorousness} of her voice.
e.zh: 评论家赞美她嗓音的悦耳。

e.en: The hall is famous for its acoustic {canorousness}.
e.zh: 这座大厅以其音响的洪亮悦耳而闻名。

cantabile.t: 如歌的；流畅抒情地（音乐术语）

e.en: The pianist played the slow movement {cantabile}.
e.zh: 钢琴家以如歌般的方式演奏慢乐章。

e.en: She admired the {cantabile} line of the melody.
e.zh: 她欣赏这段旋律如歌般的线条。

e.en: The balcony rests on a steel {cantalever}.
e.zh: 阳台架在一根钢制悬臂上。

e.en: Engineers tested the {cantalever} for heavy loads.
e.zh: 工程师们测试了这根悬臂的承重能力。

e.en: She sliced a ripe {cantaloup} for breakfast.
e.zh: 她切了一个熟透的哈密瓜当早餐。

e.en: The market sells sweet {cantaloup} in summer.
e.zh: 夏天市场上有甜美的哈密瓜出售。

e.en: Play this passage {cantando}, like a singer.
e.zh: 这一段要如歌般演奏，像歌手一样。

e.en: The violin entered softly and {cantando}.
e.zh: 小提琴轻柔而如歌般地进入。

e.en: The aging {cantatrice} still performed at small recitals.
e.zh: 那位年迈的女歌唱家仍在小型独唱会上演出。

e.en: She trained for years to become a celebrated {cantatrice}.
e.zh: 她苦练多年才成为著名的女歌唱家。

e.en: Ancient texts mention {cantharides} as a dangerous aphrodisiac.
e.zh: 古籍中提到斑蝥是一种危险的春药。

e.en: The doctor warned that {cantharides} could be fatal in small doses.
e.zh: 医生警告说斑蝥即便小剂量也可能致命。

e.en: Doctors apply {cantharidin} to remove stubborn warts.
e.zh: 医生用斑蝥素去除顽固的疣。

e.en: {Cantharidin} is extracted from blister beetles.
e.zh: 斑蝥素从斑蝥中提取。

canthi.t: 眼角；内外眦（canthus 的复数）

e.en: The surgeon examined both {canthi} carefully before operating.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术前仔细检查了双眼的眼角。

e.en: Tears collected at the inner {canthi} of her eyes.
e.zh: 泪水积聚在她的内眼角处。

e.en: A small lesion appeared near the outer {canthus}.
e.zh: 外眼角附近出现了一个小病变。

e.en: The makeup artist drew a line from the inner {canthus} outward.
e.zh: 化妆师从内眼角向外画了一条线。

e.en: The cellist played a soft {cantilena} that moved the audience.
e.zh: 大提琴手演奏了一段柔美的抒情旋律，打动了观众。

e.en: This passage is marked as a {cantilena} in the score.
e.zh: 乐谱上把这一段标注为如歌的旋律。

e.en: The rabbi will {cantillate} the Torah portion this Sabbath.
e.zh: 拉比将在本周安息日吟诵这段托拉经文。

e.en: Students learn to {cantillate} the ancient verses correctly.
e.zh: 学生们学习如何正确吟诵古老的经文。

cantillated.t: 用吟诵调诵读（cantillate 的过去式）

e.en: He {cantillated} the prayer with deep feeling.
e.zh: 他满怀深情地吟诵了那段祈祷文。

e.en: The cantor {cantillated} the passage flawlessly.
e.zh: 领唱者完美无瑕地吟诵了这段经文。

e.en: The elder was {cantillating} the scripture as we entered.
e.zh: 我们进去时，长者正在吟诵经文。

e.en: He spent hours {cantillating} the Hebrew text.
e.zh: 他花了好几个小时吟诵那段希伯来文。

cantillation.t: 吟诵；经文吟唱（尤指犹太教）

e.en: Hebrew {cantillation} follows ancient melodic patterns.
e.zh: 希伯来文的经文吟唱遵循古老的旋律范式。

e.en: He studied {cantillation} for years before leading services.
e.zh: 他研习经文吟诵多年后才主持礼拜。

e.en: He gripped the {cantle} as the horse reared.
e.zh: 马匹直立时，他紧紧抓住鞍后桥。

e.en: A leather pouch was tied to the {cantle} of the saddle.
e.zh: 一个皮袋系在马鞍的后桥上。

e.en: The {cantonization} of the territory eased ethnic tensions.
e.zh: 将该地区划分为多个州缓解了族群紧张。

e.en: Some politicians proposed {cantonization} as a federal solution.
e.zh: 一些政客提议以分州方式作为联邦解决方案。

e.en: They sought to {cantonize} the country along ethnic lines.
e.zh: 他们试图按族群划分把国家分成若干州。

e.en: Reformers wanted to {cantonize} the region for better governance.
e.zh: 改革者希望将该地区划分为多个州以改善治理。

cantoral.t: 领唱者的；唱诗领唱有关的

e.en: He pursued {cantoral} studies at the seminary.
e.zh: 他在神学院学习领唱专业。

e.en: The choir followed the {cantoral} cues precisely.
e.zh: 唱诗班严格按照领唱的提示演唱。

cantorial.t: 领唱者的；与犹太教领唱有关的

e.en: She enrolled in a {cantorial} training program.
e.zh: 她报名参加了领唱培训项目。

e.en: His {cantorial} voice filled the synagogue.
e.zh: 他作为领唱的嗓音回荡在犹太会堂里。

e.en: The trebles sang from the {cantoris} side of the choir.
e.zh: 高音童声部从唱诗班的领唱席一侧演唱。

e.en: Today the verse is taken by {cantoris}.
e.zh: 今天这一段由领唱席一侧演唱。

e.en: The wizard cast a simple {cantrip} to light the room.
e.zh: 巫师施了一个简单的小法术照亮了房间。

e.en: Children laughed at the old woman's harmless {cantrip}.
e.zh: 孩子们对老妇人无害的小咒术哈哈大笑。

e.en: The composer built the motet around a Gregorian {cantus}.
e.zh: 作曲家以一段格里高利圣咏为核心构建了这首经文歌。

e.en: The tenor sustains the {cantus} firmus throughout.
e.zh: 男高音从头到尾持续唱出定旋律。

canty.t: 快活的；活泼的（苏格兰方言）

e.en: The old fisherman remained {canty} despite his hardships.
e.zh: 那位老渔夫尽管历经艰辛仍然乐天开朗。

e.en: She greeted us with a {canty} smile.
e.zh: 她以快活的笑容迎接我们。

e.en: The nurse inserted a fine {canula} into the patient's vein.
e.zh: 护士把一根细插管插入病人的静脉。

e.en: Oxygen flowed through the {canula} into his nose.
e.zh: 氧气通过插管输入他的鼻腔。

e.en: The doctor described the {canular} procedure to the trainees.
e.zh: 医生向实习生讲解了插管操作。

e.en: He suffered a minor {canular} infection after surgery.
e.zh: 术后他出现了轻微的插管处感染。

e.en: Surgeons must {canulate} the artery before bypass.
e.zh: 外科医生必须在搭桥前为动脉插管。

e.en: They will {canulate} the vein to administer fluids.
e.zh: 他们将给静脉插管以输液。

e.en: The surgeon used a {canulated} screw to align the bone.
e.zh: 外科医生用一颗中空螺钉来对准骨骼。

e.en: They successfully {canulated} the patient's femoral artery.
e.zh: 他们成功为病人的股动脉插了管。

canulates.t: 插管；置入导管（第三人称单数）

e.en: The anesthesiologist {canulates} the vein swiftly.
e.zh: 麻醉师迅速给静脉插上导管。

e.en: She {canulates} dozens of patients each shift.
e.zh: 她每个班次为几十位病人插管。

e.en: The team is {canulating} the patient for dialysis.
e.zh: 团队正在为病人插管以进行透析。

e.en: He has trouble {canulating} small veins.
e.zh: 他给细小静脉插管有困难。

canute-like.t: 螳臂当车般的；徒劳抗拒潮流的

e.en: His {canute-like} efforts to halt the trend were doomed.
e.zh: 他想阻止这股潮流的徒劳努力注定失败。

e.en: Critics mocked the policy as {canute-like}.
e.zh: 评论人士嘲讽这项政策是螳臂当车。

canvaslike.t: 帆布般的；像画布一样的

e.en: The desert spread out, vast and {canvaslike}, before us.
e.zh: 沙漠像一幅广阔的画布一样在我们面前铺开。

e.en: She wore a sturdy, {canvaslike} jacket for the trip.
e.zh: 她穿了一件结实的帆布般的夹克去旅行。

e.en: They built a cabin on the {canyonside}.
e.zh: 他们在峡谷壁上建了一座小屋。

e.en: Wildflowers covered the steep {canyonside}.
e.zh: 野花布满了陡峭的峡谷一侧。

e.en: Gabrieli's {canzona} showcases polychoral writing.
e.zh: 加布里埃利的坎佐纳展现了多重唱队的写作手法。

e.en: The ensemble performed an early Baroque {canzona}.
e.zh: 乐团演奏了一首巴洛克早期的坎佐纳。

canzone.t: 坎佐内；一种意大利抒情诗或歌曲

e.en: Petrarch perfected the {canzone} as a poetic form.
e.zh: 彼特拉克把坎佐内这一诗体推向了完美。

e.en: The tenor sang a wistful {canzone}.
e.zh: 男高音演唱了一首充满忧思的坎佐内。

canzones.t: 坎佐内（复数）；多首意大利抒情歌

e.en: He composed a set of {canzones} for solo voice and lute.
e.zh: 他为独唱和琉特琴创作了一组坎佐内。

e.en: Her recital included several Renaissance {canzones}.
e.zh: 她的独唱会上演唱了好几首文艺复兴时期的坎佐内。

e.en: The composer wrote a charming {canzonet} for two voices.
e.zh: 作曲家为两个声部写了一首迷人的小坎佐内。

e.en: This Elizabethan {canzonet} is light and playful.
e.zh: 这首伊丽莎白时代的小坎佐内轻盈又俏皮。

e.en: Early industries imported {caoutchouc} from the Amazon.
e.zh: 早期工业从亚马逊地区进口生橡胶。

e.en: The chemist studied the elasticity of {caoutchouc}.
e.zh: 那位化学家研究了天然橡胶的弹性。

cap-a-pie.t: 全副武装地；从头到脚地

e.en: The knight rode out armed {cap-a-pie}.
e.zh: 骑士全副武装地骑马出征。

e.en: He arrived dressed {cap-a-pie} for the formal ball.
e.zh: 他从头到脚精心装扮赴正式舞会。

e.en: She wore a {cap-sleeve} dress to the wedding.
e.zh: 她穿了一件盖肩袖连衣裙去参加婚礼。

e.en: The blouse has a flattering {cap-sleeve} cut.
e.zh: 这件衬衫的盖肩袖剪裁很显身材。

e.en: The vet specializes in {caprine} diseases.
e.zh: 这位兽医专门研究山羊疾病。

e.en: Farmers studied {caprine} behavior in the highlands.
e.zh: 农民研究了高地山羊的行为。

e.en: The trained stallion performed a graceful {capriole}.
e.zh: 受训的种马优雅地腾跃了一下。

e.en: Children watched the goat's playful {capriole}.
e.zh: 孩子们看着山羊嬉戏地蹦跳。

e.en: The horse {caprioled} across the show ring.
e.zh: 那匹马在表演场上腾跃而过。

e.en: Lambs {caprioled} happily through the meadow.
e.zh: 羊羔们欢快地在草地上蹦跳。

e.en: The dressage horse executes elegant {caprioles}.
e.zh: 这匹盛装舞步马表演优雅的腾跃动作。

e.en: She admired the goat's playful {caprioles}.
e.zh: 她欣赏山羊俏皮的蹦跳。

e.en: The colt was {caprioling} in the field.
e.zh: 小马驹在田野里蹦跳着。

e.en: We saw lambs {caprioling} at sunrise.
e.zh: 我们看见羊羔在日出时蹦跳。

e.en: Oil is trapped beneath the impermeable {caprock}.
e.zh: 石油被困在不渗透的盖岩之下。

e.en: Geologists examined the eroded {caprock} layer.
e.zh: 地质学家检查了风化的盖岩层。

caprolactam.t: 己内酰胺（合成尼龙的原料）

e.en: The factory produces {caprolactam} for nylon manufacturing.
e.zh: 该工厂生产用于制造尼龙的己内酰胺。

e.en: {Caprolactam} prices fluctuate with crude oil markets.
e.zh: 己内酰胺价格随原油市场波动。

e.en: Coconut oil contains a lot of {caprylic} acid.
e.zh: 椰子油含有大量辛酸。

e.en: {Caprylic} acid has antifungal properties.
e.zh: 辛酸具有抗真菌特性。

e.en: Red peppers get their color from {capsanthin}.
e.zh: 红辣椒的颜色来自辣椒红素。

e.en: {Capsanthin} is widely used as a food colorant.
e.zh: 辣椒红素广泛用作食品着色剂。

capsheaf.t: 麦垛顶捆；顶峰；最高成就

e.en: This award is the {capsheaf} of her career.
e.zh: 这个奖项是她事业的顶峰。

e.en: He placed the {capsheaf} atop the stack.
e.zh: 他把顶捆放在麦堆顶上。

e.en: The {capsizal} of the boat shocked everyone.
e.zh: 小船的倾覆令所有人震惊。

e.en: Strong winds caused the kayak's {capsizal}.
e.zh: 强风导致皮划艇翻覆。

capsomer.t: 壳粒（病毒衣壳的蛋白亚单位）

e.en: Each viral {capsomer} forms part of the shell.
e.zh: 每个病毒壳粒构成外壳的一部分。

e.en: Researchers counted the {capsomer} units precisely.
e.zh: 研究人员精确地数出了壳粒数量。

capsomere.t: 壳粒（病毒衣壳的蛋白亚单位）

e.en: A virus capsid contains many {capsomere} subunits.
e.zh: 病毒衣壳含有许多壳粒亚单位。

e.en: Each {capsomere} is built from identical proteins.
e.zh: 每个壳粒由相同的蛋白质构成。

e.en: Hundreds of {capsomeres} form the viral coat.
e.zh: 数百个壳粒构成病毒外壳。

e.en: The {capsomeres} assemble into a symmetric shell.
e.zh: 壳粒组装成对称的外壳。

e.en: The doctor noted a {capsulary} structure on the scan.
e.zh: 医生在扫描中注意到一个囊状结构。

e.en: The tumor had a clear {capsulary} boundary.
e.zh: 肿瘤有明显的囊状边界。

e.en: The lab will {capsulate} the new medication.
e.zh: 实验室将把新药装入胶囊。

e.en: They {capsulate} the seeds for easy planting.
e.zh: 他们把种子包入囊中以便种植。

e.en: The vitamins come in {capsulated} form.
e.zh: 这些维生素以胶囊形式提供。

e.en: {Capsulated} bacteria resist immune attack.
e.zh: 有荚膜的细菌能抵抗免疫攻击。

e.en: The {capsulation} process protects the drug.
e.zh: 封装过程保护了药物。

e.en: Engineers improved the {capsulation} of the chip.
e.zh: 工程师改进了芯片的封装。

capsulise.t: 装入胶囊；概括（英式拼法）

e.en: Try to {capsulise} the report in one paragraph.
e.zh: 试着用一段话概括这份报告。

e.en: Pharmacists {capsulise} the powder for patients.
e.zh: 药剂师把粉末装入胶囊给患者服用。

e.en: She was diagnosed with adhesive {capsulitis}.
e.zh: 她被诊断为粘连性关节囊炎。

e.en: {Capsulitis} severely limited his shoulder movement.
e.zh: 关节囊炎严重限制了他的肩部活动。

e.en: Can you {capsulize} the article in two sentences?
e.zh: 你能用两句话概括这篇文章吗？

e.en: They {capsulize} the powder for easier dosing.
e.zh: 他们把粉末装入胶囊以便服用。

e.en: He {capsulized} the year's events brilliantly.
e.zh: 他出色地概括了这一年的大事。

e.en: The medicine is {capsulized} for convenience.
e.zh: 为便于服用，这种药做成了胶囊。

e.en: This phrase {capsulizes} her entire philosophy.
e.zh: 这句话概括了她的全部哲学。

e.en: The factory {capsulizes} thousands of pills daily.
e.zh: 工厂每天把数千粒药装入胶囊。

e.en: She is {capsulizing} the meeting's main points.
e.zh: 她正在概括会议的要点。

e.en: Workers are {capsulizing} the new supplement.
e.zh: 工人们正在把新补剂装入胶囊。

e.en: The surgeon performed a laser {capsulotomy}.
e.zh: 外科医生实施了激光囊切开术。

e.en: {Capsulotomy} can restore vision after cataract surgery.
e.zh: 囊切开术可在白内障手术后恢复视力。

e.en: He earned the {captainship} of the rugby team.
e.zh: 他赢得了橄榄球队的队长职位。

e.en: Her {captainship} brought the crew through the storm.
e.zh: 她的船长指挥让船员安然渡过风暴。

e.en: Farmers spray {captan} to prevent fruit rot.
e.zh: 农民喷洒克菌丹来防止水果腐烂。

e.en: Some countries have banned {captan} use.
e.zh: 一些国家已禁止使用克菌丹。

e.en: The will was challenged on grounds of {captation}.
e.zh: 这份遗嘱因涉嫌不当诱取而被质疑。

e.en: He accused her of {captation} over the inheritance.
e.zh: 他指控她在继承上施加了不当影响。

e.en: I had to solve a {captcha} to log in.
e.zh: 我得通过一个验证码才能登录。

e.en: This {captcha} is really hard to read.
e.zh: 这个验证码真难看清楚。

captionless.t: 无标题的；无说明文字的

e.en: She posted a mysterious {captionless} photo online.
e.zh: 她在网上发了一张神秘的无说明照片。

e.en: The {captionless} image confused many readers.
e.zh: 这张无说明文字的图片让许多读者困惑。

e.en: The audience listened in complete {captivation}.
e.zh: 观众完全着迷地聆听着。

e.en: Her {captivation} with art began in childhood.
e.zh: 她对艺术的迷恋始于童年。

e.en: The young singer was a true {captivator}.
e.zh: 这位年轻歌手真是个迷人的人。

e.en: As a storyteller, he is a born {captivator}.
e.zh: 作为讲故事的人，他是天生的吸引者。

e.en: In the legend, the {captress} took many prisoners.
e.zh: 传说中，那位女俘获者抓了许多俘虏。

e.en: She was hailed as a fearless {captress}.
e.zh: 她被誉为无畏的女征服者。

e.en: The monk pulled his {capuche} over his head.
e.zh: 修士把尖头风帽拉到头上。

e.en: Rain dripped from the edge of his {capuche}.
e.zh: 雨水从他风帽的边缘滴落。

e.en: A {capuched} figure walked through the cloister.
e.zh: 一个戴风帽的身影走过回廊。

e.en: The {capuched} monks chanted softly.
e.zh: 戴风帽的修士们轻声吟诵。

e.en: The training program {capacitates} workers to handle complex tasks.
e.zh: 这个培训项目使工人能够处理复杂的工作。

e.en: Specific hormones {capacitate} sperm before fertilization.
e.zh: 特定激素在受精前使精子获能。

e.en: This degree {capacitates} her to practice law.
e.zh: 这个学位让她有资格执业律师。

e.en: Long experience {capacitates} him for leadership roles.
e.zh: 长期经验使他能够胜任领导职务。

e.en: The medium is {capacitating} the sperm in vitro.
e.zh: 这种培养液正在体外使精子获能。

e.en: Mentorship is {capacitating} the new hires quickly.
e.zh: 导师指导让新员工迅速胜任工作。

e.en: Sperm {capacitation} occurs in the female reproductive tract.
e.zh: 精子获能发生在雌性生殖道内。

e.en: Staff {capacitation} is a key part of the project.
e.zh: 员工能力建设是该项目的关键部分。

e.en: The material's {capacitivity} affects circuit timing.
e.zh: 材料的电容率会影响电路时序。

e.en: Engineers measured the {capacitivity} of the dielectric.
e.zh: 工程师测量了该电介质的电容率。

e.en: We spotted a male {capercaillie} in the pine forest.
e.zh: 我们在松林里发现了一只雄性松鸡。

e.en: The {capercaillie} is now rare in Scotland.
e.zh: 如今松鸡在苏格兰已十分稀少。

e.en: The {capersome} puppy chased its own tail.
e.zh: 那只爱嬉闹的小狗追着自己的尾巴。

e.en: Her {capersome} mood lifted everyone's spirits.
e.zh: 她活泼好动的情绪感染了每一个人。

e.en: She wore soft gray {capeskin} gloves to dinner.
e.zh: 她戴着柔软的灰色山羊皮手套去赴宴。

e.en: {Capeskin} leather is prized for its suppleness.
e.zh: 开普羊皮以其柔软度而备受推崇。

e.en: The matador's {capework} drew gasps from the crowd.
e.zh: 斗牛士的披风技艺引来观众阵阵惊叹。

e.en: Years of practice perfected his {capework}.
e.zh: 多年的练习使他的披风技艺炉火纯青。

e.en: The plant produces fine {capillaceous} leaves.
e.zh: 这种植物长着细如毛发的叶子。

e.en: Under the microscope the threads looked {capillaceous}.
e.zh: 显微镜下这些丝线显得纤细如发。

e.en: Water rises in a thin tube due to {capillarity}.
e.zh: 由于毛细作用，水会在细管中上升。

e.en: Plants use {capillarity} to draw moisture from the soil.
e.zh: 植物利用毛细现象从土壤中吸取水分。

capillaroscope.t: 毛细血管显微镜；甲皱镜

e.en: The doctor used a {capillaroscope} to examine the nailbed.
e.zh: 医生用毛细血管显微镜检查甲床。

e.en: A {capillaroscope} can reveal early signs of scleroderma.
e.zh: 毛细血管显微镜能发现硬皮病的早期迹象。

e.en: He paid tax on the {capital-gain} from selling the stock.
e.zh: 他为出售股票所得的资本利得缴了税。

e.en: {Capital-gain} rates differ from ordinary income tax rates.
e.zh: 资本利得税率与普通所得税率有所不同。

capitalistically.t: 以资本主义方式；按资本主义规律

e.en: The country reformed its economy {capitalistically}.
e.zh: 这个国家以资本主义方式改革了经济。

e.en: He approaches every decision {capitalistically}.
e.zh: 他以资本主义思维考量每一个决定。

e.en: These expenses are {capitalizable} under the new rules.
e.zh: 根据新规这些费用可以资本化。

e.en: Only certain costs are {capitalizable} on the balance sheet.
e.zh: 资产负债表上只有部分成本可资本化。

capitate.t: 头状的；头状骨；簇生头状的

e.en: Clover bears small {capitate} flower clusters.
e.zh: 三叶草开着小小的头状花序。

e.en: She fractured her {capitate} bone in the fall.
e.zh: 她跌倒时摔断了头状骨。

capitellate.t: 具小头状的；簇生小头状花序的

e.en: The botanist noted the plant's {capitellate} inflorescence.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到该植物具有小头状花序。

e.en: These mosses develop {capitellate} structures at maturity.
e.zh: 这些苔藓成熟时会形成小头状结构。

e.en: The radius articulates with the {capitellum} of the humerus.
e.zh: 桡骨与肱骨小头形成关节。

e.en: He fractured the {capitellum} during the fall.
e.zh: 他跌倒时骨折了肱骨小头。

camiknicker.t: 女式连衫衬裤；连体内衣

e.en: She bought a silk {camiknicker} for her trousseau.
e.zh: 她为嫁妆买了一件丝质连衫衬裤。

e.en: The boutique displayed a vintage lace {camiknicker}.
e.zh: 精品店展示了一件复古蕾丝连衫衬裤。

camiknickers.t: 女式连衫衬裤；连体衬衣裤

e.en: She wore lace {camiknickers} under her dress.
e.zh: 她裙子里穿着蕾丝连衫衬裤。

e.en: The shop sells silk {camiknickers} in pastel colors.
e.zh: 这家店出售各色丝绸连衫衬裤。

e.en: The general planned a daring {camisade} at midnight.
e.zh: 将军计划在午夜发起一次大胆的夜袭。

e.en: Their {camisade} caught the enemy completely off guard.
e.zh: 他们的夜袭让敌人毫无防备。

e.en: He led a {camisado} against the sleeping garrison.
e.zh: 他率部对沉睡的驻军发起夜袭。

e.en: The {camisado} was a bold tactic of olden wars.
e.zh: 夜袭是古代战争中的大胆战术。

camise.t: 轻便长衫；薄衬衣；薄外袍

e.en: He wore a loose linen {camise} in the heat.
e.zh: 他在炎热中穿着宽松的亚麻长衫。

e.en: The traveler's white {camise} was stained with dust.
e.zh: 旅人白色的长衫沾满了尘土。

e.en: The merchant sold rolls of fine {camlet}.
e.zh: 商人出售上等驼毛布卷。

e.en: Her cloak was made of dark {camlet}.
e.zh: 她的斗篷由深色驼毛织物制成。

camleted.t: 用驼毛织物制成的；衬以驼毛布的

e.en: The trunk had a fine {camleted} lining.
e.zh: 箱子内衬着精致的驼毛织物。

e.en: She admired the {camleted} jacket in the window.
e.zh: 她欣赏橱窗里那件驼毛布外套。

camogie.t: 卡莫吉(爱尔兰女子曲棍球)

e.en: She plays {camogie} for her county team.
e.zh: 她为家乡郡队效力卡莫吉。

e.en: {Camogie} is a sport similar to hurling.
e.zh: 卡莫吉是一项类似爱尔兰曲棍球的运动。

camorra.t: 卡莫拉黑帮；那不勒斯犯罪集团

e.en: The {camorra} dominates the Naples underworld.
e.zh: 卡莫拉黑帮控制着那不勒斯黑社会。

e.en: Police arrested several members of the {camorra}.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了卡莫拉黑帮的多名成员。

camorrist.t: 卡莫拉成员；那不勒斯黑帮分子

e.en: The {camorrist} was sentenced to twenty years.
e.zh: 那名卡莫拉成员被判处二十年监禁。

e.en: He was identified as a notorious {camorrist}.
e.zh: 他被认定为臭名昭著的黑帮分子。

camouflageable.t: 可加以伪装的；能掩饰的

e.en: The vehicle is easily {camouflageable} in dense forests.
e.zh: 这种车辆在密林中很容易加以伪装。

e.en: Most equipment is {camouflageable} with proper paint.
e.zh: 大多数装备只要涂料合适就能加以伪装。

e.en: We sat around the {camp-fire} singing songs.
e.zh: 我们围着营火唱歌。

e.en: The scouts built a small {camp-fire} for warmth.
e.zh: 童子军们生起小篝火取暖。

camp-follower.t: 随营人员；追随者；趋附者

e.en: The army's {camp-followers} included merchants and families.
e.zh: 军队的随营人员包括商贩和家眷。

e.en: He was dismissed as a mere {camp-follower}.
e.zh: 他被讥为不过是个趋附者。

camp-in.t: 露宿静坐抗议；占地式抗议

e.en: Students staged a {camp-in} on the lawn.
e.zh: 学生在草坪上发起了露宿静坐抗议。

e.en: The protest turned into a week-long {camp-in}.
e.zh: 抗议演变成长达一周的占地静坐。

camp-out.t: 露营；户外过夜；野外过夜

e.en: We had a family {camp-out} last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们一家人去露营了。

e.en: The kids loved the backyard {camp-out}.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在后院露营过夜。

campaniform.t: 钟形的；钟状的；呈钟状的

e.en: The flower has a {campaniform} corolla.
e.zh: 这种花有钟形花冠。

e.en: Insects bear {campaniform} sensilla on their wings.
e.zh: 昆虫翅膀上长有钟形感觉器。

campanological.t: 鸣钟学的；与钟乐有关的

e.en: He took a {campanological} course at the abbey.
e.zh: 他在修道院上了一门鸣钟学课程。

e.en: The book covers many {campanological} traditions.
e.zh: 这本书介绍了许多鸣钟学传统。

campanologist.t: 鸣钟学家；敲钟人；钟乐研究者

e.en: The {campanologist} rings the cathedral's great bells.
e.zh: 这位敲钟人敲响大教堂的大钟。

e.en: She is a renowned {campanologist} in England.
e.zh: 她是英国著名的鸣钟学家。

campanology.t: 鸣钟学；钟乐研究；钟乐艺术

e.en: He devoted his life to {campanology}.
e.zh: 他毕生致力于鸣钟学研究。

e.en: {Campanology} has a rich tradition in Britain.
e.zh: 鸣钟学在英国有悠久的传统。

campanulaceous.t: 桔梗科的；属风铃草科的

e.en: Botanists study {campanulaceous} plants in the meadow.
e.zh: 植物学家在草地上研究桔梗科植物。

e.en: The garden featured many {campanulaceous} species.
e.zh: 花园里展示了许多桔梗科植物。

campanulate.t: 钟形的；钟状的；像钟一样的

e.en: The flower's {campanulate} shape attracts bees.
e.zh: 这朵花呈钟形，吸引蜜蜂。

e.en: She admired the {campanulate} blossoms in the garden.
e.zh: 她欣赏花园里钟状的花朵。

campanulated.t: 钟形的；铃铛状的；呈钟形的

e.en: The vase had a finely {campanulated} rim.
e.zh: 花瓶有精致的钟形边缘。

e.en: Each delicate petal is {campanulated} at the tip.
e.zh: 每片精致的花瓣顶端呈钟形。

e.en: The scouts learned {campcraft} from their leader.
e.zh: 童子军们跟队长学习野营技能。

e.en: Good {campcraft} keeps you safe in the wilderness.
e.zh: 良好的野营技能让你在荒野中保持安全。

campership.t: 夏令营资助；营地奖学金

e.en: She won a {campership} to attend summer camp.
e.zh: 她获得夏令营资助参加暑期营。

e.en: The charity offers {camperships} to underprivileged children.
e.zh: 慈善机构为贫困儿童提供营地奖学金。

campesterol.t: 菜油甾醇；一种植物甾醇

e.en: {Campesterol} is found in many vegetable oils.
e.zh: 菜油甾醇存在于多种植物油中。

e.en: The plant contains high levels of {campesterol}.
e.zh: 这种植物含有大量菜油甾醇。

e.en: He painted {campestral} scenes of the countryside.
e.zh: 他绘制了乡间的田园风光。

e.en: The poem evokes a peaceful {campestral} mood.
e.zh: 这首诗营造出宁静的田园氛围。

carbamate.t: 氨基甲酸酯；氨基甲酸盐

e.en: The pesticide contains a {carbamate} compound.
e.zh: 这种农药含有一种氨基甲酸酯化合物。

e.en: They synthesized a new {carbamate} for the trial.
e.zh: 他们为试验合成了一种新的氨基甲酸酯。

e.en: Some {carbamates} are widely used as insecticides.
e.zh: 一些氨基甲酸酯被广泛用作杀虫剂。

e.en: The lab tested several {carbamates} for toxicity.
e.zh: 实验室测试了几种氨基甲酸酯的毒性。

e.en: The unstable {carbamic} acid quickly decomposes.
e.zh: 不稳定的氨基甲酸会迅速分解。

e.en: They studied the {carbamic} ester intermediate.
e.zh: 他们研究了这种氨基甲酸酯中间体。

e.en: The cream contains {carbamide} to soften skin.
e.zh: 这种乳霜含有尿素以软化皮肤。

e.en: {Carbamide} is another name for urea.
e.zh: Carbamide 是尿素的另一种叫法。

e.en: They added a {carbamoyl} group to the molecule.
e.zh: 他们在分子上加了一个氨基甲酰基。

e.en: The enzyme transfers a {carbamoyl} unit.
e.zh: 这种酶会转移一个氨基甲酰基单元。

e.en: {Carbamoylation} of the protein altered its activity.
e.zh: 该蛋白的氨基甲酰化改变了其活性。

e.en: They optimized the {carbamoylation} step yield.
e.zh: 他们优化了氨基甲酰化步骤的产率。

e.en: Older papers use the term {carbamyl} group.
e.zh: 早期文献使用 carbamyl 基团这一说法。

e.en: The {carbamyl} phosphate enters the urea cycle.
e.zh: 氨基甲酰磷酸进入尿素循环。

e.en: The reaction proceeds via a stable {carbanion}.
e.zh: 该反应通过一个稳定的碳负离子进行。

e.en: A {carbanion} attacks the electrophilic carbon.
e.zh: 碳负离子进攻亲电性的碳原子。

carbarn.t: 电车车库；有轨电车停放场

e.en: The old {carbarn} now houses a museum.
e.zh: 那座老电车车库如今改作博物馆。

e.en: Trams returned to the {carbarn} at midnight.
e.zh: 电车在午夜返回车库。

carbaryl.t: 甲萘威；西维因（一种杀虫剂）
