e.en: Ornate {carven} figures decorated the church doors.
e.zh: 教堂大门上装饰着精雕细刻的人像。

e.en: Moonlight fell on the {carven} stone pillars.
e.zh: 月光洒在雕刻的石柱上。

catena.t: 一连串；一系列相关事物

e.en: He compiled a {catena} of patristic quotations.
e.zh: 他汇编了一系列教父著作的引文。

e.en: The book offers a {catena} of historical examples.
e.zh: 这本书提供了一连串历史实例。

catenaccio.t: 链式防守（意大利足球战术）

e.en: Italian teams perfected {catenaccio} in the 1960s.
e.zh: 意大利球队在六十年代将链式防守发挥到极致。

e.en: Their {catenaccio} style frustrated every attacker.
e.zh: 他们的链式防守让每个进攻球员都很沮丧。

e.en: The cable forms a {catenarian} curve.
e.zh: 这根缆绳形成一条悬链曲线。

e.en: Engineers studied the {catenarian} shape of the bridge.
e.zh: 工程师研究了这座桥的悬链形状。

e.en: The script {catenates} the strings together.
e.zh: 该脚本将字符串连接成串。

e.en: Researchers can {catenate} short DNA fragments.
e.zh: 研究人员可以将短的 DNA 片段连接起来。

e.en: The {catenated} rings cannot be separated.
e.zh: 这些连环相扣的环无法分开。

e.en: They observed {catenated} DNA loops.
e.zh: 他们观察到连成链状的 DNA 环。

catenates.t: 连接成链；串联（动词第三人称单数）

e.en: Carbon readily {catenates} with itself.
e.zh: 碳很容易自身相连成链。

e.en: This enzyme {catenates} two ring molecules.
e.zh: 这种酶将两个环状分子连接起来。

e.en: Carbon's {catenation} explains organic chemistry's diversity.
e.zh: 碳的成链能力解释了有机化学的多样性。

e.en: The {catenation} of events led to disaster.
e.zh: 一连串事件导致了灾难。

e.en: "Want to go" uses a {catenative} verb.
e.zh: "想要去"使用了连动动词。

e.en: English has many {catenative} verb constructions.
e.zh: 英语有许多连动动词结构。

e.en: A soap film between two rings forms a {catenoid}.
e.zh: 两个环之间的肥皂膜形成一个悬链曲面。

e.en: The {catenoid} is a minimal surface.
e.zh: 悬链曲面是一种极小曲面。

cater-cornered.t: 斜对角的；对角线方向的

e.en: The bakery sits {cater-cornered} from the bank.
e.zh: 那家面包店在银行的斜对角。

e.en: They lived {cater-cornered} across the intersection.
e.zh: 他们住在十字路口的斜对面。

cateran.t: 苏格兰高地劫掠者；强盗

e.en: The {cateran} raided cattle from lowland farms.
e.zh: 那个高地劫掠者从低地农场抢走牛群。

e.en: Old ballads tell of fierce {caterans}.
e.zh: 古老的民谣讲述了凶猛的高地劫匪。

e.en: The diner is {catercorner} from the post office.
e.zh: 那家餐馆在邮局的斜对角。

e.en: She glanced {catercorner} across the room.
e.zh: 她朝房间的斜对角瞥了一眼。

e.en: The houses sat {catercornered} on the lot.
e.zh: 两座房子在这块地上呈斜对角分布。

e.en: He parked {catercornered} to the curb.
e.zh: 他斜对着路边停了车。

cateress.t: 女宴席承办人；女膳食供应者

e.en: The {cateress} prepared meals for the wedding.
e.zh: 那位女宴席承办人为婚礼准备了饭菜。

e.en: She worked as a {cateress} for years.
e.zh: 她做女膳食承办人做了好多年。

catfooted.t: 轻步如猫的；脚步轻悄的

e.en: The {catfooted} thief made no sound.
e.zh: 那个脚步轻悄的小偷没发出任何声响。

e.en: She moved across the floor in a {catfooted} way.
e.zh: 她以轻盈如猫的步伐穿过地板。

catgut.t: 羊肠线（用于乐器弦或外科缝合）

e.en: Old violin strings were made of {catgut}.
e.zh: 旧的小提琴弦是用羊肠线做的。

e.en: The surgeon used {catgut} to close the wound.
e.zh: 外科医生用羊肠线缝合了伤口。

e.en: She wept {cathartically} after the funeral.
e.zh: 葬礼之后她痛快地大哭一场。

e.en: He laughed {cathartically} at the absurd situation.
e.zh: 他对那荒唐的处境痛快地大笑起来。

e.en: The anchor was secured to the {cathead}.
e.zh: 锚被固定在锚架上。

e.en: Sailors hauled the chain over the {cathead}.
e.zh: 水手们把锚链拉过锚架。

cathect.t: 投注情感能量于（心理学）

e.en: Children {cathect} their parents from infancy.
e.zh: 孩子从婴儿期就将情感投注在父母身上。

e.en: He {cathected} all his hopes onto the project.
e.zh: 他把全部希望都投注在这个项目上。

e.en: The therapist analyzed her {cathectic} bonds.
e.zh: 治疗师分析了她的情感投注关系。

e.en: Freud described {cathectic} energy in detail.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德详细描述了情感投注的能量。

e.en: The bishop spoke from his {cathedra}.
e.zh: 主教从他的座位上讲话。

e.en: The pope speaks ex {cathedra} on doctrine.
e.zh: 教宗以教座权威就教义发言。

e.en: {Cathepsin} breaks down proteins inside cells.
e.zh: 组织蛋白酶在细胞内分解蛋白质。

e.en: Researchers study {cathepsin} in cancer biology.
e.zh: 研究人员研究组织蛋白酶在癌症生物学中的作用。

catherine-wheel.t: 旋转烟花；车轮形侧手翻

e.en: The children watched the {catherine-wheel} spin in the garden.
e.zh: 孩子们看着花园里的旋转烟花飞转。

e.en: He performed a perfect {catherine-wheel} across the lawn.
e.zh: 他在草坪上做了一个漂亮的车轮翻。

catherine-wheels.t: 旋转烟花；车轮形侧手翻（复数）

e.en: They lit several {catherine-wheels} for the festival.
e.zh: 他们为节日点燃了几个旋转烟花。

e.en: The gymnasts performed a series of {catherine-wheels}.
e.zh: 体操运动员连续做了几个车轮翻。

e.en: The nurse had to {catheterise} the patient overnight.
e.zh: 护士不得不为病人通宵插导尿管。

e.en: Doctors decided to {catheterise} him before surgery.
e.zh: 医生决定在手术前给他插导管。

e.en: Cardiac {catheterization} revealed a blocked artery.
e.zh: 心导管检查发现一条动脉阻塞。

e.en: The procedure required {catheterization} of the bladder.
e.zh: 该手术需要进行膀胱导尿。

e.en: Surgeons will {catheterize} the artery to inject dye.
e.zh: 外科医生会将导管插入动脉以注入造影剂。

e.en: They had to {catheterize} him after the operation.
e.zh: 手术后他们不得不给他插导尿管。

e.en: The patient was {catheterized} on admission to the ICU.
e.zh: 病人入住重症监护室时被插了导管。

e.en: She felt uncomfortable while being {catheterized}.
e.zh: 插导管时她感到很不舒服。

catheterizes.t: 给…插导管（第三人称单数）

e.en: The cardiologist routinely {catheterizes} patients with chest pain.
e.zh: 心脏科医生通常会给胸痛患者做导管检查。

e.en: This nurse {catheterizes} several patients each shift.
e.zh: 这位护士每班都要给几位病人插导管。

e.en: {Catheterizing} the femoral vein requires careful technique.
e.zh: 插入股静脉导管需要谨慎的操作。

e.en: She is {catheterizing} the patient now.
e.zh: 她正在给病人插导尿管。

e.en: The lab used a {cathetometer} to measure liquid levels precisely.
e.zh: 实验室用高度计精确测量液面。

e.en: Calibrating the {cathetometer} took most of the morning.
e.zh: 校准测高仪花了一上午的时间。

e.en: The {cathodal} current stimulated the nerve fibres.
e.zh: 阴极电流刺激了神经纤维。

e.en: Researchers measured the {cathodal} response of the cells.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了细胞的阴极反应。

e.en: {Cathodeluminescence} imaging revealed the mineral's growth zones.
e.zh: 阴极发光成像揭示了矿物的生长带。

e.en: The lab specialises in {cathodeluminescence} analysis.
e.zh: 该实验室专门从事阴极发光分析。

e.en: The pipeline is protected {cathodically} against corrosion.
e.zh: 管道通过阴极保护防止腐蚀。

e.en: They charged the metal {cathodically} during the experiment.
e.zh: 实验中他们对金属进行了阴极充电。

cathole.t: 猫洞；野外排便挖的小坑

e.en: Hikers should dig a {cathole} well away from streams.
e.zh: 徒步者应在远离溪流的地方挖一个排便小坑。

e.en: The barn door had a small {cathole} cut into it.
e.zh: 谷仓门上开了一个小猫洞。

e.en: His tastes are {catholically} broad and unpredictable.
e.zh: 他的品味广泛而难以捉摸。

e.en: She read {catholically} across many genres.
e.zh: 她广泛涉猎各种文学体裁。

e.en: The missionaries sought to {catholicise} the region.
e.zh: 传教士试图使该地区天主教化。

e.en: Reformers tried to {catholicise} the curriculum.
e.zh: 改革者试图使课程更具普遍性。

e.en: They worked to {catholicize} the local population.
e.zh: 他们致力于使当地居民改信天主教。

e.en: The new policy aims to {catholicize} the school's outlook.
e.zh: 新政策旨在使学校的视野更加广泛。

catholicized.t: 已天主教化的；已普遍化的

e.en: The kingdom was largely {catholicized} by the tenth century.
e.zh: 到十世纪该王国大体已被天主教化。

e.en: His views had been {catholicized} by years of travel.
e.zh: 多年的旅行使他的观点变得更加包容。

catholicizes.t: 使天主教化（第三人称单数）

e.en: The church {catholicizes} new converts each Easter.
e.zh: 教会每年复活节都接纳新的天主教皈依者。

e.en: Travel naturally {catholicizes} one's perspective.
e.zh: 旅行自然会拓宽一个人的视野。

e.en: The bishop spent decades {catholicizing} remote villages.
e.zh: 主教花了数十年使偏远村庄天主教化。

e.en: Reading widely has a {catholicizing} effect on the mind.
e.zh: 广泛阅读对心智有开阔包容的作用。

e.en: He sold a so-called {catholicon} for every ailment.
e.zh: 他兜售一种号称包治百病的万灵药。

e.en: There is no {catholicon} for the economy's troubles.
e.zh: 经济问题没有什么万灵药可以解决。

e.en: The {catholyte} was carefully circulated through the cell.
e.zh: 阴极电解液被小心地循环流过电池。

e.en: Engineers monitored the {catholyte} pH every hour.
e.zh: 工程师每小时监测一次阴极电解液的pH值。

e.en: The polymer is {cationically} initiated under acidic conditions.
e.zh: 该聚合物在酸性条件下以阳离子方式引发。

e.en: These monomers polymerize {cationically} at low temperatures.
e.zh: 这些单体在低温下以阳离子方式聚合。

e.en: He dismissed the weak tea as mere {catlap}.
e.zh: 他把那杯淡茶斥为索然无味的水。

e.en: The soup was thin {catlap} not worth eating.
e.zh: 那汤稀薄无味，根本不值得喝。

e.en: He gave himself a quick {catlick} before running out.
e.zh: 他出门前匆匆抹了把脸。

e.en: The kitchen got only a {catlick} before the guests arrived.
e.zh: 客人到来前厨房只是草草擦了一下。

e.en: The telescope uses a {catoptric} system of mirrors.
e.zh: 这台望远镜使用反射镜系统。

e.en: He studied {catoptric} optics in graduate school.
e.zh: 他在研究生阶段研究反射光学。

catoptrical.t: 反射镜的；与镜面反射有关的

e.en: The lab demonstrated several {catoptrical} effects.
e.zh: 实验室演示了几种反射光学效应。

e.en: Ancient Greeks wrote about {catoptrical} principles.
e.zh: 古希腊人曾论述反射光学原理。

e.en: Hero of Alexandria wrote on {catoptrics}.
e.zh: 亚历山大的希罗著有关于反射光学的著作。

e.en: {Catoptrics} deals with the reflection of light.
e.zh: 反射光学研究光的反射现象。

e.en: Medieval mystics practiced {catoptromancy} to foresee events.
e.zh: 中世纪的神秘主义者用镜卜术预知未来。

e.en: She wrote a thesis on ancient {catoptromancy}.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于古代镜卜术的论文。

e.en: They sailed a small {catrigged} dinghy.
e.zh: 他们驾驶着一艘单桅纵帆小艇。

e.en: The {catrigged} boat handled the wind well.
e.zh: 这艘单桅纵帆船很好地应对了风力。

e.en: The old coat was lined with {catskin}.
e.zh: 那件旧外套衬着猫皮。

e.en: Vendors once sold gloves made of {catskin}.
e.zh: 商贩曾经出售猫皮手套。

e.en: He realized he was just a {catspaw} in their scheme.
e.zh: 他意识到自己不过是他们阴谋中的工具。

e.en: The minister became a {catspaw} of foreign powers.
e.zh: 那位部长成了外国势力的傀儡。

e.en: Ranchers bred {cattalo} for hardier herds.
e.zh: 牧场主培育牛野牛杂交种以获得更强健的牛群。

e.en: The {cattalo} thrived on the open range.
e.zh: 这种杂交牛在开阔的牧场上长得很好。

e.en: We boarded our cat at a local {cattery}.
e.zh: 我们把猫寄养在本地的猫舍。

e.en: She runs a small {cattery} in the countryside.
e.zh: 她在乡下经营一家小型猫舍。

cattier.t: 更刻薄的；更恶毒的（指言语）

e.en: Her remarks grew {cattier} as the night went on.
e.zh: 夜越深，她的话越刻薄。

e.en: He's {cattier} than his sister when gossiping.
e.zh: 说起闲话来他比他姐姐更尖酸。

cattiest.t: 最刻薄的；最恶毒的（指言语）

e.en: That was the {cattiest} thing she'd ever said.
e.zh: 那是她说过的最刻薄的话。

e.en: He made the {cattiest} comments at dinner.
e.zh: 他在晚餐上说了些最尖酸的话。

e.en: She {cattily} mocked her colleague's outfit.
e.zh: 她刻薄地嘲笑同事的衣着。

e.en: They gossiped {cattily} about the new hire.
e.zh: 他们刻薄地议论着新来的员工。

e.en: Her {cattiness} made the office tense.
e.zh: 她的刻薄让办公室气氛紧张。

e.en: There was a hint of {cattiness} in his tone.
e.zh: 他的语气中带着一丝刻薄。

e.en: She gave him a {cattish} smile before leaving.
e.zh: 她临走前给了他一个猫一般狡黠的微笑。

e.en: His {cattish} remarks annoyed everyone.
e.zh: 他刻薄的话让大家都很不快。

e.en: The car rattled over the {cattle-grid}.
e.zh: 汽车咣当咣当地驶过防牛栅栏。

e.en: A {cattle-grid} kept the sheep off the road.
e.zh: 防牛栅栏让羊群无法上路。

e.en: The sheriff hunted the notorious {cattle-lifter}.
e.zh: 治安官追捕那个臭名昭著的偷牛贼。

e.en: He was hanged as a {cattle-lifter}.
e.zh: 他作为偷牛贼被处以绞刑。

e.en: His grandfather was a Texas {cattle-rancher}.
e.zh: 他的祖父是德州的养牛场主。

e.en: The {cattle-rancher} drove his herd north.
e.zh: 那位养牛场主把牛群赶往北方。

e.en: Vigilantes caught the {cattlelifter} at dawn.
e.zh: 民团在黎明时分抓住了偷牛贼。

e.en: He had a reputation as a fearless {cattlelifter}.
e.zh: 他以胆大包天的偷牛贼闻名。

e.en: He grew prize-winning {cattleyas} in his garden.
e.zh: 他在花园里种出了得奖的卡特兰。

e.en: The shop displayed dozens of fragrant {cattleyas}.
e.zh: 店里陈列着几十朵芬芳的卡特兰。

catwhisker.t: （早期收音机的）触须接点；猫须线

e.en: He adjusted the {catwhisker} on the crystal radio.
e.zh: 他调整着矿石收音机上的猫须接点。

e.en: The fine {catwhisker} touched the galena crystal.
e.zh: 细细的猫须线触在方铅矿晶体上。

e.en: The surgeon examined the {cauda} equina carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了马尾神经。

e.en: Damage to the {cauda} caused leg weakness.
e.zh: 尾部损伤导致腿部无力。

e.en: The nerve runs {caudad} along the spine.
e.zh: 该神经沿脊柱向尾部延伸。

e.en: Move the probe {caudad} to find the lesion.
e.zh: 将探头向尾部方向移动以找到病灶。

e.en: The {caudate} nucleus is part of the brain.
e.zh: 尾状核是大脑的一部分。

e.en: They studied {caudate} amphibians like salamanders.
e.zh: 他们研究蝾螈等有尾两栖动物。

e.en: The fossil showed a clearly {caudated} body.
e.zh: 化石显示出明显带尾的身体。

e.en: Many {caudated} species live in damp forests.
e.zh: 许多有尾物种生活在潮湿的森林中。

e.en: The plant's swollen {caudex} stores water.
e.zh: 这种植物膨大的茎干基部储存水分。

e.en: Collectors prize the gnarled {caudex} of this species.
e.zh: 收藏家珍视这种植物虬曲的肉质茎。

e.en: The shelf displayed several twisted {caudexes}.
e.zh: 架子上摆着几株扭曲的肉质茎植物。

e.en: Older {caudexes} develop a corky surface.
e.zh: 较老的肉质茎会形成木栓状表皮。

caudices.t: 肉质茎（复数，拉丁语形式）

e.en: The botanist photographed ancient {caudices} in the desert.
e.zh: 植物学家在沙漠里拍下了古老的肉质茎。

e.en: These {caudices} can live for centuries.
e.zh: 这些肉质茎可以存活数百年。

caudillismo.t: 考迪罗主义；强人独裁政治

e.en: Latin American history is shaped by {caudillismo}.
e.zh: 拉美历史深受考迪罗主义影响。

e.en: The country struggled to escape {caudillismo}.
e.zh: 这个国家努力摆脱强人独裁政治。

caudle.t: 加香料的热饮（旧时给病人喝）

e.en: She brewed a warm {caudle} for the invalid.
e.zh: 她为病人煮了一碗暖暖的香料热饮。

e.en: Medieval recipes often included {caudle}.
e.zh: 中世纪的食谱中常有这种香料热饮。

e.en: She {caudled} the wine with eggs and spices.
e.zh: 她把葡萄酒和鸡蛋香料一起煮成热饮。

e.en: The nurse {caudled} a drink for the patient.
e.zh: 护士为病人调制了一碗香料热饮。

e.en: She spent the morning {caudling} ale for the sick.
e.zh: 她整个上午都在为病人调制香料麦酒。

e.en: {Caudling} was a common kitchen task long ago.
e.zh: 调制香料热饮过去是常见的厨房活计。

e.en: This species is distinctly {caulescent} when mature.
e.zh: 这种植物成熟时有明显的茎。

e.en: Botanists noted the {caulescent} growth habit.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到它有茎的生长习性。

e.en: The seedling's {caulicle} emerged from the soil.
e.zh: 幼苗的小茎从土壤中冒了出来。

e.en: He examined the {caulicle} under a microscope.
e.zh: 他在显微镜下观察这条幼茎。

e.en: The fungus is {caulicolous}, growing on plant stems.
e.zh: 这种真菌生于茎上，长在植物的茎部。

e.en: Researchers catalogued several {caulicolous} species.
e.zh: 研究人员记录了几种生于茎上的物种。

e.en: They sailed a wooden {catboat} across the bay.
e.zh: 他们驾着一艘木制单桅小帆船横渡海湾。

e.en: The old {catboat} had a single mast near the bow.
e.zh: 那艘旧式小帆船船首附近只有一根桅杆。

e.en: Thick {catbrier} blocked the trail through the woods.
e.zh: 密集的菝葜挡住了林间小路。

e.en: He cut back the {catbrier} growing along the fence.
e.zh: 他修剪了沿着篱笆生长的菝葜。

e.en: These drawers became {catch-alls} for random junk.
e.zh: 这些抽屉成了堆放各种杂物的万能筐。

e.en: The term covers many {catch-alls} in the law.
e.zh: 这一术语在法律中涵盖了许多概括性条款。

catch-as-catch-can.t: 随机应变的；不拘形式的

e.en: Lunch was a {catch-as-catch-can} affair on busy days.
e.zh: 忙碌的日子里午餐都是凑合着吃。

e.en: Their training was {catch-as-catch-can} during the tour.
e.zh: 巡演期间他们的训练都是见缝插针。

catch-penny.t: 哗众取宠的；廉价劣质的

e.en: The shop sold {catch-penny} trinkets to tourists.
e.zh: 那家店向游客兜售廉价的小玩意儿。

e.en: Critics dismissed the film as a {catch-penny} stunt.
e.zh: 评论家把这部电影斥为哗众取宠的噱头。

e.en: His {catch-phrase} became famous on television.
e.zh: 他的口头禅在电视上广为流传。

e.en: Every politician seems to need a {catch-phrase}.
e.zh: 似乎每个政客都需要一句标志性的口号。

e.en: We met for coffee and a quick {catch-up}.
e.zh: 我们见面喝咖啡顺便聊聊近况。

e.en: She has a lot of {catch-up} after missing class.
e.zh: 缺课之后她有很多功课要补。

catchability.t: 可捕获性；易被捕获的程度

e.en: The study measured the {catchability} of local fish.
e.zh: 该研究测量了当地鱼类的可捕获性。

e.en: Weather affects the {catchability} of the species.
e.zh: 天气会影响该物种的可捕获程度。

e.en: Equality became the {catchcry} of the campaign.
e.zh: 平等成了这场运动的口号。

e.en: Their {catchcry} was repeated at every rally.
e.zh: 他们的口号在每次集会上都被反复高呼。

e.en: Pink {catchfly} bloomed along the rocky slope.
e.zh: 粉红色的蝇子草沿着岩坡盛开。

e.en: The sticky stems of the {catchfly} trap small insects.
e.zh: 蝇子草黏黏的茎能黏住小昆虫。

catchily.t: 朗朗上口地；引人入胜地

e.en: The slogan was {catchily} written for radio.
e.zh: 这条标语为电台写得朗朗上口。

e.en: She {catchily} summed up the whole idea.
e.zh: 她用一句易记的话概括了整个想法。

catchiness.t: 易记性；朗朗上口的特质

e.en: The song's {catchiness} made it an instant hit.
e.zh: 这首歌的朗朗上口使它一炮而红。

e.en: Marketers prize {catchiness} above clarity.
e.zh: 营销人员看重易记性胜过清晰度。

e.en: The editor rewrote the {catchline} on the front page.
e.zh: 编辑重写了头版的标题行。

e.en: A clever {catchline} can sell the whole product.
e.zh: 一句巧妙的广告语就能带动整个产品。

catchpenny.t: 哗众取宠的；廉价博眼球的

e.en: The fair was full of {catchpenny} stalls.
e.zh: 集市上到处是博眼球的廉价摊位。

e.en: He despised {catchpenny} journalism.
e.zh: 他鄙视那种哗众取宠的新闻报道。

e.en: The {catchpole} dragged the debtor before the judge.
e.zh: 差役把欠债人拖到法官面前。

e.en: Medieval ballads often mock the cruel {catchpole}.
e.zh: 中世纪歌谣常嘲讽残酷的差役。

e.en: A {catchpoll} arrested him for unpaid rent.
e.zh: 一个差役因他欠租而将他逮捕。

e.en: The novel features a corrupt {catchpoll}.
e.zh: 小说中有一个腐败的差役形象。

e.en: We had a long {catchup} over dinner.
e.zh: 我们一边吃饭一边聊了很久的近况。

e.en: He poured {catchup} on his fries.
e.zh: 他在薯条上倒了番茄酱。

e.en: {Catchweed} clung to her socks during the hike.
e.zh: 猪殃殃在徒步时粘满了她的袜子。

e.en: Farmers struggle to clear {catchweed} from the wheat.
e.zh: 农民们费力地把猪殃殃从麦田中清除。

catchweight.t: 不限重量级的；议定体重的（比赛）

e.en: They agreed on a {catchweight} bout for the title.
e.zh: 他们同意以议定体重进行这场冠军赛。

e.en: The fight was contested at a {catchweight} of 165 pounds.
e.zh: 这场比赛在议定的165磅级别进行。

e.en: {Catclaw} thickets covered the desert floor.
e.zh: 猫爪刺灌木丛覆盖着沙漠地面。

e.en: His sleeve caught on a {catclaw} branch.
e.zh: 他的袖子被一根猫爪藤的枝条钩住了。

e.en: The book uses a {catechetic} format of question and answer.
e.zh: 这本书采用问答式的体例。

e.en: He prefers a {catechetic} approach to teaching doctrine.
e.zh: 他倾向于用问答方式来讲授教义。

catechetics.t: 教义问答学；教理讲授学

e.en: She studied {catechetics} at the seminary.
e.zh: 她在神学院学习教义问答学。

e.en: Modern {catechetics} draws on educational theory.
e.zh: 现代教义问答学借鉴了教育理论。

catechise.t: 用问答方式教授教义；盘问

e.en: The priest would {catechise} the children every Sunday.
e.zh: 牧师每周日都用问答方式教孩子们教义。

e.en: Reporters tried to {catechise} the witness on every detail.
e.zh: 记者们试图就每个细节盘问证人。

catechised.t: 被教义问答地教授过；被反复盘问

e.en: The students were {catechised} on the basic doctrines.
e.zh: 学生们在基本教义上接受了问答式教导。

e.en: He felt {catechised} after the long interview.
e.zh: 长时间的面谈后他感觉像被反复盘问了一遍。

e.en: The parish appointed a new {catechiser} for the youth.
e.zh: 教区为青年指派了一位新的教义问答讲授者。

e.en: As a {catechiser}, she had infinite patience.
e.zh: 作为一名教义问答讲授者，她极为耐心。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {catechising} the new converts.
e.zh: 他整个下午都在用问答方式教导新皈依者。

e.en: Her relentless {catechising} unnerved the students.
e.zh: 她不停的盘问让学生们紧张不安。

catechismal.t: 教义问答的；问答手册式的

e.en: They followed the {catechismal} order of instruction.
e.zh: 他们按教义问答的次序进行教导。

e.en: His tone took on a {catechismal} rhythm.
e.zh: 他的语气带上了问答手册般的节奏。

catechistical.t: 教义问答师的；问答教学的

e.en: The school adopted a {catechistical} method.
e.zh: 这所学校采用了问答教学的方法。

e.en: Her {catechistical} duties included weekend classes.
e.zh: 她作为教义问答师的职责包括周末授课。

catechization.t: 教义问答的教导；反复诘问

e.en: Sunday {catechization} prepared children for confirmation.
e.zh: 周日的教义问答教导帮助孩子们准备坚信礼。

e.en: He resented the constant {catechization} from his uncle.
e.zh: 他厌恶舅舅没完没了的诘问。

e.en: The reaction produces {catechol} as a byproduct.
e.zh: 该反应会产生邻苯二酚作为副产物。

e.en: {Catechol} is used in photographic developers.
e.zh: 邻苯二酚被用于照相显影剂。

e.en: The drug targets {catecholaminergic} pathways in the brain.
e.zh: 该药物作用于脑内儿茶酚胺能通路。

e.en: Stress activates {catecholaminergic} neurons.
e.zh: 压力会激活儿茶酚胺能神经元。

e.en: {Catecholase} causes apples to brown when cut.
e.zh: 儿茶酚酶会使切开的苹果变褐。

e.en: The plant produces {catecholase} as a defense.
e.zh: 这种植物分泌儿茶酚酶作为防御。

e.en: {Catechu} has long been used as a natural dye.
e.zh: 儿茶长期以来被用作天然染料。

e.en: The bark yields a strong astringent called {catechu}.
e.zh: 这种树皮可提取一种强收敛剂——儿茶。

categorematic.t: 自身可独立成义的（语词）

e.en: Nouns and verbs are typically {categorematic} terms.
e.zh: 名词和动词通常是可独立成义的词。

e.en: Logicians distinguish {categorematic} from syncategorematic words.
e.zh: 逻辑学家区分独立成义词与共意词。

e.en: As a strict {categorist}, he labeled every book.
e.zh: 作为一个严格的分类者，他给每本书都贴了标签。

e.en: The {categorist} insisted that every species fit one bin.
e.zh: 那位范畴论者坚持每个物种都必须归入一类。

e.en: The cocoa tree is {cauliflorous}, with flowers blooming directly on the trunk.
e.zh: 可可树是老茎生花植物，花朵直接长在树干上。

e.en: Botanists study {cauliflorous} species in tropical rainforests.
e.zh: 植物学家研究热带雨林中的茎花植物。

e.en: The specimen has a {cauliform} structure resembling a stem.
e.zh: 该标本具有类似茎的茎状结构。

e.en: He sketched the {cauliform} growth in his notebook.
e.zh: 他在笔记本上画下了那个茎状生长物。

e.en: The plant has narrow {cauline} leaves along its main stem.
e.zh: 这种植物的主茎上长着狭窄的茎生叶。

e.en: Botanists distinguish basal from {cauline} leaves.
e.zh: 植物学家区分基生叶和茎生叶。

e.en: Many trees are {caulocarpous}, bearing fruit year after year.
e.zh: 许多树木是多年生茎结果植物，年复一年地结果。

e.en: The textbook contrasted annual plants with {caulocarpous} ones.
e.zh: 教科书对比了一年生植物与多年生结果植物。

e.en: The {caulome} encompasses all the stem structures of the plant.
e.zh: 茎体涵盖了植物所有的茎部结构。

e.en: She labeled the {caulome} on her botanical diagram.
e.zh: 她在植物图解上标注了茎体部分。

e.en: The soldier suffered from {causalgia} after his nerve injury.
e.zh: 那名士兵在神经受伤后患上了灼性神经痛。

e.en: {Causalgia} can produce burning pain long after the wound heals.
e.zh: 灼性神经痛会在伤口愈合很久后仍引起灼烧般的疼痛。

e.en: The patient described a {causalgic} burning in his hand.
e.zh: 病人描述手上有灼性神经痛般的烧灼感。

e.en: {Causalgic} symptoms often follow peripheral nerve trauma.
e.zh: 灼性神经痛症状常出现在周围神经损伤之后。

e.en: Strict {causationism} holds that every event has a determining cause.
e.zh: 严格的因果论认为每个事件都有决定性的原因。

e.en: Philosophers have long debated {causationism} in metaphysics.
e.zh: 哲学家在形而上学中长期争论因果论。

e.en: As a strict {causationist}, he denied any role for chance.
e.zh: 作为严格的因果论者，他否认偶然性的作用。

e.en: The {causationist} insisted every effect had a clear cause.
e.zh: 那位因果论者坚持每个结果都有明确的原因。

e.en: The essay analyzes the {cause-and-effect} relationship between climate and migration.
e.zh: 这篇论文分析气候与移民之间的因果关系。

e.en: Children gradually learn {cause-and-effect} reasoning.
e.zh: 孩子们逐渐学会因果推理。

causeless.t: 无缘无故的；没有理由的

e.en: Her sudden anger seemed completely {causeless}.
e.zh: 她突如其来的愤怒似乎毫无缘由。

e.en: He insisted that no event is truly {causeless}.
e.zh: 他坚持认为没有事件是真正无缘无故的。

e.en: The {causelessness} of his outburst puzzled everyone.
e.zh: 他无缘无故的爆发让所有人困惑。

e.en: Philosophers questioned the apparent {causelessness} of certain quantum events.
e.zh: 哲学家质疑某些量子事件表面上的无因性。

e.en: He wrote a charming weekly {causerie} for the newspaper.
e.zh: 他每周为报纸写一篇有趣的随笔小品。

e.en: Their evening {causerie} drifted from books to politics.
e.zh: 他们晚上的闲谈从书籍聊到政治。

e.en: They walked along the old stone {causey} through the marsh.
e.zh: 他们沿着穿过沼泽的古老石堤道行走。

e.en: The villagers repaired the {causey} after the flood.
e.zh: 村民们在洪水过后修缮了堤道。

e.en: The {causeyed} path led across the boggy field.
e.zh: 那条铺石的小径穿过泥泞的田地。

e.en: A {causeyed} road connected the two villages.
e.zh: 一条铺有堤道的路连接着两个村庄。

e.en: His {caustical} remarks offended several guests.
e.zh: 他尖刻的言论冒犯了好几位客人。

e.en: The chemist warned about the {caustical} solution.
e.zh: 化学家警告说该溶液具有腐蚀性。

e.en: The {causticity} of her wit could wound at twenty paces.
e.zh: 她机智的尖刻能伤人于二十步之外。

e.en: Workers must handle the chemical with care due to its {causticity}.
e.zh: 由于该化学品具有腐蚀性，工人必须小心处理。

e.en: The plant uses {causticization} to convert sodium carbonate to sodium hydroxide.
e.zh: 该工厂用苛化作用将碳酸钠转化为氢氧化钠。

e.en: {Causticization} is a key step in the kraft pulping process.
e.zh: 苛化是硫酸盐制浆过程中的关键步骤。

e.en: He was {cautelous} in his dealings with strangers.
e.zh: 他在与陌生人打交道时十分谨慎。

e.en: The old courtier offered {cautelous} advice to the young king.
e.zh: 老臣对年轻的国王提出了谨慎的建议。

e.en: The surgeon applied a mild {cauterant} to seal the wound.
e.zh: 外科医生使用温和的烧灼剂封闭伤口。

e.en: Old medical kits often contained a chemical {cauterant}.
e.zh: 旧的医药箱里常装有化学烧灼剂。

e.en: The vet stopped the bleeding by {cauterization}.
e.zh: 兽医通过烧灼止住了出血。

e.en: {Cauterization} has been used in medicine for thousands of years.
e.zh: 烧灼术在医学上已被使用了数千年。

e.en: The rider guided her horse over a row of {cavaletti}.
e.zh: 骑手引导马匹跨过一排低栏跳竿。

e.en: {Cavaletti} exercises help build a horse's rhythm and balance.
e.zh: 低栏跳竿训练有助于培养马匹的节奏感和平衡感。

e.en: His {cavalierism} toward deadlines frustrated the whole team.
e.zh: 他对截止日期的傲慢轻率让整个团队都很无奈。

e.en: The historian wrote about Royalist {cavalierism} during the civil war.
e.zh: 历史学家撰文论述内战期间保王派的骑士作风。

e.en: She set up the {cavalletti} for her morning lesson.
e.zh: 她为晨间训练课摆好了低栏跳竿。

e.en: Trotting over {cavalletti} strengthens a horse's hindquarters.
e.zh: 小跑跨越低栏跳竿能强化马的后躯肌肉。

e.en: The young {cavalry-man} polished his saber before parade.
e.zh: 年轻的骑兵在阅兵前擦亮了自己的军刀。

e.en: Each {cavalry-man} was responsible for the care of his horse.
e.zh: 每名骑兵都要负责照料自己的战马。

e.en: The cliffside is dotted with ancient {cavate} dwellings.
e.zh: 悬崖边上散布着古老的凿穴居所。

e.en: Archaeologists explored the {cavate} chambers carved into the rock.
e.zh: 考古学家勘察了凿入岩石的洞穴居室。

e.en: The soprano sang a tender {cavatina} from the opera.
e.zh: 女高音演唱了那部歌剧中柔美的小咏叹调。

e.en: Beethoven's String Quartet contains a famous {cavatina}.
e.zh: 贝多芬的弦乐四重奏中有一段著名的小咏叹调。

cellularized.t: 细胞化的；分隔成小室的

e.en: The tissue became {cellularized} after a few days.
e.zh: 几天后该组织变得细胞化。

e.en: Modern offices are often heavily {cellularized}.
e.zh: 现代办公室常被分隔成许多小隔间。

e.en: Termites use {cellulase} to digest wood.
e.zh: 白蚁利用纤维素酶消化木材。

e.en: The lab purified {cellulase} from a fungus.
e.zh: 实验室从一种真菌中提纯了纤维素酶。

e.en: The young tissue began to {cellulate} rapidly.
e.zh: 幼嫩组织开始迅速形成细胞结构。

e.en: Designers often {cellulate} large open offices.
e.zh: 设计师常把大型开放式办公室分隔成小间。

cellulated.t: 由细胞构成的；分成小室的

e.en: The plant stem has a {cellulated} core.
e.zh: 该植物茎部有一个由细胞构成的核心。

e.en: They worked in a {cellulated} office layout.
e.zh: 他们在分隔成小间的办公室里工作。

e.en: Biologists studied the {cellulation} of the embryo.
e.zh: 生物学家研究了胚胎的细胞形成过程。

e.en: The building's {cellulation} created many tiny rooms.
e.zh: 这栋楼的隔间设计形成了许多小房间。

e.en: Each {cellule} contained a single spore.
e.zh: 每个小细胞内都含有一个孢子。

e.en: The monk slept in a tiny {cellule}.
e.zh: 修士睡在一个小小的隔间里。

e.en: The slide showed {celluliferous} plant tissue.
e.zh: 载玻片上显示出含细胞的植物组织。

e.en: This layer is highly {celluliferous}.
e.zh: 这一层富含细胞。

e.en: The doctor noted a {cellulitic} swelling on his leg.
e.zh: 医生注意到他腿上有蜂窝织炎性肿胀。

e.en: She was treated for a {cellulitic} infection.
e.zh: 她因蜂窝织炎感染接受了治疗。

e.en: Some bacteria are highly {cellulolytic}.
e.zh: 有些细菌具有很强的分解纤维素能力。

e.en: Researchers screened for {cellulolytic} enzymes.
e.zh: 研究人员筛选可分解纤维素的酶。

e.en: They produced fuel from {cellulosic} biomass.
e.zh: 他们用纤维素生物质生产燃料。

e.en: The fabric uses {cellulosic} fibers.
e.zh: 这种布料使用纤维素纤维。

e.en: The rock had a {cellulous} appearance.
e.zh: 这块岩石呈现多孔状外观。

e.en: The bread had a soft, {cellulous} interior.
e.zh: 面包内部柔软多孔。

e.en: He published a textbook on {celology}.
e.zh: 他出版了一本关于疝病学的教科书。

e.en: Few medical schools still teach {celology}.
e.zh: 如今很少有医学院仍开设疝病学课程。

e.en: The worm's {celom} houses its organs.
e.zh: 这种蠕虫的体腔容纳着它的器官。

e.en: Students dissected the frog's {celom}.
e.zh: 学生们解剖了青蛙的体腔。

e.en: The surgeon inserted a {celoscope} for examination.
e.zh: 外科医生插入体腔镜进行检查。

e.en: A {celoscope} can reveal internal lesions.
e.zh: 体腔镜可以发现内部病变。

e.en: The surgeon performed a {celotomy} to relieve the obstruction.
e.zh: 外科医生施行了疝切开术以缓解梗阻。

e.en: {Celotomy} is rarely needed thanks to modern techniques.
e.zh: 由于现代技术，疝切开术已很少需要。

celticism.t: 凯尔特文化特征；凯尔特风格

e.en: The poem is full of dreamy {celticism}.
e.zh: 这首诗充满了梦幻的凯尔特风格。

e.en: Scholars debated the meaning of {celticism}.
e.zh: 学者们就凯尔特文化特征的含义展开了辩论。

e.en: She added sliced {celtuce} to the stir-fry.
e.zh: 她在炒菜里加了切片的莴笋。

e.en: {Celtuce} is popular in Chinese cooking.
e.zh: 莴笋在中式烹饪中很受欢迎。

e.en: She played a Bach piece on the {cembalo}.
e.zh: 她用大键琴演奏了一首巴赫的作品。

e.en: The orchestra featured a baroque {cembalo}.
e.zh: 乐团中有一架巴洛克风格的大键琴。

e.en: The dentist examined the {cemental} layer of the tooth.
e.zh: 牙医检查了牙齿的牙骨质层。

e.en: X-rays revealed {cemental} damage.
e.zh: X光显示牙骨质受损。

cementatory.t: 具有黏合作用的；起胶结作用的

e.en: The mixture has a strong {cementatory} effect.
e.zh: 这种混合物具有很强的胶结作用。

e.en: They added a {cementatory} agent to the paste.
e.zh: 他们在浆料中加入了具有黏合作用的添加剂。

e.en: The steel contained needles of {cementite}.
e.zh: 这种钢材含有针状的渗碳体。

e.en: {Cementite} makes the alloy harder but more brittle.
e.zh: 渗碳体使合金更硬但也更脆。

e.en: They poured a {cementitious} mixture into the molds.
e.zh: 他们把胶凝混合物倒入模具中。

e.en: Fly ash has {cementitious} properties.
e.zh: 粉煤灰具有胶凝性质。

cementless.t: 非骨水泥的；不用骨水泥的

e.en: He received a {cementless} hip implant.
e.zh: 他植入了非骨水泥型髋关节假体。

e.en: {Cementless} fixation suits younger patients.
e.zh: 非骨水泥固定更适合年轻患者。

e.en: {Cementoblast} activity helps anchor the tooth.
e.zh: 成牙骨质细胞的活动有助于固定牙齿。

e.en: Researchers studied {cementoblast} differentiation.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了成牙骨质细胞的分化。

e.en: The patient exhibited symptoms of {catalepsy} during the seizure.
e.zh: 患者在发作期间表现出强直性昏厥的症状。

e.en: Doctors studied rare cases of {catalepsy} reported in the journal.
e.zh: 医生研究了期刊报道的罕见僵住症病例。

catalept.t: 患强直性昏厥的人；僵住症患者

e.en: The {catalept} lay motionless on the cot for hours.
e.zh: 那位强直性昏厥患者在床上一动不动地躺了几个小时。

e.en: Old textbooks describe a {catalept} as if turned to stone.
e.zh: 旧教科书把强直性昏厥患者描述得仿佛石化一般。

e.en: She fell into a {cataleptic} state and could not move.
e.zh: 她陷入强直性昏厥状态，动弹不得。

e.en: His {cataleptic} stillness alarmed the nurses on duty.
e.zh: 他僵住般的静止令值班护士惊慌。

cataleptically.t: 僵住状态地；强直性昏厥地

e.en: He stared {cataleptically} at the wall for hours.
e.zh: 他僵住般地盯着墙壁看了几个小时。

e.en: She lay {cataleptically} still on the worn couch.
e.zh: 她僵硬地一动不动地躺在破旧的沙发上。

e.en: Ranchers bred a {catalo} for tougher hides and meat.
e.zh: 牧场主培育出牛与野牛的杂交种以获得更结实的皮革和肉。

e.en: The {catalo} thrives in cold prairie climates.
e.zh: 这种牛与野牛的杂交种在寒冷的草原气候中能茁壮生长。

e.en: We caught a {catalufa} off the rocky coast yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天在多岩的海边钓到了一条大眼鲷。

e.en: The {catalufa} is prized for its bright red color.
e.zh: 大眼鲷因其鲜红的颜色而备受珍视。

e.en: The enzyme acts {catalytically} to speed up the reaction.
e.zh: 这种酶以催化方式加快反应。

e.en: Her presence {catalytically} transformed the entire team.
e.zh: 她的存在如催化剂般改变了整个团队。

catamenia.t: 月经的医学旧称；行经期

e.en: Ancient texts referred to menstruation as {catamenia}.
e.zh: 古代文献将月经称为catamenia。

e.en: The doctor recorded the timing of her {catamenia}.
e.zh: 医生记录了她行经期的时间。

catamite.t: 娈童；男主人豢养的男童

e.en: Roman literature occasionally mentions a master's {catamite}.
e.zh: 罗马文学偶尔提及主人的娈童。

e.en: He decried the historical abuse of any {catamite}.
e.zh: 他谴责历史上对任何娈童的虐待。

e.en: The therapist took a careful {catamnesis} of the case.
e.zh: 治疗师仔细记录了该病例的病后追访史。

e.en: Long-term {catamnesis} reveals the treatment's lasting success.
e.zh: 长期病后追访史揭示了治疗的持久效果。

e.en: A {catamorphism} folds a recursive structure into a single value.
e.zh: 同态折叠将递归结构归约为单个值。

e.en: Functional programmers use {catamorphism} to traverse trees cleanly.
e.zh: 函数式程序员使用同态折叠来优雅地遍历树。

e.en: The {catamountain} prowled the rocky cliffs at dusk.
e.zh: 美洲狮在黄昏时分于岩石峭壁上潜行。

e.en: Settlers feared the {catamountain} hiding in the hills.
e.zh: 拓荒者畏惧藏身山间的山猫。

e.en: Patients with {cataphasia} repeat the same word over and over.
e.zh: 言语重复症患者会反复重复同一个词。

e.en: His {cataphasia} made conversation nearly impossible.
e.zh: 他的言语重复症几乎使交谈无法进行。

cataphatic.t: 肯定神学的；正向描述上帝的

e.en: {Cataphatic} theology describes God through positive attributes.
e.zh: 肯定神学通过正面属性来描述上帝。

e.en: Medieval mystics balanced {cataphatic} and apophatic approaches.
e.zh: 中世纪神秘主义者在肯定神学与否定神学之间取得平衡。

e.en: The hall has surprising {cataphonic} properties.
e.zh: 大厅具有惊人的反射声学特性。

e.en: Engineers studied the {cataphonic} effects of the dome.
e.zh: 工程师研究了穹顶的反射声学效应。

e.en: {Cataphonics} examines how sound reflects off various surfaces.
e.zh: 反射声学研究声音如何从各种表面反射。

e.en: He published a paper on {cataphonics} last year.
e.zh: 他去年发表了一篇关于反射声学的论文。

cataphor.t: 后指词；语言学的下指代词

e.en: A {cataphor} refers forward to a later noun phrase.
e.zh: 后指词向后指代后面的名词短语。

e.en: Linguists carefully distinguish a {cataphor} from an anaphor.
e.zh: 语言学家仔细区分后指词与前指词。

cataphora.t: 后指；下指现象；语法后指

e.en: {Cataphora} occurs when a pronoun precedes its referent.
e.zh: 当代词出现在所指对象之前时就发生后指。

e.en: She wrote a thesis on {cataphora} in literary texts.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于文学文本中后指现象的论文。

cataphoresis.t: 阴离子电泳；电泳沉积法

e.en: {Cataphoresis} drives charged particles through the gel.
e.zh: 电泳使带电粒子通过凝胶。

e.en: Car bodies are coated using {cataphoresis} for durability.
e.zh: 汽车车身使用电泳沉积法涂装以提高耐用性。

e.en: The pronoun has a {cataphoric} reference here.
e.zh: 这里的代词具有后指功能。

e.en: Writers sometimes use {cataphoric} structures for suspense.
e.zh: 作者有时使用后指结构来制造悬念。

e.en: The Byzantine {cataphract} dominated the battlefield for centuries.
e.zh: 拜占庭重装骑兵称霸战场数百年。

e.en: Each {cataphract} was clad in heavy scale armor.
e.zh: 每名重装骑兵都披着厚重的鳞甲。

e.en: The {cataphracted} riders charged across the dusty plain.
e.zh: 披重铠的骑兵冲过尘土飞扬的平原。

e.en: He admired the {cataphracted} warriors in the painting.
e.zh: 他欣赏画中披重铠的战士。

cataphrenia.t: 早期精神病学的精神错乱旧称

e.en: Early psychiatry coined {cataphrenia} for certain mental disorders.
e.zh: 早期精神病学创造了cataphrenia一词来指代某些精神疾病。

e.en: {Cataphrenia} is rarely mentioned in modern textbooks.
e.zh: 现代教科书很少提及cataphrenia。

cataphylaxis.t: 抵抗力下降；防御力衰减

e.en: Doctors warned that {cataphylaxis} weakens the immune system.
e.zh: 医生警告说抵抗力下降会削弱免疫系统。

e.en: {Cataphylaxis} can leave the body open to infection.
e.zh: 抵抗力下降可能使身体易受感染。

e.en: The bulb is protected by a tough {cataphyll}.
e.zh: 球茎由坚韧的鳞叶保护。

e.en: Each {cataphyll} sheaths the developing bud below.
e.zh: 每片鳞叶都包裹着下方正在发育的芽。

e.en: {Cataplasia} reverses cells to a less mature state.
e.zh: 退行性变化使细胞回到较不成熟的状态。

e.en: The biopsy revealed clear signs of {cataplasia}.
e.zh: 活检显示出明显的退行性变化迹象。

e.en: The healer applied a warm {cataplasm} to the wound.
e.zh: 治疗者在伤口上敷了一剂温热的糊药。

e.en: Her grandmother made a herbal {cataplasm} for sprains.
e.zh: 她外婆为扭伤制作了一种草药糊药。

e.en: The tumor showed {cataplastic} features under the microscope.
e.zh: 肿瘤在显微镜下显示出退行性特征。

e.en: Pathologists noted {cataplastic} changes throughout the tissue.
e.zh: 病理学家注意到组织中遍布的退行性变化。

e.en: {Cataplexy} causes sudden muscle weakness triggered by emotion.
e.zh: 猝倒症由情绪触发，导致突然的肌肉无力。

e.en: Narcolepsy patients often experience episodes of {cataplexy}.
e.zh: 嗜睡症患者常经历猝倒发作。

catapultic.t: 弹射的；弩炮般的；猛烈推射的

e.en: The siege engine had a powerful {catapultic} mechanism.
e.zh: 攻城机械配备了强大的弹射装置。

e.en: He felt a {catapultic} force during the rocket takeoff.
e.zh: 他在火箭起飞时感到一股弹射般的力量。

e.en: She suffered from a {catarrhal} cold all winter.
e.zh: 她整个冬天都饱受卡他性感冒之苦。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed a stubborn {catarrhal} infection.
e.zh: 医生诊断为顽固的卡他性感染。

e.en: The patient breathed {catarrhally} through her stuffy nose.
e.zh: 患者带着黏膜炎症状通过堵塞的鼻子呼吸。

e.en: He coughed {catarrhally} throughout the long meeting.
e.zh: 他在漫长的会议期间一直伴着黏膜炎症状咳嗽。

catarrhine.t: 狭鼻猴类的；旧世界猴的

e.en: {Catarrhine} primates include humans and Old World monkeys.
e.zh: 狭鼻类灵长类包括人类和旧世界猴。

e.en: Researchers compared {catarrhine} skulls in the lab.
e.zh: 研究人员在实验室对比了狭鼻类的头骨。

e.en: His {catarrhous} cough lingered for several weeks.
e.zh: 他黏膜炎症状的咳嗽持续了好几周。

e.en: She avoided dairy when feeling {catarrhous}.
e.zh: 她在感到黏膜不适时会避免乳制品。

e.en: {Catastalsis} pushes intestinal contents downward through the gut.
e.zh: 反向蠕动将肠内容物向下推送通过肠道。

e.en: Researchers studied {catastalsis} in the digestive tract.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了消化道中的反向蠕动。

e.en: The drug has a {catastaltic} effect on the nerves.
e.zh: 这种药物对神经有抑制作用。

e.en: Doctors prescribed a mild {catastaltic} agent.
e.zh: 医生开具了一种温和的抑制性药剂。

catastasis.t: 戏剧紧张段；病情稳定期

e.en: The play's {catastasis} builds tension before the climax.
e.zh: 戏剧的紧张段在高潮前积蓄张力。

e.en: Greek dramatists carefully crafted each {catastasis}.
e.zh: 希腊剧作家精心设计每个紧张段。

catastrophist.t: 灾变论者；灾变说支持者

e.en: The {catastrophist} argued that floods reshaped the earth.
e.zh: 灾变论者认为洪水重塑了地球。

e.en: Modern geologists rejected the {catastrophist} view of history.
e.zh: 现代地质学家否定了灾变论者的历史观。

catastrophize.t: 灾难化思考；做最坏打算

e.en: Try not to {catastrophize} every small setback at work.
e.zh: 尽量不要把工作中每个小挫折都灾难化。

e.en: Anxiety made her {catastrophize} the entire situation.
e.zh: 焦虑让她把整个情况想得很糟。

celadonite.t: 绿鳞石，一种绿色云母矿物

e.en: The geologist identified the green mineral as {celadonite}.
e.zh: 地质学家鉴定出这种绿色矿物是绿鳞石。

e.en: Thin veins of {celadonite} ran through the basalt.
e.zh: 细细的绿鳞石脉贯穿在玄武岩中。

e.en: Bright {celandine} flowers covered the ditch in spring.
e.zh: 春天里，鲜艳的白屈菜花开满了沟边。

e.en: She pressed a {celandine} between the pages of her book.
e.zh: 她把一朵白屈菜夹在书页之间压平。

celature.t: 金属雕镂工艺；浮雕作品

e.en: The museum displayed exquisite Roman {celature} on silver cups.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了银杯上精美的罗马浮雕工艺。

e.en: He studied the art of {celature} for many years.
e.zh: 他研究金属雕镂艺术多年。

e.en: The square was packed with noisy {celebrators} after the win.
e.zh: 胜利后，广场上挤满了喧闹的庆祝者。

e.en: He became a famous {celebrator} of small-town life.
e.zh: 他成了著名的小镇生活的颂扬者。

e.en: The {celebrification} of politics troubles many commentators.
e.zh: 政治的明星化让许多评论员感到忧虑。

e.en: Social media accelerated the {celebrification} of ordinary people.
e.zh: 社交媒体加速了普通人变成名人的现象。

e.en: Tabloids followed every move of the young {celebutante}.
e.zh: 小报追踪着这位年轻名媛的一举一动。

e.en: She rejected being labeled a mere {celebutante}.
e.zh: 她拒绝被简单地贴上名媛的标签。

e.en: He gave a {celeritous} reply to the urgent telegram.
e.zh: 他对那封急电作了迅速的回复。

e.en: Her {celeritous} movements impressed the dance instructor.
e.zh: 她敏捷的动作给舞蹈老师留下了深刻印象。

e.en: The {celesta} adds a magical sparkle to the orchestra.
e.zh: 钢片琴为乐队增添了一抹魔幻的光彩。

e.en: Tchaikovsky famously used a {celesta} in his ballet.
e.zh: 柴可夫斯基在他的芭蕾舞剧中著名地使用了钢片琴。

e.en: The poet sought to {celestialize} ordinary moments of love.
e.zh: 诗人试图将平凡的爱情时刻升华为神圣。

e.en: Renaissance painters often {celestialized} their patrons in murals.
e.zh: 文艺复兴画家常在壁画中将赞助人神化。

e.en: The cave walls glittered with crystals of {celestine}.
e.zh: 洞穴的墙壁上闪烁着天青石晶体。

e.en: Madagascar is famous for its pale-blue {celestine}.
e.zh: 马达加斯加以出产淡蓝色天青石而闻名。

e.en: Geologists collected pale {celestite} samples from the quarry.
e.zh: 地质学家从采石场收集了淡色的天青石样本。

e.en: The {celestite} geode glowed in the museum lights.
e.zh: 博物馆灯光下，天青石晶洞熠熠生辉。

celibatarian.t: 主张独身的人；独身主义者

e.en: He proudly called himself a lifelong {celibatarian}.
e.zh: 他自豪地称自己是终身独身主义者。

e.en: The monastery attracted devout {celibatarians} from across Europe.
e.zh: 这座修道院吸引了来自欧洲各地虔诚的独身主义者。

e.en: The surgeon inserted a {celioscope} to inspect the abdomen.
e.zh: 外科医生插入腹腔镜以检查腹部。

e.en: Modern {celioscopes} allow minimally invasive procedures.
e.zh: 现代腹腔镜可以进行微创手术。

e.en: An emergency {celiotomy} saved the patient's life.
e.zh: 一次紧急剖腹术救了病人的命。

e.en: The textbook describes the steps of a routine {celiotomy}.
e.zh: 教科书描述了常规剖腹术的步骤。

e.en: The diagnosis of {celitis} required further imaging tests.
e.zh: 腹腔炎的诊断需要进一步的影像学检查。

e.en: Symptoms of {celitis} include fever and abdominal pain.
e.zh: 腹腔炎的症状包括发烧和腹痛。

e.en: The riot broke out in the maximum-security {cell-block}.
e.zh: 暴动在最高戒备的牢房区爆发。

e.en: Guards patrolled the {cell-block} every hour.
e.zh: 狱警每小时巡查一次牢房区。

e.en: Her white blood {cell-count} was higher than normal.
e.zh: 她的白细胞计数高于正常水平。

e.en: The lab repeated the {cell-count} for accuracy.
e.zh: 实验室重做了细胞计数以确保准确。

e.en: Researchers study the genes that trigger {cell-death}.
e.zh: 研究人员在研究触发细胞死亡的基因。

e.en: Programmed {cell-death} is essential for healthy development.
e.zh: 程序性细胞死亡对正常发育至关重要。

e.en: His {cell-mate} taught him to read in prison.
e.zh: 他的狱友在牢里教他识字。

e.en: They had been {cell-mates} for nearly two years.
e.zh: 他们当狱友已经将近两年了。

e.en: Antibodies bind to proteins on the {cell-surface}.
e.zh: 抗体与细胞表面的蛋白质结合。

e.en: The virus attaches to specific {cell-surface} receptors.
e.zh: 病毒附着在特定的细胞表面受体上。

cella.t: 古希腊罗马神庙的内殿

e.en: The statue of the goddess stood in the {cella}.
e.zh: 女神雕像矗立在神殿内殿之中。

e.en: Only priests could enter the temple's inner {cella}.
e.zh: 只有祭司才能进入神庙的内殿。

e.en: The old inn had extensive {cellarage} for wine.
e.zh: 那家老旅馆有宽敞的酒窖储藏空间。

e.en: They rented out the {cellarage} as storage.
e.zh: 他们把地下贮藏室出租做仓库。

e.en: A mahogany {cellaret} stood beside the dining table.
e.zh: 餐桌旁立着一个红木小酒柜。

e.en: He poured brandy from the antique {cellaret}.
e.zh: 他从那个古董酒柜里倒出白兰地。

e.en: The auction featured a Georgian {cellarete} in walnut.
e.zh: 拍卖会上展出一件乔治王朝时期的胡桃木小酒柜。

e.en: She kept liqueurs in the carved {cellarete}.
e.zh: 她把利口酒放在那个雕花小酒柜里。

e.en: A polished {cellarette} sat in the corner of the parlor.
e.zh: 客厅角落里放着一个擦得发亮的小酒柜。

e.en: The {cellarette} held a dozen crystal decanters.
e.zh: 小酒柜里装着十几个水晶酒瓶。

e.en: The {cellarmaster} selected wines for the royal banquet.
e.zh: 酒窖主管为皇家宴会挑选葡萄酒。

e.en: Becoming a {cellarmaster} requires decades of experience.
e.zh: 成为一名酒窖主管需要几十年的经验。

e.en: He stumbled down the dark {cellarway} with a candle.
e.zh: 他举着蜡烛沿着昏暗的地窖通道跌跌撞撞地下去。

e.en: The {cellarway} was hidden behind a wooden door.
e.zh: 通往地窖的通道藏在一扇木门后面。

e.en: The enzyme {cellase} breaks down cellobiose into glucose.
e.zh: 纤维二糖酶能将纤维二糖分解成葡萄糖。

e.en: Researchers extracted {cellase} from soil bacteria.
e.zh: 研究人员从土壤细菌中提取了纤维二糖酶。

e.en: Enzymes hydrolyze cellulose into {cello-oligosaccharides}.
e.zh: 酶能将纤维素水解成纤维寡糖。

e.en: {Cello-oligosaccharides} show promise as prebiotics.
e.zh: 纤维寡糖作为益生元显示出很大潜力。

e.en: Fungal {cellobiohydrolase} efficiently degrades plant cell walls.
e.zh: 真菌纤维二糖水解酶能高效降解植物细胞壁。

e.en: Industrial biofuel production relies on {cellobiohydrolase} enzymes.
e.zh: 工业生物燃料生产依赖于纤维二糖水解酶。

cease-fire.t: 停火；停战；停止敌对行动

e.en: Both sides finally agreed to a {cease-fire}.
e.zh: 双方终于同意停火。

e.en: The fragile {cease-fire} collapsed within a week.
e.zh: 脆弱的停火协议在一周内就破裂了。

cease-fires.t: 停火协议；多次停战安排

e.en: Past {cease-fires} in the region quickly fell apart.
e.zh: 该地区以往的多次停火协议都很快瓦解。

e.en: Diplomats have brokered several {cease-fires} this year.
e.zh: 今年外交官已经促成了多次停火。

e.en: The biologist examined the {ceca} of several birds.
e.zh: 生物学家检查了几只鸟的盲肠。

e.en: Many herbivores have enlarged {ceca} for fermentation.
e.zh: 许多草食动物拥有较大的盲肠用于发酵。

cecally.t: 在盲肠处地；与盲肠有关地

e.en: The lesion was located {cecally} along the bowel wall.
e.zh: 病变位于肠壁的盲肠部位。

e.en: The tumor had spread {cecally} beyond the appendix.
e.zh: 肿瘤已向盲肠方向蔓延越过阑尾。

cecum.t: 盲肠；大肠起始端的盲囊

e.en: The appendix extends from the {cecum}.
e.zh: 阑尾从盲肠延伸而出。

e.en: Inflammation of the {cecum} caused severe abdominal pain.
e.zh: 盲肠发炎引起剧烈的腹痛。

e.en: They rested beneath the {cedarn} canopy of the grove.
e.zh: 他们在树林的雪松华盖下歇息。

e.en: A {cedarn} chest perfumed the entire room.
e.zh: 一只雪松木箱让整个房间都飘着香气。

cedi.t: 塞地；加纳的法定货币单位

e.en: She exchanged her dollars for {cedi} at the airport.
e.zh: 她在机场把美元兑换成塞地。

e.en: The mango cost only two {cedi}.
e.zh: 这个芒果只要两塞地。

cedilla.t: 软音符；c字母下方的小钩

e.en: French uses a {cedilla} under the c in garçon.
e.zh: 法语在garçon中的c字母下方使用软音符。

e.en: Without the {cedilla}, the pronunciation changes completely.
e.zh: 没有软音符，发音就完全不一样了。

cedillas.t: 软音符；多个变音小尾钩

e.en: The keyboard layout supports {cedillas} for foreign words.
e.zh: 这个键盘布局支持外文中使用的软音符。

e.en: Several {cedillas} appeared throughout the Portuguese text.
e.zh: 葡萄牙文文本中多处出现软音符。

cee.t: 字母C；英语第三个字母的名称

e.en: He scrawled a big {cee} on the chalkboard.
e.zh: 他在黑板上潦草地写了一个大大的字母C。

e.en: The word begins with a {cee}.
e.zh: 这个单词以字母C开头。

ceil.t: 给屋顶装天花板；用板材饰顶

e.en: Workers were hired to {ceil} the old chapel.
e.zh: 工人受雇为旧礼拜堂装天花板。

e.en: They will {ceil} every room with carved oak.
e.zh: 他们将用雕花橡木为每个房间装天花板。

ceiled.t: 已装上天花板的；以板饰顶

e.en: The hall was {ceiled} with intricately carved cedar.
e.zh: 大厅以雕饰精细的雪松木装了天花板。

e.en: They had {ceiled} the room before the wedding.
e.zh: 他们在婚礼前已为房间装好了天花板。

ceiling-mounted.t: 吊装的；安装在天花板上的

e.en: A {ceiling-mounted} projector lit up the screen.
e.zh: 一台吊装的投影仪点亮了屏幕。

e.en: They installed a {ceiling-mounted} fan above the bed.
e.zh: 他们在床上方装了一台吊扇。

ceilometer.t: 云幂仪；测云高的气象仪器

e.en: The pilot checked the {ceilometer} before takeoff.
e.zh: 飞行员在起飞前查看了云幂仪。

e.en: A laser {ceilometer} measures the cloud base height.
e.zh: 激光云幂仪测量云底高度。

ceils.t: 装天花板；以板材饰顶（单三）

e.en: The carpenter {ceils} the attic with pine boards.
e.zh: 木匠用松木板给阁楼装天花板。

e.en: He always {ceils} a room before painting it.
e.zh: 他总是先给房间装好天花板再粉刷。

e.en: The {cementum} covers the root of the tooth.
e.zh: 牙骨质覆盖在牙根表面。

e.en: Dentists can estimate age by examining {cementum} layers.
e.zh: 牙医可以通过检查牙骨质层来估算年龄。

cemetary.t: 墓地（cemetery 的常见拼写错误）

e.en: He misspelled it as {cemetary} on the form.
e.zh: 他在表格上把它误拼成了 cemetary。

e.en: The word {cemetary} should actually be cemetery.
e.zh: cemetary 这个词其实应拼作 cemetery。

cenacle.t: 小型文艺团体；最后晚餐厅

e.en: The poets formed a small {cenacle} in Paris.
e.zh: 这些诗人在巴黎组成了一个小型文社。

e.en: Pilgrims visited the {cenacle} in Jerusalem.
e.zh: 朝圣者参观了耶路撒冷的最后晚餐厅。

e.en: Disturbed {cenesthesia} can affect a patient's body image.
e.zh: общее体感觉紊乱会影响患者的身体意象。

e.en: Psychiatrists sometimes assess {cenesthesia} in their patients.
e.zh: 精神科医生有时会评估患者的общее体感觉。

e.en: The {cenobite} lived quietly in the monastery.
e.zh: 那位修道士在修道院里安静地生活。

e.en: Early Christian {cenobites} shared meals and prayers.
e.zh: 早期基督教修道士共享膳食与祈祷。

cenobitic.t: 集体修道的；共住修道院的

e.en: They followed a strict {cenobitic} rule.
e.zh: 他们遵循严格的集体修道规则。

e.en: {Cenobitic} life emphasizes shared work and prayer.
e.zh: 集体修道生活强调共同劳作与祈祷。

cenobitical.t: 集体修道的；共修生活的

e.en: The community had a {cenobitical} structure.
e.zh: 该团体具有集体修道的结构。

e.en: He wrote about {cenobitical} traditions in early Egypt.
e.zh: 他撰文论述早期埃及的集体修道传统。

e.en: {Cenobitism} began in the deserts of Egypt.
e.zh: 集体修道制度起源于埃及的沙漠。

e.en: Pachomius is considered the founder of {cenobitism}.
e.zh: 帕科缪被视为集体修道制度的创始人。

e.en: The fungus forms a {cenocyte} with many nuclei.
e.zh: 该真菌形成一个含多个细胞核的多核细胞。

e.en: Some algae grow as a single large {cenocyte}.
e.zh: 有些藻类以一个大型多核细胞的形式生长。

e.en: Anthropologists once debated whether {cenogamy} was widespread.
e.zh: 人类学家曾争论群婚制是否曾广泛存在。

e.en: {Cenogamy} refers to a form of group marriage.
e.zh: cenogamy 指一种群婚形式。

e.en: {Cenogenesis} describes traits added during embryonic development.
e.zh: 新发生指胚胎发育中新增的特征。

e.en: Biologists distinguish palingenesis from {cenogenesis}.
e.zh: 生物学家将重演发生与新发生加以区分。

e.en: The larva shows several {cenogenetic} features.
e.zh: 幼虫表现出若干后生发育特征。

e.en: These {cenogenetic} traits evolved later in development.
e.zh: 这些后生特征是在发育晚期演化出来的。

e.en: The fossil was identified as a {cenophyte}.
e.zh: 该化石被鉴定为一种新生代植物。

e.en: {Cenophytes} dominate modern terrestrial flora.
e.zh: 新生代植物在现代陆地植物群中占主导地位。

e.en: Botanists grouped the plants into one {cenospecies}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这些植物归为一个共种。

e.en: A {cenospecies} includes forms that can interbreed experimentally.
e.zh: 共种包括在实验条件下可杂交的类型。

e.en: His {cenotophobia} made him avoid any innovation.
e.zh: 他对新事物的恐惧使他回避一切革新。

e.en: Therapists rarely encounter true {cenotophobia}.
e.zh: 治疗师很少遇到真正的恐新症。

e.en: Mammals diversified rapidly during the {Cenozoic} era.
e.zh: 哺乳动物在新生代迅速分化。

e.en: The {Cenozoic} began about 66 million years ago.
e.zh: 新生代约始于六千六百万年前。

e.en: He specialized in {cenozoology} rather than paleontology.
e.zh: 他专攻现生动物学而非古生物学。

e.en: {Cenozoology} studies animals living in the present era.
e.zh: 现生动物学研究当今时代的动物。

e.en: The priest began to {cense} the altar.
e.zh: 神父开始对祭坛焚香致敬。

e.en: They {cense} the icons during the procession.
e.zh: 他们在游行时向圣像焚香。

e.en: The deacon {censed} the congregation respectfully.
e.zh: 执事恭敬地向会众焚香致敬。

e.en: Each shrine was {censed} in turn.
e.zh: 每座神龛依次被焚香敬礼。

censes.t: 焚香敬礼（动词第三人称单数）

e.en: He {censes} the altar at every solemn mass.
e.zh: 每逢隆重弥撒，他都会向祭坛焚香。

e.en: The priest {censes} the gifts before the prayer.
e.zh: 神父在祈祷前向祭品焚香。

e.en: The {censing} of the altar is a solemn ritual.
e.zh: 向祭坛焚香是一种庄严的仪式。

e.en: He paused while {censing} the icon.
e.zh: 他在向圣像焚香时停顿了一下。

e.en: The {censorability} of online speech is widely debated.
e.zh: 网络言论的可审查性备受争议。

e.en: Editors discussed the article's {censorability} before publishing.
e.zh: 编辑们在发表前讨论了文章的可审查性。

censorable.t: 可加以审查的；应受审查的

e.en: Some scenes were judged {censorable} by the board.
e.zh: 一些场景被审查委员会认定为应受审查。

e.en: The film contained little {censorable} material.
e.zh: 这部电影几乎没有应受审查的内容。

e.en: The text was edited {censorably} for younger readers.
e.zh: 文本以可审查的方式作了删改，以适合年轻读者。

e.en: They acted {censorably} but within the law.
e.zh: 他们的行为可受审查但仍属合法。

e.en: He had a stern, {censorial} manner.
e.zh: 他举止严肃，颇有审查官风范。

e.en: The committee assumed a {censorial} role.
e.zh: 该委员会承担了监察职能。

e.en: He held {censorian} authority in the republic.
e.zh: 他在共和国中拥有监察官的权力。

e.en: The historian described his {censorian} duties.
e.zh: 史学家描述了他作为监察官的职责。

censual.t: 人口普查的；户口登记的

e.en: The {censual} records date back centuries.
e.zh: 这些人口普查记录可追溯数百年。

e.en: Researchers analyzed the {censual} data carefully.
e.zh: 研究人员仔细分析了人口普查数据。

censurable.t: 应受谴责的；该受非难的

e.en: His behavior was clearly {censurable}.
e.zh: 他的行为显然应受谴责。

e.en: The report found nothing {censurable} in her conduct.
e.zh: 报告认定她的行为没有任何应受非难之处。

cental.t: 英担（一百磅的重量单位）

e.en: They sold the wheat by the {cental}.
e.zh: 他们按英担出售小麦。

e.en: One {cental} equals one hundred pounds.
e.zh: 一英担等于一百磅。

e.en: The plot measured several hundred {centares}.
e.zh: 这块地有几百平方米。

e.en: A {centare} is one square meter.
e.zh: 一 centare 等于一平方米。

e.en: She picked some {centaury} by the roadside.
e.zh: 她在路边采了一些百金花。

e.en: Herbalists once used {centaury} as a tonic.
e.zh: 草药师曾用百金花做强身剂。

centavo.t: 分（拉美及葡语国家货币单位）

e.en: The candy cost only a few {centavos}.
e.zh: 那块糖只要几分钱。

e.en: One peso is worth one hundred {centavos}.
e.zh: 一比索等于一百分。

e.en: The {center-left} party won the election.
e.zh: 中间偏左政党赢得了选举。

e.en: She holds {center-left} views on most issues.
e.zh: 她在多数议题上持中间偏左的立场。

cephalothorax.t: 头胸部（节肢动物的合体部位）

e.en: A spider's {cephalothorax} bears its eyes and legs.
e.zh: 蜘蛛的头胸部长着眼睛和腿。

e.en: The crab's hard {cephalothorax} protects vital organs.
e.zh: 螃蟹坚硬的头胸部保护着重要器官。

ceramide.t: 神经酰胺（皮肤脂质成分）

e.en: This cream contains {ceramide} to repair the skin barrier.
e.zh: 这款面霜含有神经酰胺，可修复皮肤屏障。

e.en: {Ceramide} levels drop as the skin ages.
e.zh: 随着皮肤老化，神经酰胺含量会下降。

e.en: The pharmacist prepared a soothing {cerate} for the wound.
e.zh: 药剂师调配了舒缓伤口的蜡膏。

e.en: Old apothecaries sold rose-scented {cerate} in tins.
e.zh: 旧时药店里出售装在锡盒里的玫瑰味蜡膏。

e.en: The {cerated} canvas resisted rain perfectly.
e.zh: 那块涂蜡的帆布完全防雨。

e.en: He wrapped the cheese in {cerated} cloth.
e.zh: 他用涂蜡布把奶酪包了起来。

e.en: The shelves held jars of medicinal {cerates}.
e.zh: 架子上摆着一罐罐药用蜡膏。

e.en: Different {cerates} were used for different ailments.
e.zh: 不同的蜡膏用于治疗不同的病症。

cave-dweller.t: 穴居人；住在洞穴里的人

e.en: Early {cave-dwellers} hunted woolly mammoths for food.
e.zh: 早期穴居人猎杀长毛猛犸象作为食物。

e.en: He joked that his shy brother was a real {cave-dweller}.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说害羞的弟弟简直是个穴居人。

cave-house.t: 洞穴住宅；岩石中凿出的房屋

e.en: We rented a traditional {cave-house} in southern Spain.
e.zh: 我们在西班牙南部租了一间传统的洞穴屋。

e.en: The {cave-house} stayed cool throughout the summer.
e.zh: 那座岩洞屋整个夏天都很凉爽。

cave-in.t: 矿井或地面的塌陷；坍方事故

e.en: Three miners were trapped after the {cave-in}.
e.zh: 塌方后三名矿工被困。

e.en: Heavy rain caused a {cave-in} on the mountain road.
e.zh: 大雨导致山路发生塌陷。

cave-ins.t: 矿井或地面的塌陷；多次坍方

e.en: Recent {cave-ins} have closed several tunnels.
e.zh: 近期多起塌方导致数条隧道关闭。

e.en: Old mines often suffer dangerous {cave-ins}.
e.zh: 旧矿井常发生危险的塌方。

cave-painting.t: 洞穴壁画；史前洞窟绘画

e.en: The {cave-painting} depicts a herd of bison.
e.zh: 这幅洞穴壁画描绘了一群野牛。

e.en: Archaeologists discovered a thirty-thousand-year-old {cave-painting}.
e.zh: 考古学家发现了一幅有三万年历史的洞穴壁画。

caveatee.t: 被警告人；被通知人（法律用语）

e.en: The court formally notified the {caveatee} of the objection.
e.zh: 法庭正式向被警告人通知了异议。

e.en: As {caveatee}, she had to respond within ten days.
e.zh: 作为被警告人，她须在十天内作出回应。

caveator.t: 提出警告者；异议申请人

e.en: The {caveator} filed a notice to challenge the will.
e.zh: 异议申请人提交通知质疑遗嘱。

e.en: Each {caveator} must present supporting evidence.
e.zh: 每位异议申请人都必须提供佐证。

cavefish.t: 洞穴鱼；生活在洞穴中的鱼类

e.en: Blind {cavefish} have evolved without functional eyes.
e.zh: 盲穴鱼已进化得没有功能性的眼睛。

e.en: The aquarium displayed several rare {cavefish}.
e.zh: 水族馆展出了几种稀有的洞穴鱼。

cavelike.t: 洞穴般的；像洞穴一样的

e.en: The bedroom had a dim, {cavelike} atmosphere.
e.zh: 卧室有种昏暗的洞穴般氛围。

e.en: Their basement office felt {cavelike} and damp.
e.zh: 他们的地下室办公室感觉像洞穴一样阴湿。

cavernicolous.t: 穴居的；生活在洞穴中的生物

e.en: {Cavernicolous} insects often lack pigmentation.
e.zh: 穴居昆虫通常缺乏色素。

e.en: Researchers study {cavernicolous} species in deep caves.
e.zh: 研究人员在深洞中研究穴居物种。

e.en: The urologist diagnosed him with chronic {cavernitis}.
e.zh: 泌尿科医生诊断他患有慢性海绵体炎。

e.en: {Cavernitis} can result from infection or trauma.
e.zh: 海绵体炎可由感染或创伤引起。

cavernoma.t: 海绵状血管瘤；脑海绵状畸形

e.en: The MRI revealed a small {cavernoma} in his brain.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示他脑内有一个小的海绵状血管瘤。

e.en: Some patients with {cavernoma} experience seizures.
e.zh: 部分海绵状血管瘤患者会出现癫痫发作。

cavernulous.t: 多小孔的；布满细小空洞的

e.en: The rock had a {cavernulous} surface full of tiny pits.
e.zh: 这块岩石表面布满细小孔洞。

e.en: Bone tissue can appear {cavernulous} under the microscope.
e.zh: 骨组织在显微镜下可呈现多孔状。

cavesson.t: 马笼头；调教马匹用的鼻革带

e.en: The trainer fitted a {cavesson} on the young horse.
e.zh: 训练员给小马装上了笼头。

e.en: A leather {cavesson} helps control the horse during longeing.
e.zh: 皮制笼头有助于在调教时控制马匹。

cavetto.t: 凹弧线脚；建筑中的凹圆边饰

e.en: The ceiling joined the wall with a graceful {cavetto}.
e.zh: 天花板以优美的凹弧线脚与墙面相接。

e.en: Egyptian temples often feature a {cavetto} cornice.
e.zh: 埃及神庙常带有凹弧檐口。

cavicorn.t: 有空心角的；洞角类动物的

e.en: Cattle and antelope are classic {cavicorn} animals.
e.zh: 牛和羚羊是典型的洞角类动物。

e.en: The museum's {cavicorn} exhibit included goat skulls.
e.zh: 博物馆的洞角类展品里包括山羊头骨。

cavies.t: 豚鼠类小型啮齿动物（复数）

e.en: Wild {cavies} live in the South American grasslands.
e.zh: 野生豚鼠类动物生活在南美草原。

e.en: The pet shop sold guinea pigs and other small {cavies}.
e.zh: 宠物店售卖豚鼠和其他小型豚鼠类动物。

cavilingly.t: 吹毛求疵地；挑剔地；爱找茬地

e.en: She responded {cavilingly} to every reasonable suggestion.
e.zh: 她对每条合理的建议都吹毛求疵地回应。

e.en: He spoke {cavilingly}, finding fault with each clause.
e.zh: 他说话挑剔，对每一条款都找茬。

cavitary.t: 有空腔的；空洞性的（医学用语）

e.en: The X-ray revealed a {cavitary} lesion in the lung.
e.zh: X光显示肺部有一个空洞性病变。

e.en: Doctors monitor {cavitary} tuberculosis closely.
e.zh: 医生密切监测空洞型肺结核。

cavitate.t: 形成空腔；产生空化现象

e.en: Propeller blades can {cavitate} at high speeds.
e.zh: 螺旋桨叶片在高速时会发生空化。

e.en: The pump began to {cavitate} when the pressure dropped.
e.zh: 压力下降时水泵开始空化。

cavitied.t: 有空洞的；有龋洞的（牙齿）

e.en: The old wood was {cavitied} and crumbling.
e.zh: 旧木料已有空洞并正在崩解。

e.en: She had a {cavitied} molar that needed filling.
e.zh: 她有一颗有龋洞的臼齿需要补。

cavortings.t: 欢蹦乱跳；嬉戏腾跃；雀跃

e.en: The puppy's playful {cavortings} kept everyone laughing.
e.zh: 小狗顽皮的嬉闹让大家一直笑个不停。

e.en: We watched the dolphins' joyful {cavortings} from the boat.
e.zh: 我们从船上观看海豚欢快的腾跃嬉戏。

cavy.t: 豚鼠；南美产小型啮齿动物

e.en: The {cavy} is a small rodent native to South America.
e.zh: 豚鼠是一种原产于南美的小型啮齿动物。

e.en: She kept a friendly {cavy} as a pet.
e.zh: 她养了一只温顺的豚鼠当宠物。

cayuse.t: 印第安小马；西部牧场用矮种马

e.en: The cowboy rode a tough little {cayuse} into town.
e.zh: 牛仔骑着一匹耐劳的小马进了镇。

e.en: Ranchers preferred a sure-footed {cayuse} for mountain trails.
e.zh: 牧场主在山路上偏爱步履稳健的印第安小马。

caz.t: 随意的；休闲的（英国俚语）

e.en: She prefers a {caz} look on weekends.
e.zh: 她周末偏爱休闲的造型。

e.en: It was just a {caz} get-together with old friends.
e.zh: 那只是一次和老朋友的随意聚会。

e.en: The {cercaria} swims actively before finding a host.
e.zh: 尾蚴在寻找宿主前会主动游动。

e.en: Researchers identified the parasite at its {cercaria} stage.
e.zh: 研究人员在尾蚴阶段鉴定出该寄生虫。

e.en: Snails released thousands of {cercariae} into the pond.
e.zh: 螺类向池塘中释放出成千上万只尾蚴。

e.en: The {cercariae} penetrate human skin during contact with infested water.
e.zh: 接触受污染的水时，尾蚴会穿透人体皮肤。

cerci.t: 尾须（昆虫腹部末端的附肢）

e.en: Cockroaches use their {cerci} to detect air movement.
e.zh: 蟑螂利用尾须来感知气流。

e.en: The insect's paired {cerci} extend from its abdomen.
e.zh: 这种昆虫腹部末端伸出一对尾须。

e.en: The doctor performed a {cerclage} to prevent premature birth.
e.zh: 医生进行了宫颈环扎术以预防早产。

e.en: Bone fragments were held together by wire {cerclage}.
e.zh: 骨折片段通过钢丝环扎固定在一起。

cercus.t: 尾须；昆虫腹部末端附肢

e.en: Each {cercus} is densely covered with sensory hairs.
e.zh: 每根尾须上都密布着感觉毛。

e.en: The cricket's {cercus} senses approaching predators.
e.zh: 蟋蟀的尾须能察觉到逼近的捕食者。

e.en: The parrot's {cere} turns blue as it matures.
e.zh: 鹦鹉成熟时蜡膜会变成蓝色。

e.en: You can often tell a hawk's age by its {cere}.
e.zh: 通常可以通过蜡膜判断鹰的年龄。

e.en: The textbook compared the {cerebella} of various mammals.
e.zh: 教科书比较了各种哺乳动物的小脑。

e.en: Scans revealed differences in the {cerebella} of the twins.
e.zh: 扫描显示这对双胞胎的小脑存在差异。

e.en: The lab preserved several {cerebra} for further study.
e.zh: 实验室保存了几个大脑以供进一步研究。

e.en: Researchers compared the {cerebra} of different primates.
e.zh: 研究者比较了不同灵长类动物的大脑。

e.en: His poetry was criticized for its cold {cerebralism}.
e.zh: 他的诗歌因冷峻的主智倾向而受到批评。

e.en: The movement embraced a strict {cerebralism} over emotion.
e.zh: 该运动崇尚严格的理智至上而非情感。

e.en: Give me a moment to {cerebrate} on the problem.
e.zh: 给我点时间动动脑筋想这个问题。

e.en: He likes to {cerebrate} before making any decision.
e.zh: 他在做决定前喜欢先用脑思考一番。

e.en: She {cerebrated} for hours over the puzzle.
e.zh: 她为这道谜题动了几个小时的脑筋。

e.en: He {cerebrated} carefully before answering the question.
e.zh: 他在回答问题前仔细思考过。

cerebrates.t: 用脑思考（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {cerebrates} endlessly about minor decisions.
e.zh: 他对琐碎的决定也要反复动脑思量。

e.en: She {cerebrates} on every word she writes.
e.zh: 她对自己写下的每个字都要细细斟酌。

e.en: Don't disturb him; he's {cerebrating} on the proof.
e.zh: 别打扰他，他正在琢磨那道证明题。

e.en: She sat by the window, quietly {cerebrating}.
e.zh: 她坐在窗边，静静地思考着。

e.en: The puzzle required intense {cerebration}.
e.zh: 这道难题需要高度的脑力活动。

e.en: Solving the case took weeks of careful {cerebration}.
e.zh: 破解这桩案件花了数周的缜密思索。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with lupus {cerebritis}.
e.zh: 患者被诊断为狼疮性脑炎。

e.en: {Cerebritis} can cause severe neurological symptoms.
e.zh: 大脑炎可能引起严重的神经症状。

e.en: {Cerebroside} is a key component of the myelin sheath.
e.zh: 脑苷脂是髓鞘的重要组成成分。

e.en: Defects in {cerebroside} metabolism cause Gaucher disease.
e.zh: 脑苷脂代谢缺陷会导致戈谢病。

cerebrotonia.t: 大脑紧张型气质；内向理智型性格

e.en: Sheldon associated thin builds with {cerebrotonia}.
e.zh: 谢尔登把瘦削体型与大脑紧张型气质联系在一起。

e.en: He showed the introversion typical of {cerebrotonia}.
e.zh: 他表现出大脑紧张型气质特有的内向。

cerebrotonic.t: 大脑紧张型的；理智内向型的

e.en: The quiet scholar had a clearly {cerebrotonic} temperament.
e.zh: 这位沉静的学者明显具有大脑紧张型的气质。

e.en: She described her brother as a {cerebrotonic} introvert.
e.zh: 她形容弟弟是个理智内向型的人。

e.en: The body was wrapped in a heavy {cerecloth}.
e.zh: 尸体被裹在厚厚的蜡布中。

e.en: Archaeologists found fragments of ancient {cerecloth}.
e.zh: 考古学家发现了古代蜡布的残片。

e.en: The mummy lay wrapped in linen {cerement}.
e.zh: 木乃伊被亚麻殓衣层层包裹。

e.en: He spoke of death as donning the final {cerement}.
e.zh: 他把死亡比作穿上最后一件殓衣。

e.en: The church was criticized for its rigid {ceremonialism}.
e.zh: 该教会因僵化的礼仪主义而受到批评。

e.en: He rejected the empty {ceremonialism} of court life.
e.zh: 他厌弃宫廷生活那种空洞的礼仪主义。

ceremonialist.t: 礼仪主义者；拘泥仪式的人

e.en: As a strict {ceremonialist}, he insisted on every protocol.
e.zh: 作为严格的礼仪主义者，他坚持遵守每一条规程。

e.en: The bishop was a renowned {ceremonialist} in the diocese.
e.zh: 这位主教是教区内著名的礼仪主义者。

e.en: They tried to {ceremonialize} every step of the meeting.
e.zh: 他们试图把会议的每个环节都仪式化。

e.en: Modern weddings often {ceremonialize} small everyday gestures.
e.zh: 现代婚礼常常把日常的小举动仪式化。

e.en: The corpse had a pale, {cereous} look.
e.zh: 尸体呈现出一种苍白如蜡的样子。

e.en: Her skin was almost {cereous} after the long illness.
e.zh: 久病之后，她的皮肤几乎像蜡一样。

e.en: The candles were made with refined {ceresin}.
e.zh: 这些蜡烛是用精炼地蜡制成的。

e.en: {Ceresin} is often used as a substitute for beeswax.
e.zh: 地蜡常被用作蜂蜡的替代品。

e.en: The cosmetic contained {ceresine} as a thickener.
e.zh: 这款化妆品含有地蜡作为增稠剂。

e.en: {Ceresine} is purified from ozokerite mineral wax.
e.zh: 地蜡是从矿蜡中提纯出来的。

e.en: {Cerium} is widely used in catalytic converters.
e.zh: 铈广泛用于催化转化器中。

e.en: The lab purified a small sample of {cerium} oxide.
e.zh: 实验室提纯了一小份氧化铈样品。

cermet.t: 金属陶瓷（陶瓷与金属的复合材料）

e.en: The cutting tool is made from a hard {cermet}.
e.zh: 这把切削刀具由坚硬的金属陶瓷制成。

e.en: Engineers chose a {cermet} coating for its heat resistance.
e.zh: 工程师选用金属陶瓷涂层以获得耐热性能。

e.en: She submitted the {certificatory} documents to the board.
e.zh: 她向委员会提交了认证文件。

e.en: The agency issued a {certificatory} statement of compliance.
e.zh: 该机构出具了一份合规证明声明。

certifier.t: 认证人；签发证明的人或机构

e.en: The {certifier} signed off on the inspection report.
e.zh: 认证人在检验报告上签了字。

e.en: Each lab must work with an independent {certifier}.
e.zh: 每个实验室都必须与独立的认证机构合作。

cervices.t: 宫颈（复数）；颈部（解剖学复数形式）

e.en: The textbook illustrates the anatomy of the {cervices}.
e.zh: 教科书展示了宫颈的解剖结构。

e.en: Researchers compared tissue samples from several {cervices}.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了多个宫颈的组织样本。

e.en: She was diagnosed with chronic {cervicitis}.
e.zh: 她被诊断为慢性宫颈炎。

e.en: {Cervicitis} is often caused by a bacterial infection.
e.zh: 宫颈炎通常由细菌感染引起。

e.en: The lone {cervid} stepped cautiously into the clearing.
e.zh: 那只鹿科动物小心翼翼地走进林间空地。

e.en: Biologists tracked the {cervid} population through winter.
e.zh: 生物学家追踪了整个冬季的鹿群数量。

e.en: She moved with a {cervine} grace through the trees.
e.zh: 她在林间穿行，姿态如鹿般优雅。

e.en: His large, {cervine} eyes looked almost startled.
e.zh: 他那双大大的、像鹿一样的眼睛显得有些受惊。

cesarian.t: 剖腹产的；剖宫产手术（cesarean 的变体拼写）

e.en: The doctor recommended a {cesarian} delivery.
e.zh: 医生建议进行剖腹产。

e.en: After complications, she had to have a {cesarian}.
e.zh: 出现并发症后，她不得不接受剖腹产手术。

e.en: They danced the {chacha} all night long.
e.zh: 他们整晚都在跳恰恰舞。

e.en: She signed up for a {chacha} class.
e.zh: 她报名参加了恰恰舞课程。

e.en: A troop of {chacma} baboons crossed the trail.
e.zh: 一群豚尾狒狒穿过了小径。

e.en: The {chacma} is native to southern Africa.
e.zh: 豚尾狒狒原产于非洲南部。

chaconne.t: 恰空舞曲；一种巴洛克变奏曲

e.en: Bach's {chaconne} for solo violin is breathtaking.
e.zh: 巴赫为独奏小提琴所作的恰空舞曲令人惊叹。

e.en: She performed a stately {chaconne} on the harpsichord.
e.zh: 她在羽管键琴上演奏了一首庄重的恰空舞曲。

e.en: The farmer fed straw into the {chaff-cutter}.
e.zh: 农夫把稻草送进铡草机里。

e.en: An old {chaff-cutter} sat rusting in the barn.
e.zh: 一台老旧的铡草机在谷仓里生锈。

e.en: He repaired the broken {chaffcutter} before harvest.
e.zh: 他在收获前修好了坏掉的铡草机。

e.en: The {chaffcutter} hummed steadily in the shed.
e.zh: 铡草机在棚屋里平稳地嗡嗡作响。

e.en: They {chaffered} over the price of the goat.
e.zh: 他们就那只山羊的价格讨价还价。

e.en: Old men {chaffered} in the marketplace all morning.
e.zh: 老人们整个上午都在集市上讨价还价。

chafferer.t: 讨价还价的人；爱闲谈者

e.en: The shrewd {chafferer} drove a hard bargain.
e.zh: 那个精明的讨价还价者杀价毫不留情。

e.en: Every market has its share of {chafferer}s.
e.zh: 每个市场都少不了讨价还价的人。

e.en: Hours of {chaffering} finally settled the deal.
e.zh: 几个小时的讨价还价终于敲定了交易。

e.en: The bazaar was alive with {chaffering} traders.
e.zh: 集市上挤满了讨价还价的商贩。

e.en: She {chaffers} with vendors at every stall.
e.zh: 她在每个摊位都和商贩讨价还价。

e.en: He {chaffers} cheerfully with his old neighbors.
e.zh: 他与老邻居们愉快地闲聊。

e.en: This batch of grain is {chaffier} than the last.
e.zh: 这批谷物比上一批糠秕更多。

e.en: The hay grew {chaffier} after the dry spell.
e.zh: 干旱过后，干草变得更多糠秕。

e.en: The miller boasted of his {chaffless} flour.
e.zh: 磨坊主夸耀他磨出的面粉无糠杂质。

e.en: Pure, {chaffless} wheat fetched a higher price.
e.zh: 纯净无糠的小麦能卖出更高的价钱。

e.en: The bracts had a dry, {chafflike} texture.
e.zh: 那些苞片有一种干燥似糠的质感。

e.en: Tiny {chafflike} scales covered the seed head.
e.zh: 细小的糠秕状鳞片覆盖着种穗。

e.en: The grain was too {chaffy} to sell.
e.zh: 这些谷物糠太多，没法卖。

e.en: His speech was full of {chaffy} platitudes.
e.zh: 他的演讲充满了空洞无价值的陈词滥调。

e.en: She served the cheese in a silver {chafingdish}.
e.zh: 她用一只银制保温炖锅盛奶酪上桌。

e.en: The {chafingdish} kept the sauce warm at dinner.
e.zh: 那只小火锅在晚宴上一直为酱汁保温。

e.en: Such failures invariably {chagrine} a proud man.
e.zh: 这种失败总会让一个骄傲的人懊恼。

e.en: It seemed to {chagrine} her that we noticed.
e.zh: 我们注意到了这件事，似乎让她很懊恼。

e.en: She ordered a hot {chai} with extra cinnamon.
e.zh: 她点了一杯加肉桂的热印度香料茶。

e.en: Street vendors sold {chai} in tiny clay cups.
e.zh: 街边小贩用小陶杯卖着印度奶茶。

chain-gang.t: 铁链囚犯队；连环服劳役队

e.en: The {chain-gang} cleared brush along the highway.
e.zh: 那队铁链囚犯沿着公路清理灌木。

e.en: He spent two years on a Southern {chain-gang}.
e.zh: 他在南方的铁链劳役队里度过了两年。

e.en: Once panic sets in, markets {chain-react} quickly.
e.zh: 一旦恐慌出现，市场会迅速发生连锁反应。

e.en: These isotopes can {chain-react} under the right conditions.
e.zh: 这些同位素在适当条件下能发生连锁反应。

chain-reacting.t: 连锁反应的；正在连锁反应

e.en: A {chain-reacting} core powers the reactor.
e.zh: 一个发生连锁反应的堆芯为反应堆提供动力。

e.en: The {chain-reacting} rumors spread across the office.
e.zh: 接连引发的流言在办公室里蔓延开来。

e.en: He would {chain-smoke} whenever a deadline loomed.
e.zh: 每逢截稿期临近，他就一支接一支地抽烟。

e.en: She tried not to {chain-smoke} at the party.
e.zh: 她在聚会上尽量不一支接一支地抽烟。

e.en: He {chain-smoked} through the long meeting.
e.zh: 在那场漫长的会议中，他一支接一支地抽烟。

e.en: She {chain-smoked} cigarettes while waiting for news.
e.zh: 她一边等消息一边一支接一支地抽烟。

chain-smoker.t: 烟瘾极大的人；连续抽烟者

e.en: His grandfather was a lifelong {chain-smoker}.
e.zh: 他祖父一辈子都是个烟瘾极大的人。

e.en: As a {chain-smoker}, she developed a chronic cough.
e.zh: 作为一个烟瘾极大的人，她得了慢性咳嗽。

e.en: The bar was full of {chain-smokers} and gamblers.
e.zh: 酒吧里挤满了烟瘾极大的人和赌徒。

e.en: Doctors warn {chain-smokers} about lung disease.
e.zh: 医生警告烟瘾极大的人当心肺病。

e.en: She paced the room, {chain-smoking} nervously.
e.zh: 她在房间里踱步，紧张地一支接一支抽烟。

e.en: His {chain-smoking} habit ruined his health.
e.zh: 他一支接一支抽烟的习惯毁掉了他的健康。

e.en: Surveyors marked the {chainage} along the new road.
e.zh: 测量员沿新路标出了链距桩号。

e.en: Each milestone shows the route's {chainage}.
e.zh: 每个里程碑都标出该路线的链距。

center-mounted.t: 中心安装的；居中安装的

e.en: The {center-mounted} engine improved handling.
e.zh: 中置发动机改善了操控性。

e.en: She bought a {center-mounted} ceiling lamp.
e.zh: 她买了一盏居中安装的吸顶灯。

e.en: The flowers were the {center-piece} of the table.
e.zh: 这束鲜花是餐桌的中心摆饰。

e.en: Tax reform is the {center-piece} of his agenda.
e.zh: 税制改革是他施政纲领的核心。

e.en: She joined a {center-right} political party.
e.zh: 她加入了一个中右翼政党。

e.en: The {center-right} coalition won the election.
e.zh: 中右翼联盟赢得了选举。

centerfire.t: 中央底火的；中央发火弹药

e.en: He prefers {centerfire} rifles for hunting.
e.zh: 他打猎喜欢用中央底火步枪。

e.en: Most modern military rounds are {centerfire}.
e.zh: 大多数现代军用子弹都是中央底火的。

centesimal.t: 百分之一的；百进位制的

e.en: The {centesimal} system divides things by hundred.
e.zh: 百进位制将事物按百进行划分。

e.en: Centigrade temperature uses a {centesimal} scale.
e.zh: 摄氏温度使用百分制刻度。

centesimally.t: 按百分制地；以百分位计

e.en: The angles are graduated {centesimally}.
e.zh: 这些角度按百分制刻度划分。

e.en: Old surveying instruments measure angles {centesimally}.
e.zh: 旧测量仪器以百分制计量角度。

centesimate.t: 百中抽一处死；古罗马军法处罚

e.en: Roman generals would {centesimate} mutinous legions.
e.zh: 罗马将军会对哗变的军团百中抽一处死。

e.en: The order to {centesimate} the unit shocked everyone.
e.zh: 对该部队进行百中抽杀的命令震惊了所有人。

e.en: Amniocentesis is a type of {centesis}.
e.zh: 羊膜穿刺是一种穿刺术。

e.en: The doctor performed a {centesis} to drain fluid.
e.zh: 医生进行穿刺以引流积液。

e.en: Reaction times were measured in {centi-seconds}.
e.zh: 反应时间以百分之一秒为单位测量。

e.en: A {centi-second} delay is barely noticeable.
e.zh: 百分之一秒的延迟几乎察觉不到。

centiare.t: 平方米；公亩的百分之一

e.en: The plot measures one hundred {centiares}.
e.zh: 这块地共一百平方米。

e.en: {Centiare} is rarely used outside France.
e.zh: 平方米这一单位在法国以外很少使用。

centibar.t: 厘巴；百分之一巴的压力单位

e.en: Soil moisture is often measured in {centibars}.
e.zh: 土壤湿度常以厘巴为单位测量。

e.en: One {centibar} equals one kilopascal.
e.zh: 一厘巴等于一千帕。

e.en: The pill weighs only a few {centigrams}.
e.zh: 这粒药只有几厘克重。

e.en: Gold leaf can be measured in {centigrams}.
e.zh: 金箔可以用厘克来计量。

centigramme.t: 厘克（英式拼写）；百分之一克

e.en: British texts often use {centigramme}.
e.zh: 英国文献常用 centigramme 这种拼法。

e.en: Add five {centigrammes} of the powder.
e.zh: 加入五厘克这种粉末。

centigray.t: 厘戈瑞；辐射吸收剂量单位

e.en: Patients received forty {centigrays} per session.
e.zh: 患者每次接受四十厘戈瑞辐射。

e.en: Radiotherapy doses are stated in {centigrays}.
e.zh: 放疗剂量以厘戈瑞计。

e.en: His score sits in the ninetieth {centile}.
e.zh: 他的分数位于第九十百分位。

e.en: Growth charts plot weight by {centile}.
e.zh: 生长曲线按百分位绘制体重。

e.en: Pour fifty {centiliters} of water carefully.
e.zh: 小心倒入五十厘升水。

e.en: European recipes often use {centiliters}.
e.zh: 欧洲食谱常用厘升做单位。

centilitre.t: 厘升（英式拼写）；百分之一升

e.en: The bottle holds twenty-five {centilitres}.
e.zh: 这瓶装二十五厘升。

e.en: British recipes list quantities in {centilitres}.
e.zh: 英国食谱用厘升标注分量。

centilitres.t: 厘升（复数）；多个百分之一升

e.en: Add ten {centilitres} of cream slowly.
e.zh: 慢慢加入十厘升奶油。

e.en: She measured several {centilitres} of vinegar.
e.zh: 她量取了好几厘升醋。

centillion.t: 古戈尔级巨数；一后跟三百零三个零

e.en: A {centillion} is impossibly large.
e.zh: 一个 centillion 是个无法想象的巨数。

e.en: Few real quantities approach a {centillion}.
e.zh: 几乎没有实际数量能接近这种巨数。

e.en: She left a few {centimes} as a tip.
e.zh: 她留了几个生丁作小费。

e.en: One franc was worth a hundred {centimes}.
e.zh: 一法郎值一百生丁。

centimes.t: 生丁（复数）；法郎辅币单位

e.en: He had only a handful of {centimes} left.
e.zh: 他只剩下少许生丁。

e.en: Old French coins came in {centimes}.
e.zh: 旧时法国硬币以生丁计。

centimeter-gram-second.t: 厘米克秒单位制；旧物理单位制

e.en: Physicists once used the {centimeter-gram-second} system.
e.zh: 物理学家以前使用厘米克秒制。

e.en: The {centimeter-gram-second} units are now obsolete.
e.zh: 厘米克秒单位现已过时。

e.en: The film thickness was measured in {centimillimetres}.
e.zh: 薄膜厚度以厘毫米为单位测量。

e.en: {Centimillimetre} is a non-standard unit.
e.zh: 厘毫米是非标准单位。

e.en: Tech founders often become {centimillionaires}.
e.zh: 科技创始人常常成为亿万富翁。

e.en: The actress is now a {centimillionaire}.
e.zh: 这位女演员如今身家上亿。

centimorgan.t: 厘摩；遗传连锁图距单位

e.en: Two genes lie three {centimorgans} apart.
e.zh: 两个基因相距三厘摩。

e.en: Geneticists map distances in {centimorgans}.
e.zh: 遗传学家用厘摩量度图距。

centinormal.t: 百分之一当量浓度的；化学溶液单位

e.en: The lab prepared a {centinormal} acid solution.
e.zh: 实验室配制了百分之一当量浓度的酸液。

e.en: {Centinormal} solutions are used for titration.
e.zh: 百分之一当量浓度的溶液用于滴定。

e.en: The creature had a {centipedal} appearance.
e.zh: 这只生物外形像蜈蚣。

e.en: Old fables describe {centipedal} monsters.
e.zh: 古老寓言里有形似蜈蚣的怪物。

e.en: Water has a viscosity around one {centipoise}.
e.zh: 水的黏度约为一厘泊。

e.en: Engine oil is rated in {centipoises}.
e.zh: 机油黏度以厘泊计。

e.en: Sprinters compete down to the {centisecond}.
e.zh: 短跑运动员的比拼精确到厘秒。

e.en: Each frame lasts one {centisecond}.
e.zh: 每一帧持续一厘秒。

centisievert.t: 厘希沃特；辐射剂量单位

e.en: Workers received only a {centisievert} of exposure.
e.zh: 工作人员仅受到一厘希沃特的辐射。

e.en: Annual limits are set in {centisieverts}.
e.zh: 年度限值以厘希沃特设定。

e.en: Firewood was once sold by the {centistere}.
e.zh: 柴火曾经按厘立方米出售。

e.en: {Centistere} is rarely used today.
e.zh: 厘立方米现在很少使用。

e.en: {Centisthene} appears only in obscure texts.
e.zh: 厘斯泰内只出现在冷门文献中。

e.en: Few engineers recognize the {centisthene}.
e.zh: 少有工程师认识厘斯泰内这个单位。

centner.t: 公担；约五十公斤的重量单位

e.en: Russian harvests are measured in {centners}.
e.zh: 俄罗斯的收成以公担计算。

e.en: One {centner} equals fifty kilograms.
e.zh: 一公担等于五十公斤。

cento.t: 集句诗；由他人诗句拼成的作品

e.en: Ancient poets sometimes composed a {cento}.
e.zh: 古代诗人有时会创作集句诗。

e.en: Her {cento} drew lines from Shakespeare.
e.zh: 她的集句诗摘取了莎士比亚的诗句。

e.en: {Centonism} flourished in late antiquity.
e.zh: 集句体在古代晚期盛行。

e.en: Scholars debate the value of {centonism}.
e.zh: 学者们争论集句创作的艺术价值。

e.en: Surveying angles can be given in {centrads}.
e.zh: 测量中角度可以用厘弧度表示。

e.en: One {centrad} equals one hundredth of a radian.
e.zh: 一厘弧度等于百分之一弧度。

centralistic.t: 中央集权主义的；集权制的

e.en: He criticized the party's {centralistic} tendencies.
e.zh: 他批评该党的中央集权倾向。

e.en: {Centralistic} governments concentrate power in the capital.
e.zh: 中央集权制政府把权力集中在首都。

centre-fold.t: 杂志中央对开折页；中页插图

e.en: She appeared as the {centre-fold} of the magazine.
e.zh: 她出现在杂志的中央对开折页上。

e.en: The {centre-fold} showed a detailed world map.
e.zh: 中央对开折页上印着一张详细的世界地图。

e.en: The {centre-left} party won most of the seats.
e.zh: 中左派政党赢得了大多数席位。

e.en: She holds {centre-left} views on welfare policy.
e.zh: 她在福利政策上持中间偏左的立场。

e.en: The defender stayed near the {centre-line}.
e.zh: 那名后卫一直守在中线附近。

e.en: Please mark the {centre-line} on the floor.
e.zh: 请在地板上标出中线。

centre-piece.t: 桌饰中心摆设；最重要的部分

e.en: A silver bowl was the {centre-piece} of the table.
e.zh: 一只银碗是餐桌的中心摆设。

e.en: Healthcare reform is the {centre-piece} of his agenda.
e.zh: 医疗改革是他施政议程的核心。

e.en: A {centre-right} coalition now governs the country.
e.zh: 现在由中右派联盟执政。

e.en: His economic views lean clearly {centre-right}.
e.zh: 他的经济观点明显偏向中右派。

centreboard.t: 帆船的活动龙骨；中插板

e.en: He raised the {centreboard} as they neared shore.
e.zh: 靠近岸边时他把活动龙骨升起。

e.en: The dinghy has a retractable wooden {centreboard}.
e.zh: 这艘小帆船有一块可伸缩的木质活动龙骨。

e.en: The factory uses a {centreless} grinder for steel rods.
e.zh: 工厂用无心磨床加工钢棒。

e.en: The sprawling city felt strangely {centreless}.
e.zh: 这座蔓延扩张的城市奇怪地没有中心感。

e.en: She chose the {centremost} seat in the row.
e.zh: 她挑了那一排最中央的座位。

e.en: The {centremost} ring of the target is tiny.
e.zh: 靶子最中心的那个环非常小。

e.en: The market occupies a {centrical} position in town.
e.zh: 市场位于镇上的中心位置。

e.en: We picked a {centrical} spot for our picnic.
e.zh: 我们挑了个居中的地方野餐。

centricity.t: 中心性；居于中心的状态

e.en: Critics praised the painting's strong {centricity}.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这幅画强烈的中心性。

e.en: Planners value the {centricity} of public squares.
e.zh: 规划者重视公共广场的中心性。

centrifugalization.t: 离心分离作用；离心化处理

e.en: {Centrifugalization} separates the cream from the milk.
e.zh: 离心分离把奶油从牛奶中分离出来。

e.en: Industrial {centrifugalization} is common in oil refining.
e.zh: 炼油过程中常采用工业离心分离。

centrifugalize.t: 用离心法处理；使离心分离

e.en: The lab will {centrifugalize} the sample tomorrow.
e.zh: 实验室明天会对样本进行离心处理。

e.en: Engineers {centrifugalize} the slurry to extract solids.
e.zh: 工程师用离心法分离泥浆中的固体。

centrifugate.t: 离心分离物；用离心法处理

e.en: The {centrifugate} was poured into a clean tube.
e.zh: 离心分离液被倒入一支干净的试管。

e.en: Technicians {centrifugate} blood samples for testing.
e.zh: 技术员将血液样本离心以进行检测。

centrilobular.t: 小叶中心的（解剖与病理学术语）

e.en: The biopsy showed {centrilobular} necrosis.
e.zh: 活检显示有小叶中心性坏死。

e.en: Doctors discussed the {centrilobular} damage in the liver.
e.zh: 医生讨论了肝脏的小叶中心性损伤。

centrine.t: 中心的；与中心结构有关的

e.en: Researchers analyzed the {centrine} compound's structure.
e.zh: 研究人员分析了这种中心化合物的结构。

e.en: The {centrine} arrangement proved difficult to confirm.
e.zh: 这种以中心为基础的排列方式很难得到确认。

centriole.t: 中心粒（细胞的微小结构）

e.en: Each {centriole} helps organize the cell's microtubules.
e.zh: 每个中心粒帮助组织细胞中的微管。

e.en: Scientists watched the {centriole} dividing in two.
e.zh: 科学家观察到中心粒分裂为二。

e.en: The whirlpool demonstrated remarkable {centripetence}.
e.zh: 漩涡表现出明显的向心性。

e.en: Physicists measured the {centripetence} of the spinning disk.
e.zh: 物理学家测量了旋转圆盘的向心力倾向。

e.en: Engineers calculated the {centrobaric} point of the bridge.
e.zh: 工程师计算了这座桥的重心点。

e.en: Her thesis explored {centrobaric} coordinates in mechanics.
e.zh: 她的论文探讨了力学中的重心坐标。

centroclinal.t: 向心倾斜的（地质构造术语）

e.en: Geologists mapped the {centroclinal} folds in the basin.
e.zh: 地质学家测绘了盆地内的向心倾斜褶皱。

e.en: The {centroclinal} layers dip toward the centre.
e.zh: 这些向心倾斜的岩层朝中心倾斜。

centrolecithal.t: 中黄卵的（卵黄居中的卵）

e.en: Insect eggs are typically {centrolecithal} in structure.
e.zh: 昆虫的卵在结构上通常是中黄卵。

e.en: Embryologists study {centrolecithal} development in arthropods.
e.zh: 胚胎学家研究节肢动物的中黄卵发育。

e.en: The pathologist noted clear {centrolobular} fibrosis.
e.zh: 病理学家注意到明显的小叶中心性纤维化。

e.en: Some drugs cause {centrolobular} injury to liver cells.
e.zh: 某些药物会对肝细胞造成小叶中心性损伤。

centromere.t: 着丝粒；着丝点（染色体结构）

e.en: Each chromosome has a single {centromere}.
e.zh: 每条染色体都有一个着丝粒。

e.en: The {centromere} attaches to spindle fibres during division.
e.zh: 着丝粒在细胞分裂时与纺锤丝相连。

centroplasm.t: 中心质（细胞中心区的原生质）

e.en: Histologists examined the cell's {centroplasm} closely.
e.zh: 组织学家仔细观察了细胞的中心质。

e.en: The {centroplasm} surrounds the centrioles.
e.zh: 中心质包围着中心粒。

centroplast.t: 中心体（某些原生生物的结构）

e.en: Researchers identified the {centroplast} in protozoan cells.
e.zh: 研究人员在原生动物细胞中识别出中心体。

e.en: The {centroplast} plays a key role during division.
e.zh: 中心体在分裂过程中起关键作用。

centrosome.t: 中心体（参与细胞分裂的结构）

e.en: The {centrosome} duplicates before mitosis begins.
e.zh: 有丝分裂开始前中心体先复制。

e.en: Microtubules emerge from the {centrosome}.
e.zh: 微管从中心体伸出。

centrosomic.t: 中心体的；与中心体相关的

e.en: Researchers studied {centrosomic} abnormalities in cancer cells.
e.zh: 研究人员研究癌细胞中的中心体异常。

e.en: The drug targets a key {centrosomic} protein.
e.zh: 该药物靶向一种关键的中心体蛋白。

e.en: Geophysicists model the Earth's {centrosphere}.
e.zh: 地球物理学家对地球的中心球建模。

e.en: The {centrosphere} surrounds the centriole.
e.zh: 中心球围绕在中心粒周围。

centrosymmetric.t: 中心对称的（晶体学与化学）

e.en: The crystal has a {centrosymmetric} structure.
e.zh: 这种晶体具有中心对称的结构。

e.en: {Centrosymmetric} molecules cannot show piezoelectricity.
e.zh: 中心对称的分子不能表现出压电性。

cents-off.t: 减价的（指优惠券或促销）

e.en: She clipped a {cents-off} coupon for cereal.
e.zh: 她剪下了一张麦片的减价优惠券。

e.en: The store advertised many {cents-off} deals this week.
e.zh: 这家商店本周宣传了许多减价优惠。

centum.t: 一百；颚音语支（印欧语言学术语）

e.en: Latin belongs to the {centum} branch of Indo-European.
e.zh: 拉丁语属于印欧语系的颚音语支。

e.en: Linguists distinguish {centum} from satem languages.
e.zh: 语言学家将颚音语和咝音语区分开来。

e.en: Inflation can {centuple} the cost of basic goods.
e.zh: 通胀可使基本商品的价格增至百倍。

e.en: He vowed to {centuple} his investment within a decade.
e.zh: 他发誓要在十年内让投资增长百倍。

e.en: The corporation aims to {centuplicate} its market share.
e.zh: 该公司力图把市场份额扩大到百倍。

e.en: Demand could {centuplicate} if the rumours prove true.
e.zh: 如果传闻属实，需求可能增长到百倍。

e.en: The {centuplicated} profits stunned every analyst.
e.zh: 已增长百倍的利润让每一位分析师震惊。

e.en: She presented a {centuplicated} version of the dataset.
e.zh: 她展示了一份扩大到百倍的数据集。

e.en: They are {centuplicating} their production capacity this year.
e.zh: 他们今年正在把产能扩大到百倍。

e.en: {Centuplicating} the workload is simply unrealistic.
e.zh: 把工作量增加到百倍是根本不现实的。

e.en: The temple's {centurial} celebrations attracted thousands.
e.zh: 这座庙宇的百年庆典吸引了数千人。

e.en: Historians described the {centurial} cycle of empires.
e.zh: 历史学家描述了帝国百年的兴衰循环。

centuried.t: 历经数个世纪的；古老的

e.en: We toured a {centuried} stone manor in the countryside.
e.zh: 我们参观了乡间一座历经数百年的石砌庄园。

e.en: The {centuried} oak still stands by the river.
e.zh: 那棵历经数百年的橡树仍然立在河边。

centuries-old.t: 有数百年历史的；古老的

e.en: They visited a {centuries-old} cathedral in Cologne.
e.zh: 他们参观了科隆一座有数百年历史的大教堂。

e.en: The festival follows a {centuries-old} tradition.
e.zh: 这个节日遵循着数百年的传统。

ceorl.t: 古英格兰的自由民；平民

e.en: The {ceorl} held a small plot in the village.
e.zh: 这位自由民在村中有一小块地。

e.en: Anglo-Saxon law distinguished a thane from a {ceorl}.
e.zh: 盎格鲁-撒克逊法律把贵族与自由民区分开来。

cepalin.t: 脑磷脂（旧称，今多写作 cephalin）

e.en: Early biochemists named the substance {cepalin}.
e.zh: 早期生化学家把这种物质称作脑磷脂。

e.en: Older textbooks still use the term {cepalin}.
e.zh: 较旧的教科书仍使用脑磷脂这一术语。

cephaeline.t: 头花藜碱（吐根中提取的生物碱）

e.en: Pharmacologists studied the effects of {cephaeline}.
e.zh: 药理学家研究了头花藜碱的作用。

e.en: {Cephaeline} is extracted from ipecac roots.
e.zh: 头花藜碱从吐根的根中提取。

cephalad.t: 朝头部的；向头侧（解剖学方位词）

e.en: The nerve runs {cephalad} along the spine.
e.zh: 这条神经沿脊柱向头侧走行。

e.en: The surgeon traced the artery {cephalad}.
e.zh: 外科医生沿动脉向头侧追踪。

e.en: She was given a {cephalalgic} remedy.
e.zh: 她被开了一种治头痛的药。

e.en: The patient described a strong {cephalalgic} sensation.
e.zh: 病人描述了一种强烈的头痛感觉。

e.en: Most molluscs are {cephalate} animals.
e.zh: 大多数软体动物是有头类动物。

e.en: Biologists classify the species as {cephalate}.
e.zh: 生物学家把这种生物归入有头类。

cephalexin.t: 头孢氨苄（一种常见抗生素）

e.en: The doctor prescribed {cephalexin} for the infection.
e.zh: 医生为感染开了头孢氨苄。

e.en: {Cephalexin} treats many bacterial infections effectively.
e.zh: 头孢氨苄能有效治疗多种细菌感染。

e.en: The fibres extend {cephalically} from the brain stem.
e.zh: 这些纤维从脑干向头侧延伸。

e.en: Anatomists describe structures positioned {cephalically}.
e.zh: 解剖学家描述位于头侧的结构。

e.en: He rode a {chainless} bicycle to work.
e.zh: 他骑着一辆无链条的自行车去上班。

e.en: She felt {chainless} after quitting her job.
e.zh: 辞职后她感到无拘无束。

e.en: The molecules form a {chainlike} structure.
e.zh: 这些分子形成链状结构。

e.en: She wore a {chainlike} silver necklace.
e.zh: 她戴着一条链状的银项链。

chainman.t: 司链员；测链员（测量助手）

e.en: The surveyor's {chainman} marked each point carefully.
e.zh: 测量员的司链员仔细标出每个点。

e.en: He worked as a {chainman} on the survey team.
e.zh: 他在测量队里担任司链员。

e.en: He tends to {chainsmoke} when he's stressed.
e.zh: 他一紧张就一支接一支地抽烟。

e.en: She would {chainsmoke} through every deadline.
e.zh: 每到截稿期她总是烟不离手。

e.en: The hem was sewn with a {chainstitch}.
e.zh: 下摆是用链式针迹缝的。

e.en: She learned to {chainstitch} from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她跟奶奶学会了锁链绣。

e.en: A new {chainstore} opened on Main Street.
e.zh: 主街上新开了一家连锁店。

e.en: He manages a {chainstore} downtown.
e.zh: 他在市中心经营一家连锁店。

e.en: The bike's {chainwheel} needed replacing.
e.zh: 自行车的链轮需要更换。

e.en: He greased the {chainwheel} before the race.
e.zh: 比赛前他给链轮上了油。

e.en: We took the {chair-lift} up the mountain.
e.zh: 我们坐吊椅缆车上山。

e.en: The {chair-lift} stopped halfway up.
e.zh: 吊椅缆车在半山腰停住了。

e.en: The guest room has a convenient {chairbed}.
e.zh: 客房里有一张方便的椅床。

e.en: He unfolded the {chairbed} for his nephew.
e.zh: 他为侄子展开了椅床。

chairborne.t: 坐办公室的（戏指文职军人）

e.en: He joked about being a {chairborne} officer.
e.zh: 他开玩笑说自己是个坐办公室的军官。

e.en: The unit was mostly {chairborne} staff.
e.zh: 该部门大多是文职坐班人员。

e.en: She was elected {chairlady} of the committee.
e.zh: 她被选为委员会的女主席。

e.en: The {chairlady} opened the meeting at noon.
e.zh: 女主席于中午宣布会议开始。

chairoplane.t: 飞椅（游乐场旋转椅设施）

e.en: The kids screamed on the {chairoplane}.
e.zh: 孩子们在飞椅上尖叫。

e.en: We rode the {chairoplane} at the fair.
e.zh: 我们在游乐场坐了飞椅。

e.en: She accepted the {chairpersonship} of the board.
