e.zh: 她接受了董事会主席的职位。

e.en: His {chairpersonship} lasted five years.
e.zh: 他担任主席一职长达五年。

e.en: He held two {chairpersonships} simultaneously.
e.zh: 他同时担任两个主席职位。

e.en: Several {chairpersonships} fell vacant that year.
e.zh: 那年有几个主席职位空缺出来。

e.en: The dentist has a great {chairside} manner.
e.zh: 这位牙医对待病人的态度很好。

e.en: Her {chairside} assistant prepared the tools.
e.zh: 她的椅旁助手准备好了器具。

chairwarmer.t: 懒散的人；占着位子不干事的人

e.en: That office is full of {chairwarmer} types.
e.zh: 那间办公室里全是占位子不干活的人。

e.en: He's a {chairwarmer}, not a leader.
e.zh: 他只是个混日子的，不是领导者。

chalah.t: 哈拉面包（犹太教安息日辫子面包）

e.en: They baked {chalah} every Friday afternoon.
e.zh: 他们每周五下午都烤哈拉面包。

e.en: The {chalah} was braided and golden brown.
e.zh: 哈拉面包编成辫状，呈金棕色。

chalaza.t: 卵带（蛋白中固定蛋黄的螺旋带）；珠柄

e.en: The {chalaza} keeps the yolk centered.
e.zh: 卵带使蛋黄保持在中央位置。

e.en: Biology students examined the {chalaza} under microscopes.
e.zh: 生物系学生在显微镜下观察卵带。

e.en: Each egg contains two {chalazae} of twisted protein.
e.zh: 每个蛋含有两条由蛋白质扭绞而成的卵带。

e.en: The {chalazae} were clearly visible in the cracked egg.
e.zh: 打开的鸡蛋里能清楚看见卵带。

e.en: The {chalazal} end of the seed faces inward.
e.zh: 种子的珠柄端朝向内侧。

e.en: He studied the {chalazal} structure of the ovule.
e.zh: 他研究胚珠的珠柄结构。

chalazas.t: 卵带（chalaza 的另一复数形式）

e.en: The {chalazas} anchor the yolk inside the shell.
e.zh: 卵带把蛋黄固定在蛋壳内。

e.en: You can see the {chalazas} when you crack the egg.
e.zh: 打开鸡蛋时能看到卵带。

chalcanthite.t: 胆矾；蓝矾（含水硫酸铜矿物）

e.en: They found bright blue {chalcanthite} in the mine.
e.zh: 他们在矿井中发现了鲜蓝色的胆矾。

e.en: The collector prized his {chalcanthite} crystals.
e.zh: 收藏家很珍视他的胆矾晶体。

e.en: The vase showed a fine {chalcedonic} luster.
e.zh: 花瓶呈现出精美的玉髓光泽。

e.en: They identified the rock's {chalcedonic} bands.
e.zh: 他们识别出岩石上的玉髓条带。

chalcenteric.t: 铁肠般的；坚韧不倦的（罕见用法）

e.en: His {chalcenteric} appetite for work amazed everyone.
e.zh: 他对工作那种坚韧不倦的劲头令所有人惊叹。

e.en: She tackled the project with {chalcenteric} resolve.
e.zh: 她以铁肠般的决心投入这个项目。

e.en: The artifact had a dull {chalceous} sheen.
e.zh: 这件文物泛着暗淡的铜质光泽。

e.en: He admired the {chalceous} ornament's craftsmanship.
e.zh: 他赞赏这件铜饰品的工艺。

e.en: The {chalcid} parasitizes other insects' larvae.
e.zh: 小蜂寄生在其他昆虫的幼虫体内。

e.en: Farmers release {chalcid} wasps to control pests.
e.zh: 农民释放小蜂来防治害虫。

chalcidfly.t: 小蜂；小茧蜂（一种寄生蜂）

e.en: The {chalcidfly} lays eggs inside other insects.
e.zh: 小蜂把卵产在其他昆虫体内。

e.en: Researchers studied the {chalcidfly} as a pest control agent.
e.zh: 研究者将小蜂作为害虫防治媒介进行研究。

chalcocite.t: 辉铜矿（一种重要的铜矿石）

e.en: The mine yielded large amounts of {chalcocite}.
e.zh: 该矿出产大量辉铜矿。

e.en: {Chalcocite} is one of the richest copper ores.
e.zh: 辉铜矿是含铜量最高的矿石之一。

chalcogen.t: 氧族元素（化学元素第16族）

e.en: Sulfur is a common {chalcogen} in chemistry.
e.zh: 硫是化学中常见的氧族元素。

e.en: Each {chalcogen} has six valence electrons.
e.zh: 每种氧族元素都有六个价电子。

chalcogenide.t: 硫族化合物；氧族化合物

e.en: The lab synthesized a new {chalcogenide} semiconductor.
e.zh: 该实验室合成了一种新型硫族化合物半导体。

e.en: {Chalcogenide} glasses are used in infrared optics.
e.zh: 硫族化合物玻璃应用于红外光学。

e.en: The {chalcographer} engraved a delicate portrait.
e.zh: 铜版雕刻师刻出了一幅精致的肖像。

e.en: She trained as a {chalcographer} in Florence.
e.zh: 她在佛罗伦萨学习铜版雕刻。

e.en: The museum has a fine collection of {chalcography}.
e.zh: 博物馆收藏有精美的铜版雕刻作品。

e.en: He studied {chalcography} at the art academy.
e.zh: 他在艺术学院学习铜版雕刻术。

e.en: The miners extracted {chalcopyrite} from the deep shaft.
e.zh: 矿工们从深井中开采黄铜矿。

e.en: {Chalcopyrite} is a major source of copper.
e.zh: 黄铜矿是铜的主要来源。

chaldron.t: 查尔特隆（旧时英国煤炭计量单位）

e.en: He ordered a {chaldron} of coal for the winter.
e.zh: 他订购了一查尔特隆煤过冬。

e.en: The merchant measured the load in {chaldrons}.
e.zh: 商人按查尔特隆计量这批货。

e.en: Stonecutters once suffered widely from {chalicosis}.
e.zh: 过去石匠普遍患石末沉着病。

e.en: {Chalicosis} damages the lungs over years.
e.zh: 石末沉着病经年累月损害肺部。

e.en: The tailor left a {chalk-mark} on the seam.
e.zh: 裁缝在缝线处留了一道粉笔印。

e.en: A faint {chalk-mark} showed where to cut.
e.zh: 一道淡淡的粉笔印标出了切割处。

e.en: The coach gave a quick {chalk-talk} before the game.
e.zh: 教练在比赛前做了简短的战术讲解。

e.en: His {chalk-talk} clarified the play perfectly.
e.zh: 他的黑板讲解把战术解释得很清楚。

chalkface.t: 教学一线；课堂教学工作

e.en: After years at the {chalkface}, she finally retired.
e.zh: 在教学一线工作多年后，她终于退休了。

e.en: Policy makers rarely visit the {chalkface}.
e.zh: 决策者很少深入教学一线。

e.en: The old {chalkie} still loved his job.
e.zh: 那位老教师仍然热爱自己的工作。

e.en: Every {chalkie} in town knew her name.
e.zh: 镇上每位老师都知道她的名字。

chalkiest.t: 最像粉笔的；白垩质最重的

e.en: That ridge has the {chalkiest} soil in the region.
e.zh: 那道山脊的土壤是该地区白垩质最重的。

e.en: It's the {chalkiest} cheese I've ever tried.
e.zh: 这是我吃过粉感最强的奶酪。

e.en: The wine had a slight {chalkiness} on the palate.
e.zh: 这款酒在口中带有一丝粉状质感。

e.en: He disliked the {chalkiness} of the medicine.
e.zh: 他不喜欢这种药的粉状口感。

e.en: Children were warned to stay away from the {chalkpit}.
e.zh: 孩子们被告诫远离那个白垩矿坑。

e.en: An old {chalkpit} scarred the hillside.
e.zh: 一处旧白垩坑在山坡上留下了疤痕。

e.en: A {chalkstone} had formed near his knuckle.
e.zh: 他指关节附近形成了一颗痛风石。

e.en: The wall was built with rough {chalkstone}.
e.zh: 这堵墙是用粗糙的白垩石砌成的。

e.en: The traffic officer issued him a {challan}.
e.zh: 交警给他开了一张罚单。

e.en: She paid the {challan} at the bank.
e.zh: 她在银行缴了那张交款单。

chalone.t: 抑素（抑制细胞分裂的激素）

e.en: Researchers studied how a {chalone} slows cell growth.
e.zh: 研究人员研究抑素如何减缓细胞生长。

e.en: This {chalone} regulates tissue repair.
e.zh: 这种抑素调节组织修复。

chalutz.t: 先驱者（早期犹太复国主义移民）

e.en: Her grandfather arrived as a {chalutz} in 1925.
e.zh: 她的祖父1925年作为先驱移民来到此地。

e.en: The {chalutz} drained swamps to build farms.
e.zh: 那些先驱者排干沼泽以开辟农场。

e.en: The town was famous for its {chalybeate} springs.
e.zh: 该镇因含铁泉水而闻名。

e.en: Doctors once prescribed {chalybeate} tonics.
e.zh: 医生过去常开含铁补剂。

e.en: The besieged garrison finally beat the {chamade}.
e.zh: 被围困的守军终于擂响了投降鼓号。

e.en: A {chamade} signalled their wish to parley.
e.zh: 一阵议降鼓号示意他们想要谈判。

e.en: Heather is a typical {chamaephyte} of moorlands.
e.zh: 石南是荒原典型的地上芽植物。

e.en: A {chamaephyte} keeps its buds near the ground.
e.zh: 地上芽植物的芽贴近地面。

e.en: {Chamazulene} gives chamomile oil its blue color.
e.zh: 母菊薁让洋甘菊油呈现蓝色。

e.en: Researchers tested {chamazulene} for anti-inflammatory effects.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了母菊薁的抗炎作用。

e.en: A porcelain {chamber-pot} sat under the bed.
e.zh: 床下放着一个瓷夜壶。

e.en: Servants emptied the {chamber-pot} each morning.
e.zh: 仆人每天早上倒夜壶。

chamberlainship.t: 宫廷大臣职位；司库职位

e.en: He was awarded a {chamberlainship} at court.
e.zh: 他在宫廷被授予了大臣职位。

e.en: Her {chamberlainship} brought great influence.
e.zh: 她的司库职位带来了巨大影响力。

e.en: An old {chamberpot} stood in the corner.
e.zh: 角落里放着一个旧夜壶。

e.en: She kept a {chamberpot} for cold nights.
e.zh: 她备着一个夜壶以应付寒夜。

e.en: Her {chameleonic} style suited every role.
e.zh: 她变色龙般的风格适合每个角色。

e.en: Politicians often display {chameleonic} loyalties.
e.zh: 政客往往表现出变色龙式的忠诚。

e.en: He had a {chameleonlike} ability to fit in anywhere.
e.zh: 他有变色龙似的融入各种环境的能力。

e.en: Her moods were {chameleonlike} and unpredictable.
e.zh: 她的情绪如变色龙般难以捉摸。

e.en: The knight's horse wore a polished {chamfron}.
e.zh: 骑士的战马戴着一副擦亮的马面甲。

e.en: A bronze {chamfron} hung in the museum.
e.zh: 博物馆里挂着一副青铜马面甲。

e.en: Sheep grazed among the dry {chamiso} bushes.
e.zh: 羊群在干枯的灌木藜丛中吃草。

e.en: {Chamiso} dotted the desert hillsides.
e.zh: 灌木藜星星点点散布在沙漠山坡上。

e.en: He kept several {chammies} for polishing the car.
e.zh: 他备了几块麂皮布来擦车。

e.en: The {chammies} were soft and absorbent.
e.zh: 那些麂皮布柔软又吸水。

e.en: He wiped the windshield with a {chammy}.
e.zh: 他用一块麂皮擦了挡风玻璃。

e.en: A clean {chammy} works wonders on chrome.
e.zh: 一块干净的麂皮擦镀铬件效果极佳。

e.en: She wore gloves of soft {chamoisette}.
e.zh: 她戴着柔软的仿麂皮手套。

e.en: The lining was made of fine {chamoisette}.
e.zh: 衬里由优质仿麂皮织物制成。

e.en: The kiln was lined with {chamotte} bricks.
e.zh: 窑炉内衬使用了耐火黏土砖。

e.en: Potters mix {chamotte} into clay for strength.
e.zh: 陶工把熟料掺入黏土以增加强度。

champertous.t: 包揽诉讼的；助讼分利的

e.en: The lawyer's {champertous} agreement was deemed unethical.
e.zh: 那位律师的助讼分利协议被认为违反职业道德。

e.en: Courts long refused to enforce {champertous} contracts.
e.zh: 法院长期拒绝执行包揽诉讼的合同。

champerty.t: 包揽诉讼；助讼分利行为

e.en: Old common law treated {champerty} as a serious offense.
e.zh: 旧时普通法将包揽诉讼视为严重罪行。

e.en: Litigation funding revived debates about {champerty}.
e.zh: 诉讼融资重新引发了关于助讼分利的争论。

e.en: She sautéed the {champignons} in butter.
e.zh: 她用黄油煎炒蘑菇。

e.en: Wild {champignons} grew along the forest path.
e.zh: 林间小径旁长着野生蘑菇。

championless.t: 无人捍卫的；没有支持者的

e.en: The unpopular policy was left {championless} in parliament.
e.zh: 这项不受欢迎的政策在议会中无人为其辩护。

e.en: She felt {championless} after her mentor retired.
e.zh: 导师退休后，她感到无人撑腰。

champleve.t: 内填珐琅；雕刻填珐琅工艺

e.en: The medieval reliquary featured exquisite {champleve} enamel.
e.zh: 这件中世纪圣物盒采用了精美的内填珐琅工艺。

e.en: He collects antique {champleve} pieces.
e.zh: 他收藏古董内填珐琅作品。

chance-medley.t: 偶发斗殴致死；意外冲突

e.en: The killing was ruled {chance-medley} rather than murder.
e.zh: 该杀人事件被裁定为偶发斗殴致死，而非谋杀。

e.en: Old statutes distinguished {chance-medley} from premeditated homicide.
e.zh: 旧法规将偶发斗殴致死与预谋杀人区别对待。

e.en: Their meeting was a {chanceful} encounter at the station.
e.zh: 他们在车站的相遇纯属偶然。

e.en: Life at sea is a {chanceful} affair.
e.zh: 海上生活充满了偶然与风险。

chanceless.t: 毫无机会的；没有希望的

e.en: The underdog seemed {chanceless} against the champion.
e.zh: 这位弱者面对冠军似乎毫无胜算。

e.en: He felt {chanceless} after the third rejection.
e.zh: 第三次被拒后他感到毫无机会。

e.en: Diplomats gathered at the {chancellory} for the briefing.
e.zh: 外交官们聚集在总理府参加简报会。

e.en: The {chancellory} issued a formal statement.
e.zh: 大臣办公处发表了正式声明。

e.en: The {chanciness} of the plan worried investors.
e.zh: 该计划的不确定性令投资者担忧。

e.en: He enjoyed the {chanciness} of street photography.
e.zh: 他喜欢街头摄影中那种碰运气的成分。

e.en: The doctor identified the lesion as a {chancre}.
e.zh: 医生将该病变诊断为下疳。

e.en: A painless {chancre} is a primary symptom of syphilis.
e.zh: 无痛性下疳是梅毒的初期症状。

e.en: {Chancroid} is a sexually transmitted bacterial infection.
e.zh: 软下疳是一种性传播的细菌感染。

e.en: Antibiotics effectively treat {chancroid}.
e.zh: 抗生素能有效治疗软下疳。

e.en: The pilot executed a perfect {chandelle}.
e.zh: 飞行员完成了一个完美的急上升转弯。

e.en: A {chandelle} combines climb and turn into one maneuver.
e.zh: 急上升转弯将爬升与转弯合为一个动作。

e.en: He {chandelled} sharply to evade the chase plane.
e.zh: 他急速做了上升转弯以躲避追击的飞机。

e.en: She {chandelled} above the airfield to gain altitude.
e.zh: 她在机场上空做急上升转弯以获取高度。

e.en: Trainee pilots practice {chandelles} during advanced lessons.
e.zh: 学员飞行员在高阶课程中练习急上升转弯。

e.en: He performed two {chandelles} in succession.
e.zh: 他连续做了两个急上升转弯。

e.en: {Chandelling} requires precise control of speed and bank.
e.zh: 做急上升转弯需要精准控制速度与坡度。

e.en: He spent the morning {chandelling} over the coast.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在沿海上空做急上升转弯。

e.en: They bought rope and lanterns at the {chandlery}.
e.zh: 他们在船具店买了绳子和灯。

e.en: The harbor's old {chandlery} still serves passing yachts.
e.zh: 港口那家老船具店仍为过往游艇提供补给。

e.en: The knight's horse wore an ornate {chanfron}.
e.zh: 骑士的战马戴着华丽的马面甲。

e.en: The museum displayed a steel {chanfron} from the 15th century.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件十五世纪的钢制马面甲。

e.en: She became a {change-agent} within the organization.
e.zh: 她成为了组织内部的变革推动者。

e.en: True {change-agents} challenge entrenched assumptions.
e.zh: 真正的变革推动者会挑战根深蒂固的假设。

e.en: A weekend hike was a welcome {change-of-pace}.
e.zh: 周末徒步是一种令人愉快的节奏变化。

e.en: The pitcher's {change-of-pace} fooled the batter.
e.zh: 投手的变速球骗过了击球手。

e.en: The {change-over} to the new system took weeks.
e.zh: 切换到新系统花了好几周。

e.en: There was a smooth {change-over} between shifts.
e.zh: 两班之间的交接非常顺利。

e.en: Statisticians look for the {change-point} in the data series.
e.zh: 统计学家寻找数据序列中的变点。

e.en: The graph shows a clear {change-point} in 2019.
e.zh: 图表显示出2019年有一个明显的变点。

e.en: He struck out the batter with a sharp {change-up}.
e.zh: 他用一记犀利的变速球三振了击球手。

e.en: Her best pitch is a deceptive {change-up}.
e.zh: 她最拿手的是一记极具迷惑性的变速球。

e.en: The weather behaved {changeably} all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午天气变化无常。

e.en: He spoke {changeably}, shifting tone every minute.
e.zh: 他说话语气多变，每分钟都在转换。

e.en: His sudden {changeabout} surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他的突然转变让所有人都吃了一惊。

e.en: The party's policy {changeabout} confused voters.
e.zh: 该党政策的反复转变让选民感到困惑。

e.en: The mountain weather is notoriously {changeful}.
e.zh: 山区的天气以变化无常著称。

e.en: She had a {changeful} mood all evening.
e.zh: 她整晚情绪都飘忽不定。

e.en: The light played {changefully} on the water.
e.zh: 光线在水面上变幻闪烁。

e.en: He acted {changefully}, baffling his colleagues.
e.zh: 他的行为变幻无常，让同事困惑不已。

e.en: The award honors young {changemakers} in their communities.
e.zh: 该奖项表彰社区中的年轻变革者。

e.en: She sees herself as a {changemaker}, not a follower.
e.zh: 她视自己为变革者，而非追随者。

e.en: Players gathered in the {changeroom} after the match.
e.zh: 比赛结束后球员们聚集在更衣室里。

e.en: Please leave wet towels in the {changeroom}.
e.zh: 请将湿毛巾留在更衣室。

e.en: She tried the dress on in the {changing-room}.
e.zh: 她在试衣间里试穿了那条裙子。

e.en: The players gathered in the {changing-room} before the match.
e.zh: 球员们在比赛前聚集在更衣室里。

e.en: He likes to {channel-hop} during commercials.
e.zh: 他喜欢在广告时段不停换台。

e.en: They {channel-hop} between Dover and Calais every weekend.
e.zh: 他们每个周末都在多佛和加莱之间往返。

e.en: My dad's constant {channel-hopping} drives me crazy.
e.zh: 我爸不停换台快把我逼疯了。

e.en: Cheap flights have made {channel-hopping} popular among tourists.
e.zh: 廉价航班让跨海峡旅行在游客中流行起来。

e.en: He tends to {channel-surf} when nothing good is on.
e.zh: 没什么好节目时他就不停换台。

e.en: Stop {channel-surfing} and pick something to watch.
e.zh: 别再换台了，挑一个看吧。

e.en: Engineers plan to {channelise} the river to prevent flooding.
e.zh: 工程师计划把河流改造成渠道以防洪水。

e.en: She tried to {channelise} her anger into productive work.
e.zh: 她试图把愤怒引导到有成效的工作上。

e.en: The {channelized} stream flows much faster now.
e.zh: 被渠道化的小溪现在水流快多了。

e.en: He {channelized} his grief into writing poetry.
e.zh: 他把悲伤倾注到诗歌写作中。

channelizes.t: 使形成沟渠；引导（情感、精力）

e.en: The new system {channelizes} water to nearby farms.
e.zh: 新系统把水引向附近的农田。

e.en: She {channelizes} her energy into volunteer work.
e.zh: 她把精力投入到志愿工作中。

e.en: The slogan was short and easily {chantable} by the crowd.
e.zh: 那句口号简短，便于人群齐声呼喊。

e.en: Monks prefer hymns with {chantable} melodies.
e.zh: 僧侣偏爱旋律适合吟唱的圣歌。

e.en: The {chanticleer} crowed at the first light of dawn.
e.zh: 公鸡在黎明初露时高声啼叫。

e.en: In the fable, the proud {chanticleer} is tricked by a fox.
e.zh: 在那则寓言里，骄傲的公鸡被狐狸耍了。

e.en: The temple {chantress} led the morning prayers.
e.zh: 庙里的女吟唱者带领大家做早祷。

e.en: She trained for years to become a renowned {chantress}.
e.zh: 她苦练多年，终于成为一位著名的女歌者。

e.en: The sailors hauled the rope while singing a {chanty}.
e.zh: 水手们一边拉绳一边唱着号子。

e.en: He learned an old sea {chanty} from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他从祖父那里学会了一首古老的水手号子。

e.en: She served curry with a warm {chapatti}.
e.zh: 她端上咖喱，配着一张温热的印度薄饼。

e.en: He learned to roll {chapatti} from his grandmother.
e.zh: 他从祖母那里学会了擀印度薄饼。

e.en: We tore the {chapatty} and scooped up the dal.
e.zh: 我们撕开薄饼，蘸着扁豆糊吃。

e.en: Each {chapatty} was puffed perfectly on the open flame.
e.zh: 每张印度薄饼在明火上烤得鼓胀完美。

e.en: The sword's silver {chape} was finely engraved.
e.zh: 那把剑剑鞘尖端的银质包头雕工精美。

e.en: Archaeologists found a bronze {chape} at the dig site.
e.zh: 考古学家在挖掘现场发现了一枚青铜剑鞘头。

e.en: The old, {chapeless} scabbard was falling apart at the tip.
e.zh: 那只无金属包头的旧剑鞘尖端正在散开。

e.en: He carried a worn, {chapeless} sword on his belt.
e.zh: 他腰间挂着一把磨损的、剑鞘无包头的佩剑。

e.en: Her grandmother was a devoted {chapelgoer} all her life.
e.zh: 她祖母一辈子都是虔诚的小教堂礼拜者。

e.en: The village {chapelgoers} gathered every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 村里去小教堂礼拜的人每周日早上都会聚集。

e.en: Bach served as {chapelmaster} at the prince's court.
e.zh: 巴赫曾在亲王的宫廷担任教堂乐长。

e.en: The new {chapelmaster} rehearsed the choir every evening.
e.zh: 新任教堂乐长每晚都带唱诗班排练。

e.en: The hamlet formed its own {chapelry} in the 1800s.
e.zh: 这个小村落在十九世纪自成一个小教堂辖区。

e.en: Records of the old {chapelry} are kept in the parish archive.
e.zh: 旧教堂辖区的档案保存在堂区档案室里。

e.en: The young couple met under her aunt's strict {chaperonage}.
e.zh: 这对年轻情侣在姑妈的严格监护下见面。

e.en: School trips require parental {chaperonage}.
e.zh: 学校的外出活动需要家长陪同看护。

e.en: He arrived at the pub with a cheerful {chapess}.
e.zh: 他和一位开朗的女士一起到了酒吧。

e.en: She's a sensible {chapess} who knows what she wants.
e.zh: 她是个明白事理、清楚自己要什么的女子。

chapesses.t: 女子们（英国俚语，chapess 复数）

e.en: A group of {chapesses} from work joined us for lunch.
e.zh: 几位同事的女士和我们一起吃了午饭。

e.en: The {chapesses} laughed at his old-fashioned manners.
e.zh: 那些女士们对他老派的举止笑个不停。

e.en: He looked {chapfallen} after losing the match.
e.zh: 输了比赛后他显得垂头丧气。

e.en: She returned home {chapfallen} from the failed interview.
e.zh: 面试失败后她沮丧地回到了家。

e.en: The marble {chapiter} was carved with intricate leaves.
e.zh: 那块大理石柱头上雕着繁复的叶饰。

e.en: Each column ended in a gilded {chapiter}.
e.zh: 每根柱子的顶端都是镀金的柱头。

chaplainship.t: 牧师职位；随军牧师之职

e.en: He accepted a {chaplainship} at the military hospital.
e.zh: 他接受了军医院的随军牧师职位。

e.en: Her {chaplainship} at the university lasted ten years.
e.zh: 她在大学担任牧师一职长达十年。

e.en: She wore a {chaplet} of daisies in her hair.
e.zh: 她头发上戴着一圈雏菊编成的花冠。

e.en: The pilgrim recited prayers using a wooden {chaplet}.
e.zh: 那位朝圣者用木制念珠串念着祷词。

e.en: The {chapleted} bride walked through the rose garden.
e.zh: 戴着花冠的新娘穿过了玫瑰园。

e.en: Statues of {chapleted} nymphs lined the path.
e.zh: 小径两旁立着戴花冠的仙女雕像。

e.en: He slipped on a pair of leather {chappal} before stepping outside.
e.zh: 出门前他穿上了一双皮制印度凉鞋。

e.en: The market sold colorful {chappals} from Rajasthan.
e.zh: 市场上卖着来自拉贾斯坦的彩色印度凉鞋。

e.en: The preacher claimed to possess various {charismata}.
e.zh: 那位传教士声称拥有多种神授恩赐。

e.en: Healing is counted among the spiritual {charismata}.
e.zh: 治愈被列为属灵恩赐之一。

e.en: Orphans were sent to the local {charity-school}.
e.zh: 孤儿们被送进当地的慈善学校。

e.en: She taught reading at a Victorian {charity-school}.
e.zh: 她在一所维多利亚时代的慈善学校教阅读。

e.en: The wedding ended in a noisy {charivari}.
e.zh: 婚礼最后变成了一场喧闹的庆典。

e.en: Villagers staged a {charivari} outside his house.
e.zh: 村民们在他家门外大肆喧闹。

e.en: Gandhi spun cotton on a simple {charka}.
e.zh: 甘地用简朴的手摇纺车纺棉花。

e.en: She inherited her grandmother's wooden {charka}.
e.zh: 她继承了祖母的木制纺车。

e.en: Several {charkas} sat idle in the corner.
e.zh: 几台手摇纺车闲置在角落里。

e.en: The museum displays antique Indian {charkas}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出古老的印度纺车。

e.en: The {charladies} arrive before dawn each morning.
e.zh: 清洁女工们每天天亮前就到了。

e.en: Two {charladies} were polishing the brass.
e.zh: 两位清洁女工在擦拭铜器。

e.en: The {charlady} dusted the old library shelves.
e.zh: 清洁女工掸去旧书架上的灰尘。

e.en: Her mother worked as a {charlady}.
e.zh: 她母亲是个打杂女佣。

charlatanic.t: 江湖骗子的；招摇撞骗的

e.en: His {charlatanic} cures fooled many patients.
e.zh: 他那些江湖郎中式的疗法骗了许多病人。

e.en: The salesman had a {charlatanic} manner.
e.zh: 那个推销员一副招摇撞骗的样子。

e.en: He spoke {charlatanically} about ancient remedies.
e.zh: 他冒充内行地谈论古代疗方。

e.en: She {charlatanically} promised miraculous results.
e.zh: 她像骗子一样许诺奇迹般的效果。

charlatanistic.t: 江湖骗术的；招摇撞骗式的

e.en: Critics dismissed his theory as {charlatanistic}.
e.zh: 评论家斥其理论为江湖骗术。

e.en: The clinic had a {charlatanistic} reputation.
e.zh: 那家诊所有招摇撞骗的名声。

e.en: He limped off with a nasty {charley-horse}.
e.zh: 他因严重抽筋一瘸一拐地下了场。

e.en: A sudden {charley-horse} woke her up.
e.zh: 突如其来的腿抽筋把她痛醒了。

e.en: Yellow {charlock} covered the abandoned field.
e.zh: 黄色的野芥菜覆盖了荒废的田野。

e.en: Farmers struggle to control invasive {charlock}.
e.zh: 农民们费力地控制入侵的野芥菜。

e.en: The gown was cut from ivory {charmeuse}.
e.zh: 那件礼服由象牙白绉缎裁制而成。

e.en: She loved the drape of {charmeuse}.
e.zh: 她喜爱绉缎垂坠的效果。

e.en: Physicists studied the decay of {charmonium}.
e.zh: 物理学家研究了粲偶素的衰变。

e.en: {Charmonium} states reveal quark interactions.
e.zh: 粲偶素态揭示了夸克的相互作用。

e.en: The battlefield became a grim {charnel-house}.
e.zh: 那战场变成了一座阴森的藏骨堂。

e.en: Beneath the chapel lay an old {charnel-house}.
e.zh: 礼拜堂下方有一座古老的藏骨堂。

e.en: He slept on a creaky {charpoy}.
e.zh: 他睡在一张吱呀作响的绳床上。

e.en: The traveler rested on a wooden {charpoy}.
e.zh: 旅人在一张木绳床上歇息。

e.en: They packed strips of {charqui} for the trail.
e.zh: 他们带上风干牛肉条上路。

e.en: Andean herders still prepare {charqui} traditionally.
e.zh: 安第斯牧民仍按传统方式制作肉干。

e.en: They caught Arctic {charr} in the cold lake.
e.zh: 他们在冷湖中钓到了北极红点鲑。

e.en: Smoked {charr} is a regional delicacy.
e.zh: 烟熏红点鲑是当地的美味。

charrette.t: 集思会；密集设计研讨会

e.en: Architects gathered for a weekend {charrette}.
e.zh: 建筑师们聚在一起进行周末设计研讨会。

e.en: The community {charrette} produced fresh ideas.
e.zh: 社区集思会催生了新点子。

chart-topping.t: 高居榜首的；登顶排行榜的

e.en: Their {chart-topping} single sold millions.
e.zh: 他们那首登顶榜单的单曲销量数百万。

e.en: She delivered another {chart-topping} album.
e.zh: 她又推出了一张登顶榜首的专辑。

e.en: The leaves had a thin {chartaceous} texture.
e.zh: 那些叶子质地薄如纸。

e.en: Botanists describe the bark as {chartaceous}.
e.zh: 植物学家形容那种树皮为纸质的。

chartbuster.t: 超级流行歌曲；畅销作品

e.en: That summer {chartbuster} played everywhere.
e.zh: 那首夏日热曲到处都在播。

e.en: The band wrote yet another {chartbuster}.
e.zh: 乐队又写出了一首大热单曲。

e.en: The {charterage} was paid in advance.
e.zh: 租船费已提前支付。

e.en: Rising {charterage} hurt the shipping company.
e.zh: 租船费上涨打击了航运公司。

e.en: Both sides signed the {charterparty} yesterday.
e.zh: 双方昨日签署了租船合同。

e.en: Disputes over the {charterparty} went to arbitration.
e.zh: 租船合同的争议提交了仲裁。

chartless.t: 无图可循的；未经测绘的

e.en: They sailed across {chartless} waters bravely.
e.zh: 他们勇敢地驶过未经测绘的水域。

e.en: The explorers entered a {chartless} jungle.
e.zh: 探险者进入了一片无图可循的丛林。

e.en: The {chartographer} drew detailed coastal maps.
e.zh: 那位制图师绘制了详细的海岸地图。

e.en: She trained as a marine {chartographer}.
e.zh: 她受训成为一名海图绘制师。

e.en: They used modern {chartographic} techniques.
e.zh: 他们采用现代制图技术。

e.en: The atlas reflects {chartographic} advances.
e.zh: 这本地图集体现了制图技术的进步。

e.en: He studied {chartography} at university.
e.zh: 他在大学攻读制图学。

e.en: Digital tools have transformed {chartography}.
e.zh: 数字工具已彻底改变了制图学。

e.en: Surveyors measured distance with a {chartometer}.
e.zh: 测量员用地图测距仪量取距离。

e.en: The old {chartometer} still worked perfectly.
e.zh: 那台旧式地图测距仪仍运转良好。

e.en: Her plush {chartreux} purred contentedly.
e.zh: 她那只毛绒绒的卡尔特猫满足地咕噜着。

e.en: The {chartreux} is known for blue-grey fur.
e.zh: 卡尔特猫以蓝灰色毛皮闻名。

e.en: The monastery preserved a medieval {chartulary}.
e.zh: 修道院保存着一部中世纪的地契簿。

e.en: Historians consulted the abbey's {chartulary}.
e.zh: 史学家查阅了修道院的特许状汇编。

e.en: Several {charwomen} cleaned the office overnight.
e.zh: 几位清洁女工连夜打扫办公室。

e.en: The {charwomen} chatted while mopping floors.
e.zh: 清洁女工们一边拖地一边闲聊。

chaptalize.t: 在葡萄汁中加糖以提高酒精度

e.en: Winemakers sometimes {chaptalize} the must in cool years.
e.zh: 在凉爽年份，酿酒师有时会给葡萄汁加糖。

e.en: It is illegal to {chaptalize} wines in some regions.
e.zh: 在某些地区，给葡萄酒加糖是违法的。

chapterhouse.t: 教士会堂；修道院议事厅

e.en: The monks gathered in the {chapterhouse} each morning.
e.zh: 修士们每天早晨聚集在教士会堂里。

e.en: We toured the medieval {chapterhouse} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后我们参观了中世纪的修道院议事厅。

char-a-banc.t: 旧式长条座位的旅游大客车

e.en: They took a {char-a-banc} to the seaside.
e.zh: 他们乘坐长条座位的旅游车去海边。

e.en: Old photos show families piling into a {char-a-banc}.
e.zh: 老照片里一家人挤上一辆旧式旅游大客车。

e.en: I ordered a {char-grilled} steak with vegetables.
e.zh: 我点了一份配蔬菜的炭烤牛排。

e.en: The {char-grilled} chicken had a smoky flavor.
e.zh: 炭烤鸡肉带着烟熏味。

e.en: The aquarium featured several colorful {characin} species.
e.zh: 水族馆展示了好几种色彩鲜艳的脂鲤鱼。

e.en: Neon tetras are a popular kind of {characin}.
e.zh: 霓虹灯鱼是一种很受欢迎的脂鲤鱼。

e.en: The school emphasizes {character-training} alongside academics.
e.zh: 这所学校在学业之外也重视品格培养。

e.en: Sports can be valuable {character-training} for young people.
e.zh: 运动对年轻人来说是宝贵的品格训练。

e.en: His old teacher appeared as a {character-witness} at trial.
e.zh: 他的老老师在庭审中作为品格证人出庭。

e.en: The defense called several {character-witness} to testify.
e.zh: 辩方传唤了好几位品格证人作证。

e.en: Several {character-witnesses} spoke on her behalf.
e.zh: 好几位品格证人替她说话。

e.en: The lawyer lined up three {character-witnesses}.
e.zh: 律师安排了三位品格证人。

characteristical.t: 特有的；典型的（古旧用法）

e.en: The author noted a {characteristical} gesture of his.
e.zh: 作者提到了他特有的一个手势。

e.en: She wrote with a {characteristical} dry wit.
e.zh: 她写作带着她特有的冷面幽默。

e.en: He studied {characterology} in early psychology classes.
e.zh: 他在早期心理学课上学习性格学。

e.en: The book draws on outdated {characterology} theories.
e.zh: 这本书借鉴了过时的性格学理论。

e.en: He admired the strange {charactery} of the manuscript.
e.zh: 他欣赏手稿上奇特的文字符号。

e.en: Shakespeare uses {charactery} to mean written symbols.
e.zh: 莎士比亚用 charactery 一词指书写符号。

charactonym.t: 性格名（暗示人物特点的名字）

e.en: "Mr. Gradgrind" is a classic {charactonym} from Dickens.
e.zh: "葛擂硬先生"是狄更斯作品中典型的性格名。

e.en: Authors often invent a {charactonym} for comic effect.
e.zh: 作家常发明性格名来制造喜剧效果。

charango.t: 恰朗戈（南美安第斯小型弦乐器）

e.en: He played a lively tune on the {charango}.
e.zh: 他用恰朗戈弹奏了一支欢快的曲子。

e.en: The {charango} is traditionally made from an armadillo shell.
e.zh: 恰朗戈传统上用犰狳壳制作。

charas.t: 恰拉斯（一种手工大麻树脂）

e.en: Travelers wrote about smoking {charas} in the mountains.
e.zh: 旅行者写到在山区抽恰拉斯。

e.en: {Charas} is produced by hand-rubbing cannabis plants.
e.zh: 恰拉斯是用手搓大麻植株制成的。

e.en: We like to {charbroil} burgers in the backyard.
e.zh: 我们喜欢在后院用炭火烤汉堡。

e.en: You can {charbroil} the fish for extra flavor.
e.zh: 你可以炭火烤这条鱼，让味道更香。

e.en: The restaurant installed a new {charbroiler} in the kitchen.
e.zh: 餐厅在厨房里装了一台新的炭火烤炉。

e.en: Steaks come straight off the {charbroiler}.
e.zh: 牛排直接从炭烤架上端来。

e.en: The old {charcoal-burner} lived deep in the woods.
e.zh: 那位老烧炭工住在森林深处。

e.en: They used a small {charcoal-burner} to heat the room.
e.zh: 他们用一个小炭炉给房间取暖。

e.en: Medieval {charcoal-burners} worked in remote forests.
e.zh: 中世纪的烧炭工在偏远的森林里劳作。

e.en: Several {charcoal-burners} glowed at the campsite.
e.zh: 营地里有好几个炭炉烧得通红。

e.en: He wore a {charcoal-grey} suit to the interview.
e.zh: 他穿着一套炭灰色西装去面试。

e.en: The walls were painted a soft {charcoal-grey}.
e.zh: 墙面被刷成柔和的深灰色。

e.en: The local {charcutier} makes excellent pâté.
e.zh: 当地的熟食师傅做的肉酱非常好吃。

e.en: She trained as a {charcutier} in Lyon.
e.zh: 她在里昂接受了熟食师傅的培训。

e.en: She did a daily {chare} at the manor house.
e.zh: 她每天在庄园里做杂活。

e.en: He took on any {chare} to earn a few coins.
e.zh: 他什么零工都接，只为挣几个钱。

charge-coupled.t: 电荷耦合的（如 CCD 传感器）

e.en: The camera uses a {charge-coupled} device for imaging.
e.zh: 这款相机使用电荷耦合器件成像。

e.en: Astronomers rely on {charge-coupled} sensors for faint light.
e.zh: 天文学家依靠电荷耦合传感器捕捉微弱的光。

e.en: The police filed a {charge-sheet} against the suspect.
e.zh: 警方对嫌疑人提交了起诉书。

e.en: The {charge-sheet} listed five separate offenses.
e.zh: 起诉书上列出了五项独立的罪名。

e.en: The reaction involves rapid {charge-transfer} between molecules.
e.zh: 该反应涉及分子之间快速的电荷转移。

e.en: Scientists measured the {charge-transfer} rate in the complex.
e.zh: 科学家测量了该配合物的电荷转移速率。

e.en: The hours were billed {chargeably} to the client.
e.zh: 这些工时已可计费地记到客户账上。

e.en: All travel must be recorded {chargeably} in the system.
e.zh: 所有出差行程都须以可记账方式录入系统。

e.en: She admitted she had become a real {chargeaholic}.
e.zh: 她承认自己已经成了一个不折不扣的刷卡狂。

e.en: The book offers advice for the recovering {chargeaholic}.
e.zh: 这本书为戒掉刷卡瘾的人提供建议。

chargecap.t: 对地方收费设上限（英式用法）

e.en: Ministers threatened to {chargecap} the council again.
e.zh: 大臣们威胁要再次对该地方议会的收费设上限。

e.en: The government may {chargecap} councils that overspend.
e.zh: 政府可能对超支的地方议会的收费设上限。

chargecaps.t: 对地方收费设上限（第三人称单数）

e.en: Whitehall {chargecaps} councils that exceed the limit.
e.zh: 中央政府会对超出限额的地方议会的收费设上限。

e.en: The minister regularly {chargecaps} high-spending boroughs.
e.zh: 该大臣经常对高支出的市镇收费设上限。

e.en: Entry to the museum is {chargeless} on Sundays.
e.zh: 博物馆每周日免费入场。

e.en: A neutron is essentially a {chargeless} particle.
e.zh: 中子本质上是一种不带电荷的粒子。

e.en: We {chargrill} vegetables for a smoky flavor.
e.zh: 我们用炭火烤蔬菜以增添烟熏味。

e.en: The chef likes to {chargrill} the lamb chops.
e.zh: 主厨喜欢把羊排放在炭火上烤。

e.en: I ordered a {chargrilled} chicken sandwich.
e.zh: 我点了一份炭烤鸡肉三明治。

e.en: The menu features {chargrilled} vegetables and steak.
e.zh: 菜单上有炭烤蔬菜和炭烤牛排。

e.en: After the scandal he grew {charier} of journalists.
e.zh: 那次丑闻后他对记者更加小心了。

e.en: She became {charier} with her money as bills mounted.
e.zh: 账单越来越多，她花钱也越发谨慎。

e.en: He was the {chariest} of the group with secrets.
e.zh: 在这群人中，他是对秘密最谨慎的一个。

e.en: Even the {chariest} investors took the deal.
e.zh: 连最谨慎的投资者也接受了这笔交易。

e.en: She {charily} stepped onto the icy bridge.
e.zh: 她小心翼翼地踏上结冰的桥面。

e.en: He spoke {charily}, weighing every word.
e.zh: 他说话很谨慎，字斟句酌。

e.en: Her {chariness} with strangers came from experience.
e.zh: 她对陌生人的谨慎源自经验。

e.en: Investors showed {chariness} after the market crash.
e.zh: 市场崩盘后投资者表现得很谨慎。

e.en: Many grasses are {cespitose}, forming dense tufts.
e.zh: 许多禾草是丛生的，形成密集的草丛。

e.en: The botanist noted the {cespitose} growth pattern.
e.zh: 植物学家记录了这种丛生的生长形态。

cespitosely.t: 丛生地；以簇状方式生长

e.en: The sedges grew {cespitosely} along the bank.
e.zh: 莎草沿河岸丛生生长。

e.en: Some ferns develop {cespitosely} in shaded soil.
e.zh: 有些蕨类在阴湿土壤中以簇状方式生长。

e.en: Some languages mark {cessative} aspect explicitly.
e.zh: 有些语言会明确标记终止体。

e.en: The verb takes a {cessative} suffix here.
e.zh: 这里动词带有表示终止的后缀。

e.en: The {cessionary} acquired all contractual rights.
e.zh: 受让人取得了全部合同权利。

e.en: Notice was given to the {cessionary} promptly.
e.zh: 通知已及时送达受让人。

e.en: The old {cesspipe} had finally cracked.
e.zh: 老旧的污水管终于裂开了。

e.en: Workers replaced the rusted {cesspipe} yesterday.
e.zh: 工人昨天更换了那段生锈的污水管。

e.en: The player hurled the ball using a {cesta}.
e.zh: 球员用回力球筐把球掷出。

e.en: Each {cesta} is woven from reed strips.
e.zh: 每个回力球筐都用藤条编成。

e.en: The fighters wore heavy {cesti} during the match.
e.zh: 斗士们在比赛中戴着沉重的拳套。

e.en: Ancient {cesti} were sometimes weighted with metal.
e.zh: 古代的拳套有时镶嵌着金属配重。

e.en: The dog had a {cestode} infection.
e.zh: 那只狗感染了绦虫。

e.en: Scientists study {cestode} life cycles closely.
e.zh: 科学家细致研究绦虫的生活史。

e.en: The parasite has a {cestoid} body shape.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫呈绦虫状的体形。

e.en: Researchers examined several {cestoid} specimens.
e.zh: 研究人员检查了几个绦虫类标本。

e.en: The gladiator strapped on his {cestus}.
e.zh: 角斗士绑紧了他的拳套。

e.en: Venus was said to wear a magic {cestus}.
e.zh: 据说维纳斯佩戴一条神奇的腰带。

e.en: The poet placed a {cesura} mid-line.
e.zh: 诗人在诗行中部安置了一个停顿。

e.en: Each {cesura} gives the verse breathing space.
e.zh: 每一个中顿都为诗句留出气息。

e.en: Latin verse follows strict {cesural} rules.
e.zh: 拉丁诗歌遵循严格的中顿规则。

e.en: The reader respected each {cesural} pause.
e.zh: 朗读者尊重每个中顿停顿。

e.en: Dolphins exhibit clearly {cetaceous} traits.
e.zh: 海豚表现出明显的鲸类特征。

e.en: The museum hosted a {cetaceous} skeleton display.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一具鲸类骨骼。

cetane.t: 十六烷；柴油评级用化合物

e.en: Diesel quality is rated by {cetane} number.
e.zh: 柴油的品质以十六烷值来评定。

e.en: Higher {cetane} fuel ignites more readily.
e.zh: 十六烷值越高的燃料越容易点燃。

cetanol.t: 鲸蜡醇；十六烷醇；化妆品原料

e.en: Cosmetics often contain {cetanol} as an emollient.
e.zh: 化妆品常以鲸蜡醇作为润肤成分。

e.en: Chemists synthesized pure {cetanol} in the lab.
e.zh: 化学家在实验室合成了纯鲸蜡醇。

cete.t: 獾群；一群獾的集合名词

e.en: A {cete} of badgers crossed the road.
e.zh: 一群獾横穿了道路。

e.en: We spotted a small {cete} at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时我们发现了一小群獾。

cetene.t: 鲸蜡烯；十六碳烯类化合物

e.en: Researchers analyzed the {cetene} fraction carefully.
e.zh: 研究人员仔细分析了鲸蜡烯组分。

e.en: Pure {cetene} appears as a colorless liquid.
e.zh: 纯鲸蜡烯呈无色液体。

e.en: Old apothecaries prescribed {cetin} for skin care.
e.zh: 旧时药剂师常用鲸蜡素调护肤膏。

e.en: Whale fat yielded the substance called {cetin}.
e.zh: 鲸脂中可提取出名为鲸蜡素的物质。

cetological.t: 鲸类学的；与鲸研究有关的

e.en: She published several {cetological} papers.
e.zh: 她发表了多篇鲸类学论文。

e.en: The journal focuses on {cetological} research.
e.zh: 该期刊专注于鲸类学研究。

cetologist.t: 鲸类学家；研究鲸类的科学家

e.en: The {cetologist} tracked the migrating whales.
e.zh: 鲸类学家追踪了迁徙的鲸群。

e.en: A young {cetologist} joined the expedition.
e.zh: 一位年轻的鲸类学家加入了考察队。

cetology.t: 鲸类学；研究鲸目的学科

e.en: Melville devoted whole chapters to {cetology}.
e.zh: 梅尔维尔用整章篇幅讲述鲸类学。

e.en: Modern {cetology} relies on satellite tagging.
e.zh: 现代鲸类学依赖卫星标记技术。

cetrimide.t: 西曲铵；阳离子表面活性剂消毒剂

e.en: Hospitals stock {cetrimide} for skin disinfection.
e.zh: 医院备有西曲铵用于皮肤消毒。

e.en: Nurses cleaned the wound with {cetrimide} solution.
e.zh: 护士用西曲铵溶液清洗了伤口。

cetyl.t: 鲸蜡基；十六烷基；化学基团

e.en: The compound contains a long {cetyl} chain.
e.zh: 该化合物含有较长的鲸蜡基链。

e.en: Lotion formulators rely on {cetyl} alcohol.
e.zh: 护肤液配方师常用十六烷醇。

cetylate.t: 鲸蜡酸盐；与鲸蜡基化合

e.en: Industrial chemists synthesize various {cetylate} salts.
e.zh: 工业化学家合成了多种鲸蜡酸盐。

e.en: The reaction produces a stable {cetylate} ester.
e.zh: 反应生成了稳定的鲸蜡酸酯。

cevitamic.t: 抗坏血酸的；与维生素相关的

e.en: Older texts called vitamin C {cevitamic} acid.
e.zh: 旧文献称维生素C为抗坏血酸。

e.en: The compound was originally named {cevitamic} acid.
e.zh: 该化合物最初被命名为抗坏血酸。

cfc-free.t: 不含氯氟烃的；无氟利昂的

e.en: The spray is labeled {cfc-free} and ozone-safe.
e.zh: 这种喷雾标注无氟利昂，对臭氧层无害。

e.en: Manufacturers switched to {cfc-free} refrigerants.
e.zh: 厂商改用了不含氯氟烃的制冷剂。

e.en: They danced the {cha-cha} all evening.
e.zh: 他们整晚都跳着恰恰舞。

e.en: She taught me a basic {cha-cha} step.
e.zh: 她教了我一个基本的恰恰舞步。

cha-cha-cha.t: 恰恰恰；古巴风格恰恰舞

e.en: The band started playing a lively {cha-cha-cha}.
e.zh: 乐队开始演奏欢快的恰恰恰。

e.en: Couples crowded the floor for the {cha-cha-cha}.
e.zh: 成双成对的舞者涌上舞池跳恰恰恰。

cha-chas.t: 跳恰恰舞；恰恰舞复数形式

e.en: Several {cha-chas} were on the playlist.
e.zh: 播放列表里有好几首恰恰舞曲。

e.en: He {cha-chas} every Saturday with his wife.
e.zh: 他每周六都和妻子一起跳恰恰。

chaat.t: 印度风味小吃；街头零食

e.en: We ordered spicy {chaat} from a street vendor.
e.zh: 我们从街头小贩那里点了辛辣的印度小吃。

e.en: Mumbai is famous for delicious {chaat}.
e.zh: 孟买以美味的印度恰特小吃闻名。

e.en: The fox proved barely {chasable} through the dense underbrush.
e.zh: 那只狐狸在茂密的灌木丛中几乎无法追捕。

e.en: Some dreams are barely {chasable} without proper resources.
e.zh: 没有足够的资源，有些梦想根本无法追求。

chasidic.t: 哈西迪派的（犹太教正统派分支）

e.en: He grew up in a {chasidic} community in Brooklyn.
e.zh: 他在布鲁克林的一个哈西迪派社区长大。

e.en: The {chasidic} tradition emphasizes joyful prayer.
e.zh: 哈西迪派传统强调以喜悦之心祈祷。

e.en: They peered into the {chasmal} darkness below.
e.zh: 他们凝视着下方深渊般的黑暗。

e.en: A {chasmal} silence fell over the room.
e.zh: 屋内陷入深渊般的寂静。

e.en: The cliffs opened into a {chasmic} void.
e.zh: 悬崖间裂开一道深渊般的虚空。

e.en: There was a {chasmic} gap between their views.
e.zh: 他们的观点之间存在巨大的鸿沟。

e.en: They hiked along the {chasmy} ridgeline.
e.zh: 他们沿着裂口纵横的山脊徒步。

e.en: The {chasmy} terrain made progress slow.
e.zh: 沟壑遍布的地形让前进十分缓慢。

e.en: The {chasseur} regiment was famed for its speed.
e.zh: 那支轻装猎兵团以行动迅速闻名。

e.en: A {chasseur} carried our bags up to the suite.
e.zh: 一名旅馆侍者把我们的行李送上套房。

chassidic.t: 哈西迪派的（犹太教正统派分支）

e.en: They studied {chassidic} teachings every Sabbath.
e.zh: 他们每个安息日都研读哈西迪派的教义。

e.en: The {chassidic} rabbi was deeply respected.
e.zh: 那位哈西迪派的拉比深受敬重。

e.en: She was considered the {chastest} of the sisters.
e.zh: 她被视为姐妹中最贞洁的一个。

e.en: The poem celebrates the {chastest} of loves.
e.zh: 这首诗歌颂最纯洁的爱情。

e.en: His behavior was clearly {chastisable}.
e.zh: 他的行为显然该受到责罚。

e.en: Such offenses are {chastisable} under school rules.
e.zh: 这类过错按校规是应当惩戒的。

e.en: He spent hours on a paid {chat-line}.
e.zh: 他花了好几个小时打付费聊天热线。

e.en: Late-night {chat-line} ads filled the channel.
e.zh: 深夜频道里满是聊天热线的广告。

e.en: She appeared on a popular {chat-show} last night.
e.zh: 她昨晚上了一档热门访谈节目。

e.en: The {chat-show} host asked tough questions.
e.zh: 脱口秀主持人提出了犀利的问题。

e.en: He tried to {chat-up} a girl at the bar.
e.zh: 他在酒吧里试图搭讪一个女孩。

e.en: His clumsy {chat-up} line made everyone laugh.
e.zh: 他笨拙的搭讪台词把大家逗乐了。

chateaubriand.t: 夏多布里昂牛排（厚切菲力）

e.en: They ordered {chateaubriand} for two.
e.zh: 他们点了一份双人份的夏多布里昂牛排。

e.en: The chef prepared a perfect {chateaubriand}.
e.zh: 主厨做出了一份完美的夏多布里昂牛排。

e.en: The {chatelain} welcomed guests at the gate.
e.zh: 城堡主在门口迎接客人。

e.en: He acted as {chatelain} of the family estate.
e.zh: 他担任家族庄园的主人。

e.en: The {chatellany} included several villages.
e.zh: 该城主领地包括好几个村庄。

e.en: Records of the medieval {chatellany} survive.
e.zh: 那个中世纪城主辖区的档案得以保存。

e.en: She dialed a {chatline} out of boredom.
e.zh: 她百无聊赖地拨打了聊天热线。

e.en: The {chatline} charges by the minute.
e.zh: 这条聊天热线按分钟收费。

e.en: The gem displayed striking {chatoyancy} under light.
e.zh: 这颗宝石在光下呈现出惊艳的猫眼效应。

e.en: {Chatoyancy} is prized in tiger's eye stones.
e.zh: 虎眼石因猫眼效应而备受珍视。

e.en: She wore a {chatoyant} silk scarf.
e.zh: 她系着一条带变彩光泽的丝巾。

e.en: The polished stone was beautifully {chatoyant}.
e.zh: 那块抛光的石头泛着美丽的猫眼光泽。

e.en: They met in an online {chatroom} years ago.
e.zh: 他们多年前在网络聊天室里相识。

e.en: The {chatroom} was full of fans discussing the show.
e.zh: 聊天室里满是讨论这部剧的粉丝。

e.en: The lathe left a faint {chattermark} on the surface.
e.zh: 车床在表面留下了淡淡的颤痕。

e.en: Geologists studied the {chattermark} patterns on the rock.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了岩石上的颤痕图案。

e.en: My aunt is a {chattery} sort of person.
e.zh: 我姑妈是个特别爱讲话的人。

e.en: The {chattery} students annoyed the teacher.
e.zh: 那群叽叽喳喳的学生把老师惹烦了。

e.en: She is the {chattiest} member of the team.
e.zh: 她是团队中最健谈的成员。

e.en: That cab driver was the {chattiest} I've ever met.
e.zh: 那位出租车司机是我见过最爱聊的。

e.en: His {chattiness} made the long flight bearable.
e.zh: 他的健谈让漫长的飞行不那么难熬。

e.en: Her {chattiness} sometimes irritated her colleagues.
e.zh: 她话多有时会惹同事不快。

e.en: The buffet featured a chicken {chaudfroid}.
e.zh: 自助餐上有一道法式冷酱冻鸡。

e.en: He learned to prepare {chaudfroid} at culinary school.
e.zh: 他在烹饪学校学会了做冷酱冻肉。

e.en: Her {chauffeuse} drove the limousine smoothly.
e.zh: 她的女司机平稳地驾驶着豪华轿车。

e.en: A red {chauffeuse} sat beside the fireplace.
e.zh: 壁炉旁摆着一张红色的矮背扶手椅。

e.en: {Chaulmoogra} oil was once used to treat leprosy.
e.zh: 大风子油曾被用来治疗麻风病。

e.en: The {chaulmoogra} tree grows in tropical Asia.
e.zh: 大风子树生长于热带亚洲。

e.en: The bards would {chaunt} old ballads by the fire.
e.zh: 吟游诗人会在火边咏唱古老的歌谣。

e.en: Pilgrims softly {chaunt} a hymn at dawn.
e.zh: 朝圣者在黎明时轻声吟唱赞美诗。

e.en: The {chaunter} of his bagpipe needed reeding.
e.zh: 他风笛上的旋律管需要换簧片。

e.en: An old {chaunter} led the procession with song.
e.zh: 一位年长的吟唱者领着队伍歌唱前行。

chav.t: 小阿飞；没文化的小混混（英国俚语）

e.en: The tabloid mocked him as a typical {chav}.
e.zh: 那家小报嘲笑他是典型的小混混。

e.en: She hated the lazy {chav} stereotype on TV.
e.zh: 她讨厌电视上那种懒散的小混混刻板印象。

e.en: City folk dismissed him as a {chawbacon}.
e.zh: 城里人把他当成乡巴佬一样不屑。

e.en: Don't act like such a {chawbacon} at the party.
e.zh: 在派对上别表现得那么土气。

cheap-jack.t: 廉价货商贩；劣质廉价的

e.en: He bought it from some {cheap-jack} at the market.
e.zh: 他从市场上一个廉价小贩那里买的。

e.en: The shop sold {cheap-jack} goods of poor quality.
e.zh: 那家店卖的都是劣质廉价货。

cheap-john.t: 卖廉价货的小贩；劣质的

e.en: A {cheap-john} stall stood at the fair's edge.
e.zh: 集市边上摆着一个廉价货摊。

e.en: He peddled {cheap-john} watches to tourists.
e.zh: 他向游客兜售劣质手表。

cheap-shot.t: 卑鄙的攻击；下三滥的话

e.en: That insult was a real {cheap-shot}.
e.zh: 那句侮辱真是下三滥的攻击。

e.en: Critics took a {cheap-shot} at his accent.
e.zh: 批评者拿他的口音说事，太卑鄙了。

e.en: This pen is just a {cheapie} from the corner shop.
e.zh: 这支笔就是街角小店买的便宜货。

e.en: He directed a {cheapie} horror film last summer.
e.zh: 他去年夏天导演了一部低成本恐怖片。

cheapishly.t: 略显廉价地；有点寒酸地

e.en: The room was {cheapishly} furnished with plastic chairs.
e.zh: 房间里摆着塑料椅子，显得有点寒酸。

e.en: She dressed {cheapishly} but tried to seem elegant.
e.zh: 她穿得略显廉价，却努力装出优雅的样子。

cheapjack.t: 卖廉价货的小贩；劣质廉价的

e.en: Tourists avoided the {cheapjack} stalls near the pier.
e.zh: 游客都躲着码头附近卖廉价货的小摊。

e.en: The film had a {cheapjack} production feel.
e.zh: 这部电影制作显得粗制滥造。

e.en: It's just a {cheapy} watch I got online.
e.zh: 这只是我在网上买的便宜手表。

e.en: They went for a {cheapy} dinner near the office.
e.zh: 他们在办公室附近随便吃了顿便宜的晚饭。

e.en: In any scam, the {cheatee} suffers the most.
e.zh: 任何骗局中，受骗方损失最惨重。

e.en: The contract treats the {cheatee} as a victim.
e.zh: 合同将被欺骗的一方视作受害者。

e.en: A swift {chebec} darted past the harbor wall.
e.zh: 一艘灵巧的三桅小帆船迅速掠过港口防波堤。

e.en: Pirates often used a {chebec} to chase merchants.
e.zh: 海盗常用三桅小帆船追击商船。

chechako.t: 新来者；阿拉斯加的新移民

e.en: Old miners teased the {chechako} about the cold.
e.zh: 老矿工拿这位新来者打趣，笑他怕冷。

e.en: Every {chechako} learns to respect the wilderness.
e.zh: 每个新来的人都会学会敬畏这片荒野。

e.en: Our {check-in} at the hotel was quick and easy.
e.zh: 我们在酒店办理入住又快又方便。

e.en: Online {check-in} opens twenty-four hours before takeoff.
e.zh: 网上值机在起飞前二十四小时开放。

e.en: Weekly {check-ins} keep the team aligned on goals.
e.zh: 每周的签到会议让团队目标保持一致。

e.en: The app counts your daily {check-ins} at the gym.
e.zh: 这个应用会记录你每天在健身房的签到次数。

check-off.t: 逐项核对；从工资中代扣

e.en: Please {check-off} each item on the list.
e.zh: 请逐项核对清单上的每一项。

e.en: The union dues come through a {check-off} system.
e.zh: 工会会费通过工资代扣制度收取。

e.en: {Check-out} time is eleven in the morning.
e.zh: 退房时间是上午十一点。

e.en: The {check-out} line at the supermarket was huge.
e.zh: 超市的结账队伍排得很长。

check-string.t: 校验字串；核对用的字符串

e.en: The system rejected the upload due to a bad {check-string}.
e.zh: 系统因为校验字串错误而拒绝了上传。

e.en: Each packet carries a small {check-string} for verification.
e.zh: 每个数据包都带有一个用于验证的小校验字串。

e.en: I went for an annual {check-up} last Friday.
e.zh: 我上周五去做了年度体检。

e.en: The car needs a quick {check-up} before the trip.
e.zh: 出行前这辆车得简单检查一下。

e.en: Regular dental {check-ups} prevent serious problems.
e.zh: 定期口腔检查能预防严重问题。

e.en: Doctors recommend yearly {check-ups} after fifty.
e.zh: 医生建议五十岁后每年体检。

e.en: He handles all the {check-writing} for the office.
e.zh: 办公室所有支票都由他来开。

e.en: Online banking has largely replaced {check-writing}.
e.zh: 网上银行已基本取代了开支票。

e.en: Tick the {checkbox} to accept the terms.
e.zh: 勾选这个复选框以接受条款。

e.en: Each form has a {checkbox} for newsletter signup.
e.zh: 每张表格都有一个订阅简报的勾选框。

e.en: We picked {checkerberries} along the woodland path.
e.zh: 我们沿着林间小路采摘白珠树果。

e.en: Birds feed on {checkerberries} all winter.
e.zh: 鸟儿整个冬天都以白珠树果为食。

e.en: The {checkerberry} grows low under pine trees.
e.zh: 白珠树低矮地生长在松树下。

e.en: She brewed tea from {checkerberry} leaves.
e.zh: 她用白珠树叶泡茶。

e.en: Pink {checkerbloom} dotted the meadow in spring.
e.zh: 春天里粉红的棋盘花点缀着草地。

e.en: Bees love the wild {checkerbloom} along trails.
e.zh: 蜜蜂很喜欢小径旁的野生棋盘花。

e.en: The floor was laid in elegant {checkerwork}.
e.zh: 地板铺成了别致的棋盘格图案。

e.en: She admired the {checkerwork} on the old quilt.
e.zh: 她欣赏着旧被子上的方格图案。

e.en: Hotel {checkin} starts at three in the afternoon.
e.zh: 酒店下午三点开始办理入住。

e.en: The app sends a reminder for daily {checkin}.
e.zh: 这个应用会提醒你每日签到。

e.en: Tighten the {checknut} to prevent loosening.
e.zh: 拧紧防松螺母以防止松动。

e.en: The mechanic added a {checknut} on the bolt.
e.zh: 机修工在螺栓上加了一个锁紧螺母。

e.en: The infant was born with {cheiloschisis} and required surgery.
e.zh: 这名婴儿生来患有唇裂，需要手术治疗。

e.en: Surgeons specialize in repairing {cheiloschisis} in young children.
e.zh: 外科医生专门为幼儿修复唇裂。

cheimaphobia.t: 恐寒症；对寒冷的病态恐惧

e.en: His {cheimaphobia} kept him indoors all winter.
e.zh: 他的恐寒症使他整个冬天都待在室内。

e.en: Therapy helped her manage her severe {cheimaphobia}.
e.zh: 治疗帮助她控制了严重的恐寒症。

e.en: She practiced {cheiromancy} at the local fair.
e.zh: 她在当地集市上为人看手相。

e.en: Critics dismiss {cheiromancy} as superstition.
e.zh: 批评者将手相术斥为迷信。

e.en: The surgeon performed {cheiroplasty} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故后外科医生进行了手部整形手术。

e.en: Modern {cheiroplasty} can restore much of the hand's function.
e.zh: 现代的手部整形术能恢复手的大部分功能。

e.en: He suffered from {cheiropodagra} that swelled his fingers.
e.zh: 他患有手部痛风，手指肿胀。

e.en: Diet changes eased her {cheiropodagra}.
e.zh: 饮食调整缓解了她的手部痛风。

chela.t: 螯（蟹、蝎等的钳状肢）；门徒

e.en: The crab raised its giant {chela} in defense.
e.zh: 螃蟹举起巨大的螯进行防御。

e.en: The guru's {chela} followed him devoutly.
e.zh: 上师的弟子虔诚地追随着他。

e.en: Iron is readily {chelatable} by certain organic acids.
e.zh: 铁很容易被某些有机酸螯合。

e.en: Researchers test which metals are {chelatable} with this ligand.
e.zh: 研究人员测试哪些金属能与该配体螯合。

e.en: The molecule forms a stable {chelate} with copper ions.
e.zh: 该分子与铜离子形成稳定的螯合物。

e.en: EDTA is used to {chelate} heavy metals in the body.
e.zh: EDTA 用于螯合体内的重金属。

e.en: The supplement contains {chelated} minerals for better absorption.
e.zh: 该补充剂含有螯合矿物质，以利吸收。

e.en: Lead was {chelated} and excreted from the patient.
e.zh: 铅被螯合后从患者体内排出。

e.en: Many transition metals form colorful {chelates}.
e.zh: 许多过渡金属能形成色彩鲜艳的螯合物。

e.en: This compound {chelates} calcium very efficiently.
e.zh: 这种化合物能高效地螯合钙。

e.en: {Chelating} agents remove toxic metals from blood.
e.zh: 螯合剂能从血液中清除有毒金属。

e.en: The shampoo includes a {chelating} ingredient for hard water.
e.zh: 这款洗发水含有应对硬水的螯合成分。

e.en: They determined the calcium content using {chelatometry}.
e.zh: 他们用螯合滴定法测定钙含量。

e.en: {Chelatometry} is a standard technique in analytical chemistry.
e.zh: 螯合滴定法是分析化学中的标准技术。

e.en: Doctors prescribed a {chelator} to remove the lead.
e.zh: 医生开了螯合剂以清除铅。

e.en: This {chelator} binds tightly to iron.
e.zh: 这种螯合剂能紧紧结合铁。

chelicera.t: 螯肢（蛛形纲动物的口器）

e.en: The spider injects venom through its {chelicera}.
e.zh: 蜘蛛通过螯肢注入毒液。

e.en: Each {chelicera} ends in a sharp fang.
e.zh: 每条螯肢末端都长着尖锐的毒牙。

e.en: The {cheliceral} muscles are very strong.
e.zh: 螯肢的肌肉非常发达。

e.en: Researchers studied {cheliceral} structures under the microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下观察螯肢结构。

chelicerate.t: 螯肢类动物（如蜘蛛、蝎子）

e.en: Spiders are the most familiar {chelicerate} group.
e.zh: 蜘蛛是最常见的螯肢类动物。

e.en: Horseshoe crabs are an ancient {chelicerate} lineage.
e.zh: 鲎是一支古老的螯肢动物谱系。

e.en: They isolated {chelidonic} acid from the plant.
e.zh: 他们从该植物中分离出白屈菜酸。

e.en: {Chelidonic} compounds show interesting bioactivity.
e.zh: 白屈菜类化合物显示出有趣的生物活性。

e.en: {Chelidonine} is an alkaloid found in greater celandine.
e.zh: 白屈菜碱是白屈菜中含有的一种生物碱。

e.en: Studies suggest {chelidonine} has antitumor potential.
e.zh: 研究表明白屈菜碱具有抗肿瘤潜力。

e.en: Crabs are {cheliferous} crustaceans.
e.zh: 螃蟹是具螯的甲壳动物。

e.en: The {cheliferous} appendages are used for defense.
e.zh: 这些带钳的附肢用于防御。

e.en: The lobster has {cheliform} front claws.
e.zh: 龙虾长着钳形的前爪。

e.en: Some insects display {cheliform} mouthparts.
e.zh: 有些昆虫具有螯状的口器。

e.en: The crab waved its enlarged {cheliped} at rivals.
e.zh: 螃蟹向对手挥舞着它增大的螯足。

e.en: Males have a notably bigger {cheliped} than females.
e.zh: 雄性的螯足明显比雌性的大。

e.en: The burn left a thick {cheloid} on his arm.
e.zh: 烧伤在他手臂上留下了一块厚厚的瘢痕疙瘩。

e.en: Doctors injected steroids to flatten the {cheloid}.
e.zh: 医生注射类固醇以使瘢痕疙瘩变平。

e.en: Tortoises and turtles belong to the {chelonian} order.
e.zh: 陆龟和海龟都属于龟鳖目。

e.en: The vet specializes in {chelonian} medicine.
e.zh: 这位兽医专攻龟鳖类动物的医学。

e.en: The old text described {chemic} processes in vague terms.
e.zh: 那本旧书用模糊的语言描述了化学过程。

e.en: He had a {chemic} interest in transforming metals.
e.zh: 他对金属的转化怀有炼金术般的兴趣。

e.en: The treaty bans the use of {chemical-weapons}.
e.zh: 该条约禁止使用化学武器。

e.en: Inspectors searched for hidden {chemical-weapons}.
e.zh: 检查人员搜寻隐藏的化学武器。

chemicalize.t: 使化学化；用化学品处理

e.en: Modern farming tends to {chemicalize} the soil.
e.zh: 现代农业往往使土壤化学化。

e.en: They warned against the urge to {chemicalize} every crop.
e.zh: 他们警告不要急于对每种作物都施用化学品。

chemicking.t: 用化学漂白剂处理（织物）

e.en: The factory uses {chemicking} to whiten the cotton.
e.zh: 工厂使用化学漂白法漂白棉花。

e.en: After {chemicking}, the fabric appeared much brighter.
e.zh: 经化学漂白后，布料显得明亮得多。

e.en: They studied the {chemicophysical} properties of the alloy.
e.zh: 他们研究了该合金的化学物理性质。

e.en: This experiment requires careful {chemicophysical} analysis.
e.zh: 这项实验需要细致的化学物理分析。

e.en: She majored in {chemicophysics} at university.
e.zh: 她在大学主修化学物理学。

e.en: {Chemicophysics} bridges chemistry and physics.
e.zh: 化学物理学是化学与物理学之间的桥梁。

e.en: {Chemiculture} allows plants to grow without soil.
e.zh: 化学栽培法可使植物在无土条件下生长。

e.en: The greenhouse experimented with {chemiculture} for tomatoes.
e.zh: 温室对番茄尝试了化学栽培法。

e.en: {Chemigraphy} was once common in printing illustrations.
e.zh: 化学制版法曾在印刷插图时十分常见。

e.en: He learned {chemigraphy} from an old craftsman.
e.zh: 他向一位老工匠学习了化学制版法。

e.en: Mitochondria generate ATP via the {chemiosmotic} mechanism.
e.zh: 线粒体通过化学渗透机制生成 ATP。

e.en: The {chemiosmotic} theory revolutionized bioenergetics.
e.zh: 化学渗透理论彻底改变了生物能学。

e.en: Bacteria move via {chemiotaxis} toward nutrients.
e.zh: 细菌通过趋化性向营养物质移动。

e.en: Researchers studied {chemiotaxis} in immune cells.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了免疫细胞的趋化性。

e.en: Pollen tubes show {chemiotropism} toward the ovule.
e.zh: 花粉管表现出向胚珠的向化性。

e.en: Plant roots exhibit {chemiotropism} in soil.
e.zh: 植物根系在土壤中表现出向化性。

chemisette.t: 女式胸前装饰布；假胸衣

e.en: She wore a lace {chemisette} under her gown.
e.zh: 她在礼服里面穿了一件蕾丝胸饰。

e.en: The Victorian {chemisette} added modesty to low necklines.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的胸饰让低领口显得端庄。

e.en: The {chemism} of the reaction puzzled early scientists.
e.zh: 该反应的化学作用让早期科学家困惑。

e.en: He studied the {chemism} of mineral water.
e.zh: 他研究了矿泉水的化学性质。

e.en: Metals can {chemisorb} oxygen on their surfaces.
e.zh: 金属可以在表面化学吸附氧气。

e.en: The catalyst {chemisorbs} hydrogen molecules.
e.zh: 该催化剂化学吸附氢分子。

e.en: The {chemisorbed} layer was only one atom thick.
e.zh: 化学吸附层只有一个原子厚。

e.en: Hydrogen was {chemisorbed} onto the platinum surface.
e.zh: 氢被化学吸附到铂表面上。

e.en: {Chemisorption} involves the formation of chemical bonds.
e.zh: 化学吸附涉及化学键的形成。

e.en: They measured the rate of {chemisorption} on the catalyst.
e.zh: 他们测量了催化剂上的化学吸附速率。

e.en: I bought aspirin at the {chemist's} this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上我在药店买了阿司匹林。

e.en: The {chemist's} advice helped me choose the right medicine.
e.zh: 药剂师的建议帮我选对了药。

e.en: {Chemitype} was used for early printing illustrations.
e.zh: 化学制版法曾用于早期印刷插图。

e.en: The book featured plates made by {chemitype}.
e.zh: 该书收录了用化学制版法制作的版画。

e.en: They played {chemmy} at the casino all night.
e.zh: 他们整晚在赌场玩百家乐。

e.en: He lost a fortune at {chemmy}.
e.zh: 他在百家乐上输掉了一大笔钱。

e.en: She started {chemo-treatment} last month.
e.zh: 她上个月开始了化疗。

e.en: The {chemo-treatment} left him exhausted.
e.zh: 化疗让他筋疲力尽。

e.en: White blood cells follow {chemoattractants} to infection sites.
e.zh: 白细胞跟随趋化因子到达感染部位。

e.en: The cells released {chemoattractants} to recruit immune support.
e.zh: 这些细胞释放化学引诱剂以招募免疫支援。

e.en: A {chemoautotroph} obtains energy from inorganic chemicals.
e.zh: 化能自养生物从无机化学物质中获取能量。

e.en: Deep-sea vents host many {chemoautotroph} species.
e.zh: 深海热泉栖息着许多化能自养生物物种。

e.en: {Chemoautotrophic} bacteria thrive near hydrothermal vents.
e.zh: 化能自养细菌在热液喷口附近繁衍。

e.en: These microbes have a {chemoautotrophic} metabolism.
e.zh: 这些微生物具有化能自养代谢方式。

e.en: {Chemobiodynamics} explores how chemicals drive biological change.
e.zh: 化学生物动力学探讨化学物质如何驱动生物变化。

e.en: Her thesis focused on plant {chemobiodynamics}.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦于植物化学生物动力学。

e.en: A {chemoceptor} in the tongue detects sweet flavors.
e.zh: 舌头上的化学感受器能感知甜味。

e.en: Insects rely on antennae {chemoceptor} cells.
e.zh: 昆虫依赖触角上的化学感受器细胞。

chemodynesis.t: 化学动转性（细胞质流动）

e.en: {Chemodynesis} describes chemically induced cytoplasmic streaming.
e.zh: 化学动转性指由化学物质引起的细胞质流动。

e.en: The researchers observed {chemodynesis} in algal cells.
e.zh: 研究人员在藻类细胞中观察到化学动转性。

chemographic.t: 化学制版的；化学绘图的

e.en: The atlas used {chemographic} printing techniques.
e.zh: 该地图集采用了化学制版印刷技术。

e.en: He collected old {chemographic} prints.
e.zh: 他收藏旧的化学制版印刷品。

e.en: {Chemography} flourished in nineteenth-century print shops.
e.zh: 化学制版术在十九世纪的印刷工坊兴盛。

e.en: The museum displayed early examples of {chemography}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了化学制版术的早期实例。

e.en: {Chemoimmunology} studies chemical interactions in immunity.
e.zh: 化学免疫学研究免疫中的化学相互作用。

e.en: Her lab specializes in {chemoimmunology} of allergies.
e.zh: 她的实验室专攻过敏的化学免疫学研究。

e.en: The patient received {chemoimmunotherapy} for lymphoma.
e.zh: 患者接受了化学免疫疗法治疗淋巴瘤。

e.en: {Chemoimmunotherapy} combines drugs with immune-boosting agents.
e.zh: 化学免疫疗法将药物与免疫增强剂结合。

chemokinesis.t: 趋化运动；化学动力作用

e.en: {Chemokinesis} increases random cell movement near chemicals.
e.zh: 趋化运动使细胞在化学物质附近的随机运动增强。

e.en: Scientists distinguish chemotaxis from {chemokinesis}.
e.zh: 科学家将趋化性与趋化运动区分开来。

e.en: Some bacteria are strictly {chemolithoautotrophic}.
e.zh: 有些细菌是严格化能无机自养的。

e.en: {Chemolithoautotrophic} microbes oxidize iron for energy.
e.zh: 化能无机自养微生物通过氧化铁获取能量。

e.en: A {chemolithotroph} thrives by oxidizing inorganic compounds.
e.zh: 化能无机营养生物通过氧化无机化合物生存。

e.en: Deep rocks shelter many {chemolithotroph} species.
e.zh: 深部岩石中栖息着许多化能无机营养生物。

e.en: {Chemolithotrophic} bacteria use sulfur as an energy source.
e.zh: 化能无机营养细菌以硫为能量来源。

e.en: The vent community is dominated by {chemolithotrophic} life.
e.zh: 该热泉群落以化能无机营养生物为主。

e.en: {Chemolithotrophy} sustains life in extreme environments.
e.zh: 化能无机营养作用维持着极端环境中的生命。

e.en: The textbook explained {chemolithotrophy} in detail.
e.zh: 教科书详细解释了化能无机营养作用。

e.en: {Chemolysis} breaks down tissue using chemical agents.
e.zh: 化学分解作用利用化学试剂分解组织。

e.en: The procedure relies on controlled {chemolysis}.
e.zh: 该手术依赖于可控的化学分解。

e.en: {Chemometrics} applies statistics to chemical data analysis.
e.zh: 化学计量学将统计学应用于化学数据分析。

e.en: The lab uses {chemometrics} to interpret spectra.
e.zh: 实验室使用化学计量学来解释光谱。

e.en: {Chemomorphosis} describes form change driven by chemicals.
e.zh: 化学形态发生指由化学物质驱动的形态变化。

e.en: They observed {chemomorphosis} in developing larvae.
e.zh: 他们在发育中的幼虫身上观察到化学形态发生。

e.en: {Chemonasty} causes plant movement in response to chemicals.
e.zh: 感化性运动使植物因化学物质而产生运动。

e.en: The Venus flytrap shows {chemonasty} when prey lands.
e.zh: 猎物降落时捕蝇草表现出感化性运动。

e.en: The plant explored {chemonuclear} fuel processes.
e.zh: 该工厂研究了化学核反应燃料工艺。

e.en: {Chemonuclear} reactions remain largely experimental.
e.zh: 化学核反应仍主要处于实验阶段。

e.en: A {chemoorganotroph} uses organic molecules for energy.
e.zh: 化能有机营养生物利用有机分子获取能量。

e.en: Most fungi are classified as {chemoorganotroph} organisms.
e.zh: 大多数真菌被归类为化能有机营养生物。

e.en: {Chemoorganotrophic} bacteria dominate decaying matter.
e.zh: 化能有机营养细菌在腐烂物中占主导。

e.en: Humans are essentially {chemoorganotrophic} organisms.
e.zh: 人类本质上是化能有机营养生物。

e.en: {Chemoorganotrophy} powers most animal metabolism.
e.zh: 化能有机营养作用为大多数动物代谢提供能量。

e.en: The lecture compared autotrophy with {chemoorganotrophy}.
e.zh: 讲座比较了自养作用与化能有机营养作用。

e.en: The {chemopause} marks a chemical boundary in the atmosphere.
e.zh: 化学层顶标志着大气中的化学边界。

e.en: Sensors measured gases above the {chemopause}.
e.zh: 传感器测量了化学层顶上方的气体。

e.en: Doctors prescribed a {chemoprophylactic} regimen for travelers.
e.zh: 医生为旅行者开具了化学预防方案。

e.en: The {chemoprophylactic} drug reduces malaria risk.
e.zh: 该化学预防药物降低疟疾风险。

e.en: {Chemoprophylaxis} is recommended before travel to malaria zones.
e.zh: 前往疟疾流行区前建议进行化学预防。

e.en: The clinic offers {chemoprophylaxis} for HIV exposure.
e.zh: 该诊所提供艾滋病暴露后的化学预防。

e.en: {Chemopsychiatry} treats mental illness with medication.
e.zh: 化学精神病学用药物治疗精神疾病。

e.en: Modern {chemopsychiatry} relies on advanced neurochemistry.
e.zh: 现代化学精神病学依赖先进的神经化学。

e.en: Taste depends on {chemoreception} by tongue cells.
e.zh: 味觉依赖舌细胞的化学感受作用。

e.en: Insects use antennae for {chemoreception}.
e.zh: 昆虫用触角进行化学感受。

e.en: The fish has highly {chemoreceptive} barbels.
e.zh: 这种鱼具有高度化学感受性的须。

e.en: {Chemoreceptive} cells line the nasal passages.
e.zh: 化学感受细胞排列在鼻腔内。

e.en: Olfactory {chemoreceptivity} declines with age.
e.zh: 嗅觉化学感受性随年龄下降。

e.en: The study measured {chemoreceptivity} in larvae.
e.zh: 该研究测量了幼虫的化学感受性。

e.en: A {chemoreceptor} in the carotid artery senses oxygen levels.
e.zh: 颈动脉中的化学感受器能感知氧含量。

e.en: Moths locate mates with antennal {chemoreceptor} cells.
e.zh: 飞蛾通过触角化学感受器细胞寻找配偶。

e.en: Tumor {chemoresistance} complicates cancer treatment.
e.zh: 肿瘤的化学耐药性使癌症治疗复杂化。

e.en: Researchers study how cells develop {chemoresistance}.
e.zh: 研究人员研究细胞如何产生化学耐药性。

e.en: The reagent is highly {chemoselective} for aldehydes.
e.zh: 该试剂对醛具有高度化学选择性。

e.en: They designed a {chemoselective} catalyst for the reaction.
e.zh: 他们为该反应设计了一种化学选择性催化剂。

e.en: Tumor {chemosensitivity} predicts treatment success.
e.zh: 肿瘤的化学敏感性可预示治疗效果。

e.en: The test measures the {chemosensitivity} of cancer cells.
e.zh: 该检测测量癌细胞的化学敏感性。

e.en: Insects rely on {chemosensory} hairs to find food.
e.zh: 昆虫依靠化学感觉毛寻找食物。

e.en: COVID can disrupt {chemosensory} function.
e.zh: 新冠可能扰乱化学感觉功能。

e.en: {Chemosmosis} drives ATP synthesis in mitochondria.
e.zh: 化学渗透作用驱动线粒体合成 ATP。

e.en: The textbook explained {chemosmosis} with diagrams.
e.zh: 教科书用图示解释了化学渗透作用。

e.en: The {chemosmotic} theory revolutionized bioenergetics.
e.zh: 化学渗透理论彻底改变了生物能学。

e.en: Cells generate ATP through a {chemosmotic} gradient.
e.zh: 细胞通过化学渗透梯度产生 ATP。

e.en: Ukraine is famous for its fertile {chernozem}.
e.zh: 乌克兰以肥沃的黑钙土闻名。

e.en: The farmers prized the deep {chernozem} soil.
e.zh: 农民们珍视这片深厚的黑土。

e.en: The region has {chernozemic} soils ideal for wheat.
e.zh: 该地区拥有适合种小麦的黑钙土。

e.en: Scientists studied the {chernozemic} layer beneath the steppe.
e.zh: 科学家研究了草原下的黑钙土层。

e.en: She served a {cherried} dessert after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后她端上一道加樱桃的甜点。

e.en: His lips were {cherried} from the cold wind.
e.zh: 寒风把他的嘴唇吹得樱桃般红。

e.en: She wore a {cherry-colored} dress to the party.
e.zh: 她穿了一件樱桃色的连衣裙去派对。

e.en: The sunset turned the sky a {cherry-colored} hue.
e.zh: 夕阳把天空染成樱桃色。

e.en: Don't just {cherry-pick} the data that supports you.
e.zh: 不要只挑选支持你观点的数据。

e.en: Recruiters {cherry-pick} the top candidates.
e.zh: 招聘人员只挑最优秀的候选人。

cherry-picked.t: 精心挑选的；择优选取的

e.en: He used {cherry-picked} statistics to mislead readers.
e.zh: 他用精挑细选的数据误导读者。

e.en: The team {cherry-picked} the best engineers.
e.zh: 团队挑走了最优秀的工程师。

cherry-picking.t: 挑樱桃式选取；选择性举证

e.en: Critics accused him of {cherry-picking} evidence.
e.zh: 批评者指责他选择性地引用证据。

e.en: {Cherry-picking} examples weakens your argument.
e.zh: 挑选性举例会削弱你的论点。

e.en: He {cherry-picks} only the flattering reviews.
e.zh: 他只挑选那些奉承的评论。

e.en: The manager {cherry-picks} her favorite projects.
e.zh: 经理只挑她喜欢的项目做。

e.en: The kids drank {cherryade} at the picnic.
e.zh: 孩子们在野餐时喝樱桃汽水。

e.en: She ordered a chilled {cherryade} from the bar.
e.zh: 她在吧台点了一杯冰镇樱桃汽水。

e.en: The wine had a {cherrylike} aroma.
e.zh: 这酒带有樱桃般的香气。

e.en: Her cheeks took on a {cherrylike} flush.
e.zh: 她的脸颊泛起樱桃般的红晕。

e.en: He spat the {cherrystone} into the bowl.
e.zh: 他把樱桃核吐进碗里。

e.en: We ordered {cherrystone} clams as an appetizer.
e.zh: 我们点了小蛤蜊作开胃菜。

e.en: Geologists examined the {chertification} of the limestone.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了石灰岩的燧石化。

e.en: {Chertification} preserved the fossils beautifully.
e.zh: 燧石化作用完好地保存了化石。

e.en: The cliff was made of {cherty} limestone.
e.zh: 这悬崖由含燧石的石灰岩构成。

e.en: They walked across a {cherty} ridge.
e.zh: 他们走过一道燧石质的山脊。

e.en: The baby smiled {cherubically} at strangers.
e.zh: 婴儿天使般地朝陌生人微笑。

e.en: She sang {cherubically} in the choir.
e.zh: 她在合唱团里唱得天使般动听。

e.en: Golden {cherubim} adorned the altar.
e.zh: 金色的小天使装饰着祭坛。

e.en: The ceiling was painted with hovering {cherubim}.
e.zh: 天花板上画着翱翔的小天使。

e.en: The old text mentions a heavenly {cherubin}.
e.zh: 古籍中提到一位天上的小天使。

e.en: Painters depicted the {cherubin} with golden wings.
e.zh: 画家把小天使画上金色的翅膀。

e.en: The child had a {cherublike} face.
e.zh: 那孩子有一张天使般的脸。

e.en: She gave him a {cherublike} smile.
e.zh: 她朝他露出天使般的微笑。

e.en: He is a talented young {chess-player}.
e.zh: 他是个有天赋的年轻棋手。

e.en: The {chess-player} studied the board carefully.
e.zh: 那位棋手仔细研究着棋盘。

e.en: The dairy used a wooden {chessel} for cheesemaking.
e.zh: 奶酪坊用木制压模来做奶酪。

e.en: She placed the curds into the {chessel}.
e.zh: 她把凝乳放进奶酪压模里。

e.en: He filled the {chesset} with fresh curds.
e.zh: 他把新鲜凝乳装进小奶酪压模里。

e.en: Each {chesset} produces a small round cheese.
e.zh: 每个小压模能做出一块圆形奶酪。

e.en: He carved each {chessman} from ivory.
e.zh: 他用象牙雕出每枚棋子。

e.en: The wooden {chessman} fell off the board.
e.zh: 那枚木制棋子从棋盘上掉下来。

e.en: He arranged the {chessmen} on the board.
e.zh: 他把棋子摆在棋盘上。

e.en: The antique {chessmen} were carved from bone.
e.zh: 这套古董棋子是用骨头雕的。

e.en: The mineral collector treasured a piece of {chessylite}.
e.zh: 矿物收藏家珍藏一块蓝铜矿。

e.en: {Chessylite} is now usually called azurite.
e.zh: 蓝铜矿如今通常称为azurite。

e.en: We roasted a {chest-nut} over the fire.
e.zh: 我们在火上烤了一颗栗子。

e.en: The {chest-nut} tree shaded the whole yard.
e.zh: 那棵栗树把整个院子都遮住了。

e.en: An antique {chest-on-chest} stood in the hallway.
e.zh: 走廊里立着一只古董双层抽屉柜。

e.en: She inherited a mahogany {chest-on-chest}.
e.zh: 她继承了一个红木双层柜。

e.en: His speech was full of {chest-thumping} bravado.
e.zh: 他的演讲满是自吹自擂的虚张声势。

e.en: Voters are tired of political {chest-thumping}.
e.zh: 选民厌倦了政客的自吹自擂。

e.en: He brought home a {chestful} of old letters.
e.zh: 他带回家满满一箱旧信。

e.en: She found a {chestful} of treasures in the attic.
e.zh: 她在阁楼里发现了一箱宝贝。

e.en: She had long {chestnut-brown} hair.
e.zh: 她有一头长长的栗棕色头发。

e.en: The horse had a glossy {chestnut-brown} coat.
e.zh: 那匹马有一身光亮的栗棕色毛。

e.en: He admired her {chestnut-coloured} curls.
e.zh: 他欣赏她栗色的卷发。

e.en: The dog had a beautiful {chestnut-coloured} coat.
e.zh: 那只狗有一身漂亮的栗色毛。

e.en: The {chetah} sprinted across the savanna.
e.zh: 猎豹在草原上飞奔而过。

e.en: Old texts spell cheetah as {chetah}.
e.zh: 旧文献把cheetah拼作chetah。

e.en: The student learned to write {cheth} in Hebrew class.
e.zh: 学生在希伯来语课上学写字母Heth。

e.en: {Cheth} is the eighth letter of the Hebrew alphabet.
e.zh: Cheth是希伯来字母表的第八个字母。

chetrum.t: 切特鲁姆（不丹货币单位）

e.en: One ngultrum equals one hundred {chetrum}.
e.zh: 一努扎姆等于一百切特鲁姆。

e.en: He paid the small fee in {chetrum}.
e.zh: 他用切特鲁姆付了一小笔费用。

e.en: Soldiers placed a {cheval-de-frise} across the road.
e.zh: 士兵在路上设置了拒马。

e.en: The fortress was ringed with {cheval-de-frise}.
e.zh: 要塞周围布满拒马障碍。

e.en: She admired her dress in the {cheval-glass}.
e.zh: 她在穿衣镜前欣赏自己的裙子。

e.en: An ornate {cheval-glass} stood in the corner.
e.zh: 角落里立着一面华丽的穿衣镜。

e.en: The luthier adjusted the violin's {chevalet}.
e.zh: 制琴师调整了小提琴的琴马。

e.en: She set her canvas on the {chevalet}.
e.zh: 她把画布放上画架。

e.en: The cathedral's {chevet} faced the rising sun.
e.zh: 大教堂的半圆形后殿朝向旭日。

e.en: Pilgrims gathered around the gilded {chevet}.
e.zh: 朝圣者聚在镀金的后殿周围。

chemosorb.t: 化学吸附；以化学键吸附

e.en: Activated carbon can {chemosorb} certain pollutants from the air.
e.zh: 活性炭能化学吸附空气中的某些污染物。

e.en: Some metal surfaces readily {chemosorb} oxygen molecules.
e.zh: 某些金属表面易于化学吸附氧分子。

e.en: {Chemosorption} involves the formation of true chemical bonds.
e.zh: 化学吸附涉及真正化学键的形成。

e.en: The catalyst's efficiency depends on its {chemosorption} rate.
e.zh: 催化剂的效率取决于其化学吸附速率。

e.en: The {chemosphere} lies in the upper atmosphere.
e.zh: 化学层位于大气上层。

e.en: Photochemical reactions are intense in the {chemosphere}.
e.zh: 化学层中的光化学反应十分剧烈。

chemostat.t: 恒化器；化学恒定培养装置

e.en: Microbiologists grow bacteria in a {chemostat} for steady output.
e.zh: 微生物学家用恒化器培养细菌以获得稳定产出。

e.en: The {chemostat} maintains a constant nutrient supply.
e.zh: 恒化器维持着恒定的营养供应。

e.en: The pest control program uses a {chemosterilant} on male insects.
e.zh: 虫害防治项目对雄性昆虫使用化学绝育剂。

e.en: Researchers tested a new {chemosterilant} in the field.
e.zh: 研究人员在田间测试了一种新型化学绝育剂。

e.en: {Chemosterilization} is one method of insect population control.
e.zh: 化学绝育是控制昆虫种群的方法之一。

e.en: The ethics of {chemosterilization} were widely debated.
e.zh: 化学绝育的伦理问题受到广泛讨论。

e.en: Scientists {chemosterilize} male flies to suppress wild populations.
e.zh: 科学家对雄蝇进行化学绝育以抑制野生种群。

e.en: It is unethical to {chemosterilize} animals without oversight.
e.zh: 在缺乏监管的情况下对动物进行化学绝育是不道德的。

e.en: She underwent {chemosurgery} to remove a skin lesion.
e.zh: 她接受了化学外科手术以去除皮肤病变。

e.en: {Chemosurgery} can treat certain superficial cancers.
e.zh: 化学外科可用于治疗某些浅表癌症。

e.en: The doctor recommended a {chemosurgical} procedure.
e.zh: 医生推荐了化学外科手术。

e.en: {Chemosurgical} techniques have improved over the decades.
e.zh: 化学外科技术几十年来已大有改进。

e.en: Bacteria near deep-sea vents survive through {chemosynthesis}.
e.zh: 深海热泉附近的细菌依靠化能合成生存。

e.en: Unlike photosynthesis, {chemosynthesis} requires no sunlight.
e.zh: 与光合作用不同，化能合成不需要阳光。

e.en: White blood cells display {chemotactic} movement toward injuries.
e.zh: 白细胞向伤口表现出趋化性运动。

e.en: The bacteria showed a strong {chemotactic} response to glucose.
e.zh: 细菌对葡萄糖表现出强烈的趋化反应。

e.en: Immune cells migrate {chemotactically} toward sites of infection.
e.zh: 免疫细胞趋化性地向感染部位迁移。

e.en: Sperm move {chemotactically} toward the egg.
e.zh: 精子趋化性地游向卵子。

e.en: {Chemotaxis} guides immune cells to sites of inflammation.
e.zh: 趋化性引导免疫细胞到达炎症部位。

e.en: Bacterial {chemotaxis} has been studied in great detail.
e.zh: 细菌的趋化性已被深入研究。

e.en: The study used {chemotaxonomic} markers to classify plants.
e.zh: 该研究使用化学分类标记对植物进行分类。

e.en: {Chemotaxonomic} analysis revealed several new species.
e.zh: 化学分类分析揭示了几个新物种。

e.en: They published a {chemotaxonomical} review of the genus.
e.zh: 他们发表了该属的化学分类学综述。

e.en: {Chemotaxonomical} methods complement traditional morphology.
e.zh: 化学分类学方法对传统形态学是有益的补充。

e.en: These plants are {chemotaxonomically} quite distinct.
e.zh: 这些植物在化学分类学上差异显著。

e.en: Species can be grouped {chemotaxonomically} by their alkaloids.
e.zh: 可以根据生物碱在化学分类学上对物种进行分组。

e.en: A {chemotaxonomist} classifies plants by their chemical compounds.
e.zh: 化学分类学家根据化学成分对植物进行分类。

e.en: She trained as a {chemotaxonomist} at a botanical institute.
e.zh: 她在一家植物研究所接受了化学分类学家的训练。

e.en: {Chemotaxonomy} uses biochemistry to classify organisms.
e.zh: 化学分类学利用生物化学对生物进行分类。

e.en: Modern {chemotaxonomy} relies heavily on mass spectrometry.
e.zh: 现代化学分类学在很大程度上依赖质谱分析。

e.en: {Chemothalamectomy} was once used to relieve Parkinson's tremors.
e.zh: 化学性丘脑切除术曾用于缓解帕金森病的震颤。

e.en: The neurosurgeon performed a {chemothalamectomy} on the patient.
e.zh: 神经外科医生为该病人进行了化学性丘脑切除术。

e.en: Fish farmers added a {chemotherapeutant} to control infections.
e.zh: 养鱼户加入化学治疗剂以控制感染。

e.en: This {chemotherapeutant} targets bacterial pathogens.
e.zh: 这种化学治疗剂针对致病细菌起作用。

e.en: The tumor was treated {chemotherapeutically} with new drugs.
e.zh: 肿瘤通过化学治疗用新药进行了治疗。

e.en: Some cancers respond very well {chemotherapeutically}.
e.zh: 某些癌症对化学治疗反应非常好。

e.en: A {chemotroph} obtains energy from inorganic chemical reactions.
e.zh: 化能营养生物从无机化学反应中获取能量。

e.en: Many deep-sea bacteria are {chemotrophs}.
e.zh: 许多深海细菌都是化能营养生物。

e.en: Pollen tubes show {chemotropic} growth toward the ovule.
e.zh: 花粉管表现出朝向胚珠的向化性生长。

e.en: Roots exhibit {chemotropic} responses to mineral nutrients.
e.zh: 根对矿物养分表现出向化性反应。

e.en: Roots grow {chemotropically} toward dissolved nutrients.
e.zh: 根向化性地朝溶解的养分生长。

e.en: The fungus responds {chemotropically} to host signals.
e.zh: 真菌对宿主信号产生向化性反应。

e.en: {Chemotropism} directs pollen tube growth in flowering plants.
e.zh: 向化性引导开花植物中花粉管的生长。

e.en: The seedling exhibited positive {chemotropism} toward water.
e.zh: 幼苗表现出朝向水的正向化性。

e.en: {Chemotropy} influences how roots locate nutrients underground.
e.zh: 向化性影响根在地下寻找养分的方式。

e.en: Researchers studied {chemotropy} in pathogenic fungi.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了致病真菌中的向化性。

e.en: The {chemurgist} developed plastics made from soybeans.
e.zh: 这位农产化学工艺学家开发了大豆制成的塑料。

e.en: She works as a {chemurgist} in an agricultural lab.
e.zh: 她在农业实验室担任农产化学工艺学家。

e.en: {Chemurgy} converts farm crops into industrial products.
e.zh: 农产化学将农作物转化为工业产品。

e.en: Henry Ford was an early advocate of {chemurgy}.
e.zh: 亨利·福特是农产化学的早期倡导者。

e.en: The {chenier} plain stretches along the Louisiana coast.
e.zh: 贝壳堤平原沿路易斯安那州海岸延伸。

e.en: Geologists mapped the ancient {chenier} ridges in the marsh.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了沼泽中古老贝壳堤的地图。

e.en: The salt marsh was dominated by hardy {chenopods}.
e.zh: 盐沼中以耐受性强的藜科植物为主。

e.en: Quinoa is a well-known edible {chenopod}.
e.zh: 藜麦是一种著名的可食用藜科植物。

e.en: The garden contained several {chenopodiaceous} species.
e.zh: 花园里有几种藜科植物。

e.en: {Chenopodiaceous} plants often tolerate saline soils.
e.zh: 藜科植物常能耐盐碱土壤。

e.en: She wore a red silk {cheongsam} to the wedding banquet.
e.zh: 她穿着一件红色丝绸旗袍出席婚宴。

e.en: The modern {cheongsam} originated in 1920s Shanghai.
e.zh: 现代旗袍起源于1920年代的上海。

e.en: {Cheoplasty} was an early method of dental palate restoration.
e.zh: 金属牙腭整形术是一种早期的牙腭修复方法。

e.en: The patient underwent {cheoplasty} after losing several teeth.
e.zh: 病人在掉了几颗牙后接受了金属牙腭整形术。

e.en: He pulled out his {cheque-book} to pay the deposit.
e.zh: 他掏出支票簿来支付订金。

e.en: Many people no longer carry a {cheque-book} these days.
e.zh: 如今很多人不再随身携带支票簿了。

cheralite.t: 独居石族矿物（含钙磷酸盐变种）

e.en: The geologist identified the rare crystals as {cheralite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这些稀有晶体鉴定为铈钍石。

e.en: {Cheralite} contains thorium and rare earth elements.
e.zh: 铈钍石含有钍和稀土元素。

chereme.t: 手语形素；手语基本单位

e.en: A {chereme} is the sign language counterpart of a phoneme.
e.zh: 手语形素相当于口语中的音位。

e.en: Linguists analyze each {chereme} in detail when studying signs.
e.zh: 语言学家在研究手势时会详细分析每个手语形素。

e.en: The angler landed a plump {chevin} from the river.
e.zh: 垂钓者从河里钓上了一条肥美的鲦鱼。

e.en: Local folklore claims the {chevin} is hardest to catch.
e.zh: 当地传说鲦鱼最难捕捉。

e.en: Her gloves were made of soft {chevrette} leather.
e.zh: 她的手套是用柔软的小山羊皮制成的。

e.en: The shop sold delicate {chevrette} slippers.
e.zh: 店里出售精致的小山羊皮拖鞋。

chevronwise.t: 以人字形排列地（纹章学）

e.en: The shield was divided {chevronwise} in red and gold.
e.zh: 盾徽以人字形分成红金两色。

e.en: He arranged the badges {chevronwise} on his sleeve.
e.zh: 他把徽章以人字形排列在袖子上。

e.en: A tiny {chevrotain} darted across the forest path.
e.zh: 一只小鼷鹿迅速窜过林间小路。

e.en: The zoo's new {chevrotain} weighs only two kilograms.
e.zh: 动物园新来的鼷鹿仅重两公斤。

e.en: In some cultures people clean their teeth with a {chewing-stick}.
e.zh: 在一些文化中，人们用咀嚼木枝来洁齿。

e.en: He kept a small {chewing-stick} in his pocket.
e.zh: 他口袋里装着一根小小的洁齿木枝。

e.en: A {chewink} called from the dense underbrush.
e.zh: 一只唧鹀在茂密的灌木丛中鸣叫。

e.en: Birders hoped to spot a {chewink} at dawn.
e.zh: 观鸟者希望在清晨看到一只唧鹀。

chi-chi.t: 花哨做作的；浮夸时髦的

e.en: The boutique was full of {chi-chi} little ornaments.
e.zh: 那家精品店里满是花哨做作的小饰品。

e.en: She wore a rather {chi-chi} hat to the gallery opening.
e.zh: 她戴着一顶相当浮夸时髦的帽子去了画廊开幕式。

chi-rho.t: 基督符号（希腊字母Χ与Ρ组合）

e.en: The medieval manuscript opened with an ornate {chi-rho}.
e.zh: 那部中世纪手稿以华丽的基督符号开篇。

e.en: A gold {chi-rho} hung above the altar.
e.zh: 祭坛上方悬挂着一个金色的基督符号。

e.en: They ran a {chi-square} test to compare the two groups.
e.zh: 他们做了卡方检验来比较两组数据。

e.en: The {chi-square} value indicated a strong association.
e.zh: 卡方值表明两者关联很强。

chia.t: 奇亚（一种草本植物及其种子）

e.en: She sprinkled {chia} seeds over her morning yogurt.
e.zh: 她在早餐酸奶上撒了些奇亚籽。

e.en: {Chia} is rich in fiber and omega-3.
e.zh: 奇亚籽富含纤维和欧米伽-3。

e.en: The lads {chiacked} him about his haircut all afternoon.
e.zh: 小伙子们整个下午都在拿他的发型调侃他。

e.en: Don't take it personally; they only {chiack} their friends.
e.zh: 别往心里去，他们只会戏弄朋友。

e.en: Caravaggio is the most famous {chiaroscurist} in Western art.
e.zh: 卡拉瓦乔是西方艺术中最著名的明暗对照法画家。

e.en: The young {chiaroscurist} studied Rembrandt's lighting closely.
e.zh: 那位年轻的明暗对照法画家细致研究了伦勃朗的用光。

e.en: The optic {chiasm} lies just beneath the brain.
e.zh: 视神经交叉位于大脑下方。

e.en: Damage to the {chiasm} can affect peripheral vision.
e.zh: 视交叉损伤可能影响周边视觉。

e.en: A {chiasma} forms where chromosomes exchange segments.
e.zh: 染色体交换片段处会形成交叉。

e.en: The textbook diagrammed the optic {chiasma} clearly.
e.zh: 教科书清晰地图示了视神经交叉。

e.en: The lesion was located near the {chiasmatic} region.
e.zh: 病灶位于视交叉区附近。

e.en: {Chiasmatic} structures are crucial for genetic recombination.
e.zh: 交叉结构对基因重组至关重要。

chiasmatypy.t: 染色体交叉型（遗传学术语）

e.en: Early geneticists proposed {chiasmatypy} to explain crossover.
e.zh: 早期遗传学家提出染色体交叉型来解释互换现象。

e.en: The theory of {chiasmatypy} has largely been refined.
e.zh: 染色体交叉型的理论已大体被修正完善。

e.en: The pendant featured a polished slice of {chiastolite}.
e.zh: 那枚吊坠镶着一片打磨过的空晶石。

e.en: {Chiastolite} crystals show a distinctive cross pattern.
e.zh: 空晶石的晶体呈现独特的十字形花纹。

e.en: She writes poetry about her experience as a {chicana}.
e.zh: 她写诗描绘自己作为墨西哥裔美国女性的经历。

e.en: The exhibit highlighted contemporary {chicana} artists.
e.zh: 展览重点介绍了当代墨西哥裔美国女性艺术家。

chicanismo.t: 墨西哥裔美国人民族意识

e.en: The movement awakened a sense of {chicanismo} among students.
e.zh: 这场运动唤起了学生们的墨西哥裔民族意识。

e.en: Her murals celebrate the spirit of {chicanismo}.
e.zh: 她的壁画歌颂着墨西哥裔民族意识的精神。

e.en: The old recipe called for roasted {chiccory} root.
e.zh: 这道老菜谱需要烘烤过的菊苣根。

e.en: He brewed a bitter drink from ground {chiccory}.
e.zh: 他用磨碎的菊苣冲泡了一杯苦味饮品。

chichi.t: 花哨做作的；浮夸时髦的

e.en: The café had a slightly {chichi} atmosphere.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆带有几分花哨做作的氛围。

e.en: Her outfit was too {chichi} for a casual lunch.
e.zh: 她那身装扮对于便餐来说太浮夸了。

e.en: She added a can of {chick-pea} to the stew.
e.zh: 她往炖菜里加了一罐鹰嘴豆。

e.en: Hummus is made mainly from {chick-pea} paste.
e.zh: 鹰嘴豆泥主要由鹰嘴豆酱制成。

e.en: Come here, my little {chickabiddy}, and have some milk.
e.zh: 过来，我的小宝贝，喝点牛奶。

e.en: The farmer's children chased the yellow {chickabiddy} around the yard.
e.zh: 农夫的孩子们追着黄色的小鸡满院子跑。

e.en: A {chickaree} chattered angrily from the pine branch.
e.zh: 一只赤松鼠在松枝上愤怒地鸣叫。

e.en: We watched the {chickaree} bury cones for winter.
e.zh: 我们看着那只赤松鼠埋松果过冬。

chickee.t: 塞米诺尔人式高脚棚屋

e.en: They slept in a thatched {chickee} beside the swamp.
e.zh: 他们睡在沼泽旁的茅草高脚棚屋里。

e.en: The park rebuilt a traditional {chickee} for visitors.
e.zh: 公园为游客重建了一座传统的高脚棚屋。

e.en: We hired a {child-minder} for the evening.
e.zh: 我们晚上请了一位保姆。

e.en: The {child-minder} picks her up from school.
e.zh: 保姆负责从学校接她回家。

e.en: The {child-molester} was sentenced to twenty years.
e.zh: 那名娈童犯被判处二十年监禁。

e.en: Police arrested a suspected {child-molester} yesterday.
e.zh: 警方昨天逮捕了一名涉嫌猥亵儿童的人。

child-proof.t: 防止儿童开启的；儿童安全的

e.en: The medicine has a {child-proof} cap.
e.zh: 这药瓶有防止儿童打开的盖子。

e.en: We made the kitchen {child-proof} before the baby arrived.
e.zh: 宝宝出生前我们把厨房改造得对儿童安全。

childproof.t: 防止儿童开启的；儿童安全的

e.en: All the cabinets have {childproof} latches.
e.zh: 所有橱柜都装了防儿童开启的锁扣。

e.en: This bottle is {childproof} but hard for adults too.
e.zh: 这瓶子防儿童开启，但成年人也很难打开。

e.en: A {chiliad} of years had passed since the founding.
e.zh: 自建立以来已经过去了一千年。

e.en: He spoke of the coming {chiliad} with reverence.
e.zh: 他满怀崇敬地谈起即将到来的千年期。

chiliasm.t: 千禧年说；基督千年统治信仰

e.en: Early Christian {chiliasm} expected Christ's thousand-year reign.
e.zh: 早期基督教的千禧年说期待基督统治一千年。

e.en: The sect's doctrine bordered on outright {chiliasm}.
e.zh: 这个教派的教义近乎彻底的千禧年说。

e.en: He was a fervent {chiliast} preaching the end times.
e.zh: 他是一个狂热的千禧年说信徒，宣讲末日来临。

e.en: Medieval {chiliasts} drew large crowds with apocalyptic visions.
e.zh: 中世纪的千禧年说信徒以末世异象吸引了大批信众。

chiliastic.t: 千禧年说的；末世期盼的

e.en: The movement had a strongly {chiliastic} flavor.
e.zh: 该运动带有浓厚的千禧年说色彩。

e.en: Her sermons grew increasingly {chiliastic} over the years.
e.zh: 多年来她的布道越来越具千禧年色彩。

e.en: He ordered a {chilidog} and a soda.
e.zh: 他点了一份辣酱热狗和一杯汽水。

e.en: The diner is famous for its messy {chilidogs}.
e.zh: 这家餐馆以做得乱糟糟的辣酱热狗出名。

e.en: Let's just {chill-out} at home tonight.
e.zh: 我们今晚就在家放松一下吧。

e.en: The lounge has a great {chill-out} vibe.
e.zh: 这个休息室氛围非常放松。

chilled-out.t: 轻松悠闲的；放松随性的

e.en: He's a really {chilled-out} guy.
e.zh: 他是个非常放松随性的人。

e.en: The café has a {chilled-out} atmosphere.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆氛围悠闲。

e.en: They played some {chillout} music in the lounge.
e.zh: 他们在休息室里放了些舒缓音乐。

e.en: We need a {chillout} day after that hike.
e.zh: 那次徒步之后我们需要一个放松日。

e.en: The {chimaera} of myth breathed fire and terror.
e.zh: 神话中的奇美拉喷吐火焰，令人闻风丧胆。

e.en: Deep-sea trawlers occasionally catch a {chimaera}.
e.zh: 深海拖网渔船偶尔会捕到银鲛。

e.en: The lab produced a {chimaeric} mouse for the study.
e.zh: 实验室为这项研究培育了一只嵌合体小鼠。

e.en: His plans seemed {chimaeric} and impossible.
e.zh: 他的计划看似虚幻而不可能实现。

e.en: Genetic {chimaerism} can occur after a bone-marrow transplant.
e.zh: 骨髓移植后可能出现遗传嵌合现象。

e.en: Researchers studied {chimaerism} in the twin brothers.
e.zh: 研究人员对这对双胞胎兄弟的嵌合现象进行了研究。

e.en: We lit the {chimenea} on the patio.
e.zh: 我们在露台上点燃了陶土火炉。

e.en: A {chimenea} keeps the garden warm in autumn.
e.zh: 户外火炉让花园在秋天也暖意融融。

e.en: The bishop wore a black {chimere} over his rochet.
e.zh: 主教在白罩衣外披着一件黑色法袍。

e.en: The {chimere} is a traditional Anglican vestment.
e.zh: 这种无袖外袍是英国国教的传统法衣。

e.en: Doctors detected {chimerism} in the patient's blood.
e.zh: 医生在病人的血液中检测到嵌合现象。

e.en: {Chimerism} can complicate paternity testing.
e.zh: 嵌合体现象可能使亲子鉴定变得复杂。

e.en: I ordered a beef {chimichanga} for lunch.
e.zh: 我午餐点了一份牛肉炸卷饼。

e.en: Their {chimichanga} comes with rice and beans.
e.zh: 他们家的炸卷饼配米饭和豆子。

e.en: The steak came with fresh {chimichurri} sauce.
e.zh: 牛排配的是新鲜的阿根廷青酱。

e.en: She makes {chimichurri} with parsley and garlic.
e.zh: 她用欧芹和大蒜做青酱。

chimney-breast.t: 壁炉胸墙；烟囱凸出墙体

e.en: They mounted the TV above the {chimney-breast}.
e.zh: 他们把电视挂在了壁炉胸墙上方。

e.en: The {chimney-breast} dominated the small living room.
e.zh: 壁炉胸墙在小客厅里十分显眼。

e.en: A bird had nested in the {chimney-pot}.
e.zh: 一只鸟在烟囱顶帽里筑了巢。

e.en: The {chimney-pot} was cracked and leaking smoke.
e.zh: 烟囱顶帽裂了，正在漏烟。

e.en: Smoke poured from the factory's {chimney-stack}.
e.zh: 浓烟从工厂的烟囱柱中滚滚冒出。

e.en: The {chimney-stack} needed urgent repair.
e.zh: 那座烟囱柱亟需修缮。

e.en: A {chimney-sweep} came to clean our flue.
e.zh: 一位扫烟囱工人来清理我们的烟道。

e.en: The {chimney-sweep} was covered in soot.
e.zh: 那位扫烟囱工人浑身都是煤灰。

e.en: Victorian {chimney-sweepers} were often very young boys.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的扫烟囱工人常常是小男孩。

e.en: Two {chimney-sweepers} arrived at dawn.
e.zh: 两名扫烟囱工人天一亮就到了。

e.en: The rocks formed a tall, {chimneylike} column.
e.zh: 那些岩石形成了一根高高的烟囱状石柱。

e.en: Steam rose through a {chimneylike} vent.
e.zh: 蒸汽从一个烟囱状的出气口升起。

e.en: Grandma dozed in the {chimneynook} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后奶奶在壁炉旁的角落里打盹。

e.en: They sat in the {chimneynook} telling stories.
e.zh: 他们坐在壁炉角里讲故事。

e.en: Soot blackened the {chimneypot} above the roof.
e.zh: 屋顶上方的烟囱顶帽被煤灰熏黑了。

e.en: He climbed up to inspect the {chimneypot}.
e.zh: 他爬上去检查烟囱顶帽。

e.en: The old {chimneystack} leaned dangerously to one side.
e.zh: 那根老烟囱柱危险地向一侧倾斜。

e.en: Workers dismantled the brick {chimneystack}.
e.zh: 工人们拆除了砖砌的烟囱柱。

checkpost.t: 公路或边境上的关卡；检查哨

e.en: We were stopped at the {checkpost} for inspection.
e.zh: 我们在关卡被拦下接受检查。

e.en: Soldiers manned the {checkpost} day and night.
e.zh: 士兵日夜守在那个检查哨。

checkrail.t: 护轨；铁路上的导向轨道

e.en: The train wheels rolled smoothly along the {checkrail}.
e.zh: 列车车轮沿着护轨平稳滚动。

e.en: Engineers replaced a worn {checkrail} on the curve.
e.zh: 工程师更换了弯道上磨损的护轨。

checkrein.t: 马具上的副缰；制头缰绳

e.en: The coachman tightened the {checkrein} to steady the horse.
e.zh: 马车夫拉紧副缰让马稳住。

e.en: A leather {checkrein} kept the pony's head high.
e.zh: 一条皮制副缰让小马的头保持高昂。

e.en: The sergeant called every name on the {checkroll}.
e.zh: 中士点了名册上每一个名字。

e.en: Workers' wages were entered into the company {checkroll}.
e.zh: 工人的工资记入了公司的考勤表。

e.en: Please leave your coat at the {checkroom}.
e.zh: 请把外套放在衣帽间。

e.en: She picked up her bag from the hotel {checkroom}.
e.zh: 她从酒店寄存处取回了包。

checkrow.t: 棋盘式播种；按方格行栽种

e.en: Farmers used to {checkrow} corn for easier weeding.
e.zh: 农民过去用棋盘式播种玉米以便除草。

e.en: This old planter could {checkrow} seeds in straight grids.
e.zh: 这台旧播种机能把种子排成方格。

checkrowed.t: 已按方格行栽种；棋盘式播种过的

e.en: He {checkrowed} the field last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天他用棋盘式方法播种了那块田。

e.en: The corn was carefully {checkrowed} by hand.
e.zh: 这片玉米是人工棋盘式播种的。

checkrowing.t: 正进行棋盘式播种；方格栽种

e.en: {Checkrowing} made cross-cultivation possible.
e.zh: 棋盘式播种使交叉中耕成为可能。

e.en: He learned {checkrowing} from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他跟祖父学会了棋盘式播种。

checkrows.t: 棋盘式行；方格状的播种行

e.en: The seeds sprouted in neat {checkrows}.
e.zh: 种子在整齐的棋盘行中发芽。

e.en: He planted his beans in tidy {checkrows}.
e.zh: 他把豆子种成整齐的方格行。

checkstring.t: 马车内的信号绳；提醒车夫的拉绳

e.en: She pulled the {checkstring} to signal the driver.
e.zh: 她拉了一下信号绳示意车夫。

e.en: Each carriage seat had a silk {checkstring} above it.
e.zh: 马车里每个座位上方都有一根丝绸信号绳。

checktaker.t: 剧院或车站的检票员；查票员

e.en: The {checktaker} stood at the theater door.
e.zh: 检票员守在剧院门口。

e.en: Each passenger handed a ticket to the {checktaker}.
e.zh: 每位乘客把票交给检票员。

checkweighman.t: 矿工选派的过磅员；验煤员

e.en: The miners elected a {checkweighman} to guard their interests.
e.zh: 矿工们推选了一位验煤员来维护他们的利益。

e.en: A new {checkweighman} began work at the colliery.
e.zh: 一位新的过磅员在煤矿上岗。

checkwork.t: 核对工作；棋盘格状的图案

e.en: She finished the {checkwork} on the tax forms.
e.zh: 她完成了报税单的核对工作。

e.en: The tile floor displayed an elegant {checkwork}.
e.zh: 瓷砖地面呈现出优雅的格子图案。

cheddite.t: 切迪炸药；一种含氯酸盐的炸药

e.en: The quarry blasted rock with {cheddite}.
e.zh: 采石场用切迪炸药爆破岩石。

e.en: {Cheddite} was once popular in mining operations.
e.zh: 切迪炸药曾在采矿作业中广泛使用。

cheechako.t: 新到阿拉斯加或育空地区的菜鸟

e.en: Every {cheechako} learned to dread the long winter.
e.zh: 每个新来阿拉斯加的人都学会了畏惧漫长的冬天。

e.en: The old miner laughed at the eager {cheechako}.
e.zh: 老矿工嘲笑那个跃跃欲试的新手。

cheekful.t: 满满一腮的量；一口的份量

e.en: He spoke with a {cheekful} of bread.
e.zh: 他嘴里塞着满满一腮面包说话。

e.en: The squirrel scampered off with a {cheekful} of nuts.
e.zh: 松鼠塞了一腮坚果跑开了。

cheekiness.t: 厚脸皮；放肆；俏皮的态度

e.en: His {cheekiness} got him into trouble again.
e.zh: 他的放肆又让他惹上了麻烦。

e.en: I admire the gentle {cheekiness} of her humor.
e.zh: 我欣赏她幽默中那种温和的俏皮。

cheekpiece.t: 马笼头的颊片；枪托的颊托

e.en: He adjusted the rifle's {cheekpiece} before aiming.
e.zh: 他在瞄准前调整了步枪的颊托。

e.en: The bridle's leather {cheekpiece} had cracked.
e.zh: 马笼头上的皮颊片裂开了。

cheekybone.t: 颧骨；cheekbone 的非标准拼法

e.en: A bruise spread across his {cheekybone}.
e.zh: 他颧骨上漫开一片淤青。

e.en: Her high {cheekybone} caught the afternoon light.
e.zh: 她高高的颧骨映着午后的光。

e.en: She was the school's most enthusiastic {cheer-leader}.
e.zh: 她是学校最热情的啦啦队长。

e.en: The {cheer-leader} rallied the crowd before kickoff.
e.zh: 啦啦队长在开球前调动了观众情绪。

cheer-up.t: 鼓励的话；振作之物；安慰

e.en: He needed a real {cheer-up} after the bad news.
e.zh: 听到坏消息后他需要好好振作一下。

e.en: Her funny card was just the {cheer-up} I needed.
