e.zh: 她那张搞笑卡片正是我需要的安慰。

cheerfulfully.t: 愉快地；高兴地；cheerfully 的非标准拼写

e.en: He {cheerfulfully} agreed to help with the move.
e.zh: 他爽快地答应帮忙搬家。

e.en: She greeted us {cheerfulfully} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早晨都开心地跟我们打招呼。

cheerioh.t: 再见；干杯；你好；cheerio 的变体

e.en: He waved and called {cheerioh} from the doorway.
e.zh: 他在门口挥手喊了声再见。

e.en: {Cheerioh}! See you all next week.
e.zh: 再见啦！咱们下周见。

cheerlead.t: 当啦啦队员；摇旗呐喊；助威

e.en: She loves to {cheerlead} at football games.
e.zh: 她喜欢在橄榄球比赛上当啦啦队员。

e.en: Politicians often {cheerlead} for their own policies.
e.zh: 政客常为自己的政策摇旗呐喊。

cheero.t: 再见；干杯；英式口语招呼语

e.en: {Cheero}, mate, see you tomorrow.
e.zh: 再见啦，伙计，明天见。

e.en: He raised his glass and said {cheero}.
e.zh: 他举起酒杯说了声干杯。

e.en: She ordered a slice of {cheese-cake} for dessert.
e.zh: 她点了一块奶酪蛋糕当甜点。

e.en: This {cheese-cake} has a graham cracker crust.
e.zh: 这块芝士蛋糕底是全麦饼干做的。

e.en: The Swiss {cheese-maker} explained his craft.
e.zh: 那位瑞士制奶酪师讲解了他的手艺。

e.en: She trained as a {cheese-maker} in France.
e.zh: 她在法国学习当奶酪师傅。

e.en: His {cheese-paring} habits annoyed his family.
e.zh: 他锱铢必较的习惯惹恼了家人。

e.en: The company's {cheese-paring} budget hurt morale.
e.zh: 公司吝啬的预算打击了员工士气。

cheese-plate.t: 餐前的奶酪拼盘；奶酪小食盘

e.en: We shared a {cheese-plate} before dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐前我们分享了一份奶酪拼盘。

e.en: Her {cheese-plate} included grapes and walnuts.
e.zh: 她的奶酪拼盘里配了葡萄和核桃。

cheesebox.t: 盛奶酪的盒子；木制奶酪盒

e.en: She kept her sewing notions in an old {cheesebox}.
e.zh: 她把缝纫小物存放在一个旧奶酪盒里。

e.en: The wooden {cheesebox} smelled faintly of cheddar.
e.zh: 那个木制奶酪盒还隐约带着切达奶酪的味道。

cheeselike.t: 奶酪般的；具有奶酪质地的

e.en: The pudding had a {cheeselike} texture.
e.zh: 这布丁有奶酪般的口感。

e.en: A {cheeselike} odor filled the cellar.
e.zh: 地窖里弥漫着一股奶酪般的气味。

e.en: The local {cheesemonger} stocked over fifty varieties.
e.zh: 当地的奶酪商备有五十多个品种。

e.en: She bought a wedge of brie from her favorite {cheesemonger}.
e.zh: 她从最喜欢的奶酪商那里买了一块布里干酪。

cheesemongers.t: 奶酪商；卖奶酪的人；复数形式

e.en: Several {cheesemongers} set up stalls at the fair.
e.zh: 几位奶酪商在集市上摆起了摊位。

e.en: London's old {cheesemongers} once lined this street.
e.zh: 伦敦的老牌奶酪店曾经遍布这条街。

cheeseparing.t: 吝啬；锱铢必较；省吃俭用

e.en: Years of {cheeseparing} finally paid for the trip.
e.zh: 多年的省吃俭用终于换来了这次旅行。

e.en: His {cheeseparing} approach to the budget was unpopular.
e.zh: 他对预算锱铢必较的做法不受欢迎。

cheesesteak.t: 奶酪牛排三明治；费城牛肉芝士堡

e.en: He ordered a Philly {cheesesteak} for lunch.
e.zh: 他午餐点了一份费城奶酪牛排三明治。

e.en: This diner makes the best {cheesesteak} in town.
e.zh: 这家小餐馆做镇上最棒的奶酪牛排三明治。

cheesier.t: 更俗气的；更老套的；更感伤的

e.en: The sequel was even {cheesier} than the first film.
e.zh: 续集比第一部电影还要老套。

e.en: Her jokes got {cheesier} as the night wore on.
e.zh: 夜越深，她的笑话越俗气。

cheesiest.t: 最俗气的；最老套的；最肉麻的

e.en: That was the {cheesiest} pickup line I've ever heard.
e.zh: 那是我听过最老土的搭讪话。

e.en: He picked the {cheesiest} love song on the playlist.
e.zh: 他选了播放列表里最肉麻的情歌。

e.en: This novel is widely regarded as her {chef-d'oeuvre}.
e.zh: 这部小说被普遍视为她的代表作。

e.en: The painting is the artist's undisputed {chef-d'oeuvre}.
e.zh: 这幅画是这位艺术家无可争议的杰作。

e.en: Critics hailed the symphony as a {chefdoeuvre}.
e.zh: 评论家盛赞这部交响曲为杰作。

e.en: Few writers ever produce more than one {chefdoeuvre}.
e.zh: 很少有作家能写出不止一部代表作。

chefdom.t: 厨师界；主厨身份；厨师圈

e.en: He has reached the highest rank of {chefdom}.
e.zh: 他已跻身厨界最高等级。

e.en: Television has reshaped modern {chefdom}.
e.zh: 电视改变了现代厨师行业的面貌。

cheilitis.t: 唇炎；嘴唇红肿发炎的病症

e.en: Cold weather often triggers {cheilitis}.
e.zh: 寒冷的天气常常诱发唇炎。

e.en: The doctor prescribed an ointment for her {cheilitis}.
e.zh: 医生为她的唇炎开了药膏。

cheilodromous.t: 边缘脉的；叶脉沿叶缘走向的

e.en: The leaf shows a clearly {cheilodromous} venation pattern.
e.zh: 这片叶子呈现明显的边缘脉脉序。

e.en: Botanists describe many willows as {cheilodromous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把许多柳树描述为边缘脉植物。

cheiloplasty.t: 唇成形术；嘴唇整形手术

e.en: The patient underwent {cheiloplasty} to repair the cleft.
e.zh: 病人接受了唇成形术修复唇裂。

e.en: Modern {cheiloplasty} techniques produce minimal scarring.
e.zh: 现代唇成形术几乎不留疤痕。

e.en: The {chiru} lives on the Tibetan plateau.
e.zh: 藏羚羊生活在青藏高原上。

e.en: Poachers hunt the {chiru} for its fine wool.
e.zh: 偷猎者为获取细羊毛而捕猎藏羚羊。

e.en: In old texts a surgeon was called a {chirurgeon}.
e.zh: 古籍中外科医生被称作 chirurgeon。

e.en: The village {chirurgeon} set the broken bone.
e.zh: 村里的外科医生为骨折复位。

e.en: Medieval {chirurgery} was crude and dangerous.
e.zh: 中世纪的外科手术粗糙且危险。

e.en: He studied {chirurgery} under a famous master.
e.zh: 他师从一位名医学习外科。

e.en: They spent the afternoon in idle {chit-chat}.
e.zh: 他们整个下午都在闲聊。

e.en: Enough {chit-chat}—let's get to work.
e.zh: 别再闲扯了，开始干活吧。

e.en: A herd of {chital} grazed near the river.
e.zh: 一群花鹿在河边吃草。

e.en: The tiger stalked a young {chital}.
e.zh: 老虎悄悄逼近一只小斑鹿。

e.en: Some fungi secrete {chitinase} to break down insect shells.
e.zh: 有些真菌分泌几丁质酶以分解昆虫外壳。

e.en: Plants use {chitinase} as a defense enzyme.
e.zh: 植物把几丁质酶当作防御酶。

e.en: {Chitinization} hardens the insect's new exoskeleton.
e.zh: 几丁质化使昆虫的新外骨骼变硬。

e.en: The cuticle undergoes {chitinization} after molting.
e.zh: 蜕皮后表皮发生几丁质化。

e.en: Grandma fried up a pot of {chitlin}.
e.zh: 奶奶炸了一锅猪小肠。

e.en: {Chitlin} is a soul food classic.
e.zh: 猪小肠是经典的灵魂料理。

e.en: They served {chitlings} at the family reunion.
e.zh: 家庭聚会上端出了猪小肠。

e.en: He grew up eating {chitlings} every winter.
e.zh: 他从小每年冬天都吃猪小肠。

e.en: A {chiton} clung tightly to the tide-pool rock.
e.zh: 一只石鳖紧紧吸附在潮池岩石上。

e.en: The statue wears a flowing {chiton}.
e.zh: 雕像身着飘逸的古希腊长袍。

e.en: The {chittamwood} turns bright orange in autumn.
e.zh: 美洲苦木到了秋天变得橙红一片。

e.en: Birds love the berries of the {chittamwood}.
e.zh: 鸟儿喜欢吃美洲苦木的浆果。

e.en: He simmered the {chitterlings} for hours.
e.zh: 他把猪小肠炖了好几个小时。

e.en: {Chitterlings} are a holiday tradition in the South.
e.zh: 猪小肠是美国南方的节日传统菜肴。

e.en: He pulled a {chiv} from his sleeve.
e.zh: 他从袖子里抽出一把刀。

e.en: The inmate threatened to {chiv} him.
e.zh: 那囚犯威胁要拿刀捅他。

chivaree.t: 婚后吵闹的恶作剧庆祝

e.en: Neighbors held a noisy {chivaree} for the newlyweds.
e.zh: 邻居们给新婚夫妇办了一场吵闹的闹洞房。

e.en: The old {chivaree} tradition has faded.
e.zh: 古老的闹婚传统已渐渐消失。

e.en: She {chivied} the kids out of bed.
e.zh: 她催孩子们起床。

e.en: He {chivied} his team to finish on time.
e.zh: 他催促团队按时完成。

e.en: Don't {chivy} me—I'm almost done.
e.zh: 别催我，我快做完了。

e.en: He had to {chivy} them along.
e.zh: 他不得不一直催他们。

e.en: Stop {chivying} me about the deadline.
e.zh: 别再催我赶截止日期了。

e.en: She kept {chivying} the children to hurry.
e.zh: 她不停地催孩子们快一点。

e.en: What a {chiz}—the picnic was rained out.
e.zh: 真扫兴，野餐被雨给泡汤了。

e.en: Losing the match was a real {chiz}.
e.zh: 输掉比赛真是糟透了。

e.en: The botanist labelled the flower as {chlamydeous}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种花标注为有花被的。

e.en: Most blossoms are {chlamydeous} in structure.
e.zh: 大多数花的结构都带有花被。

e.en: The fungus survives winter as a {chlamydospore}.
e.zh: 这种真菌以厚垣孢子的形式越冬。

e.en: Each {chlamydospore} has a thick protective wall.
e.zh: 每个厚垣孢子都有一层厚厚的保护壁。

e.en: The soldier wore a short {chlamys} over his armour.
e.zh: 士兵在盔甲外披着一件短披风。

e.en: A red {chlamys} marked him as a messenger.
e.zh: 一件红色披风标明他是信使。

e.en: The actors donned matching {chlamyses}.
e.zh: 演员们披上了款式相同的希腊披风。

e.en: Several {chlamyses} hung in the museum case.
e.zh: 博物馆展柜里挂着几件希腊披风。

e.en: Pregnancy can cause {chloasma} on the face.
e.zh: 怀孕可能导致面部出现黄褐斑。

e.en: She used sunscreen to fade her {chloasma}.
e.zh: 她用防晒霜来淡化黄褐斑。

e.en: Workers exposed to dioxin developed {chloracne}.
e.zh: 接触二噁英的工人得了氯痤疮。

e.en: {Chloracne} can leave lasting facial scars.
e.zh: 氯痤疮可能在脸上留下持久的疤痕。

e.en: Potassium {chlorate} is used in fireworks.
e.zh: 氯酸钾用于制造烟花。

e.en: The lab stored {chlorate} compounds carefully.
e.zh: 实验室小心地存放氯酸盐化合物。

e.en: She drinks {chlorella} powder for its nutrients.
e.zh: 她饮用小球藻粉以摄取养分。

e.en: {Chlorella} grows quickly in fresh water.
e.zh: 小球藻在淡水中生长迅速。

e.en: The dentist rinsed her mouth with {chlorhexidine}.
e.zh: 牙医用氯己定为她漱口。

e.en: {Chlorhexidine} is a common antiseptic in hospitals.
e.zh: 氯己定是医院常用的消毒剂。

e.en: {Chloric} acid is highly corrosive.
e.zh: 氯酸具有强腐蚀性。

e.en: They studied the {chloric} compound's stability.
e.zh: 他们研究了这种含氯化合物的稳定性。

e.en: They {chloridize} the silver before extraction.
e.zh: 他们在提炼前对银进行氯化处理。

e.en: The ore was {chloridized} with salt.
e.zh: 矿石用盐进行了氯化处理。

e.en: The technician calibrated the {chlorimeter} carefully.
e.zh: 技术员仔细地校准了测氯仪。

e.en: A {chlorimeter} measures chlorine in water.
e.zh: 测氯仪用于测量水中的氯含量。

e.en: {Chlorimetry} helps assess pool water quality.
e.zh: 氯量法有助于评估泳池水质。

e.en: He used {chlorimetry} to test the sample.
e.zh: 他用氯滴定法检测样品。

e.en: Seawater {chlorinity} affects marine life.
e.zh: 海水的氯度影响海洋生物。

e.en: They measured the {chlorinity} of the sample.
e.zh: 他们测量了样品的氯度。

chimneysweep.t: 扫烟囱的工人；清洁烟囱者

e.en: The {chimneysweep} arrived at dawn covered in soot.
e.zh: 扫烟囱的工人天一亮就到了，浑身是煤灰。

e.en: In Victorian London, many children worked as {chimneysweeps}.
e.zh: 在维多利亚时代的伦敦，许多孩子都当扫烟囱工。

chin-chin.t: 干杯；（英式口语）你好；再见

e.en: He raised his glass and said {chin-chin}.
e.zh: 他举起酒杯说了声“干杯”。

e.en: {Chin-chin}, everyone—here's to a great year ahead!
e.zh: 诸位干杯，敬来年顺利！

chin-deep.t: 齐下巴深的；陷得极深的

e.en: The pond was {chin-deep} near the middle.
e.zh: 池塘中间的水深到下巴。

e.en: She was {chin-deep} in unpaid bills this month.
e.zh: 这个月她欠了一屁股的账单。

e.en: He can do twenty {chin-ups} in a row.
e.zh: 他能一口气做二十个引体向上。

e.en: {Chin-ups} are great for building back muscles.
e.zh: 引体向上很适合锻炼背部肌肉。

e.en: We had a long {chin-wag} over coffee.
e.zh: 我们喝着咖啡聊了很久。

e.en: Stop the {chin-wag} and get back to work.
e.zh: 别再闲聊了，赶紧干活。

e.en: She painted the bedroom a soft {china-blue}.
e.zh: 她把卧室刷成了柔和的瓷蓝色。

e.en: His eyes were a striking {china-blue}.
e.zh: 他有一双明亮的瓷蓝色眼睛。

e.en: Mark the slide with a {chinagraph} before staining.
e.zh: 染色前用蜡笔在载玻片上做记号。

e.en: He labelled each test tube with a {chinagraph}.
e.zh: 他用蜡笔给每支试管做了标记。

e.en: Cornish {chinastone} was prized by porcelain makers.
e.zh: 康沃尔产的瓷石深受瓷器工匠青睐。

e.en: The kiln required finely ground {chinastone}.
e.zh: 这种窑炉需要研磨得很细的瓷石。

e.en: She collected antique {chinaware} from local auctions.
e.zh: 她在当地拍卖会上收藏古董瓷器。

e.en: The shop sells handmade {chinaware} from Jingdezhen.
e.zh: 这家店出售景德镇的手工瓷器。

e.en: He bruised his {chinbone} when he tripped.
e.zh: 他绊倒时把下巴骨磕青了。

e.en: The punch landed squarely on his {chinbone}.
e.zh: 那一拳正中他的下颌骨。

e.en: {Chinch} bugs ruined the entire lawn.
e.zh: 麦长蝽把整片草坪都毁了。

e.en: The old mattress had a bad {chinch} infestation.
e.zh: 那张旧床垫闹了严重的臭虫。

e.en: Don't be {chinchy} with the tip tonight.
e.zh: 今晚别在小费上太抠门。

e.en: He was too {chinchy} to buy his sister a present.
e.zh: 他小气得连给妹妹买件礼物都舍不得。

e.en: The village doctor diagnosed the child with {chincough}.
e.zh: 村里的医生诊断那孩子得了百日咳。

e.en: Many children once died of {chincough} before vaccines existed.
e.zh: 在没有疫苗之前，许多孩子死于百日咳。

e.en: She always carries a {Chinese-English} dictionary to class.
e.zh: 她上课总带着一本汉英词典。

e.en: The school offers a {Chinese-English} bilingual program.
e.zh: 这所学校开设中英双语项目。

e.en: The lacquer box was a deep {Chinese-red}.
e.zh: 那个漆盒是浓郁的中国红。

e.en: She wore a {Chinese-red} silk dress to the wedding.
e.zh: 她穿了一件中国红的丝绸礼服去参加婚礼。

e.en: The reunion turned into an all-night {chinfest}.
e.zh: 那场聚会变成了一夜的侃大山。

e.en: Their phone call was a real {chinfest} as usual.
e.zh: 他们的电话照例聊了个没完。

chinky.t: 有裂缝的；（贬义、冒犯）中国式的

e.en: The old fence had several {chinky} gaps.
e.zh: 那道旧栅栏上有好几条裂缝。

e.en: Cold air poured through the {chinky} wooden walls.
e.zh: 冷风从有裂缝的木墙里灌进来。

e.en: Sailors had to {chinse} the deck seams before storms.
e.zh: 水手们必须在风暴来临前填塞甲板的缝隙。

e.en: They used oakum to {chinse} the leaking hull.
e.zh: 他们用麻絮填塞漏水的船体。

e.en: Polar bears are classic {chionophiles} of the Arctic.
e.zh: 北极熊是典型的北极喜雪动物。

e.en: Certain mosses are {chionophiles} that thrive beneath snow.
e.zh: 某些苔藓是喜雪植物，在雪下生长得很好。

e.en: Many alpine plants are {chionophilous} by nature.
e.zh: 许多高山植物天生就喜雪。

e.en: This {chionophilous} lichen grows only on snowy peaks.
e.zh: 这种喜雪的地衣只生长在积雪的山峰上。

e.en: Most desert reptiles are typical {chionophobes}.
e.zh: 大多数沙漠爬行动物都是典型的畏雪物种。

e.en: Tropical species are {chionophobes} that cannot survive winter.
e.zh: 热带物种畏雪，无法熬过冬天。

chicken-and-egg.t: 鸡生蛋蛋生鸡式的；因果难分先后的

e.en: It's a {chicken-and-egg} question whether confidence breeds success or success breeds confidence.
e.zh: 自信带来成功还是成功带来自信，这是个先有鸡还是先有蛋的问题。

e.en: We face a {chicken-and-egg} problem: no users without features, no features without users.
e.zh: 我们面临一个鸡生蛋蛋生鸡的难题：没用户就没功能，没功能就没用户。

chicken-breasted.t: 鸡胸的；胸骨前凸畸形的

e.en: The doctor noted that the boy was slightly {chicken-breasted} due to childhood rickets.
e.zh: 医生指出这男孩因小时候患过佝偻病而略有鸡胸。

e.en: His thin, {chicken-breasted} frame made the uniform hang loosely.
e.zh: 他瘦削的鸡胸身材让制服穿着松松垮垮。

e.en: The butcher tossed the {chicken-head} into the soup pot for stock.
e.zh: 屠夫把鸡头扔进汤锅里熬高汤。

e.en: Don't act like such a {chicken-head} when the boss is watching.
e.zh: 老板看着的时候别表现得那么蠢笨。

e.en: Don't be so {chicken-hearted}; just ask her to dance.
e.zh: 别那么胆小，去请她跳支舞嘛。

e.en: His {chicken-hearted} silence at the meeting cost him the promotion.
e.zh: 他在会上懦弱地沉默，错失了升职机会。

chicken-livered.t: 胆小如鼠的；懦弱怯懦的

e.en: He sneered that his rival was a {chicken-livered} coward.
e.zh: 他冷嘲热讽道，对手是个胆小如鼠的懦夫。

e.en: Their {chicken-livered} retreat at the first volley shocked the general.
e.zh: 他们一遇齐射就懦弱撤退，令将军震惊。

chicken-wire.t: 六角网状铁丝网；细铁丝网

e.en: We fenced the vegetable patch with {chicken-wire} to keep rabbits out.
e.zh: 我们用铁丝网把菜地围起来，防止兔子进入。

e.en: The old coop sagged under rusting {chicken-wire}.
e.zh: 旧鸡舍因生锈的铁丝网而塌陷。

chickenfeed.t: 微不足道的小钱；少量饲料

e.en: The bonus was {chickenfeed} compared to what executives earned.
e.zh: 和高管的收入相比，这点奖金算是九牛一毛。

e.en: She sells secondhand novels for {chickenfeed} at the flea market.
e.zh: 她在跳蚤市场以极低廉的价格出售旧小说。

e.en: Don't be so {chickenhearted} about confronting your landlord.
e.zh: 和房东对质时别这么胆小怯懦。

e.en: His {chickenhearted} apology only made things worse.
e.zh: 他懦弱的道歉只让事情更糟。

e.en: Their {chickenlivered} captain abandoned the crew at the first storm.
e.zh: 他们怯懦的船长在第一场风暴时就抛下了船员。

e.en: I'm too {chickenlivered} to ride that giant roller coaster.
e.zh: 我太胆小了，不敢去坐那个巨型过山车。

e.en: Hey {chickie}, want to grab some coffee after class?
e.zh: 嘿小妞，下课后要不要去喝杯咖啡？

e.en: A fluffy yellow {chickie} pecked at the corn.
e.zh: 一只毛茸茸的黄色小鸡崽啄着玉米粒。

chicklet.t: 小方块物；口香糖小片状物

e.en: Her teeth were as white and even as little {chicklets}.
e.zh: 她的牙齿洁白整齐，像一颗颗小方糖。

e.en: The laptop has a {chicklet}-style keyboard with shallow keys.
e.zh: 这款笔记本配有方块状的浅键程键盘。

e.en: Farmers in arid regions grow {chickling} as drought-tolerant fodder.
e.zh: 干旱地区的农民种植山黧豆作为耐旱饲料。

e.en: A tiny {chickling} pecked nervously at the grain.
e.zh: 一只小小的雏鸡紧张地啄着谷粒。

chiclet.t: 小方块状物；如键帽或小药片

e.en: The keyboard's {chiclet} keys click satisfyingly under my fingertips.
e.zh: 键盘的方块键在我指尖下发出令人满足的咔嗒声。

e.en: She popped a sugary {chiclet} into her mouth before the meeting.
e.zh: 开会前她往嘴里扔了一片甜甜的方糖口香糖。

chicquer.t: 更别致的；更时尚优雅的

e.en: Her tailored coat looks even {chicquer} than last season's design.
e.zh: 她那件剪裁合体的外套比上季的款式更显别致。

e.en: The renovated boutique feels far {chicquer} than its rivals.
e.zh: 翻新后的精品店比同行店铺时尚得多。

chicquest.t: 最别致的；最时尚优雅的

e.en: She wore the {chicquest} outfit at the gala that night.
e.zh: 那晚她在晚宴上穿着最别致的服装。

e.en: It is the {chicquest} restaurant in the entire neighborhood.
e.zh: 这是整个街区最时髦优雅的餐厅。

chid.t: 责骂；斥责（chide 的过去式）

e.en: She {chid} him gently for forgetting their anniversary.
e.zh: 她温和地责备他忘记了他们的纪念日。

e.en: The schoolmaster {chid} the unruly pupils for their racket.
e.zh: 校长斥责那些吵闹捣乱的学生。

chidded.t: 责骂（chide 的非标准过去式）

e.en: Grandma {chidded} the boy for tracking mud across the floor.
e.zh: 奶奶责备男孩把泥踩得满地都是。

e.en: They {chidded} him softly until he hung his head.
e.zh: 他们轻声责备他，直到他低下头。

chidden.t: 受责备的（chide 的过去分词）

e.en: Having been {chidden}, the apprentice stared at his shoes in shame.
e.zh: 被责备过后，学徒羞愧地盯着自己的鞋子。

e.en: The {chidden} child whispered an apology to his mother.
e.zh: 挨了训的孩子小声向母亲道歉。

e.en: She glanced {chidingly} at the chatty students in the back.
e.zh: 她责备地瞥了一眼后排闲聊的学生。

e.en: He spoke {chidingly}, but his eyes brimmed with affection.
e.zh: 他语气责备，眼里却满是疼爱。

e.en: The tribe's {chiefess} delivered a stirring speech to the assembly.
e.zh: 部落的女酋长向大会发表了激动人心的讲话。

e.en: As {chiefess}, she negotiated treaties with neighboring clans.
e.zh: 作为女首领，她与邻近部族协商订立条约。

e.en: After the rebellion the village remained {chiefless} for months.
e.zh: 叛乱过后，村子群龙无首长达数月。

e.en: A {chiefless} clan quickly fell into squabbling factions.
e.zh: 无首领的部族很快陷入派系纷争。

e.en: His elder brother inherited the {chiefship} after their father died.
e.zh: 父亲去世后，他的兄长继承了首领之位。

e.en: She earned the {chiefship} through decades of loyal service.
e.zh: 她凭借几十年忠心耿耿的奉献赢得了酋长之位。

e.en: The young {chiel} doffed his cap politely as we passed.
e.zh: 那年轻的小伙子在我们经过时礼貌地脱帽致意。

e.en: He's a sturdy {chiel} from a Highland farming family.
e.zh: 他是个出身高地农家、身板结实的小伙子。

chield.t: 【苏格兰】小伙子；男子（chiel 异体）

e.en: A canny {chield} from Aberdeen offered us directions.
e.zh: 一个来自阿伯丁的精明小伙子给我们指了路。

e.en: The poet wrote fondly of every {chield} in his village.
e.zh: 诗人深情地写下了村里每一个小伙子。

e.en: A {chiff-chaff} was singing brightly from the willow branches.
e.zh: 一只叽喳柳莺在柳枝间清脆地鸣唱。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted an early {chiff-chaff} arriving in March.
e.zh: 观鸟者在三月发现了一只早到的叽喳柳莺。

e.en: The {chiffchaff} repeats its name in a simple two-note song.
e.zh: 叽喳柳莺以简单的两音节啼声反复呼喊自己的名字。

e.en: We heard a lone {chiffchaff} calling near the pond.
e.zh: 我们听见一只孤单的叽喳柳莺在池塘边鸣叫。

chiffchaffs.t: 叽喳柳莺；chiffchaff 的复数形式

e.en: {Chiffchaffs} arrive in Britain from Africa each early spring.
e.zh: 叽喳柳莺每年早春从非洲飞抵英国。

e.en: Several {chiffchaffs} flitted busily among the budding willows.
e.zh: 几只叽喳柳莺在抽芽的柳树间忙碌地穿梭。

chiffonnier.t: 高脚衣物柜；窄高型五斗橱

e.en: She kept her embroidered linens in an antique {chiffonnier}.
e.zh: 她把绣花亚麻布料收在一个古董五斗橱里。

e.en: The mahogany {chiffonnier} stood proudly in the corner.
e.zh: 那个红木高脚衣柜稳稳地立在角落里。

chifforobe.t: 衣柜抽屉合体的家具；衣帽橱

e.en: Mama hung my Sunday dress carefully in the bedroom {chifforobe}.
e.zh: 妈妈把我礼拜天穿的裙子小心地挂在卧室的衣帽橱里。

e.en: The old {chifforobe} was crammed with quilts and woolen coats.
e.zh: 那个旧衣帽橱里塞满了被褥和毛呢大衣。

chigoe.t: 沙蚤；穿皮潜蚤热带寄生虫

e.en: Travelers should beware of {chigoe} fleas in tropical sandy areas.
e.zh: 旅行者在热带沙地需小心沙蚤。

e.en: A {chigoe} burrowed into his toe and laid its eggs.
e.zh: 一只沙蚤钻进他的脚趾并产了卵。

child-bearer.t: 生育者；生育子女的女性

e.en: Society long undervalued the labor of {child-bearers} and homemakers.
e.zh: 社会长期低估了生育者和持家女性的辛劳。

e.en: She refused to be defined merely as a {child-bearer}.
e.zh: 她拒绝被仅仅定义为一个生育者。

child-centered.t: 以儿童为中心的；以孩子为本的

e.en: Their preschool follows a strictly {child-centered} curriculum.
e.zh: 他们的幼儿园严格采用以儿童为中心的课程。

e.en: Therapists increasingly favor a {child-centered} approach to trauma.
e.zh: 治疗师越来越青睐以儿童为本的创伤治疗方法。

child-centred.t: 以儿童为中心的（英式拼写）

e.en: British primary schools widely embrace {child-centred} learning.
e.zh: 英国小学普遍采用以儿童为中心的学习方式。

e.en: Her {child-centred} teaching style won praise from parents.
e.zh: 她以儿童为本的教学风格赢得了家长们的赞赏。

child-free.t: 无子女的；选择不要孩子的

e.en: Many young couples now choose to remain happily {child-free}.
e.zh: 如今许多年轻夫妇选择愉快地不要孩子。

e.en: The resort offers {child-free} zones around its quieter pools.
e.zh: 该度假村在安静的泳池区设有无儿童区域。

child-mind.t: 代为照看孩子；当临时保姆

e.en: She earns extra income by {child-minding} for two neighbors.
e.zh: 她通过给两户邻居照看孩子赚取额外收入。

e.en: I {child-mind} for my niece every Saturday afternoon.
e.zh: 我每周六下午都帮忙照看我侄女。

choanocyte.t: 领细胞；海绵动物的鞭毛细胞

e.en: Sponges filter water using {choanocytes} lining their inner chambers.
e.zh: 海绵利用内腔中的领细胞过滤水。

e.en: Each {choanocyte} has a flagellum surrounded by a collar.
e.zh: 每个领细胞都有一根鞭毛，周围环绕着领状结构。

choc-ice.t: 巧克力雪糕；巧克力涂层冰淇淋

e.en: She bought a {choc-ice} from the kiosk.
e.zh: 她在小卖部买了一支巧克力雪糕。

e.en: Kids love eating a {choc-ice} on hot days.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在大热天吃巧克力雪糕。

e.en: He stocked the freezer with {choc-ices} for summer.
e.zh: 他在冰柜里塞满了巧克力雪糕过夏天。

e.en: The kids fought over the last two {choc-ices}.
e.zh: 孩子们抢着最后两支巧克力雪糕。

chocaholic.t: 嗜食巧克力的人；巧克力狂

e.en: She is a self-confessed {chocaholic}.
e.zh: 她自称是个巧克力狂。

e.en: Every {chocaholic} dreams of visiting that factory.
e.zh: 每个巧克力迷都梦想参观那家工厂。

e.en: Fancy a bit of {choccy} after dinner?
e.zh: 晚饭后想吃点巧克力吗？

e.en: He hid his {choccy} stash from the kids.
e.zh: 他把巧克力藏起来不让孩子们发现。

e.en: He grabbed a {chocice} from the freezer.
e.zh: 他从冰柜里拿了一支巧克力雪糕。

e.en: Nothing beats a {chocice} on a sunny afternoon.
e.zh: 阳光明媚的下午没什么比巧克力雪糕更棒。

chock-full.t: 塞得满满的；填得满满的

e.en: The fridge is {chock-full} of leftovers.
e.zh: 冰箱里塞满了剩菜。

e.en: His essay was {chock-full} of clever ideas.
e.zh: 他的文章充满了精妙的见解。

e.en: The market was {chockablock} on Saturday morning.
e.zh: 周六早晨市场里挤得水泄不通。

e.en: His notebook was {chockablock} with sketches.
e.zh: 他的笔记本里满是速写。

e.en: The climbers slung a rope around the {chockstone}.
e.zh: 攀岩者在卡塞石上绕了一圈绳子。

e.en: A massive {chockstone} blocked the gully.
e.zh: 一块巨大的卡石堵住了岩沟。

e.en: He offered me a piece of {choco}.
e.zh: 他给了我一块巧克力。

e.en: The kids begged for some {choco} after lunch.
e.zh: 孩子们午饭后嚷着要吃巧克力。

chocolate-box.t: 过分甜美的；俗艳唯美的

e.en: The village had a {chocolate-box} prettiness.
e.zh: 那村庄美得像糖盒画一样俗气甜腻。

e.en: Critics dismissed the painting as {chocolate-box} kitsch.
e.zh: 评论家斥这幅画为俗艳的糖盒美学。

e.en: She wore a {chocolate-brown} coat to dinner.
e.zh: 她穿了一件巧克力色的大衣去吃饭。

e.en: The dog had soft {chocolate-brown} fur.
e.zh: 那只狗有着柔软的巧克力色毛皮。

e.en: He was {choiceful} about the wines he served.
e.zh: 他对所上的葡萄酒十分挑剔。

e.en: She is {choiceful} with her words in interviews.
e.zh: 她在采访中遣词用字十分讲究。

choirgirl.t: 唱诗班女童；女童唱诗成员

e.en: The {choirgirl} sang a solo at midnight mass.
e.zh: 那位唱诗班女孩在午夜弥撒上独唱。

e.en: She had been a {choirgirl} since the age of seven.
e.zh: 她从七岁起就是唱诗班的女孩。

e.en: The singers gathered in the {choirloft} above the nave.
e.zh: 歌者们聚集在中殿上方的唱诗楼厢。

e.en: Sunlight streamed into the empty {choirloft}.
e.zh: 阳光洒进空荡的唱诗楼厢。

e.en: The veteran {choirman} led the bass section.
e.zh: 那位资深的唱诗班男成员带领着低音声部。

e.en: Each {choirman} wore a long black robe.
e.zh: 每位唱诗班男成员都穿着长长的黑袍。

e.en: Miners feared the silent threat of {choke-damp}.
e.zh: 矿工们害怕那无声的窒息瓦斯。

e.en: {Choke-damp} had filled the lower shaft.
e.zh: 窒息气已充满下层矿井。

e.en: The barn was {choke-full} of hay.
e.zh: 谷仓里塞满了干草。

e.en: His pockets were {choke-full} of coins.
e.zh: 他口袋里塞得满满都是硬币。

choke-joint.t: 扼流接头；波导阻塞接头

e.en: Engineers fitted a {choke-joint} on the waveguide flange.
e.zh: 工程师在波导法兰上加装了一个扼流接头。

e.en: The {choke-joint} prevents leakage at the connection.
e.zh: 扼流接头可防止连接处发生泄漏。

e.en: She made jam from wild {chokeberry} fruit.
e.zh: 她用野生涩果做了果酱。

e.en: The {chokeberry} bush turned brilliant red in autumn.
e.zh: 那丛野樱莓在秋天变成鲜艳的红色。

e.en: His shotgun had a tight {chokebore} for distant birds.
e.zh: 他的猎枪有一个紧缩径口，适合打远处的飞鸟。

e.en: The {chokebore} pattern was ideal for skeet shooting.
e.zh: 这种缩径口的弹型最适合飞碟射击。

e.en: The miners suffocated from {chokedamp} in the tunnel.
e.zh: 矿工们因坑道中的窒息气而窒息。

e.en: Lamps go out when {chokedamp} fills the air.
e.zh: 窒息气弥漫时，灯火便会熄灭。

e.en: He spent six months in the {chokey} for theft.
e.zh: 他因盗窃在牢里待了六个月。

e.en: They threatened to throw him in the {chokey}.
e.zh: 他们威胁要把他扔进监狱。

e.en: Grandma stewed the {choko} with onions.
e.zh: 奶奶把佛手瓜和洋葱一起炖。

e.en: {Choko} vines climbed all over the back fence.
e.zh: 佛手瓜的藤蔓爬满了后院的围栏。

e.en: Her voice went {choky} as she said goodbye.
e.zh: 她道别时声音变得哽咽。

e.en: He was thrown in the {choky} overnight.
e.zh: 他被关进牢房过了一夜。

e.en: The herb has long been used for its {cholagogic} effect.
e.zh: 这种草药因其促胆汁分泌的功效而被长期使用。

e.en: Doctors prescribed a {cholagogic} remedy for the patient.
e.zh: 医生为病人开了一种促胆汁分泌的药方。

e.en: The pharmacist recommended a mild {cholagogue}.
e.zh: 药剂师推荐了一种温和的利胆剂。

e.en: Dandelion root acts as a natural {cholagogue}.
e.zh: 蒲公英根是一种天然的利胆剂。

e.en: The bile contains {cholic} acid as a major component.
e.zh: 胆汁中含有胆酸作为主要成分。

e.en: Researchers studied {cholic} acid metabolism in the liver.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了肝脏中胆酸的代谢。

e.en: The pesticide inhibits {cholinesterase} activity in insects.
e.zh: 这种杀虫剂会抑制昆虫体内的胆碱酯酶活性。

e.en: Doctors measured {cholinesterase} levels to assess exposure.
e.zh: 医生测量胆碱酯酶水平以评估接触程度。

e.en: The athlete suffered a {chondral} injury in his knee.
e.zh: 这位运动员膝盖发生了软骨损伤。

e.en: MRI revealed a small {chondral} defect on the joint surface.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示关节面有一处小的软骨缺损。

e.en: Stem cells can be guided toward {chondrogenesis} in the lab.
e.zh: 干细胞可以在实验室中被诱导进行软骨形成。

e.en: The study examined factors regulating {chondrogenesis} during development.
e.zh: 该研究考察了发育过程中调控软骨形成的因素。

e.en: Many people take {chondroitin} supplements for joint health.
e.zh: 许多人服用软骨素补充剂来保护关节。

e.en: The cream contains glucosamine and {chondroitin}.
e.zh: 这款乳膏含有葡萄糖胺和软骨素。

e.en: The X-ray showed a benign {chondroma} on his finger.
e.zh: X光显示他手指上有一个良性软骨瘤。

e.en: Surgeons removed the {chondroma} without complications.
e.zh: 外科医生顺利切除了软骨瘤，没有出现并发症。

e.en: The toddler pointed at the {choo-choo} on the tracks.
e.zh: 小宝宝指着轨道上的小火车。

e.en: Grandpa bought him a wooden {choo-choo} for his birthday.
e.zh: 爷爷给他买了一辆木制小火车作为生日礼物。

e.en: The lab synthesized {chlorohydroquinone} as an intermediate.
e.zh: 实验室合成氯氢醌作为中间体。

e.en: {Chlorohydroquinone} is used in some photographic developers.
e.zh: 氯氢醌用于某些摄影显影剂。

chlorolabe.t: 绿敏色素（视网膜中对绿光敏感的视色素）

e.en: {Chlorolabe} responds most strongly to green light.
e.zh: 绿敏色素对绿光反应最强。

e.en: Cones contain pigments such as {chlorolabe} and erythrolabe.
e.zh: 视锥细胞含有绿敏色素和红敏色素等色素。

chloroleukemia.t: 绿色白血病；绿色瘤性白血病

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {chloroleukemia}.
e.zh: 该患者被诊断为绿色白血病。

e.en: {Chloroleukemia} forms greenish tumor masses in tissue.
e.zh: 绿色白血病在组织中形成绿色肿块。

chlorolin.t: 氯啉（一种含氯化合物名称）

e.en: The textbook briefly mentions {chlorolin} compounds.
e.zh: 教科书简要提到氯啉类化合物。

e.en: Researchers tested {chlorolin} for antimicrobial activity.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了氯啉的抗菌活性。

e.en: The pathology report indicated {chlorolymphosarcoma}.
e.zh: 病理报告显示为绿色淋巴肉瘤。

e.en: {Chlorolymphosarcoma} is an extremely rare malignancy.
e.zh: 绿色淋巴肉瘤是一种极为罕见的恶性肿瘤。

e.en: The biopsy revealed a {chloroma} on the orbit.
e.zh: 活检显示眼眶处有一绿色瘤。

e.en: A {chloroma} often accompanies acute myeloid leukemia.
e.zh: 绿色瘤常伴随急性髓系白血病出现。

e.en: He used a {chlorometer} to test the pool water.
e.zh: 他用测氯计检测泳池水质。

e.en: The {chlorometer} reading was higher than expected.
e.zh: 氯量计的读数高于预期。

e.en: {Chloromethane} is a colorless flammable gas.
e.zh: 氯甲烷是一种无色易燃气体。

e.en: Industry uses {chloromethane} to make silicone polymers.
e.zh: 工业上用氯甲烷生产硅酮聚合物。

e.en: {Chloromethylation} introduces a CH2Cl group onto aromatics.
e.zh: 氯甲基化反应将氯甲基引入芳香环。

e.en: The resin was prepared by {chloromethylation} of polystyrene.
e.zh: 该树脂通过聚苯乙烯的氯甲基化制得。

chloromorphine.t: 氯吗啡（吗啡的氯代衍生物）

e.en: Older texts mention {chloromorphine} as a derivative.
e.zh: 早期文献将氯吗啡列为吗啡的衍生物。

e.en: {Chloromorphine} is no longer used clinically.
e.zh: 氯吗啡已不再用于临床。

chloroneb.t: 敌克松；二甲氯苯醚（杀菌剂）

e.en: Farmers applied {chloroneb} to control turf disease.
e.zh: 农户施用敌克松防治草坪病害。

e.en: {Chloroneb} acts as a systemic fungicide.
e.zh: 敌克松是一种内吸性杀菌剂。

chlorooxon.t: 氯氧磷（有机磷农药的氧代形式）

e.en: The metabolite {chlorooxon} is more toxic than its parent.
e.zh: 代谢产物氯氧磷比母体更具毒性。

e.en: They detected trace {chlorooxon} in the runoff.
e.zh: 他们在径流中检出微量氯氧磷。

chloropexia.t: 氯滞留症（组织中氯化物潴留）

e.en: Severe edema may indicate {chloropexia}.
e.zh: 严重水肿可能提示氯滞留症。

e.en: {Chloropexia} appears in some metabolic disorders.
e.zh: 氯滞留症见于某些代谢紊乱。

chlorophane.t: 绿萤石；视网膜绿色色素

e.en: The crystal of {chlorophane} glowed when heated.
e.zh: 绿萤石加热时发出绿光。

e.en: {Chlorophane} is associated with cone vision.
e.zh: 绿色视色素与视锥细胞视觉有关。

e.en: They prepared a {chlorophatinate} salt for analysis.
e.zh: 他们制备了一种氯铂酸盐用于分析。

e.en: The {chlorophatinate} crystallized as orange needles.
e.zh: 该氯铂酸盐结晶为橙色针状。

e.en: {Chlorophenol} has a strong medicinal odor.
e.zh: 氯苯酚有强烈的药味。

e.en: Wastewater contained traces of {chlorophenol}.
e.zh: 废水中含有微量氯苯酚。

e.en: {Chlorophenothane} was banned for agricultural use.
e.zh: 滴滴涕已被禁止用于农业。

e.en: The pesticide is also known as {chlorophenothane}.
e.zh: 这种杀虫剂也称作滴滴涕。

e.en: {Chlorophosphonation} introduces P-Cl groups into the substrate.
e.zh: 氯膦化反应将P-Cl基团引入底物。

e.en: The polymer was modified by {chlorophosphonation}.
e.zh: 该聚合物经氯膦化反应改性。

e.en: Plants use {chlorophyl} to capture sunlight.
e.zh: 植物利用叶绿素捕获阳光。

e.en: Old textbooks spell it as {chlorophyl}.
e.zh: 旧教科书将其拼作 chlorophyl。

e.en: {Chlorophyllase} catalyzes the hydrolysis of chlorophyll.
e.zh: 叶绿素酶催化叶绿素的水解。

e.en: Ripening fruit shows higher {chlorophyllase} activity.
e.zh: 成熟果实中叶绿素酶活性较高。

e.en: {Chlorophyllide} is an intermediate in chlorophyll biosynthesis.
e.zh: 叶绿酸是叶绿素生物合成的中间体。

e.en: They isolated {chlorophyllide} from the leaf extract.
e.zh: 他们从叶提取物中分离出叶绿酸。

chlorophyllite.t: 绿叶石（一种蚀变堇青石）

e.en: The specimen contained dark green {chlorophyllite}.
e.zh: 标本中含有深绿色的绿叶石。

e.en: {Chlorophyllite} forms by alteration of cordierite.
e.zh: 绿叶石由堇青石蚀变形成。

e.en: The leaf tissue is densely {chlorophyllose}.
e.zh: 该叶组织富含叶绿素。

e.en: Older botanies described cells as {chlorophyllose}.
e.zh: 早期植物学著作将这些细胞描述为含叶绿素的。

e.en: Only {chlorophyllous} cells can perform photosynthesis.
e.zh: 只有含叶绿素的细胞才能进行光合作用。

e.en: The stem has a thin {chlorophyllous} layer.
e.zh: 茎部有一层薄薄的含叶绿素组织。

chloropicrin.t: 氯化苦（土壤熏蒸剂、催泪毒剂）

e.en: {Chloropicrin} is used to fumigate soil before planting.
e.zh: 种植前用氯化苦熏蒸土壤。

e.en: Exposure to {chloropicrin} causes severe eye irritation.
e.zh: 接触氯化苦会引起严重眼部刺激。

chloroplastic.t: 叶绿体的；与叶绿体有关的

e.en: The protein has a {chloroplastic} targeting signal.
e.zh: 该蛋白带有叶绿体定位信号。

e.en: They studied {chloroplastic} DNA replication.
e.zh: 他们研究叶绿体DNA的复制。

e.en: {Chloroplatinic} acid is a precursor for platinum catalysts.
e.zh: 氯铂酸是制备铂催化剂的前体。

e.en: They added a few drops of {chloroplatinic} solution.
e.zh: 他们加了几滴氯铂酸溶液。

chloroprene.t: 氯丁二烯（合成橡胶单体）

e.en: Neoprene is made by polymerizing {chloroprene}.
e.zh: 氯丁橡胶由氯丁二烯聚合而成。

e.en: {Chloroprene} fumes can be hazardous.
e.zh: 氯丁二烯蒸气可能有害。

e.en: Doctors prescribed {chloropromazine} for severe agitation.
e.zh: 医生开了氯丙嗪治疗严重的躁动。

e.en: {Chloropromazine} was the first antipsychotic drug.
e.zh: 氯丙嗪是首种抗精神病药。

e.en: {Chloropropane} is used as an industrial solvent.
e.zh: 氯丙烷可用作工业溶剂。

e.en: They detected {chloropropane} in the off-gas.
e.zh: 他们在尾气中检出氯丙烷。

chloropropham.t: 氯苯胺灵（马铃薯发芽抑制剂）

e.en: Stored potatoes were treated with {chloropropham}.
e.zh: 储存的马铃薯用氯苯胺灵处理过。

e.en: {Chloropropham} suppresses sprouting during storage.
e.zh: 氯苯胺灵在储藏期间抑制发芽。

chlororaphin.t: 绿针菌素（一种细菌色素）

e.en: The colonies produced green {chlororaphin} crystals.
e.zh: 菌落产生绿色的绿针菌素结晶。

e.en: {Chlororaphin} was isolated from Pseudomonas cultures.
e.zh: 绿针菌素分离自假单胞菌培养物。

e.en: Iron deficiency caused obvious {chlorosis} in the leaves.
e.zh: 缺铁使叶片出现明显的萎黄症状。

e.en: The vineyard suffered from severe {chlorosis}.
e.zh: 这片葡萄园受严重缺绿症侵害。

e.en: They measured the {chlorosity} of the seawater sample.
e.zh: 他们测量了海水样本的氯度。

e.en: High {chlorosity} indicates strong salinity.
e.zh: 氯度高表明盐度大。

chlorospinel.t: 绿尖晶石（含铜的绿色尖晶石变种）

e.en: The mineral collection included a rare {chlorospinel}.
e.zh: 该矿物藏品包括一块罕见的绿尖晶石。

e.en: {Chlorospinel} owes its color to copper impurities.
e.zh: 绿尖晶石的颜色来自铜杂质。

e.en: {Chlorosulfonation} of polyethylene yields a useful elastomer.
e.zh: 聚乙烯的氯磺化反应可制得有用的弹性体。

e.en: They optimized the {chlorosulfonation} conditions.
e.zh: 他们优化了氯磺化反应的条件。

e.en: {Chlorotetracycline} is added to animal feed.
e.zh: 金霉素被添加到动物饲料中。

e.en: The vet prescribed {chlorotetracycline} for the infection.
e.zh: 兽医开了金霉素治疗感染。

chlorothiamid.t: 草灭特（一种酰胺类除草剂）

e.en: Gardeners once used {chlorothiamid} to kill weeds.
e.zh: 园艺工人曾用草灭特除草。

e.en: {Chlorothiamid} has been withdrawn in many countries.
e.zh: 草灭特已在许多国家停止使用。

e.en: The doctor added {chlorothiazide} to control her blood pressure.
e.zh: 医生加用氯噻嗪以控制她的血压。

e.en: {Chlorothiazide} was an early thiazide diuretic.
e.zh: 氯噻嗪是早期的噻嗪类利尿药之一。

e.en: The {chlorotic} leaves had turned pale yellow.
e.zh: 萎黄的叶片已变得淡黄。

e.en: Iron sprays revived the {chlorotic} plants.
e.zh: 喷施铁肥使缺绿的植株恢复生机。

chlorotrianisene.t: 氯烯雌醚（合成雌激素药物）

e.en: {Chlorotrianisene} was historically used in hormone therapy.
e.zh: 氯烯雌醚过去用于激素治疗。

e.en: Pharmacology students still learn about {chlorotrianisene}.
e.zh: 药理学学生仍会学到氯烯雌醚。

e.en: {Chlorotrifluoromethane} was once used as a refrigerant.
e.zh: 氯三氟甲烷曾被用作制冷剂。

e.en: Production of {chlorotrifluoromethane} declined under the Montreal Protocol.
e.zh: 《蒙特利尔议定书》后氯三氟甲烷的生产下降。

e.en: {Chlorous} acid is a weak unstable acid.
e.zh: 亚氯酸是一种不稳定的弱酸。

e.en: Salts of {chlorous} acid are called chlorites.
e.zh: 亚氯酸的盐称为亚氯酸盐。

e.en: Farmers sprayed {chloroxuron} on the seedling beds.
e.zh: 农民在苗床上喷洒敌草净。

e.en: {Chloroxuron} controls broadleaf weeds.
e.zh: 敌草净可防除阔叶杂草。

chloroxylenol.t: 对氯间二甲苯酚（消毒防腐剂）

e.en: The antiseptic contains {chloroxylenol} as the active ingredient.
e.zh: 该消毒液以对氯间二甲苯酚为有效成分。

e.en: Hospitals often stock soap with {chloroxylenol}.
e.zh: 医院常备含对氯间二甲苯酚的肥皂。

chloroxylonine.t: 氯桑碱（取自锡兰柚木的生物碱）

e.en: {Chloroxylonine} was extracted from satinwood bark.
e.zh: 氯桑碱从锡兰柚木树皮中提取。

e.en: Workers handling the wood reacted to {chloroxylonine}.
e.zh: 接触该木材的工人对氯桑碱产生反应。

chionophobous.t: 厌雪的；不耐积雪的；避雪生长的

e.en: Many {chionophobous} reptiles cannot survive harsh winters.
e.zh: 许多厌雪的爬行动物无法在严冬中存活。

e.en: Desert species are typically {chionophobous} and avoid snow cover.
e.zh: 沙漠物种通常厌雪，会避开有积雪的地方。

chiphead.t: 芯片迷；电脑发烧友；硬件极客

e.en: He's a hardcore {chiphead} who built his own server.
e.zh: 他是个铁杆电脑迷，自己搭建了服务器。

e.en: Online forums are full of {chipheads} debating the newest CPUs.
e.zh: 网络论坛里满是讨论最新CPU的芯片迷。

e.en: Taiwan dominates the global {chipmaking} industry.
e.zh: 台湾在全球芯片制造业占据主导地位。

e.en: Advanced {chipmaking} requires extremely clean facilities.
e.zh: 先进的芯片制造需要极其洁净的厂房。

chipmuck.t: 花栗鼠的古旧拼法；条纹松鼠

e.en: The old book referred to the animal as a {chipmuck}.
e.zh: 那本旧书把这种动物称作花栗鼠（古拼法）。

e.en: Pioneers wrote of seeing a {chipmuck} dart through the woods.
e.zh: 拓荒者写道看见一只小花栗鼠窜过树林。

e.en: We grilled some {chipolatas} for the children's party.
e.zh: 我们为儿童派对烤了一些小香肠。

e.en: A breakfast platter usually includes a few {chipolatas}.
e.zh: 早餐拼盘通常会配上几根细香肠。

chirm.t: 鸟群齐鸣；嘈杂的鸟叫声

e.en: At dawn the garden filled with the {chirm} of sparrows.
e.zh: 黎明时分，花园里充满麻雀的齐鸣声。

e.en: We could hear the {chirm} of finches all afternoon.
e.zh: 我们整个下午都能听到雀鸟的喧鸣。

e.en: Old manuals on {chirognomy} judged character from hand shape.
e.zh: 旧时关于手相学的书籍依手形来判断性格。

e.en: Few scientists take {chirognomy} seriously today.
e.zh: 如今很少有科学家认真看待手相学。

chirograph.t: 手写文件；古代契约副本

e.en: The monks signed a {chirograph} dividing the lands.
e.zh: 僧侣们签了一份手写契约来分割土地。

e.en: Medieval {chirographs} were cut in half to prevent forgery.
e.zh: 中世纪的手写契约会被一分为二以防伪造。

e.en: The king employed a skilled {chirographer} to copy charters.
e.zh: 国王雇了一位技艺高超的书写员誊抄诏书。

e.en: She trained as a {chirographer} in the abbey scriptorium.
e.zh: 她在修道院抄写室受训成为抄写员。

e.en: The museum displays {chirographic} samples from various centuries.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了各世纪的手写样本。

e.en: Forensic experts study {chirographic} traits to identify writers.
e.zh: 法医专家研究笔迹特征来辨认书写者。

chirographical.t: 手写的；书法的；与笔迹有关的

e.en: He is famous for his {chirographical} elegance.
e.zh: 他以书法的优雅而著称。

e.en: The journal published a study of {chirographical} habits.
e.zh: 该期刊发表了一篇关于书写习惯的研究。

e.en: Her {chirography} was admired across the academy.
e.zh: 她的书法在整个学院备受推崇。

e.en: Eighteenth-century {chirography} can be hard to read.
e.zh: 十八世纪的笔迹有时很难辨认。

chirogymnast.t: 手指健身器；手部锻炼装置

e.en: The pianist used a {chirogymnast} to strengthen weak fingers.
e.zh: 钢琴家用手指健身器锻炼无力的手指。

e.en: Victorian advertisements promoted the {chirogymnast} for tired clerks.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的广告向疲倦的职员推销手指健身器。

e.en: Deaf communities once relied on a form of {chirology}.
e.zh: 聋人群体曾依靠一种手势语交流。

e.en: He claims that {chirology} reveals hidden personality traits.
e.zh: 他声称手相学能揭示隐藏的性格特征。

chiromancer.t: 手相师；看手相的算命人

e.en: A {chiromancer} read her palm at the fair.
e.zh: 一位手相师在集市上为她看手相。

e.en: The {chiromancer} predicted a long and lucky life.
e.zh: 那位看手相的人预言她会长寿且好运。

chiromancy.t: 手相术；看手相算命；掌纹学

e.en: She studied {chiromancy} from her grandmother as a child.
e.zh: 她从小跟祖母学习手相术。

e.en: Many cultures have their own traditions of {chiromancy}.
e.zh: 许多文化都有自己的看手相传统。

chiromantic.t: 手相术的；与看手相相关的

e.en: He published a {chiromantic} guide to the major palm lines.
e.zh: 他出版了一本关于主要掌纹的手相指南。

e.en: {Chiromantic} charts adorn the fortune-teller's tent.
e.zh: 算命师的帐篷里挂着手相图。

chiromantical.t: 手相术的；与看手相有关的

e.en: Her notebook was filled with {chiromantical} diagrams.
e.zh: 她的笔记本里满是手相图解。

e.en: Old texts give {chiromantical} meanings to every minor crease.
e.zh: 古籍为每条细小的纹路赋予手相意义。

e.en: {Chiromegaly} can signal an underlying hormonal disorder.
e.zh: 巨手症可能是潜在内分泌疾病的征兆。

e.en: Doctors examined the patient for symptoms of {chiromegaly}.
e.zh: 医生检查了病人是否有巨手症的症状。

chiroplasty.t: 手部整形手术；手部修复术

e.en: {Chiroplasty} restored function to her injured hand.
e.zh: 手部整形手术恢复了她受伤手的功能。

e.en: Modern {chiroplasty} combines microsurgery and rehabilitation.
e.zh: 现代手部整形术结合了显微手术和康复治疗。

chiropompholyx.t: 手部汗疱疹；手部水疱性湿疹

e.en: {Chiropompholyx} causes itchy blisters on the palms.
e.zh: 手部汗疱疹会在手掌上引起瘙痒的水疱。

e.en: Stress sometimes triggers flares of {chiropompholyx}.
e.zh: 压力有时会诱发手部汗疱疹发作。

chiropter.t: 翼手目动物；蝙蝠类动物

e.en: The cave was home to thousands of {chiropters}.
e.zh: 这个洞穴是数千只蝙蝠的栖息地。

e.en: Biologists tagged the {chiropter} before releasing it.
e.zh: 生物学家在放生这只蝙蝠前给它贴上了标记。

chiropteran.t: 翼手目的；蝙蝠的；蝙蝠类动物

e.en: Many {chiropteran} species are vital pollinators.
e.zh: 许多翼手目物种是重要的传粉者。

e.en: The {chiropteran} skeleton showed remarkable wing adaptations.
e.zh: 这具蝙蝠骨架显示出非凡的翼部适应性。

chiropterophilous.t: 由蝙蝠传粉的；依赖蝙蝠授粉的

e.en: {Chiropterophilous} flowers tend to open at night.
e.zh: 由蝙蝠传粉的花朵往往在夜间开放。

e.en: Tropical forests host many {chiropterophilous} plants.
e.zh: 热带森林里有许多依赖蝙蝠传粉的植物。

chiroxylographic.t: 手雕木刻的；手工木版印刷的

e.en: Early {chiroxylographic} books predate the printing press.
e.zh: 早期的手雕木版书早于印刷机出现。

e.en: Collectors prize rare {chiroxylographic} prints.
e.zh: 收藏家珍视稀有的手雕木刻版画。

chirpier.t: 更欢快的；更轻快活泼的

e.en: She seemed {chirpier} after her morning coffee.
e.zh: 喝完早晨的咖啡后她显得更欢快了。

e.en: The mood at the office was {chirpier} on Friday.
e.zh: 周五办公室的气氛更加轻松活泼。

chirpiest.t: 最欢快的；最轻快活泼的

e.en: He's the {chirpiest} person on our team.
e.zh: 他是我们团队里最欢快的人。

e.en: She was the {chirpiest} guest at the party.
e.zh: 她是派对上最活泼的客人。

e.en: She greeted everyone {chirpily} that morning.
e.zh: 那天早上她欢快地向每个人打招呼。

e.en: He answered the phone {chirpily} despite the bad news.
e.zh: 尽管有坏消息，他还是欢快地接了电话。

chirpiness.t: 欢快活泼；叽叽喳喳的劲头

e.en: Her morning {chirpiness} annoys her sleepy coworkers.
e.zh: 她清晨的活泼劲让昏睡的同事们很烦。

e.en: There's a forced {chirpiness} in his voice today.
e.zh: 他今天的声音里带着一种刻意的欢快。

chirr.t: 颤鸣；昆虫发出的颤抖鸣声

e.en: Crickets {chirr} loudly in the summer grass.
e.zh: 蟋蟀在夏日的草丛里大声颤鸣。

e.en: We heard the {chirr} of insects through the open window.
e.zh: 我们透过敞开的窗户听到昆虫的颤鸣。

chirred.t: 发出颤鸣声；昆虫颤抖鸣叫

e.en: The grasshoppers {chirred} all through the warm evening.
e.zh: 蚂蚱在整个温暖的夜晚不停颤鸣。

e.en: Cicadas {chirred} in the trees above the path.
e.zh: 蝉在小路上方的树上颤鸣。

chirring.t: 颤鸣声；昆虫的颤抖叫声

e.en: The {chirring} of cicadas filled the orchard.
e.zh: 蝉的颤鸣声充满了果园。

e.en: I fell asleep to the {chirring} insects outside.
e.zh: 我在外面昆虫的颤鸣声中睡着了。

e.en: The cricket {chirrs} every few seconds.
e.zh: 蟋蟀每隔几秒就颤鸣一声。

e.en: When startled the insect {chirrs} loudly.
e.zh: 受惊时这种昆虫会大声颤鸣。

e.en: I heard a sparrow {chirrup} on the windowsill.
e.zh: 我听见一只麻雀在窗台上啁啾。

e.en: The baby gave a happy {chirrup} when she saw the dog.
e.zh: 看见狗时宝宝发出愉快的咿呀声。

e.en: The finches {chirruped} cheerfully at dawn.
e.zh: 燕雀们在黎明时分欢快地啁啾。

e.en: She {chirruped} a quick goodbye and left.
e.zh: 她欢快地道了声再见就走了。

chirruping.t: 啁啾鸣叫；唧唧喳喳叫着

e.en: Birds were {chirruping} in the hedgerows.
e.zh: 鸟儿在树篱间叽叽喳喳地叫着。

e.en: The {chirruping} swallows woke me at sunrise.
e.zh: 燕子的啁啾声在日出时把我唤醒。

chirrupped.t: 啁啾叫；唧唧叫的另一拼法

e.en: The robin {chirrupped} from the garden fence.
e.zh: 知更鸟在花园的篱笆上啁啾。

e.en: She {chirrupped} a greeting before sitting down.
e.zh: 她欢快地打了声招呼便坐下了。

chirrups.t: 啁啾声；唧唧叫声；连续鸣叫

e.en: The little bird {chirrups} when it spots food.
e.zh: 那只小鸟看到食物时就会啁啾。

e.en: He answers each question with cheerful {chirrups}.
e.zh: 他用欢快的啁啾声回答每个问题。

e.en: She has a {chirrupy} voice on the radio.
e.zh: 她在电台里有一副欢快的嗓音。

e.en: His {chirrupy} manner cheered up the whole class.
e.zh: 他活泼欢快的举止让全班都振奋起来。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {cholangiocarcinoma} last year.
e.zh: 该患者去年被诊断为胆管癌。

e.en: {Cholangiocarcinoma} is often detected at a late stage.
e.zh: 胆管癌通常在晚期才被发现。

e.en: Researchers studied several {cholangiocarcinomas} in the trial.
e.zh: 研究人员在该试验中研究了多例胆管癌。

e.en: These {cholangiocarcinomas} responded poorly to chemotherapy.
e.zh: 这些胆管癌对化疗反应不佳。

e.en: The surgeon performed a {cholangioenterostomy} to restore bile flow.
e.zh: 外科医生施行胆管肠吻合术以恢复胆汁流通。

e.en: Recovery after {cholangioenterostomy} took several weeks.
e.zh: 胆管肠吻合术后恢复花了数周时间。

e.en: The hospital performs hundreds of {cholangiographies} each year.
e.zh: 该医院每年进行数百例胆管造影。

e.en: Several {cholangiographies} were needed to locate the blockage.
e.zh: 需要做多次胆管造影才能找到堵塞部位。

e.en: The doctor ordered a {cholangiography} to examine the bile ducts.
e.zh: 医生开了胆管造影来检查胆管。

e.en: {Cholangiography} revealed a small stone.
e.zh: 胆管造影显示有一颗小结石。

e.en: Sodium {cholate} is commonly used in biochemistry labs.
e.zh: 胆酸钠常用于生化实验室。

e.en: The membrane was solubilized with {cholate}.
e.zh: 用胆酸盐使膜溶解。

e.en: Levels of {cholebilirubin} were measured in the samples.
e.zh: 样本中检测了胆汁胆红素的含量。

e.en: {Cholebilirubin} indicates liver function.
e.zh: 胆汁胆红素可反映肝功能。

e.en: The supplement contains {cholecalciferol} for bone health.
e.zh: 这种补剂含有维生素D3以促进骨骼健康。

e.en: Doctors often prescribe {cholecalciferol} for vitamin D deficiency.
e.zh: 医生常开胆钙化醇治疗维生素D缺乏。

e.en: {Cholecyanin} is a pigment derived from bile.
e.zh: 胆青素是一种源自胆汁的色素。

e.en: The chemist analyzed the {cholecyanin} content.
e.zh: 化学家分析了胆青素的含量。

e.en: The {cholecyst} stores bile produced by the liver.
e.zh: 胆囊储存肝脏分泌的胆汁。

e.en: Inflammation of the {cholecyst} can cause severe pain.
e.zh: 胆囊发炎可能引起剧痛。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {cholecystagogue} to stimulate bile flow.
e.zh: 医生开了一种利胆药以促进胆汁分泌。

e.en: Fatty foods act as a natural {cholecystagogue}.
e.zh: 高脂食物可作为天然的利胆剂。

e.en: She suffered from {cholecystalgia} after eating fatty meals.
e.zh: 她吃油腻饭菜后出现胆囊痛。

e.en: {Cholecystalgia} can be a sign of gallstones.
e.zh: 胆囊痛可能是胆结石的征兆。

e.en: The {cholecystectomized} patient recovered quickly.
e.zh: 已切除胆囊的患者恢复迅速。

e.en: Studies followed {cholecystectomized} subjects for years.
e.zh: 研究对切除胆囊的受试者进行了多年随访。

e.en: A {cholecystenterostomy} was performed to bypass the obstruction.
e.zh: 施行胆囊肠吻合术以绕过梗阻。

e.en: {Cholecystenterostomy} is rarely done today.
e.zh: 如今很少再做胆囊肠吻合术。

e.en: She was hospitalized with acute {cholecystitis}.
e.zh: 她因急性胆囊炎住院。

e.en: {Cholecystitis} often requires surgery.
e.zh: 胆囊炎常需要手术治疗。

e.en: The surgeon completed the {cholecystoduodenostomy} successfully.
e.zh: 外科医生成功完成了胆囊十二指肠吻合术。

e.en: {Cholecystoduodenostomy} can relieve biliary obstruction.
e.zh: 胆囊十二指肠吻合术可缓解胆道梗阻。

e.en: {Cholecystography} was once a common diagnostic test.
e.zh: 胆囊造影术曾是常见的诊断检查。

e.en: The patient underwent {cholecystography} to detect gallstones.
e.zh: 患者接受了胆囊造影以检测胆结石。

e.en: Certain hormones have a {cholecystokinetic} effect.
e.zh: 某些激素具有促胆囊收缩作用。

e.en: The drug shows {cholecystokinetic} activity.
e.zh: 该药物表现出促胆囊收缩活性。

e.en: {Cholecystokinin} is released in response to fat in the small intestine.
e.zh: 小肠中遇到脂肪时会释放胆囊收缩素。

e.en: Researchers studied {cholecystokinin} for its role in appetite.
e.zh: 研究者探讨了胆囊收缩素在食欲中的作用。

e.en: The clinic ordered new {cholecystoscopes} for the surgical team.
e.zh: 诊所为手术团队订购了新的胆囊镜。

e.en: Modern {cholecystoscopes} provide high-resolution images.
e.zh: 现代胆囊镜可提供高清晰度图像。

e.en: A {cholecystostomy} was performed to drain the infected gallbladder.
e.zh: 施行胆囊造口术以引流感染的胆囊。

e.en: {Cholecystostomy} can be a life-saving procedure.
e.zh: 胆囊造口术可以是救命的手术。

e.en: The surgeon explained the risks of {choledochectomy}.
e.zh: 外科医生说明了胆总管切除术的风险。

e.en: {Choledochectomy} is reserved for severe cases.
e.zh: 胆总管切除术仅用于严重病例。

e.en: They performed a {choledochoenterostomy} to restore bile drainage.
e.zh: 他们施行胆总管肠吻合术以恢复胆汁引流。

e.en: {Choledochoenterostomy} carries a risk of infection.
e.zh: 胆总管肠吻合术有感染风险。

e.en: {Choledochoileostomy} is an uncommon surgical option.
e.zh: 胆总管回肠吻合术是较少见的手术选择。

e.en: The team studied outcomes after {choledochoileostomy}.
e.zh: 团队研究了胆总管回肠吻合术后的结果。

e.en: The surgeon used a {choledochoscope} to inspect the bile duct.
e.zh: 外科医生用胆道镜检查胆管。

e.en: A flexible {choledochoscope} can navigate narrow passages.
e.zh: 柔性胆道镜可通过狭窄通道。

e.en: {Choledochotomy} is used to remove ductal stones.
e.zh: 胆总管切开术用于取出管内结石。

e.en: The patient underwent {choledochotomy} last week.
e.zh: 患者上周接受了胆总管切开术。

e.en: {Choleglobin} forms during hemoglobin breakdown.
e.zh: 胆球蛋白在血红蛋白分解过程中形成。

e.en: Researchers isolated {choleglobin} from the sample.

e.zh: 该反应产生胆甾烯醇作为副产物。

e.zh: 胆甾烯酮可通过胆固醇氧化生成。

e.en: The {chromatometer} measures color intensity precisely.
e.zh: 比色计能精确测量颜色强度。

e.en: She calibrated the {chromatometer} before each test.
e.zh: 她每次测试前都校准比色计。

e.en: The {chromatophil} cells take up the dye readily.
e.zh: 嗜染色质细胞容易吸收染料。

e.en: He identified {chromatophil} structures under the microscope.
e.zh: 他在显微镜下识别出嗜染色质结构。

e.en: Octopuses change color using their {chromatophores}.
e.zh: 章鱼通过色素细胞改变颜色。

e.en: Each {chromatophore} contains pigment that can disperse.
e.zh: 每个色素细胞内的色素都能扩散。

e.en: The samples were spotted on a {chromatoplate}.
e.zh: 样品被点在色谱板上。

e.en: She prepared the {chromatoplate} for thin-layer analysis.
e.zh: 她为薄层分析准备了色谱板。

e.en: Astronomers used a {chromatoscope} to study star spectra.
e.zh: 天文学家用色谱镜研究恒星光谱。

e.en: The {chromatoscope} reveals subtle color variations.
e.zh: 色谱镜可显示细微的颜色变化。

e.en: The dermatologist diagnosed mild {chromatosis}.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生诊断为轻度色素沉着。

e.en: Hormonal changes can trigger {chromatosis}.
e.zh: 激素变化可能引发色素异常。

e.en: Early color TVs used a {chromatron} tube.
e.zh: 早期彩色电视使用克罗马管显像管。

e.en: The {chromatron} was an alternative to shadow-mask designs.
e.zh: 克罗马管是荫罩式设计的替代方案。

e.en: Victorian audiences marveled at the spinning {chromatrope}.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的观众惊叹于旋转的彩色幻灯。

e.en: The magic lantern show featured a colorful {chromatrope}.
e.zh: 幻灯表演中出现了色彩斑斓的旋色片。

e.en: Certain drugs can cause {chromaturia} as a side effect.
e.zh: 某些药物的副作用会引起尿色异常。

e.en: The doctor noted {chromaturia} in the patient's chart.
e.zh: 医生在病人的病历上记录了尿色异常。

e.en: Early {chromatype} processes produced vivid images.
e.zh: 早期的彩色照相法能产生鲜艳的图像。

e.en: He experimented with the {chromatype} technique.
e.zh: 他尝试使用彩色照相法的技术。

e.en: The motorcycle had shiny {chrome-plated} exhausts.
e.zh: 摩托车装着闪亮的镀铬排气管。

e.en: He polished the {chrome-plated} bumper of the old car.
e.zh: 他擦亮了那辆老车的镀铬保险杠。

chromel.t: 克罗梅尔合金（镍铬合金）

e.en: The thermocouple uses a {chromel} wire.
e.zh: 该热电偶使用克罗梅尔合金丝。

e.en: {Chromel} alloys withstand high temperatures.
e.zh: 克罗梅尔合金能耐高温。

e.en: People with {chromesthesia} see colors when they hear music.
e.zh: 有色听联觉的人听到音乐时会看到颜色。

e.en: The composer described his {chromesthesia} in interviews.
e.zh: 那位作曲家在采访中描述了他的色听联觉。

e.en: {Chromic} acid is used in some industrial processes.
e.zh: 铬酸用于某些工业流程。

e.en: The solution contained a {chromic} compound.
e.zh: 溶液中含有一种铬化合物。

e.en: {Chromidrosis} causes the sweat to appear colored.
e.zh: 色汗症会使汗液呈现颜色。

e.en: The rare condition known as {chromidrosis} puzzled doctors.
e.zh: 这种被称为色汗症的罕见疾病让医生们困惑。

e.en: The TV signal carries both luminance and {chrominance} information.
e.zh: 电视信号同时承载亮度和色度信息。

e.en: Engineers adjusted the {chrominance} to improve color accuracy.
e.zh: 工程师调整色度以提高颜色准确度。

e.en: {Chromising} improves the corrosion resistance of steel.
e.zh: 渗铬处理可提高钢的耐腐蚀性。

e.en: The factory specializes in {chromising} engine parts.
e.zh: 该工厂专门对发动机部件进行渗铬处理。

e.en: South Africa is a major producer of {chromite}.
e.zh: 南非是铬铁矿的主要生产国。

e.en: {Chromite} is the primary ore of chromium.
e.zh: 铬铁矿是铬的主要矿石。

e.en: The diner had {chromium-plated} stools at the counter.
e.zh: 餐厅吧台旁有镀铬的高脚凳。

e.en: He admired the {chromium-plated} grille on the vintage car.
e.zh: 他欣赏着那辆老爷车上的镀铬格栅。

e.en: Engineers {chromize} steel to enhance hardness.
e.zh: 工程师对钢进行渗铬处理以增强硬度。

e.en: They {chromize} the surface to resist corrosion.
e.zh: 他们对表面进行渗铬以抵抗腐蚀。

e.en: The factory uses {chromizing} to harden steel parts.
e.zh: 工厂用渗铬工艺来硬化钢制零件。

e.en: {Chromizing} forms a protective layer on the surface.
e.zh: 渗铬在表面形成一层保护层。

e.en: The {chromocentre} appears as a dense region in the nucleus.
e.zh: 染色中心在细胞核中表现为致密区域。

e.en: Researchers stained the {chromocentre} for observation.
e.zh: 研究人员对染色中心进行染色以便观察。

e.en: Quantum {chromodynamic} theory describes the strong force.
e.zh: 量子色动力学理论描述强相互作用力。

e.en: They studied {chromodynamic} effects in particle collisions.
e.zh: 他们研究了粒子碰撞中的色动力学效应。

e.en: The {chromogen} reacts with the enzyme to produce color.
e.zh: 色原体与酶反应产生颜色。

e.en: Scientists isolated a new {chromogen} from the plant.
e.zh: 科学家从这种植物中分离出一种新的色原体。

e.en: {Chromogenesis} in bacteria can indicate certain species.
e.zh: 细菌的色素生成可作为某些菌种的标志。

e.en: The study focused on {chromogenesis} in marine organisms.
e.zh: 该研究关注海洋生物的色素生成过程。

e.en: They used a {chromogenic} medium to identify the bacteria.
e.zh: 他们用产色培养基来鉴定细菌。

e.en: This {chromogenic} reaction makes detection easier.
e.zh: 这种生色反应使检测变得更容易。

e.en: The {chromogram} clearly showed two distinct peaks.
e.zh: 该色谱图清楚地显示出两个不同的峰。

e.en: She analyzed the {chromogram} for impurities.
e.zh: 她分析了色谱图以检测杂质。

chromograph.t: 色彩印刷机；彩色印刷品

e.en: The old {chromograph} sat in the corner of the print shop.
e.zh: 那台旧色彩印刷机放在印刷店的角落里。

e.en: He collected antique {chromograph} prints.
e.zh: 他收藏古董彩色印刷品。

e.en: The cells contained traces of {chromolipid}.
e.zh: 细胞中含有微量色脂。

e.en: {Chromolipid} pigments give certain tissues their hue.
e.zh: 色脂色素赋予某些组织特有的色调。

e.en: The book featured {chromolithographic} illustrations.
e.zh: 这本书配有彩色石印插图。

e.en: He admired the {chromolithographic} posters from the 1890s.
e.zh: 他欣赏那些1890年代的彩色石印海报。

e.en: {Chromolithography} revolutionized color printing in the 19th century.
e.zh: 彩色石印术使19世纪的彩色印刷发生了革命。

e.en: The museum displays examples of early {chromolithography}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出早期彩色石印术的样品。

e.en: Each {chromomere} appears as a bead on the chromosome.
e.zh: 每个染色粒在染色体上呈念珠状。

e.en: The arrangement of {chromomere} structures was mapped carefully.
e.zh: 染色粒结构的排列被仔细地绘制出来。

e.en: {Chromone} derivatives are used in pharmaceuticals.
e.zh: 色酮衍生物被用于制药领域。

e.en: They synthesized a new {chromone} compound.
e.zh: 他们合成了一种新的色酮化合物。

e.en: The {chromonema} is the basic thread of the chromosome.
e.zh: 染色丝是染色体的基本线状结构。

e.en: Under the microscope, the {chromonema} became visible.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，染色丝变得可见。

e.en: They studied the {chromonematic} structure of the cell.
e.zh: 他们研究了细胞的染色丝结构。

e.en: {Chromonematic} threads coil during mitosis.
e.zh: 染色丝在有丝分裂过程中盘绕起来。

e.en: {Chromonucleoprotein} is a key component of chromosomes.
e.zh: 染色核蛋白是染色体的关键组成部分。

e.en: They extracted {chromonucleoprotein} from the cell nucleus.
e.zh: 他们从细胞核中提取了染色核蛋白。

e.en: The {chromophil} cells absorbed the dye readily.
e.zh: 嗜色细胞很容易吸收染料。

e.en: She identified the {chromophil} structures in the slide.
e.zh: 她在切片中识别出了嗜色结构。

e.en: The tissue was strongly {chromophilous} when stained.
e.zh: 该组织染色后表现出强烈的嗜色性。

e.en: {Chromophilous} cells stand out under the microscope.
e.zh: 嗜色细胞在显微镜下十分突出。

e.en: {Chromophobe} cells do not take up the dye easily.
e.zh: 嫌色细胞不易吸收染料。

e.en: The pathologist noted clusters of {chromophobe} cells.
e.zh: 病理学家注意到一团团嫌色细胞。

e.en: The molecule's {chromophore} absorbs visible light.
e.zh: 该分子的发色团吸收可见光。

e.en: Modifying the {chromophore} changes the dye's color.
e.zh: 修饰发色团会改变染料的颜色。

e.en: The compound has strong {chromophoric} properties.
e.zh: 该化合物具有很强的发色性能。

e.en: {Chromophoric} groups determine the molecule's color.
e.zh: 发色基团决定了分子的颜色。

e.en: The {chromophorous} groups define the dye's hue.
e.zh: 发色团决定了染料的色调。

e.en: They analyzed several {chromophorous} compounds.
e.zh: 他们分析了几种含发色团的化合物。

e.en: The album featured early {chromophotograph} prints.
e.zh: 该相册收录了早期的彩色照片。

e.en: He restored the faded {chromophotograph} carefully.
e.zh: 他细心地修复了那张褪色的彩色照片。

e.en: {Chromophotography} was a major advance in imaging.
e.zh: 彩色摄影术是成像领域的一大进步。

e.en: He wrote a book on the history of {chromophotography}.
e.zh: 他写了一本关于彩色摄影术历史的书。

e.en: {Chromoplasm} refers to the colored protoplasm in cells.
e.zh: 色质指细胞中带颜色的原生质。

e.en: They examined {chromoplasm} distribution in the sample.
e.zh: 他们检查了样品中色质的分布。

e.en: The orange color of carrots comes from {chromoplast} pigments.
e.zh: 胡萝卜的橙色来自有色体中的色素。

e.en: {Chromoplast} structures store carotenoids in plant cells.
e.zh: 有色体在植物细胞中储存类胡萝卜素。

e.en: Hemoglobin is a well-known {chromoprotein}.
e.zh: 血红蛋白是一种著名的色蛋白。

e.en: They isolated a new {chromoprotein} from algae.
e.zh: 他们从藻类中分离出一种新的色蛋白。

e.en: They observed {chromospheric} activity on the sun.
e.zh: 他们观测到太阳上的色球层活动。

e.en: The flare produced strong {chromospheric} emissions.
e.zh: 耀斑产生了强烈的色球层辐射。

e.en: {Chromotropy} occurs when the solution is heated.
e.zh: 溶液加热时会出现变色现象。

e.en: The dye exhibits remarkable {chromotropy} under UV light.
e.zh: 该染料在紫外光下表现出明显的变色性。

e.en: The shop produced fine {chromotype} reproductions.
e.zh: 那家店制作精美的彩色印版复制品。

e.en: He framed an old {chromotype} of the harbor.
e.zh: 他把一张旧的港口彩色印版照片裱了起来。

e.en: {Chromotypography} allowed for vivid book illustrations.
e.zh: 彩色印刷术使书籍插图变得生动鲜明。

e.en: The exhibit traces the development of {chromotypography}.
e.zh: 展览追溯了彩色印刷术的发展历程。

e.en: They prepared a {chromous} chloride solution.
e.zh: 他们制备了亚铬氯化物溶液。

e.en: {Chromous} salts are strong reducing agents.
e.zh: 亚铬盐是强还原剂。

e.en: {Chromyl} chloride is a deep red liquid.
e.zh: 铬酰氯是一种深红色液体。

e.en: They handled the {chromyl} compound with extreme care.
e.zh: 他们极其小心地处理这种铬酰化合物。

e.en: {Chronaxie} measures the excitability of nerve tissue.
e.zh: 时值用于测量神经组织的兴奋性。

e.en: The doctor recorded the patient's {chronaxie} value.
e.zh: 医生记录了患者的时值数据。

e.en: The {chronaximeter} is used in neurological testing.
e.zh: 时值计用于神经学检测。

e.en: She calibrated the {chronaximeter} before each session.
e.zh: 她在每次实验前都校准时值计。

chronical.t: 长期的；慢性的（chronic的旧式拼写）

e.en: He suffered from a {chronical} cough that wouldn't go away.
e.zh: 他患有一种久治不愈的慢性咳嗽。

e.en: The village faced {chronical} water shortages every summer.
e.zh: 这个村庄每年夏天都面临长期的缺水问题。

chrono.t: 计时码表；时间相关的（前缀）

e.en: He bought a vintage {chrono} with a leather strap.
e.zh: 他买了一只配皮表带的复古计时码表。

e.en: The watch's {chrono} function lets you time short events accurately.
e.zh: 这只表的计时功能可以精确测量短时间事件。

chronobiology.t: 时间生物学；生物节律学

e.en: Researchers in {chronobiology} study how light affects sleep cycles.
e.zh: 时间生物学研究人员探究光线如何影响睡眠周期。

e.en: {Chronobiology} explains why jet lag disrupts our internal clocks.
e.zh: 时间生物学解释了为何时差会打乱我们的生物钟。

e.en: The Latin inscription is a clever {chronogram} hiding the year 1666.
e.zh: 这段拉丁铭文是一则巧妙的年代铭文，暗藏着1666年。

e.en: Scholars deciphered the {chronogram} carved above the church door.
e.zh: 学者们破译了刻在教堂门上方的纪年铭文。

chronogrammatic.t: 年代铭文的；纪年铭文式的

e.en: The plaque bears a {chronogrammatic} verse marking the cathedral's completion.
e.zh: 这块匾额刻有一段纪年铭文式的诗句，纪念大教堂的落成。

e.en: He collected {chronogrammatic} inscriptions from across Europe.
e.zh: 他收集了来自欧洲各地的年代铭文式题刻。

chronogrammatist.t: 年代铭文作者；纪年铭文撰写者

e.en: A skilled {chronogrammatist} could weave a date into any line of verse.
e.zh: 一位高明的年代铭文作者能把日期嵌入任何诗句中。

e.en: The court poet was renowned as a {chronogrammatist}.
e.zh: 这位宫廷诗人以擅长撰写纪年铭文而闻名。

e.en: The watch features {chronographic} dials for measuring lap times.
e.zh: 这款手表配有用于测量单圈时间的计时表盘。

e.en: {Chronographic} records helped astronomers track the eclipse precisely.
e.zh: 计时记录帮助天文学家精确追踪了这次日食。

e.en: The {chronologer} carefully dated each event in the ancient records.
e.zh: 这位年代学家仔细考证了古代文献中每一事件的年代。

e.en: As a {chronologer}, she specialized in medieval European timelines.
e.zh: 作为一名年代学家，她专攻中世纪欧洲的年代序列。

e.en: Please arrange the documents in {chronologic} order.
e.zh: 请把这些文件按时间顺序排列。

e.en: The museum's exhibits follow a strict {chronologic} sequence.
e.zh: 博物馆的展品严格按编年顺序陈列。

e.en: The historian tried to {chronologise} the scattered diary entries.
e.zh: 这位历史学家试图把散乱的日记条目按年代顺序整理。

e.en: It took weeks to {chronologise} the family photographs.
e.zh: 花了好几周才把家族照片按年代排好。

e.en: The {chronologist} resolved disputes about the dynasty's exact dates.
e.zh: 这位年代学家解决了关于该王朝确切日期的争议。

e.en: Archaeologists rely on a {chronologist} to align findings with history.
e.zh: 考古学家依靠年代学家把发现与历史对应起来。

e.en: He set out to {chronologize} the events of the war.
e.zh: 他着手把这场战争的事件按年代顺序整理。

e.en: It is hard to {chronologize} legends with no written records.
e.zh: 没有书面记载的传说很难按年代排序。

e.en: The lab uses {chronometrical} instruments accurate to a millisecond.
e.zh: 实验室使用精度达毫秒级的测时仪器。

e.en: Sailors once depended on {chronometrical} devices to find longitude.
e.zh: 水手们曾经依靠计时装置来确定经度。

e.en: Modern {chronometry} relies on atomic clocks for unmatched accuracy.
e.zh: 现代测时学依靠原子钟实现无与伦比的精度。

e.en: Astronomers made major contributions to early {chronometry}.
e.zh: 天文学家对早期测时学作出了重大贡献。

chronon.t: 时间子；时元（时间最小理论单位）

e.en: Some physicists speculate that time may be quantized into a {chronon}.
e.zh: 一些物理学家推测时间可能以时间子的形式量子化。

e.en: The {chronon} remains a theoretical concept in modern physics.
e.zh: 时间子在现代物理学中仍是一个理论概念。

chronoscope.t: 精密计时器；精密测时仪

e.en: The physicist used a {chronoscope} to measure the bullet's flight time.
e.zh: 物理学家用精密计时器测量子弹的飞行时间。

e.en: Early psychologists relied on a {chronoscope} to time reactions.
e.zh: 早期心理学家依靠精密计时器来记录反应时间。

e.en: Doctors use {chronotherapy} to time medication with the body's rhythms.
e.zh: 医生使用时间疗法，使药物用药时间与身体节律一致。

e.en: {Chronotherapy} can improve outcomes for some cancer treatments.
e.zh: 时辰治疗可以改善某些癌症治疗的效果。

e.en: The caterpillar transformed into a golden {chrysalid} overnight.
e.zh: 毛毛虫一夜之间变成了一只金色的蛹。

e.en: She found a fragile {chrysalid} hanging from the leaf.
e.zh: 她在叶子下发现了一只脆弱的蛹。

e.en: The children watched the {chrysalids} sway in the breeze.
e.zh: 孩子们看着蛹在微风中轻轻摇摆。

e.en: Most of the {chrysalids} hatched within a single week.
e.zh: 大多数蛹在一周之内就孵化了。

e.en: She placed a yellow {chrysanth} in the vase by the window.
e.zh: 她在窗边的花瓶里插了一朵黄色的菊花。

e.en: The garden was full of {chrysanth} blooms in autumn.
e.zh: 秋天花园里开满了菊花。

chryselephantine.t: 金象牙制的（古希腊雕像工艺）

e.en: The temple housed a magnificent {chryselephantine} statue of Athena.
e.zh: 神庙中供奉着一尊宏伟的金象牙雅典娜雕像。

e.en: Ancient sculptors mastered the difficult {chryselephantine} technique.
e.zh: 古代雕刻家精通这种高难度的金象牙工艺。

e.en: The ring featured a rare yellow-green {chrysoberyl} stone.
e.zh: 这枚戒指镶嵌着一颗罕见的黄绿色金绿宝石。

e.en: {Chrysoberyl} is prized for its hardness and brilliance.
e.zh: 金绿宝石因其硬度高、光泽好而备受珍视。

e.en: The pendant was carved from a beautiful piece of {chrysocolla}.
e.zh: 这枚吊坠是用一块美丽的硅孔雀石雕成的。

e.en: {Chrysocolla} is often found near copper deposits.
e.zh: 硅孔雀石常见于铜矿床附近。

e.en: The monastery preserved a medieval {chrysograph} of the Gospels.
e.zh: 修道院保存着一部中世纪的金字福音手稿。

e.en: Each {chrysograph} took years of patient work to produce.
e.zh: 每一部金字手稿都需要多年的耐心抄写才能完成。

chrysography.t: 金字书写艺术；以金墨抄写

e.en: Byzantine monks were famous for their exquisite {chrysography}.
e.zh: 拜占庭僧侣以其精美的金字抄写艺术而闻名。

e.en: The art of {chrysography} nearly disappeared after the Middle Ages.
e.zh: 金字书写艺术在中世纪之后几乎失传。

chrysolite.t: 贵橄榄石；金绿宝石（旧称）

e.en: The ancient brooch was set with a clear green {chrysolite}.
e.zh: 这枚古老的胸针上镶嵌着一颗清澈的绿色贵橄榄石。

e.en: Sailors once carried {chrysolite} as a charm against sea monsters.
e.zh: 水手们曾随身携带贵橄榄石以驱避海怪。

e.en: She wore a pendant of polished {chrysoprase}.
e.zh: 她戴着一枚抛光绿玉髓吊坠。

e.en: The jeweler displayed rare {chrysoprase} from Australia.
e.zh: 珠宝商展出了来自澳大利亚的稀有绿玉髓。

e.en: The collection featured several {chrysoprases} of varying hues.
e.zh: 该收藏品包含数件色调各异的绿玉髓。

e.en: Ancient artisans carved {chrysoprases} into amulets.
e.zh: 古代工匠把绿玉髓雕成护身符。

e.en: Most commercial asbestos was {chrysotile}.
e.zh: 大部分商用石棉都是温石棉。

e.en: They tested the insulation for {chrysotile} fibers.
e.zh: 他们检测了保温材料中是否含有温石棉纤维。

e.en: The myth describes {chthonian} deities of the underworld.
e.zh: 该神话描述了冥界的地下诸神。

e.en: He felt a {chthonian} dread rise from the cave.
e.zh: 他感到一股阴森的恐惧从洞穴中升起。

e.en: A sudden {chubasco} forced the boats back to port.
e.zh: 一场突如其来的强暴风雨迫使船只返港。

e.en: Fishermen feared the season's first {chubasco}.
e.zh: 渔民们担心本季第一场强暴风雨。

e.en: He's the {chubbiest} puppy in the litter.
e.zh: 它是这窝里最胖嘟嘟的小狗。

e.en: That's the {chubbiest} cheek I've ever pinched.
e.zh: 那是我捏过最圆润的脸蛋。

e.en: The toddler waddled {chubbily} across the floor.
e.zh: 那个小孩胖乎乎地摇摇晃晃走过地板。

e.en: She smiled {chubbily} at the camera.
e.zh: 她对着镜头露出胖嘟嘟的笑容。

e.en: Her baby {chubbiness} faded as she grew up.
e.zh: 她婴儿时期的胖嘟嘟随着长大渐渐消退。

e.en: He was self-conscious about his {chubbiness}.
e.zh: 他对自己的丰满身材有些在意。

chuck-a-luck.t: 骰宝（一种掷骰赌博游戏）

e.en: They played {chuck-a-luck} at the carnival booth.
e.zh: 他们在嘉年华的摊位上玩了骰宝。

e.en: Old saloons often featured {chuck-a-luck} tables.
e.zh: 旧式酒馆里常摆着骰宝赌桌。

chuck-full.t: 塞得满满的；装得鼓鼓的

e.en: The trunk was {chuck-full} of old letters.
e.zh: 那个箱子里塞满了旧信。

e.en: Her schedule is {chuck-full} this week.
e.zh: 她这周的日程排得满满的。

chuck-will's-widow.t: 卡罗来纳夜鹰（一种夜行鸟）

e.en: A {chuck-will's-widow} called from the pine woods.
e.zh: 一只卡罗来纳夜鹰在松林中啼鸣。

e.en: We heard the {chuck-will's-widow} just after dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏过后我们就听见了卡罗来纳夜鹰的叫声。

chuckawalla.t: 沙漠鬣蜥；楚克瓦拉蜥蜴

e.en: A {chuckawalla} basked on the desert rock.
e.zh: 一只沙漠鬣蜥在沙漠岩石上晒太阳。

e.en: The {chuckawalla} wedged itself into a crevice.
e.zh: 那只楚克瓦拉蜥蜴钻进了岩缝里。

e.en: The {chucker-out} escorted the rowdy patron outside.
e.zh: 那个保镖把闹事的客人请了出去。

e.en: Pubs once employed a burly {chucker-out}.
e.zh: 酒馆从前会雇一个魁梧的轰人保镖。

e.en: The club's {chuckerout} stood by the door.
e.zh: 夜店的保镖站在门口。

e.en: He worked nights as a {chuckerout}.
e.zh: 他晚上做轰人保镖的工作。

e.en: The car hit a deep {chuckhole}.
e.zh: 汽车撞进了一个很深的路面坑洞。

e.en: Spring thaw left {chuckholes} all over the road.
e.zh: 春融过后路面到处都是坑洞。

e.en: She told a {chucklesome} story at dinner.
e.zh: 她在晚餐时讲了个逗趣的故事。

e.en: The cartoon was mildly {chucklesome}.
e.zh: 这部动画片还挺让人发笑的。

chuckwalla.t: 沙漠鬣蜥（北美西部蜥蜴）

e.en: A {chuckwalla} sunned itself on the boulder.
e.zh: 一只沙漠鬣蜥在大石头上晒太阳。

e.en: The {chuckwalla} puffed up to deter the predator.
e.zh: 那只沙漠鬣蜥鼓起身体吓退捕食者。

e.en: She drew the {chuddar} over her head.
e.zh: 她把恰达尔披到了头上。

e.en: The market sold colorful {chuddars}.
e.zh: 市场上卖着各色的恰达尔披肩。

e.en: She wrapped a {chudder} around her shoulders.
e.zh: 她把披肩裹在肩上。

e.en: The embroidered {chudder} was a family heirloom.
e.zh: 那条绣花披肩是家传之物。

chuffily.t: 得意地；高兴地（英式口语）

e.en: He grinned {chuffily} at the news.
e.zh: 听到这消息他得意地咧嘴笑。

e.en: She nodded {chuffily} when praised.
e.zh: 被表扬时她得意地点了点头。

e.en: There was a hint of {chuffiness} in his voice.
e.zh: 他的声音里带着一丝得意。

e.en: Her {chuffiness} was hard to hide.
e.zh: 她的得意之情很难掩饰。

e.en: A {chuffy} little dog trotted beside her.
e.zh: 一只胖乎乎的小狗在她身旁小跑。

e.en: He had {chuffy} cheeks and a wide grin.
e.zh: 他有着胖乎乎的脸颊和灿烂的笑容。

e.en: The crowd chanted as he {chug-a-lugged} the soda.
e.zh: 他咕咚咕咚地一口气喝完汽水时人群齐声呐喊。

e.en: They {chug-a-lug} their drinks at the bar.
e.zh: 他们在吧台咕咚咕咚地把酒一饮而尽。

e.en: He decided to {chugalug} the entire bottle.
e.zh: 他决定咕咚咕咚地把整瓶喝光。

e.en: The fans {chugalug} their beers between innings.
e.zh: 球迷们在局间咕咚咕咚地猛灌啤酒。

chukka.t: 马球比赛的一节；及踝短靴

e.en: He scored twice in the final {chukka}.
e.zh: 他在最后一节马球比赛中进了两球。

e.en: She wore suede {chukka} boots to the office.
e.zh: 她穿着麂皮及踝短靴去上班。

chukkar.t: 马球比赛中的一节（chukker 的变体）

e.en: Each {chukkar} lasts about seven minutes.
e.zh: 马球的每一节大约持续七分钟。

e.en: They rested the ponies between {chukkars}.
e.zh: 他们在每节比赛之间让马休息。

chukker.t: 马球比赛的一节（七分半钟）

e.en: The match consists of six {chukkers}.
e.zh: 这场比赛由六节组成。

e.en: He fell off his pony in the third {chukker}.
e.zh: 他在第三节比赛中从马上摔了下来。

e.en: The monk wore a simple rope {cincture}.
e.zh: 修士系着一条简单的绳腰带。

e.en: A {cincture} of trees surrounded the meadow.
e.zh: 一圈树木环绕着草地。

e.en: The path was rough and {cindery} underfoot.
e.zh: 脚下的小路粗糙而满是煤渣。

e.en: They crossed a {cindery} volcanic plain.
e.zh: 他们穿过一片满是火山渣的平原。

e.en: He filmed the wedding with an old {cine-camera}.
e.zh: 他用一台旧式电影摄影机拍摄了婚礼。

e.en: The {cine-camera} whirred quietly on the tripod.
e.zh: 电影摄影机在三脚架上轻轻地转动着。

e.en: The {cineangiogram} revealed a narrowed artery.
e.zh: 电影血管造影显示动脉变窄。

e.en: Doctors reviewed the {cineangiogram} frame by frame.
e.zh: 医生逐帧查看电影血管造影片。

e.en: {Cineangiography} helps diagnose heart valve problems.
e.zh: 电影血管造影术有助于诊断心脏瓣膜问题。

e.en: She underwent {cineangiography} before the surgery.
e.zh: 手术前她接受了电影血管造影检查。

e.en: As a {cineast}, he watched three films a week.
e.zh: 作为一名影迷，他每周看三部电影。

e.en: The festival drew {cineasts} from across Europe.
e.zh: 电影节吸引了来自欧洲各地的影迷。

e.en: She loaded film into the {cinecamera}.
e.zh: 她把胶片装进电影摄影机里。

e.en: The {cinecamera} captured every detail of the parade.
e.zh: 电影摄影机捕捉到了游行的每一个细节。

e.en: He preserved the old {cinefilm} reels in cool storage.
e.zh: 他把旧电影胶片卷存放在低温环境中。

e.en: The museum digitised hours of vintage {cinefilm}.
e.zh: 博物馆将数小时的老电影胶片数字化了。

e.en: {Cinefluorography} records moving X-ray images.
e.zh: 电影荧光摄影术能记录动态的X光影像。

e.en: Doctors used {cinefluorography} to study swallowing.
e.zh: 医生用电影荧光摄影术研究吞咽过程。

e.en: {Cinefluoroscopy} reveals real-time joint movement.
e.zh: 电影荧光透视术能显示关节的实时活动。

e.en: The clinic specialises in {cinefluoroscopy} studies.
e.zh: 该诊所专门从事电影荧光透视检查。

e.en: Most {cinemagoers} prefer evening screenings.
e.zh: 大多数影迷喜欢看晚场电影。

e.en: She is a regular {cinemagoer} at the local arthouse.
e.zh: 她是当地艺术影院的常客。

e.en: The Paris {cinematheque} screens classic films nightly.
e.zh: 巴黎电影资料馆每晚放映经典影片。

e.en: He spent his afternoons at the {cinematheque}.
e.zh: 他常常在艺术影院度过下午时光。

e.en: The director hopes to {cinematise} the novel.
e.zh: 导演希望把这部小说改编成电影。

e.en: Few playwrights want their works {cinematised}.
e.zh: 很少有剧作家愿意自己的作品被改编成电影。

e.en: They plan to {cinematize} the bestselling memoir.
e.zh: 他们打算把这本畅销回忆录改编成电影。

e.en: The studio will {cinematize} her stage play.
e.zh: 该制片厂将把她的舞台剧改编成电影。

cinematograph.t: 电影放映机；电影摄影机

e.en: The Lumière brothers invented the {cinematograph}.
e.zh: 卢米埃尔兄弟发明了电影放映机。

e.en: An early {cinematograph} sat in the museum's lobby.
e.zh: 博物馆大厅里摆着一台早期的电影放映机。

e.en: The film is {cinematographically} stunning.
e.zh: 这部电影在摄影方面令人惊艳。

e.en: {Cinematographically}, the sequel disappoints.
e.zh: 在摄影方面，这部续集令人失望。

e.en: {Cinemicrography} captures cell division on film.
e.zh: 显微电影摄影术能拍下细胞分裂的过程。

e.en: His lab pioneered {cinemicrography} in the 1950s.
e.zh: 他的实验室在1950年代开创了显微电影摄影术。

e.en: {Cinemicroscopy} let scientists watch bacteria move.
e.zh: 显微电影摄影法让科学家得以观察细菌的运动。

e.en: They studied the embryo using {cinemicroscopy}.
e.zh: 他们用显微电影摄影法研究胚胎。

e.en: As a {cinephile}, she keeps a list of every film she sees.
e.zh: 作为影迷，她记录下自己看过的每一部电影。

e.en: The bar is a meeting place for local {cinephiles}.
e.zh: 这家酒吧是当地影迷的聚会场所。

e.en: {Cinephotomicrography} records microscopic events.
e.zh: 显微电影摄影术能记录微观世界的活动。

e.en: They used {cinephotomicrography} to film the cells.
e.zh: 他们用显微电影摄影术拍摄了细胞。

e.en: The old {cineprojector} clattered to life.
e.zh: 那台旧电影放映机咔哒咔哒地启动了。

e.en: He set up a {cineprojector} in the basement.
e.zh: 他在地下室架起了一台电影放映机。

e.en: {Cineradiography} shows joint motion in real time.
e.zh: 电影X射线摄影术能实时显示关节活动。

e.en: Engineers used {cineradiography} to study the engine.
e.zh: 工程师们用电影X射线摄影术研究发动机。

e.en: Bright {cineraria} blooms filled the windowsill.
e.zh: 鲜艳的瓜叶菊摆满了窗台。

e.en: She bought a pot of purple {cineraria}.
e.zh: 她买了一盆紫色的瓜叶菊。

e.en: His ashes were placed in the family {cinerarium}.
e.zh: 他的骨灰被安放在家族骨灰存放处。

e.en: The chapel houses a small marble {cinerarium}.
e.zh: 小礼拜堂里有一个小型大理石骨灰存放处。

e.en: The museum displayed an ancient {cinerary} urn.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一只古代骨灰瓮。

e.en: Roman {cinerary} vessels often bore inscriptions.
e.zh: 罗马的骨灰器皿上常刻有铭文。

e.en: The process of {cineration} reduces remains to ash.
e.zh: 焚化过程将遗体化为灰烬。

e.en: Ancient peoples practised {cineration} of the dead.
e.zh: 古代民族会对死者进行火化。

ciderkin.t: 苹果渣淡酒；二榨的淡苹果酒

e.en: Farmers used to brew {ciderkin} from leftover apple pulp.
e.zh: 农夫过去常用榨剩的苹果渣酿造淡苹果酒。

e.en: The {ciderkin} was much weaker than ordinary cider.
e.zh: 这种二榨苹果酒比一般苹果酒淡得多。

cigar-shaped.t: 雪茄形的；细长两端尖的

e.en: Astronomers spotted a {cigar-shaped} object passing through the solar system.
e.zh: 天文学家发现一个雪茄形物体正穿越太阳系。

e.en: She bought a sleek {cigar-shaped} handbag for the evening.
e.zh: 她买了一只时髦的雪茄形手袋去赴晚宴。

cigarette-card.t: 香烟卡片（旧时香烟盒内附赠的收藏画片）

e.en: He collected vintage {cigarette-cards} featuring famous footballers.
e.zh: 他收藏了印有著名足球运动员的老式香烟卡片。

e.en: Old {cigarette-cards} can fetch high prices at auction.
e.zh: 旧式的香烟卡片在拍卖会上能卖出高价。

e.en: She stubbed out the {cigarette-end} in the ashtray.
e.zh: 她把烟蒂在烟灰缸里掐灭。

e.en: The pavement was littered with {cigarette-ends}.
e.zh: 人行道上满地都是烟头。

e.en: She lit a slim {cigarlet} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后她点了一支细雪茄。

e.en: He preferred {cigarlets} to full-sized cigars.
e.zh: 比起整支雪茄，他更喜欢小雪茄。

ciguatoxin.t: 雪卡毒素（热带珊瑚鱼体内的神经毒素）

e.en: Eating large reef fish can expose you to {ciguatoxin}.
e.zh: 食用大型珊瑚礁鱼类可能让人接触到雪卡毒素。

e.en: {Ciguatoxin} causes a tropical form of food poisoning.
e.zh: 雪卡毒素会引起一种热带食物中毒。

cilery.t: 柱头叶饰雕刻（哥特建筑中柱顶的叶形装饰）

e.en: The chapel's columns featured delicate {cilery} carvings.
e.zh: 小教堂的柱子上雕有精致的叶形柱头装饰。

e.en: Medieval masons specialized in floral {cilery}.
e.zh: 中世纪石匠擅长雕刻花叶式柱头装饰。

e.en: Microscopy revealed dense {ciliation} on the cell surface.
e.zh: 显微镜下可见细胞表面密布纤毛。

e.en: The pattern of {ciliation} helps biologists identify the species.
e.zh: 纤毛分布的模式有助于生物学家鉴别物种。

cilice.t: 苦修毛衫；苦行者所穿的粗毛衣

e.en: The monk wore a rough {cilice} beneath his robe.
e.zh: 那位修士在长袍下穿着粗糙的苦修毛衫。

e.en: She practiced penance by wearing a hidden {cilice}.
e.zh: 她身穿隐秘的苦修毛衫以行苦修。

e.en: The organism has fine {ciliiform} appendages along its body.
e.zh: 该生物体侧长着细小的纤毛状附属物。

e.en: Scientists observed {ciliiform} structures lining the tissue.
e.zh: 科学家观察到组织表面排列着纤毛状结构。

ciliolate.t: 具小纤毛的；边缘有细毛的

e.en: The leaf margins are finely {ciliolate} under magnification.
e.zh: 放大后可见叶缘具细小纤毛。

e.en: Botanists describe the petals as {ciliolate}.
e.zh: 植物学家形容这些花瓣边缘有细小纤毛。

cilium.t: 纤毛（细胞表面的毛状突起）

e.en: Each {cilium} beats in coordinated waves to move fluid.
e.zh: 每根纤毛以协调的波动方式推动液体流动。

e.en: A single {cilium} extends from the surface of the cell.
e.zh: 细胞表面伸出一根单独的纤毛。

cimbalom.t: 钦巴隆琴；匈牙利大扬琴

e.en: The Hungarian musician played a soulful {cimbalom} solo.
e.zh: 那位匈牙利乐手演奏了一段动人的钦巴隆琴独奏。

e.en: Lively {cimbalom} music filled the café late into the night.
e.zh: 欢快的钦巴隆琴乐声在咖啡馆里一直回荡到深夜。

e.en: The cave was filled with {Cimmerian} darkness.
e.zh: 洞穴里一片漆黑幽暗。

e.en: A {Cimmerian} gloom hung over the moor at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时分，沼地上笼罩着一种阴森的昏暗。

cinchona.t: 金鸡纳树；金鸡纳树皮（提炼奎宁的原料）

e.en: Quinine is extracted from the bark of the {cinchona} tree.
e.zh: 奎宁是从金鸡纳树的树皮中提取的。

e.en: Colonial planters cultivated {cinchona} in the highlands.
e.zh: 殖民时期的种植园主在高地栽培金鸡纳树。

e.en: Doctors used to {cinchonise} malaria patients with quinine.
e.zh: 医生过去常用奎宁来治疗疟疾病人。

e.en: The clinic would {cinchonise} feverish travelers returning from the tropics.
e.zh: 诊所会给从热带回来发烧的旅客施以金鸡纳碱治疗。

e.en: Excessive quinine doses can cause {cinchonism}.
e.zh: 过量服用奎宁会导致金鸡纳中毒。

e.en: Symptoms of {cinchonism} include ringing in the ears and nausea.
e.zh: 金鸡纳中毒的症状包括耳鸣和恶心。

cinchonize.t: 用金鸡纳碱治疗；以奎宁处理

e.en: Army physicians would {cinchonize} the soldiers daily during the campaign.
e.zh: 战役期间军医每天给士兵服用金鸡纳碱。

e.en: They tried to {cinchonize} the wine to give it medicinal value.
e.zh: 他们试图在葡萄酒中加入金鸡纳碱以增加药用价值。

e.en: He admitted {chousing} customers out of their refunds.
e.zh: 他承认骗取了顾客本应得到的退款。

e.en: The con man was skilled at {chousing} the elderly.
e.zh: 那个骗子很擅长蒙骗老年人。

e.en: She baked light {choux} buns for dessert.
e.zh: 她为甜点烤了松软的泡芙。

e.en: The recipe calls for fresh {choux} pastry.
e.zh: 这道食谱需要新鲜的泡芙面团。

e.en: Grandma served pork chops with homemade {chow-chow}.
e.zh: 奶奶端上猪排配自制的什锦泡菜。

e.en: Their fluffy {chow-chow} barked at every stranger.
e.zh: 他们家毛茸茸的松狮犬见人就叫。

e.en: She canned jars of {chowchow} every autumn.
e.zh: 她每到秋天就装一罐罐什锦泡菜。

e.en: The {chowchow} has a distinctive blue tongue.
e.zh: 松狮犬有一条独特的蓝色舌头。

e.en: Stop acting like a {chowderhead} and read the manual.
e.zh: 别像个糊涂虫一样，去看说明书吧。

e.en: Only a {chowderhead} would lock his keys inside twice.
e.zh: 只有蠢家伙才会两次把钥匙锁车里。

chowderheaded.t: 愚蠢的；糊涂的；没脑子的

e.en: Don't make such {chowderheaded} excuses anymore.
e.zh: 别再找这种愚蠢的借口了。

e.en: His {chowderheaded} plan ruined the whole afternoon.
e.zh: 他那个糊涂的计划毁了一下午。

e.en: Every {chowhound} in town lined up for ramen.
e.zh: 城里的美食控都排队来吃这家拉面。

e.en: My brother is a real {chowhound} on weekends.
e.zh: 我弟弟一到周末就成了大吃货。

e.en: The kids came running when Dad shouted {chowtime}.
e.zh: 爸爸一喊开饭，孩子们就跑过来。

e.en: It's almost {chowtime} at the campsite.
e.zh: 营地差不多到吃饭时间了。

chrematistic.t: 谋财的；以营利为目的的

e.en: The novel critiques the {chrematistic} obsessions of high society.
e.zh: 这部小说批判上流社会对敛财的痴迷。

e.en: Ancient philosophers warned against purely {chrematistic} pursuits.
e.zh: 古代哲学家警告人们勿一味追求敛财。

e.en: Aristotle distinguished economics from {chrematistics}.
e.zh: 亚里士多德把经济学与致富学区分开。

e.en: His lectures on {chrematistics} drew small but devoted crowds.
e.zh: 他关于致富学的讲座听众不多但很忠实。

e.en: She joked that her {chrematophobia} kept her wallet thin.
e.zh: 她开玩笑说她的恐钱症让钱包总是空的。

e.en: Severe {chrematophobia} made him refuse any inheritance.
e.zh: 严重的恐钱症让他拒绝任何遗产。

chrestomathic.t: 学以致用的；选粹学习的

e.en: The textbook takes a {chrestomathic} approach to grammar.
e.zh: 这本教材用学以致用的方式教语法。

e.en: Her {chrestomathic} method emphasizes useful vocabulary first.
e.zh: 她的选粹学习法优先教实用词汇。

e.en: The teacher assigned a Greek {chrestomathy} for daily reading.
e.zh: 老师布置了一本希腊语选读集供每日阅读。

e.en: He compiled a {chrestomathy} of medieval poems.
e.zh: 他编了一本中世纪诗歌选集。

e.en: The bishop blessed the {chrismal} vessel before mass.
e.zh: 主教在弥撒前为圣油容器祝圣。

e.en: A small {chrismal} cloth covered the infant's forehead.
e.zh: 一块小圣油布盖住婴儿的额头。

chrismation.t: 涂圣油礼；东正教坚振礼

e.en: The Orthodox child receives {chrismation} right after baptism.
e.zh: 东正教的孩子在洗礼后立即接受涂圣油礼。

e.en: {Chrismation} seals the gift of the Holy Spirit.
e.zh: 涂圣油礼印证了圣灵的恩赐。

chrismatory.t: 圣油盒；存放圣油的容器

e.en: The silver {chrismatory} sat on the altar.
e.zh: 银制的圣油盒摆在祭坛上。

e.en: He polished the antique {chrismatory} before the ceremony.
e.zh: 仪式前他擦亮了那个古董圣油盒。

e.en: The white banner bore a golden {chrismon}.
e.zh: 白色横幅上印着金色的基督花押。

e.en: Each Advent we hang {chrismon} ornaments on the tree.
e.zh: 每到将临期我们就在树上挂基督符号饰品。

e.en: The infant wore a long white {chrisom}.
e.zh: 婴儿穿着长长的白色受洗袍。

e.en: Old wills mention silk for the baby's {chrisom}.
e.zh: 旧时遗嘱提到为婴儿洗礼袍准备丝绸。

christcross.t: 基督十字记号；签名替代符号

e.en: She drew a small {christcross} beside her signature.
e.zh: 她在签名旁画了个小十字记号。

e.en: The illiterate farmhand made a {christcross} on the contract.
e.zh: 目不识丁的雇工在合同上画了个十字。

christcrossrow.t: 字母表的旧称；古时字母歌

e.en: Children once chanted the {christcrossrow} in dame schools.
e.zh: 孩子们曾在主妇学校齐声背诵字母表。

e.en: He taught his son the entire {christcrossrow}.
e.zh: 他把整个旧式字母表都教给了儿子。

christianizing.t: 基督教化；使皈依基督教

e.en: The missionaries spent decades {christianizing} the region.
e.zh: 传教士花了数十年使该地区基督教化。

e.en: Critics question the legacy of {christianizing} indigenous communities.
e.zh: 批评者质疑使原住民社区基督教化的遗产。

christianlike.t: 像基督徒的；具基督徒风范

e.en: Her quiet generosity was thoroughly {christianlike}.
e.zh: 她那种默默的慷慨完全有基督徒的风范。

e.en: He tried to live a {christianlike} life among harsh neighbors.
e.zh: 他在刻薄的邻居中尽力过基督徒般的生活。

christocentrism.t: 基督中心论；以基督为中心

e.en: Her theology emphasizes a strict {christocentrism}.
e.zh: 她的神学强调严格的基督中心论。

e.en: The seminary debated the limits of {christocentrism}.
e.zh: 神学院辩论基督中心论的边界。

e.en: Doctors removed the tumor from her {chromaffin} cells.
e.zh: 医生切除了她嗜铬细胞上的肿瘤。

e.en: {Chromaffin} tissue plays a key role in adrenaline release.
e.zh: 嗜铬组织在肾上腺素释放中起关键作用。

chromakey.t: 色键合成；绿幕抠像技术

e.en: The studio uses {chromakey} for the weather forecast background.
e.zh: 演播室用色键合成做天气预报的背景。

e.en: She wore green and disappeared into the {chromakey} screen.
e.zh: 她穿着绿衣，整个人消失在抠像幕布里。

e.en: The lab calibrated its new {chromascope} this morning.
e.zh: 实验室今早校准了那台新的色谱仪。

e.en: An old {chromascope} sits on the chemistry shelf.
e.zh: 一台老式色谱仪摆在化学实验室的架子上。

e.en: Workers must avoid breathing {chromate} dust at the plant.
e.zh: 工人在厂里必须避免吸入铬酸盐粉尘。

e.en: Lead {chromate} gives some paints a bright yellow color.
e.zh: 铬酸铅让一些颜料呈现鲜亮的黄色。

chromatically.t: 按半音音阶地；在色彩方面

e.en: The melody descends {chromatically} into the bass register.
e.zh: 旋律按半音阶下行到低音区。

e.en: The painting is balanced both formally and {chromatically}.
e.zh: 这幅画在构图和色彩上都很平衡。

e.en: He used pliers to remove the {circlip} from the shaft.
e.zh: 他用钳子从轴上取下卡环。

e.en: A small {circlip} holds the bearing in place.
e.zh: 一个小卡环将轴承固定到位。

e.en: The technician soldered a chip onto the {circuit-board}.
e.zh: 技术员把芯片焊到电路板上。

e.en: A damaged {circuit-board} can disable the entire device.
e.zh: 电路板损坏会让整个设备无法工作。

e.en: The {circuit-breaker} tripped during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨期间断路器跳闸了。

e.en: Reset the {circuit-breaker} in the basement panel.
e.zh: 重置地下室配电盘里的断路器。

e.en: All the {circuit-breakers} flipped at once.
e.zh: 所有断路器同时跳闸了。

e.en: Modern homes use many small {circuit-breakers} instead of fuses.
e.zh: 现代住宅用许多小型断路器代替保险丝。

e.en: The lawyer criticized the {circuity} of the witness's answers.
e.zh: 律师批评证人的回答拐弯抹角。

e.en: There was needless {circuity} in his explanation.
e.zh: 他的解释有不必要的迂回。

circularisation.t: 传阅；散发通告；广发函件

e.en: The {circularisation} of the memo took two days.
e.zh: 备忘录的传阅花了两天时间。

e.en: Auditors rely on {circularisation} of customer balances.
e.zh: 审计师依靠对客户余额的函证。

circularise.t: 散发通告；分发传单；函询

e.en: They {circularise} all members before each vote.
e.zh: 每次投票前他们都会向所有成员发函通知。

e.en: The firm decided to {circularise} the new policy.
e.zh: 公司决定把新政策通知大家。

circularize.t: 散发通告；广发传单；函询

e.en: The committee will {circularize} the proposal next week.
e.zh: 委员会下周将把提案分发给大家。

e.en: Charities often {circularize} potential donors.
e.zh: 慈善机构常向潜在捐助人发函募款。

e.en: The auditor {circularized} all major customers.
e.zh: 审计师向所有主要客户发函询证。

e.en: They {circularized} the petition to every household.
e.zh: 他们把请愿书发到了每户人家。

circularizes.t: 散发；通函（第三人称单数）

e.en: Her department {circularizes} updates each Friday.
e.zh: 她的部门每周五发出更新通告。

e.en: The bank routinely {circularizes} its account holders.
e.zh: 银行定期向账户持有人发出通函。

circularizing.t: 正在散发；正在发函通知

e.en: They are {circularizing} the new guidelines this week.
e.zh: 他们这周正在散发新指引。

e.en: The campaign team is {circularizing} voters again.
e.zh: 竞选团队又在向选民广发宣传。

e.en: He noticed the quiet {circumambience} of the old library.
e.zh: 他注意到旧图书馆周围那份宁静的氛围。

e.en: The forest's {circumambience} calmed her nerves.
e.zh: 森林环绕的氛围让她心情平静。

e.en: The {circumambient} air was thick with smoke.
e.zh: 周围的空气弥漫着浓烟。

e.en: She felt the {circumambient} silence of the desert.
e.zh: 她感到沙漠四周的寂静。

e.en: Pilgrims {circumambulate} the temple three times.
e.zh: 朝圣者绕寺庙走三圈。

e.en: He likes to {circumambulate} the lake each morning.
e.zh: 他喜欢每天早上绕湖走一圈。

e.en: The monks {circumambulated} the shrine in silence.
e.zh: 僧侣们默默地绕着圣坛走。

e.en: She {circumambulated} the garden lost in thought.
e.zh: 她若有所思地绕着花园走。

e.en: He {circumambulates} the park every evening.
e.zh: 他每天傍晚绕公园走一圈。

e.en: The procession {circumambulates} the altar.
e.zh: 队伍绕着祭坛行进。

e.en: Tourists were {circumambulating} the ancient stupa.
e.zh: 游客们正绕着古塔行走。

e.en: She spent an hour {circumambulating} the courtyard.
e.zh: 她花了一小时绕着庭院走。

circumcenter.t: 外心（三角形外接圆圆心）

e.en: The {circumcenter} is equidistant from all three vertices.
e.zh: 外心到三个顶点的距离相等。

e.en: We constructed the {circumcenter} of the triangle.
e.zh: 我们作出了三角形的外心。

circumcentre.t: 外心（三角形外接圆圆心，英式拼写）

e.en: Find the {circumcentre} by intersecting the perpendicular bisectors.
e.zh: 通过作三条边的垂直平分线找到外心。

e.en: The {circumcentre} lies outside an obtuse triangle.
e.zh: 钝角三角形的外心在三角形外。

e.en: Every triangle has a unique {circumcircle}.
e.zh: 每个三角形都有唯一的外接圆。

e.en: The radius of the {circumcircle} is called the circumradius.
e.zh: 外接圆的半径称为外接圆半径。

circumduction.t: 环转运动；旋转（关节动作）

e.en: The shoulder allows full {circumduction} of the arm.
e.zh: 肩关节使手臂能做完整的环转运动。

e.en: Doctors test hip {circumduction} during the exam.
e.zh: 医生在检查时会测试髋关节的环转活动。

e.en: The {chummage} system once forced new prisoners to pay older inmates.
e.zh: 旧时同舍费制度迫使新囚向老囚交钱。

e.en: Historians describe the cruelty of the {chummage} fee.
e.zh: 史学家描述了同舍分摊费的残酷。

chummery.t: (殖民时期)单身汉合住的寓所

e.en: The young officers shared a {chummery} in colonial Bombay.
e.zh: 年轻军官们在殖民时期的孟买合住一处单身公寓。
