e.en: Their old {chummery} smelled of pipe smoke and curry.
e.zh: 他们旧时的合居寓所满是烟斗与咖喱味。

e.en: The two have grown {chummier} since the trip.
e.zh: 那次旅行后他们俩关系更亲密了。

e.en: He's {chummier} with the boss than the rest of us.
e.zh: 他和老板比我们都要好得多。

e.en: She's the {chummiest} of all the new colleagues.
e.zh: 她是所有新同事中最热情亲近的。

e.en: They were the {chummiest} pair in the dorm.
e.zh: 他们是宿舍里最要好的一对。

e.en: I distrust his sudden {chumminess}.
e.zh: 我不信他突然表现出的亲热劲。

e.en: Their forced {chumminess} fooled no one.
e.zh: 他们故作亲昵骗不了任何人。

e.en: Their schoolboy {chumship} lasted a lifetime.
e.zh: 他们少年时结下的友谊延续了一生。

e.en: He valued the quiet {chumship} of his old roommate.
e.zh: 他珍视与老室友间那份淡淡的交情。

e.en: After ten beers he started to {chunder}.
e.zh: 喝了十瓶啤酒后他开始呕吐。

e.en: Don't {chunder} on the carpet, mate.
e.zh: 兄弟，别吐到地毯上。

e.en: He {chundered} all over the new sofa.
e.zh: 他吐得整张新沙发都是。

e.en: The whole crew {chundered} after the rough crossing.
e.zh: 颠簸航行后全船人都吐了。

e.en: The seasick passengers looked positively {chunderous}.
e.zh: 晕船的乘客看上去就要吐了。

e.en: He gave a {chunderous} groan and ran for the bathroom.
e.zh: 他发出反胃的呻吟，跑进了卫生间。

e.en: Whenever he drinks tequila, he {chunders}.
e.zh: 他一喝龙舌兰就吐。

e.en: The puppy {chunders} in the car every trip.
e.zh: 小狗每次坐车都会吐。

e.en: The mine installed a new {chunkbreaker} on the conveyor.
e.zh: 矿场在传送带上装了一台新的块料破碎机。

e.en: A heavy-duty {chunkbreaker} crushes the oversized rock.
e.zh: 重型块料破碎机粉碎超大块的岩石。

e.en: The vegetables were {chunkily} chopped.
e.zh: 蔬菜被切成大块。

e.en: He walked {chunkily} across the yard in heavy boots.
e.zh: 他穿着重靴笨重地走过院子。

e.en: The bride and groom stood under the {chuppah}.
e.zh: 新郎新娘站在婚礼华盖下。

e.en: Friends held up the four poles of the {chuppah}.
e.zh: 朋友们撑起华盖的四根柱子。

church-goer.t: 经常上教堂做礼拜的人

e.en: She's a regular {church-goer} on Sundays.
e.zh: 她每周日都按时上教堂。

e.en: Most {church-goers} stayed for coffee afterwards.
e.zh: 大多数信众做完礼拜留下喝咖啡。

e.en: His grandfather was a devoted {church-man}.
e.zh: 他祖父是位虔诚的笃信教会者。

e.en: The old {church-man} preached every Sunday for forty years.
e.zh: 这位老教士四十年来每周日布道。

e.en: Bells rang from the ancient {church-tower}.
e.zh: 古老的教堂塔楼传出钟声。

e.en: We could see the {church-tower} from miles away.
e.zh: 几英里外就能望见那座教堂塔楼。

e.en: The {church-warden} unlocked the chapel doors.
e.zh: 教堂执事打开了礼拜堂的门。

e.en: She has served as {church-warden} for ten years.
e.zh: 她担任教堂执事已有十年。

e.en: {Churchgoing} families filled the small chapel.
e.zh: 常去做礼拜的家庭挤满了小礼拜堂。

e.en: He stopped {churchgoing} after his wife passed away.
e.zh: 妻子去世后他就不再上教堂了。

e.en: The reformer railed against empty {churchianity}.
e.zh: 改革家抨击空洞的教会形式主义。

e.en: He left the seminary, weary of mere {churchianity}.
e.zh: 他厌倦了徒有其表的教会主义而离开神学院。

e.en: Critics dismissed the movement as narrow {churchism}.
e.zh: 批评者将该运动斥为狭隘的教会至上论。

e.en: His writings reject every form of {churchism}.
e.zh: 他的著作反对一切形式的教会主义。

churchless.t: 无教堂的；不属任何教会的

e.en: He grew up in a {churchless} household.
e.zh: 他在不上教堂的家庭中长大。

e.en: Many young adults today are {churchless} but spiritual.
e.zh: 如今许多年轻人不入教会却追求灵性。

e.en: The hall had a quiet, {churchlike} atmosphere.
e.zh: 大厅有种安静、教堂般的氛围。

e.en: Sunlight filtered through {churchlike} stained glass.
e.zh: 阳光透过教堂式彩绘玻璃洒下。

e.en: Her stern {churchliness} put visitors on edge.
e.zh: 她那严正的教徒做派让来客紧张。

e.en: He missed the gentle {churchliness} of village life.
e.zh: 他怀念乡村生活中温和的教徒气息。

e.en: His high {churchmanship} showed in every sermon.
e.zh: 他的高教会立场在每篇布道中都显现出来。

e.en: They debated questions of {churchmanship} for hours.
e.zh: 他们就教会立场问题争论了数小时。

e.en: She wore a long tunic over a tight {churidar}.
e.zh: 她在紧身长裤外罩了一件长上衣。

e.en: The dancer's {churidar} was embroidered with gold.
e.zh: 舞者的紧身裤上绣着金线。

e.en: Pack a few {churidars} for the wedding week.
e.zh: 婚礼那一周记得多带几条紧身长裤。

e.en: Cotton {churidars} are best for the summer heat.
e.zh: 棉质紧身长裤最适合夏季穿着。

e.en: The sea was wild and {churned-up}.
e.zh: 海面狂浪翻腾。

e.en: She felt {churned-up} after the argument.
e.zh: 争吵之后她心里很不平静。

e.en: Crickets {churr} on the long summer evenings.
e.zh: 蟋蟀在悠长的夏夜里咕咕鸣叫。

e.en: We heard the {churr} of a nightjar in the woods.
e.zh: 我们在林中听见夜鹰的咕鸣。

e.en: We grilled {churrasco} over open coals.
e.zh: 我们在炭火上烤南美烤肉。

e.en: The restaurant serves authentic Brazilian {churrasco}.
e.zh: 这家餐馆供应正宗的巴西烤肉。

e.en: The cicadas {churred} all night long.
e.zh: 蝉整夜咕咕鸣叫。

e.en: An old motor {churred} in the basement.
e.zh: 地下室里一台旧马达咕咕作响。

e.en: We listened to the steady {churring} of insects.
e.zh: 我们听着昆虫不断的咕鸣声。

e.en: The {churring} of a generator filled the camp.
e.zh: 营地里满是发电机的咕咕声。

e.en: A nightjar {churrs} from the heath.
e.zh: 一只夜鹰在荒野上发出咕咕声。

e.en: The engine {churrs} when it overheats.
e.zh: 发动机过热时会发出咕咕响。

e.en: In old letters one finds 'I {chuse} to remain at home'.
e.zh: 在旧信里能看到"我宁愿留在家中"这样的写法。

e.en: Eighteenth-century writers often spelt it {chuse}.
e.zh: 十八世纪的作家常把choose拼作chuse。

e.en: Whoever {chuses} the menu pays the bill, the host joked.
e.zh: 主人开玩笑说：谁点菜谁买单(古拼法)。

e.en: The archaic form {chuses} still appears in old legal copies.
e.zh: 古拼法chuses仍出现在旧法律抄本中。

chut.t: 啧(表示不耐烦的感叹词)

e.en: '{Chut}!' said the old man, waving us away.
e.zh: 老人挥手赶我们走，啧了一声。

e.en: {Chut}, child, don't be silly.
e.zh: 啧，孩子，别犯傻。

e.en: The kids screamed with joy on the {chute-the-chute}.
e.zh: 孩子们在滑水道上尖叫欢呼。

e.en: Old fairgrounds had a wooden {chute-the-chute}.
e.zh: 旧时游乐场有木制的滑水道。

e.en: The {chutist} landed neatly on the target.
e.zh: 跳伞员准确降落在目标上。

e.en: Veteran {chutists} trained the new recruits.
e.zh: 老跳伞员训练新兵。

e.en: She spread mango {chutnee} on the toast.
e.zh: 她在烤面包上抹了芒果酸辣酱。

e.en: {Chutnee} is just an older spelling of chutney.
e.zh: chutnee只是chutney的旧拼法。

e.en: Old men {chutter} on the porch all afternoon.
e.zh: 老人们整下午在门廊上嘟囔。

e.en: She heard him {chutter} something rude under his breath.
e.zh: 她听见他低声嘟囔了一句粗话。

e.en: The kids stuck their {chuttie} under the desks.
e.zh: 孩子们把口香糖粘在课桌底下。

e.en: Want a piece of {chuttie}? he asked in broad Scots.
e.zh: 他用浓重的苏格兰口音问：来块口香糖吗？

e.en: Stop chewing {chutty} in class.
e.zh: 上课别嚼口香糖。

e.en: He offered me a stick of {chutty}.
e.zh: 他递给我一条口香糖。

e.en: The fluid had a {chylaceous} appearance.
e.zh: 那种液体呈乳糜状外观。

e.en: They examined the {chylaceous} discharge under a microscope.
e.zh: 他们在显微镜下检查这种乳糜状分泌物。

chyle.t: 乳糜（消化后形成的乳状液）

e.en: Fats absorbed in the gut form {chyle} in the lymph.
e.zh: 肠道吸收的脂肪在淋巴中形成乳糜。

e.en: The lacteals carry {chyle} away from the intestines.
e.zh: 乳糜管将乳糜从肠道运走。

e.en: The small intestine has a {chylific} function.
e.zh: 小肠具有产生乳糜的功能。

e.en: Old textbooks describe the {chylific} action of digestion.
e.zh: 旧教科书描述了消化过程中产生乳糜的作用。

e.en: The body works to {chylify} digested food.
e.zh: 身体努力将消化后的食物转化为乳糜。

e.en: Enzymes help to {chylify} the contents of the gut.
e.zh: 酶帮助将肠道内容物转化为乳糜。

chylomicron.t: 乳糜微粒（一种脂蛋白颗粒）

e.en: A {chylomicron} carries dietary lipids through the lymph.
e.zh: 乳糜微粒通过淋巴系统运输膳食脂质。

e.en: Each {chylomicron} is rich in triglycerides.
e.zh: 每个乳糜微粒都富含甘油三酯。

e.en: The patient developed {chylothorax} after surgery.
e.zh: 患者术后出现了乳糜胸。

e.en: A {chylothorax} can result from thoracic duct injury.
e.zh: 乳糜胸可能由胸导管损伤引起。

e.en: He pored over old {chymic} treatises.
e.zh: 他钻研着古老的化学论著。

e.en: The alchemist's {chymic} arts fascinated readers.
e.zh: 炼金术士的化学技艺令读者着迷。

e.en: The {chymiferous} vessels were carefully labeled.
e.zh: 那些输送乳糜的脉管被仔细地标记出来。

e.en: He described the {chymiferous} system in detail.
e.zh: 他详细描述了乳糜输送系统。

e.en: The seventeenth-century {chymist} mixed strange potions.
e.zh: 那位十七世纪的化学家调制着奇异的药剂。

e.en: Boyle was a celebrated {chymist} of his era.
e.zh: 波义耳是那个时代著名的化学家。

e.en: Old volumes on {chymistry} fill the library.
e.zh: 图书馆里满是关于化学的古籍。

e.en: He devoted his life to {chymistry}.
e.zh: 他将毕生献给了化学。

e.en: Doctors once injected {chymopapain} to treat herniated discs.
e.zh: 医生曾注射木瓜凝乳蛋白酶来治疗椎间盘突出。

e.en: {Chymopapain} is extracted from papaya latex.
e.zh: 木瓜凝乳蛋白酶提取自木瓜乳汁。

e.en: Cheese makers use {chymosin} to curdle milk.
e.zh: 奶酪制作者用凝乳酶让牛奶凝固。

e.en: Recombinant {chymosin} replaced traditional rennet in many factories.
e.zh: 重组凝乳酶在很多工厂取代了传统的小牛皱胃酶。

e.en: The enzyme {chymotrypsin} digests proteins in the gut.
e.zh: 胰凝乳蛋白酶在肠道中消化蛋白质。

e.en: {Chymotrypsin} cleaves bonds next to aromatic residues.
e.zh: 胰凝乳蛋白酶在芳香族残基旁切断肽键。

e.en: The pancreas secretes {chymotrypsinogen} as an inactive precursor.
e.zh: 胰腺以无活性前体形式分泌胰凝乳蛋白酶原。

e.en: Trypsin converts {chymotrypsinogen} into the active enzyme.
e.zh: 胰蛋白酶将胰凝乳蛋白酶原转化为活性酶。

chymotryptic.t: 胰凝乳蛋白酶的；具胰凝乳蛋白酶活性的

e.en: They measured the {chymotryptic} activity of the sample.
e.zh: 他们测量了样品的胰凝乳蛋白酶活性。

e.en: The proteasome has {chymotryptic} cleavage sites.
e.zh: 蛋白酶体具有胰凝乳蛋白酶样切割位点。

chypre.t: 西普调（一种以橡木苔为基调的香水类型）

e.en: She wore a classic {chypre} with notes of oakmoss.
e.zh: 她用着一款带有橡木苔气息的经典西普香水。

e.en: The perfumer specialized in modern {chypre} compositions.
e.zh: 这位调香师专精于现代西普调香水。

e.en: The breaking-news {chyron} scrolled across the screen.
e.zh: 突发新闻的字幕条在屏幕下方滚动。

e.en: A misspelled {chyron} embarrassed the network.
e.zh: 一条拼错的字幕条让该电视网很尴尬。

e.en: Several gilded {ciboria} stood on the altar.
e.zh: 几个镀金圣体盒摆在祭坛上。

e.en: The museum displayed medieval {ciboria}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了中世纪的圣体盒。

ciborium.t: 圣体盒；祭坛上方的华盖

e.en: The priest opened the silver {ciborium}.
e.zh: 神父打开了那只银制圣体盒。

e.en: A marble {ciborium} crowned the high altar.
e.zh: 主祭坛上方矗立着一座大理石华盖。

e.en: A lone {cicala} sang in the olive grove.
e.zh: 一只蝉在橄榄树林里独自鸣唱。

e.en: Italian poets often praised the {cicala}.
e.zh: 意大利诗人常常歌颂蝉。

e.en: A pale {cicatrice} ran along his cheek.
e.zh: 一道淡淡的疤痕沿着他的脸颊延伸。

e.en: The wound healed into a thin {cicatrice}.
e.zh: 伤口愈合后留下一道细疤。

e.en: Old {cicatrices} crossed the soldier's back.
e.zh: 老兵的背上交错着旧疤痕。

e.en: The tree bore the {cicatrices} of past pruning.
e.zh: 这棵树上留有过去修剪所致的疤痕。

e.en: The patient developed {cicatricial} alopecia.
e.zh: 患者出现了瘢痕性脱发。

e.en: {Cicatricial} tissue replaced the burn site.
e.zh: 瘢痕组织取代了烧伤部位。

e.en: A faint {cicatricle} marked the spot.
e.zh: 那处留下了一道微小的疤痕。

e.en: The egg's {cicatricle} contained the early embryo.
e.zh: 卵的胚盘内包含着早期胚胎。

e.en: The bark was {cicatricose} from years of damage.
e.zh: 树皮因多年损伤而满是疤痕。

e.en: He examined the {cicatricose} surface of the leaf.
e.zh: 他检查了叶片表面那些疤痕状的纹路。

e.en: The wound began to {cicatrise} after a week.
e.zh: 伤口一周后开始结疤愈合。

e.en: Ointments help cuts to {cicatrise} cleanly.
e.zh: 药膏帮助切口干净地结疤。

e.en: A small {cicatrix} remained on her forearm.
e.zh: 她前臂上留下一小块疤痕。

e.en: Each fallen leaf leaves a {cicatrix} on the stem.
e.zh: 每片叶子脱落都会在茎上留下一个叶痕。

e.en: Complete {cicatrization} took several weeks.
e.zh: 完全结疤愈合花了好几周。

e.en: Doctors monitored the {cicatrization} of the burn.
e.zh: 医生密切监测烧伤处的结疤情况。

e.en: The deep cut took a month to {cicatrize}.
e.zh: 那道深深的伤口花了一个月才结疤愈合。

e.en: Some wounds {cicatrize} faster than others.
e.zh: 有些伤口比另一些愈合得更快。

cicatrizes.t: 结疤愈合（动词第三人称单数）

e.en: The skin {cicatrizes} more slowly with age.
e.zh: 皮肤随着年龄增长结疤愈合得更慢。

e.en: A clean cut usually {cicatrizes} without complication.
e.zh: 干净的切口通常会顺利地结疤愈合。

e.en: The {cicatrizing} wound itched constantly.
e.zh: 那处正在结疤的伤口痒个不停。

e.en: Doctors applied cream to the {cicatrizing} skin.
e.zh: 医生在正在结疤的皮肤上涂抹乳膏。

e.en: A learned {cicerone} guided us through the ruins.
e.zh: 一位博学的导游带我们参观了遗址。

e.en: He served as {cicerone} for visiting scholars.
e.zh: 他为来访的学者担任向导。

e.en: Several {cicerones} waited outside the cathedral.
e.zh: 几位导游在大教堂外等候着。

e.en: The {cicerones} spoke fluent English and Italian.
e.zh: 那些导游能流利地说英语和意大利语。

e.en: Roman {ciceroni} once led grand tourists through the Forum.
e.zh: 罗马的导游曾带领壮游客穿过古罗马广场。

e.en: The old {ciceroni} knew every chapel by heart.
e.zh: 那些资深导游对每座小礼拜堂都了如指掌。

e.en: Eighteenth-century Italian ladies kept {cicisbei}.
e.zh: 十八世纪的意大利贵妇身边都养着男伴。

e.en: The {cicisbei} accompanied their patrons to the opera.
e.zh: 那些男伴陪同各自的女主人去看歌剧。

cicisbeism.t: 男伴风习（旧时意大利贵妇蓄养男伴的风俗）

e.en: {Cicisbeism} flourished in eighteenth-century Venice.
e.zh: 男伴风习在十八世纪的威尼斯盛极一时。

e.en: Moralists denounced {cicisbeism} as scandalous.
e.zh: 道德家们谴责这种男伴风习有伤风化。

cicisbeo.t: 已婚贵妇的男伴（旧时意大利风习）

e.en: Every fashionable lady seemed to have a {cicisbeo}.
e.zh: 似乎每位时髦贵妇都有一位男伴。

e.en: He was reduced to playing {cicisbeo} to a duchess.
e.zh: 他沦为一位公爵夫人的男伴。

e.en: The {circumfusion} of light around the statue created an ethereal effect.
e.zh: 光线在雕像周围的环绕营造出空灵的效果。

e.en: Ancient texts describe the {circumfusion} of incense during rituals.
e.zh: 古籍描述了仪式中香烟的弥漫环绕。

e.en: Astronomers studied the {circumgalactic} medium for clues about galaxy evolution.
e.zh: 天文学家研究星系周围介质以寻找星系演化的线索。

e.en: Hot gas fills the {circumgalactic} halo of the Milky Way.
e.zh: 炽热气体填满了银河系的星系周晕。

e.en: The {circumglobal} wind patterns affect climate worldwide.
e.zh: 环球风系影响着全世界的气候。

e.en: This species has a {circumglobal} distribution in tropical waters.
e.zh: 该物种在热带水域呈环球分布。

e.en: The dancers slowly {circumgyrate} around the central pole.
e.zh: 舞者们围绕中央柱缓缓旋转。

e.en: Planets {circumgyrate} along their orbital paths.
e.zh: 行星沿其轨道回旋运行。

e.en: The fortress dominated the {circumjacent} valleys.
e.zh: 这座要塞俯瞰着周围的山谷。

e.en: Wildflowers grew in the {circumjacent} meadows.
e.zh: 野花生长在周围的草地上。

e.en: Probes have mapped the {circumjovial} magnetic field in detail.
e.zh: 探测器详细绘制了木星周围的磁场。

e.en: The {circumjovial} moons fascinated Galileo.
e.zh: 环绕木星的卫星让伽利略着迷。

e.en: Many species thrive in the {circumlittoral} zone of the lake.
e.zh: 许多物种在湖泊的近岸带繁衍生息。

e.en: The survey covered {circumlittoral} habitats along the coast.
e.zh: 调查覆盖了沿岸带的各类栖息地。

e.en: His {circumlocutional} style frustrated readers seeking clarity.
e.zh: 他迂回累赘的文风让寻求清晰的读者感到沮丧。

e.en: Avoid {circumlocutional} phrasing in technical reports.
e.zh: 在技术报告中应避免迂回的措辞。

e.en: The mission planned a {circumlunar} flight without landing.
e.zh: 该任务计划绕月飞行而不着陆。

e.en: Engineers refined the {circumlunar} trajectory.
e.zh: 工程师优化了绕月轨道。

e.en: They sought to {circummure} the garden against intruders.
e.zh: 他们想用围墙将花园围起来以防入侵。

e.en: Old chronicles describe how soldiers would {circummure} a town.
e.zh: 古老的编年史描述了士兵如何用墙包围城镇。

e.en: The island proved {circumnavigable} in a single day.
e.zh: 事实证明这座岛屿一天之内就可环航一周。

e.en: Not every continent is easily {circumnavigable}.
e.zh: 并非每个大陆都容易环航。

e.en: Magellan is celebrated as the first {circumnavigator}.
e.zh: 麦哲伦被誉为第一位环球航行者。

e.en: The young {circumnavigator} kept a detailed journal.
e.zh: 这位年轻的环航者写了详尽的航海日记。

e.en: Several {circumnavigators} gathered at the maritime conference.
e.zh: 几位环球航行者齐聚海事会议。

e.en: The book profiles famous {circumnavigators} of the past.
e.zh: 这本书介绍了历史上著名的环球航行者。

e.en: Astronomers detected a {circumnuclear} ring of gas.
e.zh: 天文学家探测到一个环绕核区的气体环。

e.en: Star formation occurs in the {circumnuclear} region of the galaxy.
e.zh: 恒星形成发生在星系的核周区域。

e.en: Climbing plants {circumnutate} as they search for support.
e.zh: 攀缘植物在寻找支撑物时会回旋转头生长。

e.en: Seedlings {circumnutate} in slow, sweeping arcs.
e.zh: 幼苗以缓慢的弧形回旋摆动生长。

e.en: Darwin documented {circumnutation} in many plant species.
e.zh: 达尔文记录了多种植物的回旋转头运动。

e.en: Time-lapse footage reveals the {circumnutation} of vines.
e.zh: 延时摄影展示了藤蔓的回旋转头运动。

e.en: The bird's bright {circumocular} feathers stand out.
e.zh: 这只鸟眼周的鲜艳羽毛十分醒目。

e.en: Doctors examined the patient's {circumocular} swelling.
e.zh: 医生检查了病人的眼周肿胀。

e.en: The rash showed clear {circumoral} pallor.
e.zh: 皮疹呈现出明显的口周苍白现象。

e.en: Sea anemones extend tentacles in a {circumoral} ring.
e.zh: 海葵在口周伸出一圈触手。

e.en: A {circumplanetary} disk may form moons over time.
e.zh: 环行星盘可能随时间形成卫星。

e.en: They mapped the {circumplanetary} dust distribution.
e.zh: 他们绘制了行星周围的尘埃分布图。

e.en: The formula relates the triangle's area to its {circumradius}.
e.zh: 该公式将三角形的面积与其外接圆半径联系起来。

e.en: Calculate the {circumradius} of a regular hexagon.
e.zh: 计算正六边形的外接圆半径。

e.en: The {circumrotation} of the planet causes day and night.
e.zh: 行星的自转造成昼夜交替。

e.en: Engineers measured the {circumrotation} speed of the turbine.
e.zh: 工程师测量了涡轮的旋转速度。

e.en: The mechanism exhibits a smooth {circumrotatory} motion.
e.zh: 该机构呈现出平稳的回转运动。

e.en: They installed a {circumrotatory} display for the exhibit.
e.zh: 他们为展品安装了一个旋转展示台。

e.en: The polygon is {circumscribable} by a single circle.
e.zh: 该多边形可由一个圆外接。

e.en: His freedoms were not easily {circumscribable} by law.
e.zh: 他的自由不易被法律加以限定。

e.en: The treaty included {circumscriptive} clauses on territory.
e.zh: 条约包含关于领土的划界条款。

e.en: Critics called the rules overly {circumscriptive}.
e.zh: 批评者称这些规则限制性过强。

e.en: The court interpreted the statute {circumscriptively}.
e.zh: 法院对该法规作了限制性解释。

e.en: He spoke {circumscriptively} about the ongoing case.
e.zh: 他对正在进行的案件谈得有所保留。

e.en: Dust forms a faint {circumsolar} ring near Earth's orbit.
e.zh: 尘埃在地球轨道附近形成一圈微弱的环日尘环。

e.en: The probe entered a stable {circumsolar} orbit.
e.zh: 探测器进入了稳定的绕日轨道。

e.en: She gave a {circumspective} answer to the journalist.
e.zh: 她给了记者一个谨慎周到的回答。

e.en: His {circumspective} approach won everyone's trust.
e.zh: 他慎重周到的处事方式赢得了所有人的信任。

e.en: His {circumstantiality} made the report tedious to read.
e.zh: 他对细节的拘泥使报告读起来令人生厌。

e.en: The patient's {circumstantiality} is a notable symptom.
e.zh: 该患者的赘述症状十分明显。

e.en: The witness was asked to {circumstantiate} her account.
e.zh: 证人被要求详细说明她的陈述。

e.en: Please {circumstantiate} the events leading up to the accident.
e.zh: 请详细说明事故发生前的经过。

circumstantiated.t: 详细说明的；列举详情的

e.en: He {circumstantiated} every detail of the journey.
e.zh: 他详细说明了旅程的每一个细节。

e.en: The lawyer {circumstantiated} the alibi convincingly.
e.zh: 律师令人信服地详述了不在场证明。

e.en: She always {circumstantiates} her arguments with examples.
e.zh: 她总是用例子详细佐证自己的论点。

e.en: The article {circumstantiates} each claim with data.
e.zh: 这篇文章用数据详细说明了每一项主张。

e.en: He spent hours {circumstantiating} his version of events.
e.zh: 他花了数小时详细说明他对事件的叙述。

e.en: The report avoids {circumstantiating} every minor point.
e.zh: 报告避免对每个细枝末节都详加说明。

e.en: Satellites operate in {circumterrestrial} orbits.
e.zh: 卫星在环地球轨道上运行。

e.en: Debris accumulates in the {circumterrestrial} environment.
e.zh: 碎片在环地球空间中不断累积。

e.en: Roman armies would {circumvallate} besieged cities.
e.zh: 罗马军队会用壕沟围困被攻打的城市。

e.en: The tongue's {circumvallate} papillae are easy to spot.
e.zh: 舌头上的轮廓乳头很容易看到。

e.en: The {circumvallated} fortress withstood the long siege.
e.zh: 这座被壕沟环绕的要塞挺过了漫长的围攻。

e.en: Engineers {circumvallated} the camp before nightfall.
e.zh: 工程兵在天黑前用壕沟环绕了营地。

e.en: The general {circumvallates} the city to cut off supplies.
e.zh: 将军用壕沟围困城市以切断补给。

e.en: The text describes how the army {circumvallates} a stronghold.
e.zh: 文中描述了军队如何用壕沟围困要塞。

e.en: The soldiers spent weeks {circumvallating} the citadel.
e.zh: 士兵们花了数周时间用壕沟围困城堡。

e.en: {Circumvallating} the enemy proved decisive.
e.zh: 用壕沟围困敌军被证明是决定性的策略。

e.en: Caesar's {circumvallation} at Alesia was a feat of engineering.
e.zh: 凯撒在阿莱西亚修建的环堡工事是工程上的壮举。

e.en: The {circumvallation} prevented any escape from the fortress.
e.zh: 环堡工事阻止了任何人从要塞逃脱。

e.en: He used {circumventive} tactics to avoid the regulation.
e.zh: 他采用规避手段绕开监管。

e.en: The lawyer crafted a {circumventive} clause.
e.zh: 律师拟定了一条规避条款。

e.en: He was branded a {circumventor} of company policy.
e.zh: 他被指为规避公司政策之人。

e.en: Tax authorities pursue every {circumventor} of the law.
e.zh: 税务机关追查每一个规避法律的人。

e.en: {Circumvolant} swallows wheeled above the meadow.
e.zh: 环飞的燕子在草地上空盘旋。

e.en: The poem describes {circumvolant} bees around the hive.
e.zh: 诗中描绘了蜜蜂环绕蜂巢飞舞的景象。

e.en: Vines {circumvolute} the trellis throughout summer.
e.zh: 藤蔓整个夏天都缠绕着花架。

e.en: The tendrils {circumvolute} any nearby support.
e.zh: 卷须缠绕住任何附近的支撑物。

e.en: Each {circumvolution} of the spring stores more energy.
e.zh: 弹簧每多卷绕一圈就储存更多能量。

e.en: He traced the {circumvolution} of the snail's shell.
e.zh: 他描摹着蜗牛壳的螺旋卷绕。

e.en: Stars seem to {circumvolve} around the celestial pole.
e.zh: 群星似乎绕着天极回旋。

e.en: The dancers {circumvolve} slowly to the music.
e.zh: 舞者们随着音乐缓慢旋转。

e.en: The wheel {circumvolved} steadily for hours.
e.zh: 轮子稳定地旋转了数小时。

e.en: Smoke {circumvolved} above the chimney.
e.zh: 烟雾在烟囱上方回旋上升。

e.en: The Earth {circumvolves} on its axis once a day.
e.zh: 地球每天绕其轴自转一周。

e.en: A small motor {circumvolves} the display platform.
e.zh: 一台小型马达带动展示台旋转。

e.en: The sky was dotted with {cirro-cumulus} clouds at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分天空点缀着卷积云。

e.en: Sailors once read {cirro-cumulus} as a sign of changing weather.
e.zh: 水手曾把卷积云视为天气变化的征兆。

e.en: Tiny patches of {cirrocumulus} drifted across the morning sky.
e.zh: 小片的卷积云在清晨的天空中飘过。

e.en: {Cirrocumulus} often appears at very high altitudes.
e.zh: 卷积云常出现在很高的空中。

e.en: A thin veil of {cirrostratus} covered the sky.
e.zh: 一层薄薄的卷层云笼罩着天空。

e.en: {Cirrostratus} often produces a halo around the sun.
e.zh: 卷层云常在太阳周围形成光晕。

cisalpine.t: 阿尔卑斯山这边的；山南的

e.en: Caesar governed {Cisalpine} Gaul before crossing the Rubicon.
e.zh: 凯撒在跨越卢比孔河前统治着山南高卢。

e.en: The {cisalpine} regions were closer to Rome.
e.zh: 山南地区离罗马更近。

e.en: He preferred {cisatlantic} affairs to European politics.
e.zh: 他更关注大西洋这边的事务而非欧洲政治。

e.en: The {cisatlantic} colonies developed their own identity.
e.zh: 大西洋此岸的殖民地发展出自己的身份。

cislunar.t: 地月之间的；月球轨道以内的

e.en: NASA is planning new {cislunar} missions.
e.zh: 美国国家航空航天局正在规划新的地月空间任务。

e.en: {Cislunar} space lies between Earth and the Moon.
e.zh: 地月空间位于地球与月球之间。

e.en: The {cismontane} villages enjoyed milder weather.
e.zh: 山这边的村庄气候更为温和。

e.en: He wrote about {cismontane} traditions in northern Italy.
e.zh: 他撰文介绍意大利北部山这边的传统。

cispontine.t: 桥这边的（尤指伦敦泰晤士河北岸）

e.en: The {cispontine} districts of London lie north of the Thames.
e.zh: 伦敦桥北区域位于泰晤士河北岸。

e.en: He grew up in a quiet {cispontine} neighborhood.
e.zh: 他在桥北一个安静的街区长大。

e.en: The {cissoid} of Diocles was used to solve cube duplication.
e.zh: 狄奥克莱斯的蔓叶线被用来解倍立方问题。

e.en: He sketched a {cissoid} on the blackboard.
e.zh: 他在黑板上画了一条蔓叶线。

e.en: Archaeologists uncovered a Bronze Age {cist} on the hillside.
e.zh: 考古学家在山坡上发掘出一座青铜时代的石室坟墓。

e.en: Bones were found inside the stone {cist}.
e.zh: 在石棺内发现了骸骨。

cisted.t: 装于石棺中的；石室葬的

e.en: The {cisted} burial dated back thousands of years.
e.zh: 这处石室葬可追溯到数千年前。

e.en: They examined the {cisted} remains carefully.
e.zh: 他们仔细查看了石棺中的遗骸。

e.en: The {cisterna} stores cerebrospinal fluid in the brain.
e.zh: 该池在脑内储存脑脊液。

e.en: Doctors examined the patient's {cisterna} on the scan.
e.zh: 医生在扫描影像上检查了患者的脑池。

cistron.t: 顺反子（编码一条多肽链的基因单位）

e.en: A {cistron} corresponds to a single polypeptide chain.
e.zh: 一个顺反子对应一条多肽链。

e.en: Mutations in this {cistron} caused the disorder.
e.zh: 该顺反子内的突变导致了这种疾病。

e.en: Bacteria often have polycistronic, not mono{cistronic}, mRNAs.
e.zh: 细菌的mRNA通常是多顺反子而非单顺反子的。

e.en: The researchers studied the gene's {cistronic} structure.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了该基因的顺反子结构。

e.en: Make sure every claim is backed by a {citable} source.
e.zh: 确保每项论断都有可引用的来源。

e.en: His remarks were witty and highly {citable}.
e.zh: 他的话风趣,很值得引用。

e.en: The article had a strong {citational} network in the field.
e.zh: 这篇文章在该领域形成了广泛的引用网络。

e.en: Researchers track {citational} patterns to gauge influence.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪引文模式以衡量影响力。

e.en: The court issued a {citatory} order to the witness.
e.zh: 法院向证人发出了传唤令。

e.en: He received a {citatory} notice in the mail.
e.zh: 他收到了一份传唤通知。

cithara.t: 基萨拉琴（古希腊弦乐器）

e.en: The poet sang while playing a {cithara}.
e.zh: 诗人弹着基萨拉琴歌唱。

e.en: Ancient Greeks praised skilled {cithara} players.
e.zh: 古希腊人推崇技艺高超的基萨拉琴手。

e.en: She plucked a soft tune on the {cither}.
e.zh: 她在西特琴上弹出柔和的曲调。

e.en: The {cither} hung above the fireplace as a relic.
e.zh: 那把西特琴作为遗物挂在壁炉上方。

e.en: He brought out an old {cithern} for the recital.
e.zh: 他拿出一把古老的西特琴用于演奏会。

e.en: Renaissance musicians often played the {cithern}.
e.zh: 文艺复兴时期的乐手常演奏西特琴。

e.en: They traveled across the {citied} plains of the empire.
e.zh: 他们穿越帝国城邦林立的平原。

e.en: The map showed a richly {citied} coastline.
e.zh: 地图显示出沿岸城市密布。

citifies.t: 使都市化；使具有城市气息

e.en: Modern fashion {citifies} even the smallest village teen.
e.zh: 现代时尚让最小村庄里的少年也变得都市化。

e.en: The new mall {citifies} the once-rural town.
e.zh: 新商场让这个曾经的乡村小镇变得都市化。

citify.t: 使都市化；使具城市风格

e.en: They tried to {citify} their cousin from the countryside.
e.zh: 他们试图让乡下来的表亲变得都市化。

e.en: Highways slowly began to {citify} the rural landscape.
e.zh: 高速公路逐渐让乡村景观都市化。

cinerator.t: 焚化炉；用于火化的炉子

e.en: The mortuary installed a new {cinerator} last year.
e.zh: 殡仪馆去年安装了一台新的焚化炉。

e.en: Ash from the {cinerator} was carefully collected.
e.zh: 焚化炉里的骨灰被仔细收集起来。

e.en: She wore a long {cinereous} cloak.
e.zh: 她披着一件灰色的长斗篷。

e.en: The {cinereous} sky hinted at coming rain.
e.zh: 灰蒙蒙的天空预示着即将降雨。

e.en: The cliff was layered with white {cinerite}.
e.zh: 悬崖上覆盖着一层层白色的凝灰岩。

e.en: Geologists dated the {cinerite} bed precisely.
e.zh: 地质学家精确测定了凝灰岩层的年代。

cinerous.t: 灰色的；灰白色的；灰蒙蒙的

e.en: A {cinerous} mist hung over the lake.
e.zh: 灰蒙蒙的薄雾笼罩着湖面。

e.en: His hair had turned {cinerous} with age.
e.zh: 他的头发因年迈而变得灰白。

cinetheodolite.t: 电影经纬仪；摄影经纬仪

e.en: The {cinetheodolite} tracked the missile's flight path.
e.zh: 摄影经纬仪追踪了导弹的飞行轨迹。

e.en: Engineers calibrated the {cinetheodolite} before launch.
e.zh: 发射前工程师校准了电影经纬仪。

e.en: She tightened the {cingle} on her saddle.
e.zh: 她把马鞍上的腹带勒紧了。

e.en: The old leather {cingle} had begun to fray.
e.zh: 那条旧皮束带已经开始磨损。

e.en: The scan revealed {cingular} damage in the brain.
e.zh: 扫描显示大脑出现带状区域损伤。

e.en: Doctors noted unusual {cingular} inflammation.
e.zh: 医生注意到不寻常的环带状炎症。

cingulate.t: 扣带的；脑扣带回的；带状的

e.en: The {cingulate} cortex helps regulate emotion.
e.zh: 扣带皮层有助于调节情绪。

e.en: Researchers studied {cingulate} brain activity.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了扣带回的脑活动。

e.en: The dentist examined the {cingulum} of the incisor.
e.zh: 牙医检查了门齿的齿带。

e.en: MRI revealed lesions in the {cingulum}.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示扣带回有损伤。

cinnamaldehyde.t: 肉桂醛；一种芳香化合物

e.en: {Cinnamaldehyde} gives cinnamon its distinctive smell.
e.zh: 肉桂醛赋予了肉桂特有的香味。

e.en: The lab synthesized pure {cinnamaldehyde} for testing.
e.zh: 实验室合成了纯肉桂醛用于测试。

e.en: The compound contains a {cinnamic} acid group.
e.zh: 这种化合物含有肉桂酸基团。

e.en: {Cinnamic} aldehyde smells strongly of cinnamon.
e.zh: 肉桂醛闻起来有浓郁的肉桂味。

e.en: The bird had {cinnamomeous} feathers on its breast.
e.zh: 这只鸟胸前长着肉桂色的羽毛。

e.en: She admired the {cinnamomeous} hue of the wood.
e.zh: 她欣赏着木头那种肉桂色的色调。

e.en: He bought a {cinnamon-coloured} jacket for autumn.
e.zh: 他买了一件秋天穿的肉桂色夹克。

e.en: Her {cinnamon-coloured} hair shone in the sun.
e.zh: 她那肉桂色的头发在阳光下闪闪发光。

e.en: {Cinnamyl} alcohol is widely used in perfumes.
e.zh: 肉桂醇广泛用于香水中。

e.en: The fragrance contained {cinnamyl} acetate.
e.zh: 这种香料含有乙酸肉桂酯。

e.en: Yellow {cinqfoil} bloomed along the path.
e.zh: 小路边盛开着黄色的五叶草。

e.en: The Gothic window had a {cinqfoil} design.
e.zh: 那扇哥特式窗户上有五瓣花饰图案。

e.en: She wrote a delicate {cinquain} about autumn.
e.zh: 她写了一首关于秋天的精致五行诗。

e.en: Students were asked to compose a {cinquain}.
e.zh: 学生们被要求创作一首五行诗。

cinquecentist.t: 十六世纪意大利艺术家

e.en: He was a leading {cinquecentist} painter in Florence.
e.zh: 他是佛罗伦萨一位杰出的十六世纪意大利画家。

e.en: The exhibition featured several {cinquecentist} works.
e.zh: 展览展出了多件十六世纪意大利艺术作品。

cinquecento.t: 十六世纪意大利文艺时期

e.en: This painting clearly belongs to the {cinquecento}.
e.zh: 这幅画显然属于十六世纪意大利文艺时期。

e.en: She studies {cinquecento} architecture in Rome.
e.zh: 她在罗马研究十六世纪意大利建筑。

e.en: The gardener grafted a {cion} onto the apple stock.
e.zh: 园丁把接穗嫁接到苹果砧木上。

e.en: Each {cion} was carefully labeled by variety.
e.zh: 每根接穗都按品种被仔细标记。

e.en: She made her name in wartime {cipherdom}.
e.zh: 她在战时密码界声名鹊起。

e.en: {Cipherdom} flourished during the Cold War.
e.zh: 冷战期间密码学领域蓬勃发展。

cipolin.t: 葱纹大理石；葱青大理石

e.en: The columns were carved from green {cipolin}.
e.zh: 这些柱子是用绿色葱纹大理石雕成的。

e.en: He imported Italian {cipolin} for the lobby floor.
e.zh: 他进口了意大利葱纹大理石做大堂地板。

e.en: Archaeologists unearthed a Roman {cippus} at the site.
e.zh: 考古学家在遗址挖出一根罗马石柱。

e.en: The {cippus} bore a faded Latin inscription.
e.zh: 那根石柱上有一段褪色的拉丁文铭文。

e.en: The fern's {circinal} leaves slowly unfurled.
e.zh: 蕨类的卷曲叶片缓缓展开。

e.en: Botanists noted the {circinal} growth pattern.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种卷曲的生长方式。

e.en: Young fern fronds are typically {circinate}.
e.zh: 蕨类的嫩叶通常呈卷曲状。

e.en: She sketched the {circinate} bud in detail.
e.zh: 她仔细画下了那个卷曲的芽。

e.en: The leaves emerged {circinately} from the stem.
e.zh: 叶子从茎上以卷曲的姿态长出。

e.en: Each frond was rolled {circinately} inward.
e.zh: 每片叶子都向内卷曲地卷起。

circlewise.t: 成环状地；环形地；圆周状

e.en: The dancers moved {circlewise} around the fire.
e.zh: 舞者围着火堆环形移动。

e.en: Chairs were arranged {circlewise} in the hall.
e.zh: 椅子在大厅里被环形摆放。

e.en: Highland {clanship} shaped local loyalties for centuries.
e.zh: 高地的宗族关系几个世纪以来塑造了当地的忠诚。

e.en: He valued {clanship} above personal ambition.
e.zh: 他把族人情谊看得比个人抱负更重。

e.en: She is a proud {clanswoman} of the highlands.
e.zh: 她是高地一位骄傲的女族人。

e.en: Every {clanswoman} attended the gathering.
e.zh: 每一位女族人都出席了聚会。

e.en: The fowler set a {clapnet} at dawn.
e.zh: 捕鸟人在黎明时架起拍合网。

e.en: A {clapnet} can capture small birds quickly.
e.zh: 拍合网能迅速捕到小鸟。

e.en: The {clapometer} judged the loudest applause.
e.zh: 鼓掌测量器评出最响亮的掌声。

e.en: Her act sent the {clapometer} soaring.
e.zh: 她的表演让鼓掌测量器飙升。

e.en: He drove a {clapped-out} old van.
e.zh: 他开着一辆破旧不堪的旧货车。

e.en: Their {clapped-out} laptop barely turned on.
e.zh: 他们那台老掉牙的笔记本电脑几乎开不了机。

e.en: The assistant snapped the {clapperboard} before each take.
e.zh: 助理在每次拍摄前打了场记板。

e.en: A {clapperboard} helps synchronize sound and film.
e.zh: 场记板有助于声画同步。

e.en: Several {clapperboards} were stacked by the camera.
e.zh: 几块场记板堆在摄影机旁。

e.en: They prepared {clapperboards} for the shoot.
e.zh: 他们为拍摄准备了场记板。

e.en: The cats began to {clapperclaw} each other.
e.zh: 两只猫开始互相抓挠。

e.en: She would {clapperclaw} anyone who crossed her.
e.zh: 谁惹她，她就痛骂谁。

e.en: He was {clapperclawed} by the angry crowd.
e.zh: 他被愤怒的人群痛骂了一顿。

e.en: The kittens {clapperclawed} the curtains.
e.zh: 小猫们抓挠了窗帘。

e.en: They were {clapperclawing} over the inheritance.
e.zh: 他们正为遗产互相痛骂。

e.en: Stop {clapperclawing} your sister.
e.zh: 别再抓挠你妹妹了。

clapperclaws.t: 抓挠；痛骂（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {clapperclaws} her rivals in every column.
e.zh: 她在每篇专栏里都痛骂对手。

e.en: The cat {clapperclaws} anything that moves.
e.zh: 那只猫见动的东西就抓。

e.en: The dancers kept time with a {clapstick}.
e.zh: 舞者用拍击棒打着节拍。

e.en: He carved a {clapstick} from hardwood.
e.zh: 他用硬木雕了一根响板。

e.en: A hired {claqueur} led the cheering.
e.zh: 一名受雇的喝彩者带头叫好。

e.en: The opera house once employed a {claqueur}.
e.zh: 那家歌剧院曾经雇用过喝彩者。

e.en: The organist drew the {clarabella} stop.
e.zh: 管风琴师拉出克拉贝拉音栓。

e.en: A {clarabella} produces a sweet flute-like tone.
e.zh: 克拉贝拉音栓发出甜美的笛声。

e.en: She wore a {claret-colored} velvet gown.
e.zh: 她穿着一件酒红色天鹅绒礼服。

e.en: The curtains were a deep {claret-colored} fabric.
e.zh: 窗帘是深酒红色的布料。

e.en: He admired the {claret-coloured} leather binding.
e.zh: 他欣赏那本酒红色皮面装订。

e.en: A {claret-coloured} scarf hung on the chair.
e.zh: 一条酒红色围巾挂在椅子上。

e.en: Egg white serves as a {clarificant} for broth.
e.zh: 蛋清可作高汤的澄清剂。

e.en: Winemakers add a {clarificant} to remove haze.
e.zh: 酿酒师加入澄清剂以去除浑浊。

e.en: The dairy uses a {clarificator} to purify milk.
e.zh: 乳品厂用澄清器净化牛奶。

e.en: A modern {clarificator} removes solids efficiently.
e.zh: 现代澄清器能高效去除固体。

e.en: She offered a {clarificatory} note on the policy.
e.zh: 她对该政策附上了一段澄清说明。

e.en: His {clarificatory} remarks ended the confusion.
e.zh: 他的解释性发言结束了困惑。

e.en: Bach wrote demanding {clarino} parts.
e.zh: 巴赫写过艰难的高音小号声部。

e.en: The {clarino} soared above the orchestra.
e.zh: 高音小号声在乐队之上飞扬。

e.en: He played the {clarionet} in the village band.
e.zh: 他在村乐队里吹单簧管。

e.en: An old {clarionet} lay in the case.
e.zh: 一支旧单簧管放在琴盒里。

e.en: Pink {clarkia} bloomed along the trail.
e.zh: 粉色的山字草沿小径盛开。

e.en: She planted {clarkia} in the cottage garden.
e.zh: 她在乡村花园里种了山字草。

e.en: His boots were covered in {clart}.
e.zh: 他的靴子上沾满了泥污。

e.en: Don't {clart} the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 别把厨房地板弄脏了。

e.en: A {clasmatocyte} engulfs cellular debris.
e.zh: 组织细胞会吞噬细胞碎片。

e.en: The slide showed a clear {clasmatocyte}.
e.zh: 切片上清晰可见一个组织细胞。

e.en: Customers filed a {class-action} lawsuit.
e.zh: 客户提起了集体诉讼。

e.en: The {class-action} settled for millions.
e.zh: 该集体诉讼以数百万的赔偿和解。

e.en: He grew up in a {class-conscious} society.
e.zh: 他在一个有阶级意识的社会中长大。

e.en: Their {class-conscious} attitudes shaped policy.
e.zh: 他们的阶级意识塑造了政策。

e.en: Marx distinguished a {class-for-itself} from a class in itself.
e.zh: 马克思将自为阶级与自在阶级加以区分。

e.en: Workers became a {class-for-itself} through organizing.
e.zh: 工人通过组织化成为自为阶级。

e.en: A {class-in-itself} lacks shared political consciousness.
e.zh: 自在阶级缺乏共同的政治意识。

e.en: He described peasants as a {class-in-itself}.
e.zh: 他把农民描述为自在阶级。

class-list.t: 班级名单；荣誉等级名单

e.en: Her name appeared on the {class-list}.
e.zh: 她的名字出现在班级名单上。

e.en: The Oxford {class-list} was posted online.
e.zh: 牛津的荣誉等级名单已贴在网上。

e.en: Find the book by its {class-mark}.
e.zh: 按分类号查找这本书。

e.en: Each volume has a unique {class-mark}.
e.zh: 每一卷都有独特的索书号。

e.en: My {class-mate} lent me her notes.
e.zh: 我同班同学把笔记借给我。

e.en: He met an old {class-mate} downtown.
e.zh: 他在市中心遇到一位老同学。

e.en: The {class-room} was quiet during the test.
e.zh: 考试时教室里很安静。

e.en: She decorated her {class-room} with posters.
e.zh: 她用海报装饰了教室。

e.en: The species is easily {classable} as a mammal.
e.zh: 该物种很容易被归类为哺乳动物。

e.en: Not every artifact is neatly {classable}.
e.zh: 并非每件文物都能被整齐分类。

e.en: The teacher marked attendance in the {classbook}.
e.zh: 老师在点名册上记录出勤。

e.en: Each student received a new {classbook}.
e.zh: 每个学生都领到一本新课本。

e.en: He greeted an old {classfellow} warmly.
e.zh: 他热情地向一位老同学打招呼。

e.en: My {classfellow} became a respected judge.
e.zh: 我的同班同学后来成了受人尊敬的法官。

e.en: His paintings reflect strict {classicalism}.
e.zh: 他的画作体现了严格的古典主义。

e.en: The school revived eighteenth-century {classicalism}.
e.zh: 该流派复兴了十八世纪的古典主义。

classicalist.t: 古典主义者；古典派学者

e.en: The {classicalist} insisted on Latin sources.
e.zh: 那位古典主义者坚持使用拉丁语原典。

e.en: As a {classicalist}, she rejected modern interpretations.
e.zh: 作为古典派学者，她拒绝现代的诠释。

e.en: The building's {classicality} impressed every visitor.
e.zh: 这座建筑的古典气质令每位访客印象深刻。

e.en: Critics praised the {classicality} of her prose.
e.zh: 评论家称赞她散文的典雅风格。

classicise.t: 使古典化；按古典风格处理

e.en: Architects tried to {classicise} the new façade.
e.zh: 建筑师试图将新立面古典化。

e.en: He chose to {classicise} his modern poems.
e.zh: 他选择把现代诗写得带古典味。

classicistic.t: 古典主义的；仿古典风格的

e.en: The painter favored a {classicistic} style.
e.zh: 这位画家偏爱古典主义风格。

e.en: Her sculptures show {classicistic} influences.
e.zh: 她的雕塑显示出古典主义的影响。

e.en: They tried to {classicize} the temple's design.
e.zh: 他们试图把神庙的设计古典化。

e.en: Renaissance artists sought to {classicize} their works.
e.zh: 文艺复兴艺术家力求让作品具有古典风格。

classicized.t: 古典化的；按古典风格处理过的

e.en: The {classicized} facade looked like a temple.
e.zh: 那经过古典化处理的立面看起来像座神庙。

e.en: He wrote in a heavily {classicized} style.
e.zh: 他的写作风格高度古典化。

classicizes.t: 使古典化（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {classicizes} every modern theme she touches.
e.zh: 她把接触到的每个现代题材都古典化。

e.en: This architect {classicizes} suburban houses.
e.zh: 这位建筑师把郊区住宅做成古典风格。

e.en: The botanist applied {classific} principles strictly.
e.zh: 植物学家严格运用分类原则。

e.en: They reviewed the {classific} system of species.
e.zh: 他们审查了物种的分类体系。

e.en: The {classificator} sorted the rocks by size.
e.zh: 分类装置按大小对岩石进行了分选。

e.en: She served as the museum's chief {classificator}.
e.zh: 她担任博物馆的首席分类员。

e.en: The hotel exuded an unmistakable {classiness}.
e.zh: 这家酒店散发出一种明显的高雅气质。

e.en: Her outfit had quiet {classiness}.
e.zh: 她的着装透着低调的优雅。

classis.t: （归正宗教会的）区会；长老会议

e.en: The {classis} met to ordain the new minister.
e.zh: 区会开会任命新牧师。

e.en: Each {classis} oversees several local churches.
e.zh: 每个区会监管若干地方教会。

classist.t: 阶级歧视的；阶级主义者

e.en: His remarks struck many as deeply {classist}.
e.zh: 他的言论让许多人觉得带有强烈的阶级歧视。

e.en: She refused to tolerate {classist} attitudes at work.
e.zh: 她不容忍工作中带阶级歧视的态度。

classman.t: 获优等学位者；同班同学

e.en: He graduated as a first-class {classman}.
e.zh: 他以一等优等学位毕业。

e.en: Every Oxford {classman} prepared rigorously for finals.
e.zh: 每位牛津优等生都为期末考试刻苦备战。

classmen.t: 获优等学位者们；同班同学们

e.en: The top {classmen} were honored at graduation.
e.zh: 最优秀的优等生们在毕业典礼上受到表彰。

e.en: Several {classmen} joined the debating society.
e.zh: 几位同班同学加入了辩论社。

e.en: Each {clast} in the rock told a story.
e.zh: 岩石中的每一块碎屑都讲述着一段历史。

e.en: The geologist measured every visible {clast}.
e.zh: 地质学家测量了每一块可见的岩屑。

e.en: Sandstone is a common {clastic} rock.
e.zh: 砂岩是一种常见的碎屑岩。

e.en: They studied the {clastic} sediments along the river.
e.zh: 他们研究了河边的碎屑沉积物。

e.en: The old typewriter was loud and {clattery}.
e.zh: 那台旧打字机又响又咔嗒作响。

e.en: They ate in a {clattery} diner downtown.
e.zh: 他们在市中心一家嘈杂的小餐馆吃饭。

e.en: The injured runner had a {claudicant} gait.
e.zh: 那位受伤的跑者步态一瘸一拐。

e.en: His {claudicant} walk worried the doctor.
e.zh: 他跛行的步态让医生担忧。

e.en: The grammar lesson focused on {clausal} structure.
e.zh: 这节语法课重点讲分句结构。

e.en: Translators must respect {clausal} boundaries carefully.
e.zh: 译者必须仔细遵守分句界限。

claustral.t: 修道院的；隐居的；幽闭的

e.en: The monks lived a strict {claustral} life.
e.zh: 修士们过着严格的修道院隐居生活。

e.en: Her room had a {claustral} silence.
e.zh: 她的房间笼罩着修道院般的寂静。

e.en: The nun accepted her life of {claustration}.
e.zh: 那位修女接受了与世隔绝的隐居生活。

e.en: Years of {claustration} had paled his skin.
e.zh: 多年的幽闭生活让他的皮肤变得苍白。

claustrophilia.t: 幽闭爱好；喜欢狭小空间

e.en: Her {claustrophilia} made her love tiny rooms.
e.zh: 她对狭小空间的偏爱使她喜欢小房间。

e.en: The cat showed obvious {claustrophilia} toward boxes.
e.zh: 那只猫对纸箱表现出明显的幽闭偏好。

e.en: As a {claustrophobe}, he avoided elevators.
e.zh: 作为幽闭恐惧症患者，他避免乘电梯。

e.en: The narrow tunnel terrified the {claustrophobe}.
e.zh: 狭窄的隧道让那位幽闭恐惧症患者感到恐惧。

claustrophobically.t: 令人幽闭恐惧地；憋闷地

e.en: The room felt {claustrophobically} small and dark.
e.zh: 那房间小得令人幽闭恐惧，又昏暗。

e.en: The crowd pressed in {claustrophobically} around them.
e.zh: 人群令人窒息地挤压在他们周围。

e.en: The neuroscientist studied the {claustrum} in detail.
e.zh: 那位神经学家详细研究了屏状核。

e.en: The {claustrum} may help integrate conscious experience.
e.zh: 屏状核可能有助于整合意识体验。

e.en: The insect's antennae are distinctly {clavate}.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的触角明显呈棒状。

e.en: Botanists noted the {clavate} shape of the spores.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到孢子呈棒状。

e.en: The fungus had a {clavated} fruiting body.
e.zh: 这种真菌有棒状的子实体。

e.en: They identified {clavated} hairs on the plant.
e.zh: 他们在植物上发现了棒状毛。

e.en: She played Bach on a restored {clavecin}.
e.zh: 她在一架修复过的羽管键琴上演奏巴赫。

e.en: The {clavecin} sat in the music room.
e.zh: 那架羽管键琴摆在音乐室里。

e.en: The neighbors {clavered} for hours over tea.
e.zh: 邻居们喝着茶闲聊了好几个小时。

e.en: She {clavered} on about the village gossip.
e.zh: 她唠叨着村里的闲言碎语。

e.en: Don't believe his idle {clavers}.
e.zh: 别信他那些无聊的闲话。

e.en: The market is full of village {clavers}.
e.zh: 集市上满是村里的闲言碎语。

clavicembalo.t: 羽管键琴（意大利语借词）

e.en: He owned a beautifully carved {clavicembalo}.
e.zh: 他拥有一架雕刻精美的羽管键琴。

e.en: The {clavicembalo} dominated baroque keyboard music.
e.zh: 羽管键琴在巴洛克键盘音乐中占主导地位。

e.en: The {clavichordist} performed early Bach pieces.
e.zh: 那位古钢琴演奏家演奏了早期的巴赫作品。

e.en: She trained as a {clavichordist} in Vienna.
e.zh: 她在维也纳学习成为古钢琴演奏家。

clavicorn.t: 棒角甲虫；具棒状触角的

e.en: The {clavicorn} beetle has thick antennae tips.
e.zh: 那种棒角甲虫的触角末端粗大。

e.en: Entomologists collected several {clavicorn} specimens.
e.zh: 昆虫学家采集了几只棒角甲虫标本。

e.en: The X-ray revealed a {clavicular} fracture.
e.zh: X 光显示有锁骨骨折。

e.en: She felt sharp pain in the {clavicular} area.
e.zh: 她在锁骨部位感到剧痛。

e.en: The young {clavierist} performed a Bach partita.
e.zh: 这位年轻的键盘演奏家演奏了一首巴赫的组曲。

e.en: She trained as a {clavierist} in Vienna.
e.zh: 她在维也纳接受键盘演奏训练。

e.en: His {clavieristic} technique impressed the judges.
e.zh: 他的键盘演奏技巧给评委留下了深刻印象。

e.en: The piece demands great {clavieristic} skill.
e.zh: 这首曲子需要很高的键盘演奏技巧。

e.en: The fungus has a {claviform} fruiting body.
e.zh: 这种真菌有棒状的子实体。

e.en: Scientists noted the cell's {claviform} shape.
e.zh: 科学家注意到这种细胞呈棒状。

e.en: The insect's antennae are {clavulate} at the tips.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的触角末端呈棒状。

e.en: Botanists described the {clavulate} structure of the spore.
e.zh: 植物学家描述了孢子的棒状结构。

e.en: The doctor removed a painful {clavus} from his toe.
e.zh: 医生切除了他脚趾上一个疼痛的鸡眼。

e.en: Tight shoes can cause a {clavus} to form.
e.zh: 过紧的鞋子可能导致鸡眼形成。

e.en: The bank issued a {claw-back} on the bonuses.
e.zh: 银行对奖金发出了追回令。

e.en: Regulators demanded a {claw-back} of the payments.
e.zh: 监管机构要求追回这些款项。

e.en: The antique tub had a beautiful {claw-foot} base.
e.zh: 这个古董浴缸有一个漂亮的爪形脚底座。

e.en: She admired the {claw-foot} design of the table.
e.zh: 她欣赏这张桌子的爪形脚设计。

e.en: He pulled the nails out with a {claw-hammer}.
e.zh: 他用羊角锤把钉子拔了出来。

e.en: Every toolbox should have a {claw-hammer}.
e.zh: 每个工具箱里都该有一把羊角锤。

e.en: The chair had elegant {clawandball} feet.
e.zh: 这把椅子有优雅的爪握球脚。

e.en: Antique dealers prize {clawandball} furniture.
e.zh: 古董商人很珍视爪握球式家具。

clawhammer.t: 羊角锤；下击式班卓琴弹奏法

e.en: He learned to play banjo {clawhammer} style.
e.zh: 他学会了用下击式弹奏班卓琴。

e.en: The carpenter reached for his {clawhammer}.
e.zh: 木匠去拿他的羊角锤。

e.en: The {clawless} otter played in the river.
e.zh: 这只无爪水獭在河里玩耍。

e.en: Some species are entirely {clawless}.
e.zh: 某些物种完全没有爪子。

e.en: The car's {claxon} blared in warning.
e.zh: 汽车的喇叭发出警告声。

e.en: A loud {claxon} signaled the start of the drill.
e.zh: 一声响亮的汽笛宣告演习开始。

e.en: His hands were {clay-cold} from the snow.
e.zh: 他的手被雪冻得冰冷如泥。

e.en: The body lay {clay-cold} on the floor.
e.zh: 尸体冰冷地躺在地板上。

e.en: The dough had a {clay-like} texture.
e.zh: 面团有一种像黏土一样的质感。

e.en: They walked on {clay-like} soil.
e.zh: 他们走在黏土般的泥土上。

e.en: He rode a sturdy {claybank} mare.
e.zh: 他骑着一匹强壮的黄褐色母马。

e.en: The {claybank} horse stood by the fence.
e.zh: 那匹黄褐色的马站在栅栏旁。

e.en: Engineers analyzed the {clayey-silt} layer.
e.zh: 工程师分析了这一层黏质粉土。

e.en: The site contained mostly {clayey-silt}.
e.zh: 该工地主要是黏质粉土。

e.en: The mixture had a {claylike} consistency.
e.zh: 这种混合物有像黏土一样的稠度。

e.en: She molded the {claylike} substance easily.
e.zh: 她轻易地塑造这种黏土状物质。

claypan.t: 黏土硬盘层；干涸的黏土洼地

e.en: Roots cannot penetrate the dense {claypan}.
e.zh: 根系无法穿透致密的黏土硬盘层。

e.en: The dry {claypan} cracked under the sun.
e.zh: 干涸的黏土洼地在烈日下龟裂。

e.en: The cliff is composed mainly of {claystone}.
e.zh: 悬崖主要由黏土岩构成。

e.en: Geologists studied the {claystone} formation.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了这一黏土岩层。

e.en: The shop sold handmade {clayware}.
e.zh: 这家店出售手工陶器。

e.en: Ancient {clayware} was found at the dig.
e.zh: 在发掘现场发现了古代陶器。

e.en: The boiler's {cleading} was worn through.
e.zh: 锅炉的包覆层已经磨穿。

e.en: Engineers replaced the old {cleading}.
e.zh: 工程师更换了旧的保温外层。

e.en: He bought a {clean-bred} stallion at auction.
e.zh: 他在拍卖会上买了一匹纯种的种马。

e.en: The farm raises {clean-bred} cattle.
e.zh: 这个农场养纯种牛。

e.en: Natural gas is a {clean-burning} fuel.
e.zh: 天然气是一种清洁燃烧的燃料。

e.en: They installed a {clean-burning} stove.
e.zh: 他们安装了一个清洁燃烧的炉子。

clean-cut.t: 轮廓分明的；衣着整洁的

e.en: He looked {clean-cut} in his interview suit.
e.zh: 他穿着面试西装显得整洁端正。

e.en: The contract had {clean-cut} terms.
e.zh: 合同条款清晰明确。

e.en: The mayor was known as a {clean-fingered} official.
e.zh: 市长以廉洁正直而著称。

e.en: They wanted a {clean-fingered} treasurer.
e.zh: 他们想要一位清廉的司库。

e.en: He left the trial {clean-handed} and free.
e.zh: 他清清白白地走出了审判庭。

e.en: Few politicians remain truly {clean-handed}.
e.zh: 很少有政客能真正保持清白。

e.en: The {clean-limbed} athlete crossed the finish line.
e.zh: 这位四肢修长的运动员冲过了终点线。

e.en: He admired the {clean-limbed} young dancer.
e.zh: 他欣赏那位身材修长的年轻舞者。

e.en: She married a {clean-living} man from the village.
e.zh: 她嫁给了村里一位生活正派的男子。

e.en: He has always been {clean-living} and disciplined.
e.zh: 他一直作风正派、自律。

e.en: The garage needs a thorough {clean-out}.
e.zh: 车库需要彻底清理一番。

e.en: They did a {clean-out} of the old files.
e.zh: 他们清空了旧档案。

e.en: He arrived {clean-shaven} and smartly dressed.
e.zh: 他刮净胡子、衣着整洁地到了。

e.en: His {clean-shaven} face looked younger.
e.zh: 他刮净胡子的脸看起来更年轻。

e.en: The goalkeeper kept a {clean-sheet} all season.
e.zh: 这位门将整个赛季保持零失球。

e.en: They earned another {clean-sheet} victory.
e.zh: 他们又赢得了一场零失球的胜利。

clean-skin.t: 无烙印的牲畜；无前科者

e.en: The rancher rounded up a stray {clean-skin}.
e.zh: 牧场主圈住了一头走失的无烙印牲畜。

e.en: Police suspected a {clean-skin} smuggler.
e.zh: 警方怀疑是一名无前科的走私者。

e.en: We did a quick {clean-up} after the party.
e.zh: 派对后我们快速打扫了一下。

e.en: The {clean-up} took all morning.
e.zh: 清理工作花了整个上午。

e.en: This fabric is easily {cleanable}.
e.zh: 这种布料容易清洗。

e.en: They sell {cleanable} keyboards for hospitals.
e.zh: 他们出售可清洁的医院用键盘。

e.en: I dropped my coat at the {cleaner's}.
e.zh: 我把外套送到干洗店了。

e.en: She picked up the suit from the {cleaner's}.
e.zh: 她从干洗店取回了西装。

e.en: He emerged from the inquiry {cleanhanded}.
e.zh: 他清白地走出了调查。

e.en: Voters demand a {cleanhanded} leader.
e.zh: 选民要求一位清廉的领导人。

e.en: Cats are generally {cleanlier} than dogs.
e.zh: 猫通常比狗更爱干净。

e.en: Modern cities are {cleanlier} than before.
e.zh: 现代城市比从前更清洁。

e.en: She was the {cleanliest} child in the family.
e.zh: 她是家里最爱干净的孩子。

e.en: They run the {cleanliest} kitchen in town.
e.zh: 他们经营着镇上最干净的厨房。

e.en: She lived simply and {cleanlily}.
e.zh: 她生活简朴而爱干净。

e.en: The cat groomed itself {cleanlily}.
e.zh: 那只猫把自己梳理得干干净净。

e.en: The filter is fully {cleansable} and reusable.
e.zh: 这种滤芯完全可清洗、可重复使用。

e.en: Choose a {cleansable} surface for the lab.
e.zh: 实验室要选可清洁的台面。

e.en: There is no {clear-cut} answer to that question.
e.zh: 那个问题没有明确的答案。

e.en: The evidence was {clear-cut} and convincing.
e.zh: 证据明确且令人信服。

e.en: Loggers left several {clear-cuts} on the hillside.
e.zh: 伐木工在山坡上留下了几片皆伐区。

e.en: Activists protest against large {clear-cuts}.
e.zh: 活动人士抗议大规模皆伐。

e.en: {Clear-cutting} damages forest ecosystems.
e.zh: 皆伐会破坏森林生态系统。

e.en: The company stopped {clear-cutting} old growth.
e.zh: 该公司停止了对原始林的皆伐。

clear-eyed.t: 目光清澈的；清醒理智的

e.en: We need a {clear-eyed} look at the risks.
e.zh: 我们需要清醒地看待这些风险。

e.en: She gave a {clear-eyed} assessment of the plan.
e.zh: 她对计划作出了清醒的评估。

e.en: Stay {clear-headed} during the negotiation.
e.zh: 谈判时要保持头脑清醒。

e.en: He remained {clear-headed} in the crisis.
e.zh: 危机中他始终保持头脑清醒。

e.en: Grandma made fresh cheese from {clabber}.
e.zh: 奶奶用酸凝乳做了新鲜奶酪。

e.en: Raw milk will {clabber} if left in the warm kitchen.
e.zh: 生牛奶放在温暖的厨房里会变酸凝结。

clabbered.t: 已凝结变酸的；变成凝乳的

e.en: The {clabbered} milk smelled faintly sour.
e.zh: 凝结的牛奶闻起来微微发酸。

e.en: By morning the cream had {clabbered} in the jug.
e.zh: 到早上，奶罐里的奶油已经凝结变酸了。

clabbering.t: 牛奶正在变酸凝结的过程

e.en: She watched the milk {clabbering} slowly in the heat.
e.zh: 她看着牛奶在高温下慢慢凝结。

e.en: {Clabbering} milk was once used to make farmhouse cheese.
e.zh: 变酸凝结的牛奶过去常被用来制作农家奶酪。

e.en: Unrefrigerated milk {clabbers} within a day.
e.zh: 不冷藏的牛奶一天之内就会变酸凝结。

e.en: He stirred the {clabbers} into the mixing bowl.
e.zh: 他把酸凝乳搅入搅拌碗中。

clachan.t: 苏格兰小村庄；石屋小聚落

e.en: We stopped at a tiny {clachan} deep in the Highlands.
e.zh: 我们在高地深处的一个小村庄停了下来。

e.en: The {clachan} had only a few stone cottages and a chapel.
e.zh: 这个小村庄只有几间石屋和一座小教堂。

cladistic.t: 支序分类学的；进化分支的

e.en: The team used {cladistic} methods to classify the fossils.
e.zh: 研究团队用支序分类法对化石进行分类。

e.en: A {cladistic} analysis revealed unexpected family relationships.
e.zh: 支序分析揭示了意想不到的亲缘关系。

cladistically.t: 按支序分类法；从进化分支角度

e.en: The species were grouped {cladistically} rather than by appearance.
e.zh: 这些物种是按支序分类法而非外表来分组的。

e.en: {Cladistically}, birds belong within the dinosaurs.
e.zh: 从支序分类来看，鸟类属于恐龙类。

cladistics.t: 支序分类学；进化分支学

e.en: {Cladistics} is now central to modern evolutionary biology.
e.zh: 支序分类学如今是现代进化生物学的核心。

e.en: She specializes in plant {cladistics} at the museum.
e.zh: 她在博物馆专攻植物支序分类学。

cladoceran.t: 枝角类水蚤；枝角目的浮游动物

e.en: The pond was teeming with tiny {cladocerans}.
e.zh: 池塘里满是微小的枝角类水蚤。

e.en: {Cladocerans} are crucial to lake food webs.
e.zh: 枝角类水蚤对湖泊食物网至关重要。

cladode.t: 叶状茎；像叶子的扁平枝

e.en: Each prickly pear {cladode} stores plenty of water.
e.zh: 每片仙人掌的叶状茎都储存着大量水分。

e.en: The {cladode} carried tiny clustered spines.
e.zh: 这片叶状茎上长着簇生的小刺。

cladodial.t: 叶状茎的；具有扁平叶状枝的

e.en: The cactus shows clearly {cladodial} growth.
e.zh: 这种仙人掌呈现出明显的叶状茎生长方式。

e.en: Botanists noted the {cladodial} structure of the stems.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这些茎具有叶状茎结构。

cladogenesis.t: 分支进化；物种分支形成过程

e.en: {Cladogenesis} produces new species over long timescales.
e.zh: 分支进化经过漫长时间产生新物种。

e.en: Geographic isolation often drives {cladogenesis}.
e.zh: 地理隔离常常推动分支进化。

cladogenetic.t: 分支进化的；物种分化产生的

e.en: These traits arose through {cladogenetic} events.
e.zh: 这些特征是通过分支进化事件产生的。

e.en: {Cladogenetic} change creates entirely new lineages.
e.zh: 分支进化的变化会创造出全新的支系。

cladogenetically.t: 通过分支进化方式；以物种分化形式

e.en: The two lineages diverged {cladogenetically} long ago.
e.zh: 这两个支系很久以前就通过分支进化分道扬镳。

e.en: Species can evolve {cladogenetically} from a common ancestor.
e.zh: 物种可从共同祖先以分支进化的方式演化。

cladome.t: 海绵骨针的分支端结构

e.en: The {cladome} of the spicule branched outward sharply.
e.zh: 骨针的分支端结构向外锐利地展开。

e.en: Researchers measured each {cladome} under the microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下测量每一个骨针分支结构。

cladophyll.t: 叶状枝；功能似叶的扁平茎

e.en: In asparagus, tiny {cladophylls} replace true leaves.
e.zh: 在芦笋中，细小的叶状枝代替了真正的叶子。

e.en: The plant photosynthesizes mainly through its {cladophylls}.
e.zh: 这种植物主要通过其叶状枝进行光合作用。

e.en: Please complete this {claim-form} for your insurance.
e.zh: 请填写此索赔表以申办你的保险。

e.en: She handed in the signed {claim-form} at the counter.
e.zh: 她在柜台递交了签好字的索赔表。

e.en: Travel costs are {claimable} on the company expense account.
e.zh: 差旅费可在公司费用账目上报销。

e.en: The benefit becomes {claimable} after one year of service.
e.zh: 该福利在工作满一年后可申领。

e.en: After the deadline, the rejected applicant was left {claimless}.
e.zh: 过了截止日期，被拒的申请人就无可申诉了。

e.en: He walked away from the property entirely {claimless}.
e.zh: 他放弃了对该房产的一切主张。

claimsman.t: 矿权持有者；权利主张人

e.en: The old {claimsman} guarded his stake with a rifle.
e.zh: 那位老矿主持枪守着自己的矿权。

e.en: Each {claimsman} registered his land at the local office.
e.zh: 每位矿权持有者都在当地办事处登记了土地。

clair-obscure.t: 明暗对比法；绘画的明暗法

e.en: The painting uses {clair-obscure} to dramatic effect.
e.zh: 这幅画以戏剧性的效果运用了明暗对比法。

e.en: Rembrandt was a master of {clair-obscure} technique.
e.zh: 伦勃朗是明暗对比法的大师。

e.en: She claimed to possess genuine {clairaudience}.
e.zh: 她声称自己拥有真正的通灵听觉。

e.en: {Clairaudience} is described in many spiritual traditions.
e.zh: 许多灵性传统中都描述过通灵听觉。

clairaudient.t: 具有通灵听觉的；能听到灵界声音的

e.en: The medium said her sister was also {clairaudient}.
e.zh: 那位灵媒说她的姐姐也具有通灵听觉。

e.en: {Clairaudient} experiences are reported across many cultures.
e.zh: 许多文化中都有关于通灵听觉体验的报告。

clairaudiently.t: 以通灵听觉方式；超自然地听到

e.en: She insists she heard the warning {clairaudiently}.
e.zh: 她坚称自己以通灵听觉听到了那个警告。

e.en: He claims to perceive distant voices {clairaudiently}.
e.zh: 他声称能以通灵听觉感知远方的声音。

e.en: The {clairvoyante} laid out her tarot cards on the velvet.
e.zh: 这位女通灵者把塔罗牌摊在丝绒布上。

e.en: Many wealthy clients consulted the famous {clairvoyante}.
e.zh: 许多富有的客户都向那位著名的女通灵者求教。

clamant.t: 喧嚷的；急迫的；强烈呼吁的

e.en: The {clamant} demands of the crowd grew impossible to ignore.
e.zh: 人群喧嚷的诉求已无法被忽视。

e.en: There is a {clamant} need for housing reform.
e.zh: 住房改革有迫切的需要。

clamantly.t: 喧嚷地；急迫地；强烈呼吁地

e.en: The protesters spoke {clamantly} outside the courthouse.
e.zh: 抗议者在法院外喧嚷地发言。

e.en: She {clamantly} demanded an apology from the company.
e.zh: 她急切地要求公司道歉。

clamatorial.t: 鸣禽亚目的；非鸣禽鸟类的

e.en: {Clamatorial} birds have simpler vocal organs than songbirds.
e.zh: 非鸣禽鸟类的发声器官比鸣禽简单。

e.en: Many {clamatorial} species inhabit tropical rainforests.
e.zh: 许多非鸣禽种类栖息于热带雨林。

clamlike.t: 蛤蜊状的；像蛤蜊一样的

e.en: The fossil had a clearly {clamlike} appearance.
e.zh: 这块化石明显呈蛤蜊状。

e.en: Its {clamlike} shell snapped tightly shut.
e.zh: 它蛤蜊状的外壳紧紧地合上了。

clammier.t: 更湿冷黏滑的；更阴冷潮湿的

e.en: His hands grew {clammier} as the interview wore on.
e.zh: 面试越拖越久，他的手越来越湿冷黏滑。

e.en: The basement felt {clammier} than the rest of the house.
e.zh: 地下室比房子其他地方更阴冷潮湿。

clammiest.t: 最湿冷黏滑的；最阴冷潮湿的

e.en: It was the {clammiest} afternoon of the entire summer.
e.zh: 那是整个夏天最闷热湿黏的一个下午。

e.en: Her palms were the {clammiest} I had ever shaken.
e.zh: 她的掌心是我握过最湿冷黏滑的。

clammily.t: 湿冷黏滑地；阴冷潮湿地

e.en: The fog clung {clammily} to his skin and hair.
e.zh: 雾湿冷黏滑地贴在他的皮肤和头发上。

e.en: His shirt stuck {clammily} to his back after the run.
e.zh: 跑步后他的衬衫湿黏地贴在背上。

clamp-off.t: 夹断封闭；用夹具夹紧关闭

e.en: The plumber performed a {clamp-off} on the leaking pipe.
e.zh: 水管工对漏水的管道进行了夹断封闭。

e.en: Use a {clamp-off} tool for emergency gas-line repairs.
e.zh: 紧急修理燃气管线时要用夹断工具。

clamworm.t: 沙蚕；可作鱼饵的海生蠕虫

e.en: The fishermen used live {clamworms} as bait.
e.zh: 渔民用活沙蚕作鱼饵。

e.en: A {clamworm} burrows quickly into the tidal mud.
e.zh: 沙蚕会迅速钻入潮间带的泥中。

clandestinity.t: 秘密性；隐秘状态；地下行动状态

e.en: The {clandestinity} of the operation was absolutely crucial.
e.zh: 这次行动的隐秘性绝对至关重要。

e.en: Their meetings demanded complete {clandestinity}.
e.zh: 他们的会面需要完全保密。

e.en: The {clangorous} bells rang out across the old city.
e.zh: 铿锵的钟声响彻古老的城市。

e.en: A {clangorous} crash echoed from the metal workshop.
e.zh: 金属车间传出嘈杂的撞击回声。

e.en: The hammers fell {clangorously} on the iron anvil.
e.zh: 锤子铿锵地落在铁砧上。

e.en: Cathedral bells rang {clangorously} at midnight.
e.zh: 大教堂的钟声在午夜嘈杂地敲响。

clangour.t: 铿锵声；金属的嘈杂回响

e.en: The {clangour} of metal filled the cramped forge.
e.zh: 金属的铿锵声充满了狭小的锻造炉间。

e.en: She covered her ears against the {clangour} of the bells.
e.zh: 她捂住耳朵抵御钟声的铿锵嘈杂。

clangoured.t: 铿锵作响；金属嘈杂地响起

e.en: The cymbals {clangoured} as the parade passed by.
e.zh: 游行队伍走过时，铙钹铿锵作响。

e.en: Bells {clangoured} mournfully across the valley.
e.zh: 钟声哀伤地铿锵响彻山谷。

clangouring.t: 正在铿锵作响；金属嘈杂回响着

e.en: The {clangouring} bells woke the entire village.
e.zh: 铿锵作响的钟声叫醒了整个村庄。

e.en: I heard armor {clangouring} on the distant battlefield.
e.zh: 我听见远处战场上盔甲铿锵作响。

clangours.t: 铿锵声响；金属嘈杂回响

e.en: Distant {clangours} announced the approaching army.
e.zh: 远方的铿锵声响宣告了军队的逼近。

e.en: The blacksmith's hammer {clangours} from dawn till dusk.
e.zh: 铁匠的锤子从清晨到黄昏一直铿锵作响。

clankless.t: 无铿锵声的；不发响声的

e.en: The well-oiled hinges swung open {clankless} in the dark.
e.zh: 上好油的铰链在黑暗中无声地打开。

e.en: He slipped through the dungeon corridor {clankless}.
e.zh: 他无声地溜过地牢的走廊。

e.en: I did a big {clear-out} of the garage.
e.zh: 我把车库彻底清理了一遍。

e.en: The store held a {clear-out} sale before closing.
e.zh: 那家店关门前举行了清仓大甩卖。

e.en: She is a {clear-sighted} leader who anticipates trouble.
e.zh: 她是位目光敏锐、能预见麻烦的领导者。

e.en: We need a {clear-sighted} analysis of the risks.
e.zh: 我们需要对风险作清晰透彻的分析。

e.en: Maids used to {clear-starch} fine linen by hand.
e.zh: 女佣过去会亲手给上等亚麻布上清浆。

e.en: She learned to {clear-starch} collars at her grandmother's side.
e.zh: 她在祖母身边学会了给衣领上清浆。

e.en: Let's do a quick {clear-up} before the guests arrive.
e.zh: 客人到之前我们快速整理一下。

e.en: The forecast promised a {clear-up} by noon.
e.zh: 天气预报说中午前会放晴。

e.en: These cookies are easily {clearable} from your browser settings.
e.zh: 这些Cookie可在浏览器设置中轻松清除。

e.en: Make sure every debt is {clearable} before year end.
e.zh: 确保年底前每笔债务都能结清。

e.en: The forest underwent {clearage} to make way for farmland.
e.zh: 森林被砍伐清理以让位给农田。

e.en: Snow {clearage} took the crew all morning.
e.zh: 清雪工作让队员忙了一上午。

clearcole.t: 清漆底料；胶质白色底涂

e.en: Painters apply {clearcole} before laying gold leaf.
e.zh: 油漆工在贴金箔前先涂上一层胶底。

e.en: The carved wood was primed with {clearcole}.
e.zh: 雕刻的木料先涂了胶质白底。

clearheaded.t: 头脑清醒的；冷静理智的

e.en: Try to stay {clearheaded} during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机中尽量保持头脑清醒。

e.en: She remained {clearheaded} despite the chaos around her.
e.zh: 尽管周围一片混乱，她仍保持冷静。

e.en: He answered every question {clearheadedly}.
e.zh: 他思路清晰地回答了每一个问题。

e.en: She tackled the emergency {clearheadedly}.
e.zh: 她冷静理智地处理了那次紧急情况。

e.en: Her {clearheadedness} saved the negotiation from collapse.
e.zh: 她的冷静使谈判免于破裂。

e.en: Pilots are trained for {clearheadedness} under pressure.
e.zh: 飞行员被训练在压力下保持清醒。

e.en: We did a big {clearout} of the attic last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们彻底清理了阁楼。

e.en: The shop announced a major {clearout} of winter stock.
e.zh: 那家店宣布冬季存货大清仓。

e.en: He gave a {clearsighted} assessment of the company's future.
e.zh: 他对公司的前景作了清晰透彻的评估。

e.en: Only a {clearsighted} observer noticed the flaw.
e.zh: 只有目光敏锐的观察者才注意到那个缺陷。

e.en: Servants would {clearstarch} the master's shirts each week.
e.zh: 仆人每周给主人的衬衫上浆。

e.en: She knew exactly how to {clearstarch} delicate lace.
e.zh: 她非常清楚如何给精细的蕾丝上清浆。

clearstarched.t: 上过清浆的；浆得挺括的

e.en: She wore a {clearstarched} apron over her dress.
e.zh: 她在裙子外系着一条上过浆的围裙。

e.en: The {clearstarched} collar stood up crisply.
e.zh: 那只上过浆的衣领挺括地竖着。

e.en: The {clearstarcher} pressed the linens flat with care.
e.zh: 上浆工小心地把亚麻布熨平。

e.en: In her youth she worked as a {clearstarcher}.
e.zh: 她年轻时做过上浆工。

e.en: Sunlight streamed through the cathedral's {clearstory}.
e.zh: 阳光透过大教堂的高侧窗倾泻而下。

e.en: Architects often add a {clearstory} for natural light.
e.zh: 建筑师常加设高侧窗以引入自然光。

e.en: Parking on the {clearway} is strictly forbidden.
e.zh: 在禁停车道上停车是严令禁止的。

e.en: The {clearway} stretched for ten miles into the city.
e.zh: 这条禁停快速通道延伸十英里直入市区。

e.en: City {clearways} keep rush-hour traffic moving.
e.zh: 城市禁停车道使高峰期交通保持顺畅。

e.en: Several new {clearways} were marked downtown.
e.zh: 市中心新划出了几条禁停车道。

clearweed.t: 透茎冷水花（一种草本植物）

e.en: The shaded trail was lined with {clearweed}.
e.zh: 阴凉的小径两旁长满了透茎冷水花。

e.en: {Clearweed} thrives in moist, shady soil.
e.zh: 透茎冷水花在湿润背阴的土壤中茂盛生长。

e.en: A {clearwing} moth hovered over the flowers like a hummingbird.
e.zh: 一只透翅蛾像蜂鸟般悬停在花朵上方。

e.en: Gardeners often mistake the {clearwing} for a bee.
e.zh: 园丁常把透翅蛾误认为蜜蜂。

e.en: The mineral's {cleavability} makes it easy to split into sheets.
e.zh: 这种矿物的可裂性使它易于劈成薄片。

e.en: Mica is prized for its perfect {cleavability}.
e.zh: 云母因其完美的解理性而受重视。

e.en: The chemical bond is enzymatically {cleavable}.
e.zh: 这种化学键可被酶切断。

e.en: This slate is easily {cleavable} along its grain.
e.zh: 这种板岩很容易顺纹劈开。

e.en: He selected a {cleek} for the long approach shot.
e.zh: 他选了一支长铁杆做远距离切击。

e.en: She caught the loop with an iron {cleek}.
e.zh: 她用铁钩钩住了那个绳圈。

e.en: A {cleg} bit her painfully on the arm.
e.zh: 一只牛虻在她手臂上狠狠咬了一口。

e.en: Highland walkers always fear the {cleg} in summer.
e.zh: 高地徒步者夏天总怕牛虻。

e.en: Reptiles and birds lay {cleidoic} eggs.
e.zh: 爬行动物和鸟类产有壳闭合的卵。

e.en: The {cleidoic} egg allowed vertebrates to colonize land.
e.zh: 闭壳卵使脊椎动物得以登上陆地。

e.en: The violet produces {cleistogamous} flowers in late summer.
e.zh: 紫罗兰在夏末长出闭花受精的花朵。

e.en: {Cleistogamous} plants self-pollinate inside unopened buds.
e.zh: 闭花植物在未开的花蕾内自花授粉。

e.en: Some violets reproduce {cleistogamously} when pollinators are scarce.
e.zh: 有些紫罗兰在缺少传粉者时以闭花方式繁殖。

e.en: The plant flowers {cleistogamously} during dry spells.
e.zh: 该植物在干旱期闭花受精。

e.en: {Cleistogamy} ensures seed set even without insects.
e.zh: 闭花受精确保即使没有昆虫也能结籽。

e.en: Botanists have long studied {cleistogamy} in violets.
e.zh: 植物学家长期研究紫罗兰的闭花受精。

cleistothecium.t: 闭囊壳（真菌的封闭子囊果）

e.en: The fungus produces a tiny {cleistothecium} on infected leaves.
e.zh: 这种真菌在受感染的叶上长出微小的闭囊壳。

e.en: Spores develop safely inside the {cleistothecium}.
e.zh: 孢子在闭囊壳内安全地发育。

e.en: Her {cleithrophobia} flares up in crowded elevators.
e.zh: 她的幽闭恐惧症在拥挤的电梯里就会发作。

e.en: {Cleithrophobia} is the fear of being locked in.
e.zh: 幽闭恐惧症是对被困锁的恐惧。

e.en: Old poets {clepe} the moon Selene in their verses.
e.zh: 古代诗人在诗中把月亮称为塞勒涅。

e.en: They {clepe} him champion of the realm.
e.zh: 他们尊称他为王国的勇士。

e.en: In the old chronicle he was {cleped} 'the brave'.
e.zh: 在古老的编年史中他被称为'勇者'。

e.en: The maiden was {cleped} fairest in the land.
e.zh: 那少女被誉为全国最美。

e.en: The bards were {cleping} him a hero of the age.
e.zh: 吟游诗人尊称他为一代英雄。

e.en: Old texts speak of {cleping} the gods by name.
e.zh: 古籍中写到直呼诸神之名。

e.en: She sought therapy for her {cleptomania}.
e.zh: 她为偷窃癖去接受心理治疗。

e.en: {Cleptomania} is recognized as a mental disorder.
e.zh: 偷窃癖被认定为一种精神障碍。

e.en: The {cleptomaniac} couldn't resist pocketing small trinkets.
e.zh: 那位偷窃癖患者忍不住把小饰物揣进口袋。

e.en: He's not really a thief, just a {cleptomaniac}.
e.zh: 他并非真正的小偷，只是有偷窃癖。

e.en: The hospital employs a full-time {clergyperson} for patients.
e.zh: 医院聘请了一位全职神职人员服务病人。

e.en: Each {clergyperson} visits the sick once a week.
e.zh: 每位神职人员每周探访一次病人。

e.en: The new {clergywoman} delivered her first sermon on Sunday.
e.zh: 新任女牧师在周日做了首次布道。

e.en: She became the parish's first {clergywoman} in its history.
e.zh: 她成为该教区历史上第一位女牧师。

clericalist.t: 教权主义者；主张教会干政者

e.en: {Clericalist} factions opposed the secular reforms.
e.zh: 教权主义派反对那些世俗化改革。

e.en: His rivals branded him a stubborn {clericalist}.
e.zh: 对手把他贴上顽固教权主义者的标签。

citifying.t: 使乡村都市化；使变得有都市习气

e.en: Migration is rapidly {citifying} the countryside.
e.zh: 移民正快速使乡村都市化。

e.en: Modern infrastructure keeps {citifying} the rural landscape.
e.zh: 现代基建不断改变着乡村风貌。

citizeness.t: 女公民；具有公民身份的女性

e.en: She was the first {citizeness} to address the council.
e.zh: 她是首位在议会上发言的女公民。

e.en: The novel features a brave {citizeness} of Rome.
e.zh: 小说塑造了一位罗马的勇敢女公民。

citizenhood.t: 公民身份；作为公民的状态

e.en: Naturalization confers full {citizenhood} on the immigrant.
e.zh: 归化使移民获得完整的公民身份。

e.en: He values his {citizenhood} above all else.
e.zh: 他将自己的公民身份看得高于一切。

citole.t: 西托尔琴；中世纪弹拨弦乐器

e.en: The minstrel played a haunting tune on his {citole}.
e.zh: 吟游诗人用西托尔琴弹奏出动人的曲调。

e.en: Few medieval {citoles} have survived to this day.
e.zh: 极少数西托尔琴留存至今。

citramalase.t: 柠苹酸酶；催化柠苹酸分解的酶

e.en: The bacterium produces {citramalase} during fermentation.
e.zh: 这种细菌在发酵时产生柠苹酸酶。

e.en: Researchers isolated a new {citramalase} from soil microbes.
e.zh: 研究人员从土壤微生物中分离出新型柠苹酸酶。

citrange.t: 香橙；甜橙与枳的杂交品种

e.en: Farmers planted {citrange} as a cold-hardy rootstock.
e.zh: 农民种植香橙作为耐寒砧木。

e.en: The {citrange} fruit tastes too sour to eat raw.
e.zh: 香橙果实太酸不宜生吃。

e.en: The vase had a beautiful {citreous} glaze.
e.zh: 这只花瓶有漂亮的柠檬黄釉。

e.en: Her dress was a soft {citreous} shade.
e.zh: 她的裙子是柔和的柠檬黄色。

e.en: Florida's {citriculture} dominates the orange market.
e.zh: 佛罗里达的柑橘种植业主导着柳橙市场。

e.en: {Citriculture} requires careful pest management.
e.zh: 柑橘种植需要细致的病虫害管理。

citriculturist.t: 柑橘种植者；柑橘栽培专家

e.en: The {citriculturist} grafted new varieties of orange.
e.zh: 这位柑橘种植专家嫁接了新品种橙子。

e.en: Local {citriculturists} gathered for an annual conference.
e.zh: 当地柑橘种植者们聚集参加年会。

e.en: Early studies labeled the substance {citrin}.
e.zh: 早期研究将这种物质称为柠檬素。

e.en: {Citrin} occurs naturally in citrus rinds.
e.zh: 柠檬素天然存在于柑橘果皮中。

citrinin.t: 桔霉素；红色霉菌产生的毒素

e.en: Stored grain may contain trace levels of {citrinin}.
e.zh: 储存的谷物可能含有微量桔霉素。

e.en: Researchers measured {citrinin} contamination in rice.
e.zh: 研究人员检测了大米中的桔霉素污染。

citromycetin.t: 柠檬霉素；从青霉菌分离的化合物

e.en: Scientists first isolated {citromycetin} in the 1940s.
e.zh: 科学家在四十年代首次分离出柠檬霉素。

e.en: {Citromycetin} shows weak antibiotic activity.
e.zh: 柠檬霉素表现出微弱的抗生素活性。

citronellal.t: 香茅醛；具柠檬香气的化合物

e.en: The lotion contains {citronellal} to repel mosquitoes.
e.zh: 这款乳液含有香茅醛以驱蚊。

e.en: {Citronellal} gives lemongrass its distinctive smell.
e.zh: 香茅醛赋予了柠檬草独特的气味。

citronellol.t: 香茅醇；玫瑰精油的主要成分

e.en: Perfumes often include {citronellol} for floral notes.
e.zh: 香水常加入香茅醇增添花香调。

e.en: {Citronellol} is extracted from rose oil.
e.zh: 香茅醇从玫瑰油中提取。

citronetin.t: 柠檬黄烷酮素；柑橘类化合物

e.en: Chemists detected {citronetin} in the fruit's peel.
e.zh: 化学家在果皮中检测到柠檬黄烷酮素。

e.en: {Citronetin} belongs to the flavanone family.
e.zh: 柠檬黄烷酮素属于黄烷酮家族。

citrophen.t: 柠苯非那西丁；旧用退热药

e.en: Doctors once prescribed {citrophen} for fever.
e.zh: 医生曾用柠苯非那西丁治疗发烧。

e.en: {Citrophen} fell out of use due to side effects.
e.zh: 柠苯非那西丁因副作用而被弃用。

citrostadienol.t: 柠檬甾二烯醇；植物甾醇之一

e.en: Cereal grains naturally contain {citrostadienol}.
e.zh: 谷物中天然含有柠檬甾二烯醇。

e.en: {Citrostadienol} is a phytosterol of interest.
e.zh: 柠檬甾二烯醇是一种受关注的植物甾醇。

e.en: The dessert had a refreshing {citrous} note.
e.zh: 这款甜点带有清爽的柑橘风味。

e.en: He grows several {citrous} trees in his garden.
e.zh: 他在花园里种了几棵柑橘类树木。

citrullin.t: 瓜氨酸；非蛋白质氨基酸

e.en: The biochemist labeled the compound {citrullin}.
e.zh: 生化学家把这种化合物标记为瓜氨酸。

e.en: Older textbooks spell it {citrullin}.
e.zh: 旧教科书将其拼作citrullin。

citrulline.t: 瓜氨酸；一种非蛋白氨基酸

e.en: Watermelon is naturally rich in {citrulline}.
e.zh: 西瓜天然富含瓜氨酸。

e.en: Athletes take {citrulline} supplements for endurance.
e.zh: 运动员服用瓜氨酸补剂以增强耐力。

citrullol.t: 瓜氨醇；瓜氨酸相关的化合物

e.en: Old literature briefly mentions {citrullol}.
e.zh: 旧文献中简略提到过瓜氨醇。

e.en: Researchers rarely study {citrullol} today.
e.zh: 如今研究人员很少研究瓜氨醇。

cittern.t: 西特恩琴；文艺复兴时期的拨弦乐器

e.en: He strummed an old {cittern} by the fireplace.
e.zh: 他在壁炉旁拨动一把古老的西特恩琴。

e.en: Renaissance taverns echoed with the {cittern}'s twang.
e.zh: 文艺复兴时期的酒馆里回荡着西特恩琴声。

city-born.t: 城市出生的；生于都市的

e.en: Being {city-born}, he never milked a cow.
e.zh: 他生于都市，从未挤过奶。

e.en: {City-born} children rarely see open fields.
e.zh: 都市出生的孩子很少见到开阔的田野。

city-bred.t: 在城市长大的；城里养大的

e.en: Her {city-bred} manners stood out at the farm.
e.zh: 她在城里养成的举止在农场显得格格不入。

e.en: {City-bred} kids often crave a taste of nature.
e.zh: 城市长大的孩子常常渴望接触大自然。

city-state.t: 城邦；古希腊式的城市国家

e.en: Athens was a famous ancient {city-state}.
e.zh: 雅典是著名的古代城邦。

e.en: Singapore functions like a modern {city-state}.
e.zh: 新加坡的运作如同现代城邦。

citybilly.t: 都市乡巴佬；进城的乡下人

e.en: He laughed off being called a {citybilly}.
e.zh: 他对被叫作都市乡巴佬一笑置之。

e.en: Some neighbors dismissed her as a mere {citybilly}.
e.zh: 一些邻居把她当成不过是个都市乡巴佬。

citybred.t: 城市长大的；都市养成的

e.en: Their {citybred} habits clashed with rural life.
e.zh: 他们都市养成的习惯与乡村生活格格不入。

e.en: Most of her friends are {citybred} professionals.
e.zh: 她大多数朋友是城市长大的专业人士。

cityfied.t: 染上城市习气的；都市化的

e.en: His {cityfied} accent puzzled his old neighbors.
e.zh: 他染上都市口音让老邻居们感到困惑。

e.en: She returned home with a {cityfied} wardrobe.
e.zh: 她带着一身都市化的行头回到家乡。

cityward.t: 朝城市方向的；向城里去的

e.en: The travelers turned {cityward} at dawn.
e.zh: 旅人们在黎明时朝城里方向走去。

e.en: We drove {cityward} through heavy fog.
e.zh: 我们冒着浓雾朝城里开车。

citywards.t: 朝城市方向地；向城里地

e.en: The crowd surged {citywards} after the rally.
e.zh: 集会后人群涌向城里。

e.en: She gazed {citywards} from the hilltop.
e.zh: 她从山顶眺望城市方向。

civetone.t: 灵猫酮；麝猫香的主要成分

e.en: Perfumers prize {civetone} for its musky aroma.
e.zh: 调香师珍视灵猫酮的麝香气味。

e.en: Synthetic {civetone} replaced the animal extract.
e.zh: 合成灵猫酮取代了动物提取物。

civic-minded.t: 有公民意识的；热心公益的

e.en: She is a {civic-minded} member of her community.
e.zh: 她是社区里热心公益的一员。

e.en: {Civic-minded} citizens often volunteer for elections.
e.zh: 有公民意识的公民常常自愿参与选举工作。

civicism.t: 公民精神；热心公益的态度

e.en: His speech celebrated old-fashioned {civicism}.
e.zh: 他的演讲颂扬了老派的公民精神。

e.en: The textbook praises {civicism} as a national virtue.
e.zh: 教材称颂公民精神为国家美德。

civie.t: 平民；非军人；普通老百姓

e.en: After discharge he was finally a {civie} again.
e.zh: 退伍后他终于又成了平民。

e.en: The base hosted a barbecue for {civies}.
e.zh: 基地为平民举办了烧烤活动。

e.en: Off-duty soldiers changed into {civies}.
e.zh: 下班的士兵换上了便服。

e.en: He felt strange wearing {civies} after years in uniform.
e.zh: 穿了多年军装后再穿便服，他感觉有些怪。

civil-libertarian.t: 公民自由主义者；维护公民自由权利者

e.en: The judge was a noted {civil-libertarian}.
e.zh: 这位法官是著名的公民自由主义者。

e.en: {Civil-libertarian} lawyers challenged the new law.
e.zh: 公民自由主义者律师挑战了这项新法律。

e.en: The march defended every {civil-right} of the people.
e.zh: 这场游行捍卫人民的每一项公民权利。

e.en: Activists pursued {civil-right} reforms for decades.
e.zh: 活动人士数十年来推动公民权利改革。

civilianise.t: 使平民化；将军务转为民事

e.en: The government plans to {civilianise} the police force.
e.zh: 政府计划将警察部队平民化。

e.en: Officials hope to {civilianise} the agency by next year.
e.zh: 官员希望明年前将该机构平民化。

civilianize.t: 使平民化；将军务转为民事

e.en: Reforms aim to {civilianize} certain military roles.
e.zh: 改革旨在将某些军职转为平民职。

e.en: The base will {civilianize} its support staff.
e.zh: 基地将把后勤人员转为平民编制。

e.en: Colonialists wrongly judged some peoples as not {civilizable}.
e.zh: 殖民者错误地认为某些民族不可教化。

e.en: The author argued every culture is {civilizable}.
e.zh: 作者认为每种文化都是可教化的。

e.en: The {civillian} survivors received humanitarian aid.
e.zh: 幸存的平民们得到了人道主义援助。

e.en: Most casualties were ordinary {civillians}.
e.zh: 大多数伤亡者是普通平民。

civism.t: 公民精神；公民意识；爱国精神

e.en: The teacher promoted {civism} in every lesson.
e.zh: 老师在每堂课上都倡导公民精神。

e.en: True {civism} requires engagement, not just talk.
e.zh: 真正的公民精神需要参与，而非空谈。

e.en: He printed a thorough {ckecklist} for the trip.
e.zh: 他打印了一份完整的旅行清单。

e.en: Use the {ckecklist} to verify each step.
e.zh: 用这份检查表核对每个步骤。

e.en: She entered the {climacteric} stage of her life.
e.zh: 她进入了人生的更年期阶段。

e.en: The election marked a {climacteric} moment for the nation.
e.zh: 这次选举是国家的重大转折时刻。

e.en: Critics called it a {climacterical} year for the company.
e.zh: 评论家称这是公司危急的一年。

e.en: He survived a {climacterical} illness in his sixties.
e.zh: 他在六十多岁时挺过了一场危重疾病。

e.en: The novel ends {climactically} with a fierce battle.
e.zh: 小说以一场激战达到高潮收尾。

e.en: The music built up {climactically} toward the finale.
e.zh: 音乐逐渐高涨直至终曲达到高潮。

e.en: We need to {climatize} the seedlings before planting them outside.
e.zh: 我们需要让幼苗先适应气候再种到外面。

e.en: Athletes {climatize} for weeks before competing at altitude.
e.zh: 运动员在高原比赛前要适应气候数周。

e.en: The trees were carefully {climatized} to the new region.
e.zh: 这些树经过精心驯化以适应新地区。

e.en: Fully {climatized} coffee plants survive the cold winters.
e.zh: 完全适应气候的咖啡树能熬过寒冬。

e.en: {Climatizing} the saplings takes several weeks.
e.zh: 让小树苗适应气候需要好几周。

e.en: She is {climatizing} her orchids on the porch.
e.zh: 她正在门廊上让兰花适应气候。

e.en: The {climatograph} shows temperature and rainfall together.
e.zh: 这张气候图同时显示温度与降水。

e.en: Researchers prepared a detailed {climatograph} of the region.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制了该地区详尽的气候图。

e.en: {Climatopathology} studies how climate affects disease patterns.
e.zh: 气候病理学研究气候如何影响疾病分布。

e.en: He published a paper on tropical {climatopathology}.
e.zh: 他发表了一篇关于热带气候病理学的论文。

e.en: {Climatophysiology} explores how the body adapts to weather.
e.zh: 气候生理学探究身体如何适应天气。

e.en: Her research focuses on alpine {climatophysiology}.
e.zh: 她的研究专注于高山气候生理学。

e.en: Doctors recommended {climatotherapy} for his chronic asthma.
e.zh: 医生建议他采用气候疗法治疗慢性哮喘。

e.en: Mountain {climatotherapy} was popular in the nineteenth century.
e.zh: 山地气候疗法在十九世纪十分流行。

e.en: Each plant {climatotype} thrives in a specific zone.
e.zh: 每种气候型植物都在特定地带生长良好。

e.en: Scientists classified the species by {climatotype}.
e.zh: 科学家按气候型对该物种进行了分类。

e.en: The {climatron} houses tropical plants year-round.
e.zh: 这座气候馆全年容纳热带植物。

e.en: Visitors marveled at the giant geodesic {climatron}.
e.zh: 游客惊叹于那座巨大的网格穹顶气候馆。

e.en: Critics complained that the film was {climaxless}.
e.zh: 评论家抱怨这部电影毫无高潮。

e.en: A {climaxless} ending left the audience cold.
e.zh: 毫无高潮的结局让观众反应冷淡。

e.en: The minister's sudden {climb-down} surprised everyone.
e.zh: 部长突然的让步让所有人感到意外。

e.en: It was a humiliating {climb-down} for the company.
e.zh: 对公司而言这是一次屈辱的退让。

e.en: The party suffered several public {climb-downs} this year.
e.zh: 该党今年遭遇了多次公开让步。

e.en: Such embarrassing {climb-downs} damage political credibility.
e.zh: 如此尴尬的让步损害政治信誉。

e.en: The cliff is barely {climbable} without ropes.
e.zh: 没有绳索这座悬崖几乎无法攀登。

e.en: We searched for an easily {climbable} tree.
e.zh: 我们寻找一棵容易爬的树。

e.en: Children love the {climbing-frame} at the park.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢公园里的攀爬架。

e.en: She fell off the {climbing-frame} and bruised her knee.
e.zh: 她从攀爬架上摔下来擦伤了膝盖。

e.en: The plane began its {climbout} immediately after takeoff.
e.zh: 飞机起飞后立即开始爬升。

e.en: Engine failure during {climbout} can be catastrophic.
e.zh: 爬升阶段引擎故障可能是灾难性的。

e.en: The {climogram} clearly displays seasonal weather patterns.
e.zh: 这张气候图清楚地显示季节性天气变化。

e.en: Each city has its own distinctive {climogram}.
e.zh: 每座城市都有独特的气候图。

e.en: Geographers use a {climograph} for quick regional comparisons.
e.zh: 地理学家用气候图进行快速的地区比较。

e.en: The {climograph} highlighted unusually heavy rainfall.
e.zh: 这张气候图凸显出异常强降水。

e.en: The species varies {clinally} across the continent.
e.zh: 该物种在整个大陆上呈渐变变化。

e.en: Color patterns shift {clinally} with latitude.
e.zh: 颜色图案随纬度呈渐变变化。

e.en: The orchid's {clinandrium} holds the pollen sacs neatly.
e.zh: 兰花的蕊柱穴整齐地承载着花粉囊。

e.en: Botanists examine the {clinandrium} for species identification.
e.zh: 植物学家通过蕊柱穴鉴定物种。

clincher-built.t: 鱼鳞式建造的（船板搭叠）

e.en: The Viking longship was traditionally {clincher-built}.
e.zh: 维京长船传统上采用鱼鳞式造法。

e.en: {Clincher-built} hulls overlap their planks for strength.
e.zh: 鱼鳞式船壳的木板互相搭叠以增强强度。

e.en: {Clincherwork} requires great skill and patience.
e.zh: 鱼鳞式工艺需要高超技艺和耐心。

e.en: The boatwright specialized in traditional {clincherwork}.
e.zh: 造船匠专精于传统的鱼鳞式工艺。

e.en: A {clingfish} can attach itself to rocks tightly.
e.zh: 喉盘鱼能紧紧吸附在岩石上。

e.en: We spotted a tiny {clingfish} in the tide pool.
e.zh: 我们在潮池里发现了一条小喉盘鱼。

clingstone.t: 黏核果（果肉紧贴果核的桃等）

e.en: The {clingstone} peach has flesh attached firmly to the pit.
e.zh: 黏核桃的果肉紧紧贴在果核上。

e.en: Some people prefer freestone over {clingstone} fruit.
e.zh: 有人偏爱离核果而非黏核果。

e.en: The hospital held a {clinicopathologic} conference every Friday.
e.zh: 医院每周五举行临床病理研讨会。

e.en: {Clinicopathologic} review confirmed the original diagnosis.
e.zh: 临床病理复核确认了最初的诊断。

e.en: She published a {clinicopathological} study on rare tumors.
e.zh: 她发表了一项关于罕见肿瘤的临床病理研究。

e.en: {Clinicopathological} correlation often guides treatment decisions.
e.zh: 临床病理关联常常指导治疗决策。

clinker-built.t: 鱼鳞式建造的（船板搭叠）

e.en: Norse ships were typically {clinker-built} from oak planks.
e.zh: 北欧船只通常用橡木板以鱼鳞式造法建造。

e.en: A small {clinker-built} dinghy bobbed in the harbor.
e.zh: 一艘鱼鳞式小艇在港口浮动。

e.en: Geologists identified the rock as {clinkstone}.
e.zh: 地质学家鉴定该岩石为响岩。

e.en: {Clinkstone} rings sharply when struck with a hammer.
e.zh: 响岩用锤子敲击会发出清脆声响。

e.en: {Clinocephaly} is a rare congenital skull deformity.
e.zh: 鞍状头畸形是一种罕见的先天性颅骨畸形。

e.en: The infant was diagnosed with mild {clinocephaly}.
e.zh: 婴儿被诊断为轻度鞍状头畸形。

e.en: The {clinoform} layer indicates an ancient shoreline.
e.zh: 这层斜层标示出古老的海岸线。

e.en: Seismic data revealed massive {clinoform} structures offshore.
e.zh: 地震数据揭示了海上大规模的斜层构造。

e.en: Engineers used {clinographic} projection for the technical drawing.
e.zh: 工程师采用斜投影法绘制工程图纸。

e.en: {Clinographic} views can clarify three-dimensional crystal shapes.
e.zh: 斜投影视图能阐明三维晶体形状。

e.en: Surveyors carry a {clinometer} to measure slope angles.
e.zh: 测量员随身携带测斜仪以测量坡度。

e.en: The {clinometer} read fifteen degrees of incline.
e.zh: 测斜仪显示十五度的倾角。

e.en: {Clinometric} surveys mapped the entire valley floor.
e.zh: 测斜测量绘制了整个谷底地形。

e.en: Modern phones include simple {clinometric} apps.
e.zh: 现代手机内置了简单的测斜应用。

e.en: {Clinometry} is essential in forestry and mining.
e.zh: 测斜术在林业和采矿中不可或缺。

e.en: Students learned basic {clinometry} during the field trip.
e.zh: 学生在野外考察中学习了基础测斜术。

e.en: The {clinoscope} helps doctors detect spinal curvature.
e.zh: 测斜镜帮助医生检测脊柱弯曲。

e.en: Doctors used a {clinoscope} during the examination.
e.zh: 医生在检查中使用了测斜镜。

e.en: The {clinoscopic} examination revealed mild scoliosis.
e.zh: 测斜镜检查发现了轻度脊柱侧凸。

e.en: {Clinoscopic} measurements were recorded carefully in the chart.
e.zh: 测斜镜测量结果被仔细记录在病历上。

e.en: Plant biologists rotate seedlings on a {clinostat}.
e.zh: 植物生物学家在回转器上旋转幼苗。

e.en: The {clinostat} simulates weightlessness for plant experiments.
e.zh: 回转器为植物实验模拟失重环境。

clinquant.t: 闪闪发光的；金箔；浮华装饰

e.en: Her gown was decorated with {clinquant} threads.
e.zh: 她的礼服上装饰着闪闪发光的金线。

e.en: Cheap jewelry looked merely {clinquant} up close.
e.zh: 廉价首饰近看不过是浮华虚饰。

e.en: {Cliometric} research uses statistics to study history.
e.zh: 计量历史研究运用统计方法研究历史。

e.en: He published several {cliometric} papers on slavery.
e.zh: 他发表了多篇关于奴隶制的计量历史论文。

e.en: The {cliometrician} analyzed centuries of trade data.
e.zh: 这位计量历史学家分析了几个世纪的贸易数据。

e.en: She trained as both economist and {cliometrician}.
e.zh: 她既是经济学家也是计量历史学家。

e.en: {Cliometrics} combines economics with historical research.
e.zh: 计量历史学将经济学与历史研究相结合。

e.en: He won a Nobel Prize for work in {cliometrics}.
e.zh: 他凭借计量历史学的研究获得诺贝尔奖。

e.en: We heard the steady {clip-clop} of horse hooves.
e.zh: 我们听到稳定的马蹄嘚嘚声。

e.en: The pony made a cheerful {clip-clop} along the road.
e.zh: 小马沿路发出欢快的嘚嘚声。

e.en: The rifle is a {clip-fed} bolt-action design.
e.zh: 这支步枪是弹夹供弹的栓动设计。

e.en: Soldiers preferred {clip-fed} weapons for quick reloading.
e.zh: 士兵更喜欢弹夹供弹的武器以便快速换弹。

clip-joint.t: 宰客店；敲诈顾客的酒吧

e.en: Tourists complained that the bar was a {clip-joint}.
e.zh: 游客抱怨那家酒吧是宰客店。

e.en: Avoid that street; it's full of {clip-joints}.
e.zh: 避开那条街，那里全是宰客店。

e.en: He wore a {clip-on} bow tie to the wedding.
e.zh: 他戴着夹式领结去参加婚礼。

e.en: The microphone is a small {clip-on} device.
e.zh: 这只麦克风是个小巧的夹式设备。

e.en: The pipes feel {cloggy} after years of use.
e.zh: 用了多年的水管感觉容易堵塞。

e.en: The mud was thick and {cloggy} on our boots.
e.zh: 泥巴又厚又黏地糊在我们靴子上。

e.en: He led a {cloistral} life of study and prayer.
e.zh: 他过着修道院般潜心研习与祈祷的生活。

e.en: The library had a quiet, {cloistral} atmosphere.
e.zh: 那座图书馆有一种安静、隐修般的氛围。

e.en: Her doctor prescribed {clomiphene} to help her conceive.
e.zh: 医生给她开了克罗米芬以助她怀孕。

e.en: {Clomiphene} is commonly used in fertility treatment.
e.zh: 克罗米芬常用于不孕治疗。

e.en: The patient experienced {clonic} muscle spasms during the seizure.
e.zh: 癫痫发作时，病人出现了阵挛性肌肉抽搐。

e.en: Doctors observed {clonic} jerking of the limbs.
e.zh: 医生观察到四肢有阵挛性抽动。

clonk.t: 发出沉闷碰撞声；咚的一声

e.en: The bucket fell with a loud {clonk}.
e.zh: 水桶咚地一声重重落下。

e.en: I heard the engine {clonk} as it stalled.
e.zh: 我听见引擎熄火时发出咚的一声。

e.en: He {clonked} his head on the low beam.
e.zh: 他的头咚地撞上了低矮的横梁。

e.en: The hammer {clonked} against the metal pipe.
e.zh: 锤子咚地敲在金属管上。

clonking.t: 发出咚咚声的；笨重作响

e.en: There was a {clonking} noise under the car.
e.zh: 车底下传来咚咚的响声。

e.en: His boots kept {clonking} on the wooden floor.
e.zh: 他的靴子在木地板上咚咚作响。

clonks.t: 咚咚声；发出沉闷碰撞声

e.en: The pipes make strange {clonks} at night.
e.zh: 夜里水管会发出奇怪的咚咚声。

e.en: He {clonks} the kettle down on the stove.
e.zh: 他咚地把水壶放在炉子上。

e.en: The neurologist tested for ankle {clonus}.
e.zh: 神经科医生检查了踝部阵挛。

e.en: {Clonus} can indicate a problem with the nervous system.
e.zh: 阵挛可能提示神经系统存在问题。

e.en: We heard the {clop-clop} of horses on the cobblestones.
e.zh: 我们听见马蹄在鹅卵石路上嗒嗒作响。

e.en: The {clop-clop} of hooves echoed down the lane.
e.zh: 马蹄的嗒嗒声在小巷里回荡。

e.en: The container has a {closable} lid to keep food fresh.
e.zh: 这个容器有可密封的盖子以保持食物新鲜。

e.en: Make sure the dialog box is {closable} by the user.
e.zh: 确保用户可以关闭这个对话框。

e.en: Keep your phone {close-at-hand} in case of emergency.
e.zh: 把手机放在手边以备不时之需。

e.en: Help was {close-at-hand} when she fainted.
e.zh: 她晕倒时，援助就在身边。

e.en: There's a great café {close-by} the station.
e.zh: 车站附近有一家很棒的咖啡馆。

e.en: She lives {close-by}, just two streets away.
e.zh: 她就住在附近，只隔两条街。

close-cropped.t: 剪得很短的（头发或草坪）

e.en: He had {close-cropped} hair and a neat beard.
e.zh: 他留着短短的平头和整齐的胡子。

e.en: The lawn was {close-cropped} and bright green.
e.zh: 草坪修剪得很短，碧绿一片。

e.en: The soldiers all wore {close-cut} hairstyles.
e.zh: 士兵们都留着剪得很短的发型。

e.en: She prefers a {close-cut} jacket that flatters her figure.
e.zh: 她喜欢能凸显身材的紧身夹克。

e.en: His {close-fisted} uncle never gave anyone gifts.
e.zh: 他那位吝啬的叔叔从不送人礼物。

e.en: The boss was famously {close-fisted} with bonuses.
e.zh: 那位老板在发奖金方面出了名地小气。

e.en: She wore a {close-fitting} black dress.
e.zh: 她穿了一条贴身的黑色连衣裙。

e.en: The {close-fitting} helmet protected his head.
e.zh: 贴合的头盔保护了他的头部。

e.en: The cabinet is made of {close-grained} oak.
e.zh: 这个柜子是用纹理细密的橡木做的。

e.en: Carvers prefer {close-grained} wood for fine details.
e.zh: 雕刻师喜欢用纹理细密的木材来雕琢细节。

e.en: The boxer used {close-in} fighting tactics.
e.zh: 那位拳击手采用近身搏击的战术。

e.en: They prefer a {close-in} neighborhood near downtown.
e.zh: 他们喜欢靠近市中心的近郊社区。

close-knit.t: 关系紧密的；亲密无间的

e.en: They come from a {close-knit} family.
e.zh: 他们来自一个关系紧密的家庭。

e.en: The team became a {close-knit} group over the years.
e.zh: 多年下来，这支队伍成了一个亲密无间的集体。

close-lipped.t: 守口如瓶的；不肯多言的

e.en: He remained {close-lipped} about the investigation.
e.zh: 他对那起调查守口如瓶。

e.en: She was {close-lipped} regarding her personal life.
e.zh: 她对自己的私生活闭口不谈。

e.en: The dog has {close-lying} fur that repels water.
e.zh: 这条狗的毛紧贴皮肤，能防水。

e.en: Two {close-lying} villages share a school.
e.zh: 两个紧邻的村庄共用一所学校。

close-mouthed.t: 沉默寡言的；守口如瓶的

e.en: He's notoriously {close-mouthed} about his salary.
e.zh: 他对自己的薪水出了名地三缄其口。

e.en: The witness was {close-mouthed} during questioning.
e.zh: 那位证人在讯问时一言不发。

e.en: The store held a {close-out} sale before shutting down.
e.zh: 那家店在关门前进行了清仓大甩卖。

e.en: They got the furniture at {close-out} prices.
e.zh: 他们以清仓价买到了那批家具。

e.en: The {close-packed} crowd filled the square.
e.zh: 密密麻麻的人群挤满了广场。

e.en: Atoms in metals are often {close-packed}.
e.zh: 金属中的原子常常密集排列。

e.en: The election was a {close-run} thing.
e.zh: 那场选举势均力敌，难分胜负。

e.en: It was a {close-run} race to the finish line.
e.zh: 那是一场冲向终点的紧张较量。

e.en: He had small, {close-set} eyes.
e.zh: 他长着一双小而靠得很近的眼睛。

e.en: The {close-set} pillars supported the narrow arch.
e.zh: 靠得很近的柱子支撑着那道窄拱。

e.en: The notification window is {closeable} with one click.
e.zh: 这个通知窗口点一下就可以关闭。

e.en: Make sure the bag has a {closeable} top.
e.zh: 确保这个包有可封口的开口。

e.en: All our videos are {closed-captioned} for accessibility.
e.zh: 我们所有的视频都配有隐藏字幕以方便观看。
