e.en: The film was {closed-captioned} for hearing-impaired viewers.
e.zh: 这部电影为听障观众配备了隐藏字幕。

e.en: Turn on {closed-captioning} if you can't hear well.
e.zh: 如果听不清，请打开隐藏式字幕。

e.en: {Closed-captioning} is required on most U.S. broadcasts.
e.zh: 美国大多数电视广播都要求提供隐藏式字幕。

e.en: Reformers warned against the gradual {clericalization} of public schools.
e.zh: 改革者警告公立学校正在逐步神职化。

e.en: The {clericalization} of the courts undermined judicial independence.
e.zh: 法院的教士化损害了司法独立。

e.en: The bishop tried to {clericalize} every aspect of village life.
e.zh: 主教试图让村庄生活的方方面面都受教权支配。

e.en: Reformers refused to {clericalize} the school curriculum.
e.zh: 改革者拒绝将学校课程教权化。

e.en: His {clericate} began with ordination at the cathedral.
e.zh: 他的圣职生涯始于在大教堂的授职仪式。

e.en: She wrote a thesis on the medieval {clericate}.
e.zh: 她写了一篇关于中世纪教士阶层的论文。

e.en: He wrote a witty {clerihew} about the prime minister.
e.zh: 他写了一首讽刺首相的克莱里休四行诗。

e.en: Each {clerihew} pokes gentle fun at a famous figure.
e.zh: 每首克莱里休诗都温柔地调侃一位名人。

e.en: The {clerisy} shaped public opinion through the press.
e.zh: 知识阶层通过新闻媒体塑造公众舆论。

e.en: Coleridge envisioned a {clerisy} guiding national culture.
e.zh: 柯勒律治设想由文人阶层引领民族文化。

clerkess.t: 女文员；女办事员（苏格兰用法）

e.en: The bank hired a young {clerkess} from the village.
e.zh: 银行雇了一个来自村里的年轻女文员。

e.en: She started as a {clerkess} and rose to manager.
e.zh: 她从女办事员做起，后来升任经理。

e.en: He had a {clerklike} habit of double-checking every figure.
e.zh: 他有一种文员般反复核对每个数字的习惯。

e.en: She wore a neat, {clerklike} dark suit to the interview.
e.zh: 她穿着整洁的、像办事员一样的深色西装去面试。

clerkliness.t: 文员气质；办事员的特性

e.en: His meticulous {clerkliness} annoyed his more creative colleagues.
e.zh: 他那一丝不苟的文员气质惹恼了较有创意的同事。

e.en: A certain {clerkliness} pervaded the dusty old office.
e.zh: 一种文员特有的拘谨气氛弥漫在那间布满灰尘的旧办公室里。

cleromancy.t: 拈阄占卜；以抽签预言吉凶

e.en: Ancient priests practiced {cleromancy} to choose leaders.
e.zh: 古代祭司用拈阄占卜来选出领袖。

e.en: She studied {cleromancy} as part of her religion thesis.
e.zh: 她把拈阄占卜作为宗教论文的研究内容。

cleruch.t: 雅典海外殖民者；土地分配殖民者

e.en: Each {cleruch} received a plot of conquered land.
e.zh: 每位殖民者都分到一块被征服的土地。

e.en: The {cleruch} retained Athenian citizenship while living overseas.
e.zh: 那位海外殖民者旅居海外仍保留雅典公民身份。

cleruchy.t: 雅典海外殖民地（保留公民权）

e.en: Athens established a {cleruchy} on the conquered island.
e.zh: 雅典在被征服的岛屿上建立了海外殖民地。

e.en: Each {cleruchy} sent troops back to support Athens.
e.zh: 每个克鲁齐殖民地都派兵支援雅典。

cleveite.t: 钇铀矿；克利夫石（一种含氦矿物）

e.en: Helium was first detected on Earth in {cleveite}.
e.zh: 氦最初是在地球上的克利夫石中被发现的。

e.en: He showed us a small fragment of {cleveite}.
e.zh: 他向我们展示了一小块克利夫石。

cleverish.t: 略显聪明的；自作聪明的

e.en: His {cleverish} jokes never quite landed with the audience.
e.zh: 他那些自作聪明的笑话从未真正打动观众。

e.en: She made a {cleverish} remark and waited for laughs.
e.zh: 她说了句略带卖弄的俏皮话，等着大家笑。

e.en: He followed a {clew} of red yarn through the maze.
e.zh: 他顺着一团红毛线穿过迷宫。

e.en: The sailor tightened the {clew} of the foresail.
e.zh: 水手拉紧了前帆的下角。

clewed.t: 卷起了船帆；将线缠成团

e.en: The crew {clewed} up the sails before the storm hit.
e.zh: 船员在暴风雨来袭前把帆卷了起来。

e.en: She {clewed} her thread carefully into a tight ball.
e.zh: 她小心地把线缠成了一个紧实的线团。

e.en: {Clewing} the topsail required two strong sailors.
e.zh: 卷上桅帆需要两名强壮的水手。

e.en: She spent the evening {clewing} wool by the fire.
e.zh: 她晚上坐在炉火旁缠羊毛。

e.en: Several {clews} of yarn lay in her sewing basket.
e.zh: 几个毛线团放在她的针线篮里。

e.en: Sailors fastened the {clews} of the mainsail securely.
e.zh: 水手们把主帆的下角牢牢系紧。

e.en: Make sure every link on the page is {clickable}.
e.zh: 确保页面上的每个链接都是可点击的。

e.en: The button looks nice but isn't actually {clickable}.
e.zh: 那个按钮看着不错，但实际上点不动。

e.en: She lifted the {clicket} and pushed the door open.
e.zh: 她抬起门闩，把门推开。

e.en: The old gate gave a faint {clicket} as it shut.
e.zh: 那扇老门关上时发出轻微的咔嗒声。

e.en: The train went {clickety-clack} along the rails.
e.zh: 火车沿着铁轨咔嗒咔嗒地行驶。

e.en: Her heels made a steady {clickety-clack} on the tile.
e.zh: 她的高跟鞋在瓷砖地上发出有节奏的咔嗒声。

clicketyclack.t: 嘎嗒嘎嗒声；咔嗒咔嗒声

e.en: We heard a steady {clicketyclack} from the typewriter.
e.zh: 我们听到打字机不断发出咔嗒咔嗒声。

e.en: The horse's hooves made a cheerful {clicketyclack}.
e.zh: 马蹄发出欢快的嘎嗒嘎嗒声。

clickstream.t: 点击流；用户网页点击轨迹

e.en: Marketers analyze the {clickstream} to understand user behavior.
e.zh: 营销人员分析点击流来了解用户行为。

e.en: Their tool records every {clickstream} on the site.
e.zh: 他们的工具记录网站上的每一条点击轨迹。

clicktivism.t: 点击行动主义；网络轻度行动主义

e.en: Critics dismiss most online petitions as mere {clicktivism}.
e.zh: 批评者将大多数网上请愿视为纯粹的点击行动主义。

e.en: She argued that {clicktivism} can still raise awareness.
e.zh: 她认为点击行动主义仍能提高公众意识。

clicky.t: 咔嗒响的；按键发出咔嗒声的

e.en: I prefer a {clicky} mechanical keyboard for typing.
e.zh: 我打字时更喜欢按键咔嗒响的机械键盘。

e.en: The old mouse had a satisfyingly {clicky} button.
e.zh: 那只老鼠标的按键咔嗒声让人很舒服。

client-oriented.t: 以客户为本的；以客户为中心的

e.en: Our firm prides itself on being deeply {client-oriented}.
e.zh: 本公司以高度以客户为本而自豪。

e.en: She runs a {client-oriented} consulting practice downtown.
e.zh: 她在市中心经营着一家以客户为中心的咨询公司。

clientage.t: 客户群体；门客阶层；保护关系

e.en: The lawyer built a wealthy {clientage} over the years.
e.zh: 这位律师多年来积累了富有的客户群。

e.en: Roman patrons supported a large {clientage} of poor citizens.
e.zh: 罗马的庇护者供养着大批贫民门客。

e.en: She handled all {cliental} correspondence personally.
e.zh: 所有与客户的往来信件她都亲自处理。

e.en: The firm faced a serious {cliental} dispute last quarter.
e.zh: 公司上季度面临一起严重的客户纠纷。

clientitis.t: 过度迁就客户综合症；客户依赖症

e.en: Diplomats sometimes catch {clientitis} and defend foreign interests.
e.zh: 外交官有时会患上客户依赖症，反过来维护外国利益。

e.en: The agency warned its analysts against {clientitis}.
e.zh: 该机构警告分析人员不要过度迁就客户。

clientless.t: 没有客户的；无委托人的

e.en: A {clientless} lawyer struggles to pay the rent.
e.zh: 没有客户的律师连房租都难以支付。

e.en: Her first month as a freelancer was largely {clientless}.
e.zh: 她做自由职业的第一个月几乎没有客户。

cliff-hang.t: 情节留下悬念；吊人胃口

e.en: The director loves to {cliff-hang} the season finale.
e.zh: 导演喜欢让季终集留下悬念吊人胃口。

e.en: Soap operas {cliff-hang} every Friday night episode.
e.zh: 肥皂剧每周五晚的剧集都会留下悬念。

cliff-hanger.t: 悬念结尾；扣人心弦的紧张局面

e.en: The episode ended on an unbearable {cliff-hanger}.
e.zh: 那集以一个令人难忍的悬念结尾收场。

e.en: The election turned into a real {cliff-hanger}.
e.zh: 这场选举变成了一场扣人心弦的较量。

cliff-hangers.t: 悬念结尾（复数）；扣人心弦的情节

e.en: Modern dramas rely on weekly {cliff-hangers} to keep viewers.
e.zh: 现代剧集靠每周的悬念结尾来留住观众。

e.en: Her novels are full of clever {cliff-hangers}.
e.zh: 她的小说里充满了巧妙的悬念结尾。

cliff-hanging.t: 扣人心弦的；悬念迭起的

e.en: We watched a {cliff-hanging} final set at Wimbledon.
e.zh: 我们在温网观看了扣人心弦的决胜盘。

e.en: The book offers a {cliff-hanging} courtroom drama.
e.zh: 这本书呈现了一场悬念迭起的法庭戏。

cliff-hugging.t: 紧贴悬崖的；沿崖而行的

e.en: We drove along a narrow, {cliff-hugging} mountain road.
e.zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的、紧贴悬崖的山路行驶。

e.en: The {cliff-hugging} trail offered breathtaking ocean views.
e.zh: 那条沿崖小径让人欣赏到惊心动魄的海景。

cliff-top.t: 悬崖顶部；崖顶的；建在崖顶的

e.en: They built a small cottage on the {cliff-top}.
e.zh: 他们在悬崖顶上盖了一座小屋。

e.en: We watched the sunset from the windy {cliff-top}.
e.zh: 我们在风大的崖顶看着日落。

cliffhang.t: 留下悬念；让情节悬而未决

e.en: The writers chose to {cliffhang} the entire mystery.
e.zh: 编剧选择让整个谜团悬而未决。

e.en: Networks often {cliffhang} before a long hiatus.
e.zh: 电视网常在长期休播前留下悬念。

cliffhanging.t: 扣人心弦的；悬念十足的

e.en: It was a {cliffhanging} finish to a tense match.
e.zh: 这是一场紧张比赛的扣人心弦的收尾。

e.en: She loves {cliffhanging} thrillers more than romance novels.
e.zh: 她喜欢悬念十足的惊悚小说，胜过言情小说。

clifflike.t: 像悬崖一样的；陡峭如崖的

e.en: The tower's {clifflike} walls dropped straight to the sea.
e.zh: 塔楼悬崖般的墙壁直插大海。

e.en: Waves had carved a {clifflike} face into the rock.
e.zh: 海浪在岩石上凿出了陡峭如崖的一面。

cliffsman.t: 攀崖采集者；居住崖上的人

e.en: An experienced {cliffsman} gathered eggs from the nests.
e.zh: 一位经验丰富的攀崖人从崖上鸟巢里收集鸟蛋。

e.en: Local {cliffsman} legends still circulate in the village.
e.zh: 村里仍流传着关于攀崖人的传说。

e.en: We hiked along a wild, {cliffy} stretch of coast.
e.zh: 我们沿着一段崎岖陡峭的海岸徒步。

e.en: The {cliffy} shoreline made any landing impossible.
e.zh: 陡峭多崖的海岸让登陆变得不可能。

e.en: They camped beside a {clifty} stream in the woods.
e.zh: 他们在林中一条悬崖林立的小溪旁露营。

e.en: The park is famous for its {clifty} river gorge.
e.zh: 这个公园以崖壁陡峭的河谷而闻名。

cloud-cuckooland.t: 不切实际的幻想世界；理想国

e.en: Stop living in {cloud-cuckooland} and face reality.
e.zh: 别再活在幻想世界里，面对现实吧。

e.en: His business plan belongs in {cloud-cuckooland}.
e.zh: 他的商业计划简直是天方夜谭。

e.en: The {cloud-kissing} peaks were hidden in mist.
e.zh: 那些接天的山峰隐没在雾气中。

e.en: They built {cloud-kissing} towers of glass.
e.zh: 他们建起了一座座入云的玻璃高塔。

e.en: A heavy {cloudage} blanketed the valley.
e.zh: 厚厚的云层笼罩着山谷。

e.en: Morning {cloudage} soon burned off.
e.zh: 早晨的云层很快就消散了。

e.en: A dark {cloudbank} rolled in from the sea.
e.zh: 一片黑压压的云堤从海上涌来。

e.en: The plane climbed above the {cloudbank}.
e.zh: 飞机爬升至云堤之上。

cloudberries.t: 云莓（北方沼泽地的橙黄色浆果）

e.en: We picked {cloudberries} on the tundra.
e.zh: 我们在苔原上采摘云莓。

e.en: {Cloudberries} make an excellent jam.
e.zh: 云莓可以做成极好的果酱。

e.en: The {cloudberry} ripens to a golden color.
e.zh: 云莓成熟时变成金黄色。

e.en: She served pancakes with {cloudberry} sauce.
e.zh: 她端上了配云莓酱的薄煎饼。

e.en: The pilot enjoyed {cloudhopping} on clear afternoons.
e.zh: 那位飞行员喜欢在晴朗的下午穿云飞行。

e.en: They went {cloudhopping} in a small biplane.
e.zh: 他们驾着小双翼机在云间穿梭。

e.en: It was the {cloudiest} day of the month.
e.zh: 那是这个月最阴的一天。

e.en: London had its {cloudiest} summer in years.
e.zh: 伦敦经历了多年来最多云的夏天。

e.en: The sky loomed {cloudily} above the hills.
e.zh: 天空阴沉沉地笼罩在山丘上方。

e.en: His memory of that night returned {cloudily}.
e.zh: 他对那晚的记忆模糊地浮现。

e.en: Children love stories set in {cloudland}.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢以云乡为背景的故事。

e.en: He drifted off into {cloudland} during the lecture.
e.zh: 听讲座时他神游到了幻想之地。

e.en: A few {cloudlets} dotted the blue sky.
e.zh: 几朵小云点缀着蓝天。

e.en: The poem describes a lonely {cloudlet}.
e.zh: 这首诗描绘了一朵孤独的小云。

cloudnine.t: 极乐境地；欣喜若狂的状态

e.en: She was on {cloudnine} after the proposal.
e.zh: 求婚之后她欣喜若狂。

e.en: Winning the prize put him on {cloudnine}.
e.zh: 获奖让他飘飘欲仙。

e.en: The painter captured a stunning {cloudscape}.
e.zh: 那位画家捕捉到了一幅令人惊叹的云景。

e.en: From the plane we admired the vast {cloudscape}.
e.zh: 从飞机上我们欣赏着辽阔的云景。

e.en: Goats are {cloven-footed} animals.
e.zh: 山羊是偶蹄动物。

e.en: The myth featured a {cloven-footed} demon.
e.zh: 那个神话里有一个分蹄的恶魔。

e.en: Cattle and sheep are {cloven-hoofed}.
e.zh: 牛和羊都是偶蹄动物。

e.en: Folklore often depicts the devil as {cloven-hoofed}.
e.zh: 民间传说常把魔鬼描绘成分蹄的样子。

clovery.t: 长满三叶草的；三叶草似的

e.en: They picnicked on a {clovery} meadow.
e.zh: 他们在长满三叶草的草地上野餐。

e.en: The hillside was lush and {clovery}.
e.zh: 山坡上长满了茂盛的三叶草。

e.en: A {clowder} of strays lived behind the shop.
e.zh: 一群流浪猫住在那家店后面。

e.en: Her farm hosts quite a {clowder}.
e.zh: 她的农场上养着一大群猫。

e.en: His {clownage} entertained the whole class.
e.zh: 他的滑稽举动逗乐了全班同学。

e.en: The play was full of harmless {clownage}.
e.zh: 那部戏充满了无伤大雅的小丑表演。

e.en: Enough {clownery} — get back to work.
e.zh: 别再胡闹了，回去工作。

e.en: The meeting descended into pure {clownery}.
e.zh: 会议彻底沦为一场闹剧。

e.en: The {clownfish} hides among sea anemones.
e.zh: 小丑鱼藏身于海葵之间。

e.en: My daughter loves the orange {clownfish}.
e.zh: 我女儿很喜欢那条橙色的小丑鱼。

e.en: A sense of {cloyedness} followed the rich dessert.
e.zh: 吃完那份浓腻的甜点后有一种发腻的感觉。

e.en: Too much praise leads to {cloyedness}.
e.zh: 夸奖太多会让人感到腻烦。

cloyless.t: 百吃不腻的；不令人生厌的

e.en: Her charm was somehow {cloyless}.
e.zh: 她的魅力丝毫不让人腻烦。

e.en: The melody is sweet yet {cloyless}.
e.zh: 这段旋律甜美却不腻耳。

club-footed.t: 畸形足的；先天足内翻的

e.en: The poet Byron was famously {club-footed}.
e.zh: 诗人拜伦以畸形足闻名。

e.en: Surgery helped the {club-footed} child walk.
e.zh: 手术帮助这名畸形足的孩子走路。

e.en: The cactus has {club-shaped} stems.
e.zh: 那株仙人掌有棒状的茎。

e.en: He held a strange {club-shaped} tool.
e.zh: 他拿着一件奇怪的棒状工具。

e.en: He was a genial, {clubable} fellow.
e.zh: 他是个和蔼可亲、善于交际的人。

e.en: Not everyone is so {clubable}.
e.zh: 不是每个人都那么善于结交。

clubbability.t: 善于社交的特质；合群性

e.en: His {clubbability} won him many friends.
e.zh: 他善于社交，结交了许多朋友。

e.en: The job demands a certain {clubbability}.
e.zh: 这份工作需要一定的社交能力。

clubbiness.t: 小圈子作风；排外的亲昵感

e.en: The firm's {clubbiness} put outsiders off.
e.zh: 公司的小圈子作风让外人望而却步。

e.en: There's a smug {clubbiness} about the committee.
e.zh: 那个委员会有种自得的小圈子气氛。

e.en: The infant was born with {clubfeet}.
e.zh: 这名婴儿天生患有畸形足。

e.en: Doctors successfully corrected his {clubfeet}.
e.zh: 医生成功矫正了他的畸形足。

e.en: The child was born with a {clubhand}.
e.zh: 这孩子天生有畸形手。

e.en: Surgery improved the function of his {clubhand}.
e.zh: 手术改善了他畸形手的功能。

e.en: The captain had to {clubhaul} to avoid the rocks.
e.zh: 船长不得不抛锚急转向以避开礁石。

e.en: They {clubhauled} the ship in a desperate maneuver.
e.zh: 他们冒险用抛锚急转的方式操纵船只。

e.en: He swung the {clubhead} smoothly through the ball.
e.zh: 他平稳地挥动球杆头击球。

e.en: A faster {clubhead} speed adds distance.
e.zh: 杆头速度越快击球距离越远。

clubman.t: 俱乐部会员；常出入俱乐部的男子

e.en: He was a famous London {clubman}.
e.zh: 他是伦敦有名的俱乐部常客。

e.en: The old {clubman} dined there every night.
e.zh: 那位老俱乐部成员每晚都在那里用餐。

e.en: {Clubmoss} carpeted the forest floor.
e.zh: 石松像地毯一样铺满了森林地面。

e.en: Ancient {clubmoss} grew as tall as trees.
e.zh: 古代的石松长得像树一样高。

clubroot.t: 根肿病（十字花科植物的一种病害）

e.en: {Clubroot} can devastate a cabbage crop.
e.zh: 根肿病可能摧毁整片卷心菜。

e.en: Farmers rotate fields to prevent {clubroot}.
e.zh: 农民轮作以防止根肿病。

clubwoman.t: 俱乐部女会员；常参加社团活动的女性

e.en: She was an active {clubwoman} in her city.
e.zh: 她在所在城市是一位活跃的俱乐部女会员。

e.en: The old {clubwoman} organized many charity drives.
e.zh: 那位老俱乐部女会员组织过许多慈善活动。

clucky.t: 咯咯叫的；想要孩子的（非正式）

e.en: The hens sounded {clucky} all morning.
e.zh: 母鸡们整个早上咯咯叫个不停。

e.en: She felt {clucky} after holding the baby.
e.zh: 抱过那个婴儿后她也想要孩子了。

clued-up.t: 消息灵通的；熟知内情的

e.en: She's really {clued-up} on tax law.
e.zh: 她对税法非常在行。

e.en: Ask Tom — he's the most {clued-up} of us.
e.zh: 问汤姆吧，他是我们当中最了解情况的。

e.en: He {clumb} up the old oak tree.
e.zh: 他爬上了那棵老橡树。

e.en: The boys {clumb} over the fence.
e.zh: 那些男孩爬过了篱笆。

e.en: The school became {co-educational} in the 1970s.
e.zh: 这所学校在1970年代变成男女同校。

e.en: They prefer a {co-educational} environment for their children.
e.zh: 他们更愿意让孩子在男女同校的环境中学习。

e.en: The friction {co-efficient} depends on the surface.
e.zh: 摩擦系数取决于表面材质。

e.en: Calculate the drag {co-efficient} of the wing.
e.zh: 计算机翼的阻力系数。

e.en: Predators and prey often {co-evolve} over time.
e.zh: 捕食者与猎物往往随时间共同演化。

e.en: Languages and cultures {co-evolve} in close contact.
e.zh: 语言和文化在密切接触中共同演化。

e.en: The two species {co-exist} in the same forest.
e.zh: 这两个物种在同一片森林中共存。

e.en: Different religions can {co-exist} peacefully.
e.zh: 不同宗教可以和平共存。

e.en: Humans and Neanderthals {co-existed} for thousands of years.
e.zh: 人类和尼安德特人曾共存了数千年。

e.en: The two communities {co-existed} without conflict.
e.zh: 两个社区曾经毫无冲突地共处。

e.en: Peaceful {co-existence} requires mutual respect.
e.zh: 和平共处需要相互尊重。

e.en: Their {co-existence} surprised the researchers.
e.zh: 它们的共存让研究人员感到惊讶。

e.en: The old tradition {co-exists} with modern life.
e.zh: 古老的传统与现代生活并存。

e.en: Wealth {co-exists} with poverty in this city.
e.zh: 在这座城市里财富与贫困并存。

e.en: She is the {co-founder} of the startup.
e.zh: 她是这家初创公司的联合创始人。

e.en: The {co-founder} left after a disagreement.
e.zh: 那位联合创始人因意见不合而离开了。

e.en: They decided to {co-habit} before marriage.
e.zh: 他们决定在结婚前同居。

e.en: Many couples {co-habit} for years today.
e.zh: 如今许多情侣同居多年。

e.en: She serves as {co-head} of the department.
e.zh: 她担任该部门的联合负责人。

e.en: They will {co-head} the new initiative.
e.zh: 他们将共同主管这项新计划。

e.en: He became {co-heir} to the family estate.
e.zh: 他成为家族财产的共同继承人。

e.en: The siblings were named {co-heir} in the will.
e.zh: 兄弟姐妹在遗嘱中被指定为共同继承人。

e.en: She is the {co-heiress} of a vast fortune.
e.zh: 她是一笔巨额财富的共同女继承人。

e.en: The {co-heiress} sold her share of the mansion.
e.zh: 那位共同女继承人卖掉了她在豪宅中的份额。

e.en: She will {co-host} the awards ceremony.
e.zh: 她将联合主持颁奖典礼。

e.en: The two cities {co-host} the tournament.
e.zh: 两个城市共同主办这项赛事。

e.en: Our vacations happen to {co-incide} this year.
e.zh: 我们今年的假期碰巧重合。

e.en: His arrival will {co-incide} with the meeting.
e.zh: 他将在开会时同时抵达。

e.en: Her birthday {co-incides} with the holiday.
e.zh: 她的生日恰好与节日重合。

e.en: This decision {co-incides} with the new policy.
e.zh: 这一决定与新政策同时出台。

e.en: These proteins {co-localize} in the nucleus.
e.zh: 这些蛋白质在细胞核中共定位。

e.en: The two markers {co-localize} on the membrane.
e.zh: 两种标记物在膜上共同定位。

e.en: This enzyme {co-localizes} with mitochondria.
e.zh: 这种酶与线粒体共定位。

e.en: The signal {co-localizes} with the marker protein.
e.zh: 该信号与标记蛋白共定位。

e.en: The teams will {co-locate} in one office.
e.zh: 两个团队将共址办公。

e.en: They chose to {co-locate} the servers downtown.
e.zh: 他们选择把服务器集中放在市中心。

e.en: The two firms {co-manage} the project.
e.zh: 两家公司共同管理这个项目。

e.en: Doctors and patients should {co-manage} chronic illness.
e.zh: 医生和病人应共同管理慢性病。

e.en: Anxiety and depression often {co-occur}.
e.zh: 焦虑和抑郁常常同时出现。

e.en: These symptoms tend to {co-occur} in patients.
e.zh: 这些症状在病人身上往往同时出现。

e.en: The two events {co-occurred} that morning.
e.zh: 那两件事在那天早上同时发生。

e.en: Both diseases {co-occurred} in the population.
e.zh: 这两种疾病在该人群中同时出现过。

e.en: The {co-occurrence} of these traits is rare.
e.zh: 这些特征的共现非常罕见。

e.en: Researchers studied the {co-occurrence} of the disorders.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了这些疾病的共现现象。

e.en: This condition often {co-occurs} with diabetes.
e.zh: 这种疾病常与糖尿病同时出现。

e.en: The word usually {co-occurs} with negative terms.
e.zh: 这个词通常与负面词汇共现。

e.en: They bought vegetables at the local {co-op}.
e.zh: 他们在当地合作社买了蔬菜。

e.en: She lives in a {co-op} on the Upper West Side.
e.zh: 她住在上西区的一栋合作社公寓里。

e.en: The witness fully {co-operated} with police.
e.zh: 证人完全配合了警方。

e.en: The nations {co-operated} during the crisis.
e.zh: 这些国家在危机期间进行了合作。

e.en: Our team {co-operates} closely with theirs.
e.zh: 我们团队与他们密切合作。

e.en: He always {co-operates} with his colleagues.
e.zh: 他总是与同事配合。

e.en: He is a reliable {co-operator} on the project.
e.zh: 他在这个项目中是个可靠的合作者。

e.en: Every {co-operator} signed the agreement.
e.zh: 每位合作者都签署了协议。

e.en: Many {co-ops} sell organic produce.
e.zh: 许多合作社出售有机农产品。

e.en: Manhattan has many old {co-ops}.
e.zh: 曼哈顿有许多老式合作社公寓。

e.en: The committee voted to {co-opt} her as a member.
e.zh: 委员会投票将她吸纳为成员。

e.en: Politicians often {co-opt} popular slogans.
e.zh: 政客常挪用流行的口号。

e.en: The {co-optation} of new members was approved.
e.zh: 增选新成员的提议获得通过。

e.en: Critics warned against the {co-optation} of the movement.
e.zh: 批评者警告这场运动可能被吸纳收编。

e.en: She was {co-opted} onto the board last year.
e.zh: 她去年被增选进入董事会。

e.en: The brand {co-opted} the protest's imagery.
e.zh: 那个品牌挪用了抗议活动的视觉符号。

e.en: They are {co-opting} younger activists into leadership.
e.zh: 他们正把年轻活动人士吸纳进领导层。

e.en: The company is {co-opting} street culture for profit.
e.zh: 该公司正在挪用街头文化牟利。

e.en: The {co-option} of new directors took place quietly.
e.zh: 新董事的增选悄然进行。

e.en: He warned against the {co-option} of grassroots ideas.
e.zh: 他警告人们小心基层理念被收编。

e.en: The board {co-opts} two new members each year.
e.zh: 董事会每年增选两名新成员。

e.en: Advertising often {co-opts} youth slang.
e.zh: 广告常常挪用年轻人的俚语。

e.en: They launched a {co-ordinated} attack at dawn.
e.zh: 他们在黎明发动了协调一致的进攻。

e.en: Her outfit was perfectly {co-ordinated}.
e.zh: 她的搭配协调得恰到好处。

e.en: Enter the GPS {co-ordinates} into the app.
e.zh: 把GPS坐标输入到应用里。

e.en: She {co-ordinates} schedules across three offices.
e.zh: 她协调三个办公室的日程。

e.en: He is {co-ordinating} the relief effort.
e.zh: 他正在协调救援工作。

e.en: She wore a {co-ordinating} scarf and bag.
e.zh: 她戴着相搭配的围巾和包。

e.en: The {co-ordinators} met to plan the event.
e.zh: 协调员们开会筹划活动。

e.en: Volunteer {co-ordinators} reported to the manager.
e.zh: 志愿者协调员向经理汇报。

e.en: The brothers {co-own} a small bakery.
e.zh: 兄弟俩共同拥有一家小面包店。

e.en: They {co-own} the apartment with a friend.
e.zh: 他们和一位朋友共同拥有这套公寓。

e.en: She is the {co-owner} of the restaurant.
e.zh: 她是这家餐厅的共有人。

e.en: Each {co-owner} signed the contract.
e.zh: 每位共有人都签了合同。

e.en: They decided to {co-parent} after the divorce.
e.zh: 他们离婚后决定共同抚养孩子。

e.en: A good {co-parent} keeps communication open.
e.zh: 好的共同抚养人会保持沟通畅通。

e.en: They successfully {co-parented} two children.
e.zh: 他们成功地共同抚养了两个孩子。

e.en: The couple {co-parented} despite living apart.
e.zh: 那对夫妇虽分居却共同抚养孩子。

e.en: {Co-parenting} requires patience and respect.
e.zh: 共同抚养需要耐心和尊重。

e.en: They attended a {co-parenting} workshop.
e.zh: 他们参加了一个共同抚养的研讨会。

e.en: My doctor visit has a twenty-dollar {co-pay}.
e.zh: 我看一次医生要自付二十美元。

e.en: The {co-pay} for this medication is high.
e.zh: 这种药的自付额很高。

e.en: Patients must make a small {co-payment}.
e.zh: 患者必须支付一笔小额自付费用。

e.en: The insurance plan reduced the {co-payment}.
e.zh: 该保险计划降低了自付费用。

e.en: Attach the rope using a {cliphook}.
e.zh: 用一个弹簧夹钩把绳子扣上。

e.en: The harness has a steel {cliphook}.
e.zh: 这个安全带带有一个钢制弹簧夹钩。

clipper-built.t: 按飞剪式帆船样式建造的；快船型的

e.en: She owned a {clipper-built} schooner.
e.zh: 她有一艘飞剪式帆船样式建造的纵帆船。

e.en: The {clipper-built} hull cuts through waves.
e.zh: 这艘快船型的船身能劈波斩浪。

clipper-limiter.t: 削波限幅器；削波限制器

e.en: Set the {clipper-limiter} threshold lower.
e.zh: 把削波限幅器的阈值调低一些。

e.en: The {clipper-limiter} prevents audio overload.
e.zh: 这个削波限制器可以防止音频过载。

clippety-clop.t: 嗒嗒的马蹄声；嘚嘚马蹄声

e.en: We heard {clippety-clop} on the cobbles.
e.zh: 我们听见鹅卵石路上嗒嗒的马蹄声。

e.en: The pony went {clippety-clop} along.
e.zh: 小马嘚嘚地走着。

clippie.t: 女公交售票员；女售票员

e.en: The {clippie} took my fare cheerfully.
e.zh: 那位女公交售票员愉快地收了我的车费。

e.en: She worked as a {clippie} downtown.
e.zh: 她在市区当女售票员。

clipsheet.t: 新闻剪辑稿；剪报通讯稿

e.en: The agency mailed a weekly {clipsheet}.
e.zh: 该机构每周邮寄一份新闻剪辑稿。

e.en: Editors scanned the {clipsheet} for stories.
e.zh: 编辑们浏览剪报通讯稿寻找题材。

cliquey.t: 小圈子的；排外的；抱团的

e.en: That class is incredibly {cliquey}.
e.zh: 那个班级非常拉小圈子。

e.en: She found the office {cliquey} and unfriendly.
e.zh: 她觉得那间办公室排外又不友好。

cliquish.t: 抱团的；小圈子化的；排外的

e.en: The group felt {cliquish} to outsiders.
e.zh: 那个群体让外人觉得很抱团。

e.en: Avoid {cliquish} behavior at work.
e.zh: 工作中要避免拉帮结派的行为。

cliquishly.t: 拉帮结派地；抱团地；小圈子地

e.en: They behaved {cliquishly} during lunch.
e.zh: 午饭时他们抱团扎堆。

e.en: Members nodded {cliquishly} at each other.
e.zh: 成员们小圈子式地相互点头。

cliquishness.t: 小圈子作风；派系性；抱团习气

e.en: The team's {cliquishness} hurt morale.
e.zh: 团队的小圈子作风损害了士气。

e.en: She disliked the school's {cliquishness}.
e.zh: 她不喜欢学校里的抱团习气。

e.en: {Cliquism} ruined the entire department.
e.zh: 小圈子主义毁掉了整个部门。

e.en: Office {cliquism} drove him to quit.
e.zh: 办公室的派系作风逼得他辞职。

cliquy.t: 小圈子的；抱团的；排外的

e.en: The teens were notoriously {cliquy}.
e.zh: 那帮青少年是出了名地抱团。

e.en: I find these parties too {cliquy}.
e.zh: 我觉得这些派对小圈子味儿太浓。

clisere.t: 气候演替系列；植被演替序列

e.en: Botanists tracked the prairie {clisere}.
e.zh: 植物学家追踪了草原的演替系列。

e.en: A long {clisere} followed the glacier's retreat.
e.zh: 冰川退却后出现了漫长的植被演替序列。

clishmaclaver.t: 闲话；流言蜚语；东家长西家短

e.en: Stop your {clishmaclaver} and work.
e.zh: 别再嚼舌根了，干活吧。

e.en: Village {clishmaclaver} spread very quickly.
e.zh: 村里的闲言碎语传得飞快。

clistogamy.t: 闭花受精；闭花授粉现象

e.en: Many violets exhibit {clistogamy}.
e.zh: 许多紫罗兰会出现闭花受精现象。

e.en: The plant relies on {clistogamy} for seeds.
e.zh: 这种植物靠闭花授粉来结种子。

e.en: The earthworm's {clitellum} swelled visibly.
e.zh: 蚯蚓的环带明显鼓了起来。

e.en: Each {clitellum} secretes a cocoon.
e.zh: 每条环带会分泌出一个卵茧。

clithral.t: 全顶式的；有屋顶的神庙的

e.en: The temple was a {clithral} structure.
e.zh: 这座神庙是全顶式建筑。

e.en: Few {clithral} buildings survive intact today.
e.zh: 如今完好保存的有顶神庙极少。

clitic.t: 附着词；附着语素；黏着小词

e.en: Spanish pronouns can act as {clitic} elements.
e.zh: 西班牙语的代词可以作为附着词使用。

e.en: The {clitic} attaches to its host word.
e.zh: 这个附着语素依附于宿主词。

e.en: Researchers studied {clitoric} sensitivity.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了阴蒂的敏感度。

e.en: {Clitoric} anatomy varies among individuals.
e.zh: 阴蒂的解剖结构因人而异。

clitoromania.t: 女性色情狂；阴蒂亢进症

e.en: {Clitoromania} is an outdated diagnosis.
e.zh: 女性色情狂是一个过时的诊断名。

e.en: Doctors no longer use the term {clitoromania}.
e.zh: 医生不再使用阴蒂亢进症这个术语。

e.en: Hikers carefully crossed the moor's {clitters}.
e.zh: 徒步者小心地走过荒原上的碎石坡。

e.en: Granite {clitters} cover the hillside.
e.zh: 花岗岩石坡覆盖着山坡。

e.en: He's a right {cliver} lad.
e.zh: 他真是个机灵的小伙子。

e.en: That was a {cliver} solution indeed.
e.zh: 那的确是个聪明的办法。

e.en: Sticky {clivers} clung to her socks.
e.zh: 粘人的猪殃殃挂在她的袜子上。

e.en: Herbalists use {clivers} for skin remedies.
e.zh: 草药师用拉拉藤来治皮肤问题。

e.en: The land was {clivose} and rugged.
e.zh: 那片土地多丘陵且崎岖。

e.en: We crossed a {clivose} region slowly.
e.zh: 我们缓慢地穿过一片多斜坡的地区。

e.en: Reptile {cloacae} serve multiple functions.
e.zh: 爬行动物的泄殖腔有多种功能。

e.en: Surgeons examined the bird's {cloacae}.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了那只鸟的泄殖腔。

cloacal.t: 泄殖腔的；与泄殖腔有关的

e.en: Birds have a single {cloacal} opening.
e.zh: 鸟类只有一个泄殖腔开口。

e.en: {Cloacal} bacteria can cause infections.
e.zh: 泄殖腔的细菌可能引起感染。

cloak-and-dagger.t: 间谍式的；秘密阴谋的；勾心斗角的

e.en: Their {cloak-and-dagger} meetings worried me.
e.zh: 他们鬼鬼祟祟的密会让我担心。

e.en: The novel had {cloak-and-dagger} intrigue.
e.zh: 这部小说充满了间谍式的阴谋。

cloasma.t: 黄褐斑；妊娠斑；皮肤色素斑

e.en: Sunscreen helps prevent {cloasma}.
e.zh: 防晒霜有助于预防黄褐斑。

e.en: She developed {cloasma} during pregnancy.
e.zh: 她在怀孕期间长出了妊娠斑。

clochard.t: 流浪汉；街头乞丐（法语借词）

e.en: An old {clochard} slept by the Seine.
e.zh: 一个老流浪汉睡在塞纳河边。

e.en: The {clochard} mumbled to himself quietly.
e.zh: 那个街头乞丐自顾自地嘟囔着。

e.en: The {clock-maker} restored the antique piece.
e.zh: 那位钟表匠修复了这件古董。

e.en: Her grandfather was a skilled {clock-maker}.
e.zh: 她祖父是个手艺高超的制钟师傅。

clock-tower.t: 钟楼；钟塔；带大钟的塔楼

e.en: We met by the {clock-tower}.
e.zh: 我们在钟楼旁边碰头。

e.en: The old {clock-tower} chimed at noon.
e.zh: 古老的钟楼在中午敲响。

clock-watcher.t: 老盯着时钟的人；上班混日子的人

e.en: Don't be such a {clock-watcher}.
e.zh: 别老盯着钟混日子。

e.en: He's a notorious {clock-watcher} at work.
e.zh: 他在公司是出了名的盯钟摸鱼者。

e.en: The antique {clockface} was cracked.
e.zh: 那个古董钟面有裂纹。

e.en: She glanced at the {clockface} briefly.
e.zh: 她瞥了一眼表盘。

clockgenerator.t: 时钟发生器；时钟信号源

e.en: The chip's {clockgenerator} drifted noticeably.
e.zh: 芯片的时钟发生器出现了明显漂移。

e.en: Engineers debugged the {clockgenerator} circuit.
e.zh: 工程师调试了时钟信号源电路。

clocklike.t: 像时钟一样精确的；规律性的

e.en: His morning routine was {clocklike}.
e.zh: 他每天早上的作息像钟表一样规律。

e.en: Trains ran with {clocklike} precision.
e.zh: 火车以时钟般精准的程度运行。

clockwatchers.t: 老盯时钟的人们；上班混日子者

e.en: Managers really dislike {clockwatchers}.
e.zh: 经理们很讨厌那些上班混日子的人。

e.en: The office is full of {clockwatchers}.
e.zh: 办公室里到处都是盯着钟摸鱼的人。

cloddish.t: 笨拙的；粗鲁的；土里土气的

e.en: His {cloddish} manners embarrassed her.
e.zh: 他粗鲁的举止让她很尴尬。

e.en: He gave a {cloddish} reply.
e.zh: 他给出了一个笨拙的回答。

e.en: Her {cloddishness} ruined the date.
e.zh: 她的粗鲁毁了这次约会。

e.en: I tolerated his usual {cloddishness}.
e.zh: 我容忍了他一贯的笨拙。

e.en: The field was wet and {cloddy}.
e.zh: 田地又湿又多土块。

e.en: {Cloddy} soil is hard to plough.
e.zh: 多土块的土壤很难耕。

clodhopper.t: 笨重的大皮鞋；乡巴佬；土包子

e.en: He kicked off his muddy {clodhopper}.
e.zh: 他甩掉了那只沾满泥的大皮鞋。

e.en: The locals called him a {clodhopper}.
e.zh: 当地人叫他土包子。

clodhoppers.t: 笨重的大皮鞋；乡巴佬们

e.en: Mud caked his old {clodhoppers}.
e.zh: 泥巴糊满了他那双旧大皮鞋。

e.en: Those {clodhoppers} look way too heavy.
e.zh: 那双笨重的大皮鞋看起来太沉了。

e.en: He danced in a {clodhopping} style.
e.zh: 他笨手笨脚地跳着舞。

e.en: Stop that {clodhopping} walk indoors.
e.zh: 在屋里别这么笨重地走路。

e.en: His {clodpated} reply annoyed everyone.
e.zh: 他愚笨的回答惹恼了所有人。

e.en: What a {clodpated} idea that was.
e.zh: 那真是个糊涂的主意。

e.en: He called his brother a {clodpole}.
e.zh: 他叫弟弟笨蛋。

e.en: Only a {clodpole} would believe that.
e.zh: 只有糊涂蛋才会相信那种话。

clodpoll.t: 笨蛋；蠢货；笨头笨脑的人

e.en: The {clodpoll} forgot the keys again.
e.zh: 那个笨蛋又忘带钥匙了。

e.en: Stop acting like a complete {clodpoll}.
e.zh: 别表现得像个十足的糊涂蛋。

e.en: Benzene has a {closed-chain} structure of six carbon atoms.
e.zh: 苯具有由六个碳原子组成的闭链结构。

e.en: Squats are a typical {closed-chain} exercise for the legs.
e.zh: 深蹲是典型的下肢闭链运动。

e.en: The store installed {closed-circuit} cameras at every exit.
e.zh: 商店在每个出口都安装了闭路摄像头。

e.en: They watched the lecture on {closed-circuit} television.
e.zh: 他们通过闭路电视观看讲座。

e.en: The board held a {closed-door} meeting about the merger.
e.zh: 董事会就并购事宜召开了闭门会议。

e.en: Reporters were excluded from the {closed-door} session.
e.zh: 记者被拒于这场闭门会议之外。

closed-doorism.t: 闭关锁国主义；闭门主义

e.en: The reformers denounced the dynasty's {closed-doorism}.
e.zh: 改革者谴责了王朝的闭关锁国主义。

e.en: Modern economies cannot survive on {closed-doorism}.
e.zh: 现代经济无法在闭关锁国主义下生存。

e.en: She invested in a {closed-end} mutual fund last year.
e.zh: 她去年投资了一只封闭式共同基金。

e.en: The survey used {closed-end} questions for easy analysis.
e.zh: 这份问卷采用封闭式问题以便分析。

e.en: Glucose can form a {closed-ring} structure in solution.
e.zh: 葡萄糖在溶液中可形成闭环结构。

e.en: The molecule rearranged into a {closed-ring} configuration.
e.zh: 该分子重排成了闭环构型。

e.en: Her {closefisted} uncle never gave gifts at Christmas.
e.zh: 她那吝啬的舅舅圣诞节从不送礼物。

e.en: The {closefisted} landlord refused to repair the leak.
e.zh: 那个吝啬的房东拒绝修理漏水处。

e.en: She wore a {closefitting} black dress to the gala.
e.zh: 她穿着一条紧身的黑色礼服出席晚会。

e.en: Cyclists prefer {closefitting} jerseys to reduce drag.
e.zh: 自行车手喜欢穿紧身骑行服以减少阻力。

e.en: Her {closehanded} grandfather counted every penny twice.
e.zh: 她吝啬的祖父每个铜板都要数两遍。

e.en: Even charities found him too {closehanded} to approach.
e.zh: 连慈善机构都觉得他过于吝啬而不愿接触。

closehauled.t: 抢风航行的；张满帆顶风行驶的

e.en: The yacht sailed {closehauled} into a stiff breeze.
e.zh: 游艇在劲风中抢风航行。

e.en: Sailing {closehauled} demands constant trim of the sails.
e.zh: 抢风航行需要不断调整风帆。

closelipped.t: 守口如瓶的；沉默寡言的

e.en: Witnesses stayed {closelipped} about what they had seen.
e.zh: 目击者对所见之事守口如瓶。

e.en: The minister was {closelipped} during the press conference.
e.zh: 部长在记者会上守口如瓶。

e.en: They grew up in a {closely-knit} farming community.
e.zh: 他们在一个关系紧密的农业社区长大。

e.en: The team became {closely-knit} after years of competition.
e.zh: 经过多年的比赛,这支队伍变得非常团结。

closemouthed.t: 沉默寡言的；守口如瓶的

e.en: He remained {closemouthed} about his next career move.
e.zh: 他对自己下一步的职业动向守口如瓶。

e.en: The detective grew {closemouthed} whenever reporters approached.
e.zh: 每当记者靠近,那位侦探就变得沉默寡言。

e.en: Servants emptied the {closestool} early each morning.
e.zh: 仆人每天清晨倒掉便桶里的脏物。

e.en: The antique shop displayed a carved oak {closestool}.
e.zh: 古董店里陈列着一只雕花橡木便桶。

e.en: The patient developed a {clostridial} infection after surgery.
e.zh: 病人术后出现了梭状芽孢杆菌感染。

e.en: Antibiotics rarely clear severe {clostridial} colitis quickly.
e.zh: 抗生素很少能迅速治愈严重的梭菌性结肠炎。

e.en: Doctors gave him a {clotbuster} within minutes of the stroke.
e.zh: 中风后几分钟内医生就给他注射了溶栓药。

e.en: This new {clotbuster} reduces the risk of brain damage.
e.zh: 这种新型溶栓药能降低脑损伤的风险。

e.en: The publisher chose {cloth-binding} for the deluxe edition.
e.zh: 出版社为豪华版选用了布面装订。

e.en: This atlas features durable green {cloth-binding}.
e.zh: 这本地图集采用了耐用的绿色布面装订。

cloth-eared.t: 听觉迟钝的；不专心听的

e.en: Are you {cloth-eared}? I've asked you three times already!
e.zh: 你耳朵是塞布了吗?我已经问你三次了!

e.en: The {cloth-eared} student missed every instruction the teacher gave.
e.zh: 那个心不在焉的学生错过了老师的每一条指示。

e.en: He prefers a sturdy {clothback} for his reference shelf.
e.zh: 他偏爱坚固的布面精装本放在工具书架上。

e.en: The {clothback} edition costs twice as much as the paperback.
e.zh: 布面精装本的价格是平装本的两倍。

e.en: She owns a beautiful {clothbound} set of Dickens.
e.zh: 她拥有一套漂亮的布面装订的狄更斯作品集。

e.en: The {clothbound} edition holds up better than paperback.
e.zh: 布面装订的版本比平装本更耐用。

e.en: He hung wet shirts on the {clothes-horse} by the radiator.
e.zh: 他把湿衬衫挂在暖气片旁的晾衣架上。

e.en: Her sister is a real {clothes-horse} who shops every weekend.
e.zh: 她姐姐是个十足的衣裳架子,每个周末都去购物。

e.en: Mom hung the sheets on the {clothes-line} to dry.
e.zh: 妈妈把床单挂在晾衣绳上晾干。

e.en: A sparrow perched on the {clothes-line} in the yard.
e.zh: 一只麻雀停在院子里的晒衣绳上。

e.en: She fastened the towel with a wooden {clothes-peg}.
e.zh: 她用一个木制衣夹把毛巾夹住。

e.en: The wind blew a {clothes-peg} into the bushes.
e.zh: 风把一个晒衣夹吹进了灌木丛。

e.en: He pinched his nose with a {clothes-pin} before diving.
e.zh: 他跳水前用衣夹夹住了鼻子。

e.en: Each {clothes-pin} held a sock firmly in place.
e.zh: 每个衣夹都把一只袜子牢牢夹住。

e.en: She tossed her dirty laundry into the {clothesbag}.
e.zh: 她把脏衣服扔进了装衣袋里。

e.en: Travelers often pack a small {clothesbag} for soiled garments.
e.zh: 旅行者通常会带一个小装衣袋装脏衣服。

e.en: He carried the {clothesbasket} down to the laundry room.
e.zh: 他把洗衣篮搬到了洗衣房。

e.en: The {clothesbasket} was overflowing with damp towels.
e.zh: 洗衣篮里堆满了潮湿的毛巾。

e.en: Use the {clothesbrush} to remove lint from your jacket.
e.zh: 用衣服刷子把外套上的绒毛刷掉。

e.en: Grandma keeps a stiff {clothesbrush} by the front door.
e.zh: 奶奶在前门旁放了一把硬毛衣服刷。

e.en: He sold his old suits to the wandering {clothesman}.
e.zh: 他把旧西装卖给了走街串巷的旧衣商贩。

e.en: A {clothesman} used to call at our street every Tuesday.
e.zh: 过去每周二都有个旧衣贩到我们街上来吆喝。

e.en: She used a {clothespeg} to seal the bag of crisps.
e.zh: 她用一个晒衣夹封住了薯片袋。

e.en: Each {clothespeg} on the line held a fluttering shirt.
e.zh: 绳上的每个晒衣夹都夹着一件随风飘动的衬衫。

e.en: She bought a packet of wooden {clothespegs} at the market.
e.zh: 她在市场买了一包木制晒衣夹。

e.en: The {clothespegs} kept the sheets from blowing away.
e.zh: 晒衣夹防止床单被风吹走。

e.en: The {clothespole} propped up the sagging laundry line.
e.zh: 那根晾衣杆撑起了下垂的晒衣绳。

e.en: Dad replaced the rotten {clothespole} in the back yard.
e.zh: 爸爸换掉了后院里那根腐烂的晾衣杆。

e.en: She hung her dresses neatly in the antique {clothespress}.
e.zh: 她把连衣裙整齐地挂进那个古董衣橱里。

e.en: The Victorian {clothespress} dominated one wall of the bedroom.
e.zh: 那个维多利亚式衣橱占据了卧室的整面墙。

e.en: He raised the line with a tall wooden {clothesprop}.
e.zh: 他用一根高高的木制撑衣杆把晒衣绳撑起来。

e.en: The {clothesprop} kept the heavy sheets from dragging.
e.zh: 那根撑衣杆使沉重的床单不至于拖到地上。

e.en: Highway engineers use a {clothoid} for smooth transition curves.
e.zh: 公路工程师用回旋曲线来设计平顺的过渡弯道。

e.en: The roller coaster's loop follows a {clothoid} shape.
e.zh: 过山车的环形轨道采用回旋曲线的形状。

e.en: The custard turned {clotty} when it cooled too quickly.
e.zh: 蛋奶酱冷却得太快,结成了一块块。

e.en: Her blood looked {clotty} under the microscope.
e.zh: 她的血液在显微镜下显得凝结成块。

e.en: The poet imagined a {cloud-built} palace floating in the sky.
e.zh: 诗人想象着一座漂浮在天空中的云中宫殿。

e.en: Their plans were {cloud-built}, with no real foundation.
e.zh: 他们的计划是空中楼阁,毫无根基。

e.en: We hiked toward the {cloud-capped} mountain peak at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分我们朝着云遮顶的山峰前进。

e.en: {Cloud-capped} towers rose above the medieval city walls.
e.zh: 高耸入云的塔楼矗立在中世纪的城墙之上。

cloud-castle.t: 空中楼阁；不切实际的幻想

e.en: Children love to dream of a {cloud-castle} floating overhead.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢幻想头顶上漂浮着一座空中楼阁。

e.en: His ambitions are nothing but {cloud-castle} fantasies.
e.zh: 他的雄心壮志不过是空中楼阁般的幻想。

cloud-covered.t: 被云覆盖的；阴云密布的

e.en: The {cloud-covered} sky promised heavy rain by evening.
e.zh: 阴云密布的天空预示着傍晚会有大雨。

e.en: We landed in a gloomy, {cloud-covered} city.
e.zh: 我们降落在一座阴沉、云层密布的城市。

cloud-cuckoo-land.t: 虚幻世界；不切实际的幻境

e.en: Anyone expecting profits this year is living in {cloud-cuckoo-land}.
e.zh: 指望今年能盈利的人简直是活在幻境里。

e.en: Stop dreaming about early retirement in {cloud-cuckoo-land}.
e.zh: 别再做提前退休的白日梦了。

e.en: The two signals are {co-phasal} at the antenna.
e.zh: 两个信号在天线处是同相的。

e.en: Engineers prefer {co-phasal} arrays for stronger output.
e.zh: 工程师偏好同相阵列以获得更强输出。

e.en: The antennas operate in {co-phase} for clarity.
e.zh: 天线以共相位运作以保证清晰度。

e.en: We must {co-phase} the transmitters before testing.
e.zh: 我们必须在测试前让发射器同相位。

e.en: The {co-pilot} took over during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中副驾驶接管了飞行。

e.en: She trained for years to become a {co-pilot}.
e.zh: 她训练多年才成为副驾驶。

e.en: Two {co-pilots} shared the long flight.
e.zh: 两位副驾驶轮换执行了这趟长途飞行。

e.en: The airline hired more {co-pilots} this year.
e.zh: 航空公司今年招聘了更多副驾驶。

e.en: She serves as {co-president} of the firm.
e.zh: 她担任公司的共同总裁。

e.en: The two founders act as {co-president}s.
e.zh: 两位创始人共同担任联席主席。

e.en: The graphics {co-processor} speeds up rendering.
e.zh: 图形协处理器加快了渲染速度。

e.en: Modern phones include a neural {co-processor}.
e.zh: 现代手机配备了神经协处理器。

e.en: The studios {co-produce} the new series.
e.zh: 两家工作室联合制作了这部新剧。

e.en: They plan to {co-produce} a documentary.
e.zh: 他们计划共同制作一部纪录片。

co-producer.t: 联合制片人；共同制作人

e.en: She signed on as {co-producer} of the film.
e.zh: 她签约成为这部影片的联合制片人。

e.en: The {co-producer} secured extra funding.
e.zh: 联合制片人争取到了额外资金。

co-produces.t: 联合制作（第三人称单数）

e.en: Her company {co-produces} the talk show.
e.zh: 她的公司联合制作这档脱口秀。

e.en: The network {co-produces} dramas with Korea.
e.zh: 该电视台与韩国联合制作电视剧。

e.en: The treaty promised regional {co-prosperity}.
e.zh: 该条约承诺了区域共同繁荣。

e.en: Leaders spoke of {co-prosperity} between nations.
e.zh: 领导人谈到国家之间的共同繁荣。

e.en: Two presses {co-publish} the rare atlas.
e.zh: 两家出版社联合出版了这本稀有地图册。

e.en: They will {co-publish} the research findings.
e.zh: 他们将共同发表这项研究成果。

e.en: He greeted his {co-religionist} warmly.
e.zh: 他热情地问候了同教信徒。

e.en: They sheltered a {co-religionist} fleeing persecution.
e.zh: 他们收留了一位逃避迫害的同教信徒。

e.en: The {co-riparian} states share the river basin.
e.zh: 共河岸国家共享这个流域。

e.en: They held a {co-riparian} water summit.
e.zh: 他们举行了共河岸国水资源峰会。

e.en: She is the {co-scripter} of the play.
e.zh: 她是这部剧的联合编剧。

e.en: The {co-scripter} added several jokes.
e.zh: 联合编剧添加了几个笑点。

e.en: My father agreed to {co-sign} the lease.
e.zh: 我父亲同意联署这份租约。

e.en: You need someone to {co-sign} the loan.
e.zh: 你需要有人为这笔贷款做担保连署。

e.en: She will {co-star} in the new thriller.
e.zh: 她将联合主演这部新惊悚片。

e.en: His {co-star} won an award last night.
e.zh: 他的联合主演昨晚获奖。

e.en: They {co-starred} in a romantic comedy.
e.zh: 他们联袂主演了一部浪漫喜剧。

e.en: She {co-starred} with a famous actor.
e.zh: 她与一位著名演员联袂主演。

e.en: The film, {co-starring} both legends, opens Friday.
e.zh: 由两位传奇人物联袂主演的影片周五上映。

e.en: She is {co-starring} with him this season.
e.zh: 本季她与他联袂主演。

e.en: The {co-stars} became close friends.
e.zh: 联合主演成为了亲密的朋友。

e.en: Both {co-stars} attended the premiere.
e.zh: 两位联合主演都出席了首映礼。

e.en: Her {co-twin} showed similar symptoms.
e.zh: 她的双胞胎兄弟也出现了类似症状。

e.en: Researchers compared each child with their {co-twin}.
e.zh: 研究人员将每个孩子与其双胞胎手足比较。

e.en: Age was used as a {co-variate} in the model.
e.zh: 年龄在模型中被用作协变量。

e.en: We must control for this {co-variate}.
e.zh: 我们必须控制这个协变量。

e.en: My {co-worker} helped me finish the report.
e.zh: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。

e.en: She invited a {co-worker} to lunch.
e.zh: 她邀请了一位同事共进午餐。

e.en: The droplets formed a {coacervate} in solution.
e.zh: 液滴在溶液中形成了凝聚体。

e.en: A {coacervate} may model early cell membranes.
e.zh: 凝聚体可模拟早期细胞膜。

e.en: {Coacervation} is studied in origin-of-life research.
e.zh: 凝聚作用是生命起源研究的课题。

e.en: The polymers undergo {coacervation} at low pH.
e.zh: 聚合物在低pH下发生凝聚作用。

e.en: A {coach-and-four} arrived at the manor.
e.zh: 一辆四马大马车来到了庄园。

e.en: The duke traveled in a {coach-and-four}.
e.zh: 公爵乘坐四马大马车出行。

e.en: Several {coach-and-fours} lined the driveway.
e.zh: 几辆四马大马车排列在车道上。

e.en: The museum displays old {coach-and-fours}.
e.zh: 博物馆陈列着古老的四马大马车。

e.en: He drove a {coach-built} luxury sedan.
e.zh: 他开着一辆手工定制车身的豪华轿车。

e.en: This {coach-built} car is one of a kind.
e.zh: 这辆手工定制车身的汽车独一无二。

e.en: A {coach-load} of tourists arrived at noon.
e.zh: 满满一大巴车的游客中午抵达。

e.en: The festival drew {coach-load}s of fans.
e.zh: 音乐节吸引了一车又一车的粉丝。

e.en: Scouts praised the rookie's {coachability}.
e.zh: 球探称赞了这位新秀的受教能力。

e.en: Her {coachability} impressed the manager.
e.zh: 她的受教能力打动了经理。

e.en: He's a talented and {coachable} player.
e.zh: 他是个有才华又听教的球员。

e.en: Employers value {coachable} new hires.
e.zh: 雇主重视肯学肯听教的新员工。

e.en: Italian {coachbuilding} is famous worldwide.
e.zh: 意大利的汽车车身制造业闻名于世。

e.en: He apprenticed in traditional {coachbuilding}.
e.zh: 他在传统汽车车身制造业学徒。

e.en: The {coachee} set goals for the next month.
e.zh: 学员为下个月设定了目标。

e.en: Each {coachee} meets weekly with a mentor.
e.zh: 每位学员每周与导师会面。

e.en: The horse pulled with its loyal {coachfellow}.
e.zh: 这匹马与它忠实的同辕伙伴一起拉车。

e.en: The two stallions made fine {coachfellow}s.
e.zh: 两匹种马是绝佳的同辕拍档。

e.en: He cracked the {coachwhip} above the horses.
e.zh: 他在马匹上方甩响了马车鞭。

e.en: A {coachwhip} snake slid across the road.
e.zh: 一条鞭蛇滑过了路面。

e.en: The cabinet was made from {coachwood}.
e.zh: 这个柜子是用澳洲香木制成的。

e.en: {Coachwood} grows in eastern Australian rainforests.
e.zh: 澳洲香木生长在澳洲东部雨林中。

e.en: The two enzymes {coact} to break down sugar.
e.zh: 这两种酶共同作用分解糖。

e.en: Their teams {coact} on humanitarian projects.
e.zh: 他们的团队在人道项目上协同行动。

e.en: The drugs {coacted} to relieve the pain.
e.zh: 两种药物共同作用缓解了疼痛。

e.en: Several agencies {coacted} during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机期间多个机构协同行动。

e.en: The {coacting} forces shaped the structure.
e.zh: 协同作用的力量塑造了这一结构。

e.en: Several {coacting} factors drive the trend.
e.zh: 几个协同因素推动了这一趋势。

e.en: The species' {coaction} stabilizes the ecosystem.
e.zh: 物种间的协同作用稳定了生态系统。

e.en: Their {coaction} produced impressive results.
e.zh: 他们的共同行动产生了令人瞩目的成果。

e.en: The proteins {coactivate} the target gene.
e.zh: 这些蛋白质共同激活了目标基因。

e.en: Two signals {coactivate} the immune response.
e.zh: 两个信号协同激活免疫反应。

e.en: The neurons were {coactivated} during the task.
e.zh: 任务期间这些神经元被共同激活。

e.en: Two pathways were {coactivated} by the drug.
e.zh: 两条通路被药物共同激活。

coactivator.t: 共激活因子；协同激活蛋白

e.en: The {coactivator} binds the receptor complex.
e.zh: 该共激活因子与受体复合物结合。

e.en: Researchers identified a new {coactivator} protein.
e.zh: 研究人员发现了一种新的共激活蛋白。

e.en: The {coactive} forces produced the result.
e.zh: 这些协同力量产生了这一结果。

e.en: They use a {coactive} coaching method.
e.zh: 他们使用一种协同教练法。

e.en: The molecules act {coactively} on the receptor.
e.zh: 分子协同地作用于受体。

e.en: Teams worked {coactively} toward the deadline.
e.zh: 团队协同地朝着截止日期努力。

e.en: Brain {coactivity} was measured during sleep.
e.zh: 睡眠期间测量了大脑的协同活动。

e.en: Their {coactivity} suggests shared function.
e.zh: 它们的协同活性表明功能相关。

coacts.t: 共同作用（第三人称单数）

e.en: The catalyst {coacts} with the solvent.
e.zh: 催化剂与溶剂共同作用。

e.en: This factor {coacts} with several others.
e.zh: 此因素与其他几个因素协同作用。

coadapted.t: 共同适应的；协同进化的

e.en: The species are tightly {coadapted} to each other.
e.zh: 这些物种彼此紧密协同适应。

e.en: Flowers and pollinators are often {coadapted}.
e.zh: 花朵与传粉者常常是协同适应的。

e.en: The quarry exposed a thick layer of {clunch}.
e.zh: 采石场露出厚厚一层白垩黏土。

e.en: Builders once used {clunch} blocks for cottage walls.
e.zh: 建筑工人曾用白垩岩块砌造小屋的墙。

e.en: This phone is {clunkier} than the new model.
e.zh: 这款手机比新款更笨重。

e.en: The old software felt {clunkier} every year.
e.zh: 那款旧软件用起来一年比一年笨拙。

e.en: The grapes hung in {clustery} bunches from the vine.
e.zh: 葡萄一串串地挂在藤上。

e.en: She painted the flowers with a {clustery} texture.
e.zh: 她把花画得簇拥成团。

e.en: The doctor prescribed a {clyster} to ease his ailment.
e.zh: 医生开了灌肠剂来缓解他的病痛。

e.en: Old medical texts often mention the {clyster}.
e.zh: 古老的医学典籍常常提到灌肠疗法。

e.en: The jellyfish stings using a {cnidoblast} on its tentacle.
e.zh: 水母用触手上的刺细胞蜇刺猎物。

e.en: Each {cnidoblast} discharges a venomous thread.
e.zh: 每个刺细胞都会射出带毒的细丝。

e.en: Several enzymes {co-act} to digest the food.
e.zh: 多种酶共同作用以消化食物。

e.en: The two policies {co-act} to lower emissions.
e.zh: 这两项政策共同作用以降低排放。

e.en: She is the new {co-anchor} of the morning show.
e.zh: 她是早间节目的新联合主播。

e.en: They will {co-anchor} the election coverage.
e.zh: 他们将共同主持选举报道。

co-anchored.t: 共同主持过；联合担任过主播

e.en: He {co-anchored} the broadcast last night.
e.zh: 昨晚他联合主持了那档广播节目。

e.en: The two journalists {co-anchored} the debate.
e.zh: 两位记者共同主持了这场辩论。

co-anchoring.t: 共同主持中；联合担任主播

e.en: She is {co-anchoring} the news this week.
e.zh: 本周她正联合主持新闻节目。

e.en: {Co-anchoring} requires good chemistry on screen.
e.zh: 联合主持需要屏幕上的良好默契。

e.en: The two {co-anchors} bantered easily on air.
e.zh: 两位联合主播在直播中轻松地互动。

e.en: He {co-anchors} the evening bulletin every Friday.
e.zh: 他每周五共同主持晚间新闻。

e.en: She is a {co-author} of the textbook.
e.zh: 她是这本教科书的合著者。

e.en: They plan to {co-author} a paper next year.
e.zh: 他们计划明年合作撰写一篇论文。

e.en: The report was {co-authored} by three economists.
e.zh: 该报告由三位经济学家合著完成。

e.en: They {co-authored} a bestseller last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天他们合作写出了一本畅销书。

e.en: They are {co-authoring} a research paper.
e.zh: 他们正在合作撰写一篇研究论文。

e.en: {Co-authoring} can be both rewarding and frustrating.
e.zh: 合作写作既可能有所收获，也可能令人沮丧。

e.en: The book has four {co-authors}.
e.zh: 这本书有四位合著者。

e.en: She often {co-authors} articles with her mentor.
e.zh: 她常与导师合作撰写文章。

co-belligerent.t: 共同交战国；并肩作战的

e.en: Italy became a {co-belligerent} on the Allied side.
e.zh: 意大利成为同盟国一方的共同交战国。

e.en: The two states acted as {co-belligerent} powers.
e.zh: 两国作为共同交战国行事。

co-branding.t: 联合品牌营销；品牌共建

e.en: The {co-branding} deal boosted both companies' sales.
e.zh: 这项联合品牌合作提升了两家公司的销量。

e.en: {Co-branding} works best when audiences overlap.
e.zh: 当受众重叠时，联合品牌效果最好。

e.en: She was elected {co-chair} of the committee.
e.zh: 她当选为委员会的联合主席。

e.en: They will {co-chair} the upcoming summit.
e.zh: 他们将共同主持即将召开的峰会。

e.en: He served as {co-chairman} of the foundation.
e.zh: 他曾担任基金会的联合主席。

e.en: The two veterans agreed to be {co-chairman}.
e.zh: 两位资深人士同意担任共同主席。

e.en: He was named as a {co-conspirator} in the indictment.
e.zh: 他在起诉书中被列为同谋。

e.en: Her {co-conspirator} turned state's witness.
e.zh: 她的同谋转为污点证人。

co-dependent.t: 相互依赖的；共生依赖的

e.en: Their relationship had become unhealthily {co-dependent}.
e.zh: 他们的关系已变得病态地相互依赖。

e.en: The two firms are economically {co-dependent}.
e.zh: 这两家公司在经济上相互依赖。

e.en: Residents helped {co-design} the new park.
e.zh: 居民们帮助共同设计了这座新公园。

e.en: {Co-design} brings users into the creative process.
e.zh: 协同设计让用户参与到创作过程中。

e.en: She served as {co-director} of the documentary.
e.zh: 她担任了这部纪录片的联合导演。

e.en: The two {co-directors} disagreed on the ending.
e.zh: 两位联合导演对结局持不同意见。

e.en: The college went {co-ed} in 1972.
e.zh: 该学院于1972年改为男女同校。

e.en: She was a popular {co-ed} on campus.
e.zh: 她在校园里是一位很受欢迎的女大学生。

co-edition.t: 合作版本；联合出版版本

e.en: The publishers released a {co-edition} in three languages.
e.zh: 出版商以三种语言推出了合作版本。

e.en: This {co-edition} reduced printing costs significantly.
e.zh: 这一联合版本大幅降低了印刷成本。

e.en: He is {co-editor} of the literary journal.
e.zh: 他是这本文学期刊的联合主编。

e.en: The two {co-editors} chose the cover photograph together.
e.zh: 两位联合编辑共同选定了封面照片。

e.en: Many old colleges now {co-educate} their students.
e.zh: 许多老牌学院现在实行男女同校教育。

e.en: They decided to {co-educate} boys and girls.
e.zh: 他们决定让男孩和女孩同校受教育。

co-education.t: 男女同校教育；男女合校制

e.en: The school adopted {co-education} after long debate.
e.zh: 经过长期争论后，这所学校采用了男女同校教育。

e.en: {Co-education} was once considered controversial.
e.zh: 男女同校教育曾被认为颇具争议。

e.en: The two {coadjacent} fields share a fence.
e.zh: 这两块相邻的田地共用一道围栏。

e.en: Surveyors mapped the {coadjacent} parcels of land.
e.zh: 测量员绘制了相邻地块的地图。

e.en: The partners had to {coadjust} their schedules.
e.zh: 两位合伙人必须相互调整时间表。

e.en: Engineers {coadjust} the gears for smooth motion.
e.zh: 工程师共同调节齿轮以确保平稳运转。

e.en: Successful teamwork requires constant {coadjustment}.
e.zh: 成功的团队合作需要不断的相互调整。

e.en: The {coadjustment} of policies took months.
e.zh: 政策的协同调整花了数月。

e.en: He served as {coadjutant} to the senior researcher.
e.zh: 他担任资深研究员的助手。

e.en: Her {coadjutant} role was vital to the project.
e.zh: 她的协助角色对项目至关重要。

e.en: The bishop appointed a {coadjutor} to assist him.
e.zh: 主教任命了一位副主教来协助他。

e.en: She acted as {coadjutor} to the abbot.
e.zh: 她担任修道院院长的助手。

e.en: The abbess chose a {coadjutress} for daily affairs.
e.zh: 女院长选了一位女助手处理日常事务。

e.en: She became {coadjutress} to the head nun.
e.zh: 她成了主修女的女助手。

e.en: The convent named a {coadjutrix} last spring.
e.zh: 修道院去年春天任命了一位女助手。

e.en: She served as {coadjutrix} for many years.
e.zh: 她担任女副手多年。

e.en: Botanists noted the {coadunate} leaves of the plant.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到该植物的合生叶片。

e.en: The petals appear {coadunate} at the base.
e.zh: 花瓣在基部呈合生状。

e.en: The two friends planned a {coadventure} across Asia.
e.zh: 两位朋友计划共同到亚洲冒险。

e.en: Their {coadventure} in trading ended profitably.
e.zh: 他们的合伙贸易最终盈利颇丰。

e.en: The discovery resulted from the {coagency} of two labs.
e.zh: 这一发现源于两家实验室的协同作用。

e.en: Reform requires the {coagency} of citizens and government.
e.zh: 改革需要公民与政府的协同作用。

e.en: Heat acts as a {coagent} in this reaction.
e.zh: 热在此反应中起到协同作用。

e.en: She was a key {coagent} in the negotiations.
e.zh: 她是谈判中的关键协作者。

e.en: The lab examined the {coagula} under a microscope.
e.zh: 实验室在显微镜下检查这些凝块。

e.en: Tiny {coagula} formed in the cooling broth.
e.zh: 冷却的肉汤中形成了细小的凝块。

e.en: The blood test measured {coagulability} levels.
e.zh: 血液检测测量了凝血能力水平。

e.en: Cold reduces the {coagulability} of certain proteins.
e.zh: 寒冷会降低某些蛋白质的凝结性。

e.en: Egg white is a {coagulable} substance.
e.zh: 蛋白是一种可凝结的物质。

e.en: Heat turns the liquid into a {coagulable} mass.
e.zh: 加热使液体变成可凝固的团块。

e.en: The bacterium produces {coagulase} as a virulence factor.
e.zh: 该细菌产生凝固酶作为毒力因子。

e.en: Lab tests detect {coagulase} in staph cultures.
e.zh: 化验检测葡萄球菌培养中的凝固酶。

e.en: The drug has a {coagulative} effect on blood.
e.zh: 该药物对血液有促凝作用。

e.en: Doctors observed {coagulative} necrosis in the tissue.
e.zh: 医生观察到组织中的凝固性坏死。

e.en: The technician added a chemical {coagulator} to the tank.
e.zh: 技术员向罐中加入化学凝结剂。

e.en: This {coagulator} speeds up the cheese-making process.
e.zh: 这种凝结剂加快了奶酪的制作过程。

e.en: The hospital uses a {coagulometer} for clotting tests.
e.zh: 医院使用凝血计进行凝血检测。

e.en: A portable {coagulometer} simplifies bedside testing.
e.zh: 便携式凝血计简化了床旁检测。

e.en: A small {coagulum} formed in the test tube.
e.zh: 试管中形成了一小块凝块。

e.en: Surgeons removed the {coagulum} from the wound.
e.zh: 外科医生清除了伤口中的凝块。

e.en: The carpenter fitted a {coak} between the beams.
e.zh: 木匠在梁之间装入了一根榫。

e.en: Old shipwrights used a {coak} to join timbers.
e.zh: 旧时造船工用榫来连接木材。

e.en: Geologists mapped the thick {coal-bed} below the valley.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了山谷下方厚煤层的地图。

e.en: The mine tapped into a rich {coal-bed}.
e.zh: 矿井开采到一个富煤层。

e.en: She had {coal-black} hair down to her waist.
e.zh: 她有一头漆黑的长发垂至腰间。

e.en: The horse was {coal-black} and powerful.
e.zh: 那匹马通体漆黑，孔武有力。

e.en: Father refilled the {coal-box} by the fireplace.
e.zh: 父亲把壁炉旁的煤箱重新装满。

e.en: An empty {coal-box} sat in the corner.
e.zh: 角落里放着一个空煤箱。

e.en: The miners operated a powerful {coal-cutter} underground.
e.zh: 矿工在井下操作一台强力采煤机。

e.en: Modern {coal-cutter} machines have replaced manual labour.
e.zh: 现代采煤机已取代人工劳动。

e.en: He spent decades working at the {coal-face}.
e.zh: 他在采煤工作面上干了几十年。

e.en: Teachers at the {coal-face} face daily challenges.
e.zh: 奋战在第一线的教师每天都面临挑战。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a {coal-heaver} on the docks.
e.zh: 他祖父曾在码头当搬煤工。

e.en: The {coal-heaver} hauled sacks all morning.
e.zh: 那位运煤工搬了一上午的煤袋。

e.en: The {coal-master} owned several pits in the region.
e.zh: 那位煤矿矿主在当地拥有数座矿井。

e.en: Wealthy {coal-master} families dominated the town.
e.zh: 富有的矿主家族主宰着这座小镇。

e.en: {Coal-mining} once employed thousands of local workers.
e.zh: 采煤业曾雇佣了成千上万的当地工人。

e.en: The decline of {coal-mining} reshaped the valley.
e.zh: 采煤业的衰退改变了整个山谷。

e.en: He worked all his life in a {coal-pit}.
e.zh: 他一辈子都在煤矿里干活。

e.en: Children once labored in the {coal-pit} below.
e.zh: 过去孩子们也在下面的煤坑里劳作。

e.en: A {coal-whipper} unloaded ships along the Thames.
e.zh: 卸煤工人在泰晤士河沿岸卸船。

e.en: The old {coal-whipper} retired after thirty years.
e.zh: 那位老卸煤工在工作三十年后退休。

e.en: The cellar still has an old {coalbin}.
e.zh: 地下室里还有一个旧煤箱。

e.en: He emptied the {coalbin} into the furnace.
e.zh: 他把煤箱里的煤倒进炉子。

e.en: She kept a {coalbox} beside the kitchen stove.
e.zh: 她在厨房炉子旁放了一个煤箱。

e.en: The metal {coalbox} was nearly empty.
e.zh: 那个金属煤箱几乎空了。

e.en: The two cultures became {coalescent} over time.
e.zh: 两种文化随时间逐渐合并。

e.en: Scientists study {coalescent} populations in genetics.
e.zh: 科学家研究遗传学中的合并种群。

e.en: Fishermen brought home a basket of {coalfish}.
e.zh: 渔民带回家一篮青鳕。

e.en: {Coalfish} swim in cold North Atlantic waters.
e.zh: 青鳕生活在寒冷的北大西洋水域。

e.en: Old streetlamps once burned {coalgas}.
e.zh: 旧时的街灯曾燃烧煤气。

e.en: A {coalgas} leak forced the family outside.
e.zh: 煤气泄漏迫使一家人到屋外躲避。

e.en: Coal was tipped through the pavement {coalhole}.
e.zh: 煤通过人行道上的运煤口倾倒下去。

e.en: The cellar's {coalhole} was rusted shut.
e.zh: 地窖的运煤口已经锈死。

e.en: The {coalhouse} stood behind the kitchen.
e.zh: 煤房就在厨房后面。

e.en: He stored kindling in the old {coalhouse}.
e.zh: 他把引火柴放在那间旧煤房里。

e.en: {Coalification} transforms plant matter into coal.
e.zh: 煤化作用把植物物质转化为煤。

e.en: Geologists study the rate of {coalification}.
e.zh: 地质学家研究煤化作用的速率。

e.en: Strategy success depends on {coalignment} of teams.
e.zh: 战略成功取决于各团队的协同一致。

e.en: They sought {coalignment} between policy and practice.
e.zh: 他们追求政策与实践的协同一致。

e.en: The {coalitionist} pushed for an alliance with rivals.
e.zh: 那位联合主义者主张与对手结盟。

e.en: Many {coalitionist} members supported the new pact.
e.zh: 许多联合论者支持这项新协定。

e.en: A tiny {coalmouse} flitted among the pine boughs.
e.zh: 一只小煤山雀在松枝间飞掠。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a {coalmouse} at the feeder.
e.zh: 观鸟者在喂食器旁发现了一只煤山雀。

e.en: His ancestors worked in the local {coalpit}.
e.zh: 他的祖辈在当地的煤坑里干活。

e.en: The abandoned {coalpit} filled with rainwater.
e.zh: 废弃的煤坑积满了雨水。

e.en: He hoisted a heavy {coalsack} over his shoulder.
e.zh: 他把一袋沉重的煤甩上肩头。

e.en: Astronomers study the dark {coalsack} nebula.
e.zh: 天文学家研究黑暗的煤袋星云。

e.en: Workers shoveled the {coaly} debris aside.
e.zh: 工人们把含煤的碎屑铲到一边。

e.en: A {coaly} dust covered every surface.
e.zh: 一层煤灰般的尘土覆盖着每个表面。

e.en: The sailor stepped over the cockpit {coaming}.
e.zh: 水手跨过驾驶舱的围板。

e.en: Rain ran off the hatch {coaming}.
e.zh: 雨水从舱口围板上流下。

e.en: The deck's {coamings} kept water out of the hold.
e.zh: 甲板的围板把水挡在货舱外。

e.en: He repainted the worn {coamings} last week.
e.zh: 他上周给磨损的围板重新刷了漆。

e.en: The surgeon will {coapt} the edges of the wound.
e.zh: 外科医生会将伤口边缘接合起来。

e.en: Carpenters {coapt} the planks tightly together.
e.zh: 木匠把木板紧密地接合起来。

e.en: Proper {coaptation} of the bone fragments aids healing.
e.zh: 骨碎片的正确接合有助于愈合。

e.en: The cabinetmaker checked the {coaptation} of the joints.
e.zh: 家具匠检查接缝的密接情况。

e.en: The fly larva forms a {coarctate} pupa inside the hardened skin.
e.zh: 蝇类幼虫在硬化的外皮内形成围蛹。

e.en: Entomologists classify this species by its {coarctate} pupal stage.
e.zh: 昆虫学家根据其围蛹阶段对该物种进行分类。

coarctation.t: 狭窄；缩窄（尤指主动脉缩窄）

e.en: The baby was diagnosed with {coarctation} of the aorta.
e.zh: 这名婴儿被诊断为主动脉缩窄。

e.en: Surgery corrected the {coarctation} and restored normal blood flow.
e.zh: 手术矫正了缩窄并恢复了正常血流。

e.en: The carpenter avoided the {coarse-fibred} wood for fine carving.
e.zh: 木匠避免使用这种粗纤维木材做精细雕刻。

e.en: This {coarse-fibred} cloth feels rough against the skin.
e.zh: 这种粗纤维布料贴在皮肤上感觉粗糙。

e.en: Granite is a {coarse-grained} igneous rock.
e.zh: 花岗岩是一种粗粒火成岩。

e.en: The model gives only a {coarse-grained} view of the economy.
e.zh: 该模型只能粗略地反映经济状况。

e.en: Engineers measured drag using a {coast-down} test.
e.zh: 工程师通过滑行减速试验测量阻力。

e.en: The car's {coast-down} curve revealed unusual rolling resistance.
e.zh: 这辆车的滑行减速曲线显示出异常的滚动阻力。

coast-to-coast.t: 横贯全国的；从东岸到西岸的

e.en: They drove {coast-to-coast} in just five days.
e.zh: 他们仅用五天就横贯了全国。

e.en: The show received {coast-to-coast} coverage on television.
e.zh: 该节目在全国电视台都有报道。

e.en: The lab performed a {coastdown} to estimate vehicle losses.
e.zh: 实验室进行了滑行试验以估算车辆能耗损失。

e.en: Each {coastdown} run was repeated for accuracy.
e.zh: 每次滑行测试都会重复以确保准确性。

coasteering.t: 海岸探险（攀岩跳水的户外运动）

e.en: We tried {coasteering} along the rugged Welsh cliffs.
e.zh: 我们沿着崎岖的威尔士悬崖尝试了海岸探险运动。

e.en: {Coasteering} combines climbing, swimming and cliff jumping.
e.zh: 海岸探险结合了攀爬、游泳和悬崖跳水。

e.en: The {coastguardman} pulled the swimmer to safety.
e.zh: 那名海岸警卫队员把游泳者救上岸。

e.en: Every {coastguardman} on duty answered the distress call.
e.zh: 每位值班的海岸警卫队员都回应了求救信号。

e.en: A young {coastguardsman} spotted the drifting boat.
e.zh: 一名年轻的海岸警卫队员发现了漂流的船只。

e.en: The {coastguardsman} radioed for immediate backup.
e.zh: 那名海岸警卫队员用无线电请求立即增援。

e.en: The {coastwaiter} inspected every barrel unloaded at the dock.
e.zh: 沿岸海关稽查员检查了码头卸下的每个木桶。

e.en: In the 18th century a {coastwaiter} watched for smugglers.
e.zh: 十八世纪时沿岸海关稽查员负责监视走私者。

e.en: The migrating birds flew {coastward} at dawn.
e.zh: 迁徙的鸟群在黎明时分朝海岸方向飞去。

e.en: A {coastward} breeze carried the scent of salt.
e.zh: 一阵吹向海岸的微风带来了海盐的气息。

e.en: They walked {coastwards} until they reached the cliffs.
e.zh: 他们朝海岸方向走，直到来到悬崖边。

e.en: The river flows lazily {coastwards} through the valley.
e.zh: 那条河懒洋洋地穿过山谷流向海岸。

e.en: Small ships traded {coastways} between the harbours.
e.zh: 小型船只在各港口之间沿海岸航行贸易。

e.en: They sailed {coastways} rather than crossing open water.
e.zh: 他们沿海岸航行而不是横渡开阔水域。

e.en: The schooner ran {coastwise} between small fishing villages.
e.zh: 那艘纵帆船在沿海的小渔村之间往返。

e.en: {Coastwise} shipping declined after the railway opened.
e.zh: 铁路开通后，沿海航运便衰落了。

e.en: Hang your jacket on the {coat-hanger} by the door.
e.zh: 把外套挂在门边的衣架上。

e.en: She bent the {coat-hanger} to unlock the car.
e.zh: 她把衣架弄弯来打开车锁。

e.en: The child tugged at his father's {coat-tail}.
e.zh: 孩子拽着父亲的衣襟下摆。

e.en: Junior candidates rode in on the president's {coat-tail}.
e.zh: 低层候选人沾了总统的光当选。

e.en: She wore a tailored navy {coatdress} to the ceremony.
e.zh: 她穿着一件剪裁合体的海军蓝大衣式连衣裙出席典礼。

e.en: The {coatdress} buttoned all the way down the front.
e.zh: 这件大衣式连衣裙从前面一直扣到底。

e.en: The soldier's red {coatee} was trimmed with brass buttons.
e.zh: 士兵的红色短军服上缀着铜扣。

e.en: She put a knitted {coatee} on the baby.
e.zh: 她给婴儿穿上一件针织小外套。

e.en: A curious {coati} sniffed around our picnic table.
e.zh: 一只好奇的长鼻浣熊在我们的野餐桌旁嗅来嗅去。

e.en: The {coati} uses its long snout to find insects.
e.zh: 长鼻浣熊用它长长的鼻子寻找昆虫。

e.en: A {coatimundi} climbed the tree in search of fruit.
e.zh: 一只长鼻浣熊爬上树寻找果实。

e.en: Visitors photographed the friendly {coatimundi} at the lodge.
e.zh: 游客们在山间小屋拍下了那只温顺的长鼻浣熊。

e.en: A band of {coatis} rummaged through the campsite.
e.zh: 一群长鼻浣熊在营地里翻找食物。

e.en: Female {coatis} usually travel in noisy groups.
e.zh: 雌性长鼻浣熊通常成群结队地行动，吵闹不已。

e.en: She agreed to {coauthor} the textbook with her mentor.
e.zh: 她同意与导师合著这本教科书。

e.en: The paper has three {coauthors} from different universities.
e.zh: 这篇论文有三位来自不同大学的合著者。

e.en: The two circles are {coaxal} about the same line.
e.zh: 这两个圆相对于同一条直线是同轴的。

e.en: Engineers used a {coaxal} cable to reduce interference.
e.zh: 工程师使用同轴电缆来减少干扰。

e.en: The machinist checked the {coaxality} of the two shafts.
e.zh: 机械师检查了两根轴的同轴性。

e.en: Poor {coaxality} caused excessive vibration in the motor.
e.zh: 同轴性差导致电机产生过度振动。

e.en: She painted the door a deep {cobalt-blue}.
e.zh: 她把门漆成深钴蓝色。

e.en: The vase had an exquisite {cobalt-blue} glaze.
e.zh: 这只花瓶有一层精美的钴蓝色釉。

e.en: Werner's study of {cobaltammines} founded coordination chemistry.
e.zh: 维尔纳对钴胺络合物的研究奠定了配位化学。

e.en: Many {cobaltammines} display vivid colours in solution.
e.zh: 许多钴胺络合物在溶液中呈现鲜艳的颜色。

e.en: The reaction produced a stable {cobaltic} complex.
e.zh: 反应生成了一种稳定的三价钴络合物。

e.en: {Cobaltic} oxide appears as a black powder.
e.zh: 三氧化二钴呈现为黑色粉末。

e.en: Geologists located a {cobaltiferous} ore body in the hills.
e.zh: 地质学家在山中发现了一处含钴矿体。

e.en: The mine processes {cobaltiferous} rock for battery metals.
e.zh: 该矿山处理含钴岩石以提取电池金属。

e.en: Sodium {cobaltinitrite} is used to test for potassium ions.
e.zh: 亚硝酸钴钠用于检测钾离子。

e.en: The yellow precipitate is a potassium {cobaltinitrite}.
e.zh: 那种黄色沉淀是亚硝酸钴钾。

e.en: {Cobaltite} is a primary ore of the metal cobalt.
e.zh: 辉钴矿是钴金属的主要矿石。

e.en: The miners extracted gleaming crystals of {cobaltite}.
e.zh: 矿工们采出了闪闪发光的辉钴矿晶体。

e.en: {Cobaltous} chloride turns pink when it absorbs water.
e.zh: 二氯化钴吸水后会变成粉红色。

e.en: The solution contained {cobaltous} ions in trace amounts.
e.zh: 溶液中含有微量的二价钴离子。

cobbers.t: 伙伴；好友（澳大利亚俚语，复数）

e.en: His old {cobbers} from school dropped by for a beer.
e.zh: 他从学校时代的老伙计们顺道过来喝啤酒。

e.en: The two {cobbers} had been mates since childhood.
e.zh: 这两个老伙伴从小就是好朋友。

cobby.t: 矮壮的；短粗结实的（尤指马）

e.en: The pony was a sturdy, {cobby} little animal.
e.zh: 那匹小马是只结实矮壮的小家伙。

e.en: Welsh ponies tend to have a {cobby} build.
e.zh: 威尔士小马通常体格矮壮结实。

e.en: The treaty formalised their {cobelligerence} against the invader.
e.zh: 该条约正式确认了他们共同对抗侵略者的交战状态。

e.en: Historians debate the precise terms of their {cobelligerence}.
e.zh: 史学家们对他们共同交战的具体条款仍有争议。

cobelligerent.t: 共同交战的；共同交战国

e.en: Italy became a {cobelligerent} on the Allied side in 1943.
e.zh: 意大利于1943年成为同盟国一方的共同交战国。

e.en: The two nations signed a {cobelligerent} agreement.
e.zh: 两国签署了一项共同交战协议。

e.en: An old fisherman launched his {coble} from the beach.
e.zh: 一位老渔民从海滩上推下他的平底渔船。

e.en: The {coble} bobbed in the choppy North Sea waves.
e.zh: 那艘平底渔船在波涛汹涌的北海中起伏摇摆。

e.en: She cracked a {cobnut} with her teeth.
e.zh: 她用牙咬开了一颗榛果。

e.en: The hedgerow was full of ripe {cobnut} clusters.
e.zh: 树篱上挂满了成熟的榛果串。

cocain.t: 可卡因（古柯碱的旧拼写）

e.en: The novel mentions {cocain} using an older spelling.
e.zh: 这部小说用旧拼写提到了可卡因。

e.en: Old medical texts list {cocain} as an anesthetic.
e.zh: 旧医学文献把可卡因列为麻醉剂。

cocainise.t: 用可卡因麻醉；使可卡因化

e.en: The dentist would {cocainise} the gum before extraction.
e.zh: 拔牙前牙医会用可卡因麻醉牙龈。

e.en: Surgeons used to {cocainise} the eye for minor operations.
e.zh: 外科医生过去会用可卡因麻醉眼部以做小手术。

e.en: Early psychiatrists wrote about chronic {cocainism}.
e.zh: 早期精神病学家撰文论述慢性可卡因瘾。

e.en: His {cocainism} eventually destroyed his career.
e.zh: 他的可卡因瘾最终毁掉了他的事业。

e.en: The clinic specialised in treating {cocainist} patients.
e.zh: 这家诊所专门治疗可卡因成瘾者。

e.en: He was described in court as a confirmed {cocainist}.
e.zh: 法庭上他被描述为积习难改的可卡因瘾君子。

e.en: Local {cocainization} was once standard in eye surgery.
e.zh: 局部可卡因麻醉曾是眼科手术的常规做法。

e.en: The textbook describes the steps of {cocainization}.
e.zh: 教科书描述了可卡因麻醉的步骤。

e.en: The surgeon will {cocainize} the area first.
e.zh: 外科医生会先用可卡因麻醉这块部位。

e.en: They {cocainize} the cornea before the procedure.
e.zh: 手术前他们会用可卡因麻醉角膜。

e.en: The {cocainized} tissue felt completely numb.
e.zh: 经可卡因麻醉的组织完全没有知觉。

e.en: He examined the {cocainized} patient calmly.
e.zh: 他平静地检查了这位用过可卡因麻醉的病人。

cocainizes.t: 用可卡因麻醉（第三人称单数）

e.en: He routinely {cocainizes} the throat before scoping.
e.zh: 他在内镜检查前例行用可卡因麻醉咽喉。

e.en: The doctor {cocainizes} the eye for a moment.
e.zh: 医生短暂地用可卡因麻醉眼部。

e.en: She is {cocainizing} the gum right now.
e.zh: 她正在用可卡因麻醉牙龈。

e.en: The nurse watched him {cocainizing} the patient's nostril.
e.zh: 护士看着他给病人鼻孔做可卡因麻醉。

e.en: The vitamin acts as {cocarboxylase} in the cell.
e.zh: 这种维生素在细胞内起辅羧化酶的作用。

e.en: Doctors prescribed {cocarboxylase} for his metabolic disorder.
e.zh: 医生给他开了辅羧化酶来治代谢紊乱。

e.en: Tobacco smoke contains many a {cocarcinogen}.
e.zh: 烟草烟雾中含有不少协同致癌物。

e.en: Researchers identified the chemical as a {cocarcinogen}.
e.zh: 研究人员认定这种化学物质是协同致癌物。

e.en: The orchard was infested with a destructive {coccid}.
e.zh: 果园里爬满了破坏性极强的介壳虫。

e.en: Entomologists study how a {coccid} feeds on plant sap.
e.zh: 昆虫学家研究介壳虫如何吸食植物汁液。

e.en: The puppies were diagnosed with intestinal {coccidia}.
e.zh: 幼犬被诊断为肠道感染球虫。

e.en: Farmers add medication to feed to control {coccidia}.
e.zh: 农民在饲料中添加药物以防治球虫。

e.en: The vet identified a {coccidian} parasite in the sample.
e.zh: 兽医在样本中鉴定出一种球虫寄生虫。

e.en: This {coccidian} infection mainly affects young animals.
e.zh: 这种球虫感染主要影响幼年动物。

e.en: Desert workers risk catching {coccidioidomycosis}.
e.zh: 沙漠地区的工人有感染球孢子菌病的风险。

e.en: She was hospitalised with severe {coccidioidomycosis}.
e.zh: 她因严重的球孢子菌病住院。

e.en: The feed contained a low-dose {coccidiostat}.
e.zh: 饲料中含有低剂量的抗球虫药。

e.en: Farmers rotate each {coccidiostat} to prevent resistance.
e.zh: 农民会轮换使用各种抗球虫药以防耐药。

e.en: A single {coccidium} can multiply rapidly in the gut.
e.zh: 一个球虫便可在肠道内迅速繁殖。

e.en: The lab isolated one {coccidium} for study.
e.zh: 实验室分离出一个球虫用于研究。

e.en: He devoted his career to {coccidology}.
e.zh: 他将毕生精力投入介壳虫学的研究。

e.en: Few universities still teach {coccidology}.
e.zh: 如今很少有大学还开设介壳虫学。

e.en: The botanist described the petals as {coccineous}.
e.zh: 植物学家将花瓣描述为猩红色。

e.en: A {coccineous} dye was extracted from the insects.
e.zh: 从这些昆虫中提取出了一种猩红色染料。

e.en: The bacteria appeared {coccoid} under magnification.
e.zh: 放大后这种细菌呈球状。

e.en: Some algae take a {coccoid} form.
e.zh: 某些藻类呈球状形态。

e.en: Each {coccolith} is only a few microns wide.
e.zh: 每片颗石仅有几微米宽。

e.en: Chalk cliffs are built from countless a {coccolith}.
e.zh: 白垩崖是由无数颗石堆积而成。

e.en: She suffered sharp {coccygeal} pain after the fall.
e.zh: 摔倒后她感到剧烈的尾骨疼痛。

e.en: The doctor examined her {coccygeal} region carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了她的尾骨区域。

e.en: The skeletons displayed clearly visible {coccyges}.
e.zh: 骨架上的尾骨清晰可见。

e.en: Anatomists compared the {coccyges} of different primates.
e.zh: 解剖学家比较了不同灵长类的尾骨。

e.en: She was asked to {cochair} the committee.
e.zh: 她受邀共同主持该委员会。

e.en: The two senators will {cochair} the panel.
e.zh: 两位参议员将联合主持这个小组。

e.en: He served as {cochairman} of the fundraising drive.
e.zh: 他担任了募款活动的联合主席。

e.en: The board appointed a new {cochairman} last week.
e.zh: 董事会上周任命了新的联合主席。

e.en: The two {cochairmen} opened the meeting together.
e.zh: 两位联合主席共同宣布会议开始。

e.en: Both {cochairmen} signed the final report.
e.zh: 两位联合主席都在最终报告上签了字。

cochin.t: 九斤黄鸡（一种大型亚洲鸡）

e.en: He raises a flock of fluffy {cochin} hens.
e.zh: 他养了一群毛茸茸的九斤黄母鸡。

e.en: The {cochin} is prized for its calm temperament.
e.zh: 九斤黄鸡因性情温顺而备受青睐。

e.en: The scan imaged both {cochleae} in detail.
e.zh: 扫描详尽呈现了双侧耳蜗的图像。

e.en: Damage to the {cochleae} caused profound deafness.
e.zh: 耳蜗受损导致了重度耳聋。

e.en: The shell had a distinctly {cochleate} shape.
e.zh: 这个贝壳呈明显的螺旋蜗壳状。

e.en: Botanists noted the {cochleate} arrangement of the leaves.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到叶片呈螺旋状排列。

e.en: The artist carved a {cochleated} pattern into the wood.
e.zh: 艺术家在木头上雕出了螺旋花纹。

e.en: The fossil's {cochleated} structure was well preserved.
e.zh: 化石的螺旋结构保存得很好。

e.en: They will {cochromatograph} the sample with a known standard.
e.zh: 他们会把样品与已知标样进行共色谱分析。

e.en: The two compounds {cochromatograph} at the same retention time.
e.zh: 两种化合物在同一保留时间共色谱出峰。

e.en: They confirmed the identity by {cochromatography}.
e.zh: 他们通过共色谱法确认了化合物的身份。

e.en: {Cochromatography} is a quick way to compare two samples.
e.zh: 共色谱法是比较两个样品的快捷方法。

e.en: The rooster's loud {cock-a-doodle-doo} woke us up.
e.zh: 公鸡响亮的喔喔叫把我们吵醒了。

e.en: Children love to imitate a {cock-a-doodle-doo}.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢模仿公鸡的喔喔叫。

e.en: At dawn the yard echoed with {cock-a-doodle-doos}.
e.zh: 黎明时分院子里回荡着此起彼伏的公鸡叫声。

e.en: Several {cock-a-doodle-doos} announced the start of the day.
e.zh: 几声公鸡的啼叫宣告了一天的开始。

cock-a-hoop.t: 得意洋洋的；兴高采烈的

e.en: He was {cock-a-hoop} after winning the prize.
e.zh: 得奖后他得意洋洋。

e.en: The fans were {cock-a-hoop} about the victory.
e.zh: 球迷们因这场胜利而欢欣鼓舞。

cock-a-leekie.t: 鸡肉韭葱汤（苏格兰传统菜）

e.en: Granny served {cock-a-leekie} on cold winter nights.
e.zh: 奶奶在寒冷的冬夜端上鸡肉韭葱汤。

e.en: The pub menu featured a hearty {cock-a-leekie}.
e.zh: 酒吧菜单上有一道丰盛的鸡肉韭葱汤。

cock-and-bull.t: 荒诞不经的；无稽的（故事）

e.en: He told some {cock-and-bull} story about losing his wallet.
e.zh: 他编了个钱包丢了的无稽故事。

e.en: Don't give me that {cock-and-bull} excuse again.
e.zh: 别再给我那种荒唐的借口了。

cock-eyed.t: 歪斜的；荒谬的；不切实际的

e.en: He has some {cock-eyed} scheme to get rich quick.
e.zh: 他有个一夜暴富的荒唐计划。

e.en: The picture is hanging all {cock-eyed}.
e.zh: 这幅画挂得歪歪斜斜的。

e.en: A series of {cock-ups} delayed the launch.
e.zh: 一连串的乱子推迟了发布。

e.en: He's responsible for some pretty embarrassing {cock-ups}.
e.zh: 他闯过几次相当难堪的祸。

e.en: Children scooped {cockabully} from the stream.
e.zh: 孩子们从溪里捞小淡水鱼。

e.en: The {cockabully} darted under a rock.
e.zh: 那条小鱼窜到石头下面去了。

e.en: He wore a tricolor {cockade} on his hat.
e.zh: 他帽子上别着三色帽徽。

e.en: The soldier's {cockade} marked his regiment.
e.zh: 士兵的帽徽标明了他的团。

cockaleekie.t: 鸡肉韭葱汤（苏格兰传统菜）

e.en: She simmered a pot of {cockaleekie} all afternoon.
e.zh: 她炖了一下午的鸡肉韭葱汤。

e.en: {Cockaleekie} is a classic Scottish soup.
e.zh: 鸡肉韭葱汤是经典的苏格兰汤。

e.en: That little {cockalorum} thinks he runs the office.
e.zh: 那个自负的小人物以为办公室是他管的。

e.en: He strutted about like a pompous {cockalorum}.
e.zh: 他像个自命不凡的小角色四处昂首阔步。

cockamamie.t: 荒唐的；可笑的；不靠谱的

e.en: He came up with another {cockamamie} idea.
e.zh: 他又想出一个荒唐的主意。

e.en: Don't waste time on her {cockamamie} plan.
e.zh: 别在她那不靠谱的计划上浪费时间。

cockamamy.t: 荒唐的；可笑的（cockamamie 异体）

e.en: Stop telling me these {cockamamy} excuses.
e.zh: 别再跟我讲这些荒唐的借口了。

e.en: What a {cockamamy} way to fix the sink.
e.zh: 修水槽的方法真是荒谬。

e.en: Her pet {cockateel} whistles every morning.
e.zh: 她养的玄凤鹦鹉每天早晨吹口哨。

e.en: The {cockateel} perched on his shoulder.
e.zh: 那只玄凤鹦鹉栖在他肩上。

cockatrice.t: 鸡蛇怪（神话中目光致命的怪物）

e.en: Legend says the {cockatrice} could kill with a glance.
e.zh: 传说鸡蛇怪一眼就能把人杀死。

e.en: A {cockatrice} appears on the family crest.
e.zh: 家族纹章上有一只鸡蛇怪。

e.en: They rowed ashore in a tiny {cockboat}.
e.zh: 他们划着一只小艇上了岸。

e.en: The {cockboat} bobbed beside the ship.
e.zh: 小艇在大船旁起伏。

cockchafer.t: 五月鳃角金龟；棕色大甲虫

e.en: A {cockchafer} bumped against the window at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时一只大甲虫撞上了窗户。

e.en: {Cockchafer} grubs damage the lawn roots.
e.zh: 金龟子幼虫会破坏草坪根系。

e.en: The farmers were already in the fields by {cockcrow}.
e.zh: 鸡叫时分农民们已经下地了。

e.en: They set off at {cockcrow} to beat the heat.
e.zh: 为避暑他们破晓时分就出发了。

e.en: The village stirred at {cockcrowing}.
e.zh: 鸡叫时分村子开始苏醒。

e.en: He woke before {cockcrowing} to start baking.
e.zh: 他鸡鸣前就起床烤面包。

e.en: The old sailor had a famous {cockeye}.
e.zh: 那老水手有一只出名的斜眼。

e.en: He squinted at me with his {cockeye}.
e.zh: 他用那只斜眼眯着看我。

e.en: The toddler rode his wooden {cockhorse} around the room.
e.zh: 小娃娃骑着木马在屋里转。

e.en: "Ride a {cockhorse} to Banbury Cross" is a nursery rhyme.
e.zh: 《骑木马去班伯里十字》是首童谣。

e.en: He grinned {cockily} at the camera.
e.zh: 他对着镜头狂妄地咧嘴一笑。

e.en: She answered {cockily}, sure she'd win.
e.zh: 她自信满满地狂答，确信会赢。

e.en: A {cockle-bur} stuck to my sock during the hike.
e.zh: 远足时一颗苍耳粘在了我袜子上。

e.en: The dog's fur was full of {cockle-bur}.
e.zh: 狗毛上沾满了苍耳。

e.en: A narrow {cockle-stair} wound up the tower.
e.zh: 一段狭窄的螺旋楼梯通向塔顶。

e.en: They climbed the wooden {cockle-stair} to the attic.
e.zh: 他们沿木制螺旋梯上到阁楼。

e.en: He drifted out in a battered {cockleboat}.
e.zh: 他坐着一只破舢板漂了出去。

e.en: The fisherman tied his {cockleboat} to the dock.
e.zh: 渔民把小艇拴在码头。

e.en: {Cocklebur} clings stubbornly to clothing.
e.zh: 苍耳会顽固地粘在衣服上。

e.en: Cattle avoid the patch full of {cocklebur}.
e.zh: 牛会避开长满苍耳的那片地。

e.en: She collected a pretty pink {cockleshell}.
e.zh: 她捡到一只漂亮的粉色贝壳。

e.en: Their boat was a mere {cockleshell} on the open sea.
e.zh: 他们的船在大海上不过是片小舢板。

e.en: The beach was strewn with {cockleshells}.
e.zh: 海滩上散落着鸟蛤壳。

e.en: She decorated the box with painted {cockleshells}.
e.zh: 她用画过的小贝壳装饰盒子。

e.en: The tower's {cocklestairs} creaked with every step.
e.zh: 塔里的螺旋楼梯每走一步都嘎吱作响。

e.en: They descended the cramped {cocklestairs} carefully.
e.zh: 他们小心地走下狭窄的螺旋楼梯。

cockloft.t: 小阁楼；屋顶下的小空间

e.en: He stored old letters in the dusty {cockloft}.
e.zh: 他把旧信存在落满灰的小阁楼里。

e.en: A ladder led up to the cramped {cockloft}.
e.zh: 一架梯子通往那个狭小的阁楼。

cockneydom.t: 伦敦土著区；伦敦腔的世界

e.en: The novel celebrates the lively world of {cockneydom}.
e.zh: 小说颂扬伦敦土著生活的鲜活世界。

e.en: He grew up immersed in {cockneydom}.
e.zh: 他在伦敦土著文化中长大。

e.en: The actor mastered a thick {cockneyese}.
e.zh: 那演员练就了一口浓重的伦敦土腔。

e.en: He greeted us in cheerful {cockneyese}.
e.zh: 他用欢快的伦敦土腔招呼我们。

e.en: The director tried to {cockneyfy} the dialogue.
e.zh: 导演试图把对白伦敦化。

e.en: Don't {cockneyfy} every London character you write.
e.zh: 别把你笔下每个伦敦角色都伦敦腔化。

cockneyish.t: 带伦敦土腔的；考克尼味的

e.en: Her accent had a faintly {cockneyish} lilt.
e.zh: 她的口音带着一丝伦敦土腔的韵味。

e.en: The pub had a charming {cockneyish} atmosphere.
e.zh: 酒吧有一种迷人的伦敦土著气氛。

cockneyism.t: 伦敦土腔特征；伦敦土话用语

e.en: His speech was peppered with {cockneyism}.
e.zh: 他的话里夹杂着伦敦土腔用语。

e.en: The teacher noted every {cockneyism} on the page.
e.zh: 老师把页面上每处伦敦土话都标了出来。

e.en: The rooster's red {cockscomb} stood up proudly.
e.zh: 公鸡红色的鸡冠骄傲地竖着。

e.en: She planted a row of bright {cockscomb} in the garden.
e.zh: 她在花园里种了一排鲜艳的鸡冠花。

e.en: The roosters' {cockscombs} flopped as they ran.
e.zh: 公鸡们跑起来时鸡冠一颠一颠的。

e.en: Velvety {cockscombs} bloomed along the path.
e.zh: 绒绒的鸡冠花沿小径开放。

e.en: The pasture was thick with {cocksfoot}.
e.zh: 牧场上长满了鸭茅草。

e.en: Farmers sow {cocksfoot} for hay.
e.zh: 农民播种鸭茅用来做干草。

cockshot.t: 投掷标靶游戏；被嘲弄的对象

e.en: At the fair, kids lined up for a {cockshot}.
e.zh: 集市上孩子们排队玩投掷标靶游戏。

e.en: He became a {cockshot} for the whole village's jokes.
e.zh: 他成了全村人取笑的对象。

e.en: They returned home at {cockshut}.
e.zh: 他们在黄昏时回到家。

e.en: Lamps were lit by {cockshut}.
e.zh: 傍晚时分灯都点起来了。

e.en: The coconut {cockshy} drew a long queue.
e.zh: 投椰子游戏前排起了长队。

e.en: His latest book became a {cockshy} for critics.
e.zh: 他的新书成了评论家的攻击靶子。

e.en: The rooster's sharp {cockspur} drew blood.
e.zh: 公鸡尖锐的距把人划出了血。

e.en: A {cockspur} hawthorn grew by the gate.
e.zh: 门旁长着一棵山楂树。

e.en: The {cockswain} steered the lifeboat through heavy waves.
e.zh: 舵手驾着救生艇穿过大浪。

e.en: As {cockswain}, she shouted commands to the rowers.
e.zh: 作为舵手，她对桨手们喊出口令。

e.en: The schedule was a complete {cockup}.
e.zh: 排程彻底乱套了。

e.en: That email was a major {cockup} on his part.
e.zh: 那封邮件是他犯的大错。

e.en: The rally team's {codriver} read out pace notes.
e.zh: 拉力赛车队的副驾驶大声念出路线笔记。

e.en: She served as my {codriver} on the long road trip.
e.zh: 长途旅行中她担任我的副驾驶。

e.en: That theory is absolute {codswallop}.
e.zh: 那套理论纯属胡说八道。

e.en: Don't talk such {codswallop} in front of the children.
e.zh: 别在孩子面前讲这种废话。

e.en: Two scholars {coedit} the journal each year.
e.zh: 两位学者每年共同编辑该期刊。

e.en: They agreed to {coedit} the anthology of essays.
e.zh: 他们同意合编这本散文集。

e.en: The book appeared as a Franco-British {coedition}.
e.zh: 这本书以英法合作出版的形式问世。

e.en: Publishers often share costs through a {coedition}.
e.zh: 出版商常通过合版本分担成本。

e.en: She is the {coeditor} of the new linguistics handbook.
e.zh: 她是这本新语言学手册的共同编辑。

e.en: My {coeditor} handles all the figures and tables.
e.zh: 我的合编者负责所有的图表。

e.en: The school began to {coeducate} boys and girls in 1970.
e.zh: 该校于1970年开始男女同校教学。

e.en: Many colleges chose to {coeducate} after the reforms.
e.zh: 许多学院在改革后选择男女同校。

e.en: The fort fired a {coehorn} during the siege.
e.zh: 要塞在围攻中发射了一门小型臼炮。

e.en: A {coehorn} was light enough for two soldiers to carry.
e.zh: 柯霍恩臼炮轻得两名士兵就能搬动。

e.en: A jellyfish is a typical {coelenterate}.
e.zh: 水母是典型的腔肠动物。

e.en: The textbook describes {coelenterate} body structures.
e.zh: 教科书介绍了腔肠动物的身体结构。

e.en: Food enters the {coelenteron} through a single opening.
e.zh: 食物通过单一开口进入腔肠。

e.en: The {coelenteron} acts as a primitive gut.
e.zh: 腔肠起着原始肠道的作用。

e.en: The surgeon inserted a {coelioscope} to inspect the abdomen.
e.zh: 外科医生插入腹腔镜检查腹部。

e.en: A {coelioscope} allows minimally invasive examination.
e.zh: 腹腔镜可进行微创检查。

e.en: Earthworms have a true {coelom} lined with mesoderm.
e.zh: 蚯蚓拥有由中胚层衬里的真体腔。

e.en: The fluid in the {coelom} cushions internal organs.
e.zh: 体腔内的液体起到缓冲内脏的作用。

e.en: Mammals are classified as {coelomate} animals.
e.zh: 哺乳动物被归为体腔动物。

e.en: A {coelomate} body plan allows greater organ complexity.
e.zh: 具真体腔的身体构造允许更复杂的器官发育。

e.en: The biologist studied {coelomatic} fluid samples.
e.zh: 生物学家研究了体腔液样本。

e.en: {Coelomatic} cavities differ across phyla.
e.zh: 不同门类的体腔构造各不相同。

e.en: Older texts spell the cavity as {coelome}.
e.zh: 较旧的文献把这个腔写作 coelome。

e.en: The {coelome} forms during early embryonic development.
e.zh: 体腔在胚胎早期发育中形成。

e.en: Different invertebrates have differently shaped {coeloms}.
e.zh: 不同的无脊椎动物有形状各异的体腔。

e.en: The diagram compares the {coeloms} of three species.
e.zh: 图示比较了三种物种的体腔。

e.en: Astronomers used a {coelostat} to track the sun.
e.zh: 天文学家用定天镜追踪太阳。

e.en: The {coelostat} keeps the stellar image fixed.
e.zh: 定天镜使恒星影像保持固定。

coeluted.t: 共洗脱（色谱中同时被洗脱）

e.en: The two compounds {coeluted} on the column.
e.zh: 这两种化合物在色谱柱上共洗脱。

e.en: Impurities {coeluted} with the target peak.
e.zh: 杂质与目标峰一同被洗脱。

e.en: Caffeine {coelutes} with this minor metabolite.
e.zh: 咖啡因与这种次要代谢物共洗脱。

e.en: If a contaminant {coelutes}, quantification becomes hard.
e.zh: 如果污染物共洗脱，定量就会变得困难。

e.en: Roman law recognised marriage by {coemption}.
e.zh: 罗马法承认通过共同购买结成的婚姻。

e.en: Merchants engaged in {coemption} to corner the market.
e.zh: 商人通过垄断收购来操控市场。

e.en: Pilgrims visit the {coenacle} on Mount Zion.
e.zh: 朝圣者参观锡安山上的最后晚餐厅。

e.en: The painting depicts the {coenacle} scene.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了最后晚餐的场景。

e.en: Coral polyps are connected by {coenenchyma}.
e.zh: 珊瑚虫由共肉组织相连。

e.en: The {coenenchyma} contains shared digestive canals.
e.zh: 共肉组织内含有共用的消化管道。

e.en: Doctors discussed disturbances of {coenesthesia}.
e.zh: 医生讨论了共同感觉的紊乱。

e.en: {Coenesthesia} gives a person a general sense of bodily wellbeing.
e.zh: 共同感觉让人有总体的身体感受。

coenesthesis.t: 共同感觉；身体总体感觉

e.en: Philosophers once described {coenesthesis} as inner sense.
e.zh: 哲学家曾把共同感觉描述为内在感觉。

e.en: Loss of {coenesthesis} can signal neurological illness.
e.zh: 共同感觉缺失可能提示神经系统疾病。

coenobite.t: 修道院修士；集体修行者

e.en: He lived as a {coenobite} in the desert monastery.
e.zh: 他在沙漠修道院里过着集体修士的生活。

e.en: Each {coenobite} shared meals with the community.
e.zh: 每位修士都与团体一同用餐。

e.en: They followed a strict {coenobitic} rule.
e.zh: 他们遵守严格的集体修道戒律。

e.en: {Coenobitic} life emphasises shared prayer and labour.
e.zh: 集体修道生活强调共同祈祷与劳作。

coenobitical.t: 集体修道的；修道团体的

e.en: The abbey kept its {coenobitical} traditions for centuries.
e.zh: 修道院数百年来保持着集体修道传统。

e.en: He wrote a treatise on {coenobitical} discipline.
e.zh: 他写了一本关于集体修道纪律的论著。

e.en: Egyptian {coenobitism} shaped early Christian monasticism.
e.zh: 埃及的集体修道制度塑造了早期基督教修道主义。

e.en: Scholars trace {coenobitism} back to Saint Pachomius.
e.zh: 学者将集体修道制度追溯至圣帕科缪斯。

e.en: Monks gathered each evening in the {coenobium}.
e.zh: 修士们每晚聚集在集体修道院里。

e.en: Volvox forms a hollow spherical {coenobium}.
e.zh: 团藻形成中空的球形群体。

e.en: Ecologists mapped the {coenocline} along the slope.
e.zh: 生态学家沿坡面绘制了群落梯度。

e.en: A {coenocline} reflects gradual community change.
e.zh: 群落梯度反映了群落的渐变。

e.en: Some fungi form a multinucleate {coenocyte}.
e.zh: 有些真菌形成多核体。

e.en: A {coenocyte} contains many nuclei in shared cytoplasm.
e.zh: 多核体在共有的细胞质中含有许多细胞核。

e.en: The textbook compared various fungal {coenocytia}.
e.zh: 教科书比较了各种真菌的多核体。

e.en: Algal {coenocytia} can grow to remarkable sizes.
e.zh: 藻类多核体可以长得非常大。

e.en: The hyphae are {coenocytic} and lack septa.
e.zh: 这些菌丝是多核体的，没有隔膜。

e.en: {Coenocytic} algae have many nuclei per cell.
e.zh: 多核体藻类每个细胞含多个细胞核。

e.en: The biologist explained {coenogenesis} in larval stages.
e.zh: 生物学家解释了幼虫阶段的新性发生。

e.en: {Coenogenesis} adds adaptive features during development.
e.zh: 新性发生在发育过程中加入适应性特征。

e.en: Some larval traits are {coenogenetic} adaptations.
e.zh: 一些幼虫特征是新性发生的适应性表现。

e.en: He distinguished palingenetic from {coenogenetic} features.
e.zh: 他将原始重演特征与新性发生特征区分开来。

e.en: The {coenosarc} connects the polyps of the colony.
e.zh: 共肉茎连接着群体中的珊瑚虫。

e.en: Nutrients flow through the {coenosarc} to all polyps.
e.zh: 养分通过共肉茎流向所有珊瑚虫。

e.en: Certain fungi develop from a {coenozygote}.
e.zh: 某些真菌由多核合子发育而成。

e.en: A {coenozygote} contains multiple fused nuclei.
e.zh: 多核合子包含多个融合的细胞核。

e.en: Sheep can be infected by a {coenurus} larva.
e.zh: 绵羊可能被多头蚴幼虫感染。

e.en: The {coenurus} forms a fluid-filled bladder in the brain.
e.zh: 多头蚴在脑中形成充满液体的囊泡。

e.en: The reaction proceeds {coenzymatically} in the presence of NAD+.
e.zh: 该反应在NAD+存在下以辅酶方式进行。

e.en: These enzymes function {coenzymatically} with vitamin B6.
e.zh: 这些酶与维生素B6以辅酶形式协同发挥作用。

e.en: The two branches of government are {coequal} partners.
e.zh: 政府的两个分支是地位平等的伙伴。

e.en: She was treated as a {coequal} member of the team.
e.zh: 她被视为团队中地位平等的一员。

e.en: They argued for the {coequality} of all citizens before the law.
e.zh: 他们主张所有公民在法律面前一律平等。

e.en: The treaty affirmed the {coequality} of the two nations.
e.zh: 该条约确认了两国的平等地位。

e.en: Both authors contributed {coequally} to the book.
e.zh: 两位作者对本书做出了同等的贡献。

e.en: Resources should be shared {coequally} among the partners.
e.zh: 资源应在合作伙伴之间平等共享。

e.en: The regime relied on {coercionary} measures to keep order.
e.zh: 该政权依靠强制手段维持秩序。

e.en: Critics decried the {coercionary} tone of the new policy.
e.zh: 批评人士谴责了新政策的强制性口吻。

e.en: He was branded a {coercionist} for backing the harsh laws.
e.zh: 他因支持严苛法律被斥为强制论者。

e.en: The {coercionist} faction won the parliamentary vote.
e.zh: 主张强制的派别赢得了议会投票。

e.en: The alloy has a high magnetic {coercivity}.
e.zh: 这种合金具有很高的磁矫顽力。

e.en: Engineers measured the {coercivity} of the new material.
e.zh: 工程师测量了新材料的矫顽力。

e.en: The doctrine holds that the persons are {coessential}.
e.zh: 该教义认为这些位格本质相同。

e.en: Freedom and responsibility are {coessential} ideas.
e.zh: 自由与责任是本质相同的概念。

e.en: Theologians debated the {coessentiality} of the Father and Son.
e.zh: 神学家辩论圣父与圣子的本质同一性。

e.en: He stressed the {coessentiality} of liberty and law.
e.zh: 他强调自由与法律的本质同一性。

e.en: The {coestablishment} of the lab involved two universities.
e.zh: 该实验室由两所大学联合设立。

e.en: They announced the {coestablishment} of a joint fund.
e.zh: 他们宣布共同设立一项联合基金。

e.en: The two writers were {coetaneous} but never met.
e.zh: 这两位作家是同时代人，却从未谋面。

e.en: These rock layers are {coetaneous} in origin.
e.zh: 这些岩层在年代上是同期形成的。

e.en: The text describes the spirit and matter as {coeternal}.
e.zh: 该文本将精神与物质描述为共同永恒。

e.en: They believed the gods were {coeternal} with the universe.
e.zh: 他们相信诸神与宇宙共同永恒。

e.en: The doctrine asserts the {coeternity} of the divine persons.
e.zh: 该教义主张神圣位格的共同永恒性。

e.en: Philosophers questioned the {coeternity} of mind and body.
