e.zh: 他的政治反击让所有人措手不及。

e.en: They fastened the panel with a {countersunkheadrivet}.
e.zh: 他们用埋头铆钉固定了面板。

e.en: Each {countersunkheadrivet} sits flush with the surface.
e.zh: 每颗埋头铆钉都与表面齐平。

e.en: The lab built a small {countertelescope} for testing.
e.zh: 实验室搭建了一架小型反向望远镜用于测试。

e.en: A {countertelescope} can verify the optical alignment.
e.zh: 反向望远镜可以校验光学对齐。

e.en: A clear {countertendency} emerged among younger voters.
e.zh: 年轻选民中出现了明显的反向趋势。

e.en: Economists noted a {countertendency} in housing prices.
e.zh: 经济学家注意到房价出现了反向趋势。

e.en: The unit specializes in {counterterror} operations.
e.zh: 该部队专门从事反恐行动。

e.en: {Counterterror} funding has doubled this year.
e.zh: 今年的反恐经费翻了一番。

e.en: He joined a {counterterrorist} task force.
e.zh: 他加入了一支反恐特遣队。

e.en: {Counterterrorist} drills are held every month.
e.zh: 反恐演习每月举行一次。

e.en: Their {counterthrust} broke the enemy's line.
e.zh: 他们的反击突破了敌军防线。

e.en: The pilot felt the {counterthrust} as the engines reversed.
e.zh: 飞行员感受到引擎反推时的反推力。

e.en: Swimmers struggled against a strong {countertide}.
e.zh: 游泳者奋力对抗强劲的逆潮流。

e.en: A political {countertide} swept the region.
e.zh: 一股政治逆潮席卷该地区。

e.en: The tail rotor provides {countertorque}.
e.zh: 尾旋翼提供反扭矩。

e.en: Without {countertorque}, the helicopter would spin out of control.
e.zh: 没有反扭矩，直升机就会失控自转。

e.en: The deal was structured as a {countertrade}.
e.zh: 该交易以对销贸易方式进行。

e.en: {Countertrade} is common in cash-poor markets.
e.zh: 在外汇短缺的市场，对销贸易十分常见。

e.en: The cell uses ion {countertransports} to maintain balance.
e.zh: 细胞通过离子反向运输来维持平衡。

e.en: Scientists tracked several {countertransports} in the membrane.
e.zh: 科学家追踪了细胞膜中几条反向运输路径。

e.en: Traders watch for any {countertrend} signal.
e.zh: 交易员密切留意任何反向趋势信号。

e.en: The data revealed a small {countertrend}.
e.zh: 数据揭示出一股小幅的反向趋势。

e.en: The device uses a thin glass {countertube}.
e.zh: 该装置使用一根细玻璃对置管。

e.en: Gas flows through the {countertube} in reverse.
e.zh: 气体在对置管中反向流动。

e.en: The plot took a sharp {counterturn} in chapter four.
e.zh: 情节在第四章出现急剧逆转。

e.en: He gave the wheel a quick {counterturn}.
e.zh: 他迅速反向打了一下方向盘。

e.en: In literature, the villain often serves as a {countertype} to the hero.
e.zh: 在文学中，反派常作为英雄的对立类型出现。

e.en: She represents the {countertype} of the gentle housewife.
e.zh: 她代表了温柔家庭主妇的对立类型。

e.en: Geologists mapped several {counterveins} below the deposit.
e.zh: 地质学家在矿床下方绘制了几条逆向矿脉。

e.en: The {counterveins} run perpendicular to the main lode.
e.zh: 这些逆向矿脉与主矿脉垂直。

e.en: He politely offered a {counterview}.
e.zh: 他礼貌地提出了相反观点。

e.en: The article presents a useful {counterview}.
e.zh: 这篇文章提供了一个有益的相反观点。

e.en: Activists warned that repression would breed {counterviolence}.
e.zh: 活动人士警告，压制只会滋生反向暴力。

e.en: The book examines cycles of violence and {counterviolence}.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了暴力与反向暴力的循环。

e.en: Their fears {counterweigh} any optimism in the data.
e.zh: 他们的担忧抵消了数据中的任何乐观因素。

e.en: Honest critique can {counterweigh} blind enthusiasm.
e.zh: 诚实的批评可以制衡盲目的热情。

e.en: "Thing" is a classic English {counterword}.
e.zh: "thing"是一个典型的英语泛义词。

e.en: Linguists track how a {counterword} loses its specific meaning.
e.zh: 语言学家研究泛义词如何失去其具体含义。

e.en: They built a {counterwork} to defend the gate.
e.zh: 他们修筑了对抗工事来防守城门。

e.en: Every move had its {counterwork}.
e.zh: 每一步行动都有对应的反制之举。

e.en: Every {countian} was invited to the fair.
e.zh: 全县居民都被邀请参加集市。

e.en: As a lifelong {countian}, he knew every back road.
e.zh: 作为本县土生土长的居民，他熟悉每条小路。

e.en: Scrooge sat alone in his cold {counting-house}.
e.zh: 斯克鲁奇独自坐在冰冷的账房里。

e.en: The merchant kept his ledgers in the {counting-house}.
e.zh: 商人在账房里保存账簿。

e.en: Clerks scratched away in the dim {countinghouse}.
e.zh: 职员们在昏暗的账房里埋头记账。

e.en: He inherited his father's {countinghouse}.
e.zh: 他继承了父亲的账房。

e.en: The boxer lost by {countout} in the third round.
e.zh: 那名拳手在第三回合因读秒判负。

e.en: A {countout} ended the match abruptly.
e.zh: 一次读秒判负使比赛戛然而止。

countrifled.t: 乡土化的；带乡村气息的

e.en: The kitchen had a charmingly {countrifled} look.
e.zh: 厨房带着一股迷人的乡村气息。

e.en: Years in the hills had {countrifled} his accent.
e.zh: 多年的山间生活让他的口音带上了乡音。

e.en: The designer wanted to {countrify} the apartment.
e.zh: 设计师想把公寓装出乡村风。

e.en: They tried to {countrify} the old townhouse with reclaimed wood.
e.zh: 他们用回收木料把老联排别墅改造成乡村风。

e.en: She grew up listening to {country-and-western} music.
e.zh: 她从小听着乡村西部音乐长大。

e.en: The bar plays {country-and-western} every Friday.
e.zh: 这家酒吧每周五播放乡村西部音乐。

e.en: He was a {country-born} lad with city dreams.
e.zh: 他是个乡下出生、心怀城市梦想的小伙子。

e.en: Many {country-born} workers moved to the factory towns.
e.zh: 许多乡下出生的工人迁往工厂城镇。

e.en: She had a frank, {country-bred} manner.
e.zh: 她举止坦率，带着乡村长大的味道。

e.en: {Country-bred} horses tend to be hardier.
e.zh: 乡村养大的马通常更耐劳。

e.en: They held the wedding at a {country-club}.
e.zh: 他们在乡村俱乐部举办了婚礼。

e.en: Membership at the {country-club} is expensive.
e.zh: 乡村俱乐部的会员费很贵。

e.en: The {crawler-crane} lifted the steel beam easily.
e.zh: 履带式起重机轻松吊起了钢梁。

e.en: They rented a {crawler-crane} for the bridge project.
e.zh: 他们为桥梁工程租了一台履带起重机。

crawlerway.t: 履带车通行道；火箭运输车道

e.en: The rocket moved slowly along the {crawlerway}.
e.zh: 火箭沿着运输车道缓缓前行。

e.en: NASA built a wide {crawlerway} to the launch pad.
e.zh: NASA修建了一条通往发射台的宽阔履带车道。

e.en: The miners squeezed through a tight {crawlway}.
e.zh: 矿工们挤过一条狭窄的爬行通道。

e.en: A low {crawlway} connected the two chambers.
e.zh: 一条低矮的爬行通道连接着两个洞室。

e.en: The {crayonist} sketched portraits at the fair.
e.zh: 这位蜡笔画家在集市上画肖像。

e.en: She is a talented {crayonist} known for vivid landscapes.
e.zh: 她是一位以鲜艳风景画闻名的蜡笔画家。

crazy-quilt.t: 杂色拼布被；杂乱拼凑物

e.en: Grandma made me a beautiful {crazy-quilt}.
e.zh: 奶奶给我做了一床漂亮的杂色拼布被。

e.en: The city is a {crazy-quilt} of old and new buildings.
e.zh: 这座城市是新旧建筑的杂乱拼凑。

e.en: Ranchers warn cattle away from {crazyweed}.
e.zh: 牧场主警告牛群远离疯草。

e.en: Horses that eat {crazyweed} can become very sick.
e.zh: 吃了疯草的马会病得很重。

e.en: The old stairs grow {creakier} every winter.
e.zh: 那些旧楼梯每个冬天都更吱嘎作响。

e.en: His knees are {creakier} than mine.
e.zh: 他的膝盖比我的更咯吱响。

e.en: That is the {creakiest} door in the house.
e.zh: 那是屋里最吱嘎响的门。

e.en: He sat in the {creakiest} chair on the porch.
e.zh: 他坐在门廊上最吱嘎响的椅子上。

creakily.t: 吱嘎作响地；嘎吱嘎吱地

e.en: The gate swung {creakily} in the wind.
e.zh: 大门在风中吱嘎作响地摇摆。

e.en: He climbed {creakily} out of bed.
e.zh: 他嘎吱嘎吱地爬下床。

e.en: The {creakiness} of the floorboards startled the cat.
e.zh: 地板的吱嘎声把猫吓了一跳。

e.en: I noticed a new {creakiness} in my joints.
e.zh: 我注意到关节有了新的咯吱声。

e.en: She bought a {cream-cake} for her birthday.
e.zh: 她为生日买了一个奶油蛋糕。

e.en: The bakery's {cream-cake} is always sold out by noon.
e.zh: 那家面包店的奶油蛋糕中午前总是售罄。

e.en: She wore a {cream-colored} dress to the wedding.
e.zh: 她穿着一条奶油色连衣裙去参加婚礼。

e.en: They painted the walls a soft {cream-colored} shade.
e.zh: 他们把墙刷成柔和的奶油色。

cream-coloured.t: 奶油色的；米白色的（英式拼写）

e.en: The horse had a beautiful {cream-coloured} coat.
e.zh: 那匹马有一身漂亮的奶油色毛。

e.en: He bought a {cream-coloured} sofa for the living room.
e.zh: 他给客厅买了一张奶油色沙发。

e.en: She wrote the letter on {cream-laid} stationery.
e.zh: 她用奶油色直纹信纸写了那封信。

e.en: The invitations were printed on {cream-laid} paper.
e.zh: 请柬印在奶油色直纹纸上。

e.en: He devoured the whole {creamcake} in minutes.
e.zh: 他几分钟就把整个奶油蛋糕吃完了。

e.en: A slice of {creamcake} sat on the plate.
e.zh: 盘子上放着一块奶油蛋糕。

e.en: The cat had soft {creamcolored} fur.
e.zh: 那只猫有着柔软的奶油色毛。

e.en: She chose {creamcolored} curtains for the bedroom.
e.zh: 她为卧室挑选了奶油色的窗帘。

e.en: {Creamcups} bloom across the meadow each spring.
e.zh: 每到春天，乳杯花开满整片草地。

e.en: She picked a bunch of {creamcups} along the trail.
e.zh: 她沿着小径采了一束乳杯花。

e.en: The soup poured {creamily} from the jug.
e.zh: 汤从壶里丝滑地倒出。

e.en: The sauce coated the pasta {creamily}.
e.zh: 酱汁奶油般裹住意面。

e.en: The dairy uses a {creamometer} to test milk.
e.zh: 乳品厂用乳脂计检测牛奶。

e.en: He read the fat content from the {creamometer}.
e.zh: 他从乳脂计上读取脂肪含量。

e.en: The book was printed on {creamwove} paper.
e.zh: 这本书印在奶油色细布纹纸上。

e.en: She prefers {creamwove} stationery for letters.
e.zh: 她写信偏爱用奶油色细布纹信纸。

e.en: He packed a {crease-resistant} shirt for the trip.
e.zh: 他为旅行带了一件防皱衬衫。

e.en: This fabric is treated to be {crease-resistant}.
e.zh: 这种面料经过处理具有抗皱性。

e.en: Her suit was {creaseless} after hours of travel.
e.zh: 经过数小时旅程，她的西装依旧平整无皱。

e.en: He prefers {creaseless} trousers for the office.
e.zh: 他在办公室喜欢穿无褶皱的长裤。

e.en: The fence posts were soaked in {creasote}.
e.zh: 围栏柱子浸过杂酚油。

e.en: You can smell the {creasote} on the old railroad ties.
e.zh: 你能闻到旧枕木上的木馏油味。

e.en: He pulled a {creasy} map from his pocket.
e.zh: 他从口袋里掏出一张满是折痕的地图。

e.en: Her shirt looked {creasy} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后她的衬衫显得满是褶皱。

e.en: Each user account is easily {creatable} online.
e.zh: 每个用户账号都可以在线轻松创建。

e.en: The folder is not {creatable} without admin rights.
e.zh: 没有管理员权限就无法创建该文件夹。

e.en: Old textbooks still spell it {creatin}.
e.zh: 旧教科书仍把它拼作creatin。

e.en: The chemist isolated {creatin} from muscle tissue.
e.zh: 化学家从肌肉组织中分离出了肌酸。

e.en: {Creatinase} catalyzes the breakdown of creatine.
e.zh: 肌酸酶催化肌酸的分解。

e.en: Researchers measured {creatinase} activity in the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了样本中的肌酸酶活性。

e.en: Many athletes take {creatine} to build muscle.
e.zh: 许多运动员服用肌酸来增肌。

e.en: He added {creatine} powder to his shake.
e.zh: 他在奶昔里加了肌酸粉。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {creatinuria}.
e.zh: 患者被诊断为肌酸尿症。

e.en: {Creatinuria} can indicate muscle wasting.
e.zh: 肌酸尿症可能提示肌肉萎缩。

creational.t: 创造的；创建型的（设计模式）

e.en: The factory pattern is a {creational} design pattern.
e.zh: 工厂模式是一种创建型设计模式。

e.en: He studied {creational} patterns in software design.
e.zh: 他研究了软件设计中的创建型模式。

e.en: The {creationist} rejected the theory of evolution.
e.zh: 那位神创论者拒绝接受进化论。

e.en: His {creationist} views shaped the curriculum.
e.zh: 他的神创论观点影响了课程内容。

e.en: They debated the {creatorship} of the ancient text.
e.zh: 他们争论那部古籍的作者归属。

e.en: She claimed full {creatorship} of the design.
e.zh: 她声称对该设计拥有完整的创作权。

e.en: Old physiology texts mention {creatoxin} in fatigued muscle.
e.zh: 旧的生理学文献提到疲劳肌肉中的肌肉毒素。

e.en: The concept of {creatoxin} is now largely obsolete.
e.zh: 肌肉毒素这一概念现已基本过时。

e.en: She was hailed as the {creatress} of modern dance.
e.zh: 她被誉为现代舞的女创始人。

e.en: The novel celebrates the {creatress} of the gardens.
e.zh: 这部小说颂扬了那位花园的女创造者。

e.en: In the myth, she is the {creatrix} of all life.
e.zh: 在神话中，她是万物的女创造者。

e.en: Critics called her the {creatrix} of a new style.
e.zh: 评论家称她为一种新风格的缔造者。

e.en: He spoke of our shared {creatural} weakness.
e.zh: 他谈到我们共有的受造物之脆弱。

e.en: The poem celebrates {creatural} life on earth.
e.zh: 这首诗歌颂了大地上的生灵生活。

e.en: The sermon emphasized human {creatureliness}.
e.zh: 讲道强调了人类的受造性。

e.en: He embraced his own {creatureliness} with humility.
e.zh: 他怀着谦卑接受自身的受造本性。

e.en: They argued over fine {credal} differences.
e.zh: 他们为细微的教义差异争论不休。

e.en: The church holds firm to its {credal} statements.
e.zh: 教会坚守其信条声明。

e.en: The book lists the central {credenda} of the faith.
e.zh: 该书列出了这一信仰的核心信条。

e.en: Theologians debated which {credenda} were essential.
e.zh: 神学家们争论哪些信条是必要的。

credendum.t: 信条；应当相信的一条教义

e.en: Each {credendum} was carefully defined by the council.
e.zh: 每条信条都由公会议仔细界定。

e.en: The resurrection is a key {credendum} of Christianity.
e.zh: 复活是基督教的一条关键信条。

e.en: Shakespeare uses {credent} to mean trusting.
e.zh: 莎士比亚用credent表示轻信的。

e.en: She gave {credent} ear to the rumor.
e.zh: 她对流言信以为真。

e.en: Critics blame {credentialism} for inequality at work.
e.zh: 批评者把职场不平等归咎于文凭主义。

e.en: He pushed back against rigid {credentialism} in hiring.
e.zh: 他反对招聘中僵化的学历至上做法。

e.en: She paid the bill with her {credit-card}.
e.zh: 她用信用卡付了账。

e.en: My {credit-card} was declined at the store.
e.zh: 我的信用卡在商店被拒付了。

e.en: He described himself as a {creedless} seeker.
e.zh: 他自称是一个无信条的探索者。

e.en: The community welcomes both religious and {creedless} members.
e.zh: 这个团体欢迎有信仰和无信仰的成员。

e.en: We picked {cowberries} on the hillside.
e.zh: 我们在山坡上采越橘。

e.en: She made jam from the {cowberries}.
e.zh: 她用越橘做了果酱。

e.en: The {cowberry} grows wild in northern forests.
e.zh: 越橘在北方森林里野生生长。

e.en: Sweden is famous for its {cowberry} sauce.
e.zh: 瑞典以越橘酱闻名。

e.en: {Cowbind} climbs over the summer hedges.
e.zh: 白泻根爬满夏日的树篱。

e.en: The poet praised the wild {cowbind}.
e.zh: 诗人赞美了野生的白泻根。

e.en: The {cowcatcher} pushed debris off the tracks.
e.zh: 排障器把残骸推离轨道。

e.en: Old steam trains had iron {cowcatchers}.
e.zh: 旧式蒸汽机车装有铁制排障器。

e.en: The {cowfish} has horn-like spines on its head.
e.zh: 牛角鱼头上长着角状突起。

e.en: We spotted a yellow {cowfish} while snorkeling.
e.zh: 浮潜时我们看到一条黄色牛角鱼。

e.en: {Cowgrass} grows abundantly in damp meadows.
e.zh: 红三叶草在湿润草地长得很茂盛。

e.en: Farmers plant {cowgrass} to enrich the soil.
e.zh: 农民种植红三叶草来改良土壤。

e.en: Don't be so {cowhearted}—speak up for yourself.
e.zh: 别这么懦弱，为自己发声。

e.en: His {cowhearted} retreat shocked his friends.
e.zh: 他怯懦的退缩让朋友们震惊。

e.en: Grandma stewed {cowheel} for hours.
e.zh: 奶奶把牛蹄炖了好几个小时。

e.en: {Cowheel} jelly is a traditional northern dish.
e.zh: 牛蹄冻是一道北方传统菜。

e.en: {Cowherb} is used in traditional medicine.
e.zh: 王不留行常用于传统医学。

e.en: Pink flowers identify the {cowherb}.
e.zh: 粉色小花是王不留行的特征。

e.en: The young {cowherd} drove the cattle home at dusk.
e.zh: 年轻的放牛人傍晚把牛群赶回家。

e.en: He worked as a {cowherd} in the highlands.
e.zh: 他曾在高地当放牛人。

e.en: The {cowhouse} smelled of hay and dung.
e.zh: 牛棚里弥漫着干草和粪便的气味。

e.en: They cleaned out the {cowhouse} every morning.
e.zh: 他们每天早上清扫牛棚。

cowinner.t: 共同获胜者；并列优胜者

e.en: She was a {cowinner} of the science prize.
e.zh: 她是这个科学奖的共同得主。

e.en: The two athletes were declared {cowinners}.
e.zh: 两位运动员被宣布并列冠军。

cowish.t: 胆怯的；像牛一样温顺迟钝的

e.en: His {cowish} demeanor made him an easy target.
e.zh: 他怯懦的举止让他成了易受欺负的对象。

e.en: She gave a {cowish} smile and said nothing.
e.zh: 她畏怯地一笑，什么也没说。

cowitch.t: 刺毛黧豆（一种致痒植物）

e.en: {Cowitch} pods cause severe skin irritation.
e.zh: 刺毛黧豆的豆荚会引起严重皮肤刺痒。

e.en: Hikers learned to avoid the {cowitch}.
e.zh: 徒步者学会了避开刺毛黧豆。

e.en: The smell made him {cowk}.
e.zh: 那气味让他直犯恶心。

e.en: She felt ready to {cowk} at the sight.
e.zh: 她见状一阵反胃。

cowlike.t: 像牛一样的；呆滞温顺的

e.en: He stared with a {cowlike} expression.
e.zh: 他用呆滞的表情盯着看。

e.en: Her {cowlike} patience never wavered.
e.zh: 她那如母牛般的耐心从未动摇。

e.en: Two servants carried the tub on a {cowlstaff}.
e.zh: 两个仆人用杠子抬着桶。

e.en: The {cowlstaff} rested across their shoulders.
e.zh: 杠子横搭在他们肩上。

e.en: The {cowman} rode out at sunrise.
e.zh: 牧牛人日出时骑马出发。

e.en: He's the richest {cowman} in the county.
e.zh: 他是县里最有钱的养牛人。

e.en: The {cowmen} gathered around the fire.
e.zh: 牛仔们围坐在火堆旁。

e.en: Several {cowmen} drove the herd north.
e.zh: 几个牧牛人把畜群赶向北方。

e.en: He stepped on a fresh {cowpat}.
e.zh: 他踩到一坨新鲜的牛粪。

e.en: A {cowpat} dried hard in the sun.
e.zh: 一坨牛粪在阳光下晒得硬邦邦。

e.en: Dried {cowpats} can be used as fuel.
e.zh: 晒干的牛粪饼可以当燃料。

e.en: She carefully avoided the {cowpats}.
e.zh: 她小心地避开那些牛粪。

e.en: The child shrieked at finding a {cowpie}.
e.zh: 那个孩子发现牛粪饼时尖叫起来。

e.en: The pasture was full of {cowpies}.
e.zh: 牧场上到处是牛粪饼。

e.en: The old {cowpuncher} told tall tales by the fire.
e.zh: 老牛仔在火堆旁讲着夸张的故事。

e.en: He spent his youth as a {cowpuncher}.
e.zh: 他年轻时当过牛仔。

cowpuncner.t: 牛仔；放牛工（cowpuncher的拼写变体）

e.en: The dusty {cowpuncner} tipped his hat.
e.zh: 满身尘土的牛仔抬了抬帽檐。

e.en: Each {cowpuncner} rode a sturdy pony.
e.zh: 每个牛仔都骑着一匹结实的小马。

e.en: An old {cowshee} stood behind the barn.
e.zh: 谷仓后面有一座旧牛棚。

e.en: Rain leaked through the {cowshee} roof.
e.zh: 雨水从牛棚屋顶漏下来。

e.en: He played a wild {cowshot} over midwicket.
e.zh: 他在中外野上方挥出一记狂野的横扫。

e.en: The {cowshot} sent the ball into the stands.
e.zh: 那记横扫把球击进了看台。

e.en: The chair was upholstered in {cowskin}.
e.zh: 那把椅子用牛皮包面。

e.en: Craftsmen tan {cowskin} by hand.
e.zh: 工匠手工鞣制牛皮。

e.en: You old {cowson}, you cheated me!
e.zh: 你这老混账，骗了我！

e.en: He muttered '{cowson}' under his breath.
e.zh: 他低声咒骂了一句"混账"。

e.en: The femur joins the body at the {coxa}.
e.zh: 股骨在髋部与躯干相连。

e.en: An insect's {coxa} attaches the leg to the thorax.
e.zh: 昆虫的基节把腿连到胸部。

e.en: The doctor noted {coxal} tenderness.
e.zh: 医生注意到髋部压痛。

e.en: {Coxal} muscles control the leg.
e.zh: 基节肌肉控制腿部活动。

e.en: She was diagnosed with chronic {coxalgia}.
e.zh: 她被诊断为慢性髋关节痛。

e.en: Rest usually relieves mild {coxalgia}.
e.zh: 休息通常能缓解轻度髋关节痛。

e.en: Old textbooks list {coxalgy} as a symptom.
e.zh: 老教科书将髋关节痛列为症状。

e.en: The physician diagnosed {coxalgy}.
e.zh: 那位医生诊断为髋关节痛。

coxcomb.t: 自负的花花公子；纨绔子弟

e.en: That preening {coxcomb} thinks he's irresistible.
e.zh: 那个自命不凡的花花公子以为自己无人能挡。

e.en: Shakespeare often mocked the {coxcomb}.
e.zh: 莎士比亚常常讽刺这种纨绔子弟。

coxcombical.t: 纨绔气派的；自负卖弄的

e.en: His {coxcombical} airs amused everyone.
e.zh: 他那纨绔的派头让大家觉得好笑。

e.en: She dismissed his {coxcombical} compliments.
e.zh: 她对他自负的恭维不屑一顾。

e.en: His {coxcombry} embarrassed the family.
e.zh: 他的纨绔作风让家人尴尬。

e.en: The novel satirizes Victorian {coxcombry}.
e.zh: 这部小说讽刺了维多利亚时代的纨绔作风。

e.en: The patient suffered from chronic {coxitis}.
e.zh: 该患者患有慢性髋关节炎。

e.en: {Coxitis} can result from infection.
e.zh: 髋关节炎可能由感染引发。

e.en: They competed in the {coxless} fours.
e.zh: 他们参加了无舵四人赛艇比赛。

e.en: The {coxless} pair won gold.
e.zh: 无舵双人艇夺得金牌。

e.en: The {coxopodite} attaches the limb to the body.
e.zh: 基肢节把附肢连到身体上。

e.en: Biologists examined the crab's {coxopodite}.
e.zh: 生物学家检查了那只螃蟹的基肢节。

e.en: She earned her {coxswainship} after years on the water.
e.zh: 她经过多年水上历练才取得舵手资格。

e.en: His {coxswainship} guided the crew to victory.
e.zh: 他的舵手技艺带领队伍夺冠。

e.en: Don't get too {coxy} after one win.
e.zh: 赢了一场可别太得意。

e.en: His {coxy} grin annoyed the others.
e.zh: 他得意的笑容惹恼了其他人。

coydog.t: 郊狼狗（郊狼与家犬的杂交后代）

e.en: A {coydog} prowled near the farm at night.
e.zh: 夜里有一只郊狼狗在农场附近游荡。

e.en: {Coydogs} are wary of humans.
e.zh: 郊狼狗对人类很警惕。

coyish.t: 略带羞怯的；有点忸怩的

e.en: She gave him a {coyish} glance.
e.zh: 她略带羞怯地瞥了他一眼。

e.en: His {coyish} reply hinted at interest.
e.zh: 他略显忸怩的回答透出几分兴趣。

coyotillo.t: 一种美洲产的有毒灌木

e.en: Cattle avoid eating {coyotillo} berries.
e.zh: 牛群不吃这种毒灌木的浆果。

e.en: {Coyotillo} grows in the Texas borderlands.
e.zh: 这种有毒灌木生长在德州边境一带。

e.en: The {coypu} damaged the riverbank.
e.zh: 海狸鼠破坏了河岸。

e.en: Farmers trap {coypu} for their fur.
e.zh: 农民捕捉海狸鼠取皮。

e.en: How fare you, sweet {coz}?
e.zh: 你好吗，亲爱的表亲？

e.en: Shakespeare's characters often address each other as '{coz}'.
e.zh: 莎剧人物常以"表亲"相称。

e.en: They sat down for a quiet {coze}.
e.zh: 她们坐下来安静地闲聊。

e.en: We had a long {coze} by the fire.
e.zh: 我们在炉边长聊了好久。

e.en: The lawsuit accused him of {cozenage}.
e.zh: 诉讼指控他犯有欺诈行为。

e.en: Beware the {cozenage} of street vendors.
e.zh: 当心街头小贩的诓骗手段。

cozes.t: 闲聊（动词第三人称单数或名词复数）

e.en: She {cozes} with her sister every Sunday.
e.zh: 她每周日都和姐姐促膝闲聊。

e.en: Their evening {cozes} lasted hours.
e.zh: 她们晚间的闲聊一聊就是几个小时。

creephole.t: 可钻的小洞；遁词；逃避借口

e.en: The fox squeezed through a {creephole} in the fence.
e.zh: 狐狸从篱笆的小洞钻了过去。

e.en: He always finds a {creephole} to wriggle out of promises.
e.zh: 他总能找到借口逃避承诺。

e.en: Granny sat on a wooden {creepie} by the fire.
e.zh: 奶奶坐在炉火旁的木矮凳上。

e.en: He pulled up a {creepie} to milk the cow.
e.zh: 他拉过一张矮凳准备挤奶。

creepily.t: 令人毛骨悚然地；阴森地

e.en: The door swung open {creepily} on its own.
e.zh: 门阴森地自己慢慢打开了。

e.en: He smiled {creepily} from across the room.
e.zh: 他在房间另一头诡异地朝我笑。

creepy-crawlies.t: 爬虫；让人发毛的小虫子

e.en: The kids love hunting for {creepy-crawlies} in the garden.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢在花园里找小爬虫。

e.en: I shook out my boots to check for {creepy-crawlies}.
e.zh: 我把靴子抖了抖，检查有没有虫子。

creepy-crawly.t: 令人发毛的小虫；爬行小生物

e.en: A {creepy-crawly} scuttled across the bathroom floor.
e.zh: 一只让人起鸡皮疙瘩的小虫爬过浴室地板。

e.en: She screamed at the {creepy-crawly} in the sink.
e.zh: 她对水槽里那只爬虫尖叫起来。

e.en: The family scattered the {cremains} over the lake.
e.zh: 家人把骨灰撒在湖面上。

e.en: They keep his {cremains} in an urn on the mantel.
e.zh: 他们把他的骨灰放在壁炉台上的骨灰盒里。

cremationist.t: 主张火葬者；火葬支持者

e.en: As a {cremationist}, she opposed traditional burials.
e.zh: 作为火葬支持者，她反对传统土葬。

e.en: Victorian {cremationists} fought to legalize the practice.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的火葬支持者努力使其合法化。

e.en: The {cremator} carefully prepared the furnace.
e.zh: 火葬场操作员仔细准备火化炉。

e.en: Modern {cremators} burn at very high temperatures.
e.zh: 现代火化炉以极高温度燃烧。

e.en: The bone showed a small {crena} along its edge.
e.zh: 那块骨头边缘有一个小切迹。

e.en: Each leaf had a delicate {crena} pattern.
e.zh: 每片叶子都有精致的缺刻纹路。

crenate.t: 具圆齿的；锯齿状的（植物学）

e.en: The botanist noted the {crenate} edges of the leaf.
e.zh: 植物学家记录了叶片的圆齿边缘。

e.en: Many mint species have {crenate} margins.
e.zh: 许多薄荷品种叶缘呈圆齿状。

crenated.t: 有圆齿的；起皱缩的（细胞）

e.en: The red blood cells appeared {crenated} under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下红细胞呈现皱缩状。

e.en: She sketched the {crenated} outline of the leaf.
e.zh: 她描绘了那片叶子带圆齿的轮廓。

e.en: The slide showed clear {crenation} of the cells.
e.zh: 切片显示细胞明显皱缩。

e.en: The shell's edge had a regular {crenation}.
e.zh: 贝壳边缘呈规则的圆齿状。

e.en: Each {crenature} along the leaf was perfectly even.
e.zh: 叶片上的每个圆齿都十分均匀。

e.en: He measured the {crenature} of the fossil shell.
e.zh: 他测量了化石贝壳上的锯齿。

crenel.t: 城垛之间的射孔；雉堞间隙

e.en: An archer crouched behind each {crenel}.
e.zh: 每个射孔后都蹲着一名弓箭手。

e.en: Wind whistled through every {crenel} of the tower.
e.zh: 风从塔上每个垛口呼啸而过。

crenelate.t: 在城墙顶筑雉堞；建造垛口

e.en: The lord ordered masons to {crenelate} the new wall.
e.zh: 领主命令石匠为新城墙修筑雉堞。

e.en: They had royal permission to {crenelate} the manor.
e.zh: 他们获得王室许可在庄园上加筑雉堞。

e.en: The {crenelated} walls dominated the skyline.
e.zh: 带雉堞的城墙在天际线上格外醒目。

e.en: A {crenelated} tower rose above the trees.
e.zh: 一座带城垛的塔楼高出林梢。

e.en: The masons spent months {crenelating} the keep.
e.zh: 石匠花了好几个月给城堡主楼加筑雉堞。

e.en: They were {crenelating} the wall when the siege began.
e.zh: 围攻开始时他们正在为城墙加筑垛口。

e.en: A tiny {crenelet} crowned the garden folly.
e.zh: 花园中那座装饰小塔顶上有一个小垛口。

e.en: Each {crenelet} was barely wide enough for an arrow.
e.zh: 每个小垛口只够射出一支箭。

e.en: He peered through a narrow {crenelle} at the army below.
e.zh: 他从狭窄的垛口窥视下方的军队。

e.en: Sunlight streamed through every {crenelle}.
e.zh: 阳光从每个射孔射进来。

e.en: The leaf margin is finely {crenulate}.
e.zh: 叶缘呈细圆齿状。

e.en: Her dress had a {crenulate} hemline.
e.zh: 她的裙摆呈细波浪边。

e.en: The shell had a delicately {crenulated} edge.
e.zh: 贝壳带有精致的细圆齿边缘。

e.en: He admired the {crenulated} pattern on the fossil.
e.zh: 他欣赏化石上细致的波纹图案。

creodont.t: 古肉齿目动物（已灭绝的食肉哺乳类）

e.en: The museum displayed the skull of a giant {creodont}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一种大型古肉齿目动物的头骨。

e.en: Each {creodont} had powerful shearing teeth.
e.zh: 每种古肉齿目动物都长着强有力的剪切齿。

creolise.t: 克里奥尔化；混合本地化（语言、文化）

e.en: Over generations the language began to {creolise}.
e.zh: 经过几代人，这种语言开始克里奥尔化。

e.en: Immigrant cuisines often {creolise} in new countries.
e.zh: 移民饮食在新国家常常发生克里奥尔化融合。

creolize.t: 克里奥尔化；本地融合化

e.en: Pidgins typically {creolize} when children grow up speaking them.
e.zh: 当孩子们以洋泾浜语为母语时，它通常会克里奥尔化。

e.en: Music traditions {creolize} as cultures mingle.
e.zh: 音乐传统会随着文化交融而克里奥尔化。

e.en: He wrote a treatise condemning {creophagism}.
e.zh: 他撰文谴责肉食主义。

e.en: Some philosophers debated the ethics of {creophagism}.
e.zh: 一些哲学家辩论肉食主义的伦理问题。

e.en: Lions are strictly {creophagous} animals.
e.zh: 狮子是严格的肉食性动物。

e.en: He described the tribe's {creophagous} diet.
e.zh: 他描述了那个部落的肉食性饮食。

e.en: The book examined the cultural roots of {creophagy}.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了食肉习性的文化根源。

e.en: Some religions discourage {creophagy} on certain days.
e.zh: 某些宗教在特定日子禁止食肉。

e.en: Wood smoke contains traces of {creosol}.
e.zh: 木材烟雾中含有微量甲酚。

e.en: The chemist isolated {creosol} from beech tar.
e.zh: 化学家从山毛榉焦油中分离出甲酚。

e.en: Don't be such a {crepehanger}; things will improve.
e.zh: 别这么悲观，情况会好起来的。

e.en: Every team has at least one {crepehanger}.
e.zh: 每个团队里都至少有一个爱唱衰的人。

crepey.t: 皱褶如绉纱的（多形容皮肤）

e.en: The lotion is marketed for {crepey} skin.
e.zh: 这款乳液主打改善绉纱般的松弛皮肤。

e.en: Her hands had grown thin and {crepey} with age.
e.zh: 她的手随着年龄变得纤瘦而起皱。

crepitant.t: 发出爆裂声的；噼啪作响的

e.en: The doctor heard a {crepitant} sound in the patient's lungs.
e.zh: 医生在病人肺部听到爆裂音。

e.en: Dry leaves made a {crepitant} noise underfoot.
e.zh: 枯叶在脚下发出噼啪声。

e.en: The logs began to {crepitate} as they caught fire.
e.zh: 木柴一着火就开始噼啪作响。

e.en: Salt crystals {crepitate} when tossed into the flame.
e.zh: 盐粒撒入火中会噼啪爆响。

e.en: The bonfire {crepitates} cheerfully in the cold air.
e.zh: 篝火在冷空气中欢快地噼啪作响。

e.en: Hot oil {crepitates} the moment water hits it.
e.zh: 水一接触热油就噼啪作响。

e.en: We sat by the {crepitating} fire all evening.
e.zh: 我们整晚坐在噼啪作响的炉火旁。

e.en: A {crepitating} sound came from the burning brush.
e.zh: 燃烧的灌木丛中传来噼啪声。

crepitation.t: 噼啪声；爆裂音；（医学）捻发音

e.en: The doctor noted a faint {crepitation} in the lungs.
e.zh: 医生注意到肺部有微弱的捻发音。

e.en: The fire's steady {crepitation} was strangely soothing.
e.zh: 炉火持续的噼啪声出奇地令人安心。

e.en: A slight {crispation} of the leaves signaled drought.
e.zh: 叶片轻微的卷曲预示着干旱。

e.en: Her face showed a nervous {crispation}.
e.zh: 她脸上露出紧张的抽搐。

e.en: Bake the bread to {crispen} the crust.
e.zh: 烘烤面包让外皮变得酥脆。

e.en: The cold air will {crispen} the leaves overnight.
e.zh: 寒气会让叶片一夜之间变脆。

e.en: The {crispening} effect of the oven gives perfect toast.
e.zh: 烤箱的酥脆效果带来完美的吐司。

e.en: She watched the leaves {crispening} in the autumn sun.
e.zh: 她看着叶子在秋阳下逐渐变脆。

e.en: The chips lose their {crispiness} when left out.
e.zh: 薯片放久了就会失去酥脆感。

e.en: I love the {crispiness} of fresh lettuce.
e.zh: 我喜欢新鲜生菜的爽脆口感。

e.en: The fields were divided by {criss-cross} paths.
e.zh: 田野被纵横交错的小径分隔。

e.en: Trains {criss-cross} the country every day.
e.zh: 火车每天纵横穿梭于全国。

e.en: Scars {criss-crossed} his weathered hands.
e.zh: 伤疤纵横交错布满他粗糙的双手。

e.en: Power lines {criss-crossed} the valley.
e.zh: 电线纵横交错地横跨山谷。

e.en: The river {criss-crosses} the plain in lazy bends.
e.zh: 河流以懒洋洋的弯道纵横穿过平原。

e.en: He {criss-crosses} the city by bike daily.
e.zh: 他每天骑车穿梭于城市各处。

e.en: Planes were {criss-crossing} the morning sky.
e.zh: 飞机在晨空中纵横穿梭。

e.en: She spent years {criss-crossing} the country for work.
e.zh: 她多年来为工作奔波于全国各地。

e.en: The committee adopted a {criterional} approach to grading.
e.zh: 委员会采用以标准为依据的评分方法。

e.en: Her score met every {criterional} requirement.
e.zh: 她的成绩满足每一项标准化要求。

e.en: He won the downtown {criterium} by a wheel.
e.zh: 他以一个轮位的优势赢得市中心绕圈赛。

e.en: The {criterium} draws cyclists from across Europe.
e.zh: 这场绕圈赛吸引了欧洲各地的自行车手。

criticaster.t: 蹩脚的批评家；不入流的评论者

e.en: Every great writer attracts a few {criticaster} pests.
e.zh: 每位伟大作家都会招来几个蹩脚批评家般的烦人家伙。

e.en: He dismissed the reviewer as a mere {criticaster}.
e.zh: 他把那位评论者贬为不入流的批评家。

e.en: His decision is {criticisable} on several grounds.
e.zh: 他的决定在几个方面都值得批评。

e.en: Nothing she did was easily {criticisable}.
e.zh: 她所做的一切都难以指摘。

e.en: The plan is {criticizable} for ignoring costs.
e.zh: 该计划因忽视成本而值得批评。

e.en: Few of his choices were genuinely {criticizable}.
e.zh: 他的选择中真正值得指摘的没几个。

e.en: Old glass tends to {crizzle} with age.
e.zh: 古玻璃常常随时间出现细微裂纹。

e.en: The vase began to {crizzle} on the surface.
e.zh: 花瓶表面开始出现细密的裂纹。

e.en: {Cro-Magnon} humans painted the famous cave walls.
e.zh: 克罗马农人在著名的洞穴壁上作画。

e.en: The skull belonged to a {Cro-Magnon} ancestor.
e.zh: 这块头骨属于一位克罗马农人祖先。

e.en: Purple {croci} pushed up through the snow.
e.zh: 紫色番红花从积雪中破土而出。

e.en: She planted {croci} along the garden path.
e.zh: 她沿着花园小径种下了番红花。

e.en: {Crocidolite} is the most hazardous form of asbestos.
e.zh: 青石棉是危害最大的石棉品种。

e.en: Old insulation often contained {crocidolite} fibers.
e.zh: 旧式保温材料常含有青石棉纤维。

e.en: Each spire was carved with leafy {crocket} ornaments.
e.zh: 每根尖塔都雕刻着叶状卷饰。

e.en: A stone {crocket} had broken from the cathedral.
e.zh: 大教堂的一块石质卷叶饰已经脱落。

e.en: The {crocketed} pinnacles glittered in the rain.
e.zh: 装饰着卷叶饰的尖顶在雨中闪闪发光。

e.en: They restored the {crocketed} gables of the abbey.
e.zh: 他们修复了修道院饰有卷叶饰的山墙。

crocketing.t: 卷叶饰装饰；装上卷叶饰

e.en: The masons finished the {crocketing} on the spire.
e.zh: 石匠们完成了尖塔上的卷叶饰雕刻。

e.en: Elaborate {crocketing} adorned the medieval tomb.
e.zh: 精致的卷叶饰装点着这座中世纪墓葬。

e.en: Bats emerged at the {crepuscle} hour.
e.zh: 蝙蝠在黄昏时分飞出。

e.en: He wandered home in the {crepuscle}.
e.zh: 他在暮色中漫步回家。

e.en: The garden glowed at {crepuscule}.
e.zh: 花园在暮色中闪着微光。

e.en: Owls hunt during the {crepuscule}.
e.zh: 猫头鹰在曙暮时分觅食。

e.en: The symphony built through several {crescendi}.
e.zh: 交响曲经过数个渐强段层层推进。

e.en: His speeches were full of dramatic {crescendi}.
e.zh: 他的演讲充满了戏剧性的渐强高潮。

e.en: She wore a {crescent-shaped} pendant.
e.zh: 她戴着一枚新月形的吊坠。

e.en: The bay forms a {crescent-shaped} curve.
e.zh: 海湾形成一道弯月状的弧线。

e.en: Customs arise through {crescive} social habits.
e.zh: 习俗在逐渐形成的社会习惯中产生。

e.en: Language change is largely {crescive}.
e.zh: 语言的变化大多是渐进式的。

e.en: Bose invented the {crescograph} to measure plant growth.
e.zh: 博斯发明了测定植物生长的生长仪。

e.en: The {crescograph} amplified tiny movements.
e.zh: 生长仪将微小的运动放大。

e.en: {Cresol} is used as a disinfectant.
e.zh: 甲酚被用作消毒剂。

e.en: The lab smelled of {cresol}.
e.zh: 实验室里弥漫着甲酚的气味。

e.en: A {cresset} burned beside the castle gate.
e.zh: 城门旁的一个铁笼火炬熊熊燃烧。

e.en: They lit a {cresset} to guide the ships.
e.zh: 他们点燃火盆为船只引航。

e.en: They picnicked beside a {cressy} stream.
e.zh: 他们在长满水芹的小溪旁野餐。

e.en: The pond had a {cressy} green edge.
e.zh: 池塘边缘绿油油地长满了水芹。

e.en: The {crestal} ridge marks the highest point.
e.zh: 这道脊线标志着最高点。

e.en: Surgeons examined the {crestal} bone.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了顶部的骨脊。

e.en: The shield was plain and {crestless}.
e.zh: 那面盾牌朴素无饰，没有顶冠。

e.en: A {crestless} bird perched on the branch.
e.zh: 一只没有冠羽的鸟停在枝头。

cretic.t: 长短长格音步（韵律学术语）

e.en: The line ends with a clear {cretic}.
e.zh: 这行诗以一个清晰的长短长格收尾。

e.en: Latin orators favored the {cretic} rhythm.
e.zh: 拉丁演说家偏爱长短长格的节奏。

e.en: The sofa was covered in floral {cretonne}.
e.zh: 沙发上铺着印有花卉的厚棉布。

e.en: She sewed curtains from blue {cretonne}.
e.zh: 她用蓝色印花棉布缝制了窗帘。

e.en: He hooked a large {crevalle} offshore.
e.zh: 他在海上钓到一条大鲹鱼。

e.en: {Crevalle} jacks travel in fast schools.
e.zh: 鲹鱼成群快速游动。

e.en: The recruit got a sharp {crew-cut}.
e.zh: 那名新兵剪了一个利落的平头。

e.en: His {crew-cut} made him look younger.
e.zh: 他的板寸让他显得更年轻。

e.en: He wore a navy {crew-neck} sweater.
e.zh: 他穿着一件藏青色圆领毛衣。

e.en: The shop sells plain {crew-neck} tees.
e.zh: 这家店出售素色圆领T恤。

e.en: The unit operates a {crew-served} weapon.
e.zh: 该分队操作一件多人协同武器。

e.en: Heavy machine guns are {crew-served} systems.
e.zh: 重机枪属于多人操作的武器系统。

e.en: He maintained a tidy {crewcut}.
e.zh: 他始终留着整齐的平头。

e.en: The barber gave him a {crewcut}.
e.zh: 理发师给他剪了个板寸。

e.en: The cadets all sported {crewcuts}.
e.zh: 学员们都剪着平头。

e.en: Summer camp ended in matching {crewcuts}.
e.zh: 夏令营结束时大家都剪了一样的平头。

e.en: She embroidered the cushion in {crewel}.
e.zh: 她用绣花毛线绣了那只靠垫。

e.en: {Crewel} stitches add rich texture.
e.zh: 粗毛线绣针带来丰富的质感。

e.en: The museum displays antique {crewelwork}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出古老的粗毛线刺绣作品。

e.en: Her {crewelwork} won a county prize.
e.zh: 她的粗毛线刺绣作品获得了郡级奖项。

crewless.t: 没有船员的；无人驾驶的

e.en: A {crewless} ship drifted toward shore.
e.zh: 一艘无人船只向岸边漂去。

e.en: Engineers tested a {crewless} submarine.
e.zh: 工程师测试了一艘无人潜艇。

e.en: The vet treated the horse for {crib-biting}.
e.zh: 兽医为这匹马治疗啃槽癖。

e.en: {Crib-biting} can damage a horse's teeth.
e.zh: 啃槽癖会损伤马的牙齿。

e.en: They kept score on a wooden {cribbage-board}.
e.zh: 他们用一块木制计分板记录牌戏比分。

e.en: Grandpa carved his own {cribbage-board}.
e.zh: 爷爷亲手雕刻了一块克里比奇计分板。

e.en: Stable hands separate known {cribbers} from others.
e.zh: 马夫会把有啃槽癖的马与其他马分开。

e.en: Teachers quickly spotted the {cribbers}.
e.zh: 老师很快就发现了那些抄袭的人。

e.en: They {cribble} the grain before milling.
e.zh: 他们在磨粉前先筛选谷粒。

e.en: The miller began to {cribble} the flour.
e.zh: 磨坊主开始筛面粉。

e.en: The museum displayed a brilliant red {crocoite} crystal.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一块鲜红的赤铅矿晶体。

e.en: Miners in Tasmania still find {crocoite} specimens.
e.zh: 塔斯马尼亚的矿工仍能找到赤铅矿标本。

e.en: The {crombec} darted between the acacia branches.
e.zh: 那只非洲莺在金合欢枝间穿梭。

e.en: Birdwatchers spotted a rare {crombec} at dawn.
e.zh: 观鸟者在黎明时分发现了一只罕见的非洲莺。

e.en: They hiked uphill to see the ancient {cromlech}.
e.zh: 他们徒步上山去看那座古老的石桌坟。

e.en: The {cromlech} dates back to the Neolithic period.
e.zh: 这座环状立石可追溯到新石器时代。

cromlechs.t: 史前石桌坟（复数）；环状立石群

e.en: Wales is dotted with mysterious {cromlechs}.
e.zh: 威尔士各地散布着神秘的石桌坟。

e.en: Archaeologists mapped several {cromlechs} on the moor.
e.zh: 考古学家在荒原上标出了几处环状立石群。

e.en: The mayor was accused of blatant {croneyism}.
e.zh: 市长被指控公然任人唯亲。

e.en: {Croneyism} undermines fair hiring practices.
e.zh: 裙带关系破坏了公平的招聘机制。

e.en: He felt a bit {cronk} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后他感觉有点不舒服。

e.en: That deal sounds a little {cronk} to me.
e.zh: 那笔交易在我听来有点可疑。

e.en: Shakespeare portrayed Richard III as a {crookback}.
e.zh: 莎士比亚把理查三世描绘成一个驼背。

e.en: The old {crookback} hobbled across the courtyard.
e.zh: 那个驼背老人蹒跚着穿过院子。

e.en: A {crookbacked} servant opened the heavy door.
e.zh: 一个驼背的仆人打开了那扇沉重的门。

e.en: He played the {crookbacked} villain on stage.
e.zh: 他在舞台上扮演那个驼背反派。

crookery.t: 欺诈行为；不诚实的勾当

e.en: The auditors uncovered years of {crookery}.
e.zh: 审计人员揭露了多年的欺诈行为。

e.en: Voters were tired of political {crookery}.
e.zh: 选民厌倦了政治上的不诚实勾当。

e.en: She roasted a yellow {crookneck} squash for dinner.
e.zh: 她烤了一个黄色的弯颈南瓜当晚餐。

e.en: {Crookneck} grows well in the summer garden.
e.zh: 弯颈南瓜在夏季的菜园里长势很好。

e.en: Pilots {crop-dust} the wheat fields at dawn.
e.zh: 飞行员在黎明时分给麦田喷洒农药。

e.en: They hired a plane to {crop-dust} the orchard.
e.zh: 他们雇了一架飞机给果园喷农药。

e.en: {Crop-dusting} season begins in early summer.
e.zh: 农药喷洒季节在初夏开始。

e.en: He earned a living from {crop-dusting} cotton fields.
e.zh: 他靠给棉田喷洒农药为生。

crop-ear.t: 剪短耳朵的动物；短耳之人

e.en: The farmer kept a loyal {crop-ear} terrier.
e.zh: 农夫养着一只忠诚的剪耳㹴犬。

e.en: Soldiers mocked the prisoner as a {crop-ear}.
e.zh: 士兵们嘲笑那个犯人是个短耳之徒。

e.en: A {crop-eared} dog barked at the gate.
e.zh: 一只剪耳的狗在门口狂吠。

e.en: The puritans were derided as {crop-eared} radicals.
e.zh: 清教徒被讥讽为剪耳的激进分子。

e.en: The hens roosted, {crop-full} and content.
e.zh: 母鸡们饱餐之后栖息下来，心满意足。

e.en: He came home {crop-full} from the feast.
e.zh: 他从宴席上回家时已经吃得饱饱的。

e.en: Tourists flock to Barbados for {crop-over}.
e.zh: 游客们涌向巴巴多斯参加收获节。

e.en: The {crop-over} festival fills the streets with music.
e.zh: 收获节让街头充满了音乐。

crop-sprayer.t: 农作物喷雾器；农药喷洒机

e.en: He repaired the {crop-sprayer} before harvest.
e.zh: 他在收割前修好了那台农作物喷雾器。

e.en: A {crop-sprayer} flew low over the cornfield.
e.zh: 一架农药喷洒机低飞掠过玉米地。

e.en: Drought reduced the {crop-yield} sharply this year.
e.zh: 今年干旱使作物产量大幅下降。

e.en: New fertilizers boosted the {crop-yield} per acre.
e.zh: 新肥料提高了每英亩的庄稼收成。

e.en: The flooded fields lay {cropless} all summer.
e.zh: 被洪水淹没的田地整个夏天颗粒无收。

e.en: A {cropless} year devastated the village.
e.zh: 一个无收成的年份让村庄陷入困境。

croppie.t: 剪短头发的人；爱尔兰起义者

e.en: The {croppie} rebels marched on Wexford.
e.zh: 剪短发的起义者向韦克斯福德进军。

e.en: Songs still remember the brave {croppie}.
e.zh: 歌谣仍在传颂那位勇敢的剪发起义者。

croppy.t: 剪短发者；1798年爱尔兰起义者

e.en: The {croppy} boy died for Irish freedom.
e.zh: 那位剪短发的少年为爱尔兰自由献出生命。

e.en: British soldiers hunted every suspected {croppy}.
e.zh: 英国士兵搜捕每一个被怀疑的起义者。

e.en: The poet wrote of fields newly {cropt}.
e.zh: 诗人写到新近修剪过的田野。

e.en: Her hair was {cropt} short in mourning.
e.zh: 她为表哀悼把头发剪得很短。

croquembouche.t: 泡芙塔；法式焦糖泡芙塔

e.en: The wedding featured a towering {croquembouche}.
e.zh: 婚礼上摆着一座高耸的泡芙塔。

e.en: She learned to make {croquembouche} in Paris.
e.zh: 她在巴黎学会了制作泡芙塔。

e.en: The designer sketched a quick {croquis} of the dress.
e.zh: 设计师快速画了一张连衣裙的速写。

e.en: Students practice {croquis} from live models.
e.zh: 学生们对着真人模特练习速写。

e.en: The film earned twenty {crore} in its first week.
e.zh: 这部电影首周票房达两亿卢比。

e.en: He donated one {crore} rupees to charity.
e.zh: 他向慈善机构捐了一千万卢比。

e.en: The project will cost several {crores} of rupees.
e.zh: 这项工程将耗资数千万卢比。

e.en: Stars in Bollywood earn {crores} per film.
e.zh: 宝莱坞明星每部电影能赚数千万卢比。

e.en: The lineman replaced a rotting {cross-arm}.
e.zh: 电工更换了一根腐烂的电线杆横担。

e.en: Insulators sat atop the wooden {cross-arm}.
e.zh: 绝缘子安装在木制横担的顶端。

cross-banded.t: 带交叉条纹的；横纹镶边的

e.en: The antique table had a {cross-banded} veneer.
e.zh: 那张古董桌面有横纹镶边的贴面。

e.en: She admired the {cross-banded} drawer fronts.
e.zh: 她欣赏那些带横纹镶边的抽屉面板。

e.en: Geologists noted clear {cross-bedding} in the sandstone.
e.zh: 地质学家注意到砂岩中明显的交错层理。

e.en: {Cross-bedding} reveals ancient river currents.
e.zh: 交错层理显示了古老的河流水流方向。

cross-bencher.t: （英国上议院）中立议员；无党派议员

e.en: The bill passed with support from a key {cross-bencher}.
e.zh: 该法案在一位关键中立议员的支持下获得通过。

e.en: As a {cross-bencher}, she votes by conscience.
e.zh: 作为无党派议员，她按良心投票。

cribwork.t: 木笼支撑结构；填石木框

e.en: The bridge piers were stabilized with heavy {cribwork}.
e.zh: 桥墩用粗重的木笼结构加固。

e.en: Old logging dams often featured wooden {cribwork}.
e.zh: 旧时的伐木水坝常采用木笼结构。

e.en: {Crickey}, that's an enormous spider!
e.zh: 我的天，这蜘蛛也太大了！

e.en: She gasped, '{Crickey}, what a mess!'
e.zh: 她倒吸一口气：天啊，真是一团糟！

e.en: Batman is the most famous fictional {crime-fighter}.
e.zh: 蝙蝠侠是最著名的虚构打击犯罪者。

e.en: Local {crime-fighters} patrolled the neighborhood every night.
e.zh: 当地的缉凶志愿者每晚都在社区巡逻。

crimeful.t: 罪恶累累的；充满罪行的

e.en: He led a {crimeful} life in the city's underworld.
e.zh: 他在城市黑社会过着罪行累累的生活。

e.en: The novel painted a dark, {crimeful} portrait of the port.
e.zh: 这部小说把那座港口描绘得阴暗而罪恶。

e.en: She dreamed of a peaceful, {crimeless} town.
e.zh: 她梦想着一个宁静、毫无犯罪的小镇。

e.en: No real society is entirely {crimeless}.
e.zh: 现实中没有任何社会能完全杜绝犯罪。

e.en: He took several {criminalistic} courses at the academy.
e.zh: 他在学院里修了几门刑事鉴识课程。

e.en: The lab applies {criminalistic} techniques to every case.
e.zh: 实验室对每起案件都运用刑事鉴识技术。

e.en: She majored in {criminalistics} and became a forensic analyst.
e.zh: 她主修刑事鉴识学，后来成为法医分析师。

e.en: Modern {criminalistics} relies heavily on DNA evidence.
e.zh: 现代刑事鉴识学高度依赖DNA证据。

e.en: The witness refused to {criminate} his old friend.
e.zh: 证人拒绝指控他多年的好友。

e.en: Be careful not to {criminate} yourself in your testimony.
e.zh: 作证时要小心，不要把罪责揽到自己身上。

e.en: He {criminated} his partner during the lengthy trial.
e.zh: 在漫长的审判中，他把罪责推到搭档身上。

e.en: She felt unfairly {criminated} by the leaked memo.
e.zh: 那份外泄的备忘录让她觉得被无端指控。

criminates.t: 指控；归罪（第三人称单数）

e.en: Her testimony directly {criminates} the chief suspect.
e.zh: 她的证词直接指控了主要嫌疑人。

e.en: Every new detail {criminates} him further.
e.zh: 每出现一个新细节，对他的指控就重一分。

criminating.t: 指控的；归罪的（动名词/进行式）

e.en: The lawyer produced highly {criminating} evidence.
e.zh: 律师拿出了极具指控力的证据。

e.en: He kept {criminating} his colleagues to save himself.
e.zh: 他不断把同事推上前去为自己开脱。

e.en: The hearing degenerated into mutual {crimination}.
e.zh: 听证会演变成双方互相指控。

e.en: Her letter was full of bitter {crimination}.
e.zh: 她的信中充满苦涩的指控。

criminative.t: 含有指控意味的；归咎的

e.en: He adopted a {criminative} tone toward his rival.
e.zh: 他对对手用上了指控的口吻。

e.en: The editorial was sharply {criminative} of the mayor.
e.zh: 那篇社论对市长进行了严厉指控。

e.en: The judge struck the {criminatory} remarks from the record.
e.zh: 法官将那些指控性言论从笔录中删除。

e.en: Her letter contained several {criminatory} statements.
e.zh: 她的信里有几处带有指控意味的陈述。

criminous.t: 犯罪的；有罪的（古旧用法）

e.en: He led a long and {criminous} life on the frontier.
e.zh: 他在边境地区过了漫长而罪恶的一生。

e.en: Medieval {criminous} clerks were tried in church courts.
e.zh: 中世纪犯罪的神职人员由教会法庭审判。

e.en: The damp paper began to {crimple} at the edges.
e.zh: 湿透的纸张边缘开始起皱。

e.en: Heat will {crimple} the thin plastic film.
e.zh: 高温会使这层薄塑料膜起皱卷曲。

e.en: Her nose {crimpled} when she smelled the smoke.
e.zh: 闻到烟味时她皱起了鼻子。

e.en: The shirt {crimpled} badly in the wash.
e.zh: 那件衬衫在洗涤中皱得厉害。

e.en: She watched the leaves slowly {crimpling} in the heat.
e.zh: 她看着叶子在高温下慢慢卷曲。

e.en: He felt his face {crimpling} with disgust.
e.zh: 他感到自己的脸因厌恶而皱缩起来。

e.en: Her hair turned soft and {crimpy} after the perm.
e.zh: 烫过之后她的头发变得柔软而蓬松卷曲。

e.en: The wool felt warm and {crimpy} between his fingers.
e.zh: 那羊毛在指间摸起来温暖又卷曲。

cringeworthy.t: 令人尴尬的；尴尬到脚趾抠地的

e.en: His attempt at humor was absolutely {cringeworthy}.
e.zh: 他试图幽默的尝试简直让人尴尬透顶。

e.en: Watching old videos of myself is so {cringeworthy}.
e.zh: 看自己以前的视频真让人尴尬到脚趾抠地。

e.en: The sailor passed the line through the {cringle}.
e.zh: 水手把绳子穿过帆角的索眼。

e.en: Each {cringle} on the sail was reinforced with brass.
e.zh: 帆上的每个索眼都用黄铜加固。

e.en: The path wound in {crinkum-crankum} turns up the hillside.
e.zh: 小径在山坡上曲里拐弯地蜿蜒而上。

e.en: He told a {crinkum-crankum} tale full of digressions.
e.zh: 他讲了一个绕来绕去、不停跑题的故事。

e.en: Fossil {crinoids} are common in this layer of limestone.
e.zh: 这层石灰岩中常见海百合化石。

e.en: Divers spotted a brightly colored {crinoid} on the reef.
e.zh: 潜水员在礁石上发现了一只色彩鲜艳的海百合。

crinoidal.t: 海百合的；含海百合化石的

e.en: The cliff is rich in {crinoidal} limestone.
e.zh: 这悬崖富含海百合石灰岩。

e.en: She studied {crinoidal} fossils for her doctoral thesis.
e.zh: 她在博士论文中研究海百合化石。

crip.t: 残障人士（俚语，常被群体内部重新使用）

e.en: The disability community has reclaimed the word {crip} with pride.
e.zh: 残障群体已经自豪地把"crip"这个词重新拿回来使用。

e.en: He jokingly called himself a {crip} after the accident.
e.zh: 事故之后他开玩笑地自称为残障者。

crankpin.t: 曲柄销；发动机连杆轴销

e.en: The mechanic replaced the worn {crankpin} carefully.
e.zh: 机械师小心地更换了磨损的曲柄销。

e.en: A loose {crankpin} can damage the entire engine.
e.zh: 松动的曲柄销会损坏整台发动机。

crankthrow.t: 曲柄半径；曲拐回转半径

e.en: Engineers measured the {crankthrow} on the new shaft.
e.zh: 工程师测量了新轴的曲柄半径。

e.en: A larger {crankthrow} produces more torque.
e.zh: 更大的曲柄半径产生更大的扭矩。

e.en: The {crankweb} connects the crankpin to the journal.
e.zh: 曲柄臂将曲柄销连接到主轴颈。

e.en: Cracks in the {crankweb} indicate metal fatigue.
e.zh: 曲柄臂上的裂纹表明金属疲劳。

e.en: Moss grew on the {crannied} stone wall.
e.zh: 苔藓在布满裂缝的石墙上生长。

e.en: He peered through the {crannied} rocks above the cave.
e.zh: 他透过洞穴上方满是缝隙的岩石窥视。

crannog.t: 古代爱尔兰苏格兰湖上木屋

e.en: Archaeologists studied the ancient {crannog} in the loch.
e.zh: 考古学家研究了湖中的古代湖上木屋。

e.en: The {crannog} dated from the Iron Age.
e.zh: 这座湖上木屋可以追溯到铁器时代。

cranreuch.t: 苏格兰方言中指白霜或冰霜

e.en: Frost covered the fields in a heavy {cranreuch}.
e.zh: 霜冻把田野覆上了一层厚厚的白霜。

e.en: Burns wrote of the bitter {cranreuch} in winter.
e.zh: 彭斯在诗中描写了冬日刺骨的白霜。

crapehanger.t: 悲观者；扫兴的人；唱衰者

e.en: Don't be such a {crapehanger} at the party.
e.zh: 别在派对上当个扫兴鬼。

e.en: The {crapehanger} predicted disaster again.
e.zh: 那个悲观者又预言会有灾难。

crapoid.t: 极差的；糟糕透顶的俚语用法

e.en: That movie was absolutely {crapoid} from start to finish.
e.zh: 那部电影从头到尾都烂透了。

e.en: He gave a {crapoid} performance on stage.
e.zh: 他在台上的表演糟糕透顶。

crapola.t: 废话；垃圾东西；劣等货色

e.en: Stop talking that {crapola} about conspiracies.
e.zh: 别再讲那些关于阴谋论的鬼话了。

e.en: The drawer was full of {crapola}.
e.zh: 抽屉里堆满了乱七八糟的破烂。

crapple.t: 小野苹果；劣质小果实的方言

e.en: He bit into a sour {crapple} from the tree.
e.zh: 他从树上摘了一个酸涩的小野苹果咬了一口。

e.en: Children pelted each other with tiny {crapple} fruits.
e.zh: 孩子们互相投掷小野苹果。

crapule.t: 酗酒过度；放荡淫逸的生活

e.en: The poet wrote about youthful {crapule}.
e.zh: 诗人描写了年轻时的放纵酗酒。

e.en: His {crapule} ruined his health completely.
e.zh: 他的酗酒放荡彻底毁了他的健康。

crapulence.t: 醉酒过度后的不适；宿醉感

e.en: He suffered {crapulence} after the long banquet.
e.zh: 漫长的宴会之后他感到宿醉难受。

e.en: The novel depicted Victorian {crapulence}.
e.zh: 小说描写了维多利亚时代的酗酒之风。

crapulent.t: 醉醺醺的；酗酒过度的样子

e.en: The {crapulent} sailors stumbled along the dock.
e.zh: 醉醺醺的水手在码头上跌跌撞撞。

e.en: He looked {crapulent} after the all-night party.
e.zh: 通宵派对之后他看上去酒醉未醒。

crapulous.t: 酗酒成性的；放纵无度的

e.en: His {crapulous} habits scandalized the town.
e.zh: 他酗酒的恶习令全城哗然。

e.en: The {crapulous} old man slumped in his chair.
e.zh: 那个酒鬼老头瘫坐在椅子上。

crapy.t: 像绉绸的；具有皱褶状质感的

e.en: She wore a {crapy} black dress to the funeral.
e.zh: 她穿着一件像绉绸的黑裙参加葬礼。

e.en: The leaves had a {crapy} texture after drying.
e.zh: 干燥后的叶子呈现出绉绸般的质感。

craquelure.t: 古画或瓷器表面的细密裂纹

e.en: Experts examined the {craquelure} of the old painting.
e.zh: 专家检查了这幅旧画上的细裂纹。

e.en: The {craquelure} helped authenticate the artwork.
e.zh: 这些细裂纹帮助鉴定了作品的真伪。

crases.t: 元音合并的复数形式；体液配合

e.en: The grammarian listed several {crases} from Greek.
e.zh: 语法学家列出了希腊语中的几个元音合并现象。

e.en: Ancient texts contain many vowel {crases}.
e.zh: 古代文献中包含许多元音合并现象。

crash-dive.t: 紧急下潜；俯冲；急剧下跌

e.en: The submarine had to {crash-dive} to avoid detection.
e.zh: 潜艇不得不紧急下潜以避免被发现。

e.en: Stocks {crash-dive} after such bad announcements.
e.zh: 出现这样的坏消息后股票会暴跌。

crash-dived.t: 紧急下潜了；急速俯冲了

e.en: The plane {crash-dived} into the ocean.
e.zh: 飞机俯冲坠入了海洋。

e.en: The submarine {crash-dived} when sonar detected enemies.
e.zh: 声纳发现敌人时潜艇紧急下潜。

crash-diving.t: 紧急下潜中；急速俯冲行为

e.en: The pilots practiced {crash-diving} during training.
e.zh: 飞行员在训练中练习俯冲。

e.en: {Crash-diving} too steeply can rip off wings.
e.zh: 俯冲角度太陡会扯掉机翼。

crash-helmet.t: 防撞头盔；摩托车安全头盔

e.en: Always wear a {crash-helmet} when riding a motorbike.
e.zh: 骑摩托车时一定要戴防撞头盔。

e.en: His {crash-helmet} probably saved his life.
e.zh: 他的防撞头盔很可能救了他一命。

crash-land.t: 紧急迫降；飞机强行迫降着陆

e.en: The pilot had to {crash-land} in a field.
e.zh: 飞行员只得在田野里紧急迫降。

e.en: They were forced to {crash-land} on the highway.
e.zh: 他们被迫在高速公路上紧急迫降。

crash-landing.t: 紧急迫降；坠机式紧急着陆

e.en: The {crash-landing} damaged the aircraft severely.
e.zh: 这次迫降让飞机严重受损。

e.en: Everyone survived the {crash-landing} miraculously.
e.zh: 所有人都奇迹般地在迫降中幸存。

crash-landings.t: 紧急迫降；多次紧急迫降事件

e.en: Multiple {crash-landings} occurred during the war.
e.zh: 战争期间发生了多次紧急迫降。

e.en: The pilot has survived three {crash-landings}.
e.zh: 这位飞行员经历了三次紧急迫降都幸存下来。

crash-test.t: 碰撞测试；进行碰撞试验

e.en: Engineers will {crash-test} the new model tomorrow.
e.zh: 工程师明天将对新车型进行碰撞测试。

e.en: We need to {crash-test} every prototype.
e.zh: 我们需要对每个原型车进行碰撞测试。

e.en: He had to {crashland} in the desert.
e.zh: 他被迫在沙漠中紧急迫降。

e.en: Helicopters can {crashland} on water in emergencies.
e.zh: 直升机紧急情况下可以迫降在水面上。

crashlanded.t: 紧急迫降了；已强行迫降着陆

e.en: The plane {crashlanded} on a frozen lake.
e.zh: 飞机在结冰的湖面上迫降了。

e.en: Two helicopters {crashlanded} during the mission.
e.zh: 任务中有两架直升机紧急迫降。

crashproof.t: 防碰撞的；抗冲击碰撞设计

e.en: Designers want to make the car {crashproof}.
e.zh: 设计师想把汽车做得防撞。

e.en: No vehicle is truly {crashproof}.
e.zh: 没有车辆是真正防撞的。

crasis.t: 元音合并现象；体液配合

e.en: The Greek lesson covered an important {crasis}.
e.zh: 希腊语课讲到了一个重要的元音合并。

e.en: Ancient medicine spoke of bodily {crasis}.
e.zh: 古代医学讲究体液的混合。

e.en: His {crassitude} embarrassed everyone present.
e.zh: 他的粗俗让在场所有人都很尴尬。

e.en: The film exposed political {crassitude}.
e.zh: 这部电影揭露了政治上的粗鄙无知。

crassulaceous.t: 景天科的；属于景天科植物的

e.en: Botanists examined several {crassulaceous} plants in the desert.
e.zh: 植物学家在沙漠里观察了几种景天科植物。

e.en: The succulent garden featured many {crassulaceous} species.
e.zh: 多肉花园里有许多景天科植物。

crat.t: 贵族；上流社会成员的俚语

e.en: The young {crat} attended every fashionable ball.
e.zh: 那位年轻的贵族出席每一场时髦的舞会。

e.en: Old {crats} resented the new political order.
e.zh: 老贵族们对新的政治秩序心怀不满。

e.en: Hay was piled high in the {cratch}.
e.zh: 干草高高堆在草料架上。

e.en: The {cratch} held food for the cattle.
e.zh: 那个草料架装着牛的饲料。

crateful.t: 一箱的量；满满一整板条箱

e.en: She brought a {crateful} of oranges from the farm.
e.zh: 她从农场带回一箱橘子。

e.en: He drank a whole {crateful} of beer.
e.zh: 他喝了整整一箱啤酒。

crateriform.t: 火山口状的；杯状的；钵形的

e.en: The flower had a {crateriform} structure.
e.zh: 这朵花呈杯状结构。

e.en: Geologists noted the {crateriform} depression nearby.
e.zh: 地质学家注意到附近一处火山口状的洼地。

craterization.t: 火山口的形成；坑状凹陷的形成

e.en: {Craterization} of the surface occurred over millennia.
e.zh: 表面上火山口状凹陷的形成历经了千年。

e.en: Doctors studied {craterization} in the bone tissue.
e.zh: 医生研究了骨组织上凹坑的形成。

e.en: The moon's surface showed a tiny {craterlet}.
e.zh: 月球表面有一个小小的火山口。

e.en: Each meteor created a fresh {craterlet}.
e.zh: 每颗陨石都形成了一个新的小火山口。

craterous.t: 多坑的；火山口般的；满是凹坑的

e.en: The {craterous} road jolted the truck constantly.
e.zh: 坑坑洼洼的路把卡车颠个不停。

e.en: We crossed a {craterous} battlefield.
e.zh: 我们穿过一片满是弹坑的战场。

craton.t: 克拉通；地壳稳定的古陆核

e.en: The Canadian Shield is an ancient {craton}.
e.zh: 加拿大地盾是一个古老的克拉通。

e.en: Geologists mapped the African {craton}.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了非洲克拉通的地图。

e.en: The {cratonic} rocks date back billions of years.
e.zh: 这些克拉通岩石可追溯到几十亿年前。

e.en: Mining concentrated in the {cratonic} regions.
e.zh: 采矿集中在克拉通区域。

craunch.t: 嘎吱嘎吱地嚼；咯吱咯吱嚼

e.en: The dog began to {craunch} the bone loudly.
e.zh: 狗开始咯吱咯吱地大声啃骨头。

e.en: I could {craunch} apples all day long.
e.zh: 我可以整天嘎吱嘎吱地吃苹果。

craunched.t: 嘎吱嘎吱地嚼过；咯吱嚼过

e.en: She {craunched} the candy between her teeth.
e.zh: 她用牙齿咯吱咯吱地嚼着糖果。

e.en: The horse {craunched} contentedly on the carrots.
e.zh: 马心满意足地嘎吱嘎吱嚼着胡萝卜。

craunches.t: 嘎吱嘎吱地嚼；咯吱咯吱嚼着

e.en: He always {craunches} ice cubes during meetings.
e.zh: 他开会时总是嘎吱嘎吱地嚼冰块。

e.en: The squirrel {craunches} acorns near the window.
e.zh: 那只松鼠在窗边咯吱咯吱地嚼橡子。

craunching.t: 正在嘎吱嘎吱地嚼；咯吱嚼

e.en: She sat {craunching} celery at her desk.
e.zh: 她坐在桌前嘎吱嘎吱地嚼芹菜。

e.en: Stop {craunching} so loudly during the movie.
e.zh: 看电影时别那么大声嚼东西。

e.en: The mason used a {cross-bond} pattern for strength.
e.zh: 砖匠采用十字砌合法以增加强度。

e.en: This wall shows a classic English {cross-bond}.
e.zh: 这堵墙呈现经典的英式十字砖砌。

e.en: The flag bore a skull and {cross-bones}.
e.zh: 旗子上画着骷髅和交叉骸骨。

e.en: Pirates often flew the {cross-bones} emblem.
e.zh: 海盗常挂着交叉骸骨的标志。

e.en: They tackled {cross-border} smuggling together.
e.zh: 他们联手打击跨境走私。

e.en: {Cross-border} payments have become faster.
e.zh: 跨境支付已变得更快。

e.en: Engineers added a {cross-brace} to stabilize the frame.
e.zh: 工程师加装了交叉支撑以稳固框架。

e.en: The bookshelf needs a {cross-brace} at the back.
e.zh: 书架背后需要一根十字斜撑。

e.en: They raise {cross-bred} cattle on the ranch.
e.zh: 他们在牧场饲养杂交牛。

e.en: The dog is a {cross-bred} retriever.
e.zh: 那只狗是杂交的寻回犬。

e.en: Farmers {cross-breed} sheep for better wool.
e.zh: 农民让羊杂交以获取更好的羊毛。

e.en: This puppy is a charming {cross-breed}.
e.zh: 这只小狗是可爱的杂交品种。

e.en: {Cross-breeding} can improve disease resistance.
e.zh: 杂交繁育有助于提高抗病能力。

e.en: They study {cross-breeding} of native flowers.
e.zh: 他们研究本地花卉的杂交繁殖。

e.en: Open both windows for a {cross-breeze}.
e.zh: 两扇窗都打开,形成对流风。

e.en: A pleasant {cross-breeze} cooled the room.
e.zh: 一阵舒适的对流微风让房间凉爽下来。

e.en: The wrestler floored him with a {cross-buttock}.
e.zh: 摔跤手用过臀摔把他撂倒。

e.en: He learned the {cross-buttock} throw at judo class.
e.zh: 他在柔道课上学会了背摔。

e.en: Please {cross-check} the figures with last year's report.
e.zh: 请把数据与去年的报告交叉核对。

e.en: We {cross-check} sources before publishing.
e.zh: 我们发表前会交叉核实信息来源。

e.en: The editor {cross-checked} every quotation.
e.zh: 编辑交叉核对了每一句引文。

e.en: Numbers were {cross-checked} against the database.
e.zh: 数字已与数据库交叉核对过。

e.en: {Cross-checking} prevents costly mistakes.
e.zh: 交叉核对可避免代价高昂的错误。

e.en: She spent the morning {cross-checking} receipts.
e.zh: 她花了一上午交叉核对单据。

cross-checks.t: 交叉核对(复数);多次核实

e.en: The auditor {cross-checks} every transaction.
e.zh: 审计师对每笔交易都进行交叉核对。

e.en: Several {cross-checks} confirmed the result.
e.zh: 多次交叉核对证实了结果。

e.en: The data underwent {cross-classification} by age and income.
e.zh: 数据按年龄和收入进行了交叉分类。

e.en: {Cross-classification} reveals hidden patterns.
e.zh: 交叉分类能揭示隐藏的规律。

e.en: Old TVs often suffered from {cross-color} artifacts.
e.zh: 旧电视常出现串色干扰。

e.en: Engineers reduced {cross-color} in the new chip.
e.zh: 工程师在新芯片中减少了串色现象。

e.en: A {cross-connection} contaminated the water supply.
e.zh: 一处交叉连接污染了供水。

e.en: Plumbers must avoid any {cross-connection}.
e.zh: 水管工必须避免任何串接。

e.en: The inspector flagged several {cross-connections}.
e.zh: 检查员标记了几处交叉连接。

e.en: {Cross-connections} can spread contamination quickly.
e.zh: 交叉连接会迅速扩散污染。

e.en: She loves {cross-country} skiing in winter.
e.zh: 她喜欢冬天进行越野滑雪。

e.en: They drove {cross-country} to see family.
e.zh: 他们横穿全国去看家人。

e.en: In some cultures, marrying a {cross-cousin} is preferred.
e.zh: 在某些文化中,与交表亲通婚更受青睐。

e.en: Anthropologists study {cross-cousin} kinship.
e.zh: 人类学家研究交表亲的亲属关系。

e.en: The course explores {cross-cultural} communication.
e.zh: 这门课探讨跨文化沟通。

e.en: She has rich {cross-cultural} experience.
e.zh: 她拥有丰富的跨文化经验。

e.en: The findings hold up {cross-culturally}.
e.zh: 这些结论在跨文化层面同样成立。

e.en: They studied the issue {cross-culturally}.
e.zh: 他们从跨文化角度研究了这一问题。

e.en: Swimmers struggled against the {cross-current}.
e.zh: 游泳者奋力抵抗逆流。

e.en: Political {cross-currents} shaped the debate.
e.zh: 政治上的相反潮流塑造了这场辩论。

e.en: The school promotes {cross-curricular} projects.
e.zh: 学校倡导跨学科项目。

e.en: Teachers planned a {cross-curricular} unit on water.
e.zh: 老师们规划了一个关于水的跨学科单元。

e.en: The director used a {cross-cut} between two scenes.
e.zh: 导演在两个场景间使用了交叉剪辑。

e.en: Make a clean {cross-cut} along the grain.
e.zh: 沿木纹做一个整齐的横切。

e.en: They built a {cross-domain} research team.
e.zh: 他们组建了跨领域的研究团队。

e.en: {Cross-domain} requests need extra security checks.
e.zh: 跨域请求需要额外的安全检查。

e.en: He likes to {cross-dress} for the stage.
e.zh: 他喜欢为舞台反串穿装。

e.en: Some festivals encourage people to {cross-dress}.
e.zh: 有些节庆鼓励大家穿异性服装。

e.en: He {cross-dressed} for the comedy show.
e.zh: 他为这场喜剧演出反串女装。

e.en: The {cross-dressed} performer stole the scene.
e.zh: 那位反串的演员抢尽风头。

cross-dresses.t: 反串穿装(第三人称单数)

e.en: He sometimes {cross-dresses} on Halloween.
e.zh: 他偶尔在万圣节反串穿装。

e.en: The actor {cross-dresses} for several roles.
e.zh: 这位演员为多个角色反串穿装。

e.en: {Cross-dressing} has a long theatrical history.
e.zh: 异装在戏剧史上由来已久。

e.en: The film features playful {cross-dressing}.
e.zh: 这部电影呈现了俏皮的反串穿装。

e.en: The witness wilted under {cross-examination}.
e.zh: 证人在盘问下败下阵来。

e.en: Her {cross-examination} exposed the lie.
e.zh: 她的交叉询问揭穿了谎言。

e.en: Several {cross-examinations} took place that day.
e.zh: 那天进行了多次盘问。

e.en: The trial featured tense {cross-examinations}.
e.zh: 庭审中出现紧张的多场盘问。

e.en: She was {cross-examined} for two hours.
e.zh: 她被盘问了两个小时。

e.en: He {cross-examined} every claim carefully.
e.zh: 他仔细反诘了每一项说法。

e.en: The {cross-examiner} pressed the witness hard.
e.zh: 盘问者紧紧逼问证人。

e.en: She is a famously sharp {cross-examiner}.
e.zh: 她是出了名锋利的反诘律师。

e.en: The attorney {cross-examines} every witness thoroughly.
e.zh: 那位律师对每位证人都进行彻底盘问。

e.en: He {cross-examines} the data as if in court.
e.zh: 他像在法庭上一样盘问数据。

e.en: She spent hours {cross-examining} the suspect.
e.zh: 她花了几个小时盘问嫌疑人。

e.en: {Cross-examining} witnesses requires sharp focus.
e.zh: 盘问证人需要高度专注。

e.en: The child was treated for {cross-eye}.
e.zh: 那孩子接受了内斜视的治疗。

e.en: Surgery can correct {cross-eye} in many cases.
e.zh: 手术在许多情况下可矫正对眼。

e.en: The cat went {cross-eyed} watching the fly.
e.zh: 猫盯着苍蝇看成了斗鸡眼。

e.en: He pulled a {cross-eyed} face to make her laugh.
e.zh: 他做了个斗鸡眼鬼脸逗她笑。

e.en: The DJ used a smooth {cross-fade} between songs.
e.zh: DJ 在歌曲之间用了平滑的交叉淡变。

e.en: Editors added a {cross-fade} for a softer transition.
e.zh: 剪辑师加了交叉淡变,让转场更柔和。

e.en: Bees aid the {cross-fertilisation} of flowers.
e.zh: 蜜蜂助力花卉的异花授粉。

e.en: The conference encouraged {cross-fertilisation} of ideas.
e.zh: 会议促进了思想的相互启发。

e.en: Bees {cross-fertilise} apple blossoms.
e.zh: 蜜蜂为苹果花异花授粉。

e.en: The two teams {cross-fertilise} each other's ideas.
e.zh: 两个团队相互启发彼此的想法。

cross-fertilises.t: 异花授粉(第三人称单数)

e.en: The wind {cross-fertilises} many grasses.
e.zh: 风为许多草本植物异花授粉。

e.en: Travel {cross-fertilises} her writing with fresh ideas.
e.zh: 旅行让她的写作不断吸收新思想。

e.en: {Cross-fertilization} boosts genetic diversity.
e.zh: 异花授粉提升了遗传多样性。

e.en: There is rich {cross-fertilization} between art and science.
e.zh: 艺术与科学之间存在丰富的相互启发。

e.en: Insects {cross-fertilize} most fruit trees.
e.zh: 昆虫为大多数果树异花授粉。

e.en: Workshops let disciplines {cross-fertilize}.
e.zh: 研讨会让不同学科互相启发。

e.en: Some candidates {cross-file} in both primaries.
e.zh: 有些候选人在两党初选中同时申报。

e.en: Please {cross-file} this memo under both projects.
e.zh: 请把这份备忘录同时归入两个项目。

e.en: The squad practised {cross-firing} drills.
e.zh: 小队练习交叉射击演习。

e.en: Civilians were caught in the {cross-firing}.
e.zh: 平民被卷入了交火之中。

e.en: She leads a {cross-functional} team.
e.zh: 她领导一个跨职能的团队。

e.en: {Cross-functional} collaboration speeds delivery.
e.zh: 跨职能协作能加快交付。

e.en: The shed door swings on a {cross-garnet} hinge.
e.zh: 棚屋的门用丁字铰链悬挂。

e.en: He fitted a {cross-garnet} to the gate.
e.zh: 他给大门装了一个十字铰链。

e.en: The plank was hard to plane because it was {cross-grained}.
e.zh: 这块木板逆纹,很难刨平。

e.en: He's a stubborn, {cross-grained} old man.
e.zh: 他是个固执拧脾气的老头。

e.en: The artist will {cross-hatch} for deeper shadow.
e.zh: 画家会用交叉影线表现更深的阴影。

e.en: A fine {cross-hatch} gave the drawing texture.
e.zh: 细密的交叉影线赋予画作质感。

e.en: The artist {cross-hatched} the shadows carefully.
e.zh: 画家小心地用交叉线画出阴影。

e.en: The map showed {cross-hatched} regions for forests.
e.zh: 地图用交叉影线标出森林区域。

e.en: He used {cross-hatching} to add depth to the drawing.
e.zh: 他用交叉排线为画作增添层次感。

e.en: {Cross-hatching} is a classic engraving technique.
e.zh: 交叉影线是经典的版画技法。

e.en: The two firms have a {cross-holding} of shares.
e.zh: 两家公司之间存在交叉持股。

e.en: {Cross-holding} structures complicate corporate governance.
e.zh: 交叉持股结构使公司治理变得复杂。

cross-index.t: 交叉索引；建立相互参照

e.en: Please {cross-index} these entries by author and topic.
e.zh: 请按作者和主题为这些条目建立交叉索引。

e.en: The catalogue has a thorough {cross-index}.
e.zh: 目录有详尽的交叉索引。

e.en: Hospitals work hard to prevent {cross-infection}.
e.zh: 医院努力防止交叉感染。

e.en: Hand washing reduces the risk of {cross-infection}.
e.zh: 洗手能降低交叉感染的风险。

e.en: The children sat {cross-legged} on the floor.
e.zh: 孩子们盘腿坐在地板上。

e.en: She meditates {cross-legged} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上盘腿冥想。

e.en: The companies signed a patent {cross-license}.
e.zh: 两家公司签订了专利交叉许可协议。

e.en: They agreed to {cross-license} their technologies.
e.zh: 他们同意相互授权各自的技术。

e.en: Polymer chains can {cross-link} when heated.
e.zh: 聚合物链在加热时会发生交联。

e.en: A {cross-link} between the molecules strengthens the material.
e.zh: 分子间的交联使材料更坚韧。

e.en: The {cross-linkage} makes the rubber more durable.
e.zh: 交联作用使橡胶更耐用。

e.en: Aging skin shows increased collagen {cross-linkage}.
e.zh: 衰老的皮肤胶原蛋白交联增多。

e.en: UV light triggers {cross-linking} in the resin.
e.zh: 紫外线会引发树脂的交联反应。

e.en: {Cross-linking} between data sets revealed new patterns.
e.zh: 数据集之间的交叉关联揭示了新的规律。

e.en: The two brands launched a {cross-marketing} campaign.
e.zh: 两个品牌联合开展了交叉营销活动。

e.en: {Cross-marketing} can expand a brand's reach.
e.zh: 交叉营销能扩大品牌影响力。

e.en: The model performs {cross-modal} reasoning across text and images.
e.zh: 该模型可在文本和图像间进行跨模态推理。

e.en: {Cross-modal} perception links sight and sound.
e.zh: 跨模态感知将视觉和听觉联系起来。

e.en: The defendant filed a {cross-motion} to dismiss.
e.zh: 被告提出了驳回的反诉动议。

e.en: The judge heard both the motion and the {cross-motion}.
e.zh: 法官同时审理了动议和反动议。

e.en: The album marked her {cross-over} into pop music.
e.zh: 这张专辑标志着她跨界进入流行乐坛。

e.en: There is a {cross-over} between science and art.
e.zh: 科学与艺术之间存在交叉。

e.en: Regulators investigated the firms' {cross-ownership}.
e.zh: 监管机构调查了这些公司之间的交叉持股。

e.en: {Cross-ownership} of media outlets raises concerns.
e.zh: 媒体的交叉持股令人担忧。

e.en: The app is fully {cross-platform}.
e.zh: 这款应用完全支持跨平台。

e.en: They built a {cross-platform} development tool.
e.zh: 他们开发了一款跨平台开发工具。

e.en: Geologists use a {cross-plot} of porosity and permeability.
e.zh: 地质学家使用孔隙度与渗透率的交会图。

e.en: The {cross-plot} revealed two distinct populations.
e.zh: 交会图揭示了两个不同的样本群。

e.en: Old cars often used {cross-ply} tyres.
e.zh: 老式汽车常用斜交层轮胎。

e.en: {Cross-ply} construction gives the laminate strength.
e.zh: 交叉铺层结构使层压板更坚固。

e.en: Bees help {cross-pollinate} the orchard.
e.zh: 蜜蜂帮助果园异花授粉。

e.en: Workshops {cross-pollinate} ideas between teams.
e.zh: 研讨会让各团队的想法相互交流。

cross-pollinating.t: 异花授粉的；相互启发的

e.en: The conference is {cross-pollinating} researchers from many fields.
e.zh: 这场会议让多学科研究者相互启发。

e.en: Bees were busy {cross-pollinating} the flowers.
e.zh: 蜜蜂正忙着给花朵异花授粉。

e.en: {Cross-pollination} produces stronger seedlings.
e.zh: 异花授粉能培育出更强壮的幼苗。

e.en: There's lively {cross-pollination} between the two studios.
e.zh: 两个工作室之间有活跃的思想交流。

e.en: The film and the toy line did a {cross-promotion}.
e.zh: 电影和玩具系列开展了交叉推广。

e.en: {Cross-promotion} helped both brands grow.
e.zh: 交叉推广帮助两个品牌共同成长。

e.en: They were working at {cross-purpose} without realising it.
e.zh: 他们在不知不觉中目标相左。

e.en: A {cross-purpose} discussion wastes everyone's time.
e.zh: 目的相左的讨论浪费大家的时间。

e.en: We were talking at {cross-purposes} the whole meeting.
e.zh: 整场会议我们都在各说各话。

e.en: The two departments seem to be at {cross-purposes}.
e.zh: 两个部门似乎目标相反。

e.en: The detective {cross-questioned} the suspect for hours.
e.zh: 侦探盘问了嫌疑人数小时。

e.en: She was {cross-questioned} about her whereabouts.
e.zh: 她被反复追问其行踪。

e.en: The barrister proved a relentless {cross-questioner}.
e.zh: 那位大律师是个不依不饶的盘问者。

e.en: A skilled {cross-questioner} can unsettle any witness.
e.zh: 老练的盘问者能让任何证人慌乱。

e.en: The {cross-questioning} lasted all afternoon.
e.zh: 盘问持续了一整个下午。

e.en: He held up well under {cross-questioning}.
e.zh: 他在盘问下表现镇定。

e.en: The prosecutor {cross-questions} every witness sharply.
e.zh: 检察官犀利地盘问每一位证人。

e.en: She {cross-questions} her students to test understanding.
e.zh: 她反复追问学生以检验理解。

e.en: The antibody is {cross-reactive} with several viruses.
e.zh: 该抗体与多种病毒发生交叉反应。

e.en: Allergy tests can be misled by {cross-reactive} proteins.
e.zh: 交叉反应蛋白可能干扰过敏测试。

e.en: The vaccine {cross-reacts} with related strains.
e.zh: 该疫苗与相关毒株发生交叉反应。

e.en: This dye {cross-reacts} with similar compounds.
e.zh: 这种染料会与类似化合物发生交叉反应。

e.en: The two articles {cross-refer} to each other.
e.zh: 两篇文章相互参照。

e.en: Please {cross-refer} the figures to the appendix.
e.zh: 请将这些数字与附录交叉对照。

e.en: Each entry includes a {cross-reference} to related topics.
e.zh: 每个条目都附有与相关主题的交叉引用。

e.en: We need to {cross-reference} the data sources.
e.zh: 我们需要对数据源进行交叉比对。

e.en: The names were {cross-referenced} with police records.
e.zh: 这些名字已与警方记录交叉比对。

e.en: He keeps a fully {cross-referenced} index.
e.zh: 他保留着一份完整交叉索引。

e.en: The book contains many useful {cross-references}.
e.zh: 这本书包含许多有用的交叉引用。

e.en: She {cross-references} every claim with a citation.
e.zh: 她为每个论断标注交叉引用。

e.en: {Cross-referencing} the lists revealed duplicates.
e.zh: 交叉比对名单后发现了重复项。

e.en: The system saves time by automatically {cross-referencing} records.
e.zh: 系统通过自动交叉引用记录节省了时间。

e.en: The dictionary {cross-refers} synonyms to a main entry.
e.zh: 该词典将同义词交叉引向主词条。

e.en: Each chapter {cross-refers} readers to related sections.
e.zh: 每一章都让读者参照相关章节。

e.en: The bacteria show {cross-resistance} to several antibiotics.
e.zh: 该细菌对多种抗生素表现出交叉耐药性。

e.en: {Cross-resistance} complicates treatment choices.
e.zh: 交叉耐药性让治疗选择更加复杂。

e.en: The diagram shows a {cross-section} of the engine.
e.zh: 图中展示了发动机的横截面。

e.en: The survey covered a wide {cross-section} of voters.
e.zh: 调查涵盖了选民中各色各样的人。

e.en: They ran a {cross-sectional} study of the population.
e.zh: 他们对该人群进行了横断面研究。

e.en: The {cross-sectional} view shows internal layers.
e.zh: 横截面视图显示了内部层次。

e.en: The textbook includes detailed {cross-sections} of the heart.
e.zh: 教科书包含心脏的详细横截面图。

e.en: Various {cross-sections} of society attended the rally.
e.zh: 社会各阶层的人都参加了集会。

e.en: Banks rely heavily on {cross-selling} financial products.
e.zh: 银行严重依赖金融产品的交叉销售。

e.en: {Cross-selling} can boost average revenue per customer.
e.zh: 交叉销售能提高每位客户的平均收入。

e.en: The church has a {cross-shaped} floor plan.
e.zh: 这座教堂的平面呈十字形。

e.en: She wore a small {cross-shaped} pendant.
e.zh: 她戴着一个十字形小吊坠。

e.en: Sailors once used a {cross-staff} to measure star altitude.
e.zh: 水手曾用十字测角仪测量星星的高度。

e.en: The museum displays an antique {cross-staff}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件古董十字测角仪。

e.en: The surfer performed a graceful {cross-step} on the longboard.
e.zh: 冲浪者在长板上做了一个优雅的交叉步。

e.en: Learn the {cross-step} before trying advanced moves.
e.zh: 在尝试高难度动作前先学会交叉步。

e.en: A {cross-tabulation} revealed gender differences in the responses.
e.zh: 交叉制表显示出回答中的性别差异。

e.en: Use {cross-tabulation} to compare two categorical variables.
e.zh: 用交叉表比较两个分类变量。

e.en: The report includes several {cross-tabulations} of the survey data.
e.zh: 报告包含若干调查数据的交叉表。

e.en: {Cross-tabulations} help spot hidden patterns.
e.zh: 交叉表有助于发现隐藏的规律。

e.en: Shielded cables reduce {cross-talk} between channels.
e.zh: 屏蔽电缆能减少通道间的串音。

e.en: There was lively {cross-talk} between the two panels.
e.zh: 两个小组之间有活跃的交叉对话。

e.en: She picked the {crustiest} roll in the basket.
e.zh: 她挑了篮子里最脆硬的小面包。

e.en: He's the {crustiest} old sailor on the dock.
e.zh: 他是码头上脾气最坏的老水手。

e.en: He answered {crustily} and slammed the door.
e.zh: 他没好气地回了一句，砰地关上门。

e.en: She spoke {crustily} to the new intern.
e.zh: 她对新来的实习生说话很冲。

e.en: I love the {crustiness} of fresh sourdough.
e.zh: 我爱新鲜酸面包的那层脆皮。

e.en: His {crustiness} hides a kind heart.
e.zh: 他的暴躁脾气下藏着一颗善心。

e.en: The lava cooled into a {crustlike} layer.
e.zh: 熔岩冷却后形成一层硬壳。

e.en: A {crustlike} coating covered the old pipe.
e.zh: 旧管子上覆着一层硬壳般的涂层。

e.en: {Crustose} lichens cling tightly to rocks.
e.zh: 壳状地衣紧紧附着在岩石上。

e.en: We identified several {crustose} species.
e.zh: 我们鉴定出几种壳状地衣。

e.en: Prices were once quoted in {cruzeiros}.
e.zh: 物价曾经以克鲁赛罗标示。

e.en: My grandfather kept a few old {cruzeiros}.
e.zh: 我祖父留着几张旧克鲁赛罗钞票。

crwth.t: 克鲁斯琴（古威尔士弓弦乐器）

e.en: He played a haunting tune on the {crwth}.
e.zh: 他用克鲁斯琴奏出一段萦绕心头的曲子。

e.en: The {crwth} is a medieval Welsh instrument.
e.zh: 克鲁斯琴是一种中世纪威尔士乐器。

cry-baby.t: 爱哭鬼；动不动就哭的人

e.en: Don't be such a {cry-baby} over a small scratch.
e.zh: 别为一点小擦伤就当爱哭鬼。

e.en: Her brother called her a {cry-baby}.
e.zh: 她哥哥叫她爱哭鬼。

cryo.t: 低温的；冷冻（前缀或简称）

e.en: The lab uses {cryo} storage for samples.
e.zh: 实验室用低温储存保存样本。

e.en: She works in a {cryo} preservation startup.
e.zh: 她在一家低温保存初创公司工作。

e.en: The tumor was treated with {cryoablation}.
e.zh: 肿瘤通过冷冻消融术进行治疗。

e.en: {Cryoablation} can target irregular heartbeats.
e.zh: 冷冻消融术可治疗心律不齐。

e.en: They study {cryobiological} effects on cells.
e.zh: 他们研究低温生物学对细胞的影响。

e.en: The lab runs {cryobiological} experiments.
e.zh: 该实验室进行低温生物学实验。

e.en: {Cryobiology} explores life at low temperatures.
e.zh: 低温生物学研究低温下的生命现象。

e.en: She earned a doctorate in {cryobiology}.
e.zh: 她获得了低温生物学博士学位。

e.en: {Cryochemistry} studies reactions at extreme cold.
e.zh: 低温化学研究极低温下的反应。

e.en: His paper extended {cryochemistry} methods.
e.zh: 他的论文拓展了低温化学方法。

cryoconite.t: 冰尘（冰川表面深色尘粒）

e.en: {Cryoconite} darkens the glacier surface.
e.zh: 冰尘使冰川表面颜色变深。

e.en: Microbes thrive in {cryoconite} holes.
e.zh: 微生物在冰尘洞中繁衍。

e.en: {Cryodesiccation} preserves delicate proteins.
e.zh: 冷冻干燥可保存易损蛋白质。

e.en: The vaccine relies on {cryodesiccation}.
e.zh: 该疫苗依赖冷冻干燥工艺。

e.en: {Cryodrying} keeps the flavor of fruit.
e.zh: 冷冻干燥能保留水果的风味。

e.en: The factory uses {cryodrying} for herbs.
e.zh: 工厂用冷冻干燥处理香草。

e.en: {Cryoelectronics} powers many quantum chips.
e.zh: 低温电子学是许多量子芯片的基础。

e.en: He specializes in {cryoelectronics} research.
e.zh: 他专攻低温电子学研究。

e.en: {Cryoextraction} was once standard for cataracts.
e.zh: 冷冻摘除术曾是白内障的标准疗法。

e.en: The surgeon performed a careful {cryoextraction}.
e.zh: 外科医生小心地进行了冷冻摘除术。

e.en: He sterilized the {cryoextractor} before surgery.
e.zh: 手术前他对冷冻摘出器进行了消毒。

e.en: The clinic ordered a new {cryoextractor}.
e.zh: 诊所订购了一台新的冷冻摘出器。

e.en: Liquid nitrogen is a common {cryogen}.
e.zh: 液氮是一种常见的冷冻剂。

e.en: They topped up the {cryogen} reservoir.
e.zh: 他们给冷冻剂储罐加满。

e.en: The {cryogenerator} hummed in the basement.
e.zh: 低温制冷机在地下室嗡嗡作响。

e.en: They installed a more efficient {cryogenerator}.
e.zh: 他们安装了一台更高效的低温制冷机。

e.en: The {cryogenicist} adjusted the helium flow.
e.zh: 低温学家调整了氦气流量。

e.en: She trained as a {cryogenicist} at MIT.
e.zh: 她在麻省理工受训成为低温学家。

e.en: {Cryogeny} underlies many modern technologies.
e.zh: 低温学是许多现代技术的基础。

e.en: He published widely on {cryogeny}.
e.zh: 他在低温学领域发表了大量论文。

e.en: Tests revealed elevated {cryoglobulin} levels.
e.zh: 检测显示冷球蛋白水平升高。

e.en: {Cryoglobulin} can clog small blood vessels.
e.zh: 冷球蛋白可堵塞小血管。

e.en: At the eutectic point, a {cryohydrate} forms.
e.zh: 在低共熔点会形成冰盐共晶。

e.en: He measured the {cryohydrate} temperature.
e.zh: 他测量了冰盐共晶的温度。

e.en: {Cryolite} is used in aluminum smelting.
e.zh: 冰晶石用于炼铝。

e.en: Greenland once exported {cryolite}.
e.zh: 格陵兰曾出口冰晶石。

e.en: {Cryology} studies snow, ice and glaciers.
e.zh: 冰川学研究雪、冰和冰川。

e.en: Her lecture introduced basic {cryology}.
e.zh: 她的讲座介绍了冰川学基础。

e.en: The {cryometer} read minus eighty Celsius.
e.zh: 低温计显示零下八十摄氏度。

e.en: He calibrated the lab's {cryometer}.
e.zh: 他校准了实验室的低温计。

cryopanel.t: 低温板（真空系统冷凝面）

e.en: The {cryopanel} traps stray gas molecules.
e.zh: 低温板可捕获散逸的气体分子。

e.en: They cleaned the {cryopanel} after each run.
e.zh: 每次实验后他们都清洁低温板。

e.en: {Cryopedology} examines permafrost soils.
e.zh: 冻土学研究永冻层土壤。

e.en: He's a leading figure in {cryopedology}.
e.zh: 他是冻土学界的权威。

e.en: The judge identified two {cruces} in the argument.
e.zh: 法官指出了论点中的两个关键之处。

e.en: Several {cruces} appear in the manuscript's marginalia.
e.zh: 手稿的旁注中出现了若干疑难处。

e.en: Nobody questioned the {cruciality} of the decision.
e.zh: 没人质疑这一决定的至关重要性。

e.en: She emphasized the {cruciality} of early diagnosis.
e.zh: 她强调了早期诊断的关键性。

e.en: He caught a small {crucian} in the pond.
e.zh: 他在池塘里钓到一条小鲫鱼。

e.en: The {crucian} carp thrives in muddy water.
e.zh: 鲫鱼在浑浊的水中也能很好地生存。

crucifer.t: 持十字架者；十字花科植物

e.en: The {crucifer} led the procession into the cathedral.
e.zh: 持十字架者带队走进大教堂。

e.en: Cabbage is a familiar {crucifer} in many gardens.
e.zh: 卷心菜是许多花园里常见的十字花科植物。

e.en: The painting depicts the {crucifier} hammering the nails.
e.zh: 画中描绘了将人钉上十字架者挥锤钉钉。

e.en: Tradition condemns the {crucifier} as a villain.
e.zh: 传统观念将施刑钉死耶稣者视为恶人。

e.en: The cottage was built around a massive oak {cruck}.
e.zh: 这座小屋是围着一根粗大的橡木曲梁建造的。

e.en: Medieval barns often used {cruck} frames.
e.zh: 中世纪的谷仓常常使用曲木屋架结构。

e.en: She arranged a colorful {crudite} platter for guests.
e.zh: 她为客人准备了一盘色彩缤纷的生菜拼盘。

e.en: The {crudite} came with a creamy herb dip.
e.zh: 这道生菜拼盘配有奶油香草蘸酱。

e.en: It was the {cruelest} thing he ever said.
e.zh: 那是他说过最残忍的话。

e.en: April is sometimes called the {cruelest} month.
e.zh: 有人说四月是最残酷的月份。

cruelty-free.t: 非动物实验的；不虐待动物的

e.en: She only buys {cruelty-free} cosmetics.
e.zh: 她只购买非动物实验的化妆品。

e.en: The brand promotes a {cruelty-free} lifestyle.
e.zh: 该品牌倡导不虐待动物的生活方式。

e.en: The navy launched a {cruise-missile} at the target.
e.zh: 海军向目标发射了一枚巡航导弹。

e.en: A {cruise-missile} can fly low to evade radar.
e.zh: 巡航导弹可以低空飞行以躲避雷达。

cruiseway.t: 游船航道；运河巡游水道

e.en: The old canal is now a popular {cruiseway}.
e.zh: 那条老运河如今成了热门的游船航道。

e.en: They mapped a scenic {cruiseway} through the lakes.
e.zh: 他们规划了一条穿越湖区的风景巡游水道。

e.en: A linen {crumbcloth} protected the carpet beneath.
e.zh: 一块亚麻接屑布保护着下面的地毯。

e.en: Servants shook the {crumbcloth} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后仆人们抖了抖接屑布上的碎屑。

e.en: This cheese is {crumblier} than cheddar.
e.zh: 这种奶酪比切达干酪更易碎。

e.en: The cookies turned {crumblier} after a day.
e.zh: 放了一天后，饼干变得更松散易碎了。

e.en: That was the {crumbliest} shortbread I've baked.
e.zh: 那是我烤过最酥松易碎的奶油酥饼。

e.en: Find the {crumbliest} biscuit for the topping.
e.zh: 挑出最易碎的饼干来做表面装饰。

e.en: Bakers prize the {crumbliness} of good shortbread.
e.zh: 烘焙师珍视优质酥饼的酥松质地。

e.en: Test the soil's {crumbliness} before planting.
e.zh: 种植前先测试一下土壤的疏松程度。

e.en: He brushed off his {crumby} shirt.
e.zh: 他拍掉了衬衫上的面包屑。

e.en: That was a {crumby} excuse for being late.
e.zh: 那是个很差劲的迟到借口。

e.en: She played a Renaissance tune on the {crumhorn}.
e.zh: 她用克鲁姆管吹奏了一首文艺复兴时期的曲子。

e.en: The {crumhorn} produces a buzzing, reedy sound.
e.zh: 克鲁姆管会发出嗡嗡的簧片般的声音。

e.en: This hotel is even {crummier} than the last one.
e.zh: 这家酒店比上一家还要差劲。

e.en: His mood got {crummier} as the day went on.
e.zh: 他的心情随着时间推移变得更糟。

e.en: That was the {crummiest} apartment I ever rented.
e.zh: 那是我租过最破烂的公寓。

e.en: He told the {crummiest} excuse imaginable.
e.zh: 他编出了能想到的最烂的借口。

e.en: The {crumminess} of the service shocked us.
e.zh: 服务之差劲让我们大吃一惊。

e.en: She complained about the hotel's overall {crumminess}.
e.zh: 她抱怨这家酒店整体水准低劣。

crunchable.t: 可咀嚼出脆响的；可压缩处理的

e.en: These chips are perfectly {crunchable}.
e.zh: 这些薯片嚼起来恰到好处地酥脆。

e.en: The data is now {crunchable} by our model.
e.zh: 这些数据现在可以由我们的模型进行处理了。

e.en: I like my bacon a bit {crunchier}.
e.zh: 我喜欢培根再脆一点。

e.en: Toast it longer for a {crunchier} crust.
e.zh: 再多烤一会儿，外皮会更脆。

e.en: This brand makes the {crunchiest} cereal.
e.zh: 这个牌子做的麦片最脆。

e.en: Pick the {crunchiest} apples in the basket.
e.zh: 挑出篮子里最脆的苹果。

e.en: The salad's {crunchiness} comes from the celery.
e.zh: 沙拉的脆爽口感来自芹菜。

e.en: I love the {crunchiness} of fresh granola.
e.zh: 我喜欢新鲜格兰诺拉麦片的酥脆口感。

e.en: He blasted some {crunk} from the speakers.
e.zh: 他用音箱大声放着喧闹的嘻哈音乐。

e.en: By midnight everyone was getting {crunk}.
e.zh: 到了午夜，大家都开始又嗨又醉。

e.en: The curve has a {crunodal} singularity at the origin.
e.zh: 该曲线在原点处有一个结点奇异点。

e.en: They studied a {crunodal} cubic in the plane.
e.zh: 他们研究了平面上一条有结点的三次曲线。

e.en: The graph crosses itself at a {crunode}.
e.zh: 这条曲线在一个结点处自相交。

e.en: Mathematicians classify each {crunode} carefully.
e.zh: 数学家会仔细对每个结点进行分类。

e.en: The pathologist examined the dark {cruor}.
e.zh: 病理学家检查了那块深色的凝血块。

e.en: A thick {cruor} formed inside the vein.
e.zh: 静脉内形成了一块厚厚的凝血块。

e.en: He adjusted the {crupper} on the saddle.
e.zh: 他调整了马鞍上的尾革带。

e.en: The leather {crupper} kept the saddle in place.
e.zh: 那条皮制后鞧把马鞍稳稳固定住。

e.en: The surgeon repaired the {crural} hernia.
e.zh: 外科医生修复了股疝。

e.en: The {crural} muscles support running.
e.zh: 腿部肌肉支撑着跑步动作。

e.en: She poured oil from the earthen {cruse}.
e.zh: 她从陶制小油瓶里倒出了油。

e.en: The widow's {cruse} miraculously never ran dry.
e.zh: 那位寡妇的小油瓶神奇地永不见底。

e.en: They sipped champagne in the {crush-room} during intermission.
e.zh: 中场休息时他们在剧院休息厅里啜饮香槟。

e.en: The {crush-room} buzzed with opera-goers.
e.zh: 剧院休息厅里挤满了看歌剧的人。

crushable.t: 可压碎的；可折叠不变形的

e.en: This hat is soft and easily {crushable}.
e.zh: 这顶帽子很软，可以随意压扁。

e.en: Use only {crushable} ice in the cocktail.
e.zh: 鸡尾酒里只用可压碎的冰块。

e.en: The phone comes in a {crushproof} case.
e.zh: 这款手机配有耐压保护壳。

e.en: They sell {crushproof} cigarette packs.
e.zh: 他们出售防压坏的烟盒。

e.en: He devoted his career to {crustaceology}.
e.zh: 他把毕生事业献给了甲壳动物学。

e.en: The lab specializes in marine {crustaceology}.
e.zh: 该实验室专攻海洋甲壳动物学研究。

e.en: Crabs and lobsters are {crustaceous} animals.
e.zh: 螃蟹和龙虾都是甲壳类动物。

e.en: The lichen formed a {crustaceous} layer on the rock.
e.zh: 地衣在岩石上形成了一层硬壳状物。

e.en: Chert is a {cryptocrystalline} form of quartz.
e.zh: 燧石是石英的一种隐晶质形态。

e.en: The rock has a {cryptocrystalline} texture.
e.zh: 这块岩石呈隐晶质结构。

e.en: Ferns and mosses are classed as {cryptogams}.
e.zh: 蕨类和苔藓被归为隐花植物。

e.en: He studied {cryptogams} in the rainforest.
e.zh: 他在雨林里研究隐花植物。

e.en: They surveyed the {cryptogamic} flora of the cliffs.
e.zh: 他们调查了悬崖上的隐花植物群。

e.en: The {cryptogamic} crust protects desert soil.
e.zh: 隐花植物结皮保护着沙漠土壤。

e.en: The {cryptogamist} catalogued local mosses.
e.zh: 那位隐花植物学家给当地苔藓编目。

e.en: She trained as a {cryptogamist} at the herbarium.
e.zh: 她在植物标本馆受训成为隐花植物学家。

e.en: Lichens are {cryptogamous} organisms.
e.zh: 地衣是隐花生物。

e.en: He listed several {cryptogamous} species.
e.zh: 他列举了几种隐花植物。

e.en: The patient was diagnosed with {cryptogenic} stroke.
e.zh: 该病人被诊断为隐源性中风。

e.en: Doctors classified it as {cryptogenic} epilepsy.
e.zh: 医生将其归类为隐源性癫痫。

e.en: He sent the message as a {cryptograph}.
e.zh: 他把信息以密码形式发出。

e.en: The agent decoded the {cryptograph} overnight.
e.zh: 特工连夜破译了那段密码。

e.en: They published a {cryptographical} analysis of the cipher.
e.zh: 他们发表了对该密码的密码学分析。

e.en: The book covers {cryptographical} methods in detail.
e.zh: 这本书详细介绍了密码学方法。

e.en: The data is {cryptographically} signed.
e.zh: 该数据经过密码学签名。

e.en: Passwords are stored {cryptographically} hashed.
e.zh: 密码以加密哈希形式存储。

e.en: The {cryptographist} broke the wartime code.
e.zh: 那位密码学家破解了战时密码。

e.en: She works as a {cryptographist} for the agency.
e.zh: 她在该机构担任密码学家。

e.en: He has strong {cryptological} skills.
e.zh: 他具备扎实的密码学技能。

e.en: The unit handles {cryptological} research.
e.zh: 该部门负责密码学研究。

e.en: The {cryptologist} cracked the enemy's cipher.
e.zh: 那位密码学家破译了敌方密码。

e.en: She trained as a {cryptologist} in the navy.
e.zh: 她在海军中受训成为密码学家。

e.en: He blamed the plagiarism on {cryptomnesia}.
e.zh: 他把抄袭归咎于潜隐记忆。

e.en: {Cryptomnesia} can make old ideas feel new.
e.zh: 潜隐记忆会让旧想法感觉像是新的。

e.en: The spy used a {cryptonym} in all reports.
e.zh: 那名间谍在所有报告中都使用代号。

e.en: Each operation had its own {cryptonym}.
e.zh: 每项行动都有自己的代号。

e.en: The puppy was {cryptorchid} and needed surgery.
e.zh: 那只小狗有隐睾，需要做手术。

e.en: Vets often check whether stallions are {cryptorchid}.
e.zh: 兽医常会检查公马是否隐睾。

e.en: The boy was treated for {cryptorchidism}.
e.zh: 这名男孩接受了隐睾症的治疗。

e.en: {Cryptorchidism} increases the risk of infertility.
e.zh: 隐睾症会增加不育的风险。

e.en: Surgery corrected his {cryptorchism}.
e.zh: 手术矫正了他的隐睾症。

e.en: {Cryptorchism} is more common than people think.
e.zh: 隐睾症比人们想象的更常见。

e.en: He invested heavily in {cryptos} last year.
e.zh: 他去年大量投资加密货币。

e.en: The market for {cryptos} crashed overnight.
e.zh: 加密货币市场一夜之间崩盘。

e.en: They studied a {cryptovolcanic} structure in Missouri.
e.zh: 他们研究了密苏里州的一处隐火山构造。

e.en: The crater shows {cryptovolcanic} features.
e.zh: 那个陨坑显示出隐火山特征。

cryptozoic.t: 隐生的；栖息于隐蔽处的

e.en: Many beetles are {cryptozoic}, hiding under bark.
e.zh: 许多甲虫属于隐生类群，藏身于树皮下。

e.en: The forest floor hosts a rich {cryptozoic} fauna.
e.zh: 林地表层栖息着丰富的隐生动物群。

e.en: He attended a {cryptozoological} conference.
e.zh: 他参加了一场神秘动物学会议。

e.en: The show explored {cryptozoological} legends.
e.zh: 该节目探讨了神秘动物学传说。

e.en: The {cryptozoologist} hunted for Bigfoot.
e.zh: 那位神秘动物学家在追寻大脚怪。

e.en: She is a self-proclaimed {cryptozoologist}.
e.zh: 她自称是神秘动物学家。

e.en: {Cryptozoology} studies creatures like the Loch Ness Monster.
e.zh: 神秘动物学研究尼斯湖水怪之类的生物。

e.en: Most scientists dismiss {cryptozoology} as pseudoscience.
e.zh: 大多数科学家认为神秘动物学是伪科学。

e.en: She gazed into the {crystal-ball} for answers.
e.zh: 她凝视水晶球寻找答案。

e.en: I don't have a {crystal-ball} to predict the market.
e.zh: 我没有预测市场的水晶球。

crystal-clear.t: 非常清晰的；一目了然的

e.en: His instructions were {crystal-clear}.
e.zh: 他的指示非常清楚。

e.en: The lake water was {crystal-clear}.
e.zh: 湖水清澈见底。

e.en: Forecasting next year's prices feels like {crystal-gazing}.
e.zh: 预测明年的价格就像在占卜。

e.en: She dismissed his predictions as mere {crystal-gazing}.
e.zh: 她认为他的预测不过是凭空猜测。

e.en: Some {cryophilic} bacteria thrive in Arctic ice.
e.zh: 一些喜冷细菌在北极冰层中繁衍。

e.en: The lab studies {cryophilic} organisms from glaciers.
e.zh: 实验室研究来自冰川的喜冷生物。

e.en: He specializes in {cryophysics} at the institute.
e.zh: 他在该研究所专攻低温物理学。

e.en: {Cryophysics} explores matter at extremely low temperatures.
e.zh: 低温物理学研究极低温下的物质。

e.en: That alga is a true {cryophyte}.
e.zh: 那种藻类是真正的冰雪植物。

e.en: {Cryophytes} can color glaciers pink.
e.zh: 冰雪植物会把冰川染成粉色。

e.en: Researchers sampled {cryoplankton} from the glacier.
e.zh: 研究人员从冰川采集了冰雪浮游生物。

e.en: {Cryoplankton} survive in frozen meltwater.
e.zh: 冰雪浮游生物能在融冰水中生存。

e.en: The patient received {cryoprecipitate} during surgery.
e.zh: 病人在手术中输注了冷沉淀。

e.en: {Cryoprecipitate} is rich in clotting factors.
e.zh: 冷沉淀富含凝血因子。

e.en: {Cryoprecipitation} separates certain plasma proteins.
e.zh: 冷沉淀法可分离某些血浆蛋白。

e.en: They use {cryoprecipitation} to isolate the factor.
e.zh: 他们用冷沉淀法分离该因子。

e.en: The surgeon applied a {cryoprobe} to the lesion.
e.zh: 外科医生将冷冻探针置于病灶上。

e.en: A {cryoprobe} freezes tissue precisely.
e.zh: 冷冻探针能精准冻结组织。

e.en: Glycerol has strong {cryoprotective} properties.
e.zh: 甘油具有很强的冷冻保护性能。

e.en: They added a {cryoprotective} agent to the cells.
e.zh: 他们向细胞中加入了冷冻保护剂。

e.en: Abnormal {cryoprotein} levels were detected.
e.zh: 检测到冷沉淀蛋白水平异常。

e.en: {Cryoproteins} precipitate at low temperatures.
e.zh: 冷沉淀蛋白在低温下析出。

e.en: The chamber uses a {cryopump} for high vacuum.
e.zh: 该腔体使用低温泵以达到高真空。

e.en: Engineers serviced the {cryopump} this morning.
e.zh: 工程师今早维护了低温泵。

e.en: {Cryopumping} achieves ultra-high vacuum cleanly.
e.zh: 低温抽气能干净地获得超高真空。

e.en: They rely on {cryopumping} in the experiment.
e.zh: 他们在实验中依靠低温抽气。

e.en: The dairy lab uses a {cryoscope} daily.
e.zh: 乳品实验室每天使用冰点测定仪。

e.en: A {cryoscope} measures freezing-point depression.
e.zh: 冰点测定仪测量冰点下降值。

e.en: They performed a {cryoscopic} analysis of the milk.
e.zh: 他们对牛奶做了冰点测定分析。

e.en: The {cryoscopic} method detects added water.
e.zh: 冰点测定法可检出掺水。

e.en: {Cryoscopy} helps determine molecular weight.
e.zh: 冰点测定法有助于测定分子量。

e.en: Milk fraud is detected via {cryoscopy}.
e.zh: 通过冰点测定法可检出牛奶掺假。

e.en: The pump operates by {cryosorption}.
e.zh: 该泵通过低温吸附原理工作。

e.en: {Cryosorption} traps gases on cold surfaces.
e.zh: 低温吸附把气体捕集在冷表面上。

e.en: The sample sat in a {cryostatic} chamber.
e.zh: 样品放在恒低温腔体中。

e.en: They maintained {cryostatic} conditions overnight.
e.zh: 他们整夜维持恒低温条件。

e.en: The {cryosurgeon} removed the small tumor.
e.zh: 冷冻外科医生切除了那个小肿瘤。

e.en: She trained as a {cryosurgeon} abroad.
e.zh: 她在国外受训成为冷冻外科医生。

e.en: He underwent {cryosurgery} for the wart.
e.zh: 他接受了冷冻外科手术治疗疣。

e.en: {Cryosurgery} destroys tissue with extreme cold.
e.zh: 冷冻外科手术用极冷破坏组织。

e.en: Athletes often use {cryotherapy} for recovery.
e.zh: 运动员常用冷冻疗法来恢复。

e.en: The clinic offers whole-body {cryotherapy}.
e.zh: 该诊所提供全身冷冻疗法。

e.en: The {cryotron} was an early superconducting switch.
e.zh: 冷子管是一种早期的超导开关。

e.en: Engineers tested the {cryotron} in liquid helium.
e.zh: 工程师在液氦中测试了冷子管。

e.en: {Cryotronics} explores circuits at cryogenic temperatures.
e.zh: 低温电子学研究低温下的电路。

e.en: He published a paper on {cryotronics}.
e.zh: 他发表了一篇关于低温电子学的论文。
