e.zh: 医生用cyesis这一术语指代怀孕。

e.en: Pseudo-{cyesis} is a condition where a woman believes she is pregnant.
e.zh: 假性妊娠是一种女性自以为怀孕的状况。

e.en: The museum displayed several painted {cylices} from ancient Greece.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了若干来自古希腊的彩绘浅口酒杯。

e.en: Archaeologists unearthed a set of bronze {cylices}.
e.zh: 考古学家出土了一组青铜浅口酒杯。

e.en: The mechanic replaced the cracked {cylinder-head} on the engine.
e.zh: 机械师更换了引擎上破裂的汽缸盖。

e.en: A blown {cylinder-head} gasket caused the leak.
e.zh: 汽缸盖垫片爆裂导致了漏液。

e.en: She packed the cookies in a {cylinder-shaped} tin.
e.zh: 她把饼干装进一个圆柱形的铁盒里。

e.en: The lamp had a {cylinder-shaped} shade.
e.zh: 这盏灯有一个圆柱形的灯罩。

e.en: The mushroom has a slender, {cylindraceous} stem.
e.zh: 这种蘑菇有一根细长的近圆柱形菌柄。

e.en: Botanists noted the {cylindraceous} shape of the seed pods.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到种荚呈近圆柱形。

e.en: The beetle's body was distinctly {cylindrate}.
e.zh: 这种甲虫的身体呈明显的圆柱形。

e.en: He described the fossil as long and {cylindrate}.
e.zh: 他将这块化石描述为细长的圆柱形。

e.en: The container had a perfectly {cylindric} shape.
e.zh: 这个容器呈完美的圆柱形。

e.en: They studied {cylindric} coordinates in math class.
e.zh: 他们在数学课上学习了圆柱坐标。

e.en: Engineers measured the {cylindricity} of the machined shaft.
e.zh: 工程师测量了加工后的轴的圆柱度。

e.en: Tolerance for {cylindricity} must be within ten micrometers.
e.zh: 圆柱度公差必须控制在十微米以内。

e.en: The geologist identified a sample of {cylindrite} from the mine.
e.zh: 地质学家从矿场鉴定出一块圆柱锡矿样品。

e.en: {Cylindrite} forms unusual cylindrical crystals.
e.zh: 圆柱锡矿会形成不寻常的圆柱状晶体。

e.en: The lens has a slight {cylindroid} curvature.
e.zh: 这块镜片有轻微的类圆柱曲率。

e.en: He sketched a {cylindroid} surface for the math problem.
e.zh: 他为这道数学题画出了一个类圆柱面。

e.en: The cornice was crowned with a graceful {cyma}.
e.zh: 檐口顶部装饰着一道优雅的反曲线脚。

e.en: He sketched the {cyma} profile of the molding.
e.zh: 他勾画了该线脚的反曲轮廓。

e.en: She wrapped a silken {cymar} around her shoulders.
e.zh: 她把一件丝质长袍披在肩上。

e.en: The actress wore a flowing {cymar} on stage.
e.zh: 女演员在舞台上穿着一件飘逸的长袍。

e.en: The temple's {cymatium} was carved with leaves.
e.zh: 神庙的上楣线脚雕刻着叶饰。

e.en: Restorers repaired the cracked {cymatium}.
e.zh: 修复人员修补了开裂的上楣线脚。

e.en: The {cymbalist} crashed his instruments at the climax.
e.zh: 敲钹手在高潮处用力击响了乐器。

e.en: She trained as a {cymbalist} in the orchestra.
e.zh: 她在乐团里接受钹演奏训练。

e.en: He played a haunting tune on the {cymbalom}.
e.zh: 他用大扬琴弹奏了一支萦绕心头的曲子。

e.en: The {cymbalom} is central to Hungarian folk music.
e.zh: 大扬琴是匈牙利民间音乐的核心乐器。

e.en: Her greenhouse was filled with blooming {cymbidium}.
e.zh: 她的温室里满是盛开的兰花。

e.en: The {cymbidium} thrives in cool, bright rooms.
e.zh: 这种兰花在凉爽明亮的房间里生长良好。

e.en: The leaf has a distinctly {cymbiform} shape.
e.zh: 这片叶子呈明显的舟状。

e.en: Botanists noted the {cymbiform} bracts of the plant.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种植物的舟状苞片。

e.en: The plant produces a delicate white {cyme}.
e.zh: 该植物开出精致的白色聚伞花序。

e.en: Botany students learned to identify a {cyme}.
e.zh: 植物学学生学会辨认聚伞花序。

e.en: Thyme oil contains a high proportion of {cymene}.
e.zh: 百里香精油中含有较高比例的伞花烃。

e.en: Chemists isolated {cymene} from the essential oil.
e.zh: 化学家从精油中分离出伞花烃。

e.en: Grandma fried slices of fresh {cymling} for dinner.
e.zh: 奶奶煎了几片新鲜的飞碟瓜当晚餐。

e.en: The garden was full of pale green {cymling}.
e.zh: 菜园里满是淡绿色的飞碟瓜。

e.en: Early refrigerators used {cymogene} as a coolant.
e.zh: 早期冰箱曾用轻汽油作冷却剂。

e.en: The plant distilled {cymogene} from petroleum.
e.zh: 工厂从石油中蒸馏出轻汽油。

e.en: The lab used a {cymograph} to record vibrations.
e.zh: 实验室用记波器记录振动。

e.en: Engineers calibrated the old {cymograph} carefully.
e.zh: 工程师仔细校准了那台旧记波器。

e.en: The flowers form a {cymoid} cluster at the tip.
e.zh: 花朵在枝端形成似聚伞花序的花簇。

e.en: He described the inflorescence as {cymoid}.
e.zh: 他把这种花序描述为似聚伞花序的。

e.en: The technician tuned the radio with a {cymometer}.
e.zh: 技术员用波长计调谐无线电。

e.en: Early stations relied on a {cymometer} for accuracy.
e.zh: 早期电台依靠波长计来保证准确度。

e.en: The ring featured a glowing {cymophane}.
e.zh: 那枚戒指镶着一颗闪光的猫眼石。

e.en: Collectors prize fine {cymophane} from Sri Lanka.
e.zh: 收藏家珍视斯里兰卡产的优质猫眼石。

e.en: Marconi's {cymoscope} detected the faint signal.
e.zh: 马可尼的电波检测器捕捉到了微弱信号。

e.en: The museum displayed an early {cymoscope}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台早期的电波检测器。

cymose.t: 聚伞花序的；有聚伞花序的

e.en: The shrub bears small {cymose} flower clusters.
e.zh: 这种灌木结有小型聚伞花序。

e.en: Many forget-me-nots show a {cymose} arrangement.
e.zh: 许多勿忘我呈聚伞花序排列。

e.en: Each branch ended in a tiny {cymule}.
e.zh: 每根枝条末端都有一个小聚伞花序。

e.en: The herb produced delicate {cymule} flowers.
e.zh: 这种草本植物开出精致的小聚伞花序。

e.en: Artichokes contain {cynarin}, which aids digestion.
e.zh: 朝鲜蓟含有洋蓟酸，有助于消化。

e.en: Researchers studied the liver effects of {cynarin}.
e.zh: 研究者考察了洋蓟酸对肝脏的作用。

e.en: The lord enjoyed his {cynegetic} pursuits in autumn.
e.zh: 领主在秋天乐于从事打猎活动。

e.en: Medieval texts describe many {cynegetic} customs.
e.zh: 中世纪文献记载了许多狩猎习俗。

e.en: He wrote a treatise on classical {cynegetics}.
e.zh: 他写了一篇关于古典狩猎术的论文。

e.en: Greek nobles studied {cynegetics} from a young age.
e.zh: 希腊贵族从小就研习狩猎术。

e.en: Medieval maps often pictured {cynocephalous} men.
e.zh: 中世纪地图常画有狗头人。

e.en: The legend describes a {cynocephalous} tribe.
e.zh: 传说描述了一个狗头部族。

e.en: The fossil belonged to an early {cynodont}.
e.zh: 这块化石属于一种早期的犬齿兽。

e.en: Mammals evolved from {cynodont} ancestors.
e.zh: 哺乳动物起源于犬齿兽祖先。

e.en: The {cynologist} judged the show's working breeds.
e.zh: 那位犬类学家担任了工作犬组的评审。

e.en: She trained as a {cynologist} for police dog units.
e.zh: 她为警犬队伍接受犬类学家培训。

e.en: He devoted his career to {cynology}.
e.zh: 他把毕生精力献给了犬类学研究。

e.en: Modern {cynology} draws on genetics and behavior.
e.zh: 现代犬类学融合了遗传学与行为学。

cynophobia.t: 恐犬症；对狗的病态恐惧

e.en: She developed {cynophobia} after a stray bit her as a child.
e.zh: 小时候被流浪狗咬过之后，她患上了恐犬症。

e.en: Therapy gradually eased his {cynophobia}.
e.zh: 心理治疗逐渐缓解了他对狗的恐惧。

cynosural.t: 众所瞩目的；引人注目的

e.en: Her {cynosural} performance drew every camera in the room.
e.zh: 她那万众瞩目的表演吸引了全场的镜头。

e.en: The {cynosural} tower marks the city's center.
e.zh: 那座引人注目的高塔矗立在城市中心。

cystectomy.t: 膀胱切除术；囊肿切除手术

e.en: The surgeon performed a partial {cystectomy} to remove the tumor.
e.zh: 外科医生做了一次部分膀胱切除术以切除肿瘤。

e.en: Recovery from a radical {cystectomy} can take several months.
e.zh: 根治性膀胱切除术后的恢复可能需要数月时间。

cysteine.t: 半胱氨酸，一种含硫氨基酸

e.en: {Cysteine} carries a sulfur atom in its side chain.
e.zh: 半胱氨酸的侧链上带有一个硫原子。

e.en: Hair keratin is rich in {cysteine} residues.
e.zh: 头发中的角蛋白富含半胱氨酸残基。

cystine.t: 胱氨酸；半胱氨酸的氧化形式

e.en: {Cystine} forms when two cysteine molecules link via a disulfide bond.
e.zh: 两个半胱氨酸分子通过二硫键连接形成胱氨酸。

e.en: Some kidney stones are made of {cystine} crystals.
e.zh: 有些肾结石是由胱氨酸结晶形成的。

cytohistogenesis.t: 细胞组织发生；细胞与组织形成过程

e.en: The textbook devotes a chapter to {cytohistogenesis} in embryos.
e.zh: 该教科书用一章讲述胚胎中的细胞组织发生。

e.en: Researchers study {cytohistogenesis} to understand tissue formation.
e.zh: 研究人员研究细胞组织发生以了解组织形成。

e.en: The slide showed several {cytoid} bodies near the retina.
e.zh: 切片显示视网膜附近有几个类细胞体。

e.en: Pathologists noted the {cytoid} structures in the sample.
e.zh: 病理学家注意到样本中的类细胞结构。

e.en: The patient's symptoms suggested {cytokalipenia}.
e.zh: 患者的症状提示细胞内钾缺乏症。

e.en: Doctors monitored him for signs of {cytokalipenia}.
e.zh: 医生监测他是否出现细胞内钾缺乏症的迹象。

e.en: After mitosis, {cytokinesis} divides the cell into two.
e.zh: 有丝分裂后，胞质分裂将细胞一分为二。

e.en: Errors in {cytokinesis} can lead to abnormal cells.
e.zh: 胞质分裂的错误可能导致异常细胞。

e.en: {Cytokinin} promotes cell division in plant tissues.
e.zh: 细胞分裂素促进植物组织中的细胞分裂。

e.en: The lab added {cytokinin} to the growth medium.
e.zh: 实验室向培养基中加入了细胞分裂素。

e.en: The samples were examined {cytologically} for abnormalities.
e.zh: 样本从细胞学上检查是否存在异常。

e.en: {Cytologically}, the two species look almost identical.
e.zh: 从细胞学上看，这两个物种几乎相同。

e.en: The {cytologist} examined the smear under a microscope.
e.zh: 细胞学家在显微镜下检查了涂片。

e.en: She trained for years to become a {cytologist}.
e.zh: 她经过多年训练才成为一名细胞学家。

e.en: The {cytolymph} fills the space inside the cell.
e.zh: 细胞液充满细胞内部空间。

e.en: Researchers extracted {cytolymph} for analysis.
e.zh: 研究人员提取细胞液进行分析。

e.en: The bacterium releases a {cytolysin} that destroys host cells.
e.zh: 该细菌释放一种破坏宿主细胞的溶细胞素。

e.en: Antibodies neutralized the {cytolysin} in the blood.
e.zh: 抗体中和了血液中的溶细胞素。

e.en: Hypotonic solutions can cause {cytolysis} of red blood cells.
e.zh: 低渗溶液可导致红细胞的细胞溶解。

e.en: The toxin triggers {cytolysis} within minutes.
e.zh: 毒素在几分钟内引发细胞溶解。

e.en: These T cells have a strong {cytolytic} effect on tumors.
e.zh: 这些T细胞对肿瘤有很强的溶细胞作用。

e.en: The drug works through a {cytolytic} mechanism.
e.zh: 该药物通过溶细胞机制起作用。

e.en: The infant was diagnosed with {cytomegalic} inclusion disease.
e.zh: 该婴儿被诊断为巨细胞包涵体病。

e.en: Doctors saw {cytomegalic} changes in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 医生在组织样本中看到了巨细胞改变。

e.en: Tests confirmed {cytomegaloviruria} in the transplant patient.
e.zh: 检查证实该移植患者尿中排出巨细胞病毒。

e.en: {Cytomegaloviruria} can persist for months after infection.
e.zh: 感染后尿中巨细胞病毒排出可持续数月。

e.en: The {cytomembrane} controls what enters the cell.
e.zh: 细胞膜控制进入细胞的物质。

e.en: Damage to the {cytomembrane} can kill the cell.
e.zh: 细胞膜的损伤可能使细胞死亡。

e.en: Each {cytomere} eventually develops into a separate organism.
e.zh: 每个胞质节最终发育成独立的生物体。

e.en: The parasite divides into many {cytomeres}.
e.zh: 寄生虫分裂成许多胞质节。

e.en: Flow {cytometry} sorts cells by their surface markers.
e.zh: 流式细胞计量术按表面标志物分选细胞。

e.en: The lab uses {cytometry} to count immune cells.
e.zh: 实验室使用细胞计量学来计数免疫细胞。

e.en: {Cytomixis} was observed during meiosis in the plant.
e.zh: 在该植物的减数分裂中观察到了细胞融合。

e.en: Researchers studied the causes of {cytomixis}.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了细胞融合的原因。

e.en: The course covers basic {cytomorphology} of blood cells.
e.zh: 该课程涵盖血细胞的基本细胞形态学。

e.en: Abnormal {cytomorphology} suggested a malignancy.
e.zh: 异常的细胞形态学提示恶性病变。

e.en: The {cyton} houses the neuron's nucleus.
e.zh: 神经元胞体内含神经元的细胞核。

e.en: Dendrites extend outward from the {cyton}.
e.zh: 树突由神经元胞体向外延伸。

e.en: The virus showed strong {cytopathic} effects in culture.
e.zh: 该病毒在培养中显示出强烈的致细胞病变作用。

e.en: They documented the {cytopathic} changes over 48 hours.
e.zh: 他们记录了48小时内的致细胞病变改变。

e.en: This strain is highly {cytopathogenic} in liver cells.
e.zh: 该毒株对肝细胞具有高度致细胞病变性。

e.en: The team isolated a {cytopathogenic} virus from the sample.
e.zh: 团队从样本中分离出一种致细胞病变的病毒。

e.en: The {cytopathologist} reviewed the suspicious smear.
e.zh: 细胞病理学家复阅了可疑的涂片。

e.en: Only a trained {cytopathologist} can confirm the diagnosis.
e.zh: 只有受过训练的细胞病理学家才能确诊。

e.en: The infection caused widespread {cytopathy} in the lungs.
e.zh: 感染在肺部引起了广泛的细胞病变。

e.en: Researchers measured {cytopathy} after drug exposure.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了药物暴露后的细胞病变。

e.en: Chemotherapy often causes severe {cytopenia}.
e.zh: 化疗常导致严重的血细胞减少症。

e.en: Blood tests revealed marked {cytopenia}.
e.zh: 血液检查显示明显的血细胞减少症。

e.en: Macrophages engage in {cytophagy} to clear debris.
e.zh: 巨噬细胞通过吞噬细胞作用清除碎屑。

e.en: {Cytophagy} plays a role in immune defense.
e.zh: 吞噬细胞作用在免疫防御中发挥作用。

e.en: They measured cell mobility with a {cytopherometer}.
e.zh: 他们用细胞电泳仪测量了细胞迁移率。

e.en: The lab acquired a new {cytopherometer} last month.
e.zh: 实验室上个月购置了一台新的细胞电泳仪。

e.en: The antibody is highly {cytophilic} for mast cells.
e.zh: 该抗体对肥大细胞具有高度亲和性。

e.en: {Cytophilic} antibodies bind to cell surfaces.
e.zh: 亲细胞抗体结合到细胞表面。

e.en: The {cytophotometer} measures DNA content per cell.
e.zh: 细胞光度计测量每个细胞的DNA含量。

e.en: They calibrated the {cytophotometer} before each run.
e.zh: 他们在每次运行前都校准细胞光度计。

e.en: DNA was quantified {cytophotometrically} in each sample.
e.zh: 每个样本的DNA都用细胞光度法定量。

e.en: The nuclei were analyzed {cytophotometrically}.
e.zh: 细胞核用细胞光度法进行了分析。

e.en: {Cytophotometry} is used to estimate ploidy levels.
e.zh: 细胞光度测定法用于估计倍性水平。

e.en: The study relied on {cytophotometry} for measurements.
e.zh: 该研究依赖细胞光度测定法进行测量。

e.en: Her thesis focused on the {cytophysiology} of neurons.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦于神经元的细胞生理学。

e.en: {Cytophysiology} explores how cells function.
e.zh: 细胞生理学探讨细胞如何运作。

e.en: The trait is inherited {cytoplasmically} from the mother.
e.zh: 该性状通过细胞质从母方遗传。

e.en: Some genes are expressed {cytoplasmically}.
e.zh: 有些基因在细胞质中表达。

e.en: Researchers fused a nucleus with a {cytoplast}.
e.zh: 研究人员将细胞核与去核细胞融合。

e.en: The {cytoplast} retained most cellular machinery.
e.zh: 该细胞质体保留了大部分细胞机器。

e.en: They studied the {cytoplastic} membrane in detail.
e.zh: 他们详细研究了细胞质体膜。

e.en: The {cytoplastic} fraction was isolated for testing.
e.zh: 分离细胞质体部分以供测试。

e.en: Waste exits the protozoan through the {cytopyge}.
e.zh: 废物通过胞肛排出原生动物体外。

e.en: The {cytopyge} opens only during excretion.
e.zh: 胞肛仅在排泄时开放。

e.en: {Cytoskeletal} proteins maintain the cell's shape.
e.zh: 细胞骨架蛋白维持细胞的形状。

e.en: The drug disrupts {cytoskeletal} dynamics.
e.zh: 该药物扰乱细胞骨架的动态。

e.en: Many enzymes operate in the {cytosol}.
e.zh: 许多酶在胞质溶胶中起作用。

e.en: Calcium levels in the {cytosol} rose sharply.
e.zh: 胞质溶胶中的钙水平急剧上升。

e.en: They used {cytospectrophotometry} to quantify pigments.
e.zh: 他们使用细胞分光光度法定量色素。

e.en: {Cytospectrophotometry} provides precise cellular measurements.
e.zh: 细胞分光光度法提供精确的细胞测量。

cytostatic.t: 抑制细胞生长的；细胞抑制剂

e.en: The drug has a {cytostatic} effect on tumor cells.
e.zh: 该药物对肿瘤细胞有抑制生长作用。

e.en: Doctors prescribed a {cytostatic} agent.
e.zh: 医生开了一种细胞抑制剂。

e.en: The paramecium ingests food through its {cytostome}.
e.zh: 草履虫通过胞口摄入食物。

e.en: A small {cytostome} marks the cell's mouth region.
e.zh: 小小的胞口标志着细胞的口部区域。

e.en: The chemical produced a {cytotactic} response in macrophages.
e.zh: 该化学物质在巨噬细胞中引起细胞趋向反应。

e.en: They observed {cytotactic} movement toward the wound.
e.zh: 他们观察到向伤口的细胞趋向运动。

e.en: {Cytotaxonomic} data clarified the species boundary.
e.zh: 细胞分类学数据厘清了物种界限。

e.en: They published a {cytotaxonomic} survey of the genus.
e.zh: 他们发表了该属的细胞分类学调查。

e.en: The two groups differ {cytotaxonomically}.
e.zh: 这两组从细胞分类学上有所不同。

e.en: {Cytotaxonomically}, the species are closely related.
e.zh: 从细胞分类学上看，这些物种关系密切。

e.en: {Cytotaxonomy} relies heavily on chromosome analysis.
e.zh: 细胞分类学在很大程度上依赖染色体分析。

e.en: He teaches a graduate course in {cytotaxonomy}.
e.zh: 他教授一门细胞分类学的研究生课程。

e.en: The {cytotech} flagged several abnormal slides.
e.zh: 细胞技术员标记了几张异常切片。

e.en: She works as a {cytotech} at the hospital.
e.zh: 她在医院担任细胞技术员。

e.en: A {cytotechnologist} screens Pap smears for abnormal cells.
e.zh: 细胞技术专家筛查巴氏涂片中的异常细胞。

e.en: He trained as a {cytotechnologist} after college.
e.zh: 他大学毕业后受训成为细胞技术专家。

e.en: She earned a degree in {cytotechnology} last year.
e.zh: 她去年获得了细胞技术学学位。

e.en: {Cytotechnology} programs include extensive lab work.
e.zh: 细胞技术学课程包含大量实验室工作。

e.en: The tissue underwent gradual {cytothesis} after injury.
e.zh: 受伤后组织经历了逐渐的细胞修复。

e.en: Scientists studied {cytothesis} in regenerating limbs.
e.zh: 科学家研究了再生肢体中的细胞修复。

cystinuria.t: 胱氨酸尿症，遗传性代谢异常

e.en: She was diagnosed with {cystinuria} after recurrent kidney stones.
e.zh: 反复出现肾结石后她被诊断为胱氨酸尿症。

e.en: Children with {cystinuria} need lifelong fluid management.
e.zh: 患胱氨酸尿症的儿童需终生注意补液。

e.en: The patient presented with sudden {cystirrhagia} after surgery.
e.zh: 患者术后突然出现膀胱出血。

e.en: Severe {cystirrhagia} can require emergency intervention.
e.zh: 严重的膀胱出血可能需要紧急处置。

cysto.t: 膀胱镜检查的医学口语简称

e.en: The urologist scheduled a quick {cysto} for next week.
e.zh: 泌尿科医师下周安排一次简短的膀胱镜检查。

e.en: Patients often dread their first {cysto}.
e.zh: 患者通常对第一次膀胱镜检查心怀畏惧。

cystoblast.t: 囊胚细胞；生殖系前体细胞

e.en: The {cystoblast} divides to form germline cells.
e.zh: 囊胚细胞分裂以形成生殖系细胞。

e.en: Researchers tracked the {cystoblast} through development.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪囊胚细胞的发育过程。

cystocarp.t: 囊果，红藻类的生殖结构

e.en: Red algae produce a {cystocarp} after fertilization.
e.zh: 红藻在受精后会形成囊果。

e.en: The {cystocarp} releases spores into the surrounding water.
e.zh: 囊果会向周围水中释放孢子。

e.en: She underwent surgery to repair her {cystocele}.
e.zh: 她接受了膀胱膨出修补手术。

e.en: A {cystocele} can cause pelvic pressure and discomfort.
e.zh: 膀胱膨出可引起盆腔压迫感和不适。

e.en: The surgeon performed a {cystoduodenostomy} to drain the cyst.
e.zh: 外科医生施行膀胱十二指肠吻合术以引流囊肿。

e.en: Recovery after {cystoduodenostomy} usually takes several weeks.
e.zh: 膀胱十二指肠吻合术后恢复通常需要数周。

cystofiberscope.t: 膀胱光纤内窥镜，纤维膀胱镜

e.en: Doctors used a {cystofiberscope} to inspect the bladder lining.
e.zh: 医生用纤维膀胱镜检查膀胱内壁。

e.en: The flexible {cystofiberscope} allowed detailed visualization.
e.zh: 可弯曲的纤维膀胱镜使观察更为细致。

e.en: The MRI revealed {cystoid} macular edema.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示囊样黄斑水肿。

e.en: Pathologists noted several {cystoid} structures in the sample.
e.zh: 病理科医生在样本中发现多处囊样结构。

cystojejunostomy.t: 膀胱空肠吻合术，一种外科手术

e.en: A {cystojejunostomy} was chosen to manage the pseudocyst.
e.zh: 医师选择膀胱空肠吻合术处理假性囊肿。

e.en: Surgeons prefer {cystojejunostomy} for distal pancreatic cysts.
e.zh: 对于远端胰腺囊肿，外科医生倾向于膀胱空肠吻合术。

e.en: Imaging showed a large {cystolith} obstructing flow.
e.zh: 影像显示有一颗大的膀胱结石阻塞尿流。

e.en: The plant cell contained a calcium {cystolith}.
e.zh: 该植物细胞内含有钙质钟乳体。

e.en: The ovarian {cystoma} was removed during surgery.
e.zh: 卵巢囊瘤在手术中被切除。

e.en: Pathology confirmed a benign {cystoma}.
e.zh: 病理证实为良性囊瘤。

cystometrogram.t: 膀胱内压测定图，尿动力检查

e.en: The {cystometrogram} revealed an overactive bladder.
e.zh: 膀胱内压测定图显示膀胱过度活动。

e.en: Doctors order a {cystometrogram} to assess urinary function.
e.zh: 医生开具膀胱内压测定以评估排尿功能。

cystorectostomy.t: 膀胱直肠吻合术，泌尿外科手术

e.en: The surgeon performed a {cystorectostomy} as a last resort.
e.zh: 外科医生在万不得已时实施了膀胱直肠吻合术。

e.en: Recovery after {cystorectostomy} can be lengthy.
e.zh: 膀胱直肠吻合术后的康复可能漫长。

e.en: The doctor inserted a {cystoscope} to examine the bladder.
e.zh: 医生插入膀胱镜检查膀胱。

e.en: Modern {cystoscope} models are flexible and comfortable.
e.zh: 现代膀胱镜柔软可弯，使用更舒适。

cystoscopic.t: 膀胱镜的；用膀胱镜检查的

e.en: She underwent a {cystoscopic} examination last week.
e.zh: 她上周接受了膀胱镜检查。

e.en: The {cystoscopic} findings were unremarkable.
e.zh: 膀胱镜检查结果未见异常。

e.en: An emergency {cystostomy} was needed to relieve retention.
e.zh: 为缓解尿潴留，需紧急行膀胱造口术。

e.en: The {cystostomy} tube stayed in place for two weeks.
e.zh: 膀胱造口管留置了两周。

e.en: A {cystotomy} allowed removal of the bladder stone.
e.zh: 通过膀胱切开术取出了膀胱结石。

e.en: Open {cystotomy} is rarely needed today.
e.zh: 如今很少需要开放式膀胱切开术。

cystourethrography.t: 膀胱尿道造影；影像学检查

e.en: Voiding {cystourethrography} can detect reflux.
e.zh: 排尿性膀胱尿道造影可检测反流。

e.en: The child needed {cystourethrography} after recurrent infections.
e.zh: 该患儿因反复感染需进行膀胱尿道造影。

cytameba.t: 细胞变形虫，微观原生生物

e.en: Researchers studied {cytameba} under the microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下研究细胞变形虫。

e.en: The {cytameba} moved by extending pseudopodia.
e.zh: 细胞变形虫通过伸出伪足移动。

e.en: {Cytase} breaks down cellulose in plant cells.
e.zh: 纤维素酶能分解植物细胞中的纤维素。

e.en: Snails secrete {cytase} during digestion.
e.zh: 蜗牛在消化过程中分泌纤维素酶。

cytaster.t: 星状体，细胞分裂期的微管结构

e.en: During mitosis the {cytaster} forms around each centrosome.
e.zh: 有丝分裂时星状体在每个中心体周围形成。

e.en: Microtubules radiate outward from the {cytaster}.
e.zh: 微管自星状体向外辐射。

cytheromania.t: 女子性欲亢进，旧式医学术语

e.en: Old medical texts called the condition {cytheromania}.
e.zh: 旧时医书将此症状称为女子性欲亢进。

e.en: The term {cytheromania} has fallen out of clinical use.
e.zh: 该术语在临床上已不再使用。

cytidine.t: 胞苷，核糖核酸的组成成分

e.en: {Cytidine} is one of the four ribonucleosides.
e.zh: 胞苷是四种核糖核苷之一。

e.en: The drug contains a modified {cytidine} analog.
e.zh: 该药物含有一种修饰的胞苷类似物。

cytisine.t: 金雀花碱，戒烟辅助药成分

e.en: {Cytisine} helps some smokers quit successfully.
e.zh: 金雀花碱有助于部分吸烟者成功戒烟。

e.en: Trials showed {cytisine} outperformed placebo.
e.zh: 试验显示金雀花碱效果优于安慰剂。

cytoanalyzer.t: 细胞分析仪，自动化检测仪器

e.en: The lab installed a new {cytoanalyzer} last month.
e.zh: 实验室上月装设了一台新的细胞分析仪。

e.en: Automated {cytoanalyzer} screening saves technician time.
e.zh: 自动化细胞分析仪筛查节省了技术员的时间。

cytoarchitectonics.t: 细胞构筑学，研究脑皮质分层

e.en: Brodmann pioneered the field of {cytoarchitectonics}.
e.zh: 布罗德曼开创了细胞构筑学领域。

e.en: Neuroscientists rely on {cytoarchitectonics} to map the cortex.
e.zh: 神经科学家借助细胞构筑学绘制皮质图谱。

cytoarchitecture.t: 细胞构筑；组织内细胞排列方式

e.en: The {cytoarchitecture} of the hippocampus is well studied.
e.zh: 海马区的细胞构筑已被广泛研究。

e.en: Disease can alter the {cytoarchitecture} of brain tissue.
e.zh: 疾病可改变脑组织的细胞构筑。

cytoblast.t: 细胞核；旧称的细胞母质

e.en: Early biologists used {cytoblast} to describe the nucleus.
e.zh: 早期生物学家用此词指称细胞核。

e.en: The term {cytoblast} now sounds quite dated.
e.zh: 如今这个术语听起来相当过时。

cytochalasin.t: 细胞松弛素，真菌代谢产物

e.en: {Cytochalasin} disrupts actin filaments inside cells.
e.zh: 细胞松弛素会破坏细胞内的肌动蛋白丝。

e.en: Researchers added {cytochalasin} to block cell division.
e.zh: 研究人员加入细胞松弛素以阻断细胞分裂。

cytochemical.t: 细胞化学的；细胞染色相关的

e.en: {Cytochemical} staining revealed the enzyme distribution.
e.zh: 细胞化学染色显示了酶的分布。

e.en: She specializes in {cytochemical} techniques.
e.zh: 她专攻细胞化学技术。

cytochemistry.t: 细胞化学，研究细胞化学成分

e.en: Modern {cytochemistry} relies on fluorescent probes.
e.zh: 现代细胞化学依赖于荧光探针。

e.en: The textbook covers basic {cytochemistry} thoroughly.
e.zh: 该教材对基础细胞化学有详尽介绍。

cytochimera.t: 细胞嵌合体，含混合细胞的个体

e.en: Plant breeders sometimes produce a {cytochimera}.
e.zh: 植物育种者有时会培育出细胞嵌合体。

e.en: The {cytochimera} carried two distinct cell lines.
e.zh: 该细胞嵌合体携带两种不同的细胞系。

cytoclasis.t: 细胞破坏，细胞溶解作用

e.en: Tissue samples showed widespread {cytoclasis}.
e.zh: 组织样本显示出广泛的细胞破坏。

e.en: Inflammation can lead to {cytoclasis} in surrounding cells.
e.zh: 炎症可导致周围细胞溶解。

cytoclastic.t: 破坏细胞的；具细胞溶解性的

e.en: The biopsy showed {cytoclastic} changes throughout.
e.zh: 活检显示整体存在细胞破坏性改变。

e.en: {Cytoclastic} processes accompanied the infection.
e.zh: 细胞破坏过程伴随着感染发生。

e.en: Researchers documented {cytoctony} of host cells.
e.zh: 研究人员记录了宿主细胞的杀灭现象。

e.en: The pathogen induces {cytoctony} of macrophages.
e.zh: 该病原体可诱导巨噬细胞杀灭。

cytodesma.t: 细胞间连接结构，细胞桥

e.en: Plant biologists examined the {cytodesma} junctions.
e.zh: 植物生物学家研究了细胞间连接结构。

e.en: Signals can pass through the {cytodesma}.
e.zh: 信号可以通过细胞间连接结构传递。

cytodifferentiation.t: 细胞分化，细胞特化过程

e.en: Stem cells undergo {cytodifferentiation} into specialized types.
e.zh: 干细胞经历细胞分化形成特化类型。

e.en: Hormones regulate {cytodifferentiation} during development.
e.zh: 激素在发育过程中调控细胞分化。

cytoecology.t: 细胞生态学，细胞与环境关系研究

e.en: {Cytoecology} examines cells in their natural environment.
e.zh: 细胞生态学考察细胞在其自然环境中的状态。

e.en: Her dissertation focused on marine {cytoecology}.
e.zh: 她的论文聚焦于海洋细胞生态学。

cytogamy.t: 细胞融合；配合接合作用

e.en: Some protozoa reproduce through {cytogamy}.
e.zh: 某些原生动物通过细胞融合进行繁殖。

e.en: {Cytogamy} fuses two compatible cells together.
e.zh: 细胞融合将两个相容细胞合并。

cytogenesis.t: 细胞发生，细胞形成过程

e.en: Embryonic {cytogenesis} produces diverse tissues.
e.zh: 胚胎期细胞发生产生多样的组织。

e.en: Researchers traced {cytogenesis} during regeneration.
e.zh: 研究者追踪了再生过程中的细胞发生。

cytogenetical.t: 细胞遗传学的；染色体相关的

e.en: The lab offers {cytogenetical} testing services.
e.zh: 该实验室提供细胞遗传学检测服务。

e.en: {Cytogenetical} analysis confirmed the diagnosis.
e.zh: 细胞遗传学分析证实了该诊断。

e.en: The tumor was {cytogenetically} abnormal.
e.zh: 该肿瘤在细胞遗传学上属异常。

e.en: Samples were analyzed {cytogenetically} for clarity.
e.zh: 为求明确，样本以细胞遗传学方式分析。

cytogenous.t: 生成细胞的；产生新细胞的

e.en: The {cytogenous} tissue produced new cells continuously.
e.zh: 该生成细胞的组织持续产生新细胞。

e.en: Researchers identified a {cytogenous} layer in the embryo.
e.zh: 研究者在胚胎中辨识出一层生成细胞的组织。

cytogony.t: 细胞生殖；多重分裂繁殖

e.en: Some single-celled parasites reproduce by {cytogony}.
e.zh: 一些单细胞寄生虫通过细胞生殖繁衍。

e.en: {Cytogony} divides one cell into many daughter cells.
e.zh: 细胞生殖将一个细胞分裂为多个子细胞。

e.en: He used a {cable-cutter} to trim the wire.
e.zh: 他用电缆剪修剪那根线。

e.en: The toolkit includes a heavy {cable-cutter}.
e.zh: 工具箱里有一把重型切缆工具。

e.en: The {cableway} carries tourists up the mountain.
e.zh: 这条索道把游客送上山。

e.en: Workers repaired the old mining {cableway}.
e.zh: 工人修好了那条旧矿山缆车道。

e.en: His {cachinnatory} outburst startled the room.
e.zh: 他突然一阵大笑，把屋里的人吓了一跳。

e.en: The play ends with a {cachinnatory} chorus.
e.zh: 这出戏以一阵哄笑般的合唱结束。

e.en: The study measured {caffeic} acid in coffee beans.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了咖啡豆中的咖啡酸。

e.en: Some plants contain {caffeic} compounds.
e.zh: 有些植物含有咖啡酸类化合物。

e.en: The X-ray showed a {calcaneal} fracture.
e.zh: X光显示有跟骨骨折。

e.en: She felt pain near the {calcaneal} tendon.
e.zh: 她感到跟骨肌腱附近疼痛。

e.en: The museum displayed early {calcography} prints.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了早期铜版雕刻印刷品。

e.en: He studied {calcography} as a traditional printmaking method.
e.zh: 他把凹版印刷作为一种传统版画技法来研究。

e.en: Please leave your number for a {call-back}.
e.zh: 请留下号码，方便回电。

e.en: She got a {call-back} after the first audition.
e.zh: 她第一次试镜后获得了复试通知。

e.en: The invitation had a {calligraphical} elegance.
e.zh: 请柬带着书法般的雅致。

e.en: He admired the manuscript's {calligraphical} flourishes.
e.zh: 他欣赏手稿中漂亮的书法花饰。

e.en: The oil contains traces of {camphene}.
e.zh: 这种油含有微量莰烯。

e.en: Chemists identified {camphene} in the resin sample.
e.zh: 化学家在树脂样本中鉴定出樟脑烯。

e.en: The cantor {cantillates} the sacred text.
e.zh: 领唱者吟诵那段圣文。

e.en: She {cantillates} each phrase with solemn precision.
e.zh: 她庄重而准确地唱诵每个乐句。

e.en: Let the onions {caramelise} slowly.
e.zh: 让洋葱慢慢焦糖化。

e.en: The sugar will {caramelise} in the hot pan.
e.zh: 糖会在热锅里熬成焦糖。

e.en: The compound shows {carbonylic} reactivity.
e.zh: 该化合物表现出羰基反应性。

e.en: Researchers measured the {carbonylic} absorption band.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了羰基吸收带。

e.en: The metal was produced by a {carbothermal} process.
e.zh: 这种金属通过碳热工艺制得。

e.en: Engineers optimized the {carbothermal} reduction step.
e.zh: 工程师优化了碳热还原步骤。

e.en: The assay detected {carboxypeptidase} activity.
e.zh: 该检测发现了羧肽酶活性。

e.en: {Carboxypeptidase} removes amino acids from protein ends.
e.zh: 羧肽酶会从蛋白质末端切除氨基酸。

e.en: The reaction produced a foul-smelling {carbylamine}.
e.zh: 该反应生成了一种气味难闻的异腈。

e.en: Students learned the classic {carbylamine} test.
e.zh: 学生学习了经典的胩反应测试。

cartophily.t: 收藏香烟卡等卡片的爱好

e.en: His grandfather's hobby was {cartophily}.
e.zh: 他祖父的爱好是收藏香烟卡等卡片。

e.en: {Cartophily} became popular among some collectors.
e.zh: 卡片收藏在一些收藏者中流行起来。

e.en: The villagers grew {casava} beside the road.
e.zh: 村民在路边种木薯。

e.en: She thickened the soup with {casava} flour.
e.zh: 她用木薯粉把汤调稠。

e.en: He bought {cat's-meat} from the old vendor.
e.zh: 他从老摊贩那里买了猫食用肉。

e.en: The butcher sold scraps as {cat's-meat}.
e.zh: 屠夫把碎肉当作猫食卖。

e.en: The sailor feared the {cat-o'-nine-tails}.
e.zh: 那名水手害怕九尾鞭。

e.en: The museum displayed a {cat-o'-nine-tails} from the prison.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一条来自监狱的多股刑鞭。

e.en: He was her {cater-cousin} in courtly gossip.
e.zh: 在宫廷闲谈中，他是她的密友。

e.en: The phrase {cater-cousin} now sounds archaic.
e.zh: cater-cousin 这个说法如今听起来很古旧。

e.en: The film was deposited {cathodally}.
e.zh: 薄膜是在阴极上沉积的。

e.en: The surface changed when treated {cathodally}.
e.zh: 经过阴极处理后，表面发生了变化。

e.en: The farm hired a {cattle-truck} for market day.
e.zh: 农场为赶集日雇了一辆运牛车。

e.en: They converted the old {cattle-truck} into storage.
e.zh: 他们把旧牲畜运输车改成了仓储空间。

e.en: A purple {cattleya} bloomed in the greenhouse.
e.zh: 温室里开了一朵紫色卡特兰兰花。

e.en: She wore a white {cattleya} on her dress.
e.zh: 她在裙子上别了一朵白色卡特兰兰花。

e.en: The damage was {causable} by overheating.
e.zh: 这种损坏可能由过热引起。

e.en: Some symptoms are {causable} by stress.
e.zh: 有些症状可由压力导致。

e.en: The report used {cecity} as a medical term.
e.zh: 报告把 cecity 用作医学术语，表示失明。

e.en: Ancient writers linked {cecity} with prophecy.
e.zh: 古代作者把失明与预言联系起来。

e.en: I left my {cell-phone} at home.
e.zh: 我把手机忘在家里了。

e.en: Her {cell-phone} rang during the meeting.
e.zh: 她的手机在会议中响了。

e.en: The surgeon noted signs of {celophthalmia}.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到眼球凹陷症的迹象。

e.en: The article described {celophthalmia} after severe trauma.
e.zh: 文章描述了严重外伤后的眼球凹陷症。

e.en: The town preserved its {cemeterial} records.
e.zh: 小镇保存了墓地记录。

e.en: A quiet, {cemeterial} mood filled the scene.
e.zh: 现场弥漫着坟场般的寂静气氛。

e.en: The chart recorded severe {cephalalgia}.
e.zh: 病历记录了严重头痛。

e.en: Doctors use {cephalalgia} as a formal term for headache.
e.zh: 医生用 cephalalgia 作为头痛的正式术语。

e.en: The old medical note described persistent {celialgia}.
e.zh: 那份旧病历描述了持续性腹痛。

e.en: Severe {celialgia} can have many possible causes.
e.zh: 严重腹痛可能有许多不同原因。

e.en: The {centre-forward} scored twice in the first half.
e.zh: 那名中锋在上半场进了两球。

e.en: They signed a tall {centre-forward} for the new season.
e.zh: 他们为新赛季签下了一名高个中锋。

e.en: He {chain-smokes} whenever he feels nervous.
e.zh: 他一紧张就一根接一根地抽烟。

e.en: My aunt {chain-smokes} through long card games.
e.zh: 我姨妈打长时间牌局时会不停抽烟。

e.en: The police filed a {chargesheet} against the suspect.
e.zh: 警方对嫌疑人提交了起诉书。

e.en: Her name was missing from the final {chargesheet}.
e.zh: 最终的指控清单里没有她的名字。

e.en: The spider uses its {chelicerae} to grasp prey.
e.zh: 蜘蛛用螯肢抓住猎物。

e.en: Under the microscope, the {chelicerae} looked sharply curved.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，螯肢看起来弯曲而锋利。

e.en: Ancient writers called the region a {chersonese}.
e.zh: 古代作家把这一地区称为半岛。

e.en: The map showed a narrow {chersonese} reaching into the sea.
e.zh: 地图显示一条狭长半岛伸入海中。

e.en: The lab detected {chloronaphthalene} in the old coolant.
e.zh: 实验室在旧冷却剂中检测到氯萘。

e.en: Exposure to {chloronaphthalene} requires careful safety controls.
e.zh: 接触氯萘需要严格的安全控制。

e.en: The plant manufactures {chloropropene} for chemical synthesis.
e.zh: 这家工厂生产用于化学合成的氯丙烯。

e.en: A leak of {chloropropene} forced the workers outside.
e.zh: 氯丙烯泄漏迫使工人撤到室外。

e.en: The train was {chock-a-block} with commuters by eight.
e.zh: 到八点时，火车里挤满了通勤者。

e.en: Her calendar is {chock-a-block} until next Friday.
e.zh: 她的日程一直排满到下周五。

e.en: Researchers tested {cholanthrene} in a controlled laboratory study.
e.zh: 研究人员在受控实验室研究中测试了胆蒽。

e.en: The paper discussed {cholanthrene} as a carcinogenic compound.
e.zh: 论文把胆蒽作为一种致癌化合物来讨论。

e.en: He picked up the noodle with one {chop-stick}.
e.zh: 他用一根筷子夹起了那根面条。

e.en: A broken {chop-stick} lay beside the bowl.
e.zh: 碗旁边放着一根折断的筷子。

e.en: The patient reported {chromatopsia} after taking the medicine.
e.zh: 患者报告服药后出现色视症。

e.en: Doctors considered {chromatopsia} a clue to the diagnosis.
e.zh: 医生把色觉异常视为诊断线索。

e.en: The furnace lining used {chrome-magnesite} bricks.
e.zh: 炉衬使用了铬镁质耐火砖。

e.en: Engineers chose {chrome-magnesite} for its heat resistance.
e.zh: 工程师因其耐热性选择了铬镁质材料。

e.en: They decided to {chromium-plate} the steel handles.
e.zh: 他们决定给这些钢把手镀铬。

e.en: A {chromium-plate} finish protected the old bumper.
e.zh: 镀铬表面保护了旧保险杠。

e.en: The stain revealed {chromoplasmic} material near the nucleus.
e.zh: 染色显示细胞核附近有色质物质。

e.en: Her thesis examined {chromoplasmic} changes in damaged cells.
e.zh: 她的论文研究了受损细胞中的色质变化。

e.en: Several {chrysalides} hung from the underside of the leaf.
e.zh: 几只蝶蛹挂在叶子的背面。

e.en: The classroom kept {chrysalides} in a small glass case.
e.zh: 教室里把几只蛹放在小玻璃盒中。

e.en: Don't be such a {chucklehead} about it.
e.zh: 别在这件事上这么犯傻。

e.en: The old comic played a lovable {chucklehead}.
e.zh: 那位老喜剧演员演了一个讨人喜欢的傻瓜。

e.en: That was a {chuckleheaded} thing to say.
e.zh: 那句话说得真傻。

e.en: His {chuckleheaded} grin softened the mistake.
e.zh: 他那傻乎乎的笑容缓和了这个错误。

e.en: The stomach turns food into {chyme}.
e.zh: 胃会把食物变成食糜。

e.en: Doctors studied how {chyme} moved into the intestine.
e.zh: 医生研究食糜如何进入肠道。

e.en: The {cicadae} filled the trees with noise.
e.zh: 蝉鸣声响彻树林。

e.en: Several {cicadae} emerged after years underground.
e.zh: 几只蝉在地下多年后钻了出来。

cigarette-lighter.t: 香烟打火机；车载点烟器

e.en: He borrowed my {cigarette-lighter} outside the cafe.
e.zh: 他在咖啡馆外借了我的香烟打火机。

e.en: The phone charger fits the car's {cigarette-lighter}.
e.zh: 这个手机充电器可以插进车上的点烟器。

e.en: The robe was {cinctured} with a red cord.
e.zh: 那件长袍用一根红绳束着。

e.en: A {cinctured} pattern marked the snake's body.
e.zh: 蛇身上有一圈圈环带状花纹。

e.en: The dancer's slow {circumgyration} held the audience.
e.zh: 舞者缓慢的旋转吸引了观众。

e.en: The machine produced a steady {circumgyration}.
e.zh: 机器产生了稳定的绕圈运动。

e.en: The castle's {circumjacence} included farms and woods.
e.zh: 城堡周围区域包括农田和树林。

e.en: The report noted the site's {circumjacence} to wetlands.
e.zh: 报告提到该地点与湿地相邻。

e.en: The model planets {circumrotate} around the lamp.
e.zh: 模型行星围着灯转动。

e.en: Engineers watched the shaft {circumrotate} smoothly.
e.zh: 工程师看着轴平稳旋转。

e.en: The botanist described the capsule as {circumscissile}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这个蒴果描述为环裂的。

e.en: A {circumscissile} lid opened around the seed pod.
e.zh: 种荚周围裂开了一个环状盖。

e.en: The {circumvolving} wheel threw sparks into the dark.
e.zh: 旋转的轮子把火花甩进黑暗中。

e.en: She imagined moons {circumvolving} a distant planet.
e.zh: 她想象月球环绕着一颗遥远行星运行。

e.en: The scan showed a {cirrhotic} liver.
e.zh: 扫描显示肝脏已经硬化。

e.en: Alcohol can worsen {cirrhotic} damage over time.
e.zh: 酒精会随着时间加重肝硬化损伤。

e.en: Lemongrass oil contains a lot of {citral}.
e.zh: 香茅油含有大量柠檬醛。

e.en: The perfume used {citral} for a lemon note.
e.zh: 这款香水用柠檬醛来营造柠檬香调。

e.en: The museum displayed an ancient {clepsydra}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一座古代水钟。

e.en: A {clepsydra} measured time by dripping water.
e.zh: 漏壶通过滴水来计时。

e.en: The child was born with mild {clinodactyly}.
e.zh: 这个孩子出生时有轻度弯指畸形。

e.en: Doctors checked whether {clinodactyly} affected her grip.
e.zh: 医生检查弯指畸形是否影响她的握力。

e.en: Only a {clodpate} would ignore that warning.
e.zh: 只有蠢货才会无视那个警告。

e.en: The play's servant is a comic {clodpate}.
e.zh: 剧中的仆人是个滑稽的笨人。

e.en: The sauce had an unpleasant {clogginess}.
e.zh: 这种酱有一种令人不快的黏滞感。

e.en: She felt {clogginess} in her chest all morning.
e.zh: 她整个上午都觉得胸口有堵塞感。

e.en: The yacht sailed {close-hauled} into the bay.
e.zh: 游艇迎风抢航驶入海湾。

e.en: A {close-hauled} course kept the sails tight.
e.zh: 迎风抢航的航向让帆一直绷紧。

e.en: The aircraft climbed above the {cloud-top}.
e.zh: 飞机爬升到云层顶部之上。

e.en: Satellites measure {cloud-top} temperatures at night.
e.zh: 卫星在夜间测量云顶温度。

e.en: The two schools agreed to {co-operate}.
e.zh: 两所学校同意合作。

e.en: Please {co-operate} with the security staff.
e.zh: 请配合安保人员。

e.en: The vet treated the chicks for {coccidiosis}.
e.zh: 兽医给小鸡治疗球虫病。

e.en: Poor sanitation can spread {coccidiosis} quickly.
e.zh: 卫生条件差会让球虫病迅速传播。

cock-teaser.t: 挑逗男人却无意性交者

e.en: He cruelly called her a {cock-teaser}.
e.zh: 他刻薄地骂她是只挑逗男人却无意发生关系的人。

e.en: The insult {cock-teaser} is sexist and offensive.
e.zh: cock-teaser 这个侮辱语带有性别歧视且冒犯人。

e.en: The booking was a complete {cock-up}.
e.zh: 这次预订完全搞砸了。

e.en: They managed to {cock-up} a simple delivery.
e.zh: 他们竟然把一次简单送货搞砸了。

e.en: He sounded {cocksy} after one small win.
e.zh: 他才赢了一小场就显得很自负。

e.en: The foreman disliked the apprentice's {cocksy} tone.
e.zh: 工头不喜欢那个学徒神气活现的语气。

e.en: The sailors drank rough {cockyolly} at the dock.
e.zh: 水手们在码头喝着粗劣的杂酒。

e.en: He mixed a sweet {cockyolly} from leftover spirits.
e.zh: 他用剩下的烈酒调了一杯甜腻的鸡尾酒。

e.en: The witness was not legally {coercible} in this matter.
e.zh: 在这件事上，证人不能依法被强制作证。

e.en: Their consent was hardly {coercible} under the new rules.
e.zh: 按新规定，他们的同意几乎不能靠胁迫取得。

e.en: She removed the stage makeup with {cold-cream}.
e.zh: 她用冷霜卸掉了舞台妆。

e.en: A jar of {cold-cream} sat beside the mirror.
e.zh: 镜子旁放着一罐冷霜。

e.en: The lab studied {collisional} effects in hot plasma.
e.zh: 实验室研究了热等离子体中的碰撞效应。

e.en: The debate took a sharply {collisional} tone.
e.zh: 这场辩论带上了强烈的冲突语气。

e.en: The ministers were {colloguing} in a side room.
e.zh: 部长们正在侧室里私下密谈。

e.en: Neighbors accused them of {colloguing} with the enemy.
e.zh: 邻居指责他们与敌人暗中勾结商议。

e.en: The valley floor was covered with {colluvial} deposits.
e.zh: 谷底覆盖着坡积沉积物。

e.en: Farmers planted vines on the {colluvial} slope.
e.zh: 农民在这片崩积坡地上种下葡萄藤。

e.en: The {color-bearer} marched at the front of the regiment.
e.zh: 旗手走在团伍的最前面。

e.en: A young {color-bearer} carried the school flag proudly.
e.zh: 一名年轻旗手自豪地举着校旗。

e.en: Yellow {coltsfoot} appeared before the grass turned green.
e.zh: 草还没返青，黄色的款冬花就开了。

e.en: Herbalists once used {coltsfoot} in cough remedies.
e.zh: 草药师过去曾把款冬用于止咳方剂。

e.en: Older American texts call niobium {columbium}.
e.zh: 较早的美国文献把铌称为columbium。

e.en: The alloy contained a small amount of {columbium}.
e.zh: 这种合金含有少量铌。

e.en: The astronomer marked the equinoctial {colure} on the chart.
e.zh: 天文学家在星图上标出了春秋分经圈。

e.en: A {colure} helps define positions on the celestial sphere.
e.zh: 天球经圈有助于确定天球上的位置。

e.en: The stylist gave her hair a careful {comb-out}.
e.zh: 发型师仔细替她把头发梳开。

e.en: The army ordered a {comb-out} of unfit officers.
e.zh: 军方下令彻底清理不称职的军官。

e.en: The farmer noticed a rare {combless} rooster.
e.zh: 农夫注意到一只少见的无冠公鸡。

e.en: The {combless} helmet looked unusually smooth.
e.zh: 这顶没有梳状饰物的头盔显得格外光滑。

e.en: The preacher would {comminate} sinners from the pulpit.
e.zh: 那位传教士会在讲坛上严厉警告罪人。

e.en: Officials began to {comminate} anyone who broke the curfew.
e.zh: 官员开始威胁惩处违反宵禁的人。

e.en: The race {commissaire} checked each rider's number.
e.zh: 赛事裁判核对了每位骑手的号码。

e.en: A French {commissaire} supervised the local police district.
e.zh: 一名法国警务委员监督当地警区。

e.en: The surgeon examined the lip {commissure}.
e.zh: 外科医生检查了唇角的连合处。

e.en: Nerve fibers crossed through the anterior {commissure}.
e.zh: 神经纤维通过前连合交叉。

e.en: The seed was {comous}, with silky hairs at one end.
e.zh: 这粒种子带有冠毛，一端有丝状细毛。

e.en: A {comous} tuft crowned the small wildflower.
e.zh: 一簇冠毛长在这朵小野花顶端。

e.en: The engineer recommended {complanation} of the uneven surface.
e.zh: 工程师建议把不平的表面整平。

e.en: Long erosion caused the {complanation} of the plateau.
e.zh: 长期侵蚀造成了高原表面的平坦化。

e.en: My grandfather is nearly {computer-illiterate}.
e.zh: 我祖父几乎不懂电脑。

e.en: The form confused many {computer-illiterate} applicants.
e.zh: 这张表格让许多不懂电脑的申请者感到困惑。

e.en: They remained {comrades-in-arms} long after the war.
e.zh: 战争结束很久后，他们仍是战友。

e.en: The activists saw themselves as {comrades-in-arms}.
e.zh: 这些活动人士把彼此看作并肩作战的伙伴。

e.en: The instrument used a {concavo-concave} lens.
e.zh: 这台仪器使用了一片双凹透镜。

e.en: A {concavo-concave} form bends inward on both sides.
e.zh: 双凹形状的两面都向内弯曲。

e.en: Meditation can build a {concentrative} state of mind.
e.zh: 冥想能培养一种专注的心境。

e.en: The process has a {concentrative} effect on dissolved minerals.
e.zh: 这个过程会使溶解矿物产生浓缩效应。

e.en: The old radio used a paper {condensator}.
e.zh: 这台旧收音机使用纸质电容器。

e.en: Steam passed through the laboratory {condensator}.
e.zh: 蒸汽通过实验室的冷凝器。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed several {condylomata} during the exam.
e.zh: 医生在检查中诊断出几处疣状赘生物。

e.en: Untreated {condylomata} may spread to nearby tissue.
e.zh: 未经治疗的尖锐湿疣可能扩散到邻近组织。

e.en: The senator was known as a {confrontationist}.
e.zh: 这位参议员以主张对抗著称。

e.en: Her {confrontationist} style worried the negotiating team.
e.zh: 她的对抗式作风让谈判团队感到担忧。

e.en: The {congealment} of fat made the soup cloudy.
e.zh: 脂肪凝固使汤变得浑浊。

e.en: Fear produced a strange {congealment} of silence in the room.
e.zh: 恐惧让房间里凝成一种奇异的沉默。

e.en: The old guide classified the finch as a {coniroster}.
e.zh: 旧版指南把这种雀鸟归为锥嘴鸟。

e.en: A {coniroster} has a strong cone-shaped beak.
e.zh: 锥嘴鸟有坚硬的锥形鸟喙。

e.en: The two families were {consanguineously} connected for generations.
e.zh: 这两个家族几代以来都有血缘上的联系。

e.en: The inheritance rules treated {consanguineously} related heirs differently.
e.zh: 继承规则对有血缘关系的继承人另作处理。

e.en: The committee was {consentient} on the need for reform.
e.zh: 委员会在改革的必要性上意见一致。

e.en: Their {consentient} response made the decision easier.
e.zh: 他们一致的回应让这个决定更容易作出。

e.en: The merchant arranged the {consignation} of wine to London.
e.zh: 商人安排把葡萄酒托运到伦敦。

e.en: The goods remained in {consignation} until payment arrived.
e.zh: 货物在付款到账前仍处于寄售保管状态。

e.en: The sensor used {constantan} wire for stable resistance.
e.zh: 这个传感器使用康铜线来保持稳定电阻。

e.en: Engineers chose {constantan} for the thermocouple circuit.
e.zh: 工程师为热电偶电路选择了康铜。

e.en: A hard fall often {contuses} the skin without cutting it.
e.zh: 重重摔倒常会造成皮肤挫伤，但不一定破皮。

e.en: The impact {contuses} the muscle and causes swelling.
e.zh: 撞击会挫伤肌肉并引起肿胀。

e.en: The garden had several {convolvulaceous} vines climbing the fence.
e.zh: 花园里有几株旋花科藤蔓爬上了篱笆。

e.en: Botanists identified the plant by its {convolvulaceous} flowers.
e.zh: 植物学家根据它像旋花的花朵认出了这种植物。

e.en: The contract includes a seven-day {cooling-off} period.
e.zh: 这份合同包含七天的冷静期。

e.en: Both sides agreed to a {cooling-off} meeting after the dispute.
e.zh: 争执后双方同意召开一次缓和气氛的会议。

e.en: The textbook mentioned {coprophilia} in a clinical chapter.
e.zh: 这本教材在临床章节中提到了粪便恋。

e.en: Doctors discussed {coprophilia} as a rare sexual paraphilia.
e.zh: 医生把嗜粪癖作为一种罕见的性偏好障碍来讨论。

e.en: The child practiced letters in a {copy-book}.
e.zh: 孩子在抄写本里练习写字母。

e.en: Her handwriting looked like a line from a {copy-book}.
e.zh: 她的笔迹像字帖上的一行字一样工整。

e.en: The village {corn-chandler} sold oats and barley.
e.zh: 村里的谷物商出售燕麦和大麦。

e.en: A {corn-chandler} once supplied feed to nearby farms.
e.zh: 从前有位粮食零售商给附近农场供应饲料。

e.en: A red {cornel} grew beside the old wall.
e.zh: 老墙旁长着一棵红果山茱萸。

e.en: She made a tart jam from ripe {cornel}.
e.zh: 她用成熟的山茱萸果做了酸甜的果酱。

e.en: The two gears {corotate} when the clutch engages.
e.zh: 离合器接合时，这两个齿轮会共同旋转。

e.en: Dust particles can {corotate} with the magnetic field.
e.zh: 尘埃颗粒可能随磁场同向旋转。

e.en: The old theory described light as {corpusculous}.
e.zh: 旧理论把光描述成由微粒构成。

e.en: Under the lens, the fluid looked {corpusculous} and uneven.
e.zh: 在镜头下，这种液体看起来呈微粒状且不均匀。

coseismic.t: 同震的；地震同时发生的

e.en: Researchers mapped the {coseismic} ground displacement.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制了同震地表位移图。

e.en: The fault showed {coseismic} movement during the earthquake.
e.zh: 地震期间这条断层出现了同震运动。

cotquean.t: 爱管家务的男人；没男子气的人

e.en: The satire mocked him as a fussy {cotquean}.
e.zh: 那篇讽刺文章把他嘲成一个爱管家务又挑剔的男人。

e.en: In old comedy, a {cotquean} often became the joke.
e.zh: 在旧喜剧里，没男子气的男人常成了笑柄。

e.en: She wore a {cotton-padded} coat in winter.
e.zh: 冬天她穿了一件棉絮填充的外套。

e.en: The package was {cotton-padded} to protect the glass.
e.zh: 包裹里垫了棉花来保护玻璃制品。

cottonpicking.t: 该死的；烦人的；摘棉花的

e.en: Get your {cottonpicking} hands off my tools.
e.zh: 把你那该死的手从我的工具上拿开。

e.en: The film showed long {cottonpicking} days in the fields.
e.zh: 电影展现了在田里漫长摘棉花的日子。

e.en: Her statement triggered a sharp {counter-accusation}.
e.zh: 她的声明引发了尖锐的反指控。

e.en: The debate became a chain of accusation and {counter-accusation}.
e.zh: 辩论变成了一连串指控与反指控。

e.en: The company {counter-claimed} for breach of contract.
e.zh: 该公司就违约提出了反诉。

e.en: He denied the debt and {counter-claimed} damages.
e.zh: 他否认债务，并反过来要求赔偿损失。

e.en: The army launched a {counter-offensive} at dawn.
e.zh: 军队在黎明发动了反攻。

e.en: The candidate began a media {counter-offensive} after the scandal.
e.zh: 丑闻发生后，这名候选人开始在媒体上反击。

e.en: The union submitted two {counter-proposals} overnight.
e.zh: 工会连夜提交了两项反建议。

e.en: Negotiators compared the offer with several {counter-proposals}.
e.zh: 谈判代表把报价同几份对案进行了比较。

counter-subjects.t: 对题；复调中的对位主题

e.en: The fugue introduces two {counter-subjects} after the main theme.
e.zh: 这首赋格在主主题之后引入了两个对题。

e.en: Students analyzed how the {counter-subjects} interact in the passage.
e.zh: 学生分析了这一段中各个对位主题如何相互作用。

e.en: The city became a cultural {counterpole} to the capital.
e.zh: 这座城市成了首都的文化对立中心。

e.en: His calm served as a {counterpole} to her anger.
e.zh: 他的冷静与她的愤怒形成了相反的一极。

e.en: The {countersubject} returns beneath the soprano line.
e.zh: 对题在女高音声部下方再次出现。

e.en: Bach shapes the {countersubject} to fit the main subject.
e.zh: 巴赫塑造这个副主题，使其配合主主题。

e.en: The mayor praised her {countrypeople} for their patience.
e.zh: 市长称赞她的同乡人很有耐心。

e.en: He felt more at ease among simple {countrypeople}.
e.zh: 他在朴实的乡下人中间更自在。

e.en: The molecule's {covalency} affects its stability.
e.zh: 这个分子的共价性会影响它的稳定性。

e.en: Chemists measured the {covalency} of the bond.
e.zh: 化学家测量了该化学键的共价程度。

e.en: The engineer checked the board for safe {creepage}.
e.zh: 工程师检查电路板的安全漏电爬距。

e.en: Slow {creepage} of the soil damaged the wall.
e.zh: 土壤的缓慢移动损坏了那面墙。

e.en: The old tower still shows medieval {crenelation}.
e.zh: 那座古塔仍能看到中世纪的城垛结构。

e.en: The designer added {crenelation} along the metal edge.
e.zh: 设计师在金属边缘加了锯齿状装饰。

e.en: The surgeon located the {cricothyroid} membrane quickly.
e.zh: 外科医生很快找到了环甲膜。

e.en: A tense {cricothyroid} muscle can affect pitch.
e.zh: 环甲肌紧张会影响音高。

e.en: The lawyer began to {cross-examine} the witness.
e.zh: 律师开始盘问那名证人。

e.en: Reporters tried to {cross-examine} the minister after the speech.
e.zh: 演讲后，记者们试图追问那位部长。

e.en: The detective continued to {cross-question} the suspect.
e.zh: 侦探继续反复盘问嫌疑人。

e.en: Please don't {cross-question} every guest at dinner.
e.zh: 请别在晚餐时对每位客人都追问不停。

e.en: The merger exposed complex {cross-shareholdings} between the firms.
e.zh: 这次合并暴露出两家公司之间复杂的交叉持股。

e.en: Regulators worry that {cross-shareholdings} can weaken competition.
e.zh: 监管者担心交叉持股会削弱竞争。

e.en: She learned {cross-stitch} from her grandmother.
e.zh: 她跟祖母学会了十字绣。

e.en: The initials were worked in red {cross-stitch}.
e.zh: 那些姓名首字母是用红色十字针法绣成的。

e.en: Their careful {crossruffs} won the bridge hand.
e.zh: 他们谨慎的交叉将吃赢下了这副桥牌。

e.en: The lesson explained when {crossruffs} are risky.
e.zh: 这节课讲解了交叉将吃在什么情况下有风险。

e.en: Workers replaced a cracked {crosstie} near the station.
e.zh: 工人更换了车站附近一根开裂的铁路枕木。

e.en: A steel {crosstie} helped brace the frame.
e.zh: 一根钢制横向系材帮助加固了框架。

e.en: We took a {crosstown} bus to the museum.
e.zh: 我们坐穿城公交去了博物馆。

e.en: Her office is {crosstown}, near the river.
e.zh: 她的办公室在城另一头，靠近河边。

e.en: We followed a narrow {crosstrail} through the woods.
e.zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的横穿小径穿过树林。

e.en: The map marks each {crosstrail} with a blue line.
e.zh: 地图用蓝线标出每条交叉路径。

e.en: A sailor climbed to the {crosstrees} before dawn.
e.zh: 一名水手在黎明前爬上了桅顶横木。

e.en: The old ship's {crosstrees} were repaired in port.
e.zh: 那艘老船的桅顶横木在港口得到了修理。

e.en: The model estimates {crossvariance} between the two signals.
e.zh: 该模型估计两个信号之间的交叉方差。

e.en: High {crossvariance} suggested the variables moved together.
e.zh: 较高的互方差表明这些变量会同步变化。

e.en: The insect wing has a dark {crossvein}.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的翅膀上有一条深色横脉。

e.en: A tiny {crossvein} connects the larger leaf veins.
e.zh: 一条细小的交叉叶脉连接着较大的叶脉。

e.en: The crew lowered the {crossyard} during the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中，船员放下了横桁。

e.en: A broken {crossyard} left the sail hanging loose.
e.zh: 断裂的帆船横杆让船帆松垂下来。

e.en: The percussionist struck the {crotales} with a mallet.
e.zh: 打击乐手用槌敲响了小型定音钹。

e.en: Ancient {crotales} produced a bright metallic sound.
e.zh: 古钹能发出明亮的金属声。

e.en: The doctor treated a {crotaline} snakebite.
e.zh: 医生处理了一起蝮蛇类毒蛇咬伤。

e.en: Researchers studied {crotaline} venom in the laboratory.
e.zh: 研究人员在实验室研究响尾蛇类毒液。

e.en: The paper described how {crotalotoxin} affects nerves.
e.zh: 论文描述了响尾蛇毒素如何影响神经。

e.en: Scientists purified {crotalotoxin} from the venom sample.
e.zh: 科学家从毒液样本中纯化出响尾蛇毒素。

crotcheteer.t: 怪想法多的人；固执怪人

e.en: The old {crotcheteer} rejected every modern convenience.
e.zh: 那个固执怪人拒绝一切现代便利。

e.en: A cheerful {crotcheteer} can still be difficult in meetings.
e.zh: 一个爱发怪论的人即使性格开朗，开会时也可能很难相处。

e.en: His {crotchetiness} made teamwork unusually hard.
e.zh: 他的乖僻让团队合作变得格外困难。

e.en: Age had not softened her charming {crotchetiness}.
e.zh: 岁月并没有削弱她那种有点可爱的怪脾气。

e.en: The costume included {crotchless} leggings for dancers.
e.zh: 这套服装包括给舞者穿的无裆紧身裤。

e.en: The shop sold novelty {crotchless} underwear.
e.zh: 那家店出售新奇的开裆内衣。

e.en: The toxicologist tested the sample for {crotin}.
e.zh: 毒理学家检测样本中是否含有巴豆毒蛋白。

e.en: Exposure to {crotin} can damage cells.
e.zh: 接触巴豆毒蛋白可能会损伤细胞。

e.en: The factory monitors airborne {crotonaldehyde} levels.
e.zh: 工厂会监测空气中的巴豆醛浓度。

e.en: Chemists used {crotonaldehyde} in the synthesis.
e.zh: 化学家在这次合成中使用了巴豆醛。

e.en: The chemist synthesized {crotonamide} for the reaction study.
e.zh: 化学家合成了巴豆酰胺用于反应研究。

e.en: Pure {crotonamide} should be handled in a ventilated hood.
e.zh: 纯巴豆酰胺应在通风橱中处理。

e.en: The sample contained sodium {crotonate} after neutralization.
e.zh: 中和后样品中含有巴豆酸钠。

e.en: Methyl {crotonate} has a sharp, fruity odor.
e.zh: 巴豆酸甲酯有一种刺鼻的果香。

e.en: The farmer found a {crotonbug} on the young plant.
e.zh: 农民在幼苗上发现了一只巴豆臭虫。

e.en: A {crotonbug} can damage tender leaves in warm weather.
e.zh: 天气暖和时，巴豆臭虫会损害嫩叶。

e.en: The molecule includes a reactive {crotonyl} group.
e.zh: 这个分子含有一个活泼的巴豆酰基。

e.en: Researchers measured {crotonyl} modifications on several proteins.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了几种蛋白质上的巴豆酰基修饰。

e.en: Scientists isolated {crotoxin} from rattlesnake venom.
e.zh: 科学家从响尾蛇毒液中分离出巴西响尾蛇毒素。

e.en: High doses of {crotoxin} can affect the nervous system.
e.zh: 高剂量的巴西响尾蛇毒素会影响神经系统。

e.en: The reagent transferred a {crotyl} group to the aldehyde.
e.zh: 该试剂把巴豆基转移到了醛上。

e.en: A {crotyl} alcohol derivative appeared in the final mixture.
e.zh: 最终混合物中出现了一种巴豆醇衍生物。

e.en: The trained horse performed a {croupade} in the arena.
e.zh: 受训的马在场地里做了一个后腿跃起动作。

e.en: A clean {croupade} requires strength and precise timing.
e.zh: 漂亮的马后腿跃起动作需要力量和精准时机。

e.en: The rider checked the horse's {croupe} for soreness.
e.zh: 骑手检查了马臀是否酸痛。

e.en: The tailor adjusted the coat around the {croupe}.
e.zh: 裁缝调整了外套臀部周围的部分。

e.en: The doctor noted {croupous} inflammation in the report.
e.zh: 医生在报告中记录了格鲁布性炎症。

e.en: Older texts describe {croupous} pneumonia in great detail.
e.zh: 旧医学文献对格鲁布性肺炎有详细描述。

e.en: The child had a {croupy} cough all night.
e.zh: 那个孩子整晚都咳得像哮吼一样。

e.en: Her breathing sounded {croupy} after the cold worsened.
e.zh: 感冒加重后，她的呼吸听起来粗哑像哮吼。

e.en: A fine {crow's-foot} appeared beside her eye.
e.zh: 她眼角旁出现了一条细细的鱼尾纹。

e.en: The surveyor marked the stone with a {crow's-foot}.
e.zh: 测量员在石头上做了一个乌鸦脚形记号。

e.en: The old horse looked like {crowbait} after the winter.
e.zh: 过完冬天，那匹老马瘦弱得像快没用了。

e.en: He called the broken truck {crowbait} and sold it cheap.
e.zh: 他把那辆坏卡车称作废物，低价卖掉了。

e.en: They picked {crowberry} on the windswept hillside.
e.zh: 他们在风大的山坡上采摘岩高兰浆果。

e.en: The jam had a dark color from {crowberry}.
e.zh: 这种果酱因岩高兰浆果而呈深色。

e.en: He opened the crate with a heavy {crowbill}.
e.zh: 他用一根沉重的撬棍打开了板条箱。

e.en: The smith shaped the iron into a {crowbill}.
e.zh: 铁匠把铁打造成钩嘴工具。

crowd-pleaser.t: 讨观众喜欢的人或节目

e.en: The final song was a real {crowd-pleaser}.
e.zh: 最后一首歌确实很讨观众喜欢。

e.en: Chocolate cake is always a {crowd-pleaser} at parties.
e.zh: 巧克力蛋糕在聚会上总是很受大家欢迎。

crowd-pleasing.t: 讨观众喜欢的；迎合大众的

e.en: The band played a {crowd-pleasing} set of old hits.
e.zh: 乐队演奏了一组很讨观众喜欢的老热门歌曲。

e.en: His speech used {crowd-pleasing} jokes before the serious points.
e.zh: 他的演讲先用了迎合大众的笑话，再谈严肃要点。

e.en: The new exhibition became a major {crowd-puller}.
e.zh: 这个新展览成了吸引大批观众的亮点。

e.en: A local singer proved the festival's biggest {crowd-puller}.
e.zh: 一位本地歌手成了音乐节最能吸引人潮的节目。

e.en: Security moved the {crowders} away from the doorway.
e.zh: 安保人员把挤在门口的人群移开。

e.en: The loud {crowders} made it hard to hear the speaker.
e.zh: 喧闹的围拢人群让人很难听清演讲者。

e.en: She spread {crowdie} on warm oatcakes.
e.zh: 她把苏格兰软奶酪抹在热燕麦饼上。

e.en: Fresh {crowdie} tastes mild and slightly tangy.
e.zh: 新鲜的苏格兰软奶酪味道温和，略带酸味。

e.en: The family ate warm {crowdy} before work.
e.zh: 一家人在上工前吃了热燕麦粥。

e.en: The shop sold a small tub of {crowdy}.
e.zh: 这家店卖一小盒苏格兰软奶酪。

e.en: Sunlight made the {crowfeet} around his eyes clearer.
e.zh: 阳光让他眼周的鱼尾纹更明显了。

e.en: The diagram used {crowfeet} to show the relationship.
e.zh: 图表用叉状线表示这种关系。

e.en: A yellow {crowflower} grew beside the stream.
e.zh: 溪边长着一朵黄色的毛茛花。

e.en: The old herbal lists {crowflower} among spring plants.
e.zh: 那本旧草药书把毛茛花列为春季植物。

e.en: The meadow was dotted with yellow {crowfoot}.
e.zh: 草地上点缀着黄色的毛茛。

e.en: The machinist used a {crowfoot} wrench in the tight space.
e.zh: 机械师在狭小空间里用了开口套筒扳手。

e.en: The farmer hired a {crowkeeper} for the barley field.
e.zh: 农夫雇了一个人看守大麦田以防乌鸦。

e.en: A lonely {crowkeeper} watched the fields at dawn.
e.zh: 清晨，一个孤独的看田人守望着田地防乌鸦。

crown-court.t: 刑事法庭；王座法院分院

e.en: The robbery case went to {crown-court} last month.
e.zh: 这起抢劫案上个月提交到刑事法庭审理。

e.en: He appealed the ruling in {crown-court}.
e.zh: 他在王座法院分院对该裁决提出上诉。

e.en: The painting shows Christ wearing a {crown-of-thorns}.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了基督戴着荆棘冠。

e.en: A red {crown-of-thorns} grew beside the gate.
e.zh: 门边长着一株红色的麒麟花。

e.en: The old seal bears a tiny {crownet} above the shield.
e.zh: 那枚旧印章的盾徽上方有一个小冠。

e.en: She wore a silver {crownet} in the ceremony.
e.zh: 她在仪式上戴了一顶银色的小冠饰。

e.en: The forest was once managed as {crownland}.
e.zh: 这片森林曾作为王室土地管理。

e.en: Settlers could not build homes on protected {crownland}.
e.zh: 定居者不能在受保护的公有土地上建房。

e.en: He found an old {crownpiece} in the drawer.
e.zh: 他在抽屉里发现了一枚旧克朗银币。

e.en: The helmet's {crownpiece} was decorated with gold.
e.zh: 头盔的头顶装饰片镶着金饰。

e.en: Each {crowstep} on the gable was edged with slate.
e.zh: 山墙上的每级阶梯都镶着石板边。

e.en: The mason repaired a broken {crowstep} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨后，石匠修好了一个破损的阶梯形山墙台阶。

e.en: The village church has a {crowstepped} gable.
e.zh: 村里的教堂有一面阶梯形山墙。

e.en: We photographed the {crowstepped} roofs at sunset.
e.zh: 我们在日落时拍下那些阶梯形屋顶。

e.en: Yellow {crowtoe} covered the damp meadow in spring.
e.zh: 春天，潮湿的草地上开满了黄色毛茛。

e.en: The herbal note called the plant {crowtoe}.
e.zh: 那本草药笔记把这种植物称作鸦趾草。

e.en: The cooper cut a clean {croze} for the barrel head.
e.zh: 箍桶匠为桶盖切出一道整齐的内槽。

e.en: He sharpened the {croze} before shaping the cask.
e.zh: 他在制作木桶前把开槽工具磨利。

e.en: The doctor infused a {crystalloid} solution during surgery.
e.zh: 医生在手术中输注了晶体液。

e.en: The mineral had a {crystalloid} structure under the lens.
e.zh: 显微镜下，这种矿物呈类晶体结构。

e.en: He struck the {cue-ball} too hard and missed.
e.zh: 他把台球母球击得太重，结果没打中。

e.en: The {cue-ball} stopped behind the eight ball.
e.zh: 白球停在八号球后面。

e.en: Thin {cumulocirrus} drifted across the afternoon sky.
e.zh: 薄薄的积卷云飘过午后的天空。

e.en: The weather chart marked a band of {cumulocirrus}.
e.zh: 天气图上标出了一带高空积云状云。

e.en: She heated the {curling-tongs} before styling her hair.
e.zh: 她在做发型前先把卷发钳加热。

e.en: Old {curling-tongs} lay beside the dressing mirror.
e.zh: 梳妆镜旁放着一把旧烫发夹。

e.en: The cheerful {curly-pate} waved from the doorway.
e.zh: 那个开朗的卷发人从门口挥手。

e.en: Grandma called him her little {curly-pate}.
e.zh: 奶奶叫他自己的小卷发脑袋。

e.en: The company announced a {cut-back} in travel spending.
e.zh: 公司宣布削减差旅开支。

e.en: The film uses a sudden {cut-back} to show her childhood.
e.zh: 影片用一个突然的回切镜头展现她的童年。

e.en: We found a {cut-through} behind the station.
e.zh: 我们在车站后面找到了一条捷径。

e.en: The new road creates a {cut-through} to the harbor.
e.zh: 这条新路形成了一条通往港口的贯穿通道。

e.en: Farmers once used {cyanamide} as a nitrogen fertilizer.
e.zh: 农民曾把氰胺用作氮肥。

e.en: The lab stored {cyanamide} in a sealed container.
e.zh: 实验室把氨基氰存放在密封容器中。

e.en: The chemist measured {cyanate} levels in the sample.
e.zh: 化学家测量了样品中的氰酸盐含量。

e.en: A {cyanate} resin can withstand high temperatures.
e.zh: 氰酸酯树脂能承受高温。

e.en: The reaction produced a stable {cyanohydrin}.
e.zh: 该反应生成了一种稳定的氰醇。

e.en: Students learned how a {cyanohydrin} forms from an aldehyde.
e.zh: 学生们学习了羟基腈如何由醛形成。

e.en: A point on the wheel traces a {cycloid}.
e.zh: 车轮上的一个点会描出一条摆线。

e.en: The bridge arch was designed as a {cycloid}.
e.zh: 这座桥拱被设计成圆滚线形。

e.en: His old bicycle still had a working {cyclometer}.
e.zh: 他的旧自行车上仍有一个能用的里程计。

e.en: The engineer used a {cyclometer} to check the curve.
e.zh: 工程师用测圆仪检查那条曲线。

e.en: The {cyclopedist} revised several entries on astronomy.
e.zh: 那位百科全书编纂者修订了几条天文学词条。

e.en: As a careful {cyclopedist}, she checked every citation.
e.zh: 作为严谨的百科全书编纂者，她核对了每一条引文。

cytochondria.t: 细胞线粒体；旧称线粒体

e.en: Early papers sometimes called mitochondria {cytochondria}.
e.zh: 早期论文有时把线粒体称为细胞线粒体。

e.en: The stain made the {cytochondria} visible under the microscope.
e.zh: 染色使旧称线粒体的结构在显微镜下可见。

e.en: Food particles pass through the {cytopharynx} of the protozoan.
e.zh: 食物颗粒会通过这种原生动物的胞咽。

e.en: The diagram labels the {cytopharynx} near the oral groove.
e.zh: 图中在口沟附近标出了细胞咽部。

e.en: Researchers tested the drug's {cytotoxicity} on tumor cells.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了这种药物对肿瘤细胞的细胞毒性。

e.en: High {cytotoxicity} limited the compound's medical use.
e.zh: 较高的细胞毒性限制了该化合物的医学用途。

e.en: The bacteria released a {cytotoxin} that damaged nearby tissue.
e.zh: 这种细菌释放出一种细胞毒素，损伤了附近组织。

e.en: Researchers measured the {cytotoxin} level in the sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了样本中的细胞毒素水平。

e.en: The {cytotrophoblast} helps form early placental tissue.
e.zh: 细胞滋养层细胞有助于形成早期胎盘组织。

e.en: Doctors examined the {cytotrophoblast} under a microscope.
e.zh: 医生在显微镜下检查了细胞滋养层细胞。

e.en: The paper discussed {cytotrophy} in developing embryos.
e.zh: 这篇论文讨论了发育中胚胎的细胞营养作用。

e.en: Abnormal {cytotrophy} may affect tissue growth.
e.zh: 异常的细胞营养作用可能影响组织生长。

e.en: The virus showed a {cytotropic} preference for nerve cells.
e.zh: 这种病毒表现出对神经细胞的趋细胞偏好。

e.en: A {cytotropic} antibody can bind closely to cell surfaces.
e.zh: 亲细胞抗体可以紧密结合在细胞表面。

e.en: Scientists studied the virus's {cytotropism} in lung tissue.
e.zh: 科学家研究了这种病毒在肺组织中的亲细胞性。

e.en: Changes in {cytotropism} can alter disease severity.
e.zh: 趋细胞性的变化可能改变疾病的严重程度。

cytovirin.t: 抗病毒蛋白细胞病毒素

e.en: The team tested {cytovirin} against several viral strains.
e.zh: 团队测试了细胞病毒素对几种病毒株的作用。

e.en: Synthetic {cytovirin} may block viral entry into cells.
e.zh: 合成的细胞病毒素可能阻止病毒进入细胞。

e.en: The parasite has a {cytozoic} stage inside blood cells.
e.zh: 这种寄生虫有一个寄生在血细胞内的阶段。

e.en: A {cytozoic} organism lives within another cell.
e.zh: 细胞内寄生生物生活在另一个细胞内部。

e.en: The old article used {cytozyme} for a cell enzyme.
e.zh: 那篇旧文章用细胞酶一词指细胞中的酶。

e.en: A damaged {cytozyme} can disrupt normal metabolism.
e.zh: 受损的细胞酶会扰乱正常代谢。

e.en: The lab report noted mild {cyturia} after infection.
e.zh: 化验报告指出感染后有轻度尿中有细胞。

e.en: Persistent {cyturia} may require further examination.
e.zh: 持续的尿中有细胞可能需要进一步检查。

e.en: The violinist ended the concert with a lively {czardas}.
e.zh: 小提琴手以一首欢快的恰尔达什舞曲结束了音乐会。

e.en: They danced a traditional {czardas} at the festival.
e.zh: 他们在节日上跳了一支传统的恰尔达什舞。

e.en: The novel is set during the last years of {czardom}.
e.zh: 这部小说以沙皇统治的最后几年为背景。

e.en: Critics described the agency as a private {czardom}.
e.zh: 批评者把这个机构形容成一个私人的沙皇领地。

e.en: The young {czarevitch} appeared at the winter ceremony.
e.zh: 年轻的沙皇太子出席了冬季仪式。

e.en: Rumors about the {czarevitch} spread through the court.
e.zh: 关于沙皇太子的传闻在宫廷中流传开来。

e.en: The {czarevna} was educated by foreign tutors.
e.zh: 这位沙皇之女由外国家庭教师教育。

e.en: A portrait of the {czarevna} hung in the palace hall.
e.zh: 沙皇公主的画像挂在宫殿大厅里。

e.en: The revolutionaries opposed {czarism} and demanded reforms.
e.zh: 革命者反对沙皇制度，并要求改革。

e.en: His management style was criticized as modern {czarism}.
e.zh: 他的管理方式被批评为现代式的专制统治。

e.en: The {czaritza} received diplomats in the grand hall.
e.zh: 沙皇皇后在大厅接见了外交官。

e.en: Legends portray the {czaritza} as both powerful and lonely.
e.zh: 传说把这位女沙皇描绘得既强大又孤独。
